title: Bukeoguk (Dried Pollock Soup)
description: A quick and easy Korean soup made with dried pollock (or pollack) - bukeo!

ingredients.name: dried pollock (bukeo/hwangtae strips - 1 cup packed after being soaked and squeezed)
medium potato (or equal amount of Korean radish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and soak the dried pollock strips in warm water until softened, about 20 minutes. Drain, reserving the soaking water. Lightly squeeze out the water, and tear the strips into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the potato in half lengthwise, and slice into half-moon shapes. Cut tofu into 1/2-inch thick bite size pieces. Cut the scallions into 1-inch lengths.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a heated medium pot, sauté the pollock in the sesame oil (about 2 to 3 minutes) over medium high heat. Lightly season with salt. (If using Korean radish, sauté it with the pollock.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add 6 cups of water, including the water used to soak the pollock, and soy sauce to the pot. Bring it to a boil, covered, and continue to boil for 7 to 8 minutes. Add the potatoes, tofu, and garlic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook until potatoes are cooked, about 5 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Reduce the heat to medium low, drop the scallions in, and gently drizzle the beaten egg over the boiling soup right before turning the heat off.

title: Hong Kong Mango Pancake (Dim Sum Dessert Recipe)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 2-3 Tbsp sugar (if mango isn’t very sweet use more)
A few drops yellow food colouring (optional)
Lime or lemon juice as needed

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the crepes, mixing bowl method:

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the crepes, blender method:

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prep the mango:

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For the mango sauce:

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cooking the crepes:

title: Chili Garlic Roasted Broccoli
description: Ready in only 15 minutes, this Roasted Broccoli is tossed in a chili garlic sauce and topped with Parmesan cheese for a healthy and delicious veggie side dish!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 475°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add broccoli, olive oil, chili garlic sauce, salt and lime juice. Toss together to fully coat the broccoli.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer to a baking sheet and sprinkle with shredded Parmesan cheese. Bake for 10-15 minutes, flipping the broccoli over halfway through cooking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from oven, top with more Parmesan and red chili flakes if desired and serve.

title: Za'atar Garlic Salmon Recipe
description: Check out this easy, flavor-packed za'atar garlic salmon! It is a MUST-try!

ingredients.name: grape tomatoes (about 10 oz), halved if you like
Za’atar spice, divided, plus more for later

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the potatoes, grape tomatoes, and broccoli. Pour 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and toss. Then, add a little salt and pepper, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tsp za’atar spice, 1/2 tsp coriander. Toss again so that the spices are distributed to coat the vegetables. Transfer the vegetables to a large baking sheet with a rim.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat salmon dry. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle just a little extra virgin olive oil. Spread the remaining garlic evenly on top. Sprinkle the remaining za’atar and coriander.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut seasoned salmon into 4 equal pieces, and place on the prepared baking sheet with the vegetables. Add another generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil over the salmon and veggies, if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in heated oven for 15-16 minutes. Remove from heat and squeeze lemon juice on salmon. Sprinkle more za’atar all over. Enjoy with Lebanese rice and a side of your favorite salad. (See suggestions for more sides in the post above under “what to serve with za’atar garlic salmon).

title: Phyllo-dough Rolls with Feta Cheese and Peppers Recipe
description: Discover this amazing phyllo and feta cheese rolls recipe, perfect as an appetiser or side dish for a hearty family meal! And remember, make a few extra! Your loved ones will be coming back for more!

ingredients.name: graviera or kefalotyri, or any hard yellow cheese (3.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Crush the feta cheese with your hands, into a large bowl and add the grated cheese, the chopped pepper, the egg, the mayonnaise, the oregano and the fresh dill . Mix well with a spoon to combine the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat the oven at 180C and start preparing the rolls.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spread one sheet of the phyllo dough on the kitchen counter and with a cooking brush drizzle with some melted butter. Spread one more sheet on top and drizzle with some more butter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the sheets into three lanes. At the end of each lane add one tablespoon of the filling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Wrap each lane into rolls, by folding the edges inwards.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Repeat the same procedure with the rest of the phyllo sheets and filling.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Oil the bottom of a large baking tray, place the rolls and butter them with some melted butter on top. Bake in preheated oven at 180C for 30-35 minutes, until golden and crispy. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: You can make as many rolls as you like and store them in the freezer (before baking them).

title: Easy Deviled Eggs Recipe
description: Easy Deviled Eggs recipe that is simple to make, budget-friendly and so filling with mayonnaise, mustard, sweet pickle relish and Creole seasoning for a kick of heat.

ingredients.name: ½-1 teaspoon Creole seasoning (, adjust to taste)
½-1 teaspoon hot sauce (, adjust to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with cold water , then bring to a rolling boil.Once the water is boiling, cover the pot and remove from heat. Do not lift lid once covered until it is time to remove the eggs. Let it sit for about 10- 12 minutes. Remove one and do a test to be on the safe side.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the egg yolks and place in a medium mixing bowl. Add mayonnaise, creole seasoning, hot sauce , salt sweet pickle relish, mustard and pepper. Whisk ingredients until creamy and smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spoon egg yolk mixture into small resealable plastic bag. Cut small corner from bottom of bag; use to pipe filling into egg white halves.

title: Homemade Scallion Oil
description: Homemade scallion oil is a secret weapon to cook dinner with less prep and to add extra flavor to your dish. {vegan, gluten-free}

ingredients.name: peanut oil ((or grapeseed oil, or vegetable oil))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chop green onions to 5-cm (2-inch) pieces. Thinly slice shallot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a fine mesh over a large heatproof bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add oil into a large pan (or wok). Add shallots or onions into one side and green onions on the other side.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook over medium heat until the oil is brought to a boil. Press ingredients with a pair of tongs to submerge them in the oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn to medium low heat. Cook for 40 to 60 minutes, or until the shallots turn golden brown and the green onions turns dark brown. Check the pan after 30 minutes. Gently flip the ingredients with a pair of tongs to ensure even cooking. Keep cooking and check the pan every 10 minutes. When the onions turn golden, they will start to cook rather fast – so watch closely at this stage.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat immediately when the ingredients are cooked, as the residual heat will keep cooking the ingredients and they can be easily burned.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the fried onions and the fried green onions to the fine mesh over the heatproof bowl, gently press with the back of a spoon to drain extra oil. You could also drain these two ingredients separately, to use them in different dishes later. Once cooled, transfer them to a airtight container.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the oil has cooled off completely, transfer it to an airtight jar. Store it in the fridge up to 3 months.

title: Saengseon Jjim (Baked Fish)
description: Korean-style baked fish with colorful vegetables

ingredients.name: to 2.5 pounds fresh white fish fillets (haddock, tilapia, cod, or flounder)
minari (water dropwort (or 1/2 green bell pepper or a few green chili peppers))
dashima (dried kelp broth (or any other flavored broth))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the fish and pat with a paper towel to dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Set aside while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the seeds and ribs from the bell peppers. Thinly slice each color pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the minari into 2-inches pieces. Thinly slice the mushrooms and onion.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a pan with a little bit of oil. Stir fry the onion until translucent over medium high heat, lightly sprinkling with salt and pepper. Transfer to a plate. Stir fry the peppers one color at a time for 1 to 2 minutes until softened. Do not overcook, the vegetables should be crisp. Transfer to the plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Dredge the fish in flour one at a time. Shake off excess flour.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Lightly oil a baking dish. Spread 1/4 of the vegetables at the bottom, and then place 1/2 of the fish on top in a single layer. Spread another 1/4 of the vegetables on top of the fish. Drizzle 1/2 of the sauce over everything.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the remainder of the fish on top in a single layer. Drizzle the remaining sauce over the fish. Loosely cover with aluminium foil. Bake at 400 °F for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove from the oven and nicely arrange the remaining vegetables, placing each vegetable separately. Place the aluminium foil over, and bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Kelp Salad
description: Easy kelp salad with a spicy, sweet and sour taste.

ingredients.name: fresh kelp or you can use dried kelp
1-2 Thai peppers ( , cut into small pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Roll the kelp up and cut the kelp into thin shreds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then wash the kelp in cold water for 1 or 2 times to remove extra saltness.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water until boiling and then place shredded kelp in and cook for 2 minutes. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add light soy sauce, vinegar, chopped scallion, chopped chili peppers and chopped garlic. Heat Chinese cooking oil until hot and then pour the hot oil over the chopped garlic. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add some coriander.

title: Dry Tom Yum Seafood ต้มยำทะเลแห้ง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: mixed seafood of your choice (I use shrimp, scallops, and squid, see note)
stalk lemongrass, bottom half only, very thinly sliced
kaffir lime leaves, torn into chunks
3-5 Thai chilies, finely chopped (remove seeds for less heat)
finely chopped palm sugar or 1 Tbsp Thai chili paste (see note)
Check out this video for how to clean and prep a whole squid.

Using Thai chili paste will make a dish that has a more robust flavour, while using palm sugar will give you a lighter, more refreshing dish. Either is delicious. I prefer to use palm sugar because I want the subtle, sweet flavours of the scallops to come through. But if you're looking to replicate the flavour or tom yum goong soup that usually has chili paste, then I would add it.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-cook the seafood first by sauteing or searing in the wok with a little oil just until done, then remove from wok and set aside. Tips: Cook each type of seafood separately. If using scallops, cook only until medium doneness rather than well-done for best texture. If using squid, cook them last as they can release a lot of water when cooked, And be careful not to overcook squid; they should take no more than 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the same wok you cooked the seafood, add a little extra oil, then add lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chilies and shallots. Saute over medium heat for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Deglaze with a splash of water, then add fish sauce and palm sugar or chili paste. Stir briefly to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn heat to high, then add mushrooms and toss briefly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cooked seafood back in the pan along with tomatoes and toss just to mix then turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add lime juice and cilantro, and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice, enjoy!

title: Baked Spaghetti Recipe
description: BEST baked spaghetti recipe! A comforting pasta casserole that is on the healthy-ish side using less cheese (part-skim, when possible). The kicker is in the easy, flavor-packed homemade spaghetti sauce.

ingredients.name: thin spaghetti (whole grain spaghetti, if you like)
to 1 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella (non-fat, if possible), more to your liking
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
carrots, finely grated (I used this box grater)
each fresh torn basil and chopped parsley leaves

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the sauce. In a large oven-proof pan or braiser like this one, heat the olive oil over medium until just shimmering. Add the onions. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring regularly. Add the garlic and carrots and cook for another 3 minutes, stirring regularly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now add the crushed tomatoes, water, a generous pinch of salt and pepper, oregano, and paprika.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring the sauce to a boil, stirring regularly. Turn heat down to low, cover and let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes (occasionally check and give the sauce a stir).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While sauce is simmering, cook the pasta to al dente according to package. Drain and rinse.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When sauce is ready, uncover and add the cooked pasta. Stir until pasta is well-coated.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, ricotta and grated Parmesan. Add the mixture to the spaghetti. Stir until well-combined.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Top the pasta with shredded mozzarella. Transfer to oven, uncovered.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake in 375 degrees F heated-oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melty and bubbly. If you like to give the top of the baked spaghetti some color and crunch, simply switch to broil briefly (watch carefully).

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove from oven and garnish with fresh basil and parsley. Add crushed peppers, if you like. Enjoy!

title: Mexican Tres Leches Coffee
description: This Mexican Tres Leches Coffee topped with a mountain of whipped cream, cinnamon and chocolate shavings is easy to make at home and irresistibly yummy! Perfect for the holidays and the cold winter nights!

ingredients.name: Giant Eagle cinnamon, (plus more for topping)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 12 ounces of Starbucks® Holiday Blend Coffee in a large mug. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small creamer cup (or any cup), add the sweetened condensed milk, evaporated fat-free milk, half and half and cinnamon. Mix together with a spoon until fully combined to make the tres leches creamer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the tres leches creamer into the coffee, add a pinch of cinnamon and stir combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Top with a big dollop of whipped cream, chocolate shavings and more cinnamon. Enjoy!

title: Risotto with Tomatoes and Feta cheese
description: A super tasty and healthy Greek style risotto. The perfect comfort food for a cold winter's night!

ingredients.name: tomatoes, grated and 6 cherry tomatoes, cut into halves

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the stock, according to package instructions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another large saucepan, heat the olive oil into medium heat and add the onions and garlic. Sauté for 5 minutes, until the onions are softened, but not colored.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat up and add the rice. Saute the rice, whilst stirring it, until it becomes translucent. Pour in the wine and wait for it to evaporate whilst stirring.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the grated tomatoes. As soon as the rice starts to absorb the tomatoes, add your first ladle of hot stock and the cherry tomatoes and turn the heat down. Stir the rice and wait for the stock to be absorbed before adding the next ladle. Add the ouzo and repeat the procedure, with the rest of the stock. This should take about 15 minutes, until the rice is soft but with a slight bite.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove and add the feta cheese, the oregano and the butter and stir well. Season to taste.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Allow the risotto to sit for 2 minutes with the lid on and serve as soon as possible, while still hot.

title: Homemade General Tso Sauce (Bulk Version)
description: General Tso sauce is one of the most versatile stir fry sauces that I recommend every home cook store a jar in their fridge. Not only does it takes merely 3 minutes to make, but it also goes well with almost everything.

ingredients.name: Chinkiang vinegar ((or rice wine, or balsamic vinegar) (*footnote 1))
Shaoxing wine ((or dry sherry, or Japanese sake, or stock))
light soy sauce ((or soy sauce, or tamari) (*footnote 2))
dark soy sauce ((or soy sauce, or tamari) (*footnote 2))
Chicken or vegetable stock ((Add right before using the sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix all the ingredients except the stock in a jar and shake to combine. Every time before you use the sauce, shake well to dissolve all the cornstarch. Pour 1/3 cup sauce into a bowl and add 1/3 cup stock (it can be either chicken stock, vegetarian stock, or water). Mix well again right before pouring into the pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: You can store the sauce in a glass jar in the fridge for up to 3 months.

title: Oiji (Korean Pickled Cucumbers)
description: Korean fermented cucumber pickles - crunchy with deep tangy flavor!

ingredients.name: to 12 Korean white cucumbers (small and thin (or 20 kirby pickling cucumbers, small and thin))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the cucumbers, and air dry or pat dry with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring the water and salt to a boil, and continue to boil for 3 or 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the cucumbers in a jar or a container (heat proof, BPA free). Pour the boiling water directly over the cucumbers, or you can put the cucumbers in the pot with the boiling water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Keep them entirely submerged in the water by weighing them down with a heavy plate or bowl. When the salt water has cooled down, close with the lid, and let stand at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: After 2 to 3 days, pour the brine out into a large pot, and boil it for a few minutes. If there’s a while film (golmaji) on the surface of the water, strain it out before boiling. Then, cool completely.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the cooled brine back over the cucumbers. Close with the lid, and ferment at room temperature for 5 to 7 days, and then refrigerate. The color of oiji should be between olive green and yellow at this point. They can be eaten, but the flavor will further develop with more time, 2 to 3 weeks to a few weeks.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve, thinly slice the cucumber and soak in fresh water until the desired salt level is achieved. You can also cut the cucumber into about 2-inch logs and quarter each one lengthwise. Sprinkle with some gochugaru and/or sesame seeds and garnish with chopped scallion, if desired. You can also add a little bit of vinegar to taste and drop in a couple of ice cubes.

title: Pickled Vegetable Sichuan
description: Sichuan Style Pickled Vegetables

ingredients.name: lbs. chili red pepper ( , long chili red pepper; you can also replace it with green ones.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash your pickle jar carefully and then put aside to drain all the water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash all the ingredients carefully and then drain them thoroughly. There should be no water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Put the water in a large pan and heat the water to boiling. Then move away from fire to cool down naturally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Get the dried pickle jar, put one layer of chili pepper and tender ginger, add one layer of salt and sparkle some Sichuan peppercorns. Repeat again until all the peppers and gingers are placed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour cooled down water to pickle jar. Make sure that all the ingredients are soaked by water.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the lid and pour some water in the edge to prevent any air goes into the jar.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Put the jar in a cool environment and wait for 7 days.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add other ingredients into the jar to make your own favorite pickled vegetables. You can add cabbage, green beans, cucumber and radishes.

title: Thai Peppery Shrimp and Veggie Soup - Gaeng Liang
description: This healthy, herbaceous soup is loaded with veggies and juicy shrimp. In Thai culture, new moms are encouraged to eat gaeng liang because it's believed to increase milk production.

ingredients.name: chicken stock or shrimp stock, unsalted, preferably homemade
recipe gaeng liang curry paste (recipe follows)
Half an angled luffa (sing gua) or half a large zucchini
Half a chayote squash, peeled and cut into sticks (or sub more angled luffa or zucchini)
oyster mushrooms, or another Asian mushroom, torn into bite-sized pieces
shrimp or chicken (if using chicken, cut into cubes and marinate in a bit of fish sauce)
Thai lemon basil or Thai basil (see note 1)
Heaping ¼ cup shallots, thinly sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a coffee grinder, grind the dried shrimp until shredded and fluffy; set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the mortar and pestle, grind white peppercorns until fine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add grachai and Thai chilies, and pound until fine, then add shallots and pound until fine. If at any point the mixture becomes too wet and slippery and is difficult to grind, you can add some of the shredded dried shrimp to help absorb the moisture and add friction.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the shrimp paste and any remaining dried shrimp and pound to mix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a medium pot, bring stock to a boil, then add curry paste and simmer for 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 2 Tbsp of fish sauce, then add kabocha squash and simmer for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add all remaining vegetables and simmer for 3-4 more minutes or until the kabocha squash can be pierced easily with a fork. (Timing depends on thickness of your kabocha.)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add shrimp or chicken and cook just until they’re done, about 30 seconds only.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Turn off the heat and stir in Thai of lemon basil.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Taste and adjust the seasoning with more fish sauce or salt as needed. If you want it to be spicier, you can add more ground white pepper at this point.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice. I like to put a bit of rice into a bowl of kaeng liang to make a rice soup out of it!

title: Slow Cooker Pork Rib Tacos
description: These Slow Cooker Pork Rib Tacos are seasoned with Mexican spices and cooked in orange juice for a delicious and easy weeknight meal! (gluten free)

ingredients.name: rack St. Louis style ribs ((cut in half or thirds so it can fit in the slow cooker))
corn tortillas, lettuce cups or buns

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix together chili powder, cumin, oregano, coriander, salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rub spices onto ribs and place in the slow cooker. Cover ribs with any remaining spice mix and add in garlic, dried chiles and orange juice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours until fall-apart tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove bones and shred/pull apart meat using a fork. Serve in corn tortillas (or lettuce cups or buns) and top with peach strawberry salsa.

title: Za'atar Manaqish Recipe
description: Manaqish or manakish are savory pastries popular in the Levant (Eastern Mediterranean) region. My mother in law, a master of the Levant kitchen, was the one who first introduced me to the making of za'atar manaqish.

ingredients.name: active dry yeast (one package active dry yeast)
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
Homemade labneh or feta cheese (omit if vegan)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine water, sugar and yeast. Set aside for 10 minutes to foam.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the dough. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and olive oil. Work the mixture with your hands. Now, make a well in the middle and pour in the yeast and water mixture. Stir until soft dough forms.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 10 minutes or until dough is elastic, smooth, and no longer sticky (as you knead, if dough is too sticky for you, you can sprinkle just a tiny bit of flour to help it).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Form dough into a ball and place in a lightly oiled mixing bowl. Cover with damp cloth and place in a warm spot (inside a warmed but turned-off oven is a good place). Leave to rise for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Punch dough down. Knead briefly and form into 8 small balls. Arrange on lightly floured surface, cover again and leave to rise another 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare the za'atar topping. While dough is rising, mix together the za'atar spice and olive oil in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Place a large baking sheet in oven while heating.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Form za'atar manaqish. Lightly oil the heated baking sheet and set near you. Flatten the dough into small discs about 5 inches in diameter. With your finger tips, make indentations in discs and add about 1 tbsp za'atar topping in the middle of each disc, leave a narrow boarder around. Arrange discs in prepared oiled baking sheet (use two sheets if needed, do not crowd the manaqish).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake in 400 degrees F heated-oven for 7 to 8 minutes or until the dough is slightly browned on bottom and edges (za'atar topping will remain liquidy at this point). Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes or so, the topping will dry and settle into dough.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve za'atar manaqish warm or at room temprature with assorted vegetables, olives, feta cheese, or homemade labneh.

title: Homemade Ranch Dressing
description: Homemade Ranch Dressing - creamy, rich buttermilk ranch dressing with subtle flavors from fresh parsley, dill, and chives. Just the right amount of tang with a kiss of heat.

ingredients.name: ¼-½ cup (61-122g) buttermilk ((as needed for desired consistency))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, chives, parsley, dill, garlic, onion powder, mustard, hot sauce, salt, and pepper until fully blended.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Gently pour in the buttermilk a little at a time and mix until you reach the desired consistency and it's well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving. Serve with salad, baked chicken, fish, or vegetables.

title: Yogurt Balls with fresh Herbs
description: Cool, creamy and full of flavors! These refreshing little yogurt balls will become your favorite light snack! Try them with a drizzle of extra virgin olive and some cherry tomatoes or as a spread on top of salty crackers. Enjoy!

ingredients.name: 5-6 tbsps of fresh herbs (basil, mint, parsley)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these amazing yogurt balls, you need to drain all the excess water from the yogurt. Lay a piece of muslin (loosely woven cotton fabric) on a workbench and place the yogurt in the centre. Gather up the muslin sides and tie with string; place on a drainer over a large bowl and leave to drain in the fridge for 12-14 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the muslin and place the yogurt in a large bowl. Add the fresh herbs, the lemon zest and lime zest and blend. Roll the yogurt into golf-sized balls, lay on a baking tray and put them in the fridge for another 2-3 hours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and serve with some cherry tomatoes and crackers aside as a delicious snack. Enjoy!

title: 3-Ingredient Garlic Broccoli Stir Fry
description: Sometimes simplicity is the best. Although I love my roasted veggies with their heavenly char, this garlic broccoli stir fry is one of my favorite broccoli dishes.

ingredients.name: big head broccoli (, separated into florets)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large heavy-duty skillet until hot. Add oil. Swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and broccoli, and sprinkle with salt. Cook and stir to coat broccoli with oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add chicken stock. Cover and cook for 1 minute, or until the broccoli reaches your desired doneness. Turn to low heat and carefully taste the broccoli. Adjust seasoning by adding more salt, or cover to cook a bit longer if necessary.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Gujeolpan (Platter of Nine Delicacies)
description: a beautiful and nutritionally well-balanced Korean traditional platter with nine delicacies!

ingredients.name: dried shiitake mushrooms (soaked (or 3 ounces fresh shiitake))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into thin strips (about 3-inch long). Remove the stems off the soaked mushrooms. If the mushrooms are thick, place the stem side down, and carefully slice parallel to the cutting board. Then cut into thin strips.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the beef and mushrooms with the seasoning ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the cucumbers crosswise into 2-½ inch long sections. Cut each one into thin sheets discarding the seedy part, and then cut into matchsticks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the zucchini crosswise into 2-½ inch long sections. Cut each one into thin sheets, discarding the soft, seedy part, and then cut into matchsticks.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut the carrot into matchsticks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. To keep the shrimp straight after cooked, insert a toothpick straight through the leg part of each shrimp. Cook briefly, about a minute. Quickly drain and dump in cold water to stop cooking. Drain again. Remove the toothpicks. Cut into thin strips.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the flour and salt to a bowl. Stir in 1 - ⅓ cups of cold water, and mix well. The batter should be thin.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Separate the eggs. Lightly beat the white by gently cutting it with a spoon. Stir the yoke with a spoon until smooth. Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Pour each egg part into a thin layer, spreading with a spoon. Cook each side briefly. Do not brown the egg. Cool then first cut into 2-½ inch wide sheets, and then into thin strips.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Heat the pan over medium high, add a half tablespoon of oil, and briefly cook each ingredient, sprinkling with a pinch of salt, in this order: cucumber, zucchini, carrot, mushroom, and beef,. Transfer to a large plate.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan over medium low heat. Add one tablespoon of the pancake mixture into the pan, and spread it evenly into a thin round shape (about 3 inch round) with a back of the spoon. Cook until the edges start to lift up slightly, about 30 seconds, and flip over for another 30 seconds. Transfer to a large plate. Repeat until all the mixture is used.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Arrange the filling ingredients, placing the same/similar color foods on opposite sides. Stack the pancakes up and place in the center section of the platter.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the hot mustard paste and sugar until the sugar is dissolved. Add the remaining liquid ingredients and mix well again. Serve with the gujeolpan.

title: Spicy and Sour Potato
description: Chinese spicy and sour shredded potatoes

ingredients.name: Spring onion and coriander for garnishing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the potatoes and then cut into shreds of similar size.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a clean bowl with clean water. Then soak the shredded potatoes in water for several minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain shredded potatoes and set aside. Heat up oil in pan, then put in chili red pepper, Sichuan pepper and fry until aromatic. Then place garlic in and slightly fry for 3-4 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add drained potatoes shreds, quick stir-fry until the potatoes shreds become soft. Add salt, soy sauce. At last mix black vinegar evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer out and garnish some spring onion before serving

title: Malaysian/Indonesian Beef Rendang
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: (700g) stew beef such as chuck or boneless short ribs
dried shredded coconut (for making kerisik, see note)
kaffir lime leaves, torn into chunks
Optional: Fish sauce for seasoning adjustment

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the kerisik: (You can make this in advance or while the beef cooks.) Toast the coconut in a dry saute pan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until dark brown. Grind in a mortar and pestle or a coffee grinder until it becomes and oily paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the paste: Grind dry chilies and spices in a coffee grinder until fine, then add candlenuts and grind until fine. In a blender, add galangal, ginger, lemongrass, shallots and garlic and blend until smooth, adding water as needed. Once fine, add the ground dry spices and blend to mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For the curry: Bring 1/2 cup of coconut milk to a boil in a large heavy-bottomed pot. Add the curry paste and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the paste is thick, and the coconut oil is starting to sizzle away from the paste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the beef and toss to mix with the paste, add the remaining coconut milk and scrape off any bits of curry paste that might be stuck to the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add salt and tamarind, then keep the pot loosely covered, let it simmer on low heat for 2.5-3 hours or until beef is fork tender. In the beginning, stir it every 20 minutes or so, but as the sauce gets thicker, you need to stir more frequently to make sure the curry paste doesn't stick and burn to the bottom of the pot. Towards the end I stir it every 5 minutes. You should have a very thick, not runny sauce, and you can add more water if it gets too dry as it cooks. If the beef is done, but there is too much liquid, just open the pot and stir for a few more minutes to let it reduce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In the last few minutes of cooking stir in 1 Tbsp of kerisik, and roughly tear kaffir lime leaves into chunks and stir them in, letting them cook for a few more minutes to infuse. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with rice, enjoy!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Spicy Red Pepper Garlic Shrimp
description: This Spicy Red Pepper Garlic Shrimp is an easy and healthy weeknight meal that's ready in only 18 minutes. Is gluten free, paleo and low carb.

ingredients.name: For serving: cooked white rice, lime wedges, cilantro, extra red pepper flakes ((optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a bowl, mix together all the ingredients of the marinade. In a gallon-size zip lock bag, combine shrimp and marinade and toss to combine. Let sit for 15 minutes in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 1 teaspoon of olive oil into a large frying pan and heat over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add in the shrimp and the marinade and cook until shrimp turn bright pink, about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat, serve with rice, lime wedges, chopped cilantro and extra red pepper flakes if desired. Enjoy!

title: French Pear Tart
description: This French pear tart recipe is a total WIN! Absolute perfection in both presentation and taste!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Position one oven rack to middle, and move the second rack to the top slot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a bowl, mix together flour, sugar and salt. Add melted butter and combine to form dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom. With your hands press dough down to spread on bottom and onto the rims of the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place in the oven on the middle rack and bake for 30 minutes, or until crust turns golden brown. When ready remove crust from oven and let sit to cool. Leave oven on.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, heat the fig preserves in microwave for about 40 seconds. Pour heated fig preserves through a mesh strainer to separate chunks from liquid.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Now, slice five pears into 1/2-inch slices, discarding core.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat 1 tbsp of butter in a large cast iron skillet. Add pear slices and 1 tbsp water. Cover and cook on medium heat until pears are slightly tender; about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove pears onto a large platter and let sit to cool.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Take the remaining three pears and cut them in the same manner.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Now melt 2 tbsp of butter in previously used cast iron skillet. Add newly-sliced pears, chunks of fig reserves, and salt. Cook on medium heat, covered, for ten minutes; stir occasionally until pears are very tender.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Take a potato masher and mash the pears and fig reserves into a puree. Let cook for another 5-7 minutes or until pureed mixture reduces and thickens.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Transfer pear-fig puree onto the now cooled crust; spread evenly.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Now, take the cooled pear slices and begin to assemble them in layered circles, starting at the outer edges (see photo).

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Place tart on the middle rack of the oven. Bake in 350 degree F-heated oven for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Warm up the strained liquid fig preserves for 20 seconds in the microwave.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: When tart is ready, remove from oven and brush surface of the pears evenly with the warmed fig liquid.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Return to oven and place on the top rack. Broil very briefly; watching carefully until pears gain a nice caramelized look.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Remove from oven and let cool for at least 1 1/2 hours before serving.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: When ready, place the bottom of the tart pan on a wide can of food. Hold the ring part of the pan and carefully slide it downwards (see photo).

steps.title: Step 21
steps.description: Cut pear fig tart into eight slices and serve. Enjoy!

title: Greek Diples Recipe (Christmas Greek Pastry with Honey)
description: Christmas on a platter, drizzled with syrup and walnuts! Diples / Thiples are Christmas Greek pastries with honey and are named by the Greek word for “fold”

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the egg whites into the bowl of the electric mixer, along with a pinch of salt. Make sure your egg whites, bowl and whisk attachments are clean and free of any water. Whisk the egg whites until the mixture is very thick and glossy and a long trailing peak forms when the whisk is lifted (meringues).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the egg yolks one at a time, whilst mixing; wait for each one to be absorbed, before adding another. In a cup add the orange and lemon juice and baking soda and blend, until dissolved and pour in the egg mixture. Add the white wine vinegar and the sugar and mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the mixture in a large bowl or basin and sift in the flour; add the oil and knead the dough using your hands, until smooth and elastic, and not sticky (if it is sticky, add some more flour).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Separate the dough in four pieces, cover with some plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a rolling pin, roll out each part of the dough into thin rectangle sheets. Now you have to make a decision, whether you want to go the easy or the hard way!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Diples get their name from the Greek word for “fold”. This means that you have to fold them.. So if you have the time, go for the traditional version. Using a rolling cutter, cut the rolled out dough into rectangular pieces (approx. 12×25 cm). Heat the oil in a deep frying pan, until shimmering but not smoking hot. Place a cut dough sheet in the hot oil. Using two large cooking forks and placing the edge between the tines of the fork, hold the end furthest away from you and roll the sheet away from you. Hold it a little with the fork in the oil, until coloured and place on some kitchen paper to drain. Repeat with the rest. (It’s best to cut all the diples before you begin frying.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: For the easy version, using a rolling cutter, cut the rolled out dough into rectangular pieces (approx. 10x5cm) or square pieces (8×8 cm). Heat the oil in a large frying pan, and deep fry the diples in batches of 3-4 at a time, depending on the how large is the pan, pushing them down with a fork and flipping them sides, until coloured. Place on some kitchen paper to drain and repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Prepare the syrup for the diples. Pour in a pot all the syrup ingredients and bring to the boil; boil for 5 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved (do not stir the syrup).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the diples on a serving platter and drizzle with the syrup (or if you like them extra syrupy, soak each one in the syrup for a few seconds). Sprinkle with ground walnuts and cinnamon.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Alternatively, just warm up the honey, drizzle the diples and garnish with chopped walnuts. Enjoy!

title: Corn Fritters
description: Corn Fritters- wholesome, flavorful corn fritters with Cilantro Avocado dip. Crispy, cheesy, melty, sweet, and sooo crazy good!

ingredients.name: (330 g) sweet corn kernels (, about 2 ears of corn)
(4 g) salt or more (, adjust to taste)
(61 ml) or more milk (, sub with coconut milk)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove husk from corn and using a sharp knife, cut the kernels from the cob from top to bottom. It’s best to use a bundt pan to do so.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Microwave corn in bowl for about 5 -7 minutes. Or boil corn first, before removing from husk. Let it cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium bowl, mix together all the dry ingredients: corn kernels, cornmeal, green onion, bell pepper, jalapeno, flour, minced garlic, cilantro, paprika , salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then gently pour in milk. You might have to add about a tablespoon or more to form a thick batter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Finally, add cheese, if desired. Thoroughly mix until the ingredients have fully combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Working in batches, add about ¼-1/3 cup batter on skillet, Using the back of a cup or spoon gently press down on the ball to flatten, then fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side, depending on thickness.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drain on paper towels before serving.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Best serve warm with cilantro dressing.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cilantro Avocado Dip

title: Homemade Five Spice Powder
description: Making five spice powder is much easier than you think. It creates a superior spice mixture that is cheaper and makes your Chinese dishes immediately taste better.

ingredients.name: inch (2 cm) cinnamon stick (, broke apart)
star anise (, broke apart into petals)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all the spices into a small pan. Roast over medium heat until fragrance is released. You should hear faint sizzling noises if you hold the pan close to your ear.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the spices into a small bowl to cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once cooled down completely, transfer to a coffee grinder or use a mortar and pestle. Ground until it turns to fine powder. Transfer to an airtight jar and store in cool, dark place out of direct sunlight.

title: Funnel Cakes
description: Funnel Cakes – a summer fair classic treat that’s sweet and crispy served piping hot and dusted with snowfall of powdered sugar and just about anything you could think off.

ingredients.name: and ½ cups (312 g) all-purpose flour

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk the eggs, sugar, vanilla and milk.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Gently pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and continue whisking until thoroughly mixed,

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat. Then add oil about 2-3 inches. The temperature of the oil should be about 375°F (191°C) before starting to fry.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Next, pour about ⅓ cup of batter into the cake decorating tool and gently pipe out the batter into the frypan making one large swirl and connect it to some of the swirl layers. (See notes if using the funnel or piping bag or a ziplock bag.) Your swirl does not have to be pretty nor perfect. Have fun with it! Fry until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes on each side.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When ready, carefully remove funnel cake with a slotted spoon or metal spatula and place on the prepared sheet pan to cool slightly. If desired, place a wire rack over a baking sheet, for cooling or resting the funnel cakes after frying. Repeat with the remaining batter, until completely used up.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: It’s best to serve the funnel cakes while they’re still warm. Top it with your favorite toppings. Here are some of my favorites: confectioners’ sugar, whipped cream, chocolate syrup, fresh strawberry. Best enjoyed the same day.

title: Yu Xiang Qie Zi (Sichuan Eggplant)
description: Sichuan style eggplants stir fry

ingredients.name: green onions ( , white part and green part separately chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preparation

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fry the eggplants

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make Yu Xiang Sauce

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assemble the dish

title: Korean Curry Rice
description: Easy Korean-style curry rice

ingredients.name: of instant curry roux (use a couple more cubes for a thicker sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the meat into small bite size pieces. Lightly sprinkle with salt and pepper. Dice the onion, and cut the other vegetables into bite size chunks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large pot with a tablespoon of oil. Add the onion, and stir-fry until it turns translucent and light brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the meat, garlic and ginger, and cook until the meat is no longer pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining vegetables and stir fry until potatoes turn translucent and partially cooked.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the water (or chicken broth) into the pot. Bring it to a boil, and continue to boil for about 10 minutes until the meat becomes tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Break up the curry roux into small cubes. Drop them in, and stir well to dissolve.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Reduce the heat to medium low, and gently boil until the sauce is thickened. Serve over steamed rice. Add more water if too thick.

title: Pandan Coconut Cookies with Cashews
description: This recipe is adapted from Becel Plant-Based Anything Goes Cookies Dough Recipe

ingredients.name: shredded coconut, unsweetened, plus extra for garnish
concentrated pandan juice (recipe follows, see note)
whole roasted cashews for garnish, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blend half of the pandan leaves with the water until fine. Strain, then put the juice back into the blender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the other half of the pandan leaves in the blender and blend until fine and strain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: I’m blending half of the leaves at a time because the blender cannot process all the leaves at once with this amount of water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: This makes more than you need in the recipe, but I find that the blender needs at least this much volume in order to blend effectively. You can make pandan tea with the leftover juice—simply add water and sweetener of your choice and enjoy it hot or iced.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Whisk together flour, shredded coconut, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda and salt in medium bowl; set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Beat Becel® Original margarine and granulated sugar using electric mixer until light and creamy. Beat in applesauce, pandan juice and green food colouring until blended.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gradually add in flour mixture and beat on low speed, scraping down sides of bowl occasionally, stopping just as the flour is almost completely blended, but not quite.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add cashews, and use a wooden spoon or rubber spatula to fold them in until they are evenly distributed and the dough is well blended (do not overmix).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Refrigerate dough at least 30 minutes or until chilled. You can make the dough up to 2 days in advance, keeping it well covered in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: While cookie dough is chilling, preheat oven to 350°F (180°C) and set the rack in the middle of the oven. Line baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Drop cookies by tablespoonfuls on prepared baking sheet 2 inches apart.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Optional cashew garnish: place a whole roasted cashew on top of each dough ball, pressing them in so that the bottom half is buried into the dough. Optional coconut garnish: Roll the top side of each dough ball into shredded coconut. If you want to garnish the cookies with both cashews and coconut, make sure you put the cashews in first before rolling them in the coconut.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Bake 10-12 minutes or until edges are golden. (Shorter baking time yields softer cookies.)

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Let cookies cool for 5 minutes, then transfer them onto a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Buffalo Chicken Fajita Pizza Ring
description: This easy Buffalo Chicken Fajita Pizza Ring is the perfect game day appetizer for parties and get-togethers. By the end of the night, everyone will be asking for the recipe!

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast, (cut into thin fajita-style slices)
buffalo wing sauce + 2 tablespoons, divided ((I used Frank’s Red Hot sauce))
ball of pizza dough ((I used a refrigerated pizza crust dough))
chopped green onions (for sprinkling on top)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, melt the butter. Add the chicken breast, garlic and onion powder and stir to mix. Sauté until chicken is fully cooked through, about 10 to 12 minutes. Add in buffalo wing sauce, stir, and remove from heat. Transfer chicken to a heat-safe plate or bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the oven is heating up, add olive oil into the same skillet as the chicken was cooked in and place over medium-high heat. Add the red and green bell peppers and onions. Sauté until the vegetables have softened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roll out the pizza dough onto a piece of parchment paper in a large circular shape. Cut four small lines through the middle of the dough using a pizza cutter to make a star shape.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the space between the center cuts and the edge of the crust, layer the buffalo chicken and the fajita vegetables. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese on top.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Gently pull the point of each star back and tuck it over the outer crust, rolling both sides inward so they overlap and are secure. Repeat this process with all the cut sections. The final shape should look like a ring.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Brush the top of the ring with the beaten egg and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place a bowl of your favorite sauce (I used ranch!) in the center of the ring, garnish with green onions and enjoy!

title: Loaded Grilled Roast Beef Sandwich
description: Okay, there is a sandwich and then there is a loaded sandwich. Better yet, a loaded grilled roast beef sandwiches!

ingredients.name: green bell peppers, cored, sliced into batons
good French boule bread or similar
thinly sliced rare roast beef (deli roast beef is fine), divided into four equal portions

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large heavy skillet, heat 2 tbsp of olive oil on high. Add the onions and saute for five minutes then add the green peppers, garlic and a dash of seasoned salt. Saute for another 5-7 minutes until the vegetables are tender and onions have slightly caramelized. Reduce the heat to medium; add the brandy and cook until it evaporates. Remove from heat, and roughly divide the vegetables into four equal portions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lightly butter the back of each bread slice, if desired.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To assemble the first roast beef sandwich, take one slice of bread and top it with one slice of mozzarella and some of the shredded sharp cheddar. Now add the sauteed vegetables, roast beef and tomato. Top the tomato with more shredded cheddar and a slice of mozzarella cheese. Finally add another slice of bread to top the sandwich. Repeat with the remaining three sandwiches

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Grill the sandwiches, each, in a panini grill, electric plate grill, or a stove-top grill for 2-4 minutes until cheese is melted. If using a stove-top grill, carefully flip the sandwiches over mid-way through grilling. Press with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from heat. Serve with your favorite chips and beer! Enjoy!

title: Clotted Cream
description: Clotted Cream - a super quick and easy version of clotted cream made with only 4 ingredients in less than 10 minutes. No need to turn on the oven and heat up the house!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place all ingredients in a medium bowl. Using a hand mixer, whip all ingredients together until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for a week. For best use, allow it to sit at room temperature for about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Perfect Potato gratin with Feta cheese
description: The perfect potato gratin recipe! Imagine luscious layers of the most creamy béchamel-based sauce, sweet caramelised onions, tangy and salty feta cheese and tender potatoes, topped with crispy bacon and Parmesan cheese..
tags: scalloped potatoes with feta cheese recipe

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced (53 ounces)
a handful of Parmesan cheese, grated

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these amazing potato gratin recipe, finely chop the onion and garlic. Into a hot pan, add 2 tbsps of olive oil and sauté the onion and garlic, until tender. Add the honey and oregano and stir. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the béchamel sauce, melt 2 tbsps of butter into a deep pan, over medium heat. Add the flour and whisk to make a paste. Add the vegetable stock, whilst whisking and then pour in the cream, a little bit at a time, whilst whisking, to form a smooth cream. Remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes. Add the potatoes in the béchamel sauce and the spring onions and stir well. Spoon half of the potatoes mixture into the potato gratin dish in an even layer. Add the crumbled feta cheese and half of the onion mixture. Spoon the rest of the potatoes into the dish and even. Top with the rest of the onion mixture and sprinkle with Parmesan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover with aluminium foil and bake in preheated oven at 180C for 1 hour 30 minutes. Remove the foil the last 30 minutes, so that the potatoes are nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with some crispy fried bacon on top, sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley. Enjoy!

title: Chinese 4-Ingredient Fried Cabbage
description: Infuse the oil with aromatics and then toss at a high heat, This adds a smoky flavor to the sweet cabbage to make a quick and delicious side dish

ingredients.name: soy sauce ((or tamari for gluten free))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium high heat until hot. Add oil and peppercorns. Stir until the peppercorns become fragrant and turn dark brown. Turn the heat right down and scoop the peppercorns out with a spatula and put aside for later. (*footnote 1).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the heat back to medium high and add the chili peppers and cabbage. Immediately stir with spatula for 30 seconds. You should hear a vibrant sizzle. Add the salt. Keep stirring until the the edges are lightly charred and the leaves turn soft, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn to medium low heat, drizzle soy sauce over the cabbage and stir a few times to mix everything well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Chonggak Kimchi (Ponytail Radish Kimchi)
description: Chonggak kimchi is made with a small variety of white radish with long leafy stems, which is firmer and crunchier than the large varieties.

ingredients.name: to 5 pounds or about 15 small to medium young radishes with leaves (chonggak mu, 총각무)
Korean coarse sea salt - use less if using finer salt
sweet rice paste (1 tablespoon sweet rice powder simmered in 1/2 cup water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the radishes a couple of times to remove excess dirt. You will wash them again after salting. Cut off the root end of each radish. Trim off the darkish skin on the top end that is connected to the stem. Scratch off the stubborn impurities with a small knife. Do NOT peel the skin. Remove any bad leafy stems.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, place a few radishes and generously sprinkle with some salt. Add another layer of radishes and sprinkle with salt. Repeat as necessary until all the radishes and salt have been used. Let sit for 2 to 4 hours until the radishes become slightly flexible. Flip them over 2 to 3 times while salting.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the glutinous rice paste and cool. Mix all the seasoning ingredients well. Set it aside for a while for the red pepper flakes to dissolve a little and become pasty.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Rinse the radishes in cold water 2 times, and drain.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the radishes back in the large bowl. Add the seasoning. Mix everything well by hand (use kitchen gloves), until the radishes and stems are evenly coated with the seasoning. The radishes will be a little dry at this point, but they will release water during the fermentation process.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Store in an airtight container or jar. Before closing the lid, press the radishes down hard with your hand to pack them. Leave it out at room temperature for two days before storing them in the fridge. Kimchi will be ready in a few days in the fridge but takes about two weeks to fully develop the flavors. It maintains great flavor and texture for several weeks.

title: Yu Xiang Pork
description: One of the star from Sichuan cuisine, pork stir frying with hot and sour garlic sauce, which is also known as the lovely fish fragrant sauce.

ingredients.name: pork tenderloin or small tenderloin (, shredded)
tsp. dark soy sauce (, optional for coloring )
tbsp. cornstarch (, mixed with 1 tablespoon of water )
large Chinese scallion (, green part removed and cut into 1cm sections)

steps.description: Prepare and Marinat the pork

steps.description: Stir-frying

title: Quick and Easy Congee with Meatballs
description: This Thai style congee recipe is so quick and easy you can make it on a weekend morning! All you need is some leftover rice

ingredients.name: cooked jasmine rice, can be leftover
pork or chicken stock, unsalted (or if salted, reduce seasoning)
inch piece ginger, julienned, or more to taste
ground pork or chicken, preferably not lean

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If the rice is chilled, microwave it for a minute so it’s hot, which will help it absorb liquid more readily.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add rice to blender along with just enough of the stock to blend. Blend the rice briefly (several seconds) until you have your desired consistency—this could be coarser or finer depending on your preference, but make sure not to over-blend it cuz you do not want a smooth puree! (Tip: You do not actually have to blend the rice at all, but if you use whole rice it'll take longer to break down in the pot.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour blended rice into a heavy-bottomed pot, then use the remaining stock to rinse out the blender so you get everything out and add to the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add soy sauce and fish sauce and bring rice to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Simmer for at least 10 minutes, or up to 20 minutes. The longer you simmer, the softer and smoother the texture will be, but for a “quick” version, I find that 10 minutes will do just fine. Once the rice starts to thicken up, stir frequently with a rubber spatula to prevent the bottom from sticking to the pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the rice is cooking, make meatballs simply by combining all ingredients in a mixing bowl and knead everything together with your hands until smooth (wear gloves if you have them).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When rice is done, add meatballs in chunks directly into the rice using 2 teaspoons. Cook the meatballs for about 3 minutes until done.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Stir in julienned ginger if you want, or you can leave it for each person to add to their own bowl when serving.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve with green onions and extra white pepper if desired. Enjoy!

title: Roasted Poblano Broccoli Soup
description: This Roasted Poblano Broccoli Soup is made with roasted poblano peppers, caramelized onions and an entire pound of broccoli for a healthy and comforting soup that's gluten free, dairy free, vegetarian and vegan!

ingredients.name: poblano peppers ((about 2 1/2 large peppers or 5 medium peppers))
for topping: black pepper, cotija cheese, croutons, plain Greek yogurt or sour cream

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large dutch oven or pot over medium-low heat. Add olive oil, onions, garlic and salt. Mix together, cover and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally to make sure the onions aren't sticking to the bottom of the pot. Remove from heat when finished.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While onions are cooking, preheat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place broccoli florets and whole peppers on the baking sheet. Roast for 20 minutes, stirring the broccoli halfway through cooking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from oven and add broccoli to dutch oven. Place the peppers in a large bowl, cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Peel the skin off the peppers as much as you can, cut off the tops and discard the seeds and any big veins. Roughly chop and add to dutch oven.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 4 cups of broth, turn on high and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully transfer contents to a large blender (best to do this in 2 batches) and add cilantro and lime juice. Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste and season with more salt. It will need way more than you think.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with black pepper, cotija cheese, a dollop of plain greek yogurt or sour cream and croutons. Enjoy!

title: Zucchini Bechamel Casserole
description: A French-inspired Egyptian casserole combining four main ingredients: zucchini, ground beef, mozzarella cheese and bechamel sauce. Easy and hearty! Your friends will beg for the recipe.

ingredients.name: medium-sized zucchini, washed, dried, sliced in rounds or lengthwise

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 450F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Arranged zucchini slices (cut in 1/2-inch rounds or lengthwise) in one layer in oiled baking sheet. Use two or more sheets if needed, do not crowd zucchini. Season with salt and drizzle with olive oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place in oven for 15-18 minutes, turn over once midway through.When tender and slightly golden, remove from oven. Lower oven temperature to 350F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, heat one tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet. Saute minced onion briefly and add ground beef. Season with allspice, ground cardamom, salt and pepper. Cook on medium-high, stirring occasionally, until meat is well-done (about 10 minutes). Sit aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare bechamel sauce. Begin with heating 1/2 cup olive oil. Add flour and cook on medium- low for 5 minutes or until smooth and golden. Raising heat to medium, add milk one-cup-at-a-time and whisk continuously. Cook for another 7 minutes or until mixture is smooth, begins to bubble and thickens a little. Remove from heat and let sit to thicken into a creamy bechamel.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In an oiled baking dish or large cast iron skillet, assemble cassarole. Place first layer of meat, then add two layers of zucchini. Now add meat and one cup mozzarella cheese.Top the casserole with an even layer of the creamy bechamel sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Insert casserole into the now 350F oven for 45 minutes until the bechamel top turns golden- brown. Watch carefully, you do not want a completely browned bechamel.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from heat and let sit about 5 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: For side salads, you may like to add our simple Mediterranean Salad or Tabouli. Enjoy!

title: Pickled Eggs
description: Pickled Eggs - elevate your usual hard boiled eggs into this all-natural beet pickled eggs. Makes a lovely egg presentation on Easter or a great pop of color to your favorite salad. Sweet, sour and spicy!

ingredients.name: (4 g) dried crushed red pepper flakes
medium size fresh beets (, peeled and thinly sliced (1 ½ cups), optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the eggs and place in the bottom of a clean, quart-sized glass jar or 4 cup container.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium saucepan, add the vinegar, water, onion, dill, garlic, creole seasoning, pepper flakes, bay leaf, sugar, and beets if using any. Beets are optional; only use if you would like to give it some color.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring to a boil over medium high heat and cook uncovered, until the sugar has dissolved and the onions are translucent, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the pickling liquid over the eggs in the jar making sure to cover the eggs completely. Spoon the onions on the top, this helps to hold the eggs under the liquid. Cover the jar and refrigerate for about 24 hours or up to a month. The longer the eggs sit in the pickling juice, the more the pickling juice will penetrate the eggs.

title: Cinnamon Cookies with red Wine
description: Our very best recipe for cinnamon cookies; very easy to make and easier to disappear! Amazingly crunchy and scented with the aromas of red wine, cinnamon and ground clove..

ingredients.name: olive oil (1 and 5/6 cups olive oil)
red wine (3/4 of a cup red wine)
80gr sesame seeds, roasted (1/3 of a cup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these flavourful cinnamon cookies, add in a large bowl the sugar and olive oil and whisk. In a cup add the orange juice and baking soda and blend, until dissolved; pour in the bowl and add the wine, the cinnamon, the clove, the orange zest and the sesame seeds. Whisk well, until the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sieve the flour with the baking powder; add 1/2 the flour to the mixture and start kneading the dough. Slowly add the rest of the flour and knead the dough, until smooth and not sticky; don’t overwork the dough. Depending on the flour, you may need to use a little bit less or more flour than the recipe calls for. The dough should be soft, but not sticky.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 170C and line two large baking trays with parchment paper. Shape the cinnamon cookies with your hands, giving them any shape you like, sprinkle with brown sugar and bake for 25-30 minutes, until nicely coloured. Enjoy!

title: Paneer Pasanda (Restaurant Style Recipe)
description: Paneer Pasanda is a rich, luxurious recipe where sweet and spiced filling is stuffed between two pieces of paneer, then batter coated, shallow fried and served in a smooth onion-tomato and cashew gravy.

ingredients.name: paneer ((Indian cottage cheese) - one block or square)
to 2.5 tablespoon grated paneer (- can substitute grated cheddar cheese or processed cheese instead of paneer)
to 8 cashews (- finely chopped or 2 tablespoons finely chopped cashews)
or 2 green chilies (chopped, or about 1 teaspoon chopped green chilies)
oil (or add as needed, for frying)
onions (medium to large - 150 grams or 1 cup heaped chopped onions)
to 5 tablespoon water (to blend the sautéed onions. add more water if needed.)
tomatoes (medium to large - 250 grams or 1.75 cups roughly chopped tomatoes)
to 12 cashews (- halved or roughly chopped)
to 1.5 tablespoon oil (or the fried oil in which the paneer triangles were fried)
caraway seeds ((shahi jeera) - substitute cumin (jeera) if shahi jeera is not available)
inch ginger + 3 to 4 garlic (- crushed to a paste in mortar-pestle or 1 to 1.5 teaspoon ginger garlic paste (adrak lahsun ka paste))
to ½ teaspoon sugar (or as per taste)
light cream (or low-fat cream with 25% to 35% fat)
