title: Easy Swiss Chard Stir Fry
description: A delicious side dish that needs three ingredients and five minutes to cook. A great way to add vegetables to a weeknight’s dinner.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prep the swiss chard, cut off the stems and chop the leaves into 1-cm (1/2-inch) pieces. Chop the leaves into 4-cm (1.5-inch) pieces. Separate the stems and leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a cast iron pan (or wok, or a heavy skillet) until hot. Add garlic. Stir a few times until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chard stems. Cook and stir a few times until they start to soften.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the leaves. Quickly stir a few times. Add sugar and swirl in soy sauce. Immediately stir to mix well. Cook and stir until the chard turns tender. Transfer to a serving plate immediately to stop cooking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature as a side dish.

title: Tteok Mandu Guk (Rice Cake Soup with Dumplings)
description: Make this warm, soothing bowl of rice cake soup with dumplings for your New Year celebration!

ingredients.name: to 3 cups sliced rice cakes (tteokguk tteok, 떡국떡) (Soak in cold water for 10 to 20 min if hardened)
sheet gim nori, cut into thin strips

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into thin bite size pieces (1 to 1 1/2 inch).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium pot, sauté the beef with 1 tablespoon of soup soy sauce until all the pieces turn brown. Pour in 5 cups of water and bring it to a boil. Skim off the foam. Reduce the heat to medium and continue to boil, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: You can add the dumplings to the soup along with rice cakes in the next step. Another option is to cook the dumplings separately in the boiling water until the dumplings float to the top, and then add to the soup when the rice cakes are cooked. Or, line a steamer with a wet cheesecloth and then steam mandu for about 8 minutes (10 minutes if frozen).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the garlic and the rice cake slices to the boiling broth. Boil until the rice cakes turn very soft, usually about 5 – 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drop the cooked dumplings and the scallion to the soup. Let the soup come to a boil again. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Ladle the steaming soup into individual bowls and garnish with the optional egg and gim strips.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Optional garnish

title: Ants Climbing a Tree-vermicelli recipe
description: Ants climbing a tree-famous Chinese stir fried rice noodles

ingredients.name: scallion white ( , white part and green part minced separately)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinade the minced beef or pork with pinch of salt. Soak Chinese vermicelli in warm water until soft around 10 minutes Move out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok and fry the ground pork until aromatic and crispy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add doubanjiang, minced garlic, dou-chi if using, sliced ginger and chopped scallion in wok and stir-fry over medium fire until the oil becomes red and you can smell the aroma.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add soaked vermicelli, and add around 1 cup of water. Heat until it thickened once again. Add light soy sauce, dark doy sauce, and sugar. Give a big stir-fry to mix everything well. (There is no need to cook off all the liquid as the vermicelli continues to adsorb liquid after transferring out).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle chopped green onions and serve hot.

title: Freezer Red Curry with Chicken
description: This video isn't so much a "recipe", as you can apply this method to any of my curry recipes. Having said that, this recipe below is a what I made in the video

ingredients.name: (3-4 Tbsp) red curry paste (or another paste of your choice)
1-2 Tbsp fish sauce (this depends on the saltiness of your curry paste, if not sure, start with 1 and you can add more when you reheat)
kaffir lime leaves, recommended if making red, green or panang curry
(approx.) vegetables of your choice (see notes above regarding freezing vegetables)
vegetable of your choice (if you didn't add it prior to freezing)
A big handful of Thai basil, optional
Cooked jasmine rice for serving (which you can also freeze!)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Reduce ¾ cup coconut milk in a pot until thick, then add curry paste and saute with the coconut milk for a few minutes until coconut oil separates from the paste, or until the paste is very thick.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the remaining coconut milk , 1 Tbsp fish sauce and 1 Tbsp palm sugar, and simmer for 7-10 mins to reduce liquid volume by about half. Note: I keep the seasoning on the light side for now so I have room to adjust when I reheat and add fresh veggies to it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add chicken (or whatever meat you're using) and kaffir lime leaves, if using, and cook another 15-20 mins until chicken is fork tender. If using another meat, adjust cooking time accordingly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: I stop and freeze the curry at this point, and I will add vegetables, fresh herbs, and more water/stock when I reheat. But if you want, you can add in some vegetables now (see note above).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Put the curry into freezer bags, dividing it into portions that you will most likely eat at a time. So for me, I divide it into 2 servings per bag.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Removing as much air from it as you can before closing, and place in a large bowl of cold water to cool it down quickly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once cool, dry and label the bags, you might also indicate that it’s concentrated and needs diluting in case you forget!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Lay the bags flat to freeze, pressing it down so it has even thickness. This will make is fast to thaw.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bring out frozen curry and soak the bag in a bowl of hot tap water for a few minutes just until it can slide out of the bag. Meanwhile, bring water or stock to a full boil in a pot (if you divided the curry into portions, make sure you divide the water accordingly.)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Slide the curry out into the pot. Cook over medium heat until everything is melted. Bring to a simmer then add whatever vegetables you want and cook till they're done.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Stir in any fresh herbs, such as Thai basil.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Place the curry bags in a bowl of hot tap water just until it can slide out.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Break the curry into chunks and add to a microwave-safe bowl.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Add only half of the water or stock called for, then microwave until hot, stirring a few times in between.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Stir in fresh herbs at the end if desired.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more of the remaining water/stock as needed to adjust consistency and flavour.

title: Healthy Sheet Pan Sausage and Veggies
description: This Healthy Sheet Pan Sausage and Veggies recipe is easy, delicious and perfect for meal prep. It's gluten free, dairy free, paleo and Whole30.

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts ((about 24 sprouts), ends removed and halved)
14-ounce package Premio Hot and Spicy Italian Chicken Sausage ((5 sausage links))
to serve: cooked rice or quinoa ((optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add all ingredients except the sausage. Mix together until everything is evenly coated with olive oil and the herbs and spices. Transfer everything to a large baking sheet and lay sausages on top of the veggies. Lightly spray the top of the sausages with cooking spray or brush with olive oil to help the sausages brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bake on the middle rack for 15 minutes, turn the sausages over, spray the new side with cooking spray and bake another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Next, turn the oven broiler on low and cook for 5 more minutes, checking every minute to make sure nothing burns. This will ensure that the veggies and sausages get beautifully crispy and caramelized on the outside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from oven and serve with rice or quinoa, if desired.

title: BEST Turkey Bolognese Sauce (Shortcut Included)
description: This turkey bologense sauce is a lightened up version of the beloved Italian classic, but it is every bit as thick, delicious and hearty.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (I used Greek Private Reserve)
ground turkey (or lean ground beef, if you prefer)
whole canned plum tomatoes (about 1 1/2 cup), cut up

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a heavy saucepan, add extra virgin olive oil and onions. Heat on medium. Cook and stir the onions until translucent about 5 minutes, then add celery and carrots. Cook for another 3 minutes, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add ground turkey (or lean ground beef, if you prefer). Add a large pinch kosher salt and ground black pepper. Using a wooden spoon, break up the meat. Stir well until meat is no longer raw and it loses its red color.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add milk and let it come to a gentle simmer. Stir frequently until milk has completely bubbled away. Stir in nutmeg.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add wine and let it simmer until it has completely evaporated, then stir in the plum tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once tomatoes come to a gentle bubble, turn heat down to a very low simmer. Cook sauce, uncovered, for 3 hours or so.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: IMPORTANT: occasionally check if you need to add a little liquid to the sauce. If it looks dry or starts to stick, you can add about 1/2 cup of liquid (water or some of tomato water from your plum tomato can.) At the end, there should be no water remaining.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste the bolognese sauce and correct for salt.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Toss with your favorite cooked and drained pasta with a side of Parmesan.

title: Greek Meatloaf stuffed with Eggs (Rolo Kima)
description: Juicy and moist with a nicely browned thick crust and a hidden surprise in the middle.. Try out this easy, no-fail recipe for 'Rolo Kima' (Greek meatloaf stuffed with eggs) and amaze your friends and family!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the mixture for this impressive Greek meatloaf, add into a large bowl or basin the minced beef and pork along with the onions, garlic, tomatoes, the powdered all-spice berries, breadcrumbs and season well with salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly with your hands; it is important to knead the mix for at least 5-10 minutes so that all the ingredients combine and the meat absorbs all the wonderful flavours. Cover with some plastic wrap and let rest in the fridge for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime boil the eggs, for the stuffing and prepare the stock.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: On a working surface line a big piece of parchment paper and arrange half of the meat mixture as a base. Arrange the hard-boiled eggs side by side along the length mixture; cover with the rest of theÂ mixture and roll the parchment paper, forming a roll, so that it is curved down over the eggs in an arc.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Unroll carefully the meatloaf in a large, deep baking pan and add the potatoes (cut into wedges).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a bowl, mix the stock, the tomato paste and olive oil; pour 2/3 of the mixture over the meatloaf and potatoes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven (at both top and bottom heating elements) at 180C, on the bottom grill of the oven for 1 hour 30 minutes. If the meatloaf starts getting coloured to quickly, cover up with aluminium foil or lid. After an hour, check if all of the liquid has been absorbed and the pan appears to be getting dry and add the remaining stock mixture (warm), before the potatoes have fully browned.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the meatloaf is out of the oven let it rest for 15 minutes, to make it easier to slice. Slice into generous portions and pour over some of the delicious meat juices. Enjoy!

title: Eggless Chocolate Cake Recipe (Soft & Moist)
description: This Eggless Chocolate Cake is an easy one-bowl vegan recipe made with whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, sweeteners, lemon juice, vanilla, and oil. The cake is soft and moist and suitable for everyday baking.

title: Szechuan Spicy Peanuts (黄飞鸿花生, Huang Fei Hong Spicy Peanuts)
description: Szechuan spicy peanuts are an addictive beer accompaniment. Crunchy, salty, slightly sweet, and fiercely hot, with the citrusy tingle of numbingness. You won’t able to stop once you pop the first peanut into your mouth.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil ((or enough to cover the peanuts))
dried chili peppers and 1 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorn for garnish ((Optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cover peanuts with warm water. Let soak for 30 minutes to 4 hours. Peel and discard the skin. Drain and pat dry peanuts with paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the ingredients for the spice mix in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add peanuts into a wok and oil to cover. Turn on medium heat. Cook until the peanuts start to sizzle. Turn to medium low heat. Cook and stir occasionally until the surface turns pale yellow. Transfer peanuts using a colander onto a plate layered with paper towels. Remove extra oil from the wok and reserve just 1 teaspoon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: (Optional) Add chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns into the same wok. Cook and stir until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return peanuts to wok. Add the spice mix. Stir to mix well so the peanuts are evenly covered with spices. Transfer peanuts onto a big plate to cool. Don’t worry if the peanuts are not crispy enough when they’re still warm. They’ll crisp up and become crunchy once completely cooled.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve immediately as a snack or store in an air-tight container.

title: Wonton Soup Recipe
description: Spicy and mild versions of really easy wonton soup recipe

ingredients.name: small bunch of vegetable leaves ( , optional (lettuce,bok choy or other green vegetables))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the filling: In a large bowl, well combine all the ingredients together. Then stir your meat filling in one direction until the filling becomes sticky.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To assemble the wontons: Put the wonton wrapper in the center of the left hand. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of meat stuffing (or slightly more if you want)onto the center of the wrapper. Moisten the edges of the wonton wrappers with water. Fold one corner of the wrapper over the opposite corner to make a triangle just like the picture shows. Hold the wrapper with both hands, curl the corner on the right hand in firstly and then the curl the corner on the left hand to seal with another corner. You can also change the sequence. But make sure that you press them firmly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare your serving bowls: in separate serving bowls, mix all the seasonings and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil water in a wok. Put the wonton in to cook for about 5 minutes.And add your vegetable leaves prepared to cook in the last 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: scoop around 1/2 bowl of the boiling water in serving bowl (or you can use stock), and then place wonton in too.

title: Spicy Thai Glass Noodle Salad (laab woonsen)
description: A lesser known version of the classic laab salad. Glass noodles and ground meat are tossed with a spicy lime dressing with aromatic toasted rice powder. It's also loaded with fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: dried black fungus mushroom, aka wood ear or cloud ear mushrooms
ground pork or chicken, preferably not lean
Roasted chili flakes, to taste (see note)
mint leaves, roughly chop large leaves

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak dried mushrooms in hot water for 10-15 minutes until the soften.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate bowl, soak glass noodles in room temp water for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, make toasted rice powder: In a dry skillet, toast uncooked rice over high heat, stirring constantly, until it has a deep golden brown colour. Remove from pan, then pound in a mortar and pestle or grind in a coffee grinder into a powder. Be sure not to grind it so fine that it's like flour, you want a bit of grittiness.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once noodles are done soaking, drain and use scissors to cut into shorter, easier to eat pieces (I make about 3-4 cuts).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once mushrooms are done soaking, drain and cut into thin ribbons, removing any hard “core” pieces you find.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring 2-inches of water to a boil in a small pot, add noodles and mushrooms and cook 2-3 minutes until noodles are done.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the drained noodles in a mixing bowl and put the pot you used to cook the noodles back on the stove.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add about 1 tablespoon of water to the pot and turn the heat on medium high. Add the ground pork and cook, stirring constantly, until done. Add cooked pork to noodles along with all the juices.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: While noodles are still hot, toss in shallots so the heat can help wilt the shallots slightly. Then add fish sauce, lime juice, chili flakes and toss well.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add toasted rice powder and all fresh herbs, toss well, then taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Hobak hotteok (Pumpkin stuffed Korean pancake)
description: Chewy, gooey and nutty hotteok, Korean sweet stuffed pancakes!

ingredients.name: warm kabocha or pumpkin puree (either fresh* or canned)
canola or corn oil for pan frying
of assorted nuts (peanuts, walnuts, almonds, pine nuts, etc., finely chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Warm a large bowl by rinsing it with warm water. Add ⅓ cup of warm water to the bowl. Stir in the sugar, oil and yeast. Let it sit for about 10 minutes until the yeast has bubbled up.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sift the flour, glutinous rice powder, and salt together. Add the milk, pumpkin and flour mix to the yeast water. Knead until everything is well incorporated. The dough will be a little sticky.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover with plastic wrap. Place it in a warm place and let it rise until doubled, about an hour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the filling by chopping the nuts and mixing all the filling ingredients well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring the dough down by reshaping into a round. Let it sit for another 20 - 30 minutes until doubled again.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Start heating a pan with a couple of tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Lightly oil your hands. Tear a big enough piece to make an about 2 to 2-1/2-inch ball. Flatten into a thick disk, creating a shallow well in the middle. Add a tablespoon of the filling and lightly press it down with the spoon.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Carefully gather the edges together, pinching to seal. (This might take some practice.)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Put the sealed side down on the pan, flattening a little by pressing it down with an oiled hand or spatula. Cook for a minute, and then flip over. Press down for a few seconds to flatten. Cook until both sides are golden brown. Repeat the process with the remaining dough.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Lamb Leg with Mint Pesto
description: The perfect Mediterranean summer feast: Garlic-herb marinated grilled lamb with mint pesto...Plus, favorite Mediterranean sides and salads to serve along!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
boneless and butterflied leg of lamb (weighing about 3 to 4 pounds)
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the marinade. In the bowl of a food processor, add the parsley, mint, onion garlic, spices, lemon juice and olive oil. Run processor until you have a smooth green marinade.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pound lamb. Place the lamb leg on a large cutting board, cover with heavy plastic wrap. Using the smooth side of a meat tenderizer or mallet like this one, pound lamb and make sure to even out any pieces that are too thick. But remember, the goal is NOT to achieve paper-thin lamb.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat the lamb leg dry and sprinkle generously with salt on both sides. Place lamb in a large freezer bag and spread the marinade all over it. Zip the bag closed and work the marinade into the lamb to make sure every part of the lamb is well coated. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove lamb from fridge and let sit in room temperature for 20 minutes. (To make the lamb easier to turn on the grill you can insert a couple of metal skewers through the lamb, crosswise)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat an outdoor gas grill on high on all burners (this is just for the start).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place lamb, fat-side down, on the hot grill. Sear 2 minutes or so, then turn over and sear on the other side for 2 minutes. Lower the heat to low (temperature between 300 and 350 degrees F). Cover and grill for 15 minutes or so, flipping once midway through, until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the lamb reads 130 degrees F (for medium-rare). [Read note #1]

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from grill onto a cutting board. Cover with foil and let rest about 5 minutes. If using skewers, remove them, and cut across the grain and place on a serving platter.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To make the mint pesto (during downtime as the lamb is grilling or resting), simply add all the ingredients into the bowl of a clean food processor or blender. Blend until smooth. Top the grilled lamb with some of the pesto and transfer the rest of the pesto to a small serving bowl.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: You can also serve this grilled lamb with a side of this homemade Greek tzatziki sauce. Be sure to see suggestions for salads and sides up in the post under “what to serve with grilled lamb.” Enjoy!

title: Easy Gazpacho Recipe
description: A refreshing gazpacho recipe made from fresh sun-ripened tomatoes, cucumbers, bell peppers, onions and other simple ingredients. The best summer soup!

ingredients.name: ripe plum or roma tomatoes, (halved, core and seeds removed)
medium cucumber, (peeled and cut into coins )
medium red bell pepper, (stem and core removed)
medium sweet yellow onion, (peeled and cut into large chunks)
garnishes: croutons, cilantro leaves, olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all ingredients in a large blender or food processor. Puree until completely smooth, about 1-2 minutes depending on the power of your blender. (You may have to do this in two batches if your blender isn't large enough.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Taste and season with more salt if necessary.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer to a large glass container, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to overnight to help all the flavors meld together.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve cold with croutons, cilantro and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Kariokes (Walnut-filled Chocolate Crescents)
description: Delicious chocolate and walnut filled crescents dipped in more chocolate (kariokes)! Soft and with an unexpected crunchy bite, these delicious treats are very popular amongst the chocolate lovers during Christmas time.

ingredients.name: dark chocolate, cut in small pieces (4.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the filling for the kariokes, pour in a pot the water and sugar and bring to the boil. Let it boil for a few minutes, until the sugar has dissolved. Remove the pot from the stove and add the butter, the chocolate (cut in small pieces), the orange zest and the lemon juice; blend until the chocolate has melted and the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour the mixture in a bowl and mix in the powdered biscuits and chopped walnuts. Blend, until the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: On a working surface, line some plastic wrap and pour in 1/3 of the mixture. Form the mix into a roll, wrap it up and put it in the fridge overnight. Repeat the same with rest of the mixture, forming 3 rolls, about 17cm long and 3-4 cm thick. Leave in the fridge overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: A little bit before you take the rolls out of the fridge, start making the coating. To melt the chocolate it is best to use a bain-marie (or double boiler), a piece of equipment used to heat the chocolate gently and gradually to fixed temperatures so that it doesn’t burn. If you don’t have a Bain-marie, break the chocolate into small pieces and drop into a heatproof bowl. Set the bowl over a small saucepan about a quarter full with hot water and place the bowl on top so that it rests on the rim of the pan (the bowl should not to touch the water). Place the pan, with the bowl on top, over low heat until the chocolate has melted, whilst stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take the rolls out of the fridge, unwrap the plastic wrap and slice them in equal slices, about 1cm thick. Dip each piece in the chocolate, using a fork and then place on a baking tray, lined with parchment paper; repeat with all the pieces. When done, let the kariokes to cool down, at room temperature (not in the fridge), until the chocolate thickens. Enjoy!

title: South Western Egg Roll
description: Super crispy baked or fried southwestern egg roll – you won’t be able to tell the difference

ingredients.name: diced jalapeno peppers (you can take the seeds out for less spice!)
shredded Monterey Jack cheese low fat or eliminate.
7-9 8 inch tortilla or Egg roll wrappers

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle chicken evenly on both sides with salt, seasoning and pepper

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Grill on grill pan with about a tablespoon of oil. Grill chicken until cooked through, about five minutes per side. You may do this using a fry pan; instead of 1 tablespoon of oil use 2 tablespoons.Let set for a few minutes. Cut chicken into bite size pieces

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium- large skillet, add oil, onions, garlic, and green pepper until soft. Sauté, for about 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent any burns.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add beans, corn, and spinach until heated through. Then add chicken, cumin, chili, powder, smoked paprika and cayenne pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix well until all the ingredients have come together. Remove from the heat and stir in cheese.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place tortilla or 2 spring roll wrappers or on a chopping board or work surface then place 2 to 3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture in the center of each of the tortilla.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Roll the tortilla around the chicken mixture, folding the edges inward. And begin to roll with end nearest to you. Brush the edges with flour paste before final roll to keep the rolls sealed. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat up a medium skillet or cast iron with oil up to 2 inch- medium-high heat 350 degrees F. until hot but not smoking.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Gently drop the southwestern roll in the fry pan and fry in batches, turning once, until golden brown, about 5-8 minutes. Do not overcrowd the pan (it will absorb excess oil, resulting in a soggy rolls)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, remove the egg rolls and place them on paper towels.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature with this avocado ranch dressing.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: If baking Place on a baking sheet and brush with canola oil, then poke a few holes in the wrapper so that it does not break or burst during baking. Then bake at 400 degrees

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: For about 18-20 minutes until golden brown turning once.

title: Oven Roasted Green Beans with Garlic Soy Glaze
description: Try using this method to cook green beans for Thanksgiving this year and say goodbye to dull tasting side dishes!

ingredients.name: soy sauce ((or tamari for a gluten-free option))
chicken stock ((or rice wine, or water))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 230 degrees C (450 F).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil for easy cleanup, if needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dry the green beans thoroughly with a paper towel. Spread onto the baking sheet. Pour on olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Toss to mix well. Shake the pan and use a pair of tongs to arrange the green beans into a single layer, to ensure even roasting.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake for 12 minutes, until browned and almost tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While baking the green beans, prepare the garlic sauce. Mix soy sauce, chicken stock, sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm. Add garlic. Stir for a minute or until fragrant. Add the soy sauce mixture. Let cook until boiling. Stir and cook until the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the sauce over the green beans. Toss to mix well. Place them back into the oven and let bake for another 2 to 4 minutes, until the sauce is caramelized.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm as a side dish.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: You can cook these green beans ahead and store them in an airtight container in the fridge for a day. Reheat at 180 C (350 F) in the oven or microwave until warmed through.

description: Paneer is a fresh, firm and non-melting cheese popular in Indian cuisine. It is made by curdling hot milk with an acid like lemon juice or vinegar.

to 4 teaspoons lemon juice (or vinegar or 3 to 4 tablespoons curd or yogurt)
cheese cloth or muslin or a thin cotton napkin
some bowls and a heavy weight object or plates

title: Fish Fragrant Tofu
description: One of the most famous tofu stir-fry dish from Sichuan cuisine--Yu Shiang Tofu, or tofu in hot garlic sauce.

ingredients.name: box of regular firm tofu ( , cut into thick strips)
spring onions ( , white part and green part separated)
tbsp. chopped pickled pepper ( , cut into small sections)
tbsp. starch (, recommend using sweet potato starch )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut tofu into thick strips. Either larger or smaller. Then coat with cornstarch one by one.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a bowl and mix the stir fry sauce together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat oil in pan and fry tofu strips until golden brown. Transfer out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Keep the oil and then fry minced pork until crisp and browned, slow down the fire, add doubanjiang and pickled peppers. Fry for a while until the oil turn reds.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add garlic, ginger and scallion in, fry until aromatic. Pour in the mixed sauce. Simmer for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return fried tofu strips, mix well. Serve hot!

title: Dandelion Salad (Mindeulle Muchim)
description: a Korean-style dandelion salad, slightly spicy, sweet, and vinegary

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash dandelions well and drain. Remove the tough ends, and cut into small bite sizes. Place them in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix all the sauce ingredients until the sugar is dissolved. Pour over the dandelions, and toss well to mix right before serving.

title: Sukiyaki Stir-Fry (suki hang) สุกี้แห้ง
description: Suki hang is a must-try Thai street food that is uniquely delicious. Glass noodles and veggies are stir fried in a luscious red sauce, with juicy marinated chicken. It's as easy as it is flavourful!

ingredients.name: marinated chicken (recipe below), or another protein of your choice (see note)
water spinach or another leafy greens, 2-inch pieces
stalks Chinese celery or 1 stalk regular celery, cut into thin sticks
glass noodles, soaked in room temp water for 10 minutes and cut a couple of times to shorten
Green onions and/or cilantro for garnish
chicken thigh or breast, boneless, skinless, bite-sized pieces
Red bean curd cubes (see video for more info on this item)
white vinegar (*In the video I made a mistake and said 1 Tbsp vinegar; ¼ cup is the correct amount)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all ingredients and mix well; marinate for at least 20 minutes. Meanwhile, make the sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound garlic and chilies into a rough paste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add sugar and grind until fine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add sesame seeds and crush briefly just to break them up and release aroma.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add bean curd cubes and mash with pestle until there are no more lumps.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add all remaining liquid ingredients and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a wok heat just enough oil to coat the bottom over medium high heat. Once hot add chicken and sear without stirring until about halfway done. Flip the chicken then toss until completely done. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add a little more oil to wok if needed. On medium high heat add napa cabbage, water spinach, and celery and toss a couple of times just to coat in oil. Add noodles and sauce and keep tossing until noodles are cooked and all the sauce has been absorbed. If noodles dry out before it is cooked, add a splash of water.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add chicken back into the wok and toss to mix, then push noodles to one side to make room for eggs. Add a little more oil to the empty space, add eggs, then break the yolks. Put the noodles over the eggs and let sit for about 30 seconds so the eggs can cook.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Toss everything to mix the eggs, then turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Stir in green onions and/or cilantro.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve immediately with extra sauce if desired. Enjoy!

title: Jalapeno Corn Cakes
description: Quick and easy Jalapeno Corn Cakes that are gluten free and vegetarian. The perfect Mexican side dish!

ingredients.name: cooked yellow corn ((or 2 15-ounce cans of whole kernel corn))
large jalapeño peppers (deviened and finely diced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of yellow corn, onion, eggs, cilantro, salt, garlic powder and black pepper. Blend using an immersion blender (or regular stand blender) until the mixture is mostly smooth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add in remaining yellow corn, yellow corn meal, baking powder and jalapenos. Stir until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in large frying pan over medium-high heat. Using an ice cream scoop, drop scoops of the mixture into the pan and pan fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. (If you don't have an ice cream scoop, measure out about 3 heaping tablespoons per corn cake.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Season corn fritters with more salt and pepper, if necessary, and serve with crème fraîche or sour cream, freshly diced jalapenos and cilantro.

title: Kibbeh Recipe (How to Make Kibbeh)
description: In this kibbeh recipe, a mixture of bulgur wheat, onions, and ground beef forms a hollow shell for a delicious stuffing.

ingredients.name: medium yellow onion, finely chopped or grated
ground lamb or beef (I used beef here), cold

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cover a fine mesh strainer with a light cloth (a cheesecloth, if you have one). Add the bulgur wheat in, then place the strainer into a bowl filled with water. Let the fine bulgur wheat soak in the water for 15 minutes, then pull the cloth, holding the bulgur, and squeeze all the water out. You may do this a couple of times until you are sure the bulgur is rid of water. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now make the kibbeh (the actual dough that you will later use to form the kibbeh shells). Put the onion, ground beef, spices and pinch of salt into the bowl of a large food processor. Process until the meat is very finely ground almost into a paste. Transfer the meat mixture into a large bowl and add the bulgur wheat. Use damp hands to combine the bulgur with the meat mixture to make a dough. Cover and refrigerate until later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now make the filling. Heat about 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet or frying pan. Saute the onion until just golden, then add the ground beef. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the meat is fully browned. Add the toasted pine nuts, the spices, and the salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the kibbeh dough from the fridge.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To stuff the kibbeh, you need to have damp hands. Place a small bowl of water next to you. Prepare a baking sheet and line it with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: With both the bowl of kibbeh dough and the filling near, you can begin stuffing the kibbeh. Dampen your hands with some water, take a handful of the kibbeh dough (about 2 tbsp or so) and form into somewhat of an oval-shaped disc in the palm of one hand. Use your finger to make a well in the middle of the disc, and gradually hallow the disc out to make a larger well or hole for the filling. Using a spoon, add about 1 tablespoon of the filling. Seal the dough on top and, using both hands, carefully shape it into an oval (football-type shape). Place the stuffed kibbeh on the baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Repeat the stuffing steps until you run out, be sure to have damp hands throughout.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Chill the stuffed kibbeh for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees F (you’ll want the oil hot enough that you can see some gentle bubbling, but not too hot where it will burn the kibbeh shells). Deep-fry the kibbeh in the hot oil, in batches being carefully not to crowd them, until the kibbeh shells are brown (about 5 minutes or so). With a slotted spoon or tongs, carefully remove the kibbeh and place them on a pan lined with paper towel to drain. Repeat until you have fried all the stuffed kibbeh.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve hot or at room temprature with tahini sauce, tzatziki sauce or plain Greek yogurt. Enjoy!

title: Greek Roast Chicken recipe (Kotopoulo sto fourno)
description: A super easy Greek roast chicken recipe (kotopoulo sto fourno) for a hearty meal! Take your roast chicken to the next level with this Greek recipe with a twist!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Into a bowl, add 1 tbsp of salt and pepper, the garlic powder, the onion powder, 1/2tbsp oregano and a knob of butter and mix with your hands. Stuff the mixture under the skin of the chicken and place into a large pan. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use a knife to peel and cut the potatoes into wedges; add the potatoes into the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, pour the beer, add the mustard, honey, garlic, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper. With a spoon, mix the ingredients and pour the sauce over the chicken and potatoes. Season with some extra salt and pepper, if you like.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 for 75-90 minutes (depending on the size of the chicken), until the potatoes are tender and the chicken golden brown. Half time through cooking, turn the chicken upside down. Enjoy!

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
description: Sauteed Mushrooms - perfectly tender, juicy mushrooms sauteed with garlic, thyme, onion, Creole seasoning and Worcestershire sauce. Best served as an appetizer or side dish to almost anything. Quick, easy and utterly tasty!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Damp paper towel, then use to clean mushrooms one at a time, wipe the outside and underside to remove any dirt. If using small mushrooms, rinse under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove stems, if desired, and cut caps into half or desired size. Small mushrooms can be left whole.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a large skillet or cast iron on medium to high heat. Then add olive oil, swirl to coat bottom the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add mushrooms, season with salt and creole seasoning – stir for a few minutes until slightly brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Next add garlic, onions , thyme and Worcestershire sauce. Continue cooking and stirring. Remove from heat. Serve and garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Hot Corn Dip
description: A creamy, cheesy, and delightfully tangy dip guaranteed to be the life of the party! Sweet, crunchy corn melds with gooey cheese and smoky bacon for a one-of-a-kind dip that's addictively delicious.

ingredients.name: ears of fresh corn ((or one pound of frozen corn or two 15-ounce cans, drained))
(118g) grated cheddar cheese, (divided (or a similar cheese))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350℉ (180℃).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove corn kernels from the cobs if using fresh corn. Drain corn if using canned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a large, heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Then add ½ tablespoon butter and let it melt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the corn, salt, and pepper. Sauté the corn, stirring occasionally, until the corn turns deep golden brown, approximately 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from heat and place corn in a bowl. If anything sticks to the skillet, lightly wipe it with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Melt the remaining ½ tablespoon of butter in the same skillet. Follow with the onions, jalapenos, bell peppers, smoked paprika, and garlic. Cook, stirring often, until the onions are translucent (about 2 minutes).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Finally, add the green onions and continue cooking for about a minute or until tender.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer to the bowl with the corn mixture. Add the mayonnaise, half of the Monterey jack, and half of the cheddar cheese, and mix well. Pour into a 4-inch square baking dish and sprinkle the remaining cheese on top. You can refrigerate or freeze it at this point until ready to bake.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake for 10-12 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown. Serve hot with taro chips or homemade tortilla chips.

title: Kulcha Recipe | Kulcha Bread
description: Kulcha is a popular North Indian flatbread with a soft and fluffy texture. It is made from a leavened dough of all-purpose flour, yogurt, leavening agents, oil, salt and sugar.

ingredients.name: curd ((yogurt) or 3 tablespoon yogurt + 1 tablespoon milk. can use cashew yogurt)
water (- for kneading, add more if required)
some oil (or ghee or butter for roasting)
to 2 tablespoons nigella seeds ((kalonji) or sesame seeds)

title: Stir Fried Corn with Pine Nuts (松仁玉米)
description: The sweet corn kernels, pine nuts, cucumber, and carrot are lightly seasoned with green onion, salt, and sugar. Every ingredient comes together to create a hearty meal that is nutty and sweet.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prep and chop veggies.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Whisk cornstarch into chicken stock. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pine nuts into a skillet and heat over medium heat. Stir the pine nuts frequently. When the pine nuts start to turn golden brown, turn to medium low heat. Cook and stir until for another minute, until the pine nuts turn light brown. Transfer to a plate to cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add oil to the same skillet and turn to medium high heat. Add green onion and stir a few times. Add carrot and corn. Stir and cook until the corn is thawed and the carrot starts to turn tender. If the skillet gets too hot, turn to medium or medium low heat. Add cucumber. Season with salt and sugar. Stir and cook for another minute, until the cucumber is cooked.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn off heat. Whisk the potato starch slurry again and swirl it into the skillet. Stir to mix well. (*see footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste the dish and add a bit more salt if necessary.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add toasted pine nuts. Stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Shredded Beef Szechuan Style
description: Szechuan Beef Shreds Stir fry

ingredients.name: celery ( , around 5 cm long or as needed)
green onion whites ( , cut into sections around 5 cm long)
tsp. dark soy sauce (, for better coloring )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef against the grain into thin slices. Then cut into shreds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the beef with all the seasonings expect cornstarch. Marinating for 15 minutes. Then mix cornstarch in. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add around 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in wok and fry celery for 1 minutes until just cooked.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the wok until hot firstly. Then place 1 tablespoon of oil and add garlic, ginger, scallion and pickled peppers. Fry until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Push all the content in the wok to one edge of the wok, add another 2 tablespoon of cooking oil in center and spread the beef shreds in. Gently fry When the beef begin to change color on surface, place 1 tablespoon of doubanjiang in.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add dark soy sauce, celery and salt if necessary. Mix well quickly. Serve hot!

title: Korean Shrimp Salad with Hot Mustard Dressing
description: This simple and refreshing salad is packed with flavors and heat! Perfect as an elegant starter, side dish or light meal!

ingredients.name: hot mustard powder (gyeoja, 겨자) (If using prepared paste, use 1 tablespoon and add 1 tablespoon water to thin it.)
large shrimp (21-25 counts, shelled and deveined (more if using smaller shrimp))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the mustard with 1 tablespoon of warm water. Set it aside for 5 to 10 minutes. Add the remaining dressing ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the cucumbers and pear into thin slices

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: OR if using optional bell peppers, julienne the fruit and vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Have a bowl of ice water ready near the stove top. Bring a small pot of water (4 cupto a gentle boil over medium heat. Add salt, lemon and shrimp and simmer uncovered until the shrimp turn opaque and curl, about 40 seconds. Remove immediately and plunge them into the ice water to stop cooking and chill. Drain.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove immediately and plunge them into the ice water to stop cooking and chill. Drain. Cut each shrimp in half lengthwise, if desired.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Nicely arrange the cucumber, pear and shrimp (or optional julienned vegetables and pear) on a plate. Spoon the dressing over, or serve it on the side. Garnish with optional radish sprouts and/or lemon.

title: Tom Yum Pizza พิซซ่าต้มยำกุ้ง
description: Please see broiler safety notes above before making!

ingredients.name: olive oil (*in the video it says 2 Tbsp which is incorrect, sorry!)
stalk lemongrass, bottom half only, thinly sliced
Kaffir lime leaves, finely julienned then roughly chopped to shorten
28-oz (796 mL) can whole peeled tomatoes, unsalted
Thai chili paste (nam prik pao), store bought or homemade
shallot or red onion, thinly sliced, optional
(100g) oyster mushrooms, bite-sized pieces, tossed lightly in oil
(100g) small shrimp, or is using larger shrimp half them horizontally (see note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and sugar until combined, then whisk in yeast. Make a well in the centre and add water and olive oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use your hands to gradually incorporate flour into water and knead until moisture is evenly distributed throughout the dough; the dough will look a little rough and not smooth, but that is okay.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut dough into 2 equal portions. Place each one in a well-oiled bowl or container large enough to contain double the volume of the dough. Flip dough and move it around so it is coated in oil. Cover and let dough rise in the fridge for at least 1 day and up to 3 days. If in a rush, you can let it rise at room temp for 1 ½ – 2 hours and bake it right away, but the flavour will not be as good this way.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring out dough 2 hours from fridge before shaping and baking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a medium pot, add olive oil and garlic and cook over low heat for about 3 minutes so garlic is gently bubbling, and smallest bits start to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, blitz tomatoes in a blender for a few seconds just until there are no more big pieces—you don't want a smooth puree here.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add blended tomatoes, Thai chili paste, and 2 Tbsp of fish sauce into garlic pot; stir to mix. Simmer gently for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until tomato sauce is thick and luscious.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a mortar and pestle, pound lemongrass until fine. Then add galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and Thai chilies and pound until there are no more big pieces of galangal left (lime leaves won't break down completely, that's okay). Alternatively, process herbs in a coffee/spice grinder until fine.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once sauce is done simmering, add herb mixture and simmer for another 3-5 minutes (it should look a bit too thick right now). Turn off heat and stir in 3 Tbsp of lime juice, which should thin it out to the right consistency.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning with remaining fish sauce and lime juice as needed. The sauce should have a bold tom yum flavour that leads with tartness, balanced by sweetness from chili paste.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Bring dough out from fridge 2 hours before baking so it comes to room temp.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Get your toppings ready; toss mushrooms in a bit of oil to prevent them from drying out in the oven.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Preheat broiler to high while you shape the pizza, and set rack to its highest position. Note: When I put my pizza on the highest rack, it is 3 inches away from the element. If your highest rack puts your pizza closer than that, see safely notes above.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: On a baking sheet that can be used under the broiler (so no non-stick sheets), sprinkle a generous amount of flour on it. Note: Do not line the sheet with any parchment, silicone mat, or anything else.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Place one piece of dough on baking sheet and press it down into a flat disk with your fingers.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Generously flour the top of dough, then flip it upside down. Then stretch or roll pizza out to 10 inches. You can stretch it upto 12 inches if you like really thin crust, but make sure it will still fit in the skillet if you're using my method of cooking. As you stretch dough, keep moving it to check that it slides freely; if not, add extra flour to the bottom to ensure that it will not stick.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Spread sauce onto dough (you'll need about 1/4 cup). Then top with shallots, shrimp, cheese and mushrooms.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Broil the top of pizza for 2 – 2 1/2 minutes or until the crust is well browned. Watch the pizza in the first minute and rotate the pan if browning is uneven. Baking sheet will buckle a bit under high heat, this is okay, as long as the pizza is not touching the element.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: While pizza is broiling, preheat a dry 12-inch skillet on the stove over high heat.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: Once pizza edges are puffed and browned, remove from broiler and use a spatula to quickly slide pizza onto preheated skillet to cook the bottom for another 2 minutes, or until bottom is well browned.

steps.title: Step 21
steps.description: Slide pizza onto a serving plate and sprinkle with chopped cilantro. Serve immediately!

title: Easy Paleo Tortillas
description: These Paleo Tortillas are pliable, won't break when folded and are perfect for taco night! Made from coconut flour, tapioca flour and eggs.

ingredients.name: large Pete and Gerry's Organic Eggs

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a small nonstick skillet over low-medium heat. (I typically heat up two skillets at a time so I can work in bigger batches and cook two tortillas at a time.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sift the tapioca flour, coconut flour, salt and onion powder into a large mixing bowl by dumping them into a fine-mesh strainer and shaking it into the bowl. This helps eliminate and prevent any lumps in the batter.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the almond milk and eggs.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk together until the batter is completely smooth and without any lumps.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour 1/4 cup of batter into the skillet and tilt the pan around in a circular motion with your wrist to evenly distribute the batter to make a larger circle. The batter should spread to about 7 inches in diameter. Don't make it too thin.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook on low-medium heat until the batter hardens a bit and the edges of the tortilla start to come up, about 60-90 seconds.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Carefully flip the tortilla over with a spatula and raise the heat to medium-high. Cook the tortilla for about 2 to 2 1/2 more minutes, flipping the tortilla one or two more times until both sides have beautiful brown spots on them.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer the tortilla to a plate, move the skillet off the burner and let cool for 30-60 seconds. Reduce heat to low and repeat the cooking process until all the batter is used.

title: Pork bites with Greek Yogurt sauce
description: Deliciously light with a creamy, wine flavoured sauce, these little pork bites with yogurt will amaze you! Discover this refreshing, mid-week 40 minute or less recipe here!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat up the olive oil in a large pan, dice the pork in cubes and sizzle until golden brown.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in the wine and add salt and pepper and half a cup of water. Cover the pan, lower the heat and let it simmer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Right before the sauce thickens, add the dry rosemary, stir and cover the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the sauce thickens, remove pan from the stove and remove the meat, while leaving the sauce in the pan. Let it cool down for a few minutes before adding the yogurt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Slowly add the yogurt while stirring with a whisk till creamy. Re-add the meat and stir until fully covered in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with some rice and a twig of fresh rosemary.

title: Sage- Wine Braised Beef Short Ribs and Potatoes
description: How about a hearty bowl of sage-wine braised beef short ribs and potatoes?

ingredients.name: bone-in beef short ribs; ask the butcher to trim fat and cut short ribs into smaller 3-inch pieces
2-3 large russet potatoes, peeled, washed, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine 1 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1 tsp pepper, paprika and ground cardamom in a small bowl. Spice short ribs generously on all sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a French/Dutch oven or heavy braising pot, heat 2 tbsp of vegetable oil. Deeply brown the short ribs on all sides on medium-high heat. Remove from pot and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add more oil to the pot if needed and bring heat to medium, saute the potatoes, celery, and red onion, for about 10 minutes; toss occasionally. Season the vegetables lightly with seasoned salt and black pepper. Remove from pot and set aside briefly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now in the same pot, add diced tomatoes, garlic, sage, and bay leaves. Cook together for 5-7 minutes or until the tomato turns a rusty red. Then stir in the flour to coat the tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the red wine and broth, and raise the heat. Cook over high heat until the liquid is slightly reduced, about 7 minutes. Add a dash of seasoned salt to your taste.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Now add the meat and sauteed vegetables back to the pot, and let everything cook together on medium-high, uncovered, for about 5-7 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover the pot and transfer to the 300 degree F-heated oven for two hours or until short ribs are fork-tender. Serve in bowls with your favorite crusty bread!

title: Baked Yuca Fries
description: Baked yuca fries (cassava) give you a crunchy, slightly sweet treat that makes a great healthy alternative to the usual French fries. Simply guilt-free snacks!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut off both ends of the cassava and then cut it in half.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make a shallow cut into the skin and gradually work your knife under the layer of the cassava to remove the skin.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut it into desired shapes, rinse the cassava, and place it in a pot with salt, sugar, and water, just enough to barely cover.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring to a boil and cook on medium heat until fork tender. Do NOT overcook the cassava. Drain the water from the cooked cassava.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper and place the cassava in a single layer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle with garlic and parsley, and coat the cassava with cooking spray or oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake in a 425℉/220℃ oven for 20 minutes or until slightly brown, turning once.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm with hot sauce or aioli.

title: South Indian Filter Coffee
description: South Indian Filter Coffee is a traditional coffee beverage made with filter coffee powder, water, milk and sugar. The coffee decoction is brewed in a South Indian coffee filter and mixed with hot milk and sugar before serving.

ingredients.name: sugar (– for each glass or mug or add as required)

steps.description: Making coffee decoction

steps.title: Step 2

title: Szechuan Pan Fried Peppers (Tiger Skin Peppers, 虎皮尖椒)
description: These peppers are pan fried until blistered and tender, then cooked in a sour, savory sauce. The finished dish is hot, flavorful, and appetizing and will add a nice sizzle to your dinner table!

ingredients.name: and 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil ((or vegetable oil))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine soy sauce, black rice vinegar and sugar in a small bowl. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut peppers from the top to the end. Remove stem and seeds with a knife or spoon (*see footnote).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon oil to a large nonstick skillet (or a wok). Heat over medium heat until warm.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add peppers. Cook and stir until the peppers turn tender and the color turns yellowish green, and the skin is blistered nicely, about 15 minutes. Turn to low heat if the skillet starts to smoke. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil and garlic. Turn to medium high heat. Stir a few times until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add peppers back to the skillet. Stir a few time.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the sauce onto the peppers. Cook and stir until the sauce thickens, 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm or cold, over steamed rice or by itself as a side.

title: Oi Sobagi (Stuffed Cucumber Kimchi)
description: This stuffed cucumber kimchi, called oi sobagi, is an easy kimchi to make! Being a summer favorite in Korea. It’s crisp, crunchy and deliciously refreshing!

ingredients.name: coarse sea salt (less if using finer salt)
sugar - optional (or use any of your favorite sugar substitute)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse cucumbers. Cut off both ends. If using long Korean cucumbers, cut in half (or thirds if long) crosswise.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 6 cups of water with 1/2 cup of salt in a medium size pot. Bring it to a boil. Turn the heat off. Pour the boiling water over the cucumbers in a bowl. Keep the cucumbers submerged by weighing them down with a bowl or plate. Let it sit until the cucumbers are bendable, about an hour or two, depending on your cucumbers and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, cut the chives into 1/2 inch lengths. Julienne the radish (or onion), and then cut into the same lengths.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine all the stuffing ingredients along with 1/4 cup of water, and mix well. It should taste slightly salty.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain the cucumbers. Holding the top end of the cucumber on the cutting board, run a small knife through the middle lengthwise. Leave 1/2 inch uncut at both ends. Turn the cucumber and make another cut through the middle lengthwise to make a cross cut, again leaving 1/2 inch uncut at both ends. Repeat with all the cucumbers.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Gently open each slit and insert about a teaspoonful or two of the stuffing. Be sure to fill all 4 slits of each cucumber. Repeat until all the cucumbers are stuffed. Place them in a jar or an airtight container. Leave it out at room temperature for a day. Then, store in the fridge.

title: Beef with Sha Cha Sauce
description: Sha Cha beef–stir-fried beef slices with sha cha sauce

ingredients.name: small bunch of Yu Choy or Chinese broccoli

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into slices. Marinate with all the marinating seasonings for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blanch the vegetables | bring a large pot of water to a boiling and then add a small pinch of salt and 1 teaspoon of oil. Cook for 10-15 seconds until the vegetables are almost cooked. Do not kill the vegetable.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cooking oil in a large pan until the oil can evenly cover the bottom of the pan. spread the beef slices in. Let them stay for around 3-5 seconds and gently stir them several times until the color changes. Transfer the beef out immediately once the surface colors changes and leave around 1 tablespoon of the oil in. Save the extra oil for vegetable stir frying.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry garlic and sha cha sauce for around 30 seconds until aromatic. Add beef and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the beef slices to the serving plate with blanched vegetables.

title: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Tacos
description: These Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Tacos served with a cilantro lime coleslaw are easy to make and perfect for healthy weeknight meals! The recipe is gluten free and freezer-friendly.

ingredients.name: broth ((chicken, beef or vegetable will work))
