title: Chicken breasts with Tahini and Honey
description: Ready in only 15 minutes! The most juicy and delicious chicken breasts, with an amazing tahini and honey sauce! Tahini is a paste, made from ground, sesame seeds, that is commonly used in Greek cuisine.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash thoroughly the chicken breasts and dry them with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use a knife to cut the chicken breasts into large pieces (each one 3-4 pieces).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a large saucepan on high heat and add 2 tablespoons olive oil. Sauté the chicken breasts, for 3-4 minutes on each side, until nicely coloured. Add the soya sauce and stir. Sauté for 1 more minute, until cooked through (there should be no sign of pink). If the pieces are thick, turn the heat down and cook a little bit longer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat and add the tahini and honey and stir well. Let the chicken rest for 2 minutes and serve with a full spoon of yogurt on top. Serve with rice or pita breads.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To prepare the pita breads, use a cooking brush to oil the pita breads on both sides and season with salt and oregano. Place a large oven tray (upside down) at the bottom of the oven and place the pita breads on top of the tray. Bake in preheated oven at 250C for 1-2 minutes.

title: Rum Soaked Cake
description: This simple yet indulgent cake is light, moist, and loaded with boozy, buttery vanilla flavors. It may be a holiday staple, but it's so good I keep it around all year long.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rum Cake

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Butter Rum Sauce

title: Raspberry Juice Recipe
description: Raspberry Juice is a simple homemade drink made with fresh raspberries, water and sugar. The berries are blended until smooth and can be strained for a smoother texture. This juice has a naturally sweet-tart taste and a vibrant red color.

ingredients.name: to 5 tablespoons sugar (– adjust according to the sweetness of the raspberries)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the raspberries thoroughly and drain all the water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer them to a blender jar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the sugar and water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Blend until smooth and well combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Taste and adjust the sweetness if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For a slightly thinner consistency, add a little more water and blend again.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add lemon juice if desired and blend briefly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Strain the juice if you prefer a smoother texture.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour into serving glasses and serve fresh raspberry juice immediately or chill before serving for a few hours.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: For a colder drink, add a few ice cubes while serving.

title: Teriyaki King Oyster Mushroom
description: A super easy way to cook king oyster mushrooms to make a vegan dish that tastes better than meat!

ingredients.name: (14 oz. / 400 grams in total) large king oyster mushrooms
light soy sauce ((or soy sauce, or tamari for gluten-free))
servings steamed white rice (, to serve with)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Halve king oyster mushroom lengthwise, then slice into 4mm (slightly more than 1/8 in, double the thickness of a 1-dollar coin) thick slices. Transfer to a big plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine light soy sauce, Japanese sake, and sugar in a small bowl. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a dining spoon to distribute the sauce over the mushrooms. Mix with chopsticks until the mushrooms are evenly covered with the sauce. Marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon peanut oil to a nonstick skillet and heat over medium high heat until warm. Add 2 teaspoons green onion and stir a few times.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook mushrooms in batches. Spread them across the skillet without overlapping them. Save the marinating liquid for later use.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Let mushrooms grill without stirring them. When the skillet gets hot, turn to medium heat (or low heat if the skillet starts to smoke). When the bottom side turns golden, flip with chopsticks (or tongs) to grill the other side. Keep grilling and flipping, until both sides turn golden brown, with slightly charred edges. The process took me 8 minutes, but your cooking time will vary depending on the type of stove you’re using. Transfer the mushrooms to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and 2 teaspoons of green onion. Continue to cook the remainder of the mushrooms. The cooking process will be shorter this time, since the skillet is quite hot already. Adjust heat between low and medium to cook the mushrooms slowly, with the skillet remaining hot. The mushrooms should be slightly charred and dehydrated without getting burnt. (I cooked two batches with a 9" / 24 cm skillet. You might need to cook more (or fewer) batches depending on the amount of mushrooms and the size of your skillet. Be sure to adjust the amount of oil accordingly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When the last batch of mushrooms is cooked, add the previous batch(es) back into the skillet.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour the marinade over the mushrooms. Keep cooking over medium low heat until the liquid is absorbed, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place the mushrooms onto the steamed rice. Garnish with the remaining 2 teaspoons of green onion and the sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Coca Cola Chicken Wings
description: This Coca Cola Chicken Wings are easy to make. Only one bottle of coca cola is required for the flavoring. Slightly sweet taste.

ingredients.name: tbsp. light soy sauce ( ,optional for a mild spicy version)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make some cuts on the back of the chicken wings, making the flavors better absorbing.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the chicken wings to cold water and cookign wine. Cook for about 1 minute after boiling. This is optional, but it helps to remove the odd taste further.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add about 1/2 tablespoon of cooking oil to a pan and fry the chicken wings until slightly browned. This step is a must. Browned and crispy surface brings lots of flavors.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add coca cola in with allions and several slices of ginger. Then season with a very small pinch of salt, light soy sauce and oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cola to the chicken wings. Simmer for 10 minutes, then turn up the fire and cook for another 10 minutes. During this process, pick up ginger and scallion and remove the floats on the surface.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook until all the sauce is coated on the chicken wings. Serve hot!

title: Easy Arrabiata Sauce
description: This Easy Arrabiata Sauce recipe is made with simple pantry ingredients like diced tomatoes and red pepper flakes. Great on pasta, meatballs and pizza! #arrabiata #pastasauce #arrabiatasauce #marinara #pasta

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a medium pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the onions and saute for 3 minutes. Add the garlic and saute for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Reduce heat to medium and add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chicken stock, basil, parsley, red pepper flakes and salt. Simmer until reduced slightly, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use an immersion blender (or regular blender) to blend the sauce to your desired consistency. I like my sauce fairly blended, but I know some others like it chunky.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Taste and season with more salt, if needed. Serve immediately or let it cool down completely before placing it in an airtight container to store in the refrigerator.

title: Stuffed Pork Tenderloin with Feta cheese
description: The most juicy and tender stuffed pork tenderloin with an amazingly creamy wine sauce! Spice it up using some spicy feta cheese or even some red chili peppers.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the stuffed pork tenderloin, slice the tenderloin open lengthwise in half, being careful not to slice all the way down. Place one of the tenderloin between two sheets of cling film and bash with a rolling pin, to thin and flatten the tenderloin, until 1-1/2 cm thick. Repeat the same process with the rest tenderloins.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the filling for the stuffed pork tenderloins. Finely chop the pepper, the garlic and parsley. Use a fork to smash the feta cheese and leave aside. Place the tenderloins on the board and top them with feta cheese, pepper, parsley and garlic. Add a pinch of dried oregano and season with pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roll tightly the stuffed pork tenderloins lengthwise and use some kitchen string to tie the whole thing together (3-4 strings for each tenderloin). Preheat the oven to 170C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a pan over high heat. Use a pan that can also be used in an oven. Add 2 tbsps of butter and 3 tbsps olive oil. Sear the tenderloin on all sides, until nicely colored.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove, season with salt and pepper, add a knob of butter and place into the preheated oven. Cook for approx. 20-25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the oven and place the stuffed pork tenderloins on a platter, cover with some aluminum foil and let them rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the sauce. Place the pan with all the juices back on the stove on high heat and add 1/2 glass of white wine. Use a wooden spoon to scratch from the bottom of the pan all the delicacies. Wait until half of the wine evaporates and then add the cream. Stir using a spoon and turn the heat down. Let it simmer for 3 minutes, stirring once in a while, to prevent it from forming a crust.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Unwrap the tenderloins and with a sharp knife cut and remove the kitchen strings. Slice the stuffed pork tenderloins into pieces and pour over the white wine sauce. Serve with some fluffy rice and enjoy!

title: Roasted Mashed Sweet Potato with Thyme and Molasses
description: This simple roasted mashed sweet potato recipe takes inspiration from Batata Mashwiya, the roasted sweet potatoes of my childhood.
tags: sweet potato with thyme and molasses

ingredients.name: springs fresh thyme, leaves picked off stems, divided

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare large pieces of aluminum foil in a baking pan. Place each sweet potato in its own foil. Top with a drizzle of olive oil and salt. Fold the aluminum foil tightly sealing the sweet potatoes into their own pouches. Roast in the 400 degrees F heated-oven for 1 hour or until very soft (if the flesh busts out of the potato skins, that is a good sign.) Remove from the oven and let cool briefly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the sweet potatoes are cool enough to handle, peel and discard some of the skin but not all. Transfer the sweet potatoes to a pot or bowl and mash with a potato masher or fork. Now add the butter, nutmeg, 1/2 the amount of thyme, and the molasses. Stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with the remaining thyme, walnut halves and a drizzle of molasses. If you like, keep extra molasses and walnuts handy for individuals’ use. Enjoy!

title: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas - crispy, crunchy, easy healthy snack that can be made with canned or dried chickpeas and comes in two flavors - savory and sweet!

ingredients.name: 15-ounce can chickpeas (drained and dried thoroughly ) or use dry chickpeas, soaked overnight.
15-ounce cans of chickpeas, drained, rinsed, and dried

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 Degrees F about (204 degrees C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a baking or cookie sheet with a parchment paper, foil or a nonstick baking mat. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: The next step is to drain, rinse and dry the canned chickpeas really well, using a paper towel or dish towel, making sure you remove all the moisture. You can discard any excess skin that comes from the chickpeas.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the chickpeas on the baking sheet and then air dry for about 10-15 minutes, for best results.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roast for about 30-40 minutes, shaking the pan 1-2 times throughout.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the oven and toast with oil , followed by spices (either sweet or savory). Return to the oven and bake until the chickpeas are crunchy - an extra 10 or more minutes, depending on your oven or chickpeas brand. Toss once halfway through baking.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Also, keep a close eye on the chickpeas. The last few minutes of cooking is crucial. They do brown up pretty fast.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let it cool for at least 1 hour; the chickpeas will become crunchier as they cool.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Allow to cool. Store in an airtight container in a dry pantry for up to 1 week.

title: Black Sesame Salad Dressing
description: Black sesame dressing is a creamy sauce with a sweet, sour, and nutty flavor. It uses mayonnaise as the base, but the fruity vinegar gives the veggies a nice kick. I can devour a big bowl of salad in one sitting with this dressing!

ingredients.name: mixed green salad to serve with (*see footnote)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium low heat and add black sesame seeds. Cook and stir occasionally until fragrant, in 5 to 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer sesame seeds to a mortar and grind with a pestle until turned into coarse flakes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt, and half the sesame seed flakes in a medium-sized bowl and mix well. Smash garlic into a paste and add it into the bowl. Taste the dressing and add more sesame seeds if you prefer it a bit nuttier. Mix well and let it stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wash and prepare vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drizzle dressing on salad before serving.

sunflower oil (or any neutral flavored oil)
raw sugar (or brown sugar or demerara sugar)
cornstarch ((known as cornflour in UK & India))

title: Deep-Fried Pork Rolls (Dwaegi Gogi Mari Twiguim)
description: Pork rolls deep fried in light batter -- crispy outside with a burst of flavor inside!

ingredients.name: thin pork slices (about ⅛ - inch thick)
fresh ginger grated (or 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder)
Korean perilla leaves (available in Korean markets)
- 4 green chili peppers (or 1 green bell pepper, julienned)
- 4 red chili peppers (or 1 red bell pepper, julienned)
canola or vegetable oil for deep frying
*A premade batter mix can be found in Korean/Asian markets. If unavailable, beat 1 egg yolk in a bowl and mix in 3/4 cup ice water. Add 1 cup of flour. Mix until combined.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season the pork slices with ginger, salt and pepper. Set aside while preparing vegetables.Wash the perilla leaves and pat dry them. Julienne the peppers, about 4-inches long.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To put together a roll, dredge a pork slice in the flour and place it on a flat surface. Place a perilla leaf on top along with 4 or 5 pieces of each color pepper. Wrap the pork and perilla leaf around the pepper pieces, folding in the sides. Roll up to form a nice finger shape. Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients. Set aside while preparing the oil and the batter.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil to 375 degrees (or until it barely starts to smoke). In a small bowl, mix the batter with ice water for only a few seconds just until combined. (It is okay to have some visible lumps in the mixture. Do NOT over mix.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roll the pork rolls in the flour to coat lightly. Shake off excess. Dip one pork roll at a time in the batter, coat well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Carefully add to the hot oil. Fry only 4 at a time, depending on the size of the fryer. (Overcrowding the oil will lower the temperature of the oil, resulting in soggy and oily rolls.) Flip over and fry until golden on both sides, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack. Wait until the oil reaches 375 again before frying the second batch.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve immediately with a sauce.

title: Homemade Asian Pork Meatballs (look chin moo)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Sweet chili sauce (store bought or homemade)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grind peppercorns in a mortar and pestle into a powder, then add garlic and pound into a fine paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the garlic paste and all remaining ingredients, except the ice cubes, into a food processor.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Process the pork until very smooth, adding ice cubes gradually as the machine grinds. Stop to scrape 2-3 times to make sure everything is evenly ground.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the pork looks very fine (about 5 minutes on my machine) transfer into a bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large pot, add water so that it's about half full. Heat the water on high just until there is steam coming off the top but there is no bubbling in the water. Once this is reached, turn heat down to low to maintain the temperature.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Using the technique shown in the video, form the meatballs and place them into the hot water one at a time until you have finished. If you want to see the technique over and over again without having to rewind, watch this 7-min video of me just squeezing meatballs! Keep an eye on the temperature to make sure the water isn't bubbling. If you don't need them to be round, you can just use two spoons to form a lump and plop them into the water, or you can also use a small disher.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once all the meatballs are in the water, let them cook for another 10-15 minutes until the last meatballs are cooked through. TIP: Make the last few meatballs a bit misshapen so you can easily identify them and use them to check doneness.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once done, remove them with a slotted spoon. They're now ready to use!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Save the cooking water to make soup because it's now very flavourful. I usually just season it more and use it to make noodle soup which I serve with the meatballs I've just made.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To make grilled, skewered meatballs (look chin ping)

title: Spicy Lentil Soup
description: This Spicy Lentil Soup makes for a simple and hearty dinner. Full of healthy ingredients, it's an easy recipe that will keep you full and warm all season long (freezer friendly, gluten free)

ingredients.name: cooked and cubed ham, (about 3 cups - perfect use of leftovers!)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pot or dutch oven over medium-high heat, add oil, onions and garlic. Cook for about 2 minutes, until the garlic is fragrant and the onions have begun to soften.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add carrots, celery and sea salt. Cook for about 8 minutes or until veggies have softened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining ingredients except the ham. Mix together, bring to a boil and cover with lid. Reduce heat to simmer and cook for about 35 minutes, until the lentils are soft and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To thicken the soup, use an immersion stick blender to blend a bit of the soup until it reaches your desired consistency. I gave the soup 5 or 6 quick pulses. You can also transfer a cup or two of soup into a stand blender, blend and then return to the pot. Alternatively, if you like the thickness of the soup as it is, you don't have to blend it at all! It's up to you.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the ham, cover and cook for another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste and season with salt as necessary. Serve with warm bread and garnish with a fresh sprig of thyme.

title: Roasted Eggplant Caprese Salad Recipe
description: A little embellishment on the classic Caprese salad, this roasted eggplant Caprese is a filling and delicious appetizer with a special basil vinaigrette. Exceptional!

ingredients.name: large or steak tomatoes, sliced into 1/2-inch rounds
basil leaves, more for the dressing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spread the eggplant slices on a large tray and sprinkle generously with salt. Leave for 30 minutes; the eggplant will “sweat out” it’s bitterness. When ready, pat the eggplant dry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the eggplant slices and the tomato slices on a large baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil. Roast in the 425 F degree heated-oven for 10-15 minutes. Remove from the oven, but leave the oven on for step # 5.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the eggplant and tomatoes are cool enough to handle, bring a small baking dish (about 6″x 9″) and begin to assemble the Caprese salad. Arrange the eggplant, tomato, cheese and basil in the baking dish forming a tight row. Repeat the pattern (as you see in the tutorial picture below) until you fill the baking dish side-to-side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you like, place the baking dish in the oven to heat for 7-10 minutes (just until the cheese melts slightly).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the Caprese salad warms up, make the basil vinaigrette. In a small food processor, blend the chopped garlic with the basil leaves, olive oil, lime juice and spices.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ready, remove the roasted eggplant Caprese salad from the oven and spoon some of the basil vinaigrette on top. Place the extra basil vinaigrette in a bowl to serve next to the salad. Slice a loaf of crusty bread to serve along. Enjoy!

title: Hashbrown Breakfast Casserole
description: Hashbrown Breakfast Casserole – easy make-head breakfast casserole with tender hashbrown and bacon in a creamy cheesy sauce baked until hot and bubbly. A delicious holiday or lazy days’ breakfast or brunch for the whole family!

ingredients.name: sour cream ((I used light sour cream))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and grease a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray or oil. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat skillet over medium heat , then add oil or butter until melted , followed by onions , garlic , bell pepper, and green onions - saute for about 2-3 minutes .Remove from skillet and set Aside

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add butter to skillet until melted , Then add flour and whisk until fully dissolved.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Slowly pour in the milk while stirring consistently followed by the chicken stock. Season with salt, freshly ground black pepper and Creole seasoning and stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Throw in half of the shredded cheese and stir well until fully melted. Then add the sour cream and stir for about a minute. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large glass bowl, add thawed hashbrown, cooked bacon and saute bell pepper and onion combination. Stir well until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the mixture into the greased baking dish and top with remaining cheese . Place in the preheated oven and bake for 40-45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let it stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pork Pouches with Potatoes, Peppers, Onions (Xoirino Kleftiko or Exohiko)
description: Juicy and full of flavors! Surprise your guests with this Greek Pork kleftiko (Exohiko) and let them wonder what is hidden inside these cute little pouches!

ingredients.name: kg/ 35 ounces pork (leg, without the bones)
150-200g kefalotyri or graviera or any hard yellow cheese (6-7 ounces)
large potatoes, cut into slices or wedges

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash thoroughly the pork and cut into portions. Place the pork into a large bowl, along with the onions, peppers, garlic and mustard. Pour in the wine and the olive oil and season with salt, pepper and oregano. It is better to leave the pork marinade for 1-2 hours in the fridge. That will help the pork to absorb all the flavours and become more tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the potatoes into slices, or wedges, approx. 0.7 cm thick and chop the cheese into cubes. Wrap the pork in little pouches, using some grease proof paper. Cut the grease proof paper into large pieces, approx. 30*45 and arrange them on a table. In the middle of each piece layer 3-4 slices of potatoes and season with some salt. Top the potatoes with some meat and some of the ingredients of the marinade, along with the juices. Top the meat with some cubes of cheese.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut some kitchen string. Hold the grease proof paper from the edges, crosswise and grab with your hand in the middle, just above the stuffing and squeeze. Use the kitchen string to tie tightly the whole thing together, just above the stuffing. Repeat with the rest of the mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the pouches into a baking tray, and bake in a preheated oven at 180C for 85-90 minutes. Cut the kitchen strings and serve as it is.

title: Kaju Shake (Kaju Anjeer Milkshake)
description: Kaju Milkshake is a creamy and thick beverage made with cashews, dried figs and milk. Soaked cashews give the milkshake a smooth texture, while figs add natural sweetness and flavor.

ingredients.name: to 2 teaspoons raw sugar (or jaggery powder or white sugar, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and then soak the cashews and figs in hot water for about 30 to 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soaking softens the figs and they are easy to blend. Before blending, check the softness of figs. If they are not softened enough, then you will need to soak for some more time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the water and transfer the soaked cashews and figs to a blender. You can also chop the soaked figs and add.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour ½ cup of the chilled milk.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Blend to a smooth puree. Coarse bits of figs are fine, if you want the chewy texture of figs. Or else just blend till smooth.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the remaining 2 cups of chilled milk and blend again well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Check the capacity of your blender jar and add milk accordingly. Note: If the jar is small, then mix the figs-cashews puree and the remaining milk in a bowl or pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: If needed, add 1 to 2 teaspoon of raw sugar, white sugar or jaggery powder.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour kaju milkshake in glasses and serve immediately for the best flavor and texture.

title: Crispy Guljeon (Korean-style Oyster Fritters)
description: Crispy guljeon is Korean-style oyster fritters! Made with the typical savory pancake batter, loaded with oysters, and fried to perfection!

ingredients.name: buchim garu (ready-made pancake mix or flour (see note))
pinch of gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the oysters by gently swishing them around in salted water. Drain. Rinse again in clean water and keep them in a strainer over a bowl to drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Finely chop the carrot, scallion, and mushrooms.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the pancake mix, starch and baking soda and whisk well. Mix with 3/4 cup icy cold water. Add a tablespoon or two more if needed. The batter should be slightly thick but still runny.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the oyster with the sesame oil, and then add to the batter along with the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat 1/4-inch oil in a non-stick pan over medium high heat. Add about 2 heaping tablespoons of the batter, and spread it evenly into a small round shape. Depending on the size of your pan, you can cook 5 to 6 pancakes at once. Cook until the bottom is golden brown, about 2 minutes on each side. Repeat the process with the remaining batter. Serve hot with a dipping sauce.

title: Tofu & Corn Laab (Vegan)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: uncooked jasmine rice or sticky rice (for toasted rice powder)
kaffir lime leave (optional, for toasted rice powder)
Roasted chili flakes, to taste, or use any chili flakes you have
mint leaves, torn into small pieces if large
Lettuce or cabbage leaves for serving, optional
Jasmine rice or sticky rice for serving, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make toasted rice powder: In a dry saute pan, add the rice and the kaffir lime leaf, if using, and stir constantly over high heat until the rice has a deep brown colour (see video for colour). Remove from heat immediately and transfer into a mortar and pestle or a coffee grinder. Grind until fine (yes, grind the lime leaf too), but if using a coffee grinder, be careful not to over-grind—you don't want it to look like flour, you still want a bit of grittiness to it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Crumble the tofu into small pieces with your hands.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium pot, add about 2 Tbsp of water then turn the heat on high. Add tofu and corn and stir until hot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn off the heat then add shallots, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and chilies; stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add soy sauce, Golden Mountain Sauce and lime juice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When ready to serve stir in toasted rice powder, mint and cilantro. (Don't add these too far in advance as the rice will absorb the liquid and make it dry, and the herbs will wilt.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with lettuce leaves and eat like a bite-sized lettuce wrap, or serve with jasmine or sticky rice as part of a meal.

title: Chinese 5 spice recipe

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

title: Pomegranate Chicken Thigh Recipe
description: Pomegranates are everywhere these days. How about a Persian-inspired pomegranate chicken thigh recipe? Warning: you will want to make extra of this yummy chicken.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the spice rub by combining the rub ingredients in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat chicken thighs dry and begin to apply the spice rub generously. Be sure to lift skin carefully and apply some or the spice rub underneath; this is very important for flavor.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place chicken in a large dish on a bed of red onions (use 1/2 the amount of onions you sliced earlier). Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Take chicken out of the fridge and let sit in room temperature for 15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When ready, heat one tbsp of olive oil in a large and heavy skillet. Turn heat to medium-high and brown chicken thighs on both sides, beginning with skin-side. Place browned chicken in a large roasting pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To the same skillet, add a little more oil, if needed. Now, on medium-high heat, saute the remaining onion slices for 3-5 minutes or until slightly browned.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To the sauteed onions, add white wine and let simmer to reduce. Now add pomegranate molasses, bay leaf, seasoned salt, and chicken broth. Let the liquid simmer together for about 5-7 minutes to develop a nice pomegranate-wine sauce/broth.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove bay leaf and pour the pomegranate-wine sauce/broth over the chicken thighs in the roasting pan.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Cover and bake in 450 degree F-heated oven for 20 minutes. Then, uncover and bake on the lowest oven rack for another 25-30 minutes or until fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Remove from oven and let sit for five minutes.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve with a garnish of dried mint leaves and fresh pomegranate seeds.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Try these Greek potatoes as a side dish.

title: Quinoa Enchilada Bake
description: This Quinoa Enchilada Bake is a healthy Tex-Mex casserole that's easy to make and filled with lots of veggies like black beans, quinoa and enchilada sauce!

ingredients.name: chopped broccoli florets ((about 1 large bunch, stalks removed))
large red bell pepper, (chopped into chunks (about 1 1/2 cups))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place chopped broccoli, red bell peppers and onions on a large baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and add garlic powder, coriander, cumin, and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Toss together with your hands until well combined and roast in oven for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the veggies are roasting, cook the quinoa by placing it into a large saucepan with 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for about 15 minutes until all the water is absorbed. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce heat in oven to 375°F. In a large 3-quart baking dish, add cooked quinoa, roasted veggies, chopped green chiles, black beans, enchilada sauce, a generous pinch of salt and pepper and 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese. Mix together until enchilada sauce and cheese are evenly distributed in the mixture. Top with 1/2 cup remaining shredded cheese.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake for 20-25 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and melted.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve and garnish with avocados, tomatoes and cilantro, if desired.

title: Kontosouvli (Spit roasted BBQ pork)
description: Extra crispy and extra tasty! Kontosouvli is a large pork souvlaki, which is traditionally slow roasted on a rod over an open charcoal pit.

ingredients.name: pork(shoulder), cut into large pieces (28 ounces)
1-1.5 kg potatoes, cut into wedges (40-50 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the pork, cut into large pieces, into a bowl (large enough to mingle easily with the marinade). Season with salt and pepper and add a pinch of oregano.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a blender, add all the ingredients of the marinade and mix. Pour the mixture into the bowl with the pork and blend. Cover with some aluminum foil and put the bowl in the fridge for 3 hours. Ideally leave it overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Soak the wooden skewer into some water and thread the pieces of pork, comfortably, onto the skewer. In between the pieces of meat, add some sliced onion, pepper and tomato.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the kontosouvli on a large baking tray and add the potatoes, cut into wedges and season them with salt and pepper. Add 4 tbsps olive oil, 1/2 glass of water and sprinkle with a good pinch of oregano.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover with some aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven at 180C for 80 minutes. After 60 minutes, remove the aluminum foil and bake for another 20 minutes, until crunchy on the outside, tuning it upside down halftime through cooking time.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Tips: Use a piece of pork with some fat; this will make it even more delicious. While baking the pork, brush it with some olive oil an lemon juice; repeat 2-3 times. Personally, I prefer it, when the meat is a little burnt on the outside, as it reminds me of the traditional way of cooking it, over an open charcoal pit.

title: Chinese BBQ Sauce (叉烧酱)
description: This Chinese BBQ sauce has a rich, sweet, savory taste with well-balanced Asian notes of ginger and five spice. It is super fast to make and has a thick consistency.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix everything together in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat and stir constantly to dissolve the sugar. Simmer until the sauce has thickened just enough to coat the back of a spoon, 10 minutes or so. Remove it from the stove and let cool for 10 minutes. Then transfer to a container or heat-proof mason jar. The sauce will thicken further once cooled. It’s ready to use now, or you can store it sealed in the fridge for up to 4 days.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: The sauce is perfect with pork, chicken, beef, and seafood. You can serve it alongside cooked food. Or use it as a glaze to finish up grilled or baked meat. For example, you can use it to make Instant Pot Pork Ribs.

title: Twice Cooked Pork
description: Twice Cooked Pork (Double Cooked Pork) from China Sichuan Cuisine.

ingredients.name: small bunch garlic sprout ( , 3-4 ones, end removed and cut into pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place pork belly in a large pot with enough cold water to cover. Add 2 green onions, ginger, sichuan peppercorn and Shaoxing wine. Bring to boil and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes. If you are cooking a larger amount, cut the pork belly into 15cm sections. Transfer out and set aside to cool down. Then cut the pork belly into 1mm thick slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the garlic sprouts and leaves into 1.5-inch sections. Cut green peppers, chop the ginger, garlic, and green onions. Roughly chop dou-chi too.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up around 1 teaspoon of oil in a wok (not too much, otherwise the dish might be over greasy), and fry the pork belly for around 1-2 minutes (Note 2)until they begin to lose oil and are slightly brown and curled.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the pork slices out and leave oil only, fry doubanjiang over slow fire until the oil turns red. Add ginger, garlic, and scallion until aroma. Place dou-chi, fry for another half minute. Keep slow fire when adding the seasonings.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return pork slices and give a big stir fry to combine well. Add garlic sprouts, green peppers, and sugar, and pour in light soy sauce over the edge of the wok. Give everything a big stir fry to mix well. This process should be fast so the freshness won't be killed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with steamed rice.

title: Flank Steak Bulgogi
description: Korean beef bulgogi can be made with any good quality cut of meat. Flank steak is full of beefy flavor, but somewhat tough. This marinade with some juice from a can of pineapple quickly tenderizes the flank steak.

ingredients.name: rice wine (or mirin or white wine)
juice from a can of pineapple (use 100% juice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the meat (about ⅓ to ¼-inch thick) against the grain at a steep angle.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a bowl, and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the meat and scallions and mix well until evenly coated. Marinate at least for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a grill pan or a skillet over high heat and add the meat slices. Lower the heat as necessary. The marinade may burn if the heat is too high. Cook until the meat is cooked through and slightly caramelized, one to two minutes each side.

title: Gluten Free Enchilada Chicken Meatballs
description: These gluten free chicken meatballs are baked, covered in a red enchilada sauce and topped with cilantro, onions and cotija cheese for a new spin on the classic enchiladas!

ingredients.name: old fashioned oats, (lightly pulsed in a blender)
red enchilada sauce, (divided (or 2 10-ounce cans of store bought enchilada sauce))
Colby and Monterey Jack shredded cheese
optional toppings: cilantro, onion, tomatoes, sour cream or plain Greek yogurt

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the ground chicken, egg, oats, chia seeds, chili powder, salt, cumin, garlic powder and onion powder. Mix together with your hands and roll into 16 meatballs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the meatballs on the baking sheet and bake in oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a 3 quart baking dish, pour 1 cup of enchilada sauce. Place the meatballs in the dish and pour the rest of the enchilada sauce on top.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the meatballs with shredded cheese and bake for another 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from oven and garnish with toppings such as cilantro, onions, tomatoes, cotija cheese and more!

title: Phyllo Dough Meat Rolls Recipe
description: I have so been looking forward to sharing this recipe for my phyllo meat rolls! For a while, I debated between calling them phyllo dough meat rolls or meat cigars. I landed on rolls, but don't you think they kinda look like cigars? :-)

ingredients.name: olive oil, plus 1 cup for later
egg, mixed with little water (egg wash)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a non-stick pan. Add onions and saute briefly on medium-high.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add ground beef and spices. Cook on medium-high, stirring occasionally, until ground beef is fully cooked and browned (about 8 minutes). Set aside to cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When ground beef has cooled, combine it with the additional filling ingredients.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take 16 phyllo pastry sheets, more if needed, and lay them carefully in a large tray. Cover with a slightly damp kitchen towel (this will keep phyllo pastry from cracking or breaking).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Take two sheets of phyllo and lay them on a large cutting board. Brush phyllo generously with olive oil. With a good knife, cut right down the middle forming two long phyllo strips (see picture)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Take one phyllo strip and begin to make your first roll. Take a spoonful of the meat-cheese mixture and place on the short end of phyllo strip (the end closest to you). Roll away from you two times.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Fold in the phyllo strip sides all the way, and then continue to roll phyllo toward the other end (see picture).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Brush with a little more olive oil and egg wash. Place your first phyllo roll on a large and lightly oiled baking sheet. Repeat with the other phyllo strip.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Repeat with the process with remaining phyllo, working with two phyllo sheets at-a-time. You should end up with 16 phyllo dough meat rolls lined up nicely in your large baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place the phyllo rolls in the 400 degree F oven. Bake for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Remove from oven. Serve warm.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: You can add your favorite yogurt dip or sauce next to these phyllo meat rolls for dipping.

title: Angel Biscuits
description: A fabulous cross between bread and biscuits that's light, pillowy, and tasty. Perfect for breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner! What's not to love?As the name suggests, Angel Biscuits are the most tender, fluffy biscuits you'll ever make.

ingredients.name: (2 packages or 4½ teaspoons) active dry yeast

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Let it stand until creamy, about 5 minutes. Add buttermilk to the yeast mixture and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut shortening and butter into dry ingredients with a pastry cutter until the mixture looks like coarse meal.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the yeast mixture to the crumb mixture. Stir until well moistened.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place dough out onto a lightly floured board. Turn and gently knead the dough just until it comes together and appears smooth. It shouldn't take more than one minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: At this point, you can either cover the bowl and let it rise in the refrigerator overnight or at room temperature for 30-60 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ready to use, roll the dough out and cut with a biscuit cutter or form balls with your hands. The dough should be about ½- inch thick.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place on a greased baking sheet, cover, and let it rise for about 30 minutes. Then brush with butter.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake at 400℉ (205℃) for 12-18 minutes or until golden brown, depending on the size of your biscuits.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve with honey butter (or mix ⅔ cup butter with ⅓ cup honey).

title: Greek Jam Tart Recipe (Pasta Flora)
description: Looking for a traditional Greek jam tart recipe? Find out how to make this pasta flora dessert using your favorite kind of jam and wake up the whole family with its amazing smell!

ingredients.name: butter, plus extra for greasing (9 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the jam tart, start by softening the butter, being careful not to burn it. In the meantime, sieve the flour into a large bowl or basin (leave aside 2 tbsps of the flour). Add into a bowl the baking powder and the vanilla extract and blend. Pour in the butter, the egg yolk, the sugar, the lemon zest and the cognac and knead the pastry with your hands, until the ingredients are combined and the pastry is smooth and soft. Do not overwork the dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: You can either make one jam tart, or individual little tarts, using the appropriate sized trays.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To make one jam tart separate the dough in two pieces; use the one half to form the bottom of the tart. Butter the bottom and sides of a tart tray (30cm diameter). Dust a work surface and a rolling pin with flour. Roll out half the dough to fit the bottom of the tart pan approx. 1 cm thick. Carefully roll your pastry around the rolling pin and then unroll it over the tart pan and ease the dough into the dish, pushing it into all sides, and trimming the remaining dough. If the pastry tears or breaks, just patch it up.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roll out about 1/3 of the remaining pastry to make a strip (about a finger’s width), brush it with the egg white and place all around the raised sides of the tart pan, pressing it gently to join with the base.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread evenly the jam over the base. Roll out the remaining dough into thin strips, brush with egg white and decorate the tart, placing them in a latticework pattern, as seen in the picture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake the jam tart in preheated oven at 175C for 30-40 minutes, until nicely colored. Let it cool down for a while before serving, so that the jam thickens. Enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Pork Belly (Samgyupsal)
description: This slow cooked Korean flavored pork belly is great for bossam (pork wraps) or equally delicious simply served with some scallions (or spring mix).

ingredients.name: to 3 whole fresh pork belly (about 2 to 3-inch wide cut - 2.5 to 3 pounds)
doenjang (Korean fermented soybean paste, or use 1 more teaspoon salt)
Double this if you want to serve with a sauce.
liquid from cooking the pork belly, (strained through a strainer.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the seasoning ingredients in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the onion in half, and roughly slice each half, and place the slices at the bottom of the slow cooker in a single layer. Add 1/2 cup of water (or brewed coffee) to the slow cooker. Rub each pork belly with the seasoning mix. Place them on top of the onion.Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours (5 to 6 hours on low) until the pork reaches the desired tenderness.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Pour the sauce to a large pan, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Using a pair of kitchen tongs, add the meat and sear until all sides are nicely glazed with the sauce and the meat is slightly caramelized, a minute or two on each side. Do not burn the sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If doubling the sauce, use the same pan, after removing the meat, to boil the sauce over medium heat until slightly thickened. Adjust the salt level by adding a little bit of water if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the meat to a cutting board. Thinly slice crosswise.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve simply with the thinly sliced scallions, or serve with some lettuce and ssamjang. Drizzle the sauce over the meat if using extra sauce. See note.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To make pachae (thinly sliced scallions)

title: Almond Agar Jelly & Fruit Salad (Almond Float)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: + 2 tsp agar agar powder (what is agar agar?)
milk (or unsweetened milk substitute like almond or soy milk)
- 1½ tsp almond extract (depends how strong you like the flavour)
fruit mix of your choice: Papaya, mango, pineapple, grapes, strawberries

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a pot, add the water and stir in the agar agar powder. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once it comes to a full boil and the agar powder is dissolved, add milk and sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. If you want the dessert to last as long as possible, bring this mixture to a boil, otherwise you can turn it off now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir-in almond extract and pour into the mold. Let cool to room temp, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours or until cold.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a pot, combine sugar and water, and heat until the sugar is all dissolved and the syrup is just steaming but not boiling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn off the heat and add all "sturdy fruits", i.e. fruits that can stand to be cooked without turning into mush, leaving out anything that will turn mushy or discolour in the heat, like grapes and strawberries.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Let cool to room temp, then stir in the remaining "delicate fruits".

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Chill in the fridge for a few hours until cold and to give the fruit time to infuse their flavours into the syrup.

title: Easy Fig Pastry Recipe
description: Delicious flaky pastry with figs, goat cheese and walnuts. SUPER easy to make! Perfect as a dessert, appetizer or even as part of brunch.

ingredients.name: sheet of good store-bought puff pastry, thawed in fridge for 3 hours or so
walnuts, roughly chopped; more for garnish if desired

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Divide thawed puff pastry into four fairly equal rectangular pieces and place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spread goat cheese on each piece. Add jam, figs and then chopped walnuts.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Brush figs and edges of puff pastry with melted butter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Slightly turn pastry edges up.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in 375F oven for 18-20 minutes or until pastry is golden and puffy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with chopped mint leaves and more walnuts, if desired.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
description: Cream Cheese Pound Cake – a tender, moist and rich cream cheese pound cake with a hint of nutmeg glazed with mint-lime for overall satisfaction. Tasty and easy cake that is a must-served on your table every now and then.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-heat the oven to 160°C/325°F. Grease a 10 inch tube pan generously with cooking spray and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cream together the butter and sugar at high speed in a stand mixture until it’s fluffy and starting to look white, about 5- 7 minutes, add cream cheese and mix for another minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the eggs, a little at a time, beating the mixture well between each addition. Sift in the flour and baking powder into the batter, and then add the grated lime, nutmeg, and vanilla.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir well until everything is fully combined. Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour batter into a greased cake pan. Tap pans on work surface to eliminate any large air bubbles.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake at 325 until a tester inserted into the center comes out clean, 55–60minutes. Transfer to a wire rack.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a small pan combine water , lime juice, butter, mint leaves over low heat until the mixture bubbles around the edges. Remove from the heat and let it steep for 2 minutes .

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove all the moisture from the leaves and discard it .stir the lime zest and sugar into the liquid until smooth .

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Using a pastry brush the cake with mint-lime glaze.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let cake cool for 10 minutes

title: Litchi Juice (Lychee Juice)
description: Litchi Juice is a refreshing fruit drink made with fresh litchi (lychee) pulp, lemon juice, water and a sweetener. The ingredients are blended and mixed together to create a light and cooling beverage.

ingredients.name: water (– at room temperature or chilled, add as required)
to 4 tablespoons raw sugar (or white sugar, add as needed)
mint leaves (– for garnish as required, optional)
lemon slices (– for garnish, as required, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove the leathery skin of the lychee fruits.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the fleshy pulp with a paring knife or with clean fingers and discard the seeds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a blender, put all the lychee fruit pulp and make a smooth and fine puree of without adding any water. If needed, you can add in a few tablespoons of water while blending. Tiny unblended bits and pieces are alright in the puree.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a jar or bowl, add the blended lychee puree, water and sugar.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Halve the lemon and extract the juice from them directly in the jar using a lemon squeezer or press.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix and stir until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour litchi juice in glasses topped with some ice cubes if you like.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve Lychee Juice immediately.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: While serving, you can garnish Litchi Juice with few mint leaves or lemon slices.

title: Raisin Bread - The perfect healthy snack (Stafidopsomo)
description: The healthiest and super delicious raisin bread recipe (Stafidopsomo) you've ever tried! Whole-wheat flour, honey instead of sugar and only 1/2 egg and a knob of butter for eight hearty portions..

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Warm the honey and melt the butter; leave aside to reach room-temperature, so that they are not hot when using later.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the two kinds of flour (wholewheat and all-purpose), the yeast, raisins and salt; blend with a spoon to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl, add the warmed honey, the melted butter and milk and whisk. Crack in the egg and whisk again, until the ingredients combine. Pour the mixture with all the liquids in the flour-raisins mixture and blend with a spoon to combine. Knead the dough with your hands for 2-3 minutes; if you have an electric mixer mix the dough, using the dough hook for 4-5 minutes. (For the raisin bread to be soft and fluffy, the dough should be very soft and sticky, so do not try to add any more flour.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Coat a bowl with oil and place in the dough, sprinkle with some flour, cover with some plastic wrap and let it rise (in a warm place) for at least 1 hour, until it doubles its size.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the dough out onto a floured board and split in 8 pieces (work with floured hands, because the dough is very sticky). Form each piece of the dough in braids or round breads; layer the bottom of a baking tray with some greaseproof paper and place the raisin bread on top. Bake in preheated oven at 180C for 10-15 minutes, until a nicely colored crust forms and the raisin bread is cooked throughout.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If you like your raisin bread to be more shiny, brush with some honey glaze. In a bowl add 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp honey and heat in the microwave, until melted. Using a cooking brush, brush the top of each raisin bread with the honey glaze. Enjoy hot from the oven!

title: Mango Pudding (Hong Kong Style)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: mango flesh for puree, plus 1 extra mango for garnish (see note)
gelatin powder (I use Knox brand), for a firmer pudding that can be easily unmolded, use 1/2 tsp more)
Lime or lemon juice, as needed (depending on the mango)
whipping cream or coconut milk, plus extra for serving

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle gelatin onto ¼ cup cold water and let it sit for about 10 minutes until the water has been absorbed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile blend mango and 2 Tbsp of honey until smooth (you can strain it if you want to ensure smoothness) and transfer to a small pot. Add the cream and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it is steaming. Once steaming, turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour hot off-the-boil water into the bloomed gelatin and stir to completely dissolve; pour this into the mango mixture and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Taste the mixture and add more honey and/or lemon juice as needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in mango dice, pour into molds. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until the pudding is cold and set, if you want to unmold it, wait 8 hours if possible to ensure maximum firmness.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To serve pour some cream over the pudding, garnish with more mango cubes and mint leaves, enjoy!

title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
description: Holiday Chocolate Crinkle Cookies with a twist! Made with Mexican chocolate, these festive cookies are soft, chewy and covered in powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: disc (46 grams) Mexican Chocolate, (ground into a powder in a blender (I used Abuelita brand))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the butter, white sugar, ground Abuelita Mexican Chocolate disc and unsweetened cocoa powder. Beat on medium speed with a handheld mixer (or whisk together) until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add in the eggs one at a time followed by the vanilla extract, beating each until combined. Then add in the flour, baking powder and salt and mix together with a fork until combined and the mixture has formed a dough.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Form the dough into a large ball and cover it completely with a sheet of plastic wrap or place it in a bowl and cover it it with a towel. Refrigerate for 1 hour until completely chilled through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: After 1 hour, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line a large cookie sheet (or two smaller cookie sheets) with parchment paper. Add the powdered sugar into a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the dough from the fridge and using a tablespoon measure, grab a heaping tablespoon of the dough and form it into a ball. Roll the ball in the powdered sugar until it is completely covered and place it on the cookie sheet. Do this until about 24 cookies are formed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake for 10 minutes, remove from oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet until they reach room temperature. Serve and enjoy!

title: Easy Greek Easter Bread Recipe
description: Tsourike: Greek Easter Bread is a sweet yeast bread that is a bit brioche-like. You'll love this perfectly dense braided loaf that's adorned with red-dyed eggs.

ingredients.name: large eggs, beaten, PLUS 1 egg beaten with 1 tsp water (egg wash)
hard-boiled eggs, dyed red and fully dried

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine 1/3 cup hot water (about 110 degrees F) with the yeast, 1 tbsp of the flour, and 1 tbsp of the sugar. Whisk gently. Cover with a towel and leave aside for 10 minutes until bubbly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, heat the milk in a small sauce pan until the edges begin to bubble, about 4 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the butter, remaining sugar and salt. Set aside for 5 minutes to cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using the paddle attachment of your stand mixer, stir the milk mixture into the yeast mixture. While paddle is stirring, add the 2 beaten eggs. Gradually mix in the flour, anise seed, and vanilla extract. Beat unit a soft dough forms. Increase speed to medium (or medium-high if needed) until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer dough onto a lightly floured surface (dough will be sticky at this point.) Kneed by hand until very smooth (about 5 minutes), then place dough into a lightly-oiled bowl. Cover and place in a warm, closed space for 1 1/2 hours, until doubled in size. (I had heated my oven to lowest temperature, then turned it off a few minutes before placing my covered dough in.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Punch dough down, and transfer to floured surface again. Cut dough into 3 equal parts, and gently roll each to form a long 16-inch rope. Transfer to a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Press ropes together at one end and braid fairly loosely. Form into a circle and press together on the other side. Stretch the circle to about 10 inches across and the hole in the middle about 3 1/2 inches wide.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover with a clean towel and place back in warm space for 1 hour until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Rub the dyed eggs with olive oil, and buff with paper towel. Select three spots in the dough, evenly spaced, and gently insert the eggs. Cover and return to warm space. Let rise 1 more hour until dough doubles in size.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Brush the bread with the egg wash and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. Bake about 45 minutes until braided loaf turns a nice deep golden brown (should sound hallow when you tap on it.)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let cool for about 30 minutes before serving. Serve with more boiled eggs, honey or other breakfast items. Enjoy!

title: Bang Bang Shrimp Pasta
description: Plump and perfectly seasoned shrimp coated in an irresistible sauce to die for! And what better way to soak up every last drop of the creamy, spicy, tangy deliciousness than with al dente pasta?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook pasta al dente according to package instructions. Drain the pasta (reserving about ½ cup of pasta water). Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season shrimp with salt, black pepper, paprika, and one tablespoon of sweet chili sauce in a small bowl. Mix well until all shrimp are coated with the seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large skillet over medium, and melt half of the butter. Arrange seasoned shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2-3 minutes per side or until just cooked through and golden. Then transfer them to a plate, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Melt the remaining butter in the skillet, then add onion and garlic. Saute until fragrant and the onion is translucent, being careful not to burn the garlic, approximately 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Next, add mayo, sweet chili sauce, sriracha, and pasta water to the skillet and whisk until thoroughly combined. Heat to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer for 2-3 minutes or until the Bang Bang sauce is smooth and slightly thickened. Taste the sauce repeatedly to ensure it meets your liking. Add additional salt or pepper as needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add cooked pasta and toss until pasta is coated evenly with sauce. Return the shrimp and toss lightly to coat the shrimp. Squeeze fresh lime juice over the pasta and shrimp, garnish with chopped green onions, red pepper flakes, and serve.

title: Chinese Mushroom in Spicy Sauce
description: This vegan Chinese Mushroom Recipe is made in a medium spicy sauce with white button mushrooms, soy sauce, scallions, garlic and spices.

ingredients.name: spring onion whites (- chopped (scallions) or 3 tbsp finely chopped onions)
to 2 teaspoons celery (- finely chopped, optional)
soy sauce (- naturally brewed, add as required)
red chili sauce (or red chili paste or add as required, can also add sriracha sauce)
black peppercorns (or ½ teaspoon crushed black pepper or ground pepper)

description: This beer cheese soup recipe is made with two types of shredded cheese, a bottle of your favorite wheat beer and diced jalapenos! It's perfect for dunking and dipping freshly baked pretzels and crusty bread.

title: Lebanese Chicken Fatteh
description: These dinner bowls are a modern twist on the beloved Lebanese chicken fatteh casserole. Lebanese spiced poached chicken with toasted pita and mint yogurt sauce, served in dinner bowls with Lebanese rice and Mediterranean salad.

ingredients.name: medium yellow onion, peeled and thinly sliced
loaves Lebanese pita bread, toasted in the oven until lightly brown, and broken into chips
chopped fresh mint (or 2-4 tbsp dried crushed mint)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the mint yogurt sauce. Place the yogurt, garlic, mint, and salt in a small bowl. Mix with a fork until well-combined. Cover and refrigerate for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If you like, prepare Lebanese rice according to this recipe and set aside. Prepare Mediterranean salad according to this recipe; cover and refrigerate for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Arrange the chicken breasts in a single layer in the bottom of a heavy cooking pot or Dutch oven. Sprinkle with salt. Add apple cider vinegar, bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, cardamom, and cloves. Pour in enough cold water to cover the chicken by 1 inch or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the pot of chicken on the stove-top over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil. Skim off the white foam that collects on the surface of the water. Turn heat to low, cover and cook another 15-20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through registering an internal temperature of 165 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: With a slotted spoon, remove the chicken from the cooking broth and place on a cutting board to cool. Strain and reserve the broth for later or other use.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When cool enough to handle, remove the bones and shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet like this one, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat. Add the onions and cook for 4 minutes, stirring regularly. Add the garlic and cook for another minute or so. Add the chicken, paprika and sumac. Season with salt and pepper. Stir until the chicken is well-coated. Cook for 5-7 minutes until the chicken is warmed through.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from heat and add the toasted nuts. Garnish with fresh parsley leaves.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To serve, divide toasted pita bread among serving bowls. Add the Lebanese chicken;top with a generous scoop of the mint yogurt sauce and more toasted nuts, if you like. If you’ve gone a step further and prepared the rice and salad, then make room to add them next to the Lebanese chicken fatteh (as in the photos above). Enjoy!

title: Brioche Buns Recipe
description: These rich, buttery, and soft buns have an insanely satisfying tender crumb. They're perfect for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and even a snack. Pillowy and tasty buns for the win!Makes about 16 brioche buns

ingredients.name: ½-¾ cup (50-100g) granulated sugar (or coconut sugar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Microwave the coconut milk in a medium heat-safe bowl until it's warm. It may take about 30 seconds. It should be lukewarm, not hot. Let it cool if it gets too hot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a standing mixer with a paddle mixer, combine lukewarm coconut milk and yeast. Let it sit until dissolved (about a minute). Add sugar, salt, and eggs, and continue mixing on medium speed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the paddle attachment, attach the dough hook, and add flour. Continue mixing for 2-4 minutes until the dough is firm, elastic, and doesn’t stick to the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add half of the butter and continue mixing until the butter has been fully incorporated. You may have to stop the mixer and mix by hand to incorporate the butter thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the remaining of the butter a little at a time until finished. It is ok if the dough looks loose.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Continue kneading for 4-5 minutes until it is smooth, soft, and shiny. The easiest way to know when the dough is ready is when it slaps against the bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Take out the dough and place it on a lightly floured board. Knead a couple of times, then place brioche dough in a large, greased bowl.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover loosely with a clean kitchen cloth and let it rise in a warm, draft-free place for 1-2 hours or until doubled. Punch the dough down.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: At this point, the dough maybe be refrigerated overnight or until ready to use. When ready to use, remove and bring it to room temperature to make it workable for 30-60 minutes.

title: Chinese Pickled Cucumber (A Quick Pickle Recipe)
description: Chinese pickled cucumbers add a refreshing taste to any meal, are great as a snack all on their own, and can be ready overnight! {Vegan, Gluten-Free adaptable}To make this dish gluten free, use tamari to replace soy sauce.

ingredients.name: to 1 1/2 lbs (450 g to 680 g) persian cucumbers (, cut into spears (or kirby, or English cucumber) (*Footnote 1))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add cucumber into a big bowl. Sprinkle salt over the sliced cucumbers and gently toss them with your hands so the cucumbers are evenly coated. Rest for 30 minutes to an hour, tossing them occasionally.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once the cucumbers are done resting, drain off the liquid that has collected in the bottom of the container and gently rinse the cucumbers with cold water to remove the excess salt. Place the rinsed cucumbers and garlic cloves into a heat-proof, sealable container or mason jars. Make sure to arrange the cucumbers to be packed together, without too much excess space between them.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the hot brine over the cucumbers until they are completely covered.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Allow the pickles to cool to room temperature and seal the container.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let the cucumbers pickle overnight in the fridge and enjoy!

steps.description: Beat the melted butter with the sugar for a few minutes till, light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and let them absorb in the mixture.

description: Melt-in-your-mouth Egyptian butter cookies! Simple bite-sized eggless cookies, made of 3 ingredients: ghee, powdered sugar, and flour.

cup/ 63.77 g powdered sugar, sifted, and more for later

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place ghee in a large mixing bowl. Using a hand-held electric mixer like this one, mix on low until ghee is whipped.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add powdered sugar, then mix again using hand mixer. Start mixer on low and then increase speed as needed to medium until the ghee-sugar mixture is whipped (should look smooth and fluffy.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Set the mixer aside. Add baking powder, then add 1 cup flour. Knead with your hand to work flour in, then add the remaining 1 cup flour. Knead again until flour is well incorporated into a super soft dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes so that the dough will firm up a bit. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees F (see tip #2). And prepare a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When ready, remove dough from fridge. Take small portions of dough (heaping 1/2 tablespoons) and form into small walnut-sized balls. Ever so lightly press the top (do not flatten). Arrange on prepared baking sheet, about 2 to 3 inches or so apart.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Lightly press a slivered almond on each or some of the cookies.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake in heated oven for 12 to 15 minutes or so (cookies should firm up and gain a bit of color on the bottom. But should remain pretty light in color on top.)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from oven. Do NOT touch cookies until cooled (they will fall apart). Sprinkle powdered sugar on top. Enjoy!

title: How to Roast Pumpkin Seeds - the Easy Way!
description: Don't throw away your pumpkins just yet! These step-by-step instructions will show you how to roast pumpkin seeds the easy way - no soaking required.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 300°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash pumpkin seeds under running water in a fine mesh strainer or colander and remove as much of the pumpkin pulp as possible.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat the seeds with a dish towel or two until they're completely dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine seeds with olive oil, salt, chili powder, garlic powder and smoked paprika in a medium bowl. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer seeds to a large sheet pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, flipping the seeds over every 10 minutes so they bake evenly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from oven and let them cool completely before eating.

title: Fanouropita/ Phanouropita recipe (St. Fanourios cake)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare this Greek fanouropita cake recipe, add in a large bowl the sugar and vegetable oil. Using a hand whisk beat until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a separate bowl, combine the orange juice with the baking soda and mix with a fork until the baking soda froths and dissolves completely.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the orange juice and baking soda mixture to the bowl with the sugar and oil. Whisk thoroughly using a hand whisk or an electric mixer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In another bowl add the flour, ground cinnamon, ground clove, raisins and chopped walnuts. Mix using a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Hummingbird Cake

steps.title: Step 4

title: Fire Roasted Eggplant with Garlic Vinegar Sauce
description: This fire roasted eggplant recipe evokes kitchen creativity with a sauce that melds savory, sweet, sour, and garlicky flavors together with a rich and buttery texture.

ingredients.name: (450 g) Chinese long eggplant ((or 2 to 3 small eggplants))
and 1/2 tablespoons light soy sauce ((or soy sauce))
Boiled soba noodles ((or other type of thin noodles))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the eggplant(s) on a grill over high heat or cook directly on a gas burner turned to medium-high (*Footnote 2). Turn the eggplant from time to time using a pair of tongs, every 30 seconds or so, to char on all sides. When the eggplant is done, the skin will typically have turned darker purple or even black, and it will puff up and then collapse a bit. To test the doneness, gently squeeze it using your tongs to make sure it’s soft throughout. Transfer the cooked eggplant to a large plate and let it cool enough to handle. Gently peel the eggplant and discard the skin. If there’s little flecks of burned skin left here and there, that’s fine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Whisk the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: (Optional) If serving with noodles, boil the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4

title: Rice Dosa
description: This Rice Dosa recipe is an easy no-grind fermented variation made with rice flour and urad dal flour. Simply mix the flours with water, ferment overnight or for 8 to 10 hours and make crisp golden crepes.
