steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add both the rice flour and urad dal flour into a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour water and mix well. The batter has to be smooth and without any lumps and evenly mixed. The consistency should be that of a medium-thick batter but still flowing.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the batter from the mixing bowl in another bowl if needed. Cover and allow to ferment at room temperature overnight for 9 to 10 hours or more if required.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the batter is fermented well, then add salt to the batter and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat an iron tawa or skillet. Brush or spread oil lightly on the tawa.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Take a spoon or ladle with the batter and gently start spreading the batter in circular rounds. If using nonstick pan, then avoid spreading oil on the pan. Since you won't be able to spread the batter properly on the nonstick pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drizzle oil on the top and sides and let one side cook.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When one side is browned, flip and cook the other side.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Fold the dosa and serve hot with coconut chutney or sambar.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Make remaining dosas in the same way with the batter.

steps.title: Step 11

title: Mexican Coffee Buns (Rotiboy)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: salted butter, divided into 12 equal portions and keep cold (see note)
instant coffee (if you don't want to do coffee flavour, feel free to use only vanilla or other flavouring extracts as you wish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Start with Hokkaido milk bread dough that has proofed the first time until doubled in size. Turn dough out onto a work surface and press all the air out of it. Cut out one portion of the dough that weighs about 180 g (the total dough weight is about 700g). This small portion is your "inside dough", and the bigger part is your "outside dough".

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Shape the smaller inside dough into a log, then cut into 12 equal pieces; I cut it first in half, then cut each half into quarters, then each quarter into 3. For each of the small pieces, roll it out into a round sheet. Place one piece of cold salted butter inside and wrap it really well, pinching and twisting the top to make sure it's as well sealed as possible. Turn it upside down so the seam is on the bottom, set aside. Repeat for all 12 pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now shape the bigger "outside dough" into a log, then cut it also into 12 pieces. Form each piece into a round ball (see video for technique) and roll the ball into a circular sheet. Place one of the inside dough-butter balls in the middle, seam side down, and wrap the outside dough around it, making sure to seal it as best you can. Turn the buns over so now the outside seam is down (and the butter seam is up), then place the bun on a parchment-lined or greased baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining dough. Make sure you give the buns plenty of space in between as they will expand a lot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Let the buns proof in a warm place, covered with a towel, until doubled in size which should take one more hour. If it's cold where you live, it may take longer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the cookie topping:

title: Roasted Butternut Squash
description: This Oven Roasted Butternut Squash recipe is melt-in-your-mouth good! Made with maple syrup, honey and melted butter, it's tasty enough for a special occasion like Thanksgiving and Christmas holidays, yet easy enough for a weeknight meal!

ingredients.name: large butternut squash, (peeled and sliced in half lengthwise)
lime juice ((about the juice of 1/2 lime))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove and discard seeds from butternut squash. Place butternut squash onto a cutting board cut side down and slice into evenly thick half-moon slices (see photos above)*. Place in a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together melted butter, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and honey. Pour onto the sliced butternut squash and toss together until all the pieces are coated.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Flip squash over and bake for another 20 minutes, making sure to rotate the baking sheets in the oven.

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

title: How to cook Jasmine Rice
description: Jasmine Rice is a fragrant Thai long-grain rice that cooks into soft, fluffy and tender grains. It pairs well with Thai curries, stir-fries, vegetable dishes and many Southeast Asian recipes.

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 7

title: Easy Homemade Pizza Dough for Beginners
description: A super easy pizza dough recipe that rivals even the best Italian restaurants! After plenty of experimenting I have put together this super simple pizza dough recipe for you to enjoy.

ingredients.name: strong bread flour or 00-tipo pizza flour (14 oz)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat your oven to its maximum temperature or 260C/500F on the fan setting. Place your pizza stone in the oven, if you have one.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a bowl mix the lukewarm water and the sugar using a fork or a whisk. Add the yeast and stir till its fully dissolved. Let it rest for about 10 minutes or until it just starts to froth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In your bread maker bowl or your stand mixer bowl add the flour, the semolina and the salt. Stir with a fresh spoon till the ingredients are combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the olive oil and the yeast, water and sugar mixture in the mixer bowl or bread maker bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you are using a bread maker, set it to the pizza programme. It should last for 45 minutes and have kneaded the dough twice and prooved it. The pizza dough should be ready to use once the programme is done.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If you are using a stand mixer, install your dough hook and turn it on at slow speed till the ingredients combine. Then turn up the speed to about a third and let it knead the dough for 5 minutes. If the dough is too firm add two tablespoons of water. Continue kneading for another 10 minutes. The dough should be slightly sticky and have separated from the bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the dough from the hook and let it proof in the stand mixer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Reinstall the hook and knead it for a further 10 minutes on 1/3 speed. Once done remove the dough from the hook, shape it in large ball and cover it with a splash of olive oil. Place it back in the bowl and cover it with cling film. Let the dough proove for another 20 minutes. The dough should have proved by about 1/3 of its size.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Shape it into two round balls with the palm of your hands. Sprinkle some semolina on your kitchen counter and push the dough in the centre with your palm. Spread it out using your palm, lifting the dough from the counter and flipping it over every other time. Take care to leave a thicker crust on the outside of your pizza to get that wonderfully raised crust when baking.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: If you are using a pizza crisper tray place the dough on it and season with your favourite tomato sauce and toppings. If you’re using a pizza stone place the dough on some parchment paper and season with your sauce and toppings. Take the pizza stone out from the oven and put the edge of your pizza on it, gently unrolling the parchment paper underneath till its fully on the stone.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place in the oven and let it cook for approximately 20 minutes or till the edges have browned.

title: Hokkaido Milk Bread (Soft, Fluffy Asian Bread)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the whole milk with 20 g of bread flour in a small pot and stir until there are no more lumps. Heat the mixture over high heat, stirring constantly with a rubber spatula, it will get thicker and thicker until it becomes a very thick, sticky paste. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the tangzhong into a bowl and add evaporated milk; stir to mix briefly to cool the tangzhong down. Stir in the egg to combine, the mixture will be lumpy, that is okay.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer, stir together the remaining 320g of bread flour and the yeast. Add the evaporated milk mixture and mix on medium-low speed, with a dough hook attachment, just until there is no more dry flour is left in the bowl, 1-2 minutes. (If the flour around the edges of the bowl has a hard time getting mixed in, you can stop and manually mix it a little bit to help it along.) Once no more dry flour is left in the bowl, stop the mixer and let the moistened flour rest, covering the bowl with a towel, for 20 mins.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

Knead the dough until all the butter is absorbed, stopping to scrape the bowl and pull dough off hook every minute or so. It will at first be a buttery mess, and you'll feel like there's no way all the butter will get absorbed, but I promise it will!

title: Easy Carbonara Recipe with Roasted Tomato and Prosciutto
description: A lighter, flavor-packed easy carbonara recipe with garlic roasted tomatoes and fresh herbs. Follow our tips to ensure a creamy carbonara sauce without scrambling the eggs. A perfectly satisfying weeknight pasta dinner!

ingredients.name: Campari tomatoes, halved (you may use smaller vine-ripe or Roma tomatoes)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
linguine pasta (you can also use spaghetti or fettuccine)
large eggs and 1 egg yolk at room temprature
grated Parmesan cheese, more for serving
packed basil leaves, more for serving (optional)
Crusted red pepper flakes for serving (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place tomatoes on a large baking sheet. Add a generous drizzle of Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil. Season with kosher salt, pepper, paprika, and 1 tsp oregano. Add 2 minced garlic cloves. Toss to coat (make sure all the tomatoes are well coated with the olive oil, spices and garlic).

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, whisk together eggs, egg yolk, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, grated cheeses, parsley, basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, pinch black pepper, and the remainder of minced garlic. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

steps.title: Step 9

title: Christopsomo recipe (Greek Christmas Bread with Walnuts)
description: A traditional Greek Christmas Bread (Christopsomo) recipe! Discover all the secrets to make the tastiest traditional Christopsomo with this no fail recipe!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Christopsomo recipe start by making the dough. In the mixer’s bowl add the water, yeast and sugar and whisk to dissolve.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wrap the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside for about 10 minutes, until the yeast rises and starts bubbling. The water should not be hot, as it will kill the yeast, nor cold, as it will take forever for the Greek Christmas bread to rise. The water should be same temperature as your finger. Check the temperature of the water by sticking one finger in. You should feel no difference in temperature.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the flour, honey, olive oil and mahleb. Using the dough hook mix at first at low speed, until the ingredients start to combine and then mix at medium speed for about 5-10 minutes, until the dough doesn’t stick on the sides of the bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the anise, walnuts and salt and beat for 1 more minute, until combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat lightly the dough with olive oil and cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Let the dough rise in warm place for at least 1 hour, until it doubles it’s size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now prepare the dough for the decoration of Christopsomo, add the water, olive oil, flour and salt in the mixer’s bowl. Mix using the dough hook, until the dough is smooth. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and set aside for 15 minutes to rest.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: For the Christopsomo, deflate the dough lightly with your fingers and shape into a round loaf. Butter a round baking pan (28-30 cm) and line with parchment paper. Transfer the dough into the baking pan and spread lightly. Brush the top lightly with some beaten egg and water.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the plastic wrap from the decorating dough and cut it into 6 pieces. Shape each piece into a long rope. Then form 2 braids. Place the 2 braids over the Christopsomo and shape a cross. Place the whole walnut in the center. Cover the dough with a towel and wait for the dough to rise for 1 hour. (see also the preparation photos below)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180C / 350F Fan and bake for 50 minutes, until the Christopsomo is nicely coloured and cooked through.

steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a full boil. Meanwhile, put onions and tomatoes into a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Break Mama block into quarters. Reserve the broken bits at the bottom the bag for sprinkling, or you can just eat them as a snack! Cook mama in boiling water 2 minutes. Scoop the noodles out with a skimmer and place them into a sieve to drain. Add the shrimp to the same pot of water and cook them just until done, 30 seconds or so. Fish them out and add them to the noodles.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour out all the water and place the pot back on the stove. Add the Mama garlic oil packets (this is optional), turn on the heat to medium and add the ground pork or chicken. Cook the meat, breaking up the lumps, until fully cooked. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the cooked pork, with all of its liquid, into the bowl of onions and tomatoes. Add noodles and shrimp. Pour dressing over the noodles and toss to combine. Add Chinese celery and cilantro leaves, toss and serve immediately. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Note: If you have leftovers, it'll keep in the fridge and you can eat it the next day as a cold noodle salad, or warm it briefly in the microwave just to bring it to room temp.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup Recipe
description: This Roasted Butternut Squash Soup recipe is healthy, easy to make and perfect for the cold-weather season! (vegetarian, paleo, vegan)

ingredients.name: precut butternut squash ((or about 2 small-medium whole butternut squash, cubed and peeled))
roasted pepitas, Mexican crema or sour cream, fresh herbs

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-heat oven to 400°F. Line two large baking sheets with aluminum foil and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine sage, salt, celery seed, thyme, black pepper and smoked paprika.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, add butternut squash, onions and olive oil. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the spices and herbs to the butternut squash mixture and mix together until all the vegetables are evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Evenly distribute the vegetables onto the two prepared baking sheets. Roast in the oven for 45 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large pot over medium-high heat, melt butter. Add and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the roasted vegetables and stir to thoroughly mix with the garlic. Add 2 cups of stock.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Using an immersion blender, blend the vegetables carefully until completely smooth. You can also use a regular stand blender to blend the veggies in two batches. Be careful to not overfill the blender since veggies will still be very hot.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the remaining 4 cups of stock and blend again (or whisk thoroughly). Cover and cook for 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve with roasted pepitas, Mexican crema or sour cream and fresh herbs if desired.

title: Easy Skillet Zucchini Recipe with Balsamic Reduction
description: This easy zucchini recipe is the perfect last-minute side for just about any meal! Zucchini rounds sauteed in good extra virgin olive oil and finished with homemade balsamic glaze, sesame seeds and a sprinkle of dried mint or parsley.

ingredients.name: Black sesame seeds or toasted sesame seeds, optional
Dried mint or parsley flakes, a handful

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the balsamic glaze or reduction. In a saucepan, heat the balsamic vinegar and brown sugar. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and let simmer for 20 minutes or so. Remove from heat and let cool for 10 minutes; the balsamic glaze will continue to thicken as it cools (see shortcut option in notes)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a large pan or skillet, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil until shimmering but not smoking. Add zucchini rounds and season with salt, pepper and paprika. Saute over medium-high heat, tossing occasionally until zucchini rounds soften and gain some color on both sides (about 7 to 10 minutes)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, transfer sauteed zucchini to a serving platter. Drizzle with the prepared balsamic glaze. Sprinkle sesame seeds and dried mint flakes on top. Enjoy warm or at room temperature.

title: Chocolate covered Melomakarona (Greek Christmas honey cookies with chocolate)
description: For all the chocolate lovers, this one is for you! Chocolate covered Melomakarona (Greek Christmas honey cookies). Who can really resist?

ingredients.name: 500g/ 8oz. dark chocolate (or milk chocolate, if you prefer)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these melomakarona with chocolate start with the syrup. In a pot add all the ingredients for the syrup (except the honey) and bring to the boil. Boil for 3-4 minutes, until the sugar dissolves and then remove from the stove. Add the honey and stir. Set aside to cool completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a bowl add the flour semolina and baking powder and blend with a whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl pour in the orange juice, the cognac, the sugar and spices (nutmeg, cinnamon, clove, vanilla). At the end add the baking soda and whisk immediately the ingredients for 5-10 seconds, until the ingredients combine and the baking soda dissolves and starts to foam. Then add the water, oil, the orange zest and honey and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine the two mixtures. Add the mixture from step 2 (flour, semolina and baking powder) in the bowl with the rest of the ingredients from step 3 and start kneading the dough. Knead the dough for the melomakarona using your hands, until the ingredients combine and the dough is smooth and soft. When preparing this chocolate melomakarona recipe, it is very important not to overwork the dough. Knead lightly with your hands (like working with a meringue) until the flour has incorporated the mixture and the dough is really soft. Be careful not to add any more flour than this melomakarona recipe calls for, as this will make them tough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Shape the melomakarona. Pinch a portion of dough about the size of a walnut/ 50g and shape with your palms into a smooth oblong shape. Place on the baking tray, push lightly the top with a fork and make some holes on top. Continue with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 180C / 350F for approx. 20 minutes, until the melomakarona are lightly browned and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the melomakarona come out of the oven, place them in the cold syrup, flipping them with a slotted spoon to absorb the syrup for approx. 10-20 seconds. When adding syrup to the melomakarona it’s best do so in 2-3 batches. Remove the cookies using a slotted spoon and place on a rack.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Prepare the chocolate for covering the melomakarona. Break the chocolateÂ into small pieces, drop into a heatproof bowl and add the oil or butter. Set the bowl over a small saucepan about a quarter full with hot water and place the bowl on top so that it rests on the rim of the pan (the bowl should not to touch the water). Place the pan, with the bowl on top, over low heat until the chocolate has melted, whilst stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Dip each one of the melomakarona in the chocolate and place over a rack. If you like ti garnish with chopped walnuts or toasted almond silvers, do that know. Leave them for a while to cool down and serve on a platter.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Store the chocolate covered melomakarona at room temperature in an airtight container. They will last for all your Christmas Holidays!

title: Scotch Eggs(Baked or Fried)
description: Baked Scotch Eggs – Hard-boiled egg wrapped in a Flavorful Spicy Ground beef or Sausage , rolled in delicious crunchy case – Baked or Fried to Perfection ! Big, meaty and satisfying, Great as an appetizer, for brunch , breakfast or picnic.

ingredients.name: salt (omit if using seasoned sausage meat)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°. Line a baking tray with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove casings form sausage and place in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add, garlic, cayenne pepper,thyme, granulated onions, white pepper and salt. Mix thoroughly. Divide into equal portions and then shape into a thin round, flat enough to fit around the egg.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Gently wrap the sausage meat around the egg as evenly as possible making sure there are no cracks or opening.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lightly roll the boiled eggs in the flour, shaking off excess, followed by the egg mixture egg.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll in breadcrumbs mixture to coat

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake for about 25- 30minutes, or until sausage is thoroughly cooked and no longer pink near egg.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Frying

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: In a large, sauce pan pour vegetable oil, until it is at least 2 inches deep, heat to 350 degrees F. Fry for about 5 -8 minutes until it is golden brown.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels before serving.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature

title: Kesar Falooda (Saffron Pista Falooda)
description: Kesar Falooda is a rich and creamy Indian dessert made with saffron-infused milk, falooda sev, sabja seeds, ice cream and nuts. This easy layered dessert is refreshing, flavorful and perfect for summer or festive occasions.

sabja seeds ((falooda seeds or sweet basil seeds or tukmaria), soaked in ¾ cup water)
to 6 cashews (or almonds, sliced or chopped)

title: Chogyetang (Chilled Chicken Soup)
description: Tangy and refreshing Korean chilled chicken soup served with shredded chicken and vegetables

ingredients.name: boneless (skinless chicken breast or thigh (fat removed))
1 quart chicken stock (preferably good quality, low sodium)
hot mustard paste (or more to taste, geoja (겨자))
to 2 teaspoons salt (2 teaspoons or more to taste if used low sodium stock)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour the chicken stock into a medium size pot. Add onion, scallion, garlic, and ginger. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Add the chicken breast, and when it comes to a boil again, reduce the heat to medium low. Cover, and continue to boil for about 8 -10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the heat off and remove the chicken to a bowl. Place the pot in an ice bath to cool. Strain the stock, and discard the aromatic vegetables. The stock should be about 3-1/2 cups. Stir in all the seasoning ingredients, and keep it in the freezer to chill, preferably until it becomes slushy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If using the sesame seeds, blend the seeds in 1 cup of the chicken stock. Add to the prepared stock before putting it in the freezer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the chicken is cool enough to handle, shred and lightly season with salt, pepper, sesame oil, and minced garlic. Refrigerate while preparing the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Thinly slice the cucumber, and mix well with the vinegar, sugar, and salt. Set it aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Thinly slice the red cabbage and red bell pepper. If serving with the noodles, cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Be sure to rinse them in icy cold water, and drain.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve, arrange the chicken, vegetables, and noodles, if using, in a serving bowl, and ladle the icy cold broth over.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Lamb Chop Recipe with Tomato Mint Quinoa
description: Super tender grilled lamb chops that have been marinated in Mediterranean spices, garlic, and lemon juice. Serve them with tomato mint quinoa included in this recipe and a little Tztaziki sauce or see other ideas below!

ingredients.name: frenched racks of lamb, fat trimmed, separated into chops (about 16 chops)
small yellow or red onion, sliced
chopped fresh mint leaves, more for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl combine the garlic and spices with 1 tbsp fresh mint leaves and 2 tbsp of olive oil. This makes a rub for the lamb.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Take the lamb chops and rub them each on both sides with the garlic-spice rub. Place the chops in a deep dish with 2 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice and onions. Cover and leave in the fridge for 1 to 4 hours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: 20 to 25 minutes before grilling, remove the lamb chops from the fridge and let them rest at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to package instructions, adding a dash of salt and olive oil to the cooking water. (For 1 cup of quinoa, you’ll add 3 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to medium low and simmer until water is absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now let’s add flavor to the cooked quinoa! In a non-stick pan, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat. Stir in garlic and cook very briefly and then add the canned diced tomato. Season with salt and pepper and cook for 4-6 minutes, stirring occasionally. Now, stir in the cooked quinoa. Once warmed through, add the chopped fresh mint. Stir to combine and remove from heat. Off heat, add chopped red onions, feta cheese and more fresh mint leaves for garnish

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Time to grill the lamb chops! Heat an a gas grill (or an indoor grill pan) over high heat (make sure the grill is super hot) add the lamb chops and grill for about 2 minutes. Flip the chops over and cook for another 3 minutes for medium-rare or 3 1/2 minutes for medium (internal temperature should register 125 degrees F for medium-rare or 135 degrees F for medium). Let the chops rest for 10 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ready to serve, transfer the tomato mint quinoa to serving bowls, top with 2 lamb chops per person. Enjoy!

title: Homemade Baked Greek Fries recipe with feta cheese
description: This extra crispy, extra golden and super delicious Greek homemade Greek fries recipe will surely become your newest favorite! A super simple recipe that will elevate your usual chips to a whole new level!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this super easy Greek fries recipe, start by preparing the potatoes. Wash and peel the potatoes and cut into strips. At first slice the potatoes lengthwise into 1/2 cm (1/4 inch) slices and then cut each slice into strips. Place the potatoes in a large bowl with plenty of water to cover them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now it’s time to make a decision. Greek fries can be either fried or baked (for a healthier version).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If you choose to bake your Greek fries, then layer a large baking tray with parchment paper and pour in 2-3 tbsps of olive oil. Place the tray in the oven and preheat at 200C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: As soon as your oven is well preheated, drain and dry the potatoes and remove the baking tray from the oven. Place the potatoes on the baking sheet and season with salt and dried oregano. Toss the potatoes around to get them coated with the oil (add some more oil if necessary) and layer them evenly on the baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake the potatoes for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending on size, until golden and crispy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For the topping of the Greek fries use crumbled feta cheese, chopped red onions, and chopped tomatoes. Sprinkle with dried oregano and chopped parsley and squeeze over just a little bit lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy your Greek fries while still warm with some gyros and tzatziki sauce!

title: Jamaican Fried Chicken
description: Jamaican Fried Chicken –Golden brown crispy crunchy Chicken. Highly spiced, decadently tender, Bad to the bone and Finger lickin’ good! Comfort food at it’s BEST.

ingredients.name: 1-1/2 Tablespoons dried herbs (Thyme, Oregano, Parlsley) total

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chicken in a large bowl. Then seasoned with salt followed by all the other marinate ingredients- salt, chicken bouillon, garlic, ginger, paprika, white pepper, curry powder, hot sauce and thyme.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix chicken with a spoon or with hands until they are well coated, cover tightly and set aside in the fridge. Marinate for about an hour or preferably over night,

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour about 1 cup of milk in the marinated chicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, herbs and white pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When ready to fry add about 2 Tablespoons of milk to the flour mixture- thoroughly mix using your fingers. Then dredge the chicken in the flour mixture, shaking any excess flour. You may use a zip lock bag for this process. Set aside for about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat oil in a deep fryer or cast iron skillet to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Temperature will drop once you add chicken.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Using a thong place chicken carefully and slowly place the chicken in the hot oil work in batches. Do not over crowd the skillet .Fry the chicken until golden brown, turning once, 10 to 20 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. Chicken is done when it is no longer pink inside and its juices run clear. You may do a test by piercing chicken with fork.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Drain the chicken on paper towels set on a wire rack.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Repeat with remaining chicken pieces; let cool for at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Strawberry Mousse Recipe
description: A no-cook Strawberry Mousse recipe made with only three ingredients - strawberry, cream and sugar. The recipe is egg free, quick, super delish and makes for a gorgeous looking dessert.

ingredients.name: cream (- light cream with 25% to 35% fat or whipping cream with 36% to 50% fat)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse, hull and chop the strawberries. Add them to a blender along with sugar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blend to a fine and smooth puree without any strawberry chunks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour 1 tablespoon of the puree in each of the shot glasses or bowls.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add chilled cream to the strawberry puree in the blender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pulse 5 to 7 times till the cream is well blended with the strawberry puree.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Spoon the mousse in the shot glasses or bowls.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate for 4 to 5 hours or till well set.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve the Strawberry Mousse chilled and garnished with strawberry slices or grated chocolate.

title: Instant Pot Lentil Soup (Chinese Style)
description: Instant Pot Lentil Soup is a healthy one-pot vegan meal that will satisfy your hunger and craving for comfort food all at once! Learn how to use one Chinese ingredient to pack your soup with extra flavor and umami. {Vegan}

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the lentils with cold water and drain them. While rinsing, watch out and pick through your lentils to make sure there are no rocks or other debris (don’t be alarmed if there are, sometimes small rocks are overlooked during processing and packing).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the Instant Pot to the saute function. Once the screen shows “Hot”, add the olive oil, onion, and garlic. Saute until fragrant and starting to brown, around 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the doubanjiang and cumin. Saute for another minute. If it looks dry, pour in a bit more oil or stock to prevent the ingredients from sticking or burning.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the saute function off. Pour in the crushed tomato, and scrape the bottom again to make sure all the brown bits are lifted (This is important, to prevent the bottom of the pot from burning after adding pressure). Add the vegetable stock and rinsed lentils and stir to combine all the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Seal the Instant Pot and make sure the valve is pointed to lock. Set to manual, high pressure, and the timer for 10 minutes for al dente lentils with soup, or for 12 minutes for a stew-like texture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: After the cooking is done, use quick release on the lid or unseal the valve by switching the lock using a spatula (watch out for the steam coming out). Stir and taste the soup. Add the white pepper and salt (if needed), according to your own taste.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: You can top the soup with tomato, avocado, or onion if you wish. Serve hot as a side or main dish.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Store the leftover soup in a sealed container in the fridge for 5 days or in the freezer for up to 2 months.

title: Yeolmu Kimchi (Young Summer Radish Kimchi)
description: Crunchy, refreshing, and light kimchi made with Korean young summer radish greens!

ingredients.name: Korean coarse sea salt (use less if using finer salt)
Korean coarse sea salt (use less if using finer salt)
to 4 tablespoons gochugaru (Korean chili pepper flakes - use 1/2 cup or more if not using fresh peppers)
or 6 thin scallions (cut into 1-inch long pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut off the root end of each radish if the root is thin and not usable. Otherwise, cut the thin end of the root and scrape off the impurities with a small knife. Trim off any bad leafy stems, and cut the greens into about 3-inch long pieces. Transfer to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Trim off the root from each young cabbage. Cut the cabbages into about 3-inch long pieces, and transfer to another large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fill the bowl of greens with water. Let them sit in the water for about 10 minutes for the greens to release any dirt. Then, wash the greens a couple of times by gently shaking with your hands in the water. Drain. Do the same with the young cabbages.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dissolve 6 tablespoons of salt in 4 cups of water in a small bowl. Placing a handful of the greens back in the large bowl, sprinkle with some salt water. Repeat the process until all the radish greens are placed in the bowl. If you run out of salt water, pour some back out of the bowl with the greens and use again. Repeat the process for the young cabbages in another bowl with 3 tablespoons of salt and 2 cups of water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Let the vegetables sit for 40 minutes to an hour until they become slightly flexible. Flip them over once or twice while salting.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, mix the flour well with water, and boil over medium heat, stirring, to make the flour paste. Cool.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Coarsely blend the chili peppers, garlic, ginger and saewujeot together with 1/2 cup of water in a blender. Combine with the fish sauce, gochugaru, sugar and flour paste.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Gently rinse the salted radish greens and cabbages separately in cold water, and drain well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the radish greens and cabbages in 3 to 4 batches in the same large bowl, pouring in some seasoning mix each time. Add the scallions and onions. Toss everything very lightly by hand (use kitchen gloves), until everything is evenly coated with the seasoning.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Store in an airtight container or jar (about 1 gallon size). Leave it out at room temperature for a few hours before storing in the fridge. You can start eating kimchi any time, but it will taste best after a few days in the fridge.

title: Grilled Brussels Sprouts Skewers
description: Easy, tasty grilled Brussels sprouts recipe. Quickly marinated, Mediterranean-style, then perfectly charred, and finished with a sprinkle of Parmesan. A healthy, gluten free appetizer or side dish.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
pinch crushed red pepper, to your liking
grated Parmesan cheese, to your liking

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak about 10 small wooden skewers in water for 30 mins or so.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place brussels sprouts in a mixing bow and heat in microwave for 2 mins. Let cool enough before handling.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To the brussels sprouts add olive oil, lemon juice, and minced garlic. Season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, and pinch crushed red pepper flakes. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now thread 3 to 4 brussels sprouts halves on each skewer (keep the stems facing the same direction).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat indoor grill or griddle like this one over medium-high heat (or an outdoor grill over medium heat). Arrange skewers in one layer on heated grill. Cover and cook for 4 mins on one side (or until nicely charred), then, using a pair of tongs, turn skewers over and cook on the other side another 3 to 4 mins or so (covered).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer grilled brussels sprouts skewers to a serving platter. Squeeze a little bit more fresh lemon juice and sprinkle Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

title: Southern Style Fried Potatoes
description: Southern Style Fried Potatoes – a simple meal choice made with potatoes and five other simple ingredients.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Scrub potatoes, peel, and clean and cut them into cubes about ½ -¾ cubes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place in a saucepan with water and about ½ teaspoon salt, you may add more later on.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring to a boil over high heat and then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook until just the edges are tender, about 5-7 minutes. Potatoes should be almost cooked. Drain water and simmer for about 1 minute or until water has evaporated.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil, butter, or bacon fat in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high until simmering.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place potatoes in a single layer in the skillet; cook, turning each piece occasionally until potatoes are browned about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: After the potatoes are browned, add in onion and Creole seasoning. Stir for about 2-3 minutes. Adjust seasonings to taste and serve.

title: Red Braised Pig Trotter
description: Comforting Chinese red braised pig trotter

ingredients.name: pig trotters ( , remove the hair and cut into bite size chunks (resort to batcher))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut trotter into small sections. Rinse the pig trotter in clean and boiling water. Remove all the hair carefully. Put aside and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring water to a boil in a large pot and cook the pig trotter for 2-3 minutes. Transfer out and wash under running water. This process can help to remove the odd taste as much as possible. And then in a high pressure cooker or electric cooker or a pot, cover pig trotter with enough water, add ginger slices, green onion, sichuan peppercorn and cooking wine. Cook until you can insert a chopstick into the meat. If you want a softer taste like me, cook it longer. Transfer the pig trotter out and the liquid can be kept as soup stock.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up 1 tablespoon oil in wok, put the sugar in wok to stir fry until all the sugar melts and you can see large bubbles. Keep stirring during the process. Pour around 1 cup of hot water. Mix well! You need to be stay away from the wok and do not hesitate when pouring the water. If you do not want to stir fry the sugar color, just add sugar in clay pot and skip oil. The later method only influence the color but not the taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare a clay pot or another deep sauce pan or wok, fry ginger slices and other spices for 1-2 minutes until aroma. Add pig trotter in, pour some cooking liquid in the previous until the pig trotter is almost covered. Pour the sugar color in the previous step and soy sauce. Heat over high fire with the lid uncovered until there are large bubbles in the pot and the sauce is almost dried up.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle some green onion and then serve warm!

title: Beijing Hot Pot Dipping Sauce (京式火锅蘸料)
description: Sharing a nutty, savory, Beijing-style dipping sauce for hot pot that I’ve eaten my whole life. It uses a few fermented ingredients to create a super umami taste that pairs well with many types of hot pot soups.

ingredients.name: Chinese sesame paste ((or unsweetened natural peanut butter, or tahini) (*Footnote 1))
to 3 teaspoons Chinese fermented leek flower sauce ((Optional) (*Footnote 3))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the sesame paste into a big bowl. Add the water, one tablespoon at a time, and use a spatula or a spoon to blend the water in until it forms a smooth paste. Add more water and repeat, until it forms a smooth sauce that is slightly runny.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the red fermented bean curd. Break it apart while mixing it into the sauce, until fully incorporated.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the rest of the ingredients and mix, until everything is fully dissolved into the sauce. Taste it and adjust it according to your taste. If you do not use the leek flower sauce, the sauce will be milder. You can add a bit more soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic to boost the flavor.

title: Aromatic Greek-style Mulled Wine Recipe (Krasomelo/ Oinomelo)
description: Get into the holiday spirit with this deliciously fragrant Greek Style red mulled wine!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek mulled wine recipe (krasomelo) pour the wine in a sauce pan and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: As soon as the wine starts to get frothy, turn the heat down to low and add the rest of the ingredients. Let the wine simmer, whilst stirring, for about 10 minutes, until the honey melts and the flavors combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove from the heat and let sit for a while.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Strain and serve in shot glasses. Enjoy!

title: Jjukkumi Gui (Spicy Grilled Baby Octopus)
description: Baby octopus are marinated in a spicy gochujang sauce and seared quickly on the grill. Tender, enjoyably chewy, not to mention a burst of flavor with every bite!

ingredients.name: to 2 teaspoons Korean red chili pepper flakes (gochugaru)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Defrost, if frozen. If not pre-cleaned, remove and discard the inside of the head and beak. See more here. Rinse the octopus well under cold running water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the marinade ingredients. Pour over the octopus and mix to coat well. Marinate for 2 to 3 hours (up to overnight) in the fridge. Heat a lightly oiled grill or a grill pan to medium high and sear for about 3 minutes, turning a couple of times. Do not overcook. Plate them on the optional cucumber slices to serve.

title: Egg Fried Rice
description: This is an ultimate guide of egg fried rice. Egg fried rice is a classic Chinese dish that can be enjoyed as a main meal or as a side. It is made with rice, eggs and typically some very basic seasonings like salt or ground pepper.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the rice--Break the rice with a turner in a pan and make sure the rice grains are separated. This can be finished in the stir frying process too. But pre-load this step can help the beginners.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the eggs--Whisk egg with a small pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat wok--Heat wok until smoky (super important), add oil and swirl the wok to help the oil cover the surface.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry the egg liquid--Add beaten egg in. Wait for 2-3 seconds and then break the eggs with chopsticks or turner. This is a lovely way because at this stage the cracks can be easily gotten.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the rice--Add the rice in. Continue using the turner to pat the rice grains and move them until the rice pops up.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add some seasonings- add salt and pepper and pour the soy sauce over the wok edge. Mix for a while.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enhance the flavor with scallion --Mix in green onion. Give a very quick stir fry and serve hot.

title: Pomelo Salad (Yum Som-O) ยำส้มโอ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Pomelo, torn into chunks (see how to peel a pomelo in the video)
dried shrimp, blitzed in a blender or coffee grinder until fluffy
kaffir lime leaves, very finely julienned
inches lemongrass, bottom half only, very thinly sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, grind the chilies into a paste, then add palm sugar and pound until dissolved. Add fish sauce and lime juice and swirl to mix.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour the dressing into a mixing bowl, then add all other ingredients and toss to combine. That's it! You can serve it as is or serve some wild betel leaves (chaploo leaves) along side it which you can use to make little bit-sized wrap of the salad.

title: Mexican Street Corn Tostadas
description: Ready in only 15 minutes, these Mexican Street Corn Tostadas make for an easy lunch or quick dinner that’s also gluten free and vegetarian.

ingredients.name: chili powder to season for topping, (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add corn, mayonnaise, red onion, cilantro, lime juice, salt and 2 tablespoons of cotija cheese.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix together with a spoon until the corn is evenly coated with all the ingredients. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up the refried beans in a glass dish in the microwave for about 2 to 3 minutes, or until fully heated through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To assemble, spread about 3 to 4 tablespoons of refried beans onto each tostada and top with a scoop or two of the street corn mixture.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle with some cotija cheese and a dash of chili powder.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Eat up!

title: Baked Sole Fillet, the Mediterranean Way
description: Simple Baked Sole fillet, Spiced Mediterranean-style and baked in a buttery lime sauce. Green onions, dill, and capers are welcomed additions here!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
ghee or unsalted melted butter (if you like it buttery, then add up to 1/2 cup)
seasoned salt, or to your taste
4-6 green onions, top trimmed, halved length-wise
roughly chopped fresh dill for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil and melted butter with a dash of seasoned salt. Stir in the shallots, garlic and capers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate small bowl, mix together the seasoned salt, pepper, cumin and garlic powder. Spice fish fillets each on both sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the fish fillets on a lightly-oiled large baking pan or dish. Cover with the buttery lime mixture you prepared earlier. Now arrange the green onion halves and lime slices on top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake in 375 degrees F-heated oven for 10-15 minutes. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the fish fillets from the oven and garnish with the chopped fresh dill.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve next to white rice or roasted Greek potatoes and a simple Mediterranean salad.

title: Traditional Cypriot Flaouna Recipe (Flaounes)
description: A traditional Cypriot Flaouna recipe, for you to prepare this delicious treat to perfection! Discover all the secrets behind the perfect flaouna, sweet savoury and infused with the delicious aromas of mahlab and mastic!

ingredients.name: Mahlab ground to a fine powder
Mastic ground to a fine powder
A dash of warm milk for kneading (about 80ml)
Flaounas cheese or alternatively 250g haloumi and 250g mild cheddar

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In order to have the best texture for your flaouna, it is best to prepare the filling from the night before or at least 4-5 hours before baking. This would allow the cheese filling to dry out and be able to absorb more of the “moisture” from the liquid flaouna ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Start off by grating the cheese as fine as you possibly can. Add the beaten eggs, the raisins, the mint, the mastic, mahlab and the semolina and mix thoroughly. Cover it with a cloth and place in the fridge overnight or for at least 4-5 hours before baking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Next off start preparing the dough. The dough is more like a shortbread and not very bread-y hence be careful not to overwork the dough as your flaouna will be a bit doughy. In a large bowl sift the flour, add the salt, baking powder, the mahlab, mastic and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the liquid ingredients to your flaouna recipe mixture which are the butter and eggs and gently mix the flaouna dough with your fingers. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water with the sugar, pour into the dough and then add the warm milk. Be careful for your water and milk to be only lukewarm and not hot as they will kill your yeast!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Continue kneading the dough for a few minutes until the texture is firm but not bread-like. If the dough is too wet add a little more flour but be careful not to overdo it as you don’t want the flaouna to have a bread-y texture. Cover the dough mix with some cling film and let it rise for 1-2 hours or until it has almost doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now its time to start assembling your flaouna! Get the filling mixture out of the fridge and add the remaining mixture ingredients. Mix thoroughly and set it aside. Pour the flaouna dough out of the bowl and roll out in thin sheets. Cut into 12 by 12 cm rectangles, about 5 inches in each dimension. Sprinkle the sesame seeds on a small plate with approximately the same size as the flaouna dough rectangles

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Glaze the outer side of the flaouna dough with the whisked eggs and press it down on the sesame seeds. That will ensure that the seeds are firmly embedded in the dough. Grab a handful of the cheese filling and form a ball. Place in the centre of the dough (sesame seeds facing outwards), glaze the edges with a little more whisked egg and fold, pinching the corners together to form the flaouna shape.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once all your flaouna are shaped, place them on a baking tray lined with grease proof paper, let them rise for about 30-45 minutes and then bake in a pre-heated oven at 200C for about 40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Watermelon Salad
description: This refreshing Watermelon Salad is brimming with sliced sweet watermelon, cucumber, feta cheese, red onions, and mint leaves all tossed in a simple yet unusually good sweet, tangy, and spicy dressing.

ingredients.name: (66g) feta cheese or sub with queso Blanco
(25g) coarsely chopped mint leaves (, some whole for garnish )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Start by cutting off both ends of the watermelon. Then slice watermelon into half and cut in slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place each slice on the cutting board. Then cut out the skin of the watermelon slices, as you cut it out rotate the slice. Be sure to cut out all the white part. Cut it into cubes and place in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, red vinegar, lime juice, cayenne, honey, hot sauce, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine watermelon, cucumber, feta, onion, and chopped mint. Toss with dressing.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garnish with mint. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Cheesecake Recipe | New York Cheesecake Recipe
description: Creamy, tasty and soft New York Style Cheesecake. This Cheesecake recipe is made without eggs and is a baked cheesecake.

cream (- 30% to 50% fat, heavy or whipping cream)

description: If you’re looking for a super quick and easy veggie dish, make this authentic Chinese tiger salad for a tasty and refreshing addition to your meal!To make the dish gluten-free use tamari instead of soy sauce.

ingredients.name: cilantro (, thick stems removed and chopped into 1”(2.5 cm) pieces)
english cucumber (, sliced to thin strips)
to 2 anaheim chilis (, thinly sliced (or other long green chilis, depending on desired spice level))
green onions (, thinly sliced in a diagonal)

steps.title: Step 1

title: Jjolmyeon (Spicy Chewy Noodles
description: Chewy, bouncy noodles in a sweet and tangy gochujang sauce with lots of fresh, crunchy vegetables!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl, and mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil, and add the soybean sprouts. Close the lid, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Quickly transfer the sprouts to a bowl of cold water to cool, saving the cooking liquid, which can be used as a soup. (See note.) Drain the sprouts.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Thinly slice the cabbages, and cut the carrot and cucumber into matchsticks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions (usually about 5 minutes). Drain quickly and rinse in icy cold water until the noodles are very cold. Make two one-serving size mounds. Place the mounds in a colander to drain.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the noodles in the middle of a serving bowl and nicely arrange the cold vegetables over the noodles. The sauce can be served on top or separately. You can also mix the noodles and vegetables with the sauce before serving. Place a half of the boiled egg on top to serve.

title: Ancient Cookbook Recipe Experiment! - Galloping Horses ม้าฮ่อ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: kilo pork, lean and fat mixed [the recipe tells you to "chop the pork fine", which in the Thai context that means making ground pork, so you can just use regular ground pork]

Castor sugar [Not sure what she meant by castor sugar because I doubt they had actual castor sugar back then...and in either case it doesn't make sense why this recipe would need castor sugar. So I would just use palm sugar or granulated sugar]
Rambutans [I don't recommend it personally, I would go with pineapple instead :)] or oranges [Thai oranges are closer to mandarin oranges, not navel oranges]
Lard [if you can render your own lard from fatty pork, that would be the authentic way]

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chop the pork fine. Crush garlic, and fry in about 2 or 3 tablespoons of lard till light brown. Add pork, peanuts, and seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: [Nowadays, most recipes will call for garlic, white peppercorns and coriander roots to be pounded into a paste and then fried in the fat. You can do that if you want extra flavour. The "seasoning" refers to the fish sauce and sugar. You will need to just taste and adjust as the recipe doesn't specify amounts! It should be sweet and salty. Make sure you really get the pork broken up into small bits, as small as you can, and adding a bit of water in the beginning will help loosen it up a bit. If you have large chunks you'll have a hard time getting the filling to stay on the fruit and hold together.]

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: [Let the filling cool completely before proceeding.]

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut each rambutan in two and remove the seeds. In the case of oranges, separate them according to their natural sections, cutting them open on the back and lay them flat on a serving dish, skin downward. Fill each piece of fruit with the pork mixture, and decorate tastefully with picked coriander leaves and chilies.

title: Creamy Cilantro Lime Dressing
description: This Cilantro Lime Dressing is made with 6 ingredients and is the perfect blend of tangy and creamy. Use on salads, tacos, burrito bowls and grilled meats!

ingredients.name: lime juice ((about the juice of 2 limes))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all ingredients to a blender or food processor.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blend until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Taste and season with more salt, if necessary.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

title: Kidney Bean and Cilantro Salad with Dijon Vinaigrette
description: Simple Mediterranean kidney bean salad with garden vegetables, fresh cilantro, and homemade Dijon vinaigrette. See the video and recipe notes for variations.

ingredients.name: 15- oz. can kidney beans, (drained and rinsed)
Private Reserve or Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil
fresh garlic paste, (or finely chopped garlic)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium sized bowl, combine the kidney beans with the chopped vegetables and cilantro.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the vinaigrette, in a separate small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, oil, mustard, fresh garlic, sumac, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the vinaigrette over the salad and combine well with a large spoon. Add a dash of salt and pepper if you need to.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover and let sit in the fridge for half hour to an hour before serving.

title: Vinegar Coleslaw
description: Sweet, tangy, and with just a touch of spiciness, this incredible coleslaw is a fantastic flavorful alternative to your usual creamy coleslaw. Sliced almonds or roasted nuts top it off for added crunch.

ingredients.name: 1-2 tablespoons honey, (adjust to desired sweetness (sub with sugar) )
Salt and fresh ground pepper, (to taste)
Sliced almonds and/or roasted nuts, (for some extra crunch)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Whisk the mustard, honey, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, and garlic in a small bowl. Set aside. (This step may be done an hour or even a day ahead.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the sliced cabbage, grated carrots, and green onions in a salad bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour dressing on the cabbage mixture and mix; start with a small amount of dressing and add until you reach the desired ratio of salad to dressing. (Everyone has their preference.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper, toss in some sliced almonds or your favorite roasted nuts for some extra crunch, and chill before serving.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the coleslaw with the rest of the vinaigrette on the side, if desired.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake (No-Bake)

butter (– melted or 3 tablespoons melted butter)

title: Sha Cha Chicken
description: Braised Chicken with Chinese Sha Cha Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless chicken legs or 1 chicken breast ( , cut into thin slices)
green peppers ( , both bell and spicy pepper work fine)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice chicken and then marinating with soy sauce, cooking wine and water starch. Set aside for around 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat your cook firstly, then around 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a non-stick pan or wok. Place chicken in when the oil is warm but not hot. Let the chicken stay for 3-5 seconds and gently stir fry the chicken until the the chicken slices turns pale. Transfer out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Leave some oil in and fry garlic until aromatic. Place sha cha sauce in and add water. Bring everything to a boiling and then place chicken, chili peppers and red onion. Simmer for 1 minute and serve with steamed rice.

title: Roasted Kabocha Squash Soup
description: An easy roasted kabocha squash soup that yields a well-balanced, hearty, creamy soup that is garlicky and lightly sweet. You can use butternut or acorn squash if you cannot find kabocha. You can easily make the dish vegan as well.

ingredients.name: medium (about 2 lb / 1 kg) kabocha squash ((or acorn squash, or butternut squash))
butter ((or olive oil for a vegan dish))
Freshly chopped sage or thyme for garnish ((Optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 °F (220 °C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the squash into quarters (see blog post above to learn how to cut kabocha safely). Cut the onion into quarters, leaving the skin on. Chop the ginger and peel the garlic cloves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Spread the kabocha squash, onion, ginger and garlic on the tray.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drizzle with 1 tablespoon maple syrup, the olive oil, and the maple syrup. Rub it on to the squash evenly with your hands. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of salt over it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the squash and onions to be skin-side-up. Make sure the garlic cloves are under the hoods of the squash to help them keep moist.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roast for 1 hour at 425 °F (220 °C). Flip the squash and onions at the 30 minute mark, still skin-side-up, and the other cut side down.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the vegetables are done, let them cool for 5 to 10 minutes on the kitchen counter, until you can handle the squash with your hands.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Using a knife, peel the skin off the squash and discard it. Remove the dried layer from the onions and discard it.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the roasted veggies, the remaining 1 tablespoon maple syrup, and the remaining 1 teaspoon salt, along with the cumin, vegetable broth, and butter, to the blender, Blend on high until smooth, about 5 minutes. Taste the soup. Adjust the texture by adding more broth as desired, and adjust the seasoning by adding more salt if needed. Then blend again to mix well.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Garnish with olive oil (or heavy cream), chopped sage or thyme, and freshly ground black pepper, if needed. Serve hot with toasted bread. Enjoy!

title: Ojingeo Gui (Spicy Grilled Squid)
description: Tender squids (calamari) marinated in a gochujang sauce and quickly grilled

ingredients.name: 1-1/2 pounds 5 to 8 small or 2 medium to large squids

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the squid by carefully pulling the tentacles until the innards slip out of the body. Use your fingers to reach inside the tube and remove any remaining parts. Cut the tentacles from the head just below the eyes. Remove the beak from the center of the tentacles. Discard everything except the body and tentacles. Rinse the squids well under cold running water. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a bowl big enough to hold the squids, combine the marinade ingredients, and stir well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the squids and coat evenly with the marinade, and then marinate in the fridge for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a lightly oiled grill or a frying pan until very hot. Add the squids, and sear quickly until the squids curl up and turn opaque, about a minute, depending on the size of your squid. Flip them, and cook for another minute. You can baste with the sauce if you like. Remove the squids. You can pour the remaining marinade to the pan, bring to a boil, and use as extra sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Plate them on the sliced perilla leaves or any other vegetable of your choice. Drizzle some lemon juice over, and garnish with a slice of lemon.

title: Pickling Cucumbers Salad
description: Simple Spicy Picked Cucumber Salad. This salad is topped with mixed chili oil with thai fresh chili pepper and Sichuan peppercorn, and thus having a unique and fresh spicy, sweet yet crispy taste.

ingredients.name: small cucumber (, or 2 long English cucumber )
Thai chili peppers ( , chopped into small sections)
tbsp. peanut oil or other vegetable oil
dried chili peppers (, cut into sections )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the cucumber into halves and then remove the pulp inside. Further cut the cucumber into small strips. Add around 1 tablespoon of salt and mix well. Set aside at least 30 minutes (up to 2 hours). Then the water content is expelled by salt. Then discard the water. Quickly wash the cucumber strips and squeeze water out. Removing the original water content can make the cucumber much crunchier.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lay the strips in serving plates. Sprinkle garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, chopped scallion and chopped fresh peppers on top.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat around 3 tablespoons of vegetable cooking oil firstly, and then turn off fire, add chili pepper and Sichuan peppercorn in. Don't add them in the very beginning of the hot heating, they might be overcooked and taste bitter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the hot oil along with the chili pepper and Sichuan peppercorn on top of the cucumber. Try to spread the oil on top of chopped garlic to stimulate the aroma.

title: Tom Yum Fish Soup ต้มยำปลา
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: stalks lemongrass, smashed, separate top half and bottom half
Dried chilies, to taste, placed under the broiler for 30 seconds to 1 minute to char slightly
fish meat of your choice, cut into big chunks
Jasmine rice (or jasmine brown rice!) for serving

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: (Before you begin, take the soup pot you're going to use and add 4 cups of water into it. Take a mental note of what 4 cups of water looks like in this pot, i.e. how deep it is, it'll come in handy later.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make fish stock:

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a pot, add fish bones, water, shallots, cilantro roots, garlic, lemongrass tops, and daikon. Break apart some of the chilies to release the seeds, the more you break the spicier the soup will be, and add to the pot. Simmer on low heat for 45 minutes, skimming off any foam that floats to the top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once finished, remove fish bones, cilantro roots, daikon, and lemongrass tops and anything else you don't want in the final soup. I like to leave the shallots, garlic and chilies in the soup, but you don't have to. Safety Note: If your fish bones are small or they have fallen apart in the pot, I highly recommend straining out the soup to make sure there are no bones left in the pot!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: At this point you should have roughly 4 cups of fish stock (remember that mental note?). If you let it go a little long and it has reduced a bit too much, you can add water to makeup the shortfall. If you have too much, not to worry, you just may need to add a bit more seasoning, that's all.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the tom yum:

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bring the fish stock to a boil, then add lemongrass bottoms, galangal, torn kaffir lime leaves and simmer for 4-5 minutes. Note: the herbs are not meant to be eaten; they are used to infuse flavour into the soup only, so make sure you tell your guests not to eat them, or remove them altogether. What I like to do is remove some of them to make it easier to eat (less stuff to navigate around) but I leave some in there for garnish.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add fish sauce, sugar, mushroom, tomato, then the fish meat. Simmer until fish is fully cooked; 1-2 minutes depending on the size of your fish. Once the fish is fully cooked, add lime juice, then taste and more salt as needed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Top with chopped cilantro and serve! My mom loves to put rice in the soup bowl and eat is as a complete meal in one bowl. Whole grain rice such as jasmine brown rice, red rice, or black rice works particularly well in soups. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 10

title: Tomato-Basil Spaghetti with Blackened Chicken
description: Easy chicken spaghetti recipe, packed with bright Mediterranean flavors including tomatoes, basil, garlic and citrus. Serve it for dinner with your favorite salad (see ideas in the post.)

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (see our olive oil options here)
Extra virgin olive oil (see our olive oil options here)
grape or cherry tomatoes, halved (you can leave some whole)
7-8 green onions (both white and green parts), trimmed and finely chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat chicken breasts dry and season with kosher salt and black pepper. In a small bowl, mix together the oregano, coriander, paprika and nutmeg. Apply the spice mixture to chicken breasts on both sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In an oven-safe skillet, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil until shimmering but not smoking. Add chicken and brown deeply on both sides (about 4 to 5 minutes in total) Turn heat off. Add 1/4 cup water and lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer chicken to the 400 degrees F-heated oven. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning over once. (Chicken is ready when internal temperature in its thickest part reads 165 degrees F. )

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While chicken is baking, cook spaghetti according to package. Mine took about 9 minutes in boiling water with a dash of salt. Drain in a large colander. Set aside briefly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large heavy cooking skillet, heat 1/2 cup olive oil. Stir in crushed red pepper flakes, tomatoes, garlic, and chopped green onions. Season with kosher salt and pepper. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes on medium-high. Now add white wine and lemon juice. Bring to a boil, allowing the sauce to reduce a little, then reduce heat to medium, cover and let simmer for 7-10 minutes or until tomatoes sofetn and turn a nice rusty orange.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Now, add cooked spaghetti to the tomato mixture and stir to combine. When pasta heats through, toss in the basil leaves, Parmesigiano Reggiano, and pine nuts (if you choose).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer spaghetti to serving bowls and top with the baked chicken breasts. Enjoy!

title: Chicken in Mushroom Onion and Garlic Sauce
description: Crispy and tender Chicken thigh with mushroom, onion and garlic sauce- ready in under 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 175F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Trim chicken of any visible fat. Make a 1/2 " slit into chicken thigh meat on either side of the chicken

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season the 4 chicken thighs on both sides -with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place chicken, skin side down, on a non-stick skillet or cast iron with a lid, on high heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: As soon as the chicken starts to sizzle, cover and reduce the heat down to medium - move the thighs around to make sure they aren't sticking to the skillet. Let it cook for about 16-18 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prep ingredients – chop onions, chop mushrooms and mince garlic, thyme.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Make sure you check the chicken after 10 minutes. If it browning too fast reduce heat even further, until chicken is cooked. Transfer the thighs to a warm oven.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour out all of the chicken fat except for about 2 tablespoons.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Turn the heat to high and then add the onion, garlic, thyme and mushrooms. Sauté, stirring frequently, for about 3 minutes. Add Cajun salt, and then pour in the chicken stock and milk. Continue to cook for 2-3 minute over high heat until the sauce reduces. Adjust seasonings with salt and stock

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Sprinkle on some parsley and serve with rice or any side dish.

title: Extra syrupy Tulumba recipe (Fried dough pastries)
description: A delicious, traditional homemade tulumba recipe for you to recreate these little bites of heaven from scratch!

ingredients.name: of a cup vegetable oil or butter

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious extra syrupy tulumba recipe, start by making the syrup first. In a small pot add all the ingredients for the syrup and bring to the boil. Let the syrup boil for 4-5 minutes, until the sugar was dissolved and the syrup has slightly thickened. Set aside to cool down completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Continue by preparing the dough for this tulumba recipe. Pour in a deep saucepan the milk, water, sugar, salt and oil and bring to the boil over medium-high heat. As soon as the mixture boils and the sugar has dissolved, remove the pan from the stove and add all the flour at once. Stir vigorously the mixture with a wooden spoon. Stir hard, until all the flour is incorporated, for about 30-60 seconds. Lower the heat to low and return the pot on the stove. Cook whilst constantly stirring for 30-60 seconds, being careful not to burn the mixture. (What we do here, is trying to get as much water as possible to evaporate out of the mixture.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Scrape the mixture for the tulumba pasties into a mixer fitted with a paddle attachment and mix at medium speed to cool it. With the mixer running, add the 4 eggs, one at a time, waiting each time for the egg to be absorbed. Stop mixing after each addition to scrape down the sides of the bowl. Mix until the dough is smooth and glossy and the eggs are completely incorporated. The dough should be thick, but should fall slowly and steadily from the beaters when you lift them out of the bowl. Add the vanilla extract and the white vinegar and mix again, until incorporated.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the oil for deep frying the tulumba pastries over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now it’s time to shape the tulumba pastries. For this tulumba recipe you will need a pasty bag fitted with a large 1cm star nozzle. Place the dough for the tulumba pastries in the pastry bag and squeeze 5cm dough pieces, cutting the dough with wet scissors, into the hot oil. Be careful not to overcrowd the surface of the pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fry the tulumba pasties over medium heat, turning them sides and pushing them down into the hot oil, until nicely coloured and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on kitchen paper to drain.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the tulumba pastries in the cold syrup and leave them for 2-3 minutes to absorb the syrup. Remove with a slotted spoon and repeat with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve the tulumba pastries cold. Enjoy!

title: Stir-Fried Snow Peas and Water Chestnuts
description: Imported from omnivorescookbook.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a non-stick skillet on medium high heat, add peanut oil. When oil is hot, add garlic and stir until fragrant. Add carrot and keep stirring until carrot is half cooked, around 40 seconds. Add water chestnuts and snow peas, keep stir frying for around 2 minutes. Add salt and stir for another 1 minute, until all vegetables are cooked through but still crispy.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place all vegetables on a plate and serve while warm.
