title: Seafood Doenjang Jjigae
description: Doenjang jjigae (Korean soybean paste stew) made with seafood

ingredients.name: assortment of seafood (I used a few small clams, 1/2 squid, and 5 medium shrimp)
of anchovy broth or water (see note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and scrub the clams. Place the clams in salted water (1 tablespoon of salt in 2 to 3 cups of water) for 30 minutes or longer to get the clams to spit out the sand. Clean the squid, and cut into bite size pieces. Clean the shrimp.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the tofu into 1/2-inch thick bite size slices. Cut the zucchini, onion, mushrooms, and radish into bite size pieces. Roughly chop the scallion, and thinly slice the chili pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the anchovy broth (or rice water or plain water), soybean paste and gochugaru to a small pot. Stir well to dissolve the soy bean paste. Add the radish and onion. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the tofu, zucchini, mushroom, chili pepper and garlic. Boil for an additional 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the seafood, starting with the clams. Cook for another 2 to 3 minutes or until the clams are open. Stir in the vinegar, and throw in the scallion. Cook for another minute or two.

title: Mushroom Stir Fry
description: Healthy brown beech mushroom and white beech mushroom stir-fry recipe.

ingredients.name: thumb piece of ginger ( , peeled and shredded )
green onions (, white part only, cut into small sections)
tbsp. oyster sauce ( , vegan for note 1)
tsp. dark soy sauce ( , optional only for dark color)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean and prepare the beech mushrooms and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Hit up some oil in wok, add green onion white to fry over slowest fire until slightly browned and seared. Add ginger shreds in.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then place mushrooms in, add oyster sauce and soy sauce. At the very beginning, there will be lots of water. Continue to evaporate most of the water. Takes 2 to 3 minutes. Mix in sesame oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer out and sprinkle fresh ground pepper.

title: Thai Eggplant Stir Fry with Thai Basil
description: Succulent juicy eggplant stir fried with Thai basil in a flavourful sauce featuring Thai chili paste. A must try for Thai food lovers!

ingredients.name: Chinese or Japanese eggplant (about 1 large or 2 small), sliced on a bias about 0.5-inch thick, then halve each round
Red Thai chilies, to taste (use at least 3, bigger ones if you can. Take the seeds out to reduce spiciness)
ground chicken (or sub ground pork or crumbled firm tofu)
Have a little water on the ready while you cook

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all sauce ingredients together and whisk until the chili paste is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pound chilies and garlic in a mortar and pestle until there are no more big chunks (but not a fine paste). You can also chop them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large, flat skillet, add just enough oil to coat the bottom, then heat until quite hot but not smoking. Add the eggplant in one layer (you may need to do this in batches) and let sear over medium high heat, undisturbed, until the bottom side is browned. Flip and cook the other side until it is browned as well. The pieces from the bottom of the eggplant will cook faster, so you will need to remove those first. Transfer into a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a wok, add a little bit of oil and the pounded garlic and chili mixture. Saute for about 1 minute over medium heat just until the garlic starts to brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add ground chicken and cook until 80% done, adding a splash of water to loosen the chicken as needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the eggplant and the sauce, then keep tossing for about 2-3 minutes until the eggplant is fully cooked but not mushy. Add the basil, turn off the heat, then toss for 30 more seconds using the residual heat to wilt the basil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with rice. Enjoy!

title: BEST Vegetarian Baked Ziti
description: This recipe is all you need to make an all-star vegetarian baked ziti with ricotta, marinara sauce, and a layer of bright veggies. Perfect weeknight baked pasta, and you can prepare it ahead and store in the fridge or freezer for later.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil)
bell pepper (orange or red), cored and diced
basil leaves, torn or carefully sliced/chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. When ready, add the pasta and cook to al dante according to package. When ready, drain pasta but save about 1/2 cup cooking water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the pasta is cooking , cook the vegetables. In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add onions and cook for 3 minutes or so, tossing regularly, then add diced zucchini, bell pepper, and garlic. Raise heat to medium-high and cook for about 6 to 8 minutes, tossing regularly, until vegetables have softened and cooked through. Season with kosher salt, oregano and paprika. Sit aside till needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine the ricotta, 1/4 cup grated Paremsan and 3 tbsp Mozzarella. Mix well. (If needed, add a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil to help mix the cheese)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the pasta has been cooked and drained, bring it back to the cooking pot. Add 1/2 of the marinara sauce and starchy cooking water you reserved (1/2 cup). Mix well to coat the pasta with the sauce. Fold in the ricotta cheese filling. Mix again to combine, but leave some big “pockets” of the cheese mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Grab a 9 1/2″ x 13″ casserole dish. Pour a little marinara sauce to the bottom of the dish, spread. Spread half the pasta. Now add the cooked vegetables and some of the torn basil on top and spread well across the pasta layer. Sprinkle a little bit of shredded mozzarella on top (leave more mozzarella for very top layer.) Add remaining pasta. Spread remaining marinara sauce on top and add remaining mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the casserole dish on the middle rack of your heated oven. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or so. Remove from heat and let rest about 10 to 15 minutes before cutting through. garnish with fresh basil.

title: Mediterranean Sea Bass Recipe Stuffed with Tomatoes, Lemons and Olives
description: An amazingly tender Mediterranean oven baked stuffed sea bass recipe for the lovers of the Greek cuisine!

ingredients.name: whole sea bass, cleaned and gutted

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this oven baked stuffed sea bass recipe, preheat the oven to 190C and transfer the sea bass onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper. (Make sure to use enough foil to cover the fish later.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the stuffing for the sea bass. Finely slice the fennel, lemon and tomato and set aside. Peel and finely chop the garlic and slice the kalamata olives into rings.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fill the cavity of each fish with 2 slices of lemon, the fennel and half the amount of the chopped tomato, olives and capers. Scatter on top of the sea bass the chopped garlic, any remaining fennel slices and the rest of the olives, tomato and capers. Pour in the white wine and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Drizzle the sea bass with olive oil and garnish with chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To bake the stuffed sea bass, you need to seal the fish well by folding the foil up like a parcel. This will help keep the juices and flavours in and will help your stuffed sea bass maintain tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake the stuffed sea bass in preheated oven at 190C for 20-25 minutes, until cooked through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the baking tray from the oven and let it rest for 3-4 minutes, then place the stuffed sea bass with the foil on a serving platter, unwrap carefully, garnish with some lemon zest and enjoy!

title: Egg Muffins
description: Start your day more conveniently with deliciously easy to prepare EGG MUFFINS for breakfast. A keto-friendly snack with various flavorful fillings you can snack on in the morning, midday, or at night.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Grease the muffin tin pan generously with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Melt butter in a frying pan then add mushrooms (you may omit mushrooms), onions, and garlic and sauté for 3-5 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Whisk eggs to a large bowl, salt, and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add onion mushroom mixture to the eggs, thoroughly mix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Start placing ingredients into the muffin pan, depending on preference. See the picture for reference and the suggested ingredients in the list above.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the egg mixture evenly into the greased muffin pan. Add more ingredients if desired.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake for 22 -25 minutes or until the eggs are cooked. Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes in the pan. Eggs would deflate as it cools.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Use a small knife to loosen the sides of the muffins from the pan. Serve immediately with avocado, salsa, herbs, and/or hot sauce, if desired.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let it cool and freeze in a zip lock bag or airtight container, for later.

title: "Miang Kham" Wild Betel Leaf Wrap เมี่ยงคำ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: bai chaplu or la lot leaves (wild betel leaves, see note)
dried shrimp (soak in hot water for at least 15 minutes to soften)
thin-skinned limes, diced with the skin on (see note)
shrimp paste, or more if you like the flavour

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the sauce: Add dried shrimp to blender and blend until fine, then add galangal, ginger, and about half of the water and blend until fine. Pour into a small pot. Rinse blender with the remaining water to get all the bits out, then pour into pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add palm sugar, shrimp paste and fish sauce to the blended herbs, then bring to a simmer until the sugar is completely dissolved. Once all the sugar has dissolved, simmer on low heat for 5 more minutes until reduced by about half. Add the ground coconut and ground peanuts. Let the sauce cool until it's lukewarm, then check the consistency to make sure it is not too thick, if it is, you can add a bit more water. If it's too runny, reduce it a bit more. Taste and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce as needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To eat the wrap, make a little cone with the betel leaf, then fill it with all the wrap ingredients to your liking. Top with a little bit of sauce, close the cup and eat it all in one bite!

title: Spicy White Radish Salad
description: Simple Spicy White Radish Salad.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean white radish and cut into really thin shreds.I recommend using a tool for beginner.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sprinkle salt on those shreds and mix well. Put aside for 10 minutes.Then squeeze the water out. Have a taste here. If the shreds are too salty, wash it with purified water and then squeeze the water out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, add sugar, sesame oil and vinegar in with white radish shreds and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Spread the chili pepper powder on the surface of the white radish shreds. Heat up 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in pan and then pour the hot oil on the chili powder. Mix everything well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garnish some roasted sesame seeds and green onion before serving.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve directly or refrigerate for about 2 hours.

title: Oiji Muchim (Spicy Seasoned Cucumber Pickles)
description: A simple side dish made with Korean cucumber pickles, oiji!

ingredients.name: oiji (Korean pickled cucumber- 6 if using short kirby pickled cucumbers
1-1/2 tablespoons gochugaru (고추가루, Korean red chili pepper flakes)
oligodang (올리고당) or maesilcheong (매실청, Korean plum syrup) (or 1/2 tablespoon honey)
small fresh chili pepper (red or green, finely chopped - optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the cucumber pickles.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak the pickle slices in water until oiji reaches the desired salt level, about 10 minutes depending on your pickles.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain and tightly squeeze the pickles between your palms to remove as much liquid as possible. You may have to squeeze them several times.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining ingredients, except the scallion and sesame seeds, and mix everything very well until the pickles are evenly coated with gochugaru. Finish with tossing in the scallion and sesame seeds.

title: Egg Fried Rice
description: Learn how to make a mean EGG FRIED RICE at home that is on par with your favorite Chinese restaurants. Made with just a few simple ingredients, this quick and easy rice dish is also packed with tons of flavors.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If rice is clumpy, break it up before proceeding.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large wok or skillet on medium-high heat with about 1-2 tablespoons of canola or vegetable oil. Then add rice and soy sauce, quickly stir for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add oyster sauce and continue stirring, until fully incorporated. Move the rice to one side of the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add the eggs and quickly stir to break the eggs apart. Quickly stir the rice and eggs together, for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove eggs and rice mixture and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add about a tablespoon of oil or more to the wok or pan. Once hot, add onions, and garlic, stir. Followed with peas and carrots.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Finally return the rice. Stir until everything has been fully combined. Add pepper flakes or hot sauce - optional.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper and soy sauce, if necessary.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Garnish with chopped scallion and serve.

title: Middle Eastern Vegan Donuts (Zalabia)
description: Here is a super simple Middle Eastern Dessert: Vegan Donuts or Zalabia--AKA my childhood guilty pleasure, and the perfect Fat Tuesday treat! It takes 5 simple ingredients that you already have in your pantry!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Stir the instant yeast and 1 tsp sugar in 1/4 cup lukewarm water; leave the mixture until it foams.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour and corn starch with the rest of the water, then add the yeast mixture. Stir everything together to combine. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside in a warm area for about 2 hours to rise. 3-4 times during the rising time, stir the dough with a wooden spoon to get rid of air bubbles.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the dough has risen, fill a small heavy saucepan about 1/3 of the way with canola oil. Heat on medium-high until the oil is hot and you can see small bubbles forming gently. Using two oiled spoons, drop the dough by the spoonful into the hot oil (do this in small batches.) The dough will float immediately and the bottom side will turn golden brown. Flip over on the other side. Remove quickly to a large tray lined with paper towels to drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the syrup. In a small saucepan or pot, combine the sugar, honey, water and cinnamon stick. Bring to a boil on high heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Turn the heat to low and cook for a few minutes until the syrup thickens. Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the syrup is hot, drop the donuts in it. Do this in batches and make sure the donuts are completely coated with the syrup. Transfer the Zalabia vegan donuts to a serving bowl or plate. If you have any syrup left, feel free to drizzle it on the donuts or set it aside for individuals to add as they please.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Alternatively, soak only half of the donuts in the syrup, and roll the remaining donuts in lots of confectioners sugar. Enjoy!

title: Perfect Lenten Chocolate Brownies!
description: Having a craving for brownies? With this butter and egg free lenten chocolate brownies recipe you can enjoy them during the easter lent totally guilt free.

ingredients.name: walnuts, whole or roughly chopped (3.5 oz.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these delicious Lenten chocolate brownies, start by melting half of the chocolate (100g). To melt the chocolate it is best to use a bain-marie (or double boiler), a piece of equipment used to heat the chocolate gently and gradually to fixed temperatures so that it doesn’t burn. When done, set aside for 5 minutes to cool down.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl add the tahini, orange juice and cognac and whisk to combine. Pour in the melted chocolate and whisk again until incorporated. Add the flour, the baking powder and sugar and blend with a spatula, folding gently the mixture with light circular movements from the bottom up. You don’t want to overwork the mixture. Add the chopped walnuts and the rest of the chocolate (cut in pieces) and blend.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180C. Line one square baking tin (approx. 22*22cm) with parchment paper and grease with vegetable oil. Dust with cocoa powder and get rid of the excess cocoa. Tip in the brownie mixture in an even layer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake the brownies in preheated oven for about 25 minutes, until they have formed a shiny and dry slightly cracked layer but are still moist underneath (be careful not to over bake them). Set aside to cool down for about 20-30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve these delicious Lenten chocolate brownies, while still warm with melted couverture and fresh strawberries. Enjoy!

title: Mini Gimbap (Mayak Gimbap)
description: Addictive mini gimbap (Korean seaweed rice rolls) with a mustard and sesame sauce

ingredients.name: 1-1/2 cups uncooked short grain rice (standard measuring cup not the cup that comes with a rice cooker)
salt to taste (start with ⅓ teaspoon)
yellow pickled radish (danmuji strips, pre-cut for gimbap)
sesame seeds (finely ground in a spice grinder or mortar bowl)
dijon mustard (or Korean hot mustard, gyeoja)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the rice using a little less water than usual. (Fresh cooked rice is best for gimbap.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat and prepare an ice bath. Blanch the spinach, place immediately in the ice bath, then squeeze the water out. Run a knife through the squeezed spinach a couple of times. Season with the sesame oil and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Julienne the carrots. Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium high heat. Stir fry the carrots until slightly softened. Lightly season with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the pickled radish crosswise in half, and then cut lengthwise in half.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When all the ingredients are ready, remove the rice from the rice cooker. While the rice is still hot, add the sesame oil and salt. Mix well by lightly folding with a rice paddle or spoon until evenly seasoned.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cut 4 sheets of gim into quarters.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Put a quarter sheet of gim, shiny side down and shorter side toward you, on a cutting board. title: Coconut Waffle Recipe ขนมรังผึ้ง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, whisk rice flour, all-purpose flour and baking powder together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Beat eggs well and stir into the cooled coconut milk mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the coconut milk mixture into the flour bowl and stir with a rubber spatula just until combined, making sure to scrape all the way to the bottom of the bowl. Stir in the corn (or whatever you are using) and rest the batter for 30 minutes before using.

For the extra ones you're saving for later, let them cool completely on a rack and freeze in a freezer bag. title: Sichuan Boiled Fish
description: Famous Sichuan style boiled fish slices - also known as Shui Zhu Yu.

ingredients.name: half fo the fried Sichuan peppercorn
fried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorn

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare fish |Cut the fillet into thin slices and then marinate with all marinating sauce. Set aside for 30 minutes or even longer. Then add cornstarch and mix well before making the dish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fry the pepper and Sichuan peppercorn|Heat 12 to 20 dried chili peppers with slow fire for half minute and then add 1 tablespoon of Sichuan peppercorn in wok until slightly aromatic. Move out, cool down and then roughly chop.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add oil in wok and fry the doubanjiang over slow fire until the oil turns red. Then place garlic, ginger and scallion in and fry until aromatic. Then add dou-chi, Sichuan peppercorn and toasted chili pepper (half). Continue cooking for half minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Load the wok with around 4 cups of water. Let the base simmer for 10 minutes over slow fire.

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

title: Scrumptious Lenten Apple Pie Recipe! (Greek Milopita)
description: Who doesn't love a home made apple pie! However most Lenten Apple pies I tried turned out mushy, with a strong oily flavour, so I decided to improvise and make my own!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Lenten apple pie, starting by making the dough. In the mixer’s bowl add the oil and sugar and whisk for 3-4 minutes, until incorporated. Pour in the orange juice and the cognac and whisk for 1 more minute. Add the flour a little bit at a time and mix until the dough becomes soft. Wrap the dough with some plastic wrap and let it rest in the fridge for 15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the filling for the Lenten apple pie. Peel the apples and slice them in thin slices. Place the apples in a pan along with the rest of the ingredients for the filling. Heat over medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes, until the apples slightly soften.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dust a clean work surface with flour and divide the dough in two halves. Roll out one piece of the dough until 1/2 cm thick. Roll carefully the dough around the rolling pin and unroll it over your pie dish (approx. 20cm). Ease the pastry into the pan and push it into all the sides. Using a fork to make some holes on the bottom pastry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fill with the apple filling and squeeze to tight it into the dish. Roll out the other piece of dough (approx. 1/2 cm thick), cut into strips and decorate the apple pie, placing them in a latticework pattern, as seen in the picture.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle the apple pie with sugar and bake in preheated oven at 180C for approx. 40 minutes, until golden.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the apple pie from the oven and let it sit for 5-10 mins. Sprinkle with more sugar and serve while still warm from the oven. Enjoy!

title: Borracho Beans (Frijoles Borrachos)
description: Tender and creamy Borracho Beans (Frijoles Borrachos) are an easy Mexican dish made from pinto beans simmered in beer with bacon, onions and tomatoes.

ingredients.name: dried pinto beans* ((see tips below for using canned beans))
jalapeño pepper (diced (seeds and veins removed if you don't want it spicy))
ancho chili powder ((or regular if you don't have ancho))
12-ounce bottle dark lager beer ((I used Negra Modelo))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour the beans into a large bowl. Pick out and discard any beans that are shriveled or split as well as any small rocks that may have made their way into the bag.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fully cover the beans with water (at least 3 inches over the top of the beans) and set on the counter to soak for 8 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain and rinse the beans under cool water. (They will have doubled in size during the soaking process!)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the beans to a large pot or Dutch oven. Add 10 cups of water (and the optional ingredients if using them).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring beans to a boil, then reduce heat to a low simmer. Cover and cook for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. (I recommend checking them at the 2 hour mark and giving them a taste. They should be tender and fully cooked through, but still a little firm and not mushy. Cook a little longer if they're not quite done.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain cooked beans, transfer to a large bowl, and set aside. Rinse and dry the pot.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return pot to the stove and heat over medium-high heat. Add the bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crispy. Transfer the cooked bacon to a plate lined with paper towels and set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the onions and jalapeno and cook for 5 minutes, scraping up any browned bits on the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the garlic, chili powders, dried oregano, salt and ground cumin. Stir and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the cooked pinto beans, diced tomatoes, beer and brown sugar. Stir together to combine and bring to a low simmer.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Simmer the beans for 15 minutes and remove from heat. Stir in the chopped cilantro and crispy bacon. Serve immediately.

title: Fall Rotini Pasta Salad
description: This light, vegetarian rotini pasta recipe will surprise your taste buds in the best way possible!

ingredients.name: brussels sprouts, top trimmed, and halved
goat cheese, crumbled or cut into small pieces, more if you like
large shallots, sliced into half moons
fresh chopped marjoram leaves, stems removed

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the Rotini pasta in boiling water according to the package instructions to al dante (which is about 1 or 2 minutes before it’s cooked all the way to soft.) When ready, drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the pasta is cooking, heat 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil in a large cast iron. Add the butternut squash. Cook on medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until the butternut squash is cooked through. Season with a little salt. Transfer the butternut squash to a dish and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now, if needed, add 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil to the same cast iron skillet. Make sure the oil is hot. Now add the brussels sprouts, cut side down, and cook on medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes. Turn the brussels sproutss over on the other side and cook for another 5 minutes until nicely browned and tender. Sprinkle with salt. Transfer to the same dish with the butternut squash for the moment.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now make the sauce in the same cast iron skillet. Melt the butter over medium-high heat, swirling occasionally, until the butter is browned and releases a nice nutty aroma. Remove the skillet from heat briefly and add the shallots, marjarom, and garlic. Stir until fragrant (less than 1 minute). Return to medium heat and add the olive oil and lemon juice. Stir in the lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Keep the sauce in the cast iron skillet on medium heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now add the cooked pasta to the sauce and stir until the pasta is well coated. Season with a little more salt, black pepper, ground cinnamon, and nutmeg. Stir in the baby spinach and parsley. Then add the cooked butternut squash and brussels sprouts. Cook everything together on medium heat, stirring regularly, until warmed through. Taste and adjust the salt and seasoning to your liking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the warm rotini pasta salad to a large bowl. Drizzle with a little more extra virgin olive oil, if you like. Top with goat cheese and toasted pine nuts. Serve warm or at room temperature with extra goat cheese on the side! Enjoy!

title: Baked Salt-Crusted Fish ปลาเผาเกลือ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: whole white fish, at least 2 lb, gutted, preferably scales left on (see note)
stalk lemongrass, bottom half only, smashed and cut into chunks
About 3 Tbsp of kosher salt or coarse grain salt, or as needed

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all the herbs to a food processor and process just until they're coarsely chopped. Stuff the herbs into the cavity of the fish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Rub a thin layer of salt onto the fish; the body should be thoroughly coated but the salt should be thin enough that you can still see through to the skin. Place the fish onto a baking sheet lined with a rack (I didn't do this in the video because I didn't have a rack big enough, but if you have one it'll be better.) Otherwise line the baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the fish is fully cooked. To test doneness, try to life the thickest part of the fish off the bones, and cooked fish should flake off the bones easily, while undercooked fish will stick to the bones. You can also use a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the fish, and it should read at least 140°F before removing from the oven.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the dried chilies in the oven along with the fish and let it toast for 3-4 minutes until they darken and are crispy. You can also toast them in a dry saute pan over medium heat. Place them in a mortar and pestle and pound into flakes (if you want less spicy, remove the seeds first.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add garlic and pound into a paste. Add palm sugar and pound until dissolved. Add peanuts and pound until they are a coarse meal. Add all remaining ingredients and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the fish is done, brush off the excess salt from the fish and transfer onto a serving plate. Peel off the skin and serve with jasmine rice and dipping sauce. Enjoy!

description: A Korean-Chinese deep fried shrimp glazed in a sweet, slightly sour and spicy sauce.

to 5 small dried red hot peppers (roughly cut)
red bell pepper (or 1 red chili pepper, finely diced)
rice or dry white wine (or use more water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the shrimp, drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Lightly sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let it sit until ready to coat with the batter.

steps.title: Step 2

Using metal tongs or chopsticks, drop the shrimp in the oil one at a time, in two batches. Cook until lightly golden, about a minute.

title: Tapioca Coconut Mini Cookies (kanom ping) ขนมผิง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine coconut milk, sugar and pandan leaf in a heavy-bottomed pot and simmer for about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it has a thick syrupy consistency (it will thicken as it cools, so it may not look super thick while it's still hot).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the pandan leaf and let the syrup cool until it's lukewarm, then stir in an egg yolk. If you want to colour the dough with only one colour, you can add the food colouring to the syrup at this point.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the tapioca starch into a large mixing bowl, make a well in the center and pour in the coconut syrup. Using your hands, knead the dough together until it's smooth. If the dough feels very dry/stiff, add only a LITTLE water at a time; I like to use a spray bottle so I don't accidentally add too much water. If the dough feels too soft, add a little more tapioca starch. (Important: Please see "tip for success" above).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If you want to colour the dough with different colours, split the dough into portions and knead in food colouring until the colour is smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Let the dough rest for 30 minutes covered in plastic wrap to it doesn't dry out.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350°F/175°C.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Form cookies into little balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment or silicone liner; you can also generously grease your baking sheet with oil (coconut oil if you have it!). Bake in the oven for 25-30 minutes or until the bottoms are browned slightly. I like the bake 1 tray at a time for consistency, but if you want to bake 2 trays at once, switch their positions half way through the baking process.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the cookies are done, turn off the oven and open the oven door for about 8 seconds to drop the temperature, then put the cookies back in and let them cool in the warm oven. This step is optional but I recommend it as it allows the cookies to dry out completely and help lighten the texture. This also prevents the cookies from becoming too dense especially if your dough was on the dry side.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once cooled, package them into an airtight container and enjoy!

steps.description: In a small bowl, combine allspice, cinnamon, coriander, black pepper, cardamom and nutmeg. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat chicken pieces dry and place them on a lightly oiled sheet pan (or roasting pan). Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil, season with kosher salt on both sides. Add 1 tsp sumac and 1 ½ tsp of the spice mixture. Give the chicken a good rub with your hands, making sure to get the spices underneath the skin. Arrange the chicken pieces skin side up and place on the middle rack of your heated oven. Roast for about 1 hour or until fully cooked (internal temperature should register 165 degrees F.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the chicken is roasting, work on the caramelized onions. In a large cooking skillet, put just over ½ cup extra virgin olive oil, chopped onions, kosher salt, 1 tbsp sumac, 1 tbsp cumin, and 2 tsp of the spice mixture. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, adding a little bit of water (2tbsp or so at a time) as needed, until the onions have softened and cooked completely (about 30 to 40 minutes). Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: . Pour any roasting pan juices into the caramelized onions. Cover chicken loosely with aluminum foil for about 15 minutes, while you assemble the flatbreads.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn on your broiler. To assemble flatbreads, dip the edges of each bread in the oil on the surface of the onion mixture. Arrange flatbreads on a large baking sheet (you may do a couple flatbreads at a time). Spread enough of the caramelized onion mixture on the surface of each flatbread, leaving a small border around the edge (like pizza). Add a generous sprinkle of sumac. Add toasted pine nuts. Place under the broiler briefly (2 to 4 mins), watching carefully, until edges and onion mixture are nicely browned.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When flatbreads are ready, top each with a chicken portion and serve along with a side of olives and simple Mediterranean salad.

title: Greek Sesame Bread rings recipe (Koulouri Thessalonikis)
description: A traditional Greek sesame seed bread rings recipe! If you've ever found yourself walking the streets of Athens or Thessalonikis then you can't have missed on all the street vendors selling these popular sesame koulouria!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these Greek sesame bread rings recipe, start by making the dough. In the mixer’s bowl add the lukewarm water, the yeast and sugar and stir. Wrap well with plastic wrap and set aside for about 8-10 minutes, until the yeast starts bubbling. Into the same bowl, add first the flour, then the salt and olive oil. Using the dough hook, mix all the ingredients at low speed for about 7 minutes, until the dough becomes an elastic ball. When done, remove the dough from the hook and check out its texture. It should be smooth and elastic and slightly sticky. If it is too sticky, add just a little more flour (1/2 tsp), mix and check again.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Coat lightly a bowl with some olive oil, place the dough inside and cover with plastic wrap. Let the dough sit in warm place for about 30 minutes. Knead the dough again at medium-high speed for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the dough onto a working surface and divide into 12 pieces. Take one piece of the dough and roll out into a rope approx. 35cm long. Form a circle and join the ends pinching them together. Place the bread ring on a large baking tray, lined up with parchment paper and repeat with the rest of the dough. (You will need two large baking trays.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the ingredients for the garnish. In one bowl pour some water. In a separate bowl or tray place the sesame seeds. Dip the koulouria (bread rings) in water and then in sesame seeds, making sure to cover them on all sides. Place them back on your baking sheets, leaving some distance between them. Let them rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes. (For garnish you can also petimezi for extra flavour. Use 1/3 of a cup petimezi diluted in 1/4 of cup water and dip the bread rings first in the petimezi mixture and then in sesame seeds.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 200C for about 15 minutes, until nicely golden brown and crusty. Enjoy!

title: Crispy Baked Shrimp
description: Juicy, delicious shrimp dinner with a delightful crunch that comes together from start to finish in just 25 minutes. Savory, garlicky, lemony, buttery, and a bit spicy – all these beautiful flavors you'll get in just a pan!

ingredients.name: (900g) extra large or jumbo shrimp, (peeled and deveined (tails on or off))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350℉/177℃.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Microwave butter, chicken stock, garlic, and Creole seasoning for about 30 seconds or until butter melts, followed by lemon juice. Alternately, add ingredients in a small skillet, cook over medium-high heat for about 30 seconds until butter melts, then add lemon juice. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add shrimp to a large bowl and lightly season with salt and pepper. Pour in the butter mixture and thoroughly mix.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place seasoned shrimp in a single layer in a shallow 9"x13" baking dish or 12-inch cast iron skillet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, and melted butter, and evenly spread on shrimp for an extra tasty topping.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the baking dish to the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the shrimp is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Increase the oven setting to broil, then broil the shrimp for 1-2 minutes or until the crumbs brown slightly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove, and garnish with lemon and a sprinkle of parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Rabdi Recipe | Traditional Rabri
description: Rabdi or Rabri is a traditional North Indian sweet made by slow simmering milk until it reduces, thickens and forms layers of clotted cream (malai).

ingredients.name: to 3 tablespoons sugar (or add as required)
cardamom powder (or 5 to 6 green cardamoms, crushed in mortar-pestle)

title: Split Pea Soup
description: Split Pea Soup - a very simple yet hearty and comforting soup that is a great dish to make use of leftover holiday ham.

ingredients.name: - 1 ½ cups (128-192g) diced carrots ( about 2 medium carrots )
(122g) medium-diced red boiling potatoes (, unpeeled (3 small))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 1 tablespoon olive oil into a large dutch pot and heat over medium heat. Add diced ham and cook until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Throw in onions, garlic, and celery into the pot, saute frequently until onion is soft and translucent. About 3 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add in carrots, dried peas, potatoes, and stock, bring to a boil. Season with oregano, creole seasoning, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to taste. Mix thoroughly to fully combine all ingredients, cover pot with the lid and cook on low, occasionally stirring to prevent burns, until veggies are soft and desired consistency has been reached about 30-45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the soup is ready, return the ham to the pot and serve warm.

title: Chinese Beef Salad
description: A super easy Chinese beef salad you can put together in 10 minutes with no cooking required! Serve it as an appetizer for a multi-course meal, top it on steamed rice for a one-bowl lunch, or make a sandwich with it using pita bread.

ingredients.name: homemade braised beef shank (, thinly sliced (or roast beef deli meat))
stalk Chinese celery (, thinly sliced (or 1/2 stalk regular celery, diced))
broth from homemade braised beef shank (, heated up in the microwave (Optional) (*Footnote 1))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the dressing ingredients in a small bowl, stir, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add to a bowl the beef shank, celery, green onion, chilis, and half of the cilantro and peanuts. Drizzle the dressing onto it and gently toss.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Plate the salad, drizzle with some extra chili oil if desired, and garnish with the remaining cilantro and peanuts.

title: Kongnamul Japchae (Soybean Sprouts Japchae)
description: A quick and easy japchae made with soybean sprouts!

ingredients.name: Korean sweet potato starch noodles (dangmyeon, 당면)
red bell pepper (or 1/2 small carrot, julienned)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil 2 cups of water in a pan over medium high heat. Add the soybean sprouts and cook for 2 minutes. Flip the sprouts over once, if cooking uncovered, for even cooking. Do not open until done if cooking covered.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl until the sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the soybean sprouts to a bowl, reserving the cooking liquid in the pan. Add 1 teaspoon of cooking oil, 1-1/2 tablespoons of the prepared sauce, and the noodles to the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook the noodles for 6 to 7 minutes until the liquid is almost gone. When the noodles turn soft, cut with kitchen shears into shorter lengths.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the scallions and red pepper slices, and stir fry briefly until the vegetables are slightly wilted.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the soybean sprouts and the remaining sauce. Quickly toss everything until well combined before turning off the heat.

title: Home Style Tofu
description: Home style tofu, quick vegan tofu recipe.

ingredients.name: scallions white part only ( , chopped into rounds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Drain the block of tofu and cut them into thick strips about 10 cm long and 3 cm width.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up some oil in pan, and put the tofu in until one side is golden. Turn over to make the other side become golden too. Then move out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add oil and doubanjiang and fry until the oil turns red over slow fire, then place garlic, ginger and spring onion white, cook until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add carrots and green pepper in to fry for 2 minute, place sugar, light soy sauce and cooking wine. Then return the fried tofu.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Give a gentle stir and mix everything well. Serve immediately.

title: Amazing Lenten Chocolate Sponge Cake!
description: Treat yourself this Lenten season with this delicious, spongy, chocolate-y cake! And if you are wondering this Lenten chocolate sponge cake has no eggs, no dairy products and no chocolate! Yet it tastes just like the real thing!
tags: chocolate sponge cake with no butter

ingredients.name: juice of 3-4 oranges (1 cup orange juice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Lenten chocolate cake add in the mixer’s bowl the oil and sugar and whisk. Dissolve the baking soda in the orange juice and pour in the sugar mixture. Start mixing the ingredients and pour in the water and vinegar. Mix again for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime sift the flour and cocoa powder and blend to combine. Add gradually the flour-cocoa mixture and fold gently with a spatula until combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 175C (both top and bottom heating elements on). Oil the bottom and sides of a non-sticking cake tin to prevent sticking and pour in the mixture. Place the cake in the preheated oven (on the lower rack) and bake for 50-60 minutes, until nicely coloured and cooked through. Let the cake cool down for a while before removing the cake tin.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place a rack over a tray or bowl and prepare the glaze for the Lenten chocolate cake. In a large bowl add all the ingredients for the glaze and whisk to combine. Invert the cake on the rack and pour the glaze over the cake.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the cake on a serving platter and garnish with almond slivers. Enjoy this delicious Lenten chocolate cake with a hot cup of coffee or tea.

title: Vegetarian Mushroom Wonton Soup Recipe
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: large pc (65g) dried shiitake mushrooms, rehydrated and finely chopped (no stems)
Fried garlic & garlic oil (see this video @ for how to make fried garlic)
quart (946 ml) of low-sodium or unsalted vegetable broth
dried shiitake mushrooms (choose smaller or pre-sliced ones if possible)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the wonton filling: In a wok, add a little vegetable oil and saute garlic & ginger for a few minutes until smallest bits start to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add cabbage, carrots and half the soy sauce and cook until the cabbage is soft, adding a splash of water as needed, about 3-4. Once the cabbage is softened, add the mushrooms, remaining soy sauce, sugar, white pepper and sesame oil and keep tossing for another 2 minutes, adding water as needed. Add green onions and white pepper and toss to mix. Turn off the heat and taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dissolve cornstarch in water, then drizzle the slurry on top of the vegetables. Turn the heat back on and toss for another minute until the mixture starts to hold together, and there is no more starchy taste. If it feels dry, keep adding a splash of water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Let filling cool until it’s warm to the touch before wrapping.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To wrap the wontons: Keep your wrappers under a damp towel until you're using them as they dry and become brittle quickly. You can wrap these however you like, and check out this video for 5 ways to wrap wontons. Because this filling is quite light, I like to put a good 2 teaspoons of filling in each wonton, and use the "chubby pyramid" method to wrap them (see method in the video). Keep the wrapped wontons under a damp towel until ready to use. Important notes: Make sure to seal the wontons well and that there is absolutely NO hole in the wontons or water will get inside and ruin your filling! Also squeeze out as much air as you can before sealing it to prevent the wontons from rupturing when they're boiled.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To make the broth: Bring the broth to a boil, then add soy sauce, white pepper, fresh shiitake mushrooms, napa cabbage, and bok choy. Bring the broth back to a boil, and then it's done! Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Blanch the wontons for 2 minutes in rapidly simmering water (not boiling) then place in serving bowl. If the wontons have been refrigerated they might take a little longer to heat through. Reheat the broth if needed, then ladle the broth over the wontons. Top with fried garlic and garlic oil, garnish with green onions. Serve immediately!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Mexican Chicken and Rice
description: This Mexican Chicken and Rice features tender, juicy marinated chicken thighs and authentic Mexican rice cooked all in one pot!

ingredients.name: optional garnish: chopped cilantro and lime wedges

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large freezer bag (or bowl), add chicken, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, vinegar, onion powder, chili powder, paprika, salt, oregano and cumin. Seal the bag and shake up to completely coat the chicken with the marinade. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, up to overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large oven-safe saute pan/deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Add half of the chicken thighs to the pan and cook for 2 minutes per side, or until chicken is no longer pink on the outside. Transfer the chicken onto a plate and cook the remaining chicken the same way.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. In the same saute pan/skillet, add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil. (If the skillet is already very greasy and has enough oil to cover the bottom of the pan due to cooking the chicken, you can omit this last addition of oil.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the rice and saute for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice begins to brown slightly. At this point, some grains of rice may even pop. That's okay. This step adds some nuttiness and more depth of flavor to the rice.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add in the onions and minced garlic. Saute for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add in the water, tomato paste and a generous pinch of salt. Stir together to mix until the tomato paste has fully dissolved.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the saute pan with a lid or foil, place it in the oven and bake for 15 minutes. Remove it from oven, place the partially cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice, cover and cook for another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the lid or foil and bake for another 5 minutes uncovered. Check the temperature of the chicken thighs to make sure they're cooked through using a meat thermometer like this one or by slicing into one.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the pan from the oven and let cool slightly before serving. Garnish with diced cilantro and fresh lime juice, if desired.

title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
description: Cream of Mushroom Soup – creamy, elegant cream of mushroom soup made from scratch loaded with a pound of mushrooms and layers of flavors. You’ll be shock how easy it is to make!

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper ((more or less to taste))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Damp a paper towel then use this to clean mushrooms one at a time. Wipe the outside and underside to remove any dirt. If using small mushrooms, rinse under cold water, then pat dry with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a large skillet or cast iron on medium to high heat. Then add oil, swirl to coat bottom the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add mushrooms, season with salt and Creole seasoning – stir for a few minutes until slightly brown. Set aside,

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add butter to the skillet, followed by onion, cook , stirring until tender and translucent - about 3-5 minutes. Do not brown the onion.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Next, add garlic and thyme, stir for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in flour and continue cooking for another minute until flour and onions are well combined.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour in chicken stock, followed by evaporated milk, a little at a time until it forms a silky paste and starts simmering. Add bay leaf.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Simmer over medium-low heat, for about a 8-10 minutes until the soup reaches the desired thickness.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Return mushrooms together with it’s juice back to the skillet followed by chicken bouillon and Worcestershire sauce.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Pour in cream. Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper to taste .

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Lower heat and continue cooking until desired consistency has been reached. Add more cream or chicken broth for desired consistency. Garnish with chopped parsley. Serve hot.

title: Dyed Greek Easter Eggs recipe
description: These brightly colored Greek Easter eggs are the ultimate symbol of Greek Easter! Preparing these vibrant and colourful Easter eggs on Holy Thursday, always makes me realise that it's Easter time.
tags: how to dye greek easter eggs

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these colourful Greek Easter eggs, start by boiling the eggs. Wash thoroughly the eggs and place them (in one single layer) gently in an empty pot. Add enough cold water to cover the eggs by 3-4 cm.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the water with a good pinch of salt and bring to the boil. If you like your eggs hard-boiled, but juicy at the same time, boil the eggs for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the pot from the stove and place the eggs under cold running water for about 1 minute to stop the cooking process. Crack one egg to check if you are happy with the result.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: After the eggs cool down, start preparing the dye for your Greek Easter eggs. Place the warm water and the dye powder in a large glass bowl and stir, until dissolved. Add the vinegar and stir to combine. Place carefully the eggs (comfortably) in the bowl and set aside for 2-3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon on a rack over some kitchen paper and let them dry for about 40 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To give a little shine on your dyed Greek Easter eggs, wipe them with a paper towel with a little olive oil.

title: Aloo Palak Recipe (Potato Spinach Curry)
description: Aloo Palak is a simple Indian curry of potatoes cooked in a smooth spinach gravy. The potatoes are tender and absorb the mild spices and flavors of the dish. This vegetarian recipe is easy to make and works well for everyday meals.

to 3 cups water (– hot, for blanching spinach)
to 2 or 1 teaspoon green chilies (– chopped, can use serrano peppers)
tej patta (– small sized, (Indian bay leaf))

gram flour ((besan), swap with maize flour or chickpea flour)

title: How to Cook Beef Tongue
description: Beef tongue belongs in the category of foods that you wonder, why on earth someone would want to eat it, and once you taste it, you hate yourself for not having tried it sooner.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put beef tongue, onion, garlic and bay leaves in a slow cooker and add enough water to cover tongue. Cook overnight on low. You can also gently boil it on the stovetop for 2 hours to 3 hours, until the beef tongue turns very tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When tongue is cool enough to handle, peel off and discard rough tongue skin.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut tongue in 1/2-inch slices across grain then into 1/2-inch cubes. It can also be shredded or sliced, depend on the dish you cook. If you won’t serve the tongue soon, store in an airtight container or ziplock bag in the fridge up to 5 days.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When ready to serve, heat oil in a large nonstick or cast iron skillet set over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add tongue pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until tongue is well browned on all sides, 2 to 3 minutes total. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Mala Chicken
description: Authentic Szechuan Chicken recipe—Mala Chicken

ingredients.name: scallions ( ,white part and green part separated andcut into small sections)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the dried chili peppers, discard the seeds and then soak the peppers in water for 15 minutes. We are doing this so we can fry the peppers later and prevent burn the peppers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the bone of the chicken thighs and then cut into small cubes. In a large bowl, marinade the chicken cubes with all the marinating sauce. Mix well and set aside for around 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok or pan for deep-frying. Heat until really hot (you can see bubbles when you put a chopstick in). Add the chicken cubes in and fry until golden brown. Transfer out. I recommend using a pan and fry the chicken by batches. On one side, it uses less oil and on the other side, the chicken is widely touched with the bottom of the pan, which can speed up the process greatly. After add the chicken cubes, let it stay for a short time (possible about 40 seconds to 1 minute) until one side is browed and then slightly stir the chicken and fry the other side.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Get a clean wok and add only 1/2 tablespoon of oil and then fry the peppers for 1-2 minutes over slowest fire until most of them becomes dark red. Add Sichuan peppercorn in and continue frying for another 1 minute over slowest fire.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Push the spices to one side and add 1/2 tablespoon of oil in wok and fry ginger, scallion white and garlic until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return the chicken cubes, add roasted white sesame seeds, sugar, salt and scallion green sections. Mix well and serve immediately.

title: Coconut-Poached Baby Bananas กล้วยบวชชี (กล้วยไข่)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: baby bananas (gluay kai), at the perfect eating ripeness (see note)
sugar (you can add less or more to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine coconut milk, water, sugar, salt, and pandan leaf in a small pot and stir to dissolve the sugar. Add the bananas, and there should be just enough liquid to barely cover the bananas. If there doesn't seem to be enough liquid, you can add a bit more of both coconut milk and water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the heat to medium and bring to a simmer. Once it reaches a rapid simmer, turn the heat down and let it simmer gently for 5 minutes until the bananas are soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove from heat, cover, and let the bananas sit in the coconut milk for at least another 10 minutes or until ready to serve; the bananas will continue to cook and the flavours will mingle and marry further.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve warm. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Gamjaguk (Potato Soup)
description: a hearty Korean potato soup made with beef, tofu and noodles!

ingredients.name: dangmyeon (sweet potato starch noodles) (soaked in warm water for 20 minutes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the beef into short strips and mix with the soup soy sauce and garlic. Cut the potato in half lengthwise, and slice into half-moon shapes (about ⅓ - inch thick). Slice the tofu into 1/2-inch thick pieces. Cut the scallions into 1-inch lengths.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium pot, sauté the beef until all the pieces turn brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in 6 cups of water, and bring it to a boil. Skim off the foam. Reduce the heat to medium high and continue to boil, covered, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the potatoes, tofu, and salt (about 1 teaspoon) and pepper to taste. Bring it to a boil, and cook until potatoes are cooked, about 5 minutes. Be careful not to overcook the potato. Drop the the noodles and scallions in, and boil for an additional minute or two.

title: Avocado Ice Cream
description: No ice cream maker? No problem! This no churn Avocado Ice Cream is creamy, rich and smooth. All you need is a mixer! (gluten free, vegetarian)

ingredients.name: lemon juice ((about the juice of one lemon))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add avocados, sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and sea salt into a blender. Blend until completely smooth. Transfer the mixture to a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer (you can also use a hand mixer if you don't have a stand mixer), add the heavy cream. Whip on medium-high speed until firm peaks form.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the whipped cream to the pureed avocado mixture and gently fold together with a rubber spatula until completely combined and there are no white streaks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the ice cream mixture into a standard loaf pan, cover with aluminum foil and freeze until completely firm, about 6 hours.

title: Shallot Garlic Mushroom Recipe
description: Shallots, garlic and mushrooms cooked in a little EVOO and ghee and adorned with a couple warm spices. A decadent side dish or warm appetizer! Heck, serve it with rice or couscous as a vegetarian lunch!

ingredients.name: tbsp/ 30 ml Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil, more for later
lb/ 453 g baby bella mushrooms, cleaned and halved
lb/ 226 g white mushrooms, cleaned and halved
sweet paprika (or try 1/2 tsp harissa spice blend!)
low-sodium broth (vegetable or chicken broth is fine)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large skillet like this one, heat extra virgin olive oil and ghee over medium heat until shimmering. Add shallots, garlic, thyme springs and cinnamon sticks. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until shallots begin to soften.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Raise heat to medium-high and add both kinds of mushrooms (you probably need a drizzle more extra virgin olive oil here.) Cook, tossing occasionally, for 5 minutes. Season with kosher salt, pepper, and a pinch sweet paprika (or for a more exciting twist, try harissa spice)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now add broth and bring to a high simmer for about 10 minutes or so until the liquid has reduced by a lot (it should almost disappear, but not quite.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finally, stir in fresh parsley and remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To make ricotta topping (optional), simply whisk ricotta cheese with lemon zest and a drizzle of Early Harvest EVOO.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve these decadent mushrooms as a side dish with a dollop of the ricotta topping, a little crusty bread won’t hurt. These are also great or on top of cooked instant couscous, Lebanese rice, or your favorite grain.

title: Baked Cod
description: Oven Baked Cod - tender and flaky cod fillets smothered in a lemon garlic sauce with a kiss of heat. A super tasty low-carb dinner in just 20 minutes!

ingredients.name: 3-4 tablespoons unsalted butter or olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 400ºF. Spray baking pan with cooking spray or lightly oil. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dab both sides of cod fish dry with paper towels, season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small pan set over medium low, heat butter, minced garlic, paprika, onion powder, cayenne pepper and parsley or basil. Stir for about 30 seconds or 1 minute. Let this mixture sit for a little bit about 5 minutes. Add lemon juice to mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Brush cod fish with spice mixture, making sure every inch is covered with spice. Add to prepared baking dish or baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake until cooked through, about 10-15 minutes, depending on the thickness of your fish and your preferred doneness. When the thickest part of cod is easily flaked with a fork, then is perfectly cooked.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Garnish immediately with lemon.

title: Paneer Curry Recipe (Restaurant Style Gravy)
description: Paneer Curry is a rich and lightly creamy North Indian curry made with paneer, onion paste, tomato-cashew paste, spices and cream. This restaurant style paneer gravy pairs well with roti, paratha, naan or rice.

ingredients.name: or 12 to 15 cashews (– soaked in ½ cup hot water)
paneer ((Indian cottage cheese), cut in cubes or squares)
red chilli powder (or add as per taste)
light cream (or low fat cream or 1 tablespoon whipping cream)

title: Spicy Beef Stir-Fry with Pepper
description: A super comforting and appetizing stir-fried beef dish with a sweet, savory flavor and a pungent aroma. Use my homemade chili garlic sauce to create this one-dish meal for dinner in under 25 minutes!

ingredients.name: (250 grams) beef sirloin ((or other tender cut), sliced into 5mm thick pieces, cut against the grain)
and 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil ((or vegetable oil))
Steamed white rice to serve with

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine beef, dark soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine in a small bowl, mix well. Add cornstarch and mix by hand, until the beef is evenly coated and starts to feel sticky. Set aside and allow to marinate for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine oyster sauce, all-purpose chili garlic sauce, sugar, and water in a small bowl. Mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Chop veggies while marinating the beef.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a wok over medium high heat until hot. Add 1 tablespoon oil and swirl to coat the bottom. (Or you can add oil into a nonstick skillet and heat oil until hot.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add beef and spread it over the bottom of the wok with a spatula. Let it cook for 20 to 30 seconds without stirring. This will help the beef come clean from the wok when cooked and won’t stick to the bottom. Flip with spatula. Stir and cook until the surface turns dark brown but the inside is still raw. Turn to lowest heat and immediately transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil and ginger into the same wok. Turn back to medium high heat (high heat on an electric stove). Stir a few times until fragrant. Add onion. Stir and cook until soft, about 1 minute. Add bell pepper and stir and cook for 30 seconds, until it’s half cooked through. Add beef back into wok. Mix the sauce again and pour it over top of the beef and vegetables. Immediately stir to mix everything well for a minute, until the beef is cooked through (although I like to leave the beef a bit rare, so it will have a super soft texture). Turn off heat and immediately transfer everything to a plate.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve warm over steamed white rice as a main dish.

title: Fluffiest Potato Balls Recipe! (Patatokeftedes)
description: These lovely homemade potato balls will definitely become the talk of your next party! Fluffy on the inside and with a wonderful golden brown crust on the outside, these mashed potato balls are pure comfort!

ingredients.name: kefalotyri cheese, or Regato or any hard yellow cheese, grated (35 oz.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this potato balls recipe, start by washing thoroughly the potatoes. Peel the potatoes and place them in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Lower the heat to a gentle simmer and cook for about 30 minutes. (For this potato balls recipe the potatoes need to boil, until very tender.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the potatoes in a colander, place them in a large bowl and mash them, using a fork or a masher. Add the rest of the ingredients, season with salt and pepper and blend to combine. Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and place the mixture in the fridge for 1-2 hours, until firm enough to form the potato balls.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Form the mixture into little potato balls (this mixture is enough for 25 potato balls) and dredge in some flour shaking off any excess. Dip them in the egg and dredge them in powdered breadcrumbs. Fridge the potato balls for 1 more hour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry the potato balls in a non-sticking pan with plenty of oil, until nicely colored and drain them on some kitchen paper. (Tips: Heat the oil until very hot and fry the potato balls in batches. If the surface of the pan is overcrowded then the temperature of the oil will decrease and your potato balls will not be crispy any more.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the potato balls while still warm with some mustard (or mustard-mayo sauce) as a delicious starter. Enjoy!

title: Gul Tteokguk (Oyster Rice Cake Soup)
description: Korean rice cake soup made with oysters!

ingredients.name: (to 10) ounces rice cake slices (tteokguk tteok, 떡국떡)
soup soy sauce (gukganjang 국간장 or fish sauce)
sheet roasted gim (nori, cut into thin, short strips with kitchen shears)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the rice cakes in cold water for 10 to 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the oysters by gently swishing around in salted water. Drain. Rinse again in clean water and drain again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 6 cups of water and the optional dried kelp to a medium size pot. Bring it to a boil, and continue to boil for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To make the optional egg garnish (jidan), separate the egg. Lightly beat the white by gently cutting it with a spoon. Stir the yoke with a spoon until smooth. Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Pour each egg part into a thin layer, tilting the skillet and/or spreading with a spoon. Cook each side briefly until no visible liquid remains. (Do not brown the egg.) Slice into small diamond shape pieces or short thin strips.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the kelp if used. Add the rice cake slices, garlic and soup soy sauce (or fish sauce), and cook until very soft.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drop the oysters in. Cook for a couple of minutes after the soup comes to a boil again. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove the scum. Ladle the steaming soup into individual bowls and top with the scallion and the optional egg and gim strips.

title: How to Make Hot Pot at Home
description: How to make Chinese hot pot at home. Recipe listed as a hot pot party for 4 people

ingredients.name: long green onion (大葱, cut into small sections)
box of sliced meat (lamb, pork belly or beef)
meatballs (shrimp balls, pork balls, beef balls. You can get the frozen one from the store)
box of regular firm tofu or soft tofu
dark leafy vegetables (bok choy, cabbage, snow pea leaves etc, choose the seasonal ones)
mixed mushrooms (shiitake mushroom, needle mushroom and others)
root vegetable and melons (peeled and cut into thin slices)
noodles (freshly handmade noodles or glass noodles)
Fried buns with condensed milk (金银馒头)
