title: "Pan Eggs" Breakfast Thai Style (Kai Grata)
description: A Thai style street breakfast. Eggs are cooked together with various toppings and served right in the pan with some fresh bread. It's super easy to make at home for a nice brunch!

ingredients.name: eggs (if you want 3 eggs, use an 8-inch pan)
Chinese sausage, sliced, as much as you want
Vietnamese ham (cha lua), sliced, as much as you want
Optional condiments: White or black pepper, Sriracha hot sauce, ketchup, Maggi Seasoning.
Maggi Seasoning or Golden Mountain Sauce
Optional: 1 finely grated clove of garlic
a green onion, chopped (safe the other half for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the meat, oyster sauce, Maggi Seasoning, garlic (if using) and and mix well. Add a little water to a saute pan and bring to a boil. Add the meat mixture and cook, stirring to break up lumps. When the meat is fully cooked, remove from heat and stir in green onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice thinly the Chinese sausages and the vietnamese ham, then sear them in a lightly greased pan over medium heat just until they are browned. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To make the pan eggs: Heat the pan/serving dish over medium-low heat. If using stainless-steel, to prevent the eggs from sticking, you should heat the pan until hot before adding any ingredients. See video for how to do the water test!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the butter, and once melted, add the eggs. Lay the toppings on the eggs and cover the pan. Let the eggs steam for a few minutes until the whites are cooked and the yolk is done to your liking. If you prefer the yolks to be well done, keep the heat quite low to prevent the bottom from burning before the yolks finish cooking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When finished, remove from heat and garnish with a little extra green onions and white pepper if you wish. Serve with some bread and condiments. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Healthy Mexican Chickpea Salad
description: This Healthy Mexican Chickpea Salad recipe is fresh, easy to make and packed with nutritious ingredients ready in only 15 minutes! (gluten free + vegetarian + vegan)

ingredients.name: 15-ounce can of chickpeas, (drained and rinsed (about 3 cups cooked chickpeas))
finely diced red onions ((about 1/2 large red onion))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add chickpeas, red onions, cherry tomatoes, jalapeños, cilantro and avocados. Stir together and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the dressing: in a small bowl, add olive oil, white wine vinegar, lime juice, minced garlic, salt and pepper. Whisk until combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the dressing onto the mixed chickpea salad and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes until chilled, or enjoy immediately.

title: Mediterranean Flatbread served in a tray and topped with Arugula, Tomatoes, Smoked Salmon and More
description: All-star Mediterranean flatbread recipe loaded with fresh arugula, veggies, smoked salmon and other Mediterranean favorites like olives and feta! Great as a simple meal with your favorite glass of wine, or as an appetizer for a crowd.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
lb/ 453.59 g pizza dough (whole wheat dough, if you prefer) at room temperature (see note if you want to make dough from scratch)
Large handful baby arugula (about 4 oz/113.4 g)
Scant 1 pint/400 g cherry tomatoes, halved
or so hummus (homemade from this recipe or store-bought)
Crumbled feta cheese, to your liking (optional)
Few slices smoked salmon (3 to 4 oz/113 g)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a large sheet pan and brush with extra virgin olive oil. Sprinkle the bottom of pan with cornmeal, about 2-3 tbsp.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Lightly flour a clean work surface. Place pizza dough on top and roll and stretch dough to a 12 x 8 rectangle or oval. Transfer stretched dough to prepared sheet pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lightly brush top of dough with extra virgin olive oil and season with oregano and za’atar spice. Bake in heated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dough is golden and slightly crisp on bottom. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a bowl, combine arugula and tomato. Drizzle with a little extra virgin olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and a dash of Za’atar spice. Mix to combine. Set aside for a moment.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Spread a thin layer of hummus evenly over the pizza crust. Top with the arugula and tomato mixture. Now arrange the remaining ingredients on top evenly. Sprinkle a little more za’atar spice and dried oregano all over.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve as an appetizer, slice pizza into small rectangles. You’ll get 15 or more pieces. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Parmesan Recipe
description: Chicken Parmesan Recipe - fried and breaded chicken breast smothered with tomato sauce and cheeses then baked until bubbly and gooey. One of the best comforting baked chicken you'll ever have!

ingredients.name: chicken breasts, sliced in half (, or 4 thin chicken breasts)
Italian Seasoning , salt and pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a skillet or pan over medium-heat and add melted butter. After 1-2 minutes, add panko breadcrumbs, granulated onion, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and grated lemon. Mix well until combined. Remove from heat once breadcrumbs turn into light brown - around 2-3 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven at 400 degrees F and lightly grease a baking try or baking dish with cooking oil spray. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut 2 slices of chicken into 4 halves. Then season with Italian seasoning and salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: On a slightly shallow plate, whisk egg and dip chicken breast on it and coat it on a plate with the breadcrumb mixture. Make sure every surface of the chicken is covered. Shake any excess. You may let it rest in the fridge for 10 minutes or overnight to allow the coating to cling well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry chicken until golden and crispy - about 4-5 minutes per side).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Then place chicken on the greased baking tray and top each chicken breast with 1/3 cup of homemade pasta sauce, Parmesan and mozzarella cheeses and basil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Baked chicken for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melting and bubbling and the chicken all cooked through. Serve with lemon on the side or top it off with parsley.

title: Nankhatai Recipe | Nankhatai Biscuit
description: Nankhatai are traditional Indian shortbread cookies made with all-purpose flour, sugar and ghee (clarified butter) or butter, flavored with green cardamom. These bakery-style cookies or biscuits are crisp, crumbly and lightly sweet.

ingredients.name: baking soda (- can add ¼ teaspoon or skip baking soda)
sooji ((fine rava or cream of wheat) - 20 grams)
to 3 pinches nutmeg powder (or grated nutmeg or ⅛ teaspoon nutmeg powder)

sugar (100 to 110 grams sugar or ¾ cup powdered sugar or confectioner's sugar or add as per taste)
to 4 tablespoons milk (- at room temperature or cold)
almonds ( or pistachios or chironji (charoli), or any preferred nuts, optional)

title: Greek rice Pudding recipe (Rizogalo)
description: Homely, comforting and extra creamy! Find out how to make the perfect Greek rice pudding with this traditional, egg and butter free recipe, flavored with with vanilla, lemon peel or orange zest and garnished with fragrant cinnamon!

ingredients.name: zest of an orange or lemon peel, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek rice pudding recipe, heat the milk and rice in a large heavy bottomed saucepan. Simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to just below boiling point. Reduce the heat to medium-low and gently cook, stirring occasionally, for 30-40 minutes until the pudding is thick and the rice is tender. (If you like to add some extra flavour to your Greek rice pudding, add some lemon peel or orange zest)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When preparing a Greek rice pudding, it is very important to simmer at low temperatures and to stir the mixture, so that the milk doesn’t burn and the rizogalo doesn’t stick on the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove and add the sugar and the vanilla extract, stirring, until the sugar dissolves. (If the rizogalo needs to thicken a little bit more, dilute 1 tsp cornstarch in some water, add in the mixture and cook for a few more minutes.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If you don’t serve the Greek rice pudding right away, it will form a crust. A little trick to avoid that is to pour the mixture in a large bowl and place over a bowl filled with ice cubes. Then stir the mixture until cold. Spoon the rizogalo into individual bowls and store in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this traditional Greek rice pudding as a delicious dessert or mid-day snack with a sprinkle of cinnamon. Enjoy!

title: Buddha’s Delight (Jai, Chinese Vegetarian Stew)
description: An epic vegetable stew that features colorful vegetables, tender vermicelli noodles and fried tofu braised to perfection in a savory earthy sauce.

vegetarian oyster sauce ((or regular oyster sauce))
soaking water from the lily flower and mushroom ((*Footnote 2))

title: Spicy Seafood Japchae
description: Korean sweet potato starch noodles made with seafood and a spicy kick!

ingredients.name: to 1 tablespoon gochugaru (preferably finely ground - see note)
to 3 fresh shiitake mushrooms (or mushrooms of your choice, thinly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the noodles in warm water until soft (about 30 to 40 minutes), and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the shrimp and squid. Cut the squid into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables, and mix all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the vegetable oil, sesame oil, and the gochugaru to a pan, and heat until hot over medium low heat, stirring. Remove from the heat as soon as the oil starts to turn red and the chili pepper flakes become a bit pasty. Do not burn the gochugaru.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat to medium, and add the noodles to the pan along with 1-1/2 tablespoons of the prepared sauce. Stir-fry until the noodles are soft, 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the noodles onto a plate. In the same pan, stir fry the onion for a minute, and then carrot and mushrooms until wilted. Add a tablespoon of water if the vegetables look dry. Lightly season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the seafood and the remaining sauce, and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. Follow this by the scallion and optional enoki mushrooms until the scallions are slightly wilted.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Return the noodles to the pan, and toss everything well together. You can add a bit more sugar and/or soy sauce to taste.

title: Thai Hot Pot "Jim Jum" จิ้มจุ่ม แจ่วฮ้อน
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: beef, pork, or chicken, thinly sliced (choose tender cuts)
egg white (keep the remaining egg for the meat platter)
Napa cabbage, water spinach, bok choy, spinach or other soup-friendly greens with a mild flavour
Asian mushrooms such as shimeji, enoki, shiitake, oyster, or king oyster mushrooms
Glass noodles or other quick-cooking noodles you like
roasted chili flakes, or to taste
leaves sawtooth coriander, thinly slices (or use cilantro)
toasted rice powder ("how to make it" video here)
plain, unsalted pork stock (simply simmer pork bones in water for 2 hours)
stalks lemongrass, smashed and cut into 2-inch chunks
kaffir lime leaves, torn and bruised

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thoroughly mix the meat, oyster sauce, soy sauce, oil, tapioca starch and egg white. Marinate for at least 20 minutes. Arrange all types of meat on a platter and place the remaining egg in the middle of the platter right on top of the meat (you can make a little crater so the egg doesn't run). When you eat, you can dip the meat in the egg yolk before you put the meat in the broth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all ingredients excepted toasted rice powder and stir until the sugar is dissolved. Stir the toasted rice powder in just before eating.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To make the vegetable platter: Cut everything into bite-sized pieces and arrange nicely on a serving plate. If using glass noodles, soak them in water for 7-10 minutes until pliable, and cut a couple of times with scissors to shorten the noodles.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To make the broth: Bring the pork broth to a simmer and add the lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime leaves; simmer rapidly for 3-5 minutes. Add the fish sauce and right before you're ready to start eating, add the toasted rice powder into the broth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: And off you go! Diners can add the vegetables and herbs to the broth and pull them out whenever they're done to your liking; have them with a little dipping sauce. For the meat, dip the meat in raw egg (this part is optional) and then dunk it in the broth and swish it around until done to your liking (you can either do this with chopsticks if you want to eat just one piece at a time, or use one of those little hot pot strainers if you wanna do more at a time). Dip the meat in the dipping sauce and enjoy!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Creamy Cilantro Lime Chicken
description: This Cilantro Lime Chicken is a creamy low carb and gluten free dish perfect for any night of the week!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. If the chicken breasts are all an uneven thickness, use a meat tenderizer like this one or a heavy pan and pound out the breasts until they're all the same thickness. Season chicken with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, add olive oil. Place chicken breasts in skillet and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until both sides are browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place skillet in oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until chicken is fully cooked through and the internal temperature has reached 165 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the skillet from the oven and transfer the cooked chicken to a large plate. Cover with foil to keep warm.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the same hot skillet over medium heat and add the onions. Cook for 2 minutes, scraping the bottom of the skillet to get the brown bits off the pan. The skillet should still be very hot so be careful.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the green chiles and garlic. Cook for 2 minutes. Add the chicken broth, lime juice, cumin, oregano and coriander.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Mix together and bring to a gentle boil for 10 minutes or until liquid has greatly reduced.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the skillet from the heat and mix in the cream and cilantro. Place the cooked chicken in the sauce and serve.

title: Puff Pastry Parcels recipe stuffed with Caramelised Apples and Pork Sausages
description: The ultimate Christmas puff pastry parcels recipe! Sweet caramelised apples, cheese, eggs and minced herby sausages, wrapped around crispy and buttery puff pastry.. These delicious puff pastry parcels are like no other!

ingredients.name: sweet Graviera cheese or mild Cheddar or Edam (5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these delicious puff pastry parcels, start first by caramelising the apples. Peel and finely chop (or grate) the apples. Place a saucepan over high heat and melt the butter and sugar; add the apples and sauté, until soft and golden. Set aside to cool for a while.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice the sausages and place in a blender or food processor and blend to mince.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl add the minced sausages, the caramelised apples, cheese, egg and season with pepper. Blend with a wooden spoon or using your hands, until the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Layer one sheet of the puff pastry on a working surface and spread the filling making three lanes. Brush the puff pastry with egg yolk and cover with the other sheet of the pastry. Using your hands press a little bit the pasty towards the filling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a sharp knife cut the pastry in three lanes in parallel with the stuffing and then vertically in three pieces to make 12 rectangular servings. Scar the top with a knife, brush with egg yolk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Line two large baking trays with parchment paper and place the parcels, leaving some space between them. Bake in preheated oven at 200C for 20-25 minutes, until nicely coloured. Enjoy!

title: Mediterranean-Style Sweet Potato Toast Recipe
description: Easy oven baked sweet potato toast recipe. Loaded with flavor and Mediterranean toppings, these sweet potato toasts are the perfect appetizer or make-ahead breakfast or lunch.

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes of similar shape and size, scrubbed clean but not peeled
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
cooked or canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed
scallion, finely chopped (white and green parts)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash and scrub sweet potatoes very well. Cut off the pointy ends.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Microwave each sweet potato for about 45 seconds to 1 minute. And when cool enough to handle, slice length-wise thinly (1/4″ slices.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lightly brush a large baking sheet with a little extra virgin olive oil. Arrange the sweet potato slices on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with extra virgin olive oil and season with kosher salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in heated oven for about 15 minutes or so (until tender. ovens vary, so just watch that the sweet potato toasts are nice and tender, but you don’t want them to fall apart). Remove from oven.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the sweet potatoes are baking, prepare the tahini sauce according to this recipe. Prepare the remaining toppings.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve as an appetizer, transfer to a large serving platter. Sprinkle za’atar and sumac all over the sweet potatoes (a generous sprinkle.) Top with a drizzle of tahini sauce (keep the remaining tahini on the side for people to add as they wish.) Add the remaining topping. Enjoy!

title: Chinese Oxtail Soup
description: The ultimate comforting dish features beef that falls off the bone, rich tomato broth, and tender cabbage & potato. {gluten-free}

ingredients.name: (4 to 5 lbs) oxtail (, separated at joints)
Heavy cream (sour cream, or plain Greek yogurt for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add oxtail and water (or beef stock) in a big pot. Cook over medium-high heat and bring to a boil. Turn to medium-low heat. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Skim any brown foam from the top of liquid.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer oxtail to a high pressure cooker or Instant Pot using a pair of tongs. Transfer all the broth into the same pot. Cover and lock the lid. Turn on high pressure and set timer to 35 minutes. Once cooked, let it release pressure naturally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: The oxtail might leave a brown residue on the inside of the big pot you used to boil it. Wash the pot thoroughly before using in the following steps.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the oxtail from the pot and transfer onto a large plate. Transfer the broth into an oil separator to remove extra fat. Alternatively you can let the broth sit for 10 minutes and skim the fat from the top with a ladle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: (Optional) To serve the oxtail without bones, let the oxtail cool until it’s possible to handle. Remove the meat from the bones and break the meat into bite size chunks with your fingers.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While waiting the oxtail to cool, heat the big pot (from step 1) with olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and carrot. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Cook and stir until the onion softens, 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the beef broth and beef meat back to the big pot. Add ginger, potatoes, cabbage, canned tomato, tomato paste, bay leaves, sugar, salt and black pepper. Simmer for another 30 to 40 minutes (*Footnote 2), until the potato and cabbage become tender. Adjust seasoning by adding more salt, if necessary.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer the soup into serving bowls, garnish with heavy cream or Greek yogurt and serve warm as a main.

title: Bread Recipe | White Bread
description: White Bread is a soft, fluffy and light homemade loaf made with flour, yeast, sugar, oil and water.

ingredients.name: cups/360 grams cups all-purpose flour (or bread flour (preferably unbleached))
instant yeast ((rapid rise yeast) or 1½ teaspoon dry active yeast or 1 tablespoon fresh yeast)
oil (neutral flavored oil or olive oil)
to 2 tablespoons milk (– dairy or vegan, for brushing, optional)

steps.title: Step 1

title: Pink Noodles w/ Coconut Gravy (mee gati) หมี่กะทิ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: ground pork (or sub ground chicken, ground shrimp, or crumbled firm tofu)
fermented soybean paste (tao jiew), mashed with a fork roughly (what is tao jiew?)
pressed tofu, cut into small pieces (see video for size)
dry thin rice noodles (see note), soaked in room temp water for 5 minutes, then drain
cube red bean curd + 1 Tbsp of the liquid (what is red bean curd?)
white distilled vinegar or rice vinegar

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add ¼ cup of the coconut milk to a small pot, bring to a boil and simmer over medium low heat for several minutes until thick and the coconut milk is "broken" (clear coconut oil will start to separate from the white portion). If this does not happen after the coconut milk is very thick, just proceed with the recipe; some coconut milk brands have been processed to prevent this separation.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add shallots to the broken coconut milk and saute for a minute until softened. Add ground pork and quickly stir to break up all the lumps, making sure there are no big chunks. Add the remaining coconut milk, palm sugar, tamarind juice, tao jiew, sriracha, and simmer for 7-10 minutes or until it has a thick gravy-like consistency.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add tofu and simmer 1 more minute. Add whole shrimp, if using, and cook for 30 more seconds just until the shrimp are done. Taste and adjust seasoning. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To make shredded eggs: Heat a well-seasoned wok or a flat 10-inch non-stick pan over medium heat. When hot, brush some vegetable oil all over the pan. Pour in the beaten eggs, tilting the pan to create a thin, crepe-like omelette. Turn the heat to medium-low and let the eggs cook for a few minutes until the underside if golden brown. If by the time the bottom is browned, the top side have NOT cooked all the way through, flip the omelette and cook just a few more seconds to dry it off. If it has, you can remove the eggs without flipping.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll the omelette like a cigarette, then cut the roll in half horizontally (or leave it if you want longgg egg pieces). Cut the roll into 1/4-inch shreds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To make the noodles: Mash the red bean curd and its liquid with a fork until mostly smooth (little lumps are okay). Add the curd to a cold wok along with the coconut milk, water, vinegar and sugar; stir to combine and bring to a boil. While you wait for the liquid to boil, cut the noodles roughly in half with scissors (just a couple of snips, this will make it easier to toss and to eat).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the liquid is boiling, add the noodles to the sauce and keep tossing on high heat until the noodles have absorbed all the liquid. Once all the liquid is absorbed, add the bean sprouts and garlic chives, turn off the heat, and toss with tongs just until the vegetables are mixed with the noodles.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To serve: Reheat the gravy if needed. Place the noodles on a plate and top with the shredded eggs. Around the noodles, place a small bowl of gravy, extra bean sprouts, extra garlic chives, a piece of lime, and some roasted chili flakes. Pour the sauce over the noodles when ready to eat (you don’t need a lot, just enough to moisten the noodles). Enjoy!

title: Chicken Shawarma
description: You don't need a special rotisserie to make this easy homemade chicken shawarma recipe! Chicken pieces, tossed in warm Middle Eastern spices, then baked until perfectly tender. Serve it in pita pockets with Mediterranean salad and sauces.

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper, more if you prefer
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
Tahini sauce or Greek Tzatziki sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the cumin, turmeric, coriander, garlic powder, sweet paprika and cloves. Set aside the shawarma spice mix for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season with salt on both sides, then thinly slice into small bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the chicken in a large bowl. Add the shwarma spices and toss to coat. Add the onions, lemon juice and olive oil. Toss everything together again. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight (if you don’t have time, you can cut or skip marinating time)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When ready, preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Take the chicken out of the fridge and let it sit in room temperature for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread the marinated chicken with the onions in one layer on a large lightly-oiled baking sheet pan. Roast for 30 minutes in the 425 degrees F heated-oven. For a more browned, crispier chicken, move the pan to the top rack and broil very briefly (watch carefully). Remove from the oven.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the chicken is roasting, prepare the pita pockets. Make tahini sauce according to this recipe or Tztaziki sauce according to this recipe. Make 3-ingredient Mediterranean salad according to this recipe. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve, open pita pockets up. Spread a little tahini sauce or Tzatziki sauce, add chicken shawarma, arugula, Mediterranean salad and pickles or olives, if you like. Serve immediately!

title: Pork Fricassee recipe with Egg-lemon Sauce and Celery
description: The very best Pork Fricassee recipe, made in the traditional Greek way and served as part of the Christmas day dinner! Smothered in a tasty egg and lemon sauce and garnished with diced celery, this recipe will amaze you.

ingredients.name: boneless pork from the neck (43 ounces)
medium sized red onions, finely chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious traditional pork fricassee recipe, start by removing all the yellow leaves from the celery. Wash thoroughly the celery and cut in 2-3 pieces each. In a large pan add some water and a good pinch of salt and bring to the boil; parboil the celery for about 5 minutes, drain in a colander and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the pork into portions, wash, strain and season with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan, add the meat and sauté on both sides, until lightly coloured. Add the onions and sauté, until softened (but not coloured).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in 2 cups of lukewarm water, put the lid on and let it simmer for about 1 hour. Add the celery and season with salt and pepper; let it simmer for another 15-20 minutes. (Do not stir with a wooden spoon, rather than simply shake the pan occasionally, keeping the handles.) Remove the pan from the stove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To prepare the egg lemon sauce for the pork fricassee, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk; gradually add the lemon juice and the corn starch and whisk until it dissolves. Take a ladle of stock from the pan, pour in the egg and lemon mixture and whisk quickly. Add one more ladle and whisk again, so that the eggs get warm. Pour the egg mixture back into the pot, shake the pan to blend and simmer for 3 minutes. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: This traditional recipe for pork fricassee in egg lemon sauce, can be also made with veal, lamb or chicken. Enjoy while still warm. Merry Christmas!

title: Baked Chicken Spaghetti
description: This flavor-packed, cheesy, soul-satisfying recipe boasts everything you could ever want in a casserole. Cheese, chicken, and pasta create a super easy midweek dinner. And talk about the ultimate comfort food!

ingredients.name: (450g) chicken boneless breast ((or 3 cups cooked shredded chicken))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350℉/177℃.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Start by boiling the spaghetti in a large pot according to the box instructions. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season chicken with salt and pepper, or use your favorite spice mix. Let it sit until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a Dutch oven or medium pot over medium-high heat. Add about a tablespoon of oil to the skillet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then add the chicken, and saute it for 5-6 minutes on each side until it is cooked through. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat butter or oil in a skillet or pot over medium heat. Then add onions, garlic, thyme, and Creole seasoning. Stir for 3-4 minutes or until the onions wilt.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Toss in the tomatoes and bell peppers, and continue cooking for 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Stir in the flour until fully incorporated, about a minute. Gradually stir in evaporated milk and broth. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly for about 2 minutes or until the sauce thickens and bubbles.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Stir in the cheeses, and continue stirring until everything’s melted and evenly combined and smooth. Add salt & pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Then add the spaghetti and chicken to the skillet, and stir to incorporate evenly.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Transfer the spaghetti mixture into a pan or lightly greased 2-quart baking dish; top with remaining cheese.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Bake at 350F°/177℃ for 20 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

title: Asian Beef Stock
description: This beef stock recipe is a great fundamental element for making Asian noodle dishes, such as Taiwan beef noodle soup and Vietnamese beef pho.

ingredients.name: to 4 pounds beef stock bones (I used 5280 beef knuckle bones and marrow bones, sawn into smaller pieces (*see footnote 1))
beef chuck ((or beef brisket, cut to 1.5 to 2 inches (4 to 5 cm) chunks) (*see footnote 2))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spread stock bones and meat in a large roasting pan. Spray a thin layer of oil onto the bones and meat. Roast on the bottom rack until the bones and meat turn an even golden brown color, about 40 minutes. Flip once, halfway through, and check on the bones frequently. If a higher part of the bones cooks too fast, cover with aluminium foil to avoid burning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer bones and meat to a large stock pot (I used a 16-quart pot). Pour a cup of hot water into the roasting pan and scrape the brown bits off the pan. Pour everything into the stock pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add cold water to the stock pot to cover the ingredients by one inch. Turn on high heat. Add green onion, ginger, bay leaves, Japanese sake, and aromatics to the pot. Cook until bringing to a boil, stir a few times, and turn to low heat. Cook the broth at a gentle simmer. Cover and cook for 4 to 6 hours (remove the beef during this process), until the all the collagen on the bones has fallen off and the marrow is mostly dissolved. During the cooking, check on the stock and skim the brown foam from the top with a large spoon.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: (Option 1) If you’re going to make beef stew - After 1 hour of simmering, remove the beef chuck from the pot and transfer it to a container to use later.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: (Option 2) If you’re going to serve the beef immediately - Remove the beef when tender, after 2 to 3 hours.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the stock is ready, you can remove the bones and turn to high heat to reduce the soup so it’ll be easier to store.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Drain the stock with a colander and transfer it into airtight containers. Do not skim the fat from the top. You can store the stock in the fridge for 1 week or in the freezer up to 3 months.

title: Kimchi Mandu (Kimchi Dumplings)
description: These Korean dumplings filled with a kimchi mixture are highly popular in Korea. If you like kimchi, you'll love this dumpling recipe. Kimchi adds tons of spicy and savory flavors!

ingredients.name: dangmyeon (sweet potato starch noodles, soaked in warm water for about 30 min.)
Perilla seed oil (in lieu of sesame oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the kimchi and squeeze out excess liquid by hand.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water, drain, chop and squeeze out water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Squeeze out water from the tofu. Using a cheesecloth will make squeezing easier. Finely chop the noodles. Finely chop the onion and squeeze out water. Finely chop the scallions.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine all the filling ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well by hand.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place one heaping teaspoonful to a tablespoon of the filling on a wrapper. Wet the edges of the wrapper with water or egg wash and seal tightly (pushing the air out with your fingers) into a half-moon shape. (Stop here if you want a half-moon shape dumpling.) Then, bring the two ends together, apply water or egg wash to one end and press tightly to create a round shape. Repeat this process until all the filling/wrappers are used.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Kimchi mandu can be steamed for about 10 minutes in a steamer (12 minutes if frozen). Make sure to line the steamer with a wet cheesecloth, paper towel, or cabbage leaves to prevent mandu from sticking.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: For boiling, pan-frying and deep-frying dumplings, see my other mandu recipe.

title: Thai Son-in-Law Eggs Recipe ไข่ลูกเขย
description: A popular Thai dish made from hard boiled eggs, fried to develop a chewy skin, then topped with a sweet and sour tamarind sauce. It's a favourite of kids in Thailand!

ingredients.name: tamarind paste, store bought or homemade (see note)
medium boiled duck eggs, or 5 chicken eggs, peeled and cooled completely
of shallot for fried shallots, thinly sliced lengthwise
3-4 cloves garlic for garlic chips (or make as much as you like and keep for miscellaneous sprinkling!)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small pot, sauté the chopped shallots with a little oil until the shallots are browned slightly. Add palm sugar, tamarind, water and fish sauce. Let simmer for a few minutes until the sugar is all dissolved and the sauce is thickened slightly. To help the sugar dissolve more quickly, once it has had a minute to simmer in the sauce, the sugar will become soft and you can use a wooden spoon to crush all the lumps (you can see me do this in the video).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: After simmering for 3-5 minutes, the sauce should have a darker colour, becomes shiny, and has the consistency of maple syrup (it will thicken slightly as it cools). Taste and adjust seasoning, keeping in mind that the sauce will be mellowed out by the eggs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Thinly slice the shallots and lay them on a plate lined with paper towel. Sprinkle salt over them and let sit for at least 10 minutes. Once it has had time to sit, press a piece of paper towel onto the shallots to absorb all the liquid that has been drawn out by the salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat just enough oil in a wok or a shallow saucepan to cover the shallots. Turn the heat on medium high and add all the shallots to the oil without waiting for the oil to become hot. Once the shallots are bubbling, turn the heat down to low and keep them bubbling gently until they are golden browned and crispy. Keep an eye on them as they burn quickly! Remove the shallots with a slotted or mesh skimmer and drain on paper towel. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To the same oil you used the fry shallots, add the garlic slices THEN turn the heat back on low. Keep frying the garlic on low heat (gentle bubbling) until the garlic has turned a light golden colour and the bubbling has stopped. Remove the garlic chips and drain on paper towel. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To the same oil, add the dried chilies and fry them on low heat until they turn a maroon colour and smell smoky. This will take less than a minute so do not walk away! Remove and drain on paper towel.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add more oil to the pot so that it comes halfway up the eggs. Heat the oil on medium high heat until the oil reaches 375-400°F. While you wait for the oil, dry the eggs really well with paper towel to prevent oil from splattering too much. Then add the eggs to the oil, one at a time and fry them until they become golden brown (it should take just less than 1 minute). Flip the eggs and brown the other side. Remove from heat and drain on paper towel.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut the eggs in half with a sharp knife and arrange on a plate, cut side up. Reheat the sauce (add a little more water if it has become too thick) then drizzle the sauce over the eggs. Top with fried shallots, garlic, chilies and cilantro. Serve immediately with jasmine rice. Enjoy!

title: Baked Eggs (with Ham and Poblanos)
description: Easy baked eggs in a muffin tin made with ham and roasted poblanos. The perfect breakfast that's great for meal prep and eating on the go!

ingredients.name: deli ham ((or 12 if the slices are very big))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Roast the poblanos: Add the poblano peppers to a baking sheet and place under the broiler for 10 minutes until the skin is blackened and blistered, flipping halfway through.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove them from the oven, loosely cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil or plastic wrap to keep in some of the heat and help them steam, and let them sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pull and rub off as much of the loose skin on the peppers as possible. It doesn't have to be perfect. (View some step-by-step photos on how to roast poblano peppers here.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer poblanos to a cutting board, discard the stem and discard the seeds and veins if you don't want them spicy. Cut poblanos into long strips and chop into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare oven and muffin tin: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Generously spray a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray or grease with olive oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the seasoning: Combine the black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and salt in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Assemble: Place 2 slices of deli ham into the bottom of each muffin cup and press down on the bottom and sides to form a little cup/boat. (If you're using 12 large slices of ham total, use 1 slice per muffin cup.)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Evenly distribute the chopped roasted poblanos into each muffin cup, then carefully crack an egg on top of each and sprinkle with the seasoning.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the eggs are cooked through, firm, and no longer jiggly.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Cool: Remove the muffin tin from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes. Use a toothpick or knife to loosen the sides of each muffin cup and lift them out.

title: Jeweled Couscous Recipe with Pomegranate and Lentils
description: Easy, flavor-packed jeweled couscous recipe with pomegranate, lentils, mushrooms, nuts and raisins! A gorgeous little Mediterranean feast in one dish!

ingredients.name: mushrooms, cleaned and sliced (I used baby bella mushrooms, but white button mushrooms would work)
fresh mint (about 30 mint leaves), stems removed, chopped
5-6 scallions, tops trimmed, chopped (both white and green parts)
Seeds (arils) of 1 large pomegranate, more for garnish
Medjool dates, pitted, chopped (figs or dried apricots would work here as well)
EACH shelled chopped pistachios, chopped walnuts, toasted pine nuts, more for

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the lentils under cold running water. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the lentils in a saucepan and add 3 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils cook through (they should absorb all the water). Add a pinch of salt and remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the lentils are cooking, make the couscous. In a saucepan, bring the vegetable broth to a boil. Remove from heat then stir in couscous, turmeric, pinch of salt, 1/2 tbsp olive oil. Cover and let sit 5 minutes to finish cooking. Fluff with a fork and give it a try. If needed, stir in just a little more boiled vegetable broth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet like this one, heat 2 tbsp olive oil. Add the mushrooms. Cook for 4 minutes on high, tossing occasionally, until the mushrooms begin to gain color. Reduce heat to medium-high, and stir the onions and garlic and cook a couple more minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the same skillet, add in the cooked lentils and couscous. Add salt, cinnamon, paprika, cardamom, coriander, and black pepper. Mix the pomegranate molasses and lemon juice with 1 tbsp olive oil, and add the liquid to the skillet with the couscous and lentil mixture. Toss to combine. Cook on medium, stirring regularly until warmed through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the heat and add the remaining ingredients. You can transfer to a larger mixing bowl, and using a large wooden spoon, mix to combine. Transfer the couscous to a serving platter and garnish with more pomegranate seeds and nuts.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
description: Broccoli Cheese Soup - creamy, velvety and comforting soup with tender broccoli, grated carrots, cheese and so much flavors. One of the easiest soup you can indulge to!

ingredients.name: can evaporated milk ((replace with 1 1/2 cup milk ) )
½- ¾ pound broccoli florets (, cut into small pieces)
– 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese ((some reserve for garnish))
large fresh carrot ( peeled and grated)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Melt butter in a pot or Dutch oven over medium heat and saute onions, garlic , Italian and creole seasoning for 2-3 minutes or until onions are wilted.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Whisk in the flour and cook for a few minutes until it browns or enough to remove the flour taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce heat to medium-low and slowly pour in evaporated milk and stock while stirring well to dissolve the flour in the liquid. Season with mustard powder and give a quick stir. Allow it to thicken for 5-7 minutes while stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add in the broccoli florets and let it simmer for 10-15 minutes or until tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then mix in freshly grated cheddar cheese, stir until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Throw in some grated carrots, if desired, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper and let it cook through for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and serve in bread bowls or with bread rolls on the side.

title: Swiss Steak
description: Swiss Steak - a hearty and easy family dinner with pounded, coated and browned round steak slowly cooked in a rich tomato gravy, bell peppers, onions and seasonings. A tasty family-friendly steak meal that doesn't break the bank!

ingredients.name: 2-2.5 pounds beef, (top round or bottom steak cut into ½-inch cubes)
½-1 cup tomatoes, (pureed or diced (I used 1 cup))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat dry the steak with a paper towel, then season it with salt, pepper, and Cajun seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, pepper, and garlic and onion powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then coat the steak with seasoned flour and shake off any excess.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat; then sear the steak on both sides until golden brown — 6-7 minutes per side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove beef from the skillet and place it on a plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add onions to the skillet, then saute for 2-3 minutes. Follow with garlic, thyme, oregano, and bay leaf, and continue cooking for 3-5 more minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent it from burning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Next, add the tomato puree, smoked paprika, Worcestershire sauce, beef, and 1-2 cups of water. Cover and simmer for about 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Throw in the bell pepper, and continue cooking until the meat is tender.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove from heat and serve warm. Spoon the sauce over the steak.

title: Crispiest oven-baked Chicken Fingers in Amazing Yogurt Crust
description: Perfect chicken fingers!! Crispy on the outside, juicy and tender on the inside with a thick golden brown yogurt crust..

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash thoroughly the chicken breasts and cut into thick strips (3-4 strips each one, depending on the size of each chicken breast). In a large bowl, add the ingredients for the marinade and whisk to combine. Add the chicken pieces and blend to coat. Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and leave in the fridge for at least 3 hours. The longer you leave the chicken marinade, the tender it will turn out, so if you have the time, it’s best to leave it overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Take the chicken out of the fridge and drain. Prepare the ingredients for the crust. In a bowl, add the yogurt (400g), the water, the eggs, the baking powder and season with salt and pepper. Whisk the mixture until smooth, like a batter. In a separate bowl, add the flour, the semolina, the sesame seeds, 1 tsp of salt, the herbs and spices and blend to combine. (Use any kind of herbs and spices you like, the more the better!)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Take 3-4 chicken strips, dip them in the yogurt mixture and place them in the flour-semolina mixture. Shake to coat and set aside, shaking of any excess four. Repeat with the rest. To form a nice thick crust, it is important to repeat this procedure twice, starting again with the yogurt mixture and then dredging with the flour mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Butter the bottom of a large non-sticking pan and place the chicken fingers in a single layer. Bake in preheated oven at 200C for about 22 minutes, until golden brown crispy and cooked through. When you turn the chicken fingers out of the oven, you will realise that the pan is completely dry, which means extra juicy and tender chicken, as the crust helped the chicken to withhold all its juices.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you just love yogurt, then serve the chicken fingers with a cooling, thick yogurt sauce. To prepare the sauce add all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk, until smooth. Enjoy with some leafy greens aside.

title: Mom's Best Beef Stew with Tendon
description: This beef stew uses soy sauce, wine, bay leaves, chili, curry powder, and tomato paste to create a balanced and rich flavor without overpowering the taste of the beef. None of the spices stands out too much.

ingredients.name: kilograms (5 pounds) beef plate (, cut into bite-size cubes)
kilograms (1.5 pounds) beef tendon (, cut into bite-size cubes)
and 1/2 thumbnail ginger (, divided into 3 thick slices, slightly smashed with a knife)
centimeters (6 inches) scallion (, chopped (2 centimeters /1 inches in length))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place beef tendon in a pressure cooker and add water to cover beef completely. Place on high heat until rated pressure has been reached. Turn to lowest heat. Simmer at rated pressure for 30 minutes. Turn off heat and allow the pressure to release naturally.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While simmering the beef tendon, prepare beef plate. Add beef plate into a large pot and add water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil over high heat. Turn to medium-low heat and keep a gentle boil going for 10 to 15 minutes. While boiling, skim the foam from the top of the broth and discard it. Turn off heat. Use a colander to transfer beef to a wok (or a large dutch oven). Let the soup sit about 10 minutes, then pour the soup into the wok until it covers the beef completely. (There may be some clotted blood on the bottom of pot. Try to avoid pouring it into wok.) Save the rest of the soup in the pot and set it aside for later use.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the wok over medium heat. Add Shaoxing wine, chili pepper, ginger, scallion, bay leaves and black pepper (* see footnote) into wok and simmer, covered, for about 40 minutes. The beef tendon should be ready at that point.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer beef tendon from the pressure cooker to the wok, and discard the broth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add curry powder, sugar and tomato paste into wok and mix well. Simmer, covered, for about 30 minutes, until beef starts to become more tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add dark soy sauce, light soy sauce and salt into the wok. Mix well and simmer, covered, for one hour to one hour and a half (simmer time varies depending on the cut of beef). While simmering, stir the beef several times. Scoop the beef from the bottom with a spatula, to avoid burning it on the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: After 20 minutes, watch the beef more closely and adjust the seasoning. If the liquid is becoming thick, but the beef is still tough, add more broth (from step 2), half a cup at a time. The liquid should be able to cover half of the beef. However, do not add too much water at the end of simmering, when beef is already soft.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When simmering has finished, adjust the seasoning again. The beef should be very tender and the soup quite thick. If the soup is not thick enough, boil uncovered over medium heat. Stand near the wok and stir constantly until soup thickens.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve warm with steamed rice.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: The beef stew will stay good in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week, or in the freezer for up to a month.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: To store the beef stew for your lunchbox or dinner during the next two weeks, place stew in a small bowl (2 to 4 servings per bowl) and set aside. After the stew has cooled down to room temperature, cover with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator, until stew has congealed and can easily be easily taken from the bowl. Store the blocks of stew in individual ziplock bags in the freezer.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: To make a one-dish meal, you could add beans, potato, tomato, carrot or broccoli into the stew and boil them together, until the vegetables are cooked through.

title: Spicy Roasted Cauliflower Tahini Dip with Turmeric and Smoked Paprika
description: A Middle Eastern-style spicy dip with roasted cauliflower and tahini. Packs flavor from garlic, lime juice and warm spices.

ingredients.name: handful of chopped fresh parsley to garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cauliflower florets on a large, lightly oiled baking sheet. In a small bowl, mix the spices. Toss the cauliflower with the spices and the olive oil until well-coated. If needed, add more olive oil, and toss again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Be sure to spread the cauliflower florets on the baking sheet in one layer. Roast in the 450 degrees F heated oven for 45 minutes; turn the florets over midway through roasting. When the cauliflower is tender and nicely browned in some parts, remove from the oven and let cool briefly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place about 2/3 of the roasted cauliflower in the bowl of a food processor (you will use the rest later). Add the garlic, yogurt, lime juice, tahini paste and a pinch more seasoned salt. Blend until smooth. Test and season accordingly. If the dip is too thick, add very little water and blend again until you achieve desired consistency.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the roasted cauliflower tahini dip into a serving bowl and drizzle a generous amount of olive oil. Top with the remaining roasted cauliflower and the fresh parsley.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate the dip. Remove from the fridge about 10 minutes or so before serving. Serve with pita bread or chips.

title: Chipotle Shakshuka Recipe
description: This Chipotle Shakshuka recipe features baked eggs in a smoky tomato sauce for an easy and healthy dish. It's so good, even the biggest meat eater will love it! Perfect for breakfast, brunch and even dinner.

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper (plus more as needed)
crumbled cotija cheese, (plus more for topping)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oven to 375°F. While oven is heating up, heat oil in a large cast iron or oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions and bell peppers. Cook until very soft and beginning to caramelize, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes, chipotle pepper, cumin, paprika, salt and black pepper. Simmer until the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in cotija cheese, then gently crack eggs on top of the tomato mixture. Season the eggs with a little more salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer skillet to oven and bake until eggs are just set, about 10 minutes. Top with chopped cilantro, sliced avocados and enjoy!

title: Cretan Sweet Cheese Pastries Recipe (Kalitsounia)
description: Extremely soft and highly addictive! These delicious little cheese pastries (kalitsounia) are a holiday tradition from the island of Crete.

ingredients.name: of fresh soft myzithra cheese or mascarpone or ricotta (35 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the dough for the cheese pastries (kalitsounia), add into a large bowl the olive oil, sugar, yogurt and eggs; blend well, using your hands, until the ingredients combine. Pour in the orange juice, the lemon zest and vanilla extract and blend again. Sieve the flour with the baking powder and add gradually to the mixture. Knead the dough with your hands, until it softens. Depending on the flour, you may need to use a little bit less or more flour than the recipe calls for. The dough should be soft, but not sticky.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Leave the dough to rest for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime, prepare the filling for the kalitsounia. Mash the cheese into a large bowl, add the sugar, the eggs and the cinnamon; blend well, until the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the dough on a floured surface. Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough to a thickness of about 0.3 cm. Using a 10cm cutter, cut out some circles. (If you find it difficult to roll out the whole dough, cut it in half and roll out each half separately.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add a spoonful of the cheese mixture in the center of each dough circle and spread. Raise the rim of the dough up around the cheese and using your fingers, pinch the edges to pull the dough in around the cheese, leaving the center open, as shown in the picture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180-200C. Place the cheese pastries (kalitsounia) on a large baking tray, lined with parchment paper and leave to rest for 20 minutes. Into a bowl, whisk 1-2 eggs and 1 tbsp of water and brush the pastries. Sprinkle with cinnamon powder and bake for about 25 minutes, until golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve the kalitsounia as a delicious dessert with a drizzle of honey. Enjoy!

title: Honey-Soy Glazed Chicken (Reynolds Foil)
description: Honey-Soy Glazed Chicken is roasted until super juicy and tender in foil and then broiled with a glaze to give you a beautifully caramelized sweet-savory chicken dinner.

ingredients.name: Optional handful of vegetables of your choice (green beans, onion, peppers and/or tomato work great)
chili flakes ((or cayenne for a spicier result, or paprika for a non-spicy dish))
chili flakes ((or cayenne for a spicier result, or paprika for a non-spicy dish))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Combine the dry rub ingredients in a bowl, mix well, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare four 16” (40 cm) sheets of Reynolds Wrap® Heavy Duty Foil (if not heavy duty, use 2 layers of foil per chicken leg quarter). Place one leg quarter in the center of each piece of foil. Distribute the rub evenly between the legs, then thoroughly rub the spice mix onto the legs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fold each pocket by bringing up the long sides of the foil, so the ends meet over the chicken leg. Double fold the ends, leaving room for heat to circulate inside. Then double fold the two short ends to seal the packet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the foil packets onto a foil lined sheet pan. Bake for 1 hour 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the chicken bakes, prepare the glaze. Combine the honey, soy sauce, ginger, and chili flakes in a small pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce to a simmer. Simmer, stirring regularly, for about 20 minutes or until the sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat and mix in the lemon juice. Set aside and let cool. The sauce will thicken further once cooled.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: After 1 hour and 30 minutes remove the chicken from the oven. Carefully open the packets (beware of hot steam). Lift the chicken from the juices and place the chicken back on the foil-lined baking sheet. Discard the parcels and juices.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: (Optional) You can add some vegetables on the side of the chicken if you prefer.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Turn the broiler on and brush a thick layer of glaze over each chicken leg. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the glaze thickens and bubbles. Remove the baking sheet and apply another layer of glaze, and broil for another 3 to 5 minutes, or until the skin is sticky and blistered.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve hot as a main dish.

tbsp. rock sugar (, recommend yellow sugar )

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer chicken wings to a bowl, add white pepper, salt, ginger and scallion. Then message (or grasp is a more accurate words) for 3-4 minutes. This step is the key of removing odd taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a very small amount of oil in pan and fry chicken wings until slightly browned on both sides. Add scallion and ginger to fry until aroma. Transfer chicken wing to aside and fry the sugar over slow fire until bubbled. Mix well. This is the caramelization process which brings unique flavor for the chicken wings.

steps.title: Step 4

Turn up fire and thicken the sauce until all the sauces are attached on the chicken wings. Move the chicken wings continuously to help thickening the sauce and avoid burning. Serve hot!

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Thread the rice cake, meat and vegetables onto the skewers.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a large pan with a little bit of oil over medium low heat. Place the skewers in the pan. Cook each side until the meat and vegetables are cooked through and slightly caramelized, 1 – 2 minutes each side. Garnish with the optional sesame seeds or pine nuts.

title: Easy Salt Baked Chicken (简易盐焗鸡)
description: Learn this super easy recipe to create extra juicy and tender roast chicken chicken with a crispy skin that is very fragrant.

ingredients.name: ginger powder ((or sand ginger powder if available))
Shaoxing wine ((or Chinese rose wine, or dry sherry))
(3 lb to 5 lb / 1.3 kg to 2.2 kg) whole chicken ((*Footnote 1))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the Spice mix: Combine the salt, sugar, ginger powder, five spice powder, and turmeric in a small bowl. Stir to mix well. Pour in the Shaoxing wine. Stir again to dissolve as much salt and sugar as possible. Set it aside to sit while you prepare the chicken.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare the chicken: Cut the chicken along both sides of the backbone one side at a time using a pair of kitchen scissors. Flip the chicken over and flatten out the legs and wings. Press down on the center of the chicken breasts using your hands, until the breastbone cracks and the chicken lays flat. Tug the wing tips under the drumsticks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400° (200°C) convection (highly recommended, for a crispier skin) or 425°F (224°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the green onion and ginger slices in the center, to form a bed for the chicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the chicken skin side down. Spread a thin layer of the spice mix and rub until it’s even. Transfer the chicken onto the prepared green onion and ginger, skin side up this time. Rub the seasonings over the skin. You will have leftover spice mix if using a smaller chicken.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the juices run clear when you probe the thickest part of the thigh and breast. Or the meat should read 165°F (74°C) if using a thermometer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the chicken is baked, let rest for 10 minutes before carving. Serve over steamed rice as a main dish.

title: Chicken stir fry with Baby Bok Choy
description: This chicken stir fry is made with baby bok choy. The sauce is light yet rich in flavor, which goes well with chicken breast. It's quick, easy and versatile!

ingredients.name: to 12 ounces baby bok choy (or regular bok choy cut into small pieces)
canola or vegetable oil for frying (divided)
oyster sauce (or soy sauce with 1/4 teaspoon sugar)
cornstarch mixed in 2 tablespoons water (starch slurry)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the chicken into thin bite size pieces against the grain (about 1/4-inch thick).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the chicken with salt (about 1/4 teaspoon) and pepper, and then mix well with the cornstarch and egg white until the chicken is well coated. Let it sit while you prepare the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Separate the leaves by cutting off the stem of each bok choy. Rinse them a couple of times, and drain well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Thinly slice the garlic, and julienne the ginger.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a large non-stick skillet or wok over high heat. Add a tablespoon of oil. Add the chicken pieces in one layer and cook until they are no longer pink, about a minute each side. The chicken does not need to be cooked through at this point. Transfer the chicken to a plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Reheat the skillet over high heat. Add a tablespoon of the oil. Stir in the garlic and ginger, and cook just enough to infuse the oil with flavor. Add the rice wine, and cook for a minute. Pour in the chicken broth (or water), add the oyster sauce (or soy sauce and sugar), and boil for a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return the chicken to the skillet, and add the bok choy and optional water chestnut. Stir-fry everything together, for one or two minutes, until the bok choy is wilted. Taste the sauce, and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Drizzle the starch slurry over and quickly stir everything together until the sauce is well incorporated. Add the sesame oil, and give it a quick stir.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot with or over steamed rice.

title: Ultra Soft Ginger Milk Pudding
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: whole milk (if you're lactose intolerant, use lactose free milk; it will not work with non-dairy beverages like soy milk)
evaporated milk (for a lighter, softer pudding, just omit evaporated milk and substitute the same amount of milk)
Sugar, to taste (I use about 2 tsp)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grate the ginger using a fine grater, or chop and blend in a food processor or blender. Squeeze the ginger juice out either by pressing the grated ginger through a fine mesh sieve, or wrap it in cheese cloth and wring it out like I did in the video. (I find I get more juice out with the cheese cloth method.) Discard the fibre. (Tip: do not juice the ginger ahead of time as the enzymes will die off as the juice sits, and it won't set the pudding)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir the ginger juice well—as you'll notice that the starch in the ginger juice settles very quickly—and add 2 tsp of ginger juice into each of the serving cup.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the milk, evaporated milk, and sugar in a heat-proof container (best to use a spouted container for easy pouring) and microwave just until it starts to steam. Use an instant-read thermometer and check the temperature. You want the temperature to be around 70°C-75°C (although I've had success with temperatures from 65°C - 80°C without noticing a significant difference in firmness).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the milk reaches the temperature, stir the ginger juice in the serving up to make sure the starch is not settling at the bottom, then quickly pour half the milk mixture (100 ml) into the cup. Repeat with the other cup. Let the pudding set for 5 minutes without disturbing them! I forgot to mention this in the video, but if you move, shake, stir the pudding while it's trying to set, you'll break the curd and it will not be smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the pudding is set, serve warm and prepare to be soothed by this silky soft gingery pudding!

steps.title: Step 6

title: Kuku Sabzi: Baked Persian Herb Omelet
description: Kuku Sabzi is a light, flavor-packed Persian baked omelet. This is an all-star, easy recipe with loads of fresh herbs! Perfect for your next brunch!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Position an oven rack in the upper-middle position and heat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Trace the bottom of an 8-inch square pan or 9-inch round cake pan on kitchen parchment, then cut inside the lines to create a piece to fit in the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coat the bottom and sides of the pan with 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, turning the parchment to coat on both sides (the oil should pool at the bottom and generously coat the sides).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a food processor, combine the parsley, cilantro, dill, scallions and the remaining 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil. Process until finely ground (now, I like my herbs less fine, so I stopped the processor at my desired texture). Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk the baking powder, salt, cardamom, cinnamon, cumin and pepper. Add 2 eggs and whisk until blended, then add the remaining eggs and whisk until just combined. Fold in the herb-scallion mixture and the walnuts and cranberries, if using. Pour into the prepared pan and smooth the top.

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let the kuku cool in the pan undisturbed for 10 minutes. When ready, run a thin knife around the edges to loosen the kuku. Invert onto a plate and remove the parchment from bottom, then re-invert on another serving plate or a cutting board so the top of the kuku is facing you. Slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Cold Brew Coffee
description: How to Make Cold Brew Coffee at home! No more expensive and overpriced iced lattes - make your own with cold brew!
tags: how to make cold brew coffee

ingredients.name: medium or dark roast coffee beans

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grind coffee beans until coarse or medium coarse.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour room temperature water into a large jar or pitcher. Add the coffee and gently mix together until coffee grounds are fully saturated.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover jar or pitcher with a cheesecloth and secure with a lid or rubber band. Let coffee steep on the kitchen counter for 12 to 24 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the cheesecloth from the jar or pitcher and lay it flat in a large strainer. Pour the coffee through the cheesecloth and strainer into a clean container.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To serve, pour over ice. The coffee is concentrated, so taste and add a little water or milk to your liking.

title: Traditional Cretan Ntakos / Dakos recipe (Rusks with tomatoes and feta cheese)
description: Dakos/ Ntakos is a traditional Greek salad from the island of Crete. Extra virgin olive oil, juicy tomatoes, salty feta cheese combine to form an amazing, full of mediteranean flavors Greek dish!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Moisten the rusks ( paximadia ), with 4 tbsps of water each, and drizzle with the olive oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use a grater to grate the tomatoes, into a colander and leave for 5 minutes to drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Crumble the feta cheese and myzithra (soft cheese) with a fork, or grate it with a grater.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To put the dish together, spread the grated tomato on the rusks and add the crumbled cheese. Top with the olive oil and capers. Sprinkle with the oregano and drizzle with some extra olive oil.

title: Southern Pinto Beans Recipe
description: Smokey ham and hearty pinto beans with the right spices made totally from scratch. Paprika and chili powder give it the perfect heat, and oregano and cumin fill the kitchen with their mouthwatering aroma.

ingredients.name: chicken broth (and/or water (more or less for desired texture))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse dry pinto beans and pick through and discard any foreign objects. Add beans to a large pot and cover with 3-4 inches of cold water. Cover and let sit for about 8 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Start by covering the ham hocks with water in a large pot. Bring the water to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 1½-2 hours (until the meat falls off the bone). If you have a pressure cooker, it takes only 12 minutes or less once it starts cooking. Let it cool, then cut the meat into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large, heavy-bottomed pot or saute pan, sauté cooked chopped ham hock for 4-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the onions, garlic, oregano, Creole seasoning, chili spice, smoked paprika, and bay leaf. Then sauté for 3-5 minutes, until onions are wilted and aromatic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain the soaked beans, rinse, and place them in the pot. Stir for a minute or two.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add about 5 cups water or chicken broth (enough to cover the beans), and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 55 minutes or more, occasionally stirring.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add more stock or water to reach the desired thickness. The beans' texture should be thick and somewhat creamy but not watery.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove the bay leaves. Taste and adjust for seasonings with salt and pepper if needed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve with cornbread or overcooked rice and garnish with green onion or cilantro.

title: Kimchi Kongnamul Guk (Soybean Sprout Soup with Kimchi)
description: This soup is a variation of kongnamul guk (soybean sprout soup) that's made with kimchi. It's easy and refreshingly delicious with a nice spicy kick!

ingredients.name: gochugaru (red chili pepper flakes) - use less or more to taste
soup soy sauce (guk ganjang) (or 1 teaspoon saeujeot - salted shrimp)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make anchovy broth with 8 cups of water. See the recipe.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the soybean sprouts a couple of times, discarding any skins that are floating. Slice the kimchi into about 1/2-inch thick strips.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the sliced kimchi, kimchi juice, gochugaru, and the soup soy sauce (or saeujeot, salted shrimp) to the anchovy broth. Bring it to a boil. Cook over medium high heat until the kimchi turns translucent, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the bean sprouts and garlic. Cook, covered, for 3 - 4 minutes. Do not open the lid while the bean sprouts are being cooked, or the raw bean smell will linger even after cooked. Once the bean sprouts are cooked, adjust the seasoning, if needed, by adding salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the scallions and boil for another minute. Serve separately with a bowl of rice, or serve it over the rice in a bowl.

title: Spicy Shrimp Dip (Nam Prik Goong Sod) นำ้พริกกุ้งสด
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: (12 g) palm sugar, finely chopped, packed
Vegetables (raw or blanched) such as cucumber, carrots, cabbage, radish, long beans, cauliflower, anything you like for dipping!
Medium boiled eggs for serving (boil for 8 minutes)
Jasmine rice (this dip is usually served as part of a meal so there is normally rice in the mix)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven broiler on high, alternatively you can use a grill on medium heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sear the shrimp in a hot pan with a little oil just until it has a bit of browning on each side, and until it is cooked through. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Broil the garlic, shallots and chilies under a preheated broiler for a few minutes until the edges are charred. They will not finish at the same time, so keep an eye on them and remove them as they are done. If using a grill, use a vegetable grill pan, or skewer the garlic cloves and the shallots together, so they won't fall through the grate. The garlic and shallots should become soft and smells sweet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add all the herbs into a mortar and pestle and pound until creamy with no big chunks.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add palm sugar and pound until dissolved.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add shrimp (but save one for garnish!) and pound until the shrimp are all shredded.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add lime juice, fish sauce, and tamarind juice and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, but remember that the dip should be quite strong as it'll be served with vegetables and rice. If you'd like a thinner consistency you can add a tiny splash of water. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 9
