title: Braised Chicken with Dried Mushrooms
description: Braised chicken with dried shitake mushrooms,creating a fresh and light taste. Carrots and chili peppers also added in order to keep a balance between meat and vegetables.

ingredients.name: A whole young chicken ( ,around 1000g, cut into one bite sizes)
6-8 middle size dried shiitake mushrooms ( ,pre-hydrated and then cut into small chunks)
Pre-soaked vermicelli noodles or rice sticks
fresh shiitake mushrooms ( ,cut into one bite size)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the chicken into small chunks and then cook in boiling water for 3-4 minutes. Transfer the chicken out and clean with warm water. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a claypot or stewing pot, fry garlic, ginger and scallion until aromatic over slow fire. Add chicken chunks in and fry until slightly browned. Add cooking wine and light soy sauce, continue frying for 1 to 2 minutes.Add spices and rock sugar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in enough hot water to cover the chicken chunks and the water level should be at last 3 cm higher if you plan to cook noodles in the dish. Otherwise, use water to cover the chickens.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until the chicken is soft enough. Season with salt and white pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add fresh mushrooms in, cook for 5 minutes and then place the pre-soaked noodles in. Cook for 2 minutes and serve with green onions

title: Fresh Green Bean Casserole
description: Fresh green bean casserole recipe made with fresh green beans, a creamy sauce made from onions and mushrooms, and crunchy fried onions!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Add green beans and cook until bright green, about 4-6 minutes depending on how crisp you want them. While green beans are cooking, prepare an ice bath by filling a large bowl with some ice and water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the cooked green beans quickly with a slotted spoon or tongs to the prepared ice bath. Set aside and let the green beans cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. In a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat (I love using my large cast-iron for this), add butter. When melted, add onions and cook until tender and translucent, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 5 more minutes, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms have become tender and reduced in size.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add garlic and nutmeg and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently, until the flour is well combined with the mushrooms and onions.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add broth and stir to combine, making sure to scrape up any brown bits that are stuck to the bottom of the skillet. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Reduce heat to low and add half and half. Stir together to combine, bring to a simmer, and simmer 10 minutes until the sauce has thickened. The sauce should generously coat the back of a spoon without sliding off.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove from heat. Drain the green beans from the water, and add them to the skillet. Toss together with sauce until fully coated.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Top with fried onions, and bake for 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Middle Eastern Zucchini Baked Omelet
description: A baked omelet made Middle Eastern style with zucchini, onions and lots of fresh mint leaves. Comes together in 30 mins or less. The perfect breakfast or brunch, especially with a side of fattoush or tabouli salad!

ingredients.name: Whole bunch fresh mint, stems removed (about 30 mint leaves), torn
pinch red pepper flakes, to your taste
of bread (toast), crust removed and soaked in 1/3 cup milk

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sprinkle the zucchini slices with a little salt and set aside for 15 minutes. Pat the zucchini dry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a 10-inch cast iron skillet (or oven safe skillet), heat the olive oil on medium, then add the zucchini and onions. Raise the heat to medium-high and saute the vegetables for 5-7 minutes or until they are tender and golden in color. Add most of the torn mint leaves; set aside some for later. Turn the heat off and let cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium mixing bowl, whisk the eggs, salt, crushed red pepper, and the baking powder. Squeeze the toast to drain any excess milk, then break it apart with your hands and add the bread pieces to the eggs. Whisk again briefly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now stir the zucchini and onions in the egg mixture. If needed, add a little more olive oil to the cast iron skillet. Transfer the egg mixture to the skillet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in the 350 F degrees heated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the surface of the omelet looks done.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Top the zucchini baked omelet with feta cheese if you like. And garnish with the torn mint leaves you set aside earlier. Serve with lemon wedges on the side and sliced fresh vegetables like tomatoes. A great side dish to this zucchini baked omelet is fattoush salad.

title: Cabbage and Sausage
description: This fuss-free family weeknight meal is super quick, easy, and budget-friendly to boot. It’s one of my favorite simple skillet meals. I can guarantee it will satisfy your soul and pocket!

ingredients.name: (340g) sausage ((kielbasa or smoked sausage works great))

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large skillet over medium heat, sauté bacon until brown (it may take about 5 minutes). Set aside. Add sausage and brown for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add butter to the pan, followed by onions, garlic, paprika, Creole seasoning, and sausage. Let it simmer for about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burning. Then add tomatoes and green bell peppers, and continue cooking for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add the cabbage, Worcestershire sauce, and white pepper. Bring it to a simmer, cover it, and let it cook for 10-14 minutes or more, depending on preference.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Adjust for seasoning with Creole seasoning, salt, and pepper flakes.

title: Lomo Saltado (Peruvian Stir Fry)
description: This popular Peruvian-Chinese fusion enjoys the Chinese stir-fry technique with Peruvian ingredients. Tender beef strips tossed with flavorful and crisp vegetables and french fries plus an amazing aji sauce to top it all of.

ingredients.name: (453g) sirloin or ribeye, (sliced into ½-inch strips)
small green or red bell pepper, (sliced )
2-3 teaspoons lemon juice, (or white wine vinegar (adjust to taste))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven and bake your french fries according to the package instructions or make homemade fries.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sliced your sirloin, onions, peppers, tomatoes, and green onions, and mince the garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine soy sauce, oyster sauce (optional), vinegar, beef broth, and sriracha in a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Toss the beef strips with salt and let them set for 30 minutes to tenderize them.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium to high heat. Season the beef strips with salt and stir-fry them in the skillet for about 30 seconds. You may need to stir-fry it in batches.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Next, add garlic and ginger, and stir-fry for about 30 seconds (be careful not to let it burn).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Throw in the onions, green pepper, and tomatoes, then stir-fry for about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour in the sauce and stir-fry for a minute.

steps.title: Step 9

steps.title: Step 10

title: Pot Stickers-Chive and Pork
description: Simple and step to step guide to make chive and pork pot sticker at home.

ingredients.name: to 500g Chinese chives (,remove the hard ends)
chili oil (,I use laoganma crispy chili oil this time)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, add ground pork, a small pinch of salt, ginger, egg, cooking wine, light soy sauce, white pepper, and then oyster sauce . Mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then place the green onion on top and drizzle hot oil on green onions. This helps to improve the aroma of the green onion.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir the filling in one direction for 2-3 minutes until getting a paste texture and the filling becomes quite sticky and lighter in color. Set aside for 1 hour or cover with plastic wrapper and overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finely chop chives and mix with 2 tablespoons of sesame oil or other vegetable oil. Mix chive with pork before wrapping.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add around 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan (nonstick pan recommended for beginners), place the dumplings in. Pleats side up.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat over medium fire until one side becomes browned. For a even crisper version, slow down the fire and turn over the dumpling and fry the pleats side until golden brown too.Swirl around 1/4 cup of water and then cover the lid immediately. Continue heating until all of the water is evaporated.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat over slowest fire until the bottom becomes crispy and golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve directly or dipping sauce.

title: Spicy soup with leftover turkey
description: Korean spicy soup made with leftover roasted turkey. The recipe is also great with leftover roasted chicken.

ingredients.name: or more cooked turkey/chicken meat, shred into bite sizes
fresh shiitake mushrooms (or 3 soaked dry shiitake mushrooms)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the meat, bean sprouts, mushrooms, 1 tablespoon soup soy sauce, and garlic to the sesame oil mixture and mix well. Marinate for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring the stock to a boil in a large pot. Add the marinated meat and vegetables to the stock. Stir in the gochujang and 2 tablespoons of soup soy sauce. Cook for 5 minutes over medium high heat.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Thai-Style Milk Pudding เต้าหู้นมสด
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: condensed milk (45 ml) (can put more or less to taste)
Flavourings of your choice (optional): vanilla, almond, etc.
Scant 1 Tbsp (15 ml) sweetened condensed milk
Fresh fruit: Strawberries, mango, peaches, kiwi.
Canned fruit: jackfruit, lychee, fruit cocktail
Lemon basil seeds/chia seeds (soaked in hot water for 10 mins until a clear gel forms around the seeds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour about 2-3 Tbsp of the water into a small bowl, then sprinkle gelatin on top evenly and let it sit for 5-10 minutes to hydrate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, add the remaining water into a small pot and stir in agar agar powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add milk and whipping cream, then stir over medium high heat until it comes to a boil. (Be careful, it will boil over quickly.) Turn the heat down and let it simmer for 1 minute to ensure that all the agar agar powder has dissolved. To check that the agar agar has dissolved, you can use a metal spoon to scoop up some mixture and pour it off, and there should be no tiny granules stuck to the spoon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the heat off, then add the hydrated gelatin along with all the water, and stir for 1-2 minutes until the gelatin is completely dissolved. Add condensed milk and flavourings of your choice, then taste and adjust as needed. Pour into single-serving cups, making sure it’s no more than ⅔ full so you have lots of room for the toppings. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until cold.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, stir together the sauce ingredients until the condensed milk is completely dissolved. If the condensed milk won't dissolve fully, briefly warm up the mixture in the microwave to help it dissolve. (Just 10-15 seconds, it can boil over if it gets too hot!). Refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To serve, make sure the pudding and the sauce are cold! Cut your toppings into small dice then arrange on top of the pudding. Pour about 1 Tbsp of the sauce gently down the side of the fruit. Enjoy!

title: Easy Baked Salmon with Garlic Balsamic Glaze
description: Easy Baked Salmon with Garlic-Balsamic Glaze. The garlic-balsamic glaze does all the work in flavoring, but don't skip the fresh herbs! Great for a quick weeknight meal or a special dinner for a crowd!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small saucepan, mix balsamic vinegar and honey. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 15 minutes or so. Remove from heat, and let cool for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To the balsamic mixture, add garlic, spices, mustard, and olive oil. Mix until well combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Season salmon well with salt, and a little black pepper on both sides. Brush one side with the balsamic glaze, then lay salmon, glazed sided down, on the prepared baking sheet. Dress the top generously with the balsamic glaze (reserve a small bit of the glaze for the end.)

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from oven and brush with remaining glaze. Top with fresh chopped herbs. Enjoy!

title: Sichuan Dry Rub Roast Chicken Breast
description: Tender, juicy chicken breast roasted with a rich, spicy dry rub. Only 30 minutes required, including prep and cooking. {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: Chinese chili flakes ((or paprika powder for less spiciness))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Generously sprinkle salt on both sides of the chicken breasts. Let marinate at room temperature for 15 to 30 minutes, or covered and placed in the fridge for up to 6 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all the ingredients for the Sichuan dry rub in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake until a thermometer inserted reads 160 F (*Footnote 2), or until the juice runs clear when you insert a knife into the thickest part of the chicken, about 15 minutes for smaller pieces and 20 minutes for larger ones.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes. Serve hot as a main.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: You can store the leftover chicken in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days or in the freezer for up to 3 months. Reheat using microwave or a 350 F oven.

title: Feta Bouyiourdi recipe (Spicy Greek Baked Feta with Tomatoes)

title: Budae Jjigae (Army Stew)
description: Budae jjigae (Army stew) is easy to make. As long as it has kimchi and some American processed meats, it’s a budae jjigae. This budae jjigae recipe will give you a few tips for making it delicious!

anchovy broth (or beef or chicken stock) (More if you want extra broth. You can also use water.)
gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes) (Use more for a spicier stew)
soup soy sauce (or salt to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the ingredients into bite size pieces, and arrange them in a medium size shallow pot. Mix all the seasoning ingredients in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the broth, and stir in the seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook over medium high heat until the bacon is cooked through and the kimchi has softened. Add the optional ramyeon noodles and more broth or water if necessary. (The noodles soak up a lot of the liquid, so I briefly cook the ramyeon noodles in a separate pot of water before adding to the stew.)

title: Japanese Curry from Scratch!
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: beef chuck, or any other protein of your choice (see note)
+ 2 tsp curry powder (any kind will do just fine, but if you want to use Japanese curry powder, see my video for the packaging)
beef stock, unsalted (if not using beef, use stock that matches your protein)
medium apple, puréed (you may need to add a bit of water to the blender to get it going)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle a generous pinch of salt to the beef cubes and toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a heavy-bottomed pot (the one you're using for the curry) add just enough vegetable oil to coat the bottom and heat over medium high heat until the oil is very hot. Add beef to the pot without letting it crowd, you may need to do this in 2 batches. Let sear without stirring until browned, then flip and sear the other sides, and repeat until at least 3 sides are browned. Watch your heat and make sure you don't burn the brown stuff that's on the bottom of the pot. Remove the beef andset aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To the same pot, add onion, garlic, ginger and saute over medium heat for a few minutes until the onion is soft and translucent. Add tomato paste and saute for a minute. Add curry powder and toaste the spices for one more minute, adding more oil if it seems to dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the beef stock, pureed apple, the seared beef, soy sauce, and worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer on low heat for at least 2 hours or until it is almost fork tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the beef has simmered, add carrots, potato and simmer, uncovered, for another 30 minutes until the potato and carrots are tender. If using peas, stir them in about 15 minutes after the potato has gone in. Note: At this stage, I let it simmer uncovered because I want to reduce the amount of liquid slightly, but if you don't want to lose any more liquid, you can keep it covered.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, make a roux by melting butter in a small pot, then add the flour and stir over medium heat until the colour has darkened slightly. Remove from heat and set aside until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When curry is done, stir in half the roux and bring to a simmer. Check the thickness, and if you want it thicker, add some or all of the remaining roux. If you have leftover roux, you can save it for another use in the fridge or freezer, it can be used to thicken any kind of soup, stock, or stew.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: TASTE and adjust seasoning! This is very important, as you may need to add more soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour the curry over Japanese rice and serve with some fukujinzuke pickles. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Greek style Roast Pork with Honey Sauce
description: The perfect Greek style roast pork recipe ready in 3 steps and only 10 minutes prep!

ingredients.name: kg/ 8 medium potatoes, cut into wedges (53 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious roast pork, rub the pork well with salt and place on large baking. Peel and cut the potatoes into wedges and place in the pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a large bowl, add the orange juice, the lemon juice, the mustard, honey and olive oil and blend with a wooden spoon, until the ingredients are combined (for your convenience heat up the honey into a microwave, until liquid and easier to work with). Pour the mixture over the pork and the potatoes. Add one whole clove of garlic and sprinkle the pork with some fresh rosemary. Season the potatoes and sprinkle with fresh thyme.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bake uncovered for approx. 15-20 minutes in preheated oven at 220C, until nicely coloured. Remove the pork from the oven, cover with aluminium foil and lower the heat to 180C. Bake for 1 more hour (add half a glass of hot water, if the pan appears to be getting dry). Enjoy!

title: Camarones a la Diabla
description: Camarones a la Diabla (also known as diablo shrimp) are juicy, large shrimp covered in a bright red chile pepper sauce that are ready to eat in 30 minutes! (gluten free, low carb, paleo)

ingredients.name: guajillo chiles, (rinsed, stems and seeds removed)
large raw shrimp, (peeled, deveined and tail-on)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium bowl or saucepan, add dried guajillo and arbol chiles. Add very hot or boiling water until chiles are fully submerged. Cover with a lid or large plate and let sit for 15 minutes, until chiles have softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the softened chiles to a large blender. Add the tomatoes, garlic, onion and salt. Puree until completely smooth. Taste and season with more salt, if necessary. If the sauce is too spicy, add more tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large saute pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add olive oil and shrimp. Cook shrimp for 1 minute per side, or until shrimp is light pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the red chile sauce to the pan or skillet and mix together to coat the shrimp. Lower the heat to medium and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until the sauce is bubbling and hot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the pan or skillet from the heat and serve alone as an appetizer or with Authentic Mexican Rice as a meal.

title: Boat shaped Greek Pizza recipe (Peinirli or Peynirli)
description: Try a different take on the Italian pizza with this boat shaped Greek pizza recipe (Peynirli)!

ingredients.name: kasseri cheese (15 oz.) or mix of mozzarella, edam, gouda or cheddar cheese

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this Greek pizza recipe (peynirli) start by preparing the dough first. In the large bowl from an electric mixer add the milk (at room temperature), yeast and sugar and stir with a fork, so that the yeast dissolves completely. Into the same bowl, add the flour, butter,olive oil and salt. Use the dough hook to mix the ingredients in medium speed, for about 5-7 minutes. The dough for this Greek pizza recipe should be smooth and elastic and easy to roll

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Coat lightly the dough with some olive oil, place the dough inside a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let the dough sit in a warm place for at least 30 minutes, until it doubles it’s size.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Take the dough for your Greek pizza out of the bowl and split in 6 evenly sized portions. Stretch out the dough and shape in oval shaped, thin portions, like a pizza base.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For the topping for this Greek pizza recipe, grate the cheeses on top of the stretched out dough and fold the dough corners to form its crust (see pictures below). Make sure you squeeze the ends so that the dough sticks together and doesn’t unfold when baking. Fold the bottom edge first. Secure the edges by pressing them firmly or sealing them with a bit of water. Start folding the upper edge in the same way you did for the bottom. And lastly fold the two ends creating a boat-shaped pizza with raised edges. These will keep your ingredients in place.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut the bacon and peppers in little strips. Add the bacon and peppers on top, spreading them evenly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Preheat oven at 180C and bake the peinirli for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from the oven and let the peynirli cool for a few minutes. Enjoy!!

title: Moroccan Vegetable Tagine Recipe

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in chickpeas and cook another 5 minutes on low heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir in lemon juice and fresh parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or harissa spice blend to your liking.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowls and top each with a generous drizzle of Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil. Serve hot with your favorite bread, couscous, or rice.

Bring to a slow boil, then turn the heat down to medium, so it simmers gently and thickens, 12-15 minutes. Stir in the vegetables, cayenne pepper (if desired), nutmeg, and salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Orange Peel Preserve Recipe (Glyko koutaliou Portokali)
description: An absolutely delicious orange peel preserve recipe! Bright, colorful, sweet and syrupy, this the perfect way to preserve the essence of this delicious fruit all year round!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious orange peel preserve recipe, first start by preparing the oranges. Using a vegetable grater, trim them a little bit on the outside then wash them thoroughly and place them in a large pan. Pour in enough water to cover the oranges completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the pan on high heat and bring to the boil. Boil for about 7 minutes, after the water starts to bubble, sinking the oranges in the water once in a while and turning them sides. Drain the oranges into a collander and cool them under cold running water. Rinse the pan with some water. Place the oranges back to the pan, and repeat the same procedure. You should repeat the boiling procedure 3 times, until the oranges have softened and most of the bitterness has been removed. Go ahead, the best way to know if your orange peel preserve is sweet enough is by giving it a taste!

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the oranges onto a cutting board and cut them into quarters and then cut each quarter into half (8 pieces each orange). Use scissors remove the pips and any leftover flesh from the inside of the orange (the white part).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: The essence of this sweet orange peel preserve recipe is nothing else than the syrup. Add 2 1/2 cups of water and 1kg sugar into a saucepan and boil for 5 minutes. Add the orange peel into the pan and boil for a further 15 minutes. While the oranges boil, some white foam will probably surface on the water. Skim the foam with a spoon each time it develops. Once done, let them rest for at least 8 hours or preferably, overnight.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: The next day, remove the orange pieces from the pan using a skimmer and set aside. Place the pan with the syrup back on the stove on high heat and boil until it thickens. Add the lemon juice, the glucose and the vanilla extract and boil for 1 more minute. Add the orange pieces and continue boiling, until the syrup is very thick and glossy. To check if the syrup for your orange peel preserve is ready, dip a spoon to the syrup and let it drip two drops over the two opposing sides of a plate. If the syrup spreads on the plate you should boil the preserve a little longer; if the drops stand firm the syrup is ready.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove and let your orange peel preserve cool down. I know it is hard to resist, but this delight is best enjoyed cold! The preserving process has thoroughly pasteurised the preserve and if stored in the right conditions, it can last for the whole winter. The best way to store your orange peel preserve is by pouring it into sterilised glass jars (boil them in some water for a few minutes) and cover when it has cooled down completely. Store into the fridge for 6 to 8 months.

title: Pressure Cooker Bone Broth From Leftover Bones
description: Learn how to turn leftover bones into rich and flavorful broth in one hour.

ingredients.name: gallon leftover bones (chicken, turkey, duck, and/or pork etc)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add leftover bones into pressure cooker, plus enough water to just cover the bones. You don’t need to thaw the bones before cooking. But you do want use a pair of tongs to re-arrange them so you won’t need to use too much water to cover them. It will save you tons of time when reducing the broth later.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add green onions and ginger.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover and make sure the high pressure valve is sealed. Cook at high pressure for 1 hour. Let pressure release naturally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Discard the bones and aromatics. Drain the liquid with a strainer. If you want your soup clear, use an oil separator to remove the fat. I always keep the fat because it adds a very rich flavor to my soup.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For easy storage, I always reduce the broth beforehand. Transfer the drained broth into a pot. Cook over high heat until reduced to half (about 4 cups).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To store the broth, let it cool first. To cool the broth faster, place the pot into an ice bath and stir the soup constantly with a spatula. Soup can be cooled in a few minutes this way.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the portion of broth that you intend to use soon to an airtight container, and store it in the fridge for 3 to 5 days.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer the rest of the broth to large silicone ice cube trays and put them into the freezer. When the broth cubes are frozen, you can transfer them into a large freezer bag to save space. If you’re planning to store them in the ice cube tray, place the tray into a freezer bag and seal it. Store it in the freezer for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When you use the reduced bone broth, don’t forget to dilute it with water (according to taste), because it is very rich and concentrated.

title: Egyptian Vegan Stew with Peas and Carrots

title: The easiest Chocolate and Biscuit Cake (Mosaiko Tourta)
description: A mouthwatering chocolate and petit beurre biscuit cake! Crunchy, creamy with an amazing praline chocolate ganache. Ready to fridge in only 15 minutes and without using an electric mixer or an oven!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soften the butter into the microwave for 30 sec. In order to work with the butter, it should be soft, but not melted. If you don’t have a microwave, leave the butter out of the fridge, at a warm place overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare the cream for the chocolate biscuit cake, add into a bowl the icing sugar, the cocoa powder, the vanilla extract, the 1/3 of the cognac and the eggs. Stir in the softened butter and whisk, until the ingredients combine and the mixture is smooth and creamy. If you like, you can substitute cognac with orange juice for the cream. In that case use 3 tbsps orange juice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a round cake tin (without a bottom) on a serving tray. (It is better for the cake tin to be bottomless, so that you can remove it, before serving the biscuit cake.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assemble the biscuit cake. Layer some of the biscuits to form the bottom of the biscuit cake; break them, if needed, to fill the holes. With a cooking brush, sprinkle the biscuits with cognac (or orange juice). Top the biscuits with a thin layer of the cocoa cream and smooth out with a spatula. Repeat the same, until you have used all the cream and end with a layer of biscuits. You can make as many layers as you like, depending on how thick you want the cream to be. If you prefer the biscuits to be soft, you can sprinkle them with some water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To prepare the praline ganache for the biscuit cake, pour into a small pot the milk cream and bring to the boil. In the meantime, chop the chocolate into small pieces and place in a heatproof bowl. As soon as the milk cream comes to the boil, and starts to bubble, pour it into the bowl with the chopped chocolate and let it stand for 1 minute. Stir, until the chocolate has melted and the glaze is smooth and glossy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour over the biscuit cake a very thin layer of chocolate glaze, and smooth out with a spatula, so that the biscuits are covered. You will use the rest of the glaze as a chocolate sauce, when serving the cake. Put the cake in the fridge for 1-2 hours and leave the chocolate sauce at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve the biscuit cake, remove the cake tin and style it up. Remove the cake tin, using a hair drier to heat it and remove carefully.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place some biscuits around the cake and crush some on top. With a knife scratch a bar of chocolate and sprinkle with the grated chocolate and some icing sugar. Use a sharp knife, dipped into water to cut into portions (each biscuit a portion) and pour some chocolate sauce.

title: Aguijjim (Spicy Braised Monkfish)
description: This spicy braised monkfish is highly popular in Korea. The white flesh fish is tender, and the crunchy soybean sprouts nicely complement the fish with a burst of robust flavor!

ingredients.name: cooking rice wine (mirim or mirin) or dry white wine
large shrimp, unpeeled (or a few little neck clams) - optional
minari or watercress (cut into about 3 to 4 inch lengths)
corn or potato starch, mixed in 2 tablespoons of water

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean and cut the fish into about 2 inch-thick pieces. Drain, and pat dry with a paper towel. Mix well with a teaspoon of salt and the wine. Let it stand while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the seasoning ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare a bowl with ice water. In a medium size pot, bring 1 cup of water to a boil. Add the soybean sprouts, and cook, covered, for 2 minutes over high heat. Drain, and immediately plunge them into the ice water. Drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a heavy, deep skillet. Add 1/2 cup of water and the fish, and cook, covered, over medium heat, for 3 or 4 minutes. Flip the fish over halfway through the process.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the seasoning mix and the optional shrimp (or clams). Continue to cook, covered, for an additional 2 to 3 minutes, or until the fish is tender and the optional shrimp is cooked through (or the clams open).

steps.title: Step 6

title: Mango Ice Cream in a Blender! ไอศรีมมะม่วง ง่ายสุดๆ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: sweet, ripe mango, cut into small cubes and freeze until completely frozen. (see note)
(60 mL) honey (may need more if your mango isn’t very sweet)
(120 mL) Greek yogurt, plain, full-fat (about 10% fat) (if you can't find Greek yogurt, see note below on how to make your own)
1-3 tsp lime juice (amount depends on how tart your mango is, and you may not need any at all if the mango is sour)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place a metal cake pan that you will use for storing the ice cream into the freezer before you start prepping. I suggest using a metal cake pan because it will help the ice cream firm up faster. Faster freezing means less icy and more creamy ice cream.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put the greek yogurt into the blender first, followed by the lime juice (if using) and honey. Tip: Try to place the honey into the middle of the blender jug without getting it on the sides, because the part that sticks to the sides may not blend in.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add frozen mango cubes and blend on highest speed (I use the pulse function). It will likely be stuck in the beginning, so you have to keep pushing the mixture down to the blade, using either the blender tamper or a wooden spoon. After a little pushing in the beginning, the mixture will eventually blend smoothly without getting stuck, and as soon as the mixture looks smooth, it is done. Do not over blend, you don't want to melt the mixture any more than necessary.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: You can either serve it right out of the blender as a soft-serve style ice cream, or place it into the metal cake pan and freeze for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To serve: If you've let it freeze for several hours, it may be a little hard to scoop so you will just need to let it sit at room temp for 5 minutes to soften slightly to make scooping easier.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For long term storage, cover the container with plastic wrap and then another layer of aluminum foil

title: Coconut Jelly Duo วุ้นกะทิ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: sugar (you can adjust this amount depending on the sweetness of the coconut water and your taste)
Optional: If you're using coconut water straight from the whole coconut, and the coconut meat is soft and tender, you can chop up some the meat and add it to this layer for some extra texture.
sugar (you can adjust this amount depending on the sweetness of the coconut water and your taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Coconut Milk Layer: Add coconut water to a small pot, then sprinkle on agar agar powder and stir to mix. Add coconut milk, sugar, salt, and pandan leaf. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Once it comes to a full boil, the agar powder should be completely dissolved, but you can double check by spooning some liquid into a metal spoon, then pour it off, and if there are no tiny grains still stuck to the spoon, then you’re good to go. If you want to add coconut meat to this layer, you can add it at this point and bring the mixture to a boil one more time.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lower the heat to the lowest setting and keep the pot covered while you make the other layer. Make sure it’s just barely simmering and not boiling away! If you have a strong gas stove you might have a hard time getting the heat to stay very low, in that case you can keep it off heat and covered, and reheat it to boiling right before you use it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coconut Water Layer: In another small pot, add coconut water and agar agar powder and stir to break up the powder. Add sugar and pandan leaf, then bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Once it boils, check to see that there aren’t any tiny little grains of agar powder still floating around. Keep the mixture hot and covered just like the coconut milk layer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assembly: You can divide up the layers however you wish, but in the video I had 3 layers of white (⅔ cup each) and 2 layers of clear (1 cup each). Pour the first layer into your dish, spoon off any bubbles, then refrigerate just until the top has set (about 5 minutes if you’re using the same measurements as me). You can test this by gently tapping the layer with your finger, and if it’s no longer liquid and doesn’t stick to your finger, it’s ready to go.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Making sure the second layer is steaming hot, pour it over the back of a spoon, letting it drip gently onto the edges of the first layer. If you pour too quickly or too aggressively, it’ll break the first layer. Refrigerate again just until the top is set (about 7 minutes if you’re using my measurements).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Repeat with the remaining agar mixture, making sure that you keep both mixtures hot and covered while you wait for it to set. If for whatever reason it has gone cold, you can simply reheat it when you are ready to pour.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once you’re finished, let the jelly refrigerate for at least 4 hours so it is nice and cold when you serve it. Enjoy!

title: Cod Fritters with Garlic Potato Puree (Bakaliaros Skordalia)

of red wine vinegar or juice of 2 lemons

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

Using a spoon remove the cod from the batter and put it slowly into the hot oil. Dip the spoon into some water and repeat with the rest of the pieces. Deep fry the cod fritters flipping them with allotted spoon, until nicely colored on all sides. Remove the cod fritters from the pan and place on some kitchen paper to drain. Now, take each half and cut into 1/2-inch thick rings.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make marinade. In a large bowl, combine minced garlic, extra virgin olive oil, 1 tsp allspice, 1 tsp black pepper, 3/4 tsp paprika, and 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg. Mix well. (leave rest of spices for later.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dip Vegetables in Marinade. Add the vegetables (sliced acorn squash, onions, sweet potatoes, and carrots) to the marinade bowl with the garlic marinade (you may need to do this in stages.) Give them a quick toss, then transfer vegetables to a large sheet pan. Season with kosher salt.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Marinate Lamb. To the marinade bowl, add more extra virgin olive oil. Add white wine vinegar, and the remaining spices. Mix well. Add lamb chops in and toss to coat. Set aside to marinate.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake Vegetables. Place vegetables in heated oven and bake for 15 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Brown Lamb then Add to Vegetable Pan. When 15 minutes have passed, remove the vegetables from oven and set near you (leave oven on.) Heat a little bit of extra virgin olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add lamb and brown on both sides (about 3 minutes per side.) Transfer lamb to the vegetable pan, and return to heated oven to bake for 10 minutes (lamb will be medium-rare to medium. Bake a little longer for medium-well.)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Drizzle with honey. When ready, remove pan from oven and immediately drizzle honey all over the lamb and vegetables. Garnish with parsley.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let lamb chops sit for 10 minutes before serving. Serve with a side of tahini sauce, if you like.

title: Mexican Quinoa Salad with Farro and Barley
description: This Mexican Quinoa Salad with Farro and Barley is healthy, easy to make and makes a great vegetarian side dish or lunch in under 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add quinoa, farro, barley, cucumbers, tomatoes, radishes and cotija cheese. Stir together and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the dressing: in a small bowl, add olive oil, white wine vinegar, dried oregano, cilantro, sea salt, black pepper and lime juice. Whisk until combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the dressing onto the mixed salad and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes until chilled, or enjoy immediately.

title: Shrimp Creole
description: Gluten Free Shrimp Creole – A comforting plate of goodness. Easy, tasty and comes together in 30 minutes. Oh, it is gluten free too!

ingredients.name: - 1 canned 14.oz stew tomatoes (, replace with 2-3 tomatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Lightly season the shrimp with creole spice. Heat about 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat in a heavy bottomed Dutch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sauté shrimp for about 1- 2 minutes .

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add sausage sauté until browned on both sides and remove. Set aside

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add remaining oil followed by onions, celery, green pepper, thyme and garlic. Stir for about a 2-3 minutes. Then add bay leaf creole spice, followed by tomatoes, chicken broth, and Worcestershire sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring to a boil , simmer for 10-15 minutes. Add bouillon as needed or omit completely.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Toss in shrimp, sausage and green onions adjust for salt and thickness. Cook for about 2-3 more minutes. Garnish with parsley. Serve over white rice or fettuccine.

title: Chilli Potato Recipe
description: Chilli potato is a spicy starter snack from the indo-Chinese cuisine where fried potatoes are tossed in a spicy, sour and slightly sweet chilli sauce. This is a semi-dry version and is simply addictive and tasty.

ingredients.name: to 275 grams potato or 3 to 4 medium sized potatoes
to ⅓ teaspoon salt (or add as required)
corn flour (or corn starch – can use rice flour, tapioca flour or all purpose flour)
toasted sesame oil (– substitute sunflower oil for roasted sesame oil)
chopped onions (or 1 medium sized onion, chopped or 50 grams onion - can use ⅓ cup chopped spring onion whites)
finely chopped garlic (or 4 to 5 medium to large garlic or 5 grams peeled garlic)
finely chopped ginger (or 1.5 inch ginger or 5 grams ginger)
to 2 teaspoons finely chopped green chillies (or 1 or 2 green chillies, finely chopped)
naturally fermented soy sauce (or regular soy sauce)
red chilli sauce (or red chilli paste)
rice vinegar (or white vinegar or rice wine)
to 2 tablespoons chopped coriander leaves (or spring onion greens)

title: Sichuan Chicken with Spicy Sesame Sauce (怪味鸡)
description: This cold Sichuan chicken dish is served with a numbing, spicy, nutty sauce that is addictively tasty. It may look plain, but it will blow your mind with a single bite.

ingredients.name: Chinese sesame paste ((or natural peanut butter))
homemade chili oil with 1 to 2 tablespoons of its “sediment”
Sichuan peppercorn (, freshly grated roasted (*see footnote 2))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Turn to medium heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Halve green onion. Chop some of the green parts and use them to garnish the dish later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add Shaoxing wine, Sichuan peppercorn, white part of green onion, and ginger to the boiling water. Mix well. Add chicken. Cook until bringing to a simmer. Turn to low heat. Continue cooking at a very gentle simmer until the chicken is cooked through, 20 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While cooking the chicken, prepare a large bowl of ice water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: (Very important) When the chicken is just cooked, immediately transfer it to the ice bath. Add more ice if necessary. Set aside and let cool completely. This step tightens the chicken skin and firms up the texture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Combine soy sauce, black rice vinegar, and sugar in a bowl. Mix well until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add sesame paste to another bowl. Gradually blend in the sauce from last step and mix with a spoon, until the sesame paste is evenly blended and no lumps remain.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add chili oil, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and Sichuan peppercorn. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Right before serving, combine chicken and spicy sesame sauce. Toss to mix well. Spread cucumber over a deep plate. Transfer chicken on top of cucumber and garnish with sesame seeds and green onion, if using. (*see footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve as a cold appetizer, or as a main over noodles or rice.

title: Dan Dan Noodles
description: Dan Dan Noodles for two people

ingredients.name: tbsp. low sodium light soy sauce

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook noodles and serve

title: Jaengban Guksu (Platter of Cold Noodles and Vegetables)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: to 8 ounces buckwheat (memil guksu/soba, green tea noodles or somyeon/somen)
to 4 Romaine lettuce leaves, thinly sliced
- 3 teaspoons gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes) - ( adjust to taste)
orange juice or apple or any other fruit juice
hot mustard powder, gyeoja, (mixed with 2 teaspoons water (optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix all sauce ingredients and keep it cool in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables and keep them cool in the fridge or in ice water (drain well before using).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions (5 - 6 minutes). Drain quickly and shock in cold water to stop cooking. Drain and rinse in icy cold water until the noodles are very cold. Make two or three mounds. Place the mounds in a colander to drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the noodles in the middle of a large platter, and arrange the cold vegetables nicely around the noodles. At the table, you can toss everything together with the sauce or let each person take his or her portion and then mix it with the sauce to taste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: You can practically use any salad vegetables you like, including colorful bell peppers, onions, bean sprouts, watercress, and spring mix.

title: Honey Soy Glazed Ribs ft. Colin Knecht
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: rack of pork back ribs, cut into individual ribs

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pound the coriander seeds in a mortar and pestle just until they are broken up into small pieces, they don't need to be super fine. Combine all marinade ingredients together, including the coriander seeds, and pour over ribs. Coat the ribs thoroughly in the marinade and let them sit while you prepare other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound together garlic, cilantro stems or roots, and white peppercorns into a fine paste. In a wok, add a little vegetable oil and saute the garlic paste until it starts to turn golden. Add the ribs all at once, making sure you get ALL the marinade in there, and add just enough water to almost cover the ribs. Tip: Rinse the ribs bowl with the water so you get all of the marinade into the wok. Bring to a low simmer and cover the pot; simmer for 35-45 minutes or until ribs are fork tender, but not falling-off-the-bone tender, exact timing will depend on the size of your ribs—if they are meaty, they will take longer. After you cover the wok, you will need probably need to turn the heat down a bit to maintain the simmer. Make sure it does not boil vigorously, or the ribs will become dry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the ribs are tender, remove them from the cooking liquid and keep covered in foil to keep warm while you reduce the sauce. Boil the sauce on high heat and reduce it until it thickens into a luscious glaze (this will take a while, so it's a good time to prep your side dishes). Once reduced, add the ribs back in and toss to thoroughly coat the ribs in the sauce. Enjoy on their own as an appetizer or with rice as a meal!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Chicken and Green Chile Egg Muffins
description: Easy, healthy and filling Chicken and Green Chile Egg Muffins - ready in only 30 minutes, this on-the-go breakfast is gluten free, low carb and paleo friendly.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with parchment paper cup liners and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, green chiles, salt, pepper, mozzarella cheese and cilantro. Pour egg mixture evenly into 12 muffin cups.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Top each muffin cup with shredded chicken and bake in the oven for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from oven and let rest for at least 5 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Baked Shrimp Stew in a Mediterranean Chunky Tomato Sauce
description: Easy, comforting shrimp stew, cooked in a Mediterranean-style rustic chunky tomato sauce! Loads of flavor from fresh garlic, onions, bell peppers and warm spices.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek olive oil)
Lemon or lime wedges to serve

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F and position an oven rack in the middle

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large skillet or frying pan, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil until shimmering but not smoking. Add chopped onions, bell peppers, and garlic. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, tossing regularly. Stir in spices and cook another minute or so till fragrant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add diced tomatoes and water. Season with kosher salt and pepper. Bring sauce to a boil, then lower heat and let simmer about 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer sauce to an oven-save dish (unless you are using a large, deep, oven-safe skillet). Stir shrimp well into the sauce. Add parsley, pine nuts, and toasted sesame seeds. Cover with lid (or tightly with foil.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer to heated oven and bake for about 7 to 9 minutes or so (depending on your oven), then uncover and broil very briefly till shrimp is ready (shrimp is ready when it turns from gray to a translucent pink in the thickest parts.)

title: Jamaican Stew Peas
description: This cozy Jamaican stew is a delectable mix of red beans, meat, and special dumplings called spinners. Cook it all up in an aromatic coconut milk broth with Jamaican spices for a hearty island stew!

ingredients.name: (680g) meat ((stew beef, smoked turkey, oxtails, pork tails))
(700g) cooked kidney beans (or two or three 15-ounce cans, rinsed and drained)
(710ml) chicken broth ( or more (vegetable broth works, too))
(60ml) coconut milk (or water (enough to form a soft dough))
¾-1 teaspoons (6g) garlic salt (or plain salt)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season stew beef with salt and pepper to thoroughly cover all sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oil in an oven-safe Dutch oven over medium heat. Add stew beef and turkey sauté (or choice of meat), and sear for 2-3 minutes per side until the beef is slightly browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onions, green onions, garlic, thyme, bay leaf, paprika, and allspice and sauté for 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in coconut milk, broth, and beans, bring to a boil, and let it simmer for 40 minutes or more, depending on your choice of protein. If using a tough cut of meat, you may want to cook it before adding the beans.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the stew is simmering, make the spinners by combining water, flour, and garlic salt in a medium bowl. Knead the dough between 30 seconds and a minute to form a soft dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Divide the dough into 10-14 equal pieces.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Shape the pieces by rolling them with your hands into a log—somewhat like a sausage. Repeat the process until finished. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: About 15 minutes before the stew is ready, gently drop the dumplings into the pot – add more water or coconut milk if needed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let it cook until tender—15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper, and serve piping hot.

title: Potato Wedges (Fried and Baked)
description: These delicious golden brown wedges are perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Prepare them in two ways and add rice flour to make them extra crispy and gluten-free.

garlic cloves (- small to medium, minced or crushed to a paste in mortar-pestle)

olive oil (- can also add 1 tablespoon oil (use olive oil only if baking))
oil ( as required for deep frying, if frying, use any neutral flavored oil like sunflower oil)

title: Haemul Bap (Seafood Rice Bowl)
description: Haemul bap is rice cooked with seafood and served with a sauce. When making rice, simply throw in a few other ingredients while cooking the rice, you can have a filling one-pot meal!

ingredients.name: 1-1/2 cups short grain rice (standard measuring cup not the cup that comes with a rice cooker)
1-1/2 cups water (or dashima broth or other flavorful liquid)
assorted seafood (shrimp, squid, mussels, oysters, clams, etc.)
small carrot, thinly sliced (Vegetables here are guidelines. You can use any vegetables you like. )
or 3 caps shiitake mushrooms (soaked if using dried mushrooms, thinly sliced)
Korean radish (mu, cut into short match sticks)
gochugaru (고추가루), Korean red chili pepper flakes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the rice three times by swishing the rice, draining each time. Soak the rice for 20 to 30 minutes. This soaking process is very important for fluffy rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain to make sure the correct amount of water is used.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Clean the seafood, and drain well. Prepare the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the rice in a heavy bottom pot, and add the water (or flavorful broth). Cover, and bring the rice to a full boil over high heat. This will take 4 to 5 minutes. Then, reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Quickly stir in the vegetables and seafood. Cover, and cook for an additional 7 to 8 minutes. Turn the heat off, and leave the pot covered for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the rice is done, gently fluff up the rice, evenly distributing the seafood and vegetables. Serve with the sauce on the side.

title: Beef Wonton
description: Tender and juicy beef wonton for those who do not like pork that much

ingredients.name: tbsp. chili oil or to taste
a small pinch of white pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak Sichuan peppercorn with boiling hot chicken stock and set aside for 10 minutes. Strain and remove the Sichuan peppercorns.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ground beef in a large bowl with a smaller egg. Mix until the egg is well absorbed. Penetrate the chicken stock with beef by three batches. Each time after adding the stock, use a chopstick to stir it in one direction until all the liquid is absorbed. Continue stirring for couple of minutes after mixing all of the chicken stock until the beef becomes quite sticky and fluffy. Add ginger, scallion white, light soy sauce, salt, sugar, five spice powder and sesame oil. Combine well and keep stirring for couple of minutes. Set aside for 15 minutes to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assemble the wontons one by one.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To boil the wontons, bring a large pot of water to a boiling and then add wonton to cook 2-3 minutes until they floats on the surface. Then add several leafy vegetables, I use asparagus lettuce leaves this time.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix the serving seasonings in bowls and pour in the water for boiling wontons and transfer wontons.

title: Decadent Tofu Chocolate Mousse (but you couldn't tell!)
description: A rich and decadent chocolate mousse that gets its silky texture from soft tofu, but you wouldn't be able to tell! It's easy, healthy, and tastes just like a "regular" chocolate mousse!

ingredients.name: (packed) dark brown sugar or white sugar
For serving: fresh fruit, crumbled cookies, cake cubes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put the chocolate in a heat proof mixing bowl, then set it over a pot of simmering water (the bowl should not touch the water). Let it melt, stirring once or twice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the chocolate is melting, place the tofu, sugar, flavourings or your choice, and salt in a food processor or blender and blitz until smooth, scraping the side once.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the chocolate is melted, turn off the heat but keep the bowl on the pot. Gradually whisk in the tofu mixture until well blended, turning on the heat if the chocolate becomes too stiff and isn't blending smoothly. Taste and adjust the mousse as desired.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the mousse from the pot. Optional step: Using an electric mixer or a stand mixer, beat some air bubbles into the mousse to lighten it up for a few minutes, or longer if you'd like to incorporate more air.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Portion the mousse out into serving dishes then chill until ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Top the mousse with fresh fruit, crumbled cookies, cake cubes, or whatever you like!

title: Taco Pasta
description: This Taco Pasta is a one-pot cheesy weeknight dinner ready in only 40 minutes from start to finish. It's a crowd-pleasing dish that kids love!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, add all the ingredients for the taco seasoning. Mix to combine and set aside. (Alternatively, you can substitute the homemade mix with 1 packet of store-bought taco seasoning if you prefer.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add olive oil and onions and cook for about 5 minutes until onions have softened and are translucent.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add ground meat, break up with a spatula and cook until no longer pink and fully cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add diced tomatoes and taco seasoning. Stir to combine and simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add water and cream cheese. Stir together until the cream cheese has fully melted to create a sauce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add cooked pasta and shredded cheddar cheese. Gently toss to combine until the cheese has fully melted. Taste and season with salt and pepper as necessary. Top with chopped cilantro before serving.

title: Easy Vegan Pumpkin Soup
description: All-star dairy free, gluten free, vegan pumpkin soup with red lentils, garlic and a trio of warm Mediterranean spices--coriander, cumin, and turmeric. Finished with a bright splash of fresh lemon juice. Ready in 30 minutes!

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek olive oil)
pine nuts, toasted in olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If using, make the zhoug spicy cilantro pesto according to this recipe. Set aside for now or refrigerate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a 5-quart heavy pot or Dutch oven like this one, heat 2 extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the onions and cook until golden and translucent, tossing regularly. Stir in garlic, tomato paste, coriander, cumin, turmeric. Lower heat to medium and cook, stirring regularly, until fragrant (4 minutes or so).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the lentils, pumpkin puree, broth and a little salt. Stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn heat to high and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Then, reduce heat to medium-low, cover only part-way and cook another 20 minutes or until lentils are fully cooked. Occasionally, stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from heat to cool a bit. Carefully, transfer the lentil pumpkin soup to the bowl of a large food processor fitted with a blade. Puree. Return to pot over medium heat to warm through, stirring occasionally (add more liquid here if you need it.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in raisins and fresh lemon juice. Cook another 4 minutes or so, stirring regularly. Taste and adjust salt…add a pinch more if needed. You can also adjust other spices, if you like, carefully add a little more turmeric or coriander (But remember, you’ve made zhoug pesto to add on top, so don’t overdo it)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Divide the lentil pumkin soup into serving bowls. Top each with a teaspoon or so of zhoug spicy cilantro pesto, more raisins, and toasted pine nuts. Garnish with jalapeno slices if you like more heat. Serve hot with a side of warm pita or your favorite crusty bread. Enjoy!

title: Fried Feta with Honey and Sesame Seeds Recipe
description: A delicious fried feta with honey and sesame seeds recipe! This mouthwatering veggie, cheesy dish will amaze you! Imagine chunks of juicy, salty fried feta covered with crispy, golden-brown sesame seeds and drizzled in a sweet honey sauce!
tags: feta cheese with honey and sesame

ingredients.name: 70-80g of flour, enough to coat the feta (3 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the fried feta, start by cutting the feta cheese into little blocks, about 1,5cm thick.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork. Into another bowl add the flour, the paprika and the pepper and mix with a spoon, to combine the ingredients. Into a third bowl, add the sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roll each piece of feta into the eggs, then roll into the flour. Roll each piece again into the eggs and then in the sesame seeds, so that all sides are covered.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat about 6-7 tbsps of olive oil into a frying pan, just enough to cover the bottom of the pan and fry the feta until nicely colored. Use a slotted spoon to flip the fried feta, so that it is nicely colored on all sides. When done, place on some kitchen paper to absorb the extra oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the meantime, warm the honey into a saucepan, or the microwaves, until liquid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve the fried feta while still hot with a drizzle of honey.

title: Trinidad Pelau
description: Trinidad Chicken Pelau- An aromatic caramelized chicken pilaf, all the flavors of the Caribbean but quicker and easier.

ingredients.name: fresh thyme or 1 teaspoon dried thyme
oz. can pigeon beans (rinsed and drained)
or more chicken broth or water
Salt and fresh ground pepper (to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chicken in a large bowl or sauce pan then add salt, garlic, ginger, thyme, and white pepper

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix chicken with a spoon or with hands until they are well coated, set aside in the fridge. If possible marinate for 30 minutes or overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When ready to cook shake off any excess spice or from the chicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wash rice until water runs clear. Drain water. Set aside,

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place a large Dutch Oven or heavy bottom pan on medium heat, then add sugar, keep stirring until it caramelize and begin to turn deep brown. Be careful not to let it burn.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in chicken and sauté for about 3-5 minutes, stirring frequently. I usually reserve some chicken to top the rice but it must be fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Then add onions, garlic, thyme, oil, bay leaf and ketchup, sauté for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Stir in rice to the pan, followed by squash and pigeon peas for about 3 minutes. This process helps to infuse the ingredients with all the spice before the next step

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Finally add coconut milk, bouillon powder, creole spice, paprika,scotch bonnet pepper .with 3 ¼ cups of water, bring to a boil reduce heat, and simmer until rice is cooked, about 20 minutes or more. Stir frequently from the sides to prevent burns, add more broth if needed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Adjust for salt and pepper. Discard bay leaves .You have to stir occasionally to be preventing any burns.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve warm

title: The Best Cantonese Roast Chicken (广式烧鸡)
description: This Cantonese roast chicken tastes even better than one at a good restaurant. The skin is truly crispy and the meat so moist and tender. Want to to cook a perfect Asian style chicken in the oven? Look no further!

ingredients.name: Japanese sake ((or Shaoxing win, or dry sherry))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse chicken with tap water and pat dry with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the chicken to a gallon-sized Ziplock bag, legs up. Add half the marinade into the cavity of the chicken. Pour the rest of the marinade onto the chicken skin. Seal the bag halfway across. Try to squeeze out as much air as possible. Seal the bag. Rub chicken through the bag to make sure the marinade and herbs are evenly dispersed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place chicken in fridge for 24 to 48 hours (*footnote). Flip once during marinating.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: On the day of cooking, place a cooling/roasting rack over a baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the chicken from the bag to a large plate. Discard marinating liquid and all the herbs. Make sure the cavity of the chicken isn’t holding any liquid. Place the chicken onto the roasting rack, breast side up.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the baking sheet near an AC vent or in front of a fan. Let the bird air dry completely. It will take at least 4 hours if you don’t use a fan. To speed up the process, I sometimes use a hair dryer to dry the chicken. You can also place the chicken in the fridge to dry, but it takes longer.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: The surface of the chicken must be completely dry in order to yield crispy skin after baking. When the chicken is ready to bake, the surface won’t be shiny, with almost a leathery feel when touched.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 C).

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Line the baking sheet with aluminum foil to catch the chicken grease. Place the roasting rack on top. Spray a thin layer of oil onto the roasting rack. (*see footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Tie chicken legs together with kitchen twine. Spray a thin layer of oil onto another sheet of aluminum foil. Cut foil into small squares and wrap around the end of the chicken legs and wings tips. (*see footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Bake on the lowest rack in the oven for 30 minutes. Rotate chicken (don’t flip). Bake for another 30 minutes. Rotate again. Continue baking until the thermometer reads 165 F (74C) when probing into the thickest part of the leg. It takes me 1 hour and 30 minutes in total to roast a chicken from Costco (about 5 pounds).

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: During the final hour of baking, check on the chicken every 10 to 20 minutes. When you notice that any part of the chicken is already browned, cover that part with aluminum foil to prevent it from burning. If you think this is too much trouble, you can simply cover the whole chicken with a large piece of foil when most parts are nicely browned.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: When the chicken is cooked through, let cool for 15 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Serve chicken by itself as a main. Or you can serve it with sriracha, plum sauce, or soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: To reheat leftover chicken, my favorite way is to cook it with a bit of oil on the stove top. The chicken will get nicely charred and heat up in a few minutes without drying out (which happens if you reheat it in the oven).
