title: Kataifi Dough Pie with Cheese and Bechamel sauce
description: The most delicious and unique pie, with an amazingly creamy filling, wrapped in crispy golden brown kataifi dough!

ingredients.name: kataifi dough (12 ounces). Variation: Make using 350g of Phyllo dough! See photos below.
250-300g grated cheese, which melt easily (10 ounces)
melted butter, for greasing and buttering (5-6 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a saucepan to medium heat. Add 2 tbsps of olive oil and the chopped onions and sauté the onions for 3 minutes, until softened and slightly colored. Add the garlic, the mushrooms and the bacon, until most of the juices have evaporated and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the bechamel sauce, melt 6 tbsps of butter into a deep pan, over medium heat. Add the flour and whisk to make a paste. Add warmed milk to the mixture in a steady stream, whisking continuously, in order to prevent the sauce from getting lumpy. It is very important to add the milk a little bit at a time, in order for the flour to ‘brake’ and to absorb the milk, forming a smooth cream. If the sauce needs to thicken, boil over low heat, while whisking, for a few more minutes. The bechamel sauce for this recipe, should not be very thick, as it will thicken up when adding the cheese.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove and stir in the cheese. Crack in 2 eggs, 1 tsp of paprika and season to taste. Add the bacon and mushroom mix and blend well with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the kataifi dough from the plastic sleeve. Work the kataifi dough with your hands, tearing apart the shreds and gently spreading the strands out a bit if they clump together, in order to get fluffy.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Melt the butter. Using a pastry brush, butter the bottom and sides of a baking tray (approx. 20*30). Begin by layering evenly the 1/3 of the kataifi dough, sprinkle with some butter, and on top layer 1/3 more of the dough and sprinkle with some melted butter. Tip in the filling, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Layer evenly the remaining kataifi dough on top and try not leave any holes. Gently push the surface with your hands. Brush well the top with the remaining butter. The butter helps the kataifi dough to bake and become golden and crispy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in a preheated oven at 180, for about 75 minutes, until nicely colored. Best serve after half an hour, using a sharp knife.

title: Crispy Olive Oil Fried Brussels Sprouts
description: Crispy olive oil fried brussels sprouts with caramelized onions and garlic. Finish with a sprinkle of freshly grated Parmesan cheese and toasted pine nuts for the perfect side dish! Want to take things up another notch?

ingredients.name: to 5 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided (I used Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil)
Freshly-grated Parmesan cheese, to your liking (I used about 1/4 cup or so)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet, heat 2 tbsp olive oil briefly over medium heat. Add chopped onions and saute until they soft and nicely caramelized (5 to 7 minutes). Add garlic and toss another 30 seconds. Remove onions and garlic to a side plate for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add remaining extra virgin olive oil, and if needed raise heat to medium-high, till oil is shimmering but not smoking. Add brussels sprouts flat-side down first. Cook and do not stir or turn over until bottoms crisp up, turning a nice golden brown or even charred (do this to your liking, I like my brussels sprouts pretty charred.) Turn over on the other side and cook another 5 to 6 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Toss in the cooked onions and garlic. And add a generous sprinkle of kosher salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to a serving dish. Finish with grated Parmesan and toasted pine nuts if using. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Chocolate Cinnamon Rolls
description: These Mexican Chocolate Cinnamon Rolls filled with cocoa powder, brown sugar and cinnamon are a sweet breakfast and brunch treat!

ingredients.name: milk ((or coffee to make a coffee glaze))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the dough: In a small cup, mix a packet of active yeast with 1/2 a cup of warm water. Let sit for 5 minutes. The mixture should start to get foamy, which means the yeast is alive and working. If it doesn’t get foamy, the yeast isn’t activated and you should try again with another packet.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer, add butter, sugar, salt and hot water. Mix together until sugar has mostly dissolved. (If you don’t have a stand mixer, you can stir and knead everything by hand.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add half of the all-purpose flour and mix on low until well combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the yeast mixture, the egg, and half of the remaining flour. Mix on low until well combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using the dough hook, gradually mix in the remaining flour and knead on low for 6 to 8 minutes, until it becomes super smooth and silky. If the dough is sticking to the mixing bowl, add in 1 tablespoon of flour at a time until it no longer sticks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the smooth dough into a large oiled bowl and cover with a towel. Place bowl in a warm spot (like the top of your fridge or in the microwave, wherever is warmest) and let rise for 30 minutes until the dough has almost doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fill and roll the cinnamon rolls: Remove the risen dough from the bowl and place on a lightly floured surface. Roll dough into a large rectangle with a rolling pin. When you're done rolling it, lift the dough carefully your hands and add more flour to your surface to make sure the dough isn’t sticking.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, cinnamon, and cocoa powder. Spread the mixture evenly on the dough, leaving about a 1/2-inch of bare dough on all sides. Top mixture with sliced almonds and finish with butter.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Carefully roll the dough as tightly as possible into one long roll. Cut into 12 rolls using a piece of dental floss, thread, or a sharp serrated knife.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let rise one last time: Place rolls into a greased 3 quart baking dish (or large cake pan) and cover with a towel. Place in a warm spot and let rise for 1 hour. When there’s 5 minutes remaining, preheat oven to 375°F.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Bake: Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the cinnamon rolls are golden brown. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Make the glaze: In a medium bowl, add the powdered sugar, vanilla extract and milk. Whisk together until smooth. Pour the glaze on the rolls and serve.

title: Oven Baked Jerk Chicken
description: Crispy, moist, flavorful chicken smothered in spicy jerk sauce is easy to make and a real taste bud explosion! Enjoy a Caribbean vacation right out of your oven.

ingredients.name: chicken legs (or a 2½-3 pound (1-1.5k) chicken, cut up)
(8-9g) jerk seasoning (replace with salt and pepper or chicken spice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim chicken of excess fat and pat dry with a cloth or paper towel. Rub with lemon, 2 teaspoons jerk seasoning, and salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a skillet or sauté pan over medium heat. Then add scotch bonnet pepper and garlic, and sauté until browned, 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the nutmeg, brown sugar, allspice, and cinnamon, and continue stirring until the sugar melts and the mixture starts to clump together.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from the heat and let it cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the mixture in a food processor or blender, add the thyme, white pepper, ginger, green onions, soy sauce, bouillon powder, onion, and pineapple juice, and pulse for about 30 seconds until well blended.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drench the chicken with jerk marinate, place in a ziplock bag, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight. Avoid touching the jerk blend with your hands because it's extremely spicy hot (use gloves if possible).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ready to bake, preheat oven to 425℉ (220℃). Remove the chicken from the jerk marinade and drain the excess marinade. Reserve the marinade.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Line a baking pan with foil, and top with a wire rack. Arrange chicken legs in a single layer. While the chicken legs are baking, the fat will slowly drip to the bottom of the baking pan.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake chicken legs until cooked through and the skin is crispy, 45-50 minutes. Rotate the chicken halfway through, roughly 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: In a small saucepan, simmer the remaining jerk marinade along with the extra from the chicken for about 7 minutes. Serve the chicken with the marinade on the side or drizzle it on the chicken, and serve with Caribbean rice and beans.

title: Easy Kung Pao Chicken
description: A quick and easy kung pao chicken that only requires 20 minutes to prepare. Use this method and you’ll always create moist and tender chicken with no fuss!

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut and prepare the rest of the veggies.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the same nonstick skillet again, over medium high heat. If there is not enough oil to cover the bottom of the skillet, add a bit more. When the oil is hot, spread the chicken across the skillet without overlapping the . Let it cook without stirring for 20 seconds. Flip to cook the other side for another 20 seconds. Stir a few times until all surfaces are cooked and slightly browned, but the inside is still raw.

steps.title: Step 6

Immediately stir a few times to mix well until the sauce thickens, 20 seconds. Stop heat. Add peanuts and cucumber. Give it one last stir to mix well. Transfer everything to a plate.

(half a pound) short tube pasta (see note)

Green onions, halve the white part horizontally, then cut into 2-inch pieces

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a pot of water for cooking the pasta over high heat. Add salt (1 teaspoon for every 1 litre of water) and stir to dissolve. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While you wait for the water to boil, mix together ketchup, sriracha, Golden Mountain sauce, sugar and white pepper, stir to mix well. Prep all other ingredients and have them ready to go before you cook the pasta.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When all your ingredients are ready, drop the pasta into the boiling water. Set the timer for however long your particular pasta needs to cook. (Mine took 8 minutes, but this will vary depending on the shape of the pasta, so check the package.) Start the wok as soon as your pasta goes in the water and the timing will work perfectly!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a wok, add a little vegetable oil just to coat the bottom and heat over medium high heat. Add shrimp, sear until they are browned on one side, flip them and cook the other side until done. Remove from pan and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Let the pan cool down a little bit. Add a little more vegetable oil, butter, and garlic and turn the heat back on to medium. Saute the garlic until the butter browns slightly. Add onions and carrots and cook, stirring, constantly, for 1 minute if you like your carrot and onion still crunchy; if you like them soft, cook them longer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Push the carrots and onions aside, then add the eggs to the empty space. Break the yolk and stir the yolks to mix with the whites just slightly, to create a marbling effect. Let the eggs set about 70%, then toss it with the carrots and onions. The next thing to add is the pasta, and your pasta should be a few minutes from being done at this point, so turn off the wok, and wait till pasta is done. (If you're taking a little longer and your pasta is done before you're ready to add it, don't panic! Just turn off the wok, go drain the pasta and come back to the wok and carry on. It'll be fine.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the pasta is done, drain, shaking the colander well to make sure no pasta water is lodged inside the pasta tubes. Add pasta to the wok, add the sauce, turn the heat back on to medium high and toss until the pasta is coated in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Vegetarian Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
description: Mediterranean-style stuffed cabbage rolls with a vegetarian rice filling, packed with fresh herbs, tomatoes, onions and spices. Be sure to watch the video just above and review the step-by-step photos.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil (see our Greek olive oil option here)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove and discard the first couple leaves of cabbage. Wash in cold water. Cut approx 1/4″ off the bottom of the head and place the whole head of cabbage in boiling water. Boil about 2 minutes. Peel off the softened leaves, using a pair of tongs. Continue the same process, peeling off the blanched layers of cabbage leaves as they soften. Set aside to cool briefly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once cooled, cut each cabbage leaf into halves or thirds, removing any thick veins.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now prepare the rice stuffing mixture. In a large mixing bowl, combine the rice, shredded onions, chopped tomato, herbs, salt and pepper, spices, oil, 1/2 can of tomato sauce and 1/4 cup water. Mix together with a spoon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lightly oil a large Dutch oven or heavy cooking pot. Line the bottom with the sliced onions and sliced tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take a piece of cabbage and place on a flat surface, coarse side up. Add 1 tsp (more if leaves are larger) of the rice stuffing mixture at the end of the leaf closest to you (see photo). Roll up the leaf to completely enclose the stuffing. Repeat with the remaining cabbage.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Layer the cabbage rolls, seam-side down, in the prepared Dutch oven/pot. Top with the remaining 1/2 can of tomato sauce, and about 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 cups of water (water should barely reach the top layer of cabbage rolls). Add a pinch more ground cumin.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Top the cabbage rolls with a small plate. Cook on high heat for 5-7 minutes until the liquid reduces to half. Reduce the heat to low. Leaving the small plate in, and cover the pot with its own lid. Cook for 30 minutes, then remove the plate but cover with the lid only. Cook for another 15 minutes or until the liquid has been completely absorbed and the rice stuffing mixture is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: If you’re not in a hurry, leave the cabbage rolls undisturbed before transferring to a serving platter or individual plates. Enjoy!

description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Jasmine rice and sriracha hot sauce (optional) for serving

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Beat the eggs, fish sauce, oyster sauce and white pepper until well combined. Add ground pork and beat until there are no more big clumps of pork. Stir in green onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a small 8-inch non-stick saute pan or a wok over medium heat and add enough vegetable oil to generously coat the bottom. Wait for the oil to be quite hot, you can test by dropping a little bit of egg into the oil and it should puff and sizzle immediately. Pour in the eggs all at once (it should sizzle), then quickly stir the egg for a few seconds to distribute the first bit of cooked egg. As the bottom starts to firm up, lift one side of the omelette and tilt the pan to allow the liquid egg on top to flow to the bottom; repeat a couple of times. Let the omelette cook until the bottom is golden brown and the top is set enough to flip. Keep checking the colour, if the omelette is browning too fast, turn the heat down a bit.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the top is set enough to flip, flip the omelette and continue cooking the other side just for 15-20 seconds just to cook it through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve with hot jasmine rice and sriracha hot sauce!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Mexican Brussels Sprout Salad
description: This Mexican Brussels Sprout Salad is made with grilled corn, brussels sprouts, feta cheese, radishes, and a lime vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: medium ears of corn, (husks and silk removed)
freshly ground black pepper (plus more to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a grill or grill-pan over high heat. Brush ears of corn with olive oil on all sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add corn and cook for 6-10 minutes, turning every minute or so, until corn is cooked through and lightly charred in spots. Remove from grill and set aside for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When cool enough to handle, slice the kernels off the cob and transfer them to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the brussel sprouts, feta cheese, cilantro, radishes to the bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a small jar or bowl, add the lime juice, lime zest, olive oil, white wine vinegar, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix together or whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the dressing on top of the brussel sprout salad and toss together until everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Mediterranan-Style Homemade Salsa Recipe
description: Easy homemade salsa recipe with a Mediterranean twist! Fresh tomato salsa made with sweet cherry tomatoes, shallots, garlic and loads of fresh herbs. Olives and jalapeno are optional, but highly recommended.

ingredients.name: jalapeno pepper, (finely chopped (optional if you want to add spice))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place quartered cherry tomatoes, chopped shallots, minced garlic, chopped fresh herbs, chopped kalamata olives (if using), and chopped jalapeno (if using) in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season with kosher shalt, pepper, and sumac (start with a heaping 1/2 tsp sumac, add more late if needed). Toss gently.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add lemon juice and a generous drizzle of quality extra virgin olive oil (I used Early Harvest EVOO). Toss to combine. Set aside for a few minutes to let the flavors marry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve with pita chips or chips of your choice. Enjoy!

title: Jerk Chicken Salad
description: A classic summer meal that is fresh and filling all at the same time. Juicy, perfectly spiced grilled chicken, a refreshing combination of fruit and vegetables, and a tangy lime vinaigrette create a trifecta of flavors that just can’t be…

ingredients.name: mixed salad greens, (washed and patted dry)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chicken breasts on a plate, season with salt, and then with jerk seasoning. Set aside and let it marinate for 1-2 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat a grill on medium-high heat, spray with cooking spray to coat the bottom of the grill.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the grill is heated, place chicken breasts onto the grill for 5-7 minutes. Flip the chicken, and grill for another 5-7 minutes or until they reach an internal temperature of 165℉/74℃ and juices run clear. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the pineapple, mango, red onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, cucumbers, and cilantro. Place in a bowl and toss together. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a medium-sized mixing bowl, place all the ingredients to make the vinaigrette: olive oil, lime juice, lime zest, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper. Whisk together until fully combined. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place mixed salad greens in a serving plate, top with fruit and veggie mixture, sliced avocado, and finally, top with the sliced chicken breast.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drizzle with salad with vinaigrette dressing, garnish with more cilantro, and serve.

title: Poha Idli (Flattened Rice Idli)
description: Amazingly soft, light and fluffy aval idli made with poha (flattened rice), idli rice and urad dal.

ingredients.name: idli dosa rice or parboiled rice (or 200 grams idli dosa rice)
thick poha (or 80 grams thick poha (parched rice or aval))
whole urad dal ((husked whole black gram) or 40 grams whole urad dal (you can also use husked split urad dal),)
oil for greasing the idli moulds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: soaking

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: grinding poha idli batter

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: fermenting poha idli batter

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: making poha idli

title: Chinese Chicken Stock From Leftover Bones (高汤)
description: Chicken stock is one of the essential ingredients in Chinese cooking. It uses a minimal amount of fresh herbs, such as ginger and scallion, to bring out the flavor of the chicken without adding too much character to the stock.

ingredients.name: gallon (4 kg) leftover poultry bones ((chicken, turkey, and/or duck))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degree F (200 C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spread the poultry bones on a large baking pan. Drizzle with the vegetable oil. Toss with a spatula until the bones are evenly coated with oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bake until the bones are nicely charred, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove baking pan from oven and stir the bones once in the middle of roasting.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer all the bones to a large pot. Pour hot water onto the baking pan. Use a spatula to scrape off the brown bits and pour the liquid and brown bits into the pot. Add water to cover bones by 1 inch.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat over medium high heat until boiling. Add leek and ginger. Cover, turn to medium low heat, and boil until the meat starts to fall off the bones, 3 to 4 hours. If there is still a lot of liquid left, turn to medium heat and boil, uncovered, until only 4 cups of broth remain. The stock will have turned an opaque light brown color by this point.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove and discard all the solid content and drain the soup. Store in airtight container(s) in the fridge for up to 2 weeks or in the freezer for up to 3 months.

title: Greek-style Olive Oil Brownies
description: Soft, moist and extra fudgy with a shiny slightly crackled crust..These olive oil brownies are very addictive! A delicious and much healthier

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these olive oil brownies, break the eggs into a large bowl and add the sugar. Whisk with an electric mixer at high speed, until the mixture is thick, foamy and doubles it’s original volume. This should take about 5 minutes and should have stiff peaks forming.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime melt the chocolate. To melt the chocolate it is best to use a bain-marie (or double boiler), a piece of equipment used to heat the chocolate gently and gradually to fixed temperatures so that it doesn’t burn. If you don’t have a Bain-marie, break the chocolate into small pieces and drop into a heatproof bowl. Set the bowl over a small saucepan about a quarter full with hot water and place the bowl on top so that it rests on the rim of the pan (the bowl should not to touch the water). Place the pan, with the bowl on top, over low heat until the chocolate has melted, whilst stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove and stir in the extra virgin olive oil, the egg-sugar mixture and the chopped walnuts. Blend with a spatula with light circular movements from the bottom up. Sieve the flour over the bowl a little bit at a time and blend, folding gently the mixture with circular movements from the bottom up, until the ingredients combine. You don’t want to overwork the mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Line one round baking tin (approx. 18cm/7 inches ) with parchment paper and tip in the mixture in an even layer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake these olive oil brownies in a preheated oven to 160C 25-30 minutes, until they have formed a shiny and dry slightly cracked layer but are still moist underneath.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve these delicious olive oil brownies with a full spoon of vanilla ice-cream on top. Enjoy!!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: These olive oil brownies are very addictive, so in the highly impossible case that you do have some leftovers.. keep them in an airtight container at room-temperature for 1-2 weeks.

title: Oi Naengguk (Chilled Cucumber Soup)
description: Oi naengguk is a classic chilled soup made with cucumber and seaweed (miyeok). It’s a refreshing, tangy soup that’s perfect for hot summer days!

ingredients.name: Korean cucumber or 2 Kirby (pickling) cucumbers ((5 – 6 ounces))
soaked miyeok, 미역 (seaweed – about 1/2 ounce dried miyeok)
Korean green or red chili pepper or scallion

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the cucumber into matchsticks. Finely chop the chili pepper (or scallion).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the dried seaweed by soaking for 10 to 20 minutes and rinsing well. (See my miyeok guk recipe for more.) Boil water in a small pot, and add 1 teaspoon of salt. Blanch the soaked seaweed briefly, 20 to 30 seconds. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain again, squeeze out excess water, and cut into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium size bowl, gently toss the vegetables with the seasoning ingredients. Set aside for about 10 minutes. You can make ahead up to this point several hours or a day before, if desired.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix in 4 cups of cold water and season with salt. Start with a half teaspoon of salt, taste and add more if necessary. Refrigerate to chill. Serve in chilled bowls with some ice cubes.

title: Chayote & Apple Salad ตำฟักแม้ว tum fakmeaw
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: dried shrimp, roughly chopped if large
cashews, roasted, plus extra for garnish
small tomato, cut into off-set wedges (see video)
firm, crunchy apple (preferably with red skin for a nice colour contrast with the chayote)
green onion, sliced on a bias

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice up half of the apple thinly lengthwise and arrange them on a serving plate as shown in the video (if there isn't enough to go around the plate, you can slice more). Brush the apples on the plate with a little of the lime juice. Cut the remaining apples into matchsticks and toss in a bit of the lime juice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound garlic and chilies into a rough paste. Add palm sugar and pound until it is moistened and starts to dissolve. Add dried shrimp and pound just to crush. Add ¼ cup of cashews and pound until broken into small pieces. Add the remaining lime juice, fish sauce and stir to mix. Add tomato slices and crush lightly with the pestle to release the juice. Add chayote, matchstick apples, carrots, and most of the green onions; toss with a spoon until combined. Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the salad on top of the arranged apple (you may not be able to fit it all on top, so reserve the rest for refill) and sprinkle extra cashews and the remaining green onions on top. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Spicy Chex Mix Recipe
description: This Chex Mix recipe is easy to make and brings together all the crunchy, salty and delicious buttery flavors with a hint of smoky spicy goodness! It's the perfect snack for sharing!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 250ºF. In large bowl, add the corn, rice, and wheat chex cereals, mixed nuts, mini pretzels and bagel chips. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the butter in a small microwave-safe bowl and microwave on high for 30 seconds to 1 minute, until the butter completely melts. Add the Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, onion powder, chili powder, paprika and cayenne. Whisk together until combined. Pour the butter over the cereal mixture,

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the butter sauce over the cereal mixture and toss together until everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Spread the chex mix onto a large rimmed baking sheet and bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes to make sure everything crisps up evenly. Let cool slightly before eating.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Farro Salad with Shrimp
description: Bright, flavor-packed Mediterranean chickpea and farro salad with fresh veggies, herbs and a zippy citrus and olive oil dressing. You can add shrimp as instructed here or serve vegan. Lemon chicken is another great option to add.

ingredients.name: cup/345 g cooked farro (you’ll start with 1 cup dry and cook according to package, see recipe notes)
cups/330 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed (canned chickpeas are fine)
oz/283.495 g cherry tomatoes, halved (I used different color tomatoes)
green onions, trimmed and chopped (both white and green parts)
lb/453.592 g large shrimp, peeled and deviened
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Greek Early Harvest)
tbsp/ approx 75 ml extra virgin olive oil (I used Greek Early Harvest)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl or mason jar, add the dressing ingredients (lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, oregano, cumin, and sumac.) Whisk well, or close the mason jar and shake until well-combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large salad bowl, combine cooked farro with the chickpeas and remaining salad ingredients (cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, green onion, parsley, and mint leaves).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the majority of the dressing on top of the salad, toss to combine (leave a bit of the dressing, like 3 tbsp or so for the shrimp.) Set aside to allow flavors to meld.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To make the shrimp. Place uncooked shrimp in a bowl, pat dry with some paper towels. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle extra virgin olive oil and toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a skillet or griddle over high heat. Add shrimp and cook on one side till it starts to turn pink, turn over and cook on both sides (4 to 5 minutes in total.) Turn heat off and add the remaining 3 tbsp of dressing to the hot shrimp, toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To serve, transfer the farro salad to a serving platter or individual serving bowls. Add shrimp on top.

title: Jamaican Cornmeal Porridge
description: Tired of the same old oatmeal for breakfast? Mix things up with this warming cornmeal porridge instead! Infused with Caribbean spices and coconut milk, this Jamaican cornmeal porridge recipe is a thoroughly comforting breakfast.

ingredients.name: optional sweeteners ((sugar, honey, coconut sugar, brown sugar, etc.))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 2 cups water and 2 cups coconut milk to a large, heavy-bottomed saucepan. Throw in ½ stick cinnamon stick, and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Gradually whisk in the cornmeal until you have added the whole thing to the pot, a little bit at a time, and keep stirring with a wooden spoon to prevent lumps.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce the heat to low and cook until the mixture thickens, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vanilla extract, nutmeg, and sweetened condensed milk.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Adjust consistency with coconut or water if desired.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn off the heat. Serve piping hot with extra nutmeg and optional sweeteners.

title: Til Ke Laddu | Sesame Laddu (With Jaggery)
description: Til Ke Laddu or Sesame Laddu is a traditional Indian sweet made with sesame seeds, jaggery, peanuts and desiccated coconut. These nutty laddus are naturally vegan and are especially prepared during the Makar Sankranti festival.

ingredients.name: white sesame seeds (- 50 grams, unhulled or hulled)
water (or oil - a bit for greasing the palms)

steps.description: Roasting ingredients

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making jaggery syrup

title: Fluffy Homemade Burger Buns!
description: These lovely homemade burger buns will definitely become the talk of your next meal!

ingredients.name: olive oil (1/3 of a cup and 1 tbsp)
2-3 tbsps sesame seeds (optional, but recommended for a lovely nutty crunch)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these amazingly fluffy homemade burger buns start by adding the flour into a large bowl. Using your hands make a dimple in the middle and add in the salt, sugar and olive oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using your hands, dissolve the yeast into half a cup of lukewarm water and pour into the flour mixture.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix and knead all of the dough ingredients by hand, mixer, or bread machine, whilst adding gradually the rest of the lukewarm water, until the dough is soft and smooth. If the dough is too sticky add a little bit more flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the dough with a towel and let it rest in a warm place, until it doubles in size for about 1 to 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once risen, gently deflate the dough, divide into 6-7 portions and shape each piece into a round ball. Place the burger buns on a large baking tray lined with baking sheet. Gently push with your hands to flatten them just a little, drizzle with some water and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake the burger buns in a preheated oven at 180C for about 25-30 minutes until golden and crispy on the outside and cooked throughout.

title: Mom’s Best Braised Duck Leg
description: Mom’s best braised duck leg is a traditional family cooked dish. The moist and tender duck is cooked in a rich, savory broth with fresh herbs. It’s comforting and soothing.

ingredients.name: kilograms (4.5 pounds) duck legs with thigh

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Separate the thigh from the drumsticks. Continue chopping each into 4 to 5 parts.(*see footnote)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pot, add duck and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn to medium heat and boil for 3 minutes. During boiling, use a ladle to skim any foam from the surface, and discard it. Transfer the duck legs to a large colander and drain them. Discard boiling water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring 4 cups water to a boil and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a wok (or a large dutch oven) over medium high heat until hot. Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom of wok. Turn to low heat. Add Sichuan peppercorn and fry until fragrant, about 1 minute. Use a ladle to scoop out peppercorns and discard them. Add scallion and ginger and stir a few times until fragrant. Turn back to medium high heat. Carefully add duck legs back into the wok and stir immediately. Stir until duck is slightly browned on the outside, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add boiled water to cover the duck legs. Add shaoxing wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar. After bringing to a boil, turn to low heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Add salt and stir well. If the broth has reduced and no longer covers the duck, add more boiling water (about 1 cup). Simmer for another 30 minutes, covered. During simmering, check on the duck every 15 minutes. Use a spatula to scoop the duck from bottom to prevent burning. Add more water if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: The duck should turn very soft after 1 hour. The broth should be reduced to a thick sauce, just enough to coat the duck. If the sauce is still too thin, turn to medium heat and boil uncovered to thicken the sauce. Stir the duck constantly during the process.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve the duck leg warm over steamed rice or noodles. You can store duck leg in the fridge for up to 1 week or in the freezer for up to 1 month.

title: Jjapaguri with Steak from Movie Parasite
description: This instant noodle dish, called Jjapaguri (or ram-don), from the movie Parasite is getting highly popular all over the world. It's easy to make at home and quite delicious!

ingredients.name: tender beef (such as sirloin, ribeye, NY strip)
olive oil or other cooking oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into bite size pieces and generously sprinkle with salt and pepper. At this point, start boiling 4 cups of water in a medium size pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a pan with a tablespoon of olive oil or other cooking oil. Add the meat, and cook until the bottoms are nicely seared. Turn them over, and add the optional garlic. Cook/brown all sides to the slightly less than desired doneness.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When water boils, add the noodles and the vegetable mix from the packets and continue boiling for about 3 minutes. The noodles should be al dente at this point because they will be cooked again.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the noodles with a strainer to the pan with the steak, reserving the water. Pour a cup of the reserved water over the noodles. Turn the heat to medium. Add the entire packet of the Chapagetti sauce and ⅗ of the Neoguri sauce (or to taste).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir everything well until the sauce is evenly distributed and slightly thickens, about a minute. Add more reserved water if needed. Turn the heat off.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the oil from Chapagetti. Serve with pickled radish or kimchi.

title: "Singapore Cookies" - Sesame Cookies with Cashews
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: (¼ cup + 1 Tbsp) toasted black sesame seeds (for white cookies, use toasted white sesame seeds or roasted cashews)
vegetable oil or any other neutral-flavoured oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and set the rack to the middle position. (I recommend using an oven thermometer to make sure your oven is accurate.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry saute pan over medium heat, stirring constantly. Listen for the popping. Once the popping is fast and quite aggressive, let them continue to pop for another 15 seconds and remove from heat. To check that they're sufficiently toasted, look at the seeds whose black skins have split open, if the white seed inside has browned, they are done. Grind the sesame seeds using a coffee grinder by pulsing and shaking the grinder frequently until they are finely ground. Be careful not to over grind them as they will start releasing the oil and become wet and clumpy (and eventually it will turn into tahini!).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Whisk together flour, tapioca starch, salt and ground sesame seeds until combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a stand mixer with the paddle attachment or a hand mixer, beat the butter on lowest speed for a few seconds just to break it up.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add icing sugar and oil and beat on lowest speed just until combined, scraping the bottom once.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add half the dry ingredients and beat until mostly mixed, then add the other half and beat until the mixture looks homogenous, scraping the bottom once halfway through. The dough will be crumbly, this is fine.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer to a clean work surface and squeeze it together to form a smooth dough. If the dough seems too dry and won't form a smooth dough, you can put it back into the mixer and beat in a little more oil, 1 teaspoon at a time, to moisten it.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Use a rolling pin to smash it out into a 1-cm thick sheet. Knead the edges to smooth out and seal the cracks. Gently roll the dough with a rolling pin to smooth out the surface. Cut out cookies with small cookie cutters and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet, about 1-inch apart. Knead the remaining dough together then roll out and cut out more cookies. Repeat until you have no more dough left.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Brush tops of cookies with a beaten egg yolk. Place one half of a cashew on top, then brush the cashew with more egg yolk.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake the cookies for 20-25 mins until the bottoms are light golden brown. If you have more than one cookie sheets, I find the cookies cook most evenly if you bake one sheet at a time. If you’re going to bake 2 sheets at once, switch their positions halfway through the baking process.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Let cool before serving and store in an airtight container to keep them fresh.

title: Mexican Omelet
description: A quick and easy Mexican omelet packed with beans, peppers, corn, tomatoes, and onions, then topped with salsa, sour cream, and avocado.

ingredients.name: jalapeño pepper (diced (seeds removed if you don’t want it spicy))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add onions, jalapeno, and garlic. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions begin to soften.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add corn, black beans, tomatoes, oregano, cumin, and a pinch of salt. Cook for 3 more minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer filling to a medium bowl, cover, and set aside. Wipe down the skillet with a paper towel to clean.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil in the over medium heat. Pour in the whisked eggs, season with a pinch of salt, and cook for 2-3 minutes until the eggs have just set. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the shredded cheese and the corn and bean filling mixture to the middle of the cooked eggs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully fold the omelet over on both sides using a spatula, transfer it to a plate, and top with sour cream, chunky salsa, avocado, and cilantro. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean-Style Steamed Salmon with Lemon and Fresh Herbs
description: This Mediterranean-style steamed salmon with garlic, lemon and fresh herbs is the perfect quick dinner! You get spectacular results--perfectly cooked salmon that is tender, moist, and flavor-packed--with very little effort.

ingredients.name: green onions (spring onions), trimmed and sliced lengthwise, divided
skin-on salmon fillet (such as wild Alaskan), cut into 4 portions
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO)
A large handful fresh parsley (about 28 g)
white wine (or you can use water or low-sodium broth, if you prefer)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut a large piece of wax paper or parchment (about 2 feet long) and place it right in the center of a 10-inch deep pan or braiser (like this one)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the sliced yellow onions and some of the green onions the onions on the bottom of your braiser that’s been lined with parchment. Arrange salmon, skin-side down, on top. Season with kosher salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix together the coriander, cumin, and Aleppo pepper. Coat top of salmon with the spice mixture. Drizzle with a little bit of extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add garlic, parsley and the remaining green onions on top of the salmon (arrange so that everything is spread evenly over the salmon portions.) Arrange lemon slices on top.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add another drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, then pour the white wine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now, fold the parchment paper over to cover salmon and secure the edges. Cover the braiser with its lid as well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place over medium-high heat and cook for 5 minutes (do NOT uncover.) Lower heat to medium and cook for another 8 minutes or so, covered still.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from heat and let rest undisturbed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove lid and serve directly from pan/braiser.

title: Sweet and Sour Tofu
description: This lovely sweet and sour crispy tofu is paying all the work off. It tastes lightly sweet and sour but within a slightly crispy taste on the near surface of the tofu pieces.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Firstly, mix all the ingredients for sweet and sour sauce together.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut firm tofu into small cubes. Place around 1/2 cup of oil in a small pan. Place the tofu cubes in. Start the fire and fry them ( by two batches if necessary). During the process, stir them from time to time so they can be heated evenly. Transfer out when they are all golden brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove extra oil and leave only around 1 tablespoon in the pan, fry garlic, scallion white and ginger over slow fire until aromatic. Pour the sweet and sour sauce mix in, heat to boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the tofu cubes and continue heating over slow fire until the sauce is well-thickened and sticky to the tofu cubes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garlic some spring onions and serve with steamed rice.

title: Stir-fried Beef with Green Peppers
description: Quick beef stir fry with green peppers. Only 15 minutes are required.

ingredients.name: long fresh green chili pepper and one long fresh red chili pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Shred beef and then put in a bowl. Then add cooking wine, cornstarch, salt, sliced ginger and black pepper powder into a bowl. Mix together and put aside for about 10 minutes. This step is to soak the flavor into the beef meat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash the green peppers and red pepper, remove the seeds then cut into shreds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok or pan, and then add garlic, ginger and scallions white to stir-fry until smelling the aroma, put beef shreds in. Stir-fry with high fire to soft and darkened color.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up some oil in wok again, put in pepper shreds to stir-fry until soft. Add cooked beef meat and continue stir-fry for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add light soy sauce, salt; Mix all the seasoning thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare a plate, layer cooked rice below and cover stir-fried on top.

title: Jamaican Pigeon Peas and Rice
description: Plump pigeon peas, sweet corn, and traditional Jamaican spices simmered in creamy coconut milk. Simply delicious!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash rice until water runs clear. Drain water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a saucepan with oil. Then add onions, green onions, bell pepper, garlic, smoked paprika, thyme, scotch bonnet pepper, and sauté for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the rice, followed by pigeon peas and corn. Sauté for another minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in coconut milk, bouillon powder, and Creole spice with about 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover with a lid, and simmer until rice is cooked, about 18 minutes. Stir occasionally from the sides to prevent burns; add more water if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Adjust for salt and pepper.

title: Crispy Greek Chicken Casserole with Creamy Lemon Sauce
description: Nothing better than some juicy, tender, fall off the bone chicken! Serve Greek chicken casserole with some crusty sourdough bread to mop up all that delicious sauce!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek chicken casserole recipe, divide the chicken into 8 portions (leave the skin on), rinse and pat dry using a paper towel. Heat a large pan on medium high heat; add the olive oil and the chicken and sauté for 2-3 minutes on each side, until slightly coloured.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a small bowl add a glass of hot water, the mustard and the lemon juice and mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour into the pan along with the rest of the ingredients, put the lid on and turn the heat up. As soon as it comes to a boil turn the heat down and simmer for 50-60 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Traditionally Greek chicken casserole is cooked without colouring, and looks more like boiled chicken. Personally I prefer it crispy. if you do too, after cooking the chicken, transfer into a hot pan and fry each side, just a little bit for that crispy skin flavour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with some basmati rice or potatoes. If you choose to serve with rice, lift up the flavor by adding 2-3 tbsps of the chicken juices into the boiling rice.

title: Sticky Rice Cake with Red Bean Paste
description: Sticky rice cake is crispy on the outside with a gooey texture inside. You will smell the toasted sesame seeds from afar. The first bite of the slightly spongy and pleasantly fragrant rice cake has such a delightful mouthfeel.

ingredients.name: (9 ounces) glutinous rice flour and extra flour to dust working surface

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add sweet rice flour into a large bowl. Measure out 1 cup of water (You will use slightly less than a cup). Slowly add water into the flour in 4 to 5 pours, and stir with a fork until the water is fully incorporated with the flour. There should be no dry flour left, and the flour should start to have the texture of dough - soft but not runny. If the dough gets too soft and becomes difficult to shape, add more rice flour, a tablespoon at a time. Use your hand to press and knead the dough a few times, until the texture becomes consistent (* see footnote). The dough should be soft and easy to shape. When you lift the dough from the bowl, it should slightly stick to the bottom of the bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dust a working surface with rice flour and transfer the dough onto it. Divide the dough in half. Roll the dough with both hands to shape it into a long, even rod. Divide the dough equally into 6 pieces. Shape each piece into a round ball and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To make the cake, place one rice dough ball in your palm and use the other hand to gently press it into a round, flat piece (it’s very easy to shape, so you won’t need a rolling pin), about 6 centimeters (2.5 inches) in diameter, 6 millimeters (1/4 inch) in thickness.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Scoop about 2 tablespoons of red bean paste and shape the paste into a ball. Place the ball of bean paste in the center of the round dough. Pinch the edges of the dough together to completely enclose the bean paste. When the cake is shaped like a ball, gently use your palm to press it, until it is shaped like a pancake, about 6 centimeters (2.5 inches) in diameter and 1.2 centimeters (1/2 inches) in thickness. Spread 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds onto the working surface, place the cake on top of them, and gently press. Shake off the extra sesame seeds, flip the cake, and press the other side onto the seeds. Craft the rest of the cakes in the same manner.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil a non-stick skillet over medium heat. When the oil is hot, turn to medium low heat and place 4 cakes into the skillet. Cook until the bottom of the cake turns golden brown, after 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook the other side. Transfer the cakes to a large plate to cool. Cook the rest of the cakes in the same manner.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve the rice cakes warm.

steps.description: Prepare the vegetables. Mix the sauce ingredients for each sauce.

steps.title: Step 2

title: Thai Beef Stew เนื้อตุ๋น
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: (1½ lb) beef "digital muscle" (see note) or other stew-friendly beef such as shank, round or chuck, cut into 1-inch thick pieces.
black soy sauce (confused by all these sauces? See this video!)
dark brown sugar, palm sugar is okay too
Optional herbs and spices you can also add: lemongrass tops, white cardamom pods, dried goji berries, Sichuan peppercorns
4-inch piece daikon, cut into 1-inch slices (I didn't use this in the video, but it's a nice addition if you have it)
Optional condiments: Chili vinegar (any kinds of chilies soaked in 5% white vinegar for at least 15 minutes before using). Fried garlic is great on this too!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle salt over the beef on both sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pot, add a little bit of oil to coat the bottom and heat over medium high heat. Add beef and sear without stirring until well-browned. Do not crowd the pan; you will have to do this in batches. Flip and sear the other side.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once you're done, pour off excess oil but leave the browned bits in the pot; however, if you've burned these bits and they've turned black, scrub them off before proceeding. Browned bits give a nice flavour, but burned bits do not!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return all beef to the pot, cover with beef stock and add soy sauce, Golden Mountain sauce, oyster sauce, black soy sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to mix and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the beef is coming to a simmer, make your spice bag: In a muslin "soup bag" or on a square piece of cheesecloth, place all the dry spices and herbs inside and close the bag, or if using cheesecloth tie the corners together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If you notice any foam on top of the stew at this point, skim it off before adding the spice bag. Add the spice bag and push it in until it is submerged.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add onion, garlic, shiitake mushrooms and daikon (if using), then cover the pot and simmer over low heat for 3 hours or until the meat is fork tender.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: After 3 hours, remove the spice bag then taste and adjust seasoning with more salt or sugar as needed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Top with chopped cilantro and/or green onions, and drizzle with a little chili vinegar if desired.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve with rice or pour over noodles to make a delicious noodle soup!

title: General Tso Chicken
description: One of the most famous Chinese-American Chicken dish named after General Tso.

ingredients.name: ~5 boneless chicken thighs ( , around 1 pound; cut into 2 cm cubes)
dried chili pepper ( , cut into small section)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the bones out and the meat of chicken thighs into small cubes around 2 cm long. And then marinade with salt, light soy sauce, cooking wine and egg whites. Put aside for around 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine light soy sauce, sugar, cooking wine, chili oil and salt to make the stir-frying sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl, add 2 teaspoons of corn starch and 2 teaspoons of water. Mix well to make water starch.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Coat the chicken cubes with cornstarch just before the frying process.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat up the oil in wok and deep-fry the chicken cubes until golden brown. Transfer the chicken out and heat the oil again. Then return the fried chicken cubes and fry them once again for no more than 15 seconds. Transfer out and set aside. Meanwhile pour the extra oil out and leave around 1 tablespoon in wok.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add chili pepper in wok, stir fry until the color turns darker over middle fire. Return fire chicken cubes in with chopped ginger and garlic. Fry over high fire for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir in stir fry sauce in and mix evenly. Pour water starch and sesame oil. Mix thoroughly and move out immediately

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish some sesame seeds before serving.

title: Grilled Cod Recipe, Gyro-Style
description: Mediterranean pan-grilled cod recipe with lemon basil sauce. Serve it with your favorite sides, or try it gyro-style wrapped in warm pita with Mediterranean favorites like tzatziki, olives and more!

ingredients.name: lb/ 680.4 g cod fillet (or another white fish fillet of your choice)
Greek pita bread (or lettuce wraps for low-carb option)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine the spices to make the spice rub

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat fish fillets dry and season well on both sides with kosher salt and black pepper, then rub all over with the spice rub. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the lemon basil sauce. Simply combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl or mason jar. Whisk well together. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If serving this grilled fish gyro-style, prepare the pita etc. Prepare Tzatziki sauce according to this recipe, and prepare the Mediterranean salad according to this recipe. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat the bottom of a large cast iron skillet (or a non-stick skillet) with extra virgin olive oil. Warm skillet over medium-high heat until the oil is just shimmering but not smoking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add fish fillets and grill on one side for about 3 minutes or so without moving it (the underside should look golden and crispy). Then, using a fish spatula, turn it over to the other side (it should release easily from the pan). Grill for another 3 minutes or until this side turns nice and crispy as well. (You'll know your fish is ready when it turns opaque all the way through and flake apart easily.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve fish hot. Add a splash of fresh lemon juice on top and a generous drizzle of the lemon basil sauce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To assemble grilled fish gyros, use 1 pita wrap (or large lettuce leaf) per person. Swipe a bit of tzatziki sauce over the pita, add the grilled fish and lemon basil sauce, then add a bit of the Mediterranean salad and olives to your liking. Wrap or fold pita and enjoy!

title: Spicy Roasted Cauliflower
description: This Spicy Roasted Cauliflower recipe features cauliflower roasted to crispy perfection in an easy chipotle sauce making it a healthy and delicious low carb side dish!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove and discard the leaves from the cauliflower and cut it into slices. Place them on the prepared baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small blender or food processor, add olive oil, melted butter or ghee, chipotle pepper, garlic powder, and salt. Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Brush both sides of the cauliflower slices with the chipotle mixture and roast in the oven for 18-25 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender and golden brown on the edges.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Top the cauliflower with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and chopped cilantro. Serve immediately.

title: Cornmeal Coo Coo
description: Cornmeal Coo coo aka CouCou. Creamy , thick and hearty Polenta -Caribbean style . An intriguing side dish with tons of flavor.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium-sauce pan or pot add oil, onions, garlic, and thyme sauté, for about 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent any burns.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Throw in okra and red bell pepper; continue cooking for about 2 minutes, followed by about 2 cups warm water and coconut milk. Bring to a boil

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: At this point you may remove some or half of the vegetables and reserve, if you like your vegetables crunchy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Gradually whisk in the cornmeal, until you have add the whole thing in the pot, a little bit at a time and keep stirring with a whisk to prevent any lumps. You may have to remove saucepan from heat while trying to get rid of lumps- to prevent burns.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Reduce the heat to low and cook until the mixture thickens.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Then add the remaining boiled water, reduce heat, cover, and cook- for about 10 or more minutes. Return any vegetables reserved. Add butter, add more water if desired continue whisking to cornmeal consistency. I usually use about a total of 3 1/2 cups water because I like mine, really soft.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn off the heat. Scoop out and place into a wet bowl, to form a ball . Let it set for a few minutes then turn in upside down on to a plate. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Sriracha Hot Sauce ซอสพริกศรีราชา
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: red, hot chili peppers of your choice, roughly chopped (see note)
garlic, peeled and crushed just until broken

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add chilies and garlic to a small pot and add just enough vinegar to cover (you may need a little more or less than 1 cup). Simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes, or until the garlic cloves are soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer to a blender—if you want to tone down the heat slightly, leave behind the seeds. You can do this by using a slotted spoon to transfer just chilies and garlic to the blender, then pour remaining vinegar into blender through a strainer to catch seeds. (See video for this technique).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Strain the sauce through a fine mesh sieve into a small pot, pushing out as much liquid as possible with a rubber spatula, and occasionally scrape the bottom of the sieve with a knife to get the sauce that is hanging on there.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Put the sauce back on the stove over medium heat. Add salt and 1/4 cup sugar and stir until the sauce comes to a simmer. Remove from heat, taste, and adjust seasoning with the remaining sugar if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Store in an airtight container in the fridge, it should last you a few months.

title: Roasted Cauliflower Soup with Fried Jalapenos
description: This Roasted Cauliflower Soup with Fried Jalapeños is thick, creamy and loaded with healthy veggies. It's also gluten free, paleo, vegetarian and vegan!

ingredients.name: jalapeño peppers (diced (remove the seeds and veins for low spice, or leave them in for more heat))
garnish: fried jalapenos, feta cheese, black pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place cauliflower onto the prepared baking sheet in a single layer. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix together to combine and roast in the oven for 35 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large dutch oven or pot over medium-high heat, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil. And in jalapenos and fry for 3 to 5 minutes, until the edges start to get crispy. Transfer the jalapenos to a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same dutch oven or pot, add in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Add the onion and garlic, Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, until the onions starts to become translucent.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add in the roasted cauliflower, broth, sage and bay leaf. Bring the soup to a boil, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn off the heat, remove the bay leaf and puree the soup with an immersion blender or regular blender until smooth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour in the milk and 2/3 of the fried jalapenos. Mix everything together and season with more salt if needed. If the soup is too thick, feel free to add in more broth until it's just how you like it.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve in soup bowls and garnish with the remaining fried jalapenos and feta cheese.

Putting pressure on the peeler will help with cutting even slices that are as thick as possible with a peeler. You can also use a mandoline to slice the eggplant.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

title: Mackerel in Red Curry Sauce - "Choo Chee"
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: kaffir lime leaves, center rib removed, finely julienned
Spur chilies or red bell pepper, finely julienned for garnish (optional)
1-2 Tbsp extra coconut milk for garnish (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 1/4 cup of the coconut milk to a wok or a saute pan wide enough to hold the fish and bring to a boil. Add curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, reducing it until thick and until the coconut oil start separating from the paste. (If the coconut oil does not separate and the curry paste is very thick, just proceed with the recipe; some coconut milk has been processed to prevent separation.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the remaining coconut milk, palm sugar and fish sauce; stir to mix and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce has thickened to the desired consistency—you want the sauce to be rich and thick, but still easily pourable. When the sauce is close to being done, add half of the julienned kaffir lime leaves, let infuse for a minute or until the sauce has reached the desired consistency.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning, making sure that the sauce is strongly seasoned as it'll be softened when you have it with the fish and the rice. Set the sauce aside, covered if possible, while you cook the fish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pat the fish dry. In a large sauté pan, add enough vegetable oil to coat the bottom of the pan and heat over medium high heat. Once hot, place the fish, skin-side down, and cook for about 2 minutes or until the skin is golden. Flip the fish and cook the other side for 1 more minute or until done. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring the sauce back to a boil, adding more water if it has become to thick. Add the fish to the sauce, skin-side up, and let it simmer in the sauce just for 30 seconds to a minute, trying not to let the sauce get on the skin.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from heat and transfer the fish onto a serving plate. Pour the sauce around the fish, drizzling a little bit of sauce across the fillet. Pour the extra coconut milk on top (if using) and garnish with the remaining julienned kaffir lime leaves and julienned bell pepper. Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Briam: Traditional Greek Roasted Vegetables
description: Briam is simple and absolutely delicious roasted vegetables, prepared Greek style. Potatoes, Zucchini, and Red onions tossed in a mixture of EVOO, garlic, parsley and spices, then roasted in saucy diced tomatoes.

ingredients.name: lb/ 570 g gold potatoes (about 3 medium-size potatoes), peeled and thinly sliced into rounds (about 1/8-inch thick)
lb/ 570 g zucchini squash (2 to 3 zucchini), thinly sliced into rounds (about 1/4-inch thick)
Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil
28-oz/ 794 g canned diced tomatoes with juice (no-salt added organic tomatoes are recommended)
large red onion or 2 smaller red onions, thinly sliced into rounds (if large, you’ll want to cut the onion in half first, and then slice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Place a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place sliced potatoes and zucchini in a large mixing bowl. Season with kosher salt, pepper, oregano, and rosemary. Add fresh parsley, garlic, and a generous drizzle extra virgin olive oil. Toss to make sure the vegetables are well coated with the EVOO and spices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grab a large round pan on skillet (I used an 11-inch oven safe pan. See notes for more options.) Pour 1/2 of the canned diced tomatoes in and spread to cover the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange the seasoned potatoes, zucchini, and sliced onions in the pan in rows (simply going around the shape of the pan and alternating.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you have any of the extra virgin olive oil and garlic mixture left in the mixing bowl, pour that all over the veggies, then top with the remaining diced tomatoes from your can.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the pan with foil (tent foil a bit so it is not touching the veggies). Bake in 400 degrees F heated-oven for 45 minutes. Take pan out briefly to carefully remove foil, then place back in oven, uncovered, and roast for another 30-40 minutes or until the veggies are soft and charred and most of the liquid has evaporated. (ovens do vary, so pay attention and check as needed.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from oven. Serve warm or at room temperature with an added generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. (see suggestions for to serve along.)

title: Easy Citron Tea (Made with Meyer Lemons)
description: Sharing an easy citron tea that mimics the flavor and texture of the traditional Korean Yuja Cha but uses meyer lemons instead of yuzu. It has all the essentials of Yuja Cha, but uses an easier-to-source and cheaper ingredient.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thoroughly wash the lemons. Cut them in half, along the long side of the lemon. Use a spoon to scoop out the lemon flesh and transfer it into a medium-sized bowl to use later. If the lemon peel still has some pulp attached, don’t worry about it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stack two pieces of lemon peel together and slice it into thin strips, as thinly as possible. You will get about 2 cups of sliced lemon peels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the peels into a large bowl or container. Add the sugar and honey.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Squeeze out some juice from the lemon flesh. Remove the seeds but allow the pulp to stay. Transfer 1/4 cup of the juice to the bowl of lemon peels. Stir to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer everything into mason jars (great for gifting) or leave it in a tightly sealed container. Make sure you leave some space in the container (don’t fill it to the top) to prevent spilling, because the lemon peel will release juice during the process. Let it sit at room temperature overnight. Stir it with a clean spoon and transfer it into the fridge. You can store it in the fridge for up to a month.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: The citron tea mixture is ready to use once the sugar dissolves.

title: Smoky Loaded Eggplant Dip: Baba Ganoush
description: This baba ganoush is a smoky eggplant dip with tahini, garlic, lemon juice and spices. I add a little Greek yogurt to make it extra creamy, but you can omit this to keep it vegan.

ingredients.name: Drizzle Early Harvest extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a bowl add tomato, cucumber, and parsley. Season with salt, pepper, and sumac. Add lemon juice and a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Toss and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn 1 gas burner on high. Using a pair of tongs, turn eggplant every 5 minutes or so until the eggplant is completely tender and it’s skin is charred and crispy (about 15 to 20 minutes.) Don’t worry if the eggplant deflates, it’s supposed to. (You can also do this on a gas or charcoal grill over medium-high heat.) Remove from heat and let the eggplant cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once eggplant is cool enough to touch, peel the charred crispy skin off. Discard the stem. Transfer eggplant flesh to a colander; let drain for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer eggplant flesh to the bowl of a food processor. Add tahini paste, yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper, Sumac, Aleppo pepper, crushed red pepper (if using.) Give it just a couple of pulses to combine (do not over blend. See notes)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the smoky eggplant dip (baba ganoush) to a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes (or overnight).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring eggplant dip to room temperature. Top with a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Add pine nuts. Spoon the salad on top (be sure to drain any excess liquid before adding on top of the baba ganoush.) Serve with warm pita wedges or pita chips.

description: A lighter Asian-style banana fritter that is less calorie-dense and still satisfies your sweet tooth.

ingredients.name: to 5 big ripe bananas (, cut into 1-inch chunks)
Powdered sugar ((honey, or maple syrup to serve with))
milk ((or plant-based milk for a vegan dish))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the ingredients for the batter in a big bowl. Stir to mix well. It should form a runny batter similar in consistency to a pancake batter.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1 inch of oil in a small deep pot over medium-high heat until hot. Test the oil by inserting a wooden chopstick. If the oil sizzles and you can see small bubbles rising rapidly on the chopstick, the oil is ready.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Line a large plate or baking sheet with a cooling rack. Add the chopped bananas into the batter, a few pieces at a time, and coat well. Gently transfer the bananas into the oil. Fry until all sides turn golden brown. Transfer onto the cooling rack to drain the extra oil. Fry all the bananas this way in batches.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

title: Dak Gomtang (Korean Chicken Soup)
description: A flavorful chicken soup made with a whole chicken!

ingredients.name: soup soy sauce (guk ganjang, 국간장) (use regular soy sauce if unavailable)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the cleaned chicken in a stock pot large enough to hold the chicken and 10 cups of water (6 - 8 quarts pot). Add the garlic, ginger, onion, scallions, optional peppers and 10 cups of water (or enough to cover the chicken).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring it to a boil over high heat. Skim off any foam on top. Reduce the heat to medium and boil, covered, for about 40 - 50 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken. Cut through the thickest part of the breast, with a knife, to see if the chicken is cooked and tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat off and carefully remove the chicken. When the chicken is cool enough to handle, remove the meat off the bones.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Shred the meat into small bite size pieces. You can strain the broth, remove the excess fat and serve at this point. But, I put the bones back in the soup and boil again for more flavorful broth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Optional Step: Put the bones back in the broth and simmer over medium low heat for an additional 30 minutes to an hour depending on how much time you have.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Strain the broth and remove the excess fat. You can spoon off the fat, refrigerate the broth until the fat solidifies, or use a fat separator.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve, place some rice in a serving bowl, add chicken pieces, and then ladle the hot broth on top. Typically, chopped scallions, salt and pepper, and optional spicy sauce are served separately so each person can season to taste. Serve piping hot with kimchi.

title: Wonton Soup เกี้ยวนำ้
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: pork or chicken stock (I estimate ¾ cup of stock per person)
Vegetables: I use baby bok choy, but you can use any other greens you like, or no greens at all.
Fried garlic and garlic oil (simply chopped garlic fried in oil until golden, watch fried garlic tutorial at 3:06)
Chili oil (optional), you can use store bought chili oil or make your own by simply frying some dried chili flakes over low heat in vegetable oil just until the flakes darken slightly.
Chopped green onions and/or cilantro for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pound garlic, white peppercorns and cilantro roots in a mortar and pestle into a paste. In a food processor, add the garlic mixture, shrimp, ground pork, egg, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and tapioca starch; process just until there are no more big chunks of shrimp. Remove from food processor and stir together one more time to ensure even mixing. At this point you can taste the mixture by cooking up a small amount in the microwave—it only takes a few seconds to cook!

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lay wonton wrappers out and put 1 rounded teaspoon of filling in the centre. Keep the rest of wonton wrappers covered under a towel or in a ziplock bag so they don't dry out. Wrap the wontons into a "ruffled purse" by following the instructions in the video (at 3:38) or watch this video to see 5 different ways you can wrap wontons.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for blanching wontons. In another pot, bring the stock to a simmer, then add all remaining broth ingredients. Cover and keep hot until ready to serve. Blanch the bok choy (or other vegetables you're using) for 1 minute in the boiling water and place into serving bowls, shaking off as much water as you can. Boil wontons in the same water for about 1-1½ minutes or until fully cooked; drain and add to the serving bowls. Ladle the broth over the wontons, top with fried garlic, chili oil, and green onions. Serve immediately.
