title: Mediterranean Blackened Salmon Recipe with Pomegranate Salsa
description: Blackened Salmon with a warm Mediterranean seasoning mix. Served with a splash of lemon juice and bold pomegranate salsa.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil, a generous drizzle
cayenne pepper (Optional. Increase amount if you’re looking for spicy fish)
1/2lb/680.389 g center-cut salmon fillet (skin on, if possible)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine salsa ingredients. Mix and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat broiler and set oven rack about 6 inches below broiler element. Meanwhile, in a small shallow bowl, stir together spices (cumin, coriander, paprika, aleppo pepper, garlic powder, and cayenne).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat salmon dry very well. Season with salt and pepper (if using salmon fillet with no skin, season both sides.) Apply the spice mixture all over salmon flesh (I used salmon with skin, so applied the entire spice mixture to the flesh side.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place salmon in lightly-oiled cast iron skillet or a sheet-pan. Broil salmon until browned on top and the center registers 115 to 125°F for medium-rare to medium, about 5 minutes or so (Tip: some, not all, ovens cycle broiler through on and off. You want the broiler on the entire time for this. It can help to crack oven door open very slightly to prevent broiler from cycling on and off.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If salmon becomes browned on top, but center is not cooked enough, then switch broiler off and set oven to 425 degrees F then continue cooking until done (shouldn’t be more than 1 to 2 minutes longer depending on your oven.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: . While salmon is cooking, heat a small skillet (do not add any oil). Grill lemon halves, flesh-side down, for a few minutes until browned. Remove from heat (this is totally optional, but highly recommended.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When salmon is ready, remove from heat. Squeeze a generous amount of lemon juice on top (from grilled lemon halves.) Serve with pomegranate salsa and Lebanese rice (or your favorite grain.)

title: Dak Kalguksu (Chicken Noodle Soup)
description: Delicious noodle soup made with thick knife-cut noodles and a rich chicken broth

ingredients.name: small whole chicken (2.5 to 3 pounds, or bone-in pieces)
salt (about 1/2 teaspoon and pepper to taste)
medium zucchini, julienned (julienned carrot or sliced potato is also great.)
(4 servings) fresh or dried kalguksu noodles or see below for homemade noodles
water (start with 3/4 and gradually more, a tablespoon at a time until needed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If making homemade noodles, see the instructions below and make the dough ahead of time. You can roll it out and cut while boiling the chicken.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cleaned chicken in a stockpot large enough to hold the chicken and 12 cups of water. Add the onion, garlic, ginger, scallions, and 12 cups water. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Skim off any foam on top. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer, covered, for about 40 minutes. Adjust cooking time for cut pieces of chicken.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sprinkle the julienned zucchini with salt for about 15 minutes and then squeeze out the water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut through the thickest part of the breast, with a knife, to see if the chicken is cooked and tender. Turn the heat off and carefully remove the chicken.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Strain the broth and remove the excess fat. You can spoon off or use a fat separator.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the chicken is cool enough to handle, remove the meat off the bones. Shred the meat into small bite size pieces. Add the garlic, salt and pepper to the chicken. Combine well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return the broth back to the pot. Add the soup soy sauce, onion slices, and optional dried kelp. Bring it to a boil and boil for a few minutes. Remove the kelp. Add salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Meanwhile, in another pot, boil water to parboil the noodles. Or the soup will get too thick. Add the noodles, and stir. Cook halfway through.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove the noodles with a strainer and add to the pot with boiling broth. (This is a good time to add potato slices if using.) Continue to boil until the noodles are cooked through. Add the zucchini (and julienned carrot if using) with 2 to 3 minutes remaining.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To serve, ladle the noodles and soup in a serving bowl, top with the chicken pieces and chopped scallion.

title: Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Super easy and great flavor kimchi fried rice.

ingredients.name: steamed leftover rice ( , separated before frying)
green onions ( , white part and green part separated and chopped)
toasted sesame seeds for garnishing ( , optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the kimchi into small pieces and separate the steamed leftover rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil and fry white part of green onion until aroma. Add kimchi pieces and fry for 20-30 seconds. Add rice and give a big stir fry to combine everything well. Add light soy sauce, kimchi juice and half of chopped green onion. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3

title: Toasted Red Chile Salsa
description: This Toasted Red Chile Salsa made with dried Arbol and New Mexico chiles, tomatillos and garlic is easy to make and perfectly spicy. Add to eggs, tacos and more!

ingredients.name: dried árbol chiles, (, stemmed and seeded)
dried New Mexico chiles ((or dried Guajillo chiles), stemmed and seeded)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a skillet over medium-high heat, add 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add dried Arbol chiles, New Mexico chiles and garlic cloves. Toast for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chiles have softened and darkened in color. Be careful not to over-toast and burn. Transfer toasted chiles and garlic to a blender and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add remaining teaspoon of olive oil to skillet. Add tomatillos and toast for about 3 minutes per side, until caramelized and softened. Place everything in blender and add water. Blend and season with salt as needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add caramelized tomatillos, water and pinch of salt to the blender and puree until smooth. Add more water if salsa is too thick.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Season with salt to taste.

title: Chickpea Instant Pot Soup (Stovetop Option)
description: Mediterranean instant pot soup recipe with chickpeas, vegetables, fresh herbs & warm spices. Vegan. GF. Low Carb. See recipe notes for stovetop and slow cooker instructions!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve or Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chickpeas in a large bowl and add plenty of water (about 1 quart) to fill the bowl. Leave overnight to soak. Drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat your Instant Pot by selecting the saute function and adjust heat to high. Add 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and heat until shimmering. Add onions, garlic and a pinch of salt. Cook 3 mins, stirring regularly. Add carrots, bell peppers, and spices. Cook another 4 minutes or so, stirring, until vegetables have softened a bit.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now add drained chickpeas, tomatoes (and their juice), and broth. Lock your Instant Pot lid in place. Select the pressure cooking setting and set on high. Now set the time to 15 minutes (go 5 to 10 minutes longer, if you like your chickpeas on the super tender, creamier side)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: After cooking, allow time to let pressure release naturally. OR after 10 minutes or so, you can use the quick release function to let any remaining pressure out. Unlock and remove the lid.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in lemon juice and fresh cilantro. Carefully taste and adjust seasoning as desired.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowls and drizzle extra virgin olive oil. Serve with your favorite crusty bread or this Lebanese rice.

title: Ndole ( Spinach/ Bitterleaves and Peanut Soup)
description: An aromatic Cameroonian spinach stew made of spinach and bitter leaves – flavored with garlic, crayfish and fortified with shrimp and beef. Comfort food at its best.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pan season meat with salt, maggi and onions and boil until tender depending on the choice of meat. Meanwhile, boil stock fish with salt and water; add it to the boiled meat. You should have about 3 cups of stock from the meat and stock fish. Reserve the rest or freeze it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil peanuts for about 10 minutes in a sauce pan. Let it cool and blend/pulse in a food processor or blender into a fine consistency use water to facilitate the blending .Add to the mixture of beef and stockfish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Blend one onion and garlic into a fine paste and add to the mixture of peanuts and meat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the crayfish and let it simmer for 10 minutes stirring frequently to prevent burns. Season with salt and Maggi. You might have to add more later

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the bitter leaves or spinach to the pot. Stir and simmer for several minutes more

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the pot of ndole is simmering, heat oil in a fry pan or, preferably a cast iron. Add the shrimp, stirring constantly until they just turn pink. Slice and add the remaining onions stir for a few more minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Finally incorporate the mixture of shrimp, onions and oil into the pot of Ndole. Stir for a few minutes and serve hot with any of the sides mentioned above.

title: Froutalia recipe (Greek Omelette with Sausages and Potatoes)
description: A super tasty and super easy traditional Greek omellete from Cyclades islands! Froutalia can be made with a variety of ingredients, depending on the season, but a traditional froutalia should always include local good quality sausages and…

ingredients.name: medium sized sausages, cut into slices
medium sized potatoes, peeled and cut into thin slices
100g/ 3.5 ounces grated cheese (Volakias Andros or hard yellow cheese)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a spacious skillet, preferably nonstick, add enough oil to cover the bottom of the pan. When the oil warms up a bit, fry the sausages, for about 4 minutes, until crispy. Place them on paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add a little bit more oil to the pan and the salted potatoes and fry until soft. Tilt the pan over the sink and carefully pour out the extra oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the sausages back to the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a bowl, beat the eggs with the milk and add the cheese, the herbs, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cover with a large lid (with diameter greater than that of the pan) and cook the froutalia over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Check if it is cooked by lifting it from the bottom with a spatula. In order to cook the froutalia on both sides, you should turn it upside down. Over the sink, turn the pan upside down, so that the froutalia drops on the lid and push it carefully, so that it slides back into the pan. Cook for a few more minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with some crusted bread and xoriatiki (Greek feta) salad.

title: Homemade Feta cheese Pizza recipe
description: Crispy, fluffy, juicy and absolutely delicious. Full of mouthwatering Mediterranean flavours, this feta cheese pizza recipe will become your newest favorite.

ingredients.name: water, at room-temperature (1 and 1/4 of a cup)
small clove of garlic, finely chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this feta cheese pizza recipe, start by making the dough. Add into the bowl of the electric mixer the water along with the yeast. Stir with a fork and wait 3-4 minutes, for the yeast to be completely dissolved and starts bubbling. Pour in a splash of milk. Into the same bowl, add the flour, the salt and sugar. Using the dough hook, mix all the ingredients in low speed for about 5-7 minutes, until the dough becomes an elastic ball. Whilst mixing, pour in the olive oil. When done, remove the dough from the hook and check out its texture. It should be smooth and elastic and slightly sticky. If it is too sticky, add just a little more flour (1/2 tsp), mix and check again.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Leave the dough to rest for 5 minutes and then mix again for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coat lightly the dough with some olive oil, place the dough inside and cover with plastic wrap. Let the dough sit in warm place for at least 30 minutes, until it doubles it’s size.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Take the dough out of the bowl knead for a while, to deflate it and split in 3 evenly sized balls. Using a rolling pin, stretch out each ball, on a floured surface, and shape into a thin round shaped pizza base (0.5 cm thick)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Move the pizza bases on some slightly oiled grease proof paper. Do that now, before adding the toppings, as it will be more difficult to move later.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To make the sauce of the feta cheese pizza, heat a saucepan on low-medium heat and add a 1 tbsp of olive oil and the garlic. Saute, until slightly golden and then add the basil, the tomatoes, the oregano and season with salt and pepper. Simmer for about 20 minutes, mashing the tomatoes with a wooden spoon, while it cooks.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: This feta cheese pizza recipe is all about the topping! Choose some good-quality ingredients, as it will enhance the flavour.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180C. Smear the tomato sauce over the base of the pizzas and spread with a spoon. Grate the mozzarella on top and scatter the sliced tomato, the onions, the peppers and 1/3 of the olive oils and feta cheese. Bake each pizza for 15-20 minutes, until golden and crispy.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When done, top with the rest of the crumbled feta cheese, the rest of the olives and the chopped tomatoes. Adding raw ingredients on top of this feta cheese pizza, will give a unique and more earthly flavour. Drizzle with olive oil and add a good pinch of dried oregano.

title: Hobak Mandu (Zucchini Dumplings)
description: Incredibly simple Korean dumplings made with summer zucchini

ingredients.name: dried pyogo beoseot, 표고버섯 (shiitake mushrooms) (soaked (or use fresh) - optional)
soup soy sauce, 국간장 (or 1 tablespoon regular soy sauce) (or 1/4 teaspoon salt)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the zucchinis into thin disks and then into matchsticks. If the disks are big, cut in half before cutting into matchsticks. Lightly sprinkle with salt (about 1 teaspoon), and let sit for about 15 minutes until wilted and some liquid is released. Gently squeeze the liquid out from the zucchini.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the mushrooms into thin strips. If the mushrooms are thick, slice them diagonally once or twice as if you are butterflying the mushrooms, and then cut into thin strips. Mix with the soup soy sauce (or salt) and a little bit (about ½ teaspoon) of sesame oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a pan over high heat, and add two teaspoons of sesame oil and the zucchini. Stir fry until the zucchini is cooked and dry. Transfer to a large plate and spread it around to cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a pan over medium high heat, and stir fry the mushrooms for 2 minutes. Add a tablespoon or two of water or mushroom soaked water if the pan gets too dry.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine the zucchini and mushrooms. Adjust the seasoning to taste if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place one heaping teaspoonful of the filling on a wrapper placed on your palm. Wet the edges of the wrapper with water, fold the wrapper and seal tightly (pushing the air out with your fingers) into a half-moon shape. You can pinch one side of the wrapper to form pleats. Repeat this process until all the filling/wrappers are used.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the dumplings a few at a time, stirring gently so they don’t stick to the bottom of the pot. Cook only until the dumplings come up to the surface. Prepare a bowl with cold water. Remove the dumplings quickly, and plunge in the cold water to cool.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove and serve cold with a dipping sauce (2 teaspoons soy sauce, 1 teaspoon vinegar, and 2 teaspoons water) if desired.

title: Coconut Tomato Dip

ingredients.name: For serving: tortilla chips or rice crackers

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

title: Duck de Marietta (The Best Slow Roast Duck)
description: The duck is stuffed with citrus, then slow cooked until the meat is falling off the bones and the skin perfectly crisped. A restaurant recipe that requires minimal effort and yields the best results.

ingredients.name: / 5 to 6 pound whole duck ((I used D'Artagnan Rohan Duck))
to 6 mixed citrus fruits (blood orange, lemon, and/or mandarin, peels removed)
jam of your choice ((blueberry, apricot, etc.))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Adjust oven rack to the lower third. Preheat oven to 120 C (250 degrees F). Line a baking pan with aluminium foil (for easy cleanup) and top with a V-rack.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a plate. Transfer the giblets from the duck to the plate. Use a pair of poultry shears to remove the duck neck and trim the neck skin. Do not trim any skin from the bottom of the duck, because it will keep the meat moist during roasting. Save the duck neck for making sauce or stock. Save the giblets for cooking or making stock.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place duck on a working surface or a cutting board. Stuff citrus inside of the duck, using as many fruits as you can. Use a few toothpicks to seal the bottom of the duck, to secure the fruits inside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use a sharp paring knife to score the duck breast, about 1 cm (⅓ inch) apart. This will help the duck render fat faster and create a crispy skin. If you’re not familiar with this process, I suggest you start slow. The thickness of duck skin is not consistent. You need to avoid slicing through the meat, which will cause the duck to lose moisture. Gently press the knife. You might need to slice a few times to get the cut just right. (*see footnote 1)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Rub both sides of the duck with plenty of sea salt. Place duck on the V-rack, breast side up.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake until the skin turns golden brown, 6 to 7 hours (depending on the thickness of the duck skin). You do not need to flip the duck or monitor the process.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: (Optional) When most of the duck fat has rendered and the skin has become thin (usually 6 hours to 6.5 hours), turn up the heat of the oven to 260 degrees C (500 F) to brown the duck for another 5 to 10 minutes. This method works better when you choose a duck breed with thinner skin (or a duck that was air-chill processed). The skin will crisp up nicely and the meat will remain more juicy.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the duck from the oven and let rest for 15 minutes. Do NOT cover the duck with foil. This step further crisps up the skin. The stuffing will keep the duck meat hot.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer the duck onto a large cutting board. Carefully remove the citrus fruits (they will be very hot!) from the duck with a fork or a pair of tongs, and discard them.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To carve the duck beautifully, you can refer to this video. Alternatively, you can simply pull the meat apart by hand.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Transfer the rendered duck fat into a small bowl. When it has cooled off, cover with plastic wrap and store it in the fridge. Save for later use.

title: Caramel Custard Cake คาราเมลคัสตาร์ดเค้ก
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: g. cake flour (1 scant cup, sifted then measured by spooning into a measuring cup without tapping)
8-inch round cake pan. Mine is 3-inch high but you can also use a 2-inch one.
A thin off-set spatula to help get the cake out of the pan
A baking pan that's at least 1-inch thick for the water bath.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Set the oven rack in the middle.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a water bath:

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Put about 1/3-inch of water into a pan large enough for your round cake pan to sit in. Place the water bath into the preheating oven.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To make caramel:

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Put the cake pan in the hot oven while you're making the caramel. In a small heavy-bottomed pot, heat sugar until it is melted and turns into an amber-coloured caramel, stirring only as needed to even out dark spots. When caramel is almost ready, remove the cake pan from the oven, and once the caramel reaches the desired colour, immediately pour the caramel into the hot cake pan, tilting the pan around to spread out the caramel, making sure it covers the entire pan surface. If there are large bubbles, pop them with a spatula or a spoon. Set aside to cool. (If the sugar hardens before you can evenly spread out the caramel, put the cake pan on the stove on the lowest heat setting to re-melt the sugar.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For the custard:

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Whisk egg yolks and sugar together until combined. Add evaporated milk and vanilla and whisk until sugar is completely dissolved. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: For the cake:

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Sift flour, baking powder and salt into a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Grate the orange zest into a small mixing bowl, add egg yolks and sugar (for cake base) and whisk until combined. Add oil, vanilla and orange juice and whisk until combined.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Make a well in the flour mixture and pour in the orange juice mixture all at once; whisk until completely smooth.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: In a medium mixing bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar on high speed until frothy. Gradually add sugar (for meringue) and continue to beat until soft peaks. Lower speed to medium and continue to beat until stiff peaks, being careful not to overbeat the egg whites.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Gently fold the egg whites into the flour mixture in 3 additions using a rubber spatula.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Strain the custard into the caramel-lined cake pan, and gently pour the cake batter over the custard. If there are large bubbles, pop them by running a toothpick or the tip of a paring knife through them.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Place the cake in the water bath and bake for 45-55 minutes until the top of the cake is golden brown.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Remove cake pan from the water bath and immediately run a thin metal spatula around the cake to release it from the pan. Make sure that the cake is loose by shaking the pan gently and the cake should move like it is floating on the caramel. Place a large serving plate on top of the cake pan and quickly invert the cake onto the plate. Note: The plate should have some depth so that it can hold in the pooling caramel. Also, it can be a bit challenging to try to invert the cake when hot; please be very careful not to burn yourself when doing it!

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Chill in the fridge for at least a few hours until cold before serving.

description: Sweet and Sour Pork tenderloin is a dedicate Chinese dish which is popular among the whole China.

steps.description: Cut the pork tenderloin into small strips around 1.5 cm thick. Add all the marinating sauce, combine well and let the pork absorb all of the seasonings. Set aside for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the batter| in a large bow combine cornstarch, flour, salt and water. Stir until all of the ingredients are well incorporated and set aside for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the pork strips with the coating batter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat oil in a wok until 160 degree C (proof testing, when you insert a chopstick in, there will be lots of fine and small bubbles around). Place the pork strips one by one and fry until slightly Browned. Do not overcook!!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat oil until almost smoky (at least 200 degree C) and place the fried pork strips in, continue frying 6-10 seconds. Transfer out immediately.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry the ketchup and sugar with 1/2 tablespoon of oil until there are large bubbles over slowest fire.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Stir in ginger and scallion water.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add vinegar (lemon juice), salt and starch water and heat until well thickened.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place the fried pork strips in and coat well. Please fish this process as quick as possible. Sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds as decoration.

title: Moo Shu Pork
description: Famous Chinese Woo Shu Pork

ingredients.name: handful water soaked wood ear mushroom
small bunch of soaked dried daylily

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine pork with marinating sauce, do a little message to make sure the pork slices absorb the sauces well. Set aside for 30 minutes. At the same time, prepare cucumber, carrot, whisk the eggs and scallion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the stir fry sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a small pinch of salt in eggs and then whisk well. Heat around 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over high fire. Make scrambled eggs firstly and then transfer out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat your wok or pan firstly. Add cooking oil to form a 2-3 cm high layer (do not be scared by the oil amount, we do not eat them all). Spread the pork sliced in when the oil begins to warm but not hot. Let them stay for around 5-8 seconds and then quickly fry them until turns pale. Transfer out immediately.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Leave around 1 tablespoon of oil in wok and then fry garlic until aroma, place prepared wood ear mushrooms, dried lily flower and carrot. Continue frying for around 1 minute over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return pork slices, cucumber and egg.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the stir-fry sauce we prepared in previous step. Mix well. At this step, you need to taste the dish and see whether an extra pinch of salt is needed. Transfer out and serve with woo shu shells or steamed rice.

title: Traditional Sofrito Recipe from Corfu
description: A traditional Greek Beef Sofrito recipe straight from the island of Corfu! Discover how you can recreate this traditional Corfu dish with this step-by-step easy to follow Greek Sofrito recipe.

ingredients.name: (35 oz./2 pounds) boneless veal (top round), cut in 6 slices
all purpose flour, for dredging (5 oz.)
of a cup olive oil, for frying
of a cup white wine vinegar

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek sofrito recipe, start by preparing the veal. Season the meat with salt and freshly ground pepper and dredge lightly the veal slices with flour, tapping off any excess. Heat the oil and butter in a large non stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the veal (in batches) and sauté, until browned on all sides. Do not add all the meat in the sauce pan, rather sauté in batches, so that the temperature of the oil remains high and the meat is sealed. When done, remove with a slotted spoon, place on a platter, cover and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the garlic cloves in slices and add in the same oil used to brown the meat. Turn down to medium heat and stir for a minute. Pour in the white wine vinegar and deglaze. Add the veal and the white wine and wait for a couple of minutes to steam up. Add the warm broth and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat down to low-medium and simmer until the veal is tender and the sauce thickens, for about 30-40 minutes. About 5 minutes before removing from the heat, stir in the freshly chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve the Sofrito while still hot over mashed potatoes, rice or fries, with some crusted garlic bread aside. Enjoy!

title: Easy Breakfast Stuffed Peppers
description: Easy stuffed peppers for breakfast, brunch or dinner. Prepared Mediterranean-style and filled with a flavor-packed, vegetarian, gluten-free potato hash. Then topped with the perfect egg. See our prepare-ahead instructions.

ingredients.name: bell peppers, (any color, halved length-wise and cored)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Arrange pepper halves in a baking dish or cast iron skillet. Add 1 cup water to the bottom of dish or skillet. Cover with foil and bake in heated oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the potato hash stuffing. Begin by heating a 12-inch cast iron skillet over high heat. Add mushrooms, cook tossing regularly until nicely browned. Season with salt. Remove from skillet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn heat to medium-high. To the skillet, add 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil. When oil is shimmering but not smoking (which will be quick), add onions and potatoes. Season with salt and pepper and the spices. Cook, stirring regularly for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, and continue to cook over medium-high heat, stirring regularly, until potatoes are tender, another 5 to 7 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now, add the cooked mushrooms, tomato, and parsley to the potatoes. Stir to combine. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove pepper halves from oven (do not drain water.) Stuff each with the potato stuffing about 3/4 of the way. Now, carefully crack one egg into each pepper over the potato stuffing.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cover with aluminium foil (make sure to tent the foil so it does not stick to the egg yokes.) Bake in heated oven for 18 to 20 minutes, or until the eggs are soft set (longer if you like the eggs more cooked.) Serve immediately!

title: Ethiopian Yataklete kilkil
description: Ethiopian Yataklete Kilkil is a healthy dish made with potatoes, green beans, and carrots; all infused with delicious spices for that wonderful explosion of flavors. A meal that's good for your taste buds and waist!

ingredients.name: salt, (plus more adjust to suit taste buds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add potatoes in a large saucepan, salt, and add water just enough to cover potatoes. Boil until tender - about 10 minutes or more. Remove and drain water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat. Add onions, give it a minute or two then stir in all the spices; garlic, Jalapenos peppers, ginger, coriander, smoked paprika, curry, white pepper, and chili pepper. Simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burns. Then add tomatoes and bring to a boil and simmer for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add potatoes, green beans, and carrots. Season with salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Continue to simmer for about 10 minutes; stirring frequently to allow the flavors to blend. If needed, add water to prevent any burns.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Adjust for seasonings. Serve warm.

title: Pan Seared Duck Breast with Persimmon Grapefruit Sauce
description: Pan searing a duck breast is the quickest and easiest way to enjoy this delightful bird. In this recipe, the duck is marinated briefly in a soy-sauce-based liquid to infuse a succulent umami.

ingredients.name: light soy sauce ((or soy sauce, or tamari for gluten-free))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Score the skin side of the duck breast in a 1/2-inch (1 cm) crosshatch pattern with a sharp knife. Be careful not to cut into the duck flesh. You should cut almost completely through the skin, leaving a very thin layer of it intact.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine Japanese sake, light soy sauce, Sichuan peppercorn, and salt in a large bowl. Stir to mix well. Add duck breast. Gently rub both sides with the marinade. Place half of the Sichuan peppercorns and one piece of ginger on the lean side of each duck breast and return the duck to the marinade, skin side down. Let marinate for 1 to 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine persimmon, grapefruit juice, sugar, and shallot in a deep cup. Mix with an immersion blender until it forms a consistent slurry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer duck breasts to a plate and discard the marinade (including the dry ingredients). Dry with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place duck breasts into a heavy nonstick skillet, skin side down. Turn on medium low heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the duck start to sizzle, press gently with a spatula so that the skin is seared evenly. Press until the skin is set. Continue cooking until the skin renders extra fat and turns golden brown. Flip to cook the other side until the meat reaches the desired doneness. A thermometer inserted to the thickest part should read 135 F (58 C) for medium rare, 145 F (62 C) for medium, or 150 F (65 C) for medium-well. The whole cooking process usually takes 15 to 20 minutes. Immediately transfer duck breasts to a serving plate, skin side up. Cover loosely with aluminum foil. Let rest for 10 minutes. (*see footnote 1)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While resting the duck, transfer the persimmon puree to a small saucepan. Turn on medium heat. Stir occasionally. Cook until it reduces by half or reaches desired thickness. Remove from heat. Serve the sauce alongside the duck breast.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Bread Halwa Recipe
description: Bread Halwa is a quick and comforting Indian sweet made by cooking bread pieces in ghee, sugar and milk, flavored with cardamom, saffron and garnished with fried cashews and raisins.

ingredients.name: white bread cubes (or about 4 to 5 white bread slices, cubed)
to 8 tablespoons sugar (or add as required)
ghee ((clarified butter) to be added later)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Frying dry fruits

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Toasting bread

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Making Bread Halwa

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serving & Storage

title: Jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup)
description: Jjamppong is a popular Korean-Chinese noodle soup! It's loaded with pork, seafood and vegetables! The combination of all the natural ingredients creates a hearty bowl of soup that is packed with robust flavors.

ingredients.name: small carrot (about 2 ounces, thinly sliced into 2-inch lengths)
zucchini (about 3 ounces, thinly sliced into 2-inch lengths)
green cabbage (cut into 2-inch lengths (or napa cabbage or bok choy))
to 3 fresh shiitake mushrooms (or 2 shiitake mushrooms, soaked and thinly sliced)
squid (cut into bite sizes (Do not cut squids too small as they shrink a lot when cooked.))
gochugaru (Korean chili pepper flakes) (Adjust to taste (1 T for milder soup))
chicken stock (or anchovy broth or water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Have a pot of water ready to cook the noodles. (Turn the heat on when you start cooking the soup ingredients. This way you can time it so that the noodles are cooked at the same time the soup is ready.) While making the soup, cook the noodles according to the package instructions and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the pork and seafood.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a wok or a large pot over high heat. Add the oil, ginger, scallion, gochugaru and soy sauce and stir-fry for a minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the pork and stir-fry until the pork is almost cooked, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the onion, carrot, cabbage, zucchini and optional mushrooms. Lightly salt, and cook until the vegetables are slightly softened, about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour in the chicken stock (or anchovy broth/water) and boil until the vegetables are completely cooked.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the seafood starting with the clams, which require more time to cook, followed by the mussels, shrimps and squid. Bring everything to a boil again and cook until the shells have opened. Salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cook the noodles, rinse in cold water, and drain.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place a serving of the noodles in a large soup bowl and ladle the soup on top. Serve immediately while piping hot.

title: Soy Sauce Fried Rice
description: Soy sauce fried rice with shredded cabbage and scrambled egg or without egg

ingredients.name: egg ( ,beaten with a small pinch of salt and pepper)
a pinch of salt ( , if necessary )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Whisk egg with a small pinch of salt and pepper. Set aside. In a small bow, mix light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the wok until smoky (super important), add oil, and swirl the wok to help the oil cover the surface. Add beaten egg. Wait for 4-6 seconds and then break the eggs with chopsticks or a turner. This is a lovely way because at this stage the cracks can be easily gotten.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add shredded cabbage and fry for 10 cm.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place rice in and then use the scoop or turner to pat and move the rice quickly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and white pepper. Mix well. If you feel this is not salty enough, add a very small tiny pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle green onion and serve hot!

title: Chewy Banana Coconut Pancakes แป้งจี่ (pang jee)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: mashed namwa bananas (see note) or regular bananas
young coconut meat, canned, cut into ½-inch long strips

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small pot, add palm sugar and coconut milk and stir over low heat just until the sugar is mostly dissolved. Remove from heat and cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, add glutinous rice flour, mashed banana, shredded coconut, young coconut meat, salt and the sugar-coconut-milk mixture; stir until well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a flat, non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Drop about 1 tablespoon of batter onto the pan into a round shape and cook until the bottom is golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Flip and press down slightly, then cook until the other side is also golden brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Can be served at room temperature or warm. Keep refrigerated, tightly wrapped, for up to 1 week. To reheat, microwave until hot and soft, then let cool slightly before serving.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Mediterranean-Style Grilled Zucchini Salad
description: Easy Mediterranean-style grilled zucchini salad with fresh herbs, lemon juice, and a sprinkle of feta. Serve it at room temperature.

ingredients.name: zucchini squash (about 2 lb, sliced into rounds)
Private Reserve Greek Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the zucchini into a large bowl. Drizzle about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, and sprinkle with cumin. Toss with your clean hands to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a grill or griddle until hot, add zucchini in batches (do not crowd). Grill for 4 minutes or so, turning over a couple of times until zucchini are cooked through and perfectly charred.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer grilled zucchini back to the bowl. Add lemon juice, fresh garlic, salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Add fresh herbs and toss again gently.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to a serving platter and top with a sprinkle of feta or goat cheese, if you like. Serve at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For suggestions, see "what to serve with this zucchini salad" section up in the post above.

title: Fish in banana leaf (Liboke de poisson)
description: Here is a dish that would make prepping for fish exceptionally easy and fish eating, tantalizingly tasty

ingredients.name: 2-3 fish about one pound or less (fillet or whole small fish)
Chicken bouillon or Maggie to taste (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make three –four diagonal cuts in each side of the fish, all the way right through the bone. Season fish with salt, pepper, and squeeze some lemon over it. Set aside

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare plantain leaves

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the banana leaves into large rectangles, remove any ugly edges, submerge them in water to clean and drain pat- dry. Use aluminum paper if banana leaves are not available

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: The leaves must be heated and wilted over an open high flame to make them flexible.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the fish on the leaf, season with the entire spices divide equally among fish, and add onions and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Then quickly fold banana leaves over it, and press sides into a rectangle shape making sure to press inwards so none of the juice from the fish runs out.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Then fold the sides in to seal twice. You may use a rope to tie the bundle or place in foil paper. Repeat the process and set them.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake fish for about 12-20 minutes depending on fish whole fish takes longer.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove, let it cool and open check for doness.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio Recipe
description: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio recipe is a traditional Italian pasta dish made with spaghetti, olive oil, garlic and chilli flakes. It is a simple and quick pasta yet high on flavors.

ingredients.name: red chili flakes (or add as needed)
or 1.5 tablespoons parsley (- fresh, finely chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cooking spaghetti

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making spaghetti aglio e olio

title: Gluten-Free Almond Cake with Dates
description: This almond cake (Djamilah) is perfect for a holiday gift. It requires very little prep time. It’s refreshing and does not taste too sweet. It is gluten free and requires no leavening agent, yet the cake turns out so moist and crumbly.

ingredients.name: glutinous rice flour ((or tapioca starch) (*See Footnote 1))
freshly squeezed orange juice ((or strongly brewed tea, cooled))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 C). Prepare three mini loaf pans (or a regular loaf pan, or a 9-inch squared baking pan) and spray a thin layer of oil into the pan. (*See Footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add almonds and 1/2 cup sugar into a blender. Pulse until fine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add dried dates (or dried plums). Blend until the dried fruit is grated into the flour. Add rice flour. Pulse a few times to mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine egg yolks, vanilla, the remaining 1/2 cup sugar, butter, and orange juice (or brewed tea) in a big bowl. Stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the almond flour mixture into the bowl of egg yolk mixture. Stir a few times until the liquid is just mixed in.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add egg whites to a separate bowl. Whisk with a hand mixer until the egg whites form stiff peaks. Transfer to the bowl with almond mixture. Fold with a spatula until the egg whites are just incorporated. Do not overdo it.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour batter into mini loaf pans, until the pans are eighty percent filled.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: If you're making the date flavor, sprinkle cinnamon powder on top.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake until cooked through, about 35 minutes. If you use a normal loaf pan, you will need to extend baking time. If the surface of the cake already turns brown but the cake is not cooked through yet, cover the pan with aluminum foil to prevent from burning. Use a toothpick to poke the thickest part of the cake and it should come out clean.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Immediately transfer the cake onto a cooling rack and let cool completely.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: You can wrap the cake loosely with baking sheet if serving on the day its cooked.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: To serve the cake later, store in an air-tight container at room temperature up to 3 days, or in fridge up to a week.

title: Hobak bokkeum
description: A simple stir-fried zucchini side dish

ingredients.name: saeujeot (salted shrimp) or salt to taste (or fish sauce )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise (cut into quarters if using a round zucchini). Then cut crosswise into about 1/4 to 1/3-inch thick slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: You can use saeujeot as is or finely chopped. This is very salty, so use 2 teaspoons first and add more if needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a pan with a tablespoon of cooking oil over medium high heat. Add the zucchini, garlic and saeujeot (or salt or fish sauce) to the pan. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring well. Add 2 tablespoons of water to the pan while stir frying. You can add another spoon or two of water if the pan is dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the scallion, sesame oil and sesame seeds. Continue to cook until the zucchini is softened and turns translucent, about 2 to 3 minutes. Do not overcook. Taste and add more salted shrimp or salt if necessary.

title: Sweet and Sour Stir-Fry ผัดเปรี้ยวหวาน
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: medium firm tofu, 1” cubed, or another meat of your choice, cut into small bite-sized pieces (see note)
tomato, cut into wedges or 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
mini cucumber or regular cucumber, halved lengthwise and sliced on a bias
Green onions, cut into 1" pieces on a bias (half the white part horizontally if large)
white vinegar or rice wine vinegar
Thai Sriraja Panich sauce (or substitute Sriracha)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all sauce ingredients and stir to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dry off the cubes by laying them on a folded kitchen towel or paper towel and gently press on them with another towel. Heat 1.5" of vegetable oil in a pot or wok to in 350°F. Fry the tofu for 3-5 minutes until golden, making sure not to crowd the pot. Remove from oil and drain on paper towel.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok or a large saute pan, sauté garlic over medium high heat in a little bit of vegetable oil until it starts to turn golden. Add all vegetables at once, toss quickly to mix, then add the sauce. Cook the for a few minutes, stirring constantly, until the vegetables are done to your liking. Add the tofu and toss to coat in the sauce. Turn off the heat and stir in green onions and 2/3 of the cashews.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Plate, and sprinkle with the remaining cashews. Serve with jasmine rice.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a wok or a large saute pan, sauté garlic over medium high heat in a little bit of vegetable oil until it starts to turn golden. Add the meat and stir just until the exterior is cooked. Add all vegetables at once, toss quickly to mix, then add the sauce. Cook the for a few minutes, stirring constantly, until the meat is done and the vegetables are done to your liking. Turn off the heat and stir in green onions and 2/3 of the cashews.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Plate, and sprinkle with the remaining cashews. Serve with jasmine rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Easy Potato Casserole Recipe, Egyptian Style
description: This potato casserole recipe comes with a bit of an Egyptian twist. Potato wedges are combined with carrots and bell peppers, then topped with a spiced meat sauce. We use lean ground beef or ground turkey here.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
lean organic ground beef (or ground Turkey, if you prefer)
gold potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
large carrots, peeled, halved length-wise, then cut into 2-inch pieces
green bell pepper, cored and sliced into wide strips

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the meat sauce, in a large non-stick skillet, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil. Add chopped onions and cook, tossing regularly, till translucent. Add garlic and cook for another 30 seconds or so.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the ground meat (lean beef or turkey), break it up using a wooden spoon. Season with spices, salt and pepper. Cook, stirring regularly, until fully browned. Now add the peeled tomatoes and water. Using your wooden spoon, smash or break up the tomatoes a bit. Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover and let the meat sauce simmer for 10 minutes. Check to see if you might like to add a little more water. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a 9″ x 13″ baking pan like this one, arrange the potato wedges, carrots, and bell peppers. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle allspice and coriander. Toss to combine. Add about 3/4 cup water, then top with the meat sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the baking pan with foil and bake in heated oven for 30 minutes or so. Uncover and bake for another 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven and top with fresh chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To serve, add a side of Lebanese rice, if you like. A fresh salad such as this Mediterranean salad, Greek Salad, or Fattoush is a good start to this hearty meal.

title: Kashata
description: Kashata -Spiced Peanut , Coconut and Sugar Candy . Just 4 ingredients. Easy peasy with no thermometer needed.

ingredients.name: roasted peanuts shells and skin peeled lightly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Spray about an 8-inch baking pan with cooking spray. Set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large heavy sauce- pan combine granulated sugar, coconut milk, cardamom and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook over medium high heat, stirring until all the sugar has dissolved. Stop stirring when the sugar has dissolved .You may swirl pan to prevent mixture from burning. (Stirring helps form crystallization which you do not want during this process)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Continue to cook, until mixture thickens and sugar just starts to caramelize- about 10 minutes or more depending on stove You may use a spoon to check for thickness.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Finally add peanuts and coconut, quickly mix until all the ingredients have been fully combined . Remove immediately and spread mixture onto prepared pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Let it cool completely and firms up, then use a sharp knife to break into pieces. Store in airtight container.

title: Homemade Golden Syrup (转化糖浆, Invert Sugar Syrup)
description: This homemade golden syrup recipe was created to be used for traditional Cantonese mooncakes and other Chinese desserts.

ingredients.name: (1/4 cup) fresh lemon juice (, strained (from 1 big lemon))
(3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons) filtered water (, and more to brush on the pot)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Juice one big lemon. Drain lemon juice through a coarse strainer, discard the seeds and fruit bits. Place a funnel (or the funnel part of a coffee machine) over a cup and line a coffee filter inside. Pour in lemon juice and let drain. If the coffee filter gets clogged, change to a new filter. Alternatively, you can use several layers of cheesecloth or a fine strainer to drain the lemon juice. Measure 50 milliliters lemon juice in a bowl. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a cup of filtered water and a silicon blush.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine caster sugar and 200 milliliters filtered water in a small stainless pot (or ceramic pot). The deeper the pot, the better. (*see footnote 1) Do not use a pot made of aluminum or cast iron. Heat over medium heat until bringing to a boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add lemon juice. Keep cooking until it reaches a boil again. Turn to low heat and let the solution simmer. I used a heat level of 2.5 out of 10 on an electric stove. (*see footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Do not stir the syrup from this point forward.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While simmering the sugar. Dip a basting brush in water and brush along the walls of the pot to let the water run down into the syrup. This helps prevent the sugar from crystallizing along the walls of the pot. You might only need to do this at the beginning of the cooking.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Check on the syrup every 10 minutes during simmering. If you notice any crystal-like masses appearing on the walls of the pot (close to the surface of the syrup), brush water over the mass to dissolve it and let it run down into the syrup.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: It takes 40 minutes to 1 hour to cook the syrup. Keep close watch after 35 minutes. You should notice the color of the syrup turning darker and more bubbles appearing on the surface in the last 10 minutes of cooking. The pictures below shows the the syrup after 30 minutes and 40 minutes of simmering.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When the syrup color turns amber, measure with a clean thermometer. The temperature should register 230 to 239 degrees F (or 110 to 115 degrees C). It took me 54 minutes to simmer the syrup. (*see footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: If the temperature of the syrup raised too fast while its color still pale, you can add more water and let simmering a bit longer.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: When the syrup is done, remove pot from heat and let cool completely.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Transfer the golden syrup to a clean, airtight jar and store in room temperature. If you sanitize the jar, the golden syrup can be stored up to a year.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: The golden syrup will be ready to use after 24 hours. The taste gets much better after 2 to 3 days. The bubbles will disappear and the sourness will reduce significantly, thus producing a fruity aroma and more concentrated flavor.

title: Ragda Chaat
description: Ragda chaat recipe is an easy and delicious chaat made with dried white peas or safed matar, spices and herbs.

onion, (- medium to large, finely chopped)
sev ((fried gram flour vermicelli), add as required)
to 6 Papdi (- broken or crushed into small pieces)
black salt (or regular salt, as required)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soaking and pressure cooking dry white peas

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preparing ragda for ragda chaat

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assembling and making ragda chaat

title: Traditional Lagana recipe (Greek Shrove Monday Bread)
description: This traditional Greek Lagana recipe will give you the authentic, unique flavour of this delicious Greek flat-bread, scented with the aromas of white wine and tahini.

ingredients.name: dry white wine (1 oz.) or alternatively water

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek Lagana bread recipe add in a mixer’s bowl the water, yeast, sugar, wine and tahini and mix to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the flour and salt to coat the water and set aside for 10 minutes. Do not blend the flour in the water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using the dough hook, mix the ingredients (medium speed) for about 7 minutes, until the dough is soft and does not crumble. Depending on the kind of flour used, the weather and many other factors, you may need to use from 500 to 520g flour. Leave 20g of flour aside and add a little bit at a time, until the dough is firm and not too sticky.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Coat lightly a bowl with olive oil, place the dough for the Lagana inside and cover. Let it rise in warm environment for about 1 hour, or until it doubles its size.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For this Lagana recipe you need to use a large baking tray, approx. 35*25cm. Oil the bottom and sides of the baking tray and gently deflate the dough. Spread the dough for the Lagana evenly on the tray and let it rise for another 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Using your finger, poke some holes across the surface of the Lagana bread and sprinkle with water and sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake the Lagana in preheated oven at 180C for 25-30 minutes or until crispy and deep golden.

title: Galbi (Korean BBQ Beef Short Ribs)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: 3-4 pounds beef short ribs (good quality English cut)
about 1/2 of a medium Korean/Asian pear grated
about 1/2 of a medium onion grated

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the ribs and drain water. Trim excess fat. Butterfly the short ribs so the meat is 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. (See below for the instructions.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all marinade ingredients well. Marinate the meat for at least 6 hours (overnight for best results). The thicker the meat the longer you'll want to marinate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: It's best to grill over charcoal or wood charcoal (sootbul), but a gas grill works well too. Grill over medium high to high heat, turning only once, 2 - 3 minutes on each side. Make sure to preheat the grill for nice grill marks.

title: Vegan Kung Pao Tofu
description: This is a vegan kung pao tofu recipe developed based on kung pao chicken.

ingredients.name: firm tofu or extra firm tofu
green pepper ( , cut into small pieces)
to 5 dried red chili pepper ( , I use whole pieces to reduce the hotness)
leek scallions ( , cut the white part into small sections)
tsp. a small pinch of salt

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the firm tofu into cubes around 2 cm. And then drain to remove the water on the surface.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut red pepper and green pepper into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix all the ingredients for stir-fry sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up 3 tablespoons of peanut oil in wok. And get the cubes in to stir-fry until tofu becomes gold-brown in surface. Move the tofu cubes out and pour the extra oil out of the wok, left around 1 tablespoon of oil in.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry dried chili pepper and Sichuan peppercorn until aroma and then place ginger, garlic and half of leek onion in to stir-fry over slow fire until fragrant; return tofu cubes in along with pepper pieces.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Slightly stir the kung pao sauce and pour in. Give everything a give stir fry until the tofu cubes are well coated. Add toasted peanuts and the remaining leek onion sections. Mix well and serve with steamed rice or noodles.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Easy Chicken Fried Rice with carrots and fresh cucumber.

ingredients.name: boneless chicken chests ( , or 2 chicken thighs)
Half of a middle size carrot chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the chicken meat into cubes around 2cm and marinade with the sauce for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in pan. Put chicken cubs in to stir fry until the surface becomes slightly white.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cucumber and carrot in and continue to stir fry for 2 minutes or until soft.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Put leftover rice in. Add sale, light soy sauce and black pepper powder in and mix evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garnish some chopped spring onion and serve hot!

title: Stuffed Omelette ไข่ยัดไส้ (kai yud sai)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: cilantro root, chopped (or substitute 3 cilantro stems, finely chopped)
g. ground pork (you can use other ground meat or crumbled tofu)
Garnish: Finely julienned red bell pepper and cilantro

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pound together garlic, white peppercorns, and cilantro roots in a mortar and pestle until a paste is achieved.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a bowl, mix together ground pork and soy sauce until well combined, mashing the pork to get rid of the "pork tubes."

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok or a saute pan, heat a little vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the garlic mixture and stir until aromatic and the garlic starts to turn golden. Add onion and tomato and cook until the onion is translucent and the tomato begins to mush, about 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add ground pork, sugar, oyster sauce and cook, stirring constantly, until pork is almost done. Add long beans and stir for another 30-45 seconds until the pork is fully cooked. If you have liquid pooling at the bottom, turn up the heat and cook until the sauce is no longer pooling. Remove from heat, then taste and adjust seasoning; you may wish to add a teaspoon or so of tamarind juice to brighten up the flavours. Keep warm while you make the omelette.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Beat 2 eggs with fish sauce well until there are no bits of egg whites remaining. In a large (12-inch) frying pan, brush the bottom with vegetable oil and heat over medium heat (if you a using a good non-stick pan, you just need to lightly grease it). Once the pan is hot, add the eggs and tilt the pan until the entire surface of the pan is coated evenly. Reduce heat to low and let the egg cook until the top is dry and the bottom has a light golden brown colour; if your burner is smaller than the pan, move the pan around to ensure even browning. When the egg is dry, remove from heat and run a rubber spatula along the edges of the omelette to release it from the pan. For the next step, you can transfer the egg onto a plate (browned side down) or leave it in the pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Put most of the filling in the middle of the omelette, reserving about 2 Tbsp, and fold the edges over on 4 sides, creating a square package.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To flip the omelette onto a serving plate: Place the serving plate upside down on top of the omelette and, holding the serving plate securely, quickly flip the pan (or plate, if you've moved the omelette to a plate).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To serve: Score an "X" on top of the egg with a knife, open up the flaps and add the reserved filling on top to give it some extra height (you may need to push the filling around a bit to get a nice mound). Close the flaps (or leave them open) and garnish with some cilantro sprigs and finely julienned red bell pepper. Serve with jasmine rice.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Egg Salad Recipe
description: Simple and satisfying chickpea egg salad recipe, prepared Mediterranean-style! Tons of texture and flavor.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
Persian cucumbers, (or 1/2 seedless English cucumber, diced)
to 3 green onions, (trimmed, and chopped (both white and green parts))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl or mason jar, mix together the dressing ingredients. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, add all the salad ingredients except the eggs. Give the dressing a quick whisk and pour over the salad. Mix to combine. Add the sliced eggs, and mix gently again. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Add a sprinkle more sumac. Set aside a few minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld. (See recipe notes for preparing ahead). Enjoy!

title: African Yam Soup Stew
description: African Yam Soup (Stew) - flavorful, gratifying and is easy to put together stew packed with health goodness. A must-have dish on weekly rotation.

ingredients.name: -2 pounds yam peeled and cut into medium pieces (sub potatoes)
fish (tilapia,snapper, or chicken (thighs, legs)(cleaned and cut into medium pieces))
Optional Salt and pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a food processor or blender, blend, garlic, tomatoes, parsley, basil, onions, and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add to a large pot, together with the white pepper, smoked paprika, Maggie/bouillon, green onion, and about 3 cups of water, bring to a boil. If using chicken, add at this point. Then let it simmer for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Gently add yams, fish, carrots, salt and more water about 2 cups – enough to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil and let simmer for about 10 minutes.Adjust for seasonings.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove and serve warm.

title: Crispy Fried Calamari recipe (Kalamarakia Tiganita)
description: Crispy and perfectly seasoned fried calamari recipe (kalamarakia tiganita)! A favorite Greek meze that is served in every fish tavern (Psarotaverna) and you should really give it a try making it at home.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy fried calamari recipe, clean the calamari and wash thoroughly. Using a sharp knife cut the calamari in slices, approx. 1 cm each. This will create the rings, as seen in the picture below. Place the calamari rings on some paper towel to get ride of the excessive water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the seasoning for the fried calamari. In a blender add the seasoning and pulse until powdered. (Alternatively you can use a pestle.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large sandwich bag or tupperware add the flour and seasoning. Place in the sliced calamari and shake well to coat (you will need to do this in batches). Remove the calamari onto a plate, shaking of any excess flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Into a medium sized frying pan pour enough vegetable oil to deep fry the calamari. Heat the oil to medium high heat until it begins to bubble. Test if the oil is hot enough by dipping one of the calamari rings in; if it sizzles the oil is ready. Fry the calamari in batches for about 2-3 minutes, until nicely golden.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the fried calamari using a slotted spoon and place on some paper towel to dry for 1-2 minutes. Have a taste and sprinkle with some more salt.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Enjoy this delicious Greek fried calamari recipe with a last minute squeeze of a lemon.

title: Mom’s Best Honey Lemon Tea
description: A family recipe that teaches you how to create the best honey lemon tea. By marinating lemons in honey, it creates a drink that has a much richer and smoother body. It’s soothing, healing, and so comforting!

title: Jangjorim (Soy Braised Beef)
description: Jangjorim is a soy-braised beef dish. It's a slightly sweet, salty side dish that goes well with any Korean meal!

ingredients.name: beef brisket, flank steak, or shank meat
of Korean radish, mu, cut into big chunks
whole black peppers (or ground peppers to taste)
soup soy sauce (guk ganjang, 국간장) ((or use more regular soy sauce))
3-inch square dried kelp ((or a bay leaf))
to 12 Shishito peppers (or other fresh green peppers) (Use less and cut into halves if using large peppers)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into 2 to 3-inch rectangles.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a covered medium pot, bring 8 cups of water and the next 6 ingredients to a boil. Continue to boil for 5 minutes over medium high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drop the meat into the pot. Bring it to a gentle boil, and remove the scum. Reduce the heat to medium. Boil, covered, for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the meat. Strain the cooking liquid into a large bowl, and then add 2.5 cups of the liquid back to the pot. (You can save the remaining broth to make a soup or stew later.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the meat and sauce ingredients to the pot. Bring it to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium, and boil, covered, until the meat is tender and the sauce is reduced to about ⅓, about 20 minutes. You can cook longer if the meat is still not tender enough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the optional dried kelp, peppers and eggs and continue to boil for about 10 minutes. Discard the kelp, and transfer everything else to an airtight container for storage. Cool before storing in the fridge. Shred the meat and pour some sauce over to serve.

title: Breakfast Congee โจ้ก (jok)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Ground pork, as much as you'd like

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Process all ingredients in a food processor until it resembles a paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring water to a boil, add rice and stir occasionally. Once rice starts to thicken, stir constantly until the rice is thick and broken down to the desired consistency.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Put egg in a bowl and slowly pour off-the-boil water over it until it's completely submerged. Let the egg sit for 10 minutes, then immediately transfer it into cold water to stop the cooking. Note: 10 minutes is the time it takes using the setup shown in the video. The more water you have (i.e. the larger the bowl), the less time you will need because the water will stay hot longer. If you're doing multiple eggs or using different sized eggs, the time it takes may also vary. I suggest starting with 10 minutes and then adjust for your next time.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring pork stock to a boil and add the ground pork in bite-sized chunks. Season the stock with soy sauce and salt. When the pork is half way done, add the rice base and stir to break up lumps. When the pork is done and the rice is well mixed, remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Crack the soft boiled egg into the serving bowl and then pour in the jok. Top with white pepper, ginger, and green onions/cilantro. Enjoy with some Thai iced coffee!

steps.title: Step 6

title: Mushroom and Cabbage Stir Fry
description: Mushroom and cabbage stir-fry with a spicy and sour taste. Vegan reciepe.

ingredients.name: middle size cabbage ( , hand shredded into small pieces)
button mushroom ( , or white mushroom sliced)
One small bunch of chive ( , cut into sections around 10 cm long)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash and hand shredded the cabbage into small pieces. And then slice the mushrooms, garlic and cut dried chili pepper into small section.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in pan, add garlic and dried chili pepper to stir fry until aroma.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add mushroom and cabbage to stir-fry for another 4~5 minutes or until the cabbage becomes soft.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add soy sauce, black vinegar, cooking wine and salt. Mix well;

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add chive to add extra flavor; transfer and serve.

title: Mediterranean Lemon Poached Halibut Recipe
description: Easy and quick poached halibut recipe. So delicate and packed with Mediterranean flavors from spices to aromatics and fresh herbs!

ingredients.name: Halibut fillet (I used wild Alaskan Halibut)
Private Reserve Extra Virgin Olive Oil
large basil leaves, gathered together and thinly sliced (chiffonade)
scallions, both white and green parts, chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix all the spices, salt and pepper, to make the spice blend.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat halibut fillet dry, and rub both sides with the spice rub. Set aside at room temperature for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet like this one, add 1 1/2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil to coat the bottom of the skillet. Heat over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add chopped onions, and cook over medium-low heat for 4 minutes, tossing regularly until translucent. Add garlic and cook another 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now add the chicken broth, wine, lemon juice, lemon zest, fresh herbs, and capers.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring liquid to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and carefully add the fish in. Cover the skillet loosely with foil or a lid and cook on low for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the fish is opaque and flaky, firm but not dry.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the skillet from heat. Top the fish with more fresh herbs, capers, grated carrots, and chopped scallions.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If you cooked the fish in one piece like I did, cut into desired portions and serve in shallow bowls with the lemon-wine poaching liquid. You can simply add crusty bread to sop up the liquid, or serve atop plain orzo or Lebanese rice!

title: Cassava Pone
description: Cassava Pone – an African dessert that is decadent, dense pudding with crisp edges made with cassava and coconut milk and packed with great flavors. A good and healthy alternative to the usual cakes!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Grease and flour to 9x13 baking dish or use a baking spray. Set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients: grated coconut, frozen defrost cassava, coconut milk, melted butter, sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, minced ginger, salt and vanilla. Mix well until all the ingredients have been fully combined. If using raisins you may add at this point.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the mixture in the prepared baking dish and bake for about 60 minutes or until the center is firm. If it is still wobbly add another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove and let it cool for about 10 minutes, then cut in squares and serve.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: You may top with whipped cream and toasted coconut or fruits.

title: Bread machine sourdough bread recipe
description: This is my go-to Bread machine sourdough bread recipe. This is a true sourdough bread, without yeast that tastes and feels just like an artisan loaf!

ingredients.name: sugar or a drizzle of honey
sugar or a drizzle of honey

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In your bread machine basket, pour in your sourdough starter then the flour

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add in the sugar/honey, salt and the butter

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in your water around the edges of the baking basket

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Set your bread machine to the kneading cycle for 30 minutes or if it has a sourdough dough cycle use that. For the Panasonic SD-ZX2522 use menu 29. For the Panasonic SD-ZB2512 use menu 26.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once your sourdough bread has finished kneading, let your dough rest and proof for 3-4 hours or until it has risen by about 50% of its original size. For the Panasonic SD-ZX2522, use menu 30 for about 2 hours and 30 minutes to accelerate the proofing or let it rest with the machine switched off for about 4 hours for a more sour flavour. For the Panasonic SD-ZB2512KXE use menu 27 for the same amount of time (2h 30mins). Note that proofing time will depend on how active your sourdough starter is so adjust accordingly until your bread has risen the right amount.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once proofed, sprinkle some flour on top and score lengthwise with a sharp knife or a blade. Pop any large bubbles that may have appeared on the surface.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Set your bread machine to the bake programme and set its timer for 1 hour and 15 minutes. For the Panasonic SD-ZX2522 and the Panasonic SD-ZB2512, use menu 18.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once done, remove the basket and tip the bread over to an airing rack. Let it cool down for about an hour before cutting it.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: If you want to prepare your bread overnight and own a Panasonic bread machine use menu 10 for the Panasonic SD-ZB2512 and menu 11 for the Panasonic SD-ZX2522. The loaf will be slightly denser so I recommend going with the 75% Hydration – Lighter dough recipe above.

title: Chana Dal Pakora (Lentil Fritters)
