title: Hawthorn Berry Juice
description: Imported from omnivorescookbook.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add hawthorn berries into a large pot and rinse several times with tap water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add water to cover the hawthorn berries. Sprinkle salt over the water and mix well. Let sit for 5 to 10 minutes, in order to clean the fruit thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Rinse with tap water again. Transfer to a colander to drain. Set aside until the berries are dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To prepare hawthorn berries, use a knife to cut the fruit in half against the seed. Hold each piece of the fruit with both hands and gently squeeze and pull until the fruit separates in half. Use the knife to gently pry the seed out. Use the knife to cut off the tough end of the bottom. Set aside and prepare the rest of the hawthorn berries in the same way.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: (Optional) If you are using multi-crystal rock sugar, the sugar might come in large chunks. To break it into small pieces (so they dissolve better), place rock sugar into a paper (or plastic) bag and hit it with a small hammer (or the back of a cleaver).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer all the hawthorn berries to a large pot. Spread rock sugar on top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bring 1.4 liter (1.5 quarts) water to a boil. Let it cool for 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour the hot water over hawthorn berries and give it a quick stir with a ladle. Cover and place the pot in a cool place for 24 hours (or place in the fridge after it cools enough to do so).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When the hawthorn juice is ready the next day, use a ladle to mix again. Transfer the juice and hawthorn berries into clean airtight jars (you can refer to this article about how to sterilize jars).

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: About storage

title: Tangsuyuk (Sweet and sour beef or pork)
description: A Korean-Chinese style sweet and sour pork or beef

ingredients.name: tender cut of pork or beef (such as pork loin or beef sirloin)
potato starch (or corn starch, soaked in 1 cup of water for 2 to 3 hours)
canola or vegetable oil for deep frying
Starch slurry – 2 tablespoons starch* in 4 tablespoons water

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: At least an hour before cooking this dish, combine 1 cup of the starch with 1 cup of water and refrigerate until ready to use. The starch and water will separate, and you will need to pour out the water on top to use the soaked starch at the bottom.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the beef (or pork) into 2 to 2.5-inch long strips (about 3/4-inch wide and ⅛ - inch thick). Mix well with the grated ginger, and lightly sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let it sit until ready to deep fry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables by cutting into thin bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a pan, add 1 cup of water along with the remaining sauce ingredients except the starch slurry. Boil just until the sugar melts and turn off the heat. You will finish the sauce when the meat has been deep fried.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Carefully pour out the soaking water from the starch. Use your hand to mix the soaked starch with the egg and oil. The starch will be very stiff. The addition of oil will help loosen it a little.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Coat the meat with the starch batter.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add 4 cups of oil to a deep fryer, wok or large pot. Heat over high heat to 350°F. Using metal tongs or chopsticks, drop the meat in the oil one piece at a time. Do not crowd the oil. Cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes, in two or three batches, reheating the oil to 350°F between the batches.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove them with a wire skimmer or a slotted spoon. Drain on a wire rack or in a large mesh strainer set on a bowl.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Reheat the oil to 350°F. Add the meat (you can do this in one batch for the second frying) and deep fry again for 2 to 3 minute. Drain on a wire rack or in a large mesh strainer set on a bowl.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bring the sauce to a boil again. Add the carrot, onion, and optional mushrooms, which take slightly longer to cook than the green vegetable. When the sauce boils, add the starch slurry, stirring well. Taste the sauce and add a little more sugar or vinegar if desired. Turn the heat off, and then add the cucumber slices (or green pepper if using). The green vegetables lose their color quickly if boiled in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place the meat on a large serving plate and pour the tangsuyuk sauce on top or serve the sauce on the side. Serve immediately with the optional dipping sauce.

title: Zucchini Enchiladas
description: This zucchini enchiladas recipe uses thinly sliced zucchini instead of traditional tortillas! They're low carb, gluten free and fun to make!

ingredients.name: optional toppings: chopped cilantro and sour cream

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions, bell peppers and garlic. Saute for 5 minutes, until vegetables have softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ground turkey, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and oregano. Mix together and break up the meat using a spatula. Cook for 8-10 minutes, until the meat has browned and fully cooked through. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place zucchini slices in between two sheets of paper towels and pat down to remove any excess moisture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375°F. Lay out two large rectangular baking dishes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lay out 3 slices of zucchini and overlap each of them lengthwise about halfway to create one long zucchini base.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place about 1-2 tablespoons of ground turkey mixture in the middle of the zucchini and roll up like an enchilada.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the zucchini roll in the baking dish and repeat until all the ground turkey has been used.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Top enchiladas with a small spoonful of enchilada sauce and a pinch of shredded cheese.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese has melted. Top with sour cream and cilantro if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Egusi Pudding
description: Egusi Pudding - highly addictive savory bites made with African egusi seeds and chunks of protein and spices. Makes a wonderful snack bites or as side dish.

ingredients.name: beef boiled (cut in bite size) (, reserve about 1 ½ cup broth)
small scotch bonnet pepper minced or 1 teaspoon dried pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil beef with salt, pepper and some chopped onions in a medium pot until tender. You can add the smoked fish depending on its texture. . Reserve the stock for later use.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the stock and meat, fish, crayfish, pepper to the egusi. Mix well, until fully combine. Adjust for salt add more if needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place egusi mixture into prepared baking cups. Cover with mixture until about three quarters full. Gently place ramekins pans to the large baking pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring the water (to place in the large baking dish) to a light simmer on top of the stove; carefully pour hot water into the baking pan to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins cups.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees for about an hour. Let it rest for about 10 minutes or more before removing aluminum foil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully remove aluminum foil with an oven mitten.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let egusi pudding rest for about 10 minutes or more before serving.

title: Loaded Mediterranean Omelette
description: An especially satisfying and perfectly fluffy omelette, loaded with Mediterranean favorites. Turn it into lunch or a simple dinner for two with a side of warm pita bread and Greek Tzatziki sauce!

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper, to your liking (I used about 1/2 tsp each)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
tzatziki sauce recipe to serve, optional
to 1/3 cup marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
chopped fresh parsley, more for later
chopped fresh mint, more for later
Crumbled feta cheese, to your liking, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, add the eggs, milk, baking powder (if using), spices, salt and pepper. Quickly and vigorously whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a 10-inch non-stick skillet, heat extra virgin olive oil until shimmering but not smoking. Be sure to tilt the skillet to coat the bottom well with oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the egg mixture in and immediately stir with a heat-resistant spatula for like 5 seconds. Then push the cooked portions at the edge toward the center, tilting the pan to allow uncooked egg to fill in around the edges. When no more egg runs to the sides, continue to cook until almost set and the bottom is light golden (about 1 minute.) Remember, the omelette has more time to cook once filled and folded.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the skillet from the heat. Spoon a good portion of the toppings onto the center third of the omelette. Use the spatula to fold. Add the remainder of the toppings on top. Sprinkle a little more fresh herbs.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Slice the omelette into two halves and serve hot. If you like, add a side of Greek tzatziki sauce and warm pita bread. Enjoy!

title: Tagliatelle with Eggplants and Feta Cheese
description: A delicious vegetarian 20 minute pasta recipe, perfect for a light summery meal! Eggplant and feta cheese in tomato based sauce full of mediterannean flavours.

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes, chopped in small cubes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven at 250C. Chop the eggplants into cubes and place on a baking tray. Drizzle with some olive oil and bake for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, roughly chop the onions and the tomatoes. Place a large saucepan at medium-high heat, add 5 tbsps of olive oil and sauté the onions and the garlic, for 3 minutes, until soft. As soon as the onions are lightly colored, add 1 tsp of sugar and caramelize. Add the tomato paste and stir well. Turn the heat up and add the chopped tomatoes; cook for 5-6 minutes, with the lid on. At the end, remove the whole clove of garlic, add the baked eggplants and the herbs and season well with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime, boil the pasta, according to package instructions. Without draining the pasta, remove the pasta from the water, using a large fork and add them into the tomato sauce. Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and stir well. Serve on a big platter, drizzle with some extra virgin olive oil and top with some crumbled feta.

title: Chinese Fish En Papillote (Paper wrapped fish in sesame ginger sauce)
description: Instead of cooking your fish the same old way, try this Fish en Papillote that treats cod to a gingery soy sauce for a delicate and flavorful meal that’s ready in 22 minutes!

ingredients.name: (6 oz / 170 g) cod fillet ((or sea bass, or other type of white fish))
to 3 stalks small heads of Chinese broccoli (or baby bok choy, or yu choy, cut into about 8” (20 cm) pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small saucepan, heat the sesame oil over low heat until it becomes fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the ginger to the pan. Cook and stir for another minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, and sugar. Raise the heat to medium-low and let the mixture simmer for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut a piece of parchment paper that is approximately 12x15” (30x38 cm) and fold the longer side in half. Cut the folded paper into a wide half-heart shape. Unfold the paper and now it should look like a heart shape.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: You will need to arrange all the ingredients on one side of the heart, leaving enough space on the edges to seal the paper - place the Chinese broccoli in the center of one half of the heart, slightly closer to the fold crease and the rounded top. Drizzle half of the sauce and ginger over the Chinese broccoli.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Lay the fish on top of the Chinese broccoli. Drizzle the remaining sauce and ginger over the fish. Place the sprigs of cilantro on both sides of the fish.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fold the other half of the heart over the fish side. Starting at the top of the heart where it is rounded into a point, begin folding 1” (2.5 cm) sections towards the center of the package, pressing down well with each fold to seal it.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the package is completely sealed, place it onto a baking tray. Bake for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove the baking tray from the oven and let it rest until the parcel cools off a bit, 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Move the parcel to a large serving plate. Cut open the center of the parcel with a clean pair of scissors or a sharp knife. Serve immediately.

title: Oats Smoothie | Oatmeal Smoothie
description: This oats smoothie (oatmeal smoothie) is a quick, tasty and healthy smoothie made with mix fruits, milk and quick-cooking oats.

ingredients.name: mango (- large, or 1 cup peeled & chopped mangoes)
banana (- large or 2 medium or 3 small bananas - peeled and chopped)
sapota or chickoo (- medium sized, peeled and chopped)
to ⅔ cup milk ((vegan or dairy), cold)
or 2 tablespoons sugar (or honey or jaggery or maple syrup - optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and chop the fruits. I used a mix of mangoes, bananas and sapota (chikoo). You can use other fruits like apple, berries, figs etc.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the chopped fruits in a blender jar. Add milk and quick cooking oats. I did not add any sugar. But if you want you can sweeten the smoothie with sugar, jaggery or honey.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Blend till smooth. You can add some ice cubes if you want while blending.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the smoothie in glasses or mugs.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve oats smoothie immediately.

title: Broccoli Cauliflower Rice Chicken Casserole
description: This low carb and cheesy Broccoli Cauliflower Rice Chicken Casserole recipe is perfect for dinner and makes great leftovers. It's also gluten free!

ingredients.name: 10-ounce bags frozen cauliflower rice ((or 1 head of cauliflower, riced and cooked))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spray a large 3-quart baking dish with non-stick cooking spray or olive oil. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally to make them thinner, lightly coat them in olive oil and place on a baking sheet. Liberally season with salt and pepper and bake for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the chicken is baking, heat the bags of frozen cauliflower rice and broccoli according to package instructions. Discard any excess water or moisture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove chicken from oven and let cool for 5 minutes. Carefully chop baked chicken into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large bowl, add cooked cauliflower rice, broccoli, chicken, eggs, mozzarella cheese, salt, garlic powder, onion powder and butter. Toss together until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer casserole mixture to the prepared baking dish and top with the remaining Italian blend cheese.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake for 50 minutes, until the cheese on top has fully melted and started to brown slightly. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Simple Vegetarian Sweet Potato Stew, Mediterranean-Style
description: This healthy, vegetarian sweet potato stew will surprise your taste buds in the best way possible! Loaded with chunks of melt-in-your mouth sweet potatoes, tender carrots, tomatoes, and wilted baby spinach.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO)
sweet potatoes (about 1 lb), peeled and cubed
15-oz can diced tomatoes with their juices

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, add the spices (coriander, cumin, Aleppo pepper, and turmeric). Mix to combine. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add onions and garlic and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally and making sure garlic does not burn.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now, add carrots and sweet potatoes. Season with kosher salt, black pepper, and the spice mixture you prepared earlier. Raise the heat to medium-high, and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 4 to 5 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add diced tomatoes (and their juices), and broth. Bring to a boil for 10 minutes or so, then turn the heat to low. Cover the pot only part-way, allowing an opening at the top for the stew to “breath.” Cook for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until sweet potatoes are fully cooked and tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Finally, stir in the baby spinach and fresh parsley. Remove from heat, and finish with a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Serve over quick-cooked couscous or with your favorite crusty bread. Enjoy!

title: Thai Style Pork Stock
description: In Thai cuisine, pork stock is the most commonly used stock, and it is key in so many recipes, especially noodle soups. Make in bulk and freeze in zip top bags for ease of use! Also check out my Thai style chicken stock recipe.

ingredients.name: (900 g) pork bones, I use neck bones or back bones which are available at Asian butchers
Top half of one lemongrass, crushed and chopped into 2" pieces
cilantro roots, crushed, or 5 cilantro stems
4-inch section of a daikon or half an onion, peeled and large diced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the bones in cold water and add to a large stock pot. Cover the bones with the water and bring to a simmer over high heat. Reduce heat to medium or medium low to maintain a gentle simmer, and simmer for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Skim off all the scum that has floated to the top then add all of the aromatics and simmer for another hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If you want more volume you can top it up with some water, but keep in mind that the more water you add, the more diluted the stock will be.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Strain the stock, and if you see a lot of meat on the bones, pick it off and throw it into curries, stir fries, or anything else you'd like. Don't waste it!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: The stock will last up to a week in the fridge, but I always freeze my stock in portions for ease of use.

title: Traditional Spetsofai (Spetzofai) Recipe - Spicy Greek Sausages with Peppers and Tomato sauce
description: Looking for an authentic Greek Spetsofai recipe? Find out how to make this rustic, spicy Greek meze the traditional way, perfect with some salty feta...

ingredients.name: medium spicy country sausages, sliced (approx. 95g each)
sea salt and freshly ground pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek dish, place a saucepan over high heat, add one tbsp of olive oil and sauté the sausages, until nicely coloured. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on some kitchen paper and leave them aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into the same pan, add the rest of the olive oil, the chopped onion and season with freshly ground pepper; sauté for a minute. Add the garlic and tomato paste and sauté for one more minute. Add the peppers and continue sautéing.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Deglaze with the red wine, scraping the bottom of the pan, with all the delicacies, and wait for it to evaporate. Then add the sugar, the canned tomatoes, a cup of water, the herbs and spices, turn the heat down to medium and cook for 25-30 minutes with the lid on, until the peppers tenderise.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the sausages and cook a little bit longer, until the sauce thickens. Check for seasoning; if you’re using too spicy or salty sausages, you’ll probably won’t need to add any salt or pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve while still hot with some crusty bread aside or as a main dish with basmati rice. Enjoy!

title: Cassava Leaf Soup
description: Cassava leaf soup also known as saka saka or pondu is a simple, yet tasty and substantial soup that is widely consumed in many parts of Central Africa especially in countries like Sierra Leone, and Liberia.

ingredients.name: - 1 cup palm oil (I used ½ palm oil and half canola oil)
scotch bonnet pepper (1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large saucepan, season meat with salt, Maggi and onions and boil until tender, depending on the choice of meat. You should have at least 1-2 cups of stock. Remove the meat and beef stock, reserve

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a large sauce pan over medium heat , add onions and crayfish l, sauté until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add beef and or / smoked meat .

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in peanut butter or groundnut paste, then add stock about a cup cook for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Throw in the drained cassava leaves and continue cooking for about 25 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Finally if using shrimp add shrimp - cook until shrimp turns pink about 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Adjust seasonings (Maggie, salt, soup consistency with water and oil) to taste

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve warm over rice

title: Strawberry Smoothie | Strawberry Banana Smoothie
description: A 3 ingredient strawberry smoothie recipe that’s gluten-free, vegan, and easy to prepare in just minutes. Make this creamy and delicious strawberry banana smoothie for a healthy breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk (- lite or with a thin/medium consistency)

title: Sweet and Sour Salmon with Bok Choy
description: This super-simple sheet pan dinner of salmon bok choy is healthful and delicious for an impressive dish to serve guests or a good-for-you meal that’s ready super-fast! {Gluten-Free adaptable}

ingredients.name: fillets salmon (, about 4 oz (113 g) each (*Footnote 1))
bulbs baby bok choy (, split in half (*Footnote 2))
soy sauce ((or tamari for gluten free))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Adjust the oven rack so it’s 5” (13 cm) under the broiler.Turn on the broiler to preheat your oven.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small pot. Heat over medium-high heat until bringing to a boil. Boil for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring regularly, until the sauce is thick and glossy. Remove the pot from the heat and add the garlic. Stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Line a baking tray with parchment paper (optional, for easy clean up). Place the bok choy, flat side up on the tray. Brush the whole bok choy bulbs with a generous amount of sauce, making sure some sauce gets between the leaves of the bulb. Flip the bok choy and brush them again. Arrange the bok choy in an interlocking pattern with the leaves in the center. Place the salmon fillets between the bulbs, on top of the leaves (*Footnote 4). Brush both fillets generously with the sauce on all sides. (*Refer to the pictures in the blog post above to see how I arranged the bok choy and salmon)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Broil at 550°F (288°C) for 8 minutes, until the salmon is cooked through and sauce begins to caramelize. (*Footnote 5) Pull out the baking sheet and let everything sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve hot with the remaining sauce over rice. Drizzle with more sauce if needed, and enjoy!

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (or Spicy Pork Bulgogi)
description: Spicy Korean pork bulgogi marinated in a gochujang based sauce with lots of fresh garlic and ginger!

ingredients.name: thinly sliced pork shoulder or butt (or a combination of pork shoulder or butt and pork belly)
small apple grated, 3 - 4 tablespoons (or 2 T plum syrup, maesilcheong)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the meat, if not pre-sliced.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all marinade ingredients well in a large bowl. Add the meat and toss everything well to evenly coat the meat with the marinade. Add the onion and scallions and toss again. Let it sit for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grill or pan fry in a skillet (in 2 batches) over medium high heat until slightly caramelized. Adjust the heat as necessary.

title: Lemongrass Pandan Tea น้ำตะไคร้ใบเตย (nam takrai bai teoy)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Sugar or other sweetener, to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut lemongrass and pandan leaves into small pieces and add to boiling water. Let simmer for 7 minutes or until the water is fragrant and has turned a light green colour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Strain the tea and add sweetener to taste. Serve hot or let cool completely and serve cold over ice.

title: Salt and Pepper Tofu
description: Sichuan pepper and salt tofu. Excellent vegan recipe. Two versions introduced.

ingredients.name: block regular firm tofu ( , not super soft or firm)
fresh chilis ( , cut into small circles )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut tofu into small cubes and then coat with a thin layer of starch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in wok and slowly fry the tofu blocks until crispy and slightly browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove extra oil, only leave around 1 tablespoon of oil in pan, fry garlic, scallion and chili pepper until aromatic, turn off the fire. Return tofu and sprinkle salt and pepper. Toss well.

title: Mexican Arancini Rice Balls
description: These arancini rice balls are Mexican-spiced savory rice balls filled with melted cheese and covered in crispy panko breadcrumbs baked to golden perfection.

ingredients.name: freshly grated Parmesan cheese, (plus more for garnish)

title: Mediterranean Shrimp Soup
description: You'll love this quick and easy Mediterranean shrimp soup with vegetables, aromatics, and fresh herbs, including parsley and dill! Fresh lemon juice is the perfect finishing touch to this flavor-packed shrimp soup.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil)
large tomatoes, diced (canned diced tomato will work as well)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If using scallops, pat them dry and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a cast iron skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Gently add the sea scallops. Sear for about 1 1/2 minutes on each side. Scallops should form a golden brown crust. Sprinkle a large pinch of dried oregano. Transfer to a dish and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To the same cast iron skillet, add a little more extra virgin olive oil if needed. Again heat over medium-high until shimmering but not smoking. Add the shrimp; sear for about 2 minutes on both sides. You want to see some pink, but don’t worry about fully cooking it (you will finish cooking it in the soup.) Remove from the heat and sprinkle a generous pinch of dried oregano.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium heavy cooking pot, heat 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil on medium-high. Add the chopped peppers, onions, garlic, tomato paste, salt and the remaining dried oregano. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Add the diced tomatoes. Cook on medium-high for 3-5 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the liquid returns to a boil, add the orzo pasta. Turn heat down to medium and cook for 8 minutes until orzo is tender.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir in the baby spinach, parsley, dill, and lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Finally, stir in the scallops and shrimp to warm through (about 1 to 2 minutes.) Taste and adjust seasoning to your liking. Add crushed red pepper flakes for some heat, if you like. Serve with your favorite crusty bread.

title: Bitter Leaf Soup
description: Bitter Leaf soup is a robust West African soup, predominant in countries like Cameroon, Nigeria and Ghana.This dish is neither a soup nor sauce, but something in between – a slightly soupy vegetable that is served to accompany starchy food…

ingredients.name: -3 pounds of assorted meat (chicken, beef, smoked fish, smoked turkey)
washed bitterleaf (3 cups if using bitterleaf only)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pan season meat or chicken with salt, maggi and onions and boil until tender depending on the choice of meat. You should have about 3 cups of stock from the meat and smoked fish (if using any). Reserve the rest or freeze it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While chicken is cooking, slice tomatoes, onions and mince the garlic.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions. Sauté the onion until it is translucent, about 5 minutes. Season with salt, and pepper, to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the tomatoes with their juices, garlic, and crayfish. Add the chicken /beef pieces; press to submerge. Then add ground egusi with chicken stock bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add bitter-leaf, followed by spinach, let it simmer for about 2 minutes

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve warm with fufu or accompaniment of choice

title: Shrimp Egg Foo Young (鲜虾芙蓉蛋)
description: This is the only Egg Foo Young recipe you need. You can fill your omelet with any fillings you prefer and create a restaurant-style dish in your own kitchen!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Whisk together the Sauce ingredients in a saucepan over medium-low heat until the sauce simmers and thickens, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Beat together the eggs, bean sprouts, green onions, shrimp, salt, and white pepper powder in a bowl until well-combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat, and scoop about 1/2 cup of the egg mixture into the skillet to make a patty.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side, and repeat with the remaining egg mixture. Set the patties aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spoon the sauce over the patties.

title: Berry Smoothie Recipe (Berry Blast)
description: This mixed berry smoothie recipe gives you a thick and creamy café-style berry blast drink made with fresh or frozen berries, yogurt and banana.

ingredients.name: to 2 tablespoons sugar (or 1 to 2 tablespoon maple syrup or agave syrup, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse all the berries well and drain thoroughly. Hull and chop the strawberries if needed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all the berries, banana and Greek yogurt to a blender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add sugar or maple syrup depending on how sweet or tangy the berries are.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Blend till smooth and creamy. Add about ¼ to ½ cup of milk or water if the smoothie looks too thick.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: You can also add a few ice cubes if you prefer a colder smoothie and blend again briefly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste and adjust sweetness or consistency as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

title: Red Bean Paste
description: Homemade sweet red bean paste with two ways (simplified smashed version and traditional smooth versioin)

ingredients.name: tbsp. butter, lard or vegetable oil
tbsp. butter or vegetable oil ( ,28 to 30g)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the red beans and soak the dried red beans at least 8 hours or overnight. Longer soaking time can shorten the cooking time.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain and add around 3 cups of water in a high pressure cooker along with the beans.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook the beans for around 40 minutes or until quite soft.

title: Musaengchae (Sweet and sour radish salad)
description: Refreshing, sweet and sour Korean radish salad

ingredients.name: red chili pepper flakes (gochugaru, (finely ground) - optional (see note))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the radish and carrot by scrubbing with a brush and/or scratching off the stubborn impurities with a small knife. Cut into match sticks. You can use a mandoline if you have one. Use the thickest blade.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all the remaining ingredients. Mix well by hand until the sugar is dissolved and the radish is evenly coated with the gochugaru (if using). Taste and add more vinegar or sugar to your liking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Let sit for at least 30 minutes before serving. It will taste better the next day.

title: Rice & Sausage Salad ยำแหนมข้าวทอด (yum naem kao tod)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 3-4 kaffir lime leaves, center rib removed, thinly julienned
Sawtooth coriander or mint, roughly chopped (optional)
Fresh lime juice (I used about half a lime for every serving of 2 rice balls)
Fish sauce (I used about 2 teaspoons for every serving of 2 rice balls, but start with 1 teaspoon and adjust from there)
Crisp lettuce for wrapping such as green leaf, romaine, or butter lettuce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the rice balls: In a large mixing bowl, stir together curry paste, fish sauce, sugar, kaffir lime leaves, grated coconut meat, and egg until well mixed. Add the rice and mix well. Form the rice into balls of about 2-inch diameter; you can also flatten them into pucks if you want to use less oil for frying. Press the balls together tightly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat frying oil in a pot until it reaches 350 F. Stir the rice flour with water to achieve a thin batter. Dip the rice balls into the batter, let excess batter drip off, and fry them in the oil until crispy and golden browned, about 8 minutes. If you're foregoing the batter, it will take slightly less time. Let the rice balls cool while you prep the salad bar.

steps.title: Step 3

Taste and adjust the flavour and amounts of ingredients to your liking. You can eat the salad just like that or wrap each bite in a crisp piece of lettuce.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, until softened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

title: Lebanese Rice with Vermicelli
description: Vegan Lebanese rice with vermicelli and pine nuts. A great side dish next to many Mediterranean favorites.

toasted pine nuts, optional to finish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the rice well (a few times) then place it in a medium bowl and cover with water. Soak for 15 to 20 minutes. Test to see if you can easily break a grain of rice by simply placing it between your thumb and index finger. Drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium non-stick cooking pot, heat the olive oil on medium-high. Add the vermicelli and continuously stir to toast it evenly. Vermicelli should turn a nice golden brown, but watch carefully not to over-brown or burn it (If it burns, you must throw the vermicelli away and start over).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the rice and continue to stir so that the rice will be well-coated with the olive oil. Season with salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now add 3 1/2 cups of water and bring it to a boil until the water significantly reduces (see the photo below).Turn the heat to low and cover.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook for 15-20 minutes on low. Once fully cooked, turn the heat off and leave the rice undisturbed in it’s cooking pot for 10-15 minutes, then uncover and fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Traditional Soutzoukakia recipe (Greek baked Meatballs in tomato sauce)
description: An authentic Soutzoukakia recipe as introduced to the Greek cuisine in the beginning of the 20th century.

ingredients.name: of ground cumin (if you are a fan of cumin, try 3-4 teaspoons)
of stale bread soaked in red wine and squeezed dry or 1 cup of breadcrumbs
tomato juice (passata) or tinned chopped tomatoes (800g or 28 oz)
salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the soutzoukakia, knead all meatball ingredients together and leave the mixture in the fridge for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once done, portion your meatballs and shape them into oblong meatballs about 70g/2.4oz in size. You can shallow fry gently in oil till golden brown or for a lighter dish, bake the soutzoukakia in the oven at 200C/390F till golden brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While your Soutzoukakia are baking, its time to prepare the tomato sauce. Start by sauté the onion in olive oil on medium heat until translucent. Stir in the tomato paste, cumin and a bit of salt and pepper and fry for 2 minutes. Add the squashed garlic and fry for 3-4 minutes until the garlic has cooked and its aromas coming through. Finally add the wine, the tomato juice or your tinned chopped tomatoes, sugar and the bay leaf. Bring to a boil, turn the heat down to low and simmer until the Soutzoukakia sauce starts to thicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Its now time to bring your Soutzoukakia together! Gently place the fried/ baked soutzoukakia in the tomato sauce and stir gently, being careful not to break them. Cover your pan with a lid and let them simmer on low heat for 30 minutes so the meatballs absorb all the wonderful flavours from the tomato sauce. While they are cooking give them a taste and add salt and pepper to your taste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If the sauce starts to thicken too soon, add a splash of water and stir through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve the soutzoukakia (baked meatballs) while still hot with some rice or mashed potatoes and lots of tomato sauce. Enjoy!!

steps.title: Step 4

title: Walnut-filled, Crescent -Shaped Pastries (Skaltsounia)
description: Soft and crunchy crescent-shaped pastries (skaltsounia) with a delicious, flavorful walnut, jam and apple filling. This delicious treat is perfect with a nice cup of tea and as its egg and butter free, perfect for the Easter lent season!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the dough for the skaltsounia, pour into a large bowl the oil and sugar and whisk; add the wine, and the flour and blend well, using your hands, until the ingredients combine. Knead the dough, until it softens. Depending on the flour, you may need to use a little bit less or more flour than the recipe calls for. The dough should be soft, but not sticky. Leave the dough to rest for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, prepare the filling for the skaltsounia. Grate the apple into a large bowl, add the sugar, the chopped walnuts, the breadcrumbs, the jam and cinnamon. Blend well, until the ingredients combine. In Greece one can find a variety of those pastries, using different kinds of fillings, depending on the region, so feel free to experiment with the ingredients you like the most!

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the dough on a floured surface. Cut it in half and roll out each half to a thickness of about 0.4 cm. Using a 10-12 cm cutter, cut out the dough in circles. If you find it difficult to roll out the dough, take a piece of the dough (the size of a walnut) and using your hands, stretch it into a circle; repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place a teaspoon of the filling on each circle and fold the dough, creating a half-moon. Join the edges well, pressing with your fingers.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180C / 350F. Place the pastries (skaltsounia) on a large baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the skaltsounia from the oven, leave to cool for a while and sprinkle with icing sugar. Enjoy!

title: Cilantro Lime Beer Can Chicken Tacos
description: Juicy and tender beer can chicken marinated in a flavorful cilantro lime marinade and served on warm tortillas with a quick slaw.

ingredients.name: (4-5 pound) Simply Nature Fresh Organic Whole Chicken
Specially Selected Sicilian Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Simply Nature Organic Apple Cider Vinegar
(12-ounce) can Hopping Nomad Session IPA Beer

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prep the chicken: Remove the neck and giblets from the whole chicken and discard. Pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to a gallon zip-top storage bag and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the marinade: Add cilantro, oil, onion, lime zest, lime juice, garlic, apple cider vinegar, salt, chili powder, cumin, and black pepper to a food processor or blender. Pulse until smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Marinate the chicken: Pour the marinade over the chicken in the zip-top storage bag, close, and massage into the chicken so that it is completely coated. Place chicken in the refrigerator and marinate overnight, or up to 24 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prep the grill: When ready to grill, preheat the grill to medium heat (350°F-375°F) by lighting the burners (or charcoal) on only one half of the grill, and leaving them off on the other half. This creates a zone of direct heat and a zone of indirect heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the beer can in the chicken: Remove the chicken from the storage bag and shake off any excess marinade. Open the can of beer and discard (or drink) half of it. Lower the chicken onto the half-full beer, placing the can in the cavity with the chicken sitting upright.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Grill: Carefully place the chicken with the beer can onto the cool side of the grill so that it’s over indirect heat. The legs of the chicken and the beer can will act as a tripod so that the chicken sits upright. Close the lid and let the chicken cook for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Rotate and finish grilling: Open the lid and carefully rotate the chicken 180° so that it heats evenly. Close the lid and let the chicken cook for another 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until a meat thermometer reads 165°F when inserted into the thickest part of the thigh.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Rest: Carefully transfer the chicken and beer can to a rimmed plate or tray and let it rest for 10 minutes. Then, carefully remove the beer can from the cavity of the chicken and discard. The beer will still be hot so be extra careful.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Make the quick slaw: While the chicken is resting, make the slaw by adding cabbage, carrots, lime juice, cilantro, salt, and pepper to a large bowl. Mix together, taste, and season with more salt if necessary. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Cut or shred chicken: Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and slice or shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve: Serve in warm corn or flour tortillas with quick slaw and garnish with chopped cilantro and hot sauce if desired.

title: How to Make Falafel
description: Ready to learn how to make authentic falafel from scratch? My family’s secret recipe for the Best Authentic Falafel, made with chickpeas, fresh herb, and spices is all you need!

ingredients.name: dried chickpeas (Do NOT use canned or cooked chickpeas)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: (One day in advance) Place the dried chickpeas and baking soda in a large bowl filled with water to cover the chickpeas by at least 2 inches. Soak overnight for 18 hours (longer if the chickpeas are still too hard). When ready, drain the chickpeas completely and pat them dry.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the chickpeas, herbs, onions, garlic and spices to the large bowl of a food processor fitted with a blade. Run the food processor 40 seconds at a time until all is well combined forming a the falafel mixture.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Scoop tablespoonfuls of the falafel mixture and form into patties (1/2 inch in thickness each). It helps to have wet hands as you form the patties.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fill a medium saucepan 3 inches up with oil. Heat the oil on medium-high until it bubbles softly. Carefully drop the falafel patties in the oil, let them fry for about 3 to 5 minutes or so until crispy and medium brown on the outside. Avoid crowding the falafel in the saucepan, fry them in batches if necessary.

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

title: Chinese Spicy Roast Fish (重庆烤鱼)

ingredients.name: whole sea bass (400 grams / 14 ounces each (*see footnote))
thumb ginger (, half sliced, half minced)

fermented black bean sauce (dou chi jiang)
Sichuan pickled pepper (pao jiao) (or Cajun pickled pepper)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash all the vegetables and chop the onion and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven to 220 degrees C (430 F). Line a baking tray with a sheet of parchment and spray a thin layer of olive oil on top.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix chili pepper flakes and cumin powder in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Spread half of the onion slices on the baking tray.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dry the fish thoroughly with a paper towel. Place the fish on top of the onion. Grind salt and sprinkle half the chili and cumin mixture evenly over the fish. Spray a thin layer of oil on top. Flip the fish and season the other side in the same manner, spray with oil. Stuff ginger slices and a few slices of onion in the cavity of the fish.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake on the middle rack until fish is cooked through, about 20 minutes (or longer time if you use a larger fish). You should be able to easily separate the flesh from the bone with a fork, and the internal temperature of the fish should be 62 degrees C (145 F).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While the fish is baking, chop the rest of the vegetables. Place lotus root, bamboo shoots, and mushrooms on a plate. Mix chili bean paste, black chili paste and Sichuan pickled peppers in a small bowl. Add dried chili pepper and chicken broth separately in two small bowls. Place the veggies, mixed sauce, peppercorns, dried chili pepper, chicken broth, salt and sugar on the kitchen counter, near the wok.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat the wok over medium high heat and add oil. When the oil is warm, add peppercorns. Stir until fragrant and the peppercorns turn dark brown, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Turn to lowest heat. Use a ladle to scoop out the peppercorns and discard them.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Turn to medium high heat. Add the remainder of the minced ginger and garlic and stir a few times until fragrant. Add the rest of the onion. Stir until the onion turns translucent, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the mixed sauce and stir immediately to coat onion with sauce evenly, 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add chili pepper, stir a few times to mix.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add lotus root, bamboo shoots, and mushrooms. Stir continuously for 1 to 2 minutes. Add chicken broth and sugar. Continue to stir until the seasonings are mixed evenly and the veggies are cooked through. Turn to lowest heat and taste the veggies. Add more salt to adjust seasoning if necessary.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Transfer the baked fish to a big plate. Pour the veggies and sauce over top of the fish. Garnish with cilantro.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Serve immediately with steamed rice.

title: Greek Octopus and onion stew recipe (Octopus stifado)
description: A traditional Greek octopus stifado recipe! This simple octopus stew is the perfect dish for the Lenten period! The octopus is braised with wine, shallot onions, tomato, aromatic herbs and spices creating a delightful stew.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek octopus stifado recipe, place the octopus in a large pot, pour in 1 cup of water and the vinegar. Boil the octopus for about 20 minutes. Remove the octopus from the pan, chop into pieces and place in a bowl along with 1 cup of the broth (the water where the octopus just boiled in).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime peel the shallots and carve them crosswise. A little trick to peel them more easily is to place the shallots in a bowl full of water and leave them in the fridge overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a saucepan add the oil and shallots (whole) and sauté (medium heat) for about 10 minutes or until softened. Turn the heat up, add the octopus and sauté. Add the tomato paste, grated onion and garlic and sauté for 1 more minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the red wine, 1 cup of the hot broth, the bay leaves, allspice berries and season. Bring to a boil, turn the heat down and let the octopus stifado simmer for about 30-40 minutes, or until the octopus is tender and the sauce has thickened. If the sauce needs some more thickening, then let it cook for a while uncovered.

title: Mandu (Korean dumplings)
description: Learn how to make Korean dumplings (mandu) with this easy to follow recipe! They are so delicious and versatile! Much easier than you think!

ingredients.name: ground pork (or other meat if preferred)
to 2 teaspoons finely minced ginger (or juiced)

steps.title: Step 2

(This process will draw out water, soften the texture, and add flavor.) Squeeze out as much water as possible from the salted zucchini and cabbage by hand. Transfer to a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare all the remaining ingredients and add to the mixing bowl. Mix all ingredients well with your hand.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place one heaping teaspoonful of the filling on a wrapper. Wet the edges of the wrapper with water and seal tightly (pushing the air out with your fingers) into a half-moon shape. Repeat this process until all the filling/wrappers are used.

title: Chicken and Summer Squash
description: Ready in only 35 minutes, this chicken and summer squash recipe is loaded with yellow squash, zucchini, corn, tomatoes, and juicy chicken.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast, (cut into 1-inch chunks)
yellow squash, (quartered and sliced into ½-inch pieces)
zucchini, (quartered and sliced into ½-inch pieces)
fresh whole kernel corn, (sliced off from 2 medium ears of corn)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat Mazola® Corn Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic. Saute for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add chicken, chili powder, salt, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add yellow squash, zucchini, corn, and tomatoes. Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until squash starts to become tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat, top with shredded cheese, cover, and let sit for 3-5 minutes, until the cheese completely melts.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garnish with chopped cilantro and limes wedges.

title: Simple Green Juice Recipe
description: This simple homemade green juice recipe takes 6 ingredients, 15 minutes, and a juicer or blender (whatever you have will work.) Easy, healthy, and loaded with nutrition. And it tastes so refreshing!

You can pour it through a fine mesh sieve, and using the back of a spoon, press the pulp into the sieve to extract as much liquid as possible. Pour the strained juice into glasses and enjoy!

title: Hoisin Roasted Asparagus
description: You only need two ingredients to create the best baked asparagus – perfectly charred, flavorful, and tender.

ingredients.name: (450 grams) asparagus (, tough ends removed (*see footnote))
hoisin sauce ((or gluten-free hoisin sauce for a GF version))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 230 degrees C (450 F).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread asparagus and drizzle with olive oil. Toss to coat well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add hoisin sauce. Toss again to cover asparagus evenly with the sauce. Arrange asparagus so that the thicker stems are near the rim of the baking sheet. Leave some space between the asparagus spears, so they will crisp up, not become steamed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake for 5 minutes. The asparagus should be almost cooked through, but still a bit chewy. If you’re using thicker asparagus, you might need to add another minute or two. Toss again and return the tray to the oven. Turn on broiler and cook for another 2 minutes, or until the sauce is slightly caramelized. You should watch it closely after turning on the boiler. When the asparagus is done, transfer the it to a serving tray immediately so that it stops cooking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: This recipe can be used on the grill, too. To grill asparagus, build a moderate two-zone fire and place asparagus over direct fire. Flip every minute, until the asparagus is cooked through. If the asparagus gets charred too quickly (mostly likely if you’re using thicker asparagus spears), move them to the indirect fire and grill until they cook through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Lemony Greek Rice Pilaf (Pilafi) Recipe with Chicken legs
description: The perfect traditional Greek rice pilaf (pilafi) recipe! Fluffy, fragrant rice and crispy, tender, fall of the bone chicken legs with a delicious lemon kick!

ingredients.name: chicken legs, bone-in and skin on
juice of 1 lemon (or more if you prefer)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek rice pilaf recipe with chicken legs, start by washing thoroughly the chicken legs and pat them dry with some kitchen paper. Drizzle the chicken legs with olive oil, season well with salt and pepper and rub using your hands.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large pan over medium high heat and place the chicken legs inside. Let them colour and cook for about 6 minutes on each side, until the skin is nicely coloured and crispy. Remove the chicken legs from the pan and set side.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now it’s time to prepare the Greek rice pilaf. In the same pan add 1-2 tbsps olive oil and the chopped onions and sauté until soft. Add the butter and rice and sauté the rice until translucent. Pour in the chicken stock and lemon juice and deglaze. Add the chicken legs (skin side up) and season well with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the lid on, turn the heat down and simmer the Greek rice pilaf for about 15 minutes, until the chicken and rice are cooked and all the liquid has been absorbed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Finish off the Greek rice pilaf with a last minute squeeze of lemon juice, crumbled feta cheese and freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

title: Haemul Sundubu Jjigae (Seafood Soft Tofu Stew)
description: This bubbling hot, hearty stew is made with extra soft tofu (sundubu or soondubu) and seafood. It cooks up so fast, making it perfect for a weeknight meal!

ingredients.name: beef or pork (rib eye, sirloin, pork loin or pork belly)
- 8 pieces of seafood assortment (shrimp, mussels, clams, and/or oysters)
gochugaru (red chili pepper flakes) (adjust to taste.)
sesame oil (use a little more if using more gochugaru)
soup soy sauce (or regular soy sauce)
anchovy broth (or other broth or water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the meat into small (about 1-inch long) thin strips. Clean the seafood. Cut the the zucchini into about 1-inch pieces. Dice the onion and scallion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the gochugaru and sesame oil to a small pot, and place it over medium heat. Stir until the pepper flakes become a bit pasty in the heated pot. (The red chili pepper flakes burn easily, so do not preheat the pot.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the meat, onion, garlic, and soy sauce. sauté until the pork and onion are almost cooked, 2 - 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the broth (or water). Bring it to a boil and continue to boil for 3 - 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the soft tofu in big chunks along with the zucchini. Bring to a boil again. Gently stir at the bottom of the pot once or twice so the tofu does not stick to the bottom. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drop the seafood in and boil until the clams and mussels open, 2 - 3 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Add the chopped scallion right before turning the heat off. If desired, crack an egg into the stew right before serving while it's still boiling hot.

title: Chinese Steamed Egg
description: Perfect Chinese Steamed egg is also known as Chinese steamed egg custard. Only with egg, water, salt and some sesame oil, you can make this super smooth custard at home. This is a basic version.

ingredients.name: of warm water (, recommend using warmed boiled water , or milk or stock)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Gently whisk eggs with pinch of salt and water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Strain the egg liquid and transfer to the container. Remove any bubbles on surface.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Set up the steamer, bring the water to a boiling and slow down the fire to simmer for 8 to 10 minutes depending on your container. For the time, please see note 1.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from the fire and wait for 5 minutes to cool down a little bit.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the containers out. Drizzle some sesame oil and light soy sauce and garnish chopped spring onion on top.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Mexican Cauliflower Rice
description: This Mexican Cauliflower Rice is a delicious and healthy low carb alternative to traditional Mexican rice. It's ready in only 25 minutes!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut cauliflower into small chunks. Remove any of the green leaves and thick stems. Rice cauliflower on food processor or grater.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make in a food processor: add cauliflower chunks into food processor and pulse until it resembles rice or couscous.To make with a box grater: carefully grate cauliflower into a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions, tomato and garlic. Saute for 10 minutes, until onions are completely softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add broth, tomato paste, salt, paprika and cumin. Mix together until tomato paste has completely dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add cauliflower rice and stir to fully combine with the broth. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until cauliflower has softened. Taste and season with salt, if necessary.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from heat and serve with chopped cilantro and fresh limes.

title: Roasted Cauliflower and Chickpea Stew
description: My family's favorite chickpea stew is loaded with beautiful roasted cauliflowers, carrots, and tomatoes.

ingredients.name: whole head cauliflower, divided into small florets
medium-sized bulk carrots, peeled, cut into 1 1/2″ pieces
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
28-oz can diced tomatoes with its juice
parsley leaves, stems removed, roughly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix together the spices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the cauliflower florets and carrot pieces on a large lightly oiled baking sheet. Season with salt and pepper. Add a little more than 1/2 of the spice mixture. Drizzle generously with olive oil, then toss to make sure the spices evenly coat the cauliflower and carrots.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake in the 475 degrees F heated-oven for 20 minutes or until the carrots and cauliflower soften and gain some color. Remove from the heat and set aside for now. Turn the oven off.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large cast iron pot or Dutch oven, heat 2 tbsp olive oil. Add the onions and saute for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and the remaining spices. Cook on medium-high for 2-3 more minutes, stirring constantly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now add the chickpeas and canned tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the roasted cauliflower and carrots. Bring everything to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover part-way and cook for another 20 minutes. Be sure to check the stew, stir occasionally, and add a little water if needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from the heat and transfer to serving bowls. Garnish with fresh parsley and the toasted nuts (optional.) Enjoy hot over some quick-cooked couscous or with a side of warm pita bread.

title: Marinated Greek Lamb Chops with Roast Potatoes (Paidakia)
description: Discover all the secrets behind the very best Greek lamb chops with this traditional Greek recipe!

ingredients.name: medium sized potatoes, cut into wedges

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek lamb chops recipe (paidakia) start by preparing the marinade. In a shallow glass baking dish add all the marinade ingredients and blend. Add the lamb chops (paidakia) and rub the meat with the marinade. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for a least 3 hours (if you have the time leave overnight).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Return the lamb chops at room temperature and preheat the oven to 200C.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the potatoes into wedges and place them on a large metal roasting pan. Into a bowl add the remaining ingredients and blend. Pour the mixture over the potatoes and season well with salt and pepper. (The potatoes and the ‘paidakia’ cook at different times, so you should add the lamb chops later, about 20-30 minutes before the end of cooking time).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake the potatoes in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, until a nice golden crust has formed on the potatoes. Turn them out of the oven, toss them a little bit to bring them upside down, sprinkle with a pinch of oregano and put back into the oven for another 30 minutes. If all of the liquid has been absorbed and the pan appears to be getting dry, add 1/4 of a cup hot water into the pan, before they have fully browned.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the paidakia (Greek lambs chops) from the marinade and season with salt and pepper. Place the lamb chops in the same pan (on a single layer) and bake for 20-25 minutes flipping them sides halfway through cooking time.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Let the paidakia (Greek lamb chops) rest for 5-10 minutes and serve with a last minute squeeze of a lemon and a pinch of dried oregano. Enjoy!

title: One-Pot Puerto Rican Chicken and Rice
description: This incredible chicken dinner will excite your taste buds. Tender chicken, flavorful rice, and the famous sofrito come together quickly and easily.

ingredients.name: (2g) sazon seasoning ((homemade sazon, Goya sazon, or chicken bouillon))
(20g) adobo seasoning (or your favorite chicken seasoning)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash chicken thighs. For faster cooking, make a ½" slit into the meat on either side of the thigh and pat them dry with a paper towel—season with salt (about 1½ teaspoons).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rub both sides with a generous amount of the adobo seasoning or your favorite spice mixture.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place chicken (skin-side up) in a skillet, Dutch oven, or oven-safe pan for about 3 minutes. Flip and sear for another 3 minutes, being careful not to burn it. Remove from the pan and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350℉ (175℃).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, cover the rice with cold water in a large bowl. Wash the grains with your hands, tip the water out, and repeat twice or until the water runs clear.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Wipe out the pan in which the chicken was seared with a paper towel or napkin to remove any burns from the pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add a tablespoon or two of oil, followed by onions, bell pepper, garlic, bay leaf, cilantro, and cumin. Sauté until soft but not browned, 2-3 minutes. Then add tomato sauce and rice. Stir for another minute to coat the rice.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Next, add the remaining ingredients: chicken stock, pigeon peas, paprika, white pepper, olives, salt, and sazon or bouillon. Add the chicken and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place uncovered in the preheated oven. Cook for 30-35 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove, let it cool, and serve.

title: Hobakjuk (Pumpkin Porridge)
description: Hobakjuk is a golden-yellow and velvety porridge made with pumpkin and glutinous rice (aka sweet rice)! Make this delicious comfort food with my easy recipe!

ingredients.name: kabocha (danhobak, 단호박) or small pumpkin, about 2 pounds
sweet rice (aka glutinous rice), soaked in water for at least an hour
to 2 tablespoons brown sugar (adjust to taste or omit)
sweet rice flour (chapssal garu, 찹쌀가루, or mochiko)
red beans, pat (팥), soaked and boiled - optional
pine nuts, pumpkin seeds, jujubes, if available (Walnuts or pecans will be great too)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the squash into halves (or quarters). Remove the seeds. Place them in a large pot, the cut side up. Add water about one-third way up the squash, about 6 cups. Cover and boil over medium high heat until the squash turns fork tender, about 25 - 30 minutes. Discard the water and let the squash cool. See the notes for other cooking methods.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When the squash is cool enough to handle, scoop out the flesh (or peel the skin off).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: You can purée the cooked squash at this point if you want, using a blender (make sure to use some of the 3 cups of water required below). Or use an immersion blender or simply mash it with a spoon or potato masher while cooking if you like a little bit of squash lumps in my porridge.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a blender, grind the soaked glutinous rice with 1 cup of water as finely as possible.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the ground sweet rice into the pot of the prepared squash. Add 3 cups of water. Cook over medium heat, stirring and mashing the chunks of squash, until the rice starts to turn translucent and the porridge becomes thick. Cover, and reduce the heat to low. Continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes. (Adjust the consistency of the porridge to your taste by adding more water.) Stir in the salt, sugar, and the optional cooked red beans. Cook for an additional 3 - 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For the optional rice cake balls

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve

title: Classic Mojito Recipe
description: This Classic Mojito Recipe is one of the most refreshing cocktails you'll ever have! Made with white rum, lime juice and fresh mint leaves, this easy drink is a definite crowd pleaser.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Fill a 12-ounce highball glass with ice and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a cocktail shaker, add the rum, lime juice, sugar and mint leaves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using a cocktail muddler or the back of a spoon, lightly press on the mint leaves to release some of the oils until fragrant. Be careful not to overmuddle and completely tear the leaves to little pieces - just keep pressing on them with the muddler until the drink is super fragrant.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover and shake to combine. Pour into the prepared glass and top it off with a splash of club soda.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garnish with fresh lime slices and a sprig of mint.

title: Easy Lahmacun Recipe
description: Think of Lahmacun (Lahamajoun) as super thin, crispy pizza (or flatbread) known in Armenia and Turkey, topped with a flavor-packed mixture of minced meat with peppers, tomato, fresh herbs and earthy spices.

ingredients.name: sweet red pepper (cored, cut into chunks)
fresh parsley leaves with some stem
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oven to 450 degrees F. Adjust oven rack to the middle. (or see stove-top instructions in notes)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the meat mixture. In the large bowl of a food processor, fitted with blade, add red peppers, shallot, garlic, and parsley. Pulse a few times to chop. To the mixture, add ground lamb (or beef). Season with spices and salt. Add tomato paste and extra virgin olive oil. Now pulse again until well-combined (about 8 to 10 pulses.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare two large rimmed baking sheets lined with parchment paper (you'll be using these to bake the Lahmacun in batches.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the pizza dough into 4 equal balls (about 2 oz each.) Working with one ball of dough at a time, place on a floured surface. Using a rolling pin, roll dough out into as thin as you can to a disk that's about 8 or 9 inches in diameter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble Lahmacun. Place one flatbread disk on one of the prepared pans. Reshape as needed. Spoon 3–4 tbsp topping onto dough and spread topping evenly to edges, leaving a thin boarder.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in heated oven for about 5 to 7 minutes or until dough and meat are fully cooked (dough will be a little crusty around the edges.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Repeat steps 5 and 6 with the remaining dough.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Squeeze a little lemon juice on top. Serve Lahmacun hot or at room temperature. See notes below for how to serve.

title: Gigantes Plaki recipe (Gigandes Greek Baked 'Giant' Beans)
description: Filling and super-healthy! A traditional Greek Gigantes beans recipe (gigantes plaki), made of ‘giant’ beans baked in a tomato sauce with plenty of fresh herbs, for a unique taste!

ingredients.name: (14 ounces) tinned chopped tomatoes or 600g (21 ounces) ripped fresh tomatoes, grated
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the gigantes (Gigsntes) plaki, start by soaking the gigantes beans overnight into plenty of water. Drain them into a colander and rinse with plenty of water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the gigantes in a large pan with cold water, enough to cover them, add a pinch of sea salt and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down and simmer for 45 minutes, until tender but not cooked. Drain them in a colander and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime, pour into a large baking pan the olive oil, add the chopped onions, the whole garlic clove (peeled) and bake at 180C, until softened and slightly colored (approx. 15 minutes).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the baking pan out of the oven. Add the gigantes beans (drained), the celery, the parsley, ½ cup of hot water and season with salt and pepper. Put back in the oven and bake for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the baking tray out of the oven, blend the gigantes beans lightly with a wooden spoon and pour in the grated tomatoes or plum tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper, add a pinch of oregano and bake the gigantes plaki further for 50-60 minutes at 180C, until the beans are soft and tender and the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For an easier alternative, after soaking the gigantes beans overnight, drain and rinse them. Place in a large pan with enough water to cover them and bring to the boil. Boil for 5 minutes, drain them and place into a large baking pan, along with all of the ingredients, cover with some aluminum foil and bake at 180C for approx. 2 hours. The last 30 minutes, bake without the aluminium foil. Enjoy!

title: Cornmeal Pudding Pone
description: This easy yet indulgent Caribbean dessert is made with cornmeal and topped with a decadent coconut sauce. Bake until the top is bubbly, and then dig in. It's an unforgettable tropical treat.

ingredients.name: (9-10g) spices ((1 teaspoon each of nutmeg, cinnamon, allspice, etc.))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350℉ (175℃). Grease a 10-inch baking pan and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large saucepan, add butter, coconut milk, milk, sugar, spices, and salt. Bring to a boil and remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, and salt, then add a cup of water and stir. Add the rum and vanilla at this point if using.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Scoop out some coconut milk mixture and add to the cornmeal mixture a cup at a time until the mixture is smooth (you may have to add 2-3 cups).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Gradually whisk the cornmeal mixture into the saucepan (stirring continuously to prevent lumps).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring to a boil and simmer (stirring frequently) for 6-8 minutes to prevent lumps and burning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from heat, add about ½ cup of raisins. Pour or scoop the mixture into the prepared baking pan. Bake for about 60 minutes, or a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

steps.description: Coconut Sauce

steps.title: Step 9
