title: Easy Vietnamese Pho Noodle Soup
description: If you want to get a hearty bowl of Vietnamese pho noodle soup on the table within 30 minutes, look no further!

ingredients.name: raw beef short ribs ((or sirloin steak, or tenderloin) (*see footnote 2))
fresh herbs (mix of cilantro, basil, and/or mint)
Sriracha and hoisin sauce ((or homemade hoisin sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine beef stock, ginger, star anise, and cloves in a pot. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn to medium low heat. Add ginger, star anise, cloves, light soy sauce, and fish sauce. Cover and cook for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use a slotted spoon to remove all the solid ingredients and discard them. Return soup to the stove, cover, and heat over the lowest heat needed to keep it hot. If you have leftover cooked beef, you can add it into the broth now to reheat it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While boiling the soup, slice the raw beef against grain into thin slices. You can freeze the beef briefly, about 10 minutes, so it will be easier to slice. Prep and cut veggies and set them aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Ten minutes before the beef broth is ready, bring another pot of water to a boil. Add rice noodles and cook (or soak) according to instructions, or until tender. It usually takes 3 to 8 minutes, depending on the type of noodles. Rinse with tap water and drain. Divide the noodles among the serving bowls.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Top beef slices, without overlapping, on the rice noodles and pour the soup over them, to quickly cook the beef. If you want the beef to be cooked more thoroughly, lightly press them into the soup to heat evenly. Garnish with bean sprouts and herbs. Serve immediately with lime wedges, Sriracha sauce and hoisin sauce.

title: Purple Sweet Potato Buns
description: Delicious and beautiful Chinese steamed buns with purple sweet potatoes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and the purple sweet potatoes and cut into small cubes. Steam in a wok around 15 minutes or bake in oven for around 20 minutes. Then mash it with a sticker or scoop.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare warm water around 35 °C and melt the sugar in. And mix the yeast with the water. Mix well and set aside for around 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the flour in a large bowl. Pour the water with yeast slowly to the bowl with flour and stir with a chop sticker.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then knead the flour into smooth and soft dough. At the very beginning, it might be a little bit sticky.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Repeat the above steps, mix flour with mashed purple sweet potatoes to make smooth dough too.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Let the two pieces of dough rest for around 1 hour or until the paste ball doubles in size. This process can be done by mixer.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Roll the two pieces of dough into two large and thin rounds. And layer the white round underneath and the purple layer on top. Roll up to a cylinder.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut the cylinder into small sections. Brush some oil on the bottom of each section and put them in the steamer.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bring some water to a boiling and steam for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Turn down the fire and wait for around 5 minutes. Transfer out and serve hot.

title: Instant Pot Mexican Rice
description: This foolproof Instant Pot Mexican Rice recipe is ready in under 30 minutes, and makes perfectly fluffy Mexican rice every time!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add rice to a fine mesh strainer or colander and rinse under running water until the water runs clear. Drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn on the saute function on the Instant Pot and set to medium and add the oil to the pot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When hot, add the rice and saute for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice begins to lightly brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the onion, tomato, garlic and salt. Stir and saute for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the broth and tomato paste. Stir together to mix until the tomato paste has completely dissolved.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the Instant Pot off, secure the lid, and turn the valve to the sealed position.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn on Manual or High Pressure, set the pressure valve to the seal position, and pressure cook for 4 minutes. When the time is up, let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then carefully open the valve to release any remaining pressure.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the frozen peas and gently fluff the rice with a fork. Don't stir it. Taste and season with more salt if necessary.

title: Chicken Arugula Salad with Ginger Pomegranate Dressing
description: Loaded, bright, healthy, and flavor-packed chicken arugula salad. The fresh ginger and pomegranate dressing is a must! The perfect no-fuss supper salad!

ingredients.name: cooked chicken breasts (or rotisserie chicken), bones removed, sliced or shredded (remove skin as well to reduce fat)
lemon, zested and juiced (about 1/4 cup lemon juice)
Quality Greek Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the dressing. Add all dressing ingredients to a mason jar. Close tightly and shake well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine arugula, spinach, cucumbers and onions. Season with a little salt and pepper. Toss to combine, then top with avocado slices, chicken, and pomegranate arils.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Give the dressing one more shake, then drizzle generously over salad. Garnish with a sprinkle of feta and toasted walnuts. Enjoy!

title: Greek Frappe coffee (Iced coffee) Recipe
description: This is how you will make the authentic Greek frappe coffee as served at the best Cafés! A recipe to master the art of Greek frappe!
tags: how to make greek iced coffee

ingredients.name: 2-3 tsp instant coffee (Nescafe) to taste as below
glassful of cold water (250ml / 8.5 fl oz)
“Sketos”: 1-2 tsps of instant coffee and cold water.
“Metrios” : 1-2 tsps of instant coffee, 1-2 tsps of sugar (equal amount of coffee and sugar)
“Glykos” : 1-2 tsps of instant coffee, 2-4 tsps of sugar (double the amount of sugar than coffee)
“Me gala” : 1 tbsp evaporated milk (the amount of milk can vary according to preference)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek frappe coffee recipe, first of all get a tall glass, a teaspoon and an electric whizzer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then add the instant coffee (Nescafe), sugar and about 2-3 tbsp’s of cold water. You want just enough to cover the coffee and then add one tbsp more.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Whiz the mixture until a thick, creamy foam is produced.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the mixture into the serving glass.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then add 3 ice cubes and the evaporated milk if you like.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fill up the glass with cold water and serve with a drinking straw.

title: Yukgaejang (Spicy Beef Soup with Vegetables)
description: A hearty, spicy Korean beef soup packed with flavor!

ingredients.name: dried gosari, 고사리 (fernbrakes) - about 1 cup rehydrated
beef brisket, 양지머리 (or flank steak or shank meat)
onion (do not cut off the stem)
Korean radish (mu, 무), cut into big chunks - optional
dry shiitake mushrooms, soaked (or 2 ounces fresh shiitake or oyster mushrooms)
- 3 bunches scallions (or 2 or 3 stalks of Korean daepa (large variety scallion)
gochugaru, 고추가루 (red chili pepper flakes) - 2.5 to 3 TB for spicier soup
guk ganjang, 국간장 (soup soy sauce), divided
gochujang, 고추장 (red chili pepper paste) - optional
dangmyeon (당면), starch noodles (soaked in warm water for 20 minutes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the gosari and 4 cups of water to a small pot. Boil over medium heat, covered, until tender. Mine only took about 30 minutes, but the time can vary significantly depending on gosari. Turn the heat off and let it cool in the cooking water. When ready to use, rinse in cold water and drain. Cut into 4-inch lengths, removing tough ends of the stems, if any. (See note 1.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pot, bring the meat, onion, and optional radish, to a boil in 14 cups of water (see note 2 for other broth options). Reduce the heat to medium, and skim off the scum. Boil, covered, until the meat is tender enough for shredding, about 1 hour. Pull a string of meat off and check the tenderness. Let the meat cool a bit in the cooking liquid. Discard the vegetables, reserving the stock in the pot. Spoon off any visible fat. The broth should be about 7 to 8 cups.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the meat is cool enough to handle, shred into about 3 to 4-inch strips.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water for a minute. Wash with cold water and drain. Cut the scallions into 4-inch lengths. Thinly slice the soaked mushrooms.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a pan, heat the sesame oil until hot over low heat and stir in the chili pepper flakes. Turn the heat off as soon as the oil starts to turn red and the chili pepper flakes become a bit pasty. This only takes a few seconds. Do not burn the flakes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the meat, gosari, mushrooms, 1 tablespoon soup soy sauce, and garlic to the pan. Toss well to coat everything with the oiled chili pepper flakes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the meat and gosari mixture to the broth. Stir in 1 tablespoon of soup soy sauce, optional gochujang and doenjang, and boil over medium high heat, covered, for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Throw in the bean sprouts and scallions, and boil over medium heat for another 10 minutes. Add salt (1 teaspoon or more) and pepper to taste. Within a few minutes before turning the heat, add the optional noodles. Slowly drizzle the optional eggs over the boiling soup and turn the heat off. Serve with rice.

title: Healthy Pork Soup with Radish and Corn
description: Healthy pork bones soup with fresh white radish and sweet corn.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the pig bone into several sections. Wash under running water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring some water to a boiling in wok. Rinse the bone sections in water to remove impurities. Move out and wash under running water again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Put the bones in your pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare other ingredients. Cut fresh sweet corn into small sections and cut peeled radish into small cubes. Crash the root ginger too. And then put all the other ingredients in the pot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour 4 cups of water in. Bring all the contents to a boiling using high fire and then simmer for around 40 minutes using small fire.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add salt in. Mix well and serving with soup bowls. Sprinkle some chopped spring onions in.

title: Bloody Maria Recipe
description: This Bloody Maria cocktail recipe is made with tequila, lime juice, tomato juice, and spices for a fun twist on the classic Bloody Mary.

ingredients.name: For garnish: olives, pickle spears, peperoncini, celery stalks

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix together a little celery salt and smoked paprika on a shallow plate. Run a lime wedge along the rim of one pint glass, then dip it into the mixture to coat the rim. Fill with ice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a cocktail shaker (or a large cup for mixing), add tomato juice, tequila, juice from 1 lemon wedge, juice from 1 lime wedge, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce, celery salt, smoked paprika and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix together, taste, and adjust any seasonings if necessary. Pour into the prepared glass.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Garnish with the remaining lime and lemon wedges, olives, pickle spears, peperoncini and celery stalks, if desired. Enjoy!

title: Easy White Bean Salad
description: Simple white bean salad loaded with bright Mediterranean flavors! Canned beans, chopped veggies, and fresh herbs tossed together in one big bowl. No fancy dressing here, a squeeze of lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil is all you need.

ingredients.name: white beans (cannellini), drained and rinsed well
Spices (1 tsp Za’atar and 1/2 tsp each Sumac and Aleppo. See notes for more options)
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Early Harvest EVOO)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add white beans, cucumbers, tomatoes, green onions, parsley and mint to a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add lemon zest. Season with salt and pepper, then add za’atar, sumac and Aleppo pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Finish with lemon juice and a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (2 to 3 tablespoons).Give the salad a good toss to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning. Add feta cheese, if you like. (For best flavor, let the salad sit in the dressing for 30 minutes or so before serving. See notes).

title: Mussels Saganaki recipe (Greek Midia Saganaki)
description: A summery and tasty mussels saganaki recipe! Midia saganaki (fried mussels) is one of the most popular appetizers served in a Greek Psarotaverna (fish tavern) and with good reason!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blend all the vegetables, apart from the tomatoes, into a blender, until finely chopped.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large saucepan into high heat and add the olive oil. Pour in the vegetable mixture and sauté.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the cherry tomatoes into halves and add them into the pan along with the mussels and the feta cheese (crushed).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the white wine and cook at high heat, with the lid on, for 8-10 minutes.

title: Chilli Cheese Toast
description: Chilli Cheese Toast is a quick and tasty cheese toast made with bread, cheese, green chillies, ginger and seasonings. In this post, I am also sharing a cafe-style variation topped with jalapeños, olives and herbs.

crushed black pepper (or ground black pepper, as required)
butter (– salted and softened or melted, as required)
to 1 teaspoon or 1 green chilli (– finely chopped)

title: Duchess Potatoes
description: Duchess Potatoes are basically potatoes mashed until smooth and silky, with flavors of butter, nutmeg, and cream then beautifully piped, and baked until golden brown perfection!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the potatoes, removing any spoiled or spots, such as bruising and discoloration.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut into big even-sized chunks. Place potatoes in water as you peel to prevent discoloration.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wash the potatoes and rinse until water runs clear. Place the potatoes in a large pot with about 1 -2 teaspoons of salt and enough water to cover the potatoes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring to a boil. Cook until potatoes are fork-tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain potatoes after cooking, reheat the drained potatoes on low heat to remove moisture from the potatoes, about a minute or less.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer potatoes to a large bowl. Then, add butter, heavy cream, nutmeg, Parmesan cheese, black pepper, and salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Mash potatoes with the desired tool until all the ingredients have been fully incorporated. Add eggs and continue mashing until combined.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Do not over pound your potatoes, you do not them to be gluey.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Prepare a cookie sheet with parchment paper or slip mart. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Transfer mashed potatoes to a pastry bag attached with a large star tip, then pipe directly on the prepared cookie sheet in a circular/upward spiral motion about 2 inches tall, with enough room around each mount of potatoes so they don’t stick together when baking.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Repeat until all the mashed potatoes have been used up.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Brush with butter and bake for 20 – 25 minutes, or until potatoes are golden brown

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Remove and serve immediately.

title: Chinese Beef Noodle Soup (红烧牛肉面)
description: A bowl of hot noodle soup topped with tender braised beef is an absolutely satisfying comfort dish. This recipe shows you how to create a bowl of beef noodle soup that is truly rich in flavor with the fewest steps.

ingredients.name: potatoes (or 1 daikon radish, or a few carrots) ((Optional))
servings Asian beef stock ((or store bought beef stock))
Green salad leaves or blanched bok choy to garnish ((Optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you aren’t cooking the Asian beef stock as well, start by browning the beef. You can achieve this either in the oven or on the stove top. If you have already cooked my Asian beef stock recipe, skip ahead to step 5.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To brown the beef in the oven, preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 C). Cut beef into 1.5 to 2 inch chunks (about 4 to 5 cm). Spread the beef in a roasting pan. Spray a thin layer of oil onto the meat. Roast for 20 minutes. Take out the beef and flip. Cook until the beef turns to an even golden brown color, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To brown the beef on stove top, heat a large heavy skillet with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil until hot. Add beef. Let cook without moving for a minute. Continue cooking until the bottom side turns golden. Flip to cook the other sides, until the beef is evenly browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the cooked beef to a plate. Add 1/4 cup hot water to the baking tray (or the skillet). Scrape off the brown bits, so you can transfer them to the braising pot later.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a dutch oven (or a wok) with 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat until warm. Add green onion, garlic, ginger, and Sichuan peppercorn. Cook until the garlic turns a plate yellow color. Turn to medium low heat. Add doubanjiang and tomato paste. Stir and cook until the bean paste releases oil, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add beef to the pot. Stir a few times to coat beef evenly with the sauce. Add back the brown bits from step 4, if any.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add 2 cups water, Japanese sake, soy sauce, brown sugar, curry powder, and cumin powder to the the pot. Stir to mix well. Turn to medium high heat. Cook until almost bringing to a simmer. Turn to low heat and cover. Let the beef cook at a very gentle boil until it starts to get tender, about 1 hour 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add veggies of your choice (potato, daikon radish, and/or carrot). Stir to mix well. Cover and cook until both the veggies and the beef turn tender, 20 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: You can cook the beef stew one day before serving, store it in an air-tight container in the fridge, and reheat right before serving.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: When you’re ready to serve the noodles, bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the instructions.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: In another pot, add about 6 cups beef stock (add less stock plus water to dilute, if you’re using homemade condensed beef stock. Cook until bringing to a boil.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Divide beef stock among 4 bowls for serving. Add a few spoonfuls of sauce from the braised beef. Taste the broth. It should be a bit salty and very rich. Add salt if necessary. Mix well. Add noodles, top with a few chunks of beef and veggies, and garnish with green onions and greens (if using).

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve as main immediately.

title: Instant Pot Korean Short Ribs
description: Everything you need to know about how to best make these tender, juicy and flavorful Korean short ribs in the Instant Pot!

ingredients.name: Korean radish (mu, cut into large chunks)
to 4 fresh or dried shiitake mushrooms (briefly soaked, halved or quartered)
medium Korean/Asian pear or 1 small apple (grated (about 1/2 cup) )
inch ginger piece (a thumb size) or 1 teaspoon minced
rice wine (or mirin or dry white wine)
sugar (or 2 TB sugar and 2 TB honey) (or any sugar substitute )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off any thick layer of surface fat. In the pot, rinse the ribs with cold water a couple of times to remove surface blood and bone dust.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain, and fill the pot with 4 cups of water to cover the ribs. Close the lid tightly. Press the “Manual” function and High Pressure, and using the “-” button, adjust the time to 2 minutes. Make sure the pressure switch is turned to “sealing”. When finished, carefully released the pressure.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Discard the cooking liquid (or save to use it as a soup base later), and rinse the ribs and the pot. Return the ribs to the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a small blender, blend together the pear, onion, garlic, and ginger. You can separately grate them if you want. Transfer to a bowl. Mix well with the remaining braising liquid ingredients.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the radish, carrot, and mushrooms to the pot. If using fresh mushrooms, you can add them in step 7. Pour the braising liquid over to the ribs. Toss everything well to coat the ribs evenly. (You can prepare up to this point ahead of time.) Close the lid tightly. Pressure cook the ribs for 35 minutes, NPR (Natural release of Pressure) for 10 minutes. (See the quicker alternative method below.) Then, remove the ribs and vegetables to a large bowl or plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Strain the braising liquid. You can skim off the fat or use a fat separator.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Put everything back to the Instant Pot. This will be a good point to add optional chestnuts, fresh vegetables such as potatoes, and/or even rice cake (tteokbokki tteok) if you want. Boil everything together on Saute for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish with the optional scallions and sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Alternative method (to steps 5, 6 and 7)

title: Hot and Sour Soup
description: Traditional Chinese hot and sour soup

ingredients.name: dried shiitake mushrooms (, soaked in hot water and thinly sliced )
dried wood ear mushrooms (, soaked in hot water and shredded )
tsp. fresh ground white pepper powder
tbsp. light soy sauce ( , or soy sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the pork, marinate pork shreds with light soy sauce, sugar, salt and cornstarch. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a wok, add carrots, bamboo shoots, wood ear mushroom, shiitake mushroom and ginger shreds. Add chicken stock, bring to a boiling and then simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, and salt. Continue cooking for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then place shredded tofu in. Then place pork shreds in and gently stir by chopstick when the content boils again.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir the starch water once and then place the starch water in the soup. Heat to thicken.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drizzle egg liquid in. If you want smaller flowers, stirring at a faster speed. Or for larger flowers, stir roughly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place black vinegar and white ground pepper in. Turn off fire immediately.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add some extra aroma by placing chopped green onion and coriander. Drizzle some sesame oil and serve hot.

title: Easy Moroccan Lamb Stew Recipe
description: If you’re looking to make the best lamb stew, this recipe is all you need! Comforting, fall-apart tender braised lamb with loads of veggies, chickpeas and warm Moroccan flavors.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Yukon gold potatoes (or any small potatoes), peeled, cubed
boneless leg of American lamb, fat trimmed, cut into cubes (Or American lamb shoulder, bones removed, fat-trimmed)
ras el hanout Moroccan spice blend (find it here)
plum tomatoes from a can, cut in halves

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large Dutch oven (affiliate) or heavy oven-safe pot, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the heated oil, saute the onions, carrots, and potatoes for 4 minutes or so. Add the garlic and season with salt and pepper. Remove from the pot and set aside briefly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same pot, add more oil if needed, and deeply brown the lamb on all sides. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn heat to medium-high and return the sauteed vegetables to the pot. Add the dried apricots, cinnamon stick, bay leaf and spices and stir to coat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the plum tomatoes and broth and bring everything to a boil for 5 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the pot and place in the 350 degrees F heated-oven for 1 ½ hours (check partway through to add water or broth if needed). Now stir in the chickpeas, cover and return to the oven for another 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from the oven and serve hot with your choice of Lebanese rice, couscous, pita bread or your favorite rustic bread.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: A simple Mediterranean salad like Fattoush makes a great starter for this hearty meal. Enjoy!

title: Grandma's Tiropitakia with flour in 5 minutes
description: Golden and crispy on the outside fluffy in the inside and amazingly fragrant! This super easy 5 minute recipe for Grandma’s tiropitakia with flour and feta cheese will become your kids favorite!

ingredients.name: 200g/ 7oz oil (100g olive oil and 100g vegetable oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy tiropitakia recipe add all the ingredients in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the ingredients using a spoon until almost incorporated.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Knead a little bit with your hands until you have a smooth dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Line a large baking tray with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Form the dough in round balls and place on the parchment paper. (about 30 tiropitakia)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Flatten a little bit the tiropitakia with your hands.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 180C for about 25-30 min, depending on the oven, until nicely coloured and cooked through. Enjoy!

title: Methi na Gota
description: Gujarati methi na gota recipe is a tea time deep fried snack made from besan (also known as gram flour), fresh fenugreek leaves, spices, herbs and banana.

ingredients.name: to ½ teaspoon red chili powder
to 3 pinches baking soda (or ¼ teaspoon baking soda)
oil (- to add to the batter)
green chili (+ 1 inch ginger, crushed into a paste in a mortar and pestle)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making batter

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Frying methi na gota

title: Instant Pot Kimchi Jjigae (Stew)
description: This Instant Pot adaptation of the classic Korean stew made with kimchi is so flavorful and rich! The texture of the kimchi turns out nice and soft in a fraction of the time.

ingredients.name: 1-1/2 pounds well fermented kimchi (about 3 cups of cut kimchi packed)
to 3 teaspoons Korean red chili pepper flakes (gochugaru - adjust to taste)
of water* (1/2 cup more if not using kimchi juice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the meat and kimchi into bite sizes. Slice the tofu (about 1/2-inch thick), and roughly chop the scallions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Push the Saute button of the Instant Pot. When it becomes hot, add the pork and kimchi along with the sesame oil and red pepper flakes until the kimchi is slightly softened and pork is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the kimchi juice, water, soup soy sauce, and garlic. Lock the lid, change it to the Soup mode, and adjust the time to 10 minutes. Set the steam valve to “Sealing”.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the Instant Pot beeps, turn the steam valve to “Vent” to quick release the pressure. Open the lid, and add tofu and scallions. Push the Saute button again, and boil for an additional 5 minutes or longer until the kimchi reaches the desired tenderness.

title: BEST Moroccan Fish Recipe
description: This delicious Moroccan fish recipe takes the fish dinner game to a new level of delicious! Braised cod recipe in a saucy chickpea, tomato, and bell pepper medley and lots of warm Moroccan flavors from Ras El Hanout, paprika and cumin.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (I used Private Reserve EVOO)
garlic cloves, divided (4 minced cloves and 4 sliced)
Large handful fresh cilantro (about 1 cup fresh cilantro)
cod fillet pieces (about 1/2 inch in thickness)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pan with cover, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve) over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add minced garlic and cook very briefly, tossing regularly, until fragrant. Add tomato paste, diced tomato, and bell peppers. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes over medium heat, tossing frequently.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now, add chickpeas, water, cilantro, and sliced garlic. Season with kosher salt and pepper. Stir in 1/2 tsp Ras El Hanout spice mixture. Raise heat, if needed, and bring to a boil. Lower heat. Cover part-way and let simmer for about 20 minutes. (Check occasionally and add a little water if needed.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a small mixing bowl, combine remaining Ras El Hanout with cumin and paprika. Season the fish with kosher salt and pepper and the spice mixture on both sides. Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Work the fish to make sure it’s well coated with the spices and the olive oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When ready, add the season fish to the pan, and make sure to nestle the fish pieces into the saucy chickpea and tomato mixture. Ladle a bit of the sauce on top of the fish. Add lemon juice and lemon slices. Cook another 10 to 15 minutes over medium-low until the fish is fully cooked and flaky. Garnish with more fresh cilantro.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve immediately with your favorite crusty bread, grain, or rice.

title: Makaronia me Kima recipe (Greek style spaghetti in meat sauce/bolognese)
description: Makaronia me Kima (Greek style spaghetti in meat sauce recipe) - The Greek version of spaghetti bolognese - is one of the most popular dishes in Greece.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
a pinch of cinnamon or one cinnamon stick

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek style spaghetti with meat sauce recipe (Makaronia me kima), begin by preparing the meat sauce. Heat a large pan to medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Stir in the chopped onions and carrot and sauté, until softened and slightly coloured. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and the mince breaking it up with a wooden spoon and sauté, until caramelized. Pour in the red wine and deglaze (wait to evaporate). Add the tinned tomatoes, water, sugar, cinnamon stick, cloves, bay leaf and a good pinch of salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, turn the heat down and simmer with the lid on for about 30 minutes, until most of the juices have evaporated.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package instructions. Drain the pasta in a collander and stir in 2tsp of olive oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Tip over the drained pasta in the meat sauce pan and mix it so the sauce is evenly spread.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve with grated cheese and a nice refreshing Greek feta salad and enjoy over a glass of wine!

title: Pholourie
description: Easy Pholourie - Deep fried spicy split pea dough. Slightly crispy on the outside, yet some what light and fluffy on the inside.

ingredients.name: - scotch bonnet pepper minced or -1 teaspoon hot sauce (adjust to taste)
warm water or more (adjust to form a thick batter)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mini food processor blend together cilantro, parsley, garlic, onions and scotch bonnet pepper until puree. If you do not have a processor finely chop the ingredients and smash using a motor and pestle or rolling pin. If you have green seasoning use about 2 Tablespoons instead.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except the water ; flour split pea and all-purpose, yeast, salt sugar cumin, turmeric, curry, onion mix and yeast. Thoroughly mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add warm water a little at a time until you get to desired consistency – like thick pancake batter. I usually use about 1 1/3 cup . Thoroughly mix preferable with your hands.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Set the mixture in a warm area and let it rise and double in size -approximately 1- 2 hours

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large, sauce pan pour vegetable oil, until it is at least 3 inches (or about 5 centimeters) high (too little will result in flatter balls), and place on medium heat until oil is about 375 degrees.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: The dough is going to be slightly sticky so use your hands to grab a little bit of mixture at time and drop in the oil or use a spoon to spoon up the batter, and another spoon or spatula to drop it in the oil, sort of in the shape of a ball. Do not overcrowd the pan. Do so in batches

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry for a few minutes (about 7 minutes or more until the bottom side is golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn the ball over and fry for a few more minutes until the other side is slightly golden brown.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Use a large spoon or something like that to take it out of the oil. I usually place them on napkins right away to soak up some of the excess oil.

title: Baked Seafood Pasta
description: I love pasta. I love anything cooked with white sauce and cheese. I also love seafood. So guess what the best combination for me is? Baked seafood pasta, of course!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, add the shrimp, 1 teaspoon rum, slightly grated salt and pepper and mix well with a fork.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another small bowl, add the squid, the rest of the rum, slightly grated salt and pepper and mix well with a fork.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium sizde sauce pan, melt the butter on medium low heat, whisk in the flour and mix with a wooden spatula immediately, mixing until the flour is completely integrated with the butter. Keep stirring for another 1 or 2 minutes, pour in all the milk at one time and immediately stir with a spatula. Turn to medium heat and keep stirring, until boiling, then turn to medium low heat. Add salt, pepper, chicken bouillon, thyme and nutmeg. Simmer until the sauce turns thick, after about 5 minutes. Adjust seasoning by adding more salt and pepper. The sauce should taste a bit salty by itself.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring a big pot of water to a boil and cook pasta according to instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a non-stick skillet, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and heat on medium high heat. When oil is warm, add garlic and stir until fragrant. Add mushrooms and stir fry until mushrooms are cooked through and juice is fully absorbed. Place mushroom on a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In the same skillet, heat half a tablespoon of olive oil, grill shrimp side by side, until both surfaces turn pink but the shrimp are not cooked through yet. Place shrimp on a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In the same skillet, heat the rest of the olive oil and add squid, stirring until the surface of the squid turns white but the squid is not yet cooked through. Place squid on a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Preheat oven to 180 degrees C (350 F).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To assemble pasta, place a layer of pasta in a baking pan / casserole dish, add pasta and white sauce, place a layer of shrimp, squid and mushroom, then top with mozzarella. Cover the pan with aluminum foil, bake on the middle rack for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake at 200 degrees C (400F) for another 5 minutes, until the cheese turns golden.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let the pasta cool down for about 5 minutes, then serve warm with chilled sparkling wine or dry white.

title: Watercress Stir-fry Recipe
description: Quick stir-fry watercress with garlic and dried pepper. Ready 15 minutes! Healthy veggie stir-fry recipe.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the watercress carefully; remove the withered and yellow and also the old stems.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut watercress finely into small pieces. Set aside and drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut chili pepper into sections and slice the garlic cloves.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a small bowl, add cornstarch, water and salt. Mix well to make the stir-fry sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat up peanut oil in wok, add chili pepper and garlic slices to stir-fry until aroma.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add watercress in. Do a quick stir-fry until the watercress is half-cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the sit-fry sauce in and quick fry again for around 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer out and serve hot!

title: Instant Pot Spicy Galbijjim (Braised Beef Short Ribs)
description: Succulent, spicy, and fork-tender Korean beef short ribs pressure cooked in the Instant Pot! Fast and delicious!

ingredients.name: to 4 pounds English cut beef short ribs, galbi (갈비)
Korean radish, mu (무) (cut into large chunks )
to 4 dried shiitake mushrooms (briefly soaked and quartered)
rice wine ((or mirin or dry white wine))
honey (or sugar) (Use 1 TB more if you like it sweeter)
scallions (roughly chopped (and some finely sliced for optional garnish))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off any thick layer of surface fat. Place the ribs in a large bowl with enough water to cover all the ribs. Add a couple of tablespoons of sugar and stir until dissolved. Let the ribs soak for about 30 minutes. Drain and rinse the ribs. Drain well while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small blender, blend the pear, onion, garlic, and ginger well. You can separately grate them if you want. Transfer to a bowl. Mix it with the remaining braising liquid ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the short ribs in the pot, and add the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the braising liquid over. Toss everything well to coat the ribs evenly. Close the lid tightly. Press the “Meat” function, and using the “+” button, set the time to 35 minutes (or 40 minutes for fall off the bone tender meat). Make sure the pressure switch is turned to “sealing”. When finished, the Instant Pot will automatically turn to the “Keep Warm” mode. Leave the pressure cooker alone for 10 to 15 minutes before releasing the remaining pressure and opening the lid. You can leave it longer if you want.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the scallion and the sesame oil. Remove the meat and vegetables from the pressure cooker. Spoon off the fat. Pour the sauce over the ribs to serve. You can also cool it in the fridge or freezer until the fat solidifies to spoon off, and then reheat the sauce. Garnish with the optional scallions and sesame seeds.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken Feet
description: Sweet and Sour Chicken Feet

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the tiptoe of the chicken feet off. Then combine chicken feet with spring onion roots and several pieces of ginger slices. Cook for around 10 minutes after the water becomes to boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put the chicken feet in cold water to cool down.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the ingredients to make the sweet and sour sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Soak the cooked chicken feet in sweet and sour sauce in a sealed container and then place the container in refrigerator for around 8 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Get the chicken feet out and enjoy!

title: Easy Roasted Radishes
description: These easy roasted radishes are great as a snack or side! Roasted with olive oil and spices, then tossed with lime juice and cilantro!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the radishes, olive oil, salt, cumin, and garlic to a medium bowl. Toss together to fully coat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the radishes to the prepared baking sheet and place the radishes cut side down and not touching one another.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake for 40 minutes, flipping halfway through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove them from the oven and toss with lime juice. Sprinkle with cilantro and cotija cheese. Serve.

title: Grilled Swordfish Recipe with a Mediterranean Twist
description: Easy grilled swordfish recipe that utilizes a delicious Mediterranean marinade with cumin, fresh garlic cloves and more. But you don't even need to leave it in the marinade too long! Just a few minutes while your grill is heating!

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice, more for later
swordfish steaks, about 5 to 6 ounces each, from sustainable sources

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a food processor, blend the garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, spices, salt and pepper for about three minutes or until well-combined forming a thick and smooth marinade.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the swordfish steaks dry and place them in a pan (or a dish with sides to it) and apply the marinade generously on both sides and set aside for 15 minutes or so while you heat the grill.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat a gas grill on high (be sure to oil the grates before using). When ready, grill the fish steaks on high heat for 5 to 6 minutes on one side, turn over once and grill on the other side for 3 minutes or so (the fish should flake easily, while maintain firmness. You will likely see a bit of pink on the inside, but it should cook through by the time it gets to the table).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finish with a splash of fresh lemon juice and a sprinkle of crushed red pepper flakes if you like heat. Enjoy!

title: Greek Honey Sesame bars (Pasteli recipe)
description: The ancient Greek version of a power bar is "Pasteli"! Greek honey sesame bars is a snack made from honey and sesame seeds in only 10 minutes!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek honey sesame bars (Pasteli) recipe start by toasting the sesame seeds. Place a frying pan over high heat and add the sesame seeds. Toast them for 2-3 minutes until golden (not too brown). Remove the sesame seeds from the pan and set aside. Continue with the rest of the recipe quickly, so that the sesame seeds remain hot. Alternatively you can spread the sesame seeds in a pan and toast them in the oven at 180-190C (375F).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the same pan add the honey and bring to a boil, until it starts to foam. Remove the foam using a spatula, turn down the heat to medium and let it simmer until its temperature has reached 125C/260F. If you don’t have a thermometer, take a bowl of cold water and drip in a teaspoon of the honey syrup. Let it cool down for a few seconds then shape it into a small ball using your fingers. Take it out of the water and drop it on your work surface. If it sounds like it is solid, the honey syrup is done.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Its now time to add the remaining ingredients for your pasteli. Add a pinch of salt and the toasted sesame seeds and stir for about 10 minutes over medium heat, using a wooden spatula. The mixture should thicken considerably and stick to the spatula.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat, add the lemon zest and stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Line a round pan (22cm/ 8.5 inch. diameter) with parchment paper and pour in the mixture. Be careful not to touch it, as it is very hot. Spread the mixture very well using a spoon.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Let the pasteli cool down for about 20 minutes and them cut into portions. If you let it cool completely then it would be harder to cut into pieces.

title: Pineapple Ginger-Glazed Carrots
description: Pineapple Ginger-Glazed Carrots – Sweet, flavorful, and tender, with a tropical twist - nutmeg, coconut oil and topped with almonds…the perfect side dish for your holiday dinner!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the candied almonds by stirring together sliced almonds about ½ cup sliced almonds and about ¼ cup sugar for about 7 minutes or more

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium saucepan heat the butter over medium heat until melted, then add coconut oil together with ginger, stir for about 30 seconds

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add carrots and sprinkle with salt and sauté over medium-high heat for 5 minutes stirring occasionally or until slightly brown

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the pineapple juice, sweetener and nutmeg. Bring to a boil. Once boiling turn heat to medium and let cook for 5 minutes or until it has slightly thickened

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from heat and mix in apricots preserves Serve warm top with almonds and or parsley

title: Sheet Pan Vegetable Chow Mein
description: Introducing a super easy sheet pan chow mein recipe that features beautifully charred noodles loaded with colorful vegetables. It takes no time to put together, requires very little active cooking time and the clean-up is a breeze!

ingredients.name: (225 g) fresh Hong Kong pan fry noodles ((or 6 oz / 170 g dried egg noodles))
vegetarian oyster sauce ((or regular oyster sauce))
small batch (6 oz / 170 g) broccolini (, cut to bite size pieces)
small batch (8 oz / 225 g) asparagus (, tough ends removed)
green peas (, thawed if using frozen)
green onions (, cut to 2” (5 cm) pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a large baking sheet with Reynolds Wrap® Non-Stick Foil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the noodles

title: Bread Pudding | Caramel Bread Pudding
description: This no bake recipe makes a delicious steamed Bread Pudding every time. It is a terrific way to use nearly any day-old bread, and can be made with a simple homemade caramel sauce for an extra sweet dessert.

ingredients.name: bread (- large or sandwich bread or 6 slices small bread (whole wheat, brown, or white bread))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making the bread pudding mixture

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make caramel sauce

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Steaming in an electric cooker - option 1

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Steaming in a pan on the stovetop - option 2

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: steaming in a stovetop pressure cooker - option 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serving caramel bread pudding

title: Instant Pot Galbitang (Beef Short Rib Soup)
description: This Instant Pot galbitang recipe gives you the same delicious result with a nice and clean taste as the traditional stove top recipe.

ingredients.name: plump garlic cloves (or 1 whole bulb) (If using bulb, cut into halves crosswise)
Korean radish (cut into bite size pieces (about 1.5-inch square, ⅓ - inch thick) see note)
starch noodles (dangmyeon, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes - optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off any thick layer of surface fat. In the pot, rinse the ribs with cold water a couple of times to remove surface blood and bone dust. Drain, and fill the pot with enough water to cover the ribs, about 4 cups.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Close the lid tightly. Press the “Manual” function and High Pressure, and using the “-” button, adjust the time to 2 minutes. Make sure the pressure switch is turned to “sealing”. When finished, carefully release the pressure.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Discard the cooking liquid (or save to use it for the soup if you like). Strain the liquid to remove brown bits if using it. Thoroughly rinse the ribs and the pot clean.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the ribs to the pot, and add the onion, garlic, ginger and soup soy sauce. Add about 10 cups of water, making sure the water level stays below the max line for the pot. Close the lid tightly. Pressure cook the ribs for 35 to 40 minutes, depending on the thickness of the meat. NPR 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then, remove the ribs, and remove the aromatic vegetables with a strainer. Skim off the fat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Put the ribs back in the pot along with the cut radish. Change the Instant Post setting to “Saute”, and boil until the radish turns translucent, about 10 minutes after coming to a boil. Add the optional noodles a couple of minutes before turning the Instant Pot off.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Salt and pepper to taste. Skim off or use a fat separator to remove any remaining fat, if serving while still hot. Or chill the soup and discard solidified fat. Garnish with the chopped scallions to serve.

title: Chipotle Sweet Potato Pork Chili
description: A chipotle-seasoned pork chili made with black beans, dark red kidney beans, sweet potatoes, and fall-apart tender pieces of pork shoulder.

ingredients.name: boneless pork shoulder, (diced into bite-sized chunks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the pork, 1 1/2 tablespoons of kosher salt, black pepper, and coarse-ground mustard. Stir together until the meat is fully coated. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the onions and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the seasoned pork and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until the meat has browned.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the fire-roasted diced tomatoes, canned black beans, canned dark red kidney beans, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, red wine vinegar, fish sauce, the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of kosher salt, ancho chili powder, smoked paprika, ground cumin, ground cloves, ground cinnamon, and ground allspice. Stir together to combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Raise the heat to high and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 1 1/2 hours.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir and scrape up any bits that are stuck to the bottom of the Dutch oven.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the sweet potatoes, poblanos, and stir to combine. Cover and cook for 30 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve in bowls topped with cilantro, sour cream, and avocado slices.

title: Mediterranean Baked Fish Recipe with Tomatoes and Capers
description: Easy Mediterranean baked fish recipe with tomatoes and capers. A bright, delicate and flavor-packed baked fish that comes together in just 35 minutes! Make your salads and sides before you make the fish.

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
large tomatoes, diced (3 cups diced tomatoes. Use quality canned tomatoes, if you like)
white fish fillet such as cod fillet or halibut fillet (wild, if possible)
Juice of 1/2 lemon or more to your liking
Fresh parsley or mint for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the tomato and capers sauce. In a medium saucepan, heat extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add onions, cook for 3 minutes until it begins to turn gold in color, tossing regularly. Add tomatoes, garlic, spices, pinch of salt (not too much) and pepper, capers, and raisins. Bring to a boil, then turn heat down to medium-low and let simmer for 15 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat fish dry and season with salt and pepper on both sides.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour 1/2 of the cooked tomato sauce into the bottom of a 9 1/2″ x 13″ baking dish. Arrange the fish on top. Add lemon juice and lemon zest, then top with the remaining tomato sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in 400 degrees F heated-oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily (do not over-cook). Remove from heat and garnish with fresh parsley or mint to your liking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve hot with Mediterranean grilled zucchini, Greek potatoes, or Lebanese rice. (See other suggestions for sides or salads up in the post)

title: Delicious Lenten Greek Honey puffs recipe (Loukoumades)
description: These traditional sweet Greek honey puffs are one of my favourite desserts. So I was excited to prepare this dairy free Lenten alternative, which is just as delicious as the traditional Greek honey puffs!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek honey puffs recipe, start by dissolving the yeast in the water. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise for about 5 minutes, until it starts bubbling.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate bowl add the flour, corn starch and salt and blend to combine. Add the flour mixture in the yeast mixture and pour in the honey. Whisk all the ingredients together, until the batter is smooth. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the dough rise for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Into a medium sized frying pan pour enough vegetable oil to deep fry the loukoumades. Heat the oil to high heat until hot. Test if the oil is hot enough by dipping in some of the dough. If it sizzles the oil is ready or check its temperature. It should read 160C or 320F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Take a handful of the dough in your palm and squeeze it out, between your thumb and index finger, onto a tablespoon dipped in water. Then drop it in the oil and fry until golden. Repeat this procedure until the surface off the pan is comfortably filled. It is important to dip the spoon in a glass of water every time, so that the batter doesn’t stick on it. You want the spoon to be covered in water but not filled with it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While being fried, use a slotted spoon to push the honey puffs into the oil and turn them around, until golden brown on all sides. Place the loukoumades on some kitchen paper to drain and repeat with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When done, place these delicious golden Greek honey puffs on a large platter, drizzle with (heated) honey and sprinkle with cinnamon and chopped walnuts. Enjoy!

title: Paprika Chicken Legs
description: Paprika Chicken Legs - Resist the temptation of cooking the same thing over and over and make this Baked Garlic Paprika Chicken Legs. It's packed with great flavors from garlic, onion, cayenne pepper, herbs and, of course, paprika.

ingredients.name: bouillon powder ((you may replace with salt))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash chicken legs dry, rub with salt , white pepper and bouillon powder and set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small pan set over medium low heat, combine canola oil, minced garlic, fresh herbs, smoked paprika and cayenne pepper . Stir for about 30 seconds or 1 minute. Let this mixture sit for a little bit about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When ready to bake, preheat oven to 425°.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the chicken in a large bowl, toss with garlic paprika spice mix, then sprinkle with the onion powder.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Line a baking pan with foil; top with a wire rack. Arrange chicken legs out in a single layer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake chicken legs until cooked through and skin is crispy, about 40-45 minutes

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If desired rotate chicken halfway through-roughly 25 minutes. And continue cooking until chicken is fully cooked and juice from the chicken runs clear.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove and let it cool slightly before serving .

title: Bread and Butter Pudding (Without Eggs)
description: Made with pantry staple ingredients that are so much more than the sum of their parts, this Bread and Butter pudding recipe is the epitome of comfort food.

ingredients.name: to 10 slices Bread (- white bread, whole wheat, brown bread, about 350 grams of bread)
raw sugar (or regular white granulated sugar - adjust as per your taste)
to 3 tablespoons butter (- unsalted and softened, add as required)
vanilla extract ((natural) or 1 teaspoon artificial vanilla essence)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grease a rectangular or round baking pan with some softened butter. You can also use medium to large ramekins for making the pudding.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spread butter evenly on all the bread slices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Slice them in small cubes, squares or rectangles.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Layered the bread buttered side up, in the greased baking tray.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle the bottom layer with half of the raisins. Layer again with bread slices. Lastly again sprinkle the remaining raisins on top and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now preheat your oven to 180° C/356° F for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In another skillet or a sauce pan, mix milk, sugar and cornstarch very well with a wired whisk.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Keep the pan on a low heat and gently simmer this mixture, stirring often till the mixture thickens.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Make sure no lumps are formed. So you have to stir continuously.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the mixture is thickened and coats the back of a spoon, add vanilla extract, cinnamon powder and nutmeg powder. Mix to combine the flavoring evenly in the custard sauce.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Now pour this eggless custard over the bread layers.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Dot with some butter on top.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Sprinkle brown sugar evenly on the top layer.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Bake in a preheated oven at 180° C/356° F for 35 to 40 mins till the tooth pick or wooden skewer inserted in the center of the pudding comes out clean and the pudding is set.(Please check the notes section below for more details on baking time.)

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: The top layer will also get browned.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Once the Bread and Butter Pudding becomes warm or cools, slice and serve.

title: Pressure Cooker Braised Oxtail (Kkorijjim)
description: Pressure cooker Korean braised oxtail (kkorijjim) - flavorful and fork tender!

ingredients.name: to 4 dried shiitake mushrooms (briefly soaked and quartered (omit if unavailable))
rice wine (or mirin or dry white wine)
medium Korean/Asian pear, grated (or 1 bosc pear or apple)
to 3 tablespoons maesil cheong (Korean plum extract) - optional
scallions (roughly chopped (and some finely sliced for optional garnish))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off excess fat. Rinse the oxtail pieces and let them sit in cold water for 10 to 20 minutes to draw out excess blood. Drain well, and pat dry with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Press the “Saute” button on the Instant Pot. When the pot is hot, add 1 tablespoon of canola or vegetable oil. Sear the oxtail pieces in two batches, browning all sides. (Alternatively, Place the oxtail in the Instant Pot, add 2 cups of water and cook for 3 minutes on the Manual setting. Quick release the steam, discard the cooking liquid, and rinse the oxtail pieces and the pot.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix together the braising liquid ingredients. Place the oxtail pieces in one layer in the pot, and pour the braising liquid over.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Close the lid tightly. Press the “Meat” function, and using the “+” button, increase the time to 45 minutes (50 for extra tender meat). When finished, the Instant Pot will automatically turn to the “Keep Warm” mode. Leave the pressure cooker alone for about 10 minutes before opening the lid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the meat and vegetables from the pressure cooker. Strain the cooking liquid into a bowl to skim off the fat. I use a fat separator. (See note.) At this point, you can reduce the sauce in the Instant Pot using the Saute function if desired. Return the oxtail to the pot, and stir in the scallion and the sesame oil. Serve with the optional garnish.

title: Roast Beef Tenderloin & Thai Gravy
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: ground beef or any kind of inexpensive beef chopped into small bits
- 2 tsp sweet soy sauce or brown sugar
2-inch piece of lemongrass, very thinly sliced (from bottom half)
Thai chilies, thinly sliced, to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Roast Beef

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Tip: Use a shallow pan or a higher rack so that the sides of the pan do not shield the heat from circulating around the roast.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Generously salt the beef on all sides and let it sit on a rack, uncovered, in the fridge for as many hours as you have time for, and up to overnight. This will allow the salt to penetrate the beef, and it will dry off the surface which will help with browning.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450°F/230°C. (Or see stove-top sear method in the notes below.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Truss the roast and place it on a rack fitted inside a roasting pan. Insert a programmable, leave-in meat thermometer into the middle of the roast, making sure the probe is at the centre, and set the alarm to go off 10 degrees Fahrenheit lower than your desired final temperature to allow for carry-over cooking. (The medium rare doneness shown in the video was pulled at 125°F, and it reached a final temperature of 135°F during resting.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roast the beef for 10 minutes at 450°F so the beef has a chance to brown, then reduce the heat to 275°F and continue roasting at this low temperature until the meat is done to your desired doneness. This low temp will allow beautifully even cooking throughout the roast. Make the gravy while the beef is roasting.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Alternatively, use the stove-top sear method: Preheat the oven to 275°F/135°C. Heat a large skillet until very hot, and add just enough oil to coat the bottom of the pan. Sear the beef on all sides until nicely browned and finish roasting it in the oven at 275°F/135°C.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the beef is removed from the oven, loosely tent it with aluminum foil and let it rest for at least 15 minutes, and up to 30 minutes if the roast is large.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer to a cutting board, remove the twine, then slice and serve with the gravy and your favourite side dishes. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Thai Style Gravy

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Lightly grease a pan, then add the ground beef and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently until it’s caramelized; deglaze with a splash of beef stock if too much is sticking too quickly. Once the beef is quite well browned, but still has some pale pieces, add the shallots and keep cooking until the shallots are soft and the beef is very well caramelized, scraping the brown bits off the bottom of the pan as you go.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add the remaining stock to the beef, scrape off any bits stuck to the pan, and let it simmer for 15-20 minutes to reduce and infuse.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Drain the sauce and press all the juices out of the beef bits. Discard the beef and return the stock to the pan.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Add soy sauce, fish sauce, sweet soy sauce or brown sugar and bring to a simmer. Dissolve the flour in some cold water, and stir about half of this slurry into the sauce and bring the gravy to a boil. Assess the consistency of the gravy and add more of the remaining slurry as needed.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Stir in the garlic, chilies and lemongrass and remove from heat. Add a squeeze of lime juice, then taste and adjust seasoning as needed. When ready to serve, stir in some chopped cilantro.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Become a Patreon Member and Get Exclusive Rewards!

title: Silkie Chicken Soup
description: Healthy Chinese traditional Silkie chicken soup with red-dates, and dried small shitake mushrooms.

ingredients.name: chopped green onion and coriander (, as needed )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the silkie chicken carefully to remove the impurities.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add chicken in, place ginger, red dates and wolfberries. Load with 4 L water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring the content to a boiling. Remove any floats on the surface (skip this step if you are using a high pressure cooker). Slow durn the fire and simmer for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add around 1.5 to 2.5 teaspoon of salt. Serve hot with chopped green onion and coriander as aromatics.

title: BEST Greek Stuffed Tomatoes (Gemista)
description: This stuffed tomato recipe is prepared Greek-style with a hearty, flavor-packed stuffing mixture of ground meat, rice with onions, garlic, fragrant spices like cumin, oregano, and nutmeg, and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: large red onion halved, (mince 1/2 of the onion and slice the other)
lean ground beef, (you can use ground lamb or turkey)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the rice well, place in a bowl and cover with water. Soak for 15 to 20 minutes until you are easily able to break one grain of rice between your fingertips. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. And begin working on the stuffing mixture.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil and heat until just shimmering but not smoking. Add chopped onions (but not the sliced onions) and garlic, toss briefly until fragrant (do not brown the onions and garlic.) Add the ground meat, season with salt, pepper, oregano, allspice, nutmeg and cumin. Cook the meat for about 5 minutes or until fully browned and cooked through (use a wooden spoon to break the meat apart to avoid large chunks.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When meat is fully browned, add drained rice it to the meat mixture in the skillet. Add crushed tomatoes, white wine, and water (a pinch of salt if you like.) Bring the saucy mixture to a boil, turn the heat down and let simmer for for just 10 minutes or so (the simmering is an optional step, but it is helpful to get the rice cooking a little bit.) When ready, stir in the fresh herbs. Season with kosher salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, prepare tomatoes for stuffing. Cut tomato tops (about 1/2 inch from top). Set the tops aside (they will be used later). Take a small pairing knife and carefully go around the edges of the tomato to loosen/separate the flesh. Then using a spoon, carefully scoop out the tomato flesh. Chop the flesh into large pieces and set it aside of later use (see photo in the tutorial above).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare a 9 x 13 baking pan. Oil the bottom of the baking pan with extra virgin olive oil. Spread chopped tomato flesh and sliced onion the bottom of the baking dish and add the chopped tomato flesh and sliced onion to make a bed for the stuffed tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Now, spoon the saucy meat and rice mixture into the empty tomato shells. Arrange the stuffed tomatoes in the prepared baking dish. Cover the stuffed tomatoes with the reserved tops. From one of the corners of your baking dish, carefully pour about 3/4 cup of water. Add a little pinch of salt and a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil on top.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover the baking dish with foil and bake in heated oven for about 30 to 45 minutes, then uncover and cook for another 45 minutes to 1 hour or so (a total of 1 1/2 hours or until the rice is fully cooked. The tomatoes will collapse well and become super tender.) Be sure to check during baking and add a little water if needed.

title: Saganaki recipe (Pan-seared Greek cheese appetizer)
description: Looking for an authentic Saganaki recipe? Try out this super easy Greek Saganaki cheese recipe, made with only three ingredients and ready in less than 10'!

ingredients.name: cheese (Graviera). Alternatively you can use kefalograviera, kasseri, kefalotyri. Monterey Jack, provolone or young Pecorino are also great alternatives if you can’t find a Greek cheese.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this saganaki recipe, slice a large block of cheese (or some smaller if you prefer), approx. 10*7cm and 1,5 cm thick. If you cut the cheese thinner, the saganaki will melt into the pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cheese under running water and then dredge into the flour, shaking off the excess flour. This will help the saganaki form a nice golden crust and to hold its shape when fried.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Into a small heavy-bottomed pan add some oil. As soon as the oil heats, add the cheese and fry for a few minutes on both sides, flipping the saganaki carefully with a spatula, until nicely colored.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare this delicious Greek cheese saganaki recipe and serve, while still smoking hot as a delicious meze with a last minute squeeze of a lemon. Enjoy!

title: Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: These Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers are a healthy and easy weeknight meal loaded with fiber, protein, nutrients, and flavor. They make a hearty, healthy, packed meal that’s amazingly delicious and would keep your belly full.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut top about ½ inch off each bell pepper; remove core and seeds from inside the pepper. Or split in half.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To accelerate cooking time, blanch bell peppers in a large pot of boiling water for about 2-3 minutes; remove with a slotted spoon then let it dry on paper towels or clean dish towel.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium- large skillet, add oil, onions, garlic and sauté, for about 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent any burns.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add chili, cumin, creole seasoning, paprika, followed by tomatoes, continue stirring with a heavy wooden spoon for about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then add ground chicken, beans, cooked quinoa, green onions, and chicken stock. Cook for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finally, throw in corn kernels and adjust the seasoning, to taste. Remove from the heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stuff the bell peppers with the quinoa mixture and place in the baking dish. Bake them in a preheated oven at 350 F for 25 to 30 minutes or until the peppers are tender and the filling is heated through. Top with grated cheese, if desired.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
