title: Pressure Cooker Nurungji Baeksuk (Boiled Chicken with Rice)
description: Pressure cooker nurungji baeksuk -- tender, moist boiled chicken with creamy rice porridge!

ingredients.name: thin slices of ginger (about 1 inch round)
water (or 2 cups good quality chicken stock and 2 cups of water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off the excess fat from the chicken. You can also skin the chicken for less fat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the sweet rice, drain, and add to the pressure cooker/Instant Pot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the chicken on top of the rice. Add the scallion, garlic and ginger along with 4 cups of water (or 2 cups of chicken stock and 2 cups water).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Close the lid tightly. Press the “poultry” function, and using the “-” button, decrease the time to 25 (if close to 4 pounds) minutes. When finished, the Instant Pot will automatically turn to the “Keep Warm” mode. Leave the pressure cooker alone for about 10 to 15 minutes before opening the lid.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the chicken. You can turn the instant pot back on for an additional 5 minutes if you want thicker nurungji. Let it sit for about 10 minutes before scraping off the nurungji. Remove ginger and scallion. You can remove the garlic cloves as well, if desired.

title: Sweet and Sour Brussels Sprouts with Plum Sauce
description: The Brussels sprouts are roasted in the oven until golden and crispy and served with a sweet and sour plum sauce. The dish is so flavorful that it totally stands on its own as a main dish.

ingredients.name: to 1 1/2 lbs (450 to 600 g) Brussels sprouts (, tough ends removed and halved)
madras curry powder ((or Japanese curry powder))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the Brussels Sprouts: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place Brussels sprouts onto a baking tray. Add vegetable oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to mix well. Then spread out without overlapping. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 15 minutes. Flip the brussels sprouts to check on it twice, after 10 minutes and after 15 minutes. If the bottom has browned too fast, flip them and keep cooking. Once done, the bottom should have turned golden brown and the texture turned tender. If they are not quite done, return the baking sheet to the oven to bake for another 5 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For the Sauce: While baking Brussels sprouts, prep and cook the sauce. Heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and shallot. Stir and cook until the herbs start to sizzle. 3. Add the dried plums and stir a few times. Turn to medium low-heat. Add the curry powder. Cook until the ingredients are evenly coated with curry, 1 minute. Add the Chinkiang vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar. Continue cooking until it comes to a boil. Let cook for another minute or two, until the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Right before serving, place the Brussels sprouts in a bowl and add the plum sauce. Gently toss a few times and serve immediately as an appetizer or side dish. Add a few drops of homemade chili oil, if desired.

title: Quick Fry Bok Choy
description: Healthier quick stir-fry Chinese bok Choy

ingredients.name: tbsp. low sodium light soy sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the bok Choy and blanch in boiling water for around 2 minutes. Move out and drain. Make sure three is no extra water on the surface.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, add oyster sauce, salt, cornstarch and water to make the stir-fry sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil and add chopped garlic and chili peppers into stir fry for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add blanched bok Choy to wok and stir-fry sauce. Do a quick stir fry. Transfer out and enjoy!

title: Thai Fish Cakes (Tod Mun Pla) ทอดมันปลา
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: tender fish meat, dried thoroughly if thawed from frozen (see note)
Thai basil or holy basil, sliced into ribbons if large
Fish sauce, as needed (taste mixture before adding!)
spur chili (prik chee fah) or another type of big red chili pepper that's not too spicy
white vinegar, cane vinegar or rice vinegar
Optional add-ins for the dipping sauce: roasted crushed peanuts, sliced shallots

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place both chilies, garlic, vinegar, water, sugar and salt in a blender and blend just until there are no more chunks. I like to use low speed to blend so I still have chili seeds seeds and chili pieces for a nicer visual.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour the blended chilies into a small pot and bring to a simmer, then simmer for about 3-5 minutes or until it has a consistency of a thin syrup. The sauce will thicken as it cools, so if it is too thick once it is cool, you can add more water. Set aside until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the fish, curry paste, egg yolk and sugar in a food processor. Process until fine, scraping the sides as needed. Then keep processing for a few minutes longer until the fish is firm enough that it holds its shape well when spooned (see video). If this is your first time, cook up a bit of the mixture to taste for salt and spiciness. If you want a stronger curry flavour or more spiciness, add more curry paste, keeping in mind that that also adds more saltiness. If you just want more saltiness, add a little fish sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the fish paste into a mixing bowl and add chopped long beans, Thai basil and kaffir lime leaves; stir until well combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: (At this point you can deep fry the fish cakes like we traditionally do, or you can pan fry them as per instructions below)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Get your station ready by having a bowl of cold water and some paper towel (for your hands) by the stove. Heat a skillet over medium heat until hot, then add just enough oil to coat the bottom of the skillet. Wet your hands and a tablespoon in the cold water, then scoop a heaping tablespoon of fish paste with the wet spoon and place in your hands. Gently pat the fish cakes to form into patties and place in a preheated skillet. Fry until browned on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. You may need to add more oil as you go. Tip: I find it easier to form the cakes as you fry them, as opposed to pre-forming them all, because the mixture is quite soft and it's hard to pick up a pre-formed cake.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To serve, stir cucumber slices, peanuts and shallots into the dipping sauce and serve with the fish cakes. You can also serve extra cucumber on the side as it goes so well with fresh cucumber.

title: Instant Pot Refried Beans
description: These Instant Pot Refried Beans require no soaking and cut the cooking time in half compared to traditional refried beans. Creamy and flavorful!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour the dried beans into a large bowl. Pick out and discard any beans that are shriveled or split, as well as any small rocks that may have made their way into the bag.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the sorted beans and the water to the Instant Pot. Close the lid, set the pressure valve to the seal position, and pressure cook on high for 50 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then carefully open the valve to release any remaining pressure.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Set a large bowl underneath a strainer or colander. Pour the beans and the cooking liquid into the strainer so that the bowl underneath catches all of the cooking liquid. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn on the saute function on the Instant Pot and set to medium. Add the olive oil, onion, garlic, jalapeño, ground cumin, Mexican oregano, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions begin to caramelize.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn off the Instant Pot and add the cooked pinto beans. Stir and let the beans cook in the residual heat for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add in 1/2 cup of the reserved cooking liquid and stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Mash the beans using a potato masher for a chunky texture, or puree them using an immersion blender or a regular blender for a smooth texture.You may need to add more of the reserved cooking liquid if the beans are still too dry after mashing them.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Taste and season with more salt, if necessary. Serve with a sprinkle of cotija cheese and a squeeze of lime juice.

title: Middle Eastern Stuffed Zucchini Recipe
description: Middle Eastern stuffed zucchini recipe with a spiced rice and meat filling, cooked in red sauce. A must-try!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
large and very firm tomatoes, (divided (3 to be cored and stuffed, and 1 to be sliced))
Medium-sized zucchini or Middle Eastern zucchini, (about 8 or so zucchini, lightly peeled)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the stuffing ingredients of rice, ground beef, shredded onion, fresh parsley, dill, diced tomatoes, water, olive oil, allspice, garlic powder, and salt and pepper. Mix by hand to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now, remove the top of 3 tomatoes and remove the core to hollow out the tomatoes making room for the stuffing. Do this using a corer like this one.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: With a knife, remove the very top of the zucchini, then cut each zucchini in half to make shorter zucchini for stuffing. Now you need to hollow out the zucchini to make room for the stuffing.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Insert your corer about 3/4 of the way into the zucchini, making sure not to poke the bottoms. Twist the corer and pull out the zucchini cores or hearts. Do this a few times, and gently scrape the sides of the zucchini until you have hollowed each out making room for the stuffing. You'll want to leave about 1/4 inch rim of zucchini.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lightly oil the bottom of a large deep cooking pan like this one. Slice the remaining tomato and spread over the bottom of the pan. Now add the onion slices and the cores or hearts of the zucchini. Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now, using your hands, gently stuff the hollowed tomatoes with the rice stuffing. Then loosely stuff the zucchini with the rice stuffing about 3/4 of the way (do not over-stuff or crowd the rice stuffing in the zucchini or it will not cook well).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Arrange the stuffed tomatoes in the center of the cooking pan, then add the stuffed zucchini (stuffed side up) around them. Tilt the zucchini a little, this helps them cook nicely through using less liquid.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Now add the tomato sauce and water. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the pan on the stove and cook on medium-high heat until the liquid starts boiling. Turn the heat down, cover and simmer for for 50 minutes until the zucchini is tender and the rice stuffing is fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Transfer to a serving platter or individual bowls. Top with the sauce from the cooking pan. Enjoy!

title: Instant Pot Pozole
description: This Instant Pot Pozole recipe is so user friendly, you'll have this delicious, flavorful Mexican staple ready in one hour.

ingredients.name: árbol chiles, (rinsed (seeds removed if you want a mild spice level))
(15-oz) cans white hominy, (drained and rinsed (about 4 cups))
thinly shredded cabbage, diced white onions, lime wedges, dried Mexican oregano, cilantro, thinly sliced radishes, avocado

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the chile sauce: In a small pot over high heat, bring the water to a boil. Remove it from the heat and add in the dried chiles. Cover and let the chiles soak for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Carefully transfer the softened chiles and the hot water into a large blender. Add the salt, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic, and Mexican chocolate. Blend for 2-3 minutes until completely smooth. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the pozole: Season all sides of the meat with the salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Press the saute button on the Instant Pot. When hot, add 1 tablespoon of oil and 3 or 4 pieces of meat. Brown the meat on all sides, flipping every 60 seconds. When browned, transfer to a plate and set aside. Continue working in batches until all the meat is browned.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer all the meat back into the Instant Pot and turn it off. Pour in the red chile sauce and scrape the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon to loosen all the brown bits. Stir in the broth, hominy, and dried oregano and combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Close the lid of the Instant Pot and move the valve to the sealing position. Press the Manual or Pressure Cook button to high pressure, then adjust the +/- buttons until the time reads 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When finished cooking, carefully move the valve to the venting position and release the pressure. Remove the lid.

title: Homemade Pita Bread Recipe
description: My family's authentic, fool-proof pita bread recipe is easy to make and requires a few ingredients you may already have on hand!

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, divided (or 1 1/2 cup all-purpose flour and 1 1/2 cup whole wheat flour)
to 2 tsp kosher salt (I used Diamond Crystal kosher salt)
extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil), more for the bowl

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl add the lukewarm water and stir in yeast and sugar until dissolved. Add 1/2 cup flour and whisk together. Place the mixing bowl in a warm place, uncovered to form a lose sponge. Give it 15 minutes or so, the mixture should bubble.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now add salt, olive oil and almost all the remaining flour (keep about 1/2 cup of the flour for dusting later). Stir until mixture forms a shaggy mass (at this point, the dough has little to no gluten development and just looks like a sticky mess and you can easily pull bits off). Dust with a little flour, then knead the mixture inside the bowl for about a minute to incorporate any stray bits.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dust a clean working surface with just a little bit of flour. Knead lightly for a couple minutes or so until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes, then knead again for a couple more minutes. The dough should be a little bit moist, you can help it with a little dusting of flour, but be careful not to add too much flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Clean the mixing bowl and coat it lightly with extra virgin olive oil and put the dough back in the bowl. Turn the dough a couple times in the bowl to coat with the olive oil. Cover the mixing bowl tightly with plastic wrap then lay a kitchen towel over. Put the bowl in a warm place. Leave it alone for 1 hour or until the dough rises to double its size.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Deflate the dough and place it on a clean work surface. Divide the dough into 7 to 8 equal pieces and shape them into balls. Cover with a towel and leave them for 10 minutes or so to rest.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Using a floured rolling pin, roll one of the pieces into a circle that’s 8-9 inches wide and about a quarter inch thick. It helps to lift and turn the dough frequently as you roll so that dough doesn’t stick to your counter too much. (If dough starts to stick, sprinkle a tiny bit of flour). If the dough starts to spring back, set it aside to rest for a few minutes, then continue rolling. Repeat with the other pieces of dough. (Once you get going, you can be cooking one pita while rolling another, if you like). You have two options for baking the pita from here.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat the oven to 475 degrees F and place a heavy-duty baking pan or large cast iron skillet on the middle rack to heat. Working in batches, place the rolled-out pitas directly on the hot baking baking sheet (I was only able to fit 2 at a time). Bake for 2 minutes on one side, and then, using a pair of tongs, carefully turn pita over to bake for 1 minute on the other side. The pita will puff nicely and should be ready. Remove from the oven and cover the baked pitas with a clean towel while you work on the rest of the pitas.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To cook pita on stovetop: Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. (Test by adding a couple drops of water to the skillet, the skillet is ready when the beads of water sizzle immediately). Drizzle a tiny bit of extra virgin olive oil and wipe off any excess. Working with one pita at a time, lay a rolled-out pita on the skillet and bake for 30 seconds, until bubbles start to form. Using a spatula, flip the pita over and cook for 1-2 minutes on the other side, until large toasted spots appear on the underside. Flip again and cook another 1-2 minutes to toast the other side. The pita is ready when it puffs up forming a pocket (sometimes, with this method, the pita may not puff or may only form a small pocket. Try pressing the surface of the pita gently with a clean towel). Keep baked pita covered with a clean towel while you work on the rest.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make ginger water by adding the grated ginger to 4 tablespoons of water. Run it through a sieve to remove the fibrous part.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sift the flour and salt together. Add 4 tablespoons of ginger water, and mix it well. Knead with the heel of your hand until the dough comes together without visible flour in the dough and the bowl. Add a little more water if necessary, a teaspoon at a time. It should feel dry and stiff for easy shaping of cookies. Cover with a plastic wrap, and let it rest for 30 minutes. After resting, the dough will feel slightly softer.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.description: Flour a cutting board. Cut the dough (if used 1 cup of flour) into two pieces for easier handling. Flatten one piece to a small rectangle. Wrap the other one until ready to use. Roll the flattened one with a rolling pin to make a thin rectangle, about 5 x 8-inch.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut the rectangle in half lengthwise, and then cut each half into about 6 1-inch small rectangles.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fold a piece in the middle. From the folded side, make a slit in the middle, and then a shorter slit on each side of the middle slit.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Unfold it, and push one end through the middle slit, wiggling it gently to shape it. Repeat with all pieces. Repeat steps 4, 5, 6 and 7 with the other half of the dough from step 4.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour about 1 inch of oil into a heavy bottom pan. When the oil is hot (275°F/135°C), drop the pieces in one at a time. Cook for about 3 minutes. Remove and briefly set them on a wire rack or in a strainer.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Coat with the syrup while still warm. Sprinkle with the optional pine nuts on top.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: For the bi-color dough - optional

title: Blondies (Chocolate)
description: Chocolate Chip Blondies - easy and delicious breakfast or snack treat with only less than 10 minutes prep time. Chewy, sweet, rich and crunchy on the edges!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spray a 8×8 inch baking pan with cooking spray; set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium saucepan butter over medium heat until melted. Set aside and let it cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile whisk flour, salt, baking powder and in a medium bowl; set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk eggs, vanilla, almond white and brown sugar until combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in melted butter, mix and add flour mixture until everything has been fully incorporated.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add chocolate chips and scoop batter on to prepared pan and bake for about 20-22 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Allow to cool before slicing into square shapes about 12.

title: Sweet Tamales
description: Sweet Tamales made with raisins and sweetened with cinnamon and sugar. Easy to make and perfect for holidays and celebrations!

ingredients.name: + 2 tablespoons canola oil ((or corn, vegetable or other neutral-tasting oil))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prep the corn husks: Add the corn husks to a large bowl or pot. Pour enough hot water over the corn husks to cover them completely. Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and let them soak for 1 hour to soften them up. Meanwhile, rehydrate the raisins and make the sweet tamale dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rehydrate the raisins: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, add raisins and cover completely with water. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring after every minute. Remove from microwave, cover with aluminum foil or a plate and let sit for 15 minutes. Drain and discard the water. Set rehydrated raisins aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the masa harina: In a large mixing bowl, add masa harina, granulated sugar, baking powder, ground cinnamon and salt. Mix together to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the oil: Add canola oil and mix together with your hands, working the dough through your fingers until everything is well combined and incorporated. The dough should feel a little crumbly, almost like wet sand, and should lightly hold its shape when pressed together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the rehydrated raisins: Add 3 cups warm water and rehydrated raisins. Mix together with a spoon until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finish prepping the corn husks: Drain the water from the corn husks and pat them dry. Lay them flat onto a baking sheet for easy access.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fill the corn husks: Grab a corn husk and identify which is the smooth side and which is the side with ridges. Place the smooth side face up into your palm or on a plate. Using a large spoon, scoop a big spoonful of the sweet tamale dough into the middle of the softened corn husks and close - no need to spread it out since all the filling is already mixed in!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Fold: Fold together the long edges of the corn husk like a book, and then fold it once more. Fold the pointy edge over so that only one side of the corn husk is open and exposed, and secure the folded edge with thin strip of corn husk by tied a knot around the tamale. If you don't want to go to the trouble of tying a knot around each tamale, you don't have to.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Prepare the steamer pot: Fill the bottom of the steamer pot with water and cover with the steamer insert. Place the sweet tamales in the steamer with the open end facing up, making sure to lean them against the side of the pot so they don't fall down.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Steam: Cover tightly with the lid and place steamer over medium-high heat. Bring the water in the steamer pot to a boil (you should be able to hear it bubbling), then reduce the heat to low. Cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the masa is fully cooked. To check and see if it's cooked, carefully remove a tamale and open it up. The masa should easily separate from the corn husks and it should be fairly firm. When ready to eat, remove tamales from steamer, let sit for 3 minutes to cool, then serve.

title: Easy Sweet Potato Doughnuts ขนมไข่เต่า ไข่นกกระทา
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 2-3 Tbsp sugar (depending on sweetness of the potato, but 2 1/2 is a good place to start)
1-3 Tbsp coconut milk (depends on moistness of the sweet potato)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut sweet potato into chunks and steam them until fully cooked, 10-15 minutes. Pierce the biggest piece is a fork and it should go in with NO resistance. Do not boil them, we want to minimize the moisture of the sweet potato! Transfer the potatoes on to a plate and mash with a fork until smooth. Let it cool to room temp.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer cooled mashed potato to a mixing bowl, add sugar and salt then stir until combined. Add tapioca starch and flour, then sift in baking powder, then stir everything together briefly just to see where the dough is at in terms of moistness. If it needs more liquid to mix (i.e. there's a lot of dry flour that can't be incorporated) add coconut milk, 1 Tbsp at a time, until all the flour can be incorporated. Make sure you stir in that 1 Tbsp of coconut milk well before adding the next. You do NOT want to add too much liquid or you'll have a hard time forming balls.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once all the dry flour has been incorporated, you should be able to form the dough into balls easily, it shouldn't stick to your hands but it should also be soft. You should not need more than 4 Tbsp of coconut milk. See video for the texture of dough you're aiming for.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Scoop up a heaped teaspoon worth of dough (as in a measuring teaspoon, not your dessert spoon), and roll them into balls.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add enough oil into your pot to make sure it is deeper than the diameter of your balls because you want to make sure the balls can be completely submerged.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat the oil to 325°F, add the balls and make sure you stir them as soon as they go in—they will sink to the bottom in the beginning and if you don't stir them soon enough they will develop a brown patch where they touch the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Keep frying them, and eventually they will float, and once they float make sure you keep stirring them around so that they brown evenly. Let them fry for a full 5 mins, even if they colour has turned golden, in order to give them time to develop a crisp crust. Keep your temp around 325°F or they could brown too quickly. Note: If after 5 minutes of frying they're still not brown enough, just crank the heat and get them there. It just means your temp is a little low.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Scoop them up, shake off excess oil, then place them on a paper-towel lined plate. Immediately put another piece of paper towel on top and roll them around in between two sheets of paper towel to absorb surface oil. Transfer on to a rack to let them cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve these once they're cool enough to eat, they're only good when eaten fresh! These do not keep well at all, so only fry as much as you can eat, and keep the rest of the dough to fry up later. The dough will keep in the fridge at least 2 days.

title: Grilled Chicken Kofta
description: You'll love this delicious grilled chicken kofta recipe! It has a little heat from the Aleppo pepper and it's loaded with flavor from garlic, fresh herbs and olive oil.

ingredients.name: small piece sliced sandwich bread (I used whole wheat bread. Gluten free bread if needed)
small onion, grated (about 1/2 cup grated onion)
Aleppo pepper (mild/sweet pepper flakes), more for later
Drizzle extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Toast the bread until golden brown. Place it in a small bowl and cover with water. Let it sit until tender then squeeze the bread to wring out all the water (it should fall apart into smaller pieces).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the bread in a large mixing bowl. Add the ground chicken, onion, garlic, fresh parsley, mint, spices and a dash of salt and pepper. Add the egg and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Using clean hands, mix the chicken mixture until everything is well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wet your hand with a tiny bit of water and begin to form the chicken mixture into 8 oval patties that are about 1 to 1 1/2-inch in thickness (the chicken mixture may feel a bit sticky, which is fine, but the wet hands should help). Arrange the kofta patties on a tray or large plate and refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes or so just while the grill is heating.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Grease the grates of a gas grill or an indoor griddle with a little bit of oil and heat to medium-high. Place the kofta on the grill and cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side until fully cooked through (use spatula to carefully turn the kofta over halfway through cooking).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately, garnished with another sprinkle of Aleppo pepper or chili pepper flakes and your choice of sides (in this post, I served the kofta with homemade hummus, simple Mediterranean salad, pita bread and some olives).

title: Greek Pork Chops Recipe with Roast Potatoes (Brizola sto Fourno)
description: The perfect Greek pork chops recipe. Golden and crusty on the outside and perfectly tender and succulent on the inside flavoured with a delicious Greek style marinade.

ingredients.name: medium sized potatoes, cut in wedges

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek brizola recipe with roast potatoes (Greek pork chops), start by preparing the marinade. In a large bowl add the roughly chopped onions, the garlic slices and the pork chops (brizola). Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Sprinkle the pork chops with oregano and blend to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, chill and let marinade for 1-2 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut a large piece of parchment paper and soak it with water. Squeeze to get rid of the excessive water and line on a large baking tray. Place the potatoes on the parchment paper, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, pour in the white wine and season with salt. Sprinkle the potatoes with oregano and minced garlic. Cover with a large wet piece of parchment paper and join the edges together to seal. Bake at 180C for about 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now it’s time to get some colour on the pork chops. Heat a griddle pan over high heat and sear the pork chops for about 1 minute on each side, until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the baking tray out of the oven. Uncover the parchment paper and place the pork chops over the potatoes on a single layer. Cover again to seal and pop back in the oven for about 10-15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the pork chops.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the baking tray from the oven, unwrap and remove the pork chops. Cover the pork chops with aluminium foil and let rest for 10 minutes. Bake the potatoes uncovered for about 15 minutes, until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve while still warm. Enjoy!

title: Cajun Chicken Pasta
description: Spicy, Cajun-flavored chicken tossed into creamy melt-in-your-mouth Alfredo sauce with pasta. Super easy to make with amazing flavors that are perfect for family weeknight dinners or get-togethers!

ingredients.name: boneless and skinless chicken thighs (or breast)
medium red or green bell pepper, (sliced)
heavy cream ((see notes for options and adjustments ))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil your pasta in a large pot per the box instructions. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Next, salt the chicken according to taste. Then, generously season with Creole Cajun Seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat oil over medium heat in a cast-iron skillet. Pan-sear the chicken for about 8–10 minutes on each side or until fully cooked, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add onions and garlic. Stir for about a minute. Then add tomatoes, thyme, paprika, Cajun seasoning, Worcestershire sauce, bell peppers, chicken broth, and cream.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring the sauce to a boil, lower the heat, and simmer for 7–10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Slice the chicken. Mix the pasta into the sauce, add the chicken, and toss until thoroughly combined. You can also serve the chicken on top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Sprinkle with parsley and Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!

title: Tabbouleh Recipe (Tabouli Salad)
description: Tabbouleh is a Lebanese parsley salad made with fresh herbs, bulgur wheat, tomatoes, onions, mint, olive oil and lemon dressing. It is light, refreshing and full of fresh herb flavors with mild chewiness from bulgur.

ingredients.name: (65 grams) bulgur (– fine or super fine)
red onions (– finely chopped or swap with scallions/spring onions)
ground black pepper ( or white pepper)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the bulgur a few times. Place it in a bowl and pour boiling hot water over it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover and soak for 15 to 20 minutes or until softened and slightly chewy. Drain very well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables by finely chopping the onions and chopping the cucumber into 0.5 cm cubes. Halve the cherry tomatoes or quarter them if they are larger.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Rinse and dry the parsley and mint thoroughly. Chop them finely without crushing the leaves.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine the soaked bulgur, chopped vegetables and herbs in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly until evenly combined.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let the salad rest for 15 minutes at room temperature so the flavors blend well. You can also chill it in the refrigerator for 15 to 30 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve fresh with lemon wedges or garnish with mint sprigs, pomegranate arils or feta if preferred.

title: Curried Vegan Green Bean Casserole
description: This curried green bean casserole is an easy homemade vegan Thanksgiving dish that has all the creaminess of traditional creamed beans, but with the bold taste of fresh wholesome ingredients and Indian-inspired aromatics.

ingredients.name: (680 g) green beans (, tough ends removed and then halved crosswise)
(19 oz. / 560 ml) can coconut cream ((2 cups) )
soy sauce ((or tamari or coconut amino for gluten-free))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare an ice bath. Heat a large pot of water over medium-high heat to bring to a boil. Add the green beans. Let cook for 1 minute. Strain the green beans and transfer to the ice bath until completely cooled. Drain again and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat in a large nonstick skillet until hot. Add the yellow onion. Cook and stir until it becomes transparent and slightly yellow, 10 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the garlic. Cook and stir for 1 minute to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add mushrooms and drizzle 1 tablespoon oil on top. Cook and stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Use your spatula to move the veggies around the edge of the pan so the center is empty. Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and add the curry powder on top. Stir and cook the curry powder for 20 seconds to release the fragrance. Then stir everything together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the coconut cream, vegetable stock, salt, soy sauce, and sugar. Cook and stir occasionally until it thickens, 10 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (176 C).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the mushroom cream is reduced to a thick sauce, turn off the heat. Add the green beans to the mushroom cream. Stir everything together, then transfer to a large baking dish (11” x 7” x 2”). Bake for 30 minutes, until the green beans are just cooked through and the sauce becomes very creamy.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer the baking dish onto the kitchen counter. Sprinkle a layer of fried shallots on top. Return the dish to the oven and bake for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve hot or warm as a side dish.

title: Kkagangjeong (Sesame crunch)
description: This nutty, crunchy and healthy sesame crunch is so easy to make with sesame seeds, honey, and sugar! You can also add your favorite nuts and/or seeds.

ingredients.name: honey (or corn syrup, oligo syrup, rice syrup, etc. )
any roasted nuts and seeds (pine nuts, almonds, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, etc.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Toast sesame seeds in a dry pan over medium low heat for 5 to 6 minutes. Keep your eye on it not to burn them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the honey, sugar, salt and water to a pan. Stir to mix over medium low heat. Let it bubble up. Continue to cook, without stirring, until it turns light golden brown, about 3 minutes or a little longer depending on your heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat off. Stir in the sesame seeds and nuts. Stir well until everything is well coated with the syrup.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the mixture between two pieces of parchment paper. Let cool for a minute, or the mixture can stick to the paper. Press it down to flatten it, and roll it out with a rolling pin to a 1/4 to 1/2-thick rectangle. Using a side of a knife, push in the rough sides to straighten up a bit. Roll it again to an even thickness, as necessary.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When the crunch is hardened but still slightly warm, cut with a sharp knife into desired sizes.

title: Chinese BBQ Pork Buns
description: Homemade soft and yummy steamed Chinese BBQ Pork Buns.

ingredients.name: all purpose flour + more for dusting

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the filling

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the wrapper

title: Thai Fruit Dip (Nam Pla Waan)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 2-3 Tbsp fish sauce (depends on the saltiness of your shrimp paste)
Thai chilies, thinly sliced or minced, to taste
Tart, firm fruit for dipping: green mango, green apple, underripe pineapple, firm tart strawberries, cape gooseberries...or try it with something else!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine palm sugar, 2 Tbsp of fish sauce, shrimp paste and water in a small pot. Cook on medium-low heat until the sugar is dissolved, mashing the lumps of sugar along the way to help it go faster.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, grind 2 Tbsp of dried shrimp in a coffee grinder or blender until fine. Chop the other 1 Tbsp into small chunks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once all the sugar is dissolved and the mixture comes to a full boil, turn off the heat. Stir in the dried shrimp (both sets) and chilies. You can choose to stir the shallots in now while it's hot so the shallots cook and wilt a little, or stir them in once cooled to keep them fresh and pungent.Taste and adjust the sweet/salty balance as needed (you can try it with a piece of fruit so you have a better idea of how well it works and whether it needs to be sweeter or saltier).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Let cool to room temp and serve! You can keep this in the fridge in a jar and it will last you at least a month.

title: Easy Sprinkle Cookies
description: These melt-in-your-mouth sprinkle cookies are buttery, soft and chewy on the inside with a little crunch on the outside thanks to the nonpareils sprinkles!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper and pour the sprinkles in a small bowl. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, add butter and sugar. Beat with a hand mixer or a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment until creamed together, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add egg and vanilla extract. Beat for 30 seconds to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add flour one cup at a time and mixing on low until well combined before adding in the next cup of flour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Scoop and roll the dough into 18 balls (about 2 tablespoons per ball), and place them on the prepared baking sheets.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll each ball in the sprinkles, pressing down firmly to get them to stick to the outside as much as possible. Transfer to prepared baking sheets.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Flatten the cookies by gently pressing down on the tops with a flat surface until they're about 1/4 in thick. (The bottom of a measuring cup works great for this!)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the bottoms of the cookies are light to golden brown.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Lighter Orange Ricotta Cake
description: This Italian-inspired orange ricotta cake is moist, soft, and bursting with intense orange flavor from zest and fresh orange slices!

ingredients.name: orange zested and sliced PLUS zest of one more orange (use pink navel oranges, blood oranges or any oranges you find)
PLUS 2 tbsp quality extra virgin olive oil,

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F. Butter a 9-inch baking pan very well (on bottom and both sides generously). Line bottom with round of parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir brown sugar and water together to make a thick, pasty slurry, then spread it very thinly and evenly across the bottom of the pan (I used the back of a spoon and kept smoothing the slurry over until it was nice and even).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Arrange the orange slices on top of the brown sugar coating in bottom of the cake pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, whisk the ricotta, olive oil and vanilla. Add one egg at a time and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sift flour, baking powder and salt directly over the wet ingredients. Whisk or mix using a wooden spoon. Combine the sugar with the zest of two oranges and add that to the mixture. Mix again until batter is well combined (it may look a little thick and grainy. That's fine, but be sure it's well combined)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Scoop batter into the prepared cake pan. Gently shake to spread evenly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake in heated oven for 45 minutes or more until a toothpick inserted in the middle of the cake comes out clean (You should begin to check at 40 minutes or so, but this could take 1 hour to bake. You want to make sure the bottom has a nice deep caramel color but does not burn)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cool in the pan for 5 minutes or so. Run a thin knife around the corners to loosen the cake, then carefully invert onto serving plate. (Some of the orange slices at the bottom may get stuck in the pan, gently pull them up and arrange them on the cake if needed. But this is why a well-greased pan is important).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let cool completely, then cut into slices. Serve as is, or add a dollop of creme fraiche or your favorite ice-cream. Enjoy!

title: Chicken and Rice Soup
description: The perfect weeknight meal that comes together in a snap. Juicy chunks of chicken, tender vegetables, and flavorful rice make the ideal combination. Savory, brothy goodness guaranteed to warm your soul and fill your belly.

ingredients.name: stalk celery, (cut into ½-inch slices (about ¾ cup))
7-8 cups (1.5-1.9l) chicken stock, ((or water) adjust to desired soup consistency)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chicken chunks in a large bowl, mix with salt and black pepper, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add oil to a large pot over medium heat. Then brown chicken chunks for a few minutes or until brown enough.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Next, add chopped onion, garlic, celery, thyme, bouillon powder, Italian seasoning, Creole seasoning, and bay leaf.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook and stir for about 6 minutes until the vegetables are softened but not browned.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in the chicken broth or water and bring to a boil. Add the rice and carrots, and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer on medium-low until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with parsley and serve warm.

title: Greek Stuffed Peppers with Feta Cheese Recipe
description: A traditional Greek stuffed peppers with feta cheese recipe! The tanginess of strong, traditional Greek feta cheese combined with the sweetness of Romano peppers make for an extraordinary culinary combination!

ingredients.name: feta cheese, crushed with a fork (4 ounces)
kefalotyri or any hard yellow cheese, grated (2 ounces)
of olive oil for the stuffing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a saucepan with plenty of boiling salted water, add the peppers and leave them for 5 minutes, until softened. Place the peppers on some paper towel to dry and then cut the upper part of the peppers, along with the stalks and seeds (you will need them later).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the stuffing. In a food processor, add 2 tbsp’s of olive oil, the garlic and the onion and blend. Add Into a large bowl, along with the chopped parsley, the chopped tomato, the feta cheese, the kefalotyri and mix with with a fork, until the ingredients are combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a teaspoon to fill the peppers with the stuffing; spread them in a greased oven tray and use a cooking brush, to coat them with olive oil. Place the stalks back on the peppers, so that the cheese won’t pour out, when melted.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 170C for 1/2 hour until the peppers are nicely colored and the cheese starts to melt

title: Baked Chicken Tenders
description: Baked Chicken Tenders - incredibly crunchy, tender and flavorful baked chicken tenders coated dipped in a buttermilk mixture and coated with a well-seasoned flour and buttery and herb-y sauteed breadcrumbs.

ingredients.name: chicken tenders or skinless, boneless chicken breasts (, cut into ￼½-in.-thick strips)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 Degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Next line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil paper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While oven is warming up, cut chicken into desired shapes , if using whole chicken breast. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Whisk buttermilk and eggs in another medium bowl. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a medium bowl, combine: flour, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, Italian seasoning and white pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place small skillet on medium heat, add butter, stir for about 30 seconds then throw in bread crumbs. Season with black pepper . Saute for about 3 -4 minutes or until fragrant and slightly brown. Throw in dried parsley, if desired , Transfer to a bowl and let it cool. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Start evenly coating the chicken in the flour mixture first, then in the buttermilk bowl and finally into the breadcrumbs bowl.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Gently Shake excess breadcrumbs .Place chicken tenders in a single layer on prepared baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Repeat the same step with the rest of the chicken pieces.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake in for 8-9 minutes, or until bottom starts to brown , then carefully flip chicken tenders over , so as not to remove the breadcrumbs , Continue baking for another 8 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.

title: Chicago Deep Dish Pizza Recipe
description: Chicago-Style Deep Dish Pizza is a thick crust pizza layered with mozzarella cheese, sautéed onions, bell peppers, button mushrooms and tangy marinara sauce. The crust is buttery, crisp at the edges and soft and chewy inside.

ingredients.name: or 85 grams semolina flour ((rava/sooji) or cornmeal)
olive oil (– divided, for brushing the parchment)
olive oil (– divided, for brushing on the dough after the second proofing)
or 300 grams mozzarella cheese ((shredded or finely diced), divided)
medium to large green bell pepper ((capsicum) – sliced)
to 2 cups button mushrooms (– sliced or chopped)
ground black pepper (or black pepper powder)
to ½ teaspoon mixed dried herbs (or pizza seasoning)
to 1¼ cups marinara sauce ( or pizza sauce, divided)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making Deep Dish Pizza Crust Dough

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preparing Toppings

steps.title: Step 3

title: Slow Roast Goose With Black Currant Sauce
description: A perfect dish for your Thanksgiving or Christmas dinner, which you can make in advance with minimal hands-on time.

ingredients.name: (8 to 10 lbs / 3.5 to 4.5 kg) whole goose
to 7 citrus fruits (, lemon, lime, grapefruit, and/or orange, peels removed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Adjust oven rack to the lower third. Preheat oven to 120°C (250°F). Line a baking pan with aluminium foil (for easy cleanup) and top with a V-rack.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a plate. Transfer the neck and giblets from the goose cavity to the plate, and save for making stock later. Use a pair of poultry shears to trim the neck skin. Do not trim any skin from the bottom of the goose, because it will keep the meat moist during roasting.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place goose on a working surface or cutting board. Use a toothpick to prick the goose skin on the breast and the thigh without piercing the meat, as many times as possible or at least about 1/3 inch (1 cm) apart. Note, the thickness of goose skin is not consistent, so start slow and do not prick too deep. If the skin is too tough to prick through, let the goose rest at room temperature for 30 minutes, or use your hands to massage the skin to loosen it up.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Rub both sides and the inside of the goose with a generous amount of sea salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stuff citrus inside the goose, using as many fruits as you can. Use a few toothpicks to seal the bottom of the goose, to secure the fruits inside. Place goose onto the V-rack, breast side up.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake until the skin turns golden brown, 8 to 10 hours. You do not need to flip the goose or monitor the process.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If you’re going to serve the goose immediately, turn up the heat to 260°C (500°F) to brown the goose for another 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: If you’re going to serve the goose later, remove the goose from the oven. Place the goose in a cool place, loosely covered with aluminum foil, if you’re going to serve it the same day. Alternatively, you could let the goose rest for 30 minutes, then carve it into breast and leg pieces. Use aluminum foil to wrap the pieces, seal them in Ziplock bags, and store them in the fridge for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Reheat goose

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Thirty minutes before serving, heat oven to 200°C (400°F). Roast the whole goose for 30 minutes, or until the skin turns dark brown and crispy. If you have carved the goose, spread the pieces on an aluminum-foil-lined baking sheet, and bake until the skin turns crispy, 15 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Fruit sauce

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: While resting (or reheating) the goose, cook the fruit sauce. Dissolve potato starch in a few tablespoons of the sparkling wine.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Heat the rest of the sparking wine with the ginger powder in a small saucepan until bringing to a simmer. Turn to medium low heat and let simmer for 10 minutes so that the alcohol evaporates. Add the black currant jam and a pinch of salt. Stir and mix so that the jam incorporates with the wine. When the liquid comes to a simmer, taste it and adjust the flavor by adding more wine or jam.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Stir the cornstarch slurry again so that the starch fully dissolves. Slowly pour half of the slurry into the sauce, stirring at the same time. Continue adding more slurry to get the sauce to the desired thickness.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Serve

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Remove the goose from the oven and let it rest for 15 to 30 minutes for an un-carved goose. You don’t need to rest it if you’ve already carved the goose. Do NOT cover the goose with foil. The stuffing will keep the meat hot.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Transfer the goose onto a large cutting board, carve, then slice the breast meat into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Serve the goose hot with the fruit sauce on the side.

title: Korean Pickled Garlic (Maneul Jangajji)
description: Pickled garlic is a staple side dish in Korea. Through a two-step process, the garlic loses much of its pungent bite and becomes slightly sweet and tangy.

ingredients.name: non-iodized salt (Kosher salt or sea salt)
water ((bottled water, preferably, for less mineral))
1- quart jar with a lid (The photo above shows two batches.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Separate the garlic cloves from the bulbs. Soak in hot water for 30 minutes or longer. Soaking the garlic helps the skins come off easily. Peel and remove the root ends with a small knife. Rinse and drain. Add to the jar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir the vinegar brine ingredients together until the salt is dissolved. Pour over the garlic cloves. The liquid should fully cover the garlic cloves. Close the lid and let stand at room temperature for 7 to 10 days or longer without exposure to sunlight. (See note 1)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring the soy sauce, sugar and water to a boil, and gently boil for a minute over medium heat. Pour in the vinegar. Drain the vinegar brine (first brine) from the jar. Pour the soy brine, while still hot, over the garlic cloves.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make sure all the garlic cloves are fully covered. Close tightly with a lid, and let stand at room temperature for 2 weeks without exposure to sunlight (see note 1). The garlic can be eaten at this point, but it will taste better as it matures. Refrigerate after opening. The garlic cloves will keep for a few months or longer. (See note 2.)

title: Quick Cauliflower Curry Stir Fry
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: fish sauce or a pinch of salt (see note)
A dash fish sauce or soy sauce as needed (this will depend on the saltiness of your curry paste)
Fried shallots (optional, recipe below, see note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large skillet, add just enough oil to coat the bottom. Turn the heat on to medium high, and before the oil gets too hot, add cauliflower and sprinkle on some fish sauce or salt, toss briefly to mix. Arrange the cauliflower so that the flat side is touching the pan. Let sear for a few minutes until browned. You can just sear them on one side if you wanna be quick, or you can flip the florets and sear them on another side as well. We're not looking for them to be fully cooked at this point, the goal is to develop browning and flavour; we will finish cooking them in the wok.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a wok, add half of the coconut milk and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Stir in curry paste and paprika (if using) then reduce the coconut milk until thick and the coconut oil starts separating from the paste and the paste is sizzling. Add palm sugar and stir to mostly dissolve it. Add the remaining coconut milk and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onions, stir briefly to break up the layers, then add the cauliflower and keep tossing until the florets are done to your liking. Timing will depend on how cooked the cauliflower is from searing, and how soft/firm you like them. If the sauce dries up before the cauliflower cooks, add a splash of water to buy it some more time.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once cauliflower is done, add tomatoes and toss for 30 seconds to heat through. Turn off the heat, then taste add more fish sauce or soy sauce as needed. Toss in cilantro to finish. Plate and top with some fried shallots if you wish, and serve with jasmine rice! Enjoy!

title: "Swimming Rama" Thai Peanut Sauce w/ Spinach & Pork พระรามลงสรง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: pork loin or chicken breast, thinly sliced
Optional condiment: Thai chili paste (see note 3)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a bowl, toss the pork or chicken with fish sauce, water and oil. Add cornstarch and toss well to mix; let marinate for at least 20 minutes or until all the water has been absorbed into the meat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Reduce ½ cup coconut milk in a pot over medium heat until very thick.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add curry paste and stir to break it apart. If you have a hard time getting the curry paste clumps to loosen, you can add a splash of coconut milk to help it along. Keep stirring until coconut oil starts separating away from the paste and the paste is sizzling.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and tamarind and bring it to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, place the peanuts and sesame seeds into a food processor and blitz until they turn into a coarse meal. You can also pound them in a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir the peanut mixture into the sauce and let it simmer gently for 20 minutes to allow the flavours to fully develop.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the sauce is done simmering, you can add more water if the sauce is too thick. It should be rich but can still pour easily without being gloppy. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

title: Pan de Elote
description: Pan de Elote is a moist and sweet Mexican corn cake made with corn kernels, eggs flour, butter, and sweetened condensed milk.

ingredients.name: nonstick cooking spray or butter, (for greasing pan)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Coat a 9×13-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray or grease with butter. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To a large blender, add 3 ¾ cups of the corn kernels, eggs, sweetened condensed milk, butter, milk, flour, baking powder, vanilla extract, and salt. Blend until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining ¼ cup of corn kernels and give the batter one last pulse to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the wet batter into the prepared baking pan and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from oven and let cool for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Moroccan-Style Carrot Salad
description: Simple, unique, and flavorful is what this Moroccan carrot salad is all about! Tender cooked carrots are tossed with fresh herbs and warm Moroccan spices like cumin and harissa, then dressed in lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil.

ingredients.name: carrots, peeled and cut into medallions
chopped fresh cilantro (mint or parsley would work as well)
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add carrots and cook for about 20 minutes until nice and tender. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the cooked carrots immediately to a large mixing bowl. And while nice and warm, season with a dash kosher salt, and the spices (harissa spice, cumin, coriander and paprika.) Add minced garlic, celery, cilantro, lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If you like, add a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds. Give the carrot salad a good toss to combine. Set the carrot salad aside for a bit before serving (it’s best served at room temperature.)

title: Chicken Francese
description: This CHICKEN FRANCESE is a popular Italian-American dish made with egg and flour-coated chicken breast, pan-fried until golden, then simmered in a lemony white wine sauce. A one-pan gourmet dish that comes ready in just 20 minutes!

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper to taste
freshly squeezed juice from half a lemon
salt and black pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the chicken on a chopping board, then cover with a plastic wrap. Using a mallet, pound until all the pieces are of even thickness as possible. About a ¼ inch is best, but the essential thing is making sure the width is as uniform as possible. You need to cover the meat before you beat it to keep the fluids from flying around the room. Lightly season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add flour onto a plate, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. Mix until combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, add eggs, parmesan, and basil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Start by dredging chicken breast in flour mixture and then dip into the egg mixture, making sure the chicken is fully coated.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat oil in a cast iron or skillet over medium-high heat; add chicken and cook until golden brown — about 4-5 minutes. Flip and cook chicken on the other side until completely cooked through and nicely browned, about another 3 - 4 minutes. Chicken internal temperature should reach 160 Degrees F. Remove and set aside and repeat with remaining chicken.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add butter to the same skillet and let it melt, then add flour and garlic and cook for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour in the white wine and chicken stock, then bring to a boil. Reduce the heat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the lemon juice. Stir until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Season with salt, pepper flakes, and black pepper to taste. Taste and adjust seasonings, if necessary. Return chicken back to the skillet, cook for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove and serve garnished with parsley. Enjoy!

title: Kabocha Pumpkin Pie (a Lighter and Fluffier Pie)
description: This kabocha pumpkin pie recipe creates a lighter and fluffier version of the traditional pumpkin pie.

ingredients.name: pie dough for a 9" pie or premade pie crust
kabocha squash (about 1.5 pounds / 800 grams, including skin and seeds, or 1 (15-oz./425-g) can pumpkin puree)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Filling

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Microwave the kabocha squash for 2 to 3 minutes, so it’ll be much easier to cut. Halve the kabocha by tilting your knife to a 45-degree angle and slicing it down from the bottom of the squash (the softer part). Then cut to 1-inch thick slices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare a steamer with 2 inches of water in it. Top with steaming rack, and place the pumpkin on the rack. Cook covered over medium high heat until it reaches a boil and steam comes out from the lid. Steam until the squash turns tender throughout, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the kabocha to a plate and let cool for 15 minutes, until it can be handled by hand. Peel off the skin with a knife and discard. Measure 3 heaping cups (400 grams) of kabocha and transfer to a blender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the butter, heavy cream, milk, brown sugar, eggs, butter, ginger, cinnamon, and salt into the blender. Turn on low spead and gradually increase to high. Blend until it forms a silky puree, 15 to 20 seconds. The puree should have a consistency thick enough to coat a spoon. You can add more milk if the texture is too thick, or add more squash if it’s too runny.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Layer a few dish towels on your kitchen counter. Drop the blender bowl from a 2-inch height onto the dish towels a few times, to release the bubbles that have formed in the puree. Transfer into a big bowl. The puree can be made a day earlier and stored in an airtight container in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Sprinkle a thin layer of flour onto a clean working surface and place the pie dough on top. Let rest for 5 to 10 minutes, until it’s soft enough to roll out without cracking.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Dust the top of the pie dough and your rolling pin with flour. Roll out the dough into a round sheet that is about 1/8-inch (3-mm) thick, and 1-inch larger than the rim of your pie pan. Rotate the dough frequently so it won’t stick to the surface. Dust with more flour if needed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Roll the dough over your rolling pin and unroll it over the baking dish. Gently arrange the dough to fit the pan. Trim off the excess dough with scissors, leaving about 1/2 inch (1-cm) from the rim of the baking pan.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Tuck the edge of the dough underneath so it creates a thick border that rests on the rim of the baking dish. Crimp the edges by pressing the edge with your finger while holding the two sides with the knuckles of your other hand.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and transfer to the fridge. Let rest for 30 minutes to 1 hour, until it’s completely cooled and turns solid.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Adjust oven racks, so one is in the middle and one is on the bottom. Place a pizza stone on the bottom rack (Optional). Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 C).

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Beat the egg with 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl to make an egg wash.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: When the pie is well chilled, transfer to the kitchen counter. Crumple a piece of parchment paper and flatten it, cover the bottom of the pie and arrange it so it fits the shape. Add pie weights, beans, or rice onto the parchment paper. Transfer the pie onto the pizza stone. Turn the oven to 400 F (200 C). Bake for 30 minutes, or until the edges turn golden.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: (Optional) If you made the pie garnish, you can now place them on the middle rack and bake until the surface turns golden, 15 to 17 minutes.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Transfer the pie crust to the kitchen counter and remove the pie weights. Brush the entire pie crust surface with a thin layer of egg wash. Return it to the bottom of the oven and bake for another 5 to 7 minutes, until the egg wash has dried completely and the bottom of the pie crust turns solid. If you plan to make the pie in advance, you can pre-bake the pie crust one day in advance.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Let the pie crust cool completely. Turn the oven to 350 F (176 C).

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Fill the pie with the kabocha squash puree, up to 3/4 of the crust. Bake on the middle rack until the filling sets and the center jiggles slightly, about 40 minutes. Transfer the pie to a cooling rack and let cool completely before serving.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: Slice the pie and top with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream. Enjoy!

title: Madurai Butter Bun
description: Madurai Butter Bun is a popular tea stall snack from Tamil Nadu made by toasting soft sweet buns with butter, sugar and milk on a tawa or frying pan. The buns turn crisp outside while staying soft, moist and buttery inside.

ingredients.name: to 4 teaspoons jam (of choice – optional, for making butter jam buns)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix cardamom powder into milk and keep aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice the buns horizontally into halves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spread butter generously on the inner sides of the buns.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sprinkle sugar on one side and close the buns.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread some butter and optionally sugar on the outer top side.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat butter on a tawa or frying pan over low heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the buns on the pan and toast gently while pressing slightly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Toast for a minute and then flip.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Toast the second side also for a minute or until lightly crisp.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Pour some of the prepared milk around and slightly over the buns so it absorbs into the bread.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Flip again and add the remaining milk gradually.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Toast for another minute or until the buns are crisp outside and soft inside, turning gently once or twice as needed since the buns soften after absorbing the milk.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Remove and serve hot or warm with some butter spread on top and add a bit of sugar if preferred.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: For Bun Butter Jam, spread some jam on one inner side of the bun after applying butter. Sprinkle sugar, close the bun and toast as mentioned in the recipe.You can also spread jam on top of the buns after toasting.

title: Vegan Red Curry แกงเผ็ดมังสวิรัติ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: bamboo shoots, canned, strips or sticks
3-5 Tbsp red curry paste (make your own with this recipe and omit shrimp paste, or choose one with no shrimp paste if buying)
medium firm tofu (smooth variety if possible)
A handful red peppers for colour (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak shiitake mushrooms in hot water for at least 30 minutes or until the mushrooms are fully hydrated. Remove from water (reserve the water) and squeeze out water from the mushrooms. Slice off the stems and discard, and cut the cap into 1/4-inch slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse bamboo shoots well, then boil in water for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. This will remove the odour from the bamboo which some find unpleasant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 3/4 cup of the coconut milk into a heavy bottomed pot and reduce over medium heat until thick and the coconut oil starts separating from the coconut milk. If using canned coconut milk, this may not happen, in which case just proceed with the recipe.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add curry paste and stir to break it up and mix with coconut milk, then and tomato paste and keep stirring until the oil starts to sizzle around the edges of the paste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add remaining coconut milk and 1 cup of mushroom water and bring to a boil. Add soy sauce, Golden Mountain sauce and palm sugar and stir to dissolve the sugar. Add bamboo shoots, mushrooms, and tear in kaffir lime leaves and stir. Then gently add the tofu pieces and push them down so they are submerged, being careful not to break the tofu. Simmer for at least 10 minutes, if it looks a little thick, you can add more mushroom water. Add red peppers and cook for 1 minute. Stir in Thai basil and remove from heat. Serve with jasmine rice. Enjoy!
