title: Japchae (stir-fried starch noodles with beef and vegetables)
description: Japchae (or chapchae) is a classic Korean dish made with sweet potato starch noodles, meat, and vegetables! Find out how to make authentic, delicious japchae with this time-tested recipe!

ingredients.name: medium onion, preferably sweet variety, (4 to 5 ounces)
lean tender beef (sirloin, chuck tender, rib eye, etc.) (or pork loin)
to 4 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms (or 4 to 5 dried shiitake, soaked until plump)
fresh spinach (preferably a bunch of spinach)
sugar (or brown sugar) (You can use a little less if you want. )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean all the ingredients. Cut the carrot into matchsticks. Thinly slice the onion. Run the knife through the white parts of the scallions lengthwise, if thick, and then cut into about 2-inch long pieces. Remove the stems from the mushrooms, and slice into 1/4-inch thin strips. Cut the meat into thin 2-inch long strips.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and mix well until the sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large non-stick pan (see note 2), bring about 5 cups of water to a boil, and cook the noodles until completely translucent and soft (6 to 8 minutes). Drain in a strainer and rinse under cold running water. Drain well. Roughly cut the noodles with a pair of kitchen shears or a knife into 6 -7 inch lengths. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Mix well with 3 tablespoons of the prepared sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fill the same pan with 2 cups of water. When water boils, blanch the spinach only until wilted. Drain quickly and shock in cold water. Squeeze out water, run a knife through the squeezed spinach a couple of times, and lightly season with salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1/2 tablespoon of oil to the skillet, and stir fry the noodles over medium to medium high heat, stirring frequently, until translucent and a bit sticky (about 4 minutes). Transfer back to the mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 1/2 tablespoon of oil to the pan, and stir fry the carrot over medium high heat, sprinkling with a pinch of salt. When the carrot sticks are half way cooked, about a minute, push them to one side of the pan to make room for the onion slices. Stir-fry the onion slices until translucent, sprinkling with a pinch of salt. Stir-in the scallion and cook briefly. Do not overcook. The vegetables should be crisp. Transfer to the bowl with the noodles.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the beef and mushrooms along with 2 tablespoons of the prepared sauce and cook until the meat is cooked through, 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the noodles.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the spinach and the remaining sauce to the bowl with all other prepared ingredients. Toss well by hand. Adjust the seasoning to taste by adding a little more (start with 1/2 teaspoon) soy sauce and/or sugar as necessary.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Optional egg garnish

title: Moist Pumpkin Bread
description: This moist pumpkin bread is easy to make and features a crunchy crust made from turbinado sugar and pepitas!

ingredients.name: nonstick cook spray or butter, (for greasing loaf pan)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease a large loaf pan (I used a 9.25 x 5.25 inch pan) generously with nonstick cooking spray or butter. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, add flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, nutmeg, and cloves. Whisk together and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, add pumpkin puree, eggs, granulated sugar, brown sugar and oil. Whisk together until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and stir until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth with a spatula. Top with roasted pepitas and turbinado sugar.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the pan in the oven and bake for 60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the pan from the oven and place on a cooling rack. Cool for 10 minutes. Using a butter knife, carefully loosen the edges of the bread from the pan. Turn over the pan and carefully remove the bread. Let the bread cool completely on the cooling rack. When cool, slice with a serrated knife and serve.

title: Mediterranean-Style Roasted Brussels Sprouts Salad
description: This salad combines hearty, perfectly caramelized brussels sprouts with baby greens like spinach and baby arugula, shallots, and salty feta. We add a festive twist with cranberries and toasted almonds.

ingredients.name: lb/907 g brussels sprouts, well-cleaned, trimmed, and halved
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
cup/69 g blanched almonds or walnut halves, toasted
Crumbled feta cheese, to your liking
cup/ 59 ml Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place brussels sprouts in a large mixing bowl. Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil and season with salt. Toss to combine. Spread brussels sprouts on a large baking sheet. Roast in heated oven for 25 to 30 minutes until crispy on the outside and tender on the inside (check half-way through and give the brussels sprouts a quick stir so the other side has a chance to get some color.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While brussles sprouts are roasting, add the spinach, arugula, shallots, cranberries and almonds to large mixing bowl. Once ready, add the roasted brussels sprouts in.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinaigrette ingredients. Pour the vinaigrette on the salad (start with less if you’re not sure you need it all.) Toss to combine. Then add in crumbled feta and give it another gentle toss.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the salad to a large serving platter. Add another sprinkle of feta, almonds or cranberries if you like. Enjoy!

title: Greek Meatballs in Tomato Sauce (Keftedes Giouvetsi)
description: The traditional diced beef is substituted with fried meatballs (keftedes) and then baked in a rich tomato based sauce and orzo pasta or chilopites giving it that extra fresh Mediterranean flavour.

ingredients.name: 500g/18 ounces chilopites (egg pasta, cut into little square pieces). Alternatively substitute with orzo pasta.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the meatballs (keftedes), finely chop the onion and garlic. Into a hot pan, add 3 tbsps of olive oil and sauté the onion and garlic, until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, add in a large bowl the minced pork along with the egg, the breadcrumbs and chopped parsley. Season well with salt and pepper. Add the onions and garlic and mix well, squeezing the ingredients with your hands, until combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roll the mixture for the keftedakia into balls the size of a walnut (or bigger if you prefer). On the bottom of a tray, add some flour and dredge the rolled meatballs lightly in flour, making sure to shake off any excess.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour some oil into a hot pan oil and fry the keftedakia, until nicely coloured on all sides. Place the meatballs on some kitchen paper to dry.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To prepare the tomato sauce, heat a deep pan over medium heat. Pour in the olive oil and the chopped onion and garlic and sauté. Add the chopped tomatoes, the tomato sauce, 1 1/2 cup of water, a pinch of sugar, season and stir. Let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200C. Into a fireproof tray, add the sauce, along with the meatballs (keftedes) and the pasta and stir. Cover with some aluminium foil and bake for approx. 40 minutes or until the pasta is cooked. Midway through cooking time, add 1 1/2 cup of warm water and remove the aluminum foil. (If the pan appears to be getting dry, pour in some more hot water). At the end, add the crumbled feta cheese and stir with a wooden spoon. Enjoy!

title: Tuscan Chicken
description: Tuscan Chicken - deliciously creamy one-pot chicken meal served in a rich garlic cream sauce with flavor punches from sun-dried tomatoes and Italian seasoning. Fantastic weeknight family meal loaded with flavor!

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove from the heat and serve with pasta.

title: Tzatziki Recipe (Greek Cucumber Yogurt Sauce)
description: Tzatziki is a classic Greek yogurt sauce or dip made with cucumber, garlic, olive oil and herbs. It has a creamy, thick texture with a fresh and tangy taste. This Mediterranean dip is commonly served with breads, grilled dishes and snacks.

mint leaves (– chopped or use dill leaves or parsley or cilantro)
or 2 to 3 medium-sized garlic cloves (– minced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse, peel and grate the cucumber. Squeeze out all the excess water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the grated cucumber to a bowl along with minced garlic and chopped mint or choice of herbs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add apple cider vinegar (or lemon juice) and extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the greek yogurt.

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve chilled, garnished with mint or other fresh herbs and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil if you like.

title: Ginger Creme Brulee
description: A classic French dessert tweaked to Asian style, using less sugar and cream. The ginger creme brulee features a creamy custard that is more structured, with a lighter texture, but the mouthfeel remains rich and decadent.

ingredients.name: (70 g) caster sugar (, and more for caramelizing)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Custard

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven to 300 degrees F (150 C). Bring a kettle of water to a boil, keep covered and sit on lowest heat to keep warm. Place eight 2.7-oz. (80ml) or four 6-oz (177-ml) ramekins (or heatproof jars) into a deep baking tray.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add milk, cream, and ginger into a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until almost simmering. Immediately remove the pan from the stove. Let steep for 15 minutes to allow the ginger to infuse. Remove ginger using a slotted spoon and discard. Cook the mixture again until it almost reaches a simmer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While heating the cream mixture (after you've done infused the ginger), combine egg yolks and sugar in a medium-sized mixing bowl. Mix until the sugar is just incorporated.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Slowly pour about 1/2 cup of the heated cream mixture into the egg yolks and whisk until fully mixed. This step will bring the egg yolk toward the temperature of the hot liquid, so it won’t be cooked into solid egg when you add the rest of the cream.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the rest of the cream mixture while whisking, until everything is fully mixed. Pour the mixture over a strainer into a milk pan to remove any extra bits of ginger. Use a spoon to remove the foam from the surface and discard.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the custard mixture into the ramekins until each of them is 80% filled.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the baking tray into the preheated oven. Then pour the hot water into the baking tray, until it fills half way up the height of the ramekins.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake until the mixture is just set, about 25 to 30 minutes. (*Footnote 1)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove the ramekins from the water bath using a spatula and transfer them onto a cooling rack. Let cool to room temperature, for about 1 hour. Then seal the ramekins with plastic wrap (or cover the jars with lids) and store them in the fridge for at least 1 hour, up to overnight, before serving. The custard will stay good for 3 to 4 days in the fridge, but freshly made ones taste the best.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon over each chilled custard. Shake the ramekin gently so the surface is evenly covered. Light up your kitchen torch, then cook the sugar by positioning the torch at a 45-degree angle, about 6 inches (15-cm) from the sugar. Move your torch back and forth slowly so it heats up the sugar evenly and does not create any burned spots. When the sugar starts bubbling and melting and some spots turn light brown, stop the torch. The sugar will continue to cook a bit more and then set, forming a uniform golden brown crust.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: If desired, garnish the creme brulees with fresh berries and serve!

title: Dak Bulgogi (Korean Chicken BBQ)
description: Delicious chicken bulgogi!

ingredients.name: brown sugar (Use regular sugar if unavailable )
honey (or 1 - ⅓ more tablespoons brown sugar)
rice wine (or mirin or white wine)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse chicken pieces. Trim off excess fat. Cut each of the chicken pieces into small sizes (about 2-inch long and 1-inch wide). If you want to use this recipe for outdoor grilling, cut the chicken into larger pieces and marinate longer. Double (or triple) the recipe as needed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the marinade ingredients in a bowl until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coat the chicken pieces with the marinade. Marinate for about 30 minutes in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat a skillet over medium high heat. Add the chicken pieces, reserving the marinade. Cook until cooked through and slightly caramelized, about 2 minutes each side. (The sugar and honey in the marinade will burn easily, so watch it carefully and add the reserved marinade by tablespoon when the pan gets dry. You can slightly reduce the heat to avoid burning, if needed.)

title: The Best Beef & Broccoli เนื้อผัดบรอคโคลี่
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: tender cut of beef (I use ribeye), sliced against the grain into thin, bite-sized pieces
ground white pepper (I forgot to add this in the video!)
Golden Mountain sauce or soy sauce
broccoli (1 small head) cut into florets, slice the stems

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the beef in a bowl, then add oyster sauce, soy sauce and white pepper; mix well. Add egg white and cornstarch, then mix well, making sure all pieces of beef are coated in the marinade. Let sit at least 20 mins.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all sauce ingredients together, stirring to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok (if you have a round bottomed wok, use a large flat skillet), add just enough oil to coat the bottom, heat until very hot then the broccoli and spread them out into one layer, turning them so the flat side is facing down. Do this in batches as needed so you don't crowd the pan. Let the broccoli sear without moving for 1-2 minutes or until they have browned on one side. Flip them and let the other side brown briefly (it won’t brown as well but that’s okay). Remove from wok and set aside on a plate.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If you used a skillet for the broccoli, you can switch to a wok for this part for easier tossing. Add a little oil to the wok just to coat the bottom and heat over high heat until very hot. Add the beef, spreading it out into one layer as much as is possible. Let the beef sear until well browned on one side, then give the beef a quick toss. Add the broccoli and the sauce, then toss just until the beef is fully cooked, adding just a splash of water if it seems a little dry (don't add too much water, stir-fries always look dryer when they're in the pan, you will see more sauce once it is plated.) As soon as the beef is done, turn off the heat and plate!

steps.title: Step 5

description: Famous Sichuan Style Braised whole Fish with Doubanjiang. Also named as doubanjiang fish

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

description: Tasty, easy and quick to make, this Greek drunken pork stew (Mpekri or Bekri meze) is the perfect dish to share with friends over a glass of wine!

250g/ 9 ounces hard yellow cheese (cheddar, or if you can find Greek graviera)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the olive oil to a large frying pan and sauté the pork/ chicken on medium heat for 5-6 minutes, whilst stirring.

steps.title: Step 3

title: Mediterranean Roasted Artichoke Recipe
description: Mediterranean roasted artichoke recipe with capers and roasted garlic-dill vinaigrette. Perfectly tender and

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil)
Same 6 garlic cloves roasted earlier with the artichoke (see above ingredients)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To clean artichokes, first, cut off the stem/stalk. Peel off the tough outer layers by hand. When you reach the softer layers, use a serrated knife to cut off about 3/4 inches from the top. Now, cut artichoke in half length-wise. Then, using a spoon, remove the fuzzy choke on the inside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: As you clean the inside of each artichoke half, immediately add 1/2 tsp lemon juice to cover the surface to prevent the artichoke from discoloring.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: On a large baking sheet, place each artichoke half in a piece of lightly-oiled foil paper that is large enough to fold around.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Season artichokes with salt and pepper, and nestle 1 garlic clove in the center of each artichoke half. Drizzle generously with quality olive oil (it’s okay if some of the olive oil pools in the center or overflows onto the foil). Close the foil around artichokes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roast in the 400 degrees F heated-oven for 40 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Carefully open the foil pouches using tongs. Remove the roasted garlic from the center of artichoke, and close the foils back until ready to serve. Let garlic cool.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: In the bowl of a small food processor, add the roasted garlic with the remaining vinaigrette ingredients. Pulse until smooth.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove the artichokes from foil. Arrange on a serving platter, generously drizzle the roasted garlic-dill vinaigrette. Top with shallots, capers and crumbled feta cheese. Enjoy!

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: My family's secret Mediterranean chickpea salad is loaded with crunchy veggies, fresh herbs, and a tangy garlic and lime dressing! A Mediterranean diet recipe that's a winner every time Tips and video provided up in the post.

ingredients.name: large eggplant, thinly sliced (no more than 1/4 inch in thickness)
oil for frying, preferably extra virgin olive oil
small red onion, sliced in 1/2 moons
Early Harvest extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the sliced eggplant on a large tray and sprinkle generously with salt. Let it sit for 30 minutes (the eggplant will “sweat out” its bitterness as it sits.) Now line another large tray or baking sheet with a paper bag topped with paper towel and place it near the stove.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the eggplant dry. Heat 4 to 5 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium/medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Fry the eggplant in the oil in batches (do this carefully and do not crowd the skillet). When the eggplant slices turn golden brown on one side, turn over and fry on the other side. Remove the eggplant slices with a slotted spatula and arrange them on the paper towel-lined tray to drain and cool.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the tomatoes, cucumbers, chickpeas, red onions, parsley and dill. Add the remaining Za’atar, and mix gently.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing. Drizzle 2 tbsp of the salad dressing over the fried eggplant; pour the remaining dressing over the chickpea salad and mix.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Herb Crusted Pork Loin Roast

salt and white pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

If you notice the roast is browning too fast, cover with foil. This will prevent browning but continue cooking the roast.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Knol khol Recipe | Kashmiri Style Kohlrabi Curry
description: Knol khol recipe is a Kashmiri-style kohlrabi curry where pan-fried knol khol is cooked in a yogurt-based gravy with fennel, asafoetida, kashmiri chilli powder and dry ginger powder.

ingredients.name: Kashmiri chilli powder ( or deghi mirch)
water (– for dissolving chilli powder and asafoetida)
medium-sized knol khol (or kohlrabi (ganth gobi), rinsed, peeled and chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare a mixture of Kashmiri chili powder and asafoetida with 1 tablespoon water. Set this chilli water mixture aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat mustard oil and pan fry chopped knol khol until golden and tender. Remove and keep aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Some mustard oil will remain in the pan. Use the same oil and heat it on low. If it looks less, add about ½ tablespoon more if needed.Alternatively, you can use 1 to 2 tablespoons fresh mustard oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the oil is moderately hot, add black cardamom, cloves, black peppercorns and shahi jeera.

steps.title: Step 9

title: Phyllo Triangle Pastries with Custard (Trigona Panoramatos)
description: Crispy, golden, buttery phyllo triangles soaked in syrup and filled with a delicious creamy custard. This is a relatively easy to make, homely version of the recipes called 'Trigona Panoramatos'.

ingredients.name: 950g/ 33.5 ounces milk, divided in 700g/ 24 ounces and 250g/9.5 ounces
3-4 egg yolks, depending on the size of the eggs
of a cup heavy whipping cream (cold)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these amazing phyllo triangle pastries (trigona Panoramatos), start by making the syrup. In a pan add the sugar and water and bring to the boil; the syrup is ready, as soon as the sugar dissolves. Leave aside to cool down for a while.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Unroll the phyllo dough from the plastic sleeve and place on a working surface. Using a sharp knife cut the sheets of phyllo in three lanes (cut the shorter side in three lanes) and set aside. Lay one piece on the working surface (shorter side facing you) and using a cooking brush drizzle with melted butter.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spread one more sheet on top and drizzle with some more butter. Fold one corner to form a triangle and continue folding the triangle upon itself, until the entire piece of phyllo is used.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the triangle in the middle to form two little triangles. Wrinkle some parchment paper into a little ball. Expand with your fingers the phyllo triangle to make an opening and place inside the paper ball. Continue with the rest phyllo sheets.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Line a large baking tray with parchment paper, place the phyllo triangles on top and brush them with melted butter. Bake in preheated oven at 160C for about 30 minutes, until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: As soon as you turn them out of the oven, remove the parchment paper from the inside of the phyllo triangles and dip them in the cold syrup, turning them sides; remove with a slotted spoon and set aside to cool down.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Prepare the custard for the pastries. In a pan add 700g/ 24 ounces milk, the sugar and vanilla extract to bring to the boil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: In a bowl add 250g/ 9.5 ounces milk and the egg yolks; whisk to combine. Add the flour in the bowl and whisk to combine. As soon as the milk comes to the boil, remove from the heat and ladle slowly 1/3 of the milk into the flour mixture and whisk.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the pan with the milk again on the stove and turn the heat down to medium. Add the flour mixture into the pan with the remaining warm milk; whisk continuously, until the mixture has thickened and is smooth and creamy. Remove the pan from the stove, add the butter and stir.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Pour the custard in a large tray, cover with some plastic wrap (the plastic wrarp should be touching the custard, so that it doesn’t form a crust) and place in the fridge to cool.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Put the cold heavy cream into a mixer’s bowl, add the sugar and beat into whipped cream.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Remove the custard from the fridge, add the whipped cream and fold gently to combine.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Using a pastry bag, fill the triangles with custard and garnish chopped nuts. Enjoy!

title: Herbal Chrysanthemum Tea (菊花茶)
description: Herbal chrysanthemum tea is flowery and refreshing. This non-caffeinated Chinese sweet tea replenishes your energy throughout the day without the spikes and jitters from coffee. Do not drink this tea right before bed.

ingredients.name: pack Root + Spring Baby Chrysanthemum & Ginseng Herbal Tea Mix
loosely packed goji berries (Gou Ji Zi)
loosely packed American ginseng (Xi Yang Shen)
Optional 3 to 4 tablespoons rock sugar (or 1 pack Root + Spring yellow rock sugar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place all the herbs in a colander and rinse under running water. Transfer to a medium-size pot and add 10 cups water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: (Optional) If you like sweet tea, add the rock sugar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat over medium-high heat until the water is brought to a simmer. Turn to low heat. Cover and simmer for an hour. Do not uncover the pot during simmering.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the tea is done, stir a few times to make sure the rock sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place a strainer over a large bowl (or medium-size pot), pour the tea over and discard all the solid ingredients.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: You can serve the tea hot. Alternatively, wait until the tea cools down to room temperature. Add ice cubes and serve the tea cold.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: You can store the tea in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Slow cooker galbijjim (braised short ribs)
description: Slow-cooker adaptation of my recipe for traditional galbijjim, hence the same great authentic flavor!

ingredients.name: medium Korean/Asian pear (or 1 bosc pear or apple)
to 4 dried shiitake mushrooms (briefly soaked and quartered (omit if unavailable))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off any excess fat. Rinse the ribs and let them sit in cold water for about 30 minutes to draw out excess blood. Drain well or pat dry with paper towels. Prepare the vegetables and pear by cutting into large chunks (about 1-1/2-inch pieces).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the ribs and vegetables and pear in the slow cooker. Mix together the soy sauce, rice wine, honey (or sugar) and pepper, and pour over the ribs. Toss everything to coat with the sauce. Cover, and cook for 6 to 7 hours on high or 9 to 10 hours on low. Flip the ribs over midway through the process if you’re home. (Adjust the cooking time, depending on how tender you want your ribs to be.) Stir in the scallions and sesame oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the ribs and vegetables from the slow cooker. Strain the cooking liquid into a bowl to skim off the fat. I use a fat separator. Pour the sauce over the ribs to serve. (You can also cool it in the fridge or freezer until the fat solidifies to spoon off. Reheat the sauce.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve with rice.

title: Rosca de Reyes
description: Rosca de Reyes, or Three Kings Bread, is a soft orange-flavored sweet bread that's traditionally made in Mexico to celebrate Three Kings Day.

ingredients.name: guava or quince paste, (cut into strips)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the dough: In a cup or bowl, heat the milk in the microwave in 15-second increments or on the stove until it's just warm to the touch. A thermometer should read around 110°F-115°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir in the yeast and 1 tablespoon of the sugar. Stir to combine, loosely cover with plastic wrap, and let it stand for 5 minutes until it gets very foamy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer, whisk together the bread flour, all-purpose flour, remaining sugar, and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Attach the dough hook to the mixer and add the melted butter, eggs, orange zest, and yeast mixture. Mix on medium-low speed for 6-8 minutes, until the dough becomes smooth and elastic and pulls away from the bowl. If the dough is still sticky, mix in 1 tablespoon of all-purpose flour at a time until it’s just right.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat a large bowl with oil and transfer the dough to the bowl, shaping it into a ball. Cover it with a kitchen towel and let it rise for 1 to 1 ½ hours until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Divide the dough into two equal pieces and shape each into balls. Working one at a time, use your fingers to create a hole in the middle of the ball. Then gently pull and stretch the dough all around to create a large oval-shaped ring that’s about 10 ½ x 7 ½ inches in size. Repeat the process for the other dough ball.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer the shaped dough to the prepared baking sheets. Lightly cover with a kitchen towel and let rise for 45 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Make the sugar paste: While the dough is rising, make the sugar paste topping. In a medium bowl, add the egg yolk, beat together the egg yolk, all-purpose flour, confectioners sugar, and butter until well combined.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Divide the paste into 16 small pieces and shape them into strips. Refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Make the egg wash for the decoration: In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and milk until combined.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: When ready to decorate, preheat the oven to 350°F and arrange the oven racks in the middle and top positions.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Uncover the dough and brush the egg wash all over both of the roscas.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Decorate each rosca by laying 8 sugar paste strips evenly spaced across the dough. Arrange the guava or quince paste strips and the candied cherries in the empty spaces to your liking.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Bake the roscas for 25 minutes, swapping the location of the baking sheets halfway through, until the tops are golden brown and the bread is fully cooked through. Allow to cool for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Insert 1 or 2 Baby Jesus figurines into each rosca from the bottom once it has cooled. Serve.

title: Thai Glass Noodle Salad (Yum Woon Sen)
description: Yum woon sen is a classic Thai salad that's a staple in many Thai homes. This easy dish is bright and fresh, and is great as a side dish or even as the main dish for a light meal. Gluten free.

ingredients.name: dry glass noodles (aka "bean threads" or "bean vermicelli" see note 1)
julienned onion (any kind of onion is fine)
stalk Chinese celery or 2 inner small stalks and leaves of regular celery (leaves picked and stalks thinly sliced)
medium or large shrimp (peeled and deveined)
ground pork (or ground chicken or turkey)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the glass noodles in room temperature water for 7-10 minutes until soft and pliable. Once done, drain and cut them with scissors into 2-3 sections to shorten them. This will make it easier to mix and serve.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, place the dried shrimp in a small heatproof bowl, cover the shrimp with room temp water then microwave on high for about 45-60 seconds. Let it sit for a few more minutes to cool slightly. Without a microwave, you can cover the dried shrimp with boiling water and let them sit for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a spoon to remove the dried shrimp from the water, leaving the water behind, and place the shrimp in a mortar and pestle and pound to break them up into bits and remove from the mortar. Without the M&P you can chop them with a knife.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the dressing: Chop off the leafy half of the cilantro sprigs and set aside, and chop the stems-only half into small chunks and place in the mortar and pestle along with the garlic and chilies; pound into a paste. Add the palm sugar and pound until dissolved. Add the fish sauce and lime juice and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the tomato, onion, celery and dried shrimp into a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add the glass noodles and cook for 2 minutes. Remove them from the water with tongs (keep the water boiling) and place into a sieve to drain excess water; set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the fresh shrimp into the same pot of water and cook for 30 seconds or so, depending on the size, until they are cooked through. Use tongs to remove the shrimp and place them into the mixing bowl with the veggies.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour out the cooking water, leaving just enough water to cover the bottom, and return the pot back on the stove. Once the water boils, add the ground pork and the 1 tsp of fish sauce and stir until fully cooked. Remove from heat and use a slotted spoon to scoop the pork from the liquid and place into the mixing bowl. Then add about 1 tablespoon or so of the pork cooking liquid into the mixing bowl as well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the glass noodles into the mixing bowl, pour the dressing over the noodles, and quickly toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Roughly chop the leafy cilantro sprigs then toss them into the salad. Plate, and sprinkle with the peanuts. Serve immediately!

title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Tomato and Feta
description: You'll love these easy grilled zucchini boats, prepared Mediterranean-style with tomato and feta. We make every use of the zucchini flesh too! Check out the tips and ideas in the post.

ingredients.name: zucchini (trimmed and sliced length-wise into halves)
Kosher salt and pepper (to your liking)
Dried oregano (large sprinkle to your liking)
green onions (both white and green parts, ends trimmed, chopped)
crumbled feta cheese (more to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a cast iron skillet or indoor griddle over medium heat. (OR, If cooking on gas grill, lightly oil the grate and preheat grill to medium-low).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Brush zucchini generously with extra virgin olive oil on both sides. Season zucchini (particularly flesh side) with salt, freshly ground pepper, and oregano.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place zucchini, flesh-side down, on the preheated grill (or indoor griddle). Grill for 3 to 5 minutes until soft and nicely charred, then turn on back side and grill for another 3 to 5 minutes until this side is also tender and gains some color. (If using an indoor skillet or griddle, you may need to adjust heat to medium-high.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove zucchini from heat and let cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To create zucchini boats, use a small spoon to scoop out the flesh (do not discard). Squeeze all liquid out of zucchini flesh (you might use a linen kitchen towel or paper towel to do this.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the filling for the zucchini boats. Put the zucchini flesh in a mixing bowl and add the cherry tomatoes, green onions, feta, mint, parsley, lemon zest. Add a small splash of lemon juice and sprinkle a little more oregano. Drizzle a little extra virgin olive oil and mix everything together.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Spoon the filling mixture into the prepared zucchini boats and arrange on a serving platter. Enjoy!

title: Easy Chicken Recipe with Orzo pasta (Giouvetsi Kotopoulo)
description: Have you ever thought that you can have a giouvetsi in less than 30 minutes? This easy chicken recipe with orzo pasta is a delicious variation of the classic giouvetsi; the next best thing for when you are in a hurry!
tags: greek chicken and orzo in tomato sauce

ingredients.name: 550-600g/ 20 oz. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bites (or whole chicken bone-in cut in 8 pieces)
a pinch of cinnamon or a cinnamon stick

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy chicken with orzo, heat a large frying pan over medium heat, pour in 2 tbsps olive oil and sauté the onions, until softened. Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper and add in the pan; fry the chicken breasts until lightly colored.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the chicken pieces and the onions on a plate. In the same pan, add 2 tbsps olive oil and sauté the orzo pasta. Add the tomato paste and continue sautéing. Pour in the tinned tomatoes, the tomato juice and a cup of warm water. Return the chicken pieces and onions in the pan, add a pinch of sugar, a pinch of cinnamon and season well with salt and pepper. Turn the heat down to medium, place the lid on and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo pasta is cooked. (Halfway through cooking time, check out if all of the liquid has been absorbed and add 1 cup of hot water into the pan).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the pan from the stove, drizzle with olive oil and stir in the crumbled feta cheese. Let the chicken with orzo rest for 5 minutes and serve while still warm. Enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Pork Chops
description: Slow Cooker Pork Chops - fork-tender juicy pork chops smothered in a delicious creamy mushroom gravy sauce. Absolutely comforting, budget-friendly and fuss-free weeknight dinner that the whole family would love!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season pork chops generously with salt, pepper and creole seasoning. Preheat 2 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat in a cast iron or heavy Dutch pan, brown pork for about 3 minutes on each side. When ready, transfer pork into the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat the remaining oil in the cast iron pan, add in onion, garlic and thyme. Sauté until onions is transparent and fragrant, for about 3-5 minutes. Next add in mushroom, Dijon mustard and Italian seasoning. Sauté for another 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in water and heavy cream, bring to a boil and simmer for about 3-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.Transfer sauce to pork in the slow cooker and cook for about 7-8 hours on low OR 3-4 hours on high until the pork is tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Just before the pork chop is done, (about 30 minutes to the time), whisk together flour and ¼ cup of water until it is smooth in a small bowl. Pour the flour mixture with the pork chop in the slow cooker and stir gently. Cook until gravy has thickened.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve over rice, mashed potatoes or noodles and some veggies.

title: Cheesy Shrimp Baked Spring Rolls
description: A addictive dim sum dish made easy! This recipe does not require deep frying, pre-cook the filling, and is so easy to get ready.

ingredients.name: (230 grams) shrimps (, peeled and deveined (about 16 to 20 medium size shrimps) (*footnote 1))
Shaoxing wine ((or rice wine, or lemon juice))
to 5 tablespoons peanut oil ((or vegetable oil for baking))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chop the shrimps to 1-cm (1/2-inch) pieces. Transfer to a bowl. Add Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, ginger and white pepper powder. Mix well and let marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C (400 F).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Set up all the ingredients before assembling the spring roll. Drain the shrimp thoroughly and discard the marinade. This is very important, so the shrimp won’t be too wet to cause the wrapper to break apart during baking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wrap the spring rolls one by one. Spray or brush a thin layer of oil onto the top of the spring roll wrapper (*footnote 2). Place 4 to 5 pieces of shrimp, about 1 tablespoon mozzarella cheese and 1 teaspoon green onion on the lower third of the wrappers (*footnote 3). Fold the bottom to cover the filling. Then fold both side of the wrapper towards the center. Tuck and roll the filling upward to seal the wrapper until it forms the spring roll. Place each spring rolls onto the lined baking sheet, seam side down, with about 2 fingers apart in between.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake for 9 minutes, or until the bottom turns to a golden color. Flip the spring rolls and put them back in the oven. Bake for another 6 to 8 minutes, until the other side looks golden too.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To preheat any leftover spring rolls, bake at 180 degrees C (350 F) until warmed through, or for about 10 minutes or so. The rolls will remain crispy.

title: Slow Cooker Dakjjim (Korean Braised Chicken)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: medium size chicken cut up (about 2.5 pounds of cut pieces)
– 5 mushroom caps (shiitake, white, or baby bella, cut into large chunks)
– 3 dried whole red chili peppers (or green chili peppers or jalapenos – optional)
oyster sauce (or 2 more tablespoons soy sauce.)
honey (or 2 to 3 more tablespoons brown sugar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean and cut the chicken into small pieces (2 to 3-inch sizes). Trim off excess fat. Drain thoroughly or pat dry with paper towels. Place the chicken and vegetables, except scallions, in the slow cooker. Pour in the sauce and toss everything well. (You can prepare ahead of time up to this point and keep it in the fridge.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover, and cook for about 4 hours on high or 6 hours on low. Stir to rotate the chicken over midway through the process, if you’re home. Stir in the scallions, sesame oil, and sesame seeds with a few minutes remaining, or see the optional step below.

title: Easy Shrimp Chow Mein
description: slightly sweet yet spicy kung pao shrimp chow mein.

ingredients.name: fresh egg noodles or dried egg noodles ( , around 1/2 pound)
of fresh shrimp ( , or 1 cup of frozen prawn)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the fresh shrimp and then cut trail and head. Or unfreeze the frozen prawn.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a small bowl; add all the ingredients for stir-fry sauce. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in pan; add the shrimp in when you can see the waves on the surface. Do a few quick fry and move the shrimp out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Leave some oil in pan after removing the shrimps out. Add garlic, ginger, and scallions to stir-fry around 1/2 minute until aroma and then add dried chili pepper to continue cooking for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add green peppers slice to cook until soft. Return shrimps in and pour in the stir-fry sauce. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add roasted peanuts in. Mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water around 5 minutes. Then transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat up 1 tablespoon cooking oil in wok. Add cooked egg noodles as well as the cooked kung pao shrimp in. Add 2 dashes of black pepper powder, mix well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Garnish some chopped onions and serve hot!

title: Sesame Ginger Dressing Spinach
description: Easy Chinese sesame ginger Spinach

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mince the ginger carefully and pour 2 tablespoons boiled water to soak the ginger for around 20 minutes. And then add other ingredients for dressing sauce. Mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add some drops of sesame oil in water within a pot. And bring the water to a boiling.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wash the spinach and rinse in boiling water for 30 seconds along with the wolfberry or carrots. Transfer out and squeeze the water out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix the blended spinach and carrots with the salad dressing, sesame seeds and chopped spring onion.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve or place all the content to a small bowl. back off the small bowl on the plate to shape the tower.

cubes red bean curd + 1 Tbsp juice

title: Healthy Taco Dip
description: This Healthy Taco Dip made with 5 layers of delicious ingredients is ready in under 10 minutes and is the perfect appetizer for any party!

ingredients.name: jalapeño peppers (diced (or 1 bell pepper if you don't want it spicy))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add cream cheese and taco seasoning. Mix together with a hand-held mixer until well combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spread the refried beans onto a large platter or 9x9 baking dish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Top with a layer of cream cheese followed by salsa, shredded cheese, shredded lettuces, tomatoes and jalapenos.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Italian-Style Rice Salad Recipe
description: Healthy and bold brown rice salad, prepared Italian-style with tuna, artichoke hearts, fresh parsley and extra crunch from onions and pickles. A simple dressing of red wine vinegar and extra virgin olive oil brings it together!

ingredients.name: cooked brown or white rice of your choice
tuna (packed in extra virgin olive oil)
frozen peas (thawed and cooked according to package instructions (or use canned drained peas))
to 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the cooked rice, tuna, cherry tomatoes, cooked peas, onions, bell peppers, chopped pickled cucumbers, and a large handful of chopped parsley into a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients of red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, minced garlic, kosher salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning to your liking.

title: Bacon Wrapped Chicken Thighs
description: Generously seasoned chicken thighs enveloped in bacon and baked to perfection are amazing. This quick and sensational chicken dinner is easy to whip up. Plus, it can double up as an appetizer or hearty salad topper!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F (205℃). Line a baking pan with parchment or foil paper; set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If the chicken thighs are too large, you may cut them in half or thirds, especially if making them as a party appetizer. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium bowl, mix the Italian seasoning, paprika, white pepper, garlic, onion powder, cayenne pepper, and oil. Rub each piece of chicken with spice mix.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Next, wrap a chicken thigh around the middle with a couple of slices of bacon, tucking the ends underneath or securing them with a toothpick.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lay the wrapped chicken on a prepared baking sheet with the bacon seam-side down. Repeat with all the chicken thighs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake until the thighs reach an internal temperature of 165°F (75℃) on an instant-read thermometer. It usually takes 30-35 minutes.

title: Sumptuous Walnut Syrup Cake Covered with Chocolate Ganache
description: The signature fluffy and moist Greek walnut cake (karidopita) infused with cinnamon and clove syrup covered with a crispy, thick chocolate glaze!

ingredients.name: breadcrumbs or powdered Melba toast (6.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious walnut chocolate cake, add in a mixers bowl the sugar and butter. Mix for at least 5 minutes, until smooth and creamy. Add the egg yolks, one at a time, whilst continue mixing. Be careful to wait each time for each egg to be absorbed, before adding the next. Pour in the cognac and the orange zest, mix for 10 more seconds and set the mixture aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl add the breadcrumbs or powdered Melba toast, theÂ chopped walnuts, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, baking powder and blend with a spoon. Use a blender or food processor to chop the walnuts, being careful not to powder. For a more authentic texture of your cake use roughly chopped walnuts.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the mixtures from step 1 and 2 and blend, until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the egg whites and a pinch of salt in a mixers bowl, but be careful that your egg whites, bowl and whisk attachments are clean and free of any water. Whisk the egg whites until the mixture is very thick and glossy and a long trailing peak forms when the whisk is lifted (meringues).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a spatula, add gradually the meringues into the mixture (from step 3) and blend with light circular movements from the bottom up, until the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Butter the bottom and sides of a round baking tray (approx. 30cm diameter) and bake in a preheated oven at 170C, for about 35 minutes, until nicely colored on the outside and baked through. Check if it is ready, by sticking in the middle of the walnut cake a wooden skewer or toothpick. If it comes out clean, then the cake is ready.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let the cake cool down for a while and then prepare the syrup. Add all the ingredients for the syrup into a pot and bring to the boil. As soon as the sugar has dissolved, the syrup is ready. Ladle slowly the hot syrup over the cold cake, allowing time for each ladle of syrup to be absorbed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let it cool down for a while and start preparing the chocolate glaze! You can either prepare a cocoa based chocolate glaze or an chocolate ganache for the coating. The chocolate glaze is always cheaper, but the chocolate ganache is pure chocolate! So it’s up to you.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: If you choose to coat the walnut cake with chocolate glaze, then melt the butter in a saucepan and sift in the icing sugar and the cocoa powder. Remove the pan from the stove and whisk to combine the ingredients. Whisk, until all of the butter is absorbed and the glaze is smooth. Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes and pour over the cake.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: If you choose to coat the walnut cake with chocolate ganache, then place the cream in a small saucepan over medium heat and bring to just below boiling point. Place the chopped chocolate in a heatproof bowl and pour over the hot cream. Stir together until melted and smooth. Allow to cool down for 10-15 minutes before icing the cake.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: This Greek walnut cake is ideally served cold with some vanilla ice-cream aside. Enjoy!!

title: Pineapple Marinated Flank Steak

Grilled corn on the cob (tomatoes, and onion as sides)
Cooked rice or noodles as a side

steps.description: Combine every ingredient for the marinade in a bowl and whisk to mix well.

Arrange the steaks carefully so the bottom side is well coated with the marinade. You should still have half or a third of the marinade left for the salad and dipping sauce. steps.title: Step 4

title: Coconut Water Jelly Cubes

1.25” silicone cube mold, or another mold of your choice (silicone will make it easier to unmold)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For fruits that are smaller than the mold (blueberries, blackberries, mandarin slices) leave them whole. For larger fruit, cut them into small pieces no larger than ¾ inch. For strawberries, choose a small one and cut them in half.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place fruit into the molds, a few pieces per piece if they're small, but make sure you don't crowd the mold or the jelly won't be able to hold together. You want to leave plenty of room around the fruit so that it will be well surrounded by the jelly.

steps.description: Make the jelly:

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assembly

title: Slow Cooker Beef Bulgogi
description: Korean bulgogi made in the slow cooker

ingredients.name: Korean pear (or apple, grated (about 3 to 4 tablespoons))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the meat, and trim off any excess fat. Generously sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat a large pan until very hot. Add a tablespoon of canola or vegetable oil, and sear the meat, about 2 minutes on each side.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the sliced onions at the bottom of the slow cooker, and place the meat on top. Add the remaining vegetables (save a few scallion pieces for garnish). Mix all the sauce ingredients, except the sesame seeds, and pour over the meat. You can prepare ahead of time, up to this point, and keep it in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover, and cook for about 3 to 4 hours on high or 5 to 6 hours on low. Flip over once midway through the process, if you’re home. Cook until the meat is tender but sliceable. Once cooked, remove the meat to a cutting board. Drop the reserved scallion pieces into the hot cooking liquid. Transfer the vegetables to a plate.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Thinly slice the meat against the grain. Run the sauce through a strainer, and pour over the meat and vegetables to serve.

title: Chinese Sweet and Sour Sauce
description: All-purpose Chinese sweet and sour sauce, for around 500g food or a small rice bowl of dipping sauce! How to use it, add your fried chicken, pork, fish, shrimp, tofu and whatever you want before or after adding water starch!

ingredients.name: a small pinch of salt if needed

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat up vegetable oil in pan or wok; add garlic, green onions and ginger to stir-fry for around 2 minutes or until aroma with low fire.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then pour the basic sauce to the wok, bring all the content to a boiling. And add water starch in. Keep on stirring in the process.

title: Beef Empanadas Recipe
description: Easy beef empanadas made with a crisp and flaky crust filled with a savory ground beef picadillo and cheese filling.

ingredients.name: cold unsalted butter, (cut into ½-inch cubes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the pastry dough: In a food processor, add the all-purpose flour and salt. Pulse to combine. Add the butter, 1 egg, and ice water. Pulse until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. (You may need to do this in batches depending on the size of your food processor.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the dough mixture onto a clean surface and knead it for 5 minutes until it comes together and is smooth. Shape it into 2 equal sized balls, tightly cover each in plastic wrap, and refrigerate while you make the filling.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the filling: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the oil. When hot, add the tomato and onion, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the ground beef, chili powder, salt, ground cumin, dried oregano, and ground coriander, and cook for 6-8 minutes, using a spoon to break up the meat into smaller pieces and stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the potato, carrot, and water, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 10 minutes until the potatoes and carrots are soft and tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the skillet from heat, taste, and season with more salt if desired. Stir in the frozen peas and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the dough balls from the refrigerator and divide them into 18 equal pieces, then roll each piece into a ball.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball evenly into a 6½ -7-inch circle with a rolling pin.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: In a small bowl, beat the remaining egg with a fork to make an egg wash.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Working one at a time, add 3-4 tablespoons of filling to one side of the empanada round and top with a small pinch of shredded cheese.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Using a pastry brush, brush the inside edge of the empanada round, then fold the dough in half over the filling.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Seal the empanada by pressing the edges together with the tines of a fork or folding over the edges in increments with your fingers. Repeat until all the empanadas are filled and sealed.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Transfer the empanadas to 2 large baking sheets lined with parchment paper, and refrigerate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400°F with the rack in the center of the oven.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Brush the tops of each empanada with the remaining egg wash and bake for 25-30 min or until golden brown. Let them cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: BEST Chicken Marinade Recipe (W/ Video)
description: Ready to take your chicken dinner to a whole new level of delicious? The secret to tender, succulent, flavor packed chicken is in this yogurt chicken marinade.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek olive oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place yogurt, lemon juice, lemon zest and extra virgin olive oil in a mixing bowl or large measuring cup like this one. Add garlic, dried oregano and mint, cumin, coriander, paprika, and nutmeg. Season with kosher salt and black pepper to taste (a large pinch to your liking). Finally, add in fresh chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Give everything a good whisk or mix until the marinade is well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place chicken pieces in large (gallon size) zip-top bag. Pour the marinade on top. Zip the bag shut. Massage the bag so that the chicken is well-coated with the marinade. Place the bag on a baking sheet so that the chicken sits flat in a single layer in the bag. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight (if you don’t have the time, even 30 minutes will make a difference.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When ready, remove chicken from the bag, and before you cook it, give it just a bit of a shake to remove excess marinade. You have several options for cooking. In this recipe, I pan-seared the chicken (but you can grill or bake as well.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat 2 to 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high until shimmering but not smoking. Add chicken tenders to the pan (make sure to shake off any excess marinade before adding chicken to the pan.) Cook on one side undisturbed for 5 minutes until browned. Using a pair of tongs, turn chicken over and cook on other side for another 5 minutes or until chicken is done.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat an outdoor grill to medium-high and be sure to oil the grates very well. Grill chicken for 5 minutes on one side, then turn over and cook another 3 to 5 minutes or until chicken is fully done (internal temperature should register 165 degrees F.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat oven to 400 degrees F. Brush a baking dish with some extra virgin olive oil (make sure there is enough oil so the chicken does not stick.) Arrange chicken in one single layer (do not crowd.) Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake for 10 minutes covered, then uncover and bake another 8 to 10 minutes or so. Watch carefully. This can take less or more time depending on the thickness of your chicken breast cutlets. Remove from heat. Let chicken breasts rest (cover with foil or another pan) for 5 minutes or so.

title: Crispy Coconut Shrimp
description: Crispy Coconut Shrimp - fresh shrimp dipped in coconut batter, then rolled in an aromatic combination of coconut flakes, breadcrumbs and spices. So Decadent, So Exotic, So Tasty!! Can be baked or fried!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the dip by combining ingredients together and refrigerate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Marmalade Dip: In a medium bowl, combine the marmalade, mayonnaise, and Dijon mustard. Cover and refrigerate for at least several hours to allow flavors to blend. Do the same if making the sirracha sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat oven to 450°F. Align cookie sheet with parchment or foil paper, coat with cooking spray.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Peel and devein shrimp leaving the tails on. Butterfly the shrimp: cutting halfway through the back, stopping at the tail, so they will be able to stand tail up.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Whisk the egg, coconut milk, milk or beer, and flour in a medium mixing bowl until a smooth batter is formed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In another bowl, mix bread crumbs, coconut flakes, and spices.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Hold shrimp by tail, dip each shrimp first in batter, and then roll in seasoned coconut mixture. Place on baking sheet tail up.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Baking

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Frying

title: Pumpkin Curry Recipe (Thai Style)
description: Thai pumpkin curry is a coconut milk based curry made with pumpkin, Thai red curry paste and herbs. It has a balanced sweet, spicy and savory taste. The curry is easy to adapt with different vegetables and curry pastes.

ingredients.name: coconut oil (or any neutral flavored oil)
red curry paste ( or panang curry paste)
or 200 grams pumpkin (– chopped, any variety)
lemon grass stalks (– chopped into large pieces)
kaffir lime leaves (– chopped or torn)
or 1 to 2 bird's eye chillies (– sliced or Thai red chillies)
to 1.5 cups water (or add as required)
coconut milk (– thick, canned or homemade)
dark soy sauce (or ½ teaspoon regular soy sauce or light soy sauce)
to 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ( (cilantro) or Thai basil, for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat coconut oil in a pan on low heat. Add the red curry paste and sauté for 1 to 2 minutes until you see oil separating at the sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Next add chopped pumpkin, pea eggplants and green peas.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn off the heat or keep to a low.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the aromatics – lemon grass stalks, kaffir lime leaves and small bird's eye chillies or Thai chillies.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle salt as required. You can also add a dash of black pepper at this step.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the heat on again if you had switched it off.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Mix well and sauté for a minute.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add water and mix again.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cover pot with lid. Cook for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until the pumpkin is fork tender.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Cooking time depends on the size of pumpkin cubes. Small pieces cook faster, while large pieces with peel take longer but hold their shape better.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Turn off heat and add thick coconut milk, dark soy sauce and raw sugar.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Mix and simmer gently on low heat until the curry is hot and just begins to come to a boil. Do not let it boil further.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Serve Pumpkin Curry hot garnished with cilantro or Thai basil with steamed jasmine rice or basmati rice. You can also serve with roti or paratha.

title: Fried Bread stuffed with Feta Cheese (Tiganopsomo)
description: A delicious fried bread stuffed with feta cheese recipe! Tiganopsomo (fried bread) is a very easy and versatile traditional Greek dish perfect for every time of the day, that can be served as starter or side to savoury dishes or stand on…

ingredients.name: and 1/4 of a cup all-purpose flour

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious fried bread with feta cheese (tiganopsomo), start by making the dough. Add the flour into a large bowl; using your hands make a dimple in the middle and add the salt, the sugar, the yeast and pour in the olive oil. Knead the dough with your hands adding slowly the lukewarm water, until the dough becomes smooth and elastic and doesn’t stick. Cover the dough for the fried bread with some plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Divide the dough in 4 pieces. Roll the pieces of the dough into circles, approx. 0.5cm thick (that can fit your frying pan). Top two circles of dough with crumbled feta cheese and cover with the other circles. Join the edges well, using a fork.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large frying pan to medium heat and add enough oil to cover the bottom of the pan. Fry the breads, until nicely coloured. When one side becomes golden, turn them on the other side. Remove the fried bread from the pan and place on some kitchen paper to absorb the extra oil. Enjoy while still warm!

title: Creamy Chicken Potato Salad
description: Turn any meal into a picnic with this creamy chicken potato salad. It’s loaded with chunks of tender potatoes, flavorful chicken, and soft-boiled eggs for a rich side! {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: (225 g) boneless skinless chicken thigh ((or breast))
thumb ginger (, sliced to thin strips (*Footnote 2))
small white onion (, finely diced (yield 1/4 cup))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the chicken and potato
