title: Sataejjim (Slow Cooker Braised Beef Shank)
description: A traditional Korean braised beef shank dish made in the slow cooker!

ingredients.name: root vegetables (parsnip, celery root, burdock root, turnip, and/or Korean radish)
dried shiitake mushrooms (or any other dried mushrooms, broken up into 2 to 3 pieces)
small dried red chili peppers (or 1 teaspoon crushed red peppers - optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the meat. Drain well or pat dry with paper towels. Cut the meat into about 2-inch chunks. Prepare the vegetables by cutting into about 1-1/2-inch chunks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the meat and vegetables in the slow cooker. Mix together the soy sauce, rice wine, apricot preserve (or honey), sugar and pepper in a small bowl, and pour over the meat and vegetables. Toss everything to coat with the sauce. Cover, and cook for about 4 hours on high or 6 to 8 hours on low. Flip the meat over midway through the process, if you’re home. Adjust the cooking time, depending on how tender you want your meat to be.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If necessary, sprinkle with a pinch (or two) of salt, and add more sugar or honey to taste. Stir in the scallions and sesame oil before turning the slow cooker off.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the meat and vegetables from the slow cooker to a large serving bowl. Pour the sauce over the meat to serve. You can run the sauce through a strainer for a clearer sauce if you’d like.

title: Roasted Eggplant with Garlicky Shrimp
description: An easy eggplant dish that will be done in just 20 minutes! Eggplants are roasted till tender, topped with a Thai garlicky shrimp stir fry. Delicious and gluten free!

ingredients.name: Japanese eggplant (sliced ½ inch on a bias)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and drizzle with cooking oil. Place the eggplant slices on it and brush it tops of the eggplant with more cooking oil. Sprinkle with a couple of pinches of salt and roast for about 15 mins.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Crush garlic in a mortar and pestle just until they're broken into big chunks, or you can smash and roughly chop them.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Crush the chilies until broken and the seeds are released, but the chili is still in one piece. Alternatively, mince the chilies into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a wok or a large saute pan, add just enough oil to coat the bottom. Add the garlic and chilies and heat slowly over low heat until the garlic starts to turn golden around the edges.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add shrimp paste, shrimp, fish sauce and sugar. Turn the heat up to high and toss just until the shrimp are cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add halved cherry tomatoes and toss briefly. Turn off the heat and keep tossing for another 30 seconds, using the residual heat to soften the tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce or sugar as needed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: If the eggplant is not done at this point, let the sauce hang out in the pan for now. When the eggplant is done, place the eggplant in one layer on a large serving plate. Turn the heat back on the shrimp to reheat briefly, then add the chopped cilantro and toss to mix. Pour the shrimp and all the sauce over the eggplant. Serve with jasmine rice. Enjoy!

title: Huevos Divorciados
description: Huevos Divorciados (or divorced eggs) is an authentic Mexican breakfast dish made with a red and green salsa served with fried eggs.

ingredients.name: jalapeno peppers, (stems removed (seeds removed if you don’t want it spicy))
kosher salt, (divided, plus more to taste)
cotija cheese or queso fresco, (for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the tomatillos, tomatoes, onion halves, jalapeno peppers and garlic cloves to a medium pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fill the pot with water until the ingredients are completely covered and bring to a boil over high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the red salsa by adding the cooked roma tomatoes, 1 onion half, 1 jalapeno pepper, 1 clove garlic, and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt to a blender. Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Carefully pour in the blended red salsa and lightly fry for 1 minute, stirring often. Transfer to a bowl, taste, and season with more salt if necessary. Cover and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the green salsa by adding the cooked tomatillos and the remaining 1 onion half, 1 jalapeno pepper, 1 clove garlic, 5 sprigs cilantro, and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt to a blender. Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat the remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Carefully pour in the blended green salsa and lightly fry for 1 minute, stirring often. Transfer to a bowl, taste, and season with more salt if necessary. Cover and set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Fry the eggs by heating 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Carefully crack in the eggs, keeping them separate, and cook for 3 minutes, or until the whites are set. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place 2 eggs onto a plate. Spoon half of the red salsa around one of the eggs and half of the green salsa around the other egg. Garnish with a sprinkle of cotija cheese or queso fresco and some chopped cilantro. Serve with a side of refried beans and warm corn tortillas.

title: Raspberry Clafoutis Recipe
description: Melissa Clark's clafouti recipe is a light and custardy baked dessert (like a baked pancake) with juicy raspberries and a hint of lavender.

ingredients.name: (114 grams) crème fraiche, more for serving (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 375 degrees F. Butter a 9-inch ceramic baking dish, or a 2-quart gratin dish, or a 9-inch cake pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, toss the raspberries with 1 tbsp sugar. Let them sit while you prepare the remaining ingredients

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a food processor or blender, combine the remaining ½ cup sugar with the lavender; process until the lavender is mostly ground, about 2 minutes. Then pour the milk, crème fraiche, eggs, and salt, and process to combine. Add the flour and pulse just to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange the sugared berries in the prepared baking dish, then pour the egg mixture over them. Bake until the cake is golden and the center springs back when lightly touched, about 35 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the baking dish to a wire rack and let the cake cook for at least 15 minutes before serving. Then dust it with confectioners’ sugar, slice it, and serve it with a dollop of whipped crème fraiche if you like (I used Greek yogurt to serve along).

title: Crispy Greek Lamb Meatballs recipe (Keftedes Arni)
description: A traditional Greek lamb meatballs recipe (Keftedes arni). If you love lamb, this traditional Greek lamb meatballs recipe is made just for you! A famous Greek appetizer, commonly served as part of a meze platter.

ingredients.name: finely grated Greek kefalotyri cheese or good-quality pecorino or Parmigiano-Reggiano (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek lamb meatballs recipe (arnisioi keftedes), add all the ingredients into a large bowl and mix , squeezing with your hands, to allow the flavours to blend. Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and let it rest in the fridge for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To form your Greek lamb meatballs, roll the mixture into balls, the size of a walnut. Dredge lightly each meatball in flour, until well covered. Transfer to a plate, shaking off any excess flour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: The traditional way of cooking Greek lamb meatballs is frying them in plenty of oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To fry Greek lamb meatballs use a large, deep skillet and pour in the oil to a depth of 1/2 an inch (1,5 cm). Heat the oil over medium-high heat until it begins to ripple. Add the lamb meatballs in batches in a single layer and fry for about 7 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and crisp on all sides. Using a slotted spoon, remove the meatballs to a plate lined with paper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you prefer a lighter version, you can bake/ grill the meatballs. Preheat the oven at 200C, place the lamb meatballs on greased baking sheet about an inch apart. Bake for about 20 minutes, turning the meatballs upside down midway through cooking time.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Greek lamb meatballs are ideally served as an appetizer (meze) with some creamy tzatziki sauce and pita breads or as a main course with some basmati rice and Greek salad. Enjoy!

title: Banana Cream Pie
description: This rich, velvety, creamy layer of custardy filling over sweet bananas and a perfect buttery crust is hands down the best holiday pie to indulge in. And it's even better made from scratch!

ingredients.name: (125g) unsalted butter, (very cold (or frozen) and cut into small pieces)
3-4 large bananas, (ripe but not overly so)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Butter or spray a 9-inch pie pan with a removable bottom, making sure it has been generously sprayed. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pulse flour, salt, and sugar in a food processor a couple of times to mix ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Throw in butter and pulse until rough dough forms.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add eggs one a time and pulse until the dough barely comes together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place dough on a work surface – knead just enough to incorporate all the flour, working the dough as little as possible. (Do not overwork it, or it’ll be tough.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When it’s ready, the dough will be barely moist and come together into a ball.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Lightly press the dough into the prepared pie pan – working from the center up until the bottom and sides are fully covered with pastry – again, be very gentle when pressing the dough into the pie pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the pie pan in the freezer for at least 30 minutes (or longer); this helps prevent the dough from lifting- if you are in a rush, then bake it after loading it down with beans to prevent rising.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400℉/205℃ and place the rack in the center of the oven.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake the crust for 20-25 minutes or until it's dry and golden brown. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: No Bake Crust

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cream Filling

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Assembling

title: Air Fryer Garlic Ribs (蒜香排骨)
description: Sharing a super easy and addictive air fryer ribs recipe that is inspired by Chinese fried garlic ribs. The ribs are juicy, tender, very flavorful, coated with a crispy crust and finished up with crispy garlic bits.

ingredients.name: rack (1.5 lb / 680 g) well-marbled pork ribs (, cut into single ribs (*Footnote 1))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the pork ribs into a big bowl or a large ziplock bag. Combine the marinade ingredients in a small bowl. Mix well and pour over the ribs. Mix using a spatula (or massage the bag if using) until the ribs are evenly coated. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate for 2 to 3 hours at room temperature, or overnight in the fridge (highly recommended). (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When you’re ready to cook, drain the ribs and remove the excess marinade. Transfer to a large bowl if you used a ziplock bag. Combine the cornstarch and white pepper in a small bowl and stir to mix well. Then add it to the bowl of ribs, 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix to evenly coat the ribs, until all the ribs are covered. Add a bit more cornstarch if needed. Transfer the ribs into the air fryer basket without overlapping, meat side up. Spray with a generous amount of oil on top so there’s no visible dry cornstarch.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook in the air fryer at 350°F (176°C) for 10 minutes, until the top of the ribs turns golden brown. Remove the air fryer basket, flip the ribs, then cook for another 8 to 10 minutes, until the ribs turn golden brown throughout. Test a rib by cutting up a piece to make sure it’s cooked through. If not, you can cook them for another 5 to 10 minutes. (*Footnote 4)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the ribs are cooking, heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a small skillet over medium heat until hot. Add the garlic. Stir and cook until you see the edge of garlic turn pale golden. Turn to low heat. Cook and stir fry the garlic until most of them turn golden, 5 minutes or so. (*Footnote 5) Immediately transfer everything to a small bowl to cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the ribs are done, transfer them to a big platter, then cover the ribs with the fried garlic. Garnish with green onions if using. Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Watermelon Feta Salad
description: Watermelon feta salad is a quick no-cook salad made with sweet watermelon, salty feta cheese, mint, olive oil and lemon dressing. It is light, fresh and balanced in taste. The salad comes together in minutes and is served chilled.

ingredients.name: block of feta cheese (– cut into chunks)
to 2 tablespoons green olives (– sliced, optional)
crushed black pepper (or ground black pepper)
pinches salt (– optional, only if needed)
lemon juice (or add according to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add chopped watermelon to a bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add olives and mint and mix lightly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add feta chunks on top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sprinkle oregano, black pepper and salt if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix gently and taste to adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with mint and serve immediately.

title: Easy Ginger Scallion Noodles
description: Ginger scallion noodles--Easy Chinese lo mein with scallion oil and ginger sauce.

ingredients.name: fresh noodle ( , or 1/4 pound dried egg noodles)
scallion ( , shredded (you can replace with cucumber or zucchini))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the scallions and onion and then cut into small sections around 8 cm long. Drain the waters on the surface.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok around 30 seconds. When the oil becomes warm, add scallions and onions in. Stir-fry continuously during the process.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the scallions and onions become soft, lower the heat and simmer for around 10 minutes. Toss from time to time to avoid burn.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Filter the scallion and onion out and get the pour oil. Set aside to cool down.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then finely chop the ginger and soak with boiled water. Add 1 teaspoon light soy sauce, 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce and 1 teaspoon salt to make the basic ginger sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Boil the noodles in boiling water for around 5 minutes. Add some scallion shreds at the last minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add ginger sauce and around 1/2 tablespoon scallion oil and mix well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Sprinkle some chopped spring onion on top and enjoy!

title: Seafood Cheese Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cake)
description: Cheesy, spicy Korean rice cake (tteokbokki) with seafood!

ingredients.name: small piece dashima (about 3 inch square), dried kelp
mozzarella cheese (or pizza blend) (Use more if desired)
gochujang, 고추장 (Korean red chili pepper paste)
gochugaru, 고추가루 (Korean red chili pepper flakes) (adjust to taste - see note)
corn syrup or oligo syrup (or use more sugar (about ⅔ tablespoon))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the rice cakes for about 20 minutes if hardened or refrigerated.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the shrimp (saving the shells if peeling) and squid, and cut the squid into small pieces. Cut the cabbage and scallions into about 2-inch long pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 2 cups of water, dashima, and shrimp shells, if available, to a pan. Bring it to a boil, and continue to boil for 5 minutes. Remove the dashima and shrimp shells. Preheat the oven broiler if you want to use it to melt the cheese.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the sauce ingredients. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat, stirring to dissolve the sauce mix. Add the rice cakes. Boil until the rice cakes become very soft and the sauce is thickened, about 8 - 10 minutes. Stir frequently so the rice cakes don't stick to the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cabbage. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, for an additional 2 - 4 minutes. Taste the sauce, and adjust the seasoning if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix in the seafood and scallion, and continue to cook, stirring, until the seafood is almost cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the cheese on top. You can melt the cheese over the stove top, covered, or in the microwave, or under the oven broiler.

title: Sichuan Peppercorn Chicken
description: One of the most famous and delicious hot chicken recipe from Sichuan Cuisine.

ingredients.name: long fresh chili pepper (, cut into small sections)
long red chili pepper (, cut into small sections)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the chicken| In a large pot, add scallion, ginger, Sichuan peppercorn and water. Heat to a boiling, let it simmer for 5 minutes and then turn off fire and stand for 10 minutes. Remember to remove the foams after boiling.Once the meat can be insert through, it is just cooked. Place the chicken leg in iced water

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut into large pieces. And transfer chicken to serving plate with smashed cucumber. At the same time, scoop around 1 cup of chicken stock to cool down.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the sauce|Heat around 2 tablespoons of vegetable cooking in a small pot, add garlic, ginger and scallion until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place red Sichuan peppercorn and green Sichuan peppercorn in.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place fresh peppers in. Slightly heat for a while. Turn off fire, add white pepper, chicken stock (cooled), light soy sauce, oyster sauce and salt. Pour sauce in. Let them soak 30 minutes before eating.

title: Juicy Grilled Whole Chicken, Mediterranean-style
description: Easy whole grilled chicken, marinated in a garlic and citrus Mediterranean marinate and grilled over indirect heat for the best juicy grilled chicken with perfectly crispy skin.

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper (more if you like spicy)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Spatchcock (butterfly) the chicken (or ask your butcher to do it). Place the chicken on a cutting board with its backbone facing you. Using a pair of sturdy kitchen shears like this one (affiliate link) cut out the backbone by cutting along both sides of the spine, and remove it. Push down on the breasts to flatten the chicken. Flip the bird over and remove the wing tips.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the chicken. Pat chicken dry and season with salt all over, lift the skin and apply salt underneath.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the marinade. In a small bowl, mix together the marinade ingredients (olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, thyme, spices, and minced garlic cloves).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Apply the marinade to the chicken. Place the chicken in a large dish (with sides so that the marinade does not spill). Apply the majority of the marinade underneath the chicken skins (this will ensure best flavor), and be sure to rub some of the marinade on the back side of the chicken as well. Keep the chicken flat with skin side up. Marinate in the fridge for 2 to 4 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Grill. Preheat an outdoor grill over medium-high (400 degrees F) and make sure to lightly oil the grates. Place the chicken over indirect heat (this means, the burner or burners directly below the chicken should be turned off, while the outer burners surrounding it should remain on. Watch the video to see how Adam does this). Cover and cook for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until the chicken's internal temp reaches 165 degrees F. Check every few minutes, and if the chicken gains some color on one part, rotate as needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Rest. Remove the chicken from the heat and set aside to rest for 10 minutes before slicing through to serve.

title: Epic 2-Day Aged Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: These cookies always get a WOW whenever I bring them to people. There are a few tricks, one is the perfect ratio of ingredients, the use of chocolate disc, and most importantly the aging the dough for 2 days.

ingredients.name: Optional garnish: Large flakes of salt like fleur de sel or maldon salt

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place flour and salt in a large mixing bowl. Sift baking powder and baking soda through a small sieve into the flour. (This is to prevent little clumps of baking soda that often form, especially in older baking soda, from remaining unmixed, and it also helps distribute them. I always do it for all my baking recipes.) Whisk everything together until well mixed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, or an electric hand-held mixer, mix butter on low speed briefly just to make sure it is fully softened. Add brown and white sugar and mix on medium speed until the colour is lightened and the mixture looks fluffy. Stopping to scrape the bowl and paddle once in between.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add vanilla and eggs, then mix on medium speed just until well incorporated, scraping down sides as needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add dry ingredients in 4 instalments, mixing just for a few seconds each time until the flour is no longer sitting on top of the dough. This is to prevent the mixer from kicking up flour as it stirs. *If using a hand held mixer, switch to a wooden spoon and stir everything together, as this is quite a thick dough for the handheld.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: After the last addition of flour, mix very briefly just until there's a little bit of flour left unmixed. Do not mix fully yet at this point.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the chocolate discs then continue to mix on low speed just until all the flour is incorporated into the dough and the chocolate is evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Portion the dough out into 2-inch balls and place them onto a tray or a big container—I like using a #30 scoop for this and I fill it so it's just a bit rounded on the bottom. Separate each layer of dough with plastic wrap so they don't stick together. *If using chocolate discs, check to see if there are any large disc of chocolate exposed on the bottom of the ball, if so, push some dough to cover it. Because these chocolate discs are so large, if you have an big exposed piece sitting flat on the bottom it'll just melt and stick to the pan when baking and you'll lose chocolate!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover the dough tightly and refrigerate for 48 hours. Yes, trust me, this makes all the difference!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350°F. Let it preheat for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the oven is ready, pull cookies out and put them on baking sheets lined with parchment paper or silicone mat. Make sure the cookies are at least 2 inches apart (you should only put 6 cookies on a half sheet pan). Bake in the middle rack for 15 mins until the edges are golden brown but the centre is still soft. **If after your first batch you find that the cookies are spreading too much, increase the temp to 375°F and bake for 11-12 minutes.

title: Honey-glazed Greek Roast Lamb with Potatoes
description: The perfect Greek roast lamb recipe! Greeks love their lamb dishes and they love them well done. But never dry, rather slow cooked, tender and moist. This recipe will cook your lamb to perfection.

ingredients.name: leg of lamb, 1.2 kg (45 ounces) or more

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven at 180C / 350F. To prepare this super easy Greek roast lamb recipe, place the lamb in a large baking tray and scar the surface of the meat with a knife. Make little holes (8-9) on the surface of the lamb, using a sharp knife.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop the garlic into 3-4 pieces each clove. Fill each hole on the lamb with some garlic and some rosemary. Drizzle with 1-2 tablespoons of olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Pour into the baking tray 1 and 1/2 glass of white wine and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 1/2 hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: The potatoes and the lamb cook at different times, so you should add the potatoes later.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: After 1 1/2 hour remove the baking tray from the oven, unwrap the aluminum foil and add the potatoes (cut into wedges and seasoned well with salt and pepper). Drizzle with 1-2 tbsps of olive oil. At this point, there should be enough liquid remaining into the baking tray.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place some aluminum foil on the baking tray and bake for 1 more hour.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the pan out of the oven and unwrap the aluminum foil. At this time, there should be a little wine still remaining in the pan and your Greek roast lamb should be almost cooked, but not colored.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Prepare the glaze for your Greek roast lamb. Into a microwave, heat the honey, until it becomes liquid. Blend the honey with the mustard and lemon juice. With a cooking brush, brush the glaze over the lamb and the potatoes. Sprinkle with some black sugar (optional), so that the meat becomes more crunchy.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place back into the oven (uncovered) and bake for 20-25 more minutes until the lamb is nicely coloured. Let the meat rest for 5 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Enjoy this delicious honey-glazed Greek roast lamb with a nice Greek salad and creamy tzatziki sauce!

title: Strawberry Trifle
description: Strawberry Trifle - delicious and stunningly beautiful strawberry dessert of layers of vanilla cake, homemade custard, fresh strawberries, strawberry glazed and whipped cream.

ingredients.name: - 3 pounds (1.1 - 1.3 kl) homemade or store bought vanilla cake
4-5 cups (576- 720 g) fresh strawberry (, sliced length wise)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add dry ingredients to a saucepan: cornstarch, sugar and salt . Mix to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together milk, heavy cream, and egg yolks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Gently whisk the wet ingredients into the saucepan making sure there are no lumps, until sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place sauce pan, on the stove at medium high heat – keep stirring constantly until it starts to bubble. Cook for about 7-10 minutes, until mixture has thickened.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the butter and vanilla until thoroughly mixed. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the surface directly with plastic wrap to prevent the surface from drying up and forming lumps. Allow it to come to room temperature, refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cut vanilla food cake into small, bite sized cube pieces.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Layer half of the cake in the bottom of a trifle dish or large bowl. Generously top with the vanilla custard mixture, followed by sliced strawberries. Top strawberries with strawberry glaze, if using, and repeat the layering process.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Garnish the top with fresh strawberries and whipping cream. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Chinese Dry Rub Ribs
description: These super-simple dry rub ribs come out with a texture that melts in your mouth and a sweet yet spicy taste that makes them impossible to resist!

ingredients.name: rack (about 3 lbs / 1.4 kg) St Louis ribs (or baby back ribs)
ground black pepper ((or 1/2 tablespoon ground Sichuan peppercorns))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: (Optional) Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs by slicing the edge with a knife, then pull off the membrane sheet using your hand.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the rub ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Sprinkle evenly all over the ribs, front, back and sides. Gently pat and rub in the spice using your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate overnight in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper for easy cleaning. Place a rack on top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the marinated ribs on the rack. Cover with a large piece of foil that’s enough to cover the baking sheet. Fold the foil along the edges of the baking sheet to seal the ribs.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake covered for 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the baking sheet from the oven and carefully remove the foil. Turn on the boiler to 550°F (280°C). Broil for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the surface of the ribs are charred. You should stay close to the oven during the time and check on the ribs from time to time, to prevent it from burning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once done, remove the baking sheet and let it rest for 10 minutes. Carve the ribs and serve hot.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Taste and adjust sweetness. Pour into glasses and serve fresh.

title: Thai Banana Roti โรตีกล้วยหอม
description: Thai roti, or "Thai pancakes" as they are sometimes called, are super popular snacks amongst visitors to Thailand. Filled with bananas, or change up the filling to whatever you like.

ingredients.name: sweetened condensed milk (or sub 1 Tbsp sugar)
(22 g) unsalted butter (for coating the dough)
(15 ml) neutral flavoured oil (for coating the dough)
Bananas (choose ones with just a tiny hint of green on the skin, but not so green that it tastes bad! Too-ripe bananas will turn mushy quickly when cooked)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, combine salt and water and whisk until salt is dissolved. Add condensed milk and egg, whisk until combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another bowl, add flour and butter, and use your fingers to rub butter it into flour until no more big chunks are visible.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add flour-butter mixture to water mixture and knead with your hands quickly just until all the dry flour has been absorbed. It'll looks like a really shaggy, rough dough. Cover bowl with a damp cloth or plastic wrap and let rest for 15 - 30 minutes. (This resting step, called autolyse, is optional, but it will allow water to absorb into the flour and will reduce the total kneading time you need over all.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once dough has rested, transfer onto a clean work surface and continue kneading with your hands for about 5 minutes. It will feel too moist at first, but it should feel drier after a few minutes. If after a few minutes of kneading the dough is still sticking to your hands, add a little bit of extra flour and knead it in. When you're done kneading, the dough won't be super smooth. In fact, the dough may seem a little bit rough on the surface; this is okay as long as the texture and moistness of the dough is even all throughout. The dough should be quite moist and may feel tacky, but it shouldn't stick to your hands.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the dough is kneaded, let rest for another 10-15 minutes to relax the gluten. This step is also optional, but it will make it easier for you to separate the dough into portions.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While dough is resting, mix together melted butter and oil for coating dough balls.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stretch dough into a log, then cut into 80g pieces (you will get about 11 pieces total). Note: 80g dough balls is for roti made in a 12-inch pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Form each dough piece into a ball by pinching the edges together towards the centre (see video for technique). Doesn’t have to be perfect, but you want it to be round.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Brush the butter/oil mixture on the bottom of the container you’re using to store dough balls. Then brush each dough ball generously with butter mixture and place into container.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let dough rest at least 3 hours, or you can refrigerate the dough and cook it the next day. If dough is refrigerated, remove from fridge at least 2 hours before using so it can come to room temp.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: On a clean, lightly oiled work surface, press a dough ball into a flat disk.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Grab the edge, one section at a time, and stretch it out as far as it will go without tearing. Press the edge onto the counter so it doesn’t shrink back.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Go around the piece stretching until you have a very thin sheet of dough.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Use a knife to trim off the very edge of the dough which tends to be thicker.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Heat a 12-inch flat skillet (or bigger) over medium heat and add enough oil to coat the bottom. Be on the generous side with oil or you will not get a nice crisp roti. Add a little piece of dough scrap into the pan as a heat tester, and once it’s bubbling in the oil, you’re ready to cook the dough.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Carefully transfer the stretched dough into the pan, trying not to let it fold onto itself during the transfer. Once you've placed the dough, quickly use a spatula to straighten out any edges that have folded.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Arrange banana (or whatever filling you're using) in the centre of the dough in a square, about 12-16 slices. Make sure you don’t put too much or you won’t be able to cover it with the dough. Quickly fold the edges of the roti over the banana; don't wait to long before folding or the dough will become stiff and hard to fold.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Once the bottom side has browned slightly, flip and brown the other side. Keep flipping it back and forth about every minute or so until both sides are well browned and crispy. Total cooking time should be about 4-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: If you wish, and add a little piece of butter beside the roti, then move the roti to coat it in this melted butter. Let it cook in this butter for about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: Transfer roti onto a cutting board and cut into 12-16 pieces.

steps.title: Step 21
steps.description: Use a bench scraper to place it onto a serving plate. Let it cool off a bit before eating cuz that banana is HOT!

steps.title: Step 22
steps.description: When ready to eat, drizzle condensed milk (or chocolate sauce) and sprinkle on some granulated sugar. Enjoy!

title: Easy Chinese Soy Sauce Chicken

ingredients.name: small piece of sand ginger (沙姜，recommended to include it or you can use dried ones)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Firstly, remove the chicken feet and clean the main body. Add all of the marinating ingredients and massage the chicken for couple of minutes. Set aside for at least 3 hours. Turn over at least twice during the time.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the marinating juice to a pot (just enough to hold the chicken, do not use oversized pot). Add around 1 cup of chicken stock or water. Bring it to a boiling.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the chicken in and keep spreading the sauce on the chicken with the help of a scoop. After adding the chicken, the temperature of the liquid will drop quickly. Use medium to slow fire and keep the liquid almost simmering but not boiling. This is the key to keep the chicken tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Simmer one side for 10 to 12 minutes and then turn over, simmer the other side and the stomach for another 10 to 15 minutes until 3/4 of the sauce are cooked off. Cover the lid and let the chicken stay inside for 10 minutes, with no heat and covered.

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

title: Mustard Potato Salad, Mediterranean-Style
description: Mediterranean-style mustard potato salad with fresh dill, parsley, red onions and capers.

ingredients.name: small potatoes (such as new potatoes, Yukon gold potatoes, or red potatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash and scrub the potatoes and dry them well. Slice potatoes thinly using a mandoline slicer. I used this slicer (affiliate link).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place potatoes in a pot and add water to cover by 1 inch. Bring to a boil. Add salt. Turn the heat down and allow the potatoes to simmer for about 6 minutes or so until they're tender (you should be able to poke the potatoes with a fork).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add vinaigrette ingredients to a small bowl and whisk until well-combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the potatoes are ready, remove from heat and drain well. Place them in a large mixing bowl and immediately dress them with the Dijon mustard dressing. Gently toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add onions, fresh herbs, and capers. Toss gently to combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the potatoes to a serving platter. For best results, allow the potato salad some time to marinade before serving. You can refrigerate it for 1 hour or so but be sure to bring it to room temperature before serving.

title: Feta Cheese Dip (Tirokafteri)
description: Spice things up with this creamy and tangy flavored Greek feta cheese dip (tirokafteri)! Best served with some crusted bread or warm pitas as the ideal dip!

ingredients.name: red chillies (or more according to preference)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this amazing feta cheese dip (tyrokafterh), remove the stem and seeds from the pepper, and chop it finely. (If you have some extra time, roast or slightly fry the pepper before chopping)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the feta cheese into cubes and place in a bowl, add the chopped pepper and begin mixing in a blender or stand mixer (food processor). Gradually add the vinegar and olive oil, whilst mixing at medium speed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in the milk until the feta cheese dip has a silky smooth, creamy consistency. Pour in a little at a time and mix until the cheese dip is smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If you prefer the dip to be a bit more spicy you can add a couple of teaspoons of cayenne pepper to taste. The milk and cheese require quite a lot of chillies to turn spicy as the milk neutralises the spiciness in the chillies so don’t be afraid to add more if you want to.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Alternatively if you prefer your dip to be creamy and mild don’t add any chillies. If you want the sauce to be even creamier try adding a few tablespoons of yoghurt. This will make it even smoother than the milk!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the feta cheese dip (tyrokafteri) in a medium bowl and garnish with some chopped chillies and a couple of olives.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Store the feta cheese dip covered in the fridge for up to 4-5 days.

title: Thai Oxtail Soup ซุปหางวัว
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: tomatoes, half small diced, half wedges
10-12 kaffir lime leaves, torn into chunks
About 1/2 cup chopped cilantro or sawtooth coriander, or to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add oxtail to a pot and cover completely with water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the lemongrass in half, and using just the top, smash it to bruise, then add these tops to the pot. Keep the bottom half for later. Tear 5 kaffir lime leaves into chunks and add to the pot as well. Add 2 Tbsp of fish sauce and simmer the beef for 2 ½ hours. Skim off fat and scum that floats to the top as it cooks, and add water as needed to keep the beef covered.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once done, fish out lemongrass and lime leaves.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add onion and the diced tomato and simmer for another 30 mins; you want the tomatoes to dissolve into the soup.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: After the onions have softened and the tomatoes have disintegrated, check that the beef is fork tender. If not, keep it cooking longer until it is.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Smash the remaining lemongrass bottoms to bruise and release aromatic juices, then cut into 2-inch pieces and add to the pot. Tear the remaining lime leaves into chunks, and add them to the pot along with the ginger. Simmer another 15-20 mins. Note: The lemongrass, ginger and kaffir lime leaves pieces are for infusion only and are not meant to be eaten. Make sure you inform your guests or remove them before serving. You can also add them to a muslin or cheesecloth bag for easy removal.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt or fish sauce. If you want, you can add the lime juice now, or you can serve a lime wedge on the side so people can squeeze in their own lime juice as well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When ready to serve, add wedges of tomatoes and cook just for a minute to soften slightly. Remove from heat and add chopped cilantro.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve with a wedge of lime if you haven't added lime juice to the soup already. You can serve this with rice or have it on its own. Enjoy!

title: Easy Steak Fajitas
description: Juicy, tender, and flavorful steak fajitas served with peppers and onions that are better than your favorite Mexican restaurant!

ingredients.name: guacamole, sour cream, cilantro, flour tortillas, corn tortillas, lettuce cups

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large resealable plastic bag (or a large mixing bowl) add all the ingredients except the coarse sea salt and black pepper and toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours up to 8 hours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the meat from the marinade, transfer to a clean large surface or cutting board and pat dry with paper towels. Generously season both sides of the steak with coarse sea salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil. Add the steak to the skillet and cook on each side for about 3-5 minutes, depending on how thick the steak is and how "done" you want it to be. I recommend using a meat thermometer for this step if you have one.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the steak from the skillet, transfer to a cutting board to let it rest and lightly cover with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the meat is resting, add the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of cooking oil to the skillet. Add the onions, peppers and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 8 minutes, until the veggies are soft.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Uncover the steak and slice it against the grain and at an angle into thin slices. Serve along with the fajita veggies in tortillas, on a salad or in lettuce cups and enjoy!

title: Easy Honey Mustard Salmon Recipe (Two Ways)
description: This honey mustard salmon recipe features perfectly flaky salmon fillet covered in a quick honey mustard sauce with fresh garlic, smoked paprika, and a pinch of cayenne. Slightly sweet, smokey and all sorts of delicious!
tags: baked salmon with whole grain mustard and honey

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To cook in the oven, heat the oven to 375 degrees F and position a rack in the middle. To grill, heat a gas grill to medium high (about 400 degrees F).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the salmon fillet dry. Season with salt on both sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the honey mustard sauce. In a small bowl, whisk together the honey mustard sauce ingredients (whole grain mustard, honey, extra virgin olive oil, minced garlic, smoked paprika, cayenne and black pepper).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To Bake. Place the salmon on a lightly oiled sheet pan or baking dish (if using salmon with skin on, place the salmon skin side down in the dish). Spread the honey mustard sauce evenly over the surface of the salmon. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Uncover and place under the broiler for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To grill. Place the salmon (already seasoned with salt) on a large, lightly oiled piece of aluminum foil. Spread the honey mustard sauce on top of the salmon. Fold both sides of the foil over the salmon and tightly close it at the top. Place on a medium-high gas grill. Cover and let cook for about 10 to 12 minutes (grill time will vary depending on the thickness of your salmon, begin to check earlier in the process). Open the top of the foil up so the fish is exposed (lots of hot steam with be released, so be careful). Continue cooking about 3 minutes or so on the grill.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To serve. Remove from the heat. Squeeze a bit of fresh lime juice and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

title: Bon Bon Chicken (Bang Bang Chicken)
description: One of the most famous Chinese Sichuan style chicken salad--bon bon chicken. This spicy salad is featured by its unique spicy and numb, salt and slightly sour taste.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare a large pot. Add cold water, ginger slices and the boneless chicken breast in. Bring all the content to a boiling for around 3~5 minutes and immediately lower down the fire to simmer for around 5 minutes. Use a chop sticker to test; stop the heating process until you can easy insert the chop sticker in.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Leave the pot covered around 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut shallots and the white part of spring onion into shreds. And then finely chop the green parts of spring onion.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Put all the seasoning and condiments in a large bowl to make the mala sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the cold water in a large pot and move the chicken meat from the heating pot to this one. Soak around 5~10 minutes or until the meat is totally cooled down. Then move out and drain.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Put the chicken meat in a plastic bag and beat with rolling pin from one side to another. Repeat the process for 2~3 times and then shred the chicken by hands.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Then mix with chicken shreds with sauce in the large bowl. And finally add cucumber and scallions in and mix evenly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Top with chopped spring onions and its eating time.

title: Skordalia recipe (Traditional Greek Potato and Garlic dip)
description: If you love garlic, then you have to try this amazing traditional Greek skordalia recipe! Skordalia is a rich and hearty Greek potato dip, which takes its name by the basic ingredient used to prepare it and is of course skordo (garlic).

ingredients.name: a cup extra virgin olive oil
a cup water (from the boiled potatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this skordalia recipe, start by washing thoroughly the potatoes. Peel the potatoes and place them in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Lower the heat to a gentle simmer and cook for about 30 minutes. (For this skordalia recipe the potatoes need to boil, until very tender.) Drain them in a colander and keep 1/2 a cup of the boiling water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a food processor add 1/2 a cup of the boiling water, the garlic, red wine vinegar and season with salt. Blend until the garlic is diluted. Cut the potatoes in pieces, add them in the food processor and blend to combine. Pour in the olive oil a little bit at a time, whilst blending, like making mayonnaise. Blend until the oil is incorporated and the mixture is smooth and creamy. If you like your skordalia to have a mild garlicky taste, a little trick is to boil the garlic (peeled) in some milk for about 5 minutes, before using.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When making a skordalia recipe, it is essential, that the potatoes are hot. If the potatoes are cold, then it will be difficult to combine the ingredients and the skordalia will become lumpy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If you don’t have a food processor to prepare this skordalia recipe, you can mash the potatoes with a fork and combine the ingredients, using a whisk.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the skordalia as a delicious dip or side dish with some toasted bread or pita breads. Enjoy!

title: Baked BBQ Pork Buns (Char Siu Bao)
description: Bring authentic dim sum to your home with baked BBQ pork buns just like your favorite Chinese restaurant! If possible, always weigh the ingredients instead of measuring them by volume (cups).

ingredients.name: (1 cup + 2 teaspoons) milk (, warm (~110°F) (plus 1 tablespoon to wash the buns))
heaping cup (180 g / 6.5 oz) homemade char siu (, diced (or store-bought char siu))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the dough

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the filling

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Shape the buns

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Store and reheat

title: Lentil Soup Recipe
description: This super easy and healthy lentil soup is huge in flavor, loaded with earthy, aromatic spices and a bit of heat. It's great on its own but amazing with a warm slice of bread (or two).

ingredients.name: (1.5l) or more vegetable broth ((sub with chicken broth or water))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large saucepan with oil, then add onions, celery, garlic, ginger, and cumin. Stir occasionally for 2-3 minutes until onions are translucent.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then add smoked paprika and soaked lentils. Stir and sauté for about about a minute. Finally, add tomatoes, green onions, white pepper, carrots, and cayenne (optional). Add about 6 cups of chicken stock and the desired amount of salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring to a boil and simmer until the sauce thickens. It might take 30-45 minutes or more, depending on how soft you like your lentils. Throw in some parsley, adjust for salt and pepper, and adjust the soup consistency with more liquid if desired. Serve hot with bread.

title: Mango Jam Recipe
description: Mango jam is a simple preserve made by cooking mango puree with sugar and lemon juice. It has a soft, spreadable texture due to low pectin in mangoes, though it can be slightly thick when cooked longer.

ingredients.name: to 4 ¼ cups (1.15 kg or 5 medium sized) mangoes
to 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( – fresh and not bottled *check point no 2 in notes below)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blend chopped ripe mangoes to a smooth puree.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat mango puree and sugar in a thick, heavy and deep pan on low heat. Stir well until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook on low to medium heat, stirring often so it does not stick.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: The mixture will begin to bubble and splutter, especially with thick mango pulp. Partly cover with a lid or use a mesh lid. Do not cover completely.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If spluttering is too much, reduce the heat. Stir every few minutes using the lid as a shield.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: As it cooks, the mixture will reduce and the spluttering will stop. Remove the lid and continue to cook, stirring more often as it thickens.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cook until the jam looks glossy and thick.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add lemon juice and mix well. Continue to cook until the jam thickens further and falls from the spoon in sheets.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Check doneness using simple tests. For the plate test, the jam wrinkles when pushed. For the sheet test, it falls in thick sheets. For the spatula test, it leaves a clear path in the pan briefly.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: The mango jam should be thick, glossy and spreadable.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Turn off the heat and place the pan on the countertop.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add vanilla extract if using and mix well.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Pour the hot jam into a clean, dry glass jar. Seal and let it cool completely, then refrigerate.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Serve on toast, bread, roti or paratha. It can also be used as a cake or cookie filling, or with yogurt and desserts.

title: Doenjang Jjigae (Korean Soybean Paste Stew)
description: A staple Korean stew made with fermented soybean paste (doenjang)

ingredients.name: pork (preferably fatty pork) (shoulder, or loin (or beef))
Korean radish (mu, 무) (and/or 1 small potato, sliced into 1/4-inch thick bite size pieces. )
gochugaru (고추가루 ), Korean chili pepper flakes (adjust to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the tofu and zucchini into about 1-inch cubes. Cut the radish into thin small squares. Thinly slice the onion and pepper. Roughly chop the scallion. Slice the meat into thin strips.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat a small pot with a little bit of oil. Sauté the meat, soybean paste, and chili pepper flakes, over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the water (or anchovy broth) and stir well to dissolve the soybean paste. Add the radish (if using a potato, add it in the next step). Boil over medium high heat for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the onion, garlic, tofu, zucchini, and chili pepper. Boil for an additional 5 to 6 minutes. Throw in the scallion pieces and add the optional vinegar with a minute or two remaining.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with a bowl of rice while it is still bubbling from the heat.

title: Black Sesame Balls in Ginger Tea บัวลอยน้ำขิง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: A pinch of white sesame seeds (optional, see note)
About 4-6 Tbsp brown sugar, or to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the Filling

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using raw sesame seeds, roast them first by adding a pinch of white sesame seeds in with the black, then stir them over medium-low heat in a dry wok or saute pan until the white seeds turn golden. The seeds will smoke a bit; this is normal. Remove from heat and immediately spread them out onto a large plate to cool them down. If you don’t have white sesame seeds, see above.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grind the sesame seeds in a coffee grinder for 5-7 seconds until fine. The seeds should start to stick a bit to the bottom of the grinder, but still powdery and not yet oily. Do not over do it or it will turn into tahini! You can also grind them in a mortar and pestle, but this will take a while so grind a little bit at a time.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a small pot, melt 3 Tbsp coconut oil or butter with sugar and salt over low heat. Once the sugar is melted, turn off the heat and add the ground sesame and mix well. The mixture should come together into a paste that holds together. If it is too runny and you don't think you can make balls out of them later, grind some more sesame seeds and add them to absorb the liquid. If it is too dry and crumbly and isn’t holding together, add more oil or butter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the mix into a bowl and let cool to room temp.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the mixture cools, weigh out about 9g of filling, then compress it into a ball (see video for technique). It does not have to be perfect. Cover and freeze until firm.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Make the Ginger Tea

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: While the filling is cooling, this is a good time to make the ginger tea. Slice the ginger into rounds then pound it in a mortar and pestle until broken and bruised.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Simmer the ginger in water for 20-30 minutes. When done, taste the tea for spiciness. If it is too spicy add more water to dilute, if not enough, you can add more ginger and let it simmer some more until you're happy with the heat level.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Strain the tea then add dark brown sugar to taste. This tea will keep for at least a week in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Make the Dough

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add glutinous rice flour into a mixing bowl. Add a little splash of the water and mix it in with your hand. Then add a splash more water, and continue to mix it in, little by little, until a soft and smooth dough forms.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: The dough is good when it no longer sticks to bowl, and it doesn’t stick to your hands. It should be easily pliable like play-dough, but should retain its shape and doesn’t droop when left alone. Be VERY careful not to add too much water as it can go from dough to puddle with just a tiny bit too much water. So when you’re close, add just a tiny bit of water at a time.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Cover and rest the dough for at least 15 mins.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Wrap the Dumplings

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Oil the palms of your hands.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Pinch off 12g- 13g of dough, then roll it into a ball. At this point, I would watch the video again for the wrapping technique cuz it’s much easier to see than for me to write it out!

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Assembly

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the sesame balls to the water, then bring it back to a simmer (not a vigorous boil) and let them cook for 5 minutes. The balls should be floating by the time they’re done.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: If you have a few batches to cook and you’re not serving right away, scoop them out with a slotted spoon and let them sit in a bowl of room temp water while you do the other batch.This will prevent them from sticking together. If serving immediately…you could place them directly into serving bowls, but I still like to let them sit in the water briefly to cool them down a bit. They’re incredibly hot and could burn you if you eat them too soon after boiling!

steps.title: Step 21
steps.description: When ready to serve, place 2-3 sesame balls into serving bowls. Ladle some hot ginger tea on top and enjoy! (If you’re not sure how to eat them, watch the end of the video!)

title: Beef Chow Fun
description: Beef Chow Fun---Beef stir-fried with rice noodle, bean sprouts, spring onions and Chinese chives is a famous Cantonese dish.

ingredients.name: small bunch of Chinese chive or scallion ( , cut into sections around 10cm long)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut beef into thin slices, put into a bowl. And then add all of ingredients for marinade sauce. Stir until well combined and set aside for around 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in wok. Add beef slices in to cook around half minute or just until the color of beef slices changes. Transfer the beef slices out and also pour the oil out. Clean your pan or wok.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up around 1 and 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil, add rice noodle and onion shreds and straight after that stir in the stir fry sauce. Keep tossing your pan or wok until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return beef slices and bean sprouts to fry for another half minutes. Keep tossing your pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add Chinese chives or scallion to fry for another 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve hot!

title: Michelada Recipe
description: This refreshing Michelada recipe made with tomato juice, beer, lime juice, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, and hot sauce.

ingredients.name: kosher salt ((or any flaky sea salt))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix together the salt and Tajin seasoning on a shallow plate. Run a lime wedge along the rim of two pint glasses, then dip the glasses into the salt mixture to coat the rim.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fill both glasses half full with ice cubes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide the tomato juice, lime juice, worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, and hot sauce evenly into each glass.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Top both glasses evenly with beer, garnish with lime wedges, and serve.

title: Mediterranean Style Grain Bowls Recipe with lentils and chickpeas
description: Power Grain Bowls, prepared Mediterranean-style! Nutrition and protein-packed thanks to a good dose of lentils and chickpeas. The dressing is an absolute must!

ingredients.name: Early Harvest extra virgin olive oil
to 3 cups cooked farro (from 1 cup uncooked farro, prepared according to package)
cooked brown lentils or from canned lentils, drained and rinsed (see notes for lentil cooking instructions, if needed)
cooked chickpeas or from canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed
avocados, skin removed, pitted and sliced
Early Harvest Greek Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a non-stick pan or skillet, heat 2tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the sliced zucchini and saute on both sides until tender. Remove zucchini with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel to drain any excess oil. Season lightly with salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the dressing ingredients to a mason jar. Close the lid tightly, and give it a good shake. Set aside for now (but shake again before using).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide the cooked farro, lentils, and chickpeas equally among four dinner bowls (it’ll come to 1/2 cup of each per bowl). Add cooked zucchini, tomatoes, shallots, avocado slices, parsley, and kalamata olives. Season lightly with salt, pepper and more za’atar, if you like. Drizzle a bit of the dressing on top (about 2 tbsp per bowl). Finish with crumbled feta, if you like.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve at room temperature or warm, if farro and pulses were just cooked. It’s best to mix the ingredients in each bowl to allow the dressing flavors to infuse. If you have a bit of dressing left, serve it alongside.

title: Melitzanosalata recipe (Traditional Greek Eggplant dip)
description: Capture the essence of Greek cooking with this traditional Greek melitzanosalata (eggplant dip) recipe.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy melitzanosalata recipe (Greek eggplant dip), start by baking the eggplants in a preheated oven at 200C. You could either bake them whole or sliced in half length-wise, depending on how much time you’ve got to bake them. If you choose to bake them whole, use a fork to make some wholes on the aubergines, place on a tray and bake for about 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For this melitzanosalata recipe you need to use only the flesh of the eggplants. Peel the eggplants and dice the pulp.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the pulp and the remaining ingredients in a large bowl and vigorously mix with a wooden spoon. (If you prefer your melitzanosalata to have a creamier texture, then add the ingredients in a blender or food processor and pulse, adding the olive oil gradually on a steady stream. Alternatively mash the eggplants using a fork). Let the melitzanosalata (Greek eggplant dip) cool down and put in the fridge to allow the flavours to mingle.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve the melitzanosalata in a small bowl garnished with a whole black olive. Enjoy!

title: Rice Pudding Recipe
description: This deliciously creamy, quick, and easy treat makes an excellent alternative to breakfast oatmeal. Sprinkle it with cinnamon and nutmeg, and then top it with raisins for the ultimate comfort food.Makes 3-4 cups

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat milk, coconut milk, rice, and salt in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir, then simmer – the heat level should be very low. Cover the saucepan tightly with the lid. Continue cooking for 12-15 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Gently stir the rice mixture with a wooden spoon to prevent the rice from burning or sticking to the saucepan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove it from the stove. Add sugar, vanilla extract, nutmeg, cinnamon, and cardamom.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return the saucepan to the heat and cook until the desired thickness is reached – a few minutes. Make sure there is some creamy liquid in the rice. As it cools, it thickens up. Then stir in the raisins.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve warm with pineapples or mango chunks, or let it sit in the fridge until ready to eat.

title: Instant Pot Pork Chops with Black Bean Sauce
description: My super-fast recipe for Instant Pot pork chops with black bean sauce satisfies your sweet and savory senses all in one. It makes it easy to eat good, any night of the week!

ingredients.name: boneless 1” (2.5 cm) thick pork chops (, about 1 1/2 lbs (700 g) (*Footnote 1))
homemade black bean sauce ((or bottled black bean sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Transfer the pork chops to a big plate. Sprinkle a generous amount of salt on both sides. Let sit while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the sauce ingredients in a medium-sized bowl and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the peanut oil into the Instant Pot and turn on the “Saute” function. Add the onions and chilis. Cook and stir until the onions start to caramelize, about 5 minutes. If the bottom of the Instant Pot starts to char, splash a tablespoon of Shaoxing wine (or water) onto the char and use a wooden spatula to lift any brown bits. Turn off the saute function.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add a third of the mixed sauce intoto the Instant Pot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread the pork chops onto the vegetables and make sure they overlap as little as possible. Spread the rest of the sauce evenly onto the pork chops.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Seal the pot and make sure the valve is locked. Set it to manual, high pressure, and the timer for 0 minutes. Once done cooking, use natural release for 8 minutes, then fast release by switching the valve to unlock or using the release button on the top of your Instant Pot lid. (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: (Optional) If you wish to brown the pork chops, turn on the broiler and set the oven rack right under the broiler. Line a small baking tray with aluminum foil. Once the pork chops are cooked, take the pork chops out of the sauce, scrape any sauce from the pork, and place them onto the lined baking tray. Broil each side until browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: While the pork chops broil, turn on the saute function on the Instant Pot. Let the black bean sauce cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until it becomes less watery. Note, the sauce will thicken once it has cooled a bit, so you don’t need to thicken it too much. Transfer the sauce to a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let the cooked pork chops rest for 10 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To serve the pork chops, carve them into slices and spoon the sauce over them. Serve them over steamed rice or boiled noodles with blanched veggies. Use extra sauce to season the veggies. Enjoy!

title: Soy Caramel Roasted Kabocha Squash
description: A Thai-inspired veggie side dish for the holiday season or any time of year. The soy caramel glaze can be modified by using fish sauce or miso instead of soy sauce, and you can change up the squash too.

ingredients.name: Kabocha squash (about half a medium squash)
5-6 garlic cloves (or as much as you'd like)
finely julienned Thai or regular basil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Scoop out the seeds and fiber from the cavity of the squash with a spoon, then cut into 1-inch wedges (no need to peel it, and watch the video for safe cutting techniques). Place the squash on a large plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prep the garlic:Cut the root end off the garlic and crush the cloves with the flat of your knife until the cloves are broken into big chunks. Remove the peel, and tear apart or chop any chunks that are too big.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the glaze:In a small pot, add the oil and garlic and turn heat on to medium low. Once the garlic is bubbling, cook for about 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until they start to turn golden. Turn off the heat and remove from the oil. Be sure to remove ALL the little bits of garlic otherwise they will burn in the next step.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To the same pot, add palm sugar and cook until it melts, then turn off the heat. OR if you want a deeper caramel flavour, keep the sugar cooking a bit longer until the colour darkens slightly and then turn off the heat. (If you chose to further caramelize the sugar, then when you add the soy sauce it will splatter aggressively, and you may need to add a splash of water to thin out the glaze)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Take the pot off the heat then add the soy sauce, (it will splatter vigorously), and once the splattering settles you can stir to mix. If it is thick, add about 1 Tbsp of water to thin out the glaze so it can be easily brushed onto the squash. Add the pepper, then throw the garlic chunks back in to coat in the glaze.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Brush this glaze over the squash on both sides, then place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet in one layer. Be careful to get as little glaze as possible on the baking sheet cuz it'll just burn in the oven.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Put the garlic chunks inside the curve of the squash pieces, shaking off excess glaze before placing them down—this will protect them from over-browning.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Roast for 10 mins, then take the squash out and brush with more glaze on both sides; then roast them for another 10-15 minutes or until fork-tender. If the garlic is starting to get too dark, you can take them out first. To check for doneness, pierce the thickest piece with a fork and it should go right through without resistance.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: While the squash roasts, make the basil oil: Add the basil, a pinch of salt and oil into a mortar and pestle and grind to bruise and blend the basil with the oil. You can also just blend everything in a small food processor, but you may need to make a bit more basil oil than you need to make it blend effectively.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: AssemblePlace the squash on a serving platter in one layer and scatter the garlic pieces on top. Brush or drizzle the remaining glaze on the squash, then drizzle with basil oil. Serve warm or room temperature.

description: Healthy and spring flavor vegetarian wonton soup with broccoli, tofu and wood ear mushroom as filling.

ingredients.name: of dried wood ear mushroom ( , soaked in clean water around 10 minutes firstly)
small head broccoli ( , cut into small pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely cut the mushrooms, crown broccoli and tofu into small pieces and place in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add oil, salt and pepper. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare wonton and wrap wonton one by one. Heat a large pot of water to a boiling and cook the wontons for 3-4 minutes over medium fire.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 3

title: Fish en Papillote, Mediterrnanean-style
description: Tender, flavor-packed fish en papillote with green peppers, tomatoes, and a light lemony sauce, all cooked together in parchment parcels.

ingredients.name: cod fish fillet ((1-inch thick) cut into 4 pieces)
green bell pepper (cored, thinly sliced into 4 rounds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the fish with kosher salt and pepper on both sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the sauce. Place the olive oil, lemon juice, shallots, garlic and spices in a small mixing bowl or measuring cup and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare 4 large pieces of parchment paper (about 12 inches or so on each side). Fold the parchment pieces down the middle to mark two halves.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the pouches. Place each fish fillet on the bottom half of a parchment piece. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the prepared sauce over the fish. Add 1 lemon slice, 1 tomato slice, and 1 bell pepper slice on top.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fold the top half of the parchment paper over the fish and veggies and go around to fold and secure each piece of parchment around the fish and veggies creating a well-wrapped pouch.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the fish pouches on a large baking sheet. Bake on the middle rack of your heated oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until the fish is fully cooked and flakes easily.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To serve, leave the fish and veggies in their own closed parchment pouches and transfer each pouch to a serving plate.

title: Braised Thyme , Garlic , Mustard Chicken
description: Braised chicken garlic thyme –This one pot chicken meal is cooked to absolute perfection in a flavorful garlic and mustard sauce with potatoes and vegetables.

ingredients.name: 1- 11/2 teaspoon salt adjust to taste (I used Cajun seasoning salt)
2-3 pounds of chicken thighs (legs, skin on)
1- pound vegetables (baby potatoes, green beans and carrots cut up)
or more chicken broth or water.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim chicken of excess fat and pat dry with a cloth or paper napkin.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season chicken with; garlic, thyme, salt and pepper. You may let it marinate, if you have the time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When ready to make, Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees. Place about 1 tablespoon or more of oil in a cast iron, or frying pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add chicken to the pan and sear for about 3-4 minutes on each side or until slightly browned, it’s going to finish up browning in the oven. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the same pan, add garlic, onions, thyme, bay leaf and paprika, sauté for about a minute or two

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add, mustard and about 2 cups chicken broth or water, bring to ta boil. Let it simmer for about 2 minutes. Adjust for seasoning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the chicken back in the cast iron on top of the thyme mustard sauce, followed by the potatoes and vegetables

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bake for about 35 -40 minutes until chicken is done and potatoes are tender

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove from oven let it cool before serving. You may garnish with parsley.
