title: Best homemade Hamburger Buns recipe!
description: These lovely homemade hamburger buns will definitely become the talk of your next barbecue! Fresh, fluffy with a wonderful golden brown semi-soft crust..

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this homemade hamburger buns recipe, start by making the dough. Add in the mixer’s bowl the yeast, the warm water and 50g flour (5 tbsps). Using a hand whisk, whisk all the ingredients to form a batter. Wrap the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside for 6-7 minutes, until the yeast rises and starts bubbling. Be careful not do add hot water, as it will kill the yeast, nor cold, as it will take forever for your hamburger buns to rise. The water should be at the same temperature as your finger, so check it out sticking one finger in; you should feel no difference in temperature.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime melt the butter. The key is to melt the butter at very low heat, so that the temperature doesn’t kill the yeast. Remove the pan from the stove and check the temperature. The butter should be at the same temperature as your finger. If it is warmer, leave to cool down for a few minutes and check again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the butter in the yeast mixture and add the egg and sugar. Whisk to combine. Top with the flour and add the salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Using the dough hook mix at first at low speed, until the ingredients start to combine and then mix at medium-high speed for about 10 minutes, until the dough doesn’t stick on the sides of the bowl. At this point the dough should be really soft and a little sticky. (Be careful not to add any more flour than this homemade hamburger buns recipe calls for, as the dough should be really soft and not firm).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat lightly the dough with oil and place in a large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let the dough rise in a warm place for about 2 hours or until doubled in size. If the environment is cold, preheat the oven at 30C, turn it off and place the bowl inside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Gently deflate the dough and place on a lightly floured working surface. Dust your hands with flour and divide in 8 equal sized pieces (approx. 115 g./4 oz. each). Form each piece into a round shape, gently tucking ends underneath. Gently pat the dough rounds into flat disc shapes about 1.5 cm thick. Arrange the hamburger buns on a large baking tray lined with parchment paper and dust very lightly with flour. Drape some plastic wrap over the baking sheet and let rise for about 1 hour or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180C and beat the egg and milk in a small bowl. Lightly brush the top of each hamburger bun with the egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake in preheated oven for about 16-17 minutes until nicely coloured. Place the hamburger buns on a rack to cool down completely before cutting and store in airtight container for 1-2 days.

title: Tteokgalbi (Korean Short Rib Patties)
description: Delicious Korean beef patties made with short rib meat

ingredients.name: - 4 pounds beef short ribs (or 2 pounds beef chuck or brisket)
chopped pine nuts for garnish - optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim excess fat. Remove the meat as much as possible from the bones. Keep the meat in the freezer for about an hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak the ribs in cold water for 20 to 30 minutes to remove some blood. Drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grind the meat using a meat grinder or a food processor. If mincing by hand, thinly slice the meat, cut the slices into thin strips, and then cut crosswise into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mince the meat by rocking the blade back and forth into the smallest pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix all marinade ingredients well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the marinade to the meat, and then mix very well. Knead the meat until it becomes a bit sticky, 2 to 3 minutes. Marinate the meat for at least 2 hours (overnight for best results).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If using the rib bones, dredge the bone in flour.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Attach the meat to the bone in even thickness as you’re wrapping the bone with the meat. Press with your palms so the meat is tightly attached to the meat.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Otherwise, you can simply make round or oval patties.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Set the oven to broil and preheat. Lay the meat in a broil pan and place it on the top rack of the oven, usually about 6 inches below the broiler. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes. Carefully flip them over and cook for an additional 3 -4 minutes until nicely charred. You can also grill over a charcoal or gas grill. Grill over medium to medium high, turning only once, 2 – 3 minutes on each side.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork with Pineapple
description: Chinese sweet and sour pork with pineapple is a featured dish from Chinese Cantonese cuisine. With its slightly sour and sweet taste and the fresh fruit flavor, it is mostly loved by people in American and also southern part of China.

ingredients.name: pork (pork butt or pork belly without skin)
green bell pepper ( , cut into small pieces)
red bell pepper (, cut into small pieces)
oil for deep frying ( , as needed )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the pork into small cubes and place them in a large bowl. Add salt, ginger and light soy sauce. Set aside for 15 minutes. Crack the egg in and then mix in around 1/4 cup of cornstarch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a plate and coat the pork cubes with starch. Make sure each piece is dry and isolated.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare other side ingredients. And prepare the sweet and sour sauce in advance. Heat up vegetable oil in pan or wok; add garlic, green onions and ginger to stir-fry over small fire. until aroma with low fire. Then fry the ketchup for a while and then add water, light soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar and water starch. Simmer for around 1 minute until the sauce is well thickened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up enough cooking oil for deep-frying. When the oil just began to have movements on the surface, put the pork pieces to deep frying until pork pieces become golden brown. Move out and drain the oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add a very little amount of oil in wok and fry pineapple cubes and bell peppers until soft.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add well made sweet and sour sauce in. Around 4 tablespoons.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return fried pork cubes and toss the wok quickly to make each pieces of the pork coated with sweet and sour sauce. Serve hot.

title: Garlic Fried Rice ข้าวผัดกระเทียม
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: ground black pepper, or to taste
cooked short grain Japanese rice (see note)
dashi powder (hondashi), dissolved in 2 Tbsp of water

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice about 40% of the garlic; this will be for making garlic chips. (Instead of garlic chips you can also make fried garlic bits, in which case you can just chop them into small pieces.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Finely chop the rest of the half the garlic.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To make fried garlic chips, add about a centimeter of oil in a small pot or wok and turn the heat to medium. Add a little "test" piece of garlic to the oil right away, and once it starts to have a significant amount of bubbling, add the rest of the garlic and turn the heat down to low.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry the garlic chips slowly and gently until they are golden, and until the bubbling has mostly subsided. Remove and drain on paper towel. Keep the garlic oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a wok or a large skillet, add butter and melt over medium heat. Add minced garlic and black pepper and saute for a few minutes just until the garlic is aromatic and softened. If you feel like it needs more fat, add a little of the garlic frying oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add rice, soy sauce, dashi mixture, salt. Turn the heat up to high and toss until well combined, breaking up any rice lumps with the back of your spatula.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once well tossed, push the rice to one side of the pan to make some room for the eggs. Add a little bit of the garlic oil to the empty space, then add the eggs. Break the yolks, then let the eggs set a bit. Cover the eggs with the rice and let it cook for another 30 seconds longer. Then toss to break up the eggs.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn off the heat and toss in green onions.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To serve, garnish with crushed seaweed (if using) and fried garlic chips. Enjoy!

title: Easy Taco Casserole
description: This Easy Taco Casserole is made with 3 layers of corn tortillas, ground beef, corn, black beans, the best taco seasoning and lots of melted cheese!

ingredients.name: (15-ounce) can whole kernel yellow corn, (drained and rinsed)
lime juice ((about the juice of 1 lime))
For topping: chopped cilantro and sour cream

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a 3-quart 13x9-inch baking dish with cooking spray and cut 9 of the corn tortillas in half. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, add oil, onions and poblanos. Cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add in garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the ground beef and break up the meat into smaller chunks using a wooden spoon. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef is completely browned, about 8 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add taco seasoning, black beans, corn, diced tomatoes and lime juice. Stir until fully combined, taste and season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the casserole by placing 6 tortilla halves and 1 whole tortilla in the baking dish so that the bottom is completely covered. Top with 1/3 of the meat mixture and 1/3 of the shredded cheese. Repeat and make 2 more layers.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cheese is completely melted. Garnish tomatoes, cilantro and serve with sour cream.

title: Quick Pickled Cucumber Recipe
description: Crunchy, briny quick pickled cucumbers with garlic and dill. I like to add sliced green onions and some jalapenos, sliced or halved, for a little kick. These refrigerator pickles are easy to make and are ready to enjoy the next day.

ingredients.name: vinegar (distilled white vinegar or white wine vinegar will work )
Persian cucumbers or English cucumbers (sliced into 1/2-inch rounds )
green onions (trimmed and chopped (both white and green parts))
Jalapeno peppers (sliced into rounds (remove seeds for less heat))
Few sprigs of fresh dill (to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the cucumbers. (Optional) Place the sliced cucumbers and some ice cubes in a colander in the sink for 20 minutes or so (this helps give them better crunch). Drain completely and pat dry.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the Brine. In a saucepan, combine the vinegar, water, salt, mustard seed, coriander seed, peppercorn and bay leaves. Bring to a boil over high heat. Lower heat and let simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pack cucumbers and vegetables in jars. Pack the cucumbers, green onions, jalapenos, garlic, and a few springs of dill in some wide-mouth jars (they should be packed tightly).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the brine to the jars. Ladle the brine into the jars to cover the cucumbers (use the back of a spoon to push the cucumbers down to submerge). Give the jars a couple of taps to release any air bubbles and allow the cukes to settle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover tightly and refrigerate. Cover the jars tightly with their lids and refrigerate. For best results, allow the pickles a full night in the fridge before using, but you can enjoy them earlier if you like.

title: Brioche French Toast
description: Breakfast just got easier with this upgrade on a classic! Buttery Brioche bread, aromatic cinnamon, and warm vanilla combine to create the perfect breakfast comfort food.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat a large, nonstick skillet or griddle over medium-low to medium heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt in a large shallow bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Melt a tablespoon of butter in the preheated skillet (you can also use cooking spray). Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture and turn to coat both sides.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the coated brioche when the butter has melted and begun to foam. Dip and transfer as many pieces of brioche that will comfortably fit in the pan without touching. Cook each side until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove French toast from the skillet to a baking sheet and keep it warm in a 200℉/93℃ oven.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Continue toasting the remaining bread and egg mixture, add more butter as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve French toast warm with powdered sugar, whipped cream, maple syrup, fresh fruit, or any desired toppings.

title: Instant Pot Pork Ribs (Chinese-Style)
description: A super easy Instant Pot pork ribs recipe that produces juicy tender pork with a sticky glossy glaze just like real-deal barbeque pork. It takes merely 10 minutes to set it up, and your dinner will be done in 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: rack (2 to 2.5 lbs / 1 kg) baby back ribs (, or spare ribs)
Homemade Chinese Barbecue Sauce ((or store bought char siu sauce, or your favorite BBQ sauce))
Chinese chili flakes ((or paprika powder for a non-spicy dish))
freshly ground Sichuan peppercorns ((or ground black pepper))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the dry rub ingredients in a small bowl. Stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rub the dry mix over the ribs, coating all sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the steaming rack (the one that came with the Instant Pot) in the bottom of a 6-quart (or larger) Instant Pot. Add water and liquid smoke (if using). Place the ribs in a standing-up position onto the steaming rack, so the side is on the rack and the ribs form a circle in the pot (see the picture above in the blog post). You can cook more ribs (2 to 3 slabs) by letting them stand up in the same position.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the Instant Pot and seal the valve. For baby back ribs, cook on high pressure for 25 minutes. For spare ribs, cook on high pressure for 28 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn on the broiler of your oven. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper (or tin foil).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once done cooking, allow the pressure to release naturally for 5 minutes, then use quick release using a long spatula to carefully move the valve to the open position. Be careful of the hot steam coming out of the valve.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Carefully transfer the ribs onto the lined baking sheet. Brush both sides with BBQ sauce. Cook under the broiler for 2 minutes. Check on the ribs. The sauce should char slightly. Broil for another 2 minutes if needed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Mooli Paratha Recipe (Stuffed Radish Paratha)

radish (white, (mooli, daikon) - medium to large with or without leaves)
red chilli powder (as required - or cayenne pepper or paprika)
ghee ((clarified butter) or oil for roasting)

title: Greek Bifteki (Burger) with Feta cheese
description: A delicious Greek bifteki (burgers) recipe topped with spicy feta cheese and juicy grilled tomato! Greeks enhance the flavor of their burgers (bifteki) with fresh herbs, like oregano, spearmint and parsley giving them a unique taste.

ingredients.name: minced beef or a combination of beef/lamb/pork (18 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek bifteki recipe, add in a large bowl the minced beef along with the rest of the ingredients and mix thoroughly with your hands. If the mixture is too sticky add some more breadcrumbs (or some water if it is to dry), till the mix is solid. If you have the time, it is better to knead the mixture for about 10 minutes, until all the ingredients combine. Alternatively, you can mix it using an electric mixer, with the dough hook at low speed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When done, put the mixture for the burgers (bifteki) in the fridge to rest for about 10 minutes, whilst preheating the oven to 200C.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Knead the mixture in flat round burgers. Place the biftekia on a large baking tray and cook in the oven for 18 minutes, flipping the burgers, mid-through cooking time. Top each bifteki with a slice of tomato and a small block of feta cheese and bake further for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve the biftekia, while still hot with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle a pinch of dried oregano. Enjoy!

title: Chinese Sautéed Green Peppers-Tiger Skin Pepper
description: Famous common and folk Sichuan dish--Tiger Skin Peppers(sauteed green peppers with garlic)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cap the green peppers and remove the seeds. If you like spicy taste a lot, you can keep the seeds inside. Mince garlic

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up around 1 tablespoon cooking oil in wok and then add the green peppers in to sauté until the skins become slightly crinkly. Turn the peppers from time and time to water the cooking process. If you are using a non-stick wok, place the green peppers directly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Move the green peppers to the edges of the wok and add around cooking oil in, fry garlic until aromatic. Add light soy sauce, vinegar and sugar. Simmer for a while until the sauce is slightly thickened. Add a very small pinch of salt if necessary (this actually depending on how salty your soy sauce is)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve hot with steam rice.

title: Nokdujeon or Nokdu bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes)
description: Nokdujeon, aka nokdu bindaetteok, is a type of savory Korean pancake made with ground nokdu (mung beans). These crispy golden brown pancakes are soft on the inside with some crunch from the vegetables. They are deliciously nutty!

ingredients.name: dried peeled and split mung beans* (yields about 4 cups soaked)
pinch of red pepper flakes (gochugaru - optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and soak the mung beans in water for 3 - 4 hours. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, cook the mung bean sprouts in boiling water for about 2 minutes (you can skip this blanching if preferred). Rinse in cold water to stop cooking. Drain and gently squeeze out excess water. Thinly slice the kimchi and scallions. In a large bowl, combine the kimchi, bean sprouts, scallions, meat, soy sauce, sesame oil and garlic. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a blender, grind 2 cups of the soaked beans in 3/4 cup of cold water with 1/2 teaspoon of salt until it has a coarse, sandlike consistency.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add to the vegetable and meat mixture. Repeat with the remaining beans. Gently mix the mung bean batter until the ingredients are evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat 2 tablespoons or more of oil in a non-stick pan over medium to medium high heat. (See note.) Ladle the mixture into the pan and spread it evenly into a thin round shape. Cook until the bottom is golden brown (2 - 3 minutes), and turn it over, adding more oil. Press it down with a spatula, and cook for another 2- 3 minutes. Repeat the process with the rest of the mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve hot off the pan with a dipping sauce.

title: Brussel Sprouts Thai-Style ยำกะหล่ำดาว
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 6-8 cilantro sprigs, leaves and stems separated, stems chopped
Brussel sprouts, small to medium size, cut in half
roasted peanuts or cashews, roughly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the dressing:

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using a mortar and pestle, pound garlic, Thai chilies, and chopped cilantro stems together into a paste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add palm sugar and pound to melt it.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add fish sauce and lime juice and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in shallots and let it sit until ready to use. Store in the fridge for up to 1 day in advance.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stove-Top Skillet Method (better for those who like al dente Brussels sprouts):

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a large skillet, add enough vegetable oil to thoroughly coat the bottom of the pan and heat over medium high heat. Add Brussel sprouts (you can do this before the pan gets hot), add a pinch of salt and toss the sprouts with the salt.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Flip all the sprouts flat side down. And let them cook until a nice dark browning develops. Add more oil if the pan seems too dry, it will help with browning. If you want more tender sprouts, lower heat to medium and cover the pan.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once the sprouts are browned on one side, give them a toss, then go back and flip any sprouts that did not flip up. Cook the other side for just a minute or so. Check doneness with a fork—I like it so that when you pierce the sprouts with a fork, it goes through with some resistance in the middle. You may want it more cooked than that, it's up to you.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove from heat and transfer into a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Oven method (better for those who like tender Brussels sprouts):

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Toss the brussel sprouts in oil and a pinch of salt then lay them flat on a baking sheet lined with parchment. Roast for about 15 minutes or until the sprouts are well browned and tender.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Assembly:

steps.title: Step 14

title: Pinto Bean Soup
description: This Pinto Bean Soup is a healthy one-pot weeknight meal made from pinto beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, onions, garlic, and seasonings.

ingredients.name: (15-ounce) cans pinto beans, (drained and rinsed (about 4 ½ cups cooked pinto beans))
optional garnish: chopped cilantro, cotija cheese, sliced radishes,

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add onions and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until translucent and beginning to caramelize.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add in garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, coriander and oregano. Stir and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the broth, pinto beans and diced tomatoes. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lower heat to simmer, cover and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat. Using an immersion blender or regular stand blender, carefully blend the soup until it reaches the consistency you want. (I prefer to blend about half of the soup so there's a mix of smooth and chunky.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the lime juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish with chopped cilantro, cotija cheese and sliced radishes. Serve with tortilla chips and enjoy!

title: Mezze: How to Build the perfect Mediterranean Party Platter
description: An easy and healthy Mediterranean mezze platter is a sure and healthy way to please a crowd!

ingredients.name: baby eggplants, (sliced lengthwise (1/2" or so in width))
Traditional Creamy Hummus or 10-oz tub quality store-bought alternative
Homemade Roasted Red Pepper Hummus or 10-oz tub quality store-bought alternative
Homemade Greek Tzatziki or quality store-bought tzatziki
15- oz can good quality marinated artichoke hearts
Pita bread (or your choice of rustic European bread for serving)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the eggplant slices on some paper towels and sprinkle with salt. Let the eggplants "sweat out" any bitterness for 20 minutes or so. Pat dry.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Place the eggplant slices on a lightly oiled baking pan, drizzle generously with olive oil. Roast for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, assemble the remaining ingredients on a large serving platters. Begin with the two hummus spreads on opposite sides. Place Tzatziki sauce in the cored bell pepper right at the center of the platter. Assemble the remaining ingredients on the platter to your liking. When the eggplant is roasted to a nice medium-brown, remove it from the oven and sprinkle with 1 tsp of sumac. Add the roasted eggplant to the platter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: You can cover and refrigerate this mezze party platter; take it out a few minutes before your guests arrive. Enjoy with warm pita and crostini or your choice of crackers!

title: Juicy Stuffed Burgers with Feta Cheese
description: Juicy and moist, there is nothing better than homemade stuffed burgers! This is a Greek variation for burgers stuffed with feta cheese.

ingredients.name: 150-200g feta cheese for the stuffing (6 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the mixture for the stuffed hamburgers, add into a large bowl the minced beef along with the rest of the ingredients and mix thoroughly with your hands. If the mixture is too sticky, add some more breadcrumbs (or some water/olive oil if it is too dry) till the mix is solid. It is important to knead the mix for about 10 minutes so that all the ingredients combine and the beef absorbs all the flavours. An easier alternative is to mix with a hand mixer using the dough hook at low speed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Leave the mixture in the fridge to rest for 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the feta cheese into small cubes and sprinkle with some dry oregano. For the stuffed burgers, in addition to feta cheese, you could also add chopped tomatoes and peppers coarsely chopped.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Knead the mixture into flat, thin, round burgers. At the center of half of the burgers place some of the stuffing and top them with another half-burger, squeezing on the edges till they stick together. We don’t want that stuffing running out while cooking now, do we?

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the burgers on a large baking tray and cook in preheated oven at 200C for 25 minutes. Flip them once to make sure both sides are nicely cooked and crusty. Once ready, remove the tray from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve while still hot with a leafy salad sprinkled with some olive oil, sea salt and balsamic glaze. Enjoy!!!

title: Chinese Sliced Tofu Salad (凉拌豆腐丝)
description: Chinese sliced tofu salad is a quick cold dish you can toss together in 10 minutes and is perfect for summer. Learn how to use tofu noodles to make a nutrition-packed vegetarian dish that has a wonderful texture.

ingredients.name: soy sauce ((or tamari for gluten-free option))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add the sliced tofu and stir for a few seconds. Rinse the sliced tofu with tap water, drain thoroughly, and set aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Right before serving, add sliced tofu, carrot and bell peppers into a big bowl. Add the sesame oil and garlic, green onion, rice vinegar, salt, and chili oil (if using). Toss to mix well.

steps.title: Step 4

title: Easy Cauliflower Stir-Fired with Tomatoes
description: Easy and healthy cauliflower stir-fried with tomato, garlic sprouts and ketchup. 15 quick recipes.

ingredients.name: middle size cauliflower ( , or half of a large one)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the cauliflowers into small pieces and then cook in boiling water for around 2 minutes. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut tomatoes into small cubes and the garlic sprout into small sections (separate the white part and green part). Chop the garlic and spring onions too.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up around 1 tablespoon cooking oil in wok, chopped garlic, spring onions to stir fry until you can smell the aroma. Add ketchup in; Mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place cooked cauliflowers with tomato cubes and the white parts of garlic sprout in wok. Stir-fry for around 1 minute. Add green part of garlic sprout, salt in. Do a quick stir-fry to mix all the ingredients well.

steps.title: Step 5

title: Modeumjeon (Fish, Shrimp and Zucchini Pan-fried in Egg Batter)
description: A combination platter of zucchini, shrimp, and fish that are pan-fried in egg batter.

ingredients.name: flounder or cod fillet (or any white fish)
vegetable or canola oil for pan frying

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the zucchini into ⅓ - inch disks. Lightly salt both sides and set aside at least for 20 minutes. Pat dry excess water with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel and devein the shrimp, keeping the tail on. Rinse and pat dry with a paper towel. Butterfly the shrimp by cutting along the curved back. Do NOT cut through. Open the shrimp halves and remove the vein. Lightly sprinkle salt and pepper over both sides. Set aside at least for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Rinse fish and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut the fish fillet into 1/2-inch thick, 2-inch long slices by running the knife diagonally through the fillet. Lightly sprinkle salt and pepper over both sides. Set aside at least for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dredge both sides of the prepared ingredients in flour, one piece at a time. (Do this step for all the pieces before the next step.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a large non-stick skillet with a tablespoon oil over medium low heat. Dip each piece one at a time in the beaten egg, and carefully place in the heated skillet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook for 1 to 2 minutes each side, adding more oil if needed, until slightly golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Repeat until all the ingredients are pan fried. Add an additional tablespoon of oil each time. Serve warm with the dipping sauce.

title: Mediterranean Roasted Eggplant Recipe with Pomegranates and Tahini
description: This recipe is all you need to make crispy, tender roasted eggplant slices. Here we give the roasted eggplant a bit of a Mediterranean twist with warm seasonings like za'atar and sumac, a handful of fresh parsley, roasted pine nuts and…

ingredients.name: large eggplant, sliced into 3/4-inch to 1-inch rounds
Extra Virgin Olive Oil (I used Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil)
Seasoning of your choice (I used a generous sprinkle of za’atar and sumac)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle both sides of eggplant slices with kosher salt and arrange on a large tray lined with paper towels. Leave for 30 minutes to allow the eggplant to “sweat.”

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, arrange a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees F. Make the tahini sauce according to this recipe and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat the eggplant slices dry and brush both sides generously with extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO). Arrange eggplant slices on a lightly-oiled baking sheet (make sure to space them out well). Roast in heated oven for 20 minutes, turn over using a spatula and roast for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the eggplant turns golden brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the roasted eggplant is ready, remove from oven (there should not be too much excess oil, but if you like, you can carefully place the eggplant slices on a try lined with paper towel to drain.) Arrange on a serving platter and sprinkle with seasoning of choice (I used about 1 to 1 1/2 tsp of za’atar and a similar amount of sumac) Drizzle with tahini or serve tahini on side. Top with fresh parsley, pomegranate arils and toasted pine nuts.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this roasted eggplant as a vegan side or as an appetizer/mezze, it’s great on top of warm pita or your favorite crusty bread.

title: Empanadas Recipe
description: How to make empanadas from start to finish! This family empanadas recipe features a savory meat filling and a fluffy, irresistible dough.

ingredients.name: pork loin roast, (excess fat removed and cut into 2-inch cubes)
canola oil ((or other neutral-tasting vegetable oil like corn))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season the meat: Place the cubed pork in a large Dutch oven or pot. Season with salt and pepper on all sides. Add the onion, garlic cloves and bay leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook the meat: Fill the pot with water (about 1 inch above the ingredients) and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to simmer and carefully remove the white foam that has formed at the top with a spoon. Cover and simmer for 2 hours, or until the pork is fall apart tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Shred the meat: Remove the pork using a slotted spoon and transfer to a large plate. Let it sit for 10 minutes to cool slightly. Shred with two forks or your hands.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Reserve the broth: Carefully pour the broth through a strainer and into a large measuring cup until you've collected a total of 2 cups.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix the meat: In a large blender or food processor, add the shredded meat and 2 cups of broth. Cover and pulse the mixture 5-10 times, until the meat is no longer in shredded chunks and is somewhat pureed, almost like the texture of a tuna salad. See photo in blog post for reference. You may need to do this in 2 batches depending on how big your blender is. (I know this sounds weird and it won't look very pretty, but it's the texture we want for the filling! Trust me.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Saute the vegetables: Heat olive oil in a large nonstick saute pan over medium-high heat. Add minced tomatoes and onions and saute for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions start to caramelize.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Saute the meat: Add the minced/blended meat to the pan and season with cumin, garlic powder, salt, oregano and nutmeg. Mix together with the tomatoes and onions and cook for 5 more minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Prepare the yeast for the dough: In a medium bowl, mix together the warm water and yeast. Lightly cover with a kitchen towel and let the mixture sit for 5 minutes. The mixture should be somewhat bubbly or frothy, which means the yeast is alive. If it's not, throw the mixture out and try again using a different packet of yeast. Meanwhile, grease the inside of a large mixing bowl with oil and set aside.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Mix the dry ingredients: In a large mixing bowl, add 6 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, baking powder and salt. Mix together with a fork until combined.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the wet ingredients: Add the yeast mixture, oil and mix together with a fork until the dough comes together. The dough should be slightly sticky but not too much. If the dough is still too wet, add in a tablespoon of more flour at a time until it fully unsticks from the bowl.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Mix the dough: Transfer the dough onto a floured working surface. Knead the dough for 8 to 10 minutes until it's smooth and elastic. If the dough becomes too sticky while kneading, sprinkle in a bit more flour. The final dough should be tacky, but not so much that it completely sticks to your fingers and hands.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Rest the dough: Form the dough into a ball and place it in the prepared greased bowl. Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and let it rest for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cover two large baking sheets with 2 clean kitchen towels and set aside.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Make into balls: Transfer the rested dough onto a floured working surface and divide the dough into 45 pieces. (I like to divide the dough into thirds so that I know each third should yield about 15 pieces.) Roll each piece into a ball using the palm of your hands and fingers and place on the prepared baking sheets.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Roll out the balls: On a lightly floured surface, roll each dough ball into an small 5 to 6-inch circle using a rolling pin. (While you're rolling out each ball, you can place the rolled dough in a single layer on top of a clean kitchen towel or lightly-floured parchment paper.)

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Fill and fold: Continuing to work on a floured surface, place a spoonful of the mix mixture onto each flattened dough circle. Fold one side over and pinch the sides together using your index finger until the empanada is fully sealed (see photos in blog post for example). You can also press the edges together using the tines of a fork instead of your fingers. As long as the empanadas are sealed, you're good to go. Placed the filled and sealed empanadas onto the large baking sheets or a kitchen towel.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Prepare the topping: In a wide bowl or large plate, mix together sugar and cinnamon. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Prepare the frying oil: In a large saute pan over medium-high heat, add enough vegetable oil to reach a depth of 1 1/2 inches. (I used about 5 cups of oil.) Heat the oil until a thermometer reaches 350ºF. Meanwhile, line a large plate with paper towels. Set next to the stovetop.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Fry the empanadas: Working in batches, carefully place 3 or 4 empanadas in the hot oil. Fry until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer the empanadas to the plate covered with paper towels to drain off any excess oil.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Cover with cinnamon sugar: Place the empanadas on the plate with the cinnamon sugar mixture and cover them with the mixture on both sides. Transfer the empanadas to a serving platter and enjoy!

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Creamy, elegant, yet super quick and easy FETTUCCINE ALFREDO that takes just 15 minutes of your time. Serve it with your favorite protein on the side or a simple salad and white wine for amazing real comfort food!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the pasta according to package directions or until al dente. Reserve about 1 cup or more water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up skillet or saucepan on medium heat, then add butter to the pan, followed by garlic. Saute for about 30 seconds or just until the garlic is soft and fragrant. Add basil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat down to medium-low. Whisk in cream then add parmesan cheese and continue to whisk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drain the pasta and immediately add to the pan. Toss until coated in sauce. If the sauce is too thick, you may thin it out by adding some reserved pasta water, about 1-2 tablespoons at a time. Garnish with nutmeg, if desired.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately as a main course or with meat or salad.

title: Greek style beef burgers
description: There’s nothing better than a well cooked burger! Try our tasty take with this popular Greek style beef burgers recipe that will bring the taste of the Aegean to your plate!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grate the onion, garlic and tomato in a mixing bowl. Add the oregano, salt, pepper, olive oil, egg and mix using a whisk.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the minced beef and breadcrumbs and mix thoroughly using your hands. If the mixture is too sticky add some more breadcrumbs till the mix is solid. Pre-heat the oven to 200C. Leave the mixture in the fridge to rest for 10-15 minutes, while the oven is heating to temperature.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Knead the mixture in flat round hamburgers. Pre-heat some olive oil or rapeseed oil (for crispier results) in a pan and shallow fry for 1 minute on each side to lock in the flavours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the burgers on a large baking tray and cook in the oven for 20 minutes. Once ready, remove tray from the oven and let the meat rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with some basmati rice, chips or leafy salad. Enjoy!

title: Lemongrass Tea Recipe
description: Lemongrass tea is a simple herbal drink made by simmering fresh lemongrass in water. It has a mild citrus flavor and is naturally caffeine-free. This tea is popular in Indian and international kitchens as a light, everyday beverage.

lemongrass leaves (– chopped, optional *check point no 1 in notes below)
sugar (or preferred sweetener, add according to taste)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop the stalk.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chopped lemongrass stalks to water in a saucepan and heat on medium until it comes to a boil.Note: Add any optional spices if using at this point, when the water comes to a boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the water comes to a boil, simmer for 5 minutes for a light flavor or up to 10 minutes for a stronger infusion.

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

title: Folded kimbap (or gimbap)
description: The latest social media food trend in Korea! Folded kimbap (or gimbap)! So easy, quick, versatile, and yummy!

ingredients.name: gim (김밥용 김), seaweed sheet (aka laver, nori)
thin slices Spam or 2 tablespoons canned tuna (press out the liquid) ( or other cooked or processed meat)
fried egg (no runny yolk) ( or cheese, eomuk (fish cake), fried tofu, etc. )
lettuce leaf (you can use 2 or double up with a perilla leaf)
small cucumber or carrot (or your choice of veggies thinly sliced or julienned as necessary)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix warm rice with a little bit of sesame oil, salt to taste, and optional sesame seeds

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using Spam, thinly slice and pan fry for a minute or two on each side over medium heat. If using leftover cooked meat, you can heat it in the microwave as necessary. If using canned tuna, press the liquid out.

You can lightly sauté the cucumber or carrot, but not necessary. If using kimchi, thinly slice and squeeze out the liquid. You can mix kimchi with sesame oil and/or stir-fry in lightly oiled pan, but not necessary.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread the rice evenly over the bottom left quarter of the seaweed sheet. Arrange the other ingredients on each quarter. Lift the bottom left quarter and fold it onto the top left quarter, then to the top right, and finally to the bottom right. Press lightly and tuck the filling in after each fold.

title: Sautéed Potatoes
description: Snack form the memory, Chinese style salt and pepper sautéed potatoes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the potatoes into 4cm cubes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place in a large pot with enough water. Cook for 5-7 minutes until soft. Slightly drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While boiling the potatoes, heat around 1 teaspoon of salt over slow fire for 1 minute or until slightly browned. Add 1 tablespoon of ground Sichuan peppercorn and 1 tablespoon of ground cumin. Heat over slowest fire until aromatic. Transfer out to cool down.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

title: Thai Duck Noodle Soup Recipe (bamee ped toon)
description: It's a popular Thai street food for a reason! Duck legs are braised until tender in a flavourful, rich five-spice broth and served over noodles.

ingredients.name: bone-in duck hindquarter (leg and thigh combo)
ground white pepper or more to taste
fresh egg “wonton” noodles, thin (if using different types of noodles, you will need to adjust the weight according to the type of noodles you use)
Green leaf lettuce, torn into chunks (or other greens you prefer)
Fried garlic & garlic oil (optional, but recommended, recipe follows)
About 1/4 cup of neutral flavoured oil (for fried garlic)
Spicy chili peppers of your choice, you can use Thai chilies, serranos, jalapenos, or habaneros.
White vinegar, ¼-½ cup as needed to blend

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the fried garlic:

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop 1 head of garlic and add to a small pot or pan. Add just enough of the neutral flavoured oil to cover the garlic, then fry on low heat (gentle bubbling) until the garlic is golden and the bubbling has subsided. Be careful not to let the garlic get too brown or it will become bitter. Strain the garlic from the oil. You can keep them separately in the fridge in an airtight container for several weeks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the chili vinegar:

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: (Watch this video @ 7:13 for a quick visual of this being made). Cut the chilies in half and place on a foil-lined baking sheet, cut side down. Place the whole garlic cloves on the sheet as well and broil on “high” until the chilies are charred in spots and the garlic cloves are browned. Transfer to a blender, add just enough of the vinegar to blend, and blend until there are no more big chunks.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Make the broth:

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Toast the cinnamon, star anise, coriander seeds, and Sichuan peppercorns in a dry saute pan over medium high heat until the coriander seeds darken slightly and the spices are aromatic. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add chicken stock to a pot, then add all the herbs, spices, and seasoning. Bring to a simmer, then add the duck. Add just enough water to keep the duck covered, then bring it to a gentle simmer again, cover and let cook over low heat for about 2 hours or until the duck is fork tender.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: One the duck is tender, skim off the fat from the surface along with any spices that are floating. If making this in advance, you can cool the soup, refrigerate until cold, and the fat will congeal on the surface and it will be easy to scoop off. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt as needed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Assembly:

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Meanwhile, tear lettuce into bite-size chunks and line the bottom of each serving bowl.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Once water comes to a full boil, blanch the egg noodles for about 1.5-2 minutes, then remove from water and drain off as much water as you can and place in serving bowl. Blanch the bean sprouts in the same pot for 10-15 seconds, then place them in serving bowls. Place one piece of duck and about 1 cup of broth over the noodles. Drizzle with garlic oil, fried garlic, chili vinegar, white pepper, and chopped cilantro or celery leaves.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve immediately. Enjoy!

title: Easy Breakfast Enchiladas
description: Easy no-fuss Breakfast Enchiladas the whole family will love! Filled with scrambled eggs and breakfast sausage and topped with enchilada sauce and cheese.

ingredients.name: large Pete and Gerry's Organic Eggs, (beaten)
optional garnishes: crumbled cotija cheese or queso fresco, chopped cilantro, diced red onions

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add olive oil, peppers and onions. Saute for 5 minutes, until veggies soften and onions start to become translucent.

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the enchiladas: fill each tortilla with the sausage + egg mixture, roll them up and place them in the baking dish seam side down.

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

title: Caponata Recipe
description: Sicilian caponata is a tasty salad or relish made of eggplant with onions, celery, and tomatoes and augmented with tangy olives and capers.

ingredients.name: large eggplant (1 ¼ lb or so, cut into 1-inch cubes)
to ½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the eggplant cubes with salt (if you have the time, set it aside in a colander to sweat out its bitterness for about 20 or 30 minutes, while you prepare the remaining ingredients. Pat dry with paper towel).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the seasoned eggplant cubes on a sheet pan, add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (about 3 tablespoons or so) and toss to coat. Roast the eggplant in the heated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil in a large skillet. Add the onions, bell pepper, and celery. Season with a pinch of kosher salt and black pepper. Cook for about 5 to 7 minutes, tossing regularly until softened.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the tomatoes, capers, olives, raisins, honey, bay leaf and crushed pepper flakes. Pour in the vinegar and white wine. Stir to combine. Simmer on medium-low heat for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the roasted eggplant and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes in the sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and mint.

title: Self rising flour, easy bread recipe for beginners!
description: A super easy bread recipe using only four ingredients! As you are using self rising flour and beer for this easy bread recipe, you don't need to wait for the dough to rise. So more time to enjoy it!

ingredients.name: self-rising flour (17.5 ounces) without added salt. If you’re in the US, the self raising flour most likely contains salt already added to it. If you can’t find any flour without salt, try using plain flour and add 6 flat teaspoons of baking powder to the mix.
beer, blonde pale lager such as bottled Heineken (1 1/3 of a cup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this easy bread recipe, add into a basin all the ingredients and blend with your hands, until the dough becomes an elastic ball. Alternatively, add all the ingredients into a bowl and mix using your hand-mixer with the dough hook attached until the dough is soft and does not crumble. Depending on the kind of flour used, the weather and many other factors, you may not need to use all the flour, or you may need some more. Leave 50g of flour aside and add a little bit at a time, until the dough is firm and not too sticky.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200C (400F) (with both top and bottom heating elements on) or 180C (350F) fan. Because in this easy bread recipe you are using self-rising flour and beer it is not necessary to wait for the dough to rise.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the dough out onto a floured board, wet your hands and split it in half. Knead each half with your hands, to form two round loafs.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sprinkle the bread loafs with some water and sieve with some flour. You can also sprinkle with some sesame seeds for some extra crunchiness.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: With a sharp knife, score the top of each loaf. Make 3-4 slashes across the top with a few deeper than the others.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Layer the bottom of a baking tray with some greaseproof paper and place the loafs on top. Bake in the preheated oven at 200C (400F) with both top and bottom heating elements on or 180C (350F) fan and bake for 60-70 minutes, until a nicely coloured crust forms and is cooked throughout.

title: Beef Stroganoff
description: Beef Stroganoff - a classic family favorite dinner made with perfectly seared beef strips smothered in a rich, creamy mushroom gravy. Incredible dinner in just less than an hour!

ingredients.name: (680 g) beef sirloin steak, (⅓ inch thick)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash then pat dry the steak with a paper towel. Take out excess fat from the beef and pound it to ⅓-inch thick using a meat mallet or a rolling pin. Slice the beef into tiny strips (slice across the grains) and season the steak with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place a 12-inch non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, then add oil. When oil sizzles, add beef strips to the pan in a single layer and pan fry meat until all sides are well brown; stirring frequently for about 3-5 minutes. You may do this in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Take out the steak from the skillet and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Melt 1-2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat, add in mushroom and sauté until golden brown for about 7 to 10 minutes until all the liquid released have evaporated, stirring occasionally. Remove mushroom from skillet and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the remaining butter to the pan and let it melt, then add onions, garlic, thyme and bay leaf. Cook stirring for a minute until onions are softened and translucent. Sprinkle in flour and cook for another minute stirring frequently to avoid burns.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the heat to low and whisk in the beef broth slowly, deglazing the pan by scraping off all the bits on the sides and bottom of the pan. Bring the mixture to a boil and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the mixture has thickened, stir in the Worcestershire sauce, paprika, Dijon mustard and sour cream. Stir until evenly combined and aromatic, about a minute. Adjust salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Return the mushroom and steak to the skillet including all the juice on the plate of steak, simmer again for 2-3 minutes then take pan off heat.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Sprinkle Stroganoff with fresh chopped parsley and serve with pasta, mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Turmeric Tea Recipe
description: Spicy, warming and immune boosting Turmeric Tea recipe made with ground turmeric and optional spices like ground cinnamon, black pepper and ginger powder.

ingredients.name: to 1 tablespoon raw sugar (or jaggery or maple syrup or coconut sugar or palm sugar - optional or add as needed)
ground turmeric ((turmeric powder) or for a lesser pungent taste add ¼ teaspoon of ground turmeric powder)
ground ceylon cinnamon ((cinnamon powder), use ceylon cinnamon powder and not cassia cinnamon powder- optional)
crushed black pepper ( or ground black pepper (black pepper powder))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a saucepan take water and raw sugar or jaggery. You can even use maple syrup or skip the sweetener completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the water and let it come to a boil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add turmeric powder, ground ceylon cinnamon, ground ginger and crushed black pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil further for a minute or two.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour and serve. You can even strain the tea.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Enjoy turmeric tea hot or warm.

title: Thai-Style Beef Noodle Soup
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Optional aromatics: 5 pc white cardamom or a few slices galangal
Thinly sliced roast beef (if not using roast beef, see instructions below)
Green onion and/or cilantro for garnish
Chili flakes, chili oil, or any spicy condiment if you want it spicy

This is my preferred way but not traditional, it'll give you slightly pink meat: Simply salt and pepper the steak and sear the outside until nice and brown, leaving the inside rare or medium rare (remember that the hot broth will cook the meat further). Let the steak cool completely, then THINLY slice, against the grain if possible. It's now ready to be assembled into your soup.

The second way is if you like well-done meat: THINLY slice the steak, marinate it in a bit of soy sauce, then when you're assembling the noodle soup, cook the beef it in the hot broth and pour it over the noodles. If you want to do it this way just be careful not to overcook the meat, you literally need a few seconds and it will continue to cook in the hot broth!(Yes, I put THINLY in all caps cuz it's important. Otherwise it will be tough and/or overwhelm the noodles.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the broth:

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the bones and add to a large stock pot. Cover with cold water and simmer for 1.5 hours, skimming off the scum from the surface as needed. (You can make the fried garlic in the mean time.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: After 1.5 hours, add the onion, garlic, cilantro stems, black pepper, and any other aromatics you’re adding. Simmer for another 1 - 1.5 hours, uncovered.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use a slotted skimmer to fish out all the bones and aromatics from the broth. At this point if it has reduced too much and you have less liquid than you need, feel free to add more water to make up the volume. Season with fish sauce, soy sauce and sugar, then taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Make the fried garlic:

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Chop 1 head of garlic and add to a small pot or pan. Add just enough of a neutral flavoured oil to cover the garlic, then fry on low heat (gentle bubbles) until the garlic is golden and the bubbling has significantly slowed down. Be careful not to let the garlic get too brown or it will become bitter. Strain the garlic from the oil. You can keep them separately in the fridge in an airtight container for several weeks. Use over noodle soups or any dish that can use some extra garlic flavour!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Assembly:

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Soak the rice noodles in room temp water for 15-20 minutes or until the noodles are soft and pliable. Meanwhile slice the beef thinly and gather all your components.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bring a big pot of water for blanching noodles to a full boil. Meanwhile, heat the broth until it's gently bubbling.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: *If making several bowls of noodle soup, I find it easier to separate the noodles while they’re uncooked and blanch them one at a time since it only takes 5 seconds to blanch, rather than trying to separate hot, cooked noodles.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place one portion of noodles and beansprouts in a metal sieve or an Asian style noodle strainer and place it in rapidly boiling water and shake it around for 5 seconds. If you’re using bigger noodles, or you have under-soaked your noodles and they are still a bit stiff, you will need to cook them longer. Lift it from the water, drain off as much water as you can, and place the noodles into a serving bowl. Repeat with the remaining portions.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Arrange the beef slices over the cooked noodles and ladle the hot broth over; the beef will heat up and cook a little bit more. If you want the beef well-done, simply add them to the broth and let it cook for a few seconds, and then pour the broth and the beef over the noodles.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Finish it off with chopped green onions and/or cilantro, garlic oil, fried garlic and chili oil/flakes if desired. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Braised Crispy Tofu with Shrimp
description: Braised tofu is the BEST TOFU EVER! The tofu is coated with egg, grilled until crispy, and then braised in a rich shrimp chicken stock. The tofu is so tender and absorbs tons of flavor.

ingredients.name: (5 ounces / 140 grams) peeled shrimp (, deveined (*see footnote 1))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chop ginger and green onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop shrimp into small pieces and mince into even smaller bits. Transfer to a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 1/2 teaspoons minced ginger, Japanese sake (or Chinese cooking wine), 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch and pinch of salt, mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt with chicken stock.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Slice tofu into 1/3-inch (8-millimeter) rectangles.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Spread the rest of the cornstarch on a big plate. Add the egg white to another plate.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until warm.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Work on the tofu pieces one at a time. Coat a piece of tofu with cornstarch and shake off the extra. Dip in egg white, coating both sides. Immediately place into the skillet. Work on the rest of the tofu in the same way. (*see footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When the bottom side of the tofu turns golden, flip to cook the other side. If the skillet gets too hot and starts to smoke, turn to medium low heat. Cook until the bottom side turns golden.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: If you are cooking in two batches, add all the tofu back into the skillet.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add chicken stock into the skillet. Add shrimp and the remaining 1 teaspoon ginger and green onion. Carefully spread everything with a spatula, so the shrimp and herbs will be submerged in liquid.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cook until the liquid is mostly absorbed, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve warm with steamed rice or by itself.

title: Jjimdak (Korean Braised Chicken)
description: Here’s how to make a hearty, flavorful Korean braised chicken dish, jjimdak! It's very easy to make at home with a few basic ingredients! Simply omit the chili peppers for a mild version.

ingredients.name: medium-sized chicken, cut up (2.5 to 3 pounds of cut pieces)
medium white or yukon gold potatoes (about 10 ounces)
- 4 mushroom caps (rehydrated dried shiitake or fresh shiitake, white, or baby bella)
- 3 dried whole red chili peppers (4 to 5 small ones)
oyster sauce (If unavailable, use more soy sauce)
dark brown sugar ((if unavailable, use regular sugar ))
to 4 tablespoons corn syrup, Korean jocheong (rice syrup), Oligodang (oligo syrup), or 2 to 3 tablespoons honey (Adjust to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the starch noodles in warm water for about 30 minutes while preparing the other ingredients. Drain well before using.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the chicken and cut into small pieces. Trim off excess fat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the potatoes in chunks (about 1-1/2 inch) and soak them in water while preparing the other vegetables. Cut the carrot, mushrooms, and onion into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the chicken pieces to a large pot. Pour 3 cups of water over the chicken. (You should reduce the amount of water if not using the noodles.) Add the sauce ingredients except sesame oil and seeds. Bring it to a boil over high heat, uncovered, and continue to boil for about 10 minutes. Skim off the foam.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the potatoes, carrot, mushrooms, onion, dried whole red chili peppers if using, garlic and ginger. Cover, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes. You may see that there still is a lot of liquid, but the potatoes and starch noodles will soak up a lot of the liquid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Gently mix in the green chili peppers (or jalapenos), scallions and starch noodles, and continue to cook, uncovered this time, for an additional 3 minutes. Stir in the sesame oil. Garnish with the sesame seeds to serve.

title: Chinese Oyster Broccoli Salad
description: Broccoli salad with Chinese oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the broccoli into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring some water to a boiling in a pot. Add 3 drops of cooking oil and salt in the water. Blend the broccoli around 1 minute. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare a pan, add oyster sauce, light soy sauce, water and sugar together. Bring them to a boiling.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the sauce with broccoli.

title: Thai Tom Yum Noodle Soup (guay tiew tom yum)
description: A popular Thai street food, tom yum noodle soup takes the basil broth and amp it up with chilies, lime juice, ground pork, and roasted peanuts. It's super common in Thailand, but a rare find in Thai restaurants overseas.

ingredients.name: cilantro roots, smashed to bruise, or 10 cilantro stems,
top half of 2 lemongrass, smashed until broken and cut into 2-inch pieces
+ 2 tsp fish sauce (2 tsp per bowl)
ground roasted peanuts (2 Tbsp per bowl)
Roasted chili flakes or regular chili flakes, to taste (see note 1)
(720 ml) pork stock (6oz/180 ml per bowl)
Asian-style fish cakes, thinly sliced (store bought)
fresh egg noodles (thin) or another noodle of your choice (see note 2)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the broth:

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash bones in cold water, then add to a large stock pot. Cover with about 3 L of cold water and bring to a simmer; let simmer for about 45-60 mins (do not let boil). Skim off the scum that has floated to the top using a fine mesh skimmer or a ladle, then add garlic, cilantro roots, peppercorns, lemongrass. Simmer for 1 more hour then keep hot until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For the ground pork:

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add water to a small pot, then bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add ground pork and fish sauce and cook, stirring constantly to break up big chunks, until the pork is fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For fried garlic:

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add garlic to a small pot and add just enough vegetable oil to barely cover. Fry over medium low heat until the garlic is golden brown. Remove from heat and immediately transfer into a bowl to stop it from cooking further. (Note: For soups, you can keep the garlic in the oil, but if you want to keep the garlic crispy for sprinkling on other dishes, drain the garlic from the oil).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Assembly:

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Blanch bean sprouts and fish cakes in boiling water for about 7-10 seconds just to heat them up, then remove from the water (keeping the water) and divide into serving bowls.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cook noodles in the boiling water until it's just slightly underdone, timing will vary with different types of noodles so you have to taste for doneness. Drain and divide noodles between serving bowls.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To each bowl, add 2 heaping tablespoons of the cooked ground pork.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: In a medium pot, add the pork stock and heat it just until it is simmering gently (do not let it boil or it will reduce and you won't have enough broth). Turn off the heat and add the sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, ground peanuts, and chili flakes; stir to dissolve the sugar and ladle broth over the noodles, starting with ¾ cup of broth per bowl, then divide the remaining broth evenly.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Top each bowl with cilantro and fried garlic & garlic oil; serve immediately. After tasting, feel free to adjust the flavour with chili vinegar, more fish sauce, lime juice, sugar or chili flakes!

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Greek Bifteki (baked beef patties) with potatoes
description: Greek baked bifteki (beef patties) with lemon potatoes! A staple dish in every Greek household! Juicy, well seasoned minced beef, infused with the flavours of parsley, garlic, onions and oregano, paired with lemon roast potatoes.

ingredients.name: potatoes, cut in wedges (or baby potatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek beef bifteki (patties) recipe, add in a large bowl the minced beef along with the rest of the ingredients and mix thoroughly with your hands. If the mixture is too sticky add some more breadcrumbs (or some water if it is to dry), till the mix is solid. If you have the time, it is better to knead the mixture for about 10 minutes, until all the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When done, put the mixture for the burgers (bifteki) in the fridge to rest for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Form the mixture in flat round burgers.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat oven to 180* C (350* F).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If using large potatoes, cut the potatoes into wedges. In a large bowl add all the ingredients for the potatoes and whisk to combine. Add the potatoes and toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the potatoes and the marinade to a 30×40 cm roasting pan. Spread them out in the pan and bake for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the potatoes are partly cooked, place the patties over them. Bake covered with aluminum foil for 20 minutes. Remove the aluminum foil and bake for 10 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Avocado Hummus Recipe
description: This creamy avocado hummus packs flavor from garlic, lime juice, cumin and a pinch of caynne. Perfect with just a drizzle of good extra virgin olive oil.

ingredients.name: can chickpeas, (drained (or roughly 2 cups cooked chickpeas))
lime, (juice of, more to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large food processor, fitted with a blade, add the hummus ingredients (garlic, chickpeas, avocados, Greek yogurt, tahini, salt, cumin, cayenne and lime juice). Run the food processor to blend until the hummus mixture is smooth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Test, and if it's too thick, add a very little bit of the chickpeas canning liquid. Run the processor again until you achieve the desired creamy consistency. Adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the avocado hummus to a serving dish and cover tightly with plastic wrap (if you press the plastic warp well, it will help prevent air from changing the color of the avocado hummus). Chill a few minutes before serving. Uncover and smooth the surface of the hummus and drizzle a bit of extra virgin olive oil. Garnish with fresh parsley or another herb if you like.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Enjoy with pita bread or pita chips.

title: Mac and Cheese (Stovetop & Baked)
description: This homemade Mac and Cheese recipe is creamy and cheesy with a smooth stovetop cheese sauce. Cooked macaroni is mixed with the sauce for a rich and comforting dish.

to 2 pinch grated nutmeg ( or ground nutmeg powder)
or 150 grams cheese ( – shredded, mix of cheddar, mozzarella and gouda cheese or any melty cheese )
to ¼ teaspoon crushed black pepper (or as required)

description: Tuna Melt is an incredible summer sandwich made with a ridiculously flavorful tuna salad and cheese on slightly crisp sliced bread, then topped with tomatoes and avocado.
