title: Green Onion Tofu Salad (小葱拌豆腐)
description: Green onion tofu salad contains only four ingredients and takes five minutes to prepare. The tofu tastes so refreshing with the nutty sesame oil and pungent green onion.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Carefully transfer the tofu from the package to a medium-size plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sprinkle sea salt over tofu and top with green onion and a drizzle of sesame oil. Use a knife to slice tofu into strips, then gently mix it with a pair of chopsticks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve immediately.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken Wings–Glazed Version
description: Glazed Chicken Wings with honey, garlic, and oyster sauce with a slightly sweet yet strong garlic taste.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the cleaned chicken wings around 30 minutes in clean water. Drain with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the chicken wings with the marinade sauce in a container and cover with a plastic wrap. Place in refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Overnight is better.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the chicken wings on the grill and lay one layer of silver paper on the ovenware so the sauce will not sprinkle on the oven.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Melt the honey with warm water and then brush on the surface of chicken wings evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Set up the oven to 390 degree F and glaze for 15 minutes, Turn over and brush the honey water again and continue bake for 10 minutes.

title: Bossam (Boiled Pork Wraps)
description: Deliciously tender and moist pork belly served with crunch cabbage leaves and spicy radish salad!

ingredients.name: tender inner parts of 1 napa cabbage, salted ( or red or green leaf lettuce)
(Dissolve 1/2 cup coarse salt in 4 cups of water, and soak the cabbage leaves until softened, 2 to 4 hours. Rinse and drain well.)
saewujeot (salted shrimp) (use it as is or mix with a little bit of gochugaru, sesame oil and seeds, and chopped scallion)
whole fresh pork belly about 3-inch wide cut (about 2.5 pounds)
instant coffee, or a cup of brewed coffee (or a small bottle (or can) of beer - 12 ounces)
to 8 cups water (see note) (if using brewed coffee or beer, reduce the amount of water by the equal amount)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a pot, bring water and all the brine ingredients to a boil over medium high heat, and continue to boil for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the pork belly, bring it to a boil. and boil for about 5 minutes, uncovered. Reduce the heat to medium, and cook, covered, until the meat is very tender, 45 to 50 minutes. Cut a small slice and try if tender at 40 minute point before cooking longer. Turn the heat off, and cool the meat in the cooking liquid. This will keep the meat moist.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Thinly slice the meat and serve with the salted cabbage (or lettuce), saewujeot, and musaengchae.

title: The Perfect Lockdown Recipe: Glass Noodle Stir-Fry!
description: Reheating tip: Glass noodles do keep quite well BUT, you need to know one thing: they harden up in the fridge, and in order for them to be soft again, they have to be heated back up until VERY hot.

ingredients.name: glass noodles (2 small packs of Pine Brand)
ground pork or dark meat poultry, or sub another protein of your choice
carrot, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced on a bias (about half a carrot)
cabbage, cut into bite-sized pieces (or sub other veggies you’ve got in the fridge)
eggs (you can also add 3 for extra protein)
Optional garnish: Green onions or cilantro
Golden Mountain sauce (or sub Maggi Seasoning or more soy sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak glass noodles in room temperature water for 7-10 minutes until soft and pliable. Pour the water off, then cut the noodles in halfs or thirds with scissors to shorten them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the sauce, in a small bowl, mix together oyster sauce, soy sauce, Golden Mountain sauce and sugar. Keep the water separate but have it ready on the side when you're cooking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add oil to a wok or a large saute pan (preferably non-stick) and heat it on medium heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add garlic, onions, pepper and cook until the garlic starts to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the meat, turn the heat up to medium high and cook just until about 80% done.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the cabbage and carrot, about 2 tsp of the sauce, and cook for a minute to wilt the veggies.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the noodles, then pour the rest of the sauce on top of the noodles. Rinse the sauce bowl with about 3 Tbsp of the water and pour it in. Toss everything until the noodles have absorbed all the sauce and are fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the noodles have absorbed all the sauce, give it a taste to see if the noodles are done to your liking. If you want them softer, add another splash of water and toss them until they're dry again

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Push the noodles to one side and add a little extra oil to the empty space. Add the eggs to the space, then move the pan so the eggs are centered on the burner and the noodles are a bit off heat. Let the eggs set a bit, then scramble them slightly just to get a marbling of the whites and yolks. Once the eggs are about half way cooked, put the noodles on top of the eggs and let it sit without stirring for another 30 seconds to cook the eggs, then flip and tossing everything together.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add tomatoes and toss just to heat through for 10-15 seconds.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Plate, top with green onions or cilantro, and serve immediately!

title: Simple Mediterranean Cucumber Salad Recipe
description: Bright and refreshing cucumber salad, prepared Mediterranean-style with shallots, fresh dill, peppery radish and a light citrus dressing.

ingredients.name: About 1/4 oz/9 g chopped fresh dill
to 4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place sliced cucumbers in a large mixing bowl. Add sliced shallots, radish, and fresh dill.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl (or mason jar), combine the dressing ingredients (extra virgin olive oil, white wine vinegar, lemon juice, oregano, kosher salt and black pepper.) Whisk (or cover and shake the mason jar) until well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the dressing over the salad. Toss again to combine, making sure the cucumber salad is well coated with the dressing. Enjoy!

title: Horta (Boiled Greek Wild Leafy Greens)
description: Healthy and absolutely delicious Horta recipe (Boiled Greek Wild Leafy Greens) for the lovers of Greek cuisine! Horta is a very popular salad one can taste almost everywhere in Greece.

ingredients.name: wild greens (53 ounces). You can use dandelion greens, amaranth greens, swiss chard, sorrel greens or any other long stemmed robust leaf.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the wild leafy greens thoroughly and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a large saucepan pour the olive oil, add the onions and leeks and sauté for 3-4 minutes, until wilted.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the wild greens and mix with a wooden spoon. As soon as they become wilted, lower the heat and add 1/2 cup of water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: With the lid on, simmer for 35 minutes, until the wild greens are boiled.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the meantime, prepare the feta sauce. Into a blender add the feta cheese (crushed).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a small pot, warm the milk and the milk cream at low heat. Right before it comes to the boil, remove from the stove and let it cool for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the milk in the blender, along with the herbs and spices and blend, until the sauce becomes smooth.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve the horta at room temperature and drizzle some extra virgin olive oil and lemon juice. Top with the feta sauce and some grated tomato, if you wish.

title: Concha Breakfast Sandwich
description: Concha Breakfast Sandwiches made from soft maple conchas, crispy bacon, perfectly fried eggs, creamy avocado, and salty cotija cheese.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the dough. Heat the milk in the microwave in 15-second increments or on the stove until it's just warm to the touch. A thermometer should read around 110°F-115°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir in the yeast and 1 tablespoon of the sugar. Loosely cover with plastic wrap and let it stand for 5 minutes until it gets very foamy. If the mixture doesn't get foamy, throw it out and start again with a new packet of yeast.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer (or a regular large bowl), whisk together 3 ½ cups of all-purpose flour, the remaining sugar, and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Attach the dough hook to the mixer and add the melted butter, eggs, and yeast mixture. Mix together on medium-low speed for 6-8 minutes (or mix by hand), until the dough becomes smooth and elastic. The dough will be slightly tacky but not completely sticky. If it is still fairly sticky, knead in 1 tablespoon of additional flour at a time until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat a large bowl with oil and transfer the dough to the bowl, shaping it into a ball. Cover it with a kitchen towel and let it rise for 1 ½ to 2 hours, or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape into balls. Place 6 balls on each of the prepared baking sheets and cover them loosely with clean kitchen towels. Let the balls rise again for 1 ½ hours in a warm place, or until doubled in size. While the conchas rise, make the topping.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Prepare the topping. Beat together the flour, powdered sugar, butter, maple extract, vanilla extract, and ground cinnamon in a large mixing bowl with a handheld mixer until it starts to clump together and resembles wet sand. Transfer the mixture to a clean surface and knead it with your hands until it forms a smooth paste.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Divide the mixture into 12 equal pieces and shape them into balls.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Lightly flatten each ball in between two sheets of parchment paper using a tortilla press or rolling pin.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Assemble the conchas. Drape the topping onto the risen concha dough. Lightly pat it down on the sides to secure the topping.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. While the oven is preheating, cut grooves into the topping using a paring knife to resemble a clamshell, a crisscross pattern, or whichever pattern you prefer. Be careful not to cut too deep and accidentally cut the concha dough.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the bottom of the conchas is golden brown. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before slicing in half, horizontally.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Make the sandwiches. In a large skillet over medium heat, add the slices of bacon and cook until crispy on both sides. Transfer it to a plate lined with paper towels to drain.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: In a separate large nonstick skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Crack the eggs into the skillet and cook until the egg whites are just set, but the yolks are still runny. Gently flip over and cook for about 10-20 seconds. Set aside on a large plate.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Assemble the sandwiches by layering each concha bun with a slice of bacon, a fried egg, a few slices of avocado, and a sprinkle of cotija cheese.

title: Instant Pot Beef Stew
description: Warm and cozy INSTANT POT BEEF STEW with beef chunks, potatoes, carrots, peas, and seasonings. A simple yet complete dish prepared in just a few minutes that perfectly creates a tender and meaty stew.

ingredients.name: (.91 kg) stew beef or beef chuck (, cut into small chunks)
-3 large carrots (, cut into large chunks)
bouillon powder beef, chicken, or vegetable (, adjust to taste (optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thoroughly season beef with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning or Creole Seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the Instant Pot on to “SAUTE” mode.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil and heat up until it is simmering.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add beef and brown well, turning once, about 3-4 minutes per side or until beef browns up. Do not overcrowd the pan. Cook in batches, if necessary.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take the beef out and set it aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the instant pot and add onions, ginger, garlic, thyme, smoked paprika, green onions, and bay leaves. Stir for about 2-3 minutes or until onions are translucent.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add tomato paste and beef broth. Stir well thoroughly scraping the brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Make sure you remove every bit of stuck-on food so that you don’t receive a “burn” warning.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Throw in browned beef, potatoes, carrots, and beef bouillon into the instant pot and salt according to preference.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Close and seal the Instant Pot. Cook on "High Pressure" for 35 minutes, then allow the pressure to release naturally for 10 minutes. Vent to release any remaining pressure, then carefully open the lid. Remove and discard the bay leaf.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Set Instant Pot to Sauté mode.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and water to create a slurry. Add to the Instant Pot and stir until the stew thickens. Add the peas and stir to warm through.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Remove, garnish with parsley and serve with bread.

to 6 tablespoons sugar (or raw sugar or jaggery, add as per taste)
or 2 to 3 pinches black salt (– optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the gosari and 4 to 5 cups of water to a medium pot. Boil over medium heat, covered, until tender, 30 to 40 minutes. The time can vary depending on the gosari. Turn the heat off and let it cool in the cooking water. When ready to use, rinse in cold water and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut into 3 to 4-inch lengths, removing tough ends of the stems, if any.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a pan, mix the gosari with the soy sauce, sugar and garlic. Let stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the heat to medium, and sauté the gosari with 1 tablespoon of cooking oil for about 4 to 5 minutes. Pour in 1/4 cup of water (or dashima or beef broth). Cook for a few more minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is almost gone. Add the scallion, sesame oil, and sesame seeds. Stir well before turning the heat off.

title: Vegan Noodle Stir-Fry - Grandma's Signature (Pad Mee Sua)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

pressed tofu, marinated, cut into small pieces
5-6 dried shiitake mushrooms, rehydrated, stems removed, chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add noodles to rapidly boiling water and cook for about 2 minutes, just until they are pliable and release from each other but are still slightly undercooked. Timing may vary depending on your specific kind of noodles. Drain, rinse with cold water and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the noodles, then drizzle the soy sauce and golden mountain sauce over the noodles and toss with tongs until the sauces are well distributed. Sprinkle sugar and white pepper and toss to mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Check doneness of noodles, they should be done by this point, but if they're still too hard, you can add a splash of water and toss it around until all the water is absorbed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn off the heat and immediately add garlic chives, tossing it until the garlic chives are slightly wilted.

title: Chinese Steamed Fish
description: Traditional and authentic Chinese steamed fish with soy sauce.

ingredients.name: pinch of salt ( ,optional for fresh water fish only)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut half of the scallion and ginger into small sections.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For decoration: shred scallion with a fork and then soak them in cold water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Clean the fish completely and peel off any black skins in the stomach of the fish. Drain completely.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Watch the body shape if your fish. If it gets a thick back, cut a line and separate the back into two parts. Or if it gets thick stomach, cut 2 lines on the thickest meat, so the meat can be cooked in a shorter time and be kept as tender as possible. (Optional for fresh water fish only), spread a very thin layer of salt on the surface and stomach of the fish. Place scallion and ginger inside of the fish.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place two scoops on the plates, or two sections of chopsticks and then place the fish in.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring enough water to a boiling in a large pot and place the fish in after the water boils. Start the count the time, steam 5 minutes and stand for 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the fish to a clean plate, discard the scallion and ginger and place the newly cut scallions. Heat around 2 tablespoons of cooking oil until almost smoky and pour the oil evenly on the scallion shreds.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat the seasoned soy sauce until warm and pour evenly on the plate. If your soy sauce is cold, pour them on the two sides of the fish, not over the fish.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve hot and should be finished within 10 minutes.

title: Sicilian-Style Fish Stew Recipe
description: An all-star recipe for fish stew with a Sicilian twist! The comfort of Italian flavors in one delicious stew cooked in a white wine-tomato broth with garlic, capers, raisins more!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
28-oz can whole peeled plum tomatoes, juice separated and reserved
skinless sea bass fillet, about 1 1/2-inch thick, cut into large cubes
chopped fresh parsley leaves, stems removed

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in 5-quart Dutch oven (like this one) over medium heat. Add onions, celery, and a little salt and pepper (about 1/2 tsp each). Cook, stirring regularly, until softened (about 4 minutes). Add thyme, red pepper flakes and garlic and cook briefly until fragrant (about 30 more seconds).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now, stir in the white wine and reserved tomato juice from can. Bring to a simmer, and cook until the liquid is reduced by about 1/2. Add the tomatoes, vegetable broth, raisins, and capers. Cook for 15-20 minutes over medium heat until flavors combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat the fish dry and season lightly with salt and pepper. Insert the fish pieces into the cooking liquid, and give everything a gentle stir so that the fish pieces are nicely covered in the cooking liquid. Bring to a simmer and cook for another 5 minutes. Remove the Dutch oven from the heat and cover. Let sit off heat for another 4-5 minutes so that the fish will finish cooking. Fish should be flaky when gently pulled apart with a paring knife. Finally, stir in the chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Ladle the hot fish stew into serving bowls, top each with a few toasted pine nuts, if you like. Serve with your favorite crusty bread! Enjoy!

description: Tomatoes, tossed with garlic, fresh thyme, and spices, then roasted in a high-heated oven until super tender and bursting with intense, concentrated flavor.

steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2

title: Chinese Bang Bang Chicken (棒棒鸡)
description: The real-deal Sichuan version of Bang Bang chicken made with juicy tender shredded chicken covered with a savory, nutty, spicy sauce with a hint of tangy and sweet notes.

ingredients.name: (700 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts ( (or chicken thighs))
Chinese sesame paste ((or unsweetened natural peanut butter))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chop 2 green onions into 2” (5 cm) sticks. Slice the remaining 2 green onions into thin slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a steamer by adding 2” (5 cm) water into the pot. Cover and heat over medium-high heat until boiling.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a plate that can fit into your steamer rack. Spread the green onion sticks onto the plate to make a bed. Place the chicken breast on top. Sprinkle salt evenly over the chicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When steam comes out of the steamer, place the steamer rack with the chicken on top, and cover the steamer. Cook for 20 minutes. Test the chicken by using a thermometer inserted into the thickest part. It should read 165 degrees F (73 C). Or insert a knife into the thickest part, and the juice should run clear. If the chicken is still pink inside, steam for another 5 to 10 minutes. Once done, transfer the chicken to a plate to cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While cooking the chicken, combine the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk to mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the chicken is cooled, transfer it onto a cutting board. Use a meat pounder or a rolling pin to pound the chicken (optional), then shred into thin slices using two forks.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the chicken into a large bowl or deep plate. Drizzle the sauce on top and mix well. Garnish with thinly sliced green onion. If you want to create the authentic look, like at a Sichuan restaurant, drizzle more chili oil (about 1/3 to 1/2 cup) onto the chicken.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve as a cold appetizer or a main dish.

title: Extra healthy roast chicken recipe with brown rice and boiled vegetables
description: This extra healthy roast chicken recipe is based on a combination of brown rice, chicken and fresh vegetables, ideal for a quick mid-week healthy and exciting dinner.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour the rice in a bowl and let it soak in cold water for at least one hour before boiling it to soften it up.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Split the chicken thighs into two pieces and place them in an oven tray. In a separate bowl, mix olive oil, mustard, salt and the lemon juice. Stir it well and cover the chicken thighs with this delicious marinade. Make sure that the marinade covers the whole surface of the chicken thighs for a better taste! Pour a glass of water in the tray and insert in the oven.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the rice, start by boiling some water in a kettle. Pour 2 1/2 cups of water for every cup of rice in a small saucepan. The moment the water starts boiling, turn down the heat and leave it in the pot until the water is fully absorbed by the rice. It should take about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4

Before removing them from the pan you sprinkle some fresh herbs to give some extra taste. Ginger and thyme are excellent choices to mix in. Also don’t forget to pour in one tablespoon of olive oil. Your heart will thank you!

title: Dim-Sum Shrimp Dumpling (Har Gow)
description: One of the most famous Chinese dim-sum dish--shrimp dumplings. Those little shrimp dumplings have transparent outside, fresh and pink inside.

ingredients.name: lard ( , or around 1 teaspoons of cooking oil)
raw shrimp ( , rinsed, tails removed, chopped)
inch root ginger ( , finely chopped or grated)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the wheat starch, tapioca starch and the salt. Slowly stir in the boiling water and you can see there is no dry flour in the bowl. Set aside for around 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add some lard (or not) and knead the flour into a dough until smooth. If you are using cooking oil, add the oil in the middle of your kneading process. Set the dough aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Peel fresh shrimp and devein. Finely mince the shrimp and add cooking wine, soy sauce, pepper powder and chopped ginger firstly. Stir the filling in one direction until you get a paste like texture. Set aside to marinate for around 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Get the dough out and knead around another 4~5 minutes to punch the air out and then roll the dough into a cylinder around 1 inch and then cut it into small sections around 1 inch diameter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll the small sections out to thin round wrappers one by one.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add chopped spring onions in the shrimp meat and mix well. Wrap the dumplings one by one.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Slice some carrots slices and put the carrots slices firstly in your steamer and then place the dumplings on the carrots slices one by one.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Daegu Jorim (Braised Cod Fish)

ingredients.name: of cod fish (or black cod) steaks or fillets
mu (무), Korean white radish (cut into about 1/2-inch thick large chunks)
thinly sliced ginger pieces (about 1 inch round)
small green and/or red chili peppers (or 1 large) (or jalapenos, thinly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the fish. Prepare the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pan, add the radish, garlic, ginger, and sauce. Boil over medium high heat until the braising liquid is slightly thickened and the radish becomes soft, about 10 minutes. Add the onion and chili peppers and boil for another 3- 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the fish, and boil for 4-5 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fish. Carefully flip them over, and boil for another 4-5 minutes, repeatedly spooning the sauce over the fish. Serve with a bowl of rice.

title: Greek Spinach and Rice recipe (Spanakorizo)
description: Looking for a super healthy and delicious traditional Greek spinach and rice recipe? Spanakorizo is a classic Greek vegetarian dish packed with abundant amounts of nutrients and best of all? Its super simple and easy to make!

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen spinach, rinsed and stemmed (35 oz.)
tinned chopped tomatoes (5.5 oz.) or 200g of fresh tomatoes, if in season.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this spanakorizo recipe (Greek spinach and rice), heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the onions, spring onions and leek and sauté for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the spinach and cook stirring for a few minutes, until wilted. Stir in the tomatoes, the tomato paste, two cups of hot water, the vegetable stock, the rice and season. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for about 20-25 minutes, until the rice is tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the Spanakorizo is simmering away, stir it every so often and check if the pan appears to be getting dry. If it is, add some more hot water and stir.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To know when its ready, take a grain of rice out of the skillet and pinch it with your fingernails. If its white on the inside it needs a little bit longer. When it’s close to ready, season with salt and pepper to taste. Finally, finish the spanakorizo with fresh chopped dill and cook for a a couple more minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this traditional Greek spinach and rice (spanakorizo) with a squeeze of a lemon and top with crumbled feta. Enjoy!

title: White Sangria
description: This easy White Sangria is the perfect refreshing summer cocktail! Made with a blend of strawberries, peaches and apples soaked in white wine and apple brandy, this drink is a summer staple!

ingredients.name: shots apple brandy or cognac ((about ¼ cup))
(750 ml) bottle white wine ((sauvignon blanc or pinot grigio are best))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place all the ingredients, except the sparkling water, in a large pitcher and stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Refrigerate sangria for 3 to 4 hours, up to overnight, before serving.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When ready to serve, give the sangria one last stir and pour over a glass of ice. Top with sparkling water for some bubbles if desired.

title: Egyptian Dukkah Recipe
description: Quick, homemade Egyptian dukkah recipe with nuts, seeds, and a few warm spices. I like to use a combination of three nuts here (hazelnut, almonds and walnuts), but you can use just one if you like.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the hazelnuts and almonds in a dry cast iron pan (do NOT add oil). Toast briefly over medium-high heat, tossing regularly, until the nuts gain some color (watch for nuts to turn a nice golden brown). Transfer to a side dish for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the sesame seeds in the same skillet and return to the heat. Toast over medium heat, tossing regularly, until the sesame seeds turn golden brown (this will be fairly quick so watch carefully).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the toasted nuts and sesame seeds to the bowl of a small food processor fitted with a blade. Add the pistachios, fennel seeds, spices, and a generous dash of kosher salt. Pulse for a few seconds until you reach a nice coarse mixture (Do not over process the dukkah. The mixture should not be too fine. See photos and video for exact texture).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the dukkah to a bowl to serve. Add a small bowl of extra virgin olive oil and your favorite bread for dipping (I like pita bread or even Jerusalem bagel). You can also store the dukkah in a tight-lid jar for up to 2 weeks to use as a topping for salad, soup, chicken, meats, or roasted vegetables!

title: Street Noodles w/ BBQ Pork & Wontons บะหมี่แห้ง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: egg noodles (this makes 1 generous potion, see note)
Chinese BBQ pork, store bought, or use this recipe
Baby bok choy or other greens of your choice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all noodle seasoning ingredients in a mixing bowl, set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, blanch the bok choy for 30 seconds. Remove with a skimmer and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Boil the wontons, if using, until they are fully cooked. Remove with a skimmer and place in a bowl. Toss with a bit of garlic oil to prevent them from sticking to each other.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Blanch the noodles until cooked through (this takes less than 1 minute if using the wonton noodles), drain the noodles well and place them directly into the seasoning bowl. Immediately toss the noodles in the seasoning, be very thorough with the tossing to make sure the sauce is evenly absorbed. Place noodles in a serving bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the pork, wonton, and bok choy around the noodles and top with fried garlic, white pepper, chili powder, and chopped cilantro and/or green onions. Serve immediately, enjoy!

description: Chana Chaat or Chickpea Chaat is a tangy, easy snack made with cooked chickpeas, spice powders, onions, tomatoes, potatoes and lemon juice. You can also use canned chickpeas to make this chatpata chaat quickly.

title: Nutty Steamed Buns (芝麻酱花卷, Sweet Hua Juan)
description: Imported from omnivorescookbook.com.

ingredients.name: 10 ounces all-purpose flour (*see conversion to cups)
milliliters slightly less than 1 cup water (room temperature)
Chinese sesame paste (or natural peanut butter)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add flour and instant dry yeast to a big bowl. Mix well with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slowly add water and mix with a spatula, until the water is fully absorbed and there is no dry flour on the bottom of the bowl (*see footnote 1). The dough should feel very soft and sticky.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dust both hands with flour. Start kneading with hand. The dough might stick to your hand easily. Add plenty of flour and continue to knead, until dough forms.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dust a thin layer of flour on a working surface (or a large cutting board). Transfer the dough to the working surface and keep kneading. If the dough starts to feel sticky, add more flour. Knead until the dough become consistent in texture, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the dough to a big bowl. Cover with a wet clean kitchen towel and place a lid on the bowl. Let rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Dust the working surface and both hands again. Transfer the dough to the working surface. Knead the dough for about 10 minutes, until the surface becomes smooth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Divide the dough in half. Knead each piece of dough a few times to shape a ball. Cover the dough with a damp and clean kitchen towel.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let rest for 1 hour, until the texture becomes fluffy and tender and the size nearly doubles.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Stir the sesame paste (or peanut butter) until the texture becomes consistent (*see footnote 2). Add the sesame paste and sugar to a bowl. Mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Dust the working surface and the dough with flour. Work on the dough pieces one by one.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Use a rolling pin to roll the dough into a large rectangular sheet, about the thickness of two dollar coins.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Spread half of the sesame paste (or peanut butter paste) evenly on the dough sheet to form a thin layer, leaving about 2cm (0.8 inches) away from the edge. If the dough you roll is a bit thicker, you may not able to use all the sesame paste. (*see footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Roll the sheet from the short side carefully, to form a roll.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Carefully divide the roll into six even parts with a sharp knife without squeezing out the filling.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: {Option 1} To shape the flowers, work on the buns one by one. Take one bun with both hands so that the swirl side faces down. Slightly press the middle of the bun (non-swirl side) and pull the swirl-pattern parts of the bun towards you on both sides. Fold the bun so that the two swirl sides both face up. Twist the two ends in opposite directions, then pinch both ends together, and lightly press the dough together. Place the pinched side down on the working surface.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: {Option 2} If you don’t feel like shaping the buns, or are simply finding it difficult to twist them, having put too much filling into the dough, you can skip last step and steam the buns directly.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: If you have a very large steamer rack, you can work on the other piece of dough now and steam the two batches together. Otherwise, start steaming the first batch now, and work on the next batch at the same time.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Add water to a steamer. Place a wet, clean dish towel (*see footnote 4) on the steaming rack. The water should be 2cm (0.8 inch) below the steaming rack. Carefully transfer the buns onto the rack, with at least 2 cm (0.8 inch) between them. Let the buns rest on the rack for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Heat the steamer over high heat until the water begins to boil. Turn to medium or medium high heat while keeping the water boiling. Steam the buns for 12 minutes, until the buns are cooked through.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: Be careful of the steam when you remove the cover of the steamer. Let the buns cool for a minute before transferring them to a plate.

steps.title: Step 21
steps.description: Serve warm.

steps.title: Step 22
steps.description: Store and reheat

title: Kimchi Bibim Guksu (Spicy Cold Noodles with Kimchi)
description: A simple cold noodle dish made with kimchi and a few seasoning ingredients! Spicy, slightly sweet and tangy!

ingredients.name: juice from kimchi (use a little more soy sauce and vinegar if unavailable)
rice vinegar or any other clear vinegar
corn syrup (or oligo syrup, 올리고당) (use more sugar if unavailable)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil while preparing the kimchi sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Thinly slice the kimchi and place it in a medium size bowl. Add the juice from the kimchi and remaining sauce ingredients, and mix everything well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the noodles to the pot of boiling water. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions (3 – 4 minutes). Drain quickly and shock in icy cold water to stop cooking. Drain and rinse in cold water again. Repeat until the noodles become cold. Drain well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine the noodles with the kimchi sauce, and toss everything until the noodles are evenly coated with the sauce. Taste and adjust the seasoning to taste by adding more soy sauce, sugar and/or vinegar, if necessary. Garnish with your choice of the optional vegetables and/or the boiled egg and serve cold.

title: Skirt Steak Marinade
description: An easy skirt steak marinade that tenderizes and adds a pop of flavor in every bite! Perfect grilled or cooked in a cast iron skillet.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium bowl, add the orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, apple cider vinegar, garlic, red pepper flakes, and ground cumin. Whisk together to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the skirt steak in a large baking dish or gallon size zip-top bag and pour the marinade on top. Turn the steak a few times until it's completely coated with marinade, cover, and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours. Do not marinate for longer than 8 hours because the meat will start to break down.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove steak from marinade and discard any excess marinade. Pat steak dry with paper towels and season with salt and black pepper on both sides.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To grill: Preheat grill to high heat (about 450°F-500°F). Grill the skirt steak with the lid closed for about 3-4 minutes per side for medium rare, or longer depending on the thickness and your desired doneness. I recommend using an instant read meat thermometer to make sure it's perfect!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To cook on the stove: Heat a large cast-iron skillet over high heat with a generous drizzle of oil. Add the skirt steak and press down on the meat a couple of times to make sure it's fully touching the bottom of the pan (you want to get a good sear). Cook for 3-5 minutes, then flip and cook for another 3-5 minutes depending on the thickness and your desired doneness. I recommend using an instant read meat thermometer to make sure it's perfect!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes. Slice thinly across the grain and at a slight angle and serve.

title: Salted Egg Fried Rice ข้าวผัดไข่เค็ม
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 8-10 shrimp (or as many as you like)
salted egg yolks, thawed, roughly chopped
Water for deglazing the pan, as needed
long beans or French green beans, chopped into 1cm pieces
rounded Tbsp Thai chilli paste, store bought or homemade (see note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a wok or a large frying pan, add just enough oil to coat the bottom and cook off all the shrimp over medium high heat. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the same pan, over medium heat, add chopped garlic and cook for a few minutes just until it starts to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add salted egg yolks and stir until the yolks are partially dissolved but still with lots of chunks. Deglaze with a splash of water as needed to keep the pan moist.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add long beans, bell pepper, fish sauce, soy sauce, Thai chili paste, and sugar. Toss together until the chili paste is well mixed, adding water a little at a time as needed if it becomes too dry.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the rice and toss until the rice is evenly coated in sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn off the heat and toss in tomatoes and green onions.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Plate the rice and place the shrimp on top. Serve with cucumber slices and a lime wedge.

title: How to Make Homemade Pita Chips
description: Perfectly crispy homemade pita chips baked with extra virgin olive oil and your seasoning of choice (I used za'atar, but you can change things up to your liking)!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 425 degrees F. And prepare a large sheet pan (do not line with parchment).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Split the pita pockets in half to make single rounds of pita. Place each pita flat on your cutting board and split them in half from the seam with a sharp knife or kitchen shears (you should end up with 2 single rounds of pita). Note: If your pitas are the thick, single-layer kind, you can skip this step as you can't split them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Brush with extra virgin olive oil & Season. Brush the pita rounds with extra virgin olive oil and season with kosher salt and za'atar (do this on both sides).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut into triangles. Using a knife or a pair of kitchen shears again, cut each round of pita into 8 triangles.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake! Arrange the pita triangles on the prepared sheet pan. Bake anywhere from 5 to 10 minutes, checking occasionally to turn over the pita triangles that have gained color, until you have pita chips that are crispy and golden brown to your liking.

title: Easiest Homemade Kourabiedes recipe (Christmas Greek Butter Cookies)
description: If you think that making homemade kourabiedes / kourambiethes (Christmas Greek butter cookies with almonds) takes lots of time and effort, try this super easy recipe!

ingredients.name: butter made from cows milk, cold (9 ounces, 1.1 cups) (Lurpak unsalted)
almonds, roughly chopped or almond slivers, roasted (6 ounces, 1 1/4 cups)
almonds (whole) or almond slivers, raw (1.8 ounces, 1/4 cups)
lots of icing sugar for powdering

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200C / 390F. To prepare this kourabiedes (kourambiethes) recipe start by roasting the almonds. Place the roughly chopped almonds (150g/ 6 ounces) or almond silvers on a baking tray and sprinkle with some water. Bake them for 7-8 minutes, until roasted, being careful not to burn them. Set aside or put in the fridge to cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a blender, add the raw almonds (50g/ 1.8 ounces) or the pistachios and blend, until powdered. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a food processor, add the cold butter and sugar; mix for about 10 seconds, until the butter ‘breaks’ and is completely dissolved. Add the powdered almonds, a pinch of salt, the rosewater and the vanilla extract; mix for 10-20 seconds, until combined. At the end, add the baking powder and flour and mix again for 10-15 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the mixture in a large bowl and add the roasted almonds; blend lightly with your hands. For the kourabiedes to remain fluffy, it is important that the butter doesn’t warm up and melt. So wait for a while for the roasted almonds to cool, before adding them to the butter mixture.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 170C / 340F. Layer the bottom of 2 baking trays with parchment paper and form the kourabiedes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll 1 tbsp (about 30g) of the dough into a ball, place on the baking tray and push with your finger in the middle, to form a little dimple. Continue with the rest of the dough. Place in the fridge for 5 minutes until you prepare your next tray.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the baking trays with the kourabiedes in second and fourth rack of the oven. Bake for approx. 15-20 minutes, until they have a very faint golden tint and are cooked through. Be careful not to overbake them.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Leave the kourabiedes aside to cool down for a while. If you try to lift them, while still warm, they will break!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Spray the kourabiedes with rosewater and sift with icing sugar. Enjoy!

title: Mongolian Beef
description: Mongolian Beef - Enjoy P.F. Chang's Mongolian Beef at home in just 30 minutes and it's 10x better. Savory and sweet succulent beef with a crunch!

ingredients.name: 4-5 large green onions (, sliced on the diagonal into one-inch lengths)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the beef against the grain in little pieces. Then mix with cornstarch, baking soda and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove from cornstarch, shake off and let it rest for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up the wok with about ¼ -1/2 cup oil,, then add meat; let it rest for about 30 seconds before stirring. Cook for 2 minutes or until beef reaches desired doneness - it should barely cook in the center, stir the meat around a little so that it cooks evenly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove, transfer beef to a plate and keep warm.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add ab with about 1 tablespoon of oil to the wok, add ginger and garlic sauté for about a minute making sure the garlic does not burn.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a small bowl combine soy sauce , dark brown sugar and water .

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add mixture to the wok , bring to a boil and stir for about a minute .

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Next, add beef to the wok . Bring to a boil, continually stirring for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Finally add scallions, stir, turn off heat and serve over white rice.

title: Kimchijeon (kimchi pancakes)
description: This crispy flavor-packed kimchi pancakes are super easy to make with a few basic ingredients as long as you have some well fermented kimchi.

ingredients.name: to 2 scallions (Two if thin and small)
minced pork, canned tuna (without the liquid), or squid cut into small strips - optional
cooking oil with high smoke point for pan frying
all-purpose flour or buchimgaru (Korean pancake premix)
to 3 tablespoons juice/liquid from kimchi (See note on water below)
or 2 teaspoons gochujang (Korean chili pepper paste) or gochugaru - optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the kimchi, about 1/2-inch thick. Cut the scallions into about 2-inch pieces. If the white part is thick, cut in half lengthwise. Thinly slice the onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the flour (or pancake mix) with the liquid from kimchi, the optional gochujang/gochugaru and egg, and water, a little bite at a time. Start with dissolving the gochujang with water, and mix everything together. Do not over mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a little more water if the batter is too thick. The batter should flow easily from a spoon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the kimchi, scallions, onion and the optional protein of your choice.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat one tablespoon of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Ladle the mixture into the pan, and spread it evenly into a thin round shape. Cook until the edges turn light golden brown, about 3 minutes. Turn it over, and add more oil to the sides of the pan. Gently swirl the pan to distribute the oil under the pancakes. Press the pancake down with a spatula. Cook until the other side is nicely browned and crispy, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Repeat the process until there is no remaining batter. Serve hot with a dipping sauce, if desired.

title: Crab Fried Rice ข้าวผัดปู
description: Crab fried rice is arguably the most popular kind of fried rice in Thailand. It's easy, quick, and SO satisfying.

ingredients.name: green onions and/or a few sprigs of cilantro

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place sliced chilies and garlic in a small dipping sauce bowl and add enough fish sauce to completely submerge the chilies and garlic. You can add more fish sauce to make the sauce less spicy.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add lime juice and let sit until ready to use. This will keep in the fridge for a few weeks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat oil and garlic in a wok over medium heat and stir until the smallest pieces of garlic start to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add eggs, scramble slightly, then let them set about halfway before stirring to break up the pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn heat up to high then add rice, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and pepper and toss to distribute the sauce evenly. Once mixed, add most of the crabmeat (save a bit for garnish), and continue tossing for about 2 minutes, occasionally letting the rice sit without stirring so that it can toast and develop flavour. Be gentle when tossing so you don’t break up the crab pieces too much.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the rice is dry and some of the grains are toasted, turn off the heat and toss in most of the green onions and/or cilantro (save some for garnish).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Plate and top with the remainder of the crab meat and green onions/cilantro.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with cucumber slices, a lime wedge, and prik nam pla. Enjoy!

title: Crock Pot Italian Beef Stew
description: Easy, rustic Italian Beef Stew made right in your crock pot or slow cooker! Only a few minutes to prep this comforting meal.

ingredients.name: beef chuck roast, fat-trimmed, and cut into roughly 1 1/2 inch cubes
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
large red onion, cut into large pieces
4-5 large rainbow carrots (about 12 oz), cut into large pieces
white or cremini mushrooms, cleaned and sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the flour and garlic powder together.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the meat dry and season with salt and pepper. Dredge the meat into the flour mixture to coat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large cast-irons skillet, heat 2 tbsp olive oil. Brown the meat deeply for about 3-4 minutes on each side; crust should form. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now, place the browned meat in the bottom of a large crock pot. Add the remaining ingredients except the mushrooms. Stir with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the crock pot and cook on high for 4 1/2 hours. Add the sliced mushrooms. Cover and cook for another 30 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Enjoy with your favorite Italian bread or even homemade challah!
