tags: how to cook canned black beans

ingredients.name: jalapeño pepper (minced (optional; seeds and veins removed if you don’t want it spicy))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add onions, tomatoes, jalapeño (if using), garlic, cumin, oregano and smoked paprika. Stir and saute for 5 minutes, until onions have softened and become translucent.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add can of black beans (do not drain), stir and bring to a simmer. If you'd like the beans to be a bit more soupy, add in some water or broth until the consistency is to your liking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat and stir in lime juice and salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve.

title: Walnut and biscuit Chocolate Truffles (Troufakia)
description: Little bites of heaven! Crunchy and creamy chocolate truffles, stuffed with crushed biscuits and crispy walnuts, flavoured with cognac and dredged in chocolate sprinkles.. Best of all, ready to freeze in less than 10 minutes!

ingredients.name: powdered cocoa or chocolate sprinkles for coating

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the mixture for the chocolate truffles, start by melting the chocolate. Chop the chocolate in small pieces and melt over low heat using a Bain Marie or double boiler, being careful not to burn it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, crush the biscuits in a large bowl. Pour the melted chocolate over the biscuits and (using a wooden spoon) blend to coat. Add the chopped walnuts, the milk and milk cream and blend again, until the ingredients combine. Pour in the cognac and place in the fridge to cool for 1-2 hours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the mixture for the chocolate truffles from the refrigerator. Wet your hands with some water, to make it easier to work with the chocolate mixture, and shape the chocolate truffles into balls by rolling between the palms of your hands. Roll the chocolate truffles in cocoa powder or chocolate sprinkles and serve, or place back in the refrigerator until needed. Enjoy!

title: Ground Beef Casserole
description: Ground Beef Casserole made with an aromatic blend of spices, beef, tomatoes and some good old cheese. A great meal that the whole family will rave about. Cheesy, meaty goodness that is super easy to make!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook pasta according to package directions. Be sure to salt water before cooking.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a saucepan, sauté the garlic, thyme, Jalapeno pepper, smoked paprika for about 1 minute in 2 tablespoons butter.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add onions and continue cooking for about a minute more.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add beef salt and pepper. Cook, stirring until the meat is no longer pink or red.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle 2 tablespoons flour over the beef mixture and cook for a minute or two.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add in the tomatoes and continue to cook for about 2-3 minutes. Throw in pasta and milk. Cook for another 1 or two until the ingredients have been fully incorporated. Adjust seasonings salt pepper

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir in more than half of the cheese (leave the rest to sprinkle on top)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish or 13-in. x 9-in. baking dish. Sprinkle remaining cheese.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake, uncovered, at 350° F for about 20 -30 minutes or until casserole is heated through. And top is slightly brown.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove then let it rest for a few minutes and serve when it is still piping hot.

title: Sabudana Vada Recipe (For Fasting)
description: Sabudana Vada is a classic Maharashtrian snack of deep fried patties made with soaked sabudana, potatoes and crushed peanuts. This recipe gives a crisp texture outside with a soft and light inside.

ingredients.name: to 2 green chillies (- finely chopped or ½ to 1 teaspoon )
to 2 tablespoons buckwheat flour (or amaranth flour - optional)
rock salt ((edible and food grade) or sendha namak)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soaking Sabudana

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cooking Potatoes

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roasting Peanuts

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Making Sago Mixture

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Making Sabudana Vada

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serving Suggestions

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Make Ahead Options

title: Red Braised Potatoes
description: Red braised potatoes with garlic, chili bean paste and leek.

ingredients.name: doubanjiang ( , or you can adjust the amount depending how spicy you want it to be)
fresh green leeks ( , cut into 1 inch sections)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the potatoes and remove the dots on the skin with a knife or scoop if the potatoes are small in size or just cook it and peel the skins off.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add around 2 teaspoons salt in a pot along with water to cover the potatoes. Continue to cook around 15 minutes after boiling or until you can insert a chop sticker inside the potato easily.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the potatoes out and soak in cold water to cool down. Cut into small chunks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up 2 teaspoons sunflower seed oil in wok, add doubanjiang (or other chili paste) to stir-fry until the oil turns to red. Add finely chopped garlic in to stir fry until aroma.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return cooked potatoes along with the leek sections. Do a quick fry to toss the sauce evenly on potatoes.

title: Beef Bourguignon
description: Deliciously tender BEEF BOURGUIGNON slow-cooked in a red wine sauce along with different flavorful veggies. This French beef recipe can be easily made at home for a special dinner or for an intimate occasion. Truly a must-try!

ingredients.name: - 3 pounds (1133.98g-1360.77g) boneless beef chuck (, trimmed and cut into chunks)
3-4 carrots (, sliced or cut in chunks)
- 2 teaspoons (2g-4g) beef bouillon (, cubes or powder)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat dry the beef with a paper towel, lightly season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle flour on the beef and mix. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chopped bacon to a large Dutch oven or pot. Sauté the bacon over medium heat for about 6-7 minutes until crisp and browned. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and place bacon on a plate for later use. Drain excess bacon fat from the pan and leave about1-2 tablespoons in the pan. Add more oil if you do not have enough bacon fat left.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the beef, in batches, in the same pot as the bacon fat and sauté until browned on both sides- 2-3 minutes. Remove beef from the pan and place it with the bacon.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add more oil or bacon fat in the pot, as needed (1-2 Tablespoons more). Then add onions, thyme, garlic, and bay leaves. Sauté for 3-4 minutes or until onions are slightly translucent. Throw in the mushrooms and continue cooking for about 5 more minutes. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Throw in celery and carrots and saute for about 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Deglaze the pan by pouring in the red wine, beef stock, and water in the pan. Scrape the sides of the pan, using a wooden spoon. Add the tomato paste and stir until fully incorporated.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Return the beef and mushroom mixture back to the pot. Bring to boil, add beef bouillon or cubes (if desired), and lightly season with salt and pepper. Cover the pot and transfer to the lower part of the oven and simmer for 1 ½ -2 hours or until the meat is tender. Adjust cooking times to desired preference beef tenderness.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: While you cook, be sure to check on the pot if it has enough liquid. Add more water as needed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the beef is ready, taste and adjust seasonings accordingly with more salt and or pepper.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: If using pearl onions, sauté for about 3-5 minutes and place on top of the bourguignon together with reserved bacon.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Garnish with parsley and served with mashed potatoes or noodles. Enjoy!

title: Chinese Braised Daikon Radish
description: Make a comforting and healthy one-pot dinner with daikon radish and a protein of your choice! {paleo, gluten-free}

ingredients.name: (450 grams) ground meat ((beef, pork, chicken, or turkey))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a medium-size dutch oven (or heavy duty pot) over medium heat until hot. Add a tablespoon of oil. Add green onion and ginger. Cook for a minute to release the flavor.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add ground meat. Cook and stir until surface turns brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the doubanjiang. Cook and stir until the meat is evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the radish. Cook and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add Shaoxing wine, chicken stock, soy sauce, sugar, and five spice powder. Cook over medium high heat until brought to a boil. Turn to medium low heat. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the radish turns tender. Add salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with steamed rice or by itself.

title: Haemul Pajeon (Seafood Scallion Pancake)
description: Crispy delicious Korean scallion pancakes with seafood!

ingredients.name: 1-1/2 to 2 cups assortment of seafood (squid, shrimp, mussels, oysters, clams, etc., cut into bite sizes)
Korean pancake mix, buchim garu, 부침가루 ((or all purpose flour or gluten free flour with 1/2 teaspoon salt - See note))
pinch of gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the seafood, scallions and optional pepper, draining excess water. (Wet ingredients will make pajeon soggy.) Cut the scallions in half crosswise. Cut the white part of the scallions lengthwise if thick. Mix the seafood with the sesame oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix the pancake mix with 3/4 cup icy cold water. You may need a couple more tablespoons but add one tablespoon at a time. The batter should be thinner than a Western breakfast pancake batter and thicker than a crepe batter. (For a crispy pajeon, the batter should be relatively thin.) Mix in 1/2 of the seafood.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat 3 to 4 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a non-stick pan over medium high heat, ladle 1/2 of the mixture into the pan and spread it evenly into a thin round shape.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange the scallions in a single layer on top of the batter, pressing them down into the batter. Add 1/2 of the remaining seafood and a few slices of the optional pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spoon one half of the optional lightly beaten egg on top. Cook until the bottom is golden brown (3-4 minutes). Reduce the heat to medium if the pancake is browning too fast.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn it over, adding more oil (2 to 3 tablespoons) around the edges. Cook for another 3-4 minutes. Repeat the process with the remaining batter and ingredients. Serve hot off the pan with dipping sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Optional method

title: Mackerel Fried Rice "Salad" ข้าวคลุกปลาทู
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Short mackerels or use 2 regular mackerel filets
Half a sour green mango, shredded
Thai chilies, finely chopped, to taste
thinly sliced shallots, or to taste
Chopped green onion, optional, to taste
fish sauce (you can also use soy sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sear the fish: In a wok, add a generous amount of oil and heat until hot over medium high heat. Place the mackerel down (if using filets, skin side down) and let it sear until the skin is browned and crispy. Flip and repeat on the other side. Remove the fish from pan and let cool until you can handle them (keep the oil!).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once the fish is cool enough, debone and tear the meat into chunks. If using Thai short mackerel, be very careful with bones as there are many little ones (watch the video for how to systematically debone it so you don't miss any!).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To make the fried rice: Using the same oil that you used to fry the fish, pour out any excess until you've got just about 1 - 1.5 Tbsp in the pan. Add chopped garlic and saute over medium heat until it starts to turn golden. Add the rice and toss with the garlic. Add the fish sauce, sugar, and continue to toss until there are no more lumps, and the rice is well coated in the oil and seasoning. **Note I forgot to mention in the video: Different mackerels have different levels of saltiness, especially ones in Thailand, so taste your mackerel first and if it's not very salty, you may need to add more fish sauce (and a little extra sugar to balance) to your rice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assemble: Place the rice down in the middle of a plate, and arrange all salad ingredients around the rice (you can put as much or as little of each ingredient as you wish). To eat, squeeze a little lime on top and toss everything together! To add a little extra seasoning, you may sprinkle a little extra soy sauce of fish sauce. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Steamed Scallops with vermicelli (How to Cook Scallops Part I)
description: Imported from chinasichuanfood.com.

ingredients.name: small bunch of bean vermicelli ( , around 30g)
middle size garlic cloves ( , finely chopped)
spring onions ( , white part and green part separated and finely chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, add 1 cup of boiling water and soak the vermicelli until soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove scallop meat from the shell, grasp with starch for several minutes and then wash in the running water to remove sands. If encounter any dirty bits, remove them. Place the meat in a middle bowl and marinade with cooking wine for around 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wash the shell carefully too with a brush.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place some water in wok and set up the steamer. Then place the shell one by one on the steamer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place a fitful amount of vermicelli on the shell firstly and then place the meat back to the shell one by one.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan and sauté garlic until aroma, add white part of chopped spring onions to stir fry for around 1 minute. Remove the pan off the fire and add soy sauce, salt and sesame oil. Mix well to make the garlic sauce oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Scoop the garlic sauce oil to top the prepared scallops along with chopped chili pepper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bring the water to a boiling and then continue to cook for 8 minutes. Transfer out and lay in serving plates. Garnish chopped spring onions on top.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Heat up around 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in pan until there are waves on the surface. Scoop the hot oil to pour on the steamed scallops. Serve hot!

title: Sopapilla Cheesecake
description: This sopapilla cheesecake is made from a light and airy crescent roll dough, a delicious cream cheese filling, and a cinnamon sugar topping.

ingredients.name: nonstick cooking spray or oil, (for greasing)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or grease with cooking oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the cinnamon sugar topping by mixing together the sugar and ground cinnamon in a small bowl. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the cream cheese, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt to a large mixing bowl. Using a hand or stand mixer, mix together all the ingredients until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Open one can of crescent roll dough and lay it into the prepared baking dish, making sure to stretch it to reach all the edges of baking dish. Pinch together the perforations of the dough with your fingers so that it's sealed and makes one solid sheet. Do the best you can - if there are still a few holes here and there, it's okay.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread the cream cheese mixture in an even layer on top of the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Open the second can of crescent roll dough, lay it out on a sheet of parchment paper and pinch together the perforations just like the first can of dough. Remove the dough from the parchment paper and place it on top of the cream cheese seam side down.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Brush the top with melted butter and sprinkle with prepared cinnamon sugar. Bake for about 30 minutes, until dough is golden and cooked through. Let cool and slice into 12 bars.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Shrimp Kabobs Recipe
description: Easy grilled shrimp kabobs, tossed up in a Mediterranean marinade with garlic and fresh herbs, then quickly grilled for a simple weeknight dinner or enjoy as an appetizer to feed a small crowd.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the marinade ingredients in a small bowl. Reserve 2 tbsp of the marinade in a separate bowl for later.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the shrimp dry and season with kosher salt. Place the shrimp in a large bowl and pour the marinade all over. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes (do not go longer).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Thread the shrimp on skewers, about 4 large shrimp per skewer. (If using bamboo skewers they need to be soaked in water for at least 30 minutes first).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To grill on an outdoor gas grill. Preheat a gas grill to high. Then, reduce heat to low (temperature should be somewhere between 275 to 325ºF). Carefully grease the cooking grates. Once the grill reaches the recommended temperature, add the shrimp skewers and close the lid. Cook shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until no longer translucent.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To grill on an indoor griddle or cast iron grill. Heat a dry griddle over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking. Add the shrimp skewers and cook on one side about 3 or 4 minutes. Turn shrimp over and cook another 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the grilled shrimp skewers to platter and spoon the remaining marinade your reserved earlier over the grilled shrimp skewers. Add a splash of lemon juice. Serve immediately.

title: Traditional Kourabiedes/Kourabiethes with Ouzo recipe
description: Our best recipe for Kourampiedes (Kourabiethes)! Traditionally made to celebrate Christmas, these butter cookies will definitely set you on a festive mood!

ingredients.name: cow milk butter, at room temperature (9 ounces)
almonds, whole or roughly chopped, with the peel (3.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven at 200C / 390F. Place the almonds whole or roughly chopped (depending on whether you prefer the cookies to have whole or chopped almonds inside) on a baking tray and sprinkle with some water. Bake them for 7-8 minutes, being careful not to burn them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use an electric mixer, to mix the butter and the icing sugar (100g/3.5 ounces), for about 20 minutes, until the butter is creamy and fluffy, like whipped cream. (It is very important that the butter is at room temperature.) Add the vanilla extract, the rose water and the ouzo and blend; add the baked almonds and blend again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl, blend the sifted flour and the baking powder. (It is very important to sift the flour, so that the cookies will become light and smooth.) Gradually add the flour into the butter mixture (from step 2) and work the mixture with your hands, until the ingredients are combined and the dough is soft and easy to work. You will need 450-500g of flour, depending on the flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200C; layer the bottom of 2 baking trays with parchment paper and form the kourampiedes. Roll 1-2 tbsps of the dough into a ball, place on the baking tray and push with your finger in the middle, to form a little dimple. Continue with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the baking trays with the kourampiedes in second and fourth grill of the oven and turn the heat down to 180C. Bake for approx. 20 minutes, until they have a very faint golden tint and are cooked through. Be careful not to overcook them. Leave them aside to cool down for a while. If you try to lift them, while still warm, they will break.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large bowl, add 500g/18 ounces of icing sugar and dip the kourampiedes (in batches) in the sugar, rolling them around, so that the sugar sticks on all sides. Place on one or two large platters. When done, sift the extra 500g/18 ounces icing sugar over the kourampiedes.

title: Bacon Pan Fried Noodles
description: Crispy bacon, hearty noodles soaked in a rich sauce, sweet and tender cabbage, and caramelized onion make this quick one-bowl meal irresistible!

ingredients.name: (140 grams) dried egg noodles ((or spaghetti), enough to generate about 3 cups cooked noodles)
Shaoxing wine ((or dry sherry, or chicken stock))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook the noodles according to the instructions, until al dente. Rinse with tap water to stop cooking. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a teaspoon of oil in a 12-inch skillet (*footnote 3) over medium heat and spread bacon slices. Cook until the extra grease renders and the bacon turns crispy. Flip occasionally. Transfer bacon onto a plate. Let cool before tearing into bite sized pieces. Transfer the bacon grease into a bowl and save for later. Wipe the skillet with a paper towel to remove the brown bits and return the skillet to the stove.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While boiling the noodles and cooking the bacon, cut the vegetables. Whisk every ingredient for the sauce in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the noodles and the bacon are ready, add 1 tablespoon of oil to the same skillet and turn to medium high heat. When the oil is hot, spread the noodles across the skillet. Use a pair of tongs to gently shake the noodles, so that they’re evenly coated with oil. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until the bottom side turns golden and crispy. Flip the noodles to cook the other side. Swirl in 1 tablespoon of oil along the edge of the pan. Swirl the pan and agitate the noodles with the tongs so that the bottom side coats with oil again. Cook until crispy, 2 to 3 minutes. If the skillet starts to smoke, turn to medium heat. Transfer noodles to a plate. Break up and separate noodles with a fork and a pair of tongs.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of the reserved bacon grease to the skillet for more delicious results (highly recommended). Alternatively, add 1 tablespoon vegetable oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add onion. Cook and stir until softened. Add cabbage. Stir and cook until the cabbage just starts to turn tender and is lightly charred. Add noodles back. Swirl in the sauce. Toss the noodles immediately with a pair of tongs. Add bacon. Continue tossing until the noodles are coated evenly with the sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer to a plate and serve immediately.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: A savory, hearty bowl of beef stew slowly cooked to perfection with the aroma of herbs, spices, and vegetables for an ideal one-pot meal. The perfect winter comfort food!

ingredients.name: bouillon powder, (beef, chicken, or vegetable (optional and adjust to taste))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season stew beef with salt and pepper, thoroughly covering all sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oil in an oven-safe Dutch oven pan over medium heat. Add stew beef and brown well, turning once, 2 -3 minutes per side or until beef browns. Do not overcrowd the pan, cooking in batches if necessary.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onions, ginger, garlic, thyme, smoked paprika, and bay leaf to the skillet. Stir for 2-3 minutes until onions are translucent.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add tomato paste and bouillon. Stir for another minute, then add water or broth to the skillet, scraping all sides. Bring to a boil, remove from heat, and pour into the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then throw the carrots, potatoes, mushrooms, and peas into the slow cooker and salt according to preference.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or low for 6-7 hours.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove, garnish with parsley, and serve with bread.

title: Masoor Dal Recipe (Easy Red Lentil Dal)
description: Masoor Dal is a spiced lentil dish prepared with hulled and split red lentils simmered with onions, tomatoes, herbs and spices. The lentils cook to a soft and creamy consistency.

ingredients.name: to 1.75 cups water (for pressure cooking dal)
to 3 garlic cloves ((small to medium-sized), crushed or finely chopped)
to 2 or ½ to 1 teaspoon green chillies (– chopped or slit)
to 2 dry red chilies (– broken and seeds removed, optional)
or ½ teaspoon red chili powder (or cayenne pepper)
or ½ teaspoon garam masala ((homemade garam masala powder can be just ¼ teaspoon))
to 1.5 cups water ( or add as required)
dry fenugreek leaves (– crushed (kasuri methi), optional)
or 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( or according to taste)
coriander leaves (– chopped for garnish, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cooking Lentils

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making onion-tomato masala

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Making Masoor Dal

title: Kung Pao Cauliflower
description: Kung Pao Cauliflower, vegan cauliflower stir-fry recipe with Chinese Kung Pao Sauce.

ingredients.name: of cauliflower head cut into small floret pieces
Chinese large onion ( , cut into 2cm sections)
~5 dried chili peppers ( , cut into small pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut cauliflower into smaller floret pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix all the ingredient for stir fry sauce and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dry-frying the cauliflower: add a very small amount of oil to a wok and then fry the cauliflower for around 2 minutes until it becomes soft. You need to keep stirring to make sure that the cauliflower is evenly cooked.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in a pan and fry ginger, garlic, Sichuan peppercorn, and dried chili pepper until aromatic. With slow fire.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then place the cauliflower in. Fry for another half minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add large scallions and toasted peanuts. Give everything a big stir fry and then serve immediately.

title: Mak Kimchi (Easy Kimchi)
description: Good authentic homemade kimchi is much easier than you think. Cut up the cabbage, salt, rinse, and mix with the seasoning! That's what this easy kimchi recipe is about.

ingredients.name: medium size napa cabbages (about 4 pounds each) (about 8 pounds)
1-1/4 cups coarse sea salt (less if using finer salt)
small Korean radish (mu) - about 1.5 pounds (Use more cabbage by the same amount if not using radish)
airtight containers (or jar(s) - about 1.5 gallons total)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the cabbage heads lengthwise into quarters and remove the core from each quarter. Cut each quarter crosswise into bite sizes (about 1.5-inches).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cabbage pieces in a large bowl(s). In a smaller bowl, dissolve 1-1/4 cups of salt in 6 cups of water. Pour over the cabbage. Toss well to wet the cabbage pieces evenly with the salt water. Let stand until the white parts are bendable, about 2 hours, turning the cabbage pieces over occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the radish into bite sizes (about 1.5-inch square, about 1/4-inch thick). Sprinkle with a tablespoon of salt. Toss well. Let it sit for about 30 minutes. Drain. Do not wash.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the chili pepper flakes with the remaining seasoning ingredients along with 1 cup of water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Rinse the salted cabbage three times and drain to remove excess water.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the radish, scallions and seasoning to the salted cabbage. Using a kitchen glove, mix everything well by hand until the cabbage pieces are well coated with the seasoning mix. Place the kimchi in an airtight container(s) or a jar(s).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Rinse the bowl with 1/2 cup of water by swirling around, and pour over the kimchi. Press it down to remove air pockets.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Leave the kimchi out at room temperature for a day to two depending on how quickly you want your kimchi to ferment. Then, refrigerate.

title: American Fried Rice ข้าวผัดอเมริกัน
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: peas or diced sugar snap peas
Cocktail wieners, hot dogs, and/or ham, as many as you like (see video @3:04 for how to the cut hot dogs. If using long hot dogs, cut them first into 2-inch pieces)
Fresh tomatoes and cucumber slices for serving
chicken drumsticks (drumsticks are what we always use, but feel free to use other cuts you prefer)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the Fried Chicken: Place chicken, fish sauce, soy sauce, water and white pepper in a zip-top bag and squeeze out as much air as possible. Marinate chicken for 30 minutes and up to overnight, flipping the bag halfway through. If only marinating for 30 minutes, leave the chicken at room temperature. If marinating for longer than 30 minutes, put in the refrigerator but pull it out 30 minutes before frying so the chicken isn't super cold when you fry.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If you want to keep the fried chicken hot while you fry your rice, preheat the oven to 200°F/95°C and you can hold the chicken there once they are fried.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To fry, heat enough oil in a pot to completely cover the chicken (about 2 inches) and bring it to 350°F/175°C. While the oil is heating, transfer the chicken into a mixing bowl and add the cornstarch and flour. Toss until you have a smooth, thin batter, adding more flour if you'd like a thicker coating. When the oil is hot, add the chicken to the oil (don't crowd the pot) and then maintain the frying temperature at about 325°F/165°C. Fry for 8-9 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the chicken is frying, make sunny side up eggs, 1 per person.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For the hot dogs: Once the chicken is done, turn off the heat and immediately drop the hot dogs into the still-hot oil and fry for about 10 seconds just until they "bloom." Drain on some paper towel. If you're not frying chicken and you don't want to heat the oil just for the hot dogs, just heat the hot dogs up however you like: blanch, bake, grill or pan fry.

title: Rajas con Crema
description: Rajas con Crema is an easy Mexican dish that combines roasted poblano peppers with onions, Mexican cream, and melted cheese.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place poblano peppers on top. Set your oven rack directly underneath the broiler and turn the broiler on high.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Broil poblanos in the oven for 5 minutes, or until the skin is blackened and blistered. Carefully flip them over and broil for another 5 minutes, or until the skin is blackened and blistered on all sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove them from the oven, loosely cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil or plastic wrap to keep in some of the heat to help them steam, and let them sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pull and rub off as much of the loose skin on the peppers as possible. It doesn't have to be perfect. (View some step-by-step photos on how to roast poblano peppers.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer poblanos to a cutting board, discard the stems and seeds. Cut poblanos into strips and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions and cook for 5 minutes, until softened and translucent.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add roasted poblano pepper strips, Mexican crema, and salt. Stir together to combine and cook for 2 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add shredded cheese and stir together until the cheese completely melts. Remove from heat and serve immediately in warm tortillas or with tortilla chips.

title: Mosaiko recipe (Greek Chocolate and Biscuits Dessert)
description: For all the chocolate lovers..A mouthwatering all-weather Greek chocolate and biscuits dessert (Mosaiko)! Soft, creamy and with a crunchy bite.. And best of all? Ready in 10 minutes!

ingredients.name: eggs extra fresh, free range eggs (separated into whites and yolks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the mosaiko, separate the eggs into whites and yolks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the egg whites, a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar in the mixer’s bowl. Make sure your egg whites, bowl and whisk attachments are clean and free of any water. Whisk the egg whites until white and foamy. Add 35g icing sugar and whisk until the mixture is very thick and glossy and a long trailing peak forms when the whisk is lifted (meringues). You can use either pasteurised eggs or pasteurise them before using them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime melt the butter. Pour the melted butter into a large bowl, add the icing sugar, the cocoa powder, the vanilla extract and whisk to combine. Add the egg yolks and whisk. Add the meringues and blend with light circular movements. At the end add the crushed biscuits and mix.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the mixture on a rectangular baking cake tin lined with some cling film. Shape the mixture into a long strip, then take the cling film out and roll the edges together to form into a sausage. Place in the fridge or the freezer for 1-2 hours until set.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the form upside down onto a platter; remove the plastic wrap and serve the mosaiko in slices with some vanilla ice cream. Store in the fridge.

title: Green Moong Dal (Green Gram Curry)
description: Green Moong Dal is a wholesome Indian curry made with soaked whole green gram (sabut moong) cooked in an onion-tomato masala and pressure cooked until tender.

ingredients.name: moong beans ((whole and with husks) - soaked in water for an hour or two hours or overnight)

steps.description: Preparation

steps.description: Tempering for green gram curry (optional step)

title: Real-Deal Moo Shu Pork (木犀肉)
description: The tender pork, crisp vegetables, crunchy mushrooms, and creamy eggs are brought together by a simple chicken-stock-based sauce, creating a simple and earthy stir fry with great texture and nutrition.

ingredients.name: A small pinch of dried wood ear mushrooms (black fungus (yields 1 cup after rehydration))
A small handful of dried lily flowers (yields 1/2 cup after rehydration) ((Optional))
(130 grams) pork tenderloin ((1/4 of a whole tenderloin))
white onion (, sliced (or 2 green onions, chopped))
seedless cucumber (, sliced into diamond shape)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add dried wood ear mushrooms into a small bowl and hot water to cover. Add dried lily flowers into another small bowl and hot water to cover. Rehydrate for 20 to 30 minutes, or until ingredients turn tender. Check after 10 minutes to make sure the water still covers all the ingredients. If the water gets cold, change to another batch of hot water. Gently rub with hands and rinse to remove the dirt. Remove tough ends of the mushrooms and flowers. Drain and place in a small bowl. It is OK if the ingredients are still a bit wet.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice pork against the grain into bite-sized pieces, as thinly as possible.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine pork, Shaoxing wine, salt, and white pepper. Gently mix by hand so that the seasonings coat the meat evenly without tearing the meat apart. Add cornstarch. Continue to mix with hand until the it forms a thin paste that evenly coats the pork. Marinate for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In another small bowl, combine chicken stock, light soy sauce, Chinkiang vinegar, salt (if using), sesame oil, and cornstarch. Mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a wok over high heat until hot. Add 2 tablespoons oil and swirl the wok so that the oil coats the bottom (*footnote 2). When the oil just starts to smoke, spread the pork in the oil. Cook without moving for 20 to 30 seconds, until the bottom side turns golden. Flip and cook until the surface just turns white but the inside is still pink. You don’t want to stir too much here, since it might break the pork pieces. Scoop the pork with a spatula and let the oil drip back into the wok. Transfer pork to a plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: You should still have about 1 tablespoon oil in the wok. If not, add more oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add egg. Cook a few seconds to allow the bottom to set. Stir a few times until the eggs are just cooked. Transfer eggs to the same plate as the pork.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add a teaspoon of oil and the onion (or green onion) and ginger. Stir until the herbs become fragrant. Add rehydrated wood ear mushrooms and lily flowers. Stir to mix well with the oil. Swirl in the sauce. Cook until the sauce thickens. Return pork, egg, and cucumber to the wok. Stir to mix everything well. Turn to low heat. Carefully try a piece of pork with a piece of vegetable. Adjust seasoning by sprinkling a bit salt and stir well, if needed. Transfer to a serving plate.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve immediately over steamed rice.

title: Chinese steamed pork
description: Simple and Easy Chinese Steamed Pork

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add chopped lotus root, carrots, cornstarch, and all the other seasonings in a bowl. Continue stirring in one directly until the pork turns light in color and quite sticky in texture.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer all the pork to a plate. A flat plate is preferred.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Flatten the meat cake. Dig a hole in the center and place the salted duck egg yolk or a fresh egg. I use fresh egg this time. Steam for around 15 minutes to 20 minutes depending on the thickness of your meat cake.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the mixture to steaming bowls. Flatten carefully.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dig a small hole in the center to hold the yolk; Steam for around 15 to 20 minutes depending on the thickness of your meat cake.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle some chopped green onion on top and serve hot.

title: Pressure Cooker Dak Bokkeumtang (Korean Spicy Chicken Stew)
description: Classic Korean chicken dish that’s adapted for the pressure cooker! You’ll love how quick this juicy, flavorful dish is.

ingredients.name: bone-in chicken parts (cut into small pieces (excess fat removed))
potatoes (cut in big chunks (or mini potatoes))
small carrots (cut in big chunks (or baby carrots))
scallions or a few stalks of garlic chives

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the sauce ingredients except sesame oil and seeds, and mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the chicken pieces, drain, and pat dry with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Press the “Saute” button on the Instant Pot. When the pot is hot, add 1 tablespoon of canola or vegetable oil. Sear the pieces in two batches.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place all the chicken pieces in the pot, and add the potatoes, onion, and carrots. Pour the sauce over, and mix well to evenly coat the chicken and vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Close the lid tightly, and seal the vent. Press the “poultry” function, and using the “+” or “-” button, adjust the time to 10 minutes. When finished, the Instant Pot will automatically turn to the “Keep Warm” mode. Turn the pressure valve to “venting” to quickly release the pressure. Open the lid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the scallion (or garlic chives) and the sesame oil and sesame seeds. If you want, remove the meat and vegetables from the pressure cooker, turn the Instant Pot Saute function back on, and reduce the sauce to the desired level with the lid open.

title: Chiles en Nogada
description: Chiles en nogada is a traditional Mexican dish made of stuffed poblano peppers with a sweet and savory meat filling and walnut-cream sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the nogada sauce. Boil the water in a small pot over high heat. Add the walnuts, cover, and soak for 5 minutes to loosen the skin.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using your fingers or a paring knife, carefully remove the papery walnut skin off each walnut and place the peeled, skinless walnuts in a bowl. This is a very tedious process and takes patience, but it's an important step to ensure the sauce doesn't come out bitter.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the skinned walnuts, goat cheese, queso fresco, milk, Mexican crema, ground cinnamon, and sugar to a blender. Blend for 5 minutes until completely smooth. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the filling. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the ground beef and ground pork. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking up the meat into small pieces as it cooks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the tomato sauce, golden raisins, dried pineapple, salt, black pepper, ground cloves, and ground cinnamon. Cook uncovered for about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the excess moisture is cooked out.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Reduce the heat to low and stir in the pear, apple, peach, plantain, and slivered almonds. Cover and cook for about 15-20 minutes, until the fruit is tender and cooked through. Set aside to cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Prepare the poblanos. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil and place the poblano peppers on top. Set your oven rack directly underneath the broiler and turn the broiler on.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Broil the poblanos for 5 minutes or until the skin is blackened and blistered. Carefully flip them over and broil for another 5 minutes or until the skin is blackened and blistered.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove them from the oven and loosely cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil or plastic wrap to keep in some of the heat and help them steam. Let them sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Peel and rub off as much of the loose skin on the peppers as possible. It doesn't have to be perfect; just as much as you can.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cut a small slit down the middle of the peppers with a knife. Carefully scoop out and discard the seeds using a spoon.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Assemble the Chiles en Nogada. Carefully stuff the peppers with the picadillo filling. Some of the peppers will be extra fragile because of the roasting process and may tear – that's okay. Just do the best you can. The peppers do not need to fully close, so stuff them as much as you can. parsley.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Garnish and serve. Drizzle the nogada sauce over the peppers and garnish with pomegranate seeds, chopped parsley, and a sprinkle of flaky sea salt. Serve immediately.

title: Lychee Fried Rice w/ Chinese BBQ Pork ข้าวผัดลิ้นจี่หมูแดง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: lychees, if using fresh, remove seeds, if using canned, drain and rinse
lime juice or lemon juice, plus more lime wedges for serving
black soy sauce or dark soy sauce
Chinese BBQ pork (char siu), bite-sized pieces (see note)
pork loin or tenderloin, bite-sized pieces
black soy sauce or dark soy sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If marinating pork, make combine all ingredients in a bowl, stir well to mix, making sure no pieces of pork are stuck together. Let sit for 10 minutes while you prep other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Tear lychees into 3-4 pieces per lychee and place in a bowl. Add 1 Tbsp of lime juice or lemon juice, stir to coat and let sit while you prep other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine soy sauce, Golden Mountain Sauce and black soy sauce into a small bowl. In another small bowl, combine white pepper, five spice powder, and sugar.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a wok, add a little oil to coat the bottom of the pan. Add garlic and saute briefly over medium heat until the smallest pieces of garlic starts to turn golden. Add BBQ pork and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Push pork to one side and add eggs to the space. Break the yolks, then put the pork on top of the eggs. Let the eggs set about half way, then scramble briefly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add rice and toss briefly to mix it with the eggs and pork. Turn the heat up to high, add the sauce and dry spice mixture and toss until there are no more lumps of rice, and all the grains are evenly coated by the sauce. You can also let the rice sit on the pan and get a bit toasty if you like.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the rice is hot and well coated by the sauce, add cashews and the lychees LEAVING BEHIND THE LIME JUICE that the lychees are sitting in. Toss for another 20-30 seconds to heat up the lychees and cashews. Turn the heat off and stir in green onions.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish with extra cashews and green onions if desired, and serve with a wedge of lime and cucumber slices.

title: Eggplant Rollatini Recipe
description: All-star, easy eggplant rollatini recipe, made with a lighter cheese filling, basil pesto and fresh parsley.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO )
basil pesto (homemade or store-bought, more for later)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice eggplants length-wise into 1/4-inch thin slices (it's easier to do this using a mandolin slicer like this one. affiliate link) You should have about 12 slices of similar size (reserve end pieces that are shorter or odd-shaped for another use).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sprinkle eggplant slices with salt and set aside on paper towel for 20 minutes. This will help the eggplant sweat out any bitterness. Pat dry. Rinse with water, then dry again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Brush a large baking sheet with extra virgin olive oil. Arrange eggplant slices in one layer on baking sheet. Brush the tops of the eggplant slices with more extra virgin olive oil. Bake in heated oven for 8 minutes or so until soft enough to fold (do not overcook.) Remove from oven and set aside briefly to cool. (Leave the oven on for the rollatini)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, prepare the filling. In a bowl, add eggs, ricotta, Mozzarella, grated Parmesan, basil pesto, and fresh parsley. Mix until well-combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Spread about 3/4 cup marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9 1/2" x 13" baking dish.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Spoon about 2 tbsp of the filling onto one end of each eggplant slice, and spread. Starting from the short end, roll up eggplant slices tightly and arranged on prepared baking dish.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Top eggplant rollatini with the remainder of the marinara sauce, more basil pesto, and a sprinkle of mozzarella. Bake in heated oven for 30 minutes or until the eggplant rollatini are fully cooked and tender.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove from oven and let sit for 10 minutes or so before serving.

title: Melomakarona recipe (Greek Christmas Honey Cookies)
description: A traditional melomakarona recipe! These Greek Christmas honey cookies (melomakarona) are super quick to bake, so much fun to make and highly addictive!

ingredients.name: fine semolina (5.3 ounces, half a cup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this melomakarona recipe start by making the syrup first. In a pot add all the ingredients for the syrup, besides the honey and bring to the boil. Boil for 3-4 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved and remove from the stove. Stir in the honey and set aside to cool completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the dough for the melomakarona. In a bowl add the semolina, flour and baking powder and mix with a whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another large bowl add the orange juice, the cognac, the sugar and spices (nutmeg, cinnamon, clove, vanilla) and mix. Add the baking soda and whisk immediately for 5-10 seconds until the ingredients combine and the baking soda dissolves and starts to foam. Pour in the bowl the water, the oil, the orange zest and honey and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now it’s time to combine the two mixtures. Add the mixed flour, semolina and baking powder (from step 2) in the bowl with the rest of the ingredients from step 3 and start kneading the dough for the melomakarona. Knead the dough for the melomakarona using your hands, until the ingredients combine and the dough is smooth and soft and slightly sticky. Be careful not to overwork the dough as they will become tough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: . Layer the bottom of 4 large baking trays with parchment paper and start shaping the melomakarona. Pinch a portion of dough about the size of a walnut – 30g / 1oz and shape with your palms into a smooth oblong shape, like a small egg. Place on the baking tray, push lightly the top with a fork and pierce three times on top about half way through the dough. Continue with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Depending on how large on oven you have when your first two trays are ready you can start baking them. Place the baking trays with the melomakarona in the oven and bake for approx. 15-20 minutes, until the melomakarona are lightly and evenly browned and cooked through. If you’ve made them bigger, you’ll need to bump up the cooking time!!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the melomakarona come out of the oven, dip them immediately in the cold syrup, flipping them with a slotted spoon to absorb the syrup for approx. 10-20 seconds, depending on how syrupy you like them. Remove the cookies using a slotted spoon, place on a platter and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: While you are dipping your first couple of tray in the syrup add the next two in the oven to bake. Don’t forget to set your timer!!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Store the melomakarona at room temperature in an airtight container. They will keep for all your Christmas Holidays!

title: Carne Asada
description: Carne Asada - amazingly juicy and tender grilled skirt steak soaked in a flavor-packed marinade full of Mexican flavors. Best served as stuffings for tacos, burritos, and more just in time for Cinco de Mayo.

title: Loaded Lebanese Rice: Hashweh
description: This Lebanese rice pilaf called hashweh is not your ordinary rice. Loaded with lean ground beef, toasted nuts, raisins. Seasoned to perfection! See step-by-step photos below the recipe

ingredients.name: lean ground beef or lean ground lamb

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the rice in cold water for 15 minutes or until you are easily able to break one grain of rice between your thumb and index fingers. When ready, drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a heavy cooking pot. Add chopped red onions, cook on medium-high heat briefly, then add the ground beef. Season the meat mixture with 1 1/4 tsp allspice, minced garlic, 1/2 tsp ground cloves, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, salt and pepper. Toss together to combine. Cook until the meat is fully browned (8-10 minutes). Drain.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn heat to high and bring the liquid to a rolling boil. Let boil until the liquid has significantly reduced (see picture below).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now turn heat to low and cover; let cook for 20 minutes or until moisture has completely been absorbed and the rice is no longer hard nor sticky. Remove from heat and set aside for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Uncover the rice pot and place a large round serving platter on the opening of the rice pot. Carefully flip the pot contents onto the platter so that the meat layer now tops the rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with parsley, toasted pine nuts, almonds and raisins. Enjoy.

title: Extra Melty Fried Cheese Ball recipe! (Tirokroketes)
description: Get the party started with these amazing Greek-style fried cheese ball recipe! Melty on the inside and with a wonderful golden brown crust on the outside! Have a bite and let the juices flow in your mouth.

ingredients.name: Mature Cheddar cheese, Regato or Graviera (3.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these delicious fried cheese ball recipe, add all the ingredients into a medium bowl, season well with freshly ground pepper and blend to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 45 minutes. This will help the mixture for the cheese balls to firm up a bit and make it easier to roll into balls.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Form the mixture into little cheese balls (this mixture is enough for 14-15 cheese balls) and dredge in some flour shaking off any excess.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry the cheese balls in a non-sticking pan with plenty of oil, until nicely colored. Place the fried cheese balls on some kitchen paper to absorb the extra oil. (Tips: Heat the oil until very hot and fry them in batches. If the surface of the pan is overcrowded then the temperature of the oil will decrease and your cheese balls will not be crispy any more!)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the cheese balls while still hot with a squeeze of a lemon. Enjoy!

title: Braised Lamb Shanks
description: Braised Lamb Shanks - fall-off-the-bone tender lamb shanks oven-braised in a rich, deeply flavored red wine sauce. A restaurant-quality family dinner at a fraction of the cost you'd pay at expensive restaurants.

ingredients.name: large celery stalk (, chopped (about ½ cup) )
(235ml) dry red wine (, substitute with extra beef broth)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven at 350 F. Season shanks with salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large cast iron or dutch oven, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Sear the shanks in the hot oil, turning to brown all sides. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onion, carrot, and celery to the same pan and cook, stirring frequently until onions are wilted and lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in garlic, thyme, rosemary, bay leaf and tomato paste and continue cooking for about a minute or 2.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in wine and stock, followed by worcestershire sauce and bouillon powder. Lightly season with salt and pepper. Remember you can adjust salt as you go halfway through cooking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return lamb shanks back to the pot, bring to a boil, then cover with lid and place in the oven. Allow to braise slowly for 2-3 hours until the lamb is soft and succulent. Check on the lamb shanks once or twice adding more stock, if needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn oven off, remove and serve.

title: Instant Pot Oxtail Soup
description: Preparing this hassle-free hearty INSTANT POT OXTAIL SOUP has never been easier. You’ll definitely fall in love with the tender meaty chunks in glorious harmony with the flavorful sauce and veggies.

ingredients.name: 2-3 pounds (907.18g-1360.77g) oxtail (, cut up to medium pieces)
(2g) curry powder or more (, adjust to preference)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season oxtail with salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Press the “Sauté” function on your instant pot. Heat oil and brown the oxtail. You can do so in batches. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onions, garlic, thyme, green onions and stir for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add smoked paprika, all spice, curry powder, bouillon powder, scotch bonnet pepper, tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce. Stir for a minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in the water and thoroughly deglaze the instant pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the browned oxtail, potatoes, and carrots in layers. (see note 1)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Close the Instant pot and set the knob to seal.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pressure cook on high for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let it release pressure naturally for 10 minutes. And then manually release the rest of the pressure.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: When the valve drops, open the instant pot and set it to sauté mode. Let the soup thicken to the desired consistency and adjust seasoning. You may adjust the thickness of the soup with water or stock.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve with rice or bread.

title: Sundubu Ramyun
description: Elevate your instant ramyun noodles with sundubu (extra soft tofu)! It gives a bit of sundubu stew taste, while making it a healthier dish.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the sesame oil, garlic and 1/2 of the ramyun seasoning mix and optional gochugaru to a small pot and mix well over medium heat for a few seconds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 1 cup of water. Turn the heat up to medium high. When water boils, add the sundubu in big chunks, and bring it to a boil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drop the noodles in, and then add 1/2 packet of the vegetable flakes. Continue to boil until the noodles are almost cooked, about 3 minutes. The noodles should be al dente at this point.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Crack an egg straight over the noodles. You can break the egg yolk and stir into the soup if you want. Turn the heat off, and drop the scallion in, and sprinkle with pepper to taste.

title: Century Egg Salad (Pidan Salad)
description: Chinese Century Egg Salad (Pidan Salad) with green peppers and red peppers.

ingredients.name: tsp. salt ( , or more to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the century eggs and then cut into wedges. Place them in serving plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat around 1 tablespoon of vegetable cooking oil in pan and fry chopped green peppers and garlic until soft and aromatic.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the fried chili peppers to serving plate. Add sesame oil, light soy sauce and salt. Mix before enjoying.

title: Tom Yum Spaghetti สปาเก็ตตี้ต้มยำกุ้ง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: stalk lemongrass, bottom half only, thinly sliced
good quality whole peeled plum tomatoes (half of a 28oz/796ml can)
12-15 medium shrimp, or as many as you’d like
Chopped cilantro, as much as you want

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for your pasta. Add salt, about 1 tsp per one liter of water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound together lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves and Thai chilies until there are no more big chunks. It should resemble a fine crumble.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok or a large sauté pan, cook off the shrimp just until they’re done. Remove and set aside; do not clean the wok.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drop your spaghetti into the boiling water, set the timer for 1 minute LESS than the cooking time indicated on the package. Immediately start cooking your sauce once your pasta is dropped. (With this timing, your sauce should be done before the pasta is done. But if it is not, not a problem, just drain the pasta and set it aside until ready to use.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the same wok, saute onion over medium heat for a couple of minutes until they’re translucent.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the mushrooms and a little splash of fish sauce, then cook for a minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add herbs paste and quickly toss it in the oil, then add the tomatoes. Break up the tomatoes with your spatula into small chunks.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add chili paste and fish sauce, and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce is thickened.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: If the pasta is not yet done, just turn off the heat and wait for the pasta.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the spaghetti is done, add it to the sauce—I like to use tongs and add move the pasta directly from the pot to the wok, no need to drain in the colander (less dishes to do!). This way you also get more of the starchy pasta water transferred into the sauce, which helps thicken the sauce slightly. If you’re going to drain the pasta, be sure to save a cup of pasta water in case you need it.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add shrimp back in and and toss everything in the sauce for 1 more minute, adding more pasta water if you need more liquid. You can make this as dry or as saucy as you like. I prefer it on the dryer side.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Off the heat, then stir in lime juice and cilantro. Taste and adjust with more lime juice/fish sauce as needed.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve with grated parmesan if desired.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Watermelon Agua Fresca
description: Watermelon agua fresca (or agua de sandia in Spanish) is a bright and refreshing Mexican drink made from watermelon, water, and sugar!

ingredients.name: limes wedges and mint sprigs, (for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the watermelon, cold water, and ½ of the sugar to a large blender. Blend until completely smooth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Taste and add the remaining sugar if needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve immediately over ice or chill in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Garnish with lime wedges and mint sprigs if desired.

title: Italian Rice Casserole Recipe with Chicken Sausage
description: This rice casserole recipe is a asy way to get your fix of the comforting flavors of the popular Sicilian rice balls (aracini). And it's the perfect casserole to make ahead and refrigerate or freeze for later if you need to.

ingredients.name: sweet Italian chicken sausage, casings removed
store-bought marinara sauce, (plus more for serving (optional))
seasoned bread crumbs, (regular or gluten free)
chopped fresh parsley or basil for garnish, ((optional) )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the rice with the salt according to the package directions. Set aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a larger nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up into small pieces with a wooden spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes (I found adding a little extra virgin olive oil to the pan helped). Stir in the onions and cook until browned, 4 to 5 minutes more. Add the peas and 1 cup marinara sauce. Reduce the heat to low and cover. Cook until the flavors meld, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, Pecorino, eggs, and 1/2 cup marinara sauce and mix well. (The mixture should be a bit sticky).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Brush or spray the bottom and sides of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with extra virgin olive oil. Add 2 tablespoons bread crumbs to the dish and roll around to coat the bottom and sides.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Take half the rice mixture (or a little more if needed) and cover the bottom and sides of the dish, pressing the rice down to form an even bottom layer. Add the sausage-pea mixture and spread in one layer. Top with 3/4 cup mozzarella. Cover with the remaining rice mixture, press until even. Top with the remaining 1/2 cup marinara, 2 tablespoons read crumbs, and 1/2 cup mozzarella.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cover with foil and bake until hot, about 30 minutes. Garnish with parsley or basil. Cut into 8 pieces and serve with more marinara, if you like.

title: Flaky Homemade Biscuits
description: Flaky Homemade Biscuits - easy homemade buttermilk biscuits that are buttery, soft with beautiful flaky years all made completely from scratch using just a few simple ingredients.

ingredients.name: (500g) all-purpose flour (, plus more for dusting )
(227g) unsalted butter (, 2 sticks, cubed, very cold )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, shift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar and salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Quickly grate frozen butter on into the bowl of flour – grated butter ensures the fat is evenly distributed throughout the dough, making it light and fluffy. Alternatively, quickly cut butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs or just use your hands. this might take about 5 minutes. Your flour should be crumbly with pea-size chunks. Let the bowl rest in the fridge, if there is any wait time in between.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make a well in the center of the bowl, add buttermilk or milk and stir until it barely comes together, DO NOT OVER MIX. ( Just trying to make sure you get those flakes.) Let it rest in the fridge for about 10 minutes while you prepare your surface.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sprinkle flour onto a board or clean surface. Remove dough from the fridge and place on the board; knead about 3-4 times - just enough for it to come together. You will still see flakes of butter in the dough. Again, do not overmix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Gently, gently pat the dough with hands or roll it out with a rolling pin, about 1/2″ thick.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fold the dough - repeating the folding process about 6-8 times. This ensures flakiness. Go easy on the rolling process. After folding is complete gently press the dough down to a 1 inch thick, ready to be cut out.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Use a 2 or 3-inch round cookie cutter, or a rim of a glass to cut out the biscuits, firmly push it straight down, then pull up. Use your fingers to gently loosen the dough from the cutter and space them out equally across your prepared baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Knead any leftover scraps of dough together and repeat until all of the dough is used up. It might not look as pretty as the others, however, it will pass the test. Pinky promise.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Lightly brush with buttermilk or cream.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes or until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Remove and serve warm with butter (or check out my homemade garlic butter), honey or collard greens.

title: Easy Fried Noodles (20-Minute)
description: My easy fried noodles make a quick, comforting meal with chewy noodles, crisp bok choy, savory Chinese sausage, and soft scrambled eggs. Everything comes together in under 20 minutes for a satisfying dish that’s simple yet full of flavor.

ingredients.name: eggs (, beaten with a pinch of salt)
scallions (, sliced, white and green parts separated)
Sesame oil ((or chili crisp for serving) (Optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil noodles according to package instructions until al dente. Rinse with cold tap water to stop cooking, drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut off the ends of baby bok choy. Slice the whites into 1/2” (1 cm) pieces and slice the greens into 1” (2.5 cm) pieces. Soak in cold water for 2 minutes, rub gently to remove any dirt. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar and salt in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet (or a wok) over medium heat until just smoking. Add the eggs. Scramble until cooked through and the surface turns light golden. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon oil and the baby bok choy. Cook and stir until just wilted, 2 minutes or so. Transfer to the plate with the eggs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and sausage. Cook until the edges turn golden. Add the scallion and stir to release fragrance.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the noodles and toss a few times. Pour in the sauce. Cook and stir to coat noodles evenly with sauce. Add back the eggs and baby bok choy. Toss to mix well. Add the scallion greens. Transfer the noodles to individual serving plates. Serve hot as a main dish or side dish. Stir in sesame oil or chili crisp if desired.

title: Greek Moustokouloura recipe (Grape must cookies with petimezi)
description: A super easy, delicious and fragrant Greek Moustokouloura (Grape must cookies) recipe made in only 35 minutes from scratch!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180οC (360οF).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare this Greek moustokouloura recipe add in a large bowl the petimezi and water and whisk using a hand whisk.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the vegetable oil, olive oil and honey. Mix thoroughly for about 5 minutes with a hand whisk, until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same bowl add the baking ammonia and baking soda and whisk to dissolve completely.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In another bowl add the sifted flour, ground cinnamon and ground clove ad mix with a spoon.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the flour mixture into the liquid mixture and mix with a spoon until the mixture is thick and can be handled with your hands. Be careful not to knead the mixture too much, to prevent the oil from separating.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: This moustokouloura recipe make 20-22 cookies depending on the size you make them. So divide the dough to 20-22 pieces.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Take each piece of the dough and knead into a rope (approx. 10 cm) and join the edges together to form a circle.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the moustokoloura into a baking pan, lined with parchment paper, leaving 2-3cm distance between them.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake the moustokouloura for approx. 15-20 min. Be careful not to over-bake them. If you prefer them slightly softer, bake them covered with some foil, remove it 15 minutes in and let it bake uncovered for the last 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Let them cool on a rack and serve.

title: Putbaechu (Young Cabbage) Doenjang Muchim
description: a delicious Korean side dish made with young cabbage seasoned with doenjang (fermented soybean paste)!

ingredients.name: bunches young cabbage (putbaechu, 풋배추) - about 8 ounces each (- See note for substitutes.)
(or to taste) doenjang, fermented soybean paste
sesame oil or perilla seed oil (s)
gochugaru or gochujang - optional (adjust to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off the roots from the cabbage. Wash thoroughly until there is no sand in the water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a rapid boil. Add a tablespoon of salt. Blanch the cabbage until the white parts turn soft, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove the cabbage from the pot and shock in cold water to stop the cooking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain, and tightly squeeze out water. Cut into 2 to 3-inch lengths.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining ingredients and mix everything well by hand. Adjust the seasoning to taste by adding more doenjang (or gochujang or gochugaru for the spiciness). Let it sit for 10 to 20 minutes before serving for the flavor of the seasonings to seep into the cabbage.

title: Agua de Tamarindo (Tamarindo Drink)
description: Agua de tamarindo (or tamarindo drink) is a popular Mexican drink made from tamarind pods, water, and sugar. It’s a refreshing, tart and sweet agua fresca!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the tamarind pods by removing and discarding the hard shells from the outside and the fibers/strings on the inside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 6 cups of water to a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add peeled tamarind to the boiling water, cover and lower heat to medium. Continue cooking for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove pot from heat, uncover, and let it sit until completely cooled, about 2-3 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once cooled, use your hands to squeeze out the seeds from the cooked tamarind pods. Remove and discard the seeds and any remaining fibers/strings.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the tamarind liquid and pulp to a large blender. Puree until smooth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the liquid through a mesh strainer and into a large pitcher. You may have to use a spoon to stir the liquid in the strainer to help it go through. Discard any pulp and solids that don’t go through.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add remaining 6 cups of water and sugar to the pitcher. Stir together to combine, taste, and sweeten with more sugar if necessary.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve over ice and enjoy.

title: Drunken Spaghetti สปาเก็ตตี้ผัดขี้เมา (spaghetti pad kee mao)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: ground beef or other protein of your choice
spur chili or other medium-to-mild red chilies
stalks Chinese broccoli, stems thinly sliced, leaves roughly chopped
holy basil, regular basil or Thai basil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Set a large pot of water to a boil. Add salt to the water (1 tsp salt for every 1 litre of water).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound garlic, spur chilies, Thai chilies and fingerroot (if using) into a rough paste. Alternatively, you can mince everything together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once all your ingredients are ready to go and you're ready to turn on the wok, add spaghetti to the boiling salted water and cook until al dente. (Cooking the spaghetti right before you're ready to use it allows you to transfer the spaghetti directly from the pot to the wok, which is so much easier than draining it!)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a wok, cook the ground beef in a little vegetable oil, stirring to break up any clumps, until fully cooked. Remove the beef, draining off any excess fat. Wipe the wok with paper towel to get rid of excess beef fat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To the same wok, add a little vegetable oil and sauté garlic-chili mixture over medium heat until golden. Add vegetables, cooked beef, a teaspoon of the sauce and toss for 30 seconds. Your spaghetti should be a few minutes away from being done at this point, so turn off the stove and wait until the spaghetti is ready.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the spaghetti is done, use tongs or a pasta scoop to transfer the spaghetti directly into the wok. Turn the heat back on to medium high, add all remaining sauce and sugar, then toss until all the sauce is completely absorbed. If you want the dish to be a little more moist/saucy, you can add a splash of chicken stock or the pasta water (keeping in mind that the pasta water is salted, so don't add too much of it). Turn off the heat, add white pepper and holy basil and toss just to wilt the basil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve immediately with the chili vinegar, if desired.

steps.title: Step 9
