title: Eggplant Lasagna Recipe
description: All the tasty flavors and the comfort of lasagna without the noodles! Roasted eggplant slices, layered with a delicious cheese mixture with spinach and fresh herb, and of course a little red pasta sauce.

ingredients.name: to 3 eggplants (about 1 ½ pounds), (sliced lengthwise into ½-inch thick slices (about 12 slices))
frozen spinach, (thawed and fully dried (wring out all the water))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season the eggplant slices on both sides with kosher salt and set aside for 20 to 30 minutes (if you don't have the time, this step can be optional).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400 degrees F and position a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wipe the eggplant slices very well with a paper towel (you want to dry it well and remove any excess salt), then arrange on lightly oiled baking sheet (or two if needed). Brush the top of the eggplant with extra virgin olive oil. Roast in the heated oven until the eggplant softens and becomes pliable (about 15 to 20 minutes or so).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the eggplant is roasting, prepare the ricotta filling. In a mixing bowl, beat the egg. Add the ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, ¼ Parmesan, garlic, oregano, spinach and chopped herbs. Add a small pinch of kosher salt and black pepper to your liking. Mix well to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the eggplant from the oven. Lower the heat to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour a bit of the pasta sauce (about ½ cup or so) and spread it out into one layer. Lay a few eggplant slices (anywhere from 4 to 6 and it’s fine if they overlap a bit). Spread 1/2 of the ricotta filling, then spread a thin layer of the sauce. Repeat the process in the same pattern. Spread the final layer of sauce and follow with the remaining ½ cup mozzarella cheese and ¼ cup of Parmesan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cover the dish tightly with foil. Bake in the heated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, then carefully uncover and return to the oven. Bake for another 10 to 20 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the edges of the lasagna turn a nice golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

title: Crispy Eggplant with Szechuan Meat Sauce (鱼香茄子)
description: A small twist on the classic Szechuan eggplant results in a plate of crispy eggplant with an appetizing and pungent sour-spicy sauce.

ingredients.name: long eggplants (about 600 grams / 1.2 pounds total (*see footnote 1))
potato starch ((or more to coat the eggplant))
jalapeno (, pickled (or Sichuan pickled pepper, chopped))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut eggplant into long strips, about 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick and 3 inches (8 cm) long. Line a big tray with paper towels and spread eggplant on top without overlapping. Sprinkle salt onto eggplant and let sit for 15 to 20 minutes. (*footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine pork, light soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine in a small bowl. Mix well and let marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine light soy sauce, black vinegar, Shaoxing wine, sugar, salt, and 1/4 cup water in a bowl (do not add potato starch). Mix well. In another small bowl, add 2 teaspoons potato starch and 2 tablespoons water to make a slurry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat enough oil for frying in a deep pan over high heat until it reaches 350 degrees F (180 C).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While heating the oil, use paper towels to pat the eggplant dry. (*footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the eggplant to a large bowl. Add 1/3 cup potato starch. Toss eggplant to coat evenly with potato starch.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place a large strainer on top of a big bowl. Line another big plate with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Fry eggplant in small batches without overcrowding the pan (I fried them in 5 batches by using a flat bottom wok). Keep the oil temperature at 320 degrees F (160 C) during the frying process. (* see footnote 4) Fry the eggplant until the surface turns golden brown. Flip once to get both sides fried evenly. It should take about 2 minutes to fry each batch, and the eggplant shouldn’t shrink too much after frying. If it takes much longer than 2 minutes to fry a batch, it means your oil temperature is not high enough.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer the cooked eggplant to the strainer and continue to fry the next batch. When the next batch is done, transfer the eggplant from the strainer to the plate with paper towel. Place the newly fried eggplant onto the strainer. Continue this until all the eggplant is cooked. (*see footnote 5)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Transfer 2 tablespoons frying oil to a large skillet and heat over medium high heat. Add green onion, garlic, and ginger. Stir a few times until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add jalapeno. Stir and cook for a minute. Move all the ingredients to one side of the skillet.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add pork to the other side of the skillet. Stir and cook until the surface turns white.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Mix the pork with the rest ingredients. Cook until the pork is almost cooked through.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Mix the sauce again and add it into the skillet. Cook until the sauce begins to boil. Let cook for 1 minutes to thicken. Turn off heat. Stir the potato slurry again. Slowly add it to the skillet to thicken the sauce. If you don’t want the sauce to be too thick, you might not need to add all the slurry.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Transfer eggplant to a serving plate. Right before serving, pour the meat sauce onto the eggplant.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Serve immediately with steamed rice.

title: Greek Halva recipe (Semolina Pudding with Raisins)
description: The traditional Greek Halva recipe is often referred as "1:2:3:4", as it calls for one unit oil, two semolina, three sugar and four water. So simple!

ingredients.name: semolina (1 1/2 cup coarse and 1/2 cup thin)
of sugar (or 2 cups sugar and 1 cup honey)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek halva recipe, start by preparing the syrup. Add all the ingredients into a pan over high heat and bring to the boil. Boil until the sugar has dissolved and the syrup slightly thickens. Set aside, but keep warm.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, roast the almond silvers into the oven at 180C. Although the traditional Greek halva recipe doesn’t include almonds, it’s always a nice addition, which gives extra flavour and crunchiness.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large pot and add gradually the semolina. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon to allow the semolina to absorb the oil. When the semolina starts to bubble, turn the heat down and allow to toast until golden (whilst constantly stirring). The more you toast the mixture, the darker it will become. Just be careful not to over toast it, as the semolina will burn and the halva will become bitter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the pot from the stove and pour in, slowly, the warm syrup. Don’t forget to remove the lemon peel, cinnamon and clove!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir with a wooden spoon and return the pot on the stove. Add the halva spices.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook the halva (whilst stirring) until the mixture thickens and pulls away easily from the sides of the pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the pot from the stove, add the raisins and half of the roasted almond slivers and blend. Cover the halva with a towel and let it rest for 10 minutes. Pour the mixture into a pudding mold or into individual bowls.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Allow the halva to cool for about 1 1/2 hour before serving. Garnish with some cinnamon powder and sprinkle with the rest almond slivers.

title: Shrimp Stir Fry
description: Shrimp Stir Fry - a quick and easy shrimp dinner with a honey soy garlic based sauce accompanied with vegetables that comes ready in 20 minutes from start to finish. A healthy and easy meal to enjoy any time!

ingredients.name: 1- 1 1/2 cups chicken stock (, (adjust to desired thickness with more))
medium red onion (, cut into thin wedges)
– 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes (, (adjust to taste))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Whisk together soy sauce, chicken stock, cornstarch and honey. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up the skillet with about 2 tablespoon of oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Quickly stir in garlic and ginger into skillet, let it cook for about one minute or less. Do not let it burn. Add in onions continue cooking for another 2 -3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in shrimp , and cook for about 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in soy sauce mixture and let it cook until it thickens.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add vegetables, red bell pepper and green onions, continue stirring , about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Finally throw in basil, If desired, you may adjust with broth. Season with salt, pepper and red pepper flakes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with warm rice.

title: Rice Noodles w/ Curried Meat Sauce ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อสับ
description: Fresh chewy rice noodles are toasted until charred and served with a rich meat sauce flavoured with aromatic curry powder. It's one of my mom's favourite meals!

ingredients.name: ground beef (you can use regular or lean)
A couple dashes of Worcestershire sauce (optional, to taste)
stalk of Chinese celery or 2 inner stalks and leaves of regular celery
~4 cups loosely packed green leaf lettuce, cut into short ribbons.
A dash of Thai black soy sauce or dark soy sauce (optional)
Raw egg yolk, optional, 1 per portion
Sriracha or Chili vinegar (recipe follows) for serving
Spicy chili peppers of your choice, you can use Thai chilies, serranos, jalapenos, or habaneros.
White vinegar, ¼-½ cup as needed to blend

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mash together ground beef, fish sauce, and curry powder; set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a heavy-bottomed pot, sauté garlic and onion in a little vegetable oil over medium heat until the onion is translucent and the garlic starts to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn heat up to medium high, add the beef and cook, breaking up the lumps and stirring constantly, until the beef is fully cooked. Stir in tomatoes, then add chicken stock, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer gently over medium low heat for a bout 15-20 minutes, reducing the liquid until it looks like a stew.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the sauce has reduced, stir the tapioca starch with just enough water to dissolve it, then

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: add a splash of it to the sauce, quickly stirring it in. If the sauce is simmering (as it should be), the sauce will thicken almost instantly. Stir in a little more slurry as needed until the liquid part of the sauce is thick enough that it is coating the beef pieces. Season with ground white pepper, then taste and adjust seasoning. Keep hot until ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If you want raw egg yolks on top (highly recommended!), crack all your eggs into a bowl, making sure the yolks are not broken and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ready to serve, line serving plates with a handful of the green leaf lettuce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat a wok or a large non-stick pan over high heat until very hot. Coat the bottom with a little oil, then add the noodles. Add the black soy sauce and give the noodles a quick toss, then spread them out and let sit until the bottom side is toasted in some spots. Give them a flip and let them toast some more until you get some nice charred spots. Remove from heat and divide amongst serving plates.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Stir the celery into the sauce and pour the sauce over the rice noodles. If serving yolks, make a little crater on top of the noodles and use your CLEAN hands to scoop out the yolk, letting the egg white drip back into the bowl as much as possible, and place one yolk on top of each portion. To eat, drizzle a little chili vinegar or Sriracha and mix the noodles well with the egg yolk and lettuce.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Chili Vinegar

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: (Watch this video @ 7:13 for a quick visual of this being made).

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cut the chilies in half and place on a foil-lined baking sheet, cut side down. Place the whole garlic cloves on the sheet as well. Broil the chilies and garlic on “high” until the chilies are charred in spots and the garlic cloves are browned. Transfer to a blender, add just enough of the vinegar to blend, and blend until there are no more big chunks.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Youngyang Chaltteok (Healthy Sweet Rice Cake)
description: Korean rice cake made with sweet rice flour and healthy ingredients such as beans, nuts and dried fruits and pumpkin!

ingredients.name: soaked black soybeans (1/2 cup dry) (seoritae, 서리태 (or kidney beans))
jujubes (dried Korean dates, daechu, 대추 (or 1/2 cup raisins, dried cranberries or persimmons))
dried kabocha (or other type of pumpkin - optional - See note 1)
wet sweet rice flour (defrosted at room temperature, if frozen - See note 2)
sugar (2 tablespoons if you like it less sweet)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the beans by soaking in warm water for a few hours. Rinse the jujubes and cut each one around the seed into 3 to 4 pieces. Rinse the optional dried kabocha and rehydrate by adding a tablespoon or two of water at a time, until softened. Prepare the nuts.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the rice flour, sugar, and the optional almond meal. Mix well by hand or a whisk until everything is well incorporated. Add 2 tablespoons of water and rub the powder between your palms, breaking the big clumps, to evenly distribute the moisture. You don’t need to try to break up small clumps.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add all the other ingredients and gently toss to combine everything.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fill a steamer (or a pot) with water two thirds of the way. Prepare the steamer insert (or bamboo steamer) with a wet linen/cotton cloth (or cheesecloth). Turn the heat on. When it starts to steam, add the mixture to the steamer insert with a large spoon. Even the top out, but do not pack. If your cloth hangs down low, fold it over to cover the mixture. Unless using a bamboo steamer, fully cover the top with another cloth before putting the lid on. (This will prevent the water generated by steam from dripping on the rice cake.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Steam for 30 minutes, and then remove the steamer insert from the heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When it’s cool enough to handle, flip it over onto a cutting board. Remove the cloth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Shape the rice cake to a rectangle if desired. Wet your hands before touching the rice cake. Cut into serving size pieces.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Keep it in an airtight container if serving within a day or two. To store for a longer period, individually wrap and freeze the rice cake. For best results, do this within a few hours of making. Simply leave it out at room temperature until it softens before serving, or you can briefly defrost it in the microwave.

title: Corn Egg Drop Soup
description: Super easy and healthy Chinese corn egg drop soup.

ingredients.name: fresh sweet corn or canned sweet corn

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare a fresh sweet corn or purchase niblet from supermarket.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop the sweet corns with knife; keep 1/2 of the sweet corns in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the left sweet corn with around 2 tablespoons of clean water in a food processor and blend until they turn into chunks

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the blended corn, and the whole sweet corn to a pot, and add water. Cook for 4 minutes after the water boils. Add rock sugar if using and a very small pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix cornstarch with around 2 tablespoons of water. Stir well to avoid any bumps. Add the water starch to the soup. Bring to boiling again until the soup base become thick in texture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now, slow down the fire and slowly stir the whisked egg liquid in. Stir the soup with a scoop slowly, gently, and continually. And in one direction. Serve hot.

title: Raspados (Mexican Shaved Ice)
description: Raspados are the perfect treat! This Mexican shaved ice is made by blending and crushing ice, then topping it with homemade fruit syrup.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the water and sugar to a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the diced mangoes, reduce heat to medium, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mash the mangos using a potato masher for a chunky consistency, or puree the mixture using a handheld immersion blender for a smooth consistency.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Allow the mixture to reduce, uncovered, over medium-low heat, until it reaches a syrup-like consistency. This should take about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove it from the heat and allow it to cool on the counter for 30 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When ready to serve, crush and blend 4 cups of ice cubes in the blender. Transfer the crushed ice to a large bowl and repeat with the remaining ice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To assemble, pack the crushed ice into a cup and pour ¼ cup of the mango syrup on top. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Harissa Chicken
description: Thanks to harissa paste, this easy grilled chicken recipe is all the flavor! Slightly sweet, smoky, tangy, and just enough spicy. Serve it over quick-cooked couscous, a side of veggies, or with your favorite Mediterranean salad.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat the chicken dry and season with kosher salt on both sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the chicken in a bowl and add garlic, onions, spices, and harissa paste. Add lemon juice and a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat an outdoor grill or an indoor griddle to medium-high heat (between 400-450 degrees Fahrenheit) and be sure to lightly oil the grates. Grill for 6 to 7 minutes or so on each side or until the chicken is fully cooked (using an instant read thermometer chicken's internal temperature should register 165 degrees F at the thickest part).

title: Sprouts Salad (Easy & Healthy)
description: Sprouts Salad is an easy and healthy salad made with sprouted moong beans, chopped vegetables, herbs and mild spices. The ingredients are mixed together to create a fresh and lightly spiced dish.

ingredients.name: to ⅓ cup finely chopped onions (or 1 small-sized onion)
to ½ cup finely chopped tomatoes (or 1 small to medium-sized tomato)
to 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chillies (or 1 green chilli - optional)
red chilli powder (or ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper or paprika)
boiled potato (or boiled sweet potato, peeled & finely chopped - optional)
salt (or rock salt (edible and food grade) or black salt, as required)
to 2 tablespoons chopped coriander leaves (- for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boiling moong sprouts

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making sprouts salad

title: Braised Pork Shank with Black Beans
description: The braised pork shank is so tender that the meat falls from the bone at the slightest touch. The rich sauce is enhanced by the velvety black beans.

ingredients.name: pork shank ((or 2 pork hocks) about 2 pounds in total)
Golden Mountain Sauce ((or light soy sauce))
(15 ounces / 400 grams) black beans ((do not drain))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Dry pork shank thoroughly with paper towel to remove moisture (to avoid oil splatter during frying).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok or a large dutch oven over medium high heat until warm. Add pork shank and let it roast for 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook the other side for another 2 to 3 minutes. Keep flipping and cooking, until the the entire surface is golden brown. Add 6 cups water (or more) to cover the pork shank.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add Sichuan peppercorns and coriander seeds to a mesh tea strainer or infuser. (See footnote 1)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the tea strainer, garlic, green onion, ginger, cinnamon stick, star anise, and five-spice powder to the pot. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Continue cooking to bring to a boil. Skim the foam from the surface until the broth is clear.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover and turn to low heat. Simmer for 40 minutes. The broth should continue boiling throughout the process.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, Golden Mountain Sauce and palm sugar. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Keep covered and simmer for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: (Optional) Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over medium high heat until warm. Spread chicken thighs. Allow to cook without moving for 2 to 3 minutes, until the bottom side turns golden. Flip and cook the other side until golden. Transfer to the pot with the braising pork shank.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the black beans, along with all the liquid, into the pot with the pork. (See footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Cover and turn bring to a boil over medium high heat. Keep covered and simmer for 1 hour, until the pork turns tender. If the broth runs low before the pork becomes tender, add warm water to cover pork.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: If the broth is still thin, turn to medium high heat and cook uncovered until the sauce thickens. The starch from the black beans will help the sauce thicken, so there should be quite a lot of sauce (about half) left when it’s finished cooking.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve the meat, beans, and sauce over steamed rice.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Store the leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week, or in the freezer for up to 2 months.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: If you have leftover sauce, do not throw them away! Add them to a bowl of noodles, so you can create a rich and hearty noodle soup effortless (see recipe here).

title: Gyeran mari (Korean rolled omelette)
description: This Korean rolled egg recipe is made with chopped carrot and scallion! It’s a popular side dish, especially for a lunch box!

ingredients.name: large eggs (You can use 5 or more eggs for thicker rolls )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the scallion and carrot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Crack and beat the eggs, in a bowl with a spoon, a fork, or a pair of chopsticks until the yolks and whites are blended well with no visible strings of whites. Stir in salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the chopped vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add a teaspoon of vegetable oil to a medium size non-stick pan and distribute the oil evenly using a napkin or paper towel. Preheat over medium low heat, until it feels hot when you place your hand 2 to 3 inches above the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1/2 of the egg mixture to the pan. Swirl it around to cover the pan. Let it cook until the top begins to set but is still wet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Using a spatula, lift one end of the egg (about 1-1/2 inches) and fold it over to the other side. Reduce the heat or raise the pan away from the heat for a little while if the bottom is browning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Lift the folded part and fold it again. Pull the egg to the rolled side, making room on the round end for more egg mixture. Add 1/2 of the remaining egg and spread to cover the open space.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When the egg addition is set, lift the folded part and fold it again. Pull the egg to the rolled side and repeat the process with the remaining egg to make an about 2-inch egg log.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove from the pan and let cool for about 5 minutes. Slice the egg into thick, even pieces (3/4 to 1-inch thick).

title: Greek Olive Oil Cookies
description: If you are looking for a classic Greek biscuit, then look no further than these Greek olive oil cookies or koulourakia ladiou.

ingredients.name: orange juice (or 140g orange juice and 35g Metaxa/ cognac) – 5.8 oz

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these olive oil cookies add in a large bowl the orange juice and baking soda. Whisk lightly using a fork until the baking soda dissolves and starts foaming.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the same bowl add all the liquid ingredients (olive oil, vanilla extract and cognac, if using) and the sugar and beat with a hand whisk until the sugar dissolves. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl add the dry ingredients: flour, salt, orange zest, ground cinnamon and clove. Mix with a spoon to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add all the dry ingredients in the bowl with the liquid ingredients. Mix lightly with a spoon until all the ingredients incorporate. At the end use your hands to knead the dough softly until the flour is incorporated. Do not knead the dough too much because the oil will start to separate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Preheat the oven at 170-180C fan (350F).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Divide the dough in 28-30 equal balls, approx. 30-35g / 1oz each.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Shape the cookies into braids or circles.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Dredge the olive oil cookies in sesame seeds until covered on all sides.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the cookies on 2 baking trays lined with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake each tray for approx. 20-25 minutes until nicely coloured and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Remove from the oven and let them cool completely. Enjoy!

title: Sticky Rice Cake with Coconut – Nuomichi
description: Sticky Rice Cake with Coconut-Nuomichi

ingredients.name: Half cup of desiccated coconut for decoration
Mango ( ,red bean paste or any other inner filling you want)
around 3 tbsp. cornstarch or plain rice flour
around 2 tbsp. powdered sugar or to taste
tbsp. vegetable cooking oil ( ,with less taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the ingredients in the batter well in a large bowl. Covered with plastic wrapper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the large bowl in a steamer. Bring the water to a boiling and continue to steam for 20 minutes. Stir once during the process to guarantee the uniform heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer out and stir with chopsticks to help it cool down. Transfer it to a plate with plastic wrapper. Then knead for 3-4 minutes with the help of a plastic wrappers. Wrap the wrapper dough well and fridge until chilled.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the wrapper dough is well chilled, use your thumb and index finger to form a circle around the dough and squeeze a ball out. Wrap with your filling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll the ball in the bowl with desiccated coconut, place in a cupcake cup. Repeat to make all the cake. Put all of them in refrigerator for 2 hours. Enjoy!

title: Fried Tofu w/ Sweet Chili Peanut Sauce เต้าหู้ทอด
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: spur chilies, you can substitute other mild red chilies or ¼ of a red bell pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the sauce: In a blender add chilies, garlic, water, vinegar and tamarind; blend until there are no more big chunks (doesn't need to be perfectly smooth) and transfer into a small pot. Add sugar, palm sugar, salt and chili flakes and simmer for 3-5 minutes to reduce until the dip is slightly runnier than ideal as it will thicken when cooled. Let cool completely, if you want the dip to be thicker, reduce it a bit more. Taste and adjust seasoning. When ready to serve stir in peanuts and cilantro.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the tofu: Add oil to a wok or pot until it is deeper than the thickness of your tofu. Preheat the oil to 375 °F then fry tofu for about 3-4 minutes or until golden brown. If the tofu sticks to each other, let them fry until they just start to turn colour before pulling them apart, if you pull them apart before they've had a chance to firm up you may tear them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve while still hot!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Papas con Chorizo
description: Papas con Chorizo is an easy Mexican chorizo and potatoes dish that's best served with fresh tortillas. Great for breakfast and ready in only 30 minutes!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium saucepan, add potatoes. Cover completely with water, cover with lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 5-8 minutes, or until potatoes are cooked through. The potatoes should be tender and easily pricked with a fork. Carefully drain the water and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onions and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add chorizo and break up into smaller chunks using a wooden spoon. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chorizo is cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the potatoes and stir together to combine with the chorizo mixture. Cook for 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste and season with salt and pepper as necessary. Garnish with chopped cilantro and enjoy.

title: Easy Harissa Recipe
description: Make this easy harissa paste with dried chiles, garlic, and warm North African spices and keep it in the fridge for use on meat, chicken, fish, or even veggies.

ingredients.name: Dried New Mexico Chiles or Guajillo Chiles,
jarred roasted red peppers, (drained rinsed, and dried (2 large peppers))
caraway seeds, (toasted and ground (use a mortar and pestle, grinder or food processor))
Juice of 1 large lemon, (2 tbsp fresh lemon juice)
quality extra virgin olive oil, (more for later)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak and prepare the dried chiles. Place the dried chiles in a heat-safe bowl and cover with hot water. Set aside for 30 minutes until the chiles are tender and re-hydrated. Drain the chiles and remove the stems and seeds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine chiles with the remaining ingredients. Transfer the chiles to the bowl of a large food processor fitted with a blade. Add the tomato paste, roasted red peppers, garlic, ground caraway seeds, coriander, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne (if using), and a large pinch of kosher salt. Add fresh lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the harissa paste. Run the food processor, and while it’s running, drizzle the extra virgin olive oil from the top opening. Stop the processor to scrape down the sides and run again until you reach the desired paste-like texture. Taste and adjust seasonings to your liking (remember that harissa paste will deepen in flavor as it sits in the fridge over the next day or two).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Store. Transfer the harissa paste to a clean mason jar. Cover with a very thin layer of extra virgin olive oil, then cover the jar with its lid tightly and refrigerate.

title: White Sangria
description: WHITE SANGRIA - a smooth fruity mixture of fruits, rum, and white wine perfect for hosting dinner parties and barbecues, this drink is the choice for anyone who wants to have fun!

ingredients.name: passion fruit juice (, adjust to taste)
bottle (750 milliliters) dry white wine (, chilled)
simple syrup (, (homemade here) adjust to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add desired fruits (mango, berries, sliced orange, lemon and/or lime) to a pitcher.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in passion fruit juice, white wine, followed by rum, and simple syrup.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir gently to combine, adjust with more juice or syrup. Garnish with mint leaves, if desired.

title: Chinese Pork Stock
description: Pork stock is an essential ingredient in the Chinese kitchen, especially in the winter. It has a white semi-transparent color and a meaty taste. It can be added to all sorts of vegetable soups, noodle soups, and stews as a flavor enhancer.

ingredients.name: (1 kilogram / 2 pounds) pork leg bones (, chopped (*see footnote 1))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash pork bones carefully with tap water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add bones, Shaoxing wine, and ginger into a large pot (or dutch oven). Add water until the pot is 4/5 full. Cover and bring to a boil. Stir the bones a few times during cooking to keep them from sticking to the bottom. Skim the foam from the surface until the soup turns clear, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: (Optional) Turn off heat. Use a pair of chopsticks (or tongs) to transfer the bones to a plate. Place a strainer over a large bowl. Strain the broth and discard bones and other fragments. Rinse the pot to get rid of any extra foam. Transfer the broth and bone backs to the pot. (*see footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring the broth to a boil again. Cover and cook over low heat (medium heat if using an electric stove) for 3.5 to 4 hours. The broth should continue boiling throughout the cooking. You don’t need to add water during the cooking, but remember to check the broth every 20 to 30 minutes. If the water runs too low and no longer covers the bones, add boiling water, 2 cups at a time. Don’t add any water during the final hour of cooking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: At the end of cooking, the broth should be reduced to about 1/3 (or less) of the original volume. Transfer the pork stock to a bowl to cool off.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: (Optional) If the bones have any meat attached, you can separate the meat from the bones and eat it with a dipping sauce. To making the dipping sauce, combine 1 tablespoon light soy sauce with 1 teaspoon sugar. The meat will still be tender and moist and should be consumed as soon as possible. Or, you can store the meat and use it to cook fried rice later on.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: (Optional) Leave the bones in the pot and cook another batch of stock. Add water until the pot is 1/2 full. Bring the water to a boil. Cover and cook for another 2 hours to get more stock. The broth should get quite concentrated again, but won’t be as thick as the first time. You can use this broth to cook soup directly, without adding water. To store, transfer the second batch of broth to a bowl to cool off. Discard ginger and pork bones.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: You can use the stock to make soup and noodle broth and add it to stews and stir-fry dishes to enhance the flavor. If you use it to cook soup, don’t forget to add water to the stock to adjust it to taste. I used my first batch to cook four meals for two people, using the stock to cook exclusively soup.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Wait until the stock cools off completely. You can store it in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, or in the freezer for up to 2 months.

title: Amazing No knead Bread Recipe
description: A super easy recipe for an amazing no knead bread! It requires no special equipment, mixer or technique. You will only need a wooden spoon and your love!

Knead the dough a little bit with your hands and form two round loafs. Place the two breads in a casserole dish and score the top of the bread with a sharp knife.

steps.title: Step 6

Cover with plastic wrap (to avoid sticky) and then roll the minced pork into a thin meat piece. (Tips about how to make the pork sheet large and thin: roll with plastic wrapper covered so the pork won’t attach to the rolling pin. Remove the extra pork on the edges and then place in the center of the sheet, repeat the process of rolling to make it as even as possibly.)

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

Brush honey on the other side and garnish some toasted sesame seeds if using. Continue heating for another 5 to 8 minutes until the pork jerk is well colored.

steps.title: Step 7

description: Korean savory pancakes made with garlic chives!

soup soy sauce (or regular soy sauce or fish sauce)

Cook until the edges turn light golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium low if the pancake browns too quickly. Turn it over, adding more oil to the sides of the pan, and press it down with a spatula. Cook until the other side is light golden brown, about 2 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Taco Soup

lime juice ((about the juice of 1 lime))

steps.title: Step 1

title: Tahdig Recipe (Crispy Persian Rice)
description: Tahdig, pronounced tah-deeg, literally means "bottom of the pot" in Persian. And it refers to a beautiful, pan-fried Persian rice that is fluffy and buttery on the inside with a perfectly golden crust, which is the layer at the bottom of…

ingredients.name: basmati rice (like Royal Basmati Rice (affiliate link))
grape seed oil, (or any healthy neutral-tasting oil of your choice )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the saffron into 1 cup very warm (but not hot) water. Let sit for at least 10 minutes to let the saffron release all of its flavor.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a sieve, rinse the rice under cool running water until the water almost runs clear.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large pot, combine 8 cups of water and the salt (this is your one shot to season the rice itself). Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Add the rice and cook until al dente, 5 to 6 minutes. Drain the rice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium bowl, combine 1 cup of the cooked rice, the yogurt, grapeseed oil, and 2 tbsp of the saffron water. Mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread the rice-yogurt mixture evenly on the bottom of a 10-inch lidded nonstick pot. Sprinkle 1 cup of the remaining cooked rice on top, followed by 2 tablespoons of the dried cherries, a pinch of orange zest, and a pinch of cinnamon. Add another layer of rice and repeat with the cherries, orange zest, and cinnamon, reserving a couple tbsp of the cherries for garnish. As you go about layering, the rice will start to dome and look "pointy" in the middle--that's okay! Keep it that way. Finish by dotting the top with the butter and pour the rest of the saffron water all over the top.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Wrap the lid in a kitchen towel and secure it around the handle with a rubber band. Cover the pot and cook over low heat, 25 to 30 minutes or until the rice around the edges is golden and crispy; it's okay to peek under the lid! (See note #2) Be sure not to burn the bottom layer of the rice, though you do want a nice crust in the bottom.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the lid, invert a large serving plate over the pot, and carefully flip them over together. No worries if it sticks, just scrape it out and run with it! Sprinkle the tahdig with the reserved dried cherries and pistachios and serve right away.

title: Greek Bread recipe (Village bread/ Horiatiko Psomi)
description: A super easy Greek village bread recipe (Horiatiko psomi) that will never fail you! All the secrets for a perfectly baked bread; a homely version for all the bread lovers.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this easy Greek bread recipe, start by adding in a large bowl the water, yeast and sugar. Use a fork to completely dissolve the yeast in the water. Set aside for about 5 -10 minutes to activate the yeast. Note: if you don’t have fresh yeast substitute for dried – just use one third of the quantity stated.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add half the flour a little bit at time whilst mixing with a spoon. Add the olive oil and salt and the rest of the flour and mix with a spoon until all the flour has been absorbed. At this point the dough should be sticky on your hand.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Knead the dough a little bit with your hands until it’s elastic and form into a ball. Place the dough inside a lightly oiled large bowl and cover with cling film.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Let the dough rise at room temperature for 10-12 hours (or overnight).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Deflate the dough. Sprinkle semolina on a large working surface and transfer the dough on the surface. Using a sharp knife divide the dough in 2 equal pieces. (This Greek Bread recipe makes 2 loafs of bread).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Knead each piece of the dough with your hands just enough to have a nice and smooth dough that doesn’t stick too much on your hands (for about 3 minutes). Sprinkle the dough with semolina (2-3 tbsps) when kneading the dough.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Form 2 round loafs and place inside a casserole dish or clay pot with a lid. Score the top of each loaf using a sharp knife. Place the lid on the casserole dish.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Preheat the oven at 250C/ 480F. Bake for 20 minutes with the lid on and another 15 minutes or so with the lid removed, until nicely coloured and crusty.

title: Addictive Kimchi Pork Steamed Buns
description: Imported from omnivorescookbook.com.

ingredients.name: (9 ounces) all-purpose flour ((plus extra to dust the working surface))
instant dry yeast ((or 1 and 1/2 active dry yeast))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine flour and dry yeast in a large bowl and mix well. Prepare a small bowl with extra flour on the side.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slowly pour the water into the bowl with the flour and yeast, mixing them with a pair of chopsticks. When the water is mixed with the flour, dust both hands with flour and start kneading to form dough. The dough should be quite soft and sticky. When dough has formed, dust the working surface with flour and dust hands again. Transfer the dough to the working surface and continue to knead the dough until the surface of the dough becomes smooth and its texture springy, about 5 minutes. Dust hands and the working surface with extra flour whenever the dough starts to feel sticky during the process.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Rinse a clean dish towel with water. Dust the bottom of a large bowl with flour and transfer the dough to it. Cover bowl with the damp dish towel and a lid (or plastic wrap). Let the dough rest until its size doubles, 2.5 to 3 hours (depending on room temperature) (*see footnote 2).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the dough is almost ready, combine ground pork, Shaoxing wine, and soy sauce in a medium-sized bowl and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mince kimchi into small pieces. Add it to the ground pork and mix them well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: The dough should be very fluffy and sticky now. Dust the working surface and your hands with extra flour and transfer the dough onto the surface. Use a rubber spatula if the dough is too sticky and difficult to handle. Knead the dough repeatedly and add more flour if necessary, until the dough has shrunk almost to its original size and has become smooth and springy again, 3 to 5 minutes. The purpose of this step is to squeeze the air bubbles from the dough, so the bun will have a smooth texture once cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To make the bun wrappers, divide the dough into two equal pieces. Roll each piece of dough a few times into a long stick, then further divide to make 12 to 14 small doughs in total (see footnote 3).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Dust the working surface again. Take one dough and roll it a few times, until shaped into a ball. Press the dough to a round disc and roll it with a rolling pin into a round sheet. Try to roll so that that the edge is thinner than the center. The edge should be 2 to 3 millimeters (about 0.1 inch) and the center 4 to 5 millimeters (0.2 inch) in thickness (*see footnote 4).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Scoop about 2 of tablespoons pork and kimchi filling and place it in the center of the wrapper. Hold the bun with one hand and start sealing the bun with the other hand (refer to the video to see how to fold a bun). Place the bun on the working surface and work on the rest of the doughs in the same manner.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place a large container or a bowl upside down to cover the buns. Let them rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add water into a large pot and place the steaming rack on or in the pot, as the case may be. The water should be at least 3 centimeters (1 inch) below the steaming rack. Wet a clean kitchen towel and place it on the steaming rack (or you could cut baking parchment into a round shape to fit the steaming rack. Cut a few round holes in the parchment so the steam can go through). Carefully transfer the buns to the steaming rack, at least one finger’s width apart. Cook the buns in two to three batches if the steaming rack cannot fit all the buns. Add more water to the pot after each batch if the water level is running low.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cover and cook over high heat (or highest heat for electric stove). When water starts to boil, turn to medium high heat and continue to cook for 10 minutes (12 minutes if you make 12 bigger buns), until the buns are cooked through. Stop heat and let the steam release for a few minutes. Carefully transfer the buns to a plate. Cook the remainder of the buns in the same way.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve warm as main course or snack.
