title: Tsoureki Muffins!
description: A unique Greek inspired muffin recipe made with aromatic tsoureki dough! Tsoureki is a very popular Greek sweet bread, which texture resembles a brioche, only much better!

ingredients.name: butter, from cow’s milk, at room temperature (2.3 oz.)
ground mastic (buy online in Australia, UK, US/CA)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these tsoureki muffins, add in a bowl the lukewarm water, a pinch of sugar and yeast and stir. Wrap well with plastic wrap and set aside for about 6-7 minutes, until the yeast rises and starts bubbling. Be careful not do add hot water, as it will kill the yeast, nor cold, as it will take forever for the tsoureki to rise. The water should be at the same temperature as your finger, so check it out sticking one finger in; you should feel no difference in temperature.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use a pestle or a blender to ground the masticha and mahlepi, along with a pinch of sugar and set aside. (These aromatic spices will give this Greek tsoureki its distinctive taste and amazing smell. Watch out not to add any more masticha, as the tsoureki will turn out a little bitter.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a saucepan add the butter, sugar and milk. Place over very low heat and stir the mixture, until the butter has melted and the sugar has dissolved. The key is to melt the butter at very low heat, so that the temperature doesn’t ‘kill’ the yeast. Remove the pan from the stove and check the temperature. The mixture should be at the same temperature as your finger. If it is warmer, then leave to cool down for a a few minutes and check again.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the butter mixture in a large bowl and whisk in the eggs. Add the yeast mixture and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the mixer’s bowl add the flour, the ground mastic and mahlepi, orange zest and the butter-egg-yeast mixture from step 4. Using the dough hook mix at first at low speed, until the ingredients start to combine and then mix at medium-high speed for about 15 minutes, until the dough doesn’t stick on the sides of the bowl. At this point the dough should be really soft, like seen in the picture and a little sticky. (Be careful not to add any more flour, as the tsoureki dough should be really soft and not firm)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the tsoureki dough with plastic wrap and place in a warm environment, until at least it doubles it’s size (for about 2-3 hours). If the environment is cold, preheat the oven at 30C, turn off and place the bowl inside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Butter the bottom and sides of the muffin tins and divide the dough inside them. Do not add too much dough, as it will rise again. Let the tsoureki dough rise for about 40-50 more minutes at room temperature or in the oven.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: In a small bowl add the egg and 1 tbsp water and whisk with a fork. Brush the top of each tsoureki muffin with the egg, garnish with almond silvers and bake in preheated oven at 170C for about 20-25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Two -three minutes before you turn the tsoureki out of the oven, start preparing the syrup. In a small pot add the sugar and water and bring to the boil. As soon as the sugar dissolves, remove the pot from the stove and ladle the hot syrup over the hot tsoureki.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let the tsoureki muffins cool down and wrap with plastic wrap, so that they don’t become hard and dry. Store for up to 5-7 days at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Enjoy these delicious Greek inspired tsoureki muffins, over a hot cup of tea or coffee.

title: Moong Dal Halwa
description: Moong Dal Halwa is a rich Indian sweet made with moong lentils, ghee, milk, sugar and nuts. It is especially popular in Rajasthan and other parts of North India.

ingredients.name: moong dal ((spilt husked yellow mung lentils))
green cardamoms (- husked and powdered in a mortar-pestle or ¼ to ⅓ teaspoon cardamom powder)
to 12 pistachios ((unsalted), sliced or chopped or 10 to 12 blanched almonds - sliced)
or 1.25 cups sugar (or raw sugar * check notes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making moong dal paste

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making moong dal halwa

title: Chinese Hunan Chicken –Donan chicken
description: savory Chinese Hunan chicken is much easier but the same yummy as many other famous Chicken recipes.

ingredients.name: Half of a chicken ( , around 300 g)
spring onion ( , white part sliced and green part chopped)
dried chili pepper ( , cut into small sections or more as needed)
whole Sichuan peppercorn ( , optional or as needed (If vegetables are added, reduce the amount please))
salt or as needed ( , adjust according to your taste)
Some roasted sesame seeds ( , for decoration)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the hen in running water and then rinse in boiling water for around 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the chicken out and then get some fresh and clean water in a pot (just cover the chicken); bring all the content to a boiling and continue cooking for 8 minutes (the chicken should be 80% cooked).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the chicken out, cool down and cut into small chunks. Cut fresh peppers into small pieces. Mix the cornstarch with water to make the water starch.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in wok; add dried red pepper sections, Sichuan peppercorns whole seeds to stir-fry for around 1 minute. And then add garlic, ginger and white part of spring onion to stir-fry until aroma.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add chicken chunks and pepper pieces in. Pour in cooking wine, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add around 1 cup of chicken stock in wok and simmer the chicken for around 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the water starch and several drops of sesame oil in. Mix well and garnish some chopped spring onion and roasted sesame seed before serving.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot please!

title: Saewu Ganghwe (Spring Onion Tied Shrimp and Asparagus)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: medium shrimp (41 – 50 per pound sizes, peeled, tail on, and deveined)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add the shrimp, and cook briefly, about a minute. Quickly drain and dump in cold water to stop cooking. Drain. You can cut small slits on the inner curve of the curled up shrimp to flatten a little for easier wrapping.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the tough ends of the asparagus. Cut into about 2-inch lengths. Blanch them in salted boiling water until softened, about a minute. Remove with a strainer, and shock in cold water. Drain. To the same pot of boiling water, add the white parts of the green onions, and hold for about 30 seconds before submerging the whole scallions briefly to soften, about 20 seconds. Drain, and shock in cold water. Pat the green onions dry with a kitchen towel or paper towel by gently pressing to remove excess water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To assemble, hold a shrimp and an asparagus piece together along with the white end of a green onion. Tie them together by wrapping the other end of the green onion around the shrimp and asparagus several times.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use a chopstick or a toothpick to tuck the end of the green onion into the roll. Serve with the gochujang sauce.

title: Easy Turkey Pumpkin Chili
description: This Easy Turkey Pumpkin Chili recipe is made with pumpkin, sweet potatoes, beans and chipotle peppers for a quick and comforting healthy fall meal! (freezer friendly, gluten free)

ingredients.name: 15-ounce can cannellini or white kidney beans, (drained and rinsed)
large sweet potatoes, (diced into small cubes)
chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, (chopped (If you prefer lots of spice, start with this amount and add more, to taste.))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix together ground turkey, 1 tablespoon chili powder, ground ginger, salt and cumin.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large dutch oven or stockpot over medium-high heat. Add in 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the ground turkey mixture and cook for about 10 minutes, until meat is cooked through, crumbled and browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer cooked meat to a large bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add remaining 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil to dutch oven and add in onion. Cook for about 5 minutes on until translucent and soft. Add in garlic and cook for one more minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer cooked meat back to dutch oven and add chicken broth, tomatoes, black beans, white beans, pumpkin puree, sweet potatoes, chipotle pepper, remaining 2 teaspoons chili powder, oregano, salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix together and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce to simmer and cook for 45 minutes. Uncover and cook another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with chopped cilantro, fresh limes and avocados.

title: Garlic Pepper Pork หมูทอดกระเทียมพริกไทย
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: pork butt, ¼” thick slices (see note)
cilantro stems, chopped (keep the leaves for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound peppercorns until fine. Add one-third of the garlic and chopped cilantro stems and pound into a fine paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add herb paste, oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar to the pork and mix well (it's faster to massage everything in by hand, but wear gloves or your hands will smell like garlic for a long time!). Let sit for 20 mins minimum, and up to one day.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, make fried garlic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To fry the pork:

title: Apple Tres Leches Cake
description: A delicious apple cinnamon tres leches cake soaked in three types of milk and topped with cinnamon whipped cream.

ingredients.name: cooking spray, olive oil, or butter, (for greasing)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9×13-inch baking pan with cooking spray, olive oil, or butter and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, baking soda, pumpkin pie spice, ground cinnamon, baking powder, and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the applesauce, granulated sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, ¼ cup milk, and vanilla extract.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the dry ingredients to the bowl of wet ingredients and whisk until just combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the batter into the greased baking pan and bake for 23-28 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Set aside to cool for 10 minutes while you make the three milk mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a medium bowl, add the remaining ¼ cup of milk, the sweetened condensed milk, and evaporated milk. Whisk together to combine.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gently run a knife or spatula along the sides of the cake pan to unstick the sides. Using a skewer or a fork, poke holes all over the top of the cake.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Slowly pour the three milk mixture all over the top and sides of the cake. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to let the cake fully cool and absorb the liquid.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: While the cake is chilling, make the whipped cream topping. Add the heavy cream, sugar, vanilla extract, and ground cinnamon to a large bowl. Beat on high speed using a handheld or stand mixer until soft peaks form. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Spread the whipped cream over the top of the cake and sprinkle a dusting of cinnamon on top if desired.

title: Green Shakshuka Recipe
description: You'll love this modern twist on classic shakshuka! Quick Green shakshuka with power greens like spinach, kale, and brussels sprouts, and perfectly steam-poached eggs nestled in! It takes one pan and 30 minutes to make!

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil, (more for later)
large bunch kale (8 ounces), (thick veins and stems removed, chopped)
Aleppo pepper ((or ½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes))
green onion, (trimmed and chopped, both white and green parts)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a 10-inch pan or skillet with a lid, heat the extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the sliced brussels sprouts and sprinkle with a dash of kosher salt. Cook for about 5 to 6 minutes, tossing occasionally until they soften and gain some color (I like a little bit of char).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Reduce the heat to medium. Add the onions and garlic, and cook, tossing regularly for 3 to 4 minutes until softened (don’t let the garlic burn though, manage the heat as you need to).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the kale and toss for 5 minutes until it wilts a little (you may have to add it to the pan in stages). Add the spinach and toss to combine. Season with a pinch of kosher salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the spices and toss to combine. Add ½ cup of water. Turn the heat to medium-low. Cover and let cook for about 8 to 10 minutes until the kale has completely wilted. Stir in the lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a spoon, make 4 wells. Crack an egg into each well and season each egg with a bit of salt. Cover the pan and cook for another 4 minutes or until the eggs have settled to your liking (I like a runny yoke).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the heat. Add another drizzle of extra virgin olive oil if you like. Garnish with the fresh green onions, parsley and some creamy feta. Serve immediately with your favorite bread or warm pita.

title: Koulourakia recipe (Greek Easter cookies)
description: The fluffiest and crunchiest traditional Greek Easter cookies recipe (koulourakia) you have ever made! These sweet little Greek Easter cookies are super quick to bake, so much fun to make and highly addictive to eat!

ingredients.name: powdered baking ammonia (2.5 tsp, flat). If you have trouble finding baking ammonia, or you don’t like the taste, you could substitute with 2.5tsp double acting baking powder.
egg yolks and 1 tbsp water for glazing the koulourakia

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional koulourakia recipe, start by mixing the butter and sugar. In a mixer’s bowl add the sugar and butter (chopped) and mix for about 10-15 minutes, until the butter is creamy and fluffy. (Once starting to prepare this koulourakia recipe, make sure that the butter is at room temperature).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime warm the milk until lukewarm and remove the pot from the heat. Add the ammonia and whisk until fully dissolved. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: , whilst mixing, allowing time for each one to be absorbed, before adding another. Pour in the the vanilla extract, the orange zest and the milk & ammonia blend and mix to combine. Add the flour, a little bit at a time, whilst mixing, until the ingredients are combined and the dough is soft and not too sticky.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the dough for the koulourakia with some plastic wrap and set aside to rest for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the dough for the koulourakia on a clean working surface, take a small piece of dough and form long cords. Shape the koulourakia with your hands, giving them any shape you like.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Line a large baking tray with parchment paper and place the koulourakia, leaving some distance between them as they will rise a lot when baked. For this koulourakia recipe, you will need approx. 4-5 large baking trays, depending on the size of the cookies you make.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a small bowl add the egg yolks and 1 tbsp water and whisk with a fork. Brush the top of the koulourakia and bake in preheated oven at 200C/400F fan for 15-20 minutes, until fully cooked and golden brown on the outside (or the ammonia would not have been fully used up).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let the koulourakia cool down completely on a cooling rack and store in airtight containers for up to three weeks.

title: Ginger Tea
description: Experience a calm and serene feeling with every cup of this flavorful GINGER TEA that’s also good for your body. A healthy and soothing drink flavored with natural spices and sweeteners giving your body tons of benefits.

ingredients.name: 2- 4 ounces (56.7g-113.4g) fresh ginger root, (about 1 cup chopped peeled ginger)
3-4 cracked cardamon ((I used the green ones that in a pod))
6- 8 cups (1422ml-1896ml) water, (adjust to desired strength, with more or less)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add ginger, star anise, cardamon, and cinnamon sticks to a medium pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in water and place on the stove over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: As soon as the water comes to a boil, reduce the heat to low and cook for about 5-10 minutes. The longer you cook, the stronger the ginger tea is.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Adjust the cooking times as needed. Taste as it simmers and add more water if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the stove off, remove the pot. Sieve the ginger tea using a fine sieve or cheesecloth over a large bowl or teacup or mug. Discard the remaining ingredients. Add lemon juice, start with a 1/4 cup and adjust with more, as needed to suit taste buds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Top with lemon slices and sweetener, if desired.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot. Enjoy!

title: Pork Stock
description: Pork stock is an essential ingredient in the Chinese kitchen, especially in the winter. It has a white semi-transparent color and a meaty taste. It can be added to all sorts of vegetable soups, noodle soups, and stews as a flavor enhancer.

ingredients.name: thumbnail ginger (approx. 1cm by 1cm by 3cm, thickly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put pork bones in a large pot and add water until the pot is 2/3 full. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn off heat and discard the liquid. Transfer the pork bones into a colander to cool down. Rinse thoroughly under tap water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork bones back into the pot and add water again, until 2/3 full. Add ginger and the whole onion. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn to low heat and simmer for 6 hours. Periodically skim the brown foam from the surface of the broth and discard it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: (optional) If there is lean meat attached to the bones, you could choose to leave it to simmer, or take it out and eat it. You can easily separate the meat from the bones with a fork or chopsticks after three hours of boiling. The meat will still be soft and moist. My favorite way is to serve the meat as a snack, with soy sauce and a few slices of ginger for dipping. If you boil the meat for the entire 6 hours, it will be too tough and flavorless to eat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the heat back to medium high to thicken the broth. The final broth should be about 1/3 the original volume.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Wait until the soup cools off and use an airtight container(*) to store it in the fridge for up to 1 week, or in the freezer for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: The broth can be directly used in a stew or as a soup base. Add water to dilute the broth to desired consistency if using in soup.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: (optional) The first batch of broth is ready but the bones can be boiled again to make more broth. You can fill the pot halfway with water and boil another 2 to 3 hours. Store the broth the same way.

title: Southern Chocolate Gravy and Biscuits
description: Thick, rich, and luscious chocolate gravy gives a smooth glazy finish to your regular biscuits or any baked treat. Use it as a topping or simply dip your treats into a warm bowl of chocolatey goodness.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together cocoa powder, all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, and salt until fully mixed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slowly stir in the evaporated milk into the flour mixture until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour into a medium saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently. As soon as it boils, reduce the heat and continue cooking until it's smooth and thick like a gravy, about 7 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla extract into the mixture until the butter is melted. Serve immediately with these Flaky Biscuits HERE, or its bigger counterpart - Cathead Biscuits (recipe coming up soon).

title: Ganga Jamuna Juice Recipe
description: Ganga Jamuna juice is a simple and refreshing juice made with equal parts of oranges and sweet limes. This Mumbai-style juice has a balanced sweet and tangy flavor, making it perfect for hot days.

ingredients.name: to 3 tablespoon sugar (or add as required)
black salt (or add as required, optional)
ice cubes (or water to thin down the juice if required, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and remove the segments from the oranges and sweet limes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the citrus segments to the feeder tube of the juicer. Tip: You can also halve the fruits and manually extract the juice using a citrus fruit juicer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Extract the juice from the juicer and pour it in a bowl or pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add sugar as required. Also add black salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix well to dissolve the sugar. Pour the juice in glasses.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve Ganga Jamuna juice immediately, as it can turn bitter if kept for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add a few ice cubes if you prefer while serving.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: You can also sprinkle a few pinches of chaat masala or roasted cumin powder for extra flavor.

title: Chinese Cucumber Salad
description: Chinese style smashed cucumber salad

ingredients.name: fresh English cucumber ( , or two smaller ones, around 350g)
garlic cloves ( , mashed and then chopped)
~2 tsp. chili oil to taste (, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For long English cucumber, wash the cucumber and peel off tough skins. For small cucumber, remove the two ends.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Smash with a wide kitchen knife (like Chinese slicing knife) until the cucumber is well crushed. Then cut into one bite pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer all cucumber cubes into a bowl. Mix well with mashed garlic, salt and sugar.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Or further add light soy sauce and vinegar to make a more strong version.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Or add chili oil for a hot version.

title: Pa Kimchi (Green Onion Kimchi)
description: An easy kimchi made with thin green onions (also called scallions)!

ingredients.name: small dried or half-dried squid body (about 3 ounce), mareun ojingeo - optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the green onions by removing the root part and any tough/brown outer skins. Wash them thoroughly a couple of times. Shake off excess water, and drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all the seasoning ingredients in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the dried squid into about 2-inch long thin strips. Soak in water until slightly softened if very dry and hard, but this is generally not necessary.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, gently rub the seasoning mixture all over the green onions and the optional squid to evenly coat them.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Hold a couple of green onions together, and fold them before arranging in an airtight container to store. Another option is to tie them together by wrapping the other end of the green onion around the white part, making a circle in the middle, and then running the leafy part through the circle.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Keep it at room temperature for a day, and then refrigerate. Pa kimchi can be eaten right away, but the flavor develops as it ferments over 2 to 3 weeks in the fridge. Run a knife (or a pair of kitchen scissors) through the folded or tied green onions a couple of times to serve.

title: Chili Garlic Tofu Bites เต้าหู้ผัดพริกเกลือ
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: medium-firm tofu or smooth tofu (this is trimmed weight)
green chili (serrano, jalapeno, or use green bell pepper if you don't want it spicy)
of a red bell pepper or another type of red pepper (this is just for colour)
+ ⅛ tsp salt (you need fine-grain salt for this)
sugar (also fine or super fine sugar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut tofu into small cubes, about 2 cm. Place tofu cubes into a container just large enough to hold them, then cover with 1 cup of water and 3 Tbsp of soy sauce. If this amount of water does not completely cover the tofu, add more water but make sure you also add proportionately more soy sauce too. Let it soak for about 15-20 minutes, tasting the tofu at 15 minutes to see whether they are sufficiently salty (should just be mildly seasoned, but we don't want them to be bland). If you want them to be more seasoned, let them sit longer. Once they are sufficiently seasoned, drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While you wait for the tofu to soak, prep the "toppings". Combine the salt, sugar and white pepper into one small bowl. Crush the garlic until they are broken into small chunks and keep them in another bowl. Slice green onions on a bias and put the white part with the garlic and keep the green part separate. Slice the green and red peppers into small pieces or rings and place them with the garlic too.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prep the breading station: Place the all-purpose flour, 1 egg, and the breadcrumbs into separate bowls. Note: The all-purpose flour is optional, you can omit the flour if you like a thinner coating. But if you prefer a thicker, firmer crust that is more resilient to breaking, include the flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Beat the egg really well, making sure there are no more egg white blobs. If the egg is very fresh and is quite thick, add a teaspoon of water to thin it out. Stir black pepper into the breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Breading: Toss the tofu in the flour (if using), a few pieces at a time, them place them in a sieve and gently shake off excess flour as much as possible. Drop them in the egg bowl and turn them around to coat in the egg. Lift the tofu from the egg, one at a time, letting all the excess egg drip off the tofu, then place it into the breadcrumbs and immediately toss it in the breadcrumb to coat. Tip: To prevent gunky hands, keep your wet hand wet and your dry hand dry: so use one hand for the egg, and the other hand for the flour and breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Coat each piece of tofu again in the egg and breadcrumb for a second coat (no flour). You may need to add another egg.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat about 1 1/2 inch of frying oil in a small pot or wok and heat the oil to 325°F (I said 350 in the video, but I find that the coating is less likely to break if the oil is at 325°F). Drop the tofu into the oil and fry for 1 minute until golden brown. Remove from oil and drain on paper towel. If you hear loud cracking sounds while frying, that means one of the pieces has broken, so just find the culprit and remove it.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: TIP FOR EXTRA CRISPY TOFU: I did not mention this in the video, but if you want extra crispy tofu, double fry them! Let the tofu cool first and then fry them again for 1 more minute. It's important to let the tofu cool down to room temp first before frying them again.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Garlic & Chili Topping: Add just a little bit of oil to a wok, then add all the garlic, white part of green onion, and the peppers; saute over medium low heat until the garlic is soft and golden. Turn off the heat, add tofu and toss to mix. Transfer into a mixing bowl, sprinkle about 3/4 of the sugar-salt mixture over the tofu and toss to coat. Taste the tofu before you add in the final little bit—depending on how salty the inside of the tofu is, you may not need the rest. Toss in green onions and serve immediately!

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Cucumber Salsa
description: This Cucumber Salsa is easy to make, refreshing, and perfect for eating with crispy tortilla chips or on tacos, enchiladas, and grilled meats.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, cilantro, jalapeños, garlic, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl. Toss together to coat, taste, and season with more salt and black pepper as needed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to let all the flavors meld together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve with tortilla chips or on tacos, lettuce wraps, salads, fish, or any dish that needs a hint of freshness and brightness.

title: Mediterranean Breakfast Egg Muffins
description: Easy and healthy breakfast egg muffins. These low-carb, freezer friendly egg muffins make a great breakfast on the go! Also perfect for your next brunch, serve along with salad and other Mediterranean favorites (see notes for ideas!)

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil for brushing
small red bell pepper, chopped (about 3/4 cup)
to 4 oz/113 g cooked chicken or turkey, boneless, shredded
oz/ 28. 34 g (about 1/2 cup) chopped fresh parsley leaves
Handful crumbled feta to your liking

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place a rack in the center of your oven and preheat to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a 12-cup muffin pan like this one (or 12 individual muffin cups). Brush with extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide the peppers, tomatoes, shallots, olives, chicken (or turkey), parsley, and crumbled feta among the 12 cups (they should come up to about 2/3 of the way full.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large measuring cup or a mixing bowl, add eggs, salt, pepper, and spices. Whisk well to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the egg mixture carefully over each cup, leaving a little room at the top (should be about 3/4 of the way or so.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place muffin pan or muffin cups on top of a sheet pan (to help catch any spills). Bake in heated oven for about 25 minutes or until the egg muffins are set.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let cool for a few minutes, then run a small butter knife around the edges of each muffin to loosen. Remove from pan and serve!

title: Pulled Pork Egg Rolls
description: Each piece of this flavorful and easy Pulled Pork Egg Rolls screams comfort food whether it's deep-fried or air-fried. A convenient food that can be served as a crowd-pleasing appetizer or as a main dish.

ingredients.name: (142.5g) Kroger Private Selection Kansas City Barbecue Sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place pork in a medium saucepan over medium-heat. Then add enough water to moistened the shredded pork. Let it cook slightly - about 2-3 minutes or until warm through.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove and place in a medium bowl and let it cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, add pork and barbecue sauce, add sauce to your liking. Set aside

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place tortilla or 2 spring roll wrappers on a chopping board or work surface, followed by 2 tablespoons of the pork mixture in the center of each spring roll. Then add about 1-2 tablespoons of coleslaw on top of it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll the spring roll around the filling, folding the edges inward. And begin to roll with the end nearest to you. Brush the edges with flour paste before the final roll to keep the rolls sealed. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat up a medium skillet or cast iron with oil up to 2 inches on medium-high heat at 350 degrees F or until hot but not smoking.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gently drop the spring roll in the frying pan and fry in batches, turning once, until golden brown, about 3-5 minutes. Do not overcrowd the pan (it will absorb excess oil, resulting in soggy rolls).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, remove the egg rolls and place them on paper towels.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: If using an air fryer, brush with canola oil, then bake at 400 degrees F or about 18-20 minutes until golden brown turning once.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature with Simple Truth Ranch Dressing.

title: Onion Chutney Recipe
description: Onion Chutney or Vengaya Chutney is made by sautéing onions, garlic, dried red chilies, spices and tamarind. The mixture is blended smooth and finished with a tempering of mustard seeds, asafoetida and curry leaves.

ingredients.name: to ½ teaspoon (or 1 to 2 small to medium) garlic (- chopped)
oil ((can use sesame oil or sunflower oil or peanut oil))
chana dal ((husked and split bengal gram))
urad dal ((split and husked black gram))
tamarind (or a small piece of tamarind)

title: Instant Pot Congee (鸡肉菠菜粥)
description: This is your perfect one-bowl dinner. It only takes 2 minutes prepare and you’ll have dinner ready in 30 minutes. The recipe works in a normal pressure cooker too.

ingredients.name: chicken broth (, for a thicker congee (7 to 8 cups for thinner congee))
chicken breasts ((or 4 boneless skinless thighs, about 1.5 lbs (680 g)))
Sriracha sauce or homemade chili oil
Crushed roasted peanuts or roasted sesame seeds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add Jasmine rice into a large bowl. Add tap water to cover. Use your hand to rinse the rice gently a couple times, then drain the water. Repeat 2 times. Transfer the drained rice into the Instant pot. Add chicken broth, chicken, and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Close and seal the lid. Set to cook in manual mode on high pressure for 15 minutes. If using a pressure cooker, cook over medium heat until the pressure is added. Then cook on high pressure with medium-low heat for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use natural release once done. Do not use fast release. (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the chicken breasts to a big plate and shred them with forks. Transfer the chicken back into the pot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn on saute function. Add the spinach into the pot. Cook and stir for 1 minute and turn off the Instant Pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add toasted sesame oil and green onion. Stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the congee into small serving bowls. Garnish with any toppings you prefer. Or you can simply serve the hot congee as it is.

title: Lazarakia bread recipe (Greek Easter Lazarus breads)
description: This Easter try out this aromatic little Lazarakia (Greek Lazarus breads) recipe and combine tradition with family cooking creating wonderful memories for your family!

ingredients.name: sugar dissolved in 50g/ 2 oz. water for coating

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Lazarakia bread recipe start by adding all the ingredients from the “mixture 1” into the bowl of a stand mixer. Mix to combine. Set aside for 10-15 minutes to allow the yeast to work.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate bowl add the flour, spices, salt and sugar and mix with a spoon to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add this mixture in the stand mixers bowl along the yeast mixture from step 1. Pour in the olive oil and vegetable oil. Use a dough hook to knead the dough until smooth and not sticky for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the bowl with a towel and let it rise in a warm environment for about 1 hour, until it doubles its size.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Gently deflate the dough with your hands and separate the dough in 20 balls. Shape each ball like shown in the pictures.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Dissolve the sugar in the water and brush the top of the breads.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 160-170C for about 20 minutes until golden and cooked through. Enjoy!

title: Corn Fritters ทอดมันข้าวโพด
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: large ear fresh corn, uncooked (about 250 g of kernels)
a jalapeno, seeds and pith removed, small diced (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice corn kernels off the cob with a sharp knife (see video @1:00 for my technique) and place the kernels into a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another bowl, stir together flour, cornstarch or rice flour, salt, coconut, green onions, sesame seeds, and jalapenos. Add 1 cup of ice water and stir just until the batter is smooth, adding the rest of the water only as needed. The batter should be thin enough that it is easily pourable and is not gloppy, but not as thin as a crepe batter. (When in doubt, err on the side of the batter being too thick. It's much easier to add more water to thin it out if your first batch turns out to be too clumpy.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour about ¾ of the batter over the corn and stir to mix well. If it looks like it needs more batter, add some or all of the remaining batter. Note: How much batter you need will depend on the size of your corn, and also whether you like your fritters with more or less batter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat about 1-inch of vegetable oil in a pot over medium heat to 375°F. Drop the batter by the spoonful into the oil, 1 heaping tablespoon at a time. Fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes, flipping the fritters half way through. If the first batch of your fritters look clumpy, add a little more water to your batter so that the kernels spread into a nice round disc once they are dropped into the oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain on paper towel and serve immediately with Sriracha Hot Sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Crispy Pork Belly (Siu Yuk)
description: Crispy pork belly is one of my favorite Cantonese dishes for the years in Guangdong province.

ingredients.name: sea salt to cover the meat

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the pork belly in a large pot with clean water, add cooking wine, scallion, ginger and sichuan peppercorn. Continue cook for 3 minutes after boiling.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the pork out and pat dry the water. Then pork as many holes on the rind. Back and forth and repeat several times. This is the most important step.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: After the hard pork process, apply a small pinch of salt on the rind.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut two shallow lines on the pork (only the lean part, not deep to touch the fat) and then sprinkle the dry rub evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Wrap the pork belly with foil wrappers and place in fridge overnight.Uncovered please, we need the rind to be dry before roasting.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pre-heat oven to 180 degree C. Brush a thin layer of vinegar and spread salt evenly to form a protecting layer. Roast for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the salt and place the pork belly on the middle rack. Remember to use a tray to catch the dropping oils. Use upper fire only at the temperature of 220 degree C, and roast until the rind is golden brown and well crackled.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let the pork belly stay in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes until slightly cooled down. Transfer out and cut into small bites.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cutting tips: when cutting the pork belly, place the skin side down. Cut the meat part firstly and then press the knife to break the crispy rinds.

description: This baked chicken wings recipe creates flavorful crispy wings without using extra flours or coatings! Topped with a finger-licking good honey lime sauce, these wings are gluten free, low carb and paleo.

title: Jerusalem Bagel Recipe
description: Jerusalem bagel, called Ka'ak Al Quds, are soft and airy oval-shaped bagels with a slight sweetness, thanks to the honeyed sesame topping! These are easy to make and take only a few familiar ingredients.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour or white bread flour
whole milk (or unsweetened almond milk for vegan option) (warm)
sesame seeds (I used raw white sesame seeds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix and knead the dough. Put the flour, sugar, salt, milk, yeast, and baking powder in the bowl of a freestanding mixer fitted with the dough hook (do not add the olive oil yet). Mix on medium speed until the dough comes together forming a soft and pliable ball. If you do not have a mixer, mix the dough ingredients in a large bowl and knead by hand (you can knead on a clean surface if that is easier for you) until the dough is smooth and pliable (it will take a bit longer this way, but will work). You are looking for a soft, elastic but robust dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Allow the dough to rise. Rub the dough with a little bit olive oil and place it in a large bowl. Cove with plastic wrap or a damp kitchen towel. Set aside in a warm spot for 1 hour; the dough should rise and double in size.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Work on the sesame coating. In a large shallow baking dish, combine the sesame seeds and honey with 1 tablespoon of water. Mix, adding a bit more water as necessary, until you have a wet mixture that is neither too sticky and thick that it clumps up, nor too thin (you’ll need to be able to coat the dough in the sesame seeds and have them stick).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the dough and make 6 equal pieces. Punch down the risen dough and divide it into 6 portions that are equal in size. Place them on a lightly floured work surface. Roll and stretch each piece into a log (about 8-12 inches long), then attach the ends together to form a ring (you should end up with 6 rings). Gently stretch out the rings to form ovals rather than circles. Set aside for 15 minutes to rest.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the oven to 450 degrees F (gas mark 8).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Coat the rings or bagels with the sesame coating. Take each dough ring and dip it in the sesame mixture. Set it on a large baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining rings. Allow the rings to rest on the baking sheet one more time for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake. Place the baking sheet (or sheets) in the heated oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the bagels cook through and turn a deep golden color.

title: Air Fryer Chicken Legs
description: Juicy, tasty, and lip-smacking good chicken legs oozing with natural flavors. This air fryer chicken dish takes away the messy and oily spills in cooking your favorite comfort food.

ingredients.name: (1g) bouillon powder ((you may replace with salt))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash chicken legs, thoroughly dry and place on a cookie sheet in a single layer, then let them sit in the fridge for at least an hour or overnight. Do not cover them; let the air-dry them out. This step is not a must but a recommendation for extra crispy skin. If pressed for time, omit.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Salt and pepper the chicken, then thoroughly mixed with spices above or use any of our favorite spice mix we have on this blog. Jerk seasoning, Creole, or Italian seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the Air Fryer - I preheat mine at 400 Degrees F for 5 minutes - when ready to air fry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Set your Air Fryer to 380°F. Place chicken legs in the air fryer basket. Do not overcrowd. You might have to do so in batches.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook chicken for about 18-20 minutes depending on the size of your chicken. Also, keep in mind that each air fryer cooks differently. If it is your first time making chicken, check frequently especially the last few minutes of cooking, and adjust according to desired brownness.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Flip the chicken legs halfway through while cooking. Chicken legs should be brown and thoroughly cooked through before serving.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove and toss with sauce or serve with Ranch or Blue Cheese Dressing here.

title: Savory Oatmeal with Chicken and Spinach
description: Learn how to create a hearty, whole grain savory oatmeal bowl with only 4 ingredients and in 5 minutes!

ingredients.name: Bob’s Red Mill Quick Cooking Rolled Oats
leftover chicken (, shredded or cut finely)
Green peas and chopped cherry tomatoes
Crushed roasted peanuts ((or sesame for garnish))
Sesame oil (soy sauce or chili oil to finish the dish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add chicken stock to a small pot and bring to a boil. Add rolled oats, leftover chicken and spinach. Cook for 5 minutes and until the oats are cooked through. Stir occasionally. Add salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add preferred toppings and serve hot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: You can make the oatmeal ahead and store it in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Reheat in microwave without cover until hot. Stir once in between.

title: Chocolate Cake Greek style (Sokolatopita)
description: A mouthwatering Greek style chocolate cake recipe (Sokolatopita) with ingredients you already have in your kitchen and no mixer required!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek chocolate cake add in a large bowl the flour, baking powder, sugar, cocoa powder and salt. Whisk well using a hand whisk to combine the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the same bowl add the water, vanilla essence and orange zest and whisk well to form a cake batter. Be careful to scrape the flour from the bottom of the bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Butter a 22×30 cm baking dish and pour in the chocolate cake batter. Bake on preheated oven at 170C/340F for about 30 min.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the chocolate cake form the oven and let it cool for about 1-2 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare the sauce. In double boiler add the chocolate in small pieces, the milk and butter and stir with a spatula until the chocolate melts and the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Use a fork to make some holes on the top of the chocolate cake and pour over the chocolate sauce.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve while still warm with vanilla ice cream. Enjoy!

steps.description: Pre-heat oven to 150 degree C. Spread peanuts evenly on baking sheet and roast for 15 to 20 minutes. Mix the peanuts evenly once or twice to make sure they are evenly cooked.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the sugar along with water and a small pinch of salt in a pan. Heat over medium to low fire. Stir from time to time until the thin syrup form large white bubbles . Slow down fire, stir in the peanuts and make the peanuts well coated with syrup.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer out gently and cool until completely cooled down. Transfer to air-tight container. Keep in shadow place up to 1 week.

title: Maekjeok (Doenjang Marinated Pork)
description: This doenjang marinated pork is another great option for your Korean BBQ. The salty, savory doenjang adds a deep umami flavor to the pork without overpowering it.

ingredients.name: pork (Boston butt or loin), thinly sliced (about 1/4-inch thick)
doenjang, 된장, Korean fermented soybean paste
rice wine or mirin (or other white wine)
honey, rice syrup (jocheong, 조청), or oligo dang (올리고당) (or Maesil cheong (매실청), green plum extract )
If unavailable, substitute with 1 medium onion, thinly sliced
or 2 heads of red or green leaf lettuce
gochujang, Korean red chili pepper paste
doenjang, Korean soybean paste (or to taste)
If the sauce is too thick, use a tablespoon of water or soda to thin it.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the meat (about 1/4-inch thick), if not pre-sliced.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a bowl and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the meat, and mix well until evenly coated. Marinate at least for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the optional vegetables into 2 - 3 inch lengths. Heat a skillet with a tablespoon of oil, and briefly stir-fry the vegetables until slightly wilted. Salt to taste. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a grill pan or a skillet over medium high heat and add the pork slices. Immediately lower the heat to medium. The marinade will burn if the heat is too high. Cook until the pork is cooked through and slightly caramelized, one to two minutes each side. Turn over a couple of times to prevent the marinade from burning.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve on a bed of the optional stir-fried vegetables along with the vegetables for the wraps and ssamjang.

title: Crispy Laab Meatballs ลาบทอด (Laab Tod)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Thai sticky rice or jasmine rice, uncooked
kaffir lime leaves, torn into chunks, stem removed
chopped sawtooth coriander (or use more cilantro)
Mint and butter lettuce for serving

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a dry pan, toast sticky rice and kaffir lime leaves over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until the rice is a deep golden brown and the lime leaves are crisp. Let cool slightly and grind both the rice and the lime leaves in a mortar and pestle until fine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine pork, flour, toasted rice powder, shallots, lemongrass, galangal, cilantro, sawtooth coriander, lime juice, fish sauce and chili flakes; mix well. If you want to taste the mix for seasoning, you can cook up a small amount in the microwave or on a frying pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Form loosely into 1.5-inch balls and fry in 350°F oil until browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve on its own or make a wrap with a piece of lettuce and mint. Enjoy!

title: Simple Roasted Carrots Recipe
description: A couple of small tips make all the difference in making the BEST roasted carrots! Roasted at a high temperature, these carrots are perfectly tender with beautiful caramelized edges.

ingredients.name: carrots (pealed and cut on the diagonal)
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat your oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the sliced carrots in a large mixing bowl, and add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (about 2 tbsp or so.) Season with kosher salt and black pepper. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the carrots to a baking pan, making sure to spread them well in one single layer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roast in the heated oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender and slightly caramelized. Check part-way through and turn carrots over to get even color on both sides.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from oven. Transfer the roasted carrots to a serving bowl. Here, you can add flavor to your liking. To follow the recipe, season with turmeric and harissa spice blend. If you like, add a little minced garlic and a splash of lime juice. Toss to combine. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Greek Omelette recipe with Feta cheese
description: Add a mediterannean twist to your plate with this flavourful Greek omelette recipe with feta cheese, black olives and tomato!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this delicious Greek omelette recipe start by preparing the ingredients first.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the seeds and extra juice from the tomato and cut the flesh in small cubes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the pits from the olives and cut in small pieces. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Crumble the feta cheese with your hands or using a fork and set side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Crack the eggs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Beat the eggs with a fork until combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a small-medium non stick frying pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add 2 tbsps olive oil and the beaten eggs. Using a spatula, drag the omelette towards the one end of the pan and tilt the pan to let the raw eggs fill the empty side. Repeat this process for approx. 1-2 minutes until the omelette is cooked. (the eggs are set but the top is still slightly moist)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat and add the tomato, feta cheese, olives, oregano.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Slip the spatula underneath omelette, tip to loosen and gently fold omelette in half. Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve.

title: Air Fryer Hush Puppies
description: This crispy, tasty, and super-easy comfort food gives you a healthier take on this classic cornmeal treat. A hassle-free version of the southern favorite made instantly without giving you those few extra pounds.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, sugar, salt, and garlic powder.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk and lightly beaten eggs until well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, and mix until fully incorporated. Then add grated onions and butter.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lightly grease the metal basket with cooking spray and arrange hush puppies in a single layer without touching each other.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Set your air fryer to 380°F (193℃) and cook them for 4-5 minutes. Flip them over carefully and cook them on the other side for an additional 4 minutes or until cooked through and crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with this fried fish or remoulade sauce.

title: Chinese Olive Fried Rice (橄榄菜炒饭)
description: Introducing the Teochew olive vegetable, the single ingredient that will make your fried rice irresistible!

ingredients.name: heaping tablespoons Chinese olive vegetables ((*see footnote 2))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add bacon to a large nonstick pan and turn to medium heat or medium high heat (*see footnote 3). Stir and cook until golden and the fat is rendered.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: (Optional) If the bacon you use is too fatty, you might get a lot of rendered fat. Remove some of the fat by dipping a paper towel into the pan with a pair of tongs. I personally like to leave a bit of bacon fat in the pan, which will make the rice extra flavorful.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add garlic. Stir a few times until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add olive vegetables. Cook and stir until you can hear a vibrant sizzling. It might only take a few seconds if the pan is properly heated. Olive vegetables contain oil, so your pan should be greased and ready for the rest of the cooking. If you removed too much bacon fat earlier, you might want to add a small spoon of oil here, so the rice won’t dry out.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add rice. Cook and chop the rice with a spatula until separated into grains and heated through. Swirl in soy sauce and stir to mix well. You should again hear vibrant sizzling, throughout the cooking, without burning the ingredients. Adjust heat accordingly and remove the pan from the stove if it’s getting too hot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Move everything to one side of the pan. Add cucumber. Cook and stir for a few seconds to heat them.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Mix cucumber with the other ingredients, and move everything to one side of the pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add vegetable oil and beaten egg to the other side of the pan. Wait until the bottom sets. Stir everything together. Carefully taste the rice. The cucumber should be cooked through and the rice slightly crisped. Add green onion, stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Tofu Bibimbap
description: A simple, vegan bibimbap with tofu

ingredients.name: apple cider (or 1 tablespoon Korean plum extract, maesilcheong and 1 tablespoon water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the rice in a rice cooker or following package directions, using a little less water than called for. Rice for bibimbap should be slightly drier than usual for best results.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the zucchini into match sticks. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes. Squeeze out the liquid. Heat a pan with a little bit of oil. Add the zucchini and 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic. Sauté for 2 - 3 minutes over medium high heat. Stir in 1 teaspoon sesame oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Blanch the baby kale briefly in salted boiling water. Drain quickly, and shock in cold water. Drain again, and squeeze out the water. Toss with 1/2 teaspoon garlic, 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil, and salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the carrots into match sticks. Heat the pan again with a little bit of oil. Sauté the carrots for 1 - 2 minutes over medium high heat until slightly softened. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the stems off the mushrooms and cut into 1/4-inch thin slices. Sauté in the lightly oiled pan for 2 - 3 minutes over medium high heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cut the tofu into about 3/4-inch cubes, and lightly sprinkle with salt. Heat the pan with a tablespoon of oil, and pan-fry the tofu until all sides are lightly golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place a serving of rice in a bowl. Nicely arrange a small amount of each prepared vegetable over the rice and top with a few tofu pieces. Drizzle a little sesame oil over. Serve with the red pepper paste sauce.

title: Green Curry Spring Rolls
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: - 2 Tbsp green curry paste (this depends on how spicy you want it)
A big handful Thai basil leaves
A dash of fish sauce, as needed
kaffir lime leaves, centre stem removed and finely julienned
3-4 Tbsp bread crumbs (you may not need this, this is just in case the filling ends up too wet)
Thai sweet chili dipping sauce (homemade recipe here)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Julienne about 10 basil leaves and add to a mortar and pestle, chop the rest and save it for later. Add the curry paste and pound until the leaves are blended into the paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pot or wok, reduce coconut milk by about half. Add the curry paste and sugar, then cook, stirring constantly, until aromatic and thick. Add the ground chicken or turkey and break up the pieces so there are no more chunks. Keep cooking to dry out the mixture, until there is no liquid pooling at the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once dry, add all vegetables and kaffir lime leaves, then cook for about 1-2 minutes or just until the vegetables are softened slightly. Taste and add fish sauce as needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the cornstarch slurry over the mixture (don't pour into one spot) and stir to mix immediately. You will notice that the mixture will start to hold together better.

steps.title: Step 5

title: Green Curry Rice Balls ข้าวแกงทอด

ingredients.name: green bell peppers, very small diced

Kaffir lime leaves, very finely chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook rice and sticky rice together using the ratio of 1 part rice to 1 part of water, so 1 cup of water for the amount given in this recipe.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the curry: in a blender, blend ½ cup coconut milk with Thai basil until smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small pot, add ¼ cup of coconut milk and bring to a boil. Add curry paste and saute until the paste is thick. Add fish sauce, sugar and ground chicken, and stir to break up the chicken as well as you can—big chunks of chicken will make it hard to form balls. Once the chicken is cooked, add the blended coconut milk and kaffir lime leaves and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the rice is done and while it is still hot, add the hot curry and bell peppers over the rice and stir until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Pack the rice as tightly as you can and let cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once cooled, use a disher or a spoon to portion out rice and form it tightly into a ball. Tip: The smaller you make the balls, the harder it becomes to shape them unless you have tiny hands! On the flip side, the larger they are, the more oil you’ll need and the lower the ratio of crunchy crust to rice. I like them to be about 1½ - 2 Tbsp per ball.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the batter by placing flour into a small bowl and make a well in the center. Add water, beaten egg and fish sauce and stir until there are no more lumps. If it’s thick and gloopy, add a little more water until the batter pours smoothly. Add panko to another bowl. Dip the rice balls into the batter, shake off excess a couple of times, then toss in the panko, pressing the panko gently onto the rice balls, until completely coated. Place on a plate. You can make the balls up to this point and refrigerate until ready to fry. You can also freeze them and thaw before frying.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry in 350°F (175°C) oil for about 2 minutes or until golden brown. Serve, you don’t need any dipping sauce these are already so flavourful!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To reheat: preheat the oven to 375°F and bake for 7 mins or until hot inside (timing depends on how big the rice balls are).

title: Vegan Kimchi
description: Vegan kimchi that's as good as the traditional version! It tastes nice and clean!

ingredients.name: Korean coarse sea salt for making kimchi (much less (reduce by 1/4 or 1/3 depending on your salt))
large mustard green, gat (갓), leaves - optional
Korean red chili pepper flakes (gochugaru (add a couple more tablespoons if you like))
apple or Korean pear (grated (or blended with garlic and ginger below))
minced garlic (add one more tablespoon if you like)
salt or to taste (start with 1 and gradually add after tasting
glutinous rice (you can also use 3 TBS cooked rice, blended with apple or Korean pear noted above)
a large bowl or pot (7 - 8 quarts)
a 3/4 - 1 gallon airtight container or jar

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the stem end of cabbage lengthwise in half only about 3 - 4 inches in. Then, slowly pull apart to separate into two pieces by hand. Do the same for each half to make quarters. Running the knife through all the way would unnecessarily cut off the cabbage leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, dissolve 1/2 cup of coarse sea salt in 5 cups of water. Thoroughly bathe each cabbage quarter in the saltwater one at a time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using the other half cup of salt and starting from the outermost leaf, generously sprinkle salt over the thick white part of each leaf. Repeat with the rest of the cabbage quarters. Try to salt all the cabbage quarters with the 1/2 cup salt, but you can use a little more if needed. Set aside for about 6 - 8 hours, rotating the bottom ones to the top halfway through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the glutinous rice paste and the broth and cool. Prepare the other seasoning ingredients. Mix all the seasoning ingredients. Set aside while preparing the other ingredients until the red pepper flakes become pasty.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: The cabbages should be ready to be washed when the white parts are bendable with a bit of resistance. Rinse thoroughly 3 times, especially between the white parts.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain well, cut side down.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cut the radish into matchsticks (you can use a mandoline if available). Roughly chop the scallions and the optional mustard green. Transfer to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Combine with the seasoning mix. Mix well by hand. Taste a little bit. It should be a little too salty to eat as is. Let it sit for 30 minutes to an hour to allow the flavors to meld nicely.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cut off the tough stem part from each cabbage quarter, leaving enough to hold the leaves together. Place one cabbage quarter in the bowl with the radish mix. Spread the radish mix over each leaf, one to two tablespoons for large leaves. Eyeball the stuffing into 4 parts and use one part for each cabbage quarter.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Fold the leaf part of the cabbage over toward the stem and nicely wrap with the outermost leaf before placing it, cut side up, in a jar or airtight container. Repeat with the remaining cabbages. Once all the cabbages are in the jar or airtight container, press down hard to remove air pockets. Rinse the bowl that contained the radish mix with 1/4 cup of broth (if any remaining) or water and pour over the kimchi.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Leave it out at room temperature for a full day or two, depending on how fast you want your kimchi to ripe. Then, store in the fridge. Although you can start eating it any time, kimchi needs about two weeks in the fridge to fully develop the flavors. It maintains great flavor and texture for several weeks.
