title: Conchas (Mexican Pan Dulce)
description: These sweet and fluffy Conchas are one of the most popular types of pan dulce in Mexican bakeries! Here's how to make this sweet bread at home!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the dough. In a cup or bowl, heat the milk in the microwave in 15-second increments or on the stove until it's just warm to the touch. A thermometer should read around 110°F-115°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir in the yeast and 1 tablespoon of the sugar. Loosely cover with plastic wrap and let it stand for 5 minutes until it gets very foamy. If the mixture doesn't get foamy, throw it out and start again with a new packet of yeast.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer (or a regular large bowl), whisk together the all-purpose flour, remaining sugar, and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Attach the dough hook to the mixer and add the melted butter, eggs, and yeast mixture. Mix on medium-low speed for 6-8 minutes (or mix by hand), until the dough becomes smooth and elastic. The dough will be slightly tacky but not completely sticky. If it is still fairly sticky, knead in 1 tablespoon of additional flour at a time until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat a large bowl with oil and transfer the dough to the bowl, shaping it into a ball. Cover it with a kitchen towel and let it rise for 2 hours until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape into balls. Place 6 balls on each of the prepared baking sheets and cover loosely with clean kitchen towels. Let the balls rise again for 1.5 hours in a warm place, or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Prepare the topping. Beat together the flour, powdered sugar, and butter in a large mixing bowl with a handheld mixer until light and fully.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Divide the mixture into 2 equal pieces and place each halve in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Make the white vanilla topping by adding vanilla extract to half of the dough, and beat until combined. Gather the dough with your hands, divide it into 6 equal pieces and shape into balls.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Make the brown chocolate topping by adding cocoa powder to the other half of the dough, and beat until combined. Gather the dough with your hands, divide it into 6 equal pieces, and shape into balls.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Lightly flatten each ball in between two sheets of plastic wrap using a tortilla press. You could also use a rolling pin to shape the topping into rounds.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Assemble the conchas. Carefully remove the rolled out topping from the plastic wrap and drape it onto the risen concha dough. Lightly pat it down to secure the topping onto the dough.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. While the oven is preheating, cut grooves into the topping using a paring knife so it resembles a clam shell, a criss cross pattern, or whichever pattern you prefer.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Bake for 20-25 minutes, until the dough is lightly golden brown. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Ribollita Recipe
description: It doesn't get better than a satisfying pot of Ribollita, a classic Tuscan soup that's made with white beans, vegetables, and hearty day-old bread. Make it stovetop or in your slow-cooker (see notes section for this option).

ingredients.name: canned whole San Marzano tomatoes ((or any whole canned tomatoes you like) )
15- oz cans cannellini beans (drained and well rinsed)
kale, (thick stems and veins removed, chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Tear the bread into large pieces and put it on a large sheet pan. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and toss to make sure the bread is coated. Spread the bread in one layer on the sheet pan. Bake in the heated oven for about 10 minutes or until somewhat toasted and golden brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large cooking pot, heat 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the onions, celery and carrots. Sprinkle a little kosher salt. Lower the heat to medium and cook, tossing regularly, until softened. Add the garlic, and cook for 30 seconds to 1 minute, tossing regularly (do not let the garlic brown).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the tomatoes, white wine and broth. Cook over medium heat for little bit, stirring and breaking up the tomatoes with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the bowl of a food processor fitted with a blade, combine about 1/2 cup of the brothy tomato mixture and 1 cup of the cannelini beans. Puree.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To the pot with the tomato mixture, add the parmesan rind, fresh thyme, bay leaf, oregano, crushed red pepper flakes and a pinch of kosher salt. Stir to combine. Let simmer over medium heat for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Now add the white beans (both the whole and pureed beans) and fresh kale (stir to make sure the kale is submerged in the soup) to the cooking pot. Let the kale cook for a few minutes. Add 1/2 of the toasted ciabatta bread and stir. Let simmer a little bit longer until the kale has fully cooked and the bread has softened and absorbed some fo the liquid (see notes).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the heat. Remove what is left of the Parmesan rind, bay leaf and thyme sprigs. Top the soup with a bit more of the toasted bread. Finish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkle of Parmesan, if you like. Enjoy!

title: Authentic Greek Fava recipe (Yellow Split Peas Puree)
description: Creamy and super tasty! If you' ve been looking for a fava recipe that actually tastes like the one served in Greece, then you have to try this authentic Greek fava recipe.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the split peas with plenty of water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat; add 2-3 tbsps olive oil, the chopped onions, garlic and some fresh thyme and sauté.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: As soon as the onions start to caramelise add the peas and blend. Pour in the warm water and the olive oil, turn the heat down to medium and season well with salt and pepper. Simmer with the lid on for about 40-50 minutes, until the split peas are thick and mushy. While the split peas boil, some white foam will probably surface on the water. Remove the foam with a slotted spoon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When done, pour in the lemon juice and transfer the mixture in food processor. Mix, until the peas become smooth and creamy, like a puree.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the fava with a drizzle of olive oil, a tablespoon of diced onion and some capper or chopped parsley. Enjoy!

title: Uyghur Lamb Pilaf (Polo, 羊肉抓饭)
description: The rice is infused with tons of flavor from the lamb, cumin, and chili peppers, creating a sensational feast. The onion and carrot have a tender, buttery texture.

ingredients.name: (600 grams) lamb spare ribs (, cut into 1 or 2 segments (*see footnote))
dried chili peppers (reduce to 2 to 3, for less spicy dish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut lamb spare ribs into 1 or 2 segments. Prepare vegetables.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a wok over medium high heat until warm. Add garlic and ginger. Stir a few times until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Carefully add lamb ribs and let them cook without stirring for 1 minute. Stir and cook for 1 minute. Add 1 teaspoon salt. Stir and cook until the surface of ribs is cooked and turns golden brown, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add onion, stir to mix well, for 1 minute. Add carrot. Stir and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 3 cups water. Cook until brought to a boil. Skim brown foam from the surface. Add sugar, cumin powder, and chili peppers. Place Sichuan peppercorn in a tea infuser and add it into the wok. Bring to a boil again, then turn to low heat and cover. Cook for 1 hour 30 minutes. During cooking, check on the lamb 3 to 4 times. After 1 hour, add the remaining 1 teaspoon salt. If the water is reducing quickly and no longer covers the lamb, carefully add just enough hot water to cover.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Forty minutes before the lamb is ready, prepare the rice. Rinse rice 2 to 3 times. Cover with water and let soak for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the lamb is ready, use a spatula to push the lamb to the edges of the wok and leave some room in the center. Add rice to fill the space. If the water doesn’t cover the rice completely, add more hot water, about 1/2 to 1 cup. Cover the wok and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Uncover, stir, and continue cooking until the water is almost absorbed, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer everything to a large dutch oven (or a big pot with a thick bottom). Cover and simmer over lowest heat for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Easy Lasagna Recipe
description: A classic dish made with layers of gooey cheeses and rich, meaty sauce, baked to golden-brown perfection! This deliciousness is a true crowd-pleaser, appealing to even the most discriminating eater.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large pot over medium heat, add a little olive oil, and then add the ground beef and pork. Break the meat up into small pieces with a spoon. If there's any excess fat, remove it with a wooden spoon and discard it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add onion and garlic and stir until the meat is well browned. Stir in Italian seasoning, parsley, basil, fennel, bay leaves, salt, and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, water, and chicken bouillon.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir to combine and bring to a low boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally. If the sauce gets too thick, add ½ cup water. If the mixture gets too dry, add ¼ cup of tomato sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, put lasagna noodles in the bottom of a large pan. Pour boiling water directly over them (you can stack them), ensuring each noodle is covered with water. Soak them for 30 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water to prevent them from sticking together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese with an egg, 2 tablespoons parsley, dried parmesan, ½ teaspoon salt, and nutmeg. Refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375°F/190℃ and spray a 9x13 casserole dish with olive oil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To start, divide the ricotta mixture and meat sauce into thirds. Spread about 1½ cups of your meat sauce at the bottom of the dish. Place noodles on top, lengthwise. Spread with ⅓ of the ricotta cheese mixture. Top with ¼ of mozzarella cheese slices. Spoon 1½ cups of meat sauce over mozzarella. Repeat this two more times for a completed three layers. Lastly, place the final layer of pasta and top it with another cup of meat sauce to cover the pasta. Top with remaining mozzarella. Cover the dish with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake in the preheated 375°F/190℃ oven for 50 minutes, taking out after 25 minutes to remove the foil, then reinserting it into the oven or until the cheese on top is golden brown.

title: Patatas Bravas Recipe
description: Patatas bravas is a classic Spanish tapas dish made with crispy fried potato cubes served with a spicy tomato and smoked paprika based bravas sauce and a creamy garlic aioli. The potatoes are soaked, dried and fried until golden and crisp.

ingredients.name: potatoes (– Yukon gold, Russet, Maris Piper or baby potatoes)
cold water (– as required, for soaking potatoes)
oil (– any neutral flavored oil for frying)
lemon juice (or add according to taste)
to ½ teaspoon sugar (or add as required)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and cut potatoes into cubes. Soak them in cold water for 20 to 30 minutes, then drain and dry completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the aioli sauce by mixing mayonnaise, garlic, pepper and lemon juice. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For the bravas sauce, sauté garlic in extra virgin olive oil until light golden.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn off the heat. Add tomato paste and bay leaf.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Next add in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, red chili flakes and ground black pepper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Switch on the heat and mix well. Sauté for 1 to 2 minutes on low heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add water, oregano, salt and sugar. Mix and simmer the bravas sauce on low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Finish with vinegar and continue to simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Turn off heat. Remove the bay leaf and transfer the bravas sauce to a bowl.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Heat oil and fry the potatoes in batches until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towels and season lightly with salt.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place the fried potatoes in a serving dish. Spoon the bravas sauce over and drizzle aioli. Serve hot.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve patatas bravas immediately for best texture and flavor.

title: Beoseot Jeongol (Mushroom Hot Pot)
description: A healthy, delicious Korean hot pot made with mushrooms! It's vegan and so easy to put together!

ingredients.name: Korean radish ( cut into big chunks)
assorted mushrooms (button, shiitake, oyster, crimini, enoki, king, etc.)
large napa cabbage leaves (or green cabbage or bok choy)
ssukgat (쑥갓, crown daisies), watercress, or minari (미나리, water dropwort)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 5 cups water and the broth vegetables to a medium size pot. Bring it to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for about 15 minutes. Discard the vegetables. Season with the soup soy sauce, salt and pepper to taste. Yields 3 to 4 cups.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the mushrooms into bite size slices (about 1/4-inch thick). Mushrooms cook down quite a bit, so don’t cut too thin. If using oyster mushrooms, split lengthwise into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Neatly arrange the mushrooms and scallions in clusters along with other vegetables, if using, in a shallow pot. Add 2 cups of broth. Boil over medium to medium high heat until mushrooms are softened, 4 – 5 minutes. You can add more broth and any remaining ingredients while eating if you’re cooking at the table.

title: Shepherd's Pie
description: This hearty casserole epitomizes mouthwatering comfort food. Savory meat and vegetables simmered in a rich gravy, topped with buttery, creamy mashed potatoes, and baked until golden and slightly crispy.

ingredients.name: (165g) frozen sweet corn kernels, (rinsed and drained)

title: Steamed Mussels with Thai Herbs
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: stalk lemongrass, thinly sliced on a bias
kaffir lime leaves, torn into chunks, center rib removed
cherry tomatoes, halved (I prefer a mix of orange and red ones for extra colour)
For serving: grilled or toasted bread for dipping

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse mussels twice in cold water. If there are open ones, give them a tap and if they don't close, discard them (mussels close slowly, so be patient with them!). If the shells have barnacles and seaweeds growing on them, as is the case for wild mussels, give them a scrub. To debeard mussels: Some mussels already come debearded, some aren't. The beard is the tough, stringy stuff that usually sticks out between the shells, and it's what the mussels use to attach themselves to rocks or other structures. This beard is tough and not pleasant to eat so you want to remove it by grabbing on the the beard with a thin rag or a paper towel and pull it firmly towards the hinge of the shells until it detaches.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pot large enough to hold the mussels, sauté garlic and onion in the vegetable oil until the garlic starts to turn golden. Add the stock, lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, Thai chilies, 1 cup of the tomatoes, and fish sauce; bring to a boil. Add the mussels, cover the pot, and cook for about 2 minutes until the mussels are open (it will take longer if you're cooking a lot of mussels). I find it helpful to stir the mussels half way through to help distribute the heat, especially if you're cooking a large pot of mussels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the mussels are open, turn off the heat and stir in Thai basil, cilantro and the remaining 1/2 cup of cherry tomatoes. Close the lid for 20-30 seconds to let the residual heat warm up the fresh tomatoes and distribute the aroma of the basil and cilantro.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: You can serve it as is or add the lime juice for some added fresh tartness. Give the broth a taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Avgolemono: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
description: Greek Avgolemono Soup Recipe. Silky, rich, fragrant chicken soup, prepared Greek-style with avgolemono sauce, which is a Greek lemon-egg sauce with warm broth. Best part, this weeknight version comes together in just over 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (I used Private Reserve Greek olive oil)
to 1 cup finely chopped green onions
cooked boneless chicken breast pieces, shredded ( about 6 to 8 oz store-bought rotisserie chicken will work)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat 1 tbsp olive oil on medium-high. Add the carrots, celery and green onions, toss together to saute briefly then stir in the garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the chicken broth and bay leaves then raise the heat to high. Once the liquid has come to a rolling boil, add the rice, salt and pepper. Turn the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender. Now stir in the cooked chicken.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the egg-lemon sauce, in a medium bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and eggs. While whisking add 2 ladles-full of the broth from the cooking pot (this helps temper the eggs). Once fully combined, add the sauce to the chicken soup and stir. Remove from the heat immediately.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Garnish with fresh parsley, if you like. Serve hot with your favorite bread. Enjoy!

title: Pulao Recipe | Vegetable Pulao (Veg Pulav)
description: Veg Pulao or Pulav (also called Pilaf) is an easy vegetarian one-pot rice dish made with basmati rice, mixed vegetables, whole spices, and herbs. You can use vegetables like peas, potatoes, and green beans.

ingredients.name: basmati rice (- 300 grams, rinsed & soaked for 20 to 30 minutes)
baby corn (- sliced or chopped, optional)
thinly sliced onions (or 1 large onion, sliced)
to 1.5 inches ginger (- crushed to a paste in a mortar-pestle)

cumin seeds (or 1 teaspoon caraway seeds (shahi jeera))

title: Greek Lentil Soup recipe (Fakes Soupa)
description: A traditional, creamy, healthy and delicious Greek lentil soup recipe. Prepare your lentil soup the traditional Greek way, with some fresh herbs, extra virgin olive oil, a splash of red wine vinegar and top with crumbled feta cheese!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek lentil soup recipe, start by washing the lentils thoroughly and let them soak in water for about 2 hours. If you like, you can skip this process by adding them into a deep pan along with some water and place over high heat. As soon as they come to the boil, drain them into a colander.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place a pan over medium-low heat and add the lentils, the water (warmed), the chopped onions, the chopped garlic and the bay leaves. Simmer with the lid on for about 25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in the olive oil and the red wine vinegar, and season well with salt and pepper. If you prefer your Greek lentil soup to be ‘reddened’, then add 1 tablespoon of tomato paste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil the lentil soup for another 15 minutes, until it thickens and check out if they are done; keep in my mind that different kinds of lentils cook at different times.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this delicious Greek lentil soup with a splash of red wine vinegar and a drizzle of olive oil. Top with some crumbled feta cheese and enjoy!

title: Chinese Pig Ear Salad
description: Chinese Sichuan style red oil pig ear salad

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pot, add enough water to cover the pig ears and boil the pig ears with ginger, scallion and whole Sichuan peppercorn seeds for around 20 minutes. High fire during the whole process!

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the pig ears out, set aside to cool down. Cut into small strips along the gristle. Transfer to serving bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare another large bowl; mix all the ingredients for salad dressing.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the salad dressing on top of the pig ear strips on serving plate. Decorate with coriander.

title: Kimchi bulgogi cheesesteak
description: Cheesesteak made Korean-style with bulgogi and sautéed kimchi! It’s super easy and delicious!

ingredients.name: marinated bulgogi meat, uncooked (use more to taste) (Or leftover cooked bulgogi)
shredded cheese or 2 slices (mozzarella, American, provolone, etc)
hamburger buns (or hoagie rolls or 4 slices of bread)
gochujang (adjust to taste) (or buldak sauce, sriracha, or other hot sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a preheated pan, melt some butter directly on the pan over medium heat or add olive oil. You can spread butter or drizzle olive oil on the cut sides of the bun first if you want. Toast the bun, cut side down, until golden brown. Transfer to a serving plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Reheat the pan over high heat, and cook the marinated meat, loosening the meat and flipping them over once or twice. Transfer to another plate. If using cooked bulgogi, simply heat it up in the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce the heat to medium high, and add a couple of teaspoons of cooking oil to the pan. Stir fry the kimchi and optional onion slices until the kimchi turns slightly soft and deep in color, 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Top it with cheese, cover the pan, and continue to cook over medium low heat until the cheese melts.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Optional: Meanwhile, mix the mayo with gochujang until the gochujang is well incorporated into the mayo.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place a lettuce leaf on the bottom part of the bun, add bulgogi and kimchi cheese melt.

title: Steamed Fish with Lime Garlic Sauce
description: Easily the most popular steamed fish dish in Thailand. Tart, fresh, garlicky and full of flavour. It's one of the best ways to cook a fresh, delicate white fish.

ingredients.name: whole barramundi or another white fish (, guts and gills removed (see note 1))
stalk lemongrass (bottom half only, smashed and cut in chunks)
good chicken stock or fish stock

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Score the fish by making 3 diagonal incisions on each side of the fish, making sure the cuts on the two sides are perpendicular to each other. Stuff the belly of the fish with the lemongrass and place on a plate. Steam the fish over fully boiling water for about 8-12 minutes, depending on the size of the fish. (For the massive one we used in the video, it took 20 minutes)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, heat the stock and the sugar over medium high heat until the stock boils and the sugar is completely dissolved. Pour into a bowl. To the hot stock, add garlic, chilies, fish sauce and lime juice; stir to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the fish is done, transfer the fish onto a serving platter. Stuff most of the Chinese celery leaves around the sides of the fish. Add the chopped cilantro into the sauce and stir to mix. Pour the sauce over the fish. Garnish with extra Chinese celery leaves and serve with some jasmine rice.

title: Chicken Noodle Salad- Sichuan Style
description: Sichuan style chicken cold noodle salad using combined Sichuan style red oil.

ingredients.name: small cup of soaked soy beans
Oil for frying the soy beans
small chunk of boneless chicken breast

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-soak the dried soy beans until they are double in size. Transfer out and drain with kitchen towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel the tough part of cucumber and then slice into shreds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon cooking oil in wok and add soaked soy beans to fry until you hear the “Pa Pa” sound. Transfer the soy beans out and set aside to cool down.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large pot, put chicken meat, 2 slices of ginger, whole Sichuan peppercorn s and 1 spring onion in. Bring the content to a boiling and then keep cooking for 5 minutes. Cover the lid and set aside for another 10 minutes until the chicken meat is totally cooked. Soak in cold water and shred with hand.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place Sichuan peppercorn powder, chili pepper powder, 1 star anise, 2 slices of ginger in a small bowl. Heat up around 3 tablespoons of vegetable oil in pan with 2 slices of ginger and 1 star anise until there are waves on the surface and the oil is really hot. Discard the ginger slices and star anise. Pour the hot oil slowly into the bowl with the spicy powders.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook noodles in boiling water for around 4 minutes. Transfer out. Spread them and cool them down with an electric fan or cold water.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add rapeseed oil in the noodles and mix well. Transfer to a mixing bowl, add chili oil, soy sauce, salt, vinegar, sugar, garlic,shredded chicken meat, chopped spring onion and shredded cucumber. Mix well and then top with chopped spring onion and fried soy beans.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Walking Tacos
description: Walking Tacos are made with corn chips, an easy beef and bean mixture, and all your favorite toppings! Perfect for game day and tailgating!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat olive oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add ground beef and cook for 5 minutes, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon, until browned and cooked through. Drain and discard any excess liquid and grease.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place skillet back on the stove and reduce heat to low. Add chili powder and both cans of beans. Mix together to combine and cook for 5 minutes, until fully heated through and simmering. Taste and season with salt if necessary.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assemble the walking tacos by opening the bags of corn chips and spooning in some of the cooked beef and bean mixture, some shredded cheese, a dollop of sour cream, some diced tomatoes, and green onions.

title: Easy Cinnamon Roasted Sweet Potatoes
description: Easy cinnamon roasted sweet potatoes with red onions. Using this recipe, the sweet potatoes turn out perfectly creamy in the center with well-browned, caramelized edges.

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes (peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes)
small red onions (cut into large pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F, and position an oven rack in the middle

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the sweet potato cubes and onion pieces in a large mixing bowl. Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (3 to 4 tablespoons) Add salt, pepper, cinnamon and allspice. Toss well to coat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer to a sheet pan. Spread the sweet potatoes and onions well in one single layer (do not crowd the pan.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roast for 35 to 45 minutes, tossing occasionally, until the sweet potatoes are well cooked through and charred on the edges.

title: Broccoli Salad
description: Broccoli Salad Recipe - quick and easy summer salad that makes a great potluck dish or a side to your grilled meat.

ingredients.name: 1-2 tablespoons (15- 30 ml) lemon juice or vinegar

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl mix broccoli, bacon, grapes, dried cranberries and onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In another bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, honey, sugar, lemon juice or vinegar,salt and pepper and mustard , if using any. Then add to the broccoli mixture. Thrown in the sunflower seeds .

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix well to combine and adjust for seasoning. Serve immediately or refrigerate before serving. Toss again before serving and drizzle with the remaining dressing, if needed.

title: Tiropita Strifti (Feta Cheese Pie with Homemade Phyllo)
description: The most easy and delicious curly feta cheese pie with some extra crispy homemade phyllo!

ingredients.name: graviera, or any hard yellow cheese, grated (12 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In the large bowl of on electric mixer add the flour, the vinegar, the olive oil and the salt. Using a dough hook, mix the ingredients in high speed for 10 seconds and then add 130g of water and continue mixing. The dough may or may not need some extra water. After mixing for a while the dough should become an elastic ball. If the dough is still crumbled, you should add a few drops of water and mix.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wrap the dough with elastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes. Divide the dough into half and place on a floured surface. Use rolling pin to work each ball, until it becomes a very thin round pastry; the thinner, the better. You may find it easier to roll a little bit the dough with the rolling pin, and then lift it with your hands and hold it by the edge with your fists, shaking a little bit, while the rest hangs and stretches out, re positioning your hands around the perimeter of the dough and repeating (like a pizza dough).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Put all the filling ingredients in a bowl and mix till combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the dough on a large, floured kitchen towel and spread half the filling. Add in some small dices of butter for extra taste. Grab the kitchen towel by the edges lengthwise and lift it, so that the dough rolls. Turn it forming a snail and then place it on a baking tray. Butter with some melted butter and sprinkle sesame seeds. Repeat with the second ball of dough, experimenting into different shapes if you like.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 180C for 60 minutes, until nicely colored and crispy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Tips: This recipe is very easy, because the dough stretches out really easily. The most important thing is to stretch the dough as thin as possible. Don’t worry if it breaks, creating holes. It will still taste delicious! Add some fresh herbs in the filling, some fresh dill, parsley or basil for extra taste.

title: Seafood Congee
description: Seafood congee is the ultimate comfort food. The rice is cooked into a tender, silky and rich broth that is full of goodies. This recipe reveals the secret of using dried scallop to create a super flavorful broth, totally effortlessly.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse dried scallop. Place in a small bowl and tap water to cover. Let rehydrate for 2 to 3 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse rice a few times and transfer to a large pot. Add 2 liters (8 cups) water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Stir a few times. Turn to medium low or medium heat. Cover the pot halfway to keep the water boiling without spilling. Cook for 30 minutes. Stir the congee a few times during cooking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the shrimp down the center of the back into two thin pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine shrimp, Shaoxing wine, 1/2 teaspoon ginger, and 1/8 teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain dried scallop. Tear into smaller pieces by hand. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the congee has been cooking for 30 minutes and starts to thicken, add dried scallop. Keep cooking with the pot half covered, until the congee achieves the desired thickness, 15 to 20 minutes. Be careful, the congee will get quite thick and sticky towards the end. Stand close to the pot and stir frequently. It will easily spill if covered too much or if the heat is too high. The rice will stick to the bottom if you don’t stir enough.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the congee is cooked, add shrimp and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon ginger. Stir a few times. Stop heat immediately. Add the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt or salt to taste. Stir well. Drizzle with sesame oil and scatter with green onion.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm.

title: Aam Panna Recipe (With Boiled & Roasted Mangoes)
description: Aam panna is a cooling Indian drink made with raw green mangoes and flavored with cumin, cardamom and black salt. You can prepare it as a syrup concentrate or make it fresh, using either boiled or roasted mangoes.

ingredients.name: mangoes (- 400 grams, medium-sized unripe green mangoes )
sugar (or jaggery powder - 325 grams sugar or add as required)
black pepper powder (or crushed black pepper - optional)
black salt (- add regular white salt, pink salt or edible rock salt instead)
to 9 tablespoons steamed aam panna syrup
few mint leaves sprigs (or chopped coriander leaves - for garnish)
mangoes ( or 3 large unripe green mangoes)
black salt (or regular salt or pink salt)
to 3 tablespoons roasted aam panna syrup (or as required)
to 4 ice cubes ( or as required, optional)

title: Chinese Almond Cookie
description: Chinese Almond Cookie with almond flour

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cream butter with egg yolk, sugar and almond extract in a large mixing bowl and then sift salt, cake flour, almond flour and baking soda.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the ingredients together and then knead into a dough. Cover with plastic wrapper and refrigerate for 1 hour (optional in winter).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pre-heat oven to 170 degree C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the dough into 16 similar pieces and then shape each one into a round ball. Slightly flat with fingers (or if you prefer a cuter pattern, you can use forks). Then decorate whole almond in the center. Optionally, brush the egg wash.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake for 18 to 20 minutes and then let the cookies stay in the oven for another 10 minutes. Transfer to cooling rack until completely cooled. Then package with air-tight container.

title: Jangajji (Vegetable Pickles)
description: You can pickle just about any vegetables with this simple brine with 3 ingredients -- soy sauce, vinegar and sugar! Quick, delicious and crunchy!

ingredients.name: cucumbers (Kirby pickling cucumbers, Korean cucumbers) ( or any other vegetables of choice)
to 5 green chili peppers or jalapenos
vinegar (any clear type such as rice vinegar, white vinegar, etc.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean and cut the vegetables into bite size pieces, any way you want.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pack the vegetables in jars or glass containers.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 2 cups of water to a small pot along with 1 cup of soy sauce and 1/2 cup of sugar. Bring it to a boil, and gently boil for 2 to 3 minutes over medium heat, until the sugar is dissolved. Turn the heat off, and pour in 1/2 cup of vinegar. Adjust to taste if necessary.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the hot brine over the vegetables. If the vegetables are tightly packed in the jar, you don't need to weigh it down. However, make sure all the vegetables are submerged in the brine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Close tightly with a lid, and leave it out at room temperature for a day or 2. Then refrigerate. The pickles can be eaten the next day or so of pickling, but they will taste better as they mature.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Optional: To keep the pickles longer, you can pour out the brine into a pot and boil it for a few minutes. You can do this after 3 or 4 days of pickling at which time the vegetables have released their water content and diluted the brine. This time, cool it and pour back over the pickles before refrigerating.

title: Chorizo Tacos
description: These chorizo tacos are filled with Mexican chorizo and a quick lime crema. Perfect for Taco Tuesday and ready in only 15 minutes!

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chorizo and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chorizo is completely cooked.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the chorizo is cooking, warm the corn tortillas in a separate hot skillet or over the open flame on a gas stove for about 30 seconds per each side until warmed through with some toasty brown spots.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the tortillas in a tortilla warmer or cover them in a kitchen towel to keep them warm until ready to eat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fill the corn tortillas with the cooked chorizo and serve with lime crema, chopped cilantro, and diced onions.

title: Steamed Tofu "Deluxe" เต้าหู้นึ่งทรงเครื่อง
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: About ⅓ of a carrot, julienned (I use a julienne peeler)
green onion, thinly sliced on a sharp bias
tao jiew (Thai fermented soybean paste), or 1 Tbsp miso paste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the steamer so the water is on a full boil; make sure you add plenty of water so it doesn't dry out.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all sauce ingredients and stir to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Unmold the tofu onto a deep, heat resistant plate. Spread ginger juliennes on top of tofu. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok over medium high heat, then add mushrooms and spread them out so the pieces are in one layer; let it sear until browned. Once the underside is brown, toss the mushrooms so most of them flip over, and let them cook for another 30 seconds or so.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add carrot, bell peppers and a scant tablespoon of the sauce and saute until the mushrooms are fully cooked and the vegetables are softened slightly, 1-2 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in a pinch of the green onions. Place into a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour all of the remaining sauce over the tofu. Place the tofu in the steamer and steam on a rolling boil for 7-9 minutes until hot all the way through (if you're not sure whether the inside is hot, you can insert a thin paring knife into the center of the tofu and leave it there for about 3 seconds, then pull it out and feel the blade whether it is hot or not).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn off the heat, open the steamer, and you'll notice there is a lot more liquid in the sauce now, and the sauce should be diluted to the perfect saltiness. But, if this is your first time making it, you can taste the sauce and adjust it as needed—add a little more water if it's too salty, or add a splash of soy sauce if it feels too bland. Remember this will get paired with the mild-flavoured tofu, so don't make the sauce too mild!

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the sauce is as you like it, with the tofu still in the steamer, add vegetables on top and around the tofu. Top with remaining green onions then close the steamer lid for 30-45 seconds and use the residual steam to wilt the onion and warm up the vegetables. If there isn't much residual steam left, you can turn the heat back on.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve with some jasmine rice. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 10

title: Easy Homemade Phyllo Recipe for Beginners!
description: There is nothing better than a homemade pie, made with homemade phyllo! Phyllo dough or filo pastry, which means leaf or sheet in Greek, refers to the pastry that is wrapped around savoury and sweet pies and comes in many regional…

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl add the flour and salt, make a well in the centre and pour in the vinegar and the olive oil. Using a dough hook mix to combine the ingredients for 10-15 seconds. (Tip: The vinegar helps the dough to become crispy.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Depending on the kind of flour, the weather, the humidity and various factors, the dough may need a little bit more or less water than this recipe calls for. The secret to make the perfect homemade phyllo is the amount of water you will use; a few more drops may have a huge impact.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Start by adding 130g of water at first (1/2 a cup) and mix, until the flour absorbs the water; after mixing for a while, the dough should become an elastic ball. The perfect dough should be soft, malleable and smooth. If the dough is still crumbled, then you need to add a little bit more water. Add a few drops of water and mix for a while; check out the consistency of your dough and add a few more drops of water, if needed. In case you added more water than needed, the dough will become sticky. Don’t worry, you can fix that by adding some more flour (add 1/2 tsp at first, mix and check again).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When you are happy with the consistency of your dough, cut the dough in balls (slightly larger then a golf ball, approx. 80gr each, depending on size of the tray), coat lightly with olive oil, wrap with some plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 60 minutes, or longer. This is essential, so that the dough softens and you can roll it easily.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place one ball of dough on a floured surface coat your rolling pin with some flour. Make a circle of dough with your hands. Now you are ready do roll! Ensure that your dough has plenty of flour to prevent it from sticking to the working surface or the rolling pin.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Use a rolling pin to roll out the dough, until it becomes a very thin round sheet; the thinner, the better. How you do that? It’s not that difficult, if have the right technique. At first, roll out a few times, turning the dough every once in a while, to keep the circle even and the dough from sticking to the surface. Gently roll the edge of the dough over the rolling pin and roll the dough around the pin. Place your hands in the center of the rolling pin and as you roll, move them out to the sides so that both the rolling pin and your hands are working to spread and thin the dough. Unroll, turn a half turn and repeat. Continue rolling making the dough thinner and thinner each time. Move your hands from the center to the sides to keep even pressure and help in spreading and thinning the dough. The thickness of the phyllo dough depends on what you will be using it for. If you are making a spinach pie, then the dough is rolled out a little bit thicker than if you are making a feta cheese pie.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: You may find it easier to roll out a little bit the dough with the rolling pin, and then lift it with your hands and hold it by the edges with your fists, shaking a little bit, while the rest hangs and stretches out, re positioning your hands around the perimeter of the dough and repeating (like a pizza dough).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: This recipe is the ideal for beginners, as the dough stretches out really easily. The most important thing is to stretch the dough as thin as possible. Don’t worry if it breaks, creating holes, it will still taste delicious!

title: Easy Sourdough Bread recipe with Starter (prozimi)
description: Who said homemade sourdough bread needs to be difficult? This is my super easy sourdough bread recipe with starter for you to make every day with minimal effort and superb taste!
tags: easy sourdough bread recipe with starter

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In your stand mixer bowl pour in your sourdough starter, the flour, the salt and if using it, the butter. Slowly pour in your water around the edges of the mixer bowl

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put the dough hook on your stand mixer and let it knead on low to medium speed for about 10-15 minutes. Remove the bowl from the mixer, cover with cling film and let it rest for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Repeat the above – place your bowl back in the mixer and let it knead for another 10-15 minutes. Once done the dough should have formed a nice smooth and a little bit sticky ball. If the dough is too sticky, let it rest for another 10-15 minutes and knead once more.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

Tip all the ingredients in and set it to the sourdough cycle or, if it doesn’t have one, the dough cycle. For the Panasonic SD-ZX2522 its menu 29 and for the Panasonic SD-ZB2512 its menu 26. Then let it rest in the machine for 1 to 2 more hours with the lid shut until it has risen by a quarter (25%)!

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Tip the dough out from the bowl on a floured work surface. Shape your dough into a taught round ball by pulling one edge at a time and folding toward the center. Flip the dough over and using a dough scraper pull the dough across your work surface to form a round, taught ball.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Honey Lotus Root with Sticky Rice (糯米藕)
description: The sweet aroma of this dish brings flowers to mind. The root of the lotus plant is stuffed with sticky rice, slow cooked in a sweet broth until tender, sliced to reveal the floral pattern, and drizzled with flowery osmanthus syrup.

ingredients.name: (3.5 ounces) rock sugar ( (or 1/2 cup white sugar))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add glutinous rice into a small bowl and rinse it 2 to 3 times. Add water to cover rice with 1 centimeter (0.5 inch) excess. Let the rice soak at room temperature for 4 to 5 hours or in the fridge overnight (cover / wrap the bowl if placed in the fridge).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the rice. Add white sugar and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wash lotus root carefully. Peel the rind off and discard it. When you cut off the tough ends, be careful not to cut off so much that you reveal the tubes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut about 2 centimeters (1 inch) from one end of the lotus root. Save the small piece that you cut off to use as a lid.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To stuff the lotus root with glutinous rice, add a spoonful of rice onto the cut end and use a chopstick to push the rice into the holes. Use a chopstick to squeeze the stuffed rice and compress it. Carefully fill up all the tubes, including the small ones. (It will take some time. I highly suggest you sit down and play your favorite TV show while doing this.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the small “lid” back to cover the cut end, in exactly the position it originally was (so the glutinous rice will expand into the holes of the “lid” during cooking). Use 6 to 8 toothpicks to seal the “lid”. You should push the toothpicks as far in as you can. The glutinous rice will expand during cooking and the “lid” will fall off or be pushed apart if not sealed carefully.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add lotus root to a small pot, with 2 cups of water to cover (*see footnote 2). Add rock sugar (or white granular sugar) and brown sugar. Bring to a boil over high heat. Stir during boiling to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn to low heat, cover, and boil for 1 hour. Keep the water boiling throughout. Flip the lotus root after 30 minutes and add more water to cover it, if necessary.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Turn to lowest heat to simmer for another 20 minutes. Flip the lotus root 4 to 5 times during cooking.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To serve after cooking, transfer the lotus root to a cutting board and allow it to cool. Cut into evenly thick slices when the root is cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: To serve later, leave the lotus root in the pot until it cools off completely before slicing. If you plan to serve it the next day, place the lotus root in an airtight container and add the sugary water to cover. Store in fridge.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Drizzle osmanthus syrup (or honey) on top of the cut lotus root. Serve warm or cold.

title: Steamed Black Cod with Ginger Soy Sauce ปลานึ่งซีอิ้ว
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: pc dried shiitake mushrooms, rehydrated by soaking in hot water for at least 1 hour
(350g) white fish of your choice (see note)
chicken or pork stock, unsalted (See recipe for homemade stock)
green onions, thinly slice on a bias

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove soaked shiitake mushrooms from water and squeeze out excess water. Cut off the stems, then slice the cap into thin pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Note: Make sure you have all ingredients prepped before you start cooking, it goes fast!

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place fish in a deep plate and steam over vigorously boiling water until done, about 6-8 minutes depending on the thickness of the fish. While the fish is steaming make the sauce.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For the sauce: Combine stock, soy sauce, oyster sauce, Chinese cooking wine, sesame oil and sugar in a bowl. Heat 2 Tbsp of vegetable oil in a sauté pan over medium high heat. Add garlic, ginger, and shiitake mushroom slices and stir for 1-2 minutes until aromatic. Add the sauce mixture and white pepper, bring to a boil and let sauce simmer for 30 seconds. Remove from heat, taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Set aside until the fish is ready.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When fish is done, turn off the heat, and you’ll notice water collected in the plate.With the fish still in the steamer, tilt the plate to pour off the collected water, letting it run off into the cooking water below.(If using black cod filet, you may pull out pin bones at this point.) Pour the sauce over the fish, top with green onions and close the steamer lid for another 30 seconds just to steam the green onions slightly using residual steam.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve immediately with jasmine rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Tortas Ahogadas
description: A Torta Ahogada filled with mouthwatering carnitas and drowned in a red chile and tomato sauce! It's one of the best Mexican sandwiches you'll ever eat!

ingredients.name: thinly sliced red onions (or pickled red onions)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat 2 cups of water in a medium saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the saucepan from the heat, add the dried chile de arbol peppers, cover, and let sit and soak for 15 minutes to soften and rehydrate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the chiles soak, place the tomatoes on a large baking sheet. Broil in the oven for 8-10 minutes, flipping the tomatoes halfway through roasting, until the skins are blistered and charred.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the softened chiles to a blender using a slotted spoon to drain out any water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the roasted tomatoes, garlic, white onion, vinegar, salt, cumin, and oregano. Puree until smooth.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add pureed sauce, stir to cook, and bring to a simmer. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Assemble the sandwiches by filling each roll with pork carnitas, red onions, and a sprinkle of cotija cheese.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place each sandwich in a shallow bowl or a plate with a lifted edges. Pour a generous amount of sauce all over the top of each sandwich.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Squeeze a lime wedge or two on each sandwich and serve.

title: Italian Sausage Minestrone Recipe
description: You are going to LOVE this hearty soup! Pair it with some fresh bread and it is sure to be a family favorite.

ingredients.name: small pasta such as mini Farfalle or elbow macaroni

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Spray a non-stick pan with very little oil. Heat the pan on medium-high and brown the sausage until it is fully cooked. Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tbsp of oil and saute the chopped onion and celery for a brief 2-3 minutes or so. Now toss in the chopped garlic; saute for a few more seconds then add the green beans, artichoke hearts, canned tomatoes, dried oregano and a small dash of salt and pepper. Cook on medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Now add the cooked sausage and broth; stir to combine. Continue to cook on medium-high heat for another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Lower the heat to medium-low; cover and let simmer for another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Uncover to add the pasta, chickpeas, and parsley. Raise the heat back to high and cook uncovered for another 8-9 minutes (pasta should cook to al dente).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from heat and stir in the fresh basil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowls and garnish each with a little Parmaginao Reggiano! Enjoy with a side of your favorite bread.

title: Unniyappam Recipe | Unni Appam
description: Unniyappam are sweet fritters from the Kerala cuisine and are made with rice, banana, a few spices and coconut.

ingredients.name: rice (or 200 grams rice - use any type of short grained rice)
medium sized banana (or 175 grams bananas (with their peels) or ¾ cup chopped bananas)
baking soda (- you can also add ⅛ teaspoon baking soda (about 2 pinches))
to 1 teaspoon coconut oil (or ghee for each mould)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: soaking rice

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: frying coconut

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: making unniyappam batter

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: making unniyappam

title: Country-style Greek Potato stew recipe (Patates Yahni)
description: If you just love potatoes this rustic Greek potato stew recipe is a definite must try!

ingredients.name: medium potatoes, peeled and cut into 2.5 cm chunks (approx. 1.5 kg)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek potato stew recipe (patates yahni), start by preparing your vegetables. Peel and cut the potatoes into 2.5 cm chunks, finely chop (or grate) the onion and garlic and set aside. Peel the tomatoes and grate. You may find it easier to peel the tomatoes if you blanch them first for 1 minute in hot water. (For this Greek potato stew recipe, it is best to use fresh tomatoes rather than canned.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the olive oil and onion and sauté until softened. Stir in the garlic and sauté for 1 more minute. Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 more minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same pot add the grated tomatoes, the potatoes, sprinkle with chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper. Add just enough warm water to cover the potatoes (whilst stirring ocassionally) and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down to medium, cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Greek potato stew (Patates Yahni) is best served while still warm or at room temperature. Enjoy!

title: Costa Rican Style Roast Fish
description: Imported from omnivorescookbook.com.

ingredients.name: freshly squeezed lime or lemon juice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add fish and all the ingredients for marinate into a large bowl, marinate fish for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven to 200C (400F). Place aluminum foil on baking rack, fold the 4 corners so the foil will shape like a tray. Brush a thin layer of vegetable oil, add marinated fish and all the liquid on the aluminum foil. Bake for 15 minutes till fish is half done. Take fish out of oven to chill down a bit.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Line a square baking pan with aluminum foil. Add rice in baking pan and spread rice evenly on the foil, top with salsa, black beans, half of cilantro, cooked fish and the remaining liquid. Bake under 200C (400F) till fish is done, in about 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Garnish with the rest cilantro and serve during hot.

title: Easy Pasta Salad
description: Easy Pasta Salad – a classic Italian Pasta Salad loaded with fresh produce and Italian favorites like salami, black olives and cheese; tossed with a vibrant homemade Italian Dressing.

ingredients.name: rotini pasta (, cooked according to package directions)
red onion (, cut in half half moons)
1-2 cups cucumber (, cut in half moons)
mozzarella cheese cut into bite size pieces
freshly ground black pepper to taste
freshly grated parmesan cheese, or feta cheese , optional ((optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add water to a large pot, salt and then bring water to a boil. Once the water has boiled stir in the pasta, and cook according to package directions. Pasta should have a bite to it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl mix together the dressing ingredients; minced garlic, oregano, parsley, vinegar, basil, mustard , sugar salt and pepper and olive oil. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large or salad bowl, combine cooked pasta, tomatoes, onion, red peppers, cucumber, olives, peas. pepperoni/salami/ham, grated parmesan cheese, bite sized mozarella cheese, parsley, fresh basil and ground pepper to taste. Pour vinaigrette dressing over the pasta and mix thoroughly. Cover and chill before serving.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
description: Oven Fried Chicken - crispy, juicy fried chicken but without deep frying. A healthier take on the classic family-favorite fried chicken. Crispy, tasty and healthy! PLUS a video of my new oven.

ingredients.name: 1- 1 1/2 tablespoon dried herbs ( thyme, oregano, parsley)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat dry the chicken with paper towels and place them in the fridge for a minimum of 3 hours or overnight to air-dry them out. If you're short in time, you may just pat them dry well with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place chicken in a large bowl or large ziploc. Then seasoned with salt followed by all the crushed garlic, hot sauce and creole seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour buttermilk in the marinated chicken, transfer the chicken to a gallon-sized zipper-lock freezer bag and refrigerate for at least 4 hours and up to 24 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl or plate, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, bread crumbs, baking powder, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, herbs and white pepper. Thoroughly mix until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Baking the Chicken

title: Braised Mung Bean Noodles with Shrimps
description: Chinese Mung Bean Noodles braised with mushrooms and shrimp.

ingredients.name: Around 12 shrimps ( , deveined (In Chinese cooking, the shell of shrimps usually are kept; However peel it whatever if you like))
small bunches of mung bean noodles

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the mung bean noodles in clean water for around 15 minutes until soft. If you are in hurry, use warm water instead of cold water. Transfer the noodles out and discard the water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in pan; add garlic cloves, ginger, and chopped coriander steam in to stir fry until aroma. Add shrimp in to stir fry until they begin to turn red.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a clay pot, place a layer of soaked mung bean noodles firstly and then transfer all the content in the pan to the clay pot. Add salt firstly, then soy sauce; cooking wine, peppercorn powder and water (the noodles will absorb the water during the later heating process).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Continue cooking for around 5 minutes. Serve with chopped coriander or green onion garnished?

title: Miyeok Muchim (Seaweed Salad)
description: A nice, refreshing summer salad made with miyeok (aka wakame)!

ingredients.name: dried miyeok (미역, (a little more than 2 cups soaked))
small kirby cucumber (1/2 Korean cucumber, thinly sliced)
red radishes (or equivalent amount of white radish, thinly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the dried miyeok in cold water per package instructions (usually 10 to 20 minutes) or just until it turns soft and plump. Rinse a couple of times to remove any hidden sand. Drain well and cut into bite sizes. See notes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Plunge the miyeok into the water and blanch for a minute. Drain and rinse in the cold water until the miyeok is cool. Drain well, and squeeze out excess water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the miyeok into bite size pieces by running a knife through a few times in different directions.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix all the dressing ingredients well until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the miyeok, cucumber, and radish. Toss well to combine everything together. Serve cold.

title: Dim Sum Spare Ribs w/ Black Beans
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Chinese fermented black beans, rinsed thoroughly
Diced red bell peppers for colour, or sliced jalapenos if you want some spiciness, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound garlic and ginger into a fine paste; alternatively finely grate or mince them and transfer into a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add soy sauce, Chinese cooking wine, sugar, white pepper, toasted sesame oil, and rinsed black beans; stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place pork ribs into a zip-top bag and pour the marinade into it. Squeeze out as much as as possible, then squish the pork around to coat all pieces evenly. It will not look like much marinade, but trust me, this is all you need! Marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to 1 day.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer pork into a mixing bowl and add cornstarch and toss until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the pork into a heat-resistant bowl that can go into your steamer (a wider bowl is better). Steam pork over boiling water for 30-45 minutes or until the ribs are fork tender but not falling off the bones (the size I have in the videos took about 40 minutes.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: About 5 minutes before ribs are done, throw in some diced red bell peppers or jalapenos and let them steam with the ribs.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ribs are done, sprinkle green onions on top and close the lid for about 1 minute to steam green onions slightly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Carefully remove the plate from the steamer (use oven mitts!) and serve. They can be enjoyed on their own or with some some rice!

title: Melitzanosalata Recipe
description: Simple and delicious Greek eggplant dip with smoky eggplant, garlic, parsley, lemon juice and extra virgin olive oil. The perfect appetizer with a bit of warm pita bread or serve it next to grilled meats or even fish.

ingredients.name: red onion finely chopped (about 1/3 cup, more for garnish)
chopped fresh parsley (packed, more for garnish)
each ground cumin (and crushed red pepper flakes, more to your liking (optional) )
extra virgin olive oil (more for later )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Keep the eggplant whole and pierce with a fork in a few places.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Smoke the eggplant. Place the eggplant over a gas flame, grill or under a broiler, and cook, turning around using a pair of tongs, until the skin is fully charred, and the eggplant is quite tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cool and drain eggplant. Place the eggplant in a bowl and set aside until cool enough to handle (a bowl is helpful because the eggplant will release some juices). Peel the charred skins off and discard. Cut the eggplant into chunks and place in a colander to get rid of any remaining excess juices (about 10 more minutes).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the eggplant to a mixing bowl. Add the garlic, onion, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil. Add salt and pepper and spices (if using). Mix to combine and use your fork to break up the eggplant into smaller chunks.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: At this point, if you have the time, it’s a good idea to cover and chill the eggplant dip in the fridge for a few brief minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the eggplant dip to a serving plate and spread. Drizzle extra virgin olive oil. Arrange Garnish with lemon zest, parsley, red onions, olives, a sprinkle of feta. Serve with crusty bread or pita bread.

title: Ropa Vieja Slow Cooker
description: Ropa Vieja Slow Cooker- A Cuban favorite shredded beef that you can easily make right at ho and the homemade version tastes even better!

ingredients.name: 2- 2 1/2 pounds beef flank steak (, skirt or roast)
salt , pepper, cumin and Sazon ((adjust to taste))
bell peppers ((red, green), seeded and sliced into strips)
1-2 packet Sazon ((sub beef or chicken bouillon))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim beef of any excess fat , then season salt , pepper cumin and sazon Adjust to taste .

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat about 2 tablespoon oil in skillet on medium, place beef in a single layer and sear meat on both sides until brown. About 3-4 minutes each side. Throw in bay leaves after browning on one side

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add remaining oil to the skillet over medium high heat. Then add onions, , garlic, bell peppers, tomatoes , tomato sauce ,thyme, paprika, cumin, and sazon. Cook for about 3-5 minutes. Add broth. Turn off heat and add 3/4 of the sauce to the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: slow cook, until beef is tender, about 3 1/2--4 hours on High or 7 -8 hours on low, and can be easily shredded using two forks. Remove beef and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1-2 cups of the sauce from the crockpot to the the remaining sauce . Cook for about 2 minutes or more . Add more seasoning (sazon ) if need. Throw in parsley. Adjust seasoning

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finally, add shredded beef and stir for a minute. Serve with rice , beans, and tostones.

title: Chinese Pumpkin Cake (南瓜饼)
description: Chinese pumpkin cake features a beautiful golden crispy crust that is gooey and sticky like mochi inside, with a sweet red bean paste filling.

ingredients.name: (15 oz) pumpkin puree ((or 25 oz (700 g) pumpkin))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make pumpkin puree (optional)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the pumpkin cake
