steps.description: Cook the pumpkin cake

title: Mohabbat ka Sharbat Recipe
description: Mohabbat ka Sharbat is a chilled milk-based drink made with rose syrup and fresh watermelon, popular in North India. It has a light pink color, balanced sweetness and a refreshing taste.

ingredients.name: to 2½ cups watermelon ( – finely chopped (small cubes))
sabja seeds ((sweet basil seeds) – soaked in 1 cup water or 4 to 5 tbsp soaked sabja seeds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chill the milk and chopped watermelon until cold.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak sabja seeds in water until they swell, then strain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a jug or bowl, mix chilled milk with rose syrup/rooh afza until the color turns light pink.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add sugar. Stir to dissolve.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add rose water if using and mix gently.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fold in finely chopped watermelon.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add soaked sabja seeds and mix.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Drop in ice cubes if preferred.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour into glasses and serve mohabbat ka sharbat immediately.

title: Traditional Greek Green Beans recipe (Fasolakia Giaxni)
description: This traditional Greek green beans recipe (Fasolakia giaxni) will amaze you! Prepare these green beans the authentic Greek way with some sweet onions and fresh, juicy tomatoes, creating an all time favorite vegetarian dish.

ingredients.name: green beans, trimmed (45 oz.). You can use fresh or frozen.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek green beans recipe, start by washing the green beans thoroughly. Drain them in a colander and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat half the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and sauté until transculent and tender. Stir in the garlic, the grated tomatoes, the rest of the olive oil and a pinch of sugar and bring to the boil. The traditional recipe for Greek green beans calls for fresh ripe tomatoes, but if you like you can substitute with canned chopped tomatoes, or Passata tomato juice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the green beans and blend well, so that the green beans are coated with the olive oil and the tomatoes. Turn the heat down, cover with the lid and simmer for around 30 minutes, until the beans are soft and most the juices have evaporated. During cooking, check out if the pan appears to be getting dry and add a little bit hot water if needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Towards the end of cooking time season with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the Greek green beans (fasolakia giaxni) warm or at room temperature with salty crumbled feta cheese and lots of Kalamata olives. Enjoy!

title: Chinese Water Spinach Stir Fry
description: Chinese Water Spinach Stir Fry, Healthy vegetable stir fry

ingredients.name: tbsp. light soy sauce (, or use 1/2 for a lighter taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Discard the tough stems and keep the tender parts. Then break the water spinach into 10cm length sections. Wash carefully and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in wok over highest fire. Add garlic, fry for a short time (around 5-8 seconds). Add water spinach salt, quickly fry 2-3 seconds, then add salt and light soy sauce. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve immediately. After around 8-10 minutes, the vegetables become dark due to oxidation process. So this should be the last to make dish if you are preparing a large meal.

title: Minari Jeon (Water Dropwort pancake)
description: Simple Korean savory pancakes made with minari (aka Korean watercress or water dropwort)

ingredients.name: buchimgaru, 부침가루 (Korean pancake mix) or all-purpose flour (see note)
pinch gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes) - optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the minari thoroughly. Cut them into about 2 to 3-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the minari to a bowl along with the Korean pancake mix or all-purpose flour. Stir in about 1/2 cup of cold water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Toss everything lightly to evenly coat the vegetable with wet flour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat one tablespoon of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Ladle the mixture into the pan, and spread it evenly into a thin round shape. Cook until light golden brown, about 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium low if the pancake browns too quickly. Turn it over, adding more oil to the sides of the pan, and press it down with a spatula. Cook until the other side is light golden brown, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Repeat the process with the remaining vegetable mix. Serve hot with a dipping sauce, if desired.

title: Grilled Eggplant Salad ยำมะเขือยาว
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Chinese, Japanese or Thai long eggplant (about 250g)
Thai chili, or more to taste
3-4 sprigs cilantro, pick the leaves and finely chop the stems, keeping them separate
or 2 medium boiled eggs, preferably duck (8 minutes in rapidly boiling water)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the broiler to high.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak 1½ Tbsp dried shrimp in hot water for 10 minutes. Drain well, and pound in a mortar and pestle just until they’re smashed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grind the other ½ Tbsp of dried shrimp in a coffee grinder until fluffy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Poke several holes in the eggplant with a knife, then place on a foil-lined baking sheet. Broil on the top rack, and once the top side is charred (~3 minutes), turn the eggplant to char the other sides. Once the eggplant is charred on all sides and the flesh is soft, remove from the broiler and let cool. Alternatively, you can grill the eggplant on high heat, or if you have a gas stove, you char the eggplant directly in the flame.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the eggplant cools, make the dressing. In a mortar and pestle, pound the chili until fine, then add the palm sugar and pound until it becomes a paste. Add fish sauce and lime juice, and swirl the pestle until the sugar is dissolved. Add the shallots, chopped cilantro stems, and the dried shrimp (both the fluffy and the smashed ones); stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the eggplant is cool enough to handle, peel the skin off, trying your best not to get the charred skin bits on the flesh. The skin should come off quite easily. Cut the eggplant in half horizontally, then into 2-inch pieces. Arrange the eggplant flesh on a serving plate, pour the dressing over the eggplant, top with cilantro leaves and serve with the boiled egg on the side. Serve with jasmine rice, enjoy!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Turkey Gravy from Drippings
description: How to make turkey gravy from drippings the easy way. Don't let all the seasonings and juicy pan drippings from your turkey go to waste!

ingredients.name: kosher salt and black pepper, (to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Carefully pour the turkey drippings from the roasting pan through a strainer and into a large glass container or two. Place it in the fridge for 15 minutes to let the fat rise to the top and solidify.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the drippings from the fridge, scoop out 2 tablespoons of the fat, and discard the remaining fat or transfer it to a storage container to use later. (See Notes below if you don't end up with 2 tablespoons of fat.) You should now have only the liquid turkey drippings remaining.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small saucepan over medium-high heat, whisk together the 2 tablespoons of reserved fat and the all-purpose flour until smooth. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, whisking constantly, until bubbly and light to golden brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Whisk in 1 cup of the turkey drippings and the chicken broth until completely smooth. (See Notes below if you don't end up with 1 cup of turkey drippings.)Bring it to a boil, reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook until the gravy has thickened to your liking. Taste and season with salt and black pepper as needed.

title: How to Make the BEST Cheese Board: A Complete Guide
description: The perfect way to kick-off a party is an epic cheese board! Use this recipe/guide to make the perfect cheese board. Be whimsical and have fun!
tags: how to make a cheese board

ingredients.name: Hard Cheeses: Parmagian Reggiano and Sharp Cheddar, (for example)
Soft Cheeses: Brie and creamy Greek Feta
Fresh vegetables and fruit: cucumbers; grapes; sliced pears or apples, (for example)
Tangy: (olives and other marinated items like artichokes)
Fresh herbs for garnish: dill; rosemary; basil, (whatever you like)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: On a large wood board or serving platter of your choice, place one ingredient in the center of the board and 4 others on each of the corners to create shape to the board. I placed my hummus bowl in the center of the board, and in the 4 corners, a round of brie; square of aged cheddar; a bowl of olives; and a bowl of creamy crumbled feta.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: From there, fill in the board from the center to the corners with the remaining cheeses, meats, and accompaniments. Take a look and see where the gaps are, add more items as needed. Garnish with fresh herbs.

title: Cobb Salad
description: Enjoy vibrant colors and amazing textures in this nutrition-packed salad. This healthy feast in a bowl features Cajun-flavored chicken, bacon, blue cheese, boiled eggs, avocado, and lettuce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Saute chopped bacon in a skillet over medium-high heat until brown and crisp, then cool on a paper-towel-lined plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: As the bacon cooks, add all the dressing ingredients to a small mixing bowl and whisk until thoroughly combined. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season both sides of chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and Creole seasoning.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet. Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes on each side. The chicken should be cooked through and no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once ready, let the chicken rest for about 5 minutes, then slice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare (chop or slice) all other ingredients for the salad (avocado, tomatoes, onion, etc.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Hard boil two eggs, then peel and quarter them.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Chop, rinse, and drain water from romaine lettuce and arrange on a platter.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Arrange the remaining salad ingredients (chicken, eggs, avocado, tomatoes, onion, blue cheese, and bacon) in rows over the salad.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Sprinkle with chives—drizzle dressing over the salad just before serving.

title: Chorizo Cornbread Stuffing
description: This chorizo cornbread stuffing is made with chorizo, onions, celery, and fresh herbs like sage, rosemary, and thyme. It's the perfect easy side dish to serve at your Thanksgiving and holiday celebrations!

ingredients.name: roughly chopped cornbread ((the amount made from a 15-oz box of cornbread mix))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease the inside of a large casserole dish with butter and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add chorizo and crumble it up with a spatula. Cook until browned, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onion, celery, garlic, sage, rosemary and thyme and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes until vegetables begin to soften. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium bowl, add the chicken stock and egg. Whisk until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cornbread and cooked chorizo mixture to the greased casserole dish. Gently toss together to combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the chicken stock mixture evenly over the cornbread stuffing.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake for 25 minutes. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired and serve immediately.

title: Chickpea Fritters recipe (Revithokeftedes)
description: Revithokeftedes (Greek chickpea fritters) is a very healthy and delicious appetizer from Sifnos island. Serve with some yogurt sauce as a great starter!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the chickpeas into a large bowl filled with water and a pinch of salt for about 6 hours, or overnight. Drain and place them into a large pan, filled with water and boil for 40-60 minutes, until soft. When done, drain them into a colander. Place on some paper towel on a large tray and let them dry out completely for about an hour. It is very important that they dry out completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, finely chop the onions and garlic. Place a pan into medium heat, add 2 tbsps of olive oil and sauté, until tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a food processor to mix all the ingredients together. Add the boiled chickpeas, the saute onions and garlic, along with the cumin and coriander and mix. Open the food processor, blend the mixture with a spoon and mix again. Repeat 2-3 times, until all the ingredients are combined. This should take 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Into a large bowl, add the chopped parsley, 2 tbsps of flour and the chickpea mixture. Season well with salt and pepper and mix well, squeezing the ingredients with your hands, until combined. If the mixture seems loose and is not holding its shape add a bit more flour and knead them.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the mixture in the fridge for about 30 minutes. This will help solidify the mixture and make shaping them easier.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Using a spoon, take a portion of your mixture and shape into balls or flat “burgers”.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Flour them lightly and fry them into a very hot oil, until nicely colored on all sides. Place them on paper towel, to absorb the extra oil. For a healthier version, bake them in preheated oven at 180C for about 25 minutes. Brush the bottom of the baking tray and the top of the balls with some olive oil. Halfway through cooking time, flip the balls and put back in the oven.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To prepare the sauce, add all the ingredients into a bowl and whisk, until all the ingredients are combined and the sauce is smooth and creamy.

title: Rose Cookies Recipe (Achappam | Achu Murukku)
description: Rose cookies recipe, also known as achappam or achu murukku, is a traditional South Indian snack made with a light batter shaped using a mould and deep fried until crisp.

ingredients.name: (30 grams) rice flour (– fine and unroasted)
canned coconut milk (or homemade thick coconut milk)
coconut oil (or any neutral oil for deep frying)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix all-purpose flour, rice flour and sugar in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the sesame seeds, cumin seeds, cardamom powder, baking powder, salt, and 1 teaspoon coconut oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in coconut milk and water. Mix to combine and make a smooth, lump-free batter with a flowing consistency. Rest the batter briefly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in a kadai and place the mould in the hot oil for about a minute or until properly heated.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dip the mould into the batter up to three-fourth height and place it back in the hot oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: After some seconds, gently shake it so the achappam releases and floats in the oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry on medium heat until the bubbles reduce and the cookie firms up and turns pale golden.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Flip gently with a slotted spoon and cook the other side. Turn over as needed and fry until crisp and evenly light golden.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove the fried rose cookie with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Before making the next one, heat the mould again in the oil for 15 to 20 seconds.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Dip in batter and repeat the same process.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: You can also fry 2 to 3 rose cookies at a time, depending on the pan size. Do not overcrowd.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve once cooled and crisp. Store in an airtight container at room temperature. Rose cookies keep well for a few weeks at room temperature.

title: Wonton Char Siu Noodle Soup (叉烧云吞面)
description: This easy wonton char siu noodle soup features springy egg noodles and tender leafy greens served in a hearty chicken broth, topped with scrumptious char siu pork and juicy wontons.

ingredients.name: (56 g) char siu pork ((Chinese barbecued pork), sliced)
choy sum ((or baby bok choy, or other greens of your choice))
bundle (about 3.5 oz / 100 g) thin egg noodles

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the chicken broth, ginger and Shaoxing wine into a separate small pot. Cook over medium-high heat until brought to a boil. Add the soy sauce, white pepper, and sugar. Let simmer if you’re still preparing the rest of the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add a pinch of salt and a few drops of vegetable oil. Add the choy sum. Cook until turning tender, 40 to 50 seconds. Remove the choy sum and transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook the noodles in the same pot according to the package instructions, until al dente. Once done, drain the noodles and transfer to a serving bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil the wontons in the same pot. If you use my homemade wonton recipes, boil the wontons until they float to the top. Then boil for another 1 to 2 minutes. If using store bought wontons, follow the package instructions.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once done prepping, pour the hot broth over the noodles and top with the wontons. Drizzle with sesame oil. Garnish with sliced char siu pork, choy sum, fried shallot and green onion. Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Ojingeo Muchim (Spicy Squid Salad)
description: Ojingeo muchim is a spicy, sweet and tangy dish that’s made with boiled squid and fresh vegetables. The perfect blend of spicy, sweet, and sour tastes in this dish will surely increase your appetite.

ingredients.name: kirby cucumber or 1/2 Korean cucumber (thinly sliced)
a few stalks minari (water dropwort, cut into 2-inch pieces)
green or red chili pepper (thinly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the squid (see note).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a rapid boil. Drop the squid in, and cook briefly, about a minute. Quickly remove, and plunge into ice water to stop the cooking and cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the squid into thin bite size strips (about ⅓ - inch thick, 2-inch long). Keep it in the fridge to cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix all the sauce ingredients together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Combine the sauce and squid and mix well. Add the vegetables and toss well. Add more sugar, salt, or and/or vinegar to taste. Serve chilled.

title: Tofu Stir Fry with Minced Pork
description: Tofu stir fried with minced pork and Chinese chive sections.

ingredients.name: tbsp. chopped green onion or scallion

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the firm tofu into cubes and soak in slightly salted water for around 10 minutes. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate bowl, marinate minced pork with marinating sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the tofu. Heat up a saucepan over medium-high heat, add in the pork and stir-fry until fragrant and crispy. Add ginger, garlic, and Sichuan peppercorn and fry for 1 minute until aromatic (over slow fire).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the tofu cubes into the saucepan and pour in dark soy sauce (for coloring)as well. Stir-fry to combine all ingredients together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour ¼ of water, reduce heat, and simmer for 5 to 6 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated. Sprinkle some chopped green onion and serve immediately.

title: Thai BBQ Pork Jowl คอหมูย่าง นำ้จิ้มแจ่ว
description: Pork jowl is an underrated cut that is flavourful, fatty, tender, juicy...perfect for the grill. It's popular cut for the barbecue in Thailand, and the nam jim jeaw dipping sauce is a classic pairing!

ingredients.name: 1-2 cilantro roots or 4-5 cilantro stems, chopped
soy sauce (see what brands of sauces I use)
Roasted chili flakes, to taste (or sub any spicy chili powder you have)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make marinade: In a mortar and pestle, grind the white peppercorns until fine. Add garlic, lemongrass, cilantro stems of roots and pound into a paste. Add palm sugar and pound until dissolved. Add oyster sauce, soy sauce and coconut milk; stir to combine. Pour the marinade over the pork, making sure the pork is thoroughly coated. Let the pork marinate for at least 2 hours, best to do the one day in advance.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the dipping sauce: In a small pot, add palm sugar, tamarind, and about 1 Tbsp of water. Cook over medium heat until all the sugar is dissolved and the mixture has thickened. Turn off the heat, and while still hot, stir in shallots. Add fish sauce and lime juice, then taste and adjust seasoning. Leave the toasted rice powder and cilantro until close to serving time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To grill the pork: Preheat the grill (heat setting will depend on how powerful your grill is...mine is set on high but yours might only need to be on medium or medium high). Grill the pork without closing the grill lid for about 4-5 minutes on each side, timing will depend on the thickness of the pork and the heat of your grill. The pork should reach about a medium doneness (145°F internal temp).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Let the pork rest for at least 5 minutes before slicing. While the pork is resting, finish the dipping sauce by stirring in the toasted rice powder and some chopped cilantro leaves.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To serve, slice the pork THINLY and ACROSS the grain lines; this is very important as this cut of pork will be chewy if the pieces are too big and if you cut with the grain. If the pork is very thin, angle your knife about 45 degrees so you get a bigger piece.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Capirotada (Mexican Bread Pudding)
description: Capirotada, or Mexican Bread Pudding, is made with layers of crusty bread, raisins, bananas, almonds and cheese all soaked in sweetened cinnamon milk!

ingredients.name: large bolillo bread rolls, (cut into 1-inch thick pieces (about 10-12 cups))
(8-ounce) cone piloncillo ((or 1 1/4 cup dark brown sugar))
shredded Oaxaca cheese ((or any melty white cheese like Monterey Jack, Provolone or Mozzarella))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish (or a dish that's slightly bigger) with oil or butter. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cubed bolillo bread onto a large baking sheet. Bake it for 5 minutes so that bread become a little toasted and dried out. Remove it from oven and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the milk, piloncillo, cinnamon sticks, and cloves to a large pot over medium-high heat. Whisk it together and bring it to a gentle boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Reduce the heat to low and simmer it for 10 minutes, uncovered, whisking occasionally. Remove it from the heat and discard the cinnamon sticks and cloves.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the capirotada by spreading half of the toasted bread in a single layer in the prepared baking dish. Top it with all of the banana slices, half of the raisins, half of the sliced almonds and half of the shredded cheese. Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients to make one more layer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully pour the sweetened milk all over the capirotada, paying close attention to the bread on the edges.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for another 15 minutes, then remove the foil and bake it uncovered for 15 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove it from the oven, let it cool for 5 minutes, and serve warm. Or let it cool completely, cover and refrigerate, and serve cold.

title: Smoked Salmon Platter
description: Use this recipe as a guide to make an amazing salmon platter like a pro! If you're serving more than 6 people, you can double or triple the amounts used here.

ingredients.name: Red pepper flakes or Aleppo pepper
Cream cheese or Labneh ((I used homemade labneh) )
bell pepper (any color), (thinly sliced into rounds)
small red onion, (thinly sliced into rounds)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil the eggs. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil over medium-high heat (make sure the saucepan can hold all the eggs in one single layer). Using a spoon, very gently lower the eggs in the boiling water large. Cook for exactly 6½ minutes, adjusting the heat as necessary to maintain a gentle boil. When the eggs are ready, transfer them to a large bowl of iced water and let them sit for about 2 minutes. Peel the eggs and cut them in halves and season with kosher salt and a pinch of red pepper flakes or Aleppo pepper (which is milder and has a slightly sweeter finish).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To assemble the salmon platter, place a small bowl of cream cheese or labneh in one third of the the platter. Place the feta cheese in another corner of the platter. Arrange the salmon, cucumbers, bell peppers, tomatoes, radish, onions, olives, artichoke hearts and lemon wedges around the cheese. Sprinkle a little more red pepper flakes or Aleppo pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve with your favorite crackers, crostini, bagels, pita wedges or even pita chips!

title: Ekwang ( Ekpang Nkukwo )
description: Made of freshly grated cocoyam, then wrapped in leafy greens and slowly simmered with various types of fresh or smoked meat, fish, crayfish, red oil and other spices depending on the cooks preference until cooked to perfection.

ingredients.name: 4-5 bunch leafy greens (cocoyam leaves, collard greens, spinach, romaine lettuce)
scotch bonnet pepper or any hot pepper (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef in bite size chunks, season with salt, Maggi, and onions and cook until tender. make sure you have at least 2 to 3 cups of stock from the beef. to use in cooking this dish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel Coco yam with a sharp knife, peeling away from your body carefully draw the paring knife down the body of the yam, being careful not to remove too much of the yam in during the process.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Look for any spoiled spots, such as bruising and discoloration, in the Cocoyam as you peel. Remove the spots away with the tip of the knife.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut into large chunks and wash immediately to prevent discoloration and leave them in cool water until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pulse the cocoyam in a food processor with until puree or use a grater to grate the cocoyam. Lightly salt and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Wash leaves and tear them into medium pieces, making sure there are no tears or holes in the leaves.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Oil a large pot with about ½ cup of palm oil. Set aside

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Scoop a tablespoon or so of grated cocoyam mixture onto a leaf and wrap tightly (to form the shape of fingers) making sure the cocoyam is not sticking out.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Arrange wrapped cocoyam fingers in the oil pot in a circle leaving a hole in the middle. Repeat until cocoyam mixture has been completely used up.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: In a separate pot bring about 7 cups of water to a boil.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add chopped onions, crayfish, fish, meat, salt, pepper, bouillon cubes, palm oil, and country onions to the pot.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Let it simmer for about 10 minutes, there should be no stirring at this point until most of the ekwang firms up- add about 1/2 cup of beef stock to prevent any burns.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Then after ekwang firms up add about all the beef stock if you have any with about 3 cups water or just use 4-6 cups of hot water or more to the pot and let it cook on medium heat for about an hour until fully cooked. You may add more water to prevent burns.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Stirring should be kept at a minimum- to prevent the ekwang from becoming mushy.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Adjust for ekpang consistency with water, salt and pepper.

title: Udon Noodles Recipe (Yaki Udon)
description: This udon noodles recipe, also known as yaki udon, is a Japanese stir-fried dish made with thick and chewy noodles, vegetables, shiitake mushrooms and a savory sauce.

ingredients.name: onions (– sliced, can use spring onion whites instead)
bell pepper (– sliced, green or red or yellow bell pepper)
fresh spinach (– chopped or ½ cup frozen spinach)
ground white pepper ( or ground black pepper)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook Udon Noodles

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make Yaki Udon

title: Shredded Beef and Pepper Stir Fry (青椒肉丝)
description: Shredded beef and pepper stir fry features tender juicy beef and crisp peppers cooked with a spicy savory sauce. It’s easy to prepare and has a very bold flavor.

ingredients.name: (340 g) beef flank steak ((or flat iron, chuck, tri tip) (*Footnote 1))
(total 8 oz / 225 g) cubanelle peppers (, cut into matchsticks (or anaheim peppers))
long red Asian chili pepper (, sliced in rounds (or other type of hot pepper) (Optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the beef along the grain into thin slices that are about 1/2” (4 mm) thick and 2” (5 cm) long. Then further slice it into strips along the grain. Transfer to a medium-sized bowl. Add the doubanjiang, Shaoxing wine, dark soy sauce, and white pepper. Mix until all the liquid is absorbed. Add the cornstarch and mix well to coat. Then add the oil and mix again. Let marinate while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large skillet over high heat and add 1 tablespoon of oil. When the oil begins to smoke, add the marinated beef and spread it out as much as possible without overlapping. Let sear for 30 seconds without moving, until the bottom is lightly charred. Flip to sear the other sides for 20 seconds. Then stir and cook for another 30 seconds to a minute, until the beef is just browned. Transfer the beef to a large plate, leaving any oil and juices in the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil. Add the ginger. Stir a few times to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the sliced chilis to the pan and stir fry for 30 seconds. Add the cooked beef back to the pan. Swirl in the light soy sauce and sprinkle with sugar and salt. Stir fry for a minute or so, until the seasonings are fully distributed. Immediately transfer everything to a big serving plate so the ingredients won’t keep cooking in the residual heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve hot over steamed rice as a main dish.

title: Tinos Fennel Fritters recipe (Greek Marathokeftedes)
description: A Greek traditional vegetarian meze from the island of Tinos. Learn how to make these crispy and crunchy fennel fritters with this traditional recipe.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the onion, spring onions and fennel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place into a large bowl and add the flour, along with some water and mix with a wooden spoon, until the mixture forms a thick batter. Sprinkle with salt and plenty of pepper and stir well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a pan add enough oil to fry the fritters, and heat the oil into medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dip a tablespoon in some water and spoon out some of the mixture into the hot oil. Repeat this procedure until the surface of the pan is comfortably filled. You should dip the spoon in the water every time, so that the dough doesn’t stick on it. Fry the marathokeftedes until nicely colored. Place them on paper towel, to absorb the extra olive oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with sprigs of fennel and fresh yogurt.

title: Dakgangjeong (Sweet Crispy Korean Fried Chicken)
description: Crispy Korean fried chicken pieces glazed in a sticky, sweet, and spicy sauce. This recipe uses bite sized boneless chicken pieces, so it cooks up very fast! The easiest Korean fried chicken recipe you can make!

ingredients.name: potato starch (or corn starch) (you can use more)
cooking rice wine (Mirim (미림), Matsul (맛술), or Mirin)
apple cider vinegar (or rice vinegar) (or other clear vinegar)
gochujang, 고추장 (Korean red chili pepper paste)
to 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped peanuts or seeds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove any visible fat. Cut the chicken into bite sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak the chicken pieces in milk for at least 30 minutes in the fridge. This step is optional.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain well. Mix with the salt, pepper, rice wine (if you didn’t use milk) garlic, and ginger. Let it sit for 20 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a pan, add all the sauce ingredients, and stir well. Bring it to a boil. When it starts to bubble, reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer until it thickens slightly, about 3 to 4 minutes. Turn the heat off.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Coat each chicken piece well with the potato (or corn) starch.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour about 1 inch of oil in to a heavy bottom pan. Use a narrow and deep pan if available, When the oil is sufficiently hot (330°F), drop the chicken pieces in one at a time. Fry them in two batches. Overcrowding will drop the oil temperature too quickly. Cook until light golden brown, about 3 minutes. Remove and set them on a wire rack or a paper towel-lined plate.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Reheat the oil to 330°F. Deep fry again until golden brown, about a minute or two. You can do the second frying in one batch.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat the sauce over medium low heat. Add the chicken and stir well until the chicken pieces are evenly coated.

title: Mung Bean Sprouts (How to Sprout Mung Bean at Home and Salad)
description: Homemade mung bean sprouts with traditional Chinese way and a simple salad recipe.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the mung bean sprouts and remove any roots or bad ones.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add around 1 teaspoon of salt in water. Bring the water to a boiling and then rinse the mung bean sprouts for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer out and rinsing in cold water for around 1 minute. Use your hand to squeeze o remove excess water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix with sauces and serve.

title: Spicy Margarita
description: This spicy margarita is made with tequila, triple sec, jalapeño, and freshly squeezed lime juice. A crisp and refreshing cocktail with a kick!

ingredients.name: 2-3 slices fresh jalapeño, (seeds removed for less heat)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the glass by brushing or rimming a cocktail glass with chamoy, then dip this portion of the glass into Tajin to evenly coat it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a cocktail shaker, add the slices of jalapeño (you can adjust the amount of jalapeño based on your desired level of spiciness) and muddle them to release their juices and oils.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the tequila, triple sec, freshly squeezed lime juice, and sweetener to the shaker. Fill the shaker with ice, secure the lid on the shaker, and shake vigorously for about 10-15 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fill the prepared cocktail glass with ice, then strain the margarita into it, and garnish with a lime wheel and/or jalapeño ring.

title: Thai Dipping Sauce for Meat (Nam Jim Jaew)
description: This is Thai people's #1 go-to sauce for meat; especially grilled and barbecued meats. Works great on beef, pork, chicken and firmer fish such as salmon.

ingredients.name: toasted chili flakes (or to taste (see note 2))
chopped herbs such as cilantro, green onions, mint, or sawtooth coriander
tamarind paste (or sub another ½ Tbsp lime (see note 1))
toasted chili flakes (or to taste (see note 2))
chopped herbs such as cilantro, green onions, mint, or sawtooth coriander
recipe All-Purpose Nam Jim Jaew (from above)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For All-Purpose and Light Nam Jim Jaew

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the Mellow Tomato Jaew

title: Easy Greek Red Lentil Soup Recipe
description: This creamy red lentil soup, prepared Greek-style, will surprise your taste buds in the best way possible! Red lentils, combined with onions, garlic, and sweet carrots in a tomato-based broth. Infused with cumin, oregano, and rosemary.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Early Harvest)
Crumbled feta cheese to serve, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil until shimmering but not smoking. Add onions, carrots and garlic. Cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring regularly. Add spices and bay leaves. Cook for a few seconds till fragrant, keep stirring so spices don’t burn.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add crushed tomatoes, broth, lentils. Season with kosher salt. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until lentils are fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove from heat. If you have the time, let soup cool a bit before using an immersion blender to puree. Pulse a few times till you reach the creamy consitency you are looking for.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return soup to heat, and stir to warm through. Add lemon zest, lemon juice, and fresh parsley.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer soup to serving bowls and top with extra virgin olive oil. If you like, top each bowl with a generous sprinkle of feta cheese. Serve with your favorite crusty bread!

title: Vegan Tzatziki Sauce Recipe
description: This is my ultimate Vegan Tzatziki recipe! Deliciously creamy, refreshing and, best of all, even though its dairy-free, it tastes just like the original!

ingredients.name: tub of Oatly Oatgurt Greek Style Vegan Yogurt (or similar alternative)
a pinch of salt and pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare your vegan tzatziki start by pouring the vegan yoghurt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash your cucumber, cut it in half and grate it using a box grater in a second bowl. You don’t need to peel it, just grate it whole. Using your hands, squeeze your cucumber shreds until all the water has come out. Place your dried out cucumber in the yoghurt bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then, peel your garlic cloves and using a garlic press squash them into your bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finally add your olive oil, vinegar, a pinch of salt and freshly ground pepper and mix it together using a spoon. Taste your tzatziki and, if it feels bland, add some more salt, mix it and taste it again.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you’re using any herbs add them now and using your spoon mix your vegan tzatziki again.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finally top your vegan tzatziki off with some olives, some chopped up cucumber and a drizzle of olive oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Chicken Suya
description: These African-style chicken satays are smothered in a spicy, flavorful peanut butter sauce, then baked to juicy, crispy perfection. They're ideal for snacks, summer picnics, or even a main dish. Amazingly good!Makes 11-12 skewers

ingredients.name: ½-1 tablespoon (2-3g) cayenne ((depending on heat preference))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the skewers totally submerged in water for at least 20 minutes before using them to prevent them from burning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oven to 450°F/230℃. Lightly spray or oil a baking sheet or roasting pan to prevent the suya from sticking to the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, white pepper, cayenne pepper, peanut butter, and bouillon or Maggi in a medium bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel. You want your chicken completely dry before cooking. Slice the chicken into diagonal medium-thin slices. Sprinkle with salt to taste, if desired.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Thread the chicken onto the skewers, about four per skewer. Make sure to cover the skewer with the chicken slices.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Brush the chicken skewer with the spice mixture on both sides. Place skewers on the roasting pan or baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drizzle with oil and bake on for about 20 minutes - rotating sides halfway through baking until chicken is fully cooked. Towards the last 3 minutes of baking, switch from baking to broiler setting to get a nice crisp brown outside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm and pair these chicken suya with African Pepper Sauce and onions.

title: Idli Podi Recipe (Idli Milagai Podi)
description: Idli podi is made by roasting lentils, red chillies, curry leaves and sesame seeds, then grinding them to a slightly coarse powder. It has a spicy and nutty taste. Serve it with idli, dosa or uttapam with some oil or ghee.

ingredients.name: urad dal ((husked and split or whole black gram))
chana dal ((husked and split or whole bengal gram), roasted chana dal can also be used)
to 1.5 teaspoons salt (or add as per taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: roasting lentils and spices

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: making idli podi

title: Scallion Beef Stir Fry (葱爆牛肉)
description: Scallion beef stir-fry features juicy beef cooked with tender Chinese scallion in a scrumptious brown sauce that’s savory and sweet.

ingredients.name: (16 oz) beef flank steak (, sliced into 1/4” (4 mm) thick pieces (or skirt steak, or other cut))
Chinese scallions (, tough end removed and sliced on a bias (or leeks) (*Footnote 2))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the beef, Shaoxing wine, and salt in a medium-sized bowl. Mix well with your hands. Add the cornstarch and mix again, until all the ingredients are evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the sauce ingredients together in a medium-sized bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add the beef and spread it out as much as you can without overlapping (*Footnote 3). Let cook without touching for 30 seconds, or until the bottom is lightly browned. Flip and cook the other side for another 30 seconds, until the surface is cooked but the inside is still a bit pink. Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If your pan does not have any oil left, drizzle a bit more oil into it. Add the dried chili peppers and garlic. Stir a few times until the chili pepper turns dark.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the scallions. Stir and cook for 30 seconds, until the scallions start to soften. If you are using regular leeks, you might need to cook them a bit longer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add back the beef and pour in the sauce. Stir and cook until the sauce has thickened, 1 minute or so. Immediately transfer everything to a big plate. Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Tuna Gimbap
description: Gimbap (Korean seaweed rice rolls) made with canned tuna

ingredients.name: standard measuring cup not the cup that comes with a rice cooker uncooked short grain rice
salt (start with ¼ teaspoon and pepper to taste)
romaine lettuce leaves (only use green leafy part)
kirby cucumbers (cut into thick sticks or julienned (do not used seedy part))
3- inch pieces imitation crab meat (crab sticks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the rice using a little less water than usual. (Fresh cooked rice is best for gimbap.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the tuna well in a strainer. Press with a spoon to force more liquid to drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix well with the celery, mayonnaise, dijon mustard, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the other ingredients. Make sure the vegetables are dry. Pat the crab sticks and pickled radish with a paper towel to remove excess water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When all the other ingredients are ready, remove the rice from the rice cooker. While the rice is still hot, add the sesame oil and salt. Mix well by lightly folding with a rice paddle or large spoon until evenly seasoned. The rice will cool down during this process and be ready to be used.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Put a sheet of gim, shiny side down with the longer side toward you, on a cutting board or a bamboo mat if available. Spread about 3/4 of rice evenly over the gim using a rice paddle or preferably your fingers.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Lay two lettuce leaves and two perilla leaves on top of the rice, close to you, and then the tuna and other prepared ingredients.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Lift the entire bottom edge with both hands, and roll over the filling away from you, bringing it to the other end of rice and tucking in the filling with your fingers. Put firm pressure over the roll with the help of the bamboo mat, if using, to close everything in tightly. Then, continue to roll again, putting pressure evenly over the roll using both hands.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Rub or brush the roll with a little bit of sesame oil for extra flavor and a shiny look. Apply a little bit of sesame oil to a sharp knife. This will keep rice from sticking to the knife. Repeat as necessary after each cut. Wipe the knife with a damp towel if the rice still sticks. Cut the roll into 1/2-inch bite sizes.

title: Zucchini Pancakes Chinese Style
description: Old fashioned Chinese style zucchini pancake

ingredients.name: tbsp. vegetable oil for frying the pancakes
tbsp. Chinese chili oil or other brand you may have

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the zucchini and shred with a tool. Make sure that they are similar in size. Then sprinkle some salt and set aside. Then squeeze the water out.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all-purpose flour, egg, oyster sauce, salt and pepper in. Mix in one direction until there is no dry flour left any more. Set aside for around 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add vegetable oil in and spread the batter. Try to make it as round as possbile. I prefer to pan-fry the pancake one time. But you can choose to fry it as smaller ones by 2 or 3 batches.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once one side of the pancake is well browned, flip over and fry the other side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix all the ingredients for dipping sauce together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer out and serve directly or with the dipping sauce.

title: Crispy Greek Fried Eggplant recipe (Melitzanes tiganites)
description: Discover how to make the perfect Greek Fried Eggplant (Melitzanes Tiganites) with this traditional recipe. Silky, sweet aubergine coated with batter and deep fried to form an amazing, golden brown, extra crispy crust!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek fried eggplant recipe, start by preparing the eggplant. Wash the eggplant thoroughly, remove the stalks and ends and slice in slices (approx. 0.5-0.7cm) or lengthwise. Place the eggplant in a colander and salt generously. Set aside to drain for 30-60 minutes. Rinse with plenty of water, squeeze to get rid of the excessive water and pat them dry. Leave aside to dry completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, prepare the batter for the fried eggplant. Pour the beer in a large bowl and add the flour (sifted) a little bit at a time whilst whisking, being careful not to get lumpy. The batter should be liquid but firm enough to use for coating. So if it’s getting too firm, use less flour than this recipe calls for. Season with salt and pepper, cover the batter with some plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dip the eggplant one at a time in batter and fry in plenty of hot oil on both sides until nicely coloured, for about 1-2 minutes. Remove the fried eggplant using a slotted spoon and place on some paper towel to dry. Repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve this delicious batter fried eggplant while sill hot. Enjoy!

title: Taco Recipe | Vegetarian Tacos
description: This vegetarian taco recipe is made with refried beans, tomato salsa, sour cream and cheese filled in corn tortillas. The tacos have a mix of creamy, crunchy and fresh textures. You can customize the fillings as per your preference.

title: Easy Tofu and Celery Salad
description: Sharing a super easy tofu and celery salad that is perfect for hot summer days. The tender tofu and crisp celery are mixed with a savory and tart dressing with plenty of aromatics and heavenly chili oil, using minimal ingredients to create…

ingredients.name: oz. (200 g) baked tofu (, sliced to 1/2” (1 cm) thick 2” (4 cm) long sticks)
to 4 stalks regular celery (or 1 small batch Chinese celery)
ground Sichuan peppercorns ((or ground black pepper))
homemade chili oil (, or to taste (or 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the tofu and celery to a big bowl. Add the light soy sauce, Chinkiang vinegar, and sugar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat until hot. Add the garlic, ginger and ground Sichuan peppercorns. Stir a few times to release the fragrance. Immediately pour everything over the tofu and celery. Stir to mix well. Pour in the chili oil (or sesame oil) and mix again. You can either store the salad in the fridge for up to a day or serve immediately as an appetizer. The salad will taste better if you let the tofu marinate in the dressing for at least 30 minutes.

title: Tuna bibimbap with spring vegetables
description: Simple bibimbap made with spring vegetables and canned tuna. Quick, easy and delicious!

ingredients.name: to 3 lettuce leaves or a handful of spring mix
lemon juice or vinegar (or more to taste)
lemon juice or vinegar (or more to taste)
lemon juice or vinegar (or more to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix well all the sauce ingredients of the sauce option(s) you picked and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Thinly slice the asparagus, carrots, and red radish into bite-sized pieces. If the carrot is thick, cut in half lengthwise first and then thinly slice diagonally. Cut the radishes into matchsticks. Roughly chop any large green leafy vegetables.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook the peas in salted boiling water until cooked through, 6 - 8 minutes (less if frozen). Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium high heat. Separately sauté the asparagus and then the carrot for a minute or two. You can sauté the scallion briefly if you like.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place a serving of rice in a big bowl. Nicely arrange a small amount of each vegetable and tuna over the rice. Serve with the sauce.

title: Tomato Noodles with Fried Egg
description: Chinese tomato noodles with fried egg

ingredients.name: middle size tomatoes ( , washed and cubed)
spring onions ( , finely chopped (white part and green part separated))
dried noodles ( , any type you want)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok; add chopped garlic and white part of green onions to stir fry until aroma.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add tomato cubes in to simmer until the mixture becomes juice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use high fire; pour the egg liquid in by batch. Each time after pouring the egg liquid, wait for around 10 seconds ~ 20 seconds until the liquid solidify. Then repeat the process.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil dried noodles in boiling water for around 5 minutes. Transfer out and serve with the gravy prepared and chopped green onion garnished.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix the sauce with the noodles before enjoying.

title: Pumpkin Tres Leches Cake
description: This pumpkin tres leches recipe includes perfectly moist and spiced sponge cake topped with whipped cream and pumpkin pie spice!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Coat a 9×13-inch pan with cooking spray, olive oil, or butter. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, add the all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, ground cinnamon, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Whisk together to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the pumpkin puree, eggs, granulated sugar, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract. Whisk together until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and whisk together until well combined and smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Set aside to cool for 10 minutes while you make the three milk mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a medium bowl, add the milk, sweetened condensed milk, and evaporated milk. Whisk together to combine.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Using a knife or a spatula, gently unstick the sides of the cake from the pan. Then, poke holes all over the cake using a skewer or a large fork. Gradually pour the three milk mixture over the cake. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours to let the cake fully cool and absorb the liquid.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: While the cake cools, make the whipped topping. In a large bowl, add the heavy cream, sugar, and vanilla extract. Beat on high speed using a handheld or stand mixer until soft peaks form. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When the cake has cooled completely, top with the whipped topping and garnish with a dusting or sprinkle of pumpkin pie spice.

title: Vegan Moussaka with Lentils
description: So you love moussaka but you are fasting for lent or you are a vegan? That doesn't mean you have to miss out on your favorite dish anymore!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 500ml (2 cups) of boiling water over the dried mushrooms and set aside to soak.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Infuse the milk for the béchamel. Roughly chop the white onion and add to a small saucepan or milk pan along with the soy milk, cinnamon stick, one of the bay leaves and the peppercorns. Set over a medium high heat and gently bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and leave to infuse.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium-high heat. Add the chopped red onion and cook for 5-6 minutes until translucent and just starting to colour. Add the crushed garlic and cook for a further minute until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the ground cinnamon, followed by the tomato paste. Cook for a further minute or two until the tomato paste has caramelised slightly and turned brick red.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the chopped tomatoes, red wine, balsamic vinegar, and the dried mushroom soaking liquid, using a little soaking liquid or wine to wash out the tomato tin so you don’t leave any juice behind. Stir in the lentils, oregano, the remaining dried bay leaf, and the soaked dried mushrooms, finely chopped.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring to the boil and season well with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat to medium low and cook, uncovered, for 1 hour until the lentils are tender, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Meanwhile, pre-heat the oven to 220C/430F.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Slice the potatoes into 0.5cm (half a finger width) slices. Line a large baking sheet (you might need two depending on the size of your sheets) with baking parchment and lay out the potato slices. Spray with olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Flip the pieces over and repeat. Roast in the oven for 30 minutes or until well browned – with the baking parchment, there should be no need to flip them to colour both sides.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To prepare the eggplant, slice lengthwise into 1cm (one finger width) wide strips. As with the potatoes, transfer to baking parchment lined baking sheets, season on both sides with salt, and spray with olive oil. Roast for 20 minutes; there will also be no need to turn the eggplant pieces half way, but you’ll want to rotate the pans in the oven roughly half way to make sure everything browns evenly.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the vegetables are done, drop the oven temperature to 180C/350F.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: When the lentils are about 10 minutes from being cooked, start the béchamel. Heat the extra virgin olive oil in a medium, heavy bottomed saucepan over a medium heat. Once the oil has just started to shimmer, whisk in the flour. Cook for 2 minutes, whisking constantly to cook the raw flavour out of the flour.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Strain the infused milk and gradually whisk it into the flour mixture, whisking quickly to avoid any lumps. Whisk in the nutritional yeast, nutmeg, and garlic powder, and and season to taste with salt – you’ll probably need more than you think to bring out the ‘cheesy’ flavour of the nutritional yeast. Remove from the heat only when the mixture is thick, but still spreadable.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: To assemble the moussaka, spread the potatoes in a single layer across the bottom of a deep 32cm x 20cm (12 inch x 8 inch) baking dish. Then, layer half the eggplant slices, followed by the lentil mixture. Add the rest of the eggplant, and smooth the béchamel over the top.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Bake the moussaka for 30 minutes or until the top is golden. Leave to rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Whole Baked Sea Bass
description: Any white fish marinated in a simple yet flavorful mixture of lemon, tomato, garlic, herbs, and other spices is simple, easy, healthy, and incredibly flavorful!

ingredients.name: whole sea bass, (red snapper, or tilapia (1-2 pounds, scaled and cleaned))
lemon (or lime if that's what's available)
salt and pepper (to taste (½-1 teaspoon salt per pound))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make 3-4 diagonal cuts in each side of the fish, all the way right through the bone.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Squeeze some lemon over it. Season fish with salt and pepper to taste. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Chop parsley, onion (½ sliced onion), basil, tomato, and garlic. Add to a food processor or blender. Blend or pulse while adding oil or water as needed until the ingredients are pureed. If desired, add chicken bouillon to the puree, thoroughly mix.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the marinade over the fish, and gently flip them back and forth until coated inside and out. For best results, let it marinate in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Use a cooking spray to oil the bottom of a roasting pan to prevent the fish from sticking to the pan. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of water or oil on the fish and throw in the cherry tomatoes and the rest of the onion slices.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in a roasting pan at 450℉ (232℃) for 15-20 minutes, depending on the thickness of your fish.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot with plantains or potatoes and African pepper sauce.

title: Cantonese Lettuce with Oyster Sauce (蚝油生菜)
description: Make this super quick and easy Cantonese lettuce with oyster sauce for a delicious and healthy side in 10 minutes. This recipe helps you serve up a large amount of lettuce with a delicious aromatic sauce.

ingredients.name: vegetarian oyster sauce ((or regular oyster sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the tough ends off the lettuce and halve the lettuce lengthwise. Rinse with cold tap water then drain thoroughly. Prepare a large bowl of water with ice for a water bath.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add a few drops of vegetable oil and a pinch of salt (*Footnote 2). Add the lettuce leaves and turn off the heat. Stir for about 10 seconds, until the lettuce just starts to soften. Immediately drain and transfer the lettuce to the water bath to stop cooking. Then drain thoroughly again, remove excess water with paper towels, then transfer to a large plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar in a small bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of water and mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add oil to a small frying pan and heat over medium heat until hot. Add the garlic. Stir and cook for a few seconds to release the fragrance. Pour in the mixed sauce and turn to medium low heat. Simmer and stir for 1 minute, until the sauce is thick and bubbly. If the sauce becomes too dry, add a splash of water and mix well. (*Footnote 3)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the sauce is cooked, pour over the plated lettuce. Serve immediately as a side dish.
