title: Tonkatsu (Donkkaseu)
description: Crispy, crunchy panko breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet!

ingredients.name: lemon - optional for cabbage and garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off fat from the pork. Make a few slits without cutting through the meat. Then pound the meat with a meat pounder until desired thinness is achieved. See note.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Squeeze out the juice from the grated ginger and drizzle over the meat, and lightly sprinkle with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Thinly slice the cabbage leaves, and soak in cold water with a couple of slices of lemon. Drain well before serving.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the flour and breadcrumbs in two separate plates, and the egg in a shallow bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dredge the meat in flour, shaking off excess flour. Dip in the egg, and then dredge in the breadcrumbs, pressing down gently on the meat for a good coating of breadcrumbs. Repeat for the remaining pieces.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 4 cups of oil to a deep fryer, wok or a deep pan. Heat over high heat to 325°F. Drop the meat in the oil. Do not fry more than 2 pieces at a time. Cook until lightly golden brown, flipping once, about a minute each side. The cooking time will depend on the thickness of the meat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove, and drain on a wire rack or a paper towel. Reheat the oil to 325°F. Add the meat and deep fry again for a minute until lightly golden brown. Drain on a wire rack or drain on paper towel again.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut each cutlet into small pieces and serve on plate with cabbage slaw with the optional lemon and cucumber slices for garnish. Serve hot with the katsu along with rice and kimchi, if desired.

title: Soy Sauce Pan Fried Noodles (Cantonese Chow Mein)
description: Cantonese comfort dish--soy sauce fried nice also known as soy sauce chow mein.

ingredients.name: dried egg noodles ( , thinner ones are better)
bean sprouts remove the roots ( , cut into sections)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boiling and cook the noodles for 1 minute. During the process, separate the noodles. Transfer the noodles out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix all the ingredients of the sauce and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add around 2 tablespoon of oil in wok and slow down the fire, fry until the noodles becomes dry and crispy. However this is only optional if you want a real Cantonese flavor. You can skip this to make a regular chow mein recipe. Transfer the noodles out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn up the fire and add another tablespoon of oil, add onion and the white sections of green onions in.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place noodles back, add blanched chive, spring onions and drizzle the sauce. Mix well. Sprinkle some salt if necessary. Serve immediately.

title: Riceberry Congee
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: - 2½ cup pork stock or chicken stock, unsalted
ground pork or chicken (preferably not lean)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the riceberry, jasmine rice and 3 cups water in a small pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer gently for 30 minutes—you only need to stir it occasionally in the beginning, but once the rice starts to look creamy, stir very frequently to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom. Add a little more water as needed if the rice dries up too quickly, but don’t add too much because you want it to be as thick as possible at this stage. The rice is done when it is thick, creamy, and the riceberry grains have burst opened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the rice is cooking, make the pork meatballs by combining all ingredients in a food processor and blend for 15-20 seconds until it looks smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium pot, add the pork or chicken stock and the soy sauce and bring to a simmer. Using 2 small spoons, drop the pork mixture in little balls into the broth. Once all the pork has been added, bring the broth back to a boil, then add the cooked rice, stirring to break up any lumps and bring it back to a simmer. If the rice is too thick, add more stock as needed. Taste and add salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To serve, garnish the congee with julienned ginger, green onions, and white pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Green Chili Corn Casserole
description: You'll love this easy green chili corn casserole made from a mix of sweet corn, creamed corn, and a box of Jiffy corn muffin mix.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Grease 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray or oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Whisk together the corn, creamed corn, sour cream, melted butter, eggs, poblano pepper, and diced green chiles.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the corn muffin mix and cheese and whisk until well combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Taramasalata recipe (Greek Fish Roe dip or Taramosalata)
description: A traditional, creamy and absolutely delicious Taramasalata recipe made in 15'! This Greek dip is made from fish roe, olive oil, lemons, onions and bread.

ingredients.name: white stale bread (crust removed), soaked in water and squeezed (10 oz.)
170-180 ml olive oil (3/4 of a cup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious taramasalata recipe, start by soaking the bread (crust removed) in water and squeeze well to remove the excess water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a food processor add the bread, grated onion and the tarama. Blend until the ingredients are mashed (like a pulp). Add half lemon juice and blend a little more. Pour in the olive oil gradually (just a little bit at a time) whilst blending, like making mayonnaise. Blend until the oil is incorporated and the mixture is smooth and creamy. Taste the taramasalata add some more lemon juice, according to preference and blend again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve this traditional Greek taramasalata dip with lots of home made pita breads aside.

title: Beer Battered Fish
description: Beer Battered Fish - game day favorite fresh fish cod dusted and dipped in a well-seasoned flour and beer batter then fried until golden perfection. Light and crispy on the outside and flaky on the inside.

ingredients.name: (680.39g) skinless cod fillet (, about 1 inch thick, cut into strips )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, cayenne, paprika, baking powder, and salt and pepper, to taste. Reserve about ¾ cup of the flour mixture (this is used to dust fish). Set aside until ready to dip the fish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour oil into a cast iron or skillet, enough for deep frying. Preheat oil into about 375 Degrees F.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the oil is preheating, add the beer to the bowl of the flour mixture and whisk until incorporated and batter is smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then dip each fish strip in the dry flour mixture first, shake off any excess flour and deep into beer batter mixture until it’s completely covered. Remove the fish and let the excess batter drip off.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Carefully lower into cast iron, fry a few pieces at a time, moving them around so they don't stick. Fry until brown and crispy, about 3 to 4 minutes or more depending on the size.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the fryer with a slotted spoon place on a cookie or wire rack to ensure crispness. Repeat with the remaining fish strips. Serve immediately with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.

title: Panakam Recipe (Panagam)
description: Panakam, also called Panagam or Panaka, is a traditional cooling drink from South India made for the Sri Rama Navami festival. It is prepared with jaggery, lemon juice, ginger powder, cardamom and black pepper.

ingredients.name: to ½ teaspoon green cardamom powder

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a bowl, take the chopped jaggery and water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix very well and let the jaggery soak in water for 30 to 40 minutes till all of it is dissolved. If there are impurities in the jaggery syrup, then filter the solution using a fine strainer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Next add ginger powder, green cardamom powder, black pepper powder and salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Yo can also add a pinch of edible camphor. If offering panakam to deities then you can add edible camphor.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix very well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Offer panakam to the deities. If offering to the deities, then you can add a few holy basil leaves (tulsi leaves) in the panakam. If serving to your family and friends, you can refrigerate or add some ice cubes in the panakam.

title: Chicken Pad Thai (Takeout-Style)
description: Try out this vegetable-loaded takeout-style chicken pad thai if you prefer a rich and very rounded sauce without any pungent fish sauce.

ingredients.name: (115 g) dried rice noodles (, about 1/4” (5 cm)-wide)
(225 g) chicken breast (, sliced thinly against the grain (or thigh))
broccoli (, cut into small bite-size florets)
green onions (, sliced into 1” (2.5 cm) pieces)
long red pepper (, sliced (or bird eye pepper if prefer a spicier dish))
mung bean sprouts (, and extra for garnish)
lime (, sliced into wedges for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the noodles: Fully submerge the noodles in room temperature water for 30 to 40 minutes, until they are soft enough to wrap around your fingers without breaking apart, but not quite soft enough that you can bite into them. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the chicken: combine the chicken pieces and soy sauce in a medium-sized bowl. Mix with your hands until the chicken is evenly coated. Let marinate while preparing the other ingredients. (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For the sauce: Combine the sauce ingredients and mix until the sugar is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To cook: Add 1/4 cup water to a large skillet and heat over medium-high heat until simmering. Add the broccoli florets and cover. Steam for 40 seconds to 1 minute, until al dente. Transfer the broccoli to a plate. Wipe the pan clean with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the same skillet. Add the chicken pieces with as little overlapping as possible. Cook without moving until the bottom turns golden brown. Turn to the other side, for 30 seconds or so, until the bottom just turns golden. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil and pour in the beaten eggs. Let cook without moving until the bottom sets, then start to scramble lightly, until the eggs are almost cooked. Transfer the eggs to the plate with the chicken

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, the garlic, shallots, and carrot into the same pan. Cook and stir for 1 minute to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the noodles. Stir a few times to mix everything together. Pour in the sauce. Cook and stir until the sauce is mostly absorbed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add back the cooked chicken, eggs, and broccoli. Stir a few times to mix well.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the green onion, pepper, and bean sprouts. Toss for another 30 seconds, until the vegetables are just wilted. Carefully taste a noodle. If it’s still too tough, add a splash of water and stir to mix well. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until the noodles reach the texture you prefer.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Garnish with the remaining bean sprouts, peanuts, and some wedges of lime. Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Kongbiji jjigae (Ground soybean stew)
description: Warming, hearty stew made with creamy puree of soybeans along with pork ribs and kimchi

ingredients.name: gochugaru (2 teaspoons for spicier stew) - optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and soak 1 cup dried soybeans for 6 to 8 hours (or overnight). Rub the beans with your fingers to remove the skins, and pour out the skins that rise to the top. Repeat this process to remove as much skins as possible.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ribs, onion, scallion, ginger, soup soy sauce and 4 cups of water to a medium to large pot. (See note 1) Bring to a boil. Skim off the scum. Reduce the heat to medium low. Cover, and cook until the ribs are tender, 25 - 30 minutes. The resulting broth should be around 2 to 2.5 cups. Remove the aromatic vegetables. (See note 2 if using pork meat.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the kimchi, juice from kimchi, garlic, and the optional gochugaru to the pot. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Continue to cook for 5 - 6 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, finely grind the soaked beans in an equal amount of cold water (2 to 2.5 cups) until it becomes creamy.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the ground soybeans to the pot. Reduce the heat to medium low.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer, uncovered, until the soybean puree is cooked, 12 - 15 minutes, gently stirring a few times. Further reduce the heat, if necessary, to maintain a gentle simmer. Stir in the chopped scallions with 2 - 3 minutes remaining. Salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot with a bowl of rice.

title: Peking (Beijing Style)Ribs
description: Chinese Peking Ribs

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Firstly clean the ribs and then soak in clean water for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add ribs in water with green onion and slices of ginger. Bring the pot of water to a boiling and then continue cooking 1 to 2 minutes to remove the impurities and odd taste. Pick ribs up and then drain because we are going to sauté them later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add around 1 tablespoon of oil in wok or pan and fry the ribs with middle fire until the surface becomes slightly browned. This step can improve the aroma. Then add ketchup, salt, light soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and enough water to cover the ribs. The simmer for 25 minutes over slow fire. Stay covered.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: During the process, mix cornstarch with water. Add starch water to help thickening the sauce. Sprinkle some toasted white sesame seeds before serving.

title: Easy Cranberry Sauce Recipe
description: This cranberry sauce recipe made with fresh cranberries, orange zest, orange juice and honey is perfect for your upcoming Thanksgiving and Christmas feast!

ingredients.name: honey, (plus more if you like it sweeter)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all ingredients to a medium saucepan and stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, then reduce to simmer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Continue cooking for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cranberries pop and sauce begins to thicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. Serve immediately or transfer to an air-tight container and store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Traditional Greek Kolokithokeftedes (Fried Zucchini/Courgette Balls) Recipe
description: Looking for a traditional Greek kolokithokeftedes (zucchini/ courgette balls) recipe? Find out how to make this Cretan feta and courgette dish from scratch!

ingredients.name: powdered breadcrumbs (or 4 tbsps self raising flour))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Use a grater to grate the zucchini and place them in a colander with some salt. Squeeze them with your hands to get rid of the excessive water. Leave them for 30 minutes and squeeze them again.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a large bowl add all the other ingredients and mix well with your hands, until combined and the mixture is firm enough to make the balls. Add a little more flour if needed. In a pan add enough olive oil to cover the bottom of the pan, and heat the oil into medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dip a tablespoon in some water and spoon out some of the mixture into the hot oil. Repeat this procedure until the surface off the pan is comfortably filled. You should dip the spoon in the water every time, so that the dough doesn’t stick on it.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry the kolokithokeftedes for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until nicely colored. Place them on paper towel, to absorb the extra oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: A healthier alternative is to bake the balls. In that case preheat the oven at 180C, oil the bottom of a baking tray and form the balls with your hands. Take a small handful of the mixture and roll into a ball and then flatten into a patty. Place on the baking tray and form the rest of the balls. Brush the top of the ball with some olive oil and bake for 25 minutes. Halfway through cooking time flip the balls and put back to the oven.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve hot or hot with some fresh cold yogurt aside.

title: Baked Halibut
description: Baked Halibut - light and healthy halibut fish fillet and vegetables rubbed with a slightly bright, tangy, cheesy, and a bit garlicky mixture. Guilt-free and delicious baked dinner ready in just 20 minutes from start to finish!

ingredients.name: or more pint cherry tomatoes, halved ((optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 F. Spray baking dish with cooking spray. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat dry Halibut with a paper towel to remove any excess water. Then season with salt and pepper and squeeze lemon juice all over the fish. Set in a baking pan or dish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Do the same for tomatoes, and vegetables, if using any. Use a baking tray if using more vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake Halibut for about 6 -7 minutes, depending on its thickness. Be careful; they bake up pretty fast. It will finish baking after you add the sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While fish is baking, mix together butter, mayonnaise, parmesan cheese, creole seasoning, garlic, lemon zest, and basil in a small bowl. Thoroughly mix together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove halibut from the oven and spread the Parmesan mixture over the top and sides of the fish. If desired, rub it on vegetables too.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return the fish and vegetables (if using any) back into the oven. Turn the oven to broil and cook for 2-3 minutes until the tops are lightly browned. Serve immediately with a low carb meal or serve with rice. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Garlic Scape Stir Fry with Pork (蒜苔炒肉丝)
description: Garlic scape stir fry with pork is a Chinese homestyle dish that helps you incorporate garlic scapes into your weekday dinner. The crisp garlic scapes are cooked with tender pork in a brown sauce that’s just enough to coat the ingredients.

ingredients.name: (170 g) pork loin (, sliced to 1” (2.5 cm) long 1/4” (5 mm) matchsticks (or tenderloin))
dark soy sauce ((or regular soy sauce) (*footnote 1))
(340 g) garlic scapes (, sliced into 1” (2.5 cm) pieces (yields 2 1/2 cups once cut))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the pork, Shaoxing wine, soy sauce and peanut oil in a small bowl. Mix well. Add the cornstarch and mix with your fingers to coat the pork evenly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Spread the pork with as little overlap as possible. Let cook for 1 minute, until the bottom is lightly browned. Flip and stir a few times, until the pork is just cooked through. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil and the ginger. Stir a few times to release fragrance.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the garlic scapes. Cook and stir for 2 minutes for Asian garlic scapes, until the garlic scapes start to soften. Cook for a longer time for American garlic scapes (*footnote 3). Taste a piece of garlic scape. It should be starting to turn tender and easy to bite into.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the sauce over the garlic scapes. Stir and cook until the garlic scapes have turned tender but are still a bit crisp, or to the degree you prefer, 1 minute or so. Return the pork to the pan and stir a few times to mix everything well, then immediately transfer to a large serving plate. Serve hot as a main dish over steamed rice.

title: Kongguksu (Chilled Soy Milk Noodle Soup)
description: Kongguksu is a refreshing noodle dish in which noodles are served in savory soy milk. Perfect for hot summer days!

ingredients.name: roasted pine nuts (or any other nuts of your choosing)
somyeon/somen (thin wheat flour noodles - about 4 ounces per serving)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and soak 1 cup dried soybeans for 5 to 6 hours or overnight. (Yields about 2 to 2 1/4 cups soaked beans.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add enough water to cover the beans, bring to a boil and cook for an additional 3 – 4 minutes. (Do not overcook.) Drain and place the beans in cold water to cool. Rub the beans with your fingers to remove the skins. Pour out the skins that rise to the top. Add more water. Repeat this process to remove as much as possible.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a blender, puree 1/2 of the cooked beans, 2 tablespoons of nuts, and a teaspoon of sesame seeds, if using, in about 2 cups of cold water as fine as you can. (The finer it is, the creamier the result will be.) Repeat with the remaining beans. Add water (no more than a cup) to adjust the thickness of the liquid.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Run the puree through a fine strainer for a smooth milk-like texture, stirring with a spoon to force it through. (This step is optional.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lightly salt to taste. Stir well. Refrigerate to chill.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Cook somyeon noodles according to the package instructions (about 3 minutes). Drain quickly and shock in cold water to stop cooking. Drain again and rinse in icy cold water. Make serving size mounds. Place the mounds in a colander to drain.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir up the solids settled on the bottom of the soy milk and pour over the noodles in a serving bowl. Garnish with the julienned cucumbers, tomato pieces and/or sesame seeds. Drop in a few ice cubes and serve very cold.

title: Chinese Salt and Pepper Shrimp
description: Chinese style crispy salt and pepper shrimp

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Devein the shrimp and marinate with salt and ginger. Set aside for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: During this process, let make the real deal "salt and pepper". Toast Sichuan peppercorn with salt over slow fire until aromatic (takes around 1 minute). Transfer the mixture out and then ground into powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coat shrimp with starch. Shake off extra starch before frying.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok until you can see waves on the surface. Fry the shrimp for to 1 minute by two batches. Transfer shrimp out. High oil temperature is the key factor to a great flavor.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the extra oil out and leave only around 1/2 tablespoon. Fry garlic, scallion and chopped fresh peppers until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return the shrimp and sprinkle 3/4 of the salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer out and sprinkle the remaining on the surface or on small corner of the serving plate.

title: Pumpkin Empanadas
description: Pumpkin empanadas stuffed with a pumpkin filling and wrapped in a sweet and fluffy bread dough, just like from the Mexican panaderia!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Grease the inside of a large bowl with butter or oil, and line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the water in a small bowl or cup for 10-20 seconds until it reaches 105°F-110°F. Mix in the yeast and 1 tablespoon of the sugar, and loosely cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Let it sit for 5 minutes. If the mixture is bubbly or frothy, that means the yeast is alive and thriving. Continue to the next step. If the mixture hasn't really changed at all, throw the mixture out and start again with a new packet of yeast. (I recommend using a thermometer to make sure your water isn't too hot. Otherwise, it could kill the yeast.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer (or a regular large bowl), add the flour, remaining sugar, pumpkin spice, and salt. Mix together to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the melted butter and 1 egg. Mix together again to lightly combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in the yeast mixture and knead in the stand mixture using the dough hook for 6-8 minutes (or by hand), until the dough is smooth and elastic. The dough should be slightly tacky but not completely sticky. If it is sticky, add in more flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, until the dough is no longer completely sticky.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the dough in the prepared bowl, cover loosely with a sheet of plastic wrap or a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours or until the dough has about doubled in size. (I like to let mine rise on top of the fridge.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While the dough is rising, make the filling: Add the pumpkin puree, dark brown sugar, vanilla extract, and pumpkin spice to a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir together to combine and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat, transfer to a bowl, and set aside until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Divide the dough into 16 equal pieces and shape into balls.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball into a 7-8 inch circle. Place a heaping tablespoon of the pumpkin filling onto each flattened dough circle. Fold one side over and pinch the sides together using your index finger until the empanada is fully sealed. You can also press the edges together using the tines of a fork instead of your fingers. As long as the empanadas are sealed, you're good to go.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Transfer the empanadas to the prepared baking sheets. In a small bowl, whisk the remaining egg. Using a pastry brush, brush the tops of the empanadas with the egg wash.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place in the oven and bake for 23-25 minutes, until the tops are golden brown.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Transfer to a wire rack and let sit for 30 minutes to cool before serving.

title: Nicoise Salad
description: Nicoise Salad - a very satisfying salad with a combination of lean protein, hard-boiled egg, tomatoes, veggies and a wonderful balsamic red wine dressing. Highly-indulgent; not your average boring kind of salad!

ingredients.name: cooked fresh tuna or good quality canned tuna ((I used about 5 ounce fresh tuna))
salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
chopped fresh parsley (, sub with tarragon or chives leaves)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: How To Cook Tuna

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preparing the Vegetables

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dressing

title: Stir Fried Vermicelli with Pork (Ma Yi Shang Shu, 蚂蚁上树)
description: Ma Yi Shang Shu, or stir fried vermicelli with pork, is a perfect quick weekday dinner dish that is so flavorful yet easy to put together.

ingredients.name: oz. (110 g) dried mung bean vermicelli noodles

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the vermicelli noodles in a big bowl and add hot water to cover. Soak according to the package instructions. If the package does not have instructions, soak the noodles in hot water for 15 minutes. Once done, drain thoroughly, toss with 1/2 tablespoon oil, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat 1/2 tablespoon oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat until hot. Add the ginger, garlic and green onion. Cook and stir for 30 seconds to release fragrance.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the ground pork. Cook and chop the pork into smaller pieces, until the pork is fully cooked, 2 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the doubanjiang. Cook and stir for 1 minute, until the pork is covered evenly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour in the chicken broth, the soaked vermicelli noodles, and the sauce. Stir a few times to mix well. Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Uncover the pan. Stir to mix well and check the doneness of the noodles. If the noodles are still tough, cover it and cook for another minute or so. Once the noodles have turned soft, cook uncovered over medium-high heat until the liquid evaporates, about 1 minute. Once done, transfer everything to a plate. Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Greek-style Octopus recipe (Xtapodi)
description: This traditional Greek Octopus recipe will transfer you back to your favorite Greek island! Find out all the secrets to cook the perfect Greek style Octopus
tags: how to cook octopus greek style

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Into a large pan, add the tentacles of the octopus, along with the red wine vinegar, the wine and bay leaves and bring to the boil. Boil with the lid on, on medium low heat, for 40-60 minutes. Do not add any water, because the octopus, will shrink and emit enough water. Be careful not to add any salt, as the octopus is salty enough and not to over-boil it, because it will get mushy. When cooked nicely, the octopus should be crunchy.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When done, remove the octopus from the pan and keep the juices into a bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Into a very hot pan, add the octopus, without the juices, and color nicely for 1 minute. This will allow the octopus to get crispy on the outside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the sliced onions and chopped tomatoes into the pan, along with 1-2 tbsps of olive oil and the garlic and stir. Let it cook for about 5 minutes, stirring every now and again, until the onions caramelize.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Deglaze with the balsamic vinegar and wait for it to evaporate. Pour in the juices from boiling the octopus, that you kept aside, and 2 tbsps of honey. Season well with freshly ground pepper, sprinkle with some chopped pasley and cook for 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with some crusted bread and ouzo or tsipouro.

title: Ugadi Pachadi Recipe
description: Ugadi Pachadi is one of the most important dishes prepared during the Ugadi festival in the states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak tamarind in water for about 40 minutes to 1 hour. Then squeeze the tamarind pulp and set it aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small mixing bowl, add this tamarind pulp.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Next add ⅓ cup water to this bowl containing the tamarind extract or pulp.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the chopped jaggery.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix very well with a spoon so that all of the jaggery dissolves.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the finely chopped raw mangoes and neem flowers.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with salt and black pepper powder. Mix very well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Offer Ugadi Pachadi as naivedyam to your deities. Later serve it to your family as prasad.

title: Easy Enoki Mushroom Soup
description: Super easy enoki mushroom (golden needle mushroom) soup

ingredients.name: fresh enoki mushroom ( , with roots removed, you will not get too much left)
of water ( , or stock if you prefer)
Green onion or coriander for garnishing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove the roots of mushrooms and then separate by hand. Wash and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in wok on medium heat; add garlic to stir fry until aroma. Add ketchup in to stir fry until the oil begins to turn slightly red too.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the water in. Bring all the content to a boiling. Sprinkle the mushrooms in. Continue cook for around 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer out, garnish with green onion or other garnishing you like,drop sesame oil and serve hot!

title: Gungjung Tteokbokki (Royal Court Rice Cake)
description: Korean rice cake dish that originated from royal court cuisine! Mildly flavored with a soy sauce based sauce.

ingredients.name: lean beef (sirloin, eye round, chuck tender or rib eye)
or 4 shiitake mushrooms (fresh or soaked if dried)
medium zucchini (about 4 ounces) (You can also use garlic chives and/or colorful bell peppers.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the sauce ingredients well and set aside. Bring water to a boil in a medium size pot. Add the rice cake pieces. Boil until all the pieces float to the top. The time required will vary depending on the condition of rice cakes. The rice cakes will be very soft when cooked, but they will become harder as they cool. Drain them out with a sieve. Do not rinse. Mix with 2 tablespoons of the prepared sauce. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Thinly slice the beef into about 2-inch long strips. Cut stems off the mushrooms and slice into thin strips. Place the beef and mushrooms in a bowl, and mix in a tablespoon of the prepared sauce. Marinate while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise and then thinly slice crosswise and slightly diagonally to make the cuts longer. Generously sprinkle salt over zucchini slices, and set aside for 10 - 15 minutes. Squeeze out excess liquid from the zucchini by hand. In a lightly heated and oiled skillet, stir fry the onion, carrot, and zucchini over medium high heat, about 2 minutes. Add the scallion at the end (not in the photo). Transfer to a bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same skillet, cook the beef and mushrooms over medium high heat until the meat is cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium low. Add the rice cakes and stir fry for another minute or two. Turn the heat off.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the rice cakes to the bowl with the vegetables, along with the optional ginkgo or pine nuts, and the remaining sauce. Toss well to combine everything well. Adjust the seasoning with additional soy sauce or sugar as necessary. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Deviled Eggs
description: These spicy deviled eggs add a Mexican twist by incorporating a blend of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, lime juice, and red pepper flakes.

ingredients.name: For garnish: crushed red pepper flakes and sliced green onions

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Carefully add the eggs to the pot and bring the water back to a boil. Cook for 12-14 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: About 1 minute before the eggs are ready, fill a large bowl with ice and water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the eggs are done, carefully transfer them to the ice bath using a slotted spoon. Let them sit in the ice bath until they’re cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the eggs are cool enough to handle, peel and discard the shells.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Slice each egg in half lengthwise and carefully scoop the cooked yolks into a small blender or food processor. Place the egg whites on a serving plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To the blender or food processor, add the mayonnaise, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, additional adobo sauce, lime juice, and salt. Blend until smooth. Taste and add more salt as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the filling to a piping bag fitted with a large, wide-open piping tip, and pipe the filling into the hole of each egg white. Alternatively, you can carefully spoon the mixture into each hole instead of piping if you desire.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish each deviled egg with a sprinkle of crushed red pepper flakes and sliced green onions.

title: Homemade Granola Recipe with Olive Oil and Tahini
description: Perfectly crunchy, chewy homemade granola with olive oil, tahini, walnuts and dried fruit. This easy granola recipe with a Mediterranean twist is loaded with flavor and nutrition.

ingredients.name: chopped Medjool dates ((about 6 dates, pitted and chopped) )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the oats, pistachios, walnuts, sunflower seed, and sesame seeds, and coconut flakes in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl, mix the honey, tahini, olive oil, vanilla extract, brown sugar, cinnamon and cardamom. Pour over the oat mixture and toss until the oat mixture is well-coated.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Spread the mixture on a large sheet pan in one single layer. Bake in the heated oven, stirring every 7 to 10 minutes, until the mixture is golden and well-toasted (anywhere from 30 to 45 minutes)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from the heat and allow the granola to cool completely. Break it up into clusters and mix in the dates and cranberries (or other dried fruits of your choice).

title: Greek Shrimp (Prawn) Saganaki recipe with Feta cheese (Garides Saganaki)
description: A super easy, delicious shrimp (prawn) saganaki recipe for you to recreate this simple and beloved traditional Greek appetizer from scratch in less than 20 minutes!

ingredients.name: some hot chilli pepper, according to preferance
Greek drink Ouzo (1/4 of a cup)
200-250g feta cheese, crumbled or cubed (8 oz.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek shrimp saganaki recipe start by peeling and cleaning the shrimps.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Continue preparing the sauce. To prepare the sauce for this shrimp saganaki recipe, dice the fresh tomatoes in small cubes and let them strain in a colander, so that no excess water is added to the sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Begin with the sauce for the shrimp saganaki. Heat the olive oil over medium-high heat, add the chopped onion and sauté for 1 minute. Stir in the chopped garlic, chilli peppers and season with salt and and pepper. Sauté all the ingredients together for 1 more minute. Add the chopped tomatoes, cover with the lid, bring to the boil and let simmer for approx. 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens a little bit.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the meantime sauté the shrimps for this shrimp saganaki recipe. Season the shrimps with salt and pepper on both sides. Heat a large saucepan over medium heat and add 3-4 tbsps olive oil. Add the shrimps, sauté for 1 minute and deglaze with the ouzo.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the sauce in the saucepan along with the shrimps and stir. Top the shrimp saganaki with the crumbled or cubed feta cheese, place the lid on and cook for 2 more minutes, until the feta slightly melts.

title: Greek Ekmek Kataifi recipe (Custard and whipped cream pastry with syrup)
description: An absolutely delicious Ekmek Kataifi recipe! Discover how to make this traditional Ekmek dish to perfection with my extensive list of hints and tips and detailed preparation photos! Go ahead, indulge yourself!

ingredients.name: lemon peel from half a lemon
4-5 egg yolks (depending on the size of the eggs)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Ekmek kataifi recipe start by making the base. Preheat the oven to 170C and unroll the kataifi dough from the plastic sleeve. Work the kataifi dough with your hands, tearing apart the shreds and spreading the strands out a bit if they clump together, in order to get fluffy. For this ekmek kataifi recipe you will need a 25cm square non-sticking baking dish. Butter the bottom of the baking dish and spread the kataifi dough to form the base of the ekmek kataifi. Pour over the melted butter and bake in preheated oven for 30-45 minutes depending on your oven, until crispy and nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the custard for the ekmek kataifi (steps 2-4). Add in a large bowl the egg yolks with half the sugar (100g) and whisk until fluffy. Add 3-4 tbsps of the milk and the corn starch and whisk again until the corn starch has dissolved. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the rest of the milk in a large non-sticking pan and add the sugar and the vanilla extract. Place the pan over high heat and bring to the boil. As soon as the milk comes to the boil, remove from the heat and ladle gradually 1/3 of the milk into the egg mixture, whilst whisking. Place the pan (with the remaining milk) again on the stove and turn the heat down to medium. Add the egg mixture into the pan with the remaining warm milk. Whisk continuously, until the mixture has thickened and is smooth and creamy. Remove the pan from the stove, add the butter and stir.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the custard in a large tray, cover with some plastic wrap (the plastic wrarp should be touching the custard, so that it doesn’t form a crust) and let it cool, while you prepare the rest of the ekmek kataifi recipe.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the kataifi out of the oven and let it cool down completely.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare the syrup for the ekmek kataifi. Add all the ingredients for the syrup into a small pot and bring to the boil. Simmer the syrup of 3 minutes (without stirring), until slightly thickened and remove from the stove. Leave the syrup aside to cool down for a while, until lukewarm. Ladle slowly the lukewarm syrup over the cold baked pastry, enabling each ladle to be absorbed. Set aside to cool down for a while.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Prepare the whipped cream and assemble the ekmek kataifi. Top the kataifi base with the custard and even out using a spatula. Put the cold heavy cream into a mixer’s bowl, add the icing sugar and whisk on high speed until medium peaks form, about 1 minute. Top the ekmek kataifi with the whipped cream and even out. Sprinkle with the chopped pistachios and a pinch of cinnamon.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Store the ekmek kataifi in the fridge and serve cold. Enjoy!

title: Steamed Egg with Crab and Mushrooms ไข่ตุ๋น (kai toon)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: (420 ml) pork or chicken stock, unsalted
Green onions, thinly sliced on a bias
crab meat (plus extra for garnish, if desired)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat a large steamer over medium high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the egg custard: In a mortar and pestle, grind white peppercorns into a fine powder, then add garlic and cilantro roots and pound until fine. Add salt and sugar and grind until the paste is very fine. Add about ½ cup of stock and stir to mix well; set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Beat the eggs gently with a fork, trying not to create air bubbles. Add soy sauce and the remaining stock and stir. Strain to remove unbeaten egg white bits. Pour the garlic-peppercorn-cilantro-roots mixture into the eggs and stir.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If using crab filling: Drizzle soy sauce over crab and toss gently to mix. Distribute mushrooms evenly to the bowls or cups you will use to steam the eggs, then top with the crab. Then ladle in the egg mixture, stirring before you ladle each time. Steam according to the instructions below.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine all filling ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Distribute evenly into the bowls or cups you will use to steam the eggs. Steam for 4-5 minutes until the pork is cooked. Ladle in the egg mixture, stirring before you ladle each time, and steam according to the instructions below.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To Steam: Turn the steamer heat down to low so that the water is maintaining just a gentle simmer. Place the cups on the rack and close the lid, keeping it slightly ajar with a chopstick or a wooden spoon to allow excess heat to escape. Steam until the egg is done, this could take anywhere between 10-20 minutes depending on the size of your cups, the heat of the steamer and the temperature of the custard. The egg will be slightly puffed up when done. To test doneness, jiggle the cup and and the custard should jiggle slightly like jello, or insert a knife into the custard and the liquid that comes out should be clear.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with green onions and extra crab meat (if using crab) or sautéed shimeji mushrooms. Traditionally we serve this with rice, but you can serve it on its own as an appetizer or as breakfast.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To reheat: Microwave or 40%-50% power in increments of 30 seconds. A safer but slower method is to cover the cups with foil and place in a simmering water bath so that the water comes up 3/4 of the height of the cups. Simmer for 7-10 minutes until the custard is hot. You can test the temperature of the custard using a thermometer (aim for about 135 degrees farenheit), or insert a knife into the custard for 10 seconds, pull it out and feel if the knife is hot.

title: Fried Quesadillas
description: Fried quesadillas are a beloved Mexican dish made from masa pockets stuffed with cheese and fillings, then fried to a golden crisp!

ingredients.name: Shredded lettuce, Mexican crema, and your favorite salsa, (for serving)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine the masa harina and salt. Stir in the water and oil until a dough forms.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using your hands, knead the dough until it fully comes together and all the water is absorbed about 3 minutes. To make sure it’s ready, grab a small piece and roll it into a ball. Press down on it with a finger. If the edges of the dough crack, the dough is too dry. If the dough sticks to your skin, it’s too wet. Add more water or masa harina as necessary.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide the dough into 8 equal portions, then roll each into a ball. Cover them with a clean damp cloth or plastic wrap to keep the dough moist while you press and cook the dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Press and flatten each ball of dough into a circle using a tortilla press. Fill each with 2 tablespoons of shredded cheese and 2 tablespoons of shredded chicken. Fold one side over and press the edges together to secure it shut.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour enough oil into the bottom of a deep skillet or frying pan so that the oil reaches halfway up the taquitos. Heat the oil over medium-high heat to 350°F. To test, drop a small piece of tortilla in the oil. If it sizzles, it's ready.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cooking in batches of 2, fry for about 1½ -2 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown on both sides. Transfer them to a large baking sheet lined with paper towels to soak up any excess oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately with shredded lettuce, Mexican crema or sour cream, and your favorite salsa.

ingredients.name: buckwheat noodles (memil guksu) or wheat flour noodles (somyeon/somen)
sugar (or corn syrup/oligo syrup) (adjust to taste)
rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar (adjust to taste)
soft drink (such as ginger ale, Sprite, etc.), apple juice, orange juice, or 1 tablespoon of Korean plum syrup (maesilcheong)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix all sauce ingredients and keep it cool in the fridge. The sauce can be prepared ahead of time, and it will keep well for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Julienne the cucumber, carrot and red cabbage. Thinly slice the lettuce. Keep them cool in the fridge or in ice water (drain well before using) if you like.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain quickly and shock in cold water to stop cooking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drain and rinse in icy cold water until the noodles are very cold. Make two one-serving size mounds. Place the mounds in a colander to drain.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the noodles in the middle of the serving bowl and nicely arrange the cold vegetables over the noodles. Drizzle the sesame oil over, sprinkle with the sesame seeds, and place a half of boiled egg on top. The sauce can be served on top or separately.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Alternatively, you can toss it all together before serving. Mix the noodles well with the sauce, add the sesame oil and vegetables, and toss well. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and place a half of boiled egg on top.

title: Chinese Shrimp Wonton Soup
description: Chinese Cantonese fresh shrimp wonton with a mild soup base.

ingredients.name: Green onion and coriander for garnishing
small bunch of coriander ( , finely chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix minced pork and shrimp with green onions, grated ginger, coriander, light soy sauce, egg white, sesame oil and salt. Stir in one direction until the filling becomes sticky and you get a paste texture.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Scoop around 1 teaspoon filling, place in the center of the wrapper. Assemble the wonton one by one.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In serving bowls, add all the seasonings in the bottle and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil some water in pot; add wonton in to cook for around 3-4 minutes depending on the size of your wonton. Blend green vegetables too.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Scoop around 1 cup of boiling water from the pot to the serving bowls to tune the seasoning and then transfer all the wonton and green vegetables to bowls. Pour extra water to soak the wonton.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve immediately with green onion and coriander garnished.

title: Chicken Taquitos
description: Chicken taquitos stuffed and rolled with shredded chicken and cheese, then baked or fried until crispy and golden brown. Ready in 30 minutes!

ingredients.name: vegetable oil, (about 2 cups for frying or 1-2 tablespoons for baking and air frying)
shredded lettuce, Mexican crema or sour cream, pico de gallo, guacamole, salsa

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Toss together the shredded chicken, chili powder, garlic powder, ground cumin, onion powder, and salt in a large bowl. Taste and season with more salt if necessary.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and heat them in the microwave for 1-2 minutes, flipping the tortillas halfway through until all of them are warm and pliable.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Put a spoonful of shredded chicken and cheese on each tortilla. Roll tightly and secure the seams with a toothpick. (See photo in blog post for example).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To fry: Pour enough oil into the bottom of a deep skillet or frying pan so that the oil reaches halfway up the taquitos. Heat the oil over medium-high heat to 350°F. To test, drop a small piece of tortilla in the oil. If it sizzles, it's ready. Cooking in batches, add 3-4 taquitos and fry for about 1-2 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown. Transfer them to a large plate or baking sheet lined with paper towels to soak up any excess oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To bake: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Place the taquitos on a large baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Lightly brush or spray the tops with cooking oil, and bake for 15-20 minutes or until they're crispy and golden brown.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To air fry: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Place the taquitos in a single layer in the basket seam side down. Spray the tops with cooking spray, air fry for 5 minutes, flip and spray again, then air fry for 2 more minutes. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining taquitos.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the toothpicks from the taquitos, and serve with shredded lettuce, pico de gallo, Mexican crema, and guacamole.

title: Greek Dolmades recipe (Stuffed Vine/ Grape Leaves Dolmathes)
description: Little bites of heaven! This Greek dolmades recipe (stuffed vine/ grape leaves with rice) is the ultimate vegetarian appetizer!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this traditional Greek dolmades recipe (stuffed vine/ grape leaves), start by preparing the vine leaves. For this dolmades recipe, you can either use vine leaves sold in jars or fresh (if you are lucky enough to find them). If you use the ones in jar, rinse the vine leaves, remove the stems and leave them in a colander to drain. If using fresh vine leaves, wash them thoroughly, remove the stems and blanch them in boiling hot water. Remove the leaves with a slotted spoon and place them in a colander to cool down completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the filling for the stuffed vine/ grape leaves (dolmades). Place the rice in a colander and rinse with running water. Heat a large saucepan over medium heat, add 1/3 of the olive oil and the chopped onions. Sauté the onions, until translucent (but not coloured). Add the rice and sauté for 1 more minute. Pour in 2 cups of warm water and half lemon juice and simmer for about 7 minutes, until the rice absorbs all the water and is parboiled. Season with salt and pepper, stir in the herbs, remove from the stove and set aside to cool down for a while. This will be the filling for the dolmades.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Layer the bottom of a large pot with some vine leaves (use the ones that are little bit torn) and start rolling the dolmadakia. (This is probably the most difficult part of the traditional dolmades recipe). Place one vine leaf (shiny side down) on a flat surface and add 1 tsp of the filling at the bottom end (stem). Be careful not to overfill the dolmades, as the rice will expand during cooking. Fold the lower section of the leaf over the filling towards the center; bring the two sides in towards the center and roll them up tightly. Place the stuffed vine leaves (fold side down) on the bottom of the pot and top in snugly layers. Be careful not to leave any gaps between the dolmades to prevent them from cracking open when cooking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drizzle the stuffed vine leaves (dolmathes) with the rest of the olive oil and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Place an inverted plate on top to hold them down when cooking and pour in enough water just to cover them. Place the lid on and simmer the dolmades for about 30-40 minutes, until the water has been absorbed and the dolmades remain only with the oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat, remove the lid and plate and let the dolmades cool for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve this delicious Greek appetizer cold or at room temperature with a squeeze of a lemon. Give this traditional dolmades recipe a try and enjoy your own fresh homemade stuffed grape leaves (dolmades)!

title: How to Cook Couscous
description: Learn how to cook couscous perfectly every time! It takes just 15 minutes and a handful of ingredients. This quick couscous recipe is a great side next to your favorite protein, or use it as a bed to a tasty stew.

ingredients.name: dry instant couscous (I used this couscous)
Pinch ground cumin (or spice of your choice)
to 2 garlic clove (minced and sauteed in extra virgin olive oil)
Fresh herbs to your liking (I used parsley and dill)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a saucepan, add broth or water. Add a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a pinch of kosher salt. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now, toast the couscous. In a non-stick skillet or pan, heat about 1 to 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil. Add the couscous and toss around with a wooden spoon until golden brown. This is an optional step but can really adds a great nutty flavor.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir couscous in the boiled liquid quickly and immediately turn the heat off. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes or until couscous has completely absorbed the broth or water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Uncover and fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: You can serve couscous plain, or mix in spices and herbs to give it more flavor. If you like, add in a pinch of cumin, sautéed garlic, chopped green onions, and fresh herbs or your choice. Enjoy!

title: Biscotti
description: Banana Biscotti -- These biscotti treats have just the right amount of sweet and are crunchy on the outside, firm yet soft enough to bite. Perfect as on-the-go snacks, coffee or tea dunking, or as giveaways.

ingredients.name: (300grams) all-purpose flour (, (add more if dough too sticky))
-1 cup (105-140grams) mixed nuts (, almonds and pistachios)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cream butter and sugar with a mixer until light and fluffy about 2-3 minutes. Add in eggs one at a time until fully combined; beat in almond and vanilla extract.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add flour, cornmeal, salt, grated orange. and baking powder to the butter mixture, stirring until well -blended.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finally, add nuts (if using any). Thoroughly mix. If the dough is sticky, add about 2 more tablespoons to the mixture to form a less sticky dough.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide dough in half and flatten. Shape each portion into a 12 inch-long log with a 1-inch thickness. Place rolls about 4-5 inches apart on a baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake at 350°F for about 25-30 minutes. Transfer the logs to a cutting board and let cool for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: With a serrated knife, cut the logs crosswise into ½ inch slice. Arrange the cookies in a single layer on a baking sheet. Lower the oven temperature to 300 F. Bake the biscotti about 10 minutes per side, turning once as you bake. Transfer biscotti to a wire rack. The biscotti will crisp as they cool.

title: Egg and Kimchi Quesadilla
description: Quick and easy breakfast quesadilla made with scrambled eggs, sauteed kimchi, zucchini, and melty cheese. It takes no time to put together and is colorful and super hearty.

ingredients.name: large Pete and Gerry’s Organic Eggs
(a 6 oz. bag) Mexican cheese (, thinly shredded mixed)
Salsa ((or hot sauce of your choice))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Beat the eggs in a medium-sized bowl with the salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add the beaten eggs. When the bottom is just set, scramble the eggs until they are mostly cooked but the inside is still a bit runny.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil and the kimchi. Stir and cook until the kimchi is toasted and not watery anymore, 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the zucchini. Stir and cook until the zucchini is very lightly cooked, 1 to 2 minutes (*Footnote 1). Transfer everything to a big plate to cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the tortilla in a large skillet. Spread half of the cheese into a thin layer over the whole tortilla. Add half of the kimchi-zucchini stir fry over the cheese, then add half of the eggs between the gaps of the vegetables. Sprinkle half of the green onion. Aim to have everything spread out evenly without too much overlap, so they are all in contact with the cheese.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat up the skillet over medium heat. Cook until the cheese is melted completely, 2 to 3 minutes. Carefully use a spatula to lift one side of the tortilla and fold it over onto the other side, to form a half moon. Once the cheese melts, the toppings will stick to it and stay put during the folding.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Slide the quesadilla onto a cutting board. Use a sharp knife to cut it into three or four even wedges. Make the other quesadilla using the same method.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish the quesadilla with cilantro. Serve hot with your favorite salsa, hot sauce, and / or sour cream.

title: Salmon in Spicy Tomato Sauce
description: Salmon in Spicy Tomato Sauce - moist, flaky salmon fillets simmered in a rich, flavorful and spicy tomato sauce. Comes ready in no time! A perfect meal for busy weeknights.

ingredients.name: salt and freshly ground black pepper
scotch bonnet pepper or ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat about 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium, heat oil until shimmering. Season the salmon with salt and pepper and add to the skillet, skin side down. Cook over high heat until the skin begins to brown, about 2 -3 minutes each side. Remove and set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a food processor blend tomato sauce, onions, garlic, curry, white pepper, paprika, ginger, scotch bonnet pepper and parsley until puree with remaining oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add puree tomato sauce to the skillet, using a wooden spoon scrape any bits of fish sticking to the pan, bring to a boil, let it simmer for about 5 minutes, add the salmon continue simmering until cooked through . This may take about 8-10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove and serve with side of vegetables bread or rice.

title: Dubu Kimchi (Tofu with Stir-fried Kimchi and Pork)
description: Kimchi is stir-fried with pork and served with sliced tofu that has been boiled, steamed, or pan-fried.

ingredients.name: thinly sliced pork or pork belly
- 3 tablespoons gochujang (고추장), Korean red chili pepper paste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut kimchi and pork into bite sizes. Thinly slice onion and scallions. In a large bowl, combine kimchi, pork, onion, scallions and the remaining ingredients and mix well. Let it stand for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium size pot, bring about 4 cups of water to a boil. Cut the tofu into two blocks. Reduce the heat to medium high, and add the tofu. Gently boil for 5 minutes. Carefully transfer the tofu to a colander to drain. Cut each block into about 1/2-inch thick slices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large pan over medium high heat and add the kimchi and pork mix. Cook until the kimchi becomes soft, the pork is cooked through, and most of the liquid generated during the cooking process is evaporated, about 5 - 6 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange the tofu slices nicely on a plate leaving an open space in the middle part. Place the stir-fried kimchi and pork in the middle and serve. Or, you can serve the stir-fried kimchi and tofu side by side.

title: Japanese Deep Roasted Sesame Dressing
description: A delicious copycat recipe of the Kewpie Brand salad dressing.

ingredients.name: 2-3 teaspoons honey or brown sugar (or sub a sweetener of your choice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a dry saute pan, add the sesame seeds and toast them over medium high heat, stirring constantly. Once they turn golden, turn the heat down to medium and continue toasted until they have a deep, dark brown colour. Once the desired colour is reached, immediately pour onto a plate to cool and stop the toasting.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Grind the sesame seeds in a mortar and pestle using a swirling motion until most of the seeds are broken up into a fine meal but you can still see some whole seeds. Note: You can also grind sesame seeds in a coffee grinder, but be careful not to over-grind. I would do little pulses.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add all remaining ingredients to the mortar (serves as a handy mixing bowl!) and whisk to mix well and make sure the honey is completely dissolved.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning to your taste. You can also increase the mayo if you want something thicker and richer. If it's the first time you're making it I recommend tasting it with some actual salad leaves rather than tasting it straight up to get a more accurate idea of where you're at.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Store in the fridge and mix well before using. This should keep for at least a few weeks.

title: Chile Relleno Dip
description: Chile Relleno Dip made with roasted poblano peppers, cream cheese, sour cream, shredded cheese, and seasonings. A tasty Mexican appetizer!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place the poblanos on top. Set the oven rack directly underneath the broiler and turn the broiler on high.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Broil for 5 minutes, or until the skin is blackened and blistered. Carefully flip over the poblanos and broil for another 5 minutes, or until the skin is blackened and blistered on all sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove from the oven and loosely cover the peppers with aluminum foil or plastic wrap to keep in some of the heat to help them steam. Let them sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Uncover the peppers and pull and rub off as much of the blackened skin as possible. It doesn’t have to be perfect. (View step-by-step photos on how to roast poblano peppers.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the clean peppers to a cutting board, discard the stems, and finely dice them. (If you don’t want the dip to be a little spicy, you can remove and discard the seeds before dicing. Otherwise, leave them in.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer diced poblanos to a large bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a small skillet over medium-high heat. When melted, add corn, onion, and garlic. Saute for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions have softened.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer the corn mixture to the large bowl with roasted poblanos. Add the cream cheese, sour cream, shredded cheese, salt, lime juice, and ground cumin.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Mix together with a fork or an electric hand mixer until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Transfer the dip to a square 8x8 baking dish.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: In a small bowl, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and melt in the microwave in 15-second increments.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: When melted, add panko breadcrumbs and mix together with a fork until all the breadcrumbs are coated with butter.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Top the dip with the breadcrumb mixture and bake for 35 minutes, or until breadcrumbs are toasted and the dip is bubbling.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Serve with tortilla chips and enjoy.

title: Mediterranean Baked White Fish
description: Loaded with bright Mediterranean flavors, this baked white fish takes is seasoned with oregano and garlic and topped with a mixture of tomatoes, olives, and red onions. Ready in about 25 minutes!

ingredients.name: white fish fillet such as cod or halibut, ((1 to 1 ½ in thickness))
Kosher salt and ground black pepper
Juice of ½ lemon (more for later)
pitted olives, (halved (I used a combination of kalamata olives and green olives) )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the fish dry and season with salt and pepper on both sides. Brush a 9 ½ x 13-inch baking dish with a little extra virgin olive oil and put the fish in it. Squeeze ½ lemon juice all over the top of the fish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the tomatoes, olives, onions, garlic and spices. Add a very small pinch of salt and ground pepper. Add a generous drizzle (about 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil) toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the tomato and olive mixture over the fish.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in the heated oven for 15 to 20 minutes (this will depend on the thickness of your fish).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the heat and serve.
