title: Gemista recipe (Greek Stuffed Tomatoes and Peppers with rice)
description: Looking for a traditional Greek Gemista/ Yemista recipe (stuffed tomatoes and peppers with rice)? Find out how to bake them to perfection with this locally sourced recipe and secret hints and tips!

ingredients.name: green bell peppers (or orange, red or yellow if you prefer them sweet)
a small bunch of parsley, chopped
a small bunch of fresh mint, chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice off the top of the tomatoes. Using a spoon remove the flesh of the tomatoes and keep it in a bowl. (The flesh of the tomatoes will be the base for the tomato sauce for the Gemista.) Slice off the top of the eggplants and remove the flesh, using a spoon. Cut the flesh of the eggplants in small cubes and set aside, as you will use them later for the filling of the Gemista. Slice off the top of the peppers and remove the seeds and white parts from the inside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the empty vegetables on a large baking tray. Try to leave the vegetables with as little flesh as possible, but be careful not to poke through their skin. Season the empty vegetables with a pinch of salt and sugar and add a little butter on the bottom of each one.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a blender add the flesh of the tomatoes, 5-6 tbsps olive oil, the tomato paste, sugar, season with salt and pepper and mix to combine. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: . In a saucepan add some olive oil and sauté the onions, until translucent. Chop the zucchini in small cubes, add in the saucepan and sauté for one more minute. At the end add the flesh of the eggplants (chopped) and the chopped garlic and sauté, until softened. Add the rice and continue sautéing, unit it becomes transculent. Pour in 1 tin chopped tomatoes, 2 cups of water and season with salt and pepper. Let the filling come to a boil. After 5 minutes the stuffing is ready. It doesn’t need to cook throughout as it will continue cooking in the oven. Remove the pan from the stove and stir in the fresh herbs and taste and season with some more salt and pepper if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you prefer your gemista spiced up with some meat, try sizzling 250grams (8.8oz) of ground beef with the onions in the step above. Once the beef juices have been absorbed and the meat is done, chop the zucchini in small cubes, add in the saucepan and sauté for one more minute. At the end add the flesh of the eggplants (chopped) and the chopped garlic and sauté, until softened. Add the rice and continue sautéing, until it becomes transculent. Pour in 1 tin chopped tomatoes, 2 cups of water and season with salt and pepper. Let the filling come to a boil. After 5 minutes the stuffing is ready. Remove the pan from the stove and stir in the fresh herbs and taste and season with some more salt and pepper if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Peel and chop your potatoes in bite-sized chunks.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: . Spoon the filling inside the empty vegetables, filling them up by about 2/3rds of the way up. The filling will expand a bit when cooking! Add your potatoes, spreading them out in between the vegetables. Season with salt and pepper. Finally spoon the filling liquids from step 4 and your sauce from step 3 inside the vegetables until full and pour the remaining in the baking tray. Cover the vegetables with their lids and add 3 cups of water in your baking tray

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover the Gemista with aluminium foil and bake in preheated oven at 180C / 350F for 60-75 minutes. Halfway through cooking time, remove the aluminium foil and bake until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: The Gemista are equally delicious, served either warm or even straight out of the fridge. Just pair them with some salty feta cheese and enjoy!

title: Dubu Jorim (Braised Tofu)
description: Dubu jorim is a tofu dish that's braised in a simple sauce. With this recipe, you can easily turn your tofu into a flavorful side dish.

ingredients.name: scallions (1 if large), finely chopped (about 1/4 cup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the tofu block into 1/2-inch thick rectangular pieces. Pat dry with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the sauce by mixing all ingredients together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large non-stick skillet, carefully add the tofu pieces (tofu breaks easily) and sear over medium to medium high heat until lightly golden brown (about 3 - 4 minutes each side).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Spoon the sauce over the tofu pieces. Slightly lift a side of the tofu pieces to get the sauce under them. Simmer for 3 - 4 minutes over medium to medium low heat. Flip them over, and simmer for another minute or two, spooning the sauce over the tofu pieces. Serve warm or cold with a bowl of rice.

title: Chinese Vegan Pot Stickers
description: Chinese vegan potstickers with eggplants, corinader, green onions and shitake musrhooms.

ingredients.name: middle size eggplants ( , peeled and cut into small cubes)
small bunch of mung bean noodles ( , soak in warm water for around 15 minutes and then cut into small sections)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the eggplants, cut into small cubes and then soak the cubes in salted water for around 10 minutes. Transfer out and drain. This will help to reduce the oil absorbed by the eggplants in stir-fry process.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a sauce pan, heat up around 1/2 tablespoon of vegetable cooking oil and then stir fry eggplants with mashed garlic until soft. Transfer out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix stir-fried eggplants, mung bean sections, coriander, green onion and shitake mushroom with salt, light soy sauce and Chinese five spice powder.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assemble the potstickers one by one.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Brush some oil on a pan; lay the potstickers and sauté with medium fire until golden brown. In order to make sure the potstickers are cooked toughly, I would suggest pouring around 1 tablespoon warm water after sauté the bottom side to golden brown. The theory is to steam other parts of the potstickers with vapour. Turn the potstickers over from time to time.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer out when the water added are evaporated and potstickers become crispy again.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately or with chili sauce you prefer.

title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
description: Mexican Wedding Cookies are rich, buttery, and crumbly cookies made from a mixture of nuts, flour, butter, and confectioners' sugar.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Place the pecans on a baking sheet and bake for about 6-8 minutes, until fragrant and lightly toasted. (Alternatively, you could toast the pecans in a medium skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.) Let them cool completely before using, about 15 minutes on the counter.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the toasted pecans and 2 tablespoons of the ﬂour into your food processor or blender and process until they are ﬁnely ground. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter, ¼ cup powdered sugar, and vanilla extract on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: With the mixer on low, gradually beat in the remaining all-purpose flour and salt until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Scrape down the sides of the bowl, add the ground nuts, and beat on low speed until combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the dough onto a piece of plastic wrap and flatten it into a medium disc. Wrap tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour until chilled. (Alternatively, you could put the dough in the freezer for 40 minutes to speed up the process.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the chilled dough from the refrigerator and form it into 1-inch balls. I was able to make about 26 cookies.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place them in a single layer onto the prepared baking sheets and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges of the cookies start to brown. Remove them from the oven and place them on a wire rack to cool for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Roll each cookie in the remaining 1 cup of powdered sugar to coat all sides. (The warmer the cookies, the more the powdered sugar turns into a paste, so don't rush the cooling process.)

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to a week.

title: Mediterranean-Style Fish Soup Recipe
description: Quick and easy fish soup with warm Eastern Mediterranean spices, loads of fresh herbs, and a big splash of lemon juice. The perfect one-pot meal for any night of the week. Be sure to read through for important tips!

ingredients.name: Aleppo pepper flakes (or ½ teaspoon red pepper flakes)
moderately firm fish fillet, (I used a combination of sea bass and red snapper, cut into chunks (1 1/2 -inch pieces))
vegetable stock or chicken stock, (preferably low-sodium )
green onions (chopped (both white and green parts))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the spices together.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season the fish with a good pinch of kosher salt and black pepper and 2 to 3 teaspoons of the spice mixture; toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the onions, bell peppers, celery, and garlic. Cook, tossing regularly, for 5 minutes or until the vegetables soften. Season with a good pinch of kosher salt and black pepper. Add the remainder of the spice mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the tomatoes, white wine, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to medium-low. Cover the pot part-way and let simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the fish and cook for about 4 to 5 minutes or until the fish is cooked through (do not over-cook the fish, remember it will continue to cook in the hot broth even after you remove it from the heat).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the parsley, cilantro, green onions. Finish with lemon juice. Serve immediate

title: Feta Saganaki (Pan fried Feta cheese)
description: Tangy feta cheese melting inside an extra crispy coating and finished with a touch of lemon! A super quick and easy Greek feta saganaki recipe to impress your guests and family, ready in less than 10 minutes!

ingredients.name: a block of feta cheese ideally made from 100% sheep’s milk (approx. 190g/ 6.5 oz.)
flour, enough to coat the feta cheese (1.5 oz.)
Alternatively, a tablespoon of honey and sesame seeds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy feta saganaki, start by cutting the feta cheese into 1 block approx. 2cm or 1 inch thick.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Crack the egg into a bowl and whisk it with a fork.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl add the flour and the pepper and using a spoon mix to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dip the feta cheese into the whisked egg and then roll into the flour. You want the feta cheese entirely coated with flour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour your oil to the frying pan until it is about 1 cm / 0.5 inch full.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat the oil over medium-high heat until it has reached 180C/350F. If you don’t have a kitchen thermometer, drip a drop of the egg in the pan. If it sizzles immediately your oil is about the right temperature.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry the feta until nicely coloured. Use a slotted spoon to flip the feta saganaki over carefully, so that it is nicely coloured on both sides. (about 2 minutes each side)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When done, place on some kitchen paper to absorb the extra oil.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Squeeze a few drops of fresh lemon on top (or the honey and sesame seeds) and serve your feta saganaki while still warm!

title: Homemade Soft Pretzel
description: Soft Pretzel Recipe - homemade pretzels using easy made-from-scratch dough that yields a wonderful slightly chewy exterior while incredibly soft on the inside.

ingredients.name: - 3½ cups (375g-437.5g) all-purpose flour or more if needed
large egg yolk beaten with 1-2 tablespoon milk or water
(17g) coarse salt for sprinkling ((or may use sesame seeds, cinnamon sugar or spice of choice.))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine warm water and yeast in a standing mixer or large bowl. Let it sit until dissolve for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add in butter, followed by 3 cups of flour, sugar, and salt. Using the dough hook attachment, mix the dough on low speed until well combined. Change to medium speed and knead until the dough is smooth and pulls away from the side of the bowl, approximately 5-6 minutes. Add in enough additional flour (if needed) to make a soft dough. It’s best to add less flour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the dough from the bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If mixing by hand, turn dough on a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 to 6 minutes or more or until dough is smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Clean the large bowl, oil and place dough inside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover loosely with a clean cloth and let rise in a warm, draft-free place for 1 to 2 hours or until doubled.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Punch the dough down and place on a lightly floured work surface.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bring about 8 cups of water and the baking soda to a boil in a saucepan about 5 -6 quart.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Roll out each piece of dough into a long, thin rope about 22- 24-inch rope length. Make a U-shape with the rope, holding the ends of the rope, cross them over each other and press onto the bottom of the U in order to form the shape of a pretzel. Then tightly pinch the dough at the seam to secure the dough from falling apart.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let it lay onto the parchment-lined sheet pan.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Then gently place the pretzels into the pot of the boiling water, one at a time, for about 30 seconds, pretzels should be immersed in the water.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Quickly placed the wrapped pretzel in the boiling water for about 30 seconds – remove with a slotted spoon and place it on a paper to soak up any excess water from the pretzel.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Line baking sheet. Set aside. Repeat process with the rest of the pretzel.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Finally, brush each pretzel with the egg yolk mixture, and sprinkle with salt, sesame seeds, cinnamon sugar or spice of choice.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Bake for about 12-15 minutes or until golden brown, brush with melted butter and serve with ketchup, mustard or dipping sauce of choice.

title: Korean Banana Milk Recipe
description: Korean Banana Milk is a light and creamy drink made by blending ripe bananas with milk, water or ice and optional sweetener. It has a smooth, flowing consistency that is lighter than a milkshake but still rich in banana flavor.

ingredients.name: cold milk (– plant based or dairy)
cold water ( or 4 to 5 ice cubes)
raw sugar (or white granulated sugar or or any sweetener of choice, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add chopped bananas to a blender jar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in the milk and water or add ice cubes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add vanilla extract and sugar or preferred sweetener if using.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Blend until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy with a flowing consistency.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Taste and adjust the sweetness if needed. If you add more sugar or sweetener, blend again for a few seconds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

title: Da La Pi (大拉皮, Northern Chinese Potato Noodles in Sesame Sauce)
description: Da La Pi, or potato noodles in sesame sauce, is a signature Northern Chinese dish that has a fun texture, is loaded with colorful vegetables, and gets brought together with a rich and nutty sesame-wasabi dressing.

ingredients.name: Chinese sesame paste ((or unsalted natural peanut butter) (*Footnote 1))
(200 g) fresh potato noodles ((or 3.5 oz / 100 g dried potato noodles))
small carrot (, sliced to thin strips)
English cucumber (, sliced to thin strips)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the noodles (Optional)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the shredded eggs

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To mix the sauce

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To make the noodle bowl

title: (FenzhengRou)Steamed Pork with Rice Flour
description: Chinese steamed pork with rice flour, named as "粉蒸肉" in Chinese.

ingredients.name: pork belly ( , or other part with some fat to make two versions)
chopped green onion ( , optional or you can use coriander)
middle size sweet potatoes ( , cut into small cubes)
tsp. salt (, since other sauces are quite salty, you can skip salt)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash grain rice and then drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash the pork belly carefully and then cut into thin slices. I make two versions this time so I divide this batch into two bowls. Marinate pork belly with all the marinating ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add rice and spices in pan on medium heat until most of the rice grains become slightly brown. Pulverize the rice to powders using food processor or by hand.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the pulverized rice with marinated pork. Lay some fresh leaves or clean gauze and then sweet potato cubs under your bamboo steamer. Then spread the pork slices evenly on sweet potato cubes; steam with middle high fire for around 50 minutes to 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer out and garnish some chopped green onions and serve hot!

title: Spicy Roast Pork Salad ยำหมูอบ (yum moo ob)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: recipe Honey Roasted Pork Tenderloin or about 200g of any leftover cooked meat you have, such as roast chicken, steaks, pork chops, etc.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Stir together Thai chilies, honey, lime juice, fish sauce, and Thai chili paste. Add pork or whatever meat you are using and toss to mix. Add all remaining ingredients and toss.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Serve with romaine or butter lettuce, and you can use the lettuce leaf to make a wrap.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Pumpkin Arroz con Leche
description: Pumpkin arroz con leche is a delicious twist on classic rice pudding. This creamy dessert is made with pumpkin puree and pumpkin pie spice.

ingredients.name: Optional toppings: ground cinnamon, chopped nuts, a spoonful of cajeta

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the rice, cinnamon sticks, salt, and water in a medium or large Dutch oven or pot. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until most of the water has evaporated.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir in the milk, cover, and cook for another 15 minutes. Stir the mixture halfway through cooking to ensure the rice doesn’t stick to the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the pumpkin puree, sugar, vanilla extract, and pumpkin pie spice until the pumpkin is smooth and fully dissolved. Cover and cook for another 10 minutes, stirring halfway through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat and let it sit for 15 minutes to thicken and cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve in bowls with a sprinkle of ground cinnamon and chopped nuts.

title: Easy Salmon Soup
description: This easy and bright salmon soup uses simple ingredients and comes together in just over 20 minutes. Delicate, almost creamy chunks of salmon tucked in a flavor-packed broth with potatoes, carrots and fresh dill.

ingredients.name: gold potatoes, (thinly sliced into rounds (best to use a mandolin slicer))
carrot, (thinly sliced into rounds (best to use a mandolin slicer))
salmon fillet, (no skin, cut into large chunks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil in a large pot until shimmering but not smoking. Add green onions, bell pepper, and garlic and cook over medium-heat, stirring frequently until fragrant (about 3 minutes or so). Add ½ of the fresh dill, and stir for 30 seconds more.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Now add broth, potatoes and carrots. Add spices and season with kosher salt and black pepper. Bring to a rolling boil then lower heat to medium and cook for 5 to 6 minutes or until the potatoes and carrots are tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season salmon with kosher salt and gently add it to the pot of simmering soup. Lower heat and cook for a few brief minutes until salmon is cooked through about 3 to 5 minutes or until salmon is cooked and flakes easily.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in lemon zest, lemon juice and remaining dill.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer salmon soup to serving bowls. Serve with a side of your favorite crusty bread. Enjoy!

title: Scone Recipe
description: Scone Recipe - a classic afternoon treat that is soft and fluffy on the insides with that signature crusty and flaky exterior.

ingredients.name: (112 g) unsalted butter (, cold and cut in 1-inch cubes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and lime zest.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Quickly cut butter into flour mixture using your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs, this might take about 3 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make a well in the center of the bowl and add sour cream and vanilla extract. Stir with hands or rubber spatula until it forms a rough ball; do not over mix, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer dough onto a floured board or surface; then knead about 3-4 times- just enough for it to come together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Gently press the dough down to 1 inch thick, use a 2-inch round cookie cutter or a glass to cut out the biscuits into thick circles, press remaining scraps into another whole piece and cut again until the dough has been used up. You can also cut dough into 8 wedges using a knife or bench scraper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Separate wedges and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Brush the top of scones dough with cream.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake at 400°F for 12 minutes or more , until lightly browned. Start checking after 12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove, let it cool on a wire rack for about 5 minutes and serve warm with clotted cream.

title: Greek Almond Cookies Recipe (Ergolavi)
description: A traditional Greek version of the macaroon. This Greek almond cookies recipe (ergolavi) takes 5 minutes to prepare, 3 ingredients and is ready in 30 minutes!

ingredients.name: whole almonds, blanched or almond slivers (8.8 ounces), plus some extra for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these super easy Greek almond biscuits, add the raw almonds and sugar in a food processor and blend until powdered. Add the egg whites (and the vanilla extract) and pulse, until the ingredients combine, forming a firm paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Layer the bottom of 2 baking trays with parchment paper and form the cookies. Take approx. 1 1/2 tsp of the paste and place on the baking tray; repeat with the rest. Garnish with whole almonds or almond silvers and wait for a while for the dough to spread on the tray. If you like, shape the cookies using a pastry bag.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 160C for 17-20 minutes, until light golden. Be careful not to over bake them. Enjoy hot from the oven with a full-spoon of your favorite jam!

title: Chickpea Curry Recipe
description: Coconut Chickpea Curry is a South Indian style curry made with cooked chickpeas simmered in a roasted coconut and spice masala. This vegan curry has a rich aroma and mildly spiced flavor.

ingredients.name: dried white chickpeas ((kabuli chana or safed chana) - 180 grams)
dry red chilies (or 3 to 4 chillies - would make the dish spicy. remove the seeds.)
small piece stone flower ( (dagad phool, pathar phool), optional)
onions (- finely chopped, 50 grams or 1 medium-sized)
or ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ((ground turmeric))
tomatoes (- finely chopped, 80 grams or 1 medium-sized)

steps.description: Cooking chickpeas

title: Suan La Fen (Hot and Sour Noodle Soup, 酸辣粉)
description: Sharing a signature Sichuan dish Suan La Fen - a bowl of hot and sour noodle soup that features tender springy potato noodles smothered in a rich and savory broth. It’s quite easy to put together and addictive to eat!

ingredients.name: dark soy sauce ((use 2 teaspoons if not using Sui Mi Ya Cai))
(200 g) fresh sweet potato noodles ( (or 4 oz./ 120 g dried sweet potato noodles))
Pickled mustard tube ((or other Chinese pickles) (Optional))

title: Maneuljjong Bokkeum (Stir-fried Garlic Scapes)
description: A quick and easy Korean banchan (side dish) made with spring garlic scapes!

ingredients.name: oligodang or corn syrup (or more sugar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and cut the garlic scapes into 2-inch lengths. Mix the first four sauce ingredients well together, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a heated pan over medium low heat, roast the optional walnuts for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a tablespoon of oil to the pan, and increase the heat to medium high. Sauté the scapes for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Reduce the heat to medium low. Return the walnuts to the pan, and pour the sauce into the pan. Cook until the garlic scapes are tender and the sauce is almost gone, about 2 - 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the oligodang (or corn syrup), and stir well. Finish with the sesame oil and sesame seeds.

title: Roasted Cauliflower with Five-Spice
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil plus more for frying garlic
five spice powder, store-bought or homemade
3-5 dried Thai chilies, break in half and remove seeds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450°F/230°C.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Toss cauliflower thoroughly in 3 Tbsp of vegetable oil until thoroughly coated. Lift cauliflower out of the bowl, leaving behind any excess oil, and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Spread the florets out so they are not touching.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roast the cauliflower for 10 minutes, then stir the florets to promote even browning and roast for another 4-5 minutes until they have browned nicely. Remove from oven and leave to cool slightly on the pan until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a small bowl, stir together salt, sugar, white pepper and five spice powder until well combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a wok, add chopped garlic and then add just enough veg oil to almost cover the garlic. Fry gently on medium low heat until golden. Pour the garlic through a strainer, reserving the garlic oil for another use. Return the wok to medium high heat without cleaning it; we want the garlic oil that’s left on the wok.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add dried chilies to the wok and toast until darkened slightly and smells smokey. Add roasted cauliflower, sprinkle the dry seasoning evenly over the cauliflower, and pour the soy sauce in around the edges of the wok. Toss quickly until the cauliflower is thoroughly coated. Turn the heat off, add half of the fried garlic and chopped green onion and toss to combine. Plate, and sprinkle with the remaining fried garlic and green onions. Serve immediately on its own as an appetizer or as a side dish.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Tamales de Elote
description: Tamales de Elote (Sweet Corn Tamales) are an easy and delicious Mexican treat that are perfect for the holidays or any celebration!

ingredients.name: (15.25-ounce) cans sweet kernel corn, (drained and rinsed (about 6 1/3 cups))
canola oil ((vegetable or corn oil also works))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prep the corn husks: Add the corn husks to a large bowl or pot. Pour enough hot water over the corn husks to cover them completely. Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and let them soak for 1 hour to soften them up. Meanwhile, blend the corn and make the sweet tamale dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blend the corn: Add the corn to a large blender. Pulse until the corn is medium to finely ground. It won't be completely smooth, but there shouldn't be any whole kernels in the mix. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the masa harina: In a large mixing bowl, add the masa harina, granulated sugar, baking powder, ground cinnamon, and salt. Mix together to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the oil: Add the corn oil and mix together with your hands, working the dough through your fingers until everything is well combined and incorporated. The dough should feel a little crumbly, almost like wet sand, and should lightly hold its shape when pressed together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the blended corn: Add the blended corn. Mix together with a fork until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finish prepping the corn husks: Drain the water from the corn husks and pat them dry. Remove and discard any corn silk that may be on the husks. Lay the husks flat onto a baking sheet for easy access.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fill the corn husks: Grab a large corn husk and identify which is the smooth side and which is the side with ridges. Place the smooth side face up on a plate. Scoop a heaping 1/4 cup of the tamale dough into the middle of the softened corn husk.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Fold: Fold together the long edges of the corn husk like a book, and then fold it once more. Fold the pointy edge over so that only one side of the corn husk is open and exposed. Place in a bowl with the open end facing up, making sure to lean them against the side so it doesn't fall down. Repeat until all the tamales have been filled and assembled.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Prepare the steamer pot: Fill the bottom of the steamer pot with water and cover with the steamer insert. Place the sweet tamales in the steamer with the open end facing up, making sure to lean them against the side of the pot so they don't fall down.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Steam: Cover tightly with the lid and place the steamer over high heat. Bring the water in the steamer pot to a boil (you should be able to hear it bubbling), then reduce the heat to low, and cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Rest and serve: Carefully transfer the tamales to a baking sheet or serving platter and let them sit and cool slightly for 10 minutes. They may be a little squishy when you first take them out of the steamer, but will quickly firm up once they have time to cool. Serve and enjoy!

title: Mediterranean Bean Soup Recipe with Tomato Pesto
description: Not your average bean soup recipe! This one pot Mediterranean bean soup is loaded with nutrition, texture and flavor from warm spices, aromatic, and a bright tomato pesto. Vegetarian. Gluten Free. Great to make ahead and freeze (see notes.)

ingredients.name: Large russet potato (peeled, diced into small cubes)
low sodium vegetable broth, (or broth of your choice)
8- oz frozen spinach, (no need to thaw)
15- oz can red kidney beans, (drained and rinsed )
15- oz can cannellini beans, (drained and rinsed)
2-3 large garlic cloves, (you can start with less garlic if you're not sure)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat two tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the diced potatoes and onions. Cook for about 4-5 minutes, tossing regularly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the canned diced tomatoes, vinegar, spices, salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Cover and cook for another 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Uncover, add the vegetable broth and frozen spinach. Raise the heat to medium-high and bring to a boil for 4 minutes or so. Add the kidney beans, cannellini beans, and chickpeas. Bring back to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and cook for another 15 to 20 minutes (potatoes should be tender at this point).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the soup is cooking, make the tomato pesto. In the bowl of a food processor fitted with a blade, place the garlic and fresh tomatoes. Pulse a few times to combine. Add the basil and puree. While the processor is running, drizzle in the olive oil a little bit at a time. Transfer the thick tomato pesto to a bowl, and stir in the grated Parmesan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When the soup is ready, remove from heat. Stir in the tomato pesto.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowls. Top each bowl with a few basil leaves and toasted pine nuts. Enjoy with your favorite crusty bread!

title: Zhajiangmian—Minced Pork Noodles
description: Chinese Minced Pork Noodles--Zha Jiang Mian

ingredients.name: fresh noodles for serving ( ,instruction for handmade noodles)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add around 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in pan and fry the diced pork until withered and slightly browned. This is the process why we say it is “fried” sauce. Pour in Chinese cooking wine for a more pure taste. Move the pork to the edges of the pan, add garlic and ginger, fry over slow fire until aromatic. Slow down the fire, otherwise the ginger and garlic might be burnt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in our mixed sauce, dark soy sauce and let it simmer for 15 minutes over slowest fire. Mix in sugar. If necessary, turn up the fire and thicken the sauce slightly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Blanch shredded carrot for around 30 seconds and cook the noodles according to the instruction. Top the sauce and serve immediately. Since this is a dry-mixed noodle dish, I high recommend matching it with a warm soup.

title: Greek Meat Pie (Kreatopita)
description: If you are looking for a classic Greek meat pie, then this recipe for Kreatopita will be just what you need! Combining two different types of meat, it is a traditional, rustic pie you would see in villages across parts of Greece

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the Greek meat pie filling

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To assemble the Greek meat pie

title: Fry Jacks Belize
description: Fry jacks- a popular Belizean breakfast bread that can be whipped up in less than 30 mins. It sure hits the spot.

ingredients.name: whole milk or canned coconut milk

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add shortening.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then make a well then add milk, knead dough for about 30 seconds to 1 minute to form soft dough.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide dough into 6-7 equal pieces. Set aside for about 10 mins.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place each one piece on a heavily floured board and roll out dough into a circle. They do not have to be perfect circles.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Divide the circles in half and then place a slit on dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large, saucepan pour vegetable oil, until it is at least 3 inches and place on medium heat until oil is 350 degrees.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry until golden brown about 3-5 minutes depending on size. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper napkin. Let it cool

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm with honey, butter, cheese and refried beans.

title: Chana Masala Recipe (Authentic North Indian Style)
description: Chana Masala is a North Indian curry made with chickpeas simmered in a tangy, spiced onion-tomato gravy with ginger, garlic and Indian spices.

ingredients.name: dried white chickpeas ((garbanzo beans or white chana) - soaked overnight in enough water)
to 3 pieces dried amla ((Indian gooseberry, dried)or 1 black tea bag, optional)
tej patta (- small to medium sized, (Indian bay leaf), optional)
to 4 green chilies (- slit (green chili peppers))
ginger paste (or about 1 inch peeled ginger - crushed in mortar-pestle)
garlic paste (or about 6 to 7 medium-sized peeled garlic cloves - crushed in mortar-pestle)
garam masala (or chana masala powder or punjabi garam masala powder)

title: Ji Dan Bing (Chinese Breakfast Pancake, 鸡蛋饼)
description: Ji Dan Bing, or Chinese breakfast pancake, is a thin flour pancake cooked with a slightly scrambled egg, green onion and sesame, brushed with a sweet savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Toasted black sesame seeds (, for garnish)
Chili garlic sauce (, for spiciness if preferred (Optional))
hot dogs (, pan fried (or bacon strips))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the all-purpose flour and salt in a medium size bowl. Stir a few times to mix well. Slowly pour in the water while mixing, until it forms a smooth, runny batter. Add the peanut oil. Mix until fully incorporated. The batter should be quite runny, but not as runny as a crepe batter.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spray (or drizzle) a very small amount of oil onto a medium-sized or small nonstick skillet. Use paper towels to wipe the pan so the oil is very thinly coated.(*Footnote 1) Heat over medium heat until just hot and not smoking hot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add about 1/3 cup of the batter to the pan. Immediately swirl the pan so the batter will spread out evenly into a thin round shaped pancake.(*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the pancake is just set, crack an egg onto the center of it. Use a spoon to break the egg and spread it over the pancake. When the egg is still runny, sprinkle it with green onion and black sesame seeds. Cook over medium-low heat until the egg is mostly set and the bottom of the pancake just turns golden on the edges. Carefully flip the pancake. Cook for 20 to 30 seconds, until the egg is fully cooked. Transfer the pancake to a plate. Keep cooking the rest of the pancakes. Note, you might need to lower the heat while making the rest of the pancakes or remove the pan from the heat occasionally when adding the batter. If the pan gets too hot, the batter will set too quickly and will be difficult to spread out into a thin pancake.

Flip the pork and broil the other side for another 5 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F. Note: At 145°F, the pork will still be slightly pink inside; this is safe to eat and the pork will be more juicy this way!

steps.title: Step 6

Taste and adjust the flavour by adding more honey, tamarind, soy sauce, or sriracha, depending if you want the sauce to be more sweet, sour, salty, or spicy. If you want to darken the colour, add black soy sauce. If the sauce is too strong, you can add a splash of coconut milk or water to mellow it out..

title: Easy Homemade Spaghetti Sauce Recipe
description: My family's secret homemade spaghetti sauce is easy to make using a few staple ingredients you may already have on hand! Perfectly thick and packed with flavor, you'll be ditching that store bought pasta sauce!

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil)
carrots, finely grated (use a food processor or a grater)
Handful fresh basil, about ½ cup packed, torn
Handful fresh parsley, about ½ cup packed, chopped
to 1 lb of cooked pasta of your choice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pan heat the extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until just shimmering. Add the onions, garlic, and finely grated carrots. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring regularly until softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the crushed tomatoes and about 1/2 cup water. Add a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Stir in oregano, paprika, crushed pepper flakes, if using. Finally, stir in the fresh basil and parsley.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring the sauce to a boil, then turn heat to low. Cover and let simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes. Check partway through, and if you feel the sauce is too thick, you can add a bit more water (preferably some of your pasta cooking water). When sauce is ready, throw in more fresh basil, if you like.

steps.title: Step 4

title: Traditional Greek Leek Pie recipe (Prasopita)
description: Discover this traditional Greek leek pie recipe (prasopita) with homemade phyllo for you to recreate this delicious vegetarian delight from scratch!

ingredients.name: Graviera cheese, or hard yellow cheese (3.5 oz.)
olive oil or butter for brushing the pan
egg and 1 tsp water to brush the top

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you choose to prepare this Greek leek pie with commercial phyllo dough, it is important to thaw completely the phyllo dough by putting it in the fridge from the previous day. For the beginners at working with phyllo, check the handling tips before starting.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make this traditional Greek leek pie recipe, start by making the filling. Wash the leeks and trim them, keeping only the white part and cut in slices (2cm width).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a saucepan, add olive oil, the leeks and scallions and season with salt and pepper. Sauté, whilst stirring, until tender. Deglaze with the white wine and wait for it to evaporate. Remove the pan from the stove and allow them to cool down for a while.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a bowl add 1 egg yolk and the milk cream and whisk. Stir in the leeks mixture, feta cheese, graviera cheese, season with pepper and blend to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Brush a medium sized baking tray with olive oil and lay one sheet of phyllo dough, allowing it to exceed the pan. Brush the phyllo sheet with olive oil or melted butter and continue with 5-6 more phyllo sheets (brushing each one with olive oil or melted butter). Tip in the filling and even out using a spatula. With a knife trim some of the excessive phyllo, and fold the excess phyllo sheets flaps over the mixture. Add 5-6 more phyllo sheets, making sure to oil or butter each one, before adding the other. Trim some of the excessive phyllo and roll the rest on the edges.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a bowl whisk the egg and the water, brush the top of the leek pie and scar into pieces. Bake in preheated oven at 180C for about 50 minutes, until nicely coloured. Enjoy this traditional vegetarian Greek leek pie as a filling snack or as light meal. Καλή όρεξη!

title: Coconut Bake

ingredients.name: coconut oil or melted unsalted butter
all purpose flour or replace parts of the flour with wheat flour.
-¾ cup grated coconut or coconut flakes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Hit hard the middle of a coconut with a blunt side of a cleaver or hammer, just enough to crack it. Rotate the coconut, continuing to hit it at the center just enough to crack it. Rotate the coconut, continuing to hit it at the center with the hammer or cleaver. It will split in two eventually at the center or wrap coconut

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place it in the oven for about 10 minutes at 375 degrees F to facilitate removal of the flesh from the shell. Let it cool. Use a spoon to remove the coconut from the shell.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the coconut into little pieces and place in food processor, pulse several times until fine in texture. Set aside

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Warm coconut milk in a microwave until Luke warm, add yeast. Let it rest for about a minute, and then add sugar, salt, and coconut oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix, for about a minute. Finally add in wheat flour, white flour, and coconut.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix with your hands until dough clumps together and it soft

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place on lightly floured surface and knead for about 3-5 minutes. Set aside and let it sit covered for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Divide the dough into 4; roll out dough with a rolling pin into a circle about 1-2 inches thick.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Decorate the dough by pricking it with a fork. Let it rest for about 10.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place dough on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 20-25 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove and let it cool for 5 minutes.

title: Easy Greek Spinach pie for Beginners (Spanakopita)
description: It doesn’t matter if you haven’t made a pie before. This amazing easy Greek spinach pie recipe (spanakopita) is made in only one hour from scratch!

ingredients.name: small red onions, halved and sliced
spinach, washed and roughly chopped (18 ounces)
pack of filo pastry (400g / 14 oz typically) or if you can find some Horiatiko phyllo from your local Greek Deli.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you choose to prepare this Greek spinach pie recipe with commercial phyllo dough, it is important to thaw completely the phyllo dough by putting it in the fridge from the previous day. For the beginners at working with phyllo, check the handling tips before start making the spanakopita.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare this spinach pie recipe, sauté the onions in a large knob of butter until soft and turning golden. Add the garlic and cook for a couple of minutes. Add the spinach in batches and cook until wilted. Cool, then tip into a bowl (leaving behind any excess liquid from the spinach) and mix in the nutmeg, feta, eggs, spring onion and season. This will be the filling of the spanakopita.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For this spinach pie recipe you will need a non stick baking pan, about 20-22cm. Put the first sheet of filo in the pan and brush with butter, letting the excess hang over the sides. Keep going with the rest of the sheets, turning a little before adding each additional pastry sheet and brushing all over with butter. When all the pastry is used up, tip in the filling of the spanakopita and fold over the excess pastry to cover. If you like to prepare a larger pan of spanakopita for a big crowd, double the ingredients for the filling and use a 25*35 cm baking dish. Layer the 4-5 phyllo sheets to form the bottom of the spanakopita, tip in the filling and top with 4-5 more phyllo sheets.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Butter the top of the spinach pie with melted butter and scar with a sharp knife. Bake in preheated oven for about 30 minutes until the filo is crisp and golden.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Leave the spanakopita cool down for 10-15 minutes before cutting into pieces. Serve the spinach pie with Greek feta salad. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

steps.title: Step 9

steps.description: To prepare this spanakopita recipe start by making the phyllo dough first. (For step by step instructions Homemade phyllo dough). Alternatively use commercial phyllo dough.

Add the spinach in batches and cook until wilted. Cool, then tip into a bowl (leaving behind any excess liquid from the spinach) and mix in the nutmeg, feta, eggs, spring onion and season.

If you like to prepare a larger pan of spanakopita for a big crowd, double the ingredients for the filling and use a 25*35 cm baking dish. saeujeot 새우젓 (salted and fermented shrimp) or use more fish sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the cucumbers in half lengthwise. Cut each one in half again lengthwise. Dice the cucumbern quarters into about 1 to 1.5 inch-long pieces. Sprinkle the salt evenly all over the cucumber pieces. Let them sit for about 30 minutes.

title: "Thai" Granola with Coconut & Sesame
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: of coconut flakes or ½ cup dried shredded coconut
total of dried fruits, nuts, seeds of your choice (but to stick to the "kra ya saat" theme you want to have roasted peanuts in the mix)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 325 F (165 C). Line a large baking pan with parchment paper or silicone liner.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a dry saute pan, add sesame seeds and toast over medium high heat until the white ones are aromatic and golden brown. If using black ones, they should start to pop, smoke, and become aromatic. Remove and let cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same pan, reduce the heat to low, add the coconut and stir quickly until it is a deep brown colour (not light brown, you want it darker for a more toasty flavour). This can happen very quickly especially if you're using finely shredded coconut, so be sure to stir very quickly and have a plate ready to remove from the pan. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Have the oats ready in a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For the syrup: in a small pot, stir together palm sugar, coconut milk, coconut oil and salt. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and keep cooking until all the sugar is all dissolved, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn off the heat then stir in the sesame seeds, and if you're using finely shredded coconut or any other small seeds, you'll want to add that into the syrup as well. If using large flakes of coconut you can add it in at the end with the dried fruit.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drizzle the syrup over the oats and toss to thoroughly and evenly coat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Spread evenly on the baking sheet, leaving a bit of an empty space in the centre for more even baking (see video). Bake for 30-35 minutes total, taking it out after about 15 minutes to stir. When done, the oats should have darkened into a deep golden brown colour and will be completely crispy once cool. They will not be crispy when hot, so to check for crispiness, take a little bit of the mixture and blow on it to cool it down quickly and see. If not yet crispy, keep baking in 5 minute increments.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Leave to cool on the baking sheet, then transfer into a large mixing bowl, breaking large pieces up gently with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Stir in coconut flakes and all of your dried fruits, nuts and seeds.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place and it should last at least 2 months. Note: If using longans as I did, they will dry out after about a month because the oats will absorb their moisture. So if you make a large batch that you plan on keeping for a while, maybe add the longans in when you're eating.

title: Easy Flan Recipe
description: An easy flan recipe made with only 5 simple ingredients! This creamy custard dessert is topped with caramel and popular in Mexico, Spain and Latin America.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour the sugar into a skillet over medium heat. Stir the sugar continually until it begins to brown and clump together. Keep stirring until the sugar completely melts and dissolves into a golden-brown syrup. Remove the syrup from the heat as soon as it has dissolves as it can burn.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Working quickly, carefully pour the caramel into a 7-inch round pan or a special flan pan (flanera) as shown in the photos in the blog post. Pour the caramel evenly into the bottom of the pan so the entire bottom is coated. If you need to, use an oven mitt or potholders to move the pan from side to side to get the caramel evenly distributed. If the caramel hardens too quickly, you can carefully reheat the pan by placing it directly on the stove or on the skillet for a few seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Set the caramel-coated pan aside to cool and harden.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, add the eggs, sweetened condensed milk, whole milk and vanilla extract. Whisk together until everything is fully combined, but try not to overwhisk so that there aren't too many air bubbles in the mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the custard mixture into the caramel-coated pan. Cover the top of the pan with the lid (if using a flanera) or tightly with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the flan pan in a large baking dish and pour enough water in the dish until it reaches about halfway up the pan. Carefully place the baking dish in the oven and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Carefully remove the dish from the oven, and then lift the flan pan out of the water bath. Remove the lid or aluminum foil and let it cool to room temperature. The flan may still be a little jiggly, but that's okay - it will continue to cook with the residual heat.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once it's cooled, cover with the lid or aluminum foil and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: To serve, remove the lid or aluminum foil and slide a knife along the edges of the pan to loosen it up. Place a plate or platter on top of the flan, grab a hold of both the plate and the pan and quickly and securely flip it over so that the flan is now upside down. Carefully lift off the flan pan. Your flan should be sitting in the caramel on the plate, ready to enjoy!

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Carefully lift the flan pan up. The flan should be on the plate - if it's not, place the pan back down and let it sit for a few minutes. Don't freak out! It will loosen up and slide out. You could try tapping the sides of the pan a bit or even giving the sides a squeeze.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Slice the flan and serve with the rich caramel sauce!

title: Gamjajeon (Potato Pancake)

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the grated potato in a bowl lined with a strainer, reserving the liquid. Immediately transfer to the bowl with the grated onion, and mix well with the optional onion to prevent discoloring of the potato.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Let the reserved liquid sit for about 10 minutes. The starch in the liquid will sink to the bottom. Carefully pour out the water, saving the starch. Add the starch and salt to the grated potato along with the optional garlic chives. Mix well.

steps.description: Cut the sheets into three or four lanes (depending on if you like the tiropitakia to be small or larger). At the end of each lane add one tablespoon of the filling. Fold one corner to form a triangle and continue folding the triangle upon itself, until the entire piece of phyllo is used. Continue with the rest phyllo sheets and filling.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Oil the bottom of a large baking tray, place the tiropitakia and brush them with some melted butter on top. Bake in preheated oven at 180C for 25-30 minutes, until golden and crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve this delicious Greek feta cheese triangles as a great starter with some Greek salad aside.

steps.description: Pre-soak the azuki beans in water overnight if you are using ordinary cooker. For high pressure cooker, soaking process is not a must but also recommended.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put rock sugar, soaked beans, water and orange peels in a large pot. Bring all the content to a boil and then cook for 15 minutes. Turn off the fire and let the beans cool down slightly, with the lid covered. Then re-start the fire and continue simmer for 30 minutes until the beans are completely soft. Season with sugar.

title: Galbijjim (braised beef short ribs)
description: Galbijjim is braised beef short ribs in a rich sauce. You can make these tender, succulent short ribs at home with this easy, authentic recipe!

ingredients.name: cooking rice wine (or Korean matsul/mirim or mirin)
Korean radish (cut into large chunks (about 1-1/2-inch cubes))
large carrot (cut into large chunks (about 1 inch long))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off any excess fat. Rinse the ribs and let them sit in cold water for about 30 minutes to draw out excess blood. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pot, bring 5 cups of water to a boil over high heat along with the onion, ginger, garlic and scallion white parts. Add the short ribs, and bring it to a boil, uncovered, skimming off the foam. Reduce the heat to medium high and cook for about 10 minutes. Remove the ribs to a plate, reserving the stock.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Strain the stock, and skim off the fat. (Refrigerating the stock will help the fat solidify for easier removal. If you have room in the freezer, the process will go faster.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix together all the braising liquid ingredients, except the sesame oil. Return the ribs to the pot. Pour the braising liquid over the meat and stir. (You can prepare the ribs up to this point the day before, and finish braising when you need to serve.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, prepare the vegetables and optional garnish.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 2.5 cups of the reserved stock to the ribs. Cover and bring it to a boil over medium heat. Continue to boil for 20 to 30 minutes, depending on the thickness of the ribs. Stir in the radish, mushrooms, and carrots. Continue to boil, covered, for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir in the optional garnish ingredients. Return to boil, uncovered this time, for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sauce is thicker and the meat is tender but not falling apart. Add the green parts of scallions and the sesame oil and stir gently before turning the heat off.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine coconut milk, palm sugar, white sugar, and salt in a pot and cook over medium heat until all the sugar is dissolved. Stir in coconut water and vodka, if using. Let chill in the fridge completely and churn according to your ice cream machine's instructions. Add the young coconut meat and jackfruit, or any other add-ins, during the last 1-2 minutes of churning.

title: Chicken Tamales
description: Chicken tamales made from tender pieces of chicken, green chile verde sauce and an easy masa tamale dough. Great for a crowd and freezing for later!

ingredients.name: serrano pepper, (stem removed (omit if you don't want it spicy))
boneless skinless chicken thighs, (cut into very small pieces (see photo in blog post for example))
lime juice ((about the juice of 1/2 lime))
masa harina ((half of a 4.4 lb bag Maseca))
canola oil ((or corn, vegetable or any other neutral-tasting oil))
chicken broth ((or vegetable – low sodium preferred))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prep the corn husks: Add the corn husks to a large bowl or pot. Pour enough hot water over the corn husks to cover them completely. Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and let them soak for 1 hour to soften them up.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Roast the chiles: Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray or grease with oil. Place the tomatillos, jalapenos, poblanos and serrano peppers on the baking sheet and place under broiler. Broil on high for 10 minutes, turning the tomatillos and peppers over halfway through.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the skin: Remove the baking sheet from the broiler and cover with aluminum foil or plastic wrap. Let it sit for 10 minutes. Uncover and remove as much of the skin from the peppers and tomatillos as you can. At this point, you can also remove the seeds from any of the peppers if you don't want it too spicy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the green chile sauce: Add the roasted tomatillos, all the peppers, onions, garlic, salt and water to a large blender. Blend until smooth. Set aside until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook the chicken: Heat oil in a Dutch oven or large pot over medium-high heat. Add chicken, season with salt and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until chicken is no longer pink.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Simmer the chicken: Add green chile sauce and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered for 15 more minutes. Taste and season with more salt if necessary. The chicken should be tender and cooked through. If it's still a little tough, cook for another 15 minutes. Remove from heat and mix in the lime juice. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Mix the masa harina: In a very large mixing bowl or pot, add masa harina, salt and baking powder. Combine and mix with your hands.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the oil: Add canola oil and mix together, working the dough through your fingers until everything is well combined and incorporated. The dough should feel a little crumbly, almost like wet sand, and should lightly hold it's shape when pressed together.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the broth: Add broth and mix for about 3-5 minutes until the dough is fairly wet and well saturated. The dough should be soft and spreadable like thick hummus. If the dough is too dry, add more broth. If it's too wet, add more masa harina.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Finish prepping the corn husks: Drain the water from the corn husks and pat them dry. Lay them flat onto a baking sheet for easy access.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Spread the masa onto corn husks: Grab a corn husk and identify which is the smooth side and which is the side with ridges. Place the smooth side face up into your palm or on a plate. Using a large spoon, grab a heaping spoonful of masa and place it in the middle of the corn husk. Using the back of the spoon, spread the masa in a thin layer to create a rectangle shape, leaving the top 1/3 of the corn husk empty. (see post above for step-by-step photos)

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add the filling: Using a different spoon, place about one tablespoon or so of the green chile chicken into the center of the corn husk. Don't put too much filling or it will overflow when you close it.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Fold: Fold together the long edges of the corn husk like a book, and then fold it once more. Fold the pointy edge over so that only one side of the corn husk is open and exposed, and secure the folded edge with thin strip of corn husk by tied a knot around the tamale. If you don't want to go to the trouble of tying a knot around each tamale, you don't have to.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Prepare the steamer pot: Fill the bottom of the steamer pot with water and cover with the steamer insert. Place the tamales in the steamer with the open end facing up, making sure to lean them against the side of the pot so they don't fall down.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Steam: Cover tightly with the lid and place steamer over medium-high heat. Cook for 3 1/2 hours, or until the masa is fully cooked. To check and see if it's cooked, carefully remove a tamale and open it up. The masa should easily separate from the corn husks and it should be fairly firm. When ready to eat, remove tamales from steamer, let sit for 3 minutes to cool, then serve.

title: Mediterranean-Style Steamed Clams Recipe
description: Steamed clams, prepared Mediterranean-style in white wine broth with onions, garlic, bell peppers and fresh herbs. It's important to clean the clams well before you cook them.

ingredients.name: green pepper (cored and chopped (about ½ cup chopped green pepper))
red pepper (cored and chopped (about ½ cup chopped red pepper))
red pepper flakes (I used Aleppo pepper, more to your liking)
green onion (trimmed and chopped (both white and green parts))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sort through clams and discard any already open ones that won't close.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare three large bowls, fill two of them with cool water and add a good amount of salt to each (1/3 cup of salt to 1 gallon of water). Fill the third bowl with water but NO salt this time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Clean the clams. Put the clams in the first bowl of cool salted water and set them aside for 20 minutes or so. Transfer the clams to the second bowl, making sure to discard any clams that are open ( and, of course, discard the dirty water from the first bowl). Set aside for another 20 minutes or so. Using a small brush, scrub the clams clean and transfer them to the last bowl of unsalted water. Allow them another 20 minutes or so. Transfer the clean clams to a tray and cover with a damp towel. (It helps to add some ice to the water bowls to keep them cool water; alternatively, you can place the bowls in the fridge) (see notes for a shortcut)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the white wine broth. In a large Dutch oven heat ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the onions, peppers, and garlic. Season with kosher salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes or so, tossing regularly and making sure the garlic does not burn. (See note, if you want to add Spanish choriz)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the tomatoes and add the cumin, paprika and red pepper flakes (or Aleppo pepper). Pour in the white wine and water. Raise the heat to bring the liquid to a gentle boil. Cook for a few minutes until the tomatoes soften a bit (about 5 to 7 minutes). Add another pinch of salt, if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Steam the clams in the white wine sauce. Lower the heat back to medium and add the clams. Cover with a lid and cook until the majority of the clams are open (anywhere from 7 to 10 minutes) Discard any clams that are still closed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn the heat off. Add the green onion and parsley.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve immediately in bowls with a side of your favorite crusty bread.

title: Spiral-shaped Greek Cheese pie recipe (Kichi Kozanis)
description: Find out how to make the perfect spiral-shaped Greek cheese pie (Kichi Kozanis) with this traditional, locally sourced recipe. It all starts with some good quality phyllo.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you choose to prepare this Greek cheese pie with commercial phyllo dough, it is important to thaw completely the phyllo dough by putting it in the fridge from the previous day. For the beginners at working with phyllo, check the handling tips before starting.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make this Greek cheese pie, start by preparing the filling first. Pour the milk in a large bowl, crack the eggs and whisk. Add the Graviera cheese and whisk again. Stir in the crumbled feta cheese, the chopped mint, season with freshly ground pepper and sprinkle with the semolina. Blend well, so that the flavours mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 170C and oil the bottom and sides of a round baking tray (approx. 35cm diameter).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Unroll the phyllo dough from the plastic sleeve and place one sheet of phyllo on a working surface (larger side facing you). Using a pastry brush, brush with olive oil. Spread some of the filling, making a lane on the edge of the larger side of the phyllo sheet and roll into a ‘sausage’. Place the roll on the baking tray, starting from the outer side of the tray (the phyllo roll should be touching the side of the pan). Repeat with the rest of the dough, placing the rolls (touching each other) in the baking tray, forming a ‘snail’, that leads to the centre of the pan. Oil the surface of the pie with enough olive oil and bake in preheated oven at 170C for about 75 minutes, until nicely coloured and crispy.Â If the pie starts getting coloured to quickly, cover up with aluminium foil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this delicious Greek cheese pie while still warm as an appetiser, snack or side dish. Enjoy!

title: Zeppole
description: Feel the glorious sensation of perfectly cooked ZEPPOLE from its crisp exterior to the soft airy insides. This festive Italian donut can be served with your favorite sweet topping to make your own mouthwatering creations.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil in a deep fryer or cast-iron skillet to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). The temperature will drop once you add the dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, stir together flour, nutmeg, baking soda, and sugar.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Form a well then add eggs, ricotta cheese, vanilla extract, and salt. Stir until the dough comes together. The dough should be thick.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the oil is hot enough, use a spoon to scoop the batter, and another spoon or spatula to drop it in the oil, like the shape of a ball. If you can, use your hands to drop the dough. It does not have to be perfect.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry on one side for about 2 minutes, then flip and fry on the other side for 2-3 minutes or golden brown or the doughnuts are cooked through. This all depends on the size of your dough - it might take longer or less time, adjust accordingly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the dough balls from the oil and drain on paper towels. Repeat until all the dough has been used up.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If desired, sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serve warm.

title: Thai Tea Ice Cream (No Machine Method) ไอติมชาเย็น
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Irish cream liqueur such as Bailey's (optional, see note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat whipping cream in a small pot over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the cream is steaming.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add tea leaves and a small pinch of salt, and stir just until the cream boils.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove from heat and steep for 5 minutes (don't leave it sitting until it cools down or it'll be really hard to strain!).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Strain the cream using a fine mesh strainer into a 2-cup measuring cup*, pressing out as much liquid as you can—you should have about 1 1/4 cup of cream, if you have too little, add more fresh cream until you have 1 1/4 cup; if you have a little more, don't worry about it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the cream is cool enough to go into the fridge, refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until completely cold; I like to do this step 1 day in advance.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: *Note: If you don’t have a 2-cup measure, you can strain it into a 1-cup measure and another ¼ cup measure. Just make sure you don’t let the first cup overflow!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While the cream is cooling, make the topping by stirring the evaporated milk and condensed milk together. Refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the cream is chilled completely, whip the cream to soft-peak stage using a stand mixer with a whisk attachment or a hand mixer. (When the beaters start leaving a trail that doesn’t immediately disappear, you’re at soft peaks.) Add condensed milk and the Irish cream liqueur and continue whipping until stiff peaks (when you lift your whisk, the peak that forms maintains its shape).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer the ice cream into a metal container and freeze for 2-3 hours or until solid. Alternatively, put the ice cream in between your favourite cookies to make an ice cream sandwich!

title: Eomuk Bokkeum (Stir-fried Fish Cake)
description: A quick and easy side dish made with eomuk (fish cake). Make it mild or spicy to your taste.

ingredients.name: red chili pepper (or 1/4 red bell pepper) ((or 1/2 carrot))
green chili pepper (or 1/4 green bell pepper)
sugar (or two teaspoons if you like it sweeter)
to 3 teaspoons gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes) - only for the spicy version

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil and turn the heat off. Plunge the fish cake for 30 seconds. Drain and cool. This step removes excess oil and softens the fish cake, but you can skip it if you want.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the fish cake into bite size pieces. Thinly slice the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a non-stick pan with 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat. Add the garlic, onion, and scallions, and cook for a minute. Reduce the heat to medium. Add the fish cake and chili peppers, and stir-fry for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the sauce ingredients over the fish cake and vegetables. Stir well, and cook until the sauce is well distributed and absorbed and the fish cake and vegetables are tender, about 1 minute.

title: Rice Balls in Coconut Milk บัวลอย (bua loy)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: cooked and mashed taro root, kabocha squash or other colourful juices such as pandan juice or beet juice*

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the glutinous rice flour and mashed taro or squash using your fingers until well mixed. Add water, a little at a time, and knead until a dough forms. The dough should be soft but not sticky or tacky. If it becomes sticky, just add a little more flour and knead until it no longer sticks to your fingers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the dough onto a cutting board and pat it down into a rectangle a little less than 1 cm thick. Cut the dough into 1 cm-thick strips and separate the strips so they don't fuse back together. Take each strip and cut them into 1 cm-long pieces so that all your pieces are now roughly 1 cm cubes. Roll each piece either between the palms of your hands or the tips of your fingers so you have little balls. Now is the time to get your kids and friends involved!

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When all the balls are rolled, keep them wrapped tightly in plastic wrap if you are not ready to cook them immediately so they don't dry out. Bring a pot of water to a full boil, and while waiting for the water to boil, make the sweet coconut milk.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Put the coconut milk, water, pandan leaf, 1/2 cup of chopped palm sugar and salt into a pot and cook over medium heat, stirring until all the sugar is dissolved. Taste and add more sugar as needed. Turn off the heat and remove the pandan leaf.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Have a large bowl of cold water ready beside the pot of boiling water. Drop the Bua Loy into the boiling water in batches without crowding the pot. Within 1 minute they should float, and as soon as they float, fish them out using a slotted spoon and put them directly in the bowl of cold water (they will sink in cold water). Repeat until you are finished with all the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Drain the Bua Loy well and add them to the coconut milk. Heat the coconut-Bua Loy mixture just until it comes back to a simmer so that the Bua Loy can absorb the flavour of the coconut milk, and turn the heat off immediately.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve warm or room temperature.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: You can make the dough (uncooked) one day ahead of time and keep it in the fridge, well-wrapped in plastic wrap. You can also make the coconut milk the day before. However, it is best to serve them the day they are cooked as the rice balls will continue to absorb liquid and become mushy over time. Reheating leftovers after 1 day of refrigeration is doable but the texture won't be as chewy as when they are fresh. I don't recommend keeping leftovers any longer than 1 day.
