title: Moroccan Chicken Recipe
description: BEST Moroccan Chicken recipe you will find! Super succulent, fall-off-the-bone tender chicken stew w/ warm Moroccan spices, lemons, olives & dried fruit. Be sure to check out the step-by-step tutorial up in the post.

ingredients.name: lb/1587.57 g whole chicken cut into bone-in pieces (or 7 to 8 pieces of chicken with bone in. Leave skin on or remove it, up to you.)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
lemon, thinly sliced (or 1 preserved lemon, cut up into small pieces)
Toasted slivered almonds, to your liking, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine Ras El Hanout and the remaining spices to make the rub.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat chicken pieces dry and season lightly with kosher salt on both sides. Now, rub the chicken all over with the spice rub (if you kept the skins, make sure to apply the spice rub underneath the skins for best flavor.) Set aside in room temperature for 40 to 45 minutes or so (or, if you have the time, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. If you do this, take chicken out of fridge and let it rest at room temperature for a few minutes before cooking.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a 12″ deep ceramic pan or braiser like this one, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add chicken (skin side down, if you kept skin) and brown for 5 minutes. Turn over and brown on the other side for another 3 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lower heat to medium-low and add onions, garlic, and cilantro. Cover and cook for 3 minutes, then add lemon slices, olives, raisins, and dried apricots.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the tomato paste and chicken broth. Pour mixture on top of the chicken as it cooks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring to a simmer for 5 minutes, then, keeping heat on medium-low, cover and cook for 30-45 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through registering an internal temperature of 165 degrees F or higher.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with more fresh cilantro and toasted almonds, if you like. Serve over plain couscous.

title: Baked Crispy Donut Recipe
description: Baked Crispy Donuts - Guilt-Free Baked Crispy Donuts. Surprising EASY to make and equally DELICIOUS!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a stand mixer, combine lukewarm water and yeast. Let it sit until dissolve for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile in a microwave safe medium bowl, heat milk for about 2 minutes. Remove and let it cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add milk, sugar, salt, eggs, butter and 2 cups of flour to bowl of yeast.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix for 2 minutes at medium speed. Add the remaining 3 cups of flour and continue mixing dough. Scraping down sides.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place dough in a large greased bowl. Cover loosely with a clean clothe and let rise in a warm, draft-free place for about 1 to 2 hours or until doubled.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll dough out on a floured surface to about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into doughnuts using a donut cutter or cookie cutter about one 1-inch and one 3 or 4-inch .Let stand for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from oven and let it cool for about a minute or two.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Dip doughnuts in glaze and let it drip on the rack.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: In a mixing bowl sift the powdered sugar, then add all the other ingredients. Mix until all the ingredients have been fully combined.

title: Traditional Zucchini pie recipe with Feta cheese (Greek Kolokithopita)
description: A traditional Greek Courgete/ Zucchini pie recipe, made with home-made phyllo! This Kolokithopita recipe is made with juicy zucchinis, tangy feta cheese and creamy Greek yogurt, all combined into a velvety delight!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek zucchini pie recipe (kolokithopita), start by making the dough. In a large mixing bowl add the flour and salt, make a well in the centre and pour in the vinegar and olive oil. Using a dough hook mix to combine the ingredients for 10-15 seconds. (Tip: The vinegar helps the dough for the zucchini pie to become crispy.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Depending on the kind of flour, the weather, the humidity and various factors, the dough for the zucchini pie may need a little bit more or less water than this recipe calls for. Start by adding 200g of water at first (3/4 of a cup) and mix, until the flour absorbs the water. After mixing for a while, the dough should become an elastic ball. The perfect dough for your zucchini pie should be soft, malleable and smooth. If the dough is still crumbled, then you need to add a little bit more water. Add a few drops of water and mix for a while. Check out the consistency of your dough and add a few more drops of water, if needed. In case you added more water than needed, the dough will become sticky. Don’t worry, you can fix that by adding some more flour (add 1/2 tsp at first, mix and check again).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When you are happy with the consistency of the dough for your zucchini pie, wrap with some plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 45-60 minutes. This is essential, so that the dough softens and you can roll it easily.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the filling for the zucchini pie (Greek kolokithopita). Remove the skin of the zucchinis and grate them into a collander, season with salt and leave aside for 20 minutes to drain. Wrap the grated zucchinis in a towel and squeeze, in order to get rid of the excess water. In a saucepan add 2 tbsps olive oil and saute the onions, until soft. Add all the ingredients for the filling of the zucchini pie in a large bowl and blend to combine. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For this zucchini pie recipe you will need a large baking pan approx. 25x35cm. Using a cooking brush oil the bottom and sides of the pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Divide the dough into two halves. You will use half the dough for the bottom of the zucchini pie and the other half to cover it. Place half the dough on a floured surface and coat your rolling pin with some flour. Make a circle of dough with your hands; now you are ready do roll! Ensure that your dough has plenty of flour to prevent it from sticking to the working surface or the rolling pin. At first, roll out a few times, turning the dough every once in a while, to keep the circle even and the dough from sticking to the surface. Gently roll the edge of the dough over the rolling pin and roll the dough around the pin. Place your hands in the center of the rolling pin and as you roll, move them out to the sides so that both the rolling pin and your hands are working to spread and thin the dough. Unroll, turn a half turn and repeat. Continue rolling making the dough thinner and thinner each time. Move your hands from the center to the sides to keep even pressure and help in spreading and thinning the dough. Carefully roll your dough around the rolling pin and then unroll it over the pan and ease the dough into the dish, pushing it into all sides.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Tip in the filling of the zucchini pie. Roll out the rest of the dough, roll your dough around the rolling pin and then unroll it over the filling of the zucchini pie (kolokithopita). With a knife trim some of the excessive phyllo and roll the rest on the edges. Brush the top with enough olive oil and make some holes on top of the zucchini pie with a sharp knife. Drizzle the kolokithopita with some water and sprikle with sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bake the zucchini pieÂ in preheated oven at 180C for 50-60 minutes, until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve this delicious Greek zucchini pie (kolokithopita) as starter, mid-day snack or as a main dish with a nice Greek salad aside. Enjoy!

title: Gorditas Recipe
description: Making your own Mexican Gorditas at home is super easy! These little corn cakes made from masa dough have a little pocket in the middle made for stuffing with all sorts of delicious fillings! (gluten free, vegetarian, vegan)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix together masa harina, water and salt to create a dough. Roll the dough into 16 little balls. Heat a large skillet, griddle or comal over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lightly flatten a masa ball in between two sheets of plastic wrap using a tortilla press or a flat plan. Make sure not to press it down too much as it will become too thin like a normal corn tortilla. You want it about twice as thick as a normal tortilla.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the flattened masa from the plastic wrap and place it on the hot griddle. Let it cook for about 10 to 15 seconds, flip it over and let that side cook for another 10 to 15 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Flip it over one more time and cook each side for about 1 minute, until it has beautiful brown spots.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: At this point, you should notice that the gordita inflates a little bit and starts to bubble up in the middle or the sides. This is exactly what you want. Lightly press down on the sides of the gordita with a spatula or other utensil to help it inflate even more. Remove it from the griddle, place it on a plate and cover it with a light kitchen towel.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: As soon as you can handle and hold the gordita (it should still be hot but not hot enough to burn you), use a butter or paring knife to cut a slit down the edge of one side. The gordita should open up and create a pocket.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fill gordita with desired fillings and enjoy!

title: Beef Shawarma Recipe
description: Easy beef shawarma recipe with homemade shawarma seasoning! Serve it up in pita pockets with my tomato and cucumber salad and a good drizzle of tahini sauce.

3-Ingredient Mediterranean salad, ((or sliced tomatoes and cucumbers, and chopped parsley) )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In the bottom of large mixing bowl, add the shawarma spices. Add the olive oil, vinegar, and zest and juice of one lemon. Using a spoon, mix to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using a chef’s knife, cut the flap steak against the grain into thin bite-size slices (no more than ¼-inch in thickness).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the sliced meat to the bowl. Season with kosher salt and black pepper. Add the garlic and onions. Using a pair of tongs, toss very well to make sure the meat is well-coated with the marinade. Set aside to marinate at room temperature for a few minutes (or, if you have the time, cover and refrigerate for a couple of hours).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a large cast iron grill pan or skillet over high heat. Using a pair of tongs, add the meat pieces, spreading them as much as you are able. Cook over high heat for anywhere between 8 and 15 minutes, until the meat is fully cooked. (If you like less liquid in your pan and extra char on the meat, you'll likely cook it for about 15 minutes. And if your pan is not large enough, cook the meat in batches).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the meat is cooking, prepare the pita pockets and fixings. Make my 3-ingredient Mediterranean salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, and parsley. Make the tahini sauce. And prepare your pickled cucumbers, if using.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Delicious Little Cheese Pies! (Pitarakia Milou)
description: Imagine delicious packets of golden pastry wrapped around a melty cheese filling. These traditional little cheese pies (pitarakia) from the island of Milos will amaze you!

ingredients.name: red wine vinegar (or 1 tbsp lemon juice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these delicious Greek cheese pies, start by making the dough. Add the flour into a large bowl; using your hands make a dimple in the middle and pour in the olive oil, the vinegar and salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix and knead all of the dough ingredients by hand, whilst adding gradually the lukewarm water, until the dough is soft and smooth. If the dough is too sticky add a little bit more flour. Cover the dough with a towel and let it rest for 20-30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime, prepare the filling; grate the cheese and blend with the mint.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough (approx. 0.2cm thick), on a floured surface, and cut some circles (about 12 cm diameter), as seen in the picture. Place a full spoon of the filling on each circle and fold the dough, creating a half-moon. Join the edges well, using a fork.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry the cheese pies in hot oil, at medium-high heat; when one side becomes golden, turn them on the other side. Remove the pies with a slotted spoon and place on some kitchen paper to absorb the extra oil. Enjoy while still warm!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Traditionally, these Greek cheese pies (pitarakia), are made with “Milos cheese”, which is a kind of yellow, dry and salty cheese produced in Milos. As it is highly unlikely to find it anywhere else, the best alternative is to use a mixture of pecorino and emmental or regato cheese. If you, like me, love feta chesse, then a really delicious variation is to use for the filling feta cheese and a nice hard yellow cheese

title: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: Make this fresh and rich shrimp pad thai in your own kitchen using this super fast and easy recipe that highlights the vibrant flavor of the ingredients.

ingredients.name: (115 g) dried rice noodles (, about 1/4” (4 cm)-wide)
(225 g) peeled and deveined shrimp ( (10 to 12 medium-sized shrimp))
block fried tofu or baked tofu (, cut to 1” (2.5 cm)-long 1/4” (5 mm)-wide pieces)
garlic chives (or 5 green onions) (, sliced into 1” (2.5 cm) pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the noodles: Fully submerge the noodles in room temperature water for 30 to 40 minutes (*Footnote 1), until they are soft enough to wrap around your fingers without breaking apart, but soft enough that you can bite into them. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the sauce: Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and mix until the sugar is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To cook: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to a large skillet (at least 12”) and heat over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp without overlapping. Cook without moving until the bottom turns golden brown. Turn to the other side and cook for 30 seconds or so, until that side is cooked but the inside is still translucent. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same pan add 1 tablespoon of oil and pour in the beaten eggs. Let cook without moving until the bottom sets, then start to scramble lightly, until the eggs are almost cooked. Transfer the eggs to the plate with the shrimp.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, the garlic, shallots, and dried shrimp into the same pan. Cook and stir for 30 seconds, until the dried shrimp turn golden.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the noodles. Stir a few times to mix everything together. Pour in the sauce. Cook and stir to mix everything well, 1 minute or so.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the tofu and cook and stir for another minute. Then add the cooked shrimp and eggs back into the pan. Toss everything together and use your spatula to chop up the eggs into smaller pieces.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the garlic chives and bean sprouts. Toss for another 30 seconds, until the vegetables are just wilted. Carefully taste the noodles. If they’re still too tough, add a splash of water and stir to mix well. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until the noodles reach your desired texture.

title: Quick dongchimi
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: napa cabbage, tender inner parts (or 1/2 pound more radish) (See note 1)
green and/or red chili peppers (thinly sliced)
coarse sea salt (divided) (Use less (about 25% less) if using small grain salt)
sugar (optional if your radish is bitter)
Korean pear (or 1 small Asian pear or apple) (peeled and cored)
glutinous rice powder (to make a paste with 1 cup water)
salt (Use less (about 25% less) if using small grain salt)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the radishes by scrubbing with a brush and/or scratching off the impurities with a small knife. Peel the skin only if necessary. The skin is packed with nutrients. Cut each radish crosswise into about 2-inch logs. Then cut each log into 1/2-inch thick pieces and then each piece into 1/2-inch thick sticks, placing in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of salt and optional 1 tablespoon sugar (use it if your radish is bitter) over the radishes and toss well to coat evenly. Let sit for about 30 - 40 minutes until the radish sticks have softened and released some liquid. Drain, saving the liquid in a bowl or pot you'll be using to make the brine. Do NOT rinse the radish. Place the radish in the jar or kimchi container.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If using the optional cabbage, rinse the cabbage, and cut each leaf of the cabbage into 2-inch long and 1/2 - 1-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dissolve 1 tablespoon of salt in a cup of water and pour over the cabbage. Stir to coat the cabbage pieces with salt water. Let sit for 30 to 40 minutes until softened. Rotate the bottom ones to the top once or twice midway through the process. Drain, saving the liquid in a bowl or pot you'll be using to make the brine. Do NOT rinse the cabbage. Place the cabbage in the jar or kimchi container.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the radish is salting, whisk together the glutinous rice powder and 1 cup of water, and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture thickens into a thin paste. Set aside to cool it.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the pear (or apple), garlic, ginger and optional onion in the blender. Add 1/2 cup water. Puree it as fine as possible. Run it through a fine strainer to remove leftover solids for cleaner broth, if desired.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To make the brine, add about 9 cups of water to the reserved liquid from salting the radish and cabbage. Add the aromatic vegetable puree and glutinous rice paste. Stir in salt, starting with a tablespoon. Stir well to dissolve the salt, and taste it before adding more salt.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the salted radish and cabbage in a jar or air-tight container. Add the scallion and peppers. Pour the brine over. Stir well together. Taste the brine. Add more salt if necessary. If the brine is too salty, add more water to dilute. It should be a tad salty to eat as is.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Leave it out at room temperature for a full day or two until bubbles rise through the brine. Taste again and add more salt if necessary or add more water if too salty. Then, store in the fridge. Although you can start eating it any time at this point, it will need about a week or two in the fridge to fully develop the acidic, tangy flavors. It keeps well for several weeks in the fridge. Stir from the bottom each time you ladle the broth from the jar or container to serve.

title: Thai Salmon with Thai Corn Salsa

description: Air fryer beef empanadas made from flaky puff pastry wrapped around a ground beef picadillo filling. They cook in only 8 minutes!

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 12

steps.title: Step 13

steps.title: Step 1

If not, place the clams in salted water (3 Tbsp sea salt to 2 L water) for about 1 hour without disturbing them. After this time, they should spit out any sand inside them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add coconut milk, chicken stock, shallots lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, Thai chilies and sugar to a large pot with a lid. Cover and bring to a boil. Add clams, cover and cook for 2-3 mins or until all clams are open. Remove from heat, add lime juice, cilantro, and stir to mix. Taste the broth and adjust seasoning with more fish sauce or salt if needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to a serving bowl. If any clams are still closed, you can try steaming them again for another minute or so to see if they will open (some clams seem to be late bloomers!). If they still don’t open, discard them.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Agua de Pepino (Cucumber Agua Fresca)
description: Learn how to make agua de pepino! This traditional Mexican agua fresca combines cucumber, lime juice, water, and a touch of sugar.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the cucumbers, water, and sugar to a large blender and blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Strain the liquid into a pitcher to remove any seeds and pulp.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the lime juice, taste, and add more sugar if preferred.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve immediately over ice or chill in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Garnish with fresh cucumber slices and mint sprigs if desired.

title: Walnut Spinach Greek Yogurt Dip Recipe
description: You’ll love this quick and delicious Greek yogurt dip with spinach, chopped walnuts, lemon juice and fresh herbs. Yes, it’s a nutritious spinach dip with a tasty Mediterranean twist! This recipe will make about 2 cups of dip.

ingredients.name: freshly squeezed lemon juice (more to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blanch the Spinach. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare a bowl of iced water and keep it near. Add the spinach to the boiling water and cook for 10 seconds. Using a pair of tongs, transfer the spinach to the iced water and allow it to cool for a couple of minutes. Drain well and wring out any excess water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine the blanched spinach, yogurt, walnuts, garlic, lemon juice, parsley, and mint. Add a good dash of kosher salt and black pepper. Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (about 2 tablespoons). Mix to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve with your favorite veggies and homemade pita chips.

title: Lamb Kleftiko Recipe (Greek Lamb Cooked In Parchment Paper)
description: The very best traditional Greek lamb kleftiko recipe (kleftico)! Juicy, tender, melt-in-the-mouth Greek lamb cooked in parchment paper with fluffy potatoes.

ingredients.name: 1-1.2 kg/ 35 oz. leg of lamb, boneless (approx. 2kg/ 70 oz. bone in)
kefalotyri or Graviera or any had yellow cheese, cut into cubes (7 oz.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek lamb kleftiko recipe, start by washing thoroughly the lamb and cut into portions (approx. 5*6 cm). Place in a large bowl or basin and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the vegetables for the lamb kleftiko. Cut the onions in half and then in four wedges. Cut the peppers in 2-3 cm chunks and slice 2 cloves of garlic. Add the vegetables in the bowl with the lamb and pour in the olive oil, white wine and lemon juice. Add the mustard, 2 whole cloves of garlic, sprinkle with oregano and season with salt and pepper. Use your hands to blend all the ingredients together. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, chill and let marinade for at least 2 hours. It’s best to leave the meat for the lamb kleftiko marinade overnight, to soak up all the wonderful flavours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the meat for the lamb kleftiko is marinated, return the lamb at room temperature. In the same bowl add the cheese (cut into 2cm cubes) and blend. Preheat the oven to 180C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To prepare the potatoes for this lamb kleftiko recipe, peel the potatoes and cut in four pieces. (The lamb kleftiko will require about 2 1/2 hours baking, so it’s best to cut the potatoes in large pieces, to keep their shape.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now it’s time to wrap the lamb kleftiko in parchment paper. Lay 4 long pieces of parchment paper to form a star. Pop the potatoes in the centre of the parchment paper and season with salt and a pinch of oregano. Pour the marinade from the lamb over the potatoes and set the lamb and vegetables on top of the potatoes. Layer with the sliced tomato and enclose the lamb kleftiko into a pouch. To enclose the lamb kleftiko hold the parchment paper from the edges, crosswise and grab with your hand in the middle, just above the stuffing and squeeze. Use the kitchen string to tie tightly the whole thing together, just above the stuffing and lift into a roasting tin.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roast the lamb kleftiko in the oven for about 1 hour 45 minutes until tender. Remove the tin from the oven and increase the temperature to 220C. Unwrap the lamb kleftiko and scrunch the parchment paper under the rim of the tin. Baste the lamb with the juices and return in the oven for a further 20 mins until browned. Remove the pieces of lamb from the pouch and wrap them in some foil to rest. Toss the potatoes and return in the oven for about 20 minutes, until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return the lamb pieces in the roasting tin and serve the lamb kleftiko as it is. Enjoy!

title: Dahi Vada Recipe (Authentic)
description: Dahi Vada is a popular Indian snack made with soft fried lentil dumplings. The dumplings are soaked in creamy whipped yogurt and topped with sweet and spicy chutneys. It is commonly served as a snack or festive dish.

ingredients.name: heaped cup or (200 grams) urad dal
green chili (– chopped or serrano or thai chili)

title: Eye of Round Roast
description: Easy, moist-tender and flavor-packed EYE OF ROUND ROAST makes a great crowd-pleasing dinner for regular nights or the holidays. Every slice of this beefy roast packs a huge amount of flavor without the hefty price tag.

ingredients.name: (236ml) dry red wine ((Merlot or Cabernet Sauvignon works great))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the roast and pat it dry. Then season it with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the olive oil or butter, paprika, rosemary, red wine, and cayenne pepper. Rub all over the beef, covering every inch with the marinade. Place it all in a ziplock bag or seal it in a bowl, and refrigerate overnight to marinate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When ready to cook, drain the marinade and set aside. Remove any bits of herbs or spices from the beef.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use a sharp paring knife to cut deep slits all over the roast. Stuff the slits with garlic cloves. Set aside until ready to brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 250℉ (120℃).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Melt butter or add oil to a pan over medium-high heat. Sear the roast on all sides until slightly brown, 3-4 minutes per side. This helps hold the juices and creates a crust.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place in a large oven-safe pot or roasting pan. I use the same cast-iron skillet that I used to brown the roast.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Roast the eye of round for 1-2 hours or until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the roast reaches 130-140℉ (55-60℃). Please take note that cooking times will vary depending on the shape and size of the roast and the desired doneness.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Meanwhile, heat the reserved marinade and beef broth in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring it to a boil, lower the heat, and simmer until reduced and slightly thickened. Add butter, and adjust with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove the roast from the oven, and let it rest for 15-20 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute evenly throughout the roast before slicing it.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Slice the roast against the grain, starting from the ends to the center. Serve with sauce.

title: Chicken Quesadilla
description: Chicken Quesadilla – crispy tortilla stuffed with tomato salsa, guacamole, seasoned chicken and gooey cheese. Simple family-friendly summer meal that doubles up as party appetizer, too!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season lightly salt chicken then season with cumin, paprika, coriander , oregano, chili powder ,garlic and onion powder or use taco seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up skillet with about 2 tablespoon of oil, and then add chicken let it rest for about 30 seconds before stirring. Add onions , cook for about 5-7 minutes or until chicken has been fully cooked. Remove chicken and set aside for it to cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place tortilla on a plate then top with cheese, chicken, and salsa , if desired.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up another skillet , spray with oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer filled tortilla to the skillet , place another tortilla on top

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook for about 3 minutes or until the cheese melts and the bottom of the the tortilla browns .

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place a plate on top of the quesadilla and flip onto the plate. Then slide the other side onto the skillet. You can easily flip using a large spatula.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut into desired pieces serve warm with guacamole and/or sour cream.

title: Thai Long Bean Stir-Fry (pad tua fak yao)
description: Crunchy long beans in a garlicky, umami sauce is the perfect veggie dish for any Thai meal. The salted duck eggs give a salty punch, but are totally optional. You can use French green beans or even snap peas instead.

ingredients.name: long beans or French green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces
Golden Mountain sauce or fish sauce
shrimp tomalley (“shrimp paste in oil”), optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl mix together oyster sauce, soy sauce, Golden Mountain Sauce, shrimp paste (if using), 1/4 cup of water, sugar and white pepper; stir until the sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the salted duck egg in half right through the shell. Using a spoon, cut one half of the egg into chunks, and then use the same spoon to scoop out the chunks - these will get mixed into the stir fry. Scoop out the other half of the egg with a spoon in one piece, and then slice into wedges - we will use these to top the dish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok, over medium high heat, add the oil and the garlic, and stir until it starts to turn golden. Add the beans and the sauce mixture, then toss until the beans are done to your liking, 2-3 minutes, adding a splash more water if it dries up too much.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When done, toss in the chunks of salted duck eggs (if using) and stir just to mix. Plate and top with wedges of salted duck eggs. Serve with jasmine rice or as a side dish to any meal!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Chinese Steamed Chicken Recipe
description: Easy and healthy Chinese steamed chicken recipe with a savory dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Half of a whole chicken ( , around 1 and 1/2 pound)
tbsp. green onion shreds ( , white part)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the chicken and then spread the marinating sauce evenly on both sides.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lay ginger shreds and green onion shreds over to marinate at least 30 minutes. Then place in your steamer. I am using the steamer of my electric rice cooker. If you are using a steamer with wok or pot, steam with high fire around 20 minutes until soft (or you can easily insert a chop sticker in). Transfer out and cut into chunks of your favorite size. Decorate with green onions.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dipping sauce

title: Crockpot Stuffed Peppers
description: These Crockpot Stuffed Peppers are loaded with ground beef, quinoa, and cheese. They’re a tasty and time-saving option for weeknight dinners!

ingredients.name: large bell peppers, (tops and stems removed (or 7-8 medium bell peppers))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 1/2 cup of water into a large 6-quart slow cooker. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add ground beef, black beans, 1 cup shredded cheese, uncooked quinoa, tomato paste, chili powder, ground cumin, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and dried oregano. Mix together until just combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spoon the mixture into each bell pepper until it’s completely packed to the top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer them to the slow cooker, cover and cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 3 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Uncover, top the peppers with the remaining 1/2 cup shredded cheese, and cover for 10 more minutes to melt the cheese.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Top with chopped cilantro and sour cream. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy Fried Calamari Recipe
description: Crispy, succulent calamari rings, coated in seasoned flour and quickly fried to crispy perfection. Budget 30 minutes to soak the calamari in milk. This helps tenderize them while taming their fish smell.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the calamari tubes into ¾-inch thick rings.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, stir 1 teaspoon Diamond Crystal kosher salt in ½ cup milk.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the calamari rings to the milk mixture and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, oregano, black pepper, and cayenne (make sure the mixture is well combined).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare a large colander and set it on top of a large bowl. Using a pair of tongs, take a portion of the calamari rings (about ½ of them) shake off excess milk and toss the calamari in the flour mixture. Toss the calamari to coat evenly. Put the coated calamari in the colander. Repeat with the rest of the calamari.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn your oven on a low 150 degrees F. Prepare a large sheet pan and set a wire rack on top. Top the wire rack with paper towel.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat 4 inches of grape seed oil in a small cooking pot (I used a 2.5 quart pot) to somewhere between 350 and 365 degrees F. To test your oil, drop one calamari ring, many bubbles will form around it and the calamari will begin to float.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once your oil is ready, using a pair of tongs, gently add some of the calamari in and fry for about 3 minutes or until golden brown. Remove the calamari from the oil and arrange it on the paper towel on top of your prepared wire rack. Immediately season with kosher salt, then transfer to your warm oven to keep warm while you work on the rest. Repeat until you have fried all the calamari.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer the fried calamari to a serving plate and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice!

title: Greek Pastitsio recipe (Greek Lasagna with Béchamel)
description: The Best Greek Pastitsio recipe (Pastichio)! An authentic Greek Lasagna recipe to recreate this traditional delight just like my grandma used to make it.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper (to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional pastitsio recipe (pastichio), start with the meat sauce. Place a large pan over medium-high heat and add the olive oil, the chopped onions and sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add the garlic, tomato paste and the beef. Break up the meat with a wooden spoon and brown for 4-5 minutes. Pour in the red wine and wait to evaporate. Add the canned tomatoes, the sugar, cinnamon, clove, the bay leaf and season. Bring to the boil, turn the heat down and simmer with the lid on for about 30 minutes, until most of the juices have evaporated. (After the meat is cooked, discard the bay leaf, the clove and the cinnamon)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the bechamel sauce for the pastitsio. Melt the butter in a large pan over low-medium heat. Add the flour whisking continuously to make a paste. Add warmed milk in small batches, whisking continuously in order to prevent your sauce from getting lumpy. If the sauce still needs to thicken, boil over low heat whilst continuing to stir. Remove the pan from the stove and add the egg yolks, salt, pepper, a pinch of nutmeg and the grated cheese (50g/ 1.7oz.). Whisk quickly, in order to prevent the eggs from turning an omelette! Season with salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook the pasta for the pastitsio 2-3 minutes less than the package instructions, so that they don’t get mushy after turning out of the oven later. Drain the pasta and stir in the egg whites and the feta cheese (smashed with a fork) and mix gently with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For this pastitsio recipe you will need a large baking dish, approx. 25*35 cm / 10*14 inch. Butter the bottom and sides of a pan and assemble the pastitsio. Layer the pasta, top with the meat sauce and even out. Top the pastitsio with the bechamel sauce and smooth out with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle the pastichio with grated cheese and bake in preheated oven at 180C (350F) Fan for about 40 minutes, until crust turns a light golden brown. Let the pastitsio cool down for a while before serving.

title: Fondant Potatoes
description: Fondant Potatoes - Indulge yourself and your loved ones with these pillowy-soft, melt-in-your-mouth crispy potatoes roasted with butter, fresh herbs, and stock. So simple yet so divine - elegant enough to serve on a fancy date night!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel the potatoes, rinse with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Then slice the ends off the potatoes so they lay flat on either side. Cut them into 2 inch thick slices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat cooking oil in a large cast-iron or oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the potatoes cut-side down in a single layer, and cook until golden brown, 6 to 7 minutes. Flip and brown the other side for 4-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the skillet from the heat and drop in butter, thyme, rosemary, garlic, and chicken stock. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place in the preheated oven and bake, uncovered until the potatoes are fork-tender and creamy inside, about 30 minutes. If potatoes aren't tender, add 1/4 cup more stock and let it cook for 10 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To check if the potatoes are tender, insert a skewer or toothpick in the thickest part of the potatoes it should slide in easily.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Spoon the butter mixture over the cooked potatoes, garnish with parsley, or sprigs of thyme, if desired. Serve warm.

title: Sister Song’s Soup (宋嫂鱼羹, Chinese Fish Soup)
description: This centuries-old Chinese fish soup is so rich with flavor and history that it’s a national treasure and tastes just as addictive as hot and sour soup.

ingredients.name: to 2 fillets (about 6-8 oz / 170-220 g) white fish ((red snapper, sea bass, etc.))
sliced Spam (or low-sodium Spam, cut into 2” (5 cm)-long strips)
sliced bamboo shoots (, cut into 2” (5 cm)-long strips)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If using dried shiitake mushrooms, add the mushrooms to a small bowl with 1/4 cup warm water. Rehydrate for 20 minutes or until the mushrooms turn tender throughout. Gently squeeze out the excess water then slice the mushrooms. Reserve the soaking liquid.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 2” (5 cm) water to a steamer and heat over medium-high heat to bring it to a full boil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, add the fish fillet to a shallow heatproof bowl. Pour the Shaoxing wine over the fish and sprinkle it with salt. Spread the ginger and green onions over the fish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the steam comes out from the steamer, steam the fish over medium-high heat for 4 to 6 minutes (depending on the weight of the fish), or until you can easily flake the fish with a fork.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once done cooking, remove the steaming rack and let cool briefly. Then remove and discard the ginger and onions. If using a skin-on fish, peel off and discard the skin. Then flake the fish using two forks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Combine the slurry ingredients in a small bowl and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To make the soup, heat the oil in a medium-sized pot or dutch oven over medium heat until hot. Add the ginger and green onions (under “soup”). Stir and cook until fragrant, 30 seconds or so.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the chicken stock, Shaoxing wine, light soy sauce, and salt. Add the reserved mushroom soaking water (Optional). Cook until the broth comes to a boil.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Reduce the heat to a simmer. Add the mushrooms, Spam, and bamboo shoots.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Stir the slurry again to fully dissolve the cornstarch, swirl it into the soup, and stir immediately to mix well.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Turn to medium heat and bring the soup back to a low boil. Cook until the soup thickens enough to lightly coat the back of a spoon (the soup will thicken a bit more once cooled).

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add back the flaked cooked fish.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Turn the heat off and immediately drizzle the beaten eggs over the soup using a pair of chopsticks or a fork held against the bowl to form a stream. Let sit for 20 seconds to let the eggs cook. Then gently stir the eggs into the soup to form ribbons.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Combine the vinegar and white pepper in a small bowl. Stir until the white pepper is fully distributed. Pour it into the soup and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Serve hot on the side of a multi-course meal or by itself as a light main dish.

title: Rava Dosa Recipe (Quick & Crispy)
description: Rava Dosa is an instant crispy dosa made with rava, rice flour, all-purpose flour, herbs, and spices. The batter requires no grinding or fermentation. Cook until thin and golden for a quick breakfast or snack.

title: Old-Fashioned Salmon Patties
description: Crispy on the outside and tender and juicy on the inside. You can use fresh salmon or take advantage of leftover or canned salmon. Plus, you can whip these babies up in nothing flat.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place salmon on a cutting board and chop with a sharp knife until finely chopped. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add oil to a small fry pan or skillet on medium-high heat, then add onions, celery, and garlic. Saute for 2-3, or until fragrant. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix the salmon, onion mixture, eggs, Cajun seasoning, ¼ cup bread crumbs, white pepper, cayenne, salt, red pepper, and parsley. Cover and refrigerate the salmon mixture for at least an hour or more until firm for easier handling.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the salmon mixture into 6-8 balls (3-4 tablespoons each), flatten, and form a 1-inch thick patty.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dredge the patties in bread crumbs. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a small non-stick frying pan on medium-high heat, then add oil. Let the oil heat until it reaches about 350℉ (175℃).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cook the patties in hot oil until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. You may have to do so in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer to a plate with paper towels and serve warm with remoulade sauce.

title: Pickled Mustard Green Recipe
description: Pickled Mustard Green is a really important ingredients for many yummy Chinese dishes and it is very popular in Chinese cuisine.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Separate the mustard green or cut into large chunks and rinse in running water. Discard any dirt leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lay the washed mustard greens in a clean gridiron or anything similar to dry the water. Turn over several times and make sure that there is no water on the surface. I would suggest air-drying for around 12 hours until the leaves begins to wither.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the glass gar: wash the gar with boiling water and then set aside to drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the withered mustard green in a large bowl. Rub the leaves with salt until they are totally withered and begin to loose water. Transfer the mustard green leaves in the glass jar.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place 1 teaspoon of Sichuan peppercorn seeds and remaining salt in the jar. Pour water to soak all the leaves. Use a weigh to make sure the mustard greens are soaked in water.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the jar completely, move to shade place and wait for 7 to 15 days until the water becomes bright yellowish green (the time is based on room temperature, the warmer, the shorter).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste it to see whether it is ready. The well- picked mustard green should be salty and slightly sour.

title: Hobak jeon (pan-fried zucchinis in egg batter)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: a red pepper and small leaflets of green leafy vegetables such as minari, ssukgat, and parsley (Optional decorations)
You can also add a bit of sugar and/or black pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the zucchini into rounds (about ⅓ - inch thickness). Lightly salt both sides and set aside until softened and released some moisture, about 15 to 20 minutes depending on the zucchinis. Shake off excess moisture from the salted zucchini slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dredge both sides of the zucchini pieces in flour, one piece at a time. (Do this step for all the pieces before the next step.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large non-stick pan with a tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Dip each piece one at a time in the egg wash, and carefully place in the heated pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook until lightly golden, about a minute depending on the thickness and heat level. Place an optional decorative red pepper slice or green leaflet on top when the egg is almost set but still wet. Flip them over when the bottom edges turn lightly golden, and cook for another minute or so. Add more oil if necessary. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Repeat until all the pieces are pan fried. Add an additional tablespoon of oil each time. Serve warm with the dipping sauce.

title: Spicy Thai Egg Salad ยำไข่ต้ม (yum kai tom)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: inches lemongrass (from bottom half), finely sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring water to a full boil, then add the eggs and boil for 8 minutes. When finished, shock the eggs in cold water. When cool, peel and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak dried shrimp in hot water for 10-15 minutes to soften. Drain, then pound in a mortar and pestle until the shrimp are shredded into fluffy bits. Alternatively, grind dry shrimp in a coffee or spice grinder until fine (no need to soak the shrimp if using an electric grinder).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pound chilies in a mortar and pestle until there are no big chunks. Add palm sugar and pound to dissolve. Add lime juice and fish sauce, and stir to mix. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Pour the dressing into a mixing bowl (or use your mortar as the mixing bowl if it's big enough!) and toss in all the herbs and half of the dried shrimp.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the eggs in half and place them on a plate, cut side up. Distribute the herb salad over the eggs, and pour any remaining dressing over. Top the eggs with the remaining shredded dried shrimp. Serve as an appetizer or with jasmine rice as part of a meal. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Easy Calamari Recipe with Garlic Lime Sauce
description: Easy skillet calamari recipe, cooked in a light garlic lime sauce finished fresh dill. Great for dinner or as a warm appetizer, see serving suggestions.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (I used Private Reserve Greek olive oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet, heat 1/4 cup of olive oil and 1 tbsp of unsalted butter. Turn heat to medium-high and add the garlic, saute briefly, tossing regularly, until fragrant (this should take seconds, garlic should only gain a little color, do not burn it.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat calamari dry and add to the pan, cook for 1 to 2 minutes over medium-high heat (calamari will release some liquid.) Add white wine and lime juice. Cook briefly to warm though (do not overcook or calamari will turn rubbery. You are just looking for the sauce to warm through) Season with salt and pepper. If you like a little spice, add a pinch of cayenne.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Finally, stir in the fresh dill. Remove from heat and serve (see serving suggestions in notes)

title: Giouvetsi recipe (Greek Beef stew with Orzo pasta)
description: A traditional Greek Giouvetsi (youvetsi) recipe made with orzo pasta, beef and a delicious tomato sauce. This is the perfect dish for your Sunday family dinner!

ingredients.name: kg/ 35 ounces diced veal shoulder or diced beef
grated kefalotyri or feta cheese (5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat dry your Giouvetsi meat with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1/2 of a cup of olive oil into a pan, add the chopped onions and carrots and sauté for 5 minutes in medium-low heat. Turn up the heat and add the veal; brown the meat on all sides until crusty.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the tomato paste, sauté for a minute then pour in the red wine. Wait for the wine to evaporate. Add the tinned tomatoes, the sugar, the cinnamon stick and a good pinch of salt and pepper and enough water to cover the meat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the heat down and simmer with the lid on for about 45 minutes or until the beef is tender and fully cooked. Occasionally stir and top up with water if the sauce starts to dry out.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the meantime, heat another pan, add 3 tbsps of olive oil and the orzo pasta and sauté, until golden.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once your meat is done simmering, place the orzo pasta in an oven tray along with the meat and sauce (remove the cinnamon stick) and mix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If needed, add enough water so that the pasta is just covered. As a rule of thumb you’ll need about 3 cups of liquid for 1 cup of orzo pasta.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cover the tray with some aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven at 180C for 30 minutes. Remove the aluminum foil, add a splash of water if it has dried out, and put back in the oven for another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To serve, sprinkle with some grated kefalotyri or any hard yellow cheese and enjoy!

title: Honey Wheat Rolls
description: Treat your palate to these buttery, healthy, and super easy rolls brushed with honey butter mixture and baked to perfection. These pillow-like soft buns will give you a euphoric experience in every bite.

ingredients.name: – 2 cups (222- 254 g) bread or all-purpose flour

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine butter and honey until fully combined. Refrigerate or set aside until ready to be used.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine 2 tablespoons lukewarm water and yeast in a large bowl or stand mixer and let it sit until it dissolves for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a microwave-safe medium bowl, combine milk, with the butter pieces, salt. Microwave for about a minute and stir until everything is melted.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lightly whisk in the egg and the honey to the butter mixture (if the mixture is too hot let it cool to warm to prevent eggs from curdling.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dump everything into the yeast mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If using a stand mixer, mix on medium-high speed using a dough hook until all the ingredients are combined, or just mix by hand.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Then add 2 cups of whole wheat flour and 1 ¾ cups all-purpose flour. Continue mixing the dough and stop when the dough doesn’t stick to the sides or bottom of the bowl. Add additional flour (if needed) to make a soft dough. (It is better to have sticky dough than hard dough).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn the dough on a lightly floured surface and knead for 8 to 10 minutes or more if you want an airy bread. Or you may continue kneading with a dough hook for about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the bread dough in a large greased bowl. Cover it loosely with clean clothe and let it rise in a warm, draft-free place for about 45 minutes to 1 hour or until doubled. Punch the dough down.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: At this point, the dough maybe shaped into a grease loaf pan, and place seam side down in the pan or divide dough into 12 equal pieces. Shape them into balls. Place in a greased 12-inch round pans.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Brush with the honey butter mixture and bake.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350 F. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the crust is deep golden brown and the bottom of the loaf sounds hollow when tapped.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Remove from the baking pan and let it cool. Serve them warm.

title: Kheer Recipe (Rice Kheer)
description: Rice Kheer is a classic Indian dessert made by slow-cooking basmati rice in milk until thick and creamy. Sugar, cardamom, saffron and nuts are added for flavor and richness.

ingredients.name: green cardamom powder (or 5 to 6 green cardamoms powdered in mortar-pestle(choti elaichi powder))
chopped or sliced almonds or blanched almonds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preparation

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cooking rice

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Making rice kheer

title: Pork and Garlic Chive Stir Fry
description: This easy home-style Chinese recipe combines tender stir-fried pork, bright green garlic chives, and a simple yet satisfying savory sauce.

ingredients.name: (225 g) pork loin ((or chop), sliced into thin strips)
Thai chilis (, chopped (or 1 small jalapeno, diced) (*Footnote 2))
(225 g) garlic chive (, chopped into 2” (5 cm) pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the pork with the sugar, dark soy, and wine in a small bowl. Mix until the liquid is absorbed. Add the cornstarch and mix again. Marinate for 15 minutes while preparing the rest of the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large skillet with peanut oil over medium high heat until hot. Spread out the marinated pork to the pan with as little overlapping as possible. Cook undisturbed for 30 seconds, or until the bottom is cooked. Flip the pork. Immediately add the ginger, Thai chilis, and garlic sprouts. Continue stir and cook for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the sauce into the pan. Stir and cook until the sauce is reduced and coated to all the ingredients. Immediately transfer everything to a serving plate to prevent overcooking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve hot over rice as a part of a multi-course meal or as a light main dish

title: Thai Tuna Salad ยำทูน่า (yum tuna)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: fish sauce (may vary depending on how salty the tuna is)
granulated sugar or finely chopped palm sugar
Thai chili paste (also used in Tom Yum Soup and Cashew Chicken)
small tomato, cut into small wedges
stalk Chinese celery, or inner stalk and leaves of regular celery
Bottom 2 inches of lemongrass, finely sliced
roasted peanuts, cashews or other nuts of your choice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all dressing ingredients together in a mixing bowl, stir to dissolve the sugar and the chili paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all other ingredients except peanuts to the mixing bowl and toss to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer on to a plate and sprinkle with roasted peanuts. In the video I show you how to make little lettuce cups with the tuna salad, but you can also have it with rice, or use as a filing for tacos, wraps, or other appetizers.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content and rewards!

title: Kkaennip jeon (Pan-fried stuffed perilla)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the zucchini. Lightly salt. Set aside for about 10 minutes. Squeeze out the liquid. Finely chop the carrot, mushrooms, and onion. Combine all the stuffing ingredients well by hand until evenly blended.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash both sides of the perilla leaves under running water, one leaf at a time. Shake off the excess water. Do not dry completely. Dredge both sides of the perilla leaves in the flour, one leaf at a time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a perilla leaf on your hand. Add about a tablespoon of stuffing to the upper half of the perilla leaf. Spread evenly with a spoon. Bring the other half of the leaf over to cover the stuffing. Lightly flatten it with your hand. (Do this step for each leaf before the next step.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a large non-stick skillet and lightly oil, using a couple of teaspoons of oil, over medium low heat. Dip each stuffed leaf, one at a time, in the egg batter, carefully placing it in the heated skillet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook for 2 to 3 minutes each side, adding a teaspoon or two of oil, until slightly golden without browning. Repeat until all the pieces are pan-fried. Serve warm with a dipping sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Alternatively, you can stuff zucchinis or peppers:

title: Steamed Rice Cake
description: Steamed Chinese rice cake-- Rice Fa Gao

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Dissolve sugar in hot water and set aside to cool down to warm or room temperature (under 38 degree C)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix rice flour, flour and yeast in a large mixing bowl and stir in sugar liquid. Combine and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Set aside to ferment for 2-4 hours based on the temperature. It takes me 2.5 hours in room temperature around 25-28 degree C until there are lots of small bubbles on the surface and the batter rises twice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Brush the moulds with oil and scoop the liquid to full 80% full. Bring water to boil in wok and then steam the cakes for 20 minutes over high fire.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Wait for 5 minutes, transfer out, cool down slightly and de-mould when still warm.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: This cake should be served warm. Reheat before serving if necessary.

title: Cauliflower Fritters Recipe with Cumin and Mint Yogurt
description: Easy, perfectly fluffy cauliflower fritters with fresh parsley and a few warm Middle Eastern spices including cumin, turmeric, and Aleppo pepper (you can use red pepper flakes instead, if you need more heat).

ingredients.name: small cauliflower, (cut into 1 ½-inch florets (3 cups florets))
Aleppo pepper, ((or ¼ tsp red pepper flakes))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the yogurt, place all the ingredients for the mint yogurt in a bowl. Mix to combine and keep in the fridge until ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil and add the cauliflower. Simmer for 4 minutes, then (making sure to reserve 3 to 4 tablespoons of the cooking water) drain into a colander.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using a fork or a potato masher, crush the cauliflower, then transfer it to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the flour, parsley, onion, eggs, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, Aleppo pepper flakes, baking powder, and 1 ¼ salt and a good grind of black pepper. Add 3 tablespoons of the cooking water and mix well to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Line a large plate with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a large saute pan (about 9 inches wide), heat the oil. Once the oil is hot, carefully spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of batter per fritter into the oil. You’ll need to do this in batches (adding 4 to 5 fritters at a time) so as not to crowd the pan, and use a spatula to keep them apart. Fry for about 4 to 5 minutes, flipping over halfway through, until both sides are golden brown (mine took 2 minutes on each side).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked fritters to the prepared plate and set aside while you continue with the remaining batches.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature, with the mint yogurt on the side.

title: Cream of Tomato Soup
description: This smooth and creamy vegan soup is made with fresh tomatoes, onions, garlic, cashews, flour, herbs and seasonings. The cashews give the soup a rich texture without adding cream.

ingredients.name: medium sized tej patta ((indian bay leaf))
medium sized onion (or 45 grams onions or ⅓ cup chopped onions)
whole wheat flour (or all purpose flour)
medium sized tomatoes (or 500 to 520 grams tomatoes or 4 cups chopped tomatoes)
crushed black pepper (or add as required)
to 3 basil leaves ((chiffonade or chopped) or any herb of your choice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preparation

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cooking aromatics & tomatoes

steps.description: Making the soup

title: Traditional Greek lemon beef stew recipe (Moschari lemonato)
description: A traditional Greek lemon beef stew recipe (Moschari lemonato) that surely brings back childhood memories. It’s simple preparation and presentation takes nothing out of it’s exquisite taste.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek beef stew recipe (Moschari lemonato), start by cutting the beef into chunks. Wipe the meat with paper towels. Heat 1/2 of a cup of olive oil into a pan, add the beef and sauté (high heat), until the meat is browned and crusty on all sides. Add the chopped onions and garlic and sauté for 2-3 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in the wine and wait to evaporate. Add the lemon juice, the oregano and enough hot water just to cover the meat. Season with salt and pepper and stir.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat down and simmer with the lid on for at least 1-1.5 hour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve with mashed potatoes, basmati rice or french fries. Enjoy!

title: Vegan Wonton Soup
description: Vegan Wonton Soup is a restaurant-quality treat that celebrates the bright flavors and diverse textures of a number of different veggies. The homemade broth is rich with umami and deeply comforting.

ingredients.name: (170 g) napa cabbage (, finely chopped (about 1/4 small cabbage))
light soy sauce ((2 teaspoons if not using mushroom powder))
Toasted sesame oil or homemade chili oil (to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the filling

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wrap the wontons

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook and assemble

title: Samgyetang (Ginseng Chicken Soup)
description: A classic Korean chicken soup made with a small, whole chicken and ginseng.

ingredients.name: fresh ginseng root (or dried ginseng, rehydrated) (See note 1)
sweet rice (2 to 3 tablespoons more to boil with liquid if desired)
to 6 cups of water (or good quality chicken stock)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the chicken. Do not cut off the neck and/or tail, if they are still attached. They help keep the rice inside the cavity. Place the cleaned chicken on a cutting board or a large plate. Clean the inside of the cavity with a paper towel to remove any blood. Fold the attached neck into the cavity to close the hole.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stuff the cavity with the sweet rice and a couple of garlic cloves, leaving room (about 1/4 of the cavity) for the rice to expand as it cooks. You can also cut off some offshoots of the ginseng and add to the cavity if you like.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To keep the rice inside the cavity while being cooked, use of one of these two methods: (1) Make a small cut through the thick skin part between one thigh and the cavity opening, but not too close to the edge. Then, use your finger to expand the hole enough to fit the end part of a leg. Bring the other leg over, and insert the end part through the hole to keep the legs crossed together, tucking the tail in to close the opening (see the photos above); or (2) Simply cross the legs and tie together with kitchen twine. Tightly close the cavity with a toothpick if necessary.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium size pot, place the chicken and add 5 to 6 cups (or enough to cover most of the chicken) of water or chicken stock. Add the garlic, ginger, jujubes, and ginseng. If the chicken came with the neck that's been cut off, add to the pot. Also add the extra sweet rice to thicken the soup or in a herb bag to cook separately, if desired.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Skim off the foam on top. Cover, and boil for 15 minutes. You can add more water/broth if needed. Reduce the heat to medium low and boil, covered, for about 25 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken. Turn the heat off and rest the chicken in the pot for about 10 minutes. See note 3.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve piping hot with the chopped scallions and salt and pepper on the side so each person can season to taste.

title: Fish and Herbs Stir-Fry ผัดฉ่าปลา (pad cha pla)
description: A spicy, light and healthy Thai fish stir fry loaded with fresh herbs. A quick and easy meal with loads of Thai flavours!

ingredients.name: halibut, or another type of firm-fleshed fish, skin-on preferably, cut into large cubes (the skin helps the fish hold together in the wok)
chopped mild red chili pepper such as a spur chili
- 1/2 cup water or unsalted chicken stock or pork stock
young green peppercorns, picked and discard the stem

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate fish in 1/2 Tbsp of the fish sauce while you prep other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar & pestle, pound together garlic, cilantro roots, white peppercorns, Thai chilies, and spur chilies until it resembles a rough paste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok, heat a little vegetable oil over medium heat and add the herb paste. Saute the paste until it starts to turn golden. Turn the heat up to high then add the fish and toss to mix with the paste briefly. Add the remaining fish sauce, sugar, and a splash of water; toss to mix. Add fingerroots and peppercorns, toss to mix, then let the fish cook without stirring until done, flipping the pieces half way through. Add a little more water if it becomes dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When fish is done, turn off the heat and quickly toss in Thai basil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice or another grain of your choice!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Lu Rou Fan-Braised Pork Rice
description: Lu Rou Fan-Taiwanese braised pork over rice

ingredients.name: pork belly ( , either skin on or skin off)
tbsp. thickened soy sauce ( , also known as soy paste. (or 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the pork belly into small diced (around 2-3 cm).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat around 1 cup of oil in a wok or sauce pan, add sliced onion in to fry until they becomes golden brown. Control your fire especially in the final stage and stir continuously. Transfer out to cool down. After cooled, the fried onions will become quite crispy, you crack them in a plastic bag with a rolling pin or chop with a knife.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Leave around 1 tablespoon of oil and then fry pork belly until slightly browned and they begin to release oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Get a iron cast deep pot, transfer pork belly in, add shaoxing wine, soy sauce, thickened soy sauce, garlic slices, spices, white pepper, scallion, rock sugar, diced mushrooms and then strained mushroom soaking water. Then add stock or water until 2-3 cm higher than the pork belly. If you are using regular pot with more escaping steam, slightly add more water. Bring to boil and simmer for 15 minutes over slowest fire.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add fried shallots and hard boiled eggs. Cover the pot and simmer for around 30 minutes to 40 minutes over slowest fire. You may need another 20 to 30 minutes if using regular pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Use high fire to slightly thicken the soup in the last stage. You can serve directly. But the best taste comes several hours later. When all the flavors are well combined several hours later, re-heat it and stir to prevent sticking. Then serve with steamed rice and blanched vegetables.

title: Mexican Breakfast Pizza
description: A breakfast pizza with a Mexican twist! Topped with a chipotle tomato sauce, crumbled Mexican chorizo, shredded cheese, and eggs.

ingredients.name: tomato sauce ((or half of a 15-ounce can))
large Pete and Gerry’s Organic Eggs

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Roll the pizza dough out into a 12-inch circle and transfer to a large pizza pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prick the dough all around with a fork and bake for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the dough is baking, heat a medium skillet over high heat. Add the chorizo and cook for 5-7 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Transfer the cooked chorizo to a plate lined with paper towels and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the tomato sauce, chipotle pepper, oregano, onion powder, basil, salt, black pepper and cumin. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Spread the pizza sauce on top of the pre-baked pizza dough, then top it with 1 cup of the shredded cheese, followed by the crumbled chorizo, and then the remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cheese.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Create 4 little wells in the dough using the back of a spoon, and then gently crack in an egg into each well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Return the pizza to the oven and bake for 13-15 more minutes, or until the whites of the eggs are set.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Garnish the pizza with cilantro, red onions, and sour cream or Mexican crema before serving.

title: Greek Meatballs recipe (Keftedes/ Keftethes)
description: A crispy, juicy and absolutely delicious Greek meatballs (keftedes) recipe! Keftedes is a famous Greek appetizer, commonly served as part of a meze platter, with some creamy tzatziki sauce and pita breads.

ingredients.name: stale bread (5 oz.), soaked in water and squeezed to remove the excess water
fresh spearmint (chopped) and a pinch dried. Or 3/4 tbsp fresh regular mint

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek meatballs recipe (keftedes), add all the ingredients into a large bowl and mix well (for about 5-10 minutes), squeezing with your hands, to allow the flavours to blend. Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and let it rest in the fridge for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn the mixture for the keftedes out of the fridge and roll into meatballs the size of a walnut (or bigger if you prefer). If you’re frying them, dredge the rolled meatballs lightly in flour making sure to shake off any excess. Fry until nicely browned on all sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: The traditional way of cooking Greek meatballs (keftedes) is frying them. Fry the keftedes in batches of 10-15 at a time, until nicely browned on all sides.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Instead of frying you can bake / grill the keftedes in the oven. Preheat the oven at 200C, place the un-floured keftedes on greased baking sheet about an inch apart. Bake for about 20 minutes, turning the meatballs upside down midway through cooking time. The grilled version is much lighter than the fried so theres not excuse to not trying it now!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Keftedes (Greek meatballs) are ideally served as an appetizer (meze) with some creamy tzatziki sauce and pita breads or as a main course with some basmati rice and a Greek salad. Enjoy!

title: Greek Grilled Chicken Salad
description: This grilled chicken salad combines marinated chicken, fresh veggies, and bold Greek flavors all in one tasty and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil (more for later)
bell pepper any color, (cored and chopped)
Quality Greek feta blocks, (to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season and marinate the chicken tenders. In a large bowl, mix together the yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, garlic, salt, and spices. Add the chicken tenders and mix to make sure chicken is well coated with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes (or refrigerate overnight, if you like)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the dressing according to this Greek dressing recipe.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the salad. In a large bowl, combine the lettuce, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber slices, shallots and kalamata olives. Add 4 tablespoons of the Greek dressing and toss to combine (you can always add more dressing to your liking). Leave some of the dressing (about 3 tablespoons or so) for later. Add feta cheese to your liking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook the chicken. Heat 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high until shimmering but not smoking. Add chicken tenders to the pan (make sure to shake off any excess marinade before adding chicken to the pan.) Cook on one side undisturbed for 5 minutes until browned. Using a pair of tongs, turn chicken over and cook on other side for another 5 minutes or until chicken is done. (See notes for outdoor grilling)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the grilled chicken salad. Transfer the salad to serving bowls and top each bowl with the cooked chicken then drizzle a bit more of the salad dressing directly over the chicken. Serve immediately.

title: Effortless One-Pan Cajun Rice
description: Cajun rice - A one-pan meal filled with Cajun flavors that comes together in a mix of fragrant rice and perfectly browned meat. This recipe may look simple at first glance but, trust me, there’s more to it than meets the eye.

ingredients.name: pepper flakes or hot sauce (to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse rice well and transfer to a heavy-bottomed pot with a lid.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add beef broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and let it cook for 18 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large, heavy sauté pan, sauté chopped bacon until cooked, about 4-5 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add 2 tablespoons of the oil or more oil to the bacon pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Throw in the onions, thyme, bay leaf, and garlic, sauté for about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the chicken liver and ground beef, Creole seasoning, and cook, stirring, for about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add bell peppers, celery, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes. Pour in about 1 1/2 cup stock.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Finally, add the rice, mix thoroughly. Cook until the rice is heated through, about 5-7 minutes. If needed, add more stock, to prevent any burns. Do not overcook the rice. Remove from the heat and remove the bay leaf.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Stir in the cooked bacon, and green onions. Garnish with parsley, if desired.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve warm with pepper flakes for heat seekers and/or hot sauce. Enjoy!

title: Seafood Chow Mein (海鲜炒面)
description: If you’re looking for an easy dinner, look no further than this one-pan seafood chow mein that’s even more scrumptious than the restaurant version!

ingredients.name: (225 g) frozen seafood mix (, thawed and drained)
Pinch of salt and white pepper
(170 g) chow mein noodles ((Hong Kong Pan Fried Noodles, or Yakisoba) (*Footnote 1))
chicken stock ((or vegetable stock, or water))
green onions (, chopped to 1” (2.5 cm) pieces, whites and greens separated)
stalk celery (, sliced on the bias)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the seafood mix to a bowl to thaw. Once mostly thawed, sprinkle with a pinch of salt and white pepper and mix together. (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using noodles that require boiling, cook them 1 minute less than the package instructions indicate. Once done, rinse the noodles with running tap water to stop cooking, drain, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Mix until the sugar is dissolved. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
