title: Bean and Cheese Tamales
description: Bean and cheese tamales made from refried black beans and lots of shredded cheese. Quick and easy to make and a great for the holidays!

ingredients.name: cooked black beans, plus ⅔ cup cooking liquid ((or 2 15-oz cans, undrained))
V&V Supremo Shredded Chihuahua® Brand Quesadilla Cheese
V&V Supremo Crema Mexicana de Casa
V&V Supremo Sierra® Brand Cotija Cheese

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prep the corn husks. Add the corn husks to a large bowl or pot. Pour enough hot water over the corn husks to cover them completely. Cover the bowl with foil or plastic wrap and let them soak for 1 hour to soften them up. Meanwhile, make the filling and masa dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the filling. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or saute pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and jalapeño. Saute for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions begin to soften.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the black beans, their cooking liquid, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mash the beans using a potato masher for a chunky texture, or puree them using an immersion blender or regular blender for a smoother texture. Taste and season with more salt, if necessary. Remove them from the heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the masa. In a large bowl using an electric hand mixer or using a stand mixer, beat the lard and baking powder for 1 minute until whipped and fluffy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a separate bowl, combine the masa harina and salt. Add it to the bowl with the lard and mix together to combine.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: While mixing, slowly add in the broth. Continue to mix until the dough is smooth, fluffy, and has the texture of thick hummus. If the dough is too dry, add more broth. If it’s too wet, add more masa harina.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Dry the corn husks. Drain the water from the corn husks and pat them dry. Lay them flat onto a baking sheet for easy access.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Assemble the tamales. Grab a corn husk and identify which is the smooth side and which is the side with ridges. Place the smooth side face up onto the palm of your hand or on a plate. Grab a heaping spoonful of masa and place it in the middle of the corn husk. Spread it in a thin layer using the back of the spoon to create a large square shape, leaving the top ⅓ of the corn husk empty.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Smear about 1 ½ tablespoons of refried beans down the center of the masa, followed by 1 ½ tablespoons of shredded Chihuahua cheese.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Fold together the long edges of the corn husk like a book, and then fold it once more. Fold the pointy edge up so that only one side of the corn husk is open and exposed. Set aside and continue assembling all of the tamales until you’ve used up all the dough.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Steam. Fill the bottom of a large steamer pot with water. Add a penny or coin to the bottom of the pot, then cover it with the steamer insert. Place the tamales in the pot with the open end facing up. Lean them against the side of the pot so they don't fall down.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Cover tightly with the lid and place the steamer over high heat. Bring the water to a boil, reduce the heat to medium-low, and simmer for 90 minutes or until the masa is fully cooked. You’ll know the water is boiling and simmering when you hear the coin rattle in the pot!

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Check for doneness. Remove 1 tamal from the steamer pot. Let it sit for 10 minutes. If the husk peels away easily from the masa, then it’s done. If the masa is still gooey or sticks to the husk, steam it for 15 more minutes, then check again.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Serve. Remove the tamales from the pot and let them cool for 10 minutes before serving with a dollop of Crema Mexican de Casa and a sprinkle of cotija cheese.

title: Tsoureki recipe (Traditional Greek Easter bread)
description: A traditional Greek Easter Bread (Tsoureki) recipe! Discover all the secrets behind making the fluffiest, tastiest traditional Tsoureki with this step by step, no fail recipe!

ingredients.name: ground mastic (0.1 oz.) (buy online in Australia, UK, US/CA)
ground mahleb (0.35 oz.) (buy online UK, US/CA)
butter, from cow’s milk, at room temperature (4.7 oz.)
medium eggs, at room temperature (200g/ 7 oz. without their shells)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this tsoureki recipe (Greek Easter Bread), add in a bowl the lukewarm water, a pinch of sugar and yeast and stir. Wrap well with plastic wrap and set aside for about 6-7 minutes, until the yeast rises and starts bubbling. Be careful not do add hot water, as it will kill the yeast, nor cold, as it will take forever for the Greek Easter bread to rise. The water should be at the same temperature as your finger, so check it out sticking one finger in; you should feel no difference in temperature.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Use a pestle or a blender to ground the masticha and mahlepi, along with a pinch of sugar and set aside. These aromatic spices will give Greek Easter bread its distinctive taste and amazing smell. But be careful not to add any more mastic than this tsoureki recipe calls for, as it will leave a slightly bitter taste to your Greek Easter bread.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a saucepan add the butter, sugar and milk. Place over very low heat and stir the mixture, until the butter has melted and the sugar has dissolved. The key is to melt the butter at very low heat, so that the temperature doesn’t ‘kill’ the yeast. Remove the pan from the stove and check the temperature. The mixture should be lukewarm – the same temperature as your finger. If it is warmer, leave to cool down for a few minutes and check again.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the butter mixture in a large bowl and whisk in the eggs. Add the yeast mixture and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the mixer’s bowl add the flour, the ground mastic and mahlepi, orange zest and the butter-egg-yeast mixture from step 4. Using the dough hook mix at first at low speed, until the ingredients start to combine and then mix at medium-high speed for about 15 minutes, until the dough doesn’t stick on the sides of the bowl. At this point the dough should be really soft, like seen in the picture and a little sticky. (Be careful not to add any more flour than this tsoureki recipe calls for, as the dough should be really soft and not firm).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and place in a warm environment, until at least it doubles in size (about 3-4 hours). If the environment is cold, preheat the oven at 30C/85F, turn it off and place the bowl inside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gently deflate the tsoureki dough with your hands and cut in 6 equal portions (three for each Greek Easter bread). Take one piece of the dough (do not flour the working surface!) and roll it a little with your hands. Hold with your hands from the edges and shake to stretch the dough into a rope. This technique will help the Greek Easter bread (tsoureki) form the characteristic stringy texture, as seen in the picture.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Form the Greek Easter bread into a braid and transfer on a large baking tray layered with parchment paper. Repeat the same procedure with the second tsoureki. Let the Greek Easter bread rise for about 1 more hour at room temperature or in the oven, until it puffs up and almost doubles in size, like in the pictures.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: In a small bowl add the egg and 1 tbsp water and whisk with a fork. Brush the top of each Greek Easter bread with the egg, being careful not to deflate it, garnish with almond slivers and bake in preheated oven at 150C / 310F fan for about 30-40 minutes, until nicely browned and fluffy. If its getting too brown too quickly cover with some parchment paper and continue baking.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Although the traditional tsoureki recipe doesn’t call for syrup, garnishing Greek Easter bread with just a little syrup, always gives a little something! So it’s up to you to decide! Prepare the syrup for the Greek Easter bread just right before you turn the tsoureki out of the oven. In a small pot add the sugar and water and bring to the boil. As soon as the sugar dissolves, remove the pot from the stove and ladle the hot syrup over the hot tsoureki.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Let the Greek Easter bread cool down and wrap well with plastic wrap, so that it doesn’t become hard and dry. Store for up to a 5-6 days at room temperature or up to a couple of months in the freezer.

title: Gyeran mari (rolled omelette) with seaweed

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add ⅔ of the eggs to the pan. Swirl it around to cover the pan. (Reduce the heat or raise the pan away from the heat, for a little while, if the egg is cooking too fast.) See note 2.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the egg is set but the surface is still wet, add a sheet of gim. Pour the remaining egg over the gim and swirl the pan around to spread the egg mixture evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When the egg surface is set again, using a spatula, lift one end of the egg (about 1-1/2 inch) and fold it over to the other side. Quickly lift the folded part and fold it again. (The egg should be slightly wet while being folded, or the roll will become loose when sliced.)

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

title: Fish with Sweet & Sour Chili Sauce ปลาราดพริก (pla raad prik)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 2-3 Prik Chee fah (spur chilies), diced, or sub another type of mild, red chili peppers
Vegetable or canola oil for frying

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Using a mortar and pestle, pound the cilantro roots, garlic, and white pepper until it's resembles a rough paste. Add the spur chilies and Thai chilies and pound until it also resembles a rough paste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a saute pan, over medium heat, cook the chili mixture in some vegetable oil, stirring constantly. When the mixture starts to dry up and is very fragrant, add the palm sugar. When the palm sugar starts to melt, add water, fish sauce and tamarind juice. Stir and let simmer for 1-2 minutes until you achieve a thick, syrupy consistency. Taste and adjust to your liking. Set aside. If you want to prep this dish in advanced, you can refrigerate the sauce at this point and reheat it when you're ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a frying pan, add just enough vegetable oil to coat the bottom of the pan and heat over medium-high heat. When the pan is hot, place the fish presentation side down. You should hear a good sizzle as soon as the fish touches the pan, if the sizzle is gentle, the pan is not hot enough. You can always just touch the pan with the end of the fish to test the sizzle before putting the whole filet down.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the fish is half way done, flip the fish and cook the other half. The second side should take half the time it took the first side. Alternatively, when pan frying a thick piece of fish, you can finish the fish in a 350F oven after you flip it, but Thai people generally don't cook with ovens, so I usually just finish it on the stove.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Traditionally we deep fry a whole fish for this dish. So if you want, you can use a fish that's about 1-1.5 lb in weight - a tilapia or a grouper is commonly used. Score the thickest part of the fish a couple of times on each side and pat it very very dry. Heat some frying oil in a wok or a deep fryer, and when the oil temperature reaches 350 F, slide the fish gently down and let it fry until crispy, flip it half way through!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the fish on a serving plate. Reheat the sauce, when the sauce comes back to a boil, turn the heat off and add the chopped cilantro and stir to mix. At this point you can add a bit of water to loosen if it has thickened too much while it was sitting. Spoon a couple tablespoons of the sauce over the fish, and pour the rest around the fish. Garnish with cilantro sprig or sliced spur chilies. Serve with jasmine rice!

title: Mung Bean Curd with Chili Oil Sauce (Liang Fen, 凉粉)
description: A traditional Chinese street food that is bursting with the flavors of a savory spicy sauce, liang fen is just what you need to bring a taste of China to your own kitchen this weekend!

ingredients.name: homemade chili oil (, including the oil and the chili flakes, or to taste)
Chopped cilantro and/or green onions (, for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 2 1/2 cups of water to a medium-sized pot and bring it to a boil over medium-high heat. Then turn the heat down to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine the mung bean starch and 1/2 cup of water. Stir until the starch is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare a rectangular or square baking dish that can hold at least 4 cups of water but is small enough, so the mixture is at least 1” (2.5 cm) thick. (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Slowly pour the mung bean mixture into the simmering water, while stirring gently with a ladle or a whisk. Continue to stir until the mixture in the pot starts to thicken and small bubbles start to form. It should start turning somewhat translucent. Simmer for another 6 to 8 minutes while stirring, until the mixture thickens further, like a thick sauce texture. Carefully pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Let cool at room temperature until solidified. It takes about 2 hours if you use a shallower dish, but up to 3 or 4 hours if using a deeper dish. Once congealed, you can store the jelly covered in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Chinese Sausage Fried Rice
description: Easy Chinese Sausage fried rice which only requires 10 minutes preparation.

ingredients.name: Around 2 bowls of leftover steamed rice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the rice to wok firstly to stir fry until they separate with each other (use the slice to break any chunks). Push the rice to one side of your wok. Heat up 2 tablespoons of cooking oil and pour the egg liquid.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the egg liquid with rice quickly. Add salt and mix until they are well combined. Transfer egg rice out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir fry Chinese sausage dices and fresh green chili peppers for around 2 minutes over medium fire until you can smell the aroma.

steps.title: Step 4

title: Jalapeño Poppers
description: Jalapeño poppers stuffed with a tasty cream cheese filling and topped with crispy panko breadcrumbs, then baked until golden and bubbly.

ingredients.name: sliced green onions, (plus more for topping)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using a small paring knife, cut each jalapeño in half lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds and membranes using a small spoon or melon baller. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese, cheddar cheese, green onions, garlic powder, salt, and onion powder. Mix together with a spoon until all the ingredients are incorporated into the cream cheese. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a separate medium bowl, mix together the panko breadcrumbs and melted butter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fill the peppers with the cream cheese mixture and transfer them to the prepared baking sheet. Top each pepper with the breadcrumb mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the breadcrumb topping is golden and crispy. Garnish with more green onions and serve.

title: Black Beans and Rice
description: Black Beans and Rice - one of the best side dishes ever that's easy to prepare yet very versatile. Can be thrown together as a side to your favorite meat or a hearty meal on its own.

ingredients.name: (370 g) long grain white rice (, rinsed and drained)
14-ounce cans black beans (, rinsed and drained)
freshly chopped cilantro and lime wedges to serve

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large Dutch oven pan, heat olive oil over medium high heat. Add onions, garlic, thyme and bay leaf. Sauté until fragrant and onions is translucent, about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add spices: Creole or Taco seasoning, cumin, paprika, bouillon and cayenne pepper. Continue stirring for about a minute. Then add in the rinsed rice and toast until lightly brown, about 2 minutes. Next add in the beans and stir for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in chicken broth or water and season with salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil stirring once or twice, reduce heat to low and place tightly fitting lid on the pot. Cook for about 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid has been completely absorbed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use a fork or serving spoon to fluff the rice and bean mixture. Garnish with fresh cilantro and lime wedges and serve.

title: Greek Pastitsio Recipe
description: BEST Greek pastitsio recipe. Delectable and flavor-packed baked pasta with Greek-spiced meat sauce and a "lightened up" golden bechamel topping. A must-try!

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
+ 2 tbsp Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook the pasta to al dante according to package instructions. Be sure to add salt and olive oil to the boiling water. Drain and transfer pasta to 9 1/2" x 13" baking pan like this one. While still hot, drizzle pasta with a little more extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle grated Parmesan. Toss to combine. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the meat sauce. In a large pan or skillet like this one, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Saute onions until just golden, then add lean beef and garlic. Season with salt. Cook until meat is fully browned, tossing regularly and breaking up the meat with your wooden spoon (about 8 to 10 minutes). Carefully drain any excess liquid and return pan to heat. Add wine, crushed tomato, bay leaves, spices and pinch of sugar. Mix to combine. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then lower heat and let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or so. Taste and adjust salt to your liking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the meat sauce is cooking, prepare the bechamel. In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Cook until golden (if needed, added a little more olive oil). Gradually add the warmed milk, whisking continuously. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, until smooth and thick. Add nutmeg.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk a small amount of the hot bechamel mixture with the 2 eggs in a small bowl. Then return all to the pan with the remaining bechamel mixture. Continue to stir or whisk the mixture bringing to a gentle boil for just 2 more minutes. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Remove from heat and allow to cool and thicken a little more (you should have a creamy, thick and smooth bechamel sauce).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Assemble the pastitsio. Top the cooked pasta with the meat sauce; smooth with a wooden spoon to fully cover the pasta. Now top the meat sauce with the bechamel topping. Again, smooth with your wooden spoon to cover the meat sauce evenly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake the pastitsio in 350 degrees F heated-oven for 1 hour until golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside for 10 minutes before serving. Cut into square pieces and serve.

title: Lauki Sabji
description: Dudhi sabji or lauki sabzi is an easy and slightly spiced version of lauki sabzi. Lauki is also known bottle gourd or opo squash in english. Lauki is also known as ghiya, dudhi, sorakaya, sorakkai, lau in some other Indian languages.

ingredients.name: medium size onion (- finely chopped or ½ cup finely chopped onions)
medium to large tomatoes (- finely chopped or 1 to 1.25 cups tightly packed finely chopped tomatoes)
inch ginger (- finely chopped or ground or 1 teaspoon finely chopped ginger)
chopped bottle gourd ((lauki or ghiya or opo squash))
punjabi garam masala (or regular garam masala powder)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil in a 2 litre pressure cooker. Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Let the cumin seeds splutter and crackle.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add ½ cup chopped onions.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix and begin to sauté onions on a medium-low flame till they turn translucent.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now add 1 teaspoon finely chopped ginger and 1 to 2 green chilies (chopped).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sauté for some seconds till the raw aroma of ginger goes away.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Then add 1 to 1.25 cups tightly packed tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Mix and begin to sauté the tomatoes on a medium-low flame till they become mushy and pulpy. the oil also starts to leave the masala.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: In the meantime when the tomatoes are getting cooked, rinse, peel and chop the lauki. Keep aside.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: When the tomatoes have become pulpy and you see oil releasing from the sides of the masala, then add ½ teaspoon turmeric powder, ½ teaspoon red chili powder and 1 teaspoon coriander powder (optional). Also add 1 pinch of asafoetida (optional).

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Sauté for a minute.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Then add 3 cups chopped lauki (bottle gourd or ghia). sauté for a minute.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: cooking lauki sabji

title: Greek baklava rolls recipe (Saragli)
description: Greek baklava rolls (saragli) made to perfection! An amazing combination of crispy golden phyllo wrapped around flavourful nutty filling, bathed in syrup with the aromas of lemon cinnamon and clove.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this baklava rolls recipe, start by preparing the syrup first. In a small pot add all the ingredients, except the honey. Place the pot over high heat and boil until the sugar has dissolved. Remove the pot from the stove, add the honey and stir. Set aside to cool completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pan melt the butter over low heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the filling for the baklava rolls. In a food processor add the nuts and pulse until the nuts are finely (and some roughy chopped). Add the ground cinnamon and clove and mix with a spoon to combine. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Open the phyllo package and place the sheets on your kitchen counter. Cover with a damp (not wet) towel, while you prepare the baklava rolls.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: approx. 22x35cm

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place one sheet of phyllo on your counter and sprinkle with melted butter. Spread some of the nut filling (about 1-1/2 tbsp).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Then it is time to shape into a roll. Take 2 wooden skewers and place them on the sheets of phyllo like seen in the pictures (not too tightly). Then using your hands, press the ends towards the middle tucking them inside and remove the skewers. Place on your baking dish and repeat with rest.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When done, brush the top with the rest of melted butter. If you have butter left, pour it evenly on top of the rolls. With a sharp knife cut the rolls into pieces.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 150-160C (300-320F) for 60-75 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: When baked laddle slowly the cold syrup over the hot rolls. Garnish with finely chopped nuts.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Let the baklava rolls cool down before serving.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Shrimp (滑蛋虾仁)
description: This classic Chinese dish pairs delicate scrambled eggs with shrimp for a simple, delicious, and comforting stir-fry that’s sure to be a new favorite on your table.

ingredients.name: (120 g) shrimp (, peeled and deveined (small shrimp are best))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the shrimp with the marinade ingredients in a small bowl. Let marinate for 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the egg and salt in a medium-sized bowl. Beat the eggs using a fork or a pair of chopsticks until the yolks are fully broken apart and the eggs begin to froth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil in a medium-sized non-stick pan over medium heat until the oil is medium-hot. Add the marinated shrimp. Let cook for 30 seconds without touching them. When the bottoms turn white, flip and cook a bit longer until almost cooked through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat and pour in the beaten eggs. Let the eggs set around the edges, then gently push the set egg to one side and let the unset egg run into the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat to low and return the pan to the heat. Repeat the process of letting the eggs set slightly and then pushing them to the side. If the eggs start to set too fast, remove the pan from the heat completely and use the residual heat to cook the eggs. Cook until the eggs are still slightly creamy, just cooked through, or to your desired doneness. Once done, immediately transfer everything to a serving plate to prevent overcooking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Garnish with the green onions and serve immediately. You don’t need any other seasonings for this dish, but you can also pair it with your favorite hot sauce.

title: Stir-fried Cucumbers (Oi Bokkeum)

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

title: The Best Chicken Marinade
description: The best chicken marinade ever! This easy, 2-ingredient recipe makes the absolute best, most flavorful chicken you’ll ever have.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs, (breasts, or tenders*)
(26-ounce) can pickled jalapeño peppers ((with or without carrots))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the chicken in a large resealable bag or bowl. Pour the can of pickled jalapeño peppers on top and seal the bag or cover the bowl. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to 12 hours.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When ready to cook, remove the chicken from the marinade and pat it dry with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: *Optional* In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients for the optional seasoning blend. You don’t have to season the chicken with this since the pickled jalapeño juices add a ton of flavor, but I like the addition of some dry spices right before cooking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To grill: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates with vegetable oil. Grill the chicken for 5 to 10 minutes per side depending on the thickness of the meat until cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 160-165 degrees F on an instant-read thermometer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To cook on the stovetop: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 10 minutes per side depending on the thickness of the meat until cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 160-165 degrees F on an instant-read thermometer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To bake: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Arrange the chicken in a single layer on a large foil-lined baking dish. Bake the chicken until the internal temperature reaches 160-165 degrees F on an instant-read thermometer. Chicken thighs and tenders need about 15 minutes. Medium to large breasts need 20 to 25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer the chicken to a plate, loosely tent it in foil, and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Easy One-Pot Chicken and Rice Recipe
description: Simple, comforting, one-pot chicken and rice recipe with chopped veggies, chickpeas, and warm Middle Eastern spices. Ready in just over 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas (or from canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the spices to make the spice mixture. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat chicken thighs dry and cut them into large pieces (I simply cut each in half). Season well with salt, then season with the spice mixture. Work the chicken with clean hands to make sure all the pieces are well-coated with the spice mixture. Set at room temperature for 20 minutes or so (if you have the time).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large and deep cooking skillet with a lid, heat 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium-high until shimmering but not smoking. Brown the chicken briefly on both sides. Remove from the skillet and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To the same skillet, now add onions, carrots, and frozen peas. Cook for 4 minutes or so, tossing regularly, until tender. Add the chickpeas and rice. Season with salt, 1/2 tsp allspice and 1/4 tsp ground cardamom. Stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the chicken back to the skillet (nestle the pieces in the rice). Add the cinnamon sticks, bay leaf, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from the heat, garnish with parsley.

title: Chocolate Souffle in Baklava Pouches recipe!
description: Discover how to make the perfect chocolate souffle wrapped in little baklava pouches with this unique recipe!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the chocolate filling, start by melting the chocolate. Chop the chocolate in small pieces and melt over low heat using a Bain Marie or double boiler, being careful not to burn it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, add in a large bowl the sugar and the butter (40g) and whisk, using an electric mixer, until combined. Add the eggs, one at a time, whilst mixing, waiting for each one to be absorbed, before adding another. Add the vanilla extract and the flour and mix gently to combine. At the end pour in the bowl the melted chocolate and whisk, until the ingredients are combined. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200C and melt the butter (60g) in microwave or on stovetop. Using a pastry brush, lightly brush bottoms and sides of a 10-hole muffin tin with butter; set aside and start preparing the chocolate- baklava pouches.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place 6 sheets of phyllo dough in a single stack. Using a sharp knife, cut the stack of dough into 6 rectangular pieces (cut three lanes and then cut in the middle). Use four rectangles of phyllo dough to make each pouch as follows. Working with one rectangle of phyllo at a time, brush one side with melted butter and sprinkle with the chopped nuts. Place a second piece of phyllo on top of the first one in a cross-wise manner, brush with melted butter, sprinkle with chopped almonds and walnuts. Repeat with the third and fourth piece, brushing with melted butter and topping with chopped nuts, forming an ‘eight-pointed’ star.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the phyllo ‘star’ in a hole of the muffin tin, allowing the edges to fall out over the top of the hole. Fill with 2 tbsps of the chocolate mixture and pinch the sides of the phyllo dough together to close loosely the pouch. Repeat with the rest pouches.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the muffin tin in the oven, turn the heat down to 180C and bake for 13 minutes, until the top turns golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: These baklava pouches are delicious on their own, but garnishing with just a little syrup, always gives a little something! So it’s up to you to decide! To prepare the syrup add 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of water and a little lemon zest in a small pot and bring to the boil. Boil for about 5 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved and the syrup has slightly thickened. As soon as the baklava pouches are ready, drizzle the hot syrup over the pastry.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve while still warm with a full-spoon of vanilla ice-cream. Enjoy!

title: Crispy Fried Pumpkin with Salted Egg Yolk
description: With just a few simple ingredients, you can enjoy crispy fried pumpkin with salted egg yolk, a savory dish that’s bursting with flavor and so satisfying to eat. {Gluten-Free Adaptable}

ingredients.name: (450) peeled pumpkin or winter squash (, cut into 2”x1/2” (5 cm x 1 cm) sticks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the pumpkin in a deep plate. Sprinkle with the 1/2 teaspoon salt. Toss with your hands to coat the pumpkin evenly with salt. Let it rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Crush the cooked yolks with a fork in a small bowl, until they are very well crumbled.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain off the liquid from the pumpkin and transfer it to a big bowl. Add the cornstarch and toss to coat completely.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare a large plate and top it with a few layers of paper towels. Or prepare a medium-sized baking tray with a wire rack.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add the coated pumpkin. Cook until the bottom turns crisp, about 2 to 3 minutes. Flip the pumpkin to cook the other side, for another 2 to 3 minutes, until it turns crispy throughout and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn off the heat. Transfer the cooked pumpkin using a spider strainer or a slotted spoon to the prepared plate (or rack) to drain the excess oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the extra oil and only save 1 tablespoon of oil by either pouring the oil into a heat-proof bowl, or using a big ladle.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn the heat to medium-low. Add the garlic and fry until fragrant, 30 seconds or so.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the crumbled salted yolk. Cook and stir until it is thick and foaming but not browning, a few seconds.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Pour in the Shaoxing wine. Cook and stir until the liquid is mostly evaporated.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add the fried pumpkin back to the pan and sprinkle the sugar over it. Stir everything together for 1 minute, or until the pumpkin pieces are evenly coated with the yolk. Transfer to a plate immediately.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve hot as a side dish or over steamed rice as a main.

description: These have a juicy, umami filling, and are cooked using the "water frying" method for crispy bottoms without needing to boil a pot of water!

ingredients.name: dashi powder (optional; if not using add 1 tsp more soy sauce)
chopped garlic chives or 3 finely chopped green onions
Optional: A pinch of sugar (Thai people like to add this to lessen the sharpness of the vinegar)
Optional: A little drizzle of rayu (Japanese chili garlic oil, highly recommend!) or another chili oil of your choice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Separate the white and green part of napa cabbage leaves. Finely dice the white "stems" and finely chop the leaves, keeping them separate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle pound peppercorns until fine. Add garlic and ginger and pound into a fine paste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok or a large skillet over medium heat add a tablespoon of oil and the garlic paste. Saute until aromatic; about 2 mins.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add napa cabbage STEMS ONLY and turn the heat up to medium high. Add ¼ tsp of the salt and cook until soft and translucent; about 4-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cabbage leaves and cook for another 2-3 minutes until wilted and there’s no pooling liquid. Remove from heat and spread it all out on a plate to cool quickly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While the cabbage cools, combine pork, the remaining 1/4 tsp salt, soy sauce, dashi powder, sesame oil, tapioca starch, and sugar, and knead with your hands (I'd wear a latex glove) for at least 5 mins. After kneading it should look smooth and pasty.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the cooled cabbage and garlic chives and mix gently using a "fold and squish" action just until the vegetables are evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cook a little bit of filling in the microwave to taste so you can adjust the seasoning if needed. (If you follow the measurements exactly, you won't need to adjust, but it's good habit to ALWAYS taste anything that can't be fixed after cooking, because you might have forgotten something!)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Wrap the dumplings: Using a dessert spoon, scoop up a spoonful of filling (about 1 ½ Tbsp) per piece. Watch the video for how to wrap.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: If you're not cooking them right away, freeze them immediately. Do not wrap and let them sit unfrozen for any longer than a couple of hours. (See FAQ above for more details and how to properly freeze dumplings.)

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Mix together the dipping sauce before you start cooking so it'll be ready.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cook the dumplings:

title: Nacho Baked Potato Wedges
description: Perfect for sharing, this nacho baked potato wedges recipe features homemade potato wedges topped with melted cheese and nacho toppings.

ingredients.name: shredded cheese ((cheddar, monterey jack, or mozzarella))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut potatoes into wedges by slicing each potato in half lengthwise, then slicing each of those halves in half again, and slicing those halves in half one last time. Each potato should yield 8 wedges.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add potato wedges to a medium bowl and add 1 tablespoon Mazola® Corn Oil, 1/2 tablespoon kosher salt, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/2 teaspoon onion powder. Toss together to coat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the wedges in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway through. While the potatoes are baking, prepare the ground turkey.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat remaining 1/2 tablespoon Mazola® Corn Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground chicken, the remaining 1/2 tablespoon kosher salt, the remaining 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/4 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1/4 teaspoon chili powder, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is completely cooked. Set aside until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the potato wedges are finished, remove them from the oven. Push the potatoes together into a pile in the middle of the baking sheet. Top with the cooked seasoned ground turkey and the shredded cheese.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Return to the oven and bake for 3-5 minutes, until the cheese completely melts.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Top with diced onions, chopped cilantro, diced tomatoes, sour cream, and any other nacho toppings you like. Serve immediately.

title: Greek Galaktoboureko with Kataifi (Custard and shredded phyllo pie)
description: A mouthwatering variation of the traditional Greek galaktoboureko with kataifi dough (shredded phyllo dough)! Golden crispy kataifi dough wrapped around fluffy aromatic semolina custard and bathed in syrup.. Well one couldn’t ask for more!

title: Simple Pancetta Pasta with Peas and Parmesan
description: Simple pancetta pasta and peas, tossed in a simple garlic and olive oil sauce and finished with Parmesan cheese. So good!

ingredients.name: thin spaghetti (or pasta of your choice)
4- oz cubed pancetta, (cut into small bits (you can use bacon if you need to))
Grated Parmesan cheese, (1/2 cup or more to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the pasta to al dante in plenty of salted boiling water, consult package for instructions. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta cooking water aside, then drain pasta (some of the starchy pasta water will serve as sauce later)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, heat a large cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add the pancetta (or bacon) and cook, tossing regularly, until fully cooked and browned. Remove pancetta onto a plate lined with paper towel to drain. Carefully dispose of most of the pancetta fat leaving just a hint (about 2 tsp) for flavoring.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Set stove top to medium heat and return skillet to heat. To the little bit of pancetta fat, add 4 tbsp Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil. Heat until shimmering but not smoking, then add shallots, peas, salt, black pepper, and 1 tsp aleppo pepper. Raise heat to medium-high and cook for 5 minutes, tossing regularly. Add garlic and parsley and cook for another 3 mins, or until peas are fully cooked through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now return cooked pancetta to skillet. Add cooked pasta and 3/4 cup of the reserved pasta water. Add the remaining 1 tsp aleppo pepper, lemon zest and lemon juice. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add grated Parmesan cheese (you might stat with 3 to 4 tbsp and adjust as needed.) Test and adjust seasoning (salt and pepper) to your liking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer pasta to serving bowls and enjoy!

title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
description: Slow Cooker Carnitas - juicy and highly-seasoned pork slow cooked until tender enough to pull apart with forks then broiled slightly for crisp delicious edges. The most delicious, easiest and healthiest version of carnitas!

ingredients.name: - 5 lbs or 1.58-2.27 kg pork shoulder (, either butt or picnic)
or 8 fl oz orange juice or 2 oranges
or 9 g salt (, more to taste)
large onion (, chopped, plus finely chopped onion for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove pork from packaging and gently rinse pork under cold water. Remove pork skin and any visible fat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add half of the minced garlic, bay leaf , chili and the orange juice to the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season pork with salt, cumin, smoked paprika and oregano. Place in the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining crushed oregano leaves, cinnamon stick and onions in the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover and cook on Low for about 8 hours or until the pork shreds easily with a fork.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the pork roast from the slow cooker and shred. Reserve cooking liquid.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: The meat should be tender enough to pull apart with forks.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the shredded pork on a foil on a baking sheet. Use liquid from the pork to moisten carnitas.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Broil on high for 10-15 minutes, stirring once, or until the edges of the pork begin to crisp and brown. Keep a close eye to avoid burning. Use tongs or spatulas to turn as needed .

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve warm as a filling for tacos, burritos or in bowls.

title: Baba Ganoush Recipe (Smoky Eggplant Dip)
description: Baba Ganoush is a smoky eggplant dip made with roasted eggplants, tahini, yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil. The eggplants are fire roasted or grilled in an oven until soft and then blended to a creamy consistency.

ingredients.name: sea salt (or preferred salt, add salt according to taste)
to 2 tablespoons lemon juice (or as required, * check point no 6 in notes section below)
cayenne pepper (or paprika or red chili powder)
a few sprigs cilantro ((coriander leaves) or parsley)
a few pinches cayenne pepper (or paprika or red chili powder, optional)
to 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil

title: Beef with Bitter Melon (苦瓜炒牛肉)
description: Try this tender and juicy beef with bitter melon - a stir fry that hits upon savory, sweet, and tangy notes in every single bite.

ingredients.name: (225 g) flank steak (, sliced thinly against the grain)
dark soy sauce ((or regular soy sauce) (*Footnote 1))
(12-10 oz) large bitter melon (, seeded and cut into 1 cm (1/4”) slices)
black bean sauce (or fermented black beans, soaked in hot water for 1 minute, then drained and mashed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the beef and marinade ingredients in a medium-sized bowl. Mix until the beef is fully coated. Set aside and marinate for 15 minutes, while preparing other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the bitter melon to a big bowl and sprinkle the salt over it. Toss with your hand to coat it well. Let sit for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the sauce in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil over medium-high heat. Add the salted melon and boil for 1 minute. Drain off the hot water. Rinse the bitter melon with running cold tap water a few times to stop the cooking. Drain again and place the bitter melon on a plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour 1/2 tablespoon of peanut oil in a large skillet and heat over medium heat until hot. Add the garlic and black bean sauce, then stir for 30 seconds to release the fragrance. Lower the heat if the black bean sauce starts to burn.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the bitter melon and sugar. Stir and cook for another minute. Transfer everything to a big plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of oil to the pan along with the ginger. Cook and stir for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn to medium-high heat and add the marinated steak. Let cook undisturbed for 1 minute, or until the bottom is browned. Flip the meat and cook for another 1 minute or so, until the other side is browned. It’s OK if the inside of the beef is slightly pink.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour in the wine and use your spatula to scrape off any brown bits from the pan.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the sauce and stir, until it slightly thickens.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add back the cooked bitter melon. Stir fry until the sauce reaches the desired consistency and everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Transfer everything to a big plate and serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Gaji hobak muchim (grilled eggplant and zucchini)
description: Korean-flavored grilled eggplant and zucchini side dish!

ingredients.name: gochugaru - optional for a spicy version (adjust to taste)
green or red chili pepper - optional for a spicy version

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the eggplant and zucchini crosswise into about 1/3 inch-thick slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the vegetables In a bowl, and sprinkle with salt (about 1/4 teaspoon for each vegetable). Let sit for about 20 minutes until wilted and some liquid has been released. Flip them over half way through. Discard the liquid.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat a lightly oiled grill or grill pan over medium high heat. You can also use a large skillet. Grill the vegetable slices, for about two minutes per side, until cooked through and slightly charred with nice grill marks.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the seasoning ingredients and gently toss everything together.

title: Funky Shrimp Paste Dip - Nam Prik Gapi
description: A funky, umami, salty, spicy dip! This traditional dish is a staple in many Thai homes, and though it is an acquired taste, once you've acquired it, there's nothing else like it!

ingredients.name: Thai chilies (to taste (1-2 is probably enough, but some make this super spicy))
Extra chopped red and green peppers for colour (optional, but if presentation is important, you'll need it)
Vegetable omelette (see video for a quick demo of how to make it)
Japanese eggplant slices dipped in egg and pan fried
Note: Seasonings are given as a range because how much you need will depend on the kind of shrimp paste you're using

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cover dried shrimp in water and microwave for 30 seconds or however long it takes the water to be steaming hot. Let it cool for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the dried shrimp (you can keep the water and use it as the water called for in the recipe). Add dried shrimp to a mortar and pestle and pound until they're broken into small fluffy bits.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add garlic and chilies and pound until the garlic and chilies are fine. (Larger bits of chili skins are fine.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add palm sugar and pound until it's mostly dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add shrimp paste and pound to mix, making sure there are no clumps of shrimp paste left.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add lime juice and fish sauce and mix well with a spoon. Add about a tablespoon of water to start then taste; and if you want it to be a bit more mellow, add a little more water. But keep in mind this is supposed to be a strongly-flavoured dip that's used only a little at a time. You can also add more lime juice, sugar or fish sauce as needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve with all the accompaniments and enjoy!

title: Mexican Brownies
description: Mexican Brownies spiced with a touch of cayenne and cinnamon. Fudgy and chocolaty, all it takes are a few ingredients and less than 1 hour.

ingredients.name: nonstick cooking spray or oil, (for greasing pan)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oven to 350°F. Spray the inside of an 8-inch square baking pan with nonstick spray or oil. Line the pan with parchment paper, and then spray the parchment with nonstick spray or oil as well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add flour, cocoa powder, salt, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper to a large bowl. Whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, add butter and chocolate chips. Stir continuously until the mixture has completely melted.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat. Add the granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract. Stir until well combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the eggs and egg yolk. Stir until well combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the wet ingredients into the flour mixture. Fold together with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon until just combined. Try not overmix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the batter in the prepared baking pan and bake for 32-36 minutes, until the center is firm and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out mostly clean.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish with a sprinkle of flaky sea salt (optional), then let the brownies cool completely in the pan. Transfer them to a cutting board and slice them into squares before serving.

title: Homemade Kataifi recipe!
description: This is a very easy to follow Greek Kataifi recipe for you to recreate this traditional sweet delight from scratch. Kataifi is a delicious dessert, which like baklava is very popular among Greek, Turkish and Middle Eastern nations.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this Kataifi recipe, start by preparing the syrup. Add all the ingredients for the syrup into a small pot and bring to the boil. As soon as the sugar has dissolved, the syrup is ready. Leave the syrup aside to cool completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the filling for the Kataifi. In a blender add the walnuts, ground clove and cinnamon; pulse until the walnuts are roughly chopped (not powdered). Although the walnut filling is the most common, lots of kataifi recipes also add pistachios and almonds. So it’s up to you to decide.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Melt the butter and with a cooking brush butter the bottom and sides of a baking pan. (approx. 26-28cm diameter)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Unroll the Kataifi dough from the plastic sleeve. Work the dough with your hands, tearing apart the shreds and gently spreading the strands out a bit if they clump together, in order to get fluffy. Cover the Kataifi dough with a slightly damp towel.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take one piece of the kataifi dough, and spread it on a working surface or on your palm. Drizzle with melted butter and place 1 teaspoon of the filling at one end. Roll it up tightly, folding inwards the sides, to form a small cylinder. Place the kataifi roll in the pan and brush with melted butter, using the cooking brush to shape it a little bit. Repeat with the rest of the kataifi dough and filling. Place the kataifi rolls the one next to the other, leaving no gaps between them and drizzle with a little bit more butter.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake the kataifi in preheated oven at 170-180C for about 1 hour (on the middle rack), until nicely coloured and crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: As soon as you turn the kataifi out of the oven, ladle slowly the 3/4 of the cold syrup over the hot kataifi, enabling each ladle to be absorbed. Cover the pan with a towel and set aside for 10 minutes. Ladle the rest of the syrup over the kataifi and wait until absorbed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve this delicious kataifi dessert with a full spoon of vanilla ice-cream. Enjoy!

title: White Bean Hummus
description: Ultra creamy, lemony, and just enough garlicy white bean hummus! Serve it plain with a drizzle of good extra virgin olive oil with veggies and pita chips to dip. Or, dress it up with some nutty dukkah (highly recommended).

ingredients.name: 15- ounce can white beans, ((I recommend butter beans), drained and rinsed)
Aleppo pepper or 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, (more to your liking)
Juice of ½ lemon, (more to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the beans and minced garlic to the bowl of a food processor. Puree until a smooth mixture forms.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the processor is running, add an ice cube, tahini, lemon juice, spices and a big dash of kosher salt. Blend for about 4 minutes or so. Check, and if the consistency is too thick, run processor and slowly add a drizzle of hot water. Blend until you reach your desired silky smooth consistency.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning and lemon juice to your liking. If you need more garlic, add another minced clove. And if you like the dip to be even more nutty, add a little more tahini. Make sure to run the processor again until everything is well combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve or chill the dip for a later time (chilling will thicken the white bean hummus some, which is recommended). When ready to serve, spread the hummus in a serving bowl and add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Top with 2 to 3 teaspoons of dukkah, if using.

title: Thandai Recipe (Traditional Holi Drink)
description: Thandai is a festive North Indian beverage prepared with a homemade Thandai powder or paste made from nuts, seeds and whole spices. The mixture is blended with milk and lightly sweetened to make a rich, cooling drink.

to 4 green cardamoms (- husks removed and seeds kept)
milk (- cold or chilled, add as needed)
few rose petals ( or chopped almonds or pistachios for garnish)

title: Braised Short Ribs
description: Braised Short Ribs – crazy tender beef short ribs infused with flavors from garlic, rosemary and thyme. Flavorful, fragrant and fall-off-the-bones delicious!

ingredients.name: – 3 pounds beef short ribs (, (cut into 2-3-inch pieces crosswise, fat trimmed off))
bouillon powder adjust to taste optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-heat oven 325 Degrees F. Season all sides of each short rib generously with salt and pepper. Heat up a large pan with oil over medium-heat and add short ribs to the pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Brown short ribs very well, about 3-5 minute per side. Cook in batches, if necessary. Do not skip this step as browning the beef adds flavor. Remove from pot and set aside. Drain any excess oil from the pot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same pot, add onions, celery and bay leaf - saute for 2-3 minutes or until onions are wilted.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then throw in minced garlic , rosemary and thyme and saute for another 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add tomato paste, stirring constantly for 1 minute to combine the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the browned short ribs back into the pot and add in green onions Worcestershire sauce, bouillon powder, and carrots. Give it a stir to thoroughly coat the ribs.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour in water and wine, if using any, scraping the bottom to loosen brown bits. Bring to a boil, cover, and transfer to the oven.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cook short ribs in pre-heated oven until short ribs are tender, about 2-2 1/2 hours. Scoop out fat from surface of sauce and discard.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Adjust for salt and pepper and consistency. Remove from oven and serve over warm grits or polenta.

title: Hunan Pork Stir Fry
description: Chinese Hunan Style Pork Stir fry

ingredients.name: garlic sprouts or scallion white ( , cut into 5 cm sections)
long chili peppers (, use hotter peppers as a substitute )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the pork belly into thin slices, set aside. Then cut pork tenderloin into thin pieces too, marinate with salt, pepper, starch, light soy sauce and cooking wine for 15 minutes. Then add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the long chili peppers into 5 cm sections.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat up a wok or pan firstly, add chili peppers in to fry for around 1 to 2 minutes until they are slightly soft and wrinkled. Transfer out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry the pork belly until slightly cured, if you feel there is too much oil, remove the extra oil add garlic and ginger and fry until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the tenderloin in, fry for 15 to 20 seconds until the lean meat turns color, add peppers and garlic sprouts in, add sugar, salt, light soy sauce, oyster sauce and dark soy sauce. Mix well.

title: Kkaennip kimchi (perilla kimchi)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: soup soy sauce (or regular soy sauce)
sugar (or 2 ts maesilcheong, Korean plum syrup)
water or dashima (dried kelp/kombu) broth (See note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the kkaennip thoroughly under running water one at a time, especially the back, rough side. Hold the stems together, and shake off the excess water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place them in a colander to further drain/dry.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix all the seasoning ingredients well in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place 3 or 4 leaves at a time, in a bowl or container with an airtight lid, and spread about a teaspoon of the sauce all over. Repeat the process with the remaining leaves. Rotate the location of the stem part of each batch to level the stack. Pour any remaining sauce over the leaves when all the leaves are used up.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover tightly with the lid. Let it sit at room temperature for a few hours and refrigerate. You can start enjoying it right away, but it will keep well for weeks.

title: HOT THAI TUNA! Stir Fried Tuna in Red Curry
description: Tuna stir fried in red curry paste and other Thai herbs. It's an incredibly flavourful dish that is super versatile. Toss it with rice, eat with congee, add to an omelette, or anywhere you can use tasty spicy tuna!

title: Arroz Verde
description: Arroz verde is a tasty Mexican side dish that gets its signature green color from herbs like cilantro and parsley and peppers like roasted poblanos and jalapeño.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the rice to a fine mesh strainer or colander and rinse under running water until the water runs clear. Drain well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray or grease with oil. Place the poblanos and jalapeño on the baking sheet and place under the broiler. Broil on high for 10 minutes, flipping over halfway through.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the baking sheet from the broiler and cover it with aluminum foil or plastic wrap. Let it sit for 10 minutes. Uncover and remove as much of the skin from the peppers as possible. At this point, you can also remove the seeds from any of the peppers if you don’t want it too spicy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the roasted poblanos, jalapeño, onion, cilantro, parsley, garlic, and ¾ cup of broth to a food processor or blender. Blend or pulse until smooth. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the rinsed rice and saute for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice begins to brown very slightly. At this point, some grains of rice may even pop. This step adds some nuttiness and more depth of flavor to the rice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the blended poblano mixture and cook for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour in the remaining 1 ½ cups of broth and salt. Stir together with the rice until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is fully cooked and all the liquid has been absorbed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add lime juice and lightly fluff the rice with a fork. Allow the rice to sit uncovered for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Menemen Recipe: Turkish Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes
description: You'll love this easy menemen recipe of soft, perfectly scrambled eggs with tomatoes, peppers, and onions! This simple one-pan dish comes together in 20 minutes or less, and makes the perfect breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

ingredients.name: green bell pepper (Anaheim or Holland peppers will work as well), (cored, seeded and chopped)
Crushed red pepper flakes, (optional if you like spicy)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a 10-inch skillet, heat 2 tablespoons over medium heat. Add the onions and peppers and season with kosher salt. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring regularly until softened (being careful not to brown the onions).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the tomatoes and tomato paste. Season with a little more kosher salt, black pepper, oregano, and Aleppo pepper. Cook for a few minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes soften but still hold their shape (5 to 7 minutes).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Push the tomato and pepper mixture to one side of the pan. Lower the heat to medium-low. Add the beaten egg, and cook briefly, stirring gently as needed, until the eggs are just set. Fold the tomato mixture into the eggs.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finish with a little EVOO and more Aleppo pepper and crushed red pepper flakes, if you need a little kick. Serve immediately with thick slices of bread.

title: Karidopita/Karithopita recipe (Greek Walnut Cake with Syrup)
description: A mouthwatering Greek walnut cake recipe (karidopita), scented with the aromas and blends of cinnamon and grounded clove. Find out how to make the perfect walnut cake with this traditional Greek recipe.

ingredients.name: powdered Melba toast or breadcrumbs (6.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Use an electric mixer to mix the sugar and butter; mix at medium-high speed for at least 5 minutes, until smooth and creamy. Add the egg yolks, one at a time, whilst continue mixing; wait each time for each egg to be absorbed, before adding the next. Pour in the cognac and the orange zest and mix for 10 more seconds. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a large bowl, add the chopped walnut, the powdered Melba toast, the cinnamon, the clove, the nutmeg, the baking powder and blend with a spoon. (Chop the walnut, using a blender, but be careful not to powder it; the authentic greek walnut cake calls for roughly chopped walnuts.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the two mixtures and blend, until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the egg whites into the bowl of the electric mixer, along with a pinch of salt. Make sure your egg whites, bowl and whisk attachments are clean and free of any water. Whisk the egg whites until the mixture is very thick and glossy and a long trailing peak forms when the whisk is lifted (meringues).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: With a spatula add gradually the meringues into the mixture and blend with light circular movements from the bottom up.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Butter the bottom and the sides of a round baking tray, approx 30cm diameter and bake in a preheated oven at 170C, for about 35 minutes, until nicely colored on the outside and baked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Let the karidopita (greek walnut cake) to cool and then prepare the syrup. Add all the ingredients for the syrup into a pot, and boil, until the sugar has dissolved. Scar the cake into pieces, and slowly ladle the hot syrup over the cold cake, allowing time for each ladle of syrup to be absorbed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Let it cool down for a while, before serving. This Greek walnut cake is ideally served cold with some vanilla ice-cream aside. Enjoy!!

title: Slow Cooker Jerk Pulled Pork
description: Company worthy slow cooker Jerk pulled pork- Seasoned with Jerk Spice and Slowly cooked with Jerk marinate and Pineapple . Easy, tender, incredibly Flavorful.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim pork of excess fat and pat dry with a cloth or paper napkin. Cut in 2 pieces

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Generously salt pork, and then rub with jerk seasoning. Allow refrigerating overnight to allow the flavors to penetrate the meat

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a food processor or blender, combine the cinnamon,ginger, thyme, green onions, onion, habanero pepper, soy sauce, Maggi/bouillon, brown sugar, onion, nutmeg, white pepper, and all spice. Pulse for about 30 seconds until blended

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drench the pork with ¾ of the jerk marinates. Try not to touch the jerk blend with your hands because it extremely spicy hot- If possible use gloves or just place the pork pieces and marinate in the slow cooker so that they are tucked tightly. Add the pineapple slices. Cover the slow cooker, turn it on to high, and let it cook for about 5- 6hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: After shoulder pork is cooked carefully remove the Lid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: You may serve as is or shred it using a fork.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place it on a broiler pan or a baking sheet covered with foil. Be careful because the pork would be really tender. You might have to use a spatula or tongs. Add a little bit of the cooked marinate on the pork. Adjust the rack in your oven so that the top of the pork is 4-5 inches below the broiler. Broil on high for about 3 - 5 minutes or until the skin is crispy and deep brown. Don’t walk away from the pork – this really acts quickly. Broilers can burn food.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: While the pork is getting crisp simmer the sauce from the pork, if desired together with the remaining jerk marinade in a saucepan for about 5-7 minutes. Or until reduced to desired consistency. Serve with pork.

title: Stir Fried Garlic Scape with Eggs (蒜苔炒鸡蛋)
description: Crisp stir fried garlic scapes with fluffy eggs in a rich, fragrant brown sauce with a hint of sweetness. This recipe shares a super quick and easy way to consume a large amount of garlic scapes.

ingredients.name: vegetarian oyster sauce ((or regular oyster sauce))
green onion (, sliced (Reserve a small portion for garnish))
(340 g) garlic scapes (, sliced to 1” (2.5 cm) pieces (Yield 2 2/1 cup once cut))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the oyster sauce and soy sauce together in a small bowl. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add the eggs. Let cook for a few seconds until the bottom sets. Scramble the eggs lightly until just cooked through, then transfer them to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of oil, ginger and green onion. Stir a few times to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the garlic scapes. Stir and cook for 2 minutes, until it starts to soften if using Asian garlic scapes. Cook for a longer time if using US garlic scapess (*Footnote 1). Pour in the oyster sauce mixture and stir a few times to mix well. Taste a piece of garlic scape. It should be tender but still a bit crisp. You can cook it longer for a more tender texture, if you prefer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return the eggs to the pan. Stir and cook for another 30 seconds. Transfer everything to a large serving plate. Garnish with the remaining fresh green onions, if using. Serve hot over rice as a main dish or as a side dish.

title: Homemade Noodles
description: basic homemade noodles recipe

ingredients.name: high gluten flour ( , around 1 cup+2/3 cup)
water ( , around 120ml, can be replaced by egg liquid partly or completely)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add flour, pinch of salt in a deep bowl. Pour in water slowly. Stir the flour with a tool. Stop pouring water when there is no dry flour in the mixing bowl (depending on the flour you are using, the water absorption might be different. )

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Knead the dough until your hand is clean, your bowl is clean and the dough is smooth. Then keep kneading for another 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover with a wet cloth and rest for around 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the dough to a large floured operating board. Roll it into a thick wrapper firstly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll the dough into paper-thin rectangle or round wrapper, keeping remaining dough covered with flour.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll the dough into rectangle or round wrapper with around 0.5 cm in thick, keeping remaining dough covered with flour.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fold the large dough wrapper around 5cm wide. Each time after folding up, spread the surface with flour. Cut any irregular part if necessary.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut the folded dough into thin strips with a sharp and dry knife.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Spread flour on the surface before picking the noodle strips.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Unfold the strips one by one and then shake the extra flour off.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Cook them directly or refrigerated up to 7 days in air--tight bags.

title: Mediterranean Shrimp Recipe with Bell Peppers
description: Easy shrimp recipe, coated in Mediterranean spices and skillet-cooked in a light white wine and olive oil sauce with shallots, bell peppers and tomatoes. Ready in 25 minutes or less!

ingredients.name: large shrimp (or prawns, peeled and deveined (if frozen, be sure to thaw first))
butter (I prefer to use ghee clarified butter)
green bell pepper and 1/2 yellow bell pepper, (cored and sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat the shrimp dry and place it in a large bowl. Add the flour, smoked paprika, salt and pepper, coriander, cayenne, and sugar. Toss until the shrimp is well-coated.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet, melt the butter with the olive oil over medium heat. Add the shallots and garlic. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring regularly, until fragrant (be sure not to burn the garlic.) Add the bell peppers and cook another 4 minutes or so, tossing occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now add the shrimp. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, then add the diced tomatoes, broth, white wine and lemon juice. Cook for a couple more minutes or until the shrimp turns bright orange.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Finally, stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve!

title: Pan Fried Boneless Pork Chops
description: Pan Fried Boneless Pork Chops - a family-friendly meal which is an easy and quick fix for lunch and dinner, seasoned with pantry staple ingredients then pan fried to perfection and served with its orange zesty sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thoroughly dry pork chops, then season with salt and generously rub with creole seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat about 2 Tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high until hot. Then carefully add pork chops.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pan fry pork chops on both sides until golden brown — about 4 to 5 minutes per side or until no pink juice. Remove chops from the pan and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add butter to the skillet , followed by garlic and thyme; saute for about one minute or less, add orange juice, orange zest, cumin, and mustard , stir and scrape up any brown bits from the side of the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Simmer until reduced by about half, another 1 to 2 minute, adjust seasonings. Return pork back to the pan,along with any liquid from the pork chops. Stir to coat cook for about another minute or two and add parsley. Remove immediately from the heat and serve with the pan sauce.

title: Greek Ravani / Revani recipe (Coconut cake with syrup)
description: Looking for a traditional Greek Ravani recipe? This locally sourced recipe with step by step instructions will help you make the most syrupy, fluffy, tasty ravani cake!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180C/350F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In most recipes for Greek coconut cake, the eggs are added whole in the mixture, but with this recipe the egg whites are beaten into meringues. This is the secret to a more fluffy ravani cake and to avoid the egg-y smell, which can ruin the flavour of your cake.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the Greek coconut cake, start by mixing the butter and sugar (at high speed), until fluffy. Add the egg yolks, one at a time, allowing each one to be absorbed, whilst mixing. Set the mixture aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the egg whites and a pinch of sugar in a clean mixing bowl. Make sure your egg whites, bowl and whisk attachment/s are free of any water. Use an electric mixer or electric hand beaters to whisk the egg whites until the mixture is very thick and glossy, and a long trailing peak forms when the whisk is lifted (meringues).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In another bowl, blend the flaked coconut, the flour and baking powder.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: With a spatula add the meringues and half of the flour mixture into the whisked butter and blend lightly, until the ingredients are combined. Add the rest of the flour mixture and the orange zest; blend lightly with circular movements.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To bake the ravani cake, use a round cake tin, approx 30cm in diameter. Use a cooking brush to butter the bottom and sides of the cake tin. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp of flour and shake the cake tin, so that the flour covers the butter; get rid of any excess flour. This technique will prevent the ravani from sticking on the pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bake the ravani in preheated oven at 180C/350F for 40-45 minutes, until golden and cooked through. After baking the cake, let it cool down for a while.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: After the ravani has cooled down, start preparing the syrup. Add in a saucepan the sugar, the water and lemon juice; boil for about 5-10 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved and the syrup has slightly thickened. Remove the pan from the stove and ladle slowly the syrup over the ravani cake, allowing each ladle of syrup to be absorbed, before ladling again. Allow time for the syrup to be absorbed and place in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Sprinkle with some crushed pistachios and serve this extra syrupy Greek coconut cake cold with a full spoon of vanilla ice cream. Enjoy!

title: Bacon Kimchi Fried Udon
description: Super quick and easy bacon kimchi fried udon that uses less than 10 ingredients to create a satisfying meal that’s loaded with flavor.

ingredients.name: blocks (8 oz. / 225 g each) frozen udon ((or 6 oz. / 170 g spaghetti or bucatini, cooked until al dente))
