steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the other ingredients while cooking the bacon. Spread the bacon in a large skillet without overlapping. Heat over medium heat until sizzling. Turn to medium-low heat. Cook, flipping occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 6 to 10 minutes. Once done, transfer the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels. When the bacon is cool enough to handle, slice it into 1” (2.5 cm) pieces and set aside. Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, fill a large bowl with warm tap water and add the frozen udon. Once the noodles are loosened and warmed, 2 to 3 minutes, drain well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the gochujang and soy sauce in a small bowl. Stir until well combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the pan to medium heat and add the peanut oil. Add the chopped kimchi and kale stems. Stir and cook for 1 minute. Add the kale leaves. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the kale is wilted.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the oil and the gochujang soy sauce mixture. Stir to mix everything well and evenly coated. Remove the pan from the heat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the noodles, kimchi juice and bacon. Cook over low heat and toss constantly, until the noodles are coated, 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Top the noodles with your preferred toppings and serve hot as a main dish.

title: Mushroom Barley Soup Recipe
description: Hearty mushrooms, chopped vegetables, and tender pearl barley make up this simple and satisfying mushroom barley soup. As comforting as your favorite deli's barley soup, but with even more flavor and a subtle smoky finish!

ingredients.name: baby bella mushrooms, (cleaned well and halved or sliced)
low-sodium broth, (vegetable broth or beef broth)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large Dutch Oven, heat extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add baby bell mushrooms and cook until mushrooms soften and gain some color (about 5 minutes or so). Remove from the pot and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the same pot, add a little more extra virgin olive oil. Add onions, garlic, celery, carrots, and chopped white mushrooms. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes over medium-high heat. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now, add crushed tomatoes and spices (coriander, smoked paprika, cumin). Cook for 3 minutes or so, tossing regularly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add broth and pearl barley. Bring to a rolling boil for 5 minutes, then turn heat down. Cover and let simmer over low heat for about 30 minutes or until the barley is tender and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cooked bella mushrooms back to the pot and stir to combine. Cook for about 5 minutes or so until mushrooms are well warmed through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finish with fresh parsley. Transfer to serving bowls and enjoy!

title: Avocado Hummus
description: Creamy and rich avocado hummus is the perfect snack or dip. Made with ripe avocados, chickpeas, tahini, spices, and a splash of lime juice.

ingredients.name: Optional toppings: Crushed red pepper flakes and chopped cilantro

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pulse the chickpeas, tahini, olive oil, salt, pepper, and cumin in a food processor until it’s completely smooth, about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the avocado, ice cubes, and lime juice and continue to blend until its completely smooth and creamy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve topped with an additional drizzle of olive oil, crushed red pepper flakes, and chopped cilantro. Serve with pita chips, tortilla chips, or veggies.

title: Loukoumades recipe (Greek Donuts with Honey and Walnuts)
description: The very best traditional Loukoumades recipe (Greek donuts)! Loukoumades are little fluffy sweet honey balls, deep fried to golden and crispy perfection.

ingredients.name: and 1/4 of a cup flour (450g /16 oz.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional loukoumades recipe, start by making the dough. In a bowl add the water, sugar and yeast. Stir with a whisk until the yeast dissolves completely and wait for 5 minutes. In a mixers bowl add the yeast mixture add the rest of the ingredients for the dough and whisk at high speed (for about 2 minutes) until the mixture becomes a smooth batter. (You could also use a hand whisk. Whisk until the mixture has no lumps).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover the bowl with some plastic wrap and let the dough rest in a warm place for at least 1 hour to rise.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Into a medium sized frying pan pour enough vegetable oil to deep fry the loukoumades. Heat the oil on a medium heat until hot. Test if the oil is hot enough by dipping in some of the dough for the loukoumades. If it sizzles the oil is ready. A more accurate way is to use a kitchen thermometer and measure the oil to be at 160C / 320F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Dip a tablespoon in some oil, shake it a bit to remove any excess. It is best to dip the spoon in oil and not water. Dip your hand in the dough and using your palm, squeeze out a small portion of dough between your thumb and index finger, like you are making a fist. Using the spoon, grab the dough ball off your hand and let it drop in the hot oil. Repeat this procedure until the surface off the pan is comfortably filled. You should dip the spoon in the oil & shake off every time, so that the batter doesn’t stick on it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the loukoumades are fried, use a slotted spoon to push them into the oil and turn them on all sides, until golden brown. Place the loukoumades on some kitchen paper to drain. Repeat with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When done, place the loukoumades on kitchen paper to remove the excess oil. Then serve on a large platter, drizzle with the honey and sprinkle with cinnamon and chopped walnuts.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If you are in a mood for some chocolate, replace the honey with chocolate sauce. To prepare the chocolate sauce for the loukoumades, add in a saucepan the sugar and water and bring to a simmer. Simmer for 1-2 minutes, stirring continuously, until the sugar has dissolved. Add the chocolate (chopped) and whisk, until the chocolote has melted and the mixture is smooth.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour the warm chocolate over the loukoumades, sprinkle with some roughly chopped walnuts or almonds and enjoy!

title: Chicken Enchilada Roll Ups
description: Make your life a little tastier with these cheesy Chicken Enchilada Roll Ups covered in an authentic red enchilada sauce. Plus, they're low carb and gluten free!

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breasts ((about 4 or 5 large breasts))
shredded queso Chihuahua ((or Monterey Jack cheese))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large resealable freezer bag, mix together olive oil, lime juice, salt, cumin, garlic and chili powder. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the chicken breasts, slice them longways to get 2 thinner slices and firmly pound the chicken using the smooth side of a meat tenderizer. I was able to get a total of 7 chicken cutlets.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the chicken cutlets into the resealable freezer bag and shake to completely coat them in the marinade. Allow chicken to marinate for one hour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While chicken is marinating, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add in onions, kale and a pinch of salt and pepper. Saute for 10 minutes until onions are translucent and beginning to caramelize.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once chicken has marinated, preheat oven to 375 degrees.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Evenly place a scoop of the onion and kale mixture and a pinch of shredded cheese in the middle of the chicken cutlet. Roll up both sides and secure with a toothpick. Place roll ups into a 2-quart baking dish or larger. Repeat this step until all the cutlets have been rolled up.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the Authentic Red Enchilada Sauce on top of the chicken roll ups and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from oven and top with cotija cheese and cilantro. Enjoy!

title: Corn Chowder
description: Corn Chowder - hearty, creamy and comforting dish made with summer's popular fresh produce corn. Added with potatoes, carrots and bacon bits and you'll have one fantastic meal that knows no season!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice corn kernels off the cob and set aside. Take each ear of corn and hold it over a bowl. Use either the back of your knife or a spoon and scrape any remaining pulp and juice from the cobs.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook bacon pieces in large heavy bottomed over medium high heat for about 5-8 minutes, or until bacon is crisp. Transfer bacon to a paper towel lined plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a spoon to take out some of the bacon grease from the pot reserving about 1 tablespoon in the pot. Add butter and melt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add diced onions, garlic, celery and thyme and sauté for about 3-4 minutes, until soft, translucent and fragrant. Add in creole seasoning and flour, stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While whisking, pour in water and increase heat to medium high. Add in corn, potatoes, and bay leaf. Stir and bring to a low boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often until potatoes are fork tender. Throw in the carrots half way through this cooking time.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer 2 cups of the soup to a blender and blend until smooth. Stir the blended soup back into the pot.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add in heavy cream, and about half the chives. Stir in and heat through for about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Sprinkle with remaining chives and cooked bacon pieces before serving.

title: Golden Fried Rice (黄金炒饭, Huang Jin Chao Fan)
description: If you love fried rice, you’ll go crazy for this classic Chinese golden fried rice featuring crispy rice coated in egg yolk, tender shrimp and asparagus.

ingredients.name: Pete and Gerry’s Organic Egg yolks ((*Footnote 1))
oz. (225 g) shrimp (, peeled and deveined, cut into 1/2” (1 cm) pieces (about 12 shrimp))
asparagus (, sliced (or frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the rice to a medium-sized bowl and fluff with your hands to separate the grains. Add the egg yolks. Mix until all the grains of rice are evenly coated with egg yolk.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat until hot. Add the shrimp. Stir and cook until the shrimp turn white, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the shrimp to a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil to the skillet and swirl to coat well. Add the rice and sprinkle evenly with salt. Stir and cook until the egg yolks are cooked, 5 to 6 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the garlic and asparagus. Cook and stir until the asparagus is cooked through, 2 minutes or so. Add the green onions and stir everything together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add back the cooked shrimp and stir everything together. Carefully taste the rice. Add more salt to adjust seasoning if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer everything to a big bowl or plate. Serve hot as a side.

title: Hawthorn Jam Recipe
description: Healthy Homemade Hawthorn Jam

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash and rinse your storage containers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the fresh hawthorn berry and then soak in slightly salted water for around 20 minutes. Then wash again and remove the core.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer hawthorn into a food processor, add water. Blend until almost smooth but there are some small particles or smooth according to your own taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the mixture to a sauce pan; add sugar and simmer for around 80 to 100 minutes. Add fresh lemon juice in the middle. Stir from time to time.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the jam into the prepared containers. Leave 1/3 of space at the top of each container to allow room for the jam to expand in the freezer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Seal the containers and let the jam sit at room temperature for 24 hours. Then store the jam the refrigerator for up to 1 week or in the freezer for up to 1 month.

title: Janchi Guksu (Korean Warm Noodle Soup)
description: Janchi guksu is a simple warm noodle dish made with thin wheat flour noodles (somyeon) that are usually in a clear anchovy or beef broth! It's an easy comfort food that's very popular in Korea.

ingredients.name: anchovy broth (or beef, chicken or vegetable broth)
or 2 tablespoons soy sauce (or soup soy sauce) (Do not make the broth too dark. )
salt to taste (Season lightly if using the optional sauce. )
tender beef, cut into thin strips, seasoned with 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil, 1/2 teaspoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic, and pinch black pepper
kimchi, thinly sliced, mixed with 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil, and 1/4 teaspoon sugar
sheet gim (roasted dried seaweed sheet), cut into short strips or crushed
Mix all sauce ingredients well and set aside.

title: Mee Krob - Sweet & Sour Crispy Noodle Treats
description: Crispy rice noodles coated in a sweet, sour, umami sauce. It's a popular Thai snack that keeps really well. Gluten-free.

ingredients.name: shallots (thinly sliced and cut in short pieces)
A handful of fried dried chilies for garnish
A handful of fried makrut lime leaves for garnish (see note 3)

title: Spicy Avocado Toast with Egg
description: This easy, quick and healthy Spicy Avocado Toast with Egg only takes 10 minutes to make and will keep you full and satisfied all morning long.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mash the avocado using a fork until it reaches the consistency you like. (I prefer my avocado slightly chunky - mostly mashed but with small avocado chunks here and there.) Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small nonstick skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Gently crack in the eggs and cook to your liking. (I prefer mine fried on both sides with the yolk still runny in the middle.) Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To assemble, spread half of the avocado mash onto a slice of toast and season with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Top with a fried egg, 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes and 1 tablespoon of cotija cheese.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Repeat steps to assemble the other slice of toast and enjoy!

title: Roasted Beet Salad with Crispy Kale and Almonds
description: Mediterranean-Style roasted beet salad with crispy kale and slivered almonds. A simple lemon-honey vinaigrette with a hint of piney rosemary brings it all together. The perfect salad or side dish to complete a beautiful meal. Vegan.

ingredients.name: kale, (well cleaned and ribs removed (about 8 ounces kale leaves))
lb/ 1133 g beets, (6 to 7 beets washed, dried and peeled)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Toss kale with salt, pepper and a little extra virgin olive oil. Spread on a baking sheet. Roast in heated-oven for 7 minutes. Check, and if kale is not crispy enough, leave it in oven a little longer (I went up to 10 minutes). Remove from oven and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut peeled beets into wedges. Place beets on a baking sheet and season with salt. Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and toss to coat. Make sure beets are spread in one layer on the baking sheet and roast in heated oven for about 45 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While beets are roasting, make the lemon-honey vinaigrette. Simply mix vinaigrette ingredients in a small bowl and whisk to combine (if the honey is too thick, you can warm it up very briefly in the microwave for just a few seconds to help it run better.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Toast silvered almonds in a dry non-stick skillet, tossing frequently, until almonds turn a golden color (do not brown too much.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When beets are ready and you are able to stick a knife in without resistance, remove from heat and transfer to a mixing bowl. Add shallots.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the lemon-honey vinaigrette on top, and give the beets and shallots a nice toss. Add crispy kale and very gently toss.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer beet salad to a serving platter. Add toasted silvered almonds. Enjoy warm or at room temperature.

title: Traditional Greek Orange Cake with Syrup (Portokalopita)
description: Looking for a traditional Greek Orange cake recipe? Discover the secrets behind making this extra syrupy Portokalopita infused with the aromas of oranges and cinnamon.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil (1 and 1/4 of a cup)
orange juice ( 1 and 1/4 of a cup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Unwrap the phyllo dough from the plastic sleeve; place the sheets on a large surface and leave at room temperature for 20 minutes, in order to dry well. Alternatively, spread a few on a large baking tray and bake at 100C/200F, until dry; repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare this Greek orange cake, start first by preparing the syrup. Pour into a pot the water, the sugar, the orange zest and a cinammon stick and bring to the boil. Simmer for 5-10 minutes, until the sugar is dissolved and the syrup has thickened. Set aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the mixture for the orange cake. Pour the vegetable oil into a large bowl, add the sugar and the eggs and whisk. Add the yogurt, the orange juice, the orange zest and the vanilla extract and whisk well, until the ingredients combine and the mixture is smooth. Add the baking powder, and whisk lightly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: using your hands. Add them gradually into the mixture while whisking so they don’t stick to each other.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a cooking brush, oil the bottom and the sides of a baking tray (approx.20x30cm / 8×12 inch) and pour in the mixture. Bake in preheated oven at 180C/350F for 40-50 minutes until, nicely coloured and cooked through. Check if it is ready, by poking a hole with a knife. If the knife comes out clean, then the cake is ready.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To finish the orange cake, ladle slowly the cold syrup over the hot cake. Allow each ladle of syrup to be absorbed, before ladling again.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Allow time for the syrup to be absorbed and put in the refrigerator. Greek orange cake is ideally served cold, not hot, so that it does not crumble. Enjoy with a big spoonful of ice cream!

title: Fiesta Chicken Casserole
description: This Fiesta Chicken Casserole is an excellent casserole dish brimming with Southwestern flavors, corn, beans, cheese, pasta, and leftover chicken.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Then grease a baking dish or casserole. You can equally use a cooking spray. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Start by boiling pasta in a large pot according to package instructions. Drain and place in a large bowl together with sweet corn, black beans, green chiles, shredded chicken, salsa, green onions, and ½ of the cheese.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, add onions, butter, and garlic, and microwave for about a minute. Then transfer into a medium bowl together with sour cream, chili powder, smoked paprika, and cumin. Thoroughly mix.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the spice mixture to the bowl of pasta and fully combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spread the chicken pasta mixture into the prepared pan and top with the remaining cheese. Bake for 30 minutes, or until casserole is bubbly and heated through. Serve with tortilla chips, if desired.

title: Veg Kurma Recipe (Hotel Style Vegetable Korma)
description: Veg Kurma (or Vegetable Korma) is made by cooking mixed vegetables in a creamy gravy of yogurt, cashews, coconut and spices. This South Indian hotel-style recipe is mildly spiced and full of flavor.

ingredients.name: desiccated coconut ((unsweetened) or fresh/frozen grated coconut)
roasted chana dal ((roasted split & husked bengal gram))
tiny piece of stone flower ((pathar phool), optional)
green chilies (- chopped or 2 green chillies)
to 1.5 teaspoons garlic (- finely chopped or 4 to 5 small to medium-sized garlic)
ginger (- finely chopped or 1 inch ginger)
water (- for blending or add as required)
potatoes (- chopped or 1 medium potato - diced)
oil (- any neutral oil or coconut oil)
onions (- finely chopped or 1 medium sized onion)
tomatoes (- finely chopped or 1 medium tomato)
to 8 curry leaves ((medium to large) or 12 to 15 small sized)
water (- for slightly thin gravy, add 1.5 cups water)

title: Winter Melon Stir Fry
description: This quick and easy winter melon stir fry uses Chinese dried shrimp to add a super umami flavor. It’s a perfect side dish to add texture, flavor, and nutrition to your dinner table. {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: carrot (, cut into 2x1/2” (6x1 cm) batons (about 4 oz) (Optional) (*Footnote 1))
(680 g) winter melon (, peeled and cut into 2x1/2” (6x1 cm) batons)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the cornstarch and water in a small bowl. Stir to mix well and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a large skillet and add about 3” (8 cm) of water. Bring to a boil and add a pinch of salt. Add the carrots and boil for 1 minute. Add the winter melon and boil for another 1 to 2 minutes, until slightly softened but not yet translucent. Drain the cooked vegetables and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking. Drain again and set aside in a big plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Return the pan to the stove and wipe clean with a paper towel. Add the oil and heat over medium heat until hot. Add the papery shrimp. Stir and cook until the shrimp turn golden, 1 minute or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the garlic and stir a few times to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the pepper. Cook and stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the blanched carrot and winter melon, mushroom powder, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Stir and cook until the seasonings are evenly distributed and the winter melon turns tender but is not falling apart, 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir the slurry ingredients again to fully dissolve the cornstarch and pour it over the vegetables. Stir gently until the sauce thickens slightly, 1 minute or so. Carefully taste the winter melon and add more salt, if needed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot as a side dish.

title: Ganjang Gejang (Raw Crabs Marinated in Soy Sauce)
description: Ganjang gejang is a traditional dish that’s made by marinating fresh raw crabs in a mild soy-sauce based brine.

ingredients.name: medium fresh blue crabs or kkotge (about 2 pounds)
small apple (roughly sliced (or 1/2 small Korean/Asian pear, if in season))
to 3 small dried whole red chili peppers
- 3 green and/or red chili peppers (thinly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put the live crabs in the freezer for an hour or two (longer is fine as well), unless you are comfortable with handling live crabs.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, bring all the marinade ingredients to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low, and continue to boil, covered, for about 20 minutes. Remove the kelp after about 10 minutes of boiling. Strain the brine. Discard the fruit and vegetables. Cool completely, and then refrigerate until ready to use.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Clean each crab thoroughly with a kitchen brush. Drain well in a colander in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the crabs in an airtight container or jar. Add the chili pepper, onion and lemon slices. Pour the brine over the crabs. Make sure all the crabs are submerged. Weigh them down, if necessary, with a small bowl or plate that fits inside the container. Refrigerate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: After one day, strain the brine into a pot (and put the crabs back in the fridge). Bring the brine to a boil over medium heat, and boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Wait for the brine to completely cool, and then pour it back over the crabs. You can skip this process, but it enhances the flavor of the brine and helps the crabs to last longer.

title: Chinese Pumpkin Cake
description: Chinese Pumpkin Cake

ingredients.name: glutinous rice flour ( , or as needed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove all the skins of the pumpkin and then cut into cubes. Place the cubes into a steamer, cover with plastic wrap (so that there will be no extra water) and steam for around 25 to 30 minutes until completely soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Smash the steamed pumpkin with a fork and squeeze the extra water out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir the sugar in when the pumpkin puree is still hot. Set aside to cool down.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add glutinous rice flour in.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Knead the dough for several minutes until smooth. Then divide the dough into a long log. Cut around 12 equal portions out. Take one portion and wrap filling-red bean paste. Assemble as a ball firstly and slightly press with hand to make a flat cake.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To deep-fry: Heat up oil in wok or pot until really hot, brush some water on the surface and then coat the cake with bread crumbs. Lower your fire and slide the cake in the hot oil and fry until both sides becomes crispy and golden brown. Be careful during this process. Use kitchen pepper to remove extra oil. If some of the coating drops out in deep-frying process, remove them before the next batch. For a crispier taste and less oil absorbed, re-fry the cakes for around 20 seconds over medium fire.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To pan-fry: brush some oil on a pan and then fry the cake over low fire until golden brown in both sides.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Set aside to cool down a little bite. Serve warm.

title: Easy Chicken Caprese
description: 20-minute Chicken Caprese recipe with basil pesto, fresh mozzarella and ripe tomatoes. Make it indoors in your skillet or griddle, or fire up the grill, if you like!

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese, low sodium, ((about 1/4 to 1/2 inch in thickness each))
Balsamic glaze or balsamic reduction, (I used this one)
Fresh basil leaves, (leave 4 whole and slice the rest into ribbons)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If the chicken breasts are large and thick, cut them horizontally through the middle to make thinner cutlets or pieces. If you like, use a kitchen mallet to tenderize and flatten the chicken breasts before cooking. This helps them quick quickly and evenly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the chicken dry and season with salt and pepper on both sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat an indoor griddle or pan over high heat. Drizzle about 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil to coat bottom of pan. (See notes if you prefer to use an outdoor grill).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the chicken and cook for 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until done (chicken's internal temperature should register 165 degrees F).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the last couple minutes or so of cooking, top each piece of chicken with a bit of the basil pesto then add a mozzarella slice on top.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from heat. Add fresh basil leaves and tomato slices on top of each chicken piece and finish with a little balsamic reduction (or balsamic glaze). Finally, sprinkle fresh basil ribbons and serve!

title: Samali recipe (Extra syrupy Greek Semolina cake with Mastic)
description: A delicious Greek semolina cake recipe (samali) infused with the aromas and blends of mastic and garnished with a lemon and rosewater scented syrup!

ingredients.name: and 1/2 cups coarse semolina (or 1 1/2 coarse and 1 thin)
ground mastic resin (buy online in Australia, UK, US/CA)
rose water (or vanilla extract or mastic or 1 cinnamon stick)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek semolina cake recipe (samali), use pestle or a blender to ground the masticha, along with a pinch of sugar and set aside. (Mastic will give Greek semolina cake its distinctive taste and amazing smell. But be careful not to add any more mastic than this samali recipe calls for, as it will leave a slightly bitter taste to your Greek semolina cake).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the yogurt in a bowl and add the baking soda. Blend to combine and set aside. In another bowl add the semolina, sugar, ground mastic and baking powder and blend with a spoon to combine. Add the yogurt mixture in the semolina mixture and whisk until the mixture is smooth and all the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For this Greek semolina cake recipe (samali) you will need a large baking pan, approx. 38*28cm. Butter the bottom and sides of the pan and pour in the mixture. The mixture for this Greek semolina cake is a little bit tight (not liquid) so even out the surface of the samali using a wet spatula.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the samali (Greek semolina cake) with a towel and let it rest for 3 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a knife score the Greek semolina cake into little individual pieces and garnish with blanched almonds. Bake the samali in preheated oven at 180C for 35-40 minutes, until nicely coloured and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the syrup for the Greek semolina cake. In a small pot add all the ingredients for the syrup and bring to the boil. Let the syrup boil for 2-3 minutes, until the sugar was dissolved and the syrup has slightly thickened. Set aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn the cake out of the oven and using a cooking brush, brush the top with the melted butter. Ladle slowly the cold syrup over the hot samali cake, allowing each ladle of syrup to be absorbed, before ladling again. Allow time for the syrup to be absorbed. Let the samali cake cool down completely before serving.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve this extra syrupy Greek semolina cake with a full spoon of kaimaki or vanilla ice cream. Enjoy!

title: Low Carb Enchilada Cabbage Rolls
description: These Low Carb Enchilada Cabbage Rolls are made with cabbage leaves instead of tortillas and stuffed with chicken, cheese and green chiles for a healthy weeknight meal!

ingredients.name: finely diced white onion, (about 1/4 large white onion)
optional toppings: chopped cilantro, diced tomatoes, avocados

title: Stuffed Zucchini
description: Stuffed Zucchini - delicious low-carb and easy to prepare zucchini boats stuffed with seasoned ground chicken, topped with cheese, and baked until tender. A wonderful guilt-free meal to kick start the year!

ingredients.name: small green, yellow, or red pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim stems from zucchini, cut in lengthwise halves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Scoop out the flesh of the zucchini with a teaspoon, leaving some at the bottom. Reserve flesh and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add water to a medium-sized sauce pan, lightly salt, and bring to a boil. Gently place zucchinis in the pot of boiling water and boil for about 2-3 minutes. Using a tong, remove from water and pat dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up a medium saucepan with about 2 tablespoons of oil. Add onions and garlic, cook until onions are wilted.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Then add the ground meat, brown for a couple of minutes until the meat is no longer pink.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Next – add the tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper. Continue cooking for about 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Throw in the bell pepper and parsley – cook for about 2 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Finally, add about 1/2 cup of zucchini flesh, if desired. It works well with or without seeds. Adjust seasonings to taste. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Greased the baking dish with cooking spray. Then start filling the zucchini with meat mixture, sprinkle with cheese, if desired, place in the oven, and bake uncovered at 350 degrees F for about 15 -20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Puri Bhaji | Batata Bhaji
description: Puri Bhaji is made by pairing a lightly spiced potato dish called Batata Bhaji with crisp, deep-fried puri. The bhaji is semi-dry and flavored with ginger, green chilies, coriander leaves and basic Indian spices.

ingredients.name: urad dal ((husked and split black gram))
finely chopped ginger (or 1 inch peeled ginger)
or 3 tablespoons peanut oil (or sunflower oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boiling Potatoes

steps.title: Step 2

title: XO Noodles with Shrimp
description: A quick and delicious fried noodle dish with big seafood flavors, you’ll have it ready faster than takeout could possibly arrive!

ingredients.name: (225 g) fresh Hong Kong Pan Fry noodles ((or thin egg noodles))
yu choy (or baby bok choy) (, greens and stems separated and sliced on the bias)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the shrimp and the marinade ingredients in a medium-sized bowl. Stir to mix well. Set aside for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large nonstick skillet bring an inch of water to a boil over medium-high heat. Add the noodles and cook for 30 seconds (or according to the packaging). Drain and rinse the noodles with cold water to stop cooking. Add a drizzle of oil, toss, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil and heat over medium-high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the garlic. Cook until the garlic is fragrant, 30 seconds or so.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the shrimp and brown both sides, about 1 minute per side, or until the shrimp curl up. Transfer the shrimp to a large plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the yu choy stems and carrots. Let everything cook without stirring for 30 seconds, then stir and cook for another minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the noodles and yu choy greens to the pan along with another tablespoon of oil. Toss the noodles with a pair of tongs to incorporate all the ingredients, 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour in the sauce and add back the cooked shrimp. Stir and toss to coat everything evenly. The veggies should be tender but still a bit crunchy. Carefully taste the noodles and cook for another minute if needed. You can adjust the seasoning by adding a bit more XO sauce.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer everything to serving plates. Serve hot as a main dish or a side dish.

title: Yangnyeom Gejang (Spicy Raw Crabs)
description: Raw crabs marinated in a slightly sweet, salty, spicy Korean sauce

ingredients.name: medium or 4 small blue crabs (or kkotge, 꽃게)
soup soy sauce (guk ganjang, 국간장 - or use 1/2 teaspoon salt)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put the live crabs in the freezer for an hour or two (longer is fine as well).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine all the seasoning ingredients and mix well. The seasoning can be prepared a day or two in advance. It will further develop flavor as it sits.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Plunge the frozen crabs in cold water to thaw. Separate the top shell and remove the gills. Clean the shell part of the crab thoroughly, with a kitchen brush or a toothbrush, under running water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Break (or cut) the body in half (or quarters). You can cut off the sharp end of each small leg with a pair of kitchen scissors if preferred. Drain well in a colander in the fridge. It’s important to minimize the time that the crabs are out at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine the crabs and seasoning, and toss to coat well. Spoon some sauce into the top shells. Marinate for a few hours at least or up to a couple of days in the fridge. These spicy crabs are best eaten within a couple of days.

title: Claypot Glass Noodles (Vegan) - Pak Ob Woonsen
description: Glass noodles cooked in a clay pot with ginger and an umami-loaded sauce, topped with mushrooms and veggies of your choice. Quick, easy, vegan, and delicious!

ingredients.name: pc medium sized dried shiitake mushrooms (10 g) (rehydrated (see note))
vegetarian oyster sauce (or use regular oyster sauce)
- ½ tsp black or dark soy sauce
mixed mushrooms or vegetables of your choice (see note)
green onion (chopped, or a handful Chinese celery leaves)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the glass noodles in room temp water for 7-10 mins until soft and pliable.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the dried shiitake mushroom from the soaking water and squeeze out the excess water, reserving the water for the sauce. Slice off the mushroom stems and thinly slice the caps.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pound peppercorns in a mortar and pestle until fine, then add the garlic and cilantro stems and pound into a very rough paste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the sauce by combining the soy sauce, oyster sauce, black soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, and ½ cup (120 ml) of the mushroom soaking water (keep the rest of the water). Stir until the sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain the noodles and cut with scissors into roughly 3-inch sections, then add to the sauce and toss to mix (it won’t really cling to the noodles as the sauce is quite watery, but that’s okay).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Put a clay pot or a heavy-bottomed pot on medium heat and add the oil, the garlic paste, ginger, and sliced shiitake mushrooms. Saute for 2-3 minutes until aromatic and the smallest bits of garlic starts to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the noodles and the sauce and toss to mix with the herbs, scraping the bottom of the pot to make sure nothing is stuck. Close the lid and turn the heat down to low. Once you can hear bubbling resume, start the timer for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: After 3 minutes, open the pot and give the noodles a thorough tossing to distribute the sauce, then if you want the colour to be darker you can add a bit more black/dark soy sauce. Close the lid and cook for another 2 mins. *Be sure to keep the heat low to prevent the noodles from scorching.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Open the lid again and taste to check the doneness of the noodles, if you want the noodles to be softer, add a splash of the remaining mushroom soaking water (2-3 tablespoons at a time), then toss and keep it cooking for 1-2 minutes more. Glass noodles are surprisingly resilient to overcooking, so don’t be afraid to add more water if needed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the noodles are done, take it off the heat and close the lid to keep warm while you cook your toppings.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: In a large skillet over medium high heat, add just enough oil to thinly coat the bottom. Once hot, add the tofu slices and sear until browned on both sides. Remove the tofu, then add the mushrooms with a small pinch of salt and sear briefly until browned and cooked through. Repeat with any other toppings that need to be cooked.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: To serve: reheat the noodles briefly if needed, then top with the tofu, mushrooms and vegetables. Sprinkle green onions on top and serve it right in the pot! Serve by itself or with jasmine rice. *The ginger slices are not meant to be eaten so you can remove them before serving if you wish, or just tell your guests.

title: Mediterranean Pan Seared Trout Recipe with Tzatziki
description: One of the easiest and best trout recipes I've tried! Trout fillets, seasoned with a couple of warm spices, and quickly seared in extra virgin olive oil. Serve it with a dollop of Greek tzatziki and a big salad for an easy dinner.

ingredients.name: all-natural garlic powder (or 1 to 2 tsp garlic paste)
trout fillet (or butterflied trout fillet as in the pictures)
All-purpose flour for coating (no more than 1/2 cup)
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the coriander, paprika, and garlic powder in a small mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the trout fillet dry. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper on both sides, then season with the spices on both sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coat the seasoned fish with the flour, shake off any excess flour (you only want a very thin layer).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet, heat about 3 to 4 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking (see note). Sear the trout fillets for 3 minutes on each side (start with skin-side down, and use a spatula to very carefully flip the fish fillets over).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the fish from the pan and place it on a tray lined with paper towel to absorb any excess oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer to serving platter and finish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice.

title: Sichuan Hot Pot Soup Base (川式清油火锅底料)
description: Restaurant-style Sichuan hot pot soup base has a super rich aroma and tastes like the ones you’d get in China.

ingredients.name: fermented black beans ((or black bean paste/sauce))
mushroom bouillon powder ((or chicken bouillon powder))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the spices in a blender or food processor. Mix until the spices turn into small flakes but not powdered.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oil in a medium-sized pot or 9” deep pan over low heat until medium hot (if you add a small piece of garlic it should sizzle gently and not bubble furiously). Add the garlic, ginger, and green onion. Cook and stir until fragrant but not browned, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Carefully add the doubanjiang and fermented black beans to the oil. Cook and stir for another minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the blended spices. Cook, stirring frequently, for about 10 minutes. The oil should reach a vibrant orange-red color when it’s ready.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the sugar, Shaoxing wine, and mushroom powder. Stir until dissolved.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat and let cool for 10 to 20 minutes (or longer if you have a non-heat proof blender).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the cooled hot pot base mixture to the blender. Make sure the lid’s air vent is open. Start from a low speed, gradually raising to medium-high speed, blending until the oil is emulsified, about 1 minute. The mixture will look cloudy once blended.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Carefully pour the hot pot soup base into a large heat proof tupperware. Top the whole dried chilis and crushed peppercorns evenly over the base for garnish. Cover the container and freeze overnight.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once frozen, you can divide the base into individual portions by slicing it into 4 pieces. Then you can store each piece in a ziplock bag in the freezer for up to 6 months. Each block is good for a small hot pot, or one side of a hot pot with a divider.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: How to use the Sichuan hot pot soup base

title: Chinese Mongolian Beef - Scallion Fried Beef
description: Imported from chinasichuanfood.com.

ingredients.name: green onions ( , sliced into sections around 3cm long)
dried chili pepper ( , optional, cut into slices and seeds removed)
inch root ginger ( , peeled and cut into shreds)
middle size egg ( , only egg white needed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into thin slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add salt, black pepper powder, starch and light soy sauce in the beef within a small blow and mix evenly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Just before cooking process, add egg white to marinated beef and stir in one direction until you get a paste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up cooking oil in wok and stir fry beef slices around 1 to 2 minutes or until the beef begins to change color.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Move the beef slices out and leave the oil in wok. Add ginger slices, 2/3 of scallion sections and chili pepper shred to cook until aroma.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return the beef slices in wok, do a quick fry and stir in stir fry sauce. Turn off the fire and add green onion sections and the left scallion. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowl and serve hot.

title: Chinese Potato Pancake
description: Easy Chinese style potato pancake-crispy and savory. Need only 15 minutes from preparation to breakfast table.

ingredients.name: starch ( , I use sweet potato starch)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the potatoes and cut into thin shreds. You may use a shredding tool. Try to make them similar in size so the cooking time can be similar too.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add salt, ground black pepper powder, five spice powder and starch. Mix well and set aside for around 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Brush some oil in a pan, fry one side of the pancake over medium fire for around 1 to 2 minutes until shaped and slightly brown. Turn it over and continue frying the second side. Then slow down your fire and turn over the pancake several times to fry the two sides until crispy and brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve directly or with the dips you want.It can be matched with sweet chili sauce or tomato sauce.

title: Yeoneojang (Soy Marinated Raw Salmon)
description: Yeoneojang is a raw salmon dish that’s marinated in a soy sauce based marinade. Simple and delicious!

ingredients.name: or 2 green and/or red chili peppers
Thin slices of onion and lemon

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring all the marinade ingredients to a boil over medium high heat and briefly boil for a minute or two. Cool completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Thinly slice the onion, chili pepper(s), and lemon.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the salmon fillet into small pieces (about 1/4-inch thick and 2 to 3 inch long).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the salmon in an airtight container. Add the chili pepper, onion and lemon slices. Keep it in the fridge while waiting for the marinade to cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the marinade over the salmon (see note 2). Refrigerate. The salmon is ready to eat after 4 to 5 hours, but it will be better the next day and best to consume it within 2 days.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: How to serve: You can simply serve it as a side or main dish with a bowl of rice. Or, serve it on top of rice as a rice bowl (deopbap). Garnish it with optional thin slices of fresh onion and/or microgreens or baby sprouts. Spoon some marinade over the salmon and rice. Serve wasabi on the side if you like.

title: Homemade Pad Thai Sauce
description: Homemade pad thai sauce is miles better than anything you can buy, and with none of the additives. Using only a few simple ingredients, you'll have this ready to go for a quick weeknight pad thai!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium sized pot, heat the oil over medium high heat. Add the garlic and shallots, and saute until soft and translucent - about 5-8 minutes. Remove from the pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Return the pot to the stove over medium heat, then add the palm sugar and let it cook until it melts; pressing on any hard chunks to help them dissolve more quickly. After it melts, let it cook a little further until it caramelizes into a slightly darker brown for a richer flavour, being careful not to let it get too dark.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn off the heat then add the tamarind paste; it will bubble aggressively and the sugar will harden initially. Turn the heat back on to low to help the sugar dissolve and add the fish sauce. Turn off the heat after the sugar is mostly dissolved; don't worry about a few chunks left over, they will dissolve eventually.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir the garlic and shallots back in and let cool. You can also add the chili flakes at this stage if you wish to make it spicy.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Measure the volume of the sauce by pouring it into a liquid measuring cup. Divide the volume by 8 to get the amount of sauce you need per serving (if using my pad thai recipe). Write this number down and tape it to the container of the sauce, also note on the label that you need to add 1 ½ Tbsp of water per serving when you cook.

title: Easy Chocolate Baklava recipe
description: Are you a big fan of Baklava but can't have a dessert without chocolate? Then you'll love this mouthwatering Chocolate baklava recipe!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious chocolate baklava start by preparing the filling. Blitz the nuts in a food processor until fine. Chop the dark chocolate into very small pieces by hand, and stir in the spices and a generous pinch of salt. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a small saucepan set over a medium heat, melt the butter.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Brush a 20cm square (8×8 inch) baking dish with butter. Gradually layer 1/3 of the filo sheets in the bottom of the dish, generously sprinkling melted butter between each layer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Spread 1/2 of the baklava mixture across the pastry, then continue layering another 1/3 of the filo sheets sprinkled with butter. Repeat until you have used all the filling and the filo, brushing the top layer with the remaining butter so it turns crisp and golden in the oven.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a very sharp knife, cut the chocolate baklava into 4 equal, parallel pieces. Then, cut a bisecting line from the top corner of the pan to the opposite corner at the bottom. Using this line as a guide, cut more parallel, diagonal lines from the top of the cuts in the original dividing lines down to their opposite number at the bottom. You should be left with an elongated diamond pattern.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pre-heat the oven to 150C (300F). Bake the baklava for 1 1/2 hours until the pastry is crisp and golden.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Meanwhile, to make the syrup, combine the sugar, water, orange zest and the cinnamon stick and bring to the boil over a high heat, stirring constantly until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat to cool and for the cinnamon stick to infuse; once it has reached room temperature, stir in the lemon juice, honey and hazelnut liquor, if using.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Gradually pour the cold syrup over the hot baklava, making sure to pay attention to the cuts and to allow it to properly soak in. Don’t worry if things look a little flooded, everything will come right as the dish cools to room temperature, when it will be ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Let the chocolate baklava cool down completely and serve after the syrup has soaked through. Enjoy!

title: Easy Fish Piccata
description: Lemony, briny and just a bit buttery, this easy fish piccata recipe with pan-seared trout and a lemon piccata sauce comes together in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: trout fillet, (or other thin white fish fillet such as sole, halibut, or grouper )
flour for dredging, ((use whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, or gluten free flour of your choice))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season the fish on both sides with salt and pepper. Mix the oregano, paprika, and garlic powder and season the flesh side of the fish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To dredge, coat the fish on both sides with the flour. Gently shake excess flour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet, heat the olive oil and 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium-high heat. Carefully add the fish and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side (a total of 4 to 6 minutes), or until the fish is firm and flaky (being careful not to overcook the fish). Transfer the fish to a tray lined with paper towel to drain excess oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To the same pan, add 1 more tablespoon of unsalted butter. Lower the heat, and add the lemon juice, white wine, and capers. Cook briefly over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return the fish to the pan and spoon the sauce over the fish (give it just a few seconds to warm through in the sauce).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Garnish with parsley and red pepper flakes, if using. Serve immediately!

title: Greek Style Beef Stew in a Tomato Sauce (Moshari Kokkinisto)
description: Tender and juicy Moshari kokkinisto with the aromas and blends of cinnamon, clove and fresh tomatoes! A delicious and easy recipe for Greek beef stew, perfect for a Sunday family dinner!

ingredients.name: tomato paste, dissolved into a teacup of water
1-2 whole cloves, or a pinch grounded
bucatini spaghetti or plain spaghetti if you can’t find it (14 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the reddened Greek beef stew, start by cutting the beef into pieces, approx. 100g/ 3.5 ounces each one. Wash thoroughly the beef and wipe with some paper towel. It is important to dry the meat well, in order to be nicely browned.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large, deep pot to high heat. After the pan is heated, pour in the oil along with the beef. Brown the pieces of beef on one side, without stirring and then brown them on the other side. Try not to overcrowd the bottom of the pan. Browning the beef is very important, when cooking a Greek beef stew, as it helps the meat remain juicy and tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a slotted spoon to remove the pieces of meat from the pot and place them on a plate.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To prepare the sauce for the Greek beef stew, add into the pot the chopped onions and turn the heat down. Sauté for 3 minutes, until softened. Stir in the garlic and saute for 1 more minute. Pour in the red wine, turn the heat up and cook for 2 minutes, until it evaporates. Add the chopped tomatoes, the tomato paste (dissolved in a teacup of warm water), the cinnamon stick, the cloves, a pinch of sugar and salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: As soon as the sauce comes to the boil, add the beef and enough hot water to cover the 2/3 of the meat. When the sauce starts to bubble a lot, turn the heat down and half-cover with the lid (the sauce still has to bubble a little bit). Cook to medium-low heat, for about 1 1/2 hour, until the meat is tender and the sauce thickens, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If the meat is tender and cooked, but the sauce is not thick enough, remove the pieces of meat with a slotted spoon and boil the sauce alone to high heat, until it thickens. On the other hand, if the sauce becomes thick, before the meat is done, then add some warm water.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When done, boil the spaghetti into another pot, according to package instructions; drain and place in the pot, along with the sauce and the meat. Stir with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve the Greek beef stew with a drizzle of olive oil, sprinkle some grated cheese and enjoy over a glass of red wine.

title: Vegetarian Duck (素鸭) Vegan Holiday Loaf
description: A classic Chinese Buddhist dish upgraded to the holiday version. This vegetarian roast duck is a perfect holiday loaf for both vegetarian and vegan feasts.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Gently rinse the dried shiitake mushrooms with tap water to remove any dust. Add the mushrooms into a medium-sized bowl and add 1/2 cup boiling water to cover. Make sure the mushrooms are submerged. Let rehydrate until the mushrooms turn soft, 15 to 20 minutes. Cut and prepare the other ingredients in the meantime. Once the mushrooms are done soaking, squeeze out the excess liquid and slice into strips. Reserve the soaking liquid.

title: Instant Pot Curry Goat
description: Saucy, savory, and spicy INSTANT POT CURRY GOAT makes a great dinner centerpiece for any occasion. This hassle-free and mess-free dish gives you just the right amount of heat you need to make a lively feast.

ingredients.name: - 2 ½ pounds goat meat ((cut in chunks) )
scotch bonnet pepper (, adjust to suit taste buds or replace with any hot pepper)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season goat with 2 tablespoons of curry, salt, and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Press the “Saute” function on your instant pot. Heat oil and brown the goat meat. You can do so in batches. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the onions, garlic, ginger, green onions, thyme, stir for about a minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add in the rest of the curry, stir for about 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in the water or meat broth and thoroughly deglaze the instant pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the tomato paste and stir.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add meat, potatoes, scotch bonnet pepper and bouillon powder, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Close the Instant Pot and set the knob to seal.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pressure cook on high for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Let it release pressure naturally for 10 minutes. And then manually release the rest of the pressure.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Set the instant pot back to saute to let the soup thicken to the desired consistency. You may adjust the thickness of soup with water or stock.

garlic (- finely chopped or minced garlic)
mint leaves (- chopped or cilantro (coriander leaves))

title: Chicken Stir Fry with Kale and Mushrooms
description: A quick healthy one-pot meal! The stir fry sauce is so versatile that you can use it with any meat and/or vegetables in the fridge. Perfect on a busy weeknight!

ingredients.name: red chili pepper or 1/4 red bell pepper - optional
rice wine (or mirin) (or 1 tablespoon lemon juice)
sugar (or brown sugar) (adjust to taste or use your favorite sugar substitute)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the sauce ingredients, and stir well to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the chicken into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Marinate the chicken with 3 tablespoons of the sauce while preparing the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Tear the kale off the stems into small pieces. Discard thick stems. Rinse thoroughly and drain well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Give the mushrooms a quick rinse, and cut into quarters (or halves if small).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a large skillet over high heat with a tablespoon of cooking oil until very hot. Add the chicken pieces to the pan in one layer. Do not touch for a minute or two until the chicken is nicely seared. Flip them over and sear the other side. The chicken does not need to be cooked through at this point.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the kale, mushrooms, and optional red pepper. Drizzle the remaining sauce over the vegetables, and sprinkle with crushed red pepper if using. Continue to stir-fry until the kale and mushrooms are softened, about 3 minutes. Serve hot on top of rice or with a separate bowl of rice.

title: Agua de Melon
description: Agua de melon (or cantaloupe agua fresca) is a colorful, refreshing, lightly sweetened Mexican drink that only uses 3 ingredients!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the cantaloupe, water, and sugar into a large blender. Blend for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth. You may have to do this in batches if your blender isn't big enough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Taste and blend in more sugar if desired. Strain the mixture into a pitcher to remove any pulp.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve immediately over ice or chill in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Ham and Cheese Sliders
description: Nothing says “comfort food” better than HAM and CHEESE SLIDERS easily prepared for any special occasion. A sweet blend of meaty and chunky ham with generous slices of cheeses sandwiched between perfectly fluffy buns.

ingredients.name: ham or deli, or leftover ham
2-3 teaspoons everything bagel spice or poppy/sesame seeds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Then spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Set aside. For easier clean up or removal, you can place parchment or foil paper at the bottom.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the slider buns on a chopping board or surface, slice the whole 12 buns in half, just like in the photos.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the bottom part of the sliders in the 9x13 baking pan. Then layer the ham, followed by the cheeses. Top it with the other half of the slider buns.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together the melted butter, honey, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, minced onions, salt, and hot sauce (optional).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Brush or drizzle the top part of the sliders with the butter mixture. Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning or poppy and sesame seeds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover with foil paper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the pan in the oven and bake for about 20 minutes - or until the ham sliders are warmed through and cheese melted. Remove the foil paper. Then bake for an additional 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. (Optional)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the oven and serve immediately!

title: Chinese Deviled Eggs
description: Give a holiday classic a surprising twist with these Chinese deviled eggs that are bursting with exciting flavors to shake things up! {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: extra large Pete and Gerry’s Organic Eggs ((Footnote 1))
heaping teaspoon wasabi or Chinese hot mustard ((or to taste))
zha cai (Chinese pickled mustard greens, diced (Optional) (Footnote 2))
Chinese chili flakes ((or your favorite chili sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To boil the eggs, fill a pot with enough water to cover the eggs. Bring the water to a boil, then slowly lower the eggs using a ladle. Boil for 12 minutes, stirring the water in a circular motion with a spoon for the first minute (to keep the egg yolk in the center). Once the eggs are done, run them under cold tap water to stop cooking.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once the eggs are cooled, peel them and slice them in half lengthwise.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Gently pop out the cooked yolks into a big bowl using a small spoon. Mash them with the backside of a spoon. Make sure to mash them as finely as you can, so the finished filling will be smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the mayonnaise, wasabi or mustard, and rice vinegar to the bowl. Mix with a spatula (or an immersion blender) just until it forms a smooth paste. You can adjust the taste by adding more mayo, wasabi, or vinegar.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the zha cai pickles, if using. Mix again to distribute throughout the yolk mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the yolk mixture to a piping bag with a large star tip, or a small ziplock bag with a corner cut off.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pipe the yolks into the halved egg white cups.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Garnish the eggs with chili flakes (or hot sauce) and green onions. Serve as an appetizer.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: These eggs can be made ahead of time and stored in the fridge in a sealed container for up to 2 days. For the best result, you should serve them the same day you cooked them.

title: Wheat Halwa | Atta Halwa
description: Wheat Halwa or Atta Halwa is a soft and rich North Indian sweet made by roasting whole wheat flour in ghee and cooking it with sugar and water. Proper roasting of the atta gives the halwa its signature nutty aroma and taste.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the ghee in a heavy bottomed kadai or pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add whole wheat flour to the hot ghee and start roasting it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, take sugar and water in another pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Keep this pan on a medium to high flame and let the solution come to a boil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fry the atta stirring continuously till its color changes and you get the aroma of roasted whole wheat flour.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Keep on stirring the flour to ensure even browning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In the meanwhile keep your eyes also on the sugar solution.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: If the mixture starts to boil, then lower the flame and let it simmer.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: The atta or whole wheat flour should turn golden and give a good fragrance. Plus also begins to release ghee.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Increase the flame to high for the sugar solution to bubble and when it starts to bubble in a matter of seconds, immediately add it to the hot atta mixture.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Be careful as the mixture has the tendency to splutter.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Continue to stir with all your hand force, so that no lumps are formed.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Atte ka halwa will absorb water and continue to thicken quickly.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Keep on stirring. So that lumps are not formed.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: When wheat halwa is semi thick or thick like a sooji halwa, switch off the fire.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Serve atte ka halwa hot or warm.

title: Myeolchi bokkeum (Stir-fried Dried Anchovies)
description: Myeolchi bokkeum, stir-fried dried anchovies, is a popular side dish (banchan) in Korea. The stir-fried anchovies are sweet, savory, sticky and crunchy! This easy recipe also shows how to make it a bit spicy.

ingredients.name: (1 cup packed) small size myeolchi (멸치, (dried anchovies))
green chili peppers (cut into small pieces (optional))
Oligo syrup or corn syrup (or honey) (Honey is sweeter so use less)
Oligo syrup or corn syrup (or honey) (Use less if using honey)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a pan with the oil over medium heat. Add the anchovies and stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Turn off the heat. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the seasoning ingredients, except sesame oil and seeds, to the pan. If using the spicy version, stir the sauce well to dissolve the gochujang. Turn the heat back on. Boil the sauce over medium heat until it bubbles up and slightly thickens.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the anchovies and the optional chili peppers to the pan. Stir well until the anchovies are coated well with the sauce. Stir in the sesame oil and sesame seeds at the end.

title: Szechuan Fried Rice
description: Easy and common Szechuan style fried rice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pot, cook diced carrot in boiling water for around 2 to 3 minutes or until soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pan, heat around 1/2 tablespoon vegetable cooking oil and fry the leftover rice until they are separated from each other. Transfer out and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix black vinegar with light soy sauce in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat up another 1 tablespoon cooking oil again, fry doubanjiang for around 30 seconds until the oil turns red. Add garlic, green onions and red onion dices to fry until soft. Add carrot dices. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return fried rice. Stir the sauce in. Taste to see whether you need to add any salt.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Do a quick fry to mix everything well and garnish some chopped green onion before serving.

title: Frijoles Puercos
description: Frijoles puercos are a creamy Mexican dish made with refried beans, chorizo, and cheese. Perfect as a dip with chips or a side dish!

ingredients.name: shredded Chihuahua cheese ((Oaxaca and Monterey Jack also work))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add cooked beans, chipotle peppers, onion, oregano, and garlic cloves into a blender and blend until smooth. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add vegetable oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat and cook chorizo for 8-10 minutes, breaking up the meat with a spatula until fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the bean mixture into the chorizo skillet and mix together to combine. Cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Take frijoles puercos off the heat and add cheese. Lightly stir until the cheese is fully melted and combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Top with extra cheese, pork cracklins, avocados, cilantro, or chopped jalapeño, and serve immediately.

title: Black Bean and Corn Salad Recipe
description: This easy and bright black bean and corn salad with Pablano pepper, fresh mint, and lime will surprise your taste buds in the best way possible!
tags: black black bean and corn salad

ingredients.name: ears corn, (cleaned with no husks (or 1 1/2 cup cooked corn from frozen))
cooked black beans or from a can, (rinsed if from can)
to 1/4 cup lightly packed mint leaves, (chopped)
cherry tomatoes, (halved or quartered depending on size)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the corn in the microwave and prepare it. If working with corn (no husk) on the cob, wet two paper towels and wring out excess water. Wrap each ear of corn in the moist paper towel and place on a dinner plate. Cook in the microwave for 5 minutes. Let cool briefly then carefully remove the paper towel. Cut each cob in half crosswise, then stand one half at a time on a cutting board, cut side down, and slice off the kernels. Transfer the corn kernels to a large mixing bowl. (Alternatively, prepare 1 1/2 cups from frozen cooked according to package instructions.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Roast the pablano pepper. Set the pablano pepper on the grates over a gas burner turned to high and use your tongs to turn the pepper until blackened in spots all over. (Alternatively, you can do this under the broiler).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Peel the roasted pablano and chop. Place the roasted pablano in a bowl and cover plate, and let steam for 10 minutes. Uncover, and when cool enough to handle, use your fingers to slip off the blackened skin, then remove and discard the stem and seeds. Chop the roasted pablano into 1/2-inch pieces and add to the mixing bowl with the corn.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the salad. Now add the black beans, coconut, mint, lime juice, tomatoes, olive oil and kosher salt. Toss to combine. Taste and adjust salt to your liking. Serve immediately!

title: Lamb Stifado recipe (Greek lamb stew)
description: If you are searching for proper Greek comfort food then Lamb Stifado will be perfect! This Greek lamb stew is easy to make and is ideal for those cooler evenings when you want a hearty, warming dish.

ingredients.name: lamb, bone in, cut in large portions (53 oz.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek lamb stifado (lamb stew) recipe, start by preparing the lamb. In a large bowl add the meat and season well with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place a large frying pan over high heat. Add the olive oil (4 tbsps) and the lamb and sauté over high heat, until browned on all sides and sealed. When done, remove with a slotted spoon, place on a platter, cover and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Peel the baby shallot onions.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place a pot over high heat. Add the remaining olive oil and the pearl onions and sauté until caramelised.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the chopped garlic, allspice berries, rosemary, cinnamon sticks, sugar and tomato paste and sauté.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour in the vinegar and deglaze.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the canned tomatoes and water and stir. At the end add the sautéed lamb.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the lid on. A soon as it comes to a boil, lower the heat down to medium and cook for approx. 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: While the stifado is simmering, check if it needs some water; you don’t want it to dry out. If it does, pour in some boiled water. On the contrary if your sauce needs more thickening towards the end of cooking time, then remove the lid and let it boil to evaporate.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve this delicious lamb stifado with crusty bread and feta cheese. Enjoy!

title: Easy Sticky Wings with Hot Sauce
description: Cook up these super-simple, easy, sticky wings - a perfect shareable snack for movie night, game night, or any night of the week that anyone can make!The recipe is quoted with minor edits (based on the format of this blog and my own…

ingredients.name: dark soy sauce ((or regular soy sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Arrange the chicken wings in one layer in a 12” nonstick skillet, skin side up. (Use two skillets if necessary.) Sprinkle the wings with half of the salt. Flip the wings over and sprinkle the other half of the salt onto them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook the wings skin side down over medium-high heat, uncovered, until the bottoms are browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Shake the pan occasionally so the wings don’t stick. Check on the bottom of the wings every few minutes, to prevent them from overcooking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, prepare the sauce by mixing all the sauce ingredients in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the chicken wings. They should be nicely browned on the first side. Cover the skillet, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook the wings for another 12 minutes, or until they are browned on the second side and tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If the chicken wings have rendered a lot of fat, use a few layers of paper towel attached in front of a pair of tongs. Pat the pans between the wings to absorb any excess oil, and discard it.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the sauce over the wings and cook over medium-high heat, tossing the wings in the sauce, until the sauce has reduced enough that it coats the wings like a glaze, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve immediately.
