title: Easy Broiled Salmon
description: Naturally delicious salmon ramped up with a delectable mustard butter sauce is broiled for a fork-tender treat. Healthy eating has never been this delicious! And, like most fish, it cooks up quickly for a perfect busy weeknight meal!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large saucepan, melt butter, then add oil, followed by garlic. Sauté for about 30 seconds or until fragrant. Then add the minced thyme and rosemary, and cook for 30 seconds to a minute. Turn off the heat, add mustard and lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat the broiler. Adjust your rack to the center position in your oven.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Line a heavy-rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Use cooking spray to spray the baking sheet. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pat the salmon fillets dry with a paper towel. Salt and pepper them, then place them in a single layer on the baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Using a spoon, pour butter mustard sauce over the fillets. Broil for 3 minutes. Then, flip the fillets and baste them with butter sauce. Broil for another 3 minutes. Salmon is done when it is fork tender.

title: Baechu Doenjang Guk (Soybean Paste Soup with Napa Cabbage)
description: Doenjang guk is a staple soup in Korean homes. It's made with napa cabbage and doenjang (fermented soybean paste).

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make anchovy broth by boiling, uncovered, about 12 medium size dried anchovies in 6 cups of water (or water used to rinse the rice) for 10 minutes. Fish out the anchovies and discard.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the broth is being made, cut the cabbage into 2 to 3-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir the soybean paste and red pepper paste in to the broth, or run them through a strainer in the broth. The latter process helps dissolve the pastes easier and catches any big chunks of beans remaining in the soy bean paste. Add the soup soy sauce to the broth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the cabbage, cover and bring it to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook until the cabbage becomes soft, 1o to 15 minutes. Add the scallions and garlic and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Add salt, if necessary, and pepper to taste.

title: Chimichurri Sauce
description: This Chimichurri Sauce is made with simple ingredients like fresh herbs, olive oil and red wine vinegar. It's perfect with grilled meats and as a marinade!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add cilantro, parsley, olive oil, lemon juice, red onions, garlic, red wine vinegar, dried oregano, red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper to a food processor or blender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pulse in short 1-second increments about 3-5 times. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container in the fridge.

title: Mediterranean Sheet Pan Baked Shrimp and Veggies
description: Easy sheet pan baked shrimp and veggies, prepared Mediterranean style! The olive oil and citrus sauce with fresh ginger and spices makes all the difference. Comes together in 25 minutes!

ingredients.name: asparagus, tough parts removed, cut into 2-inch pieces
red onion, halved and thickly sliced
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the sauce. In a small bowl, add all the sauce ingredients. Whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the vegetables on the largest sheet pan you have (like this one). Pour 1/4 cup of the sauce on top, and work with your hands to make sure all the veggies are well coated. Spread the veggies out in one layer. Bake in heated oven for 10-12 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, add the shrimp. Pour the remaining sauce on top, and again toss to make sure all the shrimp is well-coated.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove vegetables from the oven. Push vegetables to one half of the pan, and add the shrimp on the other half of the sheet pan. Shrimp should be in one layer, do not crowd.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place pan back in oven. Bake for 5 minutes or so until shrimp is done, do not over-bake.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from oven. Finish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, freshly squeezed lemon juice, and parsley. Serve with a side of your favorite grain or this simple Lebanese rice.

title: Traditional Tiropita recipe (Greek cheese Pie with feta)
description: Looking for a traditional Greek Tiropita recipe? This delicious Greek cheese pie filled with a rich feta filling, wrapped in golden-brown crispy phyllo will amaze you.

ingredients.name: grated Parmesan or Regato or kefalograviera (3.5 ounces)
grated Gouda cheese or Emedal cheese (3.5 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you choose to prepare this Greek tiropita recipe with commercial phyllo dough, it is important to thaw completely the phyllo dough by putting it in the fridge from the previous day. For the beginners at working with phyllo, check the handling tips before starting.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the filling for the tiropita. This traditional tiropita recipe, calls for three different kind of cheese for extra flavour! Use a fork to crumble the feta cheese into a large bowl and add the beaten eggs along with the rest of the grated cheese and heavy cream. Chop some fresh mint and add to the mixture. Season with freshly ground pepper and blend well with a spoon. Place the mixture in the refrigerator for 20-30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For this tiropita recipe you will need a large baking tray, approx. 20*30 cm. Using a pastry brush, butter the bottom and sides of the tray. Place one sheet of phyllo at the bottom of the pan and with a cooking brush sprinkle some olive oil or melted butter. Repeat the procedure, adding 4-5 more sheets of phyllo dough. You will use 5-6 phyllo sheets for the bottom of the tiropita.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the feta cheese mixture and smooth with a spatula. With a knife trim some of the excessive phyllo, and fold the excess phyllo sheets flaps over the mixture. Top the tiropita with 4-5 more phyllo sheets, making sure to oil or butter each one, before adding the other; roll in the edges. Brush the top with oil or butter, sprinkle with water and sesame seeds. If using commercial phyllo dough to make this tiropita recipe make sure to scar the top with a sharp knife, to help release the steam.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake the tiropita in a preheated oven at 180C for 45-50 minutes, until the phyllo is crisp and golden. Let it cool down for a while before serving. Enjoy!

title: Tres Leches Cake
description: Tres Leches Cake – A sweet, spongy, and milky cake topped with a light and fluffy whipped cream and sprinkled with cinnamon spice. A perfect dessert for any occasion. Every bite of this extraordinary Mexican cake is in milky heaven.

ingredients.name: (180ml) coconut milk ((or whole milk, heavy cream))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350F°/177C°. Spray a 9x13-inch cake pan with baking spray or grease with butter and flour. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sift the flour, baking powder, and salt into a large bowl. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Break the eggs, then separate the egg whites from the yolk. Place in a medium bowl and add the egg whites in another bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Using a hand mixer, whisk together the egg yolks, and sugar until the yolks become pale yellow.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the milk and vanilla extract to the egg yolk mixture. Then slowly pour the egg yolk mixture to the flour mixture; stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Beat the egg whites at high speed until soft peaks form.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gently fold in the egg white mixture to the batter until just combined. Do not over mix.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour the cake batter into the greased pan and place in the oven.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake for about 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: In a medium bowl or pouring jar, combine evaporated milk, coconut milk, and condensed milk.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Using a wooden skewer, pierce the cake with holes then slowly pour ALL the milk all over the surface of the cake; making sure to pour near the edges and all around the cake.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Refrigerate the cake for at least an hour or overnight for the milk to fully penetrate the cake.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Whipped Cream Topping

title: Golgappa Recipe (Delhi Style) | Golgappa Pani
description: Golgappa is a popular North Indian street food made with crispy hollow puris filled with spiced potatoes, chickpeas, spicy tangy pani and sweet tamarind chutney. Each puri is filled just before serving for the best taste and texture.

ingredients.name: black cardamom (- seeds remove and kept)
amchur ((dry mango powder) – can also use lemon juice or kachri powder or bel powder)
black salt as required (– can also use rock salt or regular salt)
kashmiri chilli powder (or add as required)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making golgappa pani or jaljeera

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making golgappa stuffing

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assembling & making golgappa

title: Vegan Mango Pudding
description: Finish any summer evening with this light, refreshing, and absolutely delicious guilt-free mango pudding dessert. {Gluten-Free, Vegan}

ingredients.name: to 4 (24 oz/700 g in total) ataulfo mangoes
Pacific Foods Organic Unsweetened Coconut Original ((*Footnote 2))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Measure the cut mango to make sure you have around 2 1/2 cups of flesh (16 oz./ 450 g). Slice more mango for garnish if needed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Have your serving bowls ready to go. Any glass or small bowl that holds about 2/3 cup of water will work.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the mango, sugar, and lemon juice to a blender and blend on high for 1 minute. If using a common mango, check for any remaining fibers. You may need to blend for longer or run the puree through a strainer to filter out the fibers.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Measure out the blended mango, it should be just about 2 cups.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the coconut beverage and agar agar to a small pot and whisk them together. Turn the heat to medium-high and bring to a boil, whisking regularly. Once it is boiling, reduce the heat slightly and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes until the agar agar is dissolved completely. You can check that it's dissolved by dipping a spoon into the liquid and checking for obvious granules.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the mango puree and whisk until the mixture is even and smooth. Turn the heat off. Taste the mixture and adjust the taste by adding sugar and/or lemon juice, if needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the hot pudding into the serving bowls. (Do not wait for it to cool down, agar agar sets at room temperature so it will begin to set in the pot if you wait to pour it.)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Chill the puddings for 4 hours in the refrigerator. You can let them set at room temperature, but they taste better chilled.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve cold or at room temperature with extra sliced mango on top. Enjoy!

title: Ground Beef Rice Bowl
description: Spicy ground beef stir fry

ingredients.name: tbsp. ShaoXing Wine or Cooking Wine
to 8 fresh long green chili peppers ( , cut into small circles(depending on how spicy you want it to be))
fresh red chili peppers ( , cut into small circles)
middle size red onion ( , finely chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinating ground beef with Shaoxing wine, salt, and pepper. Set aside for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare all the other side ingredients during this process.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add oil to a pan and fry the minced beef until crispy and slightly golden brown. Keep string and be patient. This may take several minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the beef and leave the oil. Fry all the aromatics, including chili peppers, scallion, red onion, garlic, and ginger, until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return beef. Add salt, light soy sauce and vinegar. Drizzle some sesame oil. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To serve, pour the ground chili beef on your freshly steamed rice. And serve hot!

title: Domi Maeuntang (Spicy Fish Stew with Red Snapper)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: little neck clams (or any other small clams)
1-1/2 tablespoons gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the fish, remove guts, scales, and fins, if not already done by the fishmonger. Rinse and scrub the clams. Place the clams in salted water (1 tablespoon of salt in 2 to 3 cups of water) for 30 minutes or longer to get the clams to spit out the sand.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the vegetables. Cut the radish into bite sizes. Thinly slice the scallions and the pepper. Cut the tofu into 1/2-inch thick small pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine all the seasoning ingredients and mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the broth to a medium size pot along with the radish and the seasoning mix. Bring it to a boil over high heat. Cook until the radish turns soft, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drop in the fish, clams and tofu. When it comes to a boil again, reduce the heat to medium. Cook until the clams are open and the fish is almost cooked through, about 5 minutes. (Do not overcook. The fish will continue to cook in the boiling hot broth while being served and eaten.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the zucchini, enoki mushrooms, and scallions, and boil for a minute or two. Place the watercress or crown daisy leaves on top. Turn the heat off. Serve piping hot with the optional lemon slice on top.

title: All-Purpose Thai Basil Sauce
description: This versatile, easy basil sauce is a great way to use up any kind of basil you have on hand. Pour it onto any protein, or use it as a stir fry sauce.

ingredients.name: ground white or black pepper (to taste)
basil leaves of any kind (see note 2)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar together in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a wok or a skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onions and saute until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. To help the onions cook faster you can add a splash of water and close the lid to allow it to steam for a minute. Then uncover and cook until all the water has evaporated.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the onions are soft and translucent, add the garlic and Thai chilies and stir until the garlic starts to brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add about ¾ cup (180 ml) of the stock, the sauce mixture, and ground black or white pepper then stir to mix. If you want to darken the colour, add a dash of black/dark soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the bell pepper and cook for about a minute, then turn off the heat and stir in the basil just until wilted. Taste the sauce, and if it is too salty, add the remaining stock or water to dilute; however, it should taste slightly too salty at this point because you will be adding protein to it.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Use right away, or allow to cool and keep in the fridge for at least a week. When ready to use, reheat the sauce and pour over pan seared protein such as fish, thinly sliced steak or pork chops - or use it as a stir fry sauce! Watch the video for a demo of how to use the sauce!

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin
description: This Roasted Pork Tenderloin is rubbed with herbs and spices, seared in a cast-iron skillet and roasted in the oven with oranges and lemon to keep it juicy!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, add chili powder, salt, smoked paprika, thyme, cumin, red pepper flakes and onion powder. Mix together until combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat the pork tenderloins with paper towels until completely dry. Sprinkle the spice mixture all over the tenderloins and rub it in using your hands.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375°F. Heat a large oven-safe skillet or pan (a cast-iron skillet or dutch oven are best) over medium-high heat. Add the olive oil followed by the seasoned pork. Sear the pork on all sides, about 1 1/2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the skillet from the heat and squeeze the juice of the orange quarters and lemon halves into the skillet. Place the squeezed oranges and lemons into the skillet and bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 140°F. (I highly recommend using an in-oven meat thermometer to make sure you don't overcook the pork.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the skillet from the oven and transfer the pork tenderloins to a cutting board. Let the pork rest for 5 minutes. The pork will continue cooking a little bit during this time and the internal temperature of the meat will reach 145°F.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Slice and serve with the juices from the skillet and a garnish of chopped cilantro or parsley.

title: Lemon Broccoli Pesto Pasta Recipe
description: You'll love this twist on pesto pasta with broccoli and a good splash of fresh lemon juice. Loads of flavor! And you'll have extra pesto to freeze for later use!

ingredients.name: frozen broccoli (or 1 head broccoli, stems and florets)
packed fresh basil leaves, plus more for garnish
Zest and juice of 2 lemons, plus more for serving
short pasta like Fusilli (use Whole Wheat pasta for Mediterranean diet option)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Salt generously. Add the broccoli and cook until crisp tender (about 3 to 4 minutes). Use a slotted spoon to transfer the broccoli to a large bowl of ice water. Do not discard the cooking water (you will use it to cook the pasta later). Drain the broccoli and dry on a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the bowl of a food processor, combine the broccoli, 4 tbsp of the pine nuts, 1 1/2 cups of Parmesan, the basil leaves, and lemon zest and juice. Process until combined (about 30 seconds or so). Scrape down the sides of the bowl, cover and run the processor again. And while the processor is running, slowly stream in the extra virgin olive oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring the same pot of water back to a boil. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions (about 10 minutes or so). Drain the pasta, reserving 1/4 cup of the pasta water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the drained pasta to the pot over medium-low heat. Add 1 cup of the Parmesan cheese and the reserved 1/4 cup of pasta water and cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese coast the pasta (about 1 minute).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from the heat and add half of the broccoli pesto (I added a bit more than half). Toss to coat the pasta with the broccoli pesto. (Reserve extra broccoli pesto or freeze it for a later use).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the pasta to a large serving bowl. Top with the remaining Parmesan cheese, 2 tbsp pine nuts, and a little lemon zest. Garnish with a few basil leaves. Enjoy!

title: Delicious Briam recipe (Greek mixed Roasted Vegetables)
description: Simplicity is perfection! This amazing traditional briam recipe (Greek roast vegetables) is the brightest example of how Greek cuisine takes the simplest ingredients and with literally no effort transforms them into a finger licking dish!

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes, chopped (35 oz.). Alternatively use 3-4 tins of plum tomatoes, strained and chopped.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious briam recipe, start by preparing your vegetables. Peel and cut the potatoes in slices. Wash thoroughly the courgettes and aubergines and slice into 1cm slices. Alternatively you can cut the vegetables in chunks. Peel the tomatoes and cut into thin slices. (You can also use green bell peppers).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To bake the briam use a large baking pan, approx. 30*35cm, so that the vegetables are not layered too deep.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Layer the bottom of the pan with sliced tomatoes and season. Place on top the sliced vegetables and season well. Sprinkle with the onion and garlic and top with the rest of the tomatoes. Season well, garnish with chopped parsley and drizzle with olive oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the briam with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven at 200C (both top and bottom heating elements on) for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Uncover the briam halfway through cooking time, toss the vegetables and continue baking until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this traditional briam dish with salty feta cheese and lots of bread. Enjoy!

title: Kale Salad
description: Green, lush, and healthy KALE SALAD with broccoli, cabbage, Brussel sprouts, dried cranberries, and pumpkin seeds tossed in a creamy homemade Poppy Seed Dressing. A bowl of superfood you’ll enjoy even if you’re not a vegan.

ingredients.name: firmly packed shredded kale (, finely chopped )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Identify the tough stems on the kale. then pull the kale leaves from the stems. Alternatively, you can also perform this task by folding each leaf in half with topside of the green folded inward. Cut along the stem and discard the stem. Then thinly slice kale into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using tough kale, place the leaves into a large mixing or salad bowl, then add a tablespoon of olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of sea salt. Mix the kale gently with your hands to soften them or until the leaves are dark.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cabbage, brussels sprouts, broccoli slaw, cranberries, and pumpkin seeds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour poppy seed dressing over salad and toss to fully combine salad with dressing.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover with plastic wrap and let it rest in the refrigerator, until ready to be served.

title: Paneer Sandwich Recipe
description: Grilled Paneer Sandwich is an Indian-style vegetarian sandwich made with spiced paneer and yogurt stuffing layered with chutney and vegetables, then grilled until crisp. It is easy to prepare and makes a filling breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: green chillies (or add as per taste)
to 2 tablespoons water (or add as needed, for blending chutney)
medium onion (– thinly sliced in rounds)
small to medium red bell pepper (– thinly sliced, can use any colored bell pepper)
to 12 slices of bread (– whole wheat or brown or multigrain or white bread)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making Chutney

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making Paneer Filling

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Making Paneer Sandwich

title: Bok Choy Soup
description: Try this truly Chinese-style bok choy soup for a uniquely savory and flavorful way to enjoy more vegetables with your dinner. {Gluten-Free, Vegan}

ingredients.name: zha cai ((Chinese pickled mustard plant stem) (*Footnote 1))
to 8 heads baby bok choy (, halved or quartered depending on the size)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the sesame oil in a medium-sized pot over medium-low heat. Add the zha cai, ginger, and whites of the green onion. Saute for 3 to 5 minutes, or until they become fragrant and just start to brown.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the vegetable stock and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the bok choy and bring the stock back up to a simmer. Cover the pot and cook until the bok choy is tender, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the greens of the green onion and a drizzle of sesame oil if desired. Adjust the seasonings to taste with a pinch of sugar, salt, or a splash of the zha cai pickle liquid. (*Footnote 2)

title: Chinese Style Cabbage Stir Fry
description: Easy Chinese style cabbage stir fry--hot and sour in taste.

ingredients.name: middle size cabbage ( ,hand shredded and remove the tough parts)
to 6 dried chili pepper depending how spicy you want it to be

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Hand tear the cabbage, and keep the tender green leaves only. Discard the hard white pate. Wash gently and drain completely. This is the key step to guarantee the success of the dish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the wok first, and pour in the oil. Add dried chili pepper, to fry over a slow fire until an aromatic, place in garlic and ginger too.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cabbage immediately. Quickly fry the cabbage, add salt, light soy sauce, and vinegar.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: This process should be finished within 30 seconds. You will have full of flavor, crunchy cabbage side dish.

title: No-Bake Mango Cream Pie - Filipino Mango Royale
description: One of the simplest mango desserts you can make - yet one of the best. This Filipino classic frozen treat combines sweet, juicy Manila mangoes with fluffy whipped cream, sweetened condensed milk, and a nutty brown-butter graham cracker…

ingredients.name: very ripe manila mango flesh (see note 1)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Spray the pie plate with non-stick spray, and if you want you can line bottom with parchment. (The parchment isn't totally necessary but it does make it easier to remove.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the brown butter graham crust, place the graham cracker crumbs into a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Brown the butter by melting it in a stainless steel pot or skillet over medium heat. Once melted, keep stirring until the butter becomes very dark brown and looks almost burnt, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. (Note: There will be a lot of foam on top of the melted butter, this is normal, but if you keep stirring you will be able to see the colour of the butter through the foam.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the brown butter over the graham crumbs and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Put about 2/3 of the graham crumbs into the pie plate and spread it around, then press the crumbs up the sides of the plate making them a little less than ¼ inch thick. Then press them into the bottom of the pie plate firmly. You can take more of the reserved crumbs to fill the crust as needed, as it's most important that you have an even, sturdy bottom crust. Chill the crust in the fridge while you make the filling.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For the mango filling: Slice mango cheeks off the fruit, then use a paring knife to score the flesh into ½-inch cubes and use a spoon to scoop them out into a large mixing bowl. You can remove the flesh around the seeds, or just snack on them - as long as you have at least 700 g (25 oz) of flesh.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Use a gloved hand to squish the mangoes until it looks like a chunky mango sauce (about half chunks half puree). Taste, then add lime juice if it feels like it could use a little extra acidity.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: For the condensed whip: Combine condensed milk and cold whipping cream in a medium mixing bowl and use a hand mixer to beat them on medium to medium-low speed until firm peaks form. To check for doneness, lift your beater, and whatever sticks to your beater should be able to hold its shape against gravity with gentle shaking. Be careful not to over-whip; once your beater starts leaving clear trails you're almost there, so pay attention and check often.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Build the pie: The layers are built in this order: cream -> mango -> crumbs -> cream -> mango -> crumbs. Spread about half of the cream into the chilled crust, then spoon half of the mangoes over the cream, followed by about half of the remaining crumbs. Repeat the layers with the remaining filling, and if you don't end up using everything, that's fine. You can use whatever's left to make a mini version.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Freeze overnight (at least 8 hours), then allow to thaw for 1 hour at room temp or thaw in the fridge overnight before serving. If your schedule will allow, you can also serve it after 5-6 hours of freezing. Essentially you want to serve it semi-frozen or partially thawed.Tip: If freezing for more than 1 night, to prevent it from drying out and absorbing freezer smell I recommend covering it with a double layer of plastic wrap after the exterior has firmed up.

title: Mediterranean Broccoli Pasta with White Beans
description: Simple, hearty Mediterranean bean and broccoli pasta, tossed in a light olive oil sauce, and flavored with a few spices and herbs including oregano and fresh parsley. A sprinkle of grated Parmesan and some toasted pine nuts seal the deal!

ingredients.name: elbow macaroni, whole wheat if possible
Private Reserve Greek Extra Virgin Olive Oil
crushed red pepper, more if you like spicy
frozen broccoli florets, thawed (see notes for using fresh broccoli)
Za’atar spice blend, more for later

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to package until al dante. I like to add a little olive oil to the cooking water. Before you drain pasta, reserve 1 cup of the pasta cooking water for later.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pot, heat the extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add chopped onions and cook for 2 minutes, stirring regularly, until translucent. Add garlic, oregano, Aleppo pepper, and crushed pepper flakes. Stir till fragrant.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now add thawed broccoli florets. Cook 4 minutes, tossing regularly. Add cannellini beans. And season with salt and pepper. Cook another 3 minutes or so, tossing regularly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the cooked pasta and about 1/3 cup of the reserved cooking water into the pot. Add fresh parsley, za’atar spice, and Parmesan cheese. Toss to combine. If you need to, add a little bit more of the pasta cooking water to help combine everything. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cook until everything is very well warmed through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowls. Sprinkle toasted pine nuts, more za’atar spice, and more crushed red pepper flakes on top. Enjoy!

title: Easy Mushroom Tacos
description: Easy Mushroom Tacos filled with marinated portabello mushrooms, bell peppers and a crunchy red cabbage slaw. Ready in only 25 minutes! (vegetarian, vegan, gluten free)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove the stems and gills from the mushrooms: Cut the stems off completely off from the base of the portobella mushroom cap if they're still attached. Then, remove the dark, flaky gills by holding the mushroom in one hand and sticking the tip of a spoon into the gills with the other hand. Pry them up and away from the base as best you can. You should then be able to slide the side of the spoon all the way down and remove the gills in larger sections. (Do the best you can here. They don't have to be completely and cleanly removed.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Quickly marinate mushrooms: Slice the mushrooms into long strips and transfer them to a large mixing bowl. Add the olive oil, lime juice, cilantro, garlic, chile powder, salt, cumin, and oregano. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook the mushrooms: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer the mushrooms to a medium bowl or plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the mushrooms are cooking, make the slaw: In a large mixing bowl, add the cabbage, mayonnaise and cilantro. Toss to combine. Refrigerate until ready to assemble tacos.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook the peppers: In the same skillet, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the bell peppers. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until peppers have softened.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bring it together: Add the mushrooms back to the skillet, stir to combine with the peppers and cook them for 1 minute to warm everything back up.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Assemble the tacos: Fill warm corn or flour tortillas with a handful of slaw and the mushrooms and peppers. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Calzone Recipe
description: This CALZONE is like a folded pizza that has cheeses in it, chicken, vegetables, and pizza sauce all wrapped up and baked to golden perfection. Homemade calzones make a great make-ahead portable meal or party appetizer.

ingredients.name: 8-ounce ball pizza dough (, (click the link for homemade ) or store-bought)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with baking sheet or aluminum foil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta, mozzarella, parmesan cheese, basil, and Italian seasoning. Lightly season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add pizza dough (see my HOMEMADE HERE) on a floured board, then divide the dough into equal parts (depending on preference ), about 4-6 or more.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roll out each piece using a rolling pin into an 8-inch circle, about ¼" thick.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Spoon the ricotta cheese mixture into the filling of the dough followed by pizza sauce and any other additional toppings (like chicken and bell peppers) leaving a ½-inch border.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fold the dough over and pinch to seal the edges of the calzone. If desired, make a slit in the calzone using a sharp knife.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Lightly brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Sprinkle each calzones with 2 teaspoons parmesan and herbs (if, desired), then bake until golden brown and cooked through for 18 to 20 minutes. Serve with marinara or pizza sauce.

title: Apple Jam Recipe
description: Apple jam is a classic fruit preserve made by slowly cooking apples with sugar and a little fruit acid until thick and spreadable.

ingredients.name: kilogram or (about 5 large) apples (– such as Red Delicious)
or (300 grams) sugar (or add as needed)
two-inch piece cinnamon stick (– use true cinnamon and not cassia, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making Apple Jam

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Jam Doneness Test

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serving & Storage

title: How to cook Halloumi cheese (Pan fried and Grilled Halloumi recipe)
description: If you love the taste of halloumi cheese, you'll be pleased to know that you can cook it in various ways in no time!

ingredients.name: mixed pepper or black pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove the halloumi from any packaging and pat as dry as possible with a piece of kitchen towel. Slice into 8 pieces (approx. 1/2 inch, 1.3cm thick) and pat each piece dry with a fresh piece of paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a seasoned or non-stick griddle pan over a very high heat. Meanwhile brush each halloumi piece with olive oil and season well with freshly ground pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook the cheese for a minute or two on each side, trying not to move it around the pan so it forms nice golden lines.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from the heat and squeeze over the lemon juice before serving immediately.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the halloumi from any packaging and pat as dry as possible with a piece of kitchen towel. Slice into 8 pieces, and pat each piece dry with a fresh piece of paper.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a very bottomed, non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Toast the sesame seeds for about a minute until just coloured, and remove from the pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Wipe any stray seeds from the pan and return it to a medium high heat. Add the oil and once it is shimmering, add the halloumi. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Spoon the honey over the top of the halloumi slices. Flip them, and the moment the honey starts to bubble, remove the pan from the heat. Squeeze over the lemon juice.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve the halloumi immediately with the honey from the pan drizzled over the top, and the toasted sesame seeds sprinkled over each slice.

title: Thai Pineapple Curry with Shrimp
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: pineapple chunks, packed in juice NOT in syrup (or about 1¾ cups fresh pineapple)
4-5 Tbsp red curry paste (or to taste)
dried shrimp (optional), finely chopped or ground into a fluff in a coffee grinder
2-3 tsp chopped palm sugar (or brown or white sugar)
About 1 Tbsp cooking tamarind (what is tamarind and how to make it?)
Half a red bell pepper, julienned
medium sized shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Drain pineapple from the juice and place the chunks in a mixing bowl. (You can discard the juice or mix it with some soda water for a sparkling treat!)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Take 2-3 pieces of pineapple at a time in your hand and squeeze the juice out of them. Do not drain this juice; just leave it in the bowl. Do this for all the pineapple pieces; you want the pineapple to give up the juice so they can absorb the curry sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium pot, bring ½ cup coconut milk to a boil over medium heat, then add red curry paste and stir to mix with the coconut milk. Reduce the heat to medium low and keep cooking, stirring frequently, until the paste is very thick and you may start to see coconut oil separating out of the paste. Once the oil has started to appear, keep stirring the paste for a few more minutes, deglazing with a little bit of coconut milk if it's sticking too much to the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the rest of the coconut milk, pineapple and the juice you squeezed out, dried shrimp, and ½ cup of water or stock. Tear up makrut lime leaves into big chunks, twisting as you tear to bruise the leaves and allow the aromatic oils to come out, and add them to the pot. Simmer on medium low heat for at least 5 minutes to allow flavours to mingle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add fish sauce, sugar, and tamarind to taste; how much you need will depend on the flavour of the pineapple, so add less and then taste and adjust as needed. You want the curry sauce to have just a little bit of sweetness and tartness to match the pineapple.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add bell peppers and cook for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add shrimp and cook for 1 minute or just until fully cooked, then remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Taste and adjust final seasoning (pro tip: you can never taste too many times when you cook!) and serve with jasmine rice. Enjoy!

title: Easy Chipotle Sauce Recipe
description: This easy chipotle sauce recipe is made with only 4 ingredients and is ready in 5 minutes! Use as a condiment for burgers, tacos, burrito bowls and fries!

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use as a condiment on burgers and Baja Fish Tacos or as a dipping sauce with fries and Mexican Crispy Roasted Potatoes!

title: Best Roasted Cauliflower Recipe
description: This roasted cauliflower is perfectly and charred in all the right parts, thanks to a few simple tips.

ingredients.name: cauliflower (cored and divided into small florets)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil
to 2 tbsp lemon juice (or juice of 1/2 to 1 lemon to your liking)
cup/30 g toasted pine nuts (or toasted slivered almonds, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to anywhere between 450 to 475 degrees F (or 250 degrees C)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cauliflower florets on a large baking sheet. Drizzle extra virgin olive oil and toss to make sure florets are coated, add more EVOO as needed but don't overdo it!

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the cumin and harissa in a small dish. Season cauliflower with the spice mixture and a generous pinch of salt and black pepper. Toss again to combine. Spread cauliflower florets well on the baking sheet so that they are in one layer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover the baking sheet with foil and place on the middle rack of your heated oven. Roast covered for 15 minutes, then carefully remove the foil and return the baking sheet to the oven. Roast for another 20 to 30 minutes or so, occasionally rotating the baking sheet and turning cauliflower florets over, using a pair of tongs. (Cauliflower should be so tender and caramelized or even charred in some parts).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If serving with tahini, use the roasting time to make tahini sauce according to this recipe.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from heat and carefully transfer roasted cauliflower to a serving dish. Immediately add the lemon juice, a little drizzle of tahini (if you like), toasted nuts and a little fresh parsley for garnish. If you're like me and want even more flavor, sprinkle a bit more harissa spice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve the tahini sauce in a bowl on the side for dipping.

title: The traditional Egg-lemon sauce (Greek Avgolemono) recipe
description: The traditional Greek Avgolemono recipe can be a tricky affair. Not any more! Find out how to make the perfect egg lemon sauce with these 3 easy recipes and expert tips.

ingredients.name: warm stock or broth from your prepared soup. You’ll need about 2-3 cups depending on how thick or runny you like your avgolemono.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the classic Avgolemono recipe, start by cracking the eggs into a bowl and whisk well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Gradually add the lemon juice and whisk again to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a little of the warm stock or soup and whisk quickly, add more and whisk again. The reason for slowly adding the broth is to gradually warm up the eggs so you don’t end up with an omelette instead of a sauce!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour gradually the egg mixture back into the pot, whilst constantly stirring and bring just below boiling point. Remove the pan from the stove and serve.

title: Cassava Cake
description: This classic Filipino dessert CASSAVA CAKE will steal your heart. Made with grated cassava (yuca), this baked dessert is chewy, sticky, rich, decadent topped with a luscious sticky coconut milk-based custard topping.

ingredients.name: packs Frozen Cassava (2 pounds ) (, about 4 cups)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Leave cassava to thaw overnight - or submerge cassava packs in a large bowl of water, until cassava has thawed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Squeeze out some water from the cassava. Place on a sieve and let water from the cassava drip to a bowl. Do not squeeze dry. Cassava should have some moisture in it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Lightly spray a 9x13 baking pan. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix together cassava, condensed milk (⅔ can, reserve ⅓ can for topping) coconut milk, (⅔ can, reserve ⅓ can for topping), evaporated milk (⅔ can, reserve ⅓ can for topping) eggs, butter, vanilla extract and nutmeg.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Thoroughly mix until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the cassava mixture into the prepared baking pan. Bake in the oven for about 45 minutes to 1 hour or until a long toothpick or skewer inserted in the middle comes out clean.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Custard Topping

description: This slow cooker version of a Korean chicken soup is packed with tender chicken and soft napa cabbage!

ingredients.name: napa cabbage (thick, outer leaves preferably (see note))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the chicken, trim off excess fat and place in the slow cooker.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Roughly cut the cabbage leaves into big pieces. Cut the onion into 4 big wedges. Add the cabbage, onion, garlic, and ginger to the slow cooker. Add water to fill up to ⅔ of the slow cooker (about 8 cups). Add 1 tablespoon (2 teaspoons if using very fine salt) of salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover, and cook for about 4 hours on high or 6 hours on low. Cut the scallions into about 2-inch length pieces, and drop into the soup, with a few minutes remaining. Add salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the excess fat. You can spoon off the fat, or use a fat separator. You can transfer the chicken and vegetables to another pot, and strain the broth if you like cleaner broth.

title: Steamed Chicken with Chinese Mushroom
description: Chinese style steamed chicken with Chinese mushroom

ingredients.name: Chili sauce for serving ( , I am using homemade Hunan style chopped chili)
dark soy sauce ( , if you want to dark the color)
green onions ( , white parts (keep the green ones for garnish))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut chicken into chunks and then soak in clean water for around 30 minutes. Change the water twice during the process. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix the chicken chunks with all the marinating ingredients. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pre-soak the wood ear mushroom with clean water and slice the shitake mushrooms.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix all the content together. Transfer to steamer and steam over high fire about 30 minutes or until you can easy insert a chop sticker in the chicken meat. You can steam this dish with steamed rice if the chunks are not too large. But you need to choose a longer cooking program to guarantee the steaming time.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer out and garnish some chopped green onions. Serve with any chili sauce you prefer and steamed rice.

title: Easy Homemade Frozen Yogurt Recipe
description: Delicious and creamy frozen yogurt made with the frozen fruit of your choice (I used strawberries and bananas). It takes just 5 minutes of work, but be sure to check out my tips to achieve a creamy texture.

ingredients.name: sliced frozen strawberries, (or other frozen fruit of your choice (see notes) )
orange extract, (or vanilla extract, if you like)
to 6 tbsp honey, (more to your liking, I used Greek honey)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the frozen strawberries, banana, yogurt, orange extract (or vanilla extract), honey, sugar, and corn syrup in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a blade or a heavy duty blender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blend until everything is combined into a creamy smoothie-like mixture. Taste, and if you like it sweeter add a bit more honey.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the mixture to a freezer safe container and smooth the surface. Press a piece of parchment against the top of the yogurt to prevent ice crystals from forming. Freeze for at least 6 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To serve, allow the frozen yogurt to sit at room temperature for a few minutes just until soft enough to scoop. Scoop the amount you need (long, shallow pulls or strokes will produce better scoops). Enjoy!

title: Greek coffee recipe - How to make Greek coffee (Ellinikos Kafes)
description: Greek coffee (ellinikos kafes) requires a bit of technique and a lot of "meraki". Find out all the little tricks to prepare it traditionally!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Fill a full coffee cup with water (approx. capacity 2 fluid ounces/ 60-70 ml) and pour into the briki.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If you plan to make more than one coffee make sure to use the right size of briki. Your briki should be big enough, to allow the coffee to bubble and foam. Creating the right amount of foam is a very important part of the process.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the preferred amount of coffee and the sugar and stir well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place over medium heat and stir again once or twice. Let the coffee heat up, without stirring. Be careful not to leave the kitchen.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once you notice that the coffee starts to foam, lift the briki from the heat until the foam settles. Then put it again on the heat. Let the coffee start to foam and then remove from the heat. Be careful not to let it boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the Greek coffee into the cup and let it rest for 4-5 minutes, so that the temperature drops a bit and the granules set at the bottom.

description: Vegetarian Manchow Soup is a hot and spicy Indo-Chinese soup made with mixed vegetables, garlic, ginger, and soy sauce. It has a bold flavor profile and a slightly thick consistency.

onions (- finely chopped or ¼ cup spring onion whites)

title: Thai-Style Salmon Curry
description: Delicious and balanced, this salmon curry features crispy skin and plenty of veggies in a creamy green coconut curry inspired by Thai cuisine. {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: (450 g) salmon (, skin on & cut into 4 fillets)
green beans (, trimmed and cut in half)
small Japanese eggplant (, halved & cut into half-inch chunks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large skillet or a wide saucepan add the 2 teaspoons of oil and heat over medium heat until warm. Add the curry paste. Cook and stir to release the fragrance, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the coconut milk, chicken stock, fish sauce, and sugar. Stir to combine everything. Taste the mixture and adjust the fish sauce and sugar to your preference. (*Footnote 1)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring the broth to a boil, then lower the heat to medium-low to reduce it to a simmer. Cook until the curry is mostly thickened, 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the broth simmers, sprinkle a pinch of salt evenly onto both sides of the salmon. Add the remaining 1 teaspoon of oil to a separate pan over high heat until it is just smoking. Place the salmon, skin-side-down into the hot pan. Cook until the skin is brown and crisp, about a minute. Once done, transfer the salmon to a big plate and set it aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the broth is reduced, add the green beans and eggplant. Stir to mix well. Continue to simmer for another 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Arrange the vegetables to create 4 wells, about the size of the fillets. Place the cooked salmon skin-side-up in the wells. Simmer for another 2-3 minutes, until the salmon is just cooked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove the pan from the heat and add the basil leaves.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot over steamed rice as a main dish.

title: Galbitang (Beef Short Rib Soup)
description: A hearty, nourishing soup made with beef short ribs

ingredients.name: soup soy sauce (Use 1 T if your soy sauce is dark)
starch noodles - optional (dangmyeon, soaked in warm water for about 20 minutes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the ribs for 30 minutes in cold water. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fill a large pot with enough water to cover the ribs, about 8 cups. Bring water to a boil, and then drop the ribs in. Let it come back to a boil. Continue to boil for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the ribs. Wash the ribs under running water. Clean the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the ribs back to the pot. Add 13 to 14 cups of water, radish, onion, garlic and ginger. Add 2 tablespoons of soup soy sauce and 1 teaspoon of salt (use less if your soup soy sauce is dark and more salt). Bring it to a boil. Continue to boil, uncovered, for 30 minutes over high heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Reduce the heat to medium. Remove all the vegetables. Transfer the radish to a cutting board. Discard the other vegetables.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 2 cups of water. Continue to boil, covered, for about an hour until the meat is tender. Add 1 teaspoon of minced garlic and the optional noodles 3 or 4 minutes before turning the heat off. Cut the radish into thick bite size pieces and add to the soup. Bring everything to a boil again. Salt and pepper to taste. Skim off fat or use a fat separator to remove excess fat. Garnish with the chopped scallions to serve.

title: Easy Chinese Meatballs
description: Easy Chinese meatballs with spicy dipping sauce

ingredients.name: cornstarch (can be replaced by one large egg white)
water or chicken stock for boiling
finely chopped green onion or more as needed
finely chopped coriander or more as needed (optional)
fresh Thai chili peppers (cut into small circles)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, mix ground pork with around 1 tablespoon. Stir in one direction until the water is well absorbed by the ground pork.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add chopped green onion, ginger, cornstarch and other seasonings. Keep stirring in one direction around 2 to 3 minutes until the mixture becomes very sticky. Reset for around 5 minutes. Then stir once again.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Take one portion out and shape to a ball. Pat several times between two hands.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring around half full water in a deep pot to a boiling, and then slide the meatballs in. Gently move them and use high fire to bring the water to a boiling again and straight after the boiling, slow the fire to medium fire so the balls will be not destroyed by over-strong fire.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer out and

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a small bowl, add all the seasoning and then scoop meatball stock and pour to the dipping sauce bowl to tune the seasonings.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Decorate with coriander and then serve with dipping sauce.

title: Garlic Noodles
description: Incredibly simple yet satisfying, it's no wonder this dish became famous so quickly in San Francisco. Chewy egg noodles tossed in lots of garlic, butter, and umami-loaded sauces...it's the perfect pairing to any fish, seafood, or chicken!

ingredients.name: cooked egg noodles (if not using cooked egg noodles, see note)
garlic, minced or pounded in a mortar and pestle into a rough paste
Golden Mountain Sauce, or sub Maggi Seasoning or soy sauce (see note)
finely grated parmesan cheese (about ½ cup)
Freshly ground black or white pepper, to taste

If using fresh but raw noodles, you will need about 350g to end up with about 600g of cooked noodles. If using dry noodles, you will need about 275g. This will vary between noodles so you should weigh the cooked noodles and adjust the amount of sauce as needed.
Golden Mountain Sauce is a type of soy sauce used often in Thailand. See this video for further explanation of different Thai cooking sauces.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If using pre-cooked egg noodles that have been tossed in oil like the ones shown in the video, gently pull the noodles apart, then give them a quick rinse under cold water to wash off some of the oil they’re coated in. Drain and rest them on a paper towel-lined plate to absorb excess water. Tip: If the noodles are cold and are hard to pull apart, heat them in the microwave on 50% power, a minute at a time, just until they are warm enough to be separated. If using uncooked noodles, cook them off according to package instructions, then drain, rinse in cold water and set aside. Weigh the noodles to check the amount you have and adjust the amount of sauce up or down accordingly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pound the garlic in a mortar and pestle into a rough paste or mince them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine oyster sauce, fish sauce, and Golden Mountain sauce in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add oil and butter to a wok and melt the butter over low heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 3-4 mins or until very fragrant, keeping the heat low so as to not brown the garlic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the noodles and the sauce, then turn the heat up to high and toss until the noodles are hot and all the sauce has been absorbed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from heat, then stir in parmesan cheese. If you want you can stir in a squeeze of lemon at this stage, or serve the lemon as wedges on the side.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Plate, and garnish with black or white pepper and green onions if desired.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with a lemon wedge and enjoy!

title: Cheese Enchiladas
description: Cheese enchiladas made with an easy red enchilada sauce and filled with savory melted cheese. Ready in only 30 minutes!

ingredients.name: corn or flour tortillas ((see notes if using flour tortillas))
toppings: diced onions, chopped cilantro, sour cream, shredded lettuce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Add 1/4 cup of enchilada sauce to the bottom of a large baking dish and spread it evenly over the entire surface.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using corn tortillas: Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and heat them in the microwave for 1 minute, flipping the them halfway through until all of them are warm and pliable.If using flour tortillas: Microwave the tortillas on a plate for 1 minute, flipping them halfway through until all of them are warm and pliable.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assemble the enchiladas by filling each tortilla evenly with about 3 tablespoons of shredded cheese. Roll the tortillas tightly to close and place in the prepared baking dish seam side down.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the remaining 1 cup enchilada sauce over the tortillas, top with the remaining shredded cheese, and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese on top has melted.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately and garnish with desired toppings.

title: Harira Recipe
description: Harira is a classic Moroccan lentil and chickpea soup with fresh herbs and loads of warm spices. This satisfying vegetarian soup is even better the next day, so it is the perfect make-ahead pot to feed a little crowd.

ingredients.name: long grain rice, rinsed (or ¼ cup broken vermicelli)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large Dutch Oven, heat 4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add the onions, celery, and carrots. Season with kosher salt. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring regularly until softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the garlic and spices and cook for a couple of 1 to 2 minutes, stirring regularly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, cilantro, lentils (both green and red), and chickpeas. Add a dash more kosher salt and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the broth and raise the heat. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then turn the heat to low. Cover and let simmer for 45 minutes or until the legumes are fully cooked and very tender (check occasionally and plan to add more stock or water. The soup will be thick, but it should not be too thick that you cannot pour it. Make sure to adjust the salt as you add more liquid.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the rice and cook for another 15 or until the rice is fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Sour Cherry Spoon Sweet Preserve (Vyssino Glyko koutaliou)
description: Our favorite fruit spoon sweet preserve! Sour cherry spoon sweet is probably the most popular preserve in Greece. Serve as a topping for dark chocolate ice cream and be amazed!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash thoroughly the cherries, remove the stems and drain them on some paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the pits from the cherries, being careful to keep them intact. Removing the pits can be a little tricky and you will need to use a cherry pitter. Do that over a wide pot, that you will use later to prepare the sweet, so that you can preserve the juices falling from the cherries. Place the pits into a bowl and add the water (1/2 cup).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When done, place the cherries into the wide pot, that you have preserved the juices from the cherries and cover them with the sugar. Drain the pits from the water and pour the water also in the pot. Let them stand like that overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: The next day, place the pot on the stove and bring to the boil over high heat. While the cherries boil, some white foam will probably surface on the water. Remove that foam using a slotted spoon each time it surfaces. When the syrup thickens, add the lemon juice and boil further for 30 seconds. To check if the syrup is ready, take some syrup with a spoon and let it drip over the pan. When the last drops start to drip, place a plate under the spoon and drip one two drops on different spots on the plate. If the syrup spreads on the plate, you should boil a little bit more; if the drops stand firm, then the syrup is ready.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat and allow to cool. In the meantime, wiggle the pot once in a while (5-6 times), to help the cherries puff and become bigger.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place into sterilized jars and cover when it cools down completely. Store into the fridge.

title: Shrimp and Snow Peas
description: Juicy and tender shrimp with crispy snow peas in a refreshing and healthy gingery sauce. It’s a comforting Chinese takeout dish you can whip up quickly any night of the week!

ingredients.name: (225 g) snow peas (, cleaned and strings removed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the shrimp and the marinade ingredients in a medium-size bowl. Mix well with your hands and set aside while you prepare the rest of the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large carbon steel skillet (or non-stick pan) heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat until hot. Add the shrimp and spread it into a single layer. I do not recommend "The Ruffled Purse" for frying because that leaves the filling exposed to the oil, and if using the "pyramid" do not make them fat and chubby like the one I showed in the video, keep the filling to 1 tsp! Wonton wrapping tips: Do not overstuff (no more than 1 tsp of filling per piece) as these only take 1 minute to fry, so there won’t be time to cook a big ball of filling. Make sure you get out as much air as possible before sealing the wontons otherwise you will get big bubbles when you fry them! (See video for an example)

Drain off any excess oil by giving it a little shake while holding it with tongs, then transfer it onto a plate or baking sheet lined with paper towels. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.

steps.title: Step 5

Place the smothered tortilla on a plate and fill with a generous spoonful of the chicken filling mixture, then roll it up. Continue this process with the remaining tortillas.

steps.title: Step 6

title: Festive Roast Turkey with Rosemary, Garlic and Lemon Sauce
description: Celebrate this festive season with nothing other than a well prepared, moist, tender festive turkey! We've come up with this amazing recipe flavored with the aromas of rosemary and lemon for a truly memorable family meal!

ingredients.name: whole turkey (about 12 pounds), neck and giblets removed, rinsed and patted dry
wide strips lemon zest (from 1 large lemon)
Mushroom and Walnut Stuffing (or your favorite kind!)
large yellow onion, cut into 8 wedges

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To ensure your amazing festive turkey is thoroughly cooked the first thing you need to do is let it sit at room temperature for about an hour. That-way the meat will be the same temperature throughout and cooked evenly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat your oven at 400F (200C) with the rack placed in the lower third of the oven. You don’t want this amazing festive turkey to get burned, do you?

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now its time to prepare the glazing. In a small saucepan heat the oil till hot but not enough to cause the ingredients to sizzle. Place the rosemary, garlic and lemon zest and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook until the lemon is slightly shriveled and garlic is soft. It should take about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the glazing from the heat and let it cool.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Now its time to start preparing your amazing festive turkey! Start by tucking its wing tips underneath the body. Season on the inside with plenty of pepper and some salt – careful not to make it too salty though!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fill stuff the turkey with your stuffing, fold the neck skin over the opening and tie the legs together with a kitchen twine.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Now for the glazing. Brush your amazing festive turkey with 1/2 cup of the rosemary-lemon oil and sprinkle some salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Peal your onions in quarters and layer them on the bottom of a heavy roasting pan. Place your roasting rack on top followed by your perfectly seasoned and glazed festive turkey!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Roast until the turkey is golden brown. It will take about 45 minutes to 1 hour. To keep it nice and moist reduce heat to 375F (190C), add 1 cup of water to the pan, brush with the rosemary oil. Remember to cover with a lid or foil at this stage. Repeat every 30 minutes. If the pan becomes dry remember to add some more water.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: The best way to know when your festive turkey is done is using a meat thermometer in the thickest part of the thigh. If it reads 165F (73C) it’s done!

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Once ready, transfer your amazing festive turkey to a platter or carving board and loosely tent with foil. Remember to let it rest for 30 minutes as the juices are still hot on the inside and if carved straight away they will simply run out of the meat…

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: You can use your roasting pan glazing as a base for an amazing white wine gravy. Just add 1 cup of white wine and let it simmer for a few minutes for an amazing sauce…

title: Muhammara Recipe (Roasted Red Pepper Dip)
description: Muhammara (roasted red pepper and walnut dip) makes the perfect addition to the mezze table next to other favorites like baba ganoush or hummus. Serve it with warm pita bread or pita chips.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Brush the bell peppers with 1 tbsp of olive oil, and place in a lightly oiled oven-safe pan or cast-iron skillet. Roast the peppers in the 425 degrees F heated oven for 30 minutes or so, turning them over once or twice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove from the oven and place the peppers in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap for a few minutes. This traps the steam from the roasted peppers, making them easy to peel. When cool enough to handle, simply peel the peppers, remove the seeds and slice the peppers into small strips.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now in the bowl of a large food processor, combine the roasted red pepper strips with 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, garlic, walnuts, tomato paste, bread crumbs, pomegranate molasses, Aleppo pepper, sugar, sumac, salt and cayenne. Blend into a smooth paste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer to a serving bowl. You may cover the muhammara and refrigerate, but be sure to bring the dip to room temperature before serving.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When ready to serve, top the dip with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, and garnish with a little more walnuts and fresh parsley, if you like. Serve with pita bread or pita chips. Enjoy!

title: Peri Peri Marinated Chicken Skewers
description: Peri Peri Chicken Skewers - flavor-packed BBQ chicken skewers marinated in a spicy pepper, garlic, lemon, basil and oregano sauce.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Trim chicken thighs of excess fat and pat dry with a cloth or paper napkin. Cut chicken thighs into 2-inch chunk.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Season with salt, chicken bouillon and pepper or adobo seasoning mix. You can either marinate the chicken now or thread then marinate-about 4 pieces per skewer. Making sure the skewer is fully covered with chicken chunks.

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pre heat grill to medium- high heat.

title: Homemade Tahini Recipe
description: Tahini (also called Tahina) is a smooth, fine paste made from ground sesame seeds and oil. This homemade version uses lightly toasted white sesame seeds and sunflower oil. It has a mild, nutty flavor and creamy texture.

ingredients.name: to 5 tablespoons sunflower oil (or add as needed, can use any neutral flavored oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Lightly toast the sesame seeds on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until aromatic. Stir often.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cool them completely before blending.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grind the seeds and salt in a blender or food processor until powdery.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add 3 tablespoons oil gradually and blend until smooth and creamy. If needed, add 1 to 2 more tablespoons oil while blending.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Check the taste and add more salt if needed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer to a jar and refrigerate. Tahini keeps well for 3 to 4 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Celtuce Stir Fry with Eggs (莴笋炒鸡蛋)
description: Delicate and delicious celtuce stir fry with eggs is an authentic Chinese homestyle dish that gives you a unique balance of texture and taste that you won’t want to miss! {Gluten-Free, Vegetarian}

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 1/2 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick pan and heat over medium-high heat. When the pan is hot, add the beaten eggs and a pinch of salt. Cook until the bottom is set, then scramble the eggs with a spatula until the eggs are broken into smaller pieces and just cooked through. Transfer the eggs to a plate.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of oil and the garlic. Stir a few times to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the celtuce. Cook and stir until the celtuce just starts to soften, 2 minutes or so.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add back the cooked eggs and sprinkle evenly with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Stir to mix everything well. Turn to medium-low heat and taste the celtuce. Adjust the seasoning by adding more salt, if needed. Once done, immediately transfer everything to a serving plate.

steps.title: Step 5

title: Snowy Chocolate Cookies!
description: Beautiful and highly addictive Christmas snowy chocolate cookies! Crispy on the outside with a chewy middle rich in chocolate and all this sprinkled with 'snow' - powdered sugar!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare these delicious snowy chocolate cookies, start by preparing your ingredients. In a bowl add the flour and the baking powder and blend. Melt the butter and the chocolate separately. To melt the chocolate it is best to use a bain-marie (or double boiler), a piece of equipment used to heat the chocolate gently and gradually to fixed temperatures so that it doesn’t burn. If you don’t have a Bain-marie, break the chocolate into small pieces and drop into a heatproof bowl. Set the bowl over a small saucepan about a quarter full with hot water and place the bowl on top so that it rests on the rim of the pan (the bowl should not touch the water). Place the pan, with the bowl on top, over low heat until the chocolate has melted, whilst stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a bowl add the eggs and whisk with a hand-mixer until they thicken. Set your mixer to low speed and pour in the melted butter, the melted chocolate, the espresso coffee, the brown sugar, the vanilla extract and the flour (one at a time, whilst mixing).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover the dough with some plastic wrap (the plastic wrap should be touching the dough, to prevent it from forming a crust) and place in the fridge for 3 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the icing sugar and the sugar in 2 separate plates, large enough to roll the cookie balls. Preheat the oven to 200C / 400F and line two baking trays with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take one teaspoon of the dough, shape into a ball and roll the ball first in the sugar and then in the icing sugar. Place on the baking tray and repeat with the rest of the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the baking trays with the cookies in second and fourth grill of the oven, turn the heat down to 180C and bake for 12-15 minutes, depending on whether you prefer them chewy or crispy. Leave them aside to cool down for a while, if you can resist eating them hot from the oven.. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

title: Beef Satay with Thai Peanut Sauce
description: Marinated skewered beef, basted with coconut milk on the grill for moist tenderness. Served with an authentic Thai peanut sauce that you'll want to put on everything!

ingredients.name: finely chopped palm sugar (or brown sugar)
Thai chilies or jalapenos (or to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the beef into ¼-inch thick slices against the grain, then cut each slice down into small, bite-sized pieces. Place into a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the marinade: Grind coriander seeds, cumin seeds, and black peppercorns in a mortar and pestle until very fine, then add lemongrass, galangal and fresh turmeric (if using); pound into a fine paste. Add the turmeric powder (if using), cinnamon, sugar, salt, vinegar, and coconut milk; stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the marinade over the beef and massage it with your hands, making sure that no pieces of meat are stuck together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the peanut sauce. Using a food processor or mortar and pestle, grind the peanuts and sesame seeds into a fine meal, being careful not to over grind them into nut butter.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a small pot over medium heat, bring about ¼ cup (60 ml) of the coconut milk to a boil. Turn the heat to medium-low, then add the red curry paste and stir to mix well. Keep cooking for about 2 minutes until it is very thick, and coconut oil starts to separate from the paste.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Stir in the rest of the coconut milk, ground peanuts, ground sesame seeds (if using), fish sauce, palm sugar and tamarind paste. Simmer for about 5 minutes until it has thickened into a dip-like consistency, stirring frequently to prevent the bottom from scorching.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning with more sugar, fish sauce, and tamarind paste as needed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To make the pickling liquid for the ajaad: In a small pot over medium heat, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt; cook just until the sugar is completely dissolved. Allow to cool completely.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Skewer the beef onto bamboo skewers, making sure the skewer goes through the beef so the bamboo isn’t exposed, and do not let the tip of the skewer be exposed either. Put 3 pieces on each skewer, and lay them flat on a plate.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Oil and preheat the grill to medium. Tear off 2 pieces of aluminum foil, each 8-inch wide, and fold them in half lengthwise so that you have a long rectangle about 4 inches wide. Place this onto the grill, and this is where the handles of the skewers will rest to prevent them from burning.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Brush the top side of the skewers with coconut milk, then place them on the grill, coconut-nut-milk-side down. Brush the other side of the skewers with coconut milk and grill for a minute or so just until it has nice grill marks and is about halfway cooked. Flip the skewers and grill the other side just until done. These are small and thin skewers and should only take 2-3 minutes to cook, and you do not need to cover them. If you have space on the grill, you can grill your bread along with the skewers, otherwise you can grill them after.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: When ready to serve, finish the ajaad by placing the cucumber, shallots, and chilies into a small bowl then pour the cooled vinegar mixture over them. (Tip: You don’t want to combine the cucumber with the pickling liquid longer than about 10 minutes before serving to preserve the crunch and freshness of the cucumber.) Pour the peanut sauce onto a plate with a little depth, which will allow people to dip the whole skewer in one go. Serve the beef satay on a platter alongside the peanut sauce, ajaad, and toast.

title: Air Fryer Chicken Quesadilla
