title: 15-Minute Korean Noodle Soup
description: This 15-minute Korean noodle soup is a perfect one-pot dinner for your busy weekdays. You only need a few ingredients and some leftovers in your pantry to make this hearty dish that is bursting with flavor and loaded with nutrients.

ingredients.name: kimchi (, roughly chopped with 2 teaspoons juice)
Pacific Foods Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth
(180 g) somen noodles (2 bundles) (, or 2 packs instant noodles (without the seasoning packs))
Rotisserie chicken (or other leftover meat), shredded ((Optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring the broth to a boil and add the noodles and bok choy. Cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: (Optional) You can add the egg to the broth along with the bok choy to make runny poached eggs. Alternatively, you can top the noodles with raw egg yolks. Or you can fry the eggs in a separate pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the broth is done cooking, add the sauce mixture and stir to incorporate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately as a main dish.

title: Gilgeori toast (Korean street toast)
description: This veggie-packed Korean street toast is easy and delicious! Experience the streets of Korea with a few ingredients you most likely have in your fridge.

ingredients.name: bread (white, wheat, multi-grain, or milk bread)
green cabbage, yangbaechu (양배추) up to 4 ounces ( 1 cup, packed)
stalks garlic chives, buchu (or 1 small scallion)
butter (or margarine or olive oil), or to taste, divided
sugar to taste (Halmeoni Toast uses a heaping tablespoon)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the cabbage, onion, and carrot. Cut the garlic chives into about 1.5-inch long pieces. If using a scallion, thinly slice diagonally.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large non-stick pan, melt butter or margarine (use as needed or to taste) over medium heat. Place both slices of the bread, moving them around and flipping over. Toast until golden-brown, 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small, deep bowl or cup (2-cup size), place the veggies (reserving about 1/5) along with a pinch of salt. Crack the egg in it. Mix everything well by hitting them down with a pair of tongs or a fork until the veggies and egg are well incorporated and reduced in volume, about 20 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same pan, melt some more butter or margarine over medium heat. Add the egg and veggie mixture, flattening and shaping it to a large round with a spatula. Place the reserved veggies on top. Cook the mixture until it turns lightly golden, about 3 minutes. Carefully flip it over with a spatula, add more butter or margarine, and cook the other side for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the omelet on one piece of toast. Sprinkle it with sugar and top with a good squirt of ketchup to taste, and place the other slice of bread on top and serve.

title: Scallion Oil Noodles
description: Easy Chinese noodles tossed with scallion oil-- Scallion oil noodles

ingredients.name: cooking oil ( , vegetable oil or lard)
green onions ( , skinny scallion, cut into long segments around 5 cm long)
servings yellow alkaline noodle ( , or thin ramen noodles)
tsp. dark soy sauce ( , optional for darker color)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the green onions into sections around 5-8 cm long. Add garlic clove into pieces and cut 4 slices of ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add oil in a wok, add garlic, scallion white and ginger along with the oil. Heat over high fire until the white part becomes slightly browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add green onion sections. Simmer until the green onion section becomes crispy and browned.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat and then add 1 tablespoon of Sichuan peppercorn. Let the remaining heat from the oil motivating the aroma. Then cool down.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook the noodle and then soak in clean water. Drain completely and then add 1.5 tablespoons of the scallion oil. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the basic sauce in. Mix well. This is for 2 servings of noodles. And lastly, top with crispy scallion. Optionally, drop 1 teaspoon of Chili oil. Serve directly.

title: Sopa de Letras
description: Sopa de letras is a delicious and hearty homemade Mexican alphabet soup. It's a warming childhood favorite perfect for the whole family!

ingredients.name: chicken bouillon ((vegetable and tomato also work))
Optional toppings: Avocado, queso fresco or cotija cheese, lime juice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 1 cup of broth, the tomatoes, onion, bouillon, garlic, and salt to a blender. Blend until smooth and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a medium pot over medium heat. Add the alphabet pasta and stir to coat it evenly with oil. Toast until golden brown for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in the blended tomato mixture and stir to combine. Cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes until the mixture starts to darken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the remaining 5 cups of broth, increase the heat to high, and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 more minutes or until the pasta is tender and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Taste and adjust salt if necessary. Serve immediately.

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Recipe with Peas and Artichokes
description: Easy lemon garlic shrimp with peas and artichokes. Perfect on top of orzo pasta or rice.

ingredients.name: (about 454 g) large shrimp or prawns, peeled, deviened, tail-on (if frozen, thaw properly before use)
Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix spices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place shrimp in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and about 2 1/2 tsps of the spice mixture (keep rest of spice mixture for later.) Set shrimp aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet like this one, heat 2 tbsp Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add onions. Cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add garlic. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more, stirring regularly, until fragrant and golden (do not brown garlic.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add white wine. Cook to reduce by half, then add lemon juice, honey and broth. Raise heat and bring the liquid to a boil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add peas and artichokes. Season with salt and pepper and the remainder of the spice mixture. Cook for 10 minutes or so until peas are cooked through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add shrimp and cook until just pink (this will be very quick, so watch for shrimp to turn color, toss as needed.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from heat. Sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese to your liking and garnish with fresh parsley.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot with a side of simple orzo or this Lebanese rice.

title: Traditional Greek Salad recipe (Horiatiki / Xoriatiki)
description: Looking for how to make Greek salad (Horiatiki) that actually tastes like the one served in Greece? Then you have to try this authentic Greek salad recipe!

ingredients.name: medium red onion, sliced into rings
of a cup extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: As said before, the secret to make a delicious Greek salad is in the ingredients: juicy tomatoes, crisp cucumber, creamy feta cheese, good quality extra virgin olive oil and some tangy black olives will really make a difference.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make this Greek salad recipe (Horiatiki), start by preparing your vegetables. Wash thoroughly and strain the vegetables. Cut the tomatoes into wedges, slice the onion into thin rings, cut the cucumber in thick slices and place everything in a large bowl. Don’t forget to add the olives as well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season with salt and pour over the extra virgin olive oil and vinegar. Toss everything together, so that the flavours mix. Be careful not to add too much salt, as the feta cheese and the olives are salty enough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Greek salad (Horiatiki) is always served with feta cheese on top, a drizzle of olive oil and dried oregano. Enjoy your delicious Greek salad as a side dish or as a light summer meal with lots of crusty bread aside!

title: No-Machine Soft Ice Cream Bars - Thai Tea Flavor
description: Soft and creamy ice cream bars without needing a machine but instead adding tapioca starch. It's an old-school treat in Thailand and a brilliantly easy way to make ice cream at home!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare your molds. If using a dish, grease the bottom and sides with oil. Cut a piece of parchment paper so it's as wide as the longest side of your container. Line the dish with the parchment, leaving plenty of overhang on two sides. Press the parchment into the oil so it sticks, and use a bulldog clip to secure the overhang onto the edge of the dish to prevent the paper from moving around. For easier removal, you can line with another piece of parchment, going across the first piece so you have overhang on all 4 sides. Tip: I recommend using good quality, sturdy parchment paper for this. Cheap filmy parchment might tear as you try to pull the ice cream out (as I found out the hard way!)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Steep the tea leaves in hot-off-the-boil water for 5 mins, then strain using a fine mesh strainer, pressing out most of the liquid. You should end up with a little more than 1 cup of tea (1 cup exactly is fine, but it should be less than 1 ¼ cups.) Allow the tea dust to settle to the bottom for a minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, put the tapioca starch into a small mixing bowl, add about ⅓ cup of the evaporated milk and whisk to dissolve the starch - making extra sure there are no lumps. Pour the starch slurry into a medium size pot, followed by the remaining evaporated milk.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the sweetened condensed milk, whipping cream, and salt to the pot. Then pour in the tea, holding back the last little bit so as to not pour in too much of the tea dust. Stir until the condensed milk is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat on medium and stir constantly with a rubber spatula, scraping the bottom. The mixture will slowly start to thicken, and once the mixture starts to bubble and is no longer getting any thicker, it is fully cooked. (To check for bubbling you'll have to stop stirring for a few seconds and watch for movement.)Remove from heat and, while still hot, pour or ladle it into your molds. Pop any big buggles with a toothpick, then allow the ice cream to cool to room temp before freezing for at least 6 hours before unmolding.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To unmold, I highly recommend watching the video to see how this is done so you have a better idea. If using a cake pan or a dish, use a thin knife or metal offset spatula and run it along the edges that don't have parchment paper. You can dip the knife in hot water if you're having a hard time inserting. Carefully lift the parchment overhang to remove the ice cream from the pan. If you're having a hard time removing, try running the knife around the edges one more time, especially around any rounded corners, or wait a minute; resisting the urge to dip the mold in hot water as this ice cream melts quickly.Once it's out, place it on a cutting board and use a knife to trim the edges if you wish, then cut into blocks of your desired size. If making bars, insert a sturdy bamboo skewer into the ice cream, using a knife or something sturdy to push against the top to hold the ice cream steady. Peel it off the paper and enjoy!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To store: wrap each piece in parchment paper to prevent them from sticking to each other.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Tip: Because of the added starch, these are soft and creamy but also melt quickly, so work quickly when unmolding the ice cream.

title: Carrot Ginger Soup
description: Carrot Ginger Soup - healthy and refreshing soup made with roasted carrots and sweet potatoes blended together with coconut milk, vegetable broth, and sauteed onions and ginger.

ingredients.name: coconut milk (, (can be subbed for almond milk))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 ℉.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and evenly disperse the carrots, garlic, and sweet potatoes on top. Drizzle with olive oil and place in the oven to roast for one hour, flipping halfway. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add the onion and ginger, sauteing until onions turn translucent, about 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. When the onions start to brown, take off the heat and transfer to a high powered blender along with the carrots, garlic, sweet potatoes, orange zest, coconut milk, and vegetable broth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Blend on high for 60 seconds or until smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour into bowls and garnish with pumpkin seeds and serve with bread.

title: Traditional kimchi (Pogi Kimchi)
description: This Korean kimchi recipe shows you everything you need to know about how to make traditional cabbage kimchi. With this small batch recipe, you’ll find it not that difficult to make good authentic kimchi at home.

ingredients.name: large Napa cabbage, baechu (배추), (about 5 to 6 pounds, or 2 small (about 3 pounds each))
Korean coarse sea salt, gulgeun soguem (굵은소금)
dasima, 다시마 (dried kelp), about 2 to 3 inch square) - optional
saeujeot, 새우젓 (salted and fermented shrimp), (roughly chopped )
- 4 raw shrimps, about 2 ounces, finely minced or ground (- optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the thick white part of the cabbage in half lengthwise. Then, slowly pull it apart to separate into two pieces. Do the same for each half to make quarters. Running the knife through all the way would unnecessarily cut off the cabbage leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, dissolve 1/2 cup of salt in 5 cups of water. Thoroughly bathe each cabbage quarter in the salt water one at a time, shake off excess water back into the bowl, and then transfer to another bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using the other half cup of salt and starting from the outermost leaf, generously sprinkle salt over the thick white part of each leaf (similar to salting a piece of meat). Try to salt all the cabbage quarters with 1/2 cup salt, but you can use a little more if needed. Repeat with the rest of the cabbage quarters. Pour the remaining salt water from the first bowl over the cabbage. Set aside for about 6 - 8 hours, rotating the bottom ones to the top every 2 - 3 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: The cabbages should be ready to be washed when the white parts of the leaves are bendable. It's okay to have a bit of resistance. Rinse thoroughly 3 times, especially between the white parts. Drain well, cut side down.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Meanwhile, make the optional dasima broth by boiling a small piece (2 to 3 inch square) in 1.5 cups of water for 5 minutes, and cool. Mix the rice flour with 1/2 cup water (or optional dasima broth) and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until it thickens to a thin paste, and cool. Yields about 3 - 4 tablespoons.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Prepare the garlic, ginger and saeujeot. Combine all the seasoning ingredients, including the rice paste and about 1/2 cup water (or the optional dashima broth), and mix well. Set aside until the gochugaru dissolves slightly and becomes pasty.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cut the radish and optional pear into matchsticks (use a mandoline if desired), transferring to a large bowl. Cut the scallions diagonally into about 1-inch long pieces. Add the prepared seasoning mix to the radish, and mix well by hand. Throw in the scallions, and mix everything lightly. Taste a little bit. It should be a little too salty to eat as is. You can add salt, more salted shrimp or fish sauce, as needed. Let it sit for about 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld nicely.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut off the tough stem part from each cabbage quarter, leaving enough to hold the leaves together. Place one cabbage quarter in the bowl with the radish mix. Spread the radish mix over each leaf, one to two tablespoons for large leaves. (Eyeball the stuffing into 4 parts and use one part for each cabbage quarter.)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Fold the leaf part of the cabbage over toward the stem and nicely wrap it with the outermost leaf. Place it, cut side up, in a jar or airtight container. Repeat with the remaining cabbages. If you have loose large leaves, you can use them to cover the top of the kimchi (see note 1). Once all the cabbages are in the jar or airtight container, press down hard to remove air pockets. To collect any remaining seasoning, rinse the bowl with 1/2 cup of water (or the remaining optional dasima broth), and add it to the kimchi container. Close the lid.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Leave it out at room temperature for a full day or two. It can be longer, depending on the weather and how fast you want your kimchi to ripen. Then, store in the fridge. (see note 2)

title: Wonton Wrappers
description: Homemade Wonton Wrappers recipe.

ingredients.name: Starch for dusting ( , cornstarch or wheat starch recommended)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix flour with salt and then add egg in. Stir well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slowly add water and keep stirring the mixture. Then grasp with hand to form a ball. Adjust the amount of water based on the water absorbing capacity of your brand of flour. Stop adding water when there is no dry flour in your bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the dough in a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap and rest for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: And then knead the dough again for around 8-15 minutes until smooth. Rest for around 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Divide dough in half. Press on half down and roll out to a larger wrapper around 3mm in thickness. Fold up and cover with plastic wrap again for the next resting process.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finish the other half and reset both for another 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Take one larger wrapper out and divide in half. Roll each of the halves into paper-thin wrapper or as thin as possible. Keep dusting. Then cut the large wrappers into small squares around 8cm.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Repeat to finish all.

title: Chinese Sausage Fried Rice ข้าวผัดกุนเชียง
description: A childhood comfort food for many growing up in Asia. It's easy and quick, making it the perfect weeknight meal. Make sure you choose a good brand of Chinese sausage that are not too salty, and feel free to change up the veggies.

ingredients.name: chopped gai lan, stems cut in thin rounds, leaves in ribbons
For serving: chopped cilantro or green onions, cucumber slices, and a wedge of lime

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the sausage to a wok and spread out into a single layer. Turn heat on medium high and let them cook without stirring until they start to brown on one side and render a little bit of fat. Toss the sausage and keep cooking briefly just to cook them through. Do not cook them for too long or you will render out too much fat and cause the sausage to become too salty. Remove from heat, then remove the sausage from the pan, leaving any rendered fat behind.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add more oil to coat the bottom of the pan. Turn the heat on medium and add onions and carrots and cook for about 2 minutes or until onions are translucent. Add garlic and cook for another 30 seconds, then add gailan and toss just until wilted.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Push veggies to one side to create space for the eggs, and move the wok so the veggies are sitting a bit off the element. If the pan is dry, you can add a bit more oil for the eggs here. Add the eggs and break the yolks, then let them set about half way.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Scramble briefly, then add the rice and pour the soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and pepper onto the rice and toss everything together briefly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the sausage back in and continue tossing until the rice is all separated and evenly coated in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once well mixed, let the rice sit without stirring for 10-15 seconds to toast slightly, then toss to mix and let it toast again. Do this 3 times, or more if your rice is a bit moist, until the rice is dry and some of the grains have browned.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from heat and plate. Top with some chopped cilantro or green onions and serve with fresh cucumber slices. I like to squeeze a bit of lime over it as well to cut the richness. Enjoy!

title: Taco Soup Recipe
description: This taco soup recipe is hearty, healthy, and ready in under 1 hour! Made with ground beef, taco seasoning, beans, corn, peppers, and more.

ingredients.name: ancho chili powder ((or regular chili powder))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the bell peppers, onion, Anaheim pepper, and garlic and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ground beef, chili powder, ancho chili powder, salt, ground cumin, paprika, and oregano. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, crumbling the meat with a spoon and stirring occasionally until the meat has browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir in the diced tomatoes, pinto beans, black beans, and corn. Cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the lime juice and cilantro. Taste and season with more salt as needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve in bowls topped with shredded cheese, sour cream, and tortilla chips.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Eggplant with Whipped Feta
description: Tender and perfectly charred, this Mediterranean Grilled Eggplant is finished with a drizzle of olive oil infused with garlic and jalapeno. It's a warm and smoky appetizer that's best served Mediterranean-style with whipped feta and pita.

ingredients.name: jalapeno, (finely chopped, remove ribs and seeds if you need it to be more mild)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice and salt the eggplant. Lay the eggplant slices on a large tray lined with paper towel. Salt the eggplant generously and let it sit for 20 to 30 minutes while you work on other things. Beads of water will form. Wipe the eggplant dry and remove excess salt before grilling.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the garlic, jalapeno and olive oil sauce. In a small bowl, combine 3 tablespoons olive oil with the lemon juice, garlic, and jalapeno. Add a pinch of kosher salt and set aside (the lemon and olive oil will tame the hot peppers and the pungent taste of garlic).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If serving with whipped feta, follow this recipe but you do not need the nuts in this case.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When ready, heat a gas grill or an indoor griddle over medium-high and lightly oil the grates. Make sure the grill is fully heated before adding the eggplant.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Brush the eggplant slices on one side with olive oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Arrange the eggplant on the heated grill, oiled side down first. Grill anywhere for 3 to 4 minutes on this side or until some char marks form on the bottom, then turn over and brush the other side of the eggplant with olive oil. Cook for another 3 to 4 minutes or until the eggplant is tender and good char marks have formed on both sides.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Arrange the grilled eggplant on a large platter and immediately season with sumac and drizzle the olive oil and jalapeno mixture all over. Add the plate of feta and warmed pita bread for serving.

title: Refreshing Watermelon Feta Salad recipe
description: An absolutely delicious watermelon feta salad recipe. Watermelon is with no doubt the fruit of the summer and this refreshing combination of juicy, chilled slices of watermelon and salty, creamy feta cheese make for a Greek salad summer…

ingredients.name: watermelon, seedless and cut into chunks (35oz.)
feta cheese, cut into cubes or crumbled (9 oz.)
a bunch of mint, leaves only, chopped
of a cup extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this watermelon feta salad recipe start by removing the rind and seeds from the watermelon, and cut into triangular chunks. Cut the feta cheese into small cubes, or bigger if you prefer, and place both into a large bowl. Slice the onions into paper-thin slices and place in the bowl with the rest of the ingredients, add the chopped mint leaves and the kalamata olives and set aside. (If you choose to prepare this watermelon feta salad recipe using cucumber too, then peel and slice the cucumber into half-moons and place in the bowl with rest of the ingredients).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the dressing for the watermelon feta salad. In a small bowl add the olive oil, lemon juice and brown sugar and season. Whisk the ingredients to combine, taste and adjust the seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the dressing over the watermelon feta salad and toss to coat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the watermelon feta salad among individual serving plates and serve immediately. Enjoy!

title: Aloo Paratha Recipe (Stuffed Potato Paratha)
description: Aloo Paratha is a popular Punjabi breakfast made with unleavened whole wheat flatbread stuffed with a spiced, tangy mashed potato filling.

title: Oi Muchim (Spicy Cucumber Salad)
description: An easy cucumber side dish that's spicy, slightly sweet and tangy! It'll be an excellent complement to any of your main dishes.

ingredients.name: Korean red chili pepper flakes (gochugaru (고추가루) – use less if desired)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice the cucumber (1/8 to 1/4-inch thick). Toss gently with salt and set aside for about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain excess liquid. Avoid squeezing them because they will bruise. Mix well with all of the remaining ingredients. Taste a little and adjust the seasonings if necessary.

title: Easy Chicken Enchiladas
description: These Easy Chicken Enchiladas make the best Mexican dinner! They're stuffed with shredded chicken and cheese, topped with red enchilada sauce and baked.

ingredients.name: corn or flour tortillas ((see note if using flour tortillas))
optional toppings: diced onions, chopped cilantro, sour cream, shredded lettuce, cotija cheese

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350ºF. In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, ¼ cup enchilada sauce and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Mix together and taste. Season with more salt and pepper as needed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using corn tortillas: Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and heat them in the microwave for 1 minute, flipping the them halfway through until all of them are warm and pliable.If using flour tortillas: Microwave the tortillas on a plate for 1 minute, flipping them halfway through until all of them are warm and pliable.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assemble the enchiladas by filling each tortilla evenly with the shredded chicken mixture and 1 cup of shredded cheese. Roll the tortillas tightly to close and place in large baking dish seam side down.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the remaining 1 ¾ cup enchilada sauce over the tortillas, top with the remaining 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, and bake for 20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately and garnish with desired toppings.

title: Fried Eggplant Recipe with Green Peppers and Tomatoes
description: Vegan and gluten free fried eggplant recipe with green peppers and tomatoes! Serve it as a vegetarian main with warm pita bread, rice or your favorite grain.

ingredients.name: large eggplant (washed, dried, sliced in 1/2" rounds)
large green bell peppers (washed, dried, sliced in 1"- wide strips)
5-6 large slicing tomato (washed, dried, sliced in 1/2"rounds)
healthy cooking oil (more as needed (see post above for more information))
fresh mint or parsley leaves for garnish (optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Spread eggplant slices on paper towels and sprinkle generously with kosher salt. Let sit for 30 minutes to sweat out any bitterness. Pat dry when ready.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oil on medium-high heat (be sure the oil is shimmering but not smoking). Start by frying green peppers, skin side down, until tender and skin turns brown. (Do this carefully and use a splatter screen as recommended.) Remove from heat and place on paper towels to drain. Sprinkle with a little salt and a generous sprinkle of sumac.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same frying pan, now fry the eggplant. Do this very carefully (use tongs to keep your distance and a splatter screen to cover the pan or skillet). Oil should still be hot or else eggplant will absorb way too much of it. When edges of one side turn golden brown, flip over. When eggplant turns golden brown on both sides, remove from heat and place on paper towels to drain. Sprinkle generously with sumac.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If needed, add a little bit of oil to your frying pan. Now, fry the tomatoes for two minutes then add the garlic. Cook another 4 to 5 minutes, tossing gently. Turn the heat down and add 2 tbsp of vinegar, salt, and a generous pinch of sumac. When the tomatoes are tender, releasing juices and turning bright orange in color, turn the heat off.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the fried eggplant dish. Grab a large serving platter, layer a bit of the eggplant at the bottom, then add green peppers, then the saucy tomatoes on top. Repeat as needed till you have all the veggies on your platter. Garnish with fresh mint and walnut hearts.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature with a side of pita or Lebanese rice.

title: Delicious Greek Lentil Salad Recipe with Feta cheese (Fakes Salata)
description: An absolutely delicious and super healthy Greek lentil salad recipe with feta cheese and fresh vegetables. Whether eaten as a snack, side or light vegetarian meal, this super easy feta lentil salad recipe never fails to impress!

ingredients.name: brown lentils, picked and rinsed (14 oz.)
2-3 peppers (red, orange, yellow), roasted and sliced
cherry tomatoes, cut in half or 1 juicy tomato, cut in cubes
a handful fresh parsley (or dill), chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek style lentil salad recipe with feta cheese, start by cooking the lentils. Place the lentils in a colander and rinse them thoroughly under running water. Drain and place them in a large pot. Cover the lentils with a 5-6cm of cold water, season with salt, add the bay leaf and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to a gentle simmer and cook for about 20-25 minutes. For this Greek lentil feta salad recipe the lentils should be cooked, but still retain a slight tooth. Keep in mind that different varieties of lentils cook at different times, so have a taste after 15 minutes and be careful not to overcook them!

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the vegetables. For this Greek feta lentil salad recipe, you could use the peppers raw, cut into little cubes or roasted. Roasting the peppers, until slightly soft, will give extra flavour. To roast the peppers, cut them in half crosswise and place on a baking tray, lined with parchment pepper. Drizzle with a little olive oil and season with salt. Bake in preheated oven at 200-220C for about 20 minutes, or until softened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the dressing for this Greek lentil salad recipe, add all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the lentils are cooked, drain them in a colander and place under cold running water to stop the cooking process. Once cooled slightly place lentils in a large serving bowl and toss with dressing. Add the chopped onion, cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, olives and roasted peppers (sliced) and blend. Wait to add the fresh herbs just before serving. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Stew (African-Style)
description: This stew is like no other. It's easy, aromatic, and flavorful with a thick, rich tomato-based sauce. For a great weeknight meal, pair it with steaming rice and plantains. And you'll have your new favorite chicken dinner!

ingredients.name: ¼-½ cup (62-125g) oil ((canola, olive, or vegetable oil))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and Creole seasoning. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat until hot, and then add the chicken and sauté, stirring frequently and scraping any browned bits off the bottom of the pot until the chicken is brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If using fresh tomatoes, blend tomatoes, onions, and garlic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If using tomato sauce, saute the onion and garlic until tender (4-5 minutes).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the tomato blend (or sauce, onion, and garlic) into the pot of chicken, add the thyme, smoked paprika, curry powder, bay leaf, and bouillon, bring to a boil, and let it simmer until tender (depending on the chicken), 20-30 minutes, frequently stirring to prevent the stew from sticking to the bottom of the saucepan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add carrots, green onions, and parsley. Cook for five more minutes. Adjust the thickness of the stew with water or stock.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with salt according to preference. Remove bay leaf.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve over warm rice.

title: Leftover Ham Fried Rice with Pineapple
description: Turn your leftover ham into a quick meal that tastes better than Chinese takeout. Learn all the secrets to creating the best fried rice without a wok. {Gluten-Free}

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix the soy sauce and pineapple juice together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to a large nonstick pan and heat it over medium-high heat until hot. Add the ham and pineapples. Cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized, about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the bell peppers. Stir a few times to mix well, then transfer everything to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil and the garlic into the skillet. Stir a few times to release the fragrance. Add the rice and spread it out with your spatula. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the rice is lightly toasted.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Move the rice to one side of the pan and add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of oil to the other side of the skillet. Add the beaten eggs onto the oil. Let it cook until the bottom sets, 30 seconds. Scramble a few times until most of the eggs are cooked but some parts are still runny. Mix the rice into the egg, chopping and stirring to mix everything together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Move the rice to the edge of the pan to make a well in the center. Pour the soy sauce and pineapple juice into the center. Let it cook for a few seconds to evaporate the liquid. Stir everything together until the rice is evenly coated with the seasonings. Let it cook, stirring occasionally, until the moisture is cooked off.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the cooked ham mixture back into the pan. Stir everything together. Taste the rice. Add a pinch of salt and mix again, if needed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot as a main dish.

title: Dak Galbi (Spicy Stir-fried Chicken)
description: A spicy stir-fried chicken dish made with boneless chicken pieces, rice cakes (tteokbokki tteok), green cabbage, sweet potato, and other vegetables.

ingredients.name: small Korean sweet potato (goguma 고구마), about 6 ounces
tteokbokki tteok 떡볶기 떡 (10 to 12 pieces), rice cakes
shredded cheese (mozzarella, pizza blend, etc.) or more to taste -- optional
green or red leaf lettuce and ssamjang - optional (see note)
gochugaru, 고추가루 (Use 1 to 1.5 TBS for less spicy dish)
Korean curry powder 카레가루 (Powder form of curry sauce mix )
corn or oligo syrup (or more sugar)
sheet roasted gim (김), dried seaweed sheet

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the rice cakes in cold water for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all the sauce ingredients well in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the chicken into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine the chicken pieces with the sauce (reserving one tablespoon if you’re going to make fried rice at the end) and marinate while preparing vegetables.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut the sweet potato in half lengthwise and then thinly slice crosswise and slightly diagonally. Cut the cabbage, kkaennip, and scallion into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a pan over medium high heat. You can add a tablespoon of oil if you want, but it should not be necessary. Add the chicken, sweet potatoes, rice cakes, and cabbages. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Lower the heat if the ingredients (especially the rice cakes) stick to the pan and browns too fast. The steam from the vegetables should keep them from sticking to the pan, but you can also add about 1/4 cup of water.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the kkaennip and scallion and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes until the rice cake and the sweet potato pieces turn soft. By then the chicken should be cooked through as well. If using cheese, you can add it in this step with 2 to 3 minutes remaining.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Optional Fried Rice

title: Glutinous Rice Ball with Crushed Peanuts
description: One of the another yummy Chinese sticky rice ball dessert with peanuts, roasted sesame seeds and coconut.

ingredients.name: lukewarm water or slightly more to adjust

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, place glutinous rice flour and rice flour. Add warm water and knead for form dough. Divide the dough into 7-10 portions; roll each portion into round ball.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring some water to boil in a pot and cook all glutinous rice balls until they float on the surface. Stir to prevent them sticking; transfer the balls out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add brown sugar and water in saucepan. Cook until the sugar dissolves into syrup over medium heat. Then low the heat and cook for another one or 2 minutes until the syrup is thickened as preferred.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roast or pan fry the peanuts until crispy and then crush.

steps.title: Step 5

title: Grandma's Garlic Shrimp Recipe
description: This sweet garlicky shrimp is a dish my grandma made that is so good I still remember it to this day. Soft, chunky pieces of garlic in a sweet-salty sauce. It's so tasty, and so quick and easy!

ingredients.name: Chopped cilantro or green onions for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the sauce by combining the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, water and shrimp paste. Stir to dissolve the sugar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pound garlic until chunky. Remove all but about 1 clove’s worth from the mortar. To the garlic in the mortar, add peppercorns, and cilantro stems and pound into a paste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Dry the shrimp well with a paper towel, and if you’re leaving the tail on be sure to dry the tail extra carefully as water can collect there and cause a lot of splattering in the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a wok over high heat, add enough oil to coat the bottom. Once the oil is very hot, lay the shrimp down in one layer; you will need to do this in 2 batches. Let the shrimp sear until at least halfway cooked and slightly browned on the underside. Flip and cook the other side just until done (timing will depend on the size of the shrimp, but it should take no more than a few minutes total). Remove the pan from the heat and take out the shrimp, leaving all the oil behind. Repeat with the other half.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Allow the pan to cool for a minute, then add the chunky garlic and turn the heat back on to medium low. Add more oil if needed, then saute the garlic for about 2 minutes or until softened and the edges start to turn golden. Add the herb paste and saute for 15-20 seconds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the heat up to medium and add the cooked shrimp including all the collected juices. Add the sauce mixture, then toss for about 30 seconds to mix and reduce the sauce slightly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Plate and garnish with chopped cilantro and/or green onions and/or fried garlic, if desired. Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Smoked Salmon Dip
description: Smoked Salmon Dip - a super easy elegant appetizer that is soft, creamy, smoky with a tanginess from sour cream and lemon, freshness from dill and a hint of saltiness from the capers. Such an indulgent party recipe to ring in the holidays!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the smoked salmon.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all ingredients to a large mixing bowl and stir with a wooden spoon to combine. The mixture will be a bit liquidy. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 30 minutes before serving. Best served with baguette slices!

title: Homemade Tortilla Chips
description: Crispy and crunchy homemade tortilla chips made with only 3 ingredients. The perfect Mexican appetizer for dipping and snacking.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil, (for frying (avocado, canola, and corn oil all work))
Flaky or fine sea salt, (for seasoning)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Line a large baking sheet or plate with paper towels and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the corn tortillas into fourths for large tortilla chips or into sixths for small tortilla chips.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fill a heavy skillet or Dutch oven with ¼ - ½ -inch of oil or enough oil to fully submerge the chips.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the oil over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F or a small piece of tortilla sizzles when placed in the oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add a handful of tortilla wedges into the oil and fry for about 2 minutes, flipping halfway through with metal tongs or a slotted spoon, until the chips are crisp and turn a beautiful golden yellow color. Transfer the chips to the lined baking sheet or plate to drain off any excess oil. Continue working in batches so as not to completely crowd the skillet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle the chips with salt and serve immediately.

title: Potato Salad Recipe with Tuna
description: Bright, flavor-packed Potato Salad with tuna, green beans and tomatoes. A couple of spices add depth, and a simple dressing pulls it together.This has hints of Nicoise salad and the popular Spanish Potato Salad known as Ensaladilla Rusa.

ingredients.name: fingerling potatoes or small red potatoes
small tomatoes, (such as campari tomatoes, or small Roma tomatoes, cut into wedges)
pearl red onions or small shallots, (quartered)
Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place fingerling potatoes in a large pot and cover well with water. Boil for 10 minutes or until you are able to stick a fork through potatoes. Using a slotted spoon, remove potatoes from boiling water and transfer to a plate for now. Do not discard water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a large bowl with iced water and set aside near the pot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same cooking pot, with the water boiling, add green beans. Cook 4 minutes or so. Drain, and immediately place the green beans in the bowl with the iced water (ice bath) to stop cooking (this helps them keep their vivid green color too.) When cooled enough, remove green beans from ice bath and pat dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut fingerling potatoes in halves length-wise, and place them in a large mixing bowl. Add green beans, tomatoes, onions (or shallots), tuna (crumble it up a bit before adding), and garlic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Season with salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, and crushed red pepper. Combine Early Harvest EVOO and vinegar then add to the salad. Give everything a gentle toss making sure all the ingredients are well-coated. Taste and adjust seasoning or add more smoked paprika, cumin, or crushed red pepper to your liking (remember, flavors meld with time.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Assemble spring greens or butter lettuce on a nice platter. Arrange the salad on top. Enjoy!

title: Homemade Cream of Chicken Soup
description: Homemade Cream of Chicken Soup - rich, creamy, thick and completely made from scratch soup. This cream of chicken soup starts with a roux and doesn't require cream to bring out all those wonderful flavors.

ingredients.name: medium carrots (, sliced in thick chunks (about 1-1 ½ cups))
(1g) freshly ground black pepper (more or less to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat butter in a medium pot over medium heat. Add onions, garlic, carrots, celery, thyme, and bay leaf. Saute for 5-6 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the flour and stir until fully incorporated. Follow with adding, evaporated milk and chicken broth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring everything to boil, constantly stirring, until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add shredded chicken, creole seasoning, chicken bouillon, Worcestershire sauce, and peas. Add salt and pepper to taste and adjust the seasonings to suit your preference.

steps.title: Step 5

title: Grilled Halloumi and Roasted Vegetables Salad Recipe
description: A delicious Halloumi salad recipe, packed with Mediterranean flavours! Soft and colourful roasted vegetables mixed with grilled Halloumi and crunchy leafy greens coated in an exquisite oil and lemon sauce.

ingredients.name: of a cup extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 200C and prepare the vegetables for the halloumi salad. Halve and deseed the peppers and cut each half into 4 pieces. Cut the red onion into 8 wedges. Halve the zucchinis lengthways and then slice into 2cm chunks. Top and tail the aubergine, cut it in half and slice. Place all the vegetables (and the garlic) in a large baking tray and sprinkle with some fresh thyme and rosemary leaves. Season and drizzle with some olive oil and toss them to coat. Roast the vegetables for about 35 minutes, until golden, soft and cooked through. While the veggies are cooking, get them a good stir every now and again.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare the dressing for the halloumi salad (oil and lemon sauce/ ladolemono), add into a blender all the ingredients and blend, until combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the Halloumi cheese in a hot frying or griddle pan and cook until it turns golden brown, turning half way through cooking (about a minute on each side).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Assemble the Halloumi salad. Put the leafy greens and the roasted vegetables in a large salad bowl. Pour in the sauce (be careful not to add too much sauce, because the greens will become wilt and no longer crunchy). Toss to coat everything in the dressing; have a taste and add some more seasoning, if needed. Tear the Halloumi into pieces over the salad and serve while still warm. Enjoy!

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts Recipe
description: Roasted Brussels Sprouts are an oven-roasted vegetable dish made with fresh sprouts, olive oil, dried herbs, salt, and pepper. The sprouts are cut evenly and roasted at high heat until tender and browned.

title: Chinese Spring Roll
description: Chinese deep-fried spring roll for Chinese New Year

ingredients.name: shredded napa cabbage (, white part recommended )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate pork with all the marinating sauce in a small bowl. Set aside for around 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up around 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in wok, add shredded pork in and fry until there is no pink color any more. Transfer immediately to avoid overcook since we will deep fry later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Finely shredded other vegetables. Heat up around 1/2 tablespoon oil in wok and fry all the other side ingredients until slightly soft. Sprinkle pinch of salt and mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare all the ingredients (fried pork and side ingredients) and your spring roll wrappers. Whisk the slurry in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Assemble the spring roll one by one as the picture showed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pre-heat the oil for deep-frying in a small pot or a wok. When the oil is ready, place a chopstick in and there will be lots of small bubbles around it. Or you can use leftover wrappers for testing. The content can float on surface immediately. The oil temperature should be around 160 degree C or 320 degree F.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Slowly slide the spring rolls in and deep fry in small batches. Deep fry until the spring rolls become lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat the oil around2-3 minutes (oil temperature around 190~200 degree C or 390 degree F )and then place all of the spring rolls in and then continue frying for 10 seconds. Watch carefully until the they are almost browned.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: And then drain on a paper towel before serving. You can serve along with some of your favorite sauces.

title: Gamjatang (Spicy Pork Bone Stew)
description: Spicy, hearty Korean stew made with pork bones, potatoes and other vegetables

ingredients.name: of pork spine or neck bones
to 6 ounces young cabbage, putbaechu, 풋배추 or napa cabbage (1 cup, boiled)
to 8 perilla leaves, kkaennip, 깻잎, roughly sliced
crushed perilla seeds, 들깨가루 (Or sesame seeds)
gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes) -- use a teaspoon or 2 more for a spicier stew)
gukganjang, 국간장, soup soy sauce (or fish sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the bones for an hour or longer in cold water. Change the water half way through if you can. Drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Drop the bones in. Let it come back to a boil. This will take about 7 to 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the bones. Wash the bones under running water. Clean the pot. Return the bones back to the pot. Add 8 cups of water, the onion, garlic, ginger and scallion. Bring it to a boil. Continue to boil, uncovered, for 10 minutes over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low. Continue to boil, covered, for 50 minutes to an hour until the meat is tender and the broth is milky.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix the seasoning ingredients well together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring a medium pot of water to a rapid boil. Blanch the cabbage until the white parts turn soft, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove the cabbage from the pot (keep the hot water to boil the potatoes) and shock in cold water to stop the cooking. Drain and squeeze out water. Cut into 2 to 3-inch lengths.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix the cabbage well with 1 tablespoon of the seasoning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cut the potatoes in half with the skin on. In the pot of water used to blanch the cabbage, boil the potatoes until almost cooked. Peel the potatoes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the meat from the broth. Discard the aromatic vegetables, reserving the broth (about 5 cups). Place the bone back in the pot with the broth. Add the cabbage, potatoes, and the remaining seasoning. Boil for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Throw in the perilla leaves and scallion. Add salt and pepper to taste. Boil for an additional couple of minutes, and then add the crushed perilla seeds.

title: Esquites
description: Esquites (also known as elote en vaso and Mexican street corn salad) is the best street food snack made of corn in a creamy mayo sauce!

ingredients.name: fresh corn kernels, (cut off the cob (about 4 medium ears of corn))
jalapeño pepper, (minced (seeds removed if you don't want it spicy))
crumbled cotija cheese, (plus more for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the butter, fresh corn kernels, garlic, and jalapeño. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Transfer to a medium mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the mayonnaise, cotija cheese, cilantro, salt, and lime juice. Add the chili powder and optional ingredients if using. Mix until fully combined. Taste and season with more salt and mayonnaise if desired.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Garnish with chili powder to your liking, a lime wedge, and a sprinkle cotija cheese.

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 3

title: Chicken Stroganoff
description: Chicken Stroganoff - everything you love in a Beef Stroganoff except that it's made with juicy tender seared boneless chicken thigh strips bathed in a creamy mushroom sour cream sauce.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash then pat dry chicken thighs with a paper towel. Take out excess fat from chicken Slice chicken into strips. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place a 12-inch non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, then add oil. When oil sizzles, add chicken to the pan in a single layer and brown both sides ; about 3-4 minutes per side. You may do this in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Melt 1-2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat, add in mushroom ,onions, garlic, thyme and bay leaf. Cook stirring for about 3-5 minutes or until onions are softened and translucent. Sprinkle in flour and cook for another minute stirring frequently to avoid burns.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat to low and whisk in the chicken broth slowly, deglazing the pan by scraping off all the bits on the sides and bottom of the pan. Bring the mixture to a boil and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the mixture has thickened, stir in the Worcestershire sauce, paprika, Dijon mustard and sour cream. Stir until evenly combined and aromatic, about a minute. Adjust salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Return chicken to the skillet including all the juice on the plate of chicken . simmer again for 2-3 minutes then take pan off heat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Sprinkle Stroganoff with fresh chopped parsley and serve with pasta, mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Orecchiette with White Beans, Tomatoes, and Olives
description: This quick Mediterranean orecchiette pasta with simple pantry staples is the perfect dinner for busy nights!

ingredients.name: orecchiette pasta or similar short pasta
15- ounce can cannellini beans (or white beans of your choice, drained and rinsed)
Pearls Kalamata Pitted Greek Olives (plus more to your liking)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add salt. Cook the pasta in boiling water to al dante. Be sure to reserve a bit of the pasta cooking water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: About 4 minutes after you put the pasta in the boiling water, work on the sauce. In a large skillet, heat 4 tablespoons EVOO over medium heat. Add the garlic and onions, and season with kosher salt. Add the thyme, oregano, and pepper flakes. Cook, tossing occasionally, for about 3 to 5 minutes or until the garlic and onions have softened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the white wine and cook for a couple of minutes until it reduces a bit, then add the lemon juice and ¼ cup of the pasta cooking water. Add the tomatoes and beans and cook for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the pasta is ready drain and add it to the skillet and toss to combine with the tomatoes and beans. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the arugula, olives, and feta cheese, if using. Enjoy!

title: Greek Pasta Salad recipe
description: If you are looking for a twist on your classic pasta salad, go Greek with this sprightly Greek pasta salad recipe! Go ahead, taste all the earthy flavours that characterize the Greek cuisine in one simple dish!

ingredients.name: tomatoes, cut into wedges or 18 cherry tomatoes, cut into halves
and 1/2 tbsps extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy Greek pasta salad recipe, start by cooking the pasta. Boil the pasta according to package instructions and drain. Set aside to cool down for a while.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime prepare your vegetables for the Greek pasta salad. Wash thoroughly and strain the vegetables. Cut the tomatoes into wedges, the cucumber into half moons, slice the pepper and the red onion. Place all the vegetables in a large salad bowl and add the pasta, the olives and feta cheese. Garnish with chopped parsley and mix everything together so that all the wonderful flavours mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the dressing for the Greek pasta salad add all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the dressing over the Greek pasta salad and toss to coat. Taste and adjust the seasoning according to preference.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare this Greek pasta salad recipe a few hours before serving to allow the flavours to mingle and develop and it will certainly reward you.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Divide the Greek pasta salad among individual serving plates and serve cold. Enjoy!

title: Tofu gimbap
description: delicious vegan gimbap made with fried tofu

ingredients.name: uncooked short grain rice (standard measuring cup not the cup that comes with a rice cooker - see note)
burdock root (uoeong, braised - see the recipe)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the rice using a little less water than usual. Fresh cooked rice is best for gimbap.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the tofu into about 3/4-inch thick sticks. Pat dry with a paper towel, and lightly sprinkle with salt. Heat a small pan with enough oil to cover the pan. Add the tofu pieces and fry until all sides are golden brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat, and prepare an ice bath. Blanch the spinach, place immediately in the ice bath, then squeeze out the water. Cut into short lengths by running a knife through a few of times. Season with the sesame oil (about 1/2 teaspoon) and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the cucumber into 1/2-inch thick sticks. Do not use the seedy part. Heat the pan with a little bit of oil over medium high heat. Stir fry the cucumber until softened. Lightly season with salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Julienne the carrots. Heat the pan with a little bit of oil over medium high heat. Stir fry the carrots until softened. Lightly season with salt.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For the burdock root, see the recipe.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When all the other ingredients are ready, remove the rice from the rice cooker. While the rice is still hot, add the sesame oil and salt. Mix well by gently folding with a rice paddle or large spoon until evenly seasoned. Add more salt to taste. The rice will cool down during this process and be ready to be used.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Put a sheet of gim, shiny side down and longer side toward you, on a cutting board or a bamboo mat if available. Spread about 3/4 cup to 1 cup of rice evenly over the gim, using a rice paddle or your fingers preferably. Lay the prepared ingredients on top of the rice close to the side toward you.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Lift the entire bottom edge with both hands and roll over the filling away from you, tucking in the filling with your fingers. Put firm pressure over the roll with the help of the bamboo mat, if using, to close everything in tightly. Then, continue to roll again, putting pressure evenly over the roll using both hands.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Rub or brush the roll with a little bit of sesame oil for extra flavor and shiny look. Apply a little bit of sesame oil to a sharp knife. This will keep rice from sticking to the knife. Repeat as necessary after each cut. Wipe the knife with a damp towel if the rice still sticks. Cut the roll into 1/2-inch thick bite sizes.

title: Easy Fried Halloumi Recipe with Warmed Honey
description: Pan fried halloumi in olive oil makes a great appetizer in 5 minutes or less! Serve halloumi fries, drizzled with warmed honey and toasted sesame seed for a sweet and salty combo!

ingredients.name: Halloumi cheese, (pat dry and cut into 1/2-inch sticks)
crushed red pepper flakes ((I used Aleppo pepper))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a non-stick pan, heat 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When the oil is hot and shimmering, add the halloumi sticks in one single layer, making sure not to crowd the pan. Cook for 1 to 2 minute on one side, until a golden brown crust forms. Using a pair of tongs, turn over and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes watching for that beautiful crust to form.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, warm your honey either in a skillet or put your tightly-closed jar in warm water to help the honey loosen a bit.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the fried halloumi to a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds and a dash of red chili flakes or Aleppo pepper. Drizzle with the warmed honey all over (serve unused honey in a small bowl to the side).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you like, arrange some fruit such as grapes, figs, or berries on the same platter around the cheese. Serve immediately!

title: Crack Chicken
description: Crack Chicken - scrumptious and easy baked chicken dinner topped with ranch cream cheese mixture, crispy bacon bits and cheesy melty goodness. Flavorful LOW-CARB dish that can be served in so many ways!

ingredients.name: (907 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs or breast
(8 g) Creole seasoning blend or Italian seasoning blend
4-6 bacon slices ( , chopped, cooked crispy and crumbled)
8-ounce package Cream Cheese (, cut into smaller chunks)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Lightly grease cast iron skillet or a 9x13 baking dish. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Season boneless chicken with salt and pepper, then rub both sides with Creole or Italian seasoning. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a large heavy sauté pan, saute chopped bacon until brown and crispy - about 6-7 minutes, remove bacon. Set aside. Leave bacon fat for browning the chicken, if desired.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add vegetable oil to the remaining bacon fat, enough to brown chicken, depending on the amount left over from the bacon.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once oil is hot enough, add chicken and brown for about 5-6 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove chicken from skillet and arrange in previously prepared baking dish. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: In a small bowl combine cream cheese, garlic powder, onion powder and ranch seasoning mix. Mix until thoroughly combined. Add shredded cheese. Mix again. Taste for seasonings and adjust accordingly.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Top each piece of chicken with equal amounts of the cream cheese and cheddar mixture. Evenly spread over each chicken using a fork or knife.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Top with bacon and remaining cheese. Place in the pre-heated oven , add about 1/2 cup chicken broth and bake uncovered, for about 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked all the way through; Cheese melts and browns lightly .

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Remove from oven, garnish with green onions.

title: Greek style no bake cheesecake with yogurt
description: A delicious and easy Greek style no bake cheesecake recipe! Creamy, rich and refreshing with a crunchy biscuit base and a delicious jam topping.

ingredients.name: to 1 cup of jam of your choice (depends how thick you want it to be)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the base, butter a 23cm loose-bottomed tin (you can also use individual small tins). Place the biscuits in a food processor and pulse until crumbs remain. Transfer the crumbs to a bowl, then pour over the melted butter. Mix thoroughly until the crumbs are completely coated. Tip them into the tin and press firmly down into the base in an even layer. Put the tin in the fridge while you make the filling.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the cream cheese, Greek yogurt, vanilla, icing sugar and honey in a bowl, then beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Tip in the double cream and continue beating until the mixture is completely combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the mixture into the biscuit crust and top the cheesecake with the jam. Refrigerate overnight, or for at least 6 hours. Enjoy!
