title: Kongnamul Guk (Soybean Sprout Soup)
description: A staple Korean soup made with soybean sprouts! Nice and refreshing!

ingredients.name: - 8 medium to large size dried anchovies for broth
plump garlic clove (thinly sliced or minced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium size pot, bring 6 cups of water with the anchovies and garlic to a boil, uncovered. Reduce the heat to medium high and boil, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Remove the anchovies and garlic from the broth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the soybean sprouts a couple of times, discarding any skins floating.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the bean sprouts and 1 teaspoon of salt and boil, covered, Bring it to a boil, and continue to cook for 4 - 5 minutes over medium high heat. Do not open the lid while the bean sprouts are being cooked, or the raw bean smell will linger even after cooked. Once kongnamul is cooked, taste for salt and pepper. The amount of salt needed at this point will depend on your salt and taste. Add the scallions and serve.

title: Five-Spice Powder Recipe
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a dry skillet, add all of the whole spices and toast over medium high heat until the coriander seeds darken slightly and there is smoke coming up from the pan. Pour immediately onto a plate to cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put the spices in a coffee grinder, spice grinder, or a mortar and pestle. Add the cinnamon and grind into a fine powder. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

title: Chinese Congee with Pork and Century Egg
description: Chinese congee with century egg and minced pork

ingredients.name: white rice ( , I am using jasmine white rice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the rice; soak with clean water for at least 1 hour. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Marinate rice with salt and oil. Rest for around 15 minutes. And then marinate minced pork with cornstarch and pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a pot, bring water or stock to a boil and then add rice. After 10 minutes, turn down the fire to simmer for around 40 minutes or until the rice is almost broken. Stir several times to prevent rice stick to the bottom.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place pork and century egg in. Continue simmer for around 5 to 8 minutes over medium fire.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle salt and mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer to serving bowl, top with spring onion, coriander plus preserved Sichuan mustard (optional) before serving.

title: Nopales de Quesadillas en Chile Rojo
description: Quesadillas filled with nopales en chile rojo, or cactus paddles in a red chile sauce, with shredded cheese. An authentic Mexican recipe!

ingredients.name: kosher salt + 1 teaspoon, (plus more as needed)
V&V Supremo Shredded Chihuahua® Brand Quesadilla Cheese

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the nopales: In a medium pot, add the diced cactus paddles, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon kosher salt, ¼ teaspoon Mexican oregano, and enough water to completely cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the water from the nopales and rinse them under warm water to remove any excess slimy liquid.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the nopales are cooking, make the chile rojo: In a medium pot, add the guajillo chiles, árbol chiles, and enough water to completely cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat. Remove the pot from the heat, cover, and let the chiles soak for 10 minutes to soften.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the softened chiles to a blender. Add the tomato, the remaining 1 clove garlic, the remaining 1 teaspoon kosher salt, the remaining ¼ teaspoon Mexican oregano, and ½ cup fresh water. Blend until completely smooth. If the sauce is not smooth, strain it through a fine mesh strainer to remove any solids.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add in the sliced onion and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add in the drained nopales and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the chile rojo and cook for 6 more minutes until the sauce has thickened. Taste and season with more salt as needed. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Assemble and cook: Layer the half of each tortilla with ⅓ cup cheese, ⅓ cup cooked nopales, and another ⅓ cup cheese in each tortilla. Fold it over and cook the quesadillas in a hot skillet or comal for 1 to 2 minutes per side until the cheese has fully melted and the quesadillas are golden brown.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve with Crema Mexicana de Casa, guacamole, and garnish with cilantro.

title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts recipe (Yiaourti me meli)
description: A delicious Greek Yogurt with Honey recipe, drizzled with walnuts, infused with vanilla essence and sprinkled with fragrant cinnamon!
tags: greek yogurt with honey and walnuts

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this delicious Greek Yogurt with Honey dessert start by toasting the walnuts. Preheat the oven to 180C. Spread the walnuts in a single layer on a baking sheet and toast for 7-8 minutes or until turning golden and fragrant. Transfer the toasted walnuts in a bowl, add the honey and blend to coat. Set aside to cool down for 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In the meantime, stir together the Greek yogurt and vanilla extract and divide among 6-7 dessert bowls. Spoon the honey-walnut mixture over the yogurt and sprinkle with cinnamon powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve immediately or store in the fridge. Enjoy!

title: Pickled Mustard Green Noodles
description: Yummy and popular noodle soup with pickled mustard green

ingredients.name: fresh or dried chilies ( , seed removed and cut into small pieces)
of pork stock for serving ( , you can use chicken stock)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate shredded pork with all the marinating sauce in a small bowl. Stir for several minutes until well combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up around 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in wok; fry shredded pork until no more pink. Add pickled mustard greens and chili peppers. Stir fry for several minutes.Transfer to a bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook noodles according to the instructions and then drain. Boil pork stock too.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the noodles in the serving bowls and then pour over pork stock; add shredded pork and mustard greens. Sprinkle chopped green onion, coriander and drop 3 or 4 drops of sesame oil on each serving bowl.

title: Pan Con Tomate (Spanish Tomato Bread)
description: A perfect use of ripe summer tomatoes and day-old bread, Pan con Tomate (Spanish Tomato Bread) is an easy Catalan tapa, made with just 5 ingredients: bread, tomatoes, garlic, salt, and a splash of lime juice.

ingredients.name: loaf ciabatta bread, (or similar hearty bread)
tomatoes, (large and very ripe tomatoes are best, I used heirloom tomatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Turn the broiler function of your oven and position a rack about 6 inches away from the heat source.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice the bread loaf in half length-wise then in 2-inch slices. Brush the bread generously with extra virgin olive oil and arrange on a sheet pan. Toast in the heated oven about 6 inches from the broiler for 3 minutes or until the bread is lightly golden brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Slice a small part at the very tip of the tomatoes and grate the tomatoes over the large holes of a box grater. Discard the peels. Season the tomato puree with salt and a splash of lime juice, if you like.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the bread is ready, rub the garlic cloves over the hot bread, then spread the grated tomatoes over the bread. Serve.

title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
description: Skip the store-bought stuff and make your very own warm, melty spinach artichoke dip that’s a million times tastier. Always a fan-favorite, this homemade dip is perfectly creamy, cheesy, and oh-so-satisfying.

ingredients.name: (284g) chopped frozen spinach, (thawed and water squeezed out)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 350℉/177℃.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place a small saucepan with olive oil over medium-high heat, add onions and saute until soft. Then add the garlic and saute for a minute longer. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, half of the mozzarella cheese, parmesan, Worcestershire sauce, Creole seasoning, pepper flakes, and ground black pepper in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the spinach, artichokes, and sauteed onion mixture until thoroughly combined. Spread the mixture in a 9×13-inch baking dish, top with remaining mozzarella cheese, and bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve slightly cooled with tortilla chips, crackers, or toasted baguette slices.

title: Steamed Salmon in Black Bean Sauce
description: The steamed salmon is cooked until tender and moist and the asparagus perfectly done. The dark black bean sauce complements both ingredients perfectly and turns these simple ingredients into a feast.

ingredients.name: fermented black beans ((or bottled black bean sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To mix the sauce, combine the fermented black beans with the Shaoxing wine in a bowl. Let it sit while you prepare the other ingredients so the black beans will soften, 5 minutes or so. Once the fermented black beans turn soft, smash them with the back of a spoon to thicken the paste. It’s fine if you cannot smash the beans evenly and completely. Once done, add the rest of the sauce ingredients and mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Line a large dutch oven or heavy-duty pot with parchment paper and make sure you have about 8” (20cof paper poking out of the pot, so you can wrap up the ingredients later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spread the onion onto the bottom of the lined dutch oven. Place the fish on top of the onion, skin-side-down. Arrange the asparagus between the salmon fillets. Pour the black bean sauce over the salmon. Drizzle the olive oil and sprinkle the green onion over the salmon and asparagus.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fold the paper over to cover the fish and crimp the edges loosely together so it forms a pocket to hold all the ingredients. Add 1/2 cup water outside of the parchment paper, and make sure the water doesn’t enter the paper pocket and dilute the sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the dutch oven with the lid. Cook over medium-high heat until the water boils, 5 minutes or so. Do not uncover the lid during the process. You should hear the water bubble when it starts to boil. Reduce the heat to medium or medium-low. Continue to cook for another 6-10 minutes depending on the thickness of the fish and the doneness you’re looking for. After 6 minutes, uncover the pot and unfold the parchment paper using a pair of tongs (be careful of the hot steam coming out of the pot). Test the doneness of the salmon by inserting a fork into the thickest part of the fillet. It should flake easily and the color should be pale pink throughout. If the salmon is mostly cooked but still has spots of darker pink, cover the pot again, remove it from the stove, and let sit for 3 to 4 minutes. If the salmon doesn’t flake easily, return it to cook on the stove for longer until it’s done.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the salmon is cooked, remove the pot from the stove immediately and uncover the pot. Let the steam out for a minute, remove the lid, and carefully open the paper. Transfer the salmon with the onions and asparagus onto a serving plate. Transfer the remaining sauce as much as possible onto the salmon using a spoon.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot with steamed rice as a main dish.

title: Greek Yogurt Cake Soaked in Syrup Recipe (Yiaourtopita)
description: A delicious Greek yogurt cake recipe, infused with the aromas and blends of oranges and lemons and garnished with a cognac scented syrup!

ingredients.name: and 1/4 of a cup self rising flour

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the syrup for this Greek yogurt cake, add all the ingredients for the syrup in a small pot and bring to the boil. Boil for about 2-3 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved and the syrup has slightly thickened. Leave aside to cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare the Greek yogurt cake (yiaourtopita), divide the eggs into yolks and whites. Place the egg whites in the mixer’s bowl, along with a pinch of salt. Make sure your egg whites, bowl and whisk attachments are clean and free of any water. Whisk the egg whites until the mixture is very thick and glossy and a long trailing peak forms when the whisk is lifted (meringues). Place the mixture in a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In another bowl, sift the flour and the baking powder and blend.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use an electric mixer, to mix the butter and sugar for about 15 minutes, until the butter is creamy and fluffy (it is very important that the butter is at room temperature). Add the egg yolks, one at a time, whilst mixing, allowing time for each one to be absorbed, before adding another. Add the yogurt, the orange and lemon zest and the vanilla extract and blend to combine. Add 1/3 of the sifted flour and blend, using a maryse spatula. Add 1/3 of the meringues and blend with light circular movements from the bottom up. Repeat with the rest of the flour and meringue (adding 1/3 of the flour and 1/3 meringue and then the remaining flour and meringue).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 190C (both top and bottom heating elements on). To bake the Greek yogurt cake, use a round cake tin, approx. 26cm in diameter. Butter the bottom and sides of the tin and pour in the mixture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the cake in the preheated oven, on the lower rack, turn the heat down to 175C and bake for 50-60 minutes, until nicely coloured and cooked through. Check if it is ready, by sticking in the middle of the cake a wooden skewer or toothpick. If it comes out clean, then the cake is ready.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To finish the Greek yogurt cake, ladle slowly the cold syrup over the hot cake, allowing each ladle of the syrup to be absorbed, before ladling again. Allow time for the syrup to be absorbed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: This Greek yogurt cake is ideally served cold, not hot, with a fresh fruits, yogurt or ice-cream . Enjoy!

title: Chinese Fried Stuffed Eggplant (炸茄盒, Zha Qie He)
description: A Northern Chinese delicacy, these fried stuffed eggplants feature a juicy filling, tender eggplant, and a super crispy crust. It’s like fried dumplings, but using eggplant to replace the dough wrapper.

ingredients.name: to 4 cups vegetable oil ((or enough for deep frying))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the filling: Add the ground pork into a medium-sized bowl. Add all the seasoning ingredients except the sesame oil. Mix in one direction until sticky and streaky. Add the sesame oil and mix well. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To prepare the eggplant: Cut off and discard the tough end of the eggplant. Slice the eggplant into 1/4” (1/2 cm) thick pieces without cutting through the eggplant, leaving a small part attached. Then keep cutting another 1/4” (1/2 cm) thick piece, this time slicing all the way through. So you will get an eggplant “slider bun” and use it to stuff the meat filling in between to form a burger. Repeat to cut all the eggplant the same way.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To assemble: Add 1 to 2 teaspoons of filling into each eggplant pocket, depending on the eggplant size. Push down the filling, then gently press the eggplants so the filling reaches the edges of the eggplant. Do not stuff too much filling, as doing so can make it hard to cook through later.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make the batter: Add the flour and salt into a big bowl. Stir to mix well. Slowly add the ice water and stir with a spatula. Mix until the water is just incorporated. The batter should be runny but not too thick, able to coat the eggplant easily. You can adjust the batter by adding more water or flour, if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To cook: Add the oil into a medium-sized pot (or high-walled pan). Heat over medium heat until it reaches 350°F (176°C). Prepare a baking sheet lined with parchment or a wire rack.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Working in batches of a few eggplant pockets at a time: dip each piece into the batter to coat well, then gently lower it into the hot oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Fry until the batter is set and turns pale yellow, flipping occasionally, about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the oil and transfer onto the lined baking sheet to cool.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once you’ve fried all the eggplant, turn up the heat and wait until the oil reaches 375°F (190°C). Return all the eggplant to the pan in batches. Cook until the eggplant turns golden brown, another 4 to 5 minutes. Once done cooking, transfer the eggplant to the same baking sheet to cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve hot by itself or with your favorite dipping sauce.

Meanwhile, place carrots and cucumber into a glass jar or another container that is heat-proof and acid-safe. Pour the boiled pickling liquid over the vegetables, making sure everything is submerged. Close the container jar, and once it is cooled to room temperature, it is ready to use. Store in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Thinly slice shallots lengthwise and spread them out on a piece of paper towel. Sprinkle salt over them and let sit for at least 10 minutes to let the salt draw out the moisture. Once the moisture has been drawn out, pat the shallots dry with a double layer of paper towel. Fry them on LOW heat in a small pot or a round-bottomed wok, with just enough oil to submerge them. Once they turn a deep golden colour, and the bubbling has subsided, fish them out with a mesh skimmer and drain them on paper towel. The may take 7-10 minutes depending on your heat and how much you are frying. They will darken a bit more once you've taken them out, so be careful not to let them get too dark. They also burn quickly so do not walk away!

steps.title: Step 3

Once they puff and expand, which only take a few seconds, they are done. If you want a darker colour you can keep them in a few seconds longer. Let drain on paper towel. Store in an air-tight container once cooled completely. Note: While you're frying, keep the heat low because, unlike most other foods, these crackers do not lower the oil temperature much when they're fried, so the oil can quickly get too hot if the heat is too high.

steps.description: Salt the pork ribs. In a large heavy bottomed pot, add a little oil just to coat. Once oil is hot, add the ribs and sear until browned on both sides; do not crowd the pot, you will probably need to do this in a couple of batches.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once the pork is all seared, add them all back to the pot and add just enough water to cover the pork by about 1 cm. Add the fish sauce and simmer for about 15-20 minutes or until scum and foam has collected on top. Skim off the scum with a fine mesh strainer, then add onion and tomatoes, and simmer for another 45 minutes or until the pork is fork tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, if using tamarind pulp, use this time to make tamarind paste. Place the pulp in a medium bowl, cover with off-the-boil water and let sit until cool enough to handle. Squish the tamarind with your hands until all pulp has been released into the water. Strain off all the fibers.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the pork is fork tender, add taro cubes and chilies, and simmer for 7 minutes. Add the beans and cook for 2 more minutes, then add bok choy or any leafy greens you're using. Check that the taro is tender by piercing a fork through it and it should go through easily. Season the soup with most of the tamarind juice and then taste, adding more fish sauce and tamarind as needed (note: I used up all of my tamarind juice in the video). You shouldn't need any added sugar for this, but if the soup feels too sour, you can add a little sugar to balance.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice!

title: Easy Apple Strudel with Phyllo
description: Make the perfect apple strudel! Homemade apple filling in flaky, extra crispy phyllo dough. A light and delicious fall dessert to feed a crowd. Be sure to watch the video above for how to make this apple strudel

ingredients.name: Private Reserve Greek extra virgin olive oil,
apples, (peeled, cored, thinly sliced (1 Granny Smith and 2 Gala apples worked well))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the filling. In a large skillet heat ghee and extra virgin olive oil. Add the sliced apples, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, cardamom and orange juice. Cook over medium heat, stirring as needed, for about2 minutes or so (you are not looking to cook the apples all the way, just a little bit to allow some juice to release.) Stir in walnuts and raisins. Remove from heat and set aside briefly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare a large sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Pour the juices from the apple filling in a small bowl and mix with a little more extra virgin olive oil (you'll use this mixture to brush the phyllo sheets).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lay 10 to 12 sheets of phyllo flat on a clean surface (you can cover with a clean towel to keep the phyllo from drying, although this should be a quick process.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Take 1 phyllo sheet and lay it in the sheet pan. Brush with the mixture you prepared (apple filling juice and olive oil). Sprinkle a little brown sugar on top. Repeat the process with the remaining phyllo sheets.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now, with the sheet pan placed horizontally (one long edge of phyllo facing you), spoon the apple filling somewhat towards the middle leaving about a 2-inch boarder of phyllo all around. Fold the short edges of phyllo to cover 2 -inches of apple mixture on each end. Brush ends with extra virgin olive oil. Starting at the long edge closest to you, fold the phyllo over the apple filling and roll towards the other end (jellyroll fashion, but do not roll the phyllo too tightly). Keep the seam on the bottom.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Brush the strudel with extra virgin olive oil. Bake in the heated oven on the middle rack for 35 minutes or until the phyllo turns a nice golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the oven and let cool in the sheet pan. To garnish, sprinkle the apple strudel with confectioner's sugar, add any walnuts or raisins remaining. Slice and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Greek Yogurt Dessert
description: This Greek yogurt dessert is creamy, extra cooling and with a crunchy bite! Ready in less than 10 minutes it is the perfect way to finish off a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: biscuits Petit beurre or digestive (7 ounces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this creamy yogurt dessert, add the yogurt, condensed milk and the zest and juice of 1 lemon in a large bowl, whisk, until the ingredients combine and the mixture is smooth and creamy like a mousse.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To serve, place some crumbled biscuits on the bottom of a glass or a bowl and top with the yogurt mousse. Layer the ingredients, according to your preference and top with some lemon or lime zest and crushed dark chocolate.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
description: Honey Mustard Chicken - succulent pan-seared chicken thighs simmered in a sweet tangy with a nice little kick sauce and finished in the oven for an incredibly tasty dinner option!

ingredients.name: (52 g) stone ground or whole grain mustard

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat dry chicken thighs with a paper towel and place in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season both sides with salt and pepper if using any, rub with creole seasoning; set aside. If desired this can be done an hour or two before to let in seasoning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (175 degrees Celsius).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a Cast Iron or skillet over medium high heat; place chicken side down in a skillet. Fry each side for about 3 minutes until golden brown on both sides, be very careful with the chicken, it shouldn’t burn. Chicken will finish cooking in the oven. Set chicken aside on a plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the sliced onion, garlic and thyme to the skillet, quickly stir for about 30 seconds, be careful not to let it burn cause it might alter the flavor.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together creole seasoning, mustard and honey.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Deglaze the pan by adding chicken stock to the skillet, then make sure to scrape all food particles in the skillet, bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Quickly pour in mixture into the skillet and let it simmer for 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Return the chicken thighs to the skillet, coat in sauce.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Transfer the skillet to the oven. Bake for about 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Remove from the oven, platter and serve with rice/vegetables/potatoes.

title: Pork Lettuce Wrap (San Choy Bow)
description: A super easy and fast San Choy Bow, or pork lettuce wrap recipe, that features tender pork and crisp vegetables brought together with a scrumptious brown sauce served on lettuce leaves.

ingredients.name: to 12 lettuce leaves ((Iceberg, Bibb, Butterhead, or Romaine))
Chili garlic sauce ((or your favorite hot sauce))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the sauce: Add all the sauce ingredients into a small bowl and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To make the filling: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add the ground pork and spread into an even layer. Cook without touching until the bottom is browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Flip the pork and chop into smaller pieces. Cook until the other side turns golden. Move the pork to one side of the pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of oil, onion, garlic and ginger to the other side of the pan. Stir and cook for 2 minutes. Then mix everything together.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the water chestnut and the red pepper. Stir and cook for another 2 minutes, until the vegetables soften. Transfer everything to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To serve and eat: Add a spoonful of the pork filling onto a lettuce leaf. Add some roasted peanuts and green onions. Drizzle a bit of chili garlic sauce or your favorite hot sauce for a spicy taste, if desired. Enjoy as an appetizer.

description: Peanut Chaat is a quick Indian snack made by mixing peanuts with onions, tomatoes, spices, and lemon juice. It can be prepared using boiled peanuts made from fresh peanut pods or roasted and salted peanuts.

title: Daegu Tang (Mild Cod Fish Stew)
description: Daegu tang (or daegu jiri) is a mild Korean fish stew made with cod fish and vegetables. Refreshingly delicious!

ingredients.name: cod fish (daegu, 대구) (preferably steak cuts, but fillets are okay too)
a handful of watercress, crown daisy leaves (ssukgat) or minari.
salt and pepper ((a little bit of saeujeot (salted shrimp or fish sauce is great as an additional seasoning.))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the fish and clams (or shrimp).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Clean the vegetables. Cut the radish into thin bite sizes. Roughly slice the scallions and chili pepper. Cut the tofu into 1/2-inch thick bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 4 cups of water (or anchovy broth) to a medium size pot along with the radish and dasima (dried kelp). Bring it to a boil over high heat. Cook until the radish turns soft, about 5 minutes. Remove the dried kelp. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drop in the fish, clams and tofu. Add the garlic. When it comes to a boil again, reduce the heat to medium high. Cook until the clams are open and the fish is almost cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes. (Do not overcook. The fish will continue to cook in the boiling hot broth while being served and eaten.) Adjust the seasoning if needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the enoki mushrooms, if using, scallions, and chili pepper. Continue to boil for a minute, and add the watercress or crown daisy leaves. Turn the heat off. Serve piping hot.

title: Salad Rolls w/ Spicy Garlicky Creamy Dip
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: sheets Vietnamese rice paper (one 8-inch round sheet makes 2 pieces)
Baby salad greens (spring mix, arugula, baby lettuces)
Cucumber, cut into 3 inch sticks, seeds removed
Other veg you can add to the mix: Bell peppers, avocado, beets, sprouts, cilantro, mint, Thai basil
Protein of your choice: Ham, tuna salad, shrimp, imitation crab, marinated tofu (see note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the dipping sauce

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a mortar and pestle, pound garlic and chilies into a paste. Add salt, and using a swirling motion, grind the chili garlic paste further until there are no more pieces of chili skin left. Add condensed milk, mayo, and lime juice; stir until combined. Taste and adjust seasoning. Refrigerate while you make the salad rolls.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: For the salad rolls

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: (Note: it is easiest to watch the video for this part.) Cut rice paper in half with scissors, if it cracks around the edges where you cut them, do not worry. Soak rice paper in warm water for about 10 seconds, longer if the water has cooled down.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lay on a clean work surface and let it sit for another 10-15 seconds until it has absorbed all the water around it and the sheet has softened. Fold about 1 inch of the rounded side in towards the center; press the fold gently to flatten it.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Gather about 4 leaves of baby greens, picking different colours and shapes, and place them neatly on top of each other. Lay the salad bundle down on the rice paper, about 2 inches above the edge closest to you, and making sure the top of the leaves are sticking out about half an inch over the left side of the paper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Repeat with the another batch of salad greens and place it in the same manner on the right side of the paper. Place other vegetables and protein, but this time you want to center them on the paper. Wrap and roll tightly. Cut each roll in the middle to make 2 pieces.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with the dipping sauce. If it needs to sit out for a while, be sure to place plastic wrap over them so they don't dry out. Enjoy!

title: Crock Pot Pinto Beans
description: Easy and flavorful crock pot pinto beans pair with any meal and require no soaking at all! Only 7 ingredients required.

ingredients.name: jalapeño pepper (diced (seeds removed if you don’t want it spicy))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and clean the beans by picking out and discarding any that are shriveled or split, as well as any small rocks that may have made their way into the batch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the beans to a large slow cooker along with the onion, jalapeno, garlic, bay leaves, and broth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Stir to combine, cover, and cook on low for 8 hours (or on high for 5 to 6 hours) until the beans are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove and discard the bay leaves. Stir in the salt, taste, and add more as needed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve as is, make into refried beans, or store in the fridge or freezer for later use.

title: Vegan Chickpea Chili (Slow Cooker or Stovetop)
description: Warm, hearty, and flavorful Tomato and Chickpea Chili! Make it in the slow cooker for best flavor and for a hands-off dinner, or try the stovetop method in the recipe notes!

ingredients.name: dry chickpeas ((OR 3 15-ounce cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed))
peeled whole tomatoes ((crushed with their juices))
large red bell pepper ((halved and sliced into ½-inch wide strips))
corn kernels ((fresh cooked or thawed if previously frozen))
scallions ((green and white parts, thinly sliced))

title: Instant Pot Pinto Beans
description: These Instant Pot Pinto Beans come out tender and flavorful EVERY TIME. No soaking required! Easy step-by-step instructions for the best pinto beans ever.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and drain pinto beans under running water. Discard any beans that are cracked or split in half, as well as any rocks or debris.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Press the saute button on the Instant Pot and add the olive oil. When hot, add the onions. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions become translucent.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt, oregano and black pepper. Cook for 30 seconds, stirring continuously.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the water and pinto beans. Stir everything together to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover with lid, seal the pressure valve and cook on high pressure for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the timer goes off, let the pressure release naturally for 20 minutes. Then carefully open the pressure valve to manually release any remaining pressure.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Season with salt, starting with 1 teaspoon. Then taste and season with more salt as desired.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve immediately with chopped cilantro for garnish.

title: Talatouri recipe (Cypriot tzatziki sauce with mint)
description: Mint or no mint? Everyday we receive messages from our readers, asking if the traditional Tzatziki recipe is using mint or not, and if lemon juice or vinegar.

ingredients.name: of a cup extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Cypriot talatouri sauce recipe, remove the skin and the seeds of the cucumber and grate it into a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and leave aside for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wrap the grated cucumber in a towel and squeeze, in order to get rid of the excess water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assemble the Talatouri sauce. In a bowl, add the cucumber, the minced garlic and olive oil, the yogurt, juice of 1 lemon, mint, a pinch of salt and blend, until the ingredients are combined. Store in the fridge and always serve cold. (Alternatively, if you have a blender, pour in the olive oil and garlic and blend until combined. Then mix with the rest of the ingredients using a spoon. This will help the garlic to mix better with the rest of the ingredients).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare this traditional Talatouri sauce for your friends and family and serve as a delicious dip with some warm pita breads aside, or as a sauce for Greek-style souvlaki. Enjoy!

title: Creamy Chicken Pasta Salad
description: Creamy Chicken Pasta Salad - filling and oh-so-easy pasta salad packed with great flavors, textures and colors. A fantastic summer dish that can be served as a side or a complete meal on its own!

ingredients.name: rotini pasta (, cooked according to package directions,)
freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain using a colander, let it cool then place in a large bowl, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Season chicken with salt, pepper and your favorite seasoning ( I used creole seasoning)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large skillet, heat half of the oil over medium to high heat, add chicken and sear for about 5 minutes on each side, flipping intermittently so all sides cook evenly. Cooking time will vary based on thickness of chicken breasts and sizes of the pieces. Chicken should be about 90% cooked through. Let it rest for about 10 minutes, then cut into bit slices.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To the large bowl of pasta add cucumbers, bell pepper, green onions, olives, red onions and chicken. set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To a medium bowl or large measuring cup, add the remaining olive oil, vinegar, honey, mustard, mayonnaise, ranch dressing salt and pepper and blend until they are fully incorporated.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the dressing to the chicken and pasta and stir until coated. cover bowl with a transparent plastic wrap and let it sit in the fridge for about an hour before serving.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve cold or reheat gently prior to serving, if desired.

title: Chinese Chicken Noodle Salad (鸡丝凉面)
description: Chinese chicken noodle salad is a perfect summer dish. Thin noodles are tossed in a nutty, aromatic and savory sesame sauce and topped with tender shredded chicken and crunchy cucumber.

ingredients.name: (1 lb / 450 g) total small boneless skinless chicken breasts ((or thighs) (*Footnote 1))
(450 g) fresh thin wheat noodles (, or 14 oz (400 g dried noodles) (*Footnote 2))
Chinese sesame paste ((or unsweetened natural peanut butter))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chop the green onions into 2” (5 cm) sticks, reserving a small amount of the green part for garnishing. For garnishing, thinly slice the green onion into rounds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare a steamer by adding 2” (5 cm) water into the pot. Cover and heat over medium-high heat until boiling. Use a plate that can fit into your steamer rack. Spread the green onion sticks onto the plate to make a bed. Place the chicken breast on top. Sprinkle salt evenly over the chicken.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When steam comes out of the steamer, place the steamer rack with the chicken on top, and cover the steamer. Cook for 15 minutes. Test the chicken by using a thermometer inserted into the thickest part. It should read 165°F (73°C). Or insert a knife into the thickest part, and the juice should run clear. If the chicken is still pink inside, steam for another 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the chicken to a plate to cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the chicken is cooked, you can use the same pot of water to boil the noodles according to the package instructions. Once done, drain the noodles, rinse with tap water to stop cooking. Then drain again and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While cooking the chicken, combine the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk to mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Boil the noodles according to package instructions, until al dente. Drain the cooked noodles and rinse the noodles with cold tap water to stop cooking. Then transfer to a big bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the chicken has cooled, transfer it onto a cutting board. Shred the chicken into thin slices using two forks.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: To assemble, add the sauce into the cooked noodles. Toss to mix well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To serve, transfer the noodles into individual serving bowls. Top with the shredded chicken, cucumber and green onion. Serve at room temperature.

title: Jajangmyeon (noodles in a black bean sauce)
description: Jajangmyeon (noodles in a black bean sauce) is a popular Korean-Chinese dish. Learn how to make this restaurant favorite at home with this easy to follow recipe!

ingredients.name: to 4 servings fresh jajangmyeon/udon noodles (about 6 ounces per serving)
Chunjang (춘장), Korean black bean paste (some may be labeled as jjajang (짜장))
chicken stock or water (You can add 1/2 cup more for thinner, more liquidy/watery sauce. See note.)
potato or corn starch (dissolved in 1/4 cup of chicken stock or water)
to 10 ounces pork (preferably with some visible fat, pork shoulder cut, Boston butt, etc.) (or lean cut if preferred)
extra large onion (or 2 medium, 12 to 14 ounces) (See note if adding potatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Have a pot of water ready to cook the noodles. Turn the heat on when you start cooking the meat. This way you will have the boiling water ready, for cooking the noodles, by the time the sauce is done.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the pork and vegetables by cutting them into 1/2 - 3/4 inch cubes. Marinate the pork with a tablespoon of rice wine (or mirin), ginger, salt and pepper while preparing the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the black bean paste to a small saucepan with the oil, sugar, and the optional oyster sauce. Fry it over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring constantly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a large pan with 2 tablespoons of cooking oil over medium high heat. Add the pork and stir fry until no longer pink, adding a tablespoon of soy sauce half way through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the onion and cook until soft, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the cabbage and zucchini and continue to stir fry until vegetables are softened.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir in the black bean paste and mix everything together until all the meat and vegetables are coated well with the paste.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Mix everything together until all the meat and vegetables are coated well with the paste. If you like ganjjajang, you can stop here and skip the next two steps. See note.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour in the stock (or water) and bring it to a boil. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Stir in the starch slurry and cook briefly until the sauce is thickened. Add more sugar to taste.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add the noodles in the boiling water. Cook according to the package instructions and drain. Do not overcook. The noodles should have a firm bite to them (al dente). Place a serving size of noodles in each bowl. Spoon the sauce over the noodles and garnish with the optional cucumber matchsticks. Alternatively, you can serve over cooked rice.

title: Yu Choy Stir Fry
description: Easy and healthy Chinese green (Yu Choy) stir fry with minced garlic

ingredients.name: Yu Choy also known as Yu Chai ( , tough skin removed and cut into stalks if necessary)
garlic cloves ( , finely chopped or mashed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix water, salt with oyster sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in wok until hot. Slow down the fire and add minced garlic to fry until aroma. Place in the mixed sauce in the first step.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large pot, bring enough water to boil. Add around 1/8 teaspoon of salt and several drops of sesame oil after boiling. Place the Yu Choy in. Heat until the water boils again.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer out and place in serving plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour the hot garlic oyster mixture on top of the vegetables. Serve hot.

title: Pancit Canton - Filipino Egg Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: 10-12 Shrimp, or as many as you like
Chinese broccoli, stems thinly sliced on a bias, leaves roughly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the sauce by combining fish sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, black pepper and water in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook the noodles: In a large pot of boiling UNSALTED water, add the noodles and cook until they are done. The time will vary depending on the type and thickness of the noodles, so just follow package instructions. Have a large bowl of ice-cold water ready and when noodles are done, immediately shock them in the cold water to stop the cooking and cool them down. Swish them around for just a few seconds and drain immediately. Do not let the noodles sit in the water or they will swell up and get mushy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: This part is optional, but once drained, use scissors to cut the noodles down a few times just so they're easier to toss and eat. Fun fact: for some Chinese people, long noodles symbolizes long life so they do not cut the noodles!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a wok or a large skillet over medium heat, add just a little bit of oil and add the sliced Chinese sausages. Let the sausages sear and let some of the fat render until they look blistered on one side, quickly flip them and let the other side sear briefly (if there are too many to flip individually you can just give them a quick toss). Be careful with these as the high sugar content in the sausages means they burn quick! Remove from pan, leaving the fat behind.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sear the shrimp in the rendered fat on both sides just until done, remove from pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To the same pan, over medium heat, add onion and garlic and saute until the garlic starts to brown. Add all the vegetables and crank the heat to high and toss to wilt. Drizzle about ~ 2 tsp of the sauce over the veggies and toss to mix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the noodles, all of the remaining sauce and toss until all the liquid has been absorbed into the noodles and everything is thoroughly mixed. Throw in the sausage and shrimp (along with any juices in the bowl) and toss until combined. Turn off the heat and toss in green onions if using.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with calamansi or lime, and make sure you drizzle some juice on the noodles for added brightness!

steps.title: Step 9

title: Authentic Tzatziki sauce Recipe (Greek Yogurt, Cucumber Dip)
description: The authentic Greek tzatziki sauce recipe. Find out how to prepare this creamy Greek yogurt, cucumber and garlic dip as served in the very best taverns!

ingredients.name: of a cup extra virgin olive oil
a pinch of salt and freshly ground pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this authentic Greek tzatziki sauce recipe, remove the skin and the seeds of the cucumber and grate it into a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and leave aside for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Afterwards, wrap the grated cucumber in a towel and squeeze, in order to get rid of the excess water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Assemble the tzatziki sauce. In a bowl, add the cucumber, the minced garlic and olive oil, the yogurt, 1-2 tbsps of red wine vinegar, a pinch of salt and blend, until the ingredients are combined. Store the tzatziki sauce in the fridge and always serve cold. (Alternatively, if you have a blender, pour in the olive oil and garlic and blend until combined. Then mix with the rest of the ingredients using a spoon. This will help the garlic to mix better with the rest of the ingredients).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare this traditional tzatziki sauce for your friends and family and serve as a delicious dip with some warm pita breads aside, or as a sauce for Greek-style souvlaki. Enjoy!

title: Citrus Rosemary Chicken Recipe
description: Crisp, tangy, and succulent citrus rosemary chicken, seasoned Mediterranean-style with garlic, rosemary, and oregano, and covered in a bold wine and orange marinade. Use split chicken or chicken pieces of similar size for even cooking.
tags: roasted chicken with rosemary and citrus

ingredients.name: whole chicken ((about 3 ½ pounds), split in half through the backbone)
orange zested and juiced (plus 1 sliced orange)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Season the chicken with kosher salt on all sides, making sure to season underneath the skin as well. (You can do this one night ahead of time and keep the chicken in the fridge to air-chill uncovered).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the citrus marinade. In a large bowl, add the wine, orange juice and zest, lime juice, 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, tomato paste, spices, and a good dash of kosher salt. Add the garlic and onion. Whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chicken and toss to coat, making sure to lift the skin up and spoon some of the marinade underneath (this will give you more flavor). Set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes. Alternatively, cover and refrigerate for an hour or two (for best results, take it out of the fridge and leave the chicken at room temperature for 30 to 45 minutes before cooking)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 425 F and adjust a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the chicken and the marinade to a braising pan. Roast for 30 minutes, then carefully turn the pan 180 degrees and roast for another 15 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender (juices should run clear).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix together the honey with 1 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil. Carefully remove the chicken from the oven and brush the top with the honey and olive oil mixture.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Switch the oven to the broil function. Return the chicken back to the oven about 6 inches away from the broiler and cook briefly for 3 to 4 minutes, watching for the skin to turn a nice golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the heat and finish with lime juice. Add slices of fresh orange and wedges of lime.

title: Instant Pot Black Beans
description: The easiest way to make black beans in the Instant Pot! No soaking required and cooks dried black beans with the best texture and flavor.

ingredients.name: green bell pepper, diced ((or anaheim or jalapeno))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and drain black beans. Discard and beans that are cracked or split in half, as well as any rocks or debris.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Press the saute button on the Instant Pot and add the olive oil. When hot, add the onions and bell pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions become translucent.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the bay leaves, garlic, salt, cumin and oregano. Cook for 30 seconds, stirring continuously.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the water and rinsed black beans. Stir everything together to combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover with lid, seal the pressure valve and cook on high pressure for 35 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the timer goes off, let the pressure release naturally for 20 minutes, then carefully open the pressure valve to manually release any remaining pressure.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Discard the bay leaves and serve immediately with chopped cilantro for garnish.

title: Arroz con Pollo
description: Arroz con Pollo - a fantastic one-pot chicken and rice meal featuring layers of perfectly seared juicy chicken meat, super flavorful rice and loads of veggies. An easy, loaded meal that comes together in less than an hour!

ingredients.name: 3-3 ½ pounds chicken cut in 8 halves or 2 lb chicken thighs
or more sazon seasoning(optional) (Sub with favorite chicken seasoning or black pepper )
freshly ground black pepper or to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat dry chicken and season with salt, pepper and taco seasoning, if desired. Preheat oven to 350F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add chicken to skillet skin side down and cook until golden, 5 minutes on each side. Remove from pan and set aside on a plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To same skillet, heat the remaining oil over medium heat; add onion, bell pepper, garlic and thyme. Sauté until fragrant and onions is translucent, about 3 to 4 minutes. Add in the remaining ingredients; oregano, bay leaf, paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper and tomato paste, stir for about a minute. Deglaze the pan with white wine and cook for about 2 minutes till most of the wine evaporates.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add in the rice, corn and peas, cook until coated with ingredients.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour in chicken broth and water, give it a stir. Add chicken back to the skillet and bring it to a boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cover skillet with a lid and bake for about 30 minutes until the rice is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove let it cool, garnish with cilantro and lemon slices and serve.

title: Sesame Toast Recipe
description: Vegetarian Sesame Toast is an Indo-Chinese snack made with bread slices topped with a spiced vegetable mixture and sesame seeds. The prepared toasts are shallow fried until crisp and golden.

ingredients.name: or 1 small to medium carrot (– parboiled & finely chopped)
or 8 to 10 french beans (– parboiled & finely chopped)
medium potato (– boiled or about ½ cup of mashed potato)

inch ginger (– peeled and finely chopped)

oil (– as needed for shallow frying or deep frying)

title: 15-Minute Tomato Egg Noodles
description: Make this quick tomato egg noodle dish when you’re in a rush because it takes no time to whip it up for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: oz. (225 g) wheat noodles (, dried (or udon noodles))
and 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil ((or vegetable oil))
(28 oz. / 800 g in total) tomatoes (, diced (or 4 ripe tomatoes, or a mix of both))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Cook the noodles according to the instructions on the package. Once done, run under tap water to cool. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a medium-sized non-stick pan over medium-high heat until hot. Add the eggs and let them sit without touching until the bottom side is done, but the top is still raw, about 30 seconds. Stir with a spatula, chopping the egg into bite-sized pieces, until the eggs are just cooked. Transfer the eggs to a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil, green onion, and garlic to the pan. Stir a few times to release the fragrance. Add the tomatoes and/or canned tomato. Stir and cook until the tomatoes turn tender, about 2 minutes. Add the soy sauce and stir to mix well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the cooked eggs, salt, and sugar. Stir everything together to mix well. Taste the sauce. Adjust the seasoning by adding more salt and/or sugar, if needed. Transfer everything to a big plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: To serve, divide the noodles among the serving bowls. Add a few spoonfuls of the tomato egg sauce. Mix well and enjoy! To spice up the noodles, you can use the nutty sauce from this recipe. The flavors go very well together.

title: Grape Salad
description: Grape Salad - refreshingly sweet, creamy side dish or dessert with juicy fresh grapes coated in a luscious yogurt dressing and sprinkled with brown sugar and pecans. An irresistible fruity recipe made in just 5-minutes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash and drain grapes, place them in a large bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together the cream cheese, sour cream, yogurt, vanilla extract and brown sugar until fully blended.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the cream cheese mixture to the grapes, toss until fully combined and all the grapes are coated with the cream.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer grape salad to a serving bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving, about 1 hour. Top with brown sugar and chopped pecans just before serving.

title: Rosemary Roasted Chicken Recipe with Vegetables
description: Comforting, flavor-packed roasted rosemary chicken recipe and vegetable all in one sheet pan. Be sure to review the step-by-step photos and tips in the post!

ingredients.name: chicken pieces (I used bone in pieces, 5 thighs and 5 drumsticks)
Extra virgin olive oil (I used Private Reserve Greek EVOO)
yellow onion, cut into large pieces or slices

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix spices. Reserve 1 tsp of spice mixture to the side for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat chicken pieces dry and season with kosher salt on both sides, and make sure to get some salt underneath the skin. Lift chicken skin up and add minced garlic underneath (this provides a lot of flavor and protects the garlic from burning in the oven. Now seasons chicken with the spice mixture all over, making sure to get some of it also underneath the skin. (remember to keep 1 tsp of the spice mixture aside for the vegetables.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange chicken pieces on a lightly oiled large sheet pan. Add lemon juice and a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (give a little rub to distribute the lemon juice and olive oil.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix the vegetables (potatoes, carrots, and onions) with the remaining 1 tsp of spice mixture, a dash of salt, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. Toss to combine, then transfer to sheetpan with the chicken. Arrange everything on the pan in one layer.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked (check at the earlier mark so you don’t over-cook the chicken. Using an instant-read thermometer, inserted at the thickest part of the chicken, it should register register 165 degrees F.) If you like a little more color, place the sheetpan under the broiler briefly and watch carefully.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove from heat and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

title: Tacos Al Pastor
description: Tacos al Pastor features pork marinated in pineapple, Mexican chiles, and achiote. The perfect combo of sweet, savory, citrus, and spice!

ingredients.name: pineapple, (1 cup diced and the rest sliced into rounds)
boneless pork shoulder, (sliced into thin slices)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium pot, add the guajillo chiles, ancho chiles, and enough water to completely cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat. Remove the pot from the heat, cover it, and let the chiles soak for 10 minutes to soften.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the softened chiles to a blender. Add 1 cup of the chile-soaked water, 1 cup of diced pineapple, the achiote paste, onion, garlic, chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, salt, Mexican oregano, cumin, and white vinegar. Blend for 3 to 5 minutes until completely smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine the pork shoulder with the marinade in a large glass or stainless steel bowl. Toss together until all the meat is fully coated, then cover and refrigerate for 4 to 24 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat a grill for direct heat grilling at high heat (450-500°F) or a grill pan over high heat. Remove the pork shoulder from the marinade and shake off any excess marinade. Grill for 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a large plate and set aside to rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the meat is resting, brush oil on all sides of the remaining pineapple slices. Grill over high heat until heated through and grill marks appear. Transfer to a cutting board and dice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Chop the grilled meat into small bite-sized pieces and serve in warm corn tortillas topped with the diced grilled pineapple, diced white onion, chopped cilantro, a squeeze of fresh lime juice, and salsa verde. Slice thinly against the grain and serve.

title: Greek marinade for chicken
description: All you need to take your chicken to the next level is a simple yet full of Mediterranean flavours marinade! And I have just the perfect Greek marinade for chicken for you to try!

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt (or the juice of 1 lemon)
chicken thighs, breasts, or other chicken pieces, skin on or off (1 lb 1 1/2 oz)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl or ziplock bag combine the oil, lemon zest, garlic cloves, peeled and crushed, Greek yogurt (or the juice of the lemon, if you don’t have any Greek yogurt to hand), dried oregano, honey, red wine vinegar, salt and plenty of black pepper. Whisk to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add your choice of chicken pieces and marinate in the fridge for at least two hours, but preferably overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a 200 degrees (390 fahrenheit) oven roast the chicken pieces for 20-30 minutes depending on their size (40 minutes for bone in chicken thighs) until the meat is cooked through. If the pieces still have their skin, finish them under a hot grill if needed to get nice crispy skin and a good level of caramelisation.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook on a direct heat until the meat is caramelised before moving to the edge of the pan or an area of indirect heat to cook through. We do not recommend the griddle pan method, only the barbecue for skin on or bone in pieces of chicken, though skin on, bone in chicken thighs can be browned in the pan before being transferred to the oven to cook through.

title: Manchurian Recipe | Veg Manchurian Gravy
description: Manchurian is a popular Indo-Chinese dish made with crispy fried mixed vegetable balls simmered in a spicy, sweet, tangy, umami sauce or gravy. Veg Manchurian gravy pairs well with noodles, fried rice, or plain steamed rice.

oil (– as required, for shallow or deep frying - sunflower oil or any neutral tasting oil)

title: Filipino Adobo with Pork and Pineapple
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: pork belly, cut into large cubes (for a leaner adobo, use half pork shoulder)
filipino soy sauce (or sub Chinese or Japanese soy sauce)
fresh pineapple, cut into small bite-sized pieces (see note)
Cilantro or green onions for garnish, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large, heavy bottomed pot, add a little bit of vegetable oil and heat over medium high heat until hot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add pork pieces without crowding them and sear until well browned. Flip and brown the other side. Do this in batches as needed. Once the pork is done, set them aside in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If there is too much pork fat in the pot, you may pour some of it out but do not wash the pot. Then add onions and a pinch of salt and cook until it is browned slightly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add garlic and stir for one more minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add coconut milk and scrape off all the browned bits from the pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaf, black pepper and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add pork and just enough water so it barely covers the pork. Close the lid and simmer gently for 1 1/2 - 2 hours, or until the pork is fork tender.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: At about halfway through the cooking, check the amount of the liquid you have in the pot. If it's too much, keep the lid ajar to reduce, if there isn't enough, add some more water. See video for how much sauce you should be aiming for.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Meanwhile, caramelize the pineapple by adding a little oil to a large skillet, and when hot, add the pineapple pieces and sear until browned. Toss them and brown the other side. Set them aside in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the pork is fork tender, stir in the caramelized pineapple and let simmer for 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning and it's done!

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Yangpa kimchi (onion kimchi)
description: A simple kimchi made with sweet onions

ingredients.name: onions (small, sweet variety such as Viidalia)
coarse sea salt (use 2T if using fine tablesalt) (See note)
scallions (and/or 2 ounces of garlic chives) - optional
saeujeot (Korean salted and fermented shrimp) (or 2T more fish sauce)
sweet rice flour (chapssal garu, 찹쌀가루) (or regular rice flour or all purpose flour)
sugar - optional but use 1-2 T if not using sweet onions

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To avoid tearing, put the onions in icy cold water for about 30 minutes before peeling. Cut onion in half from the tip to the bulb end, and remove the outer skin. Place the onion half, cut side down, on a cutting board, and cut it lengthwise at a slight angle into 2 or 3 even wedges.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dissolve the salt in 2 cups of water and pour over the onions. Let sit for about an hour, flipping them over half way through.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Whisk together the glutinous powder and 1/2 cup of water. Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until it thickens to a thin paste. Let it cool. Then, mix all the seasoning ingredients in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Drain the onions from salt water. Rinse the onion in fresh water once, and drain well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the onions, and toss everything well until the onion slices are evenly coated with the seasonings.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Throw in the optional scallion and/or garlic chives. Store the kimchi in an airtight container. Keep it at room temperature for a day, and then refrigerate. Onion kimchi can be eaten right away, but the flavor develops as it ferments over a week or two in the fridge.

title: Jalapeño Cornbread
description: This Jalapeño Cornbread recipe is sweet and perfectly moist with a spicy kick! Ready in 25 minutes, enjoy with your favorite soup or chili.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place a 9 or 10-inch cast iron skillet on the middle rack in the oven, and preheat to 400°F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, butter, and cream-style corn.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir together until well combined. Fold in the shredded cheese and jalapenos until just combined.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Carefully remove the hot cast iron skillet form the oven and add the oil or butter to grease the skillet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the batter into the skillet, and bake for 20-25 minutes, until lightly browned and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Fa Gao (Fortune Cake)
description: Chinese steamed cake--Fa gao also known as Fortune Cake

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Melt brown sugar with hot water and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine flour with baking powder. Add the sugar water. Stir the batter in one direction for around 3-5 minutes. The longer; the better.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour batter to molds. I will recommend using a scoop and pour the batter directly to the center of the molds from higher places and let the batter flat by itself. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring enough water to boil in a large wok or deep pot, set up the steamer and place the batter in when the water begins to boil. I would suggest add more water with the level just below the moulds.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cove the lid and continue steam for around 20 to 25 minutes. The blossoming should occur around 10 minutes. So in the first 10 minutes, use high fire and you can choose to slow down your fire slightly or use high fire during the whole process (depending on how much water you added for steaming and do not burn your wok).

title: Chinese Cabbage Stir Fry
description: Szechuan style Chinese cabbage stir fry in hot garlic sauce.

ingredients.name: Napa cabbage around 2 pounds ( , remove the parts with fresh leaves)
green onion ( , white and green part separated and minced)
fresh Thai red chili pepper ( , or Szechuan style pickled red pepper)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the Napa cabbage; remove the green leaves. Cut the white part into pieces around 1/2 inch long.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Minced garlic, ginger, white part of green onions, and red pepper. In a small bowl, mix vinegar, water, sugar, starch, soy sauce and sesame oil. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large pan or wok, heat up oil and fry ginger, garlic and green onion white parts until aroma. Add doubanjiang and continue frying for around 1 minute over medium fire until there is red oil coming out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the Napa cabbage pieces. Cook until slightly soft (around 1 to 2 minutes). Swirl the sauce and bring to a boiling. Taste to see whether pinch of salt is desired.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer out and top with chopped green onions. Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Za'atar Olive Oil Fried Eggs
description: Fried eggs in olive oil with a generous sprinkle of za'atar are next level delicious! I love serving my za'atar eggs with a few chopped cherry tomatoes and warmed pita bread.

ingredients.name: to 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, (more if you like)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Crack your egg in a ramekin or small dish.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Over medium-high heat, warm a nonstick skillet. Add the olive oil and turn the heat to medium. Tilt the pan around to spread the oil, and watch for it to shimmer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Carefully slide the eggs in the heated oil. Season with Kosher salt and the za'atar. Cook for about 2 to 3 minutes over medium heat, spooning some of the olive oil on top, until the whites are cooked the edges crisp up and the yolk is cooked to your liking (if you like, you can cover the pan for a few seconds to help it).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve immediately with warmed pita bread or your favorite crusty bread!

title: Grilled Lobster Tail
description: Grilled Lobster Tail - surprisingly easy grilled lobster recipe with juicy, tender and flavorful meat in every bite. You don't need to order one at a restaurant to experience fancy seafood meal.

ingredients.name: (6-8 ounce) (170 - 226 g) frozen lobster tails (, thawed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat grill over medium heat. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients; butter, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, chives, sriracha, Creole, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Mix until fully combined. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using kitchen sears or scissors, cut top of lobster shell lengthwise down the center but no further to the tail. Cut the shell again at an angle away from the center on both sides downwards to loosen meat from shell, keeping the fin end attached; lift the meat and lay over shell.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Rub the lobster meat with the olive oil-garlic mixture making sure all part is covered with the spice blend. Cover with a plastic wrap and let it marinade in the fridge for about 25-30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lightly oil grill grate, place lobster on the preheated grill flesh side down and grill for about 8-10 minutes, on medium heat or until meat turns pink and opaque. Lightly basting lobster frequently with marinade. Carefully flip lobster tails and grill for an additional 3-5 minutes. Lobster is ready when it is opaque and firm to the touch.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with salad, roasted corn, Spanish rice, broccoli, asparagus or any veggies of your choice.

title: Hokkien Noodles (福建炒面, Hokkien Mee)
description: This Hokkien noodles recipe creates a super rich and fragrant one-pan meal that contains tender chicken bites, crisp veggies, and tender noodles. Learn how to make these easy restaurant-style fried noodles without a wok!

ingredients.name: oz. (170g) dried egg noodles ((or 10 oz./280 g fresh Hong Kong style pan fried noodles))
boneless skinless chicken breast or 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs ((about 1/2 lbs / 225 g), sliced to 1/4-inch thick pieces)
bell pepper (, or 2 anaheim peppers, seeded and thinly sliced)
Sambal chili sauce or Sriracha (, for garnish (optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to the instructions. Once cooked, transfer to a colander and rinse with tap water to cool. Drain and set aside. Skip this step if using fresh pan-fried noodles.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the marinade ingredients in a medium-sized bowl. Stir to mix well. Let sit for 10 minutes while preparing the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a large nonstick pan (or cast iron pan, or carbon steel paover medium-high heat until hot. Add the beaten eggs and cook them until the bottom sets. Stir to scramble. Once cooked through, immediately transfer the eggs to a plate.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan and spread the chicken in it in a single layer. Cook without touching until the bottom turns golden, 40 seconds to 1 minute. Flip to cook the other side until light golden. Transfer the chicken to a plate.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 1 tablespoon of oil, along with the shallots, green onions, and garlic to the pan. Cook and stir for 1 minute, to release the fragrance. Move all the ingredients to one side of the pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the cooked noodles. Toss with a pair of tongs to mix with the veggies. Let the noodles sit in the hot pan for a few seconds without moving, to help it char on the bottom. Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil (or wateif the noodles look dry.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Stir the sauce again and pour it into the pan. Toss the noodles to mix well with the sauce, 1 minute or so.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the peppers, and add back the cooked chicken and eggs. Toss to mix everything well, until the sauce is fully absorbed. Transfer everything to serving plates.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add a spoonful of chili sauce to the noodles, if using. Serve hot as a main dish.
