title: Maneuljjong Muchim (Spicy Garlic Scapes)
description: A simple side dish made with seasonal garlic scapes! It's super easy and delicious!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the scapes, and trim off the tough ends and the tips of the buds. Cut them into about 2-inch lengths.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add a teaspoon of salt, and drop the garlic scapes in. Leave them in for about 30 seconds. Try one to see if they are tender to your taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain quickly and plunge them in cold water. Drain well in a strainer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a bowl, mix the scapes well with the seasoning ingredients.

title: Mapo Tofu
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: Chinese black beans, rinsed and roughly chopped (see note)
chicken stock or pork stock, UNSALTED, or water

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Toast Sichuan peppercorns in a dry saute pan for a few minutes, stirring constantly until they are aromatic and darken slightly. Grind in a mortar and pestle or a coffee grinder until fine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a wok or a saute pan over medium high heat, add the ground beef (no oil needed) and the soy sauce. Cook the beef, stirring constantly to break it up into small pieces, until the water that comes out of the meat has evaporated and the beef is browned slightly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn off the heat and remove the beef with a slotted spoon, leaving any fat behind. If your beef is quite lean and there isn't much fat left, add a little more cooking oil to the pan so there's enough to saute the garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the heat back on to medium, add garlic and ginger and saute until the garlic starts to turn golden. Add ground black pepper, half of the ground Sichuan peppercorns (or all of it if you like more of the numbness and aroma), the broad bean paste and the black beans. Saute the herbs and seasoning for about 30 seconds, then deglaze with stock, scraping off any bits that are stuck to the bottom.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add sugar, Chinese cooking wine, and the beef; simmer gently for 5 mins.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, dissolve the cornstarch in about 3 Tbsp of cold water.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the sauce is done simmering, pour in half of the cornstarch slurry while stirring, and let it come back to a simmer. Check the sauce for thickness, and if it's still too runny, add a little bit more of the cornstarch slurry until the desired consistency is reached. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the tofu to the sauce and gently nudge the tofu around so it is sitting in one layer. Spoon some the sauce over the tofu, then let it simmer gently for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Transfer onto a serving bowl, drizzle with more chili oil if desired, and garnish with chopped green onions and some of the reserved Sichuan peppercorns if desired. Tip: Some people do not like the numbing sensation from the Sichuan peppercorns, so it might be safe to serve the extra Sichuan pepper on the side so people can sprinkle on more if they want it.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice, and enjoy!

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Instant Pot Mexican Shredded Beef
description: This moist and tender Mexican Shredded Beef is made in the Instant Pot in less than 2 hours! Its delicious by itself or great in tacos, salads and more.

ingredients.name: beef stew meat, (cut into small chunks (chuck roast or round roast works well))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl add beef, chili powder, salt, minced onion, ground cumin, garlic powder, oregano and black pepper. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Press the sauté button on the Instant Pot and add the cooking oil. When hot, add the seasoned meat and sear until browned on all sides.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the broth, cover with lid, seal the pressure valve and cook for 50 minutes at high pressure.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Open the pressure valve to quickly release the pressure. Carefully open the lid and transfer the beef to a large plate using a slotted spoon.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Shred beef with two forks and then return it to the Instant Pot. Add lime juice, chopped cilantro and stir. Serve and enjoy in tacos, burrito bowls and salads.

title: Italian Apple Olive Oil Cake
description: Simple and rustic Apple Olive Oil Cake with chunks of apple, raisins and the perfect combination of spices. The kind of no-fuss olive oil cake you'll love.

ingredients.name: large Gala apples (peeled and chopped as finely as possible)
Orange juice to soak apples in
gold raisins, (soaked in warm water for 15 minutes and then drained well)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the chopped apples in a bowl and add orange juice; just enough juice to toss and coat apples so as to prevent browning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl sift together the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder and baking soda. Set aside for now

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a whisk, add sugar and extra virgin olive oil. Mix on low for 2 minutes until well-combined

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While mixer is on, add the eggs, one at a time, and continue to mix another 2 minutes until mixture increases in volume (it should be thicker but still runny)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In the large bowl with the dry ingredients, make a well in the middle of the flour mixture. Add the wet mixture (the sugar and olive oil mixture) into the well. Using a wooden spoon, stir until just blended; it will be a thick batter (do not add anything to loosen it).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drain raisins (which have been soaking in water) completely; and rid apples of excess juice. Add both raisins and apples to the batter and mix with spoon until well-combined. Again, batter will be fairly thick.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Line a 9-inch cake pan with parchment paper. Spoon thick batter into the pan, and level the top with the back of your wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake in 350 degrees F for 45 minutes or until an inserted tooth pick or wooden skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Cool completely in pan. When ready, simply lift parchment up to transfer cake into a serving dish. Dust with confectioner's sugar. Alternatively, heat some dark honey to serve on top (those with a sweeter tooth like this option.)

title: Easy Greek Spanakopita with puff Pastry
description: Making spanakopita sounds too complicated? Well not anymore with my super easy spanakopita with puff pastry recipe!

ingredients.name: x 500g block puff pastry (1 lb 1 1/2 oz)
flour, for rolling out the pastry
softened butter, for greasing the baking dish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this super easy spanakopita with puff pastry recipe, start by making the filling first.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the oil in a very large frying pan or skillet set over a medium heat. Trim and slice the leeks into 1 cm (1/3 inch) pieces and fry with a pinch of salt for about 10 minutes until they’re soft and just starting to colour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Peel and crush the garlic into to the pan, cooking for a further minute until it has turned soft and aromatic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roughly chop the spinach and gradually add handfuls to the pan, stirring often until it has wilted enough to allow you to fit more. Then, continue to cook the spinach until almost all of its liquid has evaporated; this should take around 15-20 minutes, depending on the size of your pan. Remove it from the heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Top, tail and finely slice the spring onions before stirring them into the spinach mixture along with the fresh mint, roughly chopped, the lemon zest and the nutmeg. Crumble in the feta, before seasoning to taste with more salt and a little black pepper. Leave the spanakopita filling to cool.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Meanwhile, pre-heat the oven to 200 degrees C (390 fahrenheit).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: On a lightly floured surface, divide the pastry block into two. Generously butter a 20x20cm (roughly 8×8 inch) baking dish and roll out one piece of pastry to be big enough to line the dish allowing the filling to take up at least 4cm (1 1/4 inches) of depth, and the other to form a lid. Line the dish, pressing the pastry into the corners carefully with your fingertips.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Lightly beat the first egg, and stir it into the spinach mixture before spooning the cooled filling into the prepared pastry case, pushing it into the corners and smoothing the surface with the back of the spoon.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Beat the other egg, and brush the egg wash across the exposed lip of the pastry, just above the filling. Top with the lid, and again use your fingertips to press the edges together. If necessary, trim off any excess that overhangs the dish with a sharp knife before folding the pastry over and crimping it with your fingertips to seal the pie. Brush with the remaining egg wash and cut two small slits in the middle of the pie to allow steam to escape.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Bake for 30 minutes until the pastry is crisp and golden. Remove from the oven, and rest for a further 30 minutes at least before slicing and serving either warm or at room temperature. Enjoy!

title: Crab Cakes
description: Crab Cakes - deliciously easy crab cakes made with fresh lump crab meat and various spices and seasonings then pan-fried to perfection. Slightly crusty on the outside and succulent and juicy on the inside.

ingredients.name: -¾ cup (25- 37.5 g) Panko, or 10 crackers or 2 slices of white bread

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, add mayonnaise, beaten egg, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce and Creole seasoning, celery, green onions, minced garlic, parsley and whisk together until fully combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the crab meat (make sure to check the meat and take out any hard cartilage), bread crumbs (or crackers), pepper and salt. Using a rubber spatula, gently fold mixture together until just combined, being careful not to shred the crab meat any further.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using your hands, shape into 6-8 crab cakes forming a disk, about ½ cup each (2-2 ½ inches in diameter) and place them on a greased baking pan. Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour. This will help the cakes to set and not break apart during cooking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in a large nonstick pan or cast iron pan on medium high heat. When the oil is hot, place crab cakes in the pan and cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side or until golden brown flipping cake once. Cook crab cakes in badges to avoid overcrowding the pan.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately with tartar sauce and lemon wedges.

title: Tomato Rasam Recipe (Thakkali Rasam)
description: Tomato rasam is a tangy and spicy South Indian soup-like dish made with fresh tomatoes, spices, herbs, and water. It can be served with rice or enjoyed on its own as an appetizer drink.

ingredients.name: coriander stems (– with or without leaves)
to 1¾ cups or (275 grams or 3 large-sized) tomatoes (– chopped)
oil (– gingelly oil (sesame oil made from raw sesame seeds) or sunflower oil or peanut oil)
urad dal (– husked, split or husked, whole black gram)
or 2 dry red chillies (– broken and seeds removed)
to 12 curry leaves (or 1 sprig of curry leaves)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making ground spice & herbs mixture

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making tomato puree

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Making tomato rasam

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serving suggestions

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Storage

title: Chinese Yellow Chives and Eggs Stir Fry (韭黄炒鸡蛋)
description: The Chinese yellow chives are stir fried with scrambled eggs. Made with 3 ingredients, this dish is light, nutritious, and hearty. Serve it as a side dish or top it on steamed rice as a light main. {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: small batch (14 oz./400g) Chinese yellow chives

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse the yellow chives with running tap water. Use your fingers to gently wash them in small batches to remove any dirt. During this process, snip off any withered ends and peel off any parts that do not look fresh and discard them. Once done, drain the chives. Chop about 2 inches from the bottom (the white part is usually tougand discard it. Chop the rest of the chives into 2-inch pieces and set them aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a large 12” nonstick frying pan over medium-high heat until warm. Add the beaten eggs. Let cook until the bottom sets. Stir them with your spatula and chop them into smaller bits, like you’re cooking scrambled eggs. Once the eggs are just cooked, remove the pan from the stove immediately and transfer the eggs to a plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. When the oil just starts to smoke, add the yellow chives. Quickly stir a few times to coat the chives evenly with oil. When the chives start to turn tender, add back the eggs and sprinkle salt over everything evenly. Stir and cook until the chives turn tender and the volume reduces. Remove the pan from the stove and taste the chives. If the chive are still tough, you can return them to the stove and cook them a bit longer. The chives will start to release water when they turn very tender and it won’t affect the taste. Once done, transfer everything to a plate.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve hot immediately over steamed rice.

title: Shaking Beef (Bo Luc Lac)
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: black soy sauce (or sub dark soy sauce and reduce soy sauce amount slightly)
A handful cherry tomatoes, pierced with a knife, or julienned bell peppers.
Pickled red onion or another pickle of your choice, optional (see recipe below)
Some salad greens for serving, optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thinly slice a red onion so you have about 1 cup loosely packed, place into a thick glass jar with a lid. In a small pot, combine 1/2 cup vinegar (you can use white or rice vinegar), 2 tsp sugar and ¼ tsp salt (you can add more sugar if you like a sweet pickle). Bring to a boil, then pour the hot vinegar over the onion until it is completely submerged (you may need to push the onion down a bit). Close the lid and let it sit at room temp until cool. Store in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the Shaking Beef:

title: Korean Potato Salad
description: This Korean potato salad is easy to make with a few staple ingredients. The salad is soft and creamy with some crunch from other vegetables.

ingredients.name: mayonnaise - use your favorite (start with 5 TB and use more to taste (see note))
salt and pepper to taste (start with 1 teaspoon salt)
- 2 tablespoons lemon juice (or 1 tablespoon vinegar - rice, white, apple cider, etc.)
small apple (sweet variety), cut into thin, small slices

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and cut the potatoes into similar size chunks (1 to 1.5-inch pieces).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the potatoes in a medium size pot, and cover with cold water. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium, cover and continue to boil the potatoes until easily pierced with a fork or a chopstick.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain and mash the potatoes in a mixing bowl with a fork until smooth. Leave some small chunks if you like. Set it aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the egg(s) in a small sauce pot with cold water covering the egg(s). Bring it to a boil. Turn the heat off, cover, and let the eggs cook in hot water for 12 - 13 minutes. Remove the eggs and place them in cold water for about 10 minutes before peeling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise and thinly slice. Lightly sprinkle with salt. Set it aside while preparing the other ingredients, and then tightly squeeze to remove moisture.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cut the carrot in half lengthwise and thinly slice. No salt is necessary as the carrot doesn’t contain as much moisture as the cucumber.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Roughly chop the egg(s), leaving the yolk if using it for optional garnish. See optional garnish below.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the cucumber, carrot, mayonnaise (start with 5 tablespoons), salt (start with 1 teaspoon), optional sugar, and lemon juice (or vinegar) to the bowl with the mashed potatoes. Mix everything well. Taste and add more mayonnaise, salt, and/or sugar to taste.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Throw in the chopped egg and toss gently to evenly distribute the egg pieces.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Optional egg yolk garnish

title: Shrimp Congee
description: Chinese shrimp congee (porridge)

ingredients.name: small-sized shrimps or more if you wanted ( , divined and unshelled, I keep the tail)
minced greens ( , Bok Choy, Yu Choy etc)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, marinate shrimp with 2-3 ginger shreds, cooking wine and ground pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak the rice for around 30 minutes and then wash and drain. In a small bowl, marinade the rice with pinch of salt and cooking oil for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large pot, bring enough water to boil and then add rice. Use lowest fire to simmer for around 40 minutes until the rice is broken and get a thick soup base.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add ginger and minced greens and continue cooking for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add shrimp in; Turn off immediately the fire until the shrimp becomes red.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Garnish with green onion and serve hot with small side dishes like cucumber salad, pickles or fried shallot.

title: Salt and Pepper Chicken Wings
description: Salt and pepper chicken wings. Can be adjusted with any spices you wanted.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle some salt evenly on chicken wings and then marinate for around 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dry spice mixture: heat around 1 teaspoon of salt over slow fire for 1 minute or until slightly browned. Add 1 tablespoon of Chili pepper flakes and 1 tablespoon of ground cumin. Heat over slowest fire until aromatic. Transfer out to cool down.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the chicken wings in a pan and let the chicken wings stay for several minutes after putting them down. Do not turn over frequently. We need to cook them well in the shortness time. Fry until one side become golden-brown and then turn over. If there is a layer of oil, then pour the oil out.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Continue frying the other side and half cover the lid like the picture shows. Pan until both side becomes crispy. Sprinkle ground pepper and serve with the dry spice mixture.

title: Beef Taquitos (Baked or Fried)
description: Crunchy Mexican Beef Taquitos filled with seasoned ground beef and shredded cheese, then baked or fried for a crispy crunchy exterior.

ingredients.name: oil ((about 2-3 cups for frying or 1-2 tablespoons for baking))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and onion. Saute for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions have softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add ground beef and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add tomato paste, chipotle chiles in adobo sauce, chili powder, salt, cumin, oregano, and water. Stir to combine and cook for 3 more minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wrap the corn tortillas in a damp paper towel and heat them in the microwave for 1-2 minutes, flipping the tortillas halfway through until all of them are warm and pliable. Place them in a tortilla warmer or wrap them in a clean kitchen towel to keep them warm during assembly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place a heaping spoonful of the ground beef mixture and a pinch of shredded cheese onto each tortilla. Tightly roll up each tortilla and secure it closed by threading a toothpick along the seam (see photo in blog post).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To fry the taquitos: Pour enough oil into the bottom of a deep skillet or frying pan so that the oil reaches halfway up the taquitos. Heat oil over medium-high heat to 350°F (To test, drop a small piece of tortilla in the oil. If it sizzles, it's ready.) Cooking in batches, add 3-4 taquitos and fry for about 1 1/2-2 minutes per side until golden brown. Transfer taquitos to a large plate or baking sheet lined with paper towels to soak up any excess oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To bake the taquitos: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Place the taquitos on a large baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Lightly brush or spray the tops of the taquitos with cooking oil. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until they're crispy and golden brown.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the toothpicks from the taquitos and serve with shredded lettuce, pico de gallo, mexican crema and guacamole.

title: Youvetsi: Greek Lamb Stew with Orzo
description: Easy stovetop youvetsi can be made with lamb or beef and small orzo noodles, all cooked together in an aromatic tomato sauce with garlic, oregano, and other comforting Greek flavors! Tips and make-ahead instructions included.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder ((boneless, or lamb leg, trimmed of fat and cut into small 1-inch chunks))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat the lamb dry and season with kosher salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large, ceramic braising pan or heavy pan with a lid, heat 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add the lamb and cook for 7 to 10 minutes, tossing regularly, until browned. Transfer the lamb to a large plate for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same pan, add the onions and garlic. Season with kosher salt. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring regularly, until softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the lamb to the pan. Add the red wine, oregano, paprika, cinnamon, nutmeg and bay leaf. Cook until the wine has reduced by at least ½, then add 1 cup of water and the tomatoes. Break the tomatoes up using a wooden spoon. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and let simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until the lamb is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the orzo and cover the pan. Let cook for another 20 minutes or until the orzo has cooked through and most of the moister has been absorbed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Garnish with parsley and crumbled feta, if you like, before serving.

title: Banana Foster
description: Banana Foster - decadent New Orleans dessert with sauteed bananas in butter, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg and bathed in a rum syrup. Top with vanilla ice cream and you'll have the fanciest 10-minute dessert for dinner date nights!

ingredients.name: firmly ripe bananas (, peeled and halved lengthwise and crosswise)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Melt butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium low heat, add the brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg, and cook until moist for about 1 minute. Stir in 1 tablespoon of rum, water and vanilla extract, cook stirring continuously, until the grainy texture disappears and the mixture rolls off the spoon in a steady stream (bubbly and thickened) - 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the bananas to the skillet and turn them until coated with the sauce. Remove the pan from the heat and pour in the remaining rum. Carefully ignite the rum with a long match or grill lighter, using extreme caution to stay away from the flame! Allow the alcohol to burn off, then return the skillet to heat and cook for 2 to 3 minutes stirring and flipping the bananas until the sauce is thickened and the bananas are tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To serve, place warm banana foster on a plate or bowl and top generously with vanilla ice cream.

title: Tomatokeftedes (Fried Santorini tomato balls / tomato fritters)
description: Looking for an authentic Greek tomatokeftedes recipe? Bring back memories from Greek island holidays with these Santorini tomato balls (tomato fritters)!

ingredients.name: of tomatoes, finely chopped. Ideally use vine ripened tomatoes to get maximum flavour
of a cup red onion (1 large onion), grated
flour (or slightly more if the mixture is too loose)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the tomatoes into 4 pieces, and with a spoon remove the flesh. Chop the flesh of the tomatoes, into small cubes, place in a colander, strain them and add sprinkle of salt. Add the grated tomatoes and mix together. Leave them for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Into a bowl, combine the chopped tomatoes, the onions, the egg and mix with a spoon; add the herbs, and the feta cheese, smashed with a fork. In a separate bowl, mix the flour with the baking powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the four mixture to the tomato mixture, whilst stirring with a spoon, until the ingredients are combined and the mixture is firm enough to make the balls. Add a little more flour if needed. Put in the fridge for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a pan add enough olive oil to cover the bottom of the pan, and heat the oil into medium-high heat. Dip a tablespoon in some water and spoon out some of the mixture into the hot oil. Repeat this procedure until the surface off the pan is comfortably filled. You should dip the spoon in the water every time, so that the dough doesn’t stick on it. Fry the tomatokeftedes for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until nicely colored. Place them on paper towel, to absorb the extra olive oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Enjoy this very best Greek island recipe with some crusted bread, yogurt and a sip of ouzo!

title: Salt and Pepper Chicken Without Deep-Frying (椒盐鸡)
description: This Taiwanese salt and pepper chicken recipe uses minimal oil to create the most scrumptious result. These chicken bites are super crispy, juicy, and bursting with flavor. {Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: (450 grams) boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts) (, cut to 1-inch (2-cm) pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the chicken and the marinade ingredients in a big bowl. Mix well. Marinate for at least 30 minutes at room temperature, or up to overnight in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the ingredients for the spice mix in a small bowl and stir to mix well. Note, this recipe prepares more spice mix than you might use, so you can adjust the seasoning according to your preference.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When you’re ready to cook, add the beaten egg into the bowl with the chicken. Stir to mix well. Add the cornstarch. Stir to coat the chicken, until it forms an uneven coating with a little dry cornstarch left unattached. The batter should be quite dry and not very runny.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the oil to a large skillet (nonstick or carbon steel), just enough to coat the bottom of the pan. Heat over medium-high heat until hot. Add the chicken one piece at a time using a pair of chopsticks or tongs. Turn to medium heat if the pan starts to smoke too much.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook the chicken until the bottom turns golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Flip to brown the other side, 2 to 3 minutes. (Alternatively, you can deep-fry the chicken with more oil at 350 F (176 C) until golden brown.) Transfer chicken to a large plate and remove the pan from the stove to let it cool a bit.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Your pan should still have a thin layer of oil remaining in it. If not, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil. Heat over medium heat. Spread the basil leaves. Cook the bottom side for 30 seconds. Flip to cook the other side until crispy. Transfer the basil leaves to a large plate to cool.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While the chicken is still hot, sprinkle about half of the spice mix over the chicken and gently toss it with a pair of tongs. Taste the chicken. Add more spice mix if needed. Add the cooked basil leaves and toss again.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve as an appetizer.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: You can store the leftover chicken in a sealed container in the fridge. To reheat the chicken, preheat your oven to 350 degrees F (176 C). Heat the chicken for 10 to 15 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Carrot Rice Recipe (Easy & Healthy)
description: This South Indian style Carrot Rice recipe is lightly spiced and delicious rice preparation made with grated carrots, aromatics, spices, herbs, cashews and cooked rice. It can be made quickly if you have leftover cooked rice.

ingredients.name: rice ((short to medium grained) or basmati rice or 3 cups cooked rice)
to 1 cups water (- for pressure cooking)
or (100 grams or 2 medium) carrots (- grated)
green chili (- chopped or serrano pepper)
to 12 cashews (- kept whole or halved)

steps.description: Cooking rice

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sautéing

steps.description: Making carrot rice

title: Wanja jeon (Pan-fried egg battered meat balls)
description: These Korean mini meat patties are egg-battered and pan-fried. They are Nicely soft, moist, and delicious!

ingredients.name: ground beef (or combination of beef and pork (half and half))
salt (about 1/2 teaspoon and pepper to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the tofu in a cheese cloth or kitchen towel and squeeze out as much water as possible. Break up any large chunks of tofu into crumbles.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine all the prepared ingredients, and mix very well by hand until everything is evenly blended, crushing any remaining big pieces of tofu. You can cook a little bit in the microwave (or in a pan) to see if it needs more salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Shape the mixture into 1-inch balls, and then gently press between your palms to flatten.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Dredge the patties in flour one at a time, coating well. Shake off excess flour.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat a non-stick pan over medium low heat. Coat the pan evenly with 1/2 tablespoon of oil. Dip each piece in the beaten egg, and carefully place in the heated skillet. Cook for about 2 minutes on each side, adding more oil, until the meat is cooked through. The meat is ready if it feels firm. Clean the pan, and repeat with the remaining pieces.

title: Licuado de Plátano
description: A licuado de plátano is a classic Mexican-style smoothie made with bananas, milk, cinnamon, and a sweetener.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the milk, bananas, agave nectar, vanilla extract, and cinnamon into a blender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blend until completely smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour into glasses, garnish with a sprinkle of ground cinnamon, and serve immediately.

title: Indonesian Mie Goreng | Wok-Fried Egg Noodles
description: Imported from hot-thai-kitchen.com.

ingredients.name: + 1 tsp sweet soy sauce "kecap manis" (what is kecap manis?)
sambal oelek (chili garlic paste) or sriracha
Thai chilies, chopped, to taste, optional
15-18 shrimp, or another protein of your choice (see note)
dark sturdy greens (Chinese broccoli or kale), cut into ribbons
Optional: Fried shallots, store bought or homemade (See note)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl and stir to mix.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a wok, heat a little oil over medium high heat and sear off the shrimp or whatever protein you’re using. When fully cooked, remove from wok and set aside. Do not clean the wok.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a little more oil in the wok as needed, turn heat on to medium low, and add the garlic, shallots and chilies. Sauté until the shallots are translucent.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add all the vegetables except tomatoes, turn the heat up to medium high, add a little splash of the sauce, then toss until wilted, about 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Push all the vegetables to one side of the pan, add a little extra oil into the empty space and add the eggs. Break the yolks and let the eggs set half way. Put all the vegetables back over the eggs, let it set for another 15 seconds or so, then toss everything together.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn heat up to high then add the noodles, the protein, and all the remaining sauce, then keep tossing until all the sauce is well mixed and absorbed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn off the heat and toss in tomatoes and most of the green onions. Toss briefly just to warm up the tomatoes and mix everything.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Plate. Top with extra green onions and fried shallots if desired, and serve immediately.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Join us on Patreon for bonus content & rewards!

title: Preserved Lemons Recipe
description: Homemade preserved lemons will take 20 minutes of active work time and about 1 month of pickling time in the fridge.

ingredients.name: Fresh lemon juice of 7 to 8 lemons, ((about 2 1/2 cups of fresh lemon juice) )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut about 1/4 -inch of the top and bottom of the lemons. Cut each lemon into quarters part-way through so that they remain connected at the bottom

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the lemons to a large bowl and toss well with the salt and sugar. Open up the lemons some and stuff them with the kosher salt and sugar mixture. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight and up to 24 hours, the lemons will release some juice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: The next day, transfer the lemons and their juices to a large sterilized canning jar. Press them down firmly into the jar. Add the pepper corns and bay leaves. Top with fresh lemon juice (your goal is to submerge the lemons in the juice).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Seal the jar shut and store in the fridge for 3 weeks to 1 month before consuming.

title: Greek lemon Chicken Soup recipe (Kotosoupa Avgolemono)
description: The perfect dish for a cold winter’s day! 'Kotosoupa Avgolemono' is a hearty and delicious classic Greek lemon chicken soup, bursting with Mediterranean flavours.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek lemon chicken soup, place your chicken in a deep pot. Push the chicken with your hands down to the bottom of the pan, add the whole onion, the carrot, pour in the water and season. The water should be enough to cover the chicken. Place on high heat, put the lid on and bring to the boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When the chicken starts to boil, turn the heat down and boil the chicken for about 1 hour and 15 minutes. The chicken is ready when the meat can be removed easily from the bones. While the chicken boils, some white foam will probably surface on the water. Remove the foam with a slotted spoon.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Proceed to pre soak your rice. While the chicken is cooking, rinse your rice and add it in a bowl and cover it with some water. Let it stand for 30 minutes. Using a fine colander, drain the water and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the chicken from the broth and strain the broth. You should have about 1 litre of broth left. If it has reduced a lot, add some water. Add the hot broth in another pot, add the rice and season with salt and pepper and boil, until done.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While the rice is being cooked, prepare your chicken. Pull the chicken meat from the bones and discard the skin. Shred the meat into bite sized chunks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: To prepare the egg lemon sauce for this Greek lemon chicken soup, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk, until foamy; add the lemon juice and whisk again. Add into the bowl a ladle of hot soup and whisk quickly. Add one more ladle and whisk again, so that the eggs gradually warm up and cook gently. Pour the egg mixture back into the pot, whilst constantly stirring so your eggs do not curdle. Then put the lid on and set it aside for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To assemble and serve your chicken soup, ladle the soup into your bowls, top with the diced chicken and sprinkle with freshly ground pepper or paprika. Enjoy!

title: Ethiopian Lentil Stew
description: A deliciously healthy and spicy vegetarian lentil recipe with homemade berbere spice, spiced butter, and satisfying lentils. Every spoonful of this delectable meal will have you sighing in pure delight. And you won't even miss the meat!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash your lentils, then let them soak while you prepare the seasonings.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large saucepan with oil and spiced butter, then add onions, berbere spice, garlic, ginger, cumin, and smoked paprika. Stir occasionally for 2-3 minutes until the onions are translucent.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add the soaked lentils and tomato paste. Stir and sauté for 2-3 more minutes. Add stock or water and season with salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bring to a boil and let it simmer until it thickens. It might take about 30 minutes, depending on how you like your lentils. Throw in some parsley, adjust for salt and pepper, and adjust the stew's consistency.

title: Brinjal Fry (Maharashtrian Style Baingan Fry)
description: This Maharashtrian-style Brinjal Fry, known in Marathi as Vangyachya Kaap, uses sliced brinjal coated with ground spices and rava (sooji/semolina) for a crisp texture.

ingredients.name: eggplant (large sized, (bharta baingan), having less seeds)
to 5 tablespoons semolina flour ((rava, suji or cream of wheat) or gram flour or rice flour or cornstarch or all-purpose flour)
to 6 tablespoons oil (or add as required)

steps.description: Preparation

steps.title: Step 2

title: Easy Fried Udon (Yaki Udon)
description: An easy fried udon recipe with a Chinese twist that yields a rich result that tastes like a beef burger. The recipe calls for very basic ingredients and doesn’t require a wok.

ingredients.name: (225 g) ground beef ((or ground pork, or ground chicken))
toasted sesame seeds (, plus more for serving)
Sliced dried nori sheets for garnish

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To thaw the noodles, either place them in the fridge overnight, boil them for about 3 minutes, or microwave until just thawed. If the noodles have completely thawed you do not need to boil them. If using dried noodles, follow the instructions on the package. When you’re ready to cook, rinse the noodles with tap water as you gently separate them by hand, and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the sauce ingredients in a medium-sized bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large nonstick pan (or cast iron pan, or carbon steel pawith 1/2 tablespoon of oil until hot. Add the eggs. Cook until the bottom turns golden, the egg white is cooked, and the yolk is still runny. You can also cook the eggs to your desired doneness.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil into the pan. Add the ground beef. Cook and break it apart using your spatula. Cook until the meat is lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the carrot and napa cabbage. Stir and cook for 1 minute. Add a bit more oil if the pan looks dry.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the green onion and ginger. Stir for 30 seconds or so, to release the fragrance.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add back the noodles and pour in the sauce. Stir and mix until the sauce is absorbed. Transfer everything to serving plates. Top with the cooked egg and garnish with sesame seeds and nori.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot as a main dish. (This dish keeps well and you can definitely use it for meal prep. Store in an airtight container in the fridge up to 4 days.)

title: Shui Zhu Pork- Szechuan Pork in Spicy Broth
description: Super yummy Sichuan Shui Zhu Pork

ingredients.name: small bunch of oyster mushrooms (, break into smaller pieces )
pork butt or pork tenderloin ( , highly recommend the butt)
12-20 dried chili pepper (, or as needed)
tbsp. doubajiang (, or half doubanjiang and half hot pot soup base)
green onions ( , white part cut into 2cm long and green pert chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice the pork thinly and then add pinch of white pepper, light soy sauce, oyster sauce and cooking wine. Combine well and set aside for 15 minutes. Then add water starch to coat well. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 12 to 20 dried chili peppers for half minute and then 1 tablespoon of Sichuan peppercorn in wok until slightly aromatic. Move out, cool down and then roughly chop.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a wok, add 2 tablespoon of oil, fry doubanjiang and hot pot seasoning if you are using with slow fire until the red turns red, then add ginger, scallion sections, garlic, fry for 1 minute until aromatic too. Then place 1/3 of the chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorn we prepared in the first step.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour 800ml hot water. Then season the broth with 1/4 teaspoon of sugar and 1 tablespoon of light soy sauce. Let it simmer for 5-8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In the meantime, blanch bean sprouts and oyster mushroom in boiling water. Then lay in the bottom of the serving bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 1 teaspoon of oil in the marinated pork and mix them again to make sure they are evenly coated. Turn up fire and add the pork slices in and cook until the broth begin to boil again. Wait for around 20 to 30 seconds and transfer them out immediately.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the broth to fill the container. Place fresh garlic, chopped peppers prepared in step 1, chopped green onion, white sesame seeds on top, then pour 2 tablespoon of hot oil on top. Serve immediately.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve directly with coriander.

title: Beoseot Gangjeong (Sweet Crispy Mushrooms)
description: Imported from koreanbapsang.com.

ingredients.name: bell pepper (red, orange or yellow or a combination)
vinegar (rice wine vinegar or any other clear vinegar)
rice syrup (jocheong, 조청), corn syrup, or oligodang (올리고당) (or 1 to 1.5 tablespoons honey)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the dried mushrooms until they are plump and tender. This will take over 2 hours depending on the size of the mushrooms.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Squeeze out the water from the soaked mushrooms, and then cut the mushrooms into quarters (or halves if small). Cut the peppers into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the potato (or corn) starch to the mushrooms, and massage them well to coat evenly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a pan, add all the sauce ingredients, and stir well. Bring it to a boil. When it starts to bubble, reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer until it thickens slightly, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add oil to a heavy bottom pan, about 1/2 inch high. When the oil is sufficiently hot (about 320°F), drop the mushroom pieces in one at a time. Cook until light golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove and set them on a wire rack or a paper towel-lined plate.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Reheat the oil to 320°F. Deep fry again until golden brown, about a minute.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat the sauce over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and peppers, and stir well until the mushroom pieces are evenly coated.

title: Fried Ice Cream Recipe
description: The easiest recipe for fried ice cream you will find. It takes 2 ingredients, but the result is indulgent and satisfying. Try serving it with the pineapple caramel sauce to jazz it up!

ingredients.name: of soft, thin sandwich bread, square shaped (see note)
Pineapple coconut caramel sauce with cinnamon sprinkles (recipe follows)
Nutella or chocolate sauce, crushed nuts & sautéed bananas
Chunky strawberry sauce or another fruit sauce
Condensed milk with Ovaltine or Milo powder
A dash of cinnamon for serving

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Scoop out ice cream into balls and place on a plate; freeze for at least 30 minutes to firm up.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Tip: If you want to fold other ingredients into the ice cream, such as chopped chocolate or cookie bits, scoop ice cream into a pre-frozen ceramic bowl, then quickly stir in mix-in ingredient and reshape into a ball. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until firm.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Trim crust off of the bread, making sure you trim off enough that there aren’t any denser part of bread left on (see video). Roll bread out with a rolling pin to flatten slightly. You may need to roll out the edges more to get them to flatten.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To wrap ice cream: Have a 12-inch sheet of plastic wrap ready on a work surface. Place the firmed ice cream on top of a piece of bread and bring the edges up around ice cream.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the other piece of bread on top, matching corners of the top piece with “valleys” of the bottom piece. Press bread around the ice cream, making sure there are no uncovered areas (it won’t stay wrapped at this point, don’t worry).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Wrap the whole thing in plastic wrap tightly, bringing corners up and twisting the wrap to secure bread onto ice cream. You want this tight! Freeze for at least 6 hours. Note: You may be able to get away with less time, but I have never tried frying ice cream that has been frozen for less than 6 hours, so I don’t know what the true “minimum” is. This will also depend on how cold your freezer is.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While ice cream freezes, prep sauce and toppings.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Heat palm sugar over medium heat in a small pot or a saute pan until melted, stirring frequently. Once melted, keep heating and stirring until it caramelizes into a dark amber colour.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add coconut milk (it will bubble aggressively) and pineapple juice. Keep cooking until the sugar dissolves and sauce has reduced into a thin caramel sauce consistency.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the pineapple pieces and cook for 2-3 more minutes in the sauce, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Remove from heat and stir in butter until melted.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Let cool before serving. It will thicken a bit more once cooled.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Add enough oil to a small pot so that it will keep the whole ice cream ball submerged.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Heat the oil to 375°F. It is important that you are sure the oil is hot enough. If the oil is too cold the bread won't brown fast enough and the ice cream might melt. Too-cold oil would also result in an oily crust. I recommend using a deep fry thermometer.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Fry the ice cream just until golden brown, this should take about 30 seconds only, and no more than 40 seconds.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Serve immediately with sauce of your choice.

title: Beef Tinga
description: This beef tinga features tender shredded beef in a smoky chipotle sauce made in the slow cooker or Instant Pot for an easy weeknight meal!

ingredients.name: beef chuck roast, (cut into large 4-inch chunks)
kosher salt, (divided, plus more as needed)
chipotles in adobo sauce, (plus 1 tablespoon of adobo sauce)
