title: Spanish Chickpea Stew
description: Flavor-packed Spanish chickpea stew with spinach and almonds. Serve it warm or at room temperature--as a tapas dish or dinner--with your favorite crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Early Harvest Greek extra virgin olive oil
whole wheat bread, crust removed, cut into small cubes
sherry vinegar or red wine vinegar, more for later
small sweet bell pepper (any color), cored and chopped
canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed (just over 2 cans of chickpeas)
Cubed bread, toasted in olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large skillet like this one, heat 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add spinach and cook, tossing regularly, until just wilted. Transfer spinach to a colander to drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Return skillet to heat and add a little more extra virgin olive oil. Add blanched almonds and bread. Saute briefly until almonds turn a golden brown color, then add garlic, spices, and a dash of salt and pepper. Cook briefly until garlic gains a little color, be sure to toss well so that the spices coat the almonds and bread.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Let cool briefly, then transfer almond and bread mixture to food processor fitted with a blade (a small food processor like this one works really well here.) Add vinegar and pulse a few times until you have a thick, crumbly, paste-like mixture. Set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wipe the skillet and add a little more extra virgin olive oil. Add chopped onion and bell pepper and cook, tossing regularly, until tender. Add chickpeas, tomato sauce, and 1/2 cup (125 ml) water. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a high simmer, then lower heat and let simmer on low for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the wilted spinach and almond-bread mixture to the chickpeas. Stir and let simmer another 5 minutes. Taste and adjust salt and pepper and spices to your liking (if you like it a little more spicy, add a dash more cayenne. And if you want it a bit more smoky, add a dash of smoked paprika.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Finish with a splash more vinegar. Garnish with cilantro, toasted bread, and toasted blanched almonds (optional). Transfer to a serving bowl and add a generous drizzle of Early Harvest extra virgin olive oil. Enjoy warm or at room temperature with your favorite crusty bread!

title: Capsicum Fry | South Indian Bell Pepper Stir Fry
description: Quick and delicious South Indian style capsicum fry made with bell pepper, potato, herbs and spices.

ingredients.name: capsicum ((bell pepper) or 1 medium to large capsicum or ¾ cup chopped capsicum cubes)
small to medium potato (or ⅓ cup potato chopped in small cubes)
sesame oil ((sunflower oil can be used instead))
to 7 curry leaves (- chopped or 1 teaspoon chopped curry leaves)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil in a small frying pan. Lower the flame and add 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds and let them crackle. They should make the crackling sound, before you proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once the mustard seeds have started crackling, then add 1 teaspoon chopped curry leaves, a pinch of asafoetida and 1 green chili (chopped). Stir well. Instead of green chili, 1 dry red chili can be added.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add potatoes which have been chopped in small cubes. Do chop potatoes in small cubes, so that they cook quickly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: On sim or low flame with stirring at intervals, saute the potatoes. Spread them in the pan, so that they cook evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Saute till the potatoes become light browned or slightly crisp from their surface and edges.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now add chopped capsicum. The capsicum also have to be chopped in small pieces. Stir and mix well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add a pinch of turmeric powder.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Mix again and saute on a low heat stirring after every 3 to 4 minutes. Spread the veggies in a pan, so that they cook evenly.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Saute till the capsicum edges also get golden. By the time the capsicum gets almost cooked, the potatoes will also be done. The capsicum in this recipe is not completely softened. There is a slight crunch in them.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Lastly season with salt as per taste. Mix very well.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Switch off the heat and add 1 tablespoon chopped coriander leaves. Mix again.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve capsicum fry hot or warm with chapatis or a side with dal or any curry.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken soup with Orzo (Avgolemono)
description: Greek lemon chicken soup with orzo (Avgolemono) is a traditional Greek soup that combines the tangy flavors of lemon and eggs with the heartiness of orzo pasta.
tags: greek lemon chicken soup with orzo

ingredients.name: skin on bone in chicken thighs
small handful fresh dill, roughly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the chicken thighs in a large pot with the red onion, peeled and halved, and the carrots, peeled and finely chopped. Season well and add the water, adding more if needed to make sure the chicken pieces are completely covered. Bring to the boil before reducing the heat to low. Allow to simmer with the lid on for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Remove the chicken thighs from the pan and set aside. Check the seasoning and add more salt and pepper to the soup if needed. Add the orzo and turn the heat up to medium. Cook with the lid on for another 15 minutes, or until the pasta is just tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Meanwhile, once the chicken is cool enough to touch discard the skins and shred the meat from the bone, returning the bones to the pot as soon as you can.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the orzo is tender, remove the chicken bones and red onion, and remove 3-4 ladles of hot soup from the pot into a jug, using a sieve to leave any carrot or orzo pieces behind.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Whisk the eggs until just frothy and then whisk in the lemon juice. Whisking constantly, slowly pour the hot soup into the egg mixture until loose, light and creamy. Then slowly whisk it back into the soup pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Return the shredded chicken to the soup. Add a little more water if needed, and check the seasoning again. Once the chicken has warmed through remove from the heat and stir through the chopped dill before serving.

title: Aunty's Signature Beef Pho Recipe
description: This is the best pho I've ever had anywhere, and it's a signature dish of Aunty Jacqueline, my mother in law's childhood friend. The amount of spices and seasonings are just right, and the broth is super rich and fragrant.

ingredients.name: beef bones (joint or marrow bones preferred)
brisket or chuck (if using chuck, cut into 1-inch thick slabs)
large onion (halved through the root end and peeled)
daikon (peeled and cut into 1-inch thick slices)
thinly sliced hotpot-style beef (cut of your choice)
Any of these fresh herbs to your liking: green onions, Thai basil, cilantro, sawtooth coriander

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the bones, oxtail and stewing beef thoroughly under tap water and place into the stock pot. Cover with 4L of water and bring to a simmer. (If the water doesn’t fit in your pot, you can top it up later after it has reduced.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the ginger and the onion halves, cut side up, on a baking sheet, and place under the broiler for about 10 minutes, or until the onions are slightly charred. Slice the broiled ginger lengthwise into a few pieces, or smash it with a pestle until broken.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Toast the spices: Add the cinnamon stick, star anise, black cardamom, and green cardamom into a dry skillet and toast over high heat for a few minutes, moving the pan constantly, until the green cardamom browns slightly. Remove from the pan, then reduce the heat to medium and add the coriander seeds. Move the pan constantly until they darken slightly - this should take less than a minute. Remove from the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Crush the black and green cardamom pod with a pestle or something heavy until they break open, then place all the spices in a soup infusion bag or wrap them in cheesecloth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: By this time your water should be close to simmering. Add the salt, sugar and beef stock powder and stir briefly. Let the broth simmer gently (don’t let it boil) for 1 hour, skimming off the scum after you see a bunch collected on the surface.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: After 1 hour of simmering, do a final skim of the scum, then add the onion, ginger, spice bag, and the daikon. Simmer for at least 2-2.5 more hours, or however long it takes for the largest piece of meat or oxtail to be fork tender. As the broth simmers, top it up with just enough water to keep everything submerged; do not add too much water however or you will dilute the broth.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While the broth is simmering, prepare your pho bowl supplies. Soak noodles in room temp water for 20-30 minutes or until they turn an opaque white and are fully pliable; drain well. Prepare all your other toppings: cut the lime, soak the onion in cold water, and pick your herbs. Keep everything in the fridge until ready to use, and be sure the noodles are in an airtight container so they don't dry out.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the broth is done, remove the spice bag, ginger and onion and discard. Remove the bones, and if you see any meat or tendon attached to them, pick them off before you discard the bones as they are delicious!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Remove the brisket, and if serving right away, slice into thin pieces once it’s cool enough to handle then place on a serving platter. If not serving right away, soak it in cold water for 5 minutes to cool it down then refrigerate in a covered container; this will prevent it from drying and turning dark.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove the daikon and cut them into smaller pieces and place on the same serving platter as the brisket. Leave the oxtail in the broth.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Final seasoning of the broth: Add all of the fish sauce, and then taste the broth and add more hot water as needed until it is no longer too salty. If you find that it needs more fish sauce rather than more water, go ahead and add more fish sauce or salt. The broth should taste a little too strong right now, because it will be diluted once it goes over the noodles. You can also add a little more sugar if you think it needs it.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Assembly:

title: Kimchi Sundubu Jjigae
description: This warming and comforting sundubu jjigae is made with thinly sliced meat and kimchi. It takes less than 30 minutes to prepare this bubbling pot of stew packed with robust flavors!

ingredients.name: to 3 teaspoons gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes)
sesame oil (use a little more if using more gochugaru)
saewujeot (salted shrimp) or salt to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the meat and kimchi into small thin strips. Add the kimchi, meat, gochugaru, garlic and sesame oil to a small pot, and place it over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stir-fry until the meat is almost cooked, 3 - 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour in water (or broth) and the juice from the kimchi. Bring it to a boil, and continue to boil for 3 - 4 minutes. Skim off the scum.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the soft tofu in big chunks. Stir in the salted shrimp (or salt) to taste (start with 1/4 teaspoon) and black pepper. Cook for 4 -5 minutes. Add the chopped scallion just before removing the pot from the heat. If desired, crack an egg into the stew to serve while it’s still boiling hot.

title: Small Sticky Rice Balls over Mango Smoothie
description: Small sticky rice balls over mango smoothie

ingredients.name: large cooled ripe mangos ( , peeled and cubed)
cooled banana for adding some sweetness ( , peeled (optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, mix glutinous rice flour with water. Knead several minutes to form dough. And then take a small portion; shape the portion into a small around ball (size should be similar to litter finger top). Or you can firstly take one third out and shape it into a thin long log for an equal segmentation. Anyway, use the most comfort way to make small around balls.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: To cook the balls, bring water to boil in a large pot. Cook until the sticky rice balls floating on the surface and then continue cooking for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer them out and soak in iced water until completely cooled down (to make them more elastic). And then drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Put 2/3 of the mango cubes and banana in your blender and add coconut milk(I do not list a specific amount because I cannot define the size of the mango, So adjust it according to your own experience. Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lay the smoothie firstly and then add mango cubes and sticky rice balls. Enjoy!

title: Pico de Gallo
description: This pico de gallo recipe is a classic and authentic Mexican dish made with fresh tomatoes, onions, jalapeños, cilantro, and lime juice.

ingredients.name: large jalapeños, (seeds and veins removed, finely diced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all ingredients to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Toss together, taste, and add more salt if needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Enjoy immediately or refrigerate and serve when ready to eat.

title: Mediterranean Spinach Chickpea Stew
description: This spinach chickpea stew turns a bag of frozen spinach and some chickpeas into a wholesome one-pot dinner to feed a crowd! There are variations of this spinach stew recipe with tomatoes throughout the Mediterranean and the Middle East.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large pot, heat ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add the onions and garlic and cook, tossing regularly, for 3 to 5 minutes or until softened.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the tomatoes, spinach, chickpeas, and chicken broth. Add the parsley and season with a good dash of kosher salt and black pepper. Stir in the spices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring to a boil of medium-high, then turn the heat down to low and cover partway, leaving part of the top open. Allow the spinach to simmer for 25 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the spinach stew is simmering, toast the vermicelli. In a small pan, heat about 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high. Add the vermicelli and continuously stir to toast it evenly. Vermicelli should turn a nice golden brown, but watch carefully not to over-brown or burn. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Stir in the toasted vermicelli in the spinach stew and cook for another 10 minutes or until the vermicelli noodles are cooked to tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the heat and finish with lemon juice and a good drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

title: Vegetarian Moussaka Recipe with Mushroom Sauce
description: Best Greek vegetarian moussaka recipe with layers of aubergine, comforting potatoes, béchamel and a delicious mushroom sauce! The ultimate veggie moussaka!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this vegetarian moussaka recipe, begin by preparing your eggplants. Remove the stalks from the eggplants and cut them into slices, aprrox.1 cm thick. Season with salt and place in a colander for about half an hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the eggplants with plenty of water and squeeze with your hands, to get rid of the excessive water. Pat them dry and fry in plenty of oil, until nicely colored. Place the fried eggplants on some paper, in order to absorb the oil. For a healthier version of this vegetarian moussaka recipe try drizzling the eggplants with some olive oil and bake them for 15 minutes at 200C instead of frying them.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now it’s time to prepare a delicious mushroom based sauce for your vegetarian moussaka. Heat a pan to medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Stir in the chopped mushrooms and sauté, until most of the juices have evaporated. Add the chopped onions and garlic and sauté. Pour in the wine and wait to evaporate. Add the tinned tomatoes, mushing them with a wooden spoon, the sugar, cinnamon and a good pinch of salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, turn the heat down and simmer for about 15 minutes until most of the juices have evaporated and the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lastly prepare the béchamel sauce for the vegetarian moussaka. Use a deep pan to melt the butter over low-medium heat. Add the flour whisking continuously to make a paste and add warmed milk in a steady stream. Keep whisking in order to prevent your sauce from getting lumpy. If the sauce still needs to thicken, boil over low heat while continuing to stir. Remove the pan from the stove and stir in the egg yolks, salt, pepper, a pinch of nutmeg and the grated cheese. Whisk really quickly, season with salt to taste and set aside while you assemble the dish.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For this vegetarian moussaka recipe you will need a large baking dish, approx. 20*30 cm. Butter the bottom and sides of the pan and sprinkle with some breadcrumbs (this will help absorb the extra juices). Layer the eggplants. Pour in the mushroom sauce and even out. Add a second layer of eggplants, top with the béchamel sauce and smooth out with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake the vegetarian moussaka in preheated oven at 180-200C for about 25-30 minutes, until crust turns light golden brown. Even though it will be really hard.. you should wait for the moussaka to cool down for a while before cutting into pieces.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve this delicious vegetarian moussaka with a refreshing Greek salad aside. Enjoy!

title: Thai Peanut Butter Ramen
description: This Thai peanut butter ramen is a perfect dish for your weekday dinner. The tender noodles, juicy chicken and colorful veggies are soaked in a rich broth that is nutty, savory, spicy and sweet.

ingredients.name: to 4 tablespoons Thai red curry paste ((*Footnote 1))
(8 oz / 225 g) boneless skinless chicken breast ((or 2 chicken thighs))
lime (, juiced (and more lime wedges to garnish))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat oil in a 4-quart (3.78-litedutch oven (or heavy poover medium-high heat until hot. Add the onion. Cook and stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the garlic, ginger, and red curry paste. Cook and stir for another minute or so, until it becomes very fragrant and the curry paste evenly coats the veggies.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chicken broth. Use a spatula to scrape the bottom of the dutch oven to release the brown bits. Add the coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir to mix well. Try to use your spatula to break apart the peanut butter. The peanut butter will melt into the broth once it starts simmering. Taste the broth. You can add more Thai red curry paste if the broth is not spicy enough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the broth comes to a boil, add the chicken breast and mushrooms. Turn to medium-low heat and cover. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the chicken breast is just cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the chicken to a plate. Shred with two forks. If you find the inside of the chicken is still pink, return it to the pot and cook for a few more minutes, until it just cooked through.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn to medium-high heat and bring to a boil. Add the instant noodles and bell peppers. Boil according to the package instructions until the noodles turn tender, 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn off the heat. Add back the chicken and lime juice. Stir to mix well. Taste the broth. You can adjust the taste by adding more salt. If the broth is too spicy, you can add more sugar to balance the hot taste.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve hot with more lime wedges and cilantro, if using.

title: Cabbage Thoran Recipe
description: Cabbage Thoran is a dry vegetable dish from the South Indian state of Kerala made with finely chopped cabbage and fresh coconut. It is cooked in coconut oil with onions, green chillies, curry leaves, and a few spices.

ingredients.name: onions (– finely chopped or ⅓ cup sliced pearl onions or chopped shallots)
to 2 tablespoons coriander leaves (– chopped, for garnish, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preparation

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making Cabbage Thoran

title: Shrimp Salad
description: Shrimp Salad – amazingly delicious and easy shrimp salad with the best flavors of summer. Perfect for BBQ party, picnics, potluck or for light dinner. Creamy, vibrant, and outrageously delicious!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium-size pot, bring 3 quarts of water with 1 tablespoon of salt to a boil over medium high heat. Add the shrimp and reduce the heat to medium-low. Cover the pan and simmer for about 3- 5 minutes, until the shrimp are opaque and pink. Do not overcook. Drain immediately and transfer to a bowl. Cool completely, set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, mix together onion, mayonnaise, mustard, Creole seasoning, lemon juice and zest. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add in the shrimp and chopped green onions. Mix until fully combined and garnish with chopped dill. Cover bowl with a transparent plastic wrap. Place in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve on a bed of lettuce, mixed greens, avocado or tomato wedges, if desired.

title: Shaobing
description: ShaoBing, Chinese old style bread.

ingredients.name: warm water ( , around 35 degree C (10ml for adjusting ))
Sichuan peppercorn ( , adjust according to personally preference)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Melt sugar and yeast with warm water. And then mix with flour and salt. Knead until smooth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cover with a wet cloth and proof for around 30 minutes in warm places until 1 and 1/2 times in size.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix sesame paste with salt and sesame oil until well combined. Toast Sichuan peppercorn with lowest fire and then ground it after cooling down.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Coat the operating board with sesame oil. Roll out to a large rectangle (mine around 30cm long and 20cm wide). Spread the mixed sauce and Sichuan pepper powder evenly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll the dough up tightly starting from the long side. Try to stretch the dough slightly during this process cause we just want more layers inside the Shaobing.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cut into six portions and blend the two ends of each portion together (to wrap the fillings inside) and make round balls.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat oven to 180 degree C around 365 degree F if you plan to bake them.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Brush each one with light soy sauce and then press them gently into a bowl with toasted sesame seeds. Turn around and coat the other side.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake for around 15 to 20 minutes until the outside surface becomes stiff and brown. Or heat up a plan over medium fire and then pan fry the first side around 5 minutes over medium fire and then the second side 4 minutes over low fire. Both sides should be crispy and slightly browned.

title: Bulgogi Deopbap (Bulgogi Rice Bowl)
description: This bulgogi rice bowl is an easy one-dish meal! The recipe adds extra veggies and sauce to make it a well balanced one-dish meal.

ingredients.name: thinly sliced beef (rib eye, top sirloin, chuck tender, etc.) (Note 1)
grated Asian pear (you can use more) (optional)
water (or anchovy, dasima, or vegetable broth) (Note 2 )
mushrooms (white, crimini, or shiitaki, oyster, etc.), thinly sliced

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix all the marinade ingredients in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If using packaged pre-sliced meat, separate the slices. Add the meat, onion, and scallions to the marinade. Toss gently, with hands, to mix everything well. Marinate for 30 minutes to an hour in the fridge.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add the meat along with any remaining marinade. Cook the meat for about a minute. Try not to cook off the sauce by lowering the heat if needed. Then, add the vegetables and the sauce. Stir-fry for an additional 2 - 3 minutes until the meat and vegetables are cooked. Serve over rice.

title: Ensalada de Nopales
description: Ensalada de Nopales, or cactus salad, is an authentic Mexican side dish that features crisp nopales, tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and queso panela for a quick and refreshing recipe that pairs well with any Mexican meal.

ingredients.name: large nopales cactus paddles, (trimmed, cleaned, and diced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the diced cactus paddles, 1 teaspoon kosher salt, and enough water to cover them completely in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the water from the nopales and rinse them under warm water to remove any excess slimy liquid.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the cooked nopales into a separate bowl. Add the Roma tomatoes, jalapeño, onion, lime juice, remaining 1 teaspoon of kosher salt, cilantro, and queso panela.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lightly toss to combine all the ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to come together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Uncover and serve as a side dish or appetizer with tortilla chips.

title: Lebanese-Style Cinnamon Meatballs Recipe
description: A unique meatballs recipe with a Lebanese twist! Melt-in-your-mouth tender meatballs with vivid notes of cinnamon and allspice. And the braising tomato sauce...not your average!

ingredients.name: sandwich bread, toasted to a golden brown
Private Reserve extra virgin olive oil
Crushed red pepper flakes (optional, if you like a spicy sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F, and prepare a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, place the toasted bread and cover with the milk. Let the bread soak in the milk until very soft and mushy (about 15 minutes), then squeeze the bread well to wring all the milk out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, add the bread, ground beef, and the remaining meatballs ingredients. Using clean hands, mix/knead to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Form the meat mixture into meatballs (each the size of a tablespoon.) Arrange the meatballs in one layer on the prepared baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in 375 degrees F heated oven for 11 to 14 minutes or so. (don’t worry if they’re not fully done at this point, take them out and set aside)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While meatballs are baking, prepare the sauce. In a 5-quart braiser like this one or a large, deep saute pan like this one, heat 2 tbsp olive oil until shimmering but not smoking. Add the onions and cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring regularly, until golden. Add the garlic and cook for a quick 30 seconds while tossing.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Now add carrots, crushed tomatoes and the remaining sauce ingredients. Bring sauce to a boil for 5 minutes or so, then lower heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the meatballs to the sauce, cover and let simmer for 20 minutes or so until the meatballs are fully cooked through. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if you like.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve in dinner bowls with Lebanese rice or warm pita. A side of fattoush salad is a great addition to this meal.

title: Greek Bougatsa recipe (Custard Pie with Phyllo and ground Cinnamon)
description: The authentic greek bougatsa recipe! A traditional Greek dessert made with the most creamy custard wrapped in golden brown crispy phyllo, sprinkled with melted butter and garnished with icing sugar and cinammon.. Simply amazing!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make this traditional bougatsa recipe, start by making the filling. To prepare the filling for the bougatsa add in a large bowl the sugar, eggs and flour; whisk until the ingredients combine.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour into a saucepan the milk and the vanilla extract and bring to the boil. Right before the milk comes to the boil, pour 1/3 of the milk & vanilla extract mix into the flour mixture from step 1 and stir.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn the heat down. Add the flour & milk mixture into the saucepan with the remaining warm milk. Whisk very quickly, until the mixture has thickened and is smooth and creamy. Do not remove the pan from the stove while whisking. This should take 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: to keep the custard from forming a skin on top, while you prepare the rest of the bougatsa recipe.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: For this bougatsa recipe you will need a large baking tray, approx. 20×30 cm / 8×12 inch. Using a pastry brush, butter the bottom and sides of the tray.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: from the plastic sleeve. To make this bougatsa recipe you will need 10-12 phyllo sheets. Use 5-6 sheets of phyllo for the bottom of the bougatsa and 4-5 sheets for the top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Begin by layering the sheets one by one on the bottom of the tray, making sure to sprinkle each one thoroughly with melted butter. Tip in the custard from step 4, smoothing the surface with a spatula and fold the phyllo sheet flaps over the custard.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: , sprinkling each sheet with melted butter. With a knife trim some of the excessive phyllo, if you like, and roll the rest on the edges. Brush the top with plenty of butter and score the top of the bougatsa with a sharp knife.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bake the bougatsa in preheated oven at 160C / 320F for 45 minutes, until the phyllo is crisp and golden brown.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: for a while before serving and sprinkle with icing sugar and cinnamon. Enjoy while still warm with a hot cup of coffee or tea.

title: Squash Casserole
description: Creamy, cheesy, and downright gorgeous, this casserole is magnificent as a stand-alone dish or as a comforting side. Vibrant yellow squash in a rich, cheesy sauce is exceptionally delicious.

ingredients.name: sleeves round buttery crackers, (crushed (I used Ritz))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350℉/177℃. Lightly grease an 8- or 9-inch square baking pan or casserole dish and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onions, garlic, and thyme. Sauté for about a minute until the onions are soft and translucent.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Then add squash, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetable softens and liquid is released, about 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat and drain out any extra liquid.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a medium mixing bowl, stir together eggs, sour cream, and mayonnaise until fully combined. Stir the egg mixture into the squash mixture, add the cheese, and mix to coat the squash.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the squash mixture to the prepared baking pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In another small bowl, toss together crushed crackers and butter. Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over the top of the squash.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Bake at 350℉/177℃ for 20-25 minutes (uncovered) until the casserole is set and the topping is lightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Stir Fried Water Spinach - Two Ways
description: Introducing two ways to cook stir-fried water spinach, and both require fewer than five ingredients. Try out this Chinese leafy green to add color and nutrition to your dinner table. {Vegan, Gluten-Free}

ingredients.name: liquid from the jar of fermented tofu
Shaoxing wine ((or chicken stock, or vegetable stock))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the water spinach by cutting off the tough stems, usually 2 to 3 inches from the bottom end. Discard the leaves that are withered, have brown spots, or have turned yellow. Thoroughly rinse with tap water and transfer to a colander to drain. Separate the stems and leaves with a pair of kitchen scissors. Cut the stems into 1-inch long pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Method 1

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Method 2

title: Teriyaki Chicken
description: Teriyaki Chicken – flavorful and juicy chicken thighs coated in a delicious homemade and easy Teriyaki sauce.

ingredients.name: (5 ml) freshly squeezed lemon juice (or apple cider vinegar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chicken thighs in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste, making sure all sides of the chicken are covered with seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium size bowl, combine soy sauce, brown sugar, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, green onions and olive oil. Gently whisk ingredients together until fully combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer spice mix to the chicken and mix until every part of the chicken is covered with spice. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let it marinade for about 1 to 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil a large 12 inch cast iron skillet (non sticky sauce pan) over medium-high heat. Using a thong, add in marinated chicken to the skillet making sure to shake off any excess spice. Sear both sides of the chicken until golden and lightly charred- about 8 to 10 minutes on each side depending on the thickness of your fillet.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add in the marinade into the cooked chicken and continue to cook and toss chicken until the sauce thickens, about 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Grill Method. Using a tong, remove chicken from the sauce and discard any excess marinate. Preheat grill to medium- high heat. Place chicken on the grill and grill for about 4-5 minutes on each side, until you have a nice char – you may need to turn the chicken occasionally on each side until it is cooked all the way. Do this in batches if you have a small grill. Do not overcook chicken. Remove from grill (or grill pan). Let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve immediately.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with green onions if desired and serve warm with rice, broccoli or any veggies of your choice.

title: Beans Thoran Recipe
description: Beans Thoran is a dry vegetable dish from Kerala cuisine made with french beans, coconut, onions, curry leaves, and mild spices. It is cooked in coconut oil and finished with fresh grated coconut.

ingredients.name: to 7 pearl onions (or sambar onions, ¼ to ⅓ cup chopped shallots or onions can also be used)
to 4 garlic cloves (– small to medium-sized, finely chopped)
green chilli (– chopped or ½ to 1 teaspoon)
french beans (or green beans, about 1.5 to 1.75 cups finely chopped beans)
grated fresh coconut (– can swap with frozen coconut)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Chopping Green Beans

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making Beans Thoran

title: Nabak Kimchi (Water Kimchi)
description: Nabak kimchi is a type of water kimchi that’s made with thinly sliced radish squares and other vegetables. It is easy to make, yet deliciously refreshing!

ingredients.name: - 16 ounces napa cabbage (baechu, 배추) -- inner yellowish leaves
to 1.5 tablespoons gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes) (Adjust to taste)
thin ginger slices, about 1 inch rounds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Clean the radish by scrubbing with a brush and/or scratching off the stubborn impurities with a small knife. Do not peel the skin. Cut into about 1-inch thick discs. Cut each disc into 3 pieces, and then slice thinly into about 1-inch squares, placing in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Rinse the cabbage leaves a couple of times. Cut each leaf lengthwise into 1-inch wide pieces, and then crosswise into about 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the radish. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of salt, and toss well to evenly distribute the salt. Let it sit until wilted, about 30 minutes. Do not drain or rinse.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, soak the gochugaru in 1/2 cup of warm water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To cut the carrot into flower shapes, cut 3 to 4 ”‘V” shape grooves lengthwise, and then cut into thin slices. Or simply slice crosswise into thin rounds. Cut the pear into about 1-inch squares. Cut other vegetables into about 1-inch lengths. Add to the bowl with the salted radish and cabbage.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a large bowl, dissolve 2 tablespoons of salt in 10 cups of water. Strain the soaked gochugaru into the water through a fine mesh.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the broth over the salted radish and cabbage mix and stir well to combine everything. Adjust the seasoning to taste if necessary. The combined broth should taste slightly too salty to eat as is. The saltiness will reduce as the kimchi ferments. It will actually be easier to handle if you place the salted radish and cabbage along with its liquid in the container or jar first, and then add the broth with gochugaru.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Keep it in an airtight container or jar. Leave it out at room temperature for a day or two before storing in the fridge. The kimchi can be eaten within a few days. Stir to the bottom each time before taking some out to serve.

title: Thai Leftover Roast Salad (Laab)
description: Use up any leftover roast in a Thai laab, a northeastern Thai salad bright with mint and lime juice.

ingredients.name: Roughly 150 g leftover meat or vegetables
finely chopped palm sugar or light brown sugar
- ½ tsp dried chili flakes, to taste
A big handful of mint and any other fresh herbs you have sitting around; cilantro, green onions, and dill are all good options.
Optional for serving: cucumber, crisp lettuce (if you want to make a wrap), rice or sticky rice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a dry saute pan, add the rice and cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly until the rice has a deep brown colour. Remove from heat and grind into a powder in a mortar and pestle or using a coffee grinder.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For leftover poultry, shred the meat into small strips. If using roast beef, thinly slice into bite-sized pieces. For roast veggies, cut into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the leftovers up slightly so they are warm or room temp.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chilies and shallots; stir until the sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the leftovers, toasted rice powder and fresh herbs, and toss until well combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve with cucumber or lettuce (make a lettuce wrap). Add Thai sticky rice for a truly traditional meal.

title: Veg Fried Rice
description: Chinese veg fried rice, seasoned with light soy sauce

ingredients.name: Bok Choy ( , you can use celery to replace it)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook carrot and purple cabbage in boiling water for around 1 minute. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up 1/2 tablespoon cooking oil in wok and then fry mushrooms for around 1 minute. Add leftover rice, carrot and corn. Give a big stir-fry until all the ingredients are well mixed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add light soy sauce, salt and then Bok Choy. Fry for around 20-30 seconds until well combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve hot better with soups.

title: Homemade Chamoy
description: This homemade chamoy sauce is the ultimate combination of sweet, sour, spicy, tangy, and sticky. This Mexican condiment is super versatile!

ingredients.name: dried hibiscus flowers ((can be easily found in most Hispanic grocery stores, sometimes labeled as “flor de jamaica”))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium saucepan or pot, add water, dried apricots, prunes, dried mango, dried hibiscus flowers, granulated sugar, and chili lime seasoning. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Once boiling, cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Turn off the heat and uncover. Allow the mixture to cool for about 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add mixture into a food processor or blender along with lime juice and blend until smooth. Taste for seasoning and add more lime juice or chili lime seasoning if desired. For a more runny consistency, add more water 1 tablespoon at a time.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer chamoy into glass containers for storage. Serve with fresh fruit or rim glasses for drinks and cocktails.

title: Sheet Pan Baked Meatballs and Vegetables (Italian-Style)
description: With Italian-style meatballs, sliced baby potatoes, and a few fresh vegetables, this Sheet Pan Baked Meatballs is a complete meal in one. And you'll love the big flavors in this easy dinner! Be sure to review my full post for more tips!

ingredients.name: red onion ((large, halved and thinly sliced (1/4-inch) ))
baby potatoes ((quartered or sliced small to cook quickly))
baby bell peppers ((any color, cut into 1/4 inch thick batons))
canned San Marzano tomatoes ((whole, peeled with their juices))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 400 degrees F and position a rack in the center.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, combine the vegetables, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Drizzle 2 extra virgin olive oil and toss to combine. Transfer the vegetables to a large lightly oiled sheet pan and spread them out.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same large bowl, combine the meat, onions, garlic, parsley, oregano, mint, Parmesan, bread crumbs and egg. Season with a big pinch of kosher salt and black pepper. Drizzle with a little olive oil (about 1 tbsp). Mix until everything is well-combined. Form the meat mixture into 1-inch meatballs and lightly press the center of the meatballs with your thumb (do not completely flatten).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Arrange the meatballs (or patties) in the same sheet pan with the vegetables. Pour the canned tomatoes all over. Season with kosher salt and drizzle the top of the tomatoes generously with extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the sheet pan with foil and bake in the heated oven for about 15 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 4 to 5 minutes or until the meatballs are fully cooked through.

title: Fish Fillet in Cream Sauce
description: Fish Fillet in Cream Sauce – the EASIEST, most simple, quick and flavorful fish fillet in a cream sauce. Ready in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: 1-11/2 pound (453- 680 g) red snapper fillet (about 2-3 fillets)
(28 ml) olive oil or canola oil
(5 g) minced garlic or 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder
(60 g) cream (, heavy or whipping cream)
(1 g) white pepper or black pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse fish fillet, season with seasoned salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat until hot, and then add the fish fillet, brown 2 minutes on each side to ensure even brownness.

steps.title: Step 3

title: Greek Beef Soup recipe (Kreatosoupa)
description: For a cold winter's day; hearty, aromatic, warming Greek beef soup (Kreatosoupa) with vegetables and potatoes for the whole family to enjoy!
tags: beef soup with potatoes and vegetables

ingredients.name: carrots, peeled and cut in slices
medium potatoes, peeled and cut in cubes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek beef soup recipe, first cut the beef into 5cm (2 inches) pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large pot over high heat. Add the olive oil and beef and sauté, until nicely coloured.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the finely chopped onions and carrots and sauté for 1 more minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the same pot approx. 1.5L of water. (The water should cover the ingredients.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the celery, potatoes, bay leaves, thyme and beef cube. Stir well with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the lid on, turn the heat down and let the beef soup simmer for approx. 2 hours. Check once in a while to remove the foam from the surface with a spoon. Add more water if needed as it evaporates.

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

title: Chinese Seaweed Salad (凉拌海带丝)
description: Tender meaty seaweed served in a savory, sour, and garlicky sauce. This seaweed salad is very easy to make and is a perfect cold appetizer to add nutrition to your meal in the summer. {Vegan}

ingredients.name: oz. 120 fresh seaweed strips or 1 oz. dried kombu ( (kelp))
dried Chinese chili peppers (torn into 2 to 3 pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you’re using dried kombu, place the kombu in a large bowl and add warm water to cover. Let rehydrate until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Slice into strips (refer to the blog post above to see how to slice the rehydrated kombu).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: If you’re using fresh seaweed, rinse with tap water and drain.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring a small pot of water to a boil over medium-high heat. Add the seaweed. Let cook for 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain and rinse the seaweed under tap water to cool. Drain thoroughly and transfer to a medium-sized bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Stir to mix well. Pour sauce into the bowl with the cooked seaweed. Make sure not to stir it, so all the garlic and ginger will be on top of the seaweed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the oil in a small skillet (or saucepaover medium heat until hot. Add the dried chili peppers. Stir a few times until the chili peppers turn dark red. Immediately pour the oil into the bowl with the seaweed, doing your best to pour it directly onto the ginger and garlic. Toss with a pair of tongs to mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Garnish with the cilantro and toss again.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve at room temperature or cold as an appetizer or side dish.

title: How to make homemade dumpling wrappers
description: Making dumpling wrappers at home is easier than you may think. All you need is good old all-purpose flour, salt and water. The result is tender and chewy wrappers that are easy to work with.

ingredients.name: all purpose flour (about 280 grams, more for dusting)
to 3/4 cup hot water, about 170°F (75°C) (See note 1)
to 3 tablespoons Cornstarch or potato starch for dusting (if storing (See note 2))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 2 cups of flour to a bowl. Dissolve 1/2 teaspoon of salt in 2/3 cup of hot water. Gradually add the water to the flour while mixing with a spoon and checking the moisture level.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix it by hand, squeezing and digging into the dough with your fingers, until the dough comes together, and knead with the heel of your hand until the dough is smooth but slightly stiff. You can adjust the dough by kneading in a little more flour or more water by a teaspoon or wetting your hands.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover with a plastic wrap, and let it rest for 30 minutes to an hour. After resting, the dough should feel soft and smooth. (This is a good time to start making the filling.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Shape the dough into a rectangular/oval disk on a lightly floured work surface. Using a sharp knife, cut the dough into 3 long pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll a piece with both hands to make a thin log, about 1-inch diameter and about 8-inch long. Cover the remaining dough to keep it from drying out.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cut the log into 3/4-inch pieces (10 to 11 pieces). Press the cut side with your palm to flatten to a small disk. Dust and roll out each disk with a small rolling pin to a thin 3.5 to 4-inch circle. (You can also use a round cutter or wine glass to make a perfect round.) Repeat steps 5 and 6 with the remaining 2 logs. It’s best to make a few wrappers at a time and wrap the filling in. Always cover the dough and wrappers that are not being used.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: The dumpling wrappers can be stored for up to 2 days in the fridge. Dust each piece with cornstarch or potato starch before stacking up. Wrap the stacked dumpling wraps with a plastic, and keep it in an airtight plastic bag. You can also freeze the dough the same way.

steps.title: Step 8

title: Thai Curry Crab Stir Fry
description: Pu Pad Pong Garee is a classic seafood dish in Thailand, and one of my fave. Crab meat is stir fried in a custardy curry sauce. The flavour is to die for, and it is incredibly quick and easy to make!

ingredients.name: Thai chili paste oil (the red oil that floats on top of the chili paste jar) (or another chili oil)
fresh crab meat (set aside a couple of teaspoons for garnish)
small handful celery leaves and thinly sliced stalk (or chopped Chinese celery, plus extra for garnish)
A few pieces of julienned red chilies or bell pepper (optional garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: For the custard: Whisk the chili paste and the chili oil together to loosen the paste. Add about a tablespoon of the evaporated milk and whisk to make sure there are no lumps of chili paste remaining. Add the rest of the evaporated milk, the eggs, oyster sauce, fish sauce and white pepper. Whisk until well combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Have all your ingredients and serving plate ready to go and within arm's reach, as the cooking goes very fast!

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a nonstick skillet or well-seasoned wok on medium heat, then add the oil, onions, and garlic and saute for a minute or so just until the onion doesn't taste raw but is still crunchy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Keeping the heat on medium, add the curry powder and stir for just 5 seconds to infuse into the oil. Do not use high heat or the curry powder will burn instantly.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the crab and toss for just 10-15 seconds to heat up the crab. Be gentle, try not to break up the crab too much.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the custard and using a rubber spatula stir without stopping until the mixture is thick and creamy, but still looks slightly undercooked. Off the heat, stir in the celery and immediately transfer onto a serving plate.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Garnish with red pepper juliennes, more celery leaves and extra crab meat

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with jasmine rice and prik nam pla, if desired.

title: Garlic Snow Peas Stir Fry
description: Enjoy this simple 5 minutes healthy spring and summer dish--garlic snow peas stir fry

ingredients.name: toasted sesame seeds for garnishing ( , optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring water to boil in a medium pot, add several drops of oil and a really small pinch of salt. Place the snow peas to cook for around 1 minute. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up oil in wok over medium fire and then fry the minced garlic until aroma. Add snow peas in, followed with salt and sesame oil. Give a quick stir-fry to mix everything together. Transfer out immediately.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and enjoy.

title: Mediterranean Vegan Wraps with Cauliflower and Tahini
description: Mediterranean Vegan Wraps with roasted cauliflower, tahini, and a peppery arugula salad! This healthy and hearty recipe can be prepared ahead for lunch or a light dinner. Be sure to read through the tips and variation ideas.

ingredients.name: lemon, (cut in half (you'll use as much of the lemon juice to your liking))
small red onion, (halved then thinly sliced)
bell pepper, (any color, cored and sliced into thin batons)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the tahini sauce according to this recipe and set aside for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the cauliflower on a large baking sheet. Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil (I used a little more than 1/4 cup Private Reserve EVOO). Toss to coat. Season with salt, za'atar, paprika, and cumin. Toss again until cauliflower is well coated with the spices and olive oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roast in the 450 degrees heated oven for 20 minutes. Turn florets over and roast for another 10 to 15 minutes or until browned to your liking (I like mine deeply browned, so I tend to leave them in the oven even longer). Remove from oven. Add a sprinkle of za'atar and squeeze just a little fresh lemon juice on top.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: While cauliflower is roasting, make the salad. In a salad bowl, mix arugula, red onion, chickpeas, bell peppers, and jalapenos. Add a pinch of salt, extra virgin olive oil, and a little lemon juice to your liking. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Assemble the Mediterranean vegan wraps. Lay flatbreads flat, spread some tahini sauce on top. Add roasted cauliflower, and arugula salad. Drizzle with more tahini and roll the flatbreads from one end to another making 4 sandwich wraps. Enjoy!

title: Greek Chickpea soup recipe (Revithia)
description: Hearty, simple and extra comforting, this Greek chickpea soup recipe (revithia soupa) is with no doubt the perfect dish for a cold winter’s day!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek chickpea soup recipe (revithia soupa), start by washing the chickpeas and let them soak in plenty of cold water overnight (ideally for 18 hours).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: When you are ready to make this Greek chickpea soup recipe, drain the chickpeas (revithia) and discard the soaking water. Place the chickpeas in a colander and rinse very well with plenty of water (4-5 times). Put your hands in the colander and rub them well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the revithia in a large pan with enough cold water to cover them (about 4cm over the chickpeas).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the heat up and bring to the boil. Keep removing the froth from the top with a wooden spoon for about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain the chickpeas and then put them back in the pan and add enough warm water to cover them again. Bring to the boil and add the olive oil, chopped onion, oregano and bay leafs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Turn the heat down to a simmer and place the lid on. Let the revithia cook for 1-2 hours, depending on the chickpeas, until tender. Add more water if necessary in order not to dry.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If you prefer your soup to be thicker, during the end of cooking time add in a bowl the flour and lemon juice and pour gradually 1-2 ladles of the soup and whisk. Add the mixture slowly in the pan with the chickpeas and season. Stir gently for 2-3 minutes until the soup thickens.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve this Greek chickpea soup while still warm with lots of Kalamata olives and crusted bread aside. Enjoy!

title: Three Bean Salad
description: Three Bean Salad - the perfect healthy make-ahead side dish for your summer backyard barbecues or potlucks. A classic salad with garbanzo beans, kidney beans, cannellini beans and green beans tossed in a vibrant dressing.

ingredients.name: can kidney beans (, drained and rinsed)

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, mustard, lemon juice, sugar, salt, onion powder, and parsley. Pour the dressing over the bean mixture and thoroughly mix to coat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover salad with a plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours before serving.

title: Traditional Greek bean soup recipe (Fasolada)
description: Looking for an authentic Greek bean soup (fasolada) recipe? Find out how to make it the traditional Greek way! This is the authentic recipe for fasolada, a trademark dish that has nourished generations.

ingredients.name: dry white kidney beans or cannellini beans or navy beans (18 ounces)
large white onion, finely chopped (if you love onions, add one more!)
a pinch of paprika (hot or sweet, according to preferance)
salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste (min 2 flat teaspoons each)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare the fasolada (Greek bean soup), place the beans in a saucepan with plenty of cold water to cover them. Bring to the boil, turn the heat down to medium and parboil for 30-35 minutes, until slightly tender. Drain in colander and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Finely chop the onion, celery and carrots. Add 3-4 tbsps of olive oil in a deep pan, add the chopped vegetables and blend. Sauté for about 2 minutes and add the tomato paste and continue sautéing for a minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the parboiled beans in the pan and pour in enough boiling water to cover the beans and little bit more and blend lightly. Place the lid on and simmer the fasolada for about 35 minutes, until the beans are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Towards the end of cooking time, pour in the remaining olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Boil for a few more minutes, until the soup becomes thick and creamy.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this traditional Greek bean soup (fasolada) while still steaming hot with a few Kalamata olives and of course some village bread. Enjoy!

title: Za'atar Roasted Chicken Breast Recipe
description: Best roasted chicken breast recipe you will find! Marinated in lemon and olive oil, and covered in Middle Eastern flavors including allspice, sumac, Za'atar. Roasted to fall-off-the-bone perfect.

ingredients.name: chicken breasts, bone in, skin on
medium red onion, sliced or roughly chopped

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a mixing bowl, combine the marinade ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the chicken in a deep pan, sprinkle with salt and pepper and cover with the marinade, making sure to work some of the marinade underneath the skin (this is important for flavor). Cover and place the chicken in the fridge for four hours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer the chicken and marinade to a baking dish or a cast iron skillet. Sprinkle with a little more sumac and paprika. Now, sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the za’atar, and take another tablespoon to work underneath the skin of chicken breasts. (You should have 1 tablespoon of za’atar left for later use).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the chicken in the heated oven and roast for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes (once the chicken’s internal temperature reaches 165 degrees F, it is ready).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle with a little more sumac and the remaining za’atar. Garnish with the toasted nuts and fresh parsley. Enjoy!

title: Aloo Bhaja Recipe
description: Aloo Bhaja is a classic Bengali side dish made with sliced potatoes fried until crisp. It uses very few spices and relies on simple ingredients for flavor. This recipe is quick to make and fits well into everyday meals.

ingredients.name: potatoes (or 1 extra large potato or 3 medium-sized potatoes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and then peel the potatoes. Cut in slices of 0.3 cm to 0.4 cm thickness. Also heat a tawa or frying pan with 1 to 2 tablespoon oil in it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Take the potato slices in a mixing bowl. Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt as required.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix very well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Immediately place the potato slices in the hot oil. Fry on medium low to medium flame. Add less oil as potatoes absorb more oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: When one side is lightly crisp, turn over and fry the second side.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Flip again and a couple of times and fry till the potato slices are crisp and golden. This way fry in batches and add more oil if required. Overall I used 2.5 tablespoons mustard oil for frying.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Remove each fried slice and place on kitchen paper towels for the extra oil to be absorbed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Alternatively, you can also dredge the potato slices in some rice flour and then fry. This way the alu bhaja becomes more crisp and less oil is absorbed. Sometimes I follow this method also.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve aloo bhaja hot or warm as a side dish with khichdi, dal-rice, curd rice or rasam-rice.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Chicken Fajitas - quick, easy, delicious and healthy meal that makes a great weekly rotation menu. Tender and juicy chicken thighs served with strips of colorful crisp-charred bell peppers, onions and avocado slices.

ingredients.name: (907 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts
fresh avocados (, peeled, seeded and sliced)
lime (, cut in wedges, for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place chicken thighs in a large bowl and season with salt and taco seasoning, making sure all sides of the chicken are covered with seasoning. Let rest for about 30 minutes or more , if possible.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a large 12 inch cast iron skillet over medium-high heat, when the pan is hot, add in a tablespoon of oil to lightly coat the bottom of the pan. Using a tong, add in the chicken and sear both sides until golden , lightly charred and cooked through - about 8 to 10 minutes on each side depending on the thickness of your fillet. Transfer chicken to a plate and let rest.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the onions and peppers to the skillet, drizzle with the remaining oil, and cook until the onion is soft and the peppers are slightly softened and charred, for about 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Slice chicken into strips.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve with sliced avocado, lime, tortillas, chopped cilantro, and any other condiments.

title: Hunan Beef -A Spicy Beef Stir Fry Popular Across the Country
description: Hunan style beef stir fry--a classic and popular Chinese beef stir fry recipe

ingredients.name: pickled yellow pepper (, or replaced by thai chili peppers (Note1))
tbsp. oyster sauce (, can be replaced by light soy sauce )
small pinch of salt (, around 1/8 tsp. )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut beef into thin slices (as thin as possible). If you are not skilled at cutting, frozen the beef for around 10 or 15 minutes before cutting.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer beef into a large bowl and then add salt, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, cooking wine, and pepper. Mix competely and set aisde for 15 minutes. Then add starch to mix well. Coat with vegetable cooking oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare all the side ingredients, cut peppers, celery, garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the wok first and then also heat up cooking oil in a wok until warm and then spread the beef slices for around 30 seconds. Transfer out.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return the extra oil to the wok, and fry garlic, ginger, and all the peppers until aroma.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Returan the beef in; add celery, oyster sauce and sugar too. Give a quick fry. Transfer and serve with steamed rice immediately.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: These Chicken Fajitas are ready in 30 minutes for a quick and easy Mexican dinner made with juicy chicken with tender peppers and onions.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast, (pounded to an even ½-inch thickness)
bell peppers, (red and orange, cut into thin strips)
Pinch kosher salt, (plus more to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all the ingredients for the chicken to a large bowl and toss together to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator while you cook the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: For the peppers and onions, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the peppers, onions, soy sauce, and kosher salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions are translucent and begin to caramelize and the bell peppers are soft and tender. Transfer them to a bowl and cover with foil to keep warm.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To the same hot skillet, add 1 teaspoon of olive oil and the marinated chicken. Cook for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165℉.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let it cool slightly before slicing into strips.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the sliced chicken and peppers and onions back to the skillet, and give it quick toss to combine. Serve in warm corn or flour tortillas with guacamole, sour cream, and pico de gallo.

title: Mediterranean-Style Sauteed Shrimp and Zucchini
description: This EASY recipe for sauteed shrimp with vegetables is colorful, flavorful and bursting with Mediterranean flavors. Healthy never tasted so good!

ingredients.name: bell pepper (cored and sliced into sticks)
to 2 zucchini (halved length-wise, sliced into ½ moons (you can use 1 zucchini and 1 yellow squash))
Handful fresh basil leaves (torn or sliced into ribbons (you can use a different herb, depending on what’s available to you))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine the spices (oregano, cumin, coriander, and paprika.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pat shrimp dry and season with kosher salt and 1 ½ tsp of the spice mixture. Set aside briefly or refrigerate till later. (Reserve the remaining spice mixture for the vegetables.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large cast iron skillet, heat 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat. Add onions and ½ the amount of garlic and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, tossing regularly till fragrant (do not allow the garlic to burn.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add zucchini, bell peppers, and chickpeas. Season with salt and pepper and the remaining spice mixture. Toss to combine. If needed, raise the heat just a bit and cook the veggies until tender, tossing regularly (about 5 to 7 minutes.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the veggies to a large plate for now. Return the skillet to the heat and add a little bit of extra virgin olive oil. Add the seasoned shrimp and remaining garlic. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until shrimp is totally pink (about 4 to 5 minutes).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the cooked vegetables back to the skillet with the shrimp. Add cherry tomatoes and lemon juice. Give everything a good toss. Finish with the fresh basil.

title: Traditional Greek Meatball Soup (Giouvarlakia/ Youvarlakia) in Egg-lemon sauce recipe
description: Want to make a traditional Greek Meatball Soup in Egg-lemon sauce (Youvarlakia Avgolemono)? This is a hearty and delicious dish, perfect for a cold winter's day!

ingredients.name: of a cup long-grain rice (not boiled)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek meatball soup, start by making the meatballs (youvarlakia). Place all the meatball ingredients into a large bowl, knead the mixture squeezing the ingredients with your hand until smooth. Leave the mixture to rest in the fridge for 15 minutes. This will prevent the youvarlakia to break up when boiled. Form the meatballs (youvarlakia) and set them aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour into a large pan 2 ½ cups of water and bring to the boil. Turn the heat down and gently add the meatballs (youvarlakia) in the water, put the lid back on and cook for 20-25 minutes. (The water should be enough to cover the meatballs, so add some more warm water if needed)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the egg lemon sauce for the Greek meatball soup, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk. Add the lemon juice and whisk well. Add into the bowl a ladle of hot soup and whisk quickly. Add one more ladle and whisk again until combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the egg lemon sauce into the youvarlakia soup and cook for 2-3 minutes over medium heat, until warm but not boiling.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve this extra warming Greek meatball soup, while still hot with a sprinkle of chopped parsley.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make sure that you do not cover any left overs until they have cooled; the sauce may curdle otherwise!!

title: Venezuelan Arepas
description: Flat, round, savory bread made with only 5 ingredients. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, this Latin-American staple can be enjoyed plain, on the side, or stuffed with your favorite filling!Makes 8-10 arepas

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a large bowl, combine arepa flour and salt until thoroughly combined. Make a well in the center and add the melted butter and water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Gradually stir using a wooding spoon until no dry lumps remain. Adjust the consistency by adding more flour or water as needed; the dough is ready when it doesn’t stick to the sides of the bowl or your fingers. Let it rest for about 5 minutes to hydrate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grab 3 tablespoons of the dough and form a ball, gently press the dough between your palms to flatten, forming about a ¼-inch thick patty. Pay attention to the edges, so you don't leave cracks. If using cheese, make a little well in the center of the dough ball before flattening. Place flattened dough on greased parchment paper and repeat the process for the remaining dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in a large cast-iron or non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the arepas in batches, flipping once, until golden brown in batches, for 5-8 minutes on each side. Drain on a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the arepas to a wire rack and let them cool. Split them and stuff them with the desired filling; shredded chicken, pork, guacamole, butter, maple syrup, or enjoy them as they are.

title: Begun Bhaja Recipe (Baingan Bhaja)
description: Begun Bhaja is a classic Bengali dish made with thinly sliced eggplant that is lightly seasoned and fried in mustard oil until crisp. The slices can also be dusted with rice flour and fried.

ingredients.name: to 6 tablespoons Rice Flour (or gram flour (besan))
to 7 tablespoons mustard oil (for pan frying, you can also use sunflower oil)

Homemade sweet chili sauce ((or store bought))

steps.description: Egg roll filling

steps.description: Wrap the egg rolls
