title: Ojingeochae Muchim (Spicy Squid Strips)
description: dried squid strips seasoned with a sweet and spicy sauce!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the dried squid strings into shorter lengths with kitchen scissors. Rinse in cold water, and drain. Add 1/2 cup of water, and cover. Set it aside until softened, about 20 minutes, flipping over once.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a pan, heat one and a half tablespoons of oil, until hot, over low heat and stir in the chili pepper flakes. Remove from the heat when it becomes pasty. Add the gochujang, corn syrup, soy sauce, and minced garlic. Over medium heat, bring the sauce mixture to a boil, stirring well. Turn the heat off, and stir in sesame oil and sesame seeds. Cool the sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Squeeze the excess water from the squid, and toss well with the sauce. The squid will absorb the sauce better if you massage everything together by hand, using a kitchen glove.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Keep the leftovers in the fridge. It will keep well for a couple of weeks.

title: Rice Cooker Noodles with Shrimp and Ginger
description: Use a rice cooker to simplify and take the guesswork out of this classic Thai noodle dish goong ob woonsen. Glass noodles with shrimp and ginger, done in 15 minutes in even the most basic rice cooker.

ingredients.name: black soy sauce or dark soy sauce
dry glass noodles (sometimes labelled "bean vermicelli" or "bean threads")
large size shrimp (deveined with shell on preferred (see note 1))
low-sodium bacon or pork belly (cut into 1-inch chunks, OR use 2 Tbsp neutral oil)
handful celery leaves or Chinese celery (chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak glass noodles in room temperature water for 10 minutes to soften. Drain and cut the noodles with scissors in half or thirds to shorten them; this will make them easier to eat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix all sauce ingredients together into a large mixing bowl, and stir until the sugar is dissolved. Put the noodles and the shrimp into the bowl and toss to mix. Let this sit until you’re ready to cook.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a rice cooker, add the bacon or oil, garlic, ginger, chopped cilantro stems, and white pepper and/or sichuan peppercorns. Turn it to “cook” and cook for about 3 minutes or until the bacon fat has rendered and the garlic has softened, stirring once or twice in between. *If your rice cooker will not stay on “cook” mode without the lid on at this stage, it is okay to keep the lid on and open it once or twice to stir in between. You’ll just need to press the cook button again after you put the lid back on. (more on this above)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use tongs to place the noodles on top of the bacon and herbs, then pour the sauce and the shrimp on top and arrange the shrimp so they’re in one layer. Cover and let the rice cooker cook for about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: After 4 mins, open the rice cooker and use chopsticks or tongs to stir the noodles, bringing the bottom up the the top, to help redistribute the sauce. Then do your best and bring the shrimp back up to the top, flipping them so the side that is less cooked is facing down (it's not a big deal if a few of them end up under the noodles at this point.) Cover and let it cook again until the rice cooker clicks off, total cooking time should be about 10 minutes but this will vary from machine to machine. *If you have a smart rice cooker, like the Zojirushi Neuro Fuzzy, it should be done as soon as the rice cooker starts giving you a timer countdown, or you can open and check it after noodles have been in there for 10 mins (see more about this above).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the rice cooker clicks off (or switches to warm mode) open and toss everything to distribute all the bits. Taste the noodles, and if they taste a bit underdone, add a splash more water (~2 Tbsp/30 mL) and keep it cooking for a few more minutes. If the shrimp are already cooked at that point, you can remove them before further cooking the noodles.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: To finish, top with celery leaves and/or cilantro and/or green onions, then transfer everything into a serving dish, or serve it right from the rice cooker! Serve with jasmine rice, if desired. PS. The slices of ginger are meant for infusion only and are not meant to be eaten, though you can if you like that strong ginger flavour.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: Chicken Tortilla Soup filled with shredded chicken, tortilla strips, beans, and corn. A comforting soup perfect for weeknight dinners!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the broiler. Line a small baking sheet with aluminum foil and arrange the tomatoes in a single layer on top. Broil for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the skin is blackened and blistered. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Carefully toast the pasilla peppers over an open flame for a few seconds on each side until very fragrant. Alternatively, toast the peppers in a small skillet over medium-high heat for 10 to 20 seconds, until fragrant. Be careful not to burn the peppers. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large pot or Dutch oven. Add the onion and garlic and saute for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the cooked onion, garlic, toasted peppers, and roasted tomatoes to a large blender. Blend until completely smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in the same large pot of Dutch oven. Pour in the blended tomato mixture and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the chicken breast, broth, and salt. Raise heat to high and bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until chicken is tender and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While the soup is cooking, make the tortilla strips by heating ¼ cup vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. When hot, add in a handful of the tortilla strips and fry for about 60 to 90 seconds, or until golden brown and crispy. Transfer them to a plate lined with paper towels and repeat until all the tortilla strips are fried. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove the cooked chicken from the pot and transfer to a plate. Shred with 2 forks.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the shredded chicken back to the pot along with the black beans and corn. Cook for 3 more minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the lime juice. Serve in bowls topped with tortilla strips, queso fresco, avocado, cilantro, and more lime wedges.

title: Italian-Style Skillet Chicken with Tomatoes and Mushrooms
description: Easy, flavor-packed skillet chicken dinner with an Italian twist! Chicken cutlets, pan-seared and finished in a white wine sauce with garlic, tomatoes, mushrooms! Ready in 30 minutes or less.

ingredients.name: large chicken cutlets, (boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into 1/4-inch thin cutlets)
Baby Bella or white mushrooms, (cleaned, trimmed, and sliced )
freshly squeezed lemon juice, (juice of 1/2 lemon)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat chicken cutlets dry. Season on both sides with 1/2 tbsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Coat the chicken cutlets with the flour; dust off excess. Set aside briefly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large cast iron skillet with a lid like this one. Brown the chicken cutlets on both sides (3 minutes or so). Transfer the chicken cutlets to a plate for now.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the same skillet, add more olive oil if needed. Add the mushrooms and saute briefly on medium-high (about 1 minute or so). Then add the tomatoes, garlic, the remaining 1/2 tbsp oregano, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper, and 2 tsp flour. Cook for another 3 minutes or so, stirring regularly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Now add the white wine, cook briefly to reduce just a little; then add the lemon juice and chicken broth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring the liquid to a boil, then add the chicken back in the skillet. Cook over high heat briefly (about 3 minutes), then reduce the heat to medium-low. Cover and cook for another 7 to 8 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked and its internal heat registers a minimum of 165 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If you like, stir in a handful of baby spinach just before serving. Enjoy hot with your favorite small pasta like orzo and a crusty Italian bread!

title: Shredded Chicken
description: Shredded Chicken - perfectly moist and seasoned chicken breast shredded into bits and use in a variety of ways. And it freezes well for your weekly meal prepping.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pat dry chicken breast with a paper towel and season generously on both sides with salt, pepper and Creole seasoning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet on medium high heat and carefully add your chicken to the skillet using tongs. Sear chicken on both sides for about 2 to 3 minutes each.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Next, add in onions, garlic, tomatoes and chicken broth. Then bring it to a boil, reduce the heat to low, and cover the skillet with a lid. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes depending on the thickness of the chicken breast. Alternatively, you could also use chicken thighs if you prefer. Since thighs are usually smaller and thinner, the cooking time will be about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Lastly, turn the heat off, and use two forks or a stand mixer to shred the chicken.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: If you want a little moisture in the mixture, add the extra sauce from the skillet into the mixing bowl. Use the shredded chicken for your favorite recipes or put in a storage container and freeze for future use

title: Traditional Magiritsa recipe (Greek Easter soup)
description: A traditional Greek Magiritsa recipe (Greek easter soup), perfect for your Easter family dinner!

ingredients.name: lamb offal (heart, liver, lungs and other organs)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this traditional Greek magiritsa recipe, clean and wash thoroughly the organs and set aside. Wash thoroughly the intestines under running water, rub them with sea salt and lemon juice and wash again. (To wash them more easily you can either slice them up lengthwise or turn them inside out.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large pot add the organs and plenty of water and bring to the boil. Blanch the organs in the hot water for about 3-5 minutes. Add the intestines and blanch for 5 more minutes. Drain and set aside to cool down for a while. Chop in small pieces and remove the excessive fat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add the olive oil, the chopped onions and the meat. Sauté for 5-6 minutes, until browned. Add 2-3 glasses of hot water and simmer for about 10 minutes. Add the roughly chopped lettuce squeezing them down to fit and place the lid on. Cook for 10 minutes, remove the lid and season. Stir well and cook the magiritsa with the lid on for about 40-50 more minutes. (If you choose to make this magiritsa recipe with rice, stir in the rice about 10 minutes before the end of cooking time.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Prepare the egg lemon sauce for the magiritsa. Start off by separating the egg whites from the egg yolks. In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks and add the lemon juice whist whisking until combined. In another bowl add the egg whites and whisk using a hand mixer until the egg whites are foamy and thick. While whisking slowly add the yolk mixture in the egg whites. Continue whisking for 1-2 minutes and gradually add 1-2 ladles of the hot broth from the magiritsa, a litte bit at a time. Make sure you add the broth slowly or the egg whites will curdle! When done, pour the mixture back into the pot and add the chopped dill. Stir well, place the lid on and leave aside for 5 minutes. (See also some tips to make the perfect Avgolemono).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Ladle the magiritsa (Greek Easter soup) while still warm into bowls and sprinkle with freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: (If you like to prepare a stock form the lamb head and neck for the magiritsa, wash thoroughly the head and neck and place in a large pot, along with two red onions. Pour in enough water to cover, season and simmer for approx. 1 hour, skimming the surface. When the meat falls from the bones, remove the pot from the stove and strain the stock. Let the stock cool down completely and skim the fat. Use the stock and equal amount of water to prepare the magiritsa soup.)

title: Pressure Cooker Oxtail Soup (An Instant Pot Recipe)
description: A simplified version based on my original oxtail soup recipe so you can use minimal prep and time to cook everything in one pot. No searing or par-boiling required. The oxtails will turn out soft like butter and the soup rich and hearty.

ingredients.name: (1.4 kg) oxtails (, separated at the joints)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all the ingredients to the pressure cooker (or Instant Pot) except the potato, carrot, and cabbage. Try to arrange the oxtails in a single layer so they cook evenly. If you’re concerned about scorching, especially if you’re using a stovetop pressure cooker, layer the onions on the bottom before adding the oxtails.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Seal the lid and be sure to close the valve.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If you’re using a pressure cooker, heat over medium heat until pressure is added. Then turn to medium-low heat and cook for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If you’re using an Instant Pot, select high pressure and set the timer to 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once it’s done cooking, let rest for 10 minutes. Then use the quick release method to release the pressure. (*Footnote 2)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Use a ladle to skim and discard the oil floating on top. If you plan to store the soup for later, I highly recommend you fridge (or freeze) the soup at this point. It’s so much easier to skim the oil completely once the soup is chilled because the oil will clot into a white layer, separate from the soup. You can boil the veggies when you reheat the soup in a pot, so the veggies will be freshly cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: (Optional) Remove the oxtails from the soup and place them onto a big plate. Use a pair of tongs and a fork to remove the meat from the bones. I usually do this step if I’m serving guests but skip it if I’m cooking for myself.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the potato and carrot to the pot. For the pressure cooker, turn to medium heat. For the Instant Pot, turn on the Saute function. Let boil for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the cabbage and cook for another 5 minutes, or until all the vegetables turn tender. Turn off heat.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: (Optional) Return the oxtail meat to the pot if you removed it from the bones previously.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Serve the soup hot with steamed rice or bread as a main dish.

title: Three Cup Chicken
description: Taiwanese three-cup chicken with sweet basil, rice wine, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic and ginger. Clay pot version.

ingredients.name: chicken leg quarters ( , you can use whole chicken, just cut it into small pieces)
soy sauce ( , 1 and 3/4 tablespoons light soy sauce+1/4 tablespoon dark soy sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut chicken into small pieces for better flavoring. Cook chicken in boiling water for around 2 minutes to remove impurities. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat up a clay pot over medium fire, add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and then lay garlic, ginger and green onion whites in bottom.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add chicken chunks, rice wine, light soy sauce and rock sugar. Cover the lid and simmer for 15 minutes to 20 minutes over medium fire or slow fire.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add sweet brail leaves and turn up the fire to thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Szechuan Lotus Root
description: Szechuan style Lotus Root

ingredients.name: lotus root sections ( , cut into thin slices)
fresh red pepper ( , cut into small pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook pork belly in boiling water for 20 minutes and then cut into slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Blanch the lotus root in a pot of water for 2 minutes. Transfer out and drain. Then prepare all of the other seasonings.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add a small amount of oil to a pan or wok, and fry for 1 minute. If you plan to skip pork, you can increase the amount of oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place ginger, garlic, and fresh chili peppers. Fry until aromatic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Return blanched lotus root.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add salt, sugar, light soy sauce and dark soy sauce. Give everything a big stir fr y and serve hot.

title: Sopa de Fideo
description: Sopa de Fideo is a traditional Mexican soup made from toasted fideo noodles cooked in a flavorful tomato broth. Perfect for the whole family!

ingredients.name: bouillon cube ((about 2 teaspoons), chicken or vegetable, optional)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add the tomatoes, onion, garlic, cumin, and 1 cup of the chicken broth to a large blender. Blend until completely smooth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Strain the blended tomato sauce through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl to remove any solids. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Stir in the fideo pasta and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta begins to light brown and blister.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the blended tomato sauce and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add in the remaining 5 cups of chicken broth, chicken bouillon (if using), and salt. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 more minutes or until the pasta is tender and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Taste and adjust salt if necessary. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
description: Made with rich nutty tahini and a few warm spices, this Roasted Butternut Squash Soup is all the comfort without the use of heavy cream! Smooth, creamy and a little nutty, you won't even know it's vegan!

ingredients.name: butternut squash ((about 3 pounds, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1-inch cubes or chunks))
red onion ((large, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks))
to 5 cups vegetable broth, ((low sodium, preferred))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the oven to 425 degrees F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Arrange the butternut squash and onions in one single layer on a large sheet pan. Season with kosher salt and black pepper. Generously drizzle with extra virgin olive oil (about 3 tbsp) and toss to coat (make sure to spread everything out evenly on the sheet pan). Put the garlic cloves in a small piece of foil and drizzle with olive oil, then fold the foil shut.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Roast in the heated oven for 30 minutes or until the butternut squash is tender and fully cooked through and charred nicely in some parts.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from the oven and allow to cool just a little bit, then carefully transfer to the bowl of a large food processor fitted with a blade. Add 2 cups of broth (or less, being careful not to fill the processor too much). Close the lid and blend until smooth.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the mixture to a large pot and stir in the remaining broth, spices, and 3 tablespoons of tahini paste. Simmer over medium heat, stirring regularly until the soup is fully warmed through (another 10 minutes or so)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the remaining tahini paste and honey until well combined.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When ready to serve, transfer the soup to serving bowls and top each bowl with a drizzle of the tahini and honey mixture and a bit of the crushed hazelnuts, if using. Enjoy!

title: Hasselback Potatoes
description: Hasselback Potatoes – stunning golden brown sliced potatoes with crispy edges and tender buttery inside. An elegant potato dish for all occasion yet super easy to prepare. You’d also be surprised how delicious it is!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pre-heat oven to 200C/400F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash, then thoroughly scrub potatoes and pat dry. Remove any blemishes from the potatoes. You may take of its skin, if desired.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place each potato between two wooden spoons or chopsticks, this will help guide or prevent you from accidentally cutting all the way through while making slits in the potatoes. Space out potato slices about 1/8-inch to 1/4-inch apart.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place potatoes in a large bowl or pan. Next, season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: In a small pan set over medium low heat butter, minced garlic, thyme and creole seasoning. Stir for about 30 seconds or 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Brush each potato well with garlic butter mixture using a pastry or basting brush.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place potatoes in a cast iron next to each other. You may use a baking dish.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bake the potatoes for about 30-40 minutes. After baking for about 30 minutes, then the layers off the potatoes will start separating.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: At this point, you may baste the potatoes again, making sure every inch of potatoes is fully covered, poking plenty down into the potato slits.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove the pan from the oven and brush the potatoes again with the remaining fat — you can nudge the layers apart if they’re still sticking together. Make sure some of the fat drips down into the space between the slices.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Return the skillet or cast iron back to the the oven for about another 30 minutes or more until the potatoes are cooked through and brown.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Garnish with thyme and parsley , if desired.

title: Stuffed Capsicum | Bharwa Shimla Mirch
description: Bharwa Shimla Mirch is a delicious recipe of green bell peppers stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes filling and then further cooked.

to 5 medium potatoes (or about 180 to 200 grams potatoes)

title: Homemade Greek Pork Gyros Souvlaki recipe
description: Make your own traditional Greek pork souvlaki with gyros with this easy to follow recipe and discover what makes this souvlaki the most popular Greek street food!

ingredients.name: of a cup extra virgin olive oil
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this souvlaki recipe start by preparing the pork gyros. Mix into a large bowl the tenderloin (cut into strips), the garlic, the red onion, 3-4 tbsp of olive oil, 1-2 tbsp of red wine vinegar, some thyme, some rosemary, and mix with your hands. Squeeze the ingredients together, so that all the flavours blend and add 1/2 tbsp of honey. Wrap the bowl and put it into the fridge. Leave the marinade in the fridge for at least 2 hours, before using it (ideally leave it over night).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a (very hot) large non-sticking pan, add the tenderloin along with the ingredients of the marinade, and sauté for 1 minute on each side, without stirring, until the meat is nicely coloured, crispy and tender inside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: To prepare the tzatziki sauce for the pork gyros, pour in a food processor the olive oil and garlic and blend until the garlic is diluted (don’t leave any large pieces of garlic). Into a large bowl, grate the cucumber, season with salt and pepper and leave it aside for 10 minutes. Wrap the grated cucumber into a towel and squeeze, in order to get rid of most of the water. Into a bowl, add the cucumber, the blended garlic and oil, the yogurt, 1-2 of red wine vinegar, salt and pepper and mix. (This recipe is for 5-6 servings. Store in the fridge and always serve cold.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use a cooking brush to oil the pita breads on both sides and season with salt, pepper and oregano. Place a large pan (upside down) at the bottom of the oven, place the pita breads on top, and bake in preheated oven at 250C for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pork gyros is usually served wrapped, like a sandwich. To serve, spread some tzatziki sauce on the pita breads and top with the pork gyros, some slices of red onion, some sliced tomato and wrap.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: For an easier version, you can substitute the tzatziki sauce with some fresh yogurt or some mustard and mayonnaise sauce.

title: Chinese Mango Pudding
description: Chinese style mango pudding

ingredients.name: granulated sugar ( , or more if needed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak gelatin sheets in cold water until soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small pot, dissolve sugar in clean water. Then heat the water temperature among 50℃ to 70℃, place gelatin in. Stir until dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut fresh mango in half and then dice the fresh mangos out. Blend well with the gleatine liquid. Blend well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add milk, cream and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Divide into four containers. Chill until firmed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Before eating, decorate the fresh mango dices.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork Recipe (No Fry)
description: This Thai style sweet and sour pork is lighter and healthier than what you'd get at a Chinese takeout. No deep frying, no breading, not overly sweet, and lots of veggies. It's also quick, easy, and weeknight-friendly!

ingredients.name: Mini or English cucumber (halved lengthwise and sliced)
unsalted roasted cashews (plus extra for garnish)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove any silver skin from the pork, then cut the tenderloin in half horizontally. Cut each half into 1/3-inch (8 mm) slices and place them in a small mixing bowl. Add the 2 teaspoons (10 ml) soy sauce and mix well to coat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the sweet and sour sauce by combining all the ingredients in a small bowl; stir until the sugar is mostly dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a wok on high heat and add the oil. Once it’s very hot, add the pork and spread it out into one layer (you may need to do this in batches ). Let the pork cook without moving it until browned on the underside, 1 to 2 minutes. Toss and stir for about 30 seconds, or just until most of the exterior looks cooked; don’t worry about the inside being done at this point. Place the pork in a bowl, leaving behind any oil and juices.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: In the same wok on medium heat, add a little more oil if needed, then add the garlic and onions and stir until the garlic starts to turn golden.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat up to high and add the cucumber, pineapple, bell peppers, and sauce. Toss for about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the pork back in and stir for 30 seconds, just until heated through. Be careful not to overcook the pork, as lean meat like tenderloin becomes dry quickly. (Pork is perfectly safe to eat medium-cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 145°F/63°C ). Turn off the heat and stir in the cashews and green onions.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Plate and top with more cashews and green onions, if you like. Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Kimchi Jjim (Braised Kimchi)
description: Kimchi jjim (or kimchijjim) is a kimchi dish that's slow-braised in a small amount of liquid. It's typically made with pork. You can also use beef or omit the meat.

ingredients.name: pork belly or shoulder (or beef chuck or brisket)
kimchi (1 quarter of the whole napa cabbage) (You can use more or less kimchi. Simply adjust the water amounts. )
water (or anchovy broth) (If making rice, use the water used to rinse rice (ssalddeumul, 쌀뜨물) instead of plain water. )
to 2 teaspoons gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes)
sugar (You can omit if you like. (see note))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the pork meat into large chunks (about 1/2-inch thick). In a pot, preferably with a thick bottom, combine the meat with the ginger and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut the kimchi crosswise into 2 or 3 sections or use the whole quarter cabbage kimchi intact.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add to the pot with the meat. Add the kimchi juice, water(or broth), and gochugaru. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low. Simmer, covered, until the kimchi and meat are tender, about 40 minutes. If the liquid is evaporating too quickly, add more water (or broth) or reduce the heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Stir in the scallions and sugar, 5 minutes before turning the heat off. Serve with cooked rice.

title: Easy Orzo Recipe with Zucchini and Chickpeas
description: Super easy Mediterranean-style orzo recipe with zucchini and chickpeas in a tasty, garlicy, chunky tomato sauce. Fresh mint and toasted pine nuts are the perfect finishing touch.

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil (I used Greek Private Reserve)
canned diced tomatoes (or 5 medium tomatoes, diced)
canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed (or 2 cups fully cooked chickpeas)
Toasted pine nuts (I used more than 1/2 cup), optional

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook orzo pasta according to package instructions (I cooked mine in 3 qt salted boiling water for about 9 minutes). Drain, keeping about 1/2 cup of the cooking water. Set aside

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large braiser or heavy pan like this one, heat 4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add zucchini; raise heat if needed and saute for about 5 minutes or so. Season with a little salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Now add garlic, diced tomatoes, chickpeas, and spices. Add the reserved pasta water. Stir to combine. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then lower heat, cover and let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or so. (Occasionally check and stir together, making sure to add a little bit of liquid if needed.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Uncover, stir in already cooked orzo pasta. Add lemon juice and stir again. Cook briefly until pasta is just warmed trough (a minute or 2.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from heat and stir in fresh mint. Top with lots of toasted pine nuts. Enjoy!

title: Pambazo
description: Pambazos are Mexican sandwiches with a potato and chorizo filling, made with telera bread dipped in a red guajillo chile sauce.

ingredients.name: peeled and diced russet or yukon gold potatoes ((about 3 medium-sized potatoes))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the sauce. Add the guajillo chiles, árbol chiles, and enough water to completely cover them in a medium pot. Bring to a boil over high heat. Remove the pot from the heat, cover, and let the chiles soak for 10 minutes to soften.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the softened chiles to a blender. Add ½ cup fresh water, the tomato, garlic, onion, and salt. Blend until completely smooth. If the sauce is not smooth, strain it through a fine mesh sieve to remove any solids. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the filling. Add the diced potatoes and enough water to completely cover them in a small pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked through. They should be tender and easily pricked with a fork. Carefully drain the water and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chorizo and cook for 8-10 minutes, breaking it up into chunks and stirring occasionally until fully cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cooked potatoes to the skillet and lightly stir to combine. Cook for an additional 3 minutes, remove from heat, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fry the telera bread. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brush a generous amount of the chile sauce all over the top and bottom crust of the telera bread. Place it in the hot oil crust side down and fry for 1 minute, until crispy. Flip and fry the inside of the bread for 1 more minute until crispy. Repeat this process with the remaining bread rolls, adding more oil when needed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Assemble the pambazos. Fill the telera bread with a scoop of the papas con chorizo filling, a drizzle of your favorite salsa, some shredded lettuce, a sprinkle of cotija cheese, some pickled red onions, and a little Mexican crema. Serve and enjoy!

title: Marinated Greek Beef Souvlaki Skewers (Beef Kabobs) recipe
description: Juicy, caramelised and smoky Greek beef souvlaki skewers recipe! Take your Beef kabobs to the next level with this simple flavourful marinade.

ingredients.name: top sirloin beef cut in chunks (35 oz.)
freshly ground black and pink peppercorns (to taste)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek beef souvlaki recipe, cut the beef into equal sized (3 cm/1 inch) cubes and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the marinade for the beef kabobs. In a large bowl add all the ingredients for the marinade and the meat and blend to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let them marinade for at least 1 hour in the fridge. Preferably leave them to marinade overnight so they soak up even more all those wonderful flavours.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When you are ready to cook the kabobs, prepare the vegetables. Cut the peppers and onion into 3-3.5 cm equal wide squares. Place them in a bowl, drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil and season with salt and ground pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: For this Beef souvlaki recipe, you will need about 9-10 wooden skewers, depending on how big you want them to be. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water to prevent them from burning. And make sure to cut the tip so it fits your grill pan!

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: comfortably, on the skewers. Use 1 piece of pepper and 1 piece of onion between each piece of meat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: and drizzle with olive oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: over high heat. Add 1 tbsp oil and cook the kabobs in batches for about 8 minutes. 2 minutes on each side until nicely coloured and cooked through. (Baste with olive oil as you go.)

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the beef skewers on a plate, cover with foil and let them rest for 3-4 minutes before serving.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Strawberry Shortcake - gorgeous three-layered classic dessert featuring sweet yellow cakes filled with cream cheese filling in between and macerated strawberries. Perfect for summer BBQ, potlucks and birthday parties!

ingredients.name: (907 g) strawberries ((Reserve some for garnishing), hulled and sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Generously grease 3 9-inch round cake pans with baking spray and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a medium bowl, sift together the all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl and using a hand mixer, cream together the softened butter and granulated sugar for about 4-5 minutes until creamy and fluffy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the eggs one at a time lightly beating after each addition. Scrape the sides of the bowl periodically so all ingredients will combine.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the sifted dry ingredients alternately with the heavy cream and vanilla extract. Beat on medium speed until all has come together, then increase the speed of the mixer and beat for 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Divide dough evenly between the prepared pans. Place into the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes back clean. Remove cakes from the oven and let them cool completely on a wire rack.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place sliced strawberries in a bowl and sprinkle with sugar, let them macerate for about 1 hour. Set aside so some juice will form while you prepare the filling.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: In a medium size mixing bowl, cream together the cream cheese, sugar and salt until creamy using a hand mixer for about 3-5 minutes. Add the heavy cream and vanilla extract, beat on medium-high for 3-5 minutes or until stiff peaks form.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: To assemble: Center one cake on a cake stand. Top with 1/2 of sliced strawberries and top with 1/3 whipped cream. Repeat the process with the other cakes ending with whipped cream. Garnish with whole berries or cut in half as desired.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Chill thoroughly for at least 1 hour or so before serving. Store leftovers in the refrigerator chilled.

title: Cabbage Bhaji
description: A simple home style cabbage bhaji made with coconut and few spices.

ingredients.name: chopped cabbage ((patta gobi) or 300 grams cabbage - shredded or chopped)
tightly packed grated coconut (or desiccated coconut powder)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse and then slice or shred or chop 300 grams cabbage. Also chop 1 green chili. Keep aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a shallow kadai or a shallow frying pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Then add curry leaves, chopped green chilies and a pinch of asafoetida. Stir and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover the pan with a rimmed lid. Pour water on the lid. The water in the lid, creates steam in the pan and helps in cooking the cabbage. Steam cook on sim or a low flame.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Do check the cabbage after every 5 to 6 minutes, by carefully removing the lid. In case the water dries on the lid, then add some more water and continue cooking the cabbage.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If you see the cabbage getting browned, then sprinkle some water in the pan. Usually the cabbage does not get browned. But depending on the type and quality of pan, the cabbage can get browned.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When the cabbage is cooked well, then add 1/4 cup grated coconut. Mix well and saute for a minute.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Switch off the heat. Lastly add 2 tablespoon chopped coriander leaves. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve cabbage bhaji hot with chapatis or paratha a side dish with any dal-rice or sambar-rice.

title: Oven Roasted Peking Chicken
description: A cross between a roasted chicken and Peking duck, this recipe is for days when you have that craving for peking duck but chicken is all you have to work with. {Gluten-Free adaptable}

ingredients.name: to 5 lbs / 1.5 to 2 kg whole chicken
five spice powder (for dusting the cavity)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Marinate the chicken

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prior cooking

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Basting sauce

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roast chicken

title: Gochu doenjang muchim (green chili peppers seasoned with doenjang)
description: Fresh green chili peppers seasoned with doenjang make for a simple summer side dish that goes especially well with Korean BBQ.

ingredients.name: mild green chili peppers (Korean asagi gochu, 아삭이고추) (6 to 8, depending on the size)
gochujang, 고추장 (Korean red chili pepper paste) (or 1 teaspoon gochugaru (Korean red chili pepper flakes))
sugar or 2-3 teaspoons maesilcheong 매실청 (Korean plum syrup) (or any other sugar substitute of your choice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Trim off the stems, and rinse the peppers. Cut them into one-inch pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a bowl, combine doenjang, gochujang, garlic, sugar (or substitute), sesame oil and sesame seeds and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the peppers and toss everything well with a spoon or by hand until each piece is well coated with the sauce. Adjust the seasoning to taste by adding more doenjang or gochujang (or gochugaru).

title: Di San Xian—Chinese Sautéed Potato Eggplants and Green Peppers
description: Famous Chinese Northern Dish- Di San Xi known as three treasures of the earth.

ingredients.name: potatoes ( , cut into thick slices or chunks )
green pepper ( , cut into small pieces)
green onion ( , white part only, chopped)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the eggplants in slightly salted water for 15 minutes. Drain completely and then coat evenly with a thin layer of cornstarch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix all of the stir-frying sauce together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If you cut potatoes in chunks, then cook the chunks in boiling water for around 4-5 minutes. Transfer out and drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in wok (recommend adding more oil to fasten the process, do not worry, we will remove extra oil later) to form a 3 cm oil layer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place potatoes in and fry until the surface becomes slightly crispy. Then place the eggplant in and gently fry during the process until well cooked. Fry green pepper for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour extra oil out and leave around 1/2 tablespoon of cooking oil in. Fry green onion and garlic until aromatic. Place the stir fry sauce in. Wait for a while until boiling. Place potato, green pepper and eggplants in. Fry until each piece is well coated.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Tequila Sunrise
description: Tequila Sunrise is a classic tequila cocktail made with orange juice, tequila, grenadine, and a splash of lime juice. Easy and beautiful!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Fill a 12-ounce highball glass with ice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour the orange juice, tequila, and lime juice into a cocktail shaker. Cover and shake to combine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Strain the orange juice mixture into the prepared glass. Pour the grenadine down the side of the glass and let it settle to the bottom to get the "sunrise" effect.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Garnish with an orange slice and a maraschino cherry.

title: Marinated Greek Lamb Souvlaki recipe (Skewers) with Pita and Tzatziki
description: A delicious, super easy Greek lamb souvlaki recipe (lamb souvlaki skewers) with pita bread and tzatziki sauce to make your own juicy lamb kebab from scratch.

ingredients.name: lamb leg or shoulder, cut into chunks (35 oz.)
dried thyme or some fresh thyme, chopped
of a cup extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To prepare this Greek lamb souvlaki recipe, cut the meat into equal sized (3 cm) chunks and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Prepare the marinade for the lamb kebab. In a large bowl add the olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, the herbs and spices and season with freshly ground pepper – don’t add salt yet. Whisk all the ingredients to combine. Add the meat and the chopped onions and blend to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, chill and let marinade for at least 4 hours. It’s best to leave the meat for the lamb souvlaki marinade overnight, to soak up all the wonderful flavours. (If you are at home blend the marinade once in a while).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the tzatziki sauce. Pour in a blender the olive oil and grated garlic and blend until combined. Remove the skin and the seeds of the cucumber and grate it into a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and leave aside for 10 minutes. Wrap the grated cucumber in a towel and squeeze, in order to get rid of the excess water. In a bowl, add the cucumber, the blended garlic and oil, the yogurt, 1-2 tbsps of red wine vinegar, a pinch of salt and blend, until the ingredients are combined. Store the tzatziki sauce in the fridge and always serve cold.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: To assemble the lamb kebab you can either use wooden or metal skewers. For this lamb souvlaki recipe, you will need about 10 skewers, depending on the size of each souvlaki. If using wooden skewers, cut them to fit your griddle pan and soak them in water. (This will prevent them from burning.) Lift the chunks of lamb out of the marinade and thread the pieces, comfortably, on the skewers. At this point don’t forget to season your lamb souvlaki with salt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a grill, barbecue or griddle pan and cook the lamb kebab for about 10-15 minutes, until cooked to your liking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: In the meantime prepare the pita breads. Preheat the oven to 250C. Use a cooking brush to lightly oil the pita breads on both sides and season with salt and oregano. Place a large oven tray at the bottom of the oven and place the pita breads on top of the tray. Bake for 2-3 minutes. (Alternatively barbecue the pita breads, until nicely coloured on both sides).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy this delicious Greek lamb souvlaki recipe with pita bread and tzatziki sauce with a nice refreshing Greek feta salad.

title: Mediterranean Farro Salad with Arugula and Walnuts
description: Farro salad recipe, prepared Mediterranean-style with peppery arugula, fresh veggies, feta and a good handful of walnuts. It’s the perfect weeknight meal and is even better for lunch the next day!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the farro. Bring 3 cups of water, seasoned with kosher salt, to a boil. Add the farro and lower the heat to medium. Simmer for 20 to 40 minutes, depending on the kind of farro you are using. The farro will have absorbed the water but use a sieve to fully drain. If you like, spread the farro on a tray or sheet pan and pat dry with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the dressing using this Greek salad dressing recipe.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Toss the salad together. In a mixing bowl, combine the farro (still somewhat warm) with the arugula, tomatoes, onions, peppers, walnuts, and fresh herbs. Pour the salad dressing, then toss well. Taste and adjust seasoning. Finish with a sprinkle of feta cheese to your liking.

title: Avarakkai Poriyal | Avarakkai Recipe
description: Avarakkai poriyal is a tasty dry vegetable side dish from the Tamil Nadu cuisine. It is made with flat beans (broad beans), some spices and freshly grated coconut.

ingredients.name: coconut oil (or gingelly oil or sunflower oil or peanut oil)
urad dal ((husked and split black gram))
green chilli, chopped (or 1 dry red chilli broken and seeds removed)
to 8 small to medium sized curry leaves
grated fresh coconut or desiccated coconut flakes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: preparation

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: tempering for making avarakkai poriyal

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: making avarakkai poriyal

title: Tofu with Century Egg Salad (皮蛋豆腐)
description: A childhood favorite and a popular diner food, the tofu with century egg salad requires just five ingredients and takes five minutes to make. Experiment with this new ingredient if you’re interested in discovering what people eat in China.

ingredients.name: block (16 oz / 450 g) silken tofu (, cubed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add tofu into a big bowl. Top with eggs. Drizzle light soy sauce and sesame oil on top. Garnish with green onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Serve cold as an appetizer. To enjoy the dish, use a spoon to get a mixture of everything. You can also drizzle more soy sauce or sprinkle some salt to adjust seasoning as needed.

title: Pork Fried Rice
description: A kind of fried rice with pork

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the wok over high heat for about a minute or so. Add the oil and swirl it around until it becomes runny and shows off a nice sheen.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Turn down the heat to medium then carefully add in the minced pork. Stir-fry the minced pork for a few minutes. Break up the larger pieces of meat into smaller pieces. Continue to stir-fry until the minced meat is cooked through and some of the edges have turned crispy and golden brown. The fat will render and we’ll use that extra fat for our fried rice. No need to strain it.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add half a tablespoon of soy sauce and a quarter teaspoon of dark soy sauce to deglaze the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the cooked rice and mix well. Break up large clumps of rice to separate the grains. Make sure to coat the rice in all that lovely pork fat and oil.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat back on high. Stir-fry the rice and pork together until the rice grains are thoroughly separated. Let the rice rest between tossing and stirring. This way you can let your arms rest and the rice at the bottom of the pan crisps up a bit.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Beat two eggs. Move all the ingredients to the outer rim of the wok creating a center. Add in 2 tablespoons of oil and once hot, pour the eggs in the center. Let it sit before lightly scrambling it for about two minutes. Gently stir the eggs until they are almost cooked through but still a little wet.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the blanched carrots and peas. Stir-fry and toss everything together for two minutes. Add a half tablespoon of light soy sauce, a half teaspoon of salt, and a few generous dashes of black pepper powder, then stir-fry again, religiously. Toss and fry everything swiftly around the wok until the rice is well-coated in the additional seasonings. You can add more oil if the rice begins to stick to the wok. Check the seasoning of the fried rice at this point. If you think it needs a little bit more soy sauce or salt, add some more.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Generously sprinkle with green onions. Reduce heat if the rice begins to scorch. Give it another good toss. Ready to serve!

title: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
description: Chicken thighs marinated in a spicy, flavorful Korean marinade and grilled to perfection!

ingredients.name: boneless chicken thigh (You can use chicken breast if you want)
to 3 tablespoons gochugaru (고추가루), Korean red chili pepper flakes
sugar (or light brown sugar) (or your favorite sugar substitute)
rice wine or mirin (white wine is good too)
gochujang (고추장), Korean red chili pepper paste
maesil chung, 매실청 (or 2 to 3 tablespoons pineapple juice or grated apple)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Rinse chicken pieces. Drain. Trim off excess fat. Cut each chicken thigh in half crosswise. Cut open any thick parts.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the marinade ingredients in a bowl and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Coat the chicken with the marinade. Marinate for a few hours (preferably overnight) in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat a lightly oiled grill over medium high heat. When hot, add the chicken pieces. Cook until cooked through and slightly caramelized, about 4 to 6 minutes each side. Reduce the heat if the chicken starts to burn. You can also cook the chicken indoor on a grill pan or in a skillet.

title: Thai Glass Noodle Soup
description: A comforting-yet-light soup with a flavourful rich broth. This classic Thai recipe is a kid-friendly soup that's beloved by adults as well. Glass noodles, napa cabbage and egg tofu can all be subbed out for whatever you'd like!

ingredients.name: Chinese-style chopped pork spare ribs or chicken wings drumettes (see note 2)
2-inch section daikon or ¼ onion (peeled and large-diced (optional))
Fried garlic and garlic oil for topping (optional but highly recommended, recipe below)
ground pork or chicken (preferably not lean)
Few cracks of freshly ground white pepper

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: If you’re using pork ribs, go through them to find ones that are meaty, and cut them down so the meaty part isn’t more than about ½-inch thick. This is just to speed up the cooking; you can leave them chunky if you have time to let them cook longer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the ribs or the wings to a pot, cover with water and season with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and white pepper. Let that simmer for 5-10 minutes, just until you see a bunch of foam gathered on top, and then skim it off.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cilantro stems and daikon and loosely cover the pot so it doesn’t reduce too much. Let this simmer until the meat is fork tender, wings will take a total of 20 mins, and the ribs 30-40 mins depending on the size.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Meanwhile soak the glass noodles in room temp water for at least 7 minutes to soften, then drain and cut into 2-3 sections. (If you want to add fried garlic, now would be a good time to make it, recipe below.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Make the meatballs by combining all ingredients together and use your hand to knead the mixture until well combined.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the ribs/wings are done simmering, use 2 spoons to scoop and flick bite-sized chunks of meatballs into the soup.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: After the meatballs are all added, allow the soup to come back to a boil if it has stopped, and then add the napa cabbage and egg tofu, then wait for the soup to come back to a boil. Then add the glass noodles and cook for 3 mins.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Taste and adjust seasoning with more soy sauce or fish sauce as needed, then finish it off with green onions and/or cilantro. Top with fried garlic to finish. This soup is typically served with rice, but if you want to eat it by itself, that's fine too!

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: For the Fried Garlic and Garlic Oil

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
description: Make homemade flour tortillas in under an hour! This flour tortilla recipe makes fluffy tortillas, perfect for burritos, fajitas, and tacos!

ingredients.name: olive oil ((avocado oil or room temperature unsalted butter is also great!))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix together the flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl until well combined.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the oil and water, and mix together with your hands until the dough starts to come together and all the dry ingredients are incorporated.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the dough onto a well-floured work surface and knead for 5 minutes until the dough is super smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces for large burrito-size tortillas or 10 equal pieces for medium soft-taco-size tortillas. Roll each piece into a ball.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Lightly flour a baking sheet covered with parchment paper and place the dough balls on top. Cover with a clean kitchen towel and allow to rest for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours on the counter.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball into an 8 to 10-inch circle for large tortillas, or a 6 to 8-inch circle for medium size tortillas. Make sure to keep your working surface and your rolling pin lightly floured to prevent the dough from sticking. (While you're rolling out each ball, you can place the rolled tortillas on top of a clean kitchen towel or a piece of lightly floured parchment paper. Don’t stack them on top of each other or they may stick together.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. When very hot, place a tortilla on the skillet and cook for 30-45 seconds, or until small bubbles start to form. Flip it over with your hands or a spatula and cook for another 30-45 seconds. The bottom surface should have some brown spots.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer the cooked tortilla to a tortilla warmer or a plastic zip-top bag to keep the tortillas soft and warm. Repeat with the remaining dough.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator for 5-7 days.

title: Simple Boiled Potatoes with Garlic and Fresh Herbs
description: Simple and delicious boiled potatoes, tossed in extra virgin olive oil with garlic and fresh herbs. Serve this side dish warm or at room temperature. Vegan and Gluten Free.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold potatoes, (peeled and halved (other waxy, all-purpose potatoes will work) )

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place potatoes in a large cooking pot. Add water to cover potatoes by 1 inch. Add a dash of kosher salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook over high heat to bring water to a rolling boil, then reduce heat to medium-low or low. Cover and let cook in gently boiling water for 20 minutes or so until potatoes are tender (cooking time will depend on how large the potato pieces are.) Test using a fork; fork should easily go through a potato.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain in a colander and transfer hot potatoes to a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Season potatoes with a dash of kosher salt and black pepper. Add garlic, rosemary, parsley and a generous drizzle of quality extra virgin olive oil, about 1/4 cup or so. Toss to make sure the potatoes are well-coated. Set aside briefly before serving.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Best Corned Beef and Cabbage
description: Beef brisket slowly cooked on a low fire to give you tender and juicy beef oozing with delectable goodness in every bite.

ingredients.name: (3-4 pound) corned beef with spice packet
large head green cabbage, ( cut into 8 wedges)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove the corned beef from its package and rinse the meat several times under cool water to remove any excess salt from it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place corned beef in a large dutch oven or oven-safe pot. Then sprinkle with the contents of the spice packet, if any.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add onion, garlic, thyme, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns, allspice berries, and mustard seeds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour in the broth and beer and add more water to fully cover the beef.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the pot on the stove on medium heat. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Let it cook for about 2 1/2 -3 hours.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While your meat is cooking, wash and cut the potatoes into desired chunks, depending on the size of the potatoes. Peel and slice the carrots in large chunks.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If using a small cabbage, cut it in wedges otherwise cut in large chunks. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When brisket is cooked to desired tenderness, add the carrots, and potatoes, to the pot so it is fully covered in the liquid. If desired, remove the corned beef before adding potatoes and carrots.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bring the pot to a boil, reduce heat and cook on medium-high for about 13-15 minutes or until tender. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Carefully remove the corned beef from the dutch oven and place it on a large plate or a platter.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Heat up a skillet with butter then add the potatoes and carrots and saute for 3-5 minutes or until slightly brown. Place them on the platter.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: In the same skillet, add butter, or oil followed by onions, and garlic. Add the cabbage and thoroughly mix. Cook over medium heat, adding liquid from the beef as needs to flavor the cabbage and prevent any burns.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove and place next to the corned beef. Slice the beef into thin slices against the grain and serve with cabbage, potatoes, and carrots. If desired, serve with a horseradish sauce.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Traditional Method

description: Braised chicken in the sweet and salty homemade teriyaki sauce

steps.description: Trim fat from chicken thighs and cut into bite size pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat vegetable oil hot in a skillet (or frying pan), add chicken and pan fry at medium high heat until browned outside and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add sugar, soy sauce, and sake to chicken and cook until the sauce thickens, about 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add green onions.

title: Shibuya Honey Toast 渋谷ハニートースト
description: Famous Shibuya Honey Brick Toast home recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 180 (356f).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop off a large chunk of the end of the bread loaf.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut out a square of the inside bread of the chunk and gently pull the square out of the inside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Chop the pulled-out square into small bite-sized cubes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Line a baking tray with baking paper and lightly coat the inside of the bread chunk and the bite-sized cubes with the butter and honey and place them on the tray.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake in the oven for about 10 minutes or until slightly brown and crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Take out of the oven and allow it to cool.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Fill the bread chunk with the bread cubes and chopped strawberries.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Top with ice-cream, whipped cream, Oreos, strawberries, chocolate chips, crushed Oreos, and drizzle with milk chocolate.

title: Sushi Rice
description: Steamed rice seasoned with rice vinegar and sugar

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook the rice in a rice cooker, or follow the method in our Steamed Rice recipe. If you’re using the Steamed Rice recipe, be sure to reduce the water by 1/4 cup (60 ml) when making sushi rice so the grains stay slightly firmer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl until sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Transfer the hot rice to a large, flat bowl, then gently “cut” the vinegar mixture into the rice using a rice paddle.

title: California Roll
description: Rolled Sushi with crab, avocado, and cucumber

ingredients.name: sheets nori roasted seaweed (large, cut into halves)
crab meat (seasoned with lemon juice and salt)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put plastic wrap on a bamboo rolling mat (makisu).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place a half sheet of roasted seaweed on the plastic.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Spread 1/4 of the Sushi Rice on the seaweed. Sprinkle sesame seeds on the rice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn the seaweed over, rice side down on the plastic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Put some crab mixture, avocado, and cucumber horizontally on the middle of the seaweed. This will form the center of the roll.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roll and tighten hard with the rolling mat to make a log.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cut into 8 pieces.

title: Hand Roll Sushi
description: Individual free-form rolled Sushi with fish and vegetables

ingredients.name: sheets nori roasted seaweed (large, cut into quarters)
Japanese or Persian cucumber (cut into julienne)
Suggested other ingredients: smoked salmon (cream cheese, rolled omelet (tamago-yaki), etc.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium bowl, mix tuna, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut sheets of seaweed into quarters. Put some Sushi Rice on the seaweed, then add tuna mixture and cucumber strips in the middle of the rice. Roll it into a cone shape.

title: Chicken Katsu Curry チキンカツカレー
description: Chicken Katsu Curry is succulent and crispy fried chicken coated with panko crumbs on a bed of plain steamed Japanese rice drizzled with delicious Japanese curry.

ingredients.name: store bought Japanese curry roux (about 6 cubes *1)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the potato and dice it to 2cm cubes. Set aside in a bowl of water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel the carrot and chop off the top and end. Cut it in half length wise.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the half carrot in half again length wise and chop it diagonally by rotating the carrot with the left hand and set aside. *2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Peel the onion and cut it in half horizontally.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut the half onion into wedges. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the chopped onion first.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: After cooking the onion for a couple minutes, add the carrot and stir.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the potato and sautee all together for a couple minutes then pour the water into the pot.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Bring it to boil, put the lid on, and simmer for about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Turn the heat off and add curry roux.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Dissolve the curry roux in and put the pot back on low heat and bring it to simmer. Simmer for about 5 minutes then turn the heat off.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Serve the rice in a shallow bowl.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Cut the chicken katsu in half and slice them to strips.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Place the cut chicken katsu on the rice.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Pour the curry over the chicken katsu and rice and serve. Add Rakkyo and Fukushinzuke on the side of rice. *3

title: Konnyaku Steak with Shishito Peppers 蒟蒻ステーキ
