title: Okonomiyaki (Savory Cabbage Pancake)
description: Pan-fried cabbage pancake with pork and savory Okonomiyaki sauce

ingredients.name: 2-3 Tbsp pickled red ginger Benishoga (chopped fine)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a big bowl, whisk flour and Dashi (fish broth) together until smooth. Stir egg and yam to flour mixture. Season it with salt and soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add chopped cabbage, onions, and ginger to the batter and mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat oil in a skillet, pour half of the pancake batter into an 8" circle, and lay 3 pieces of pork slices on it. Fry at medium heat until the bottom becomes golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Flip to fry the other side until the pork becomes crispy, about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Flip one more time, pork side up, and spread Okonomiyaki sauce and mayo on the pancake.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sprinkle dried green seaweed, then dried bonito flakes over the pancake. Serve hot.

title: Japanese Beef Curry Rice ビーフカレー
description: The most popular Japanese beef curry rice take away meal home using store bought Japanese curry roux, potato, beef, carrot and onion on plain steamed rice.

ingredients.name: box of Japanese curry sauce mix (I used JAVA curry medium hot)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut all the vegetables and beef into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat the butter over medium heat in a pressure cooker.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add all the vegetables and beef into the pressure cooker and cook well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the water and put the lid on the pressure cooker.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cook for 10 minutes until the pressure is reached on your pressure cooker.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove from the heat and break the curry sauce mix into chunks and add to the pressure cooker.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Stir until all the curry sauce mix has dissolved.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Put back on low heat and bring to a boil then simmer until the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Serve over cooked rice.

title: Sunomono (Cucumber Salad)
description: Cucumber salad with rice vinegar dressing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice cucumbers as thin as you can. Stir in salt, and let it sit for 5 minutes. Squeeze water out from cucumbers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix rice vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce together until sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add vinegar mixture and sesame seeds to prepared cucumbers and mix well.

title: Royal Milk Tea
description: This rich and creamy Japanese Royal Milk Tea is a strong, sweet and milky tea that can be enjoyed morning or afternoon and goes perfectly with cakes and desserts.

ingredients.name: water (plus extra to warm the cup)
Assam tea (loose, approx 5g per cup (see note))
milk (I recommend whole milk or a creamy plant-based alternative like oat milk)
sweetener of your choice (use more or less to taste, I like to use condensed milk for an extra creamy flavor)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 80 ml water into a saucepan, plus enough to warm your cup (approx 240ml). Bring to a rolling boil, then turn off the heat. Pour the hot water into your cup, making sure there is 80 ml water left in the pan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 2 ½ tsp Assam tea to the pan and mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a lid on top of the pan and steep for 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove the lid, add 160 ml milk and stir. If you are making one portion for yourself, you can also add your sweetener here. Heat on low until small bubbles appear around the edges, then turn off the heat. Do not let it boil, and avoid heating over 70 °C (158 °F) as this can scold the milk and alter the flavor.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cover with a lid and steep for 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Pour the hot water out of the teacup, then pour the tea through a tea strainer and into the cup.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If you didn't add your sweetener earlier, you can add it now and adjust it according to your preference. Enjoy!

title: Tamagoyaki (pan fried rolled egg)
description: Japanese pan-fried rolled omelet, a great dish for Bento lunch

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix eggs, salt, soy sauce and Mirin in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a pan at medium high temperature and add oil. (A rectangular Tamagoyaki pan is best, but a round pan can work as well.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour a thin layer of egg mixture in the pan, tilting to cover the bottom of the pan. After the thin egg has set a little, gently roll into a log. Start to roll when the bottom of the egg has set and there is still liquid on top. If you let the egg cook too much, it will not stick as you roll the log. Now you have a log at one end of the pan. Pour some more egg mixture to again cover the bottom of the pan, with the roll of egg at the end. After the new layer has set, roll the log back onto the the cooked thin egg and roll to the other end of the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Repeat adding egg to the pan and rolling back and forth until the egg is used up.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from the pan and cool for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Slice the ends of the log off and then slice the log into 1/2" pieces. You should see a nice spiral pattern in the cross section of the egg.

title: Curry Bread カレーパン
description: Karee Pan, or Curry Bread, is one of the most delicious Japanese food creations ever! It is bread filled with curry and is great to eat on the go!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine the yeast, milk, and sugar in a small bowl or jug then cover and set aside for 10 minutes then stir in the egg.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make a well in the centre of the flour and add the liquid mixture and stir to form a soft dough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to an electric mixer fitted with a dough hook and knead for about 5 min or until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: With the mixer motor running, add the chopped butter and mix until the butter is combined and a smooth and silky dough forms.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the dough in a greased bowl and cover and set aside in a warm place to prove for 1 hour or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Meantime, make the curry filling.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut the carrot, onion and garlic finely.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Peel and cut potato into bite size pieces and cook until soft to make potato mash. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a frying pan and cook the onion, carrot, and garlic until soft then add beef mince to the frying pan to cook.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add water to the frying pan and bring it to boil.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Turn the heat down to low and add the curry roux.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Stir and mix the curry roux to dissolve.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Add the mashed potato and simmer till the mixture has thickened.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Pour it into a flat container and when it is set, divide it into 8 even sizes.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Divide the bread dough into 8 equal sized balls and knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Wrap the curry piece with a bread rol.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Spray it with olive oil and roll in panko crumbs to coat the bread.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Repeat the process for the 7 others.

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: Place them on a cooking paper lined oven tray and cover with clean damp cloth and set aside for about 45 min or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 21
steps.description: Preheat oven to 180 degree and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Nameraka Purin (Silky No Bake Japanese Custard Pudding)
description: This silky Japanese purin is made with a creamy, melt-in-mouth custard poured over a layer of rich homemade caramel. Best of all, it's no-bake, easy to make, and uses simple ingredients!

ingredients.name: vanilla essence (or half the amount of vanilla extract)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Before you start, pour 300 ml whole milk into microwavable container and stir in 50 g white sugar and 7 g gelatin powder. Mix and leave the gelatin to bloom for 5-10 minutes. While you wait, make the caramel.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Make the caramel

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make the custard

title: Japanese Souffle Pancake スフレパンケーキ
description: Airy fluffy Japanese souffle pancake recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Separate the egg yolk and the egg white into two different bowls.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Keep the egg white refrigerated until it’s ready to be whipped.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Set the cooking plate temperature to a very low or keep warm setting.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place egg yolk into a mixing bowl, add milk and mayonnaise and mix well

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sift the flour into the yolk mixture and mix well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Make the meringue: Take the egg white out of the fridge and add a cream of tartar.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Whip the egg white until bubbles start to form.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add 1/3 of sugar (5 g) to the egg white and keep whipping until fine bubbles form.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add another 1/3 of sugar and continue to whip.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add the last 1/3 of sugar and whip until the foam becomes shiny and soft peaks start to form.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Take 1/3 of meringue to the egg yolk mixture and fold it in.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add another 1/3 of meringue, and again carefully fold into the yolk mixture.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Pour the yolk mixture into the meringue bowl and carefully mix it all together with a spatula.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Drop a spatula spoonful of the batter onto a cooking plate, then top with an additional ½ spoonful on top of each pancake to help add height and cook it for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Flip them over after 3 minutes and then cook for a further 3 minutes or until both sides are browned.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Dust with icing sugar and syrup, and serve immediately.

title: Kabocha no Nimono (Simmered Pumpkin) Recipe
description: Imported from japanesecooking101.com.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Remove seeds and cut Kabocha into 3" square pieces. Cut off sharp edges of the Kabocha pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil Dashi in a pot and put Kabocha in it. Cook Kabocha covered until tender at medium heat, about 20-30 minutes depending on how hard your Kabocha is.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add sugar, soy sauce, sake, and salt to the Kabocha. Reduce heat to medium low, and cook another 15 -20 minutes to reduce the broth a little.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove from heat and let it sit covered until cool. As it cools, Kabocha will absorb more of the flavor from the broth. If you like it warm, reheat before serving.

title: Wafu Butter Shoyu Pasta (Japanese Style Spaghetti)
description: This quick and flavorful Wafu Pasta combines crispy bacon, tender mushrooms, and fresh spinach with a rich butter and soy sauce finish. It's light, umami-packed, and perfect for lunch or a weeknight dinner!

ingredients.name: Oriental spinach (cut into bitesize pieces, or whole leaves of baby spinach)
fresh shiitake mushrooms (about 100 g, sliced ¼-inch thick)
bacon (with visible fat, cut into short strips)
cooking oil (only if bacon is lean)
Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) (divided (2 tsp for the first stage, 1 tsp for the second stage))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Fill a pot with 1600 ml water and bring to a rolling boil. Add 1 tbsp salt, give it a stir and then drop in 180 g dry spaghetti. Boil for 1 minute less than the packaging states.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While you wait, heat a large skillet over medium-low. Add 50 g bacon in a single layer and fry gently to render the fat. If using leaner bacon, add a splash of cooking oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the bacon is lightly browned and the fat has rendered out, add 4 fresh shiitake mushrooms and 1 garlic clove. Fry undisturbed for 2-3 minutes, or until the garlic is fragrant and golden.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour 1 tbsp sake into the pan along with ⅛ tsp dashi granules. Scrape the bottom of the pan to lift the caramelized bits off of the surface, and mix it into the other ingredients.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 100 g Oriental spinach and stir for 15-20 seconds until wilted. Then, push everything to one side and pour ½ tbsp mirin into the empty space. Let it bubble for 10 seconds, then mix it with the rest of the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Push everything to one side once more. Measure out 1 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu), then add two-thirds of it directly to the pan. Let it sizzle for 10 seconds and stir everything together, then reduce the heat to the lowest setting. If the pan seems too dry, add a splash of pasta cooking water to prevent sticking.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Reserve 4 tbsp pasta water, then use tongs to lift the al dente spaghetti out of the pot and into the pan. Add the reserved pasta water a little at a time and mix thoroughly until it reaches your desired consistency (slightly glossy), you might not use all of it.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Turn off the heat, and stir in 1 tbsp unsalted butter and the rest of the soy sauce until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Squeeze a few drops of lemon juice over the pasta and mix once more.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Divide into serving bowls and top with kizami nori (shredded nori), chopped green onions, shredded shiso leaves, and ground black pepper to taste. Enjoy!

title: Salmon Soboro 鮭そぼろ
description: 3 ingredients Salmon Soboro recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil enough water to cook salmon in a pot over high heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the salmon slices and cook for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove the cooked salmon slices from the pot and place on a meshed tray.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the salmon slices have cooled down, carefully remove the skin, brown parts, and bones if there are any.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the prepared salmon into a small food processor and pulse a few times until the salmon becomes fine flakes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place a small frying pan over medium heat and add sake and mirin.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the food processed salmon into the frying pan and continuously stir until all the sake and mirin has absorbed and evaporated.

title: Spinach Ohitashi
description: Spinach salad with lightly sweeten soy sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix Dashi, soy sauce and sugar in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil water in a large pot, then add spinach. After 15-30 seconds, remove from heat and drain water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cool spinach in running water, and squeeze water out from spinach.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut spinach into 2" sections and place in a bowl. Add Dashi sauce mixture and mix well.

steps.title: Step 5

title: Matcha and White Chocolate Muffins
description: These light and fluffy muffins are flavored with matcha green tea powder and packed with white chocolate chips, creating perfect balance of earthy and sweet. Great for a breakfast treat or anytime snack!

ingredients.name: unbleached cake flour (or all purpose flour)
vanilla essence (or half the amount of vanilla extract)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat your oven to 200 °C (392 °F). While it heats, sift 180 g unbleached cake flour and 1 tbsp matcha powder into a mixing bowl. Add the 1 ½ tsp baking powder, ¼ tsp baking soda, ¼ tsp cinnamon powder and 1 pinch salt and whisk all the dry ingredients until well distributed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate bowl whisk 1 egg and 100 g granulated sugar for about 1 minute or until the sugar is dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add 120 ml whole milk, 3 tbsp plain yogurt, 60 ml cooking oil and ½ tsp vanilla essence to the whisked egg mixture, and whisk until well incorporated.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the wet mixture. Gently fold with a spatula until well incorporated, scraping the edges as you go. Be careful not to over-mix and stop when there is no more dry flour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Measure out 100 g white chocolate chips and reserve a few for the tops. Add the rest to the mixture, fold through a few times to distribute evenly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Spoon the mixture into about 6 standard sized muffin cases about 2/3 of the way up and sprinkle with the reserved chocolate chips.Bake at 200 °C (392 °F) for just 5 minutes to give them a rising boost, then lower the heat to 180 °C (356 °F) and bake for anoter 12-15 mins. (Or until cooked through - test with a toothpick if unsure. If it comes out clean then they're cooked.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Transfer to a wire rack and leave to cool. Enjoy!

title: Grilled Miso Salmon
description: Salmon fillets marinaded in miso paste and grilled in a frying pan

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix miso, mirin, sake, and sugar in a bowl. Marinate salmon fillets in the miso mixture for at least 3 hours, or overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Carefully wipe excess marinade from the salmon fillets.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If using an oven: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, lightly oil it, and bake for 10-12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: If cooking on the stovetop: Heat a nonstick frying pan with a touch of oil over low heat. Place salmon fillets in the pan and cook until nicely browned on both sides.

title: Taiyaki たい焼き
description: Taiyaki are cute and delicious Japanese fish shaped waffles filled with sweet red bean paste. They're a popular and classic sweet street food in Japan.

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 6

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Heat the taiyaki pan over low-medium heat and pour about 2 tbs batter to the bottom side of the pan. Pour the batter from the top edge so that the batter will dribble down to the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Press the pan and cook each side for 3-5 minutes over low heat.

steps.title: Step 10

steps.title: Step 11

title: Hamburger Steak
description: Pan-fried ground meat steak with savory sauce

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide the meat into 4 pieces and roll into oval balls. Push down to flat steaks and make an indentation in the middle. (if you would like to freeze some, wrap each steaks with plastic.)

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

title: Wasabi Cucumber Pickles
description: These delicious Japanese-style quick pickles are made with just 4 simple ingredients and flavored with a fiery kick of wasabi. It's ready in just 12 hours and makes the perfect appetizer, side, or snack!

ingredients.name: Japanese cucumber (or Persian cucumber (if using English cucumber, cut in half lengthways and scrape out the seeds first))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash 500 g Japanese cucumber and cut off the ends.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut up the cucumber into rough chucks, try and make sure every piece has skin attached.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place into a large zip lock bag.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add 65 g sugar, 20 g salt and 1 tbsp wasabi paste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Rub the ingredients all over the cucumber, try and make sure all of the cucumber is covered. You can do this from the outside of the zip lock bag, there's no need to get your hands dirty!

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once evenly coated, seal the bag and leave in the fridge for 12 hours before eating. I recommend placing the bag in a container to prevent any leaks.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Matcha and White Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: These vibrant Matcha Cookies are soft, chewy, and loaded with chunks of white chocolate for the perfect sweet treat with a Japanese twist!

ingredients.name: vanilla essence (or half the amount of vanilla extract)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Take a large mixing bowl and mix 110 g unsalted butter, 100 g white sugar and 100 g light brown sugar until smooth and creamy.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Crack 1 egg into the bowl and add ½ tsp vanilla essence. Mix gently but thoroughly until well combined, being careful not to let the egg get foamy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a separate bowl, add 180 g all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda and ¼ tsp salt. Sift in 1 tbsp matcha powder and whisk until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Cut 150 g white chocolate into rough chunks and mix them into the dough.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Line a sealable container with baking paper. Roll the cookie dough into 40g balls (about 2 tbsp each) and place them in the container in a single layer. Seal with a lid and place in the fridge or freezer while you preheat your oven to 170 °C (338 °F).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once your oven is fully preheated, line your baking sheet(s) with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Place the balls of cookie dough on the baking sheet with plenty of space between (they will spread as they bake).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Bake on the middle shelf for about 10 minutes, or until slightly browned in the edges and barely cooked in the center.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: While they're still hot, take a large glass or cookie cutter (bigger than the cookies) and place it over one cookie. Move it in a circular motion to neaten the edges and make each cookie perfectly round.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Cool for 20-30 minutes on the baking sheet before moving them. Enjoy!

title: Gateau Invisible Apple Cake ガトーインビシブル
description: Gateau Invisible Apple cake update recipe with crumble on top

ingredients.name: Apples (each weighing around 150 g each, I used the Lady Pink variety)
Large eggs (each weighing around 50 g each)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: To make the crumble: Place the flour and almond meal in a mixing bowl. Add cold diced butter into the bowl. Combine the butter with the flour and almond meal by squish and rubbing together with your fingertips to create a crumble or breadcrumb like texture.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wrap the crumble mix with cling film and keep refrigerated until needed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare the baking tin by spreading a little unsalted butter thinly around the pan, then dust with about ½ tbsp. of caster sugar. Line with 8 x 36 cm baking paper strip along the edges of the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180 Celsius degrees (350 Fahrenheit).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Melt the butter and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place the egg and sugar in a large mixing bowl and combine.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the cinnamon and flour into the mixing bowl and mix together.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the milk a small amount at a time, ensuring to stir well after each addition.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the melted butter to the mixture and mix well.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Slice the apples thinly (3 – 4 mm) and add them carefully into the mixture.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Coat the apple slices with the cake batter using a spatula in a gentle folding motion. Make sure not to break the apple slices into smaller pieces.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Pour the mixture into the prepared tin, lining up the apple slices in the same direction (this will make the cut surface look pretty for presentation).

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Sprinkle the crumble over the cake and bake it for about 40 minutes.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: One cooked, take the cake out of the tin and let it cool down for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before slicing the cake to allow the cake to cool completely.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Sift the icing sugar over and slice to serve.

title: Cucumber Tsukemono with Ginger (Japanese Pickled Cucumber)
description: Pickles are so versatile and the perfect pallet cleanser or snack. None are more refreshing than this Japanese cucumber tsukemono flavored with ginger and a sprinkling of chili for a mild kick!

ingredients.name: ginger root (approx 3cm, a little over 1 inch)
Japanese cucumber (or Persian cucumber (if using English cucumber, cut in half lengthways and scrape out the seeds first))
salt (coarse type to scratch the skin)
Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) (tamari works for GF)
toasted sesame oil (don’t substitute with neutral oil)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: First, peel the skin off 20 g ginger root and cut it into thin strips (julienne).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut 1 dried red chili pepper into thin slices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wash 300 g Japanese cucumber and sprinkle a chopping board with 1 tsp salt. Roll each cucumber in the salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wash off the salt and dry the cucumber. (If you're using English cucumber, cut it in half lengthways and scoop out the seeds with a spoon.)

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Smash the cucumber with something sturdy like a heavy glass cup or rolling pin. Crush/break it slightly, but not too much.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Roughly cut the cucumber into bitesize pieces.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the cucumber in a sealable bag with the ginger and chili, then add the 1 tsp sea salt, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp unseasoned rice vinegar (komezu), 1 tsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) and 1 tsp toasted sesame oil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Massage the ingredients into the cucumber to evenly distribute them.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Marinate in the refrigerator for at least one hour. (For best results, overnight.)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Sprinkle with 1 pinch toasted white sesame seeds upon serving and enjoy!

title: Homemade Pocky 自家製ポッキー

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 9

title: Zaru Udon (Cold Udon with Homemade Dipping Sauce)
description: There's nothing more refreshing than Zaru Udon served with a delicious chilled Mentsuyu sauce to cool you down on a hot summer's day. This recipe is quick and easy to make, not to mention highly customizable!

ingredients.name: portions udon noodles (fresh, frozen, or dried)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Take a small pan and add 200 ml dashi stock, 5 tsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) and 4 tsp mirin. Boil for 1 minute to burn off the alcohol in the mirin and add ½ tbsp sugar. Mix until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Take the pan off the heat, pour the dipping sauce into a heatproof jug and leave to cool. Once cool to the touch, you can transfer it to the refrigerator. Tip: Mixing will help it cool faster.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook 2 portions udon noodles according the the instructions on the packaging. Once cooked, pour the udon into a strainer to drain and rinse with cold running water. Drain once more and place the sieve over a bowl, add a few ice cubes to make the udon extra cold.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Take two small plates and to each one, add 1/2 tsp wasabi, 1/2 tsp grated ginger, 1 tbsp tempura flakes and 1 tbsp chopped green onion (all extras are optional).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place each serving of udon on a "zaru" and sprinkle with kizami nori. (You can use a bamboo sushi mat on a plate if you don't have a zaru.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Serve each portion of udon with a cup of cold mentsuyu dipping sauce and the small plate of ingredients to flavor the sauce.

title: Gyoza Recipe
description: Pan-fried Japanese dumplings with pork and vegetables

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cook cabbage in boiling water in a pot for 1-2 minutes. Cool and mince.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a large bowl, add the first 8 ingredients and mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Take a sheet of gyoza wrapper in your hand and place a tablespoon size of meat mixture in the center of the wrapper. Moisten the edge along the lower half of the wrapper and fold the upper half of the wrapper up to meet the moistened edge. Fold one of the edges in a series of pleats (about 6), leaving the other edge smooth. Press the edges together to seal the gyoza. Another simpler way to fold is to first press the smooth edges together and then fold both edges into pleats. (This can sound a little confusing, but it's easy after watching the video.) Repeat for the rest of the wrappers.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a pan at medium high heat and add oil. Place gyoza on a pan and cook until the bottom becomes golden brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add water and immediately cover with a lid. Cook until water boils away.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, and chili oil together for dipping sauce.

title: Hanami Dango 花見団子

title: Homemade Tsubuan (Chunky "Anko" Sweet Red Bean Paste)
description: Tsubuan is a delicious and chunky sweet red bean paste that can be used in all kinds of traditional Japanese desserts. Learn how to make it from scratch at home with just 3 simple ingredients!

ingredients.name: fresh water (+ extra for washing and first boil)
sugar (I use 60% white sugar, 40% light brown sugar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 100 g dry adzuki beans into a bowl and fill it with water until the beans are fully covered. Swill the beans around and then drain the water. Repeat 2-3 times to wash.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the adzuki beans to a pot and fill with cold water until the beans are submerged. (The water should be 3-4 times the amount of beans.) Bring to a boil over a medium heat and cook for 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the water and discard.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Rinse out the pot and pour the beans back. Pour 750 ml fresh water into the pot until the beans are fully submerged once more. Again, the water should be 3-4 times the amount of beans.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring to a boil over a medium heat once more and scoop out any foam that forms on the surface of the water.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once it's boiling, lower the heat slightly and place a drop lid on top. Gently boil until the beans are fully softened (usually about 1 hour). Check the beans occasionally, stir them and top up the water as necessary so that they're always submerged.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: After 45 minutes, take a few of the larger beans, run under cold water and press them between your thumb and forefinger. If they're soft enough to spread like a paste, the beans are fully cooked. If it's a little hard in the middle, continue to cook. Check every 10 minutes until they're soft to the core.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once soft, turn off the heat and save a few tablespoons of the leftover cooking liquid in a bowl. Pour the beans through a sieve to drain the rest of the water.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Return the beans to the pot and add a 1-2 tbsp of the cooking liquid. Save the rest for later just in case.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Measure out 100 g sugar and add about one-quarter of it to the pot. Mix thoroughly and turn the heat on medium-low.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Stir over the heat while lightly crushing the beans (don't crush too much). As it starts to thicken, add more sugar one-quarter at a time. Repeat until all the sugar is added.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Continue to stir over the heat until slightly thickened. The consistency should be a little loose (but not watery). If it gets too thick, you can add a little more of the leftover cooking liquid.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Remove from the heat and add 1 pinch salt. Mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Transfer to a wide container and cover with plastic wrap touching the surface to prevent it from drying out.Cool to room temperature, then seal the container with a lid and store in the fridge for up to 3 days. Alternatively, divide into portions and freeze for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Use your homemade tsubuan chunky red bean paste to make a variety of Japanese desserts!

title: Maguro Zuke Don (Marinated Tuna Sashimi Bowl)

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6

title: Japanese Apple Jam 林檎ジャム
description: Delicious and subtly sweet Japanese apple jam can be easily made at home to enjoy with yoghurt, Shokupan toast, and more

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel and core the apple. Retain the peeled apple skin and core to use later.

steps.description: Fill water in a large bowl and add a teaspoon of salt. Add the peeled and cored apple as you work. *2

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the cut apple into a enamel-coated pot and add the peeled skin and core as well. *3

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

steps.title: Step 9

steps.title: Step 10

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Cool it down at room temperature then refrigerate.

title: Dashimaki Tamago (Japanese Rolled Omelette with Dashi)
description: Delicious and tender Dashimaki Tamago is an iconic dish that makes a perfect side or snack. This Japanese rolled omelette is flavored with dashi stock and Japanese condiments creating the ultimate umami bomb!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Crack 4 egg into a bowl and beat lightly with chopsticks in a back and forth motion to break up the yolks and whites. Avoid whisking in a circular motion as this can form too many bubbles.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate medium-sized bowl, mix 3 tbsp dashi stock, 4 tsp mirin, 1 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp salt and ½ tsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu). Mix thoroughly until the salt and sugar are dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place a sieve on top of the bowl and pour the eggs into the dashi mixture. Mix gently to prevent too many air bubbles forming.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour 1 tsp cooking oil into a tamagoyaki (rectangular) pan and place on the stove over a medium heat. Use a piece of kitchen paper to spread the oil around the pan and wipe away the excess. Keep the kitchen paper close-by, we will re-use it to lightly grease the pan later.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the pan is heated, pour the egg mixture into the pan until the base is coated in a thin, even layer. It should be thin enough that it cooks quickly, but not so thin that it breaks. If you see air bubbles, pierce them with chopsticks.If you notice some parts cooking too quickly or you realize it's getting too hot, lift the pan off the heat temporarily and readjust as necessary. (Try and avoid changing the temperature unless absolutely necessary.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When it's half cooked, begin to roll the egg starting from the back of the pan first and rolling towards you. The first step is to lightly pinch the edge furthest from you. Then, with your other hand holding the panhandle, make a gentle scooping motion to help flip the far edge over and start your roll. (Don't rely purely on the chopsticks to fold it over, otherwise it will surely break.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Repeat this action to keep rolling the egg until it reaches the edge of the pan closest to you, and then use the kitchen paper from earlier to grease the empty space. Push the rolled tamagoyaki back to the far end of the pan and lightly grease the remaining side.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pour another layer of the egg mixture into the pan and gently lift the rolled piece while tilting the pan so that some of the mixture goes underneath. This will create a seamless roll.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Tilt the pan again to make sure the rest of the mixture is flat and even. Once again wait for it to become half cooked, popping air bubbles and lifting the pan off the heat when you feel it's necessary.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Roll and repeat until you've used all of the egg mixture.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Once it's done, transfer the dashimaki tamago to a inverted bamboo sushi mat (this will make a striped pattern on the surface.) Press into shape and then transfer to a chopping board.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cut into slices approx 1 inch pieces and served with 1 tbsp grated daikon radish (daikon oroshi).

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: My Favorite Awase Dashi with Niboshi, Katsuobushi and Kombu

steps.title: Step 10

title: Kashiwa Mochi (柏餅)
description: Kashiwa Mochi is a traditional Japanese rice cake made with sweet and chewy mochi stuffed with red bean paste and wrapped with a decorative oak leaf.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 150 g rice flour (joshinko), 45 g glutinous rice flour and 30 g white caster sugar to a microwaveable bowl and mix.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pour in 250 ml hot water, one quarter at a time, mixing thoroughly each time with a rice paddle until it forms a thick, paste-like consistency.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover the bowl loosely with plastic wrap and microwave for 1 minute 30 seconds at 600W.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use the rice paddle to mix/knead the mixture and microwave again for 1 minute 30 seconds at 600W. The dough will get thicker each time you microwave it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix once more and then microwave for the last time, 1 minute, 600W. By the end you should have a firm dough with a slight yellowish hue and rice aroma.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Scoop the dough into a zip lock bag and place it into a bowl of cold water to cool for about 5-10 minutes. (Leave the ziplock bag open to let the heat escape but try not to get the dough wet.)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Divide 120 g smooth red bean paste (koshian) into 20g pieces. Wet your hands and roll them into balls.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Wipe 6 oak leaves with a clean damp cloth and gently pat them dry with a paper towel.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once the dough is cool enough to touch, knead until smooth (about 20 times). (You can keep it in the zip lock bag if you don't want to handle the dough with your bare hands.)

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Divide the dough into equal pieces (70g each), then wet your hands and roll each piece into a ball.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place one ball of dough in your palm. Press it flat into an oval shape and place a ball of red bean paste in the center. (Keep a bowl of water nearby and wet your hands each time it becomes too sticky to handle.)

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Fold the mochi over and gently pinch the edges to seal.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Wrap each mochi with an oak leaf.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Enjoy!

steps.description: Put the agar powder in a small saucepan.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add a little bit of water at a time (to avoid creating lumps) to the saucepan and continuously stir to dissolve the powder.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bring it to boil over heat then turn it down to simmer for 2 minutes over low heat stirring constantly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Turn it down and continue to stir constantly in the saucepan then transfer to a sink filled with water and continue to stir so that it cools quickly (make sure not to get any extra water in the pan).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour it in an ice ball mold and fill half (semi sphere/half sphere?) place the lid on and fill the ball from the top hole. Leave it in the fridge to set for at least one hour.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When it is set, remove from the mold and serve it with 1 tbs soy bean powder and 1 tbs brown sugar syrup

title: Shira-ae (Tofu Salad) Recipe
description: Flavored vegetables mixed with mashed tofu

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice Tofu into 6-8 pieces. Place them on paper towels over a plate and microwave for 2 minutes. Change to new paper towels and microwave for 2 more minutes. Change to new paper towels again and let Tofu cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook spinach in boiling water for a minute. Wash under cold water and squeeze water out very well. Cut into 1" long bunches.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a medium pot, heat Dashi to boil, add carrot and Konnyaku, and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add Mirin and soy sauce and cook until liquid is almost gone. Let it cool, then add spinach and mix.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Grind sesame seeds, and mix with soy sauce and sugar.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mash Tofu and mix in sesame sauce. Then add cooked vegetables.

title: Hiyashi Tanuki Udon (Cold)
description: Hiyashi Tanuki Udon is a refreshing chilled noodle dish made with chewy udon topped with crispy tempura flakes and served in a flavourful cold dashi broth. The perfect easy meal on a hot day!

ingredients.name: kamaboko fish cake (optional, omit for plant-based)
bonito flakes (katsuobushi) (optional garnish, omit for plant-based)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix 2 tbsp dashi stock, 1 ½ tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu), ½ tbsp mirin and ½ tsp light brown sugar in a saucepan and bring to a boil on a medium heat. Allow to boil for 1-2 minutes and then remove from the stove.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 2 ice cubes to the sauce to cool it quickly. Once cool, store in the fridge until serving time.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If using wakame, soak according to the instructions on the packaging. (Usually about 5-10 mins.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook the udon noodles according to the instructions on the packaging. Once cooked, pour them into a colander and wash with cold running water. Place a bowl underneath and add a few ice cubes to the noodles. Leave to chill for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare your toppings according to the instructions in the ingredient list. Divide the udon into serving bowls and arrange the toppings on top.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add a small amount of wasabi to the side of the bowl (optional) and drizzle with sesame oil. Finally, pour the chilled sauce over the top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Mix thoroughly before eating and enjoy!

title: Gyudon (Beef Bowl) Recipe
description: Seasoned thinly sliced beef and onion over steamed rice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice onion thinly, and cut sliced beef in 2" width.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil Dashi in a pot and add sliced onion. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Add soy sauce, sugar, and Sake, then add grated ginger.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add sliced beef in pot and stir. Cook a couple of minutes or until meat is cooked through.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour meat and sauce over rice and top with pickled red ginger.

title: Melon Pan メロンパン
description: Melon bread, or 'melon pan', is a type of Japanese sweet bread. It's super yummy but has no melon flavour, it's just named for its appearance!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make the cookie dough by placing the butter and sugar in a large bowl and beat until light and creamy.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the egg and vanilla essence and mix until well combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Fold through the flour and baking powder.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Divide the cookie dough into 8 small balls and set aside in the fridge. *1

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Combine egg, yeast, milk and sugar in a small bowl or jug

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Make a well in the centre of the flour and add the liquid mixture and stir to form a soft dough.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer to an electric mixer fitted with a dough hook and knead for about 10 min or until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: With the mixer motor running, add the chopped butter until the butter is combined and a smooth and silky dough forms (about a further 10 minutes).

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place the dough in a greased bowl and cover and set aside in a warm place to prove for 1 hour or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Divide the bread dough into 8 equal sized balls and knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Roll out the refrigerated cookie dough on cling wrap to 5mm thick.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Once it is rolled place one bread dough on top of one cookie dough ball and wrap together using cling wrap.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Take the cling wrap off and score the cookie dough surface diagonally and sprinkle the granule sugar.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Repeat for all 8 bread rolls.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Place them on a cooking paper lined oven tray and cover with clean damp cloth and set aside for about 40 min or until doubled in size.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Preheat oven to 180 degree(356 f) and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Tuna-jaga Recipe
description: Simmered potatoes and canned tuna in sweet-soy broth

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and cut each potato into 4 pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put the potatoes and water in a pot, cover, and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the tuna, sugar, soy sauce, sake, and grated ginger root. Stir and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for another 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cover and let it cool for 30 minutes.

title: Nasu no Agebitashi (Fried Eggplant in Dashi Broth)
description: Nasu no Agebitashi is a vibrant and savory dish made with deep-fried eggplant soaked in a rich dashi broth. This addictive side dish is packed with flavor and can be made with a variety of different vegetables!

ingredients.name: dried red chili pepper (deseeded and thinly sliced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add 100 ml dashi stock, 1 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu), 1 tbsp mirin, ¼ tsp sugar, and 1 dried red chili pepper to a small saucepan. Place on the stove on medium heat and bring it to a boil. Allow it to boil for 1 minute, then remove it from the heat and leave to cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wash 2 eggplants and cut off the stems. Cut in half lengthways and make shallow, diagonal slices across the skin side. (Each incision should be about ½ cm apart.)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: If you have small eggplants, cut them in half horizontally. If you have longer eggplants, cut them into thirds or quarters.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat your oil to 170 °C (338 °F) and add the eggplant with the skin side facing down, fry for 1 min on each side. Fry 6 shishito peppers for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove the eggplant and shishito peppers from the oil and transfer to colander. Place the colander either in the sink or in a large heat proof bowl and pour boiling water over it to wash off the excess oil.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Transfer the eggplant and shishito peppers to the agebitashi broth and leave to cool. Once cool, chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Dish up and serve with 1 tbsp grated daikon radish (daikon oroshi) and finely chopped green onions.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Halloween Pull-Apart Bread ハロウィーンちぎりパン
description: This Halloween Pull-Apart Bread is so much fun to decorate and pull apart to eat! It's perfect to serve at a Halloween party or to trick-or-treaters!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make Yudane the night before. Place the bread flour in a bowl and add boiling water and mix well. Put cling wrap and refrigerate overnight. *1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add all bread ingredients to the bread machine.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Knead them for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While the bread is being kneaded, make the purple sweet potato and kabocha pumpkin paste.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place each powder into two separate small bowls and add water and stir. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: When the surface of the dough becomes shiny, take the dough out of the machine and divide the dough into three (to make white, purple, and orange dough).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Knead the purple sweet potato paste into one dough and the kabocha pumpkin paste into another.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Spray some oil in three bowls and put each dough in the centre.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cover each bowl with cling wrap and leave them somewhere warm (or leave them in an oven for 1 hour at 30 c).

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Once the dough has been left for an hour (or doubled in size) take each out of the bowl and place onto a floured bench or chopping bread. Preheat the oven to 180 c.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Punch each ball of dough down and divide them into 6 even-sized pieces. Shape each piece into a nice round shape and place it in a baking tin lined up next to each other.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Cover the baking tin with cling wrap and leave it in warm place till the size of the dough doubles.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Bake it for about 20 minutes. Occasionally check the bread to see if it has become browned (you need to cover with aluminium foil to prevent further browning or burning).

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Take the bread out of the oven once it has cooked, allow it to cool down a little, then have fun decorating it with a deco-pen filled with melted chocolate.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Serve the bread on a plate for everyone to pull apart.

title: Okra Salad Recipe
description: Boiled and sliced Okura with soy sauce and Katsuobushi bonito flakes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil water in a pot and cook okra about 2 minutes. Drain and let it cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut thinly and diagonally and mix with soy sauce. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with bonito flakes.

title: Tsukimi Dango (Moon Gazing Dumplings)
description: Tsukimi dango is a chewy rice dumpling displayed and eaten during the Japanese mid-autumn festival when the moon is at its most beautiful. Learn the easy way to make this festive sweet with just 3 ingredients!

ingredients.name: silken tofu (+ 5g if the mixture is too dry)
mitarashi sauce (recipe below or smooth red bean paste (optional))

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil over medium heat. While you wait, whisk the 100 g glutinous rice flour in a bowl. (If you use mochiko you can sift it instead.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 125 g silken tofu to the bowl and knead it with your hands.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Knead until it reaches a play dough texture. It should be smooth with no cracks. If it feels a little dry, add more silken tofu 1 tsp at a time. (If you don't have any more tofu then add 1/2 tsp water at a time instead.)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Measure out 14 balls, approx 14-15g each.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Optional step: Add 1 pinch yellow food dye to the last piece of dough and knead until the color is even.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: You should have 15 balls in total.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Gently add the dango to the pot of boiling water and stir from time to time to stop them from sticking to the bottom.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once they start to float (approx 5-7 minutes later) set a timer for 2 minutes. During these two minutes, prepare a bowl of ice cold water.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: After 2 minutes of floating, transfer the dango to a bowl of ice cold water and leave to cool for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Line a plate with kitchen paper and place the dango on the paper, leave them to air dry for about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Make the base of the pyramid by lining up 9 balls in a 3x3 formation.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: For the next layer, add 4 balls in a 2x2 formation.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: The top layer has two. If you make a yellow one, it should be on the top at the front of the display.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Mitarashi sauce (optional)

title: Halloween Three Coloured Dango ハロウィーン三色団子
description: Let your imagination and creativity run wild, and make traditional Japanese dango with Halloween themed colours: purple, yellow and black.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix purple sweet potato powder and water in a small mixing bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix kabocha pumpkin powder and water in a small mixing bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place Shiratamako and silken tofu in a large mixing bowl. As you drop the tofu in, break tofu in your hand.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Knead them all together until all are combined well and the softness is like your ear lobe.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Divide the dough into three equal portion.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add sweet potato paste into one dough, Kabocha pumpkin paste into the second dough and black sesame paste into the third dough.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Knead them into each dough, until each colour is spread and mixed in evenly.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Divide the each dough into 6 equal portions.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Shape them into round balls with your hands and wrap them gently with cling wrap so that the balls don't become dry.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Boil about a litre of water in a large saucepan over high heat.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add the dango dough into the boiling water and turn the heat down to medium.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Let the water simmer until all the dango dumpling dough balls float up to the simmering water surface.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Use a strainer to drain the dango dumplings out, and put them into a bowl of cold water to cool down.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: When all dango are cooled, drain them out again using the strainer and place them on a plate.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Put one black, one yellow and one purple onto a skewer. Repeat the process for all dango dumplings.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Serve them on a plate with Japanese brown sugar syrup or soybean powder (kinako) *5

title: Hamburger Steak with Daikon Oroshi
description: Pan-fried ground meat steak with grated Daikon radish and vinegary-soy sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put Panko in a large bowl, add milk and stir.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add meat, onion, egg, salt, and pepper to the Panko mixture. Mix with your hands very well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Divide the meat into 4 to 6 pieces and roll into oval balls. Push down to flat steaks and make an indentation in the middle.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil in a frying pan at medium high temperature, place the patties in the hot oil, and fry for 4-6 minutes on one side. Flip over and fry for 3-5 minutes covered until cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix Ponzu sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the steak from the pan and top grated Daikon radish and green onion. Drizzle Ponzu sauce over the steak.

title: Chawanmushi Recipe
description: Savory egg flan with chicken, shrimp, and vegetables

ingredients.name: 2-4 shrimp (sliced into 2 pieces each if big)
chicken thigh (cut into bite size pieces)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preseason chicken and shrimps. In a small bowl, mix chicken pieces with 1/2 tsp soy sauce and 1/2 tsp Sake. In another bowl, mix shrimp and 1/2 tsp soy sauce and 1/2 tsp Sake. Let them sit for a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix eggs, Dashi, salt, 1 tsp soy sauce, and Mirin together. Strain the egg mixture through a sieve. Let as much egg as you can go through the sieve.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place 1/4 amount of chicken, shrimp, and shiitake mushrooms in each of 4 small cups (such as ramekins), then pour egg mixture over them to fill 3/4 of a cup. Cover with aluminum foil and put the covered cups into a steamer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Steam at medium heat for 10-15 minutes. Check with a wooden skewer to see if it's done. If clear broth comes out when poked, take the cups out from the steamer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle Mitsuba leaves and cover again for 2-3 minutes.

title: Asparagus Ohitashi Recipe
description: Cooked Asparagus in savory Dashi sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Cut off the tough end of the asparagus and place them on a baking sheet. Roast the asparagus for 15-20 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix Dashi, soy sauce and sugar in a bowl or a shallow pan that is large enough to soak asparagus.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Soak roasted asparagus in the prepared dashi sauce turning every now and then. Ideally soak them for 1 hour or longer, but if you don't have time 20 minutes will still make it a tasty dish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Chill or serve right away with a sprinkle of Katsuobuhi.

title: Easy Okayu with Egg (Japanese Rice Porridge)
description: Okayu is a comforting and warming rice porridge dish made with minimal ingredients, it's perfect for those days when you're feeling under the weather and looking for a simple dish to pick you back up!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 400 ml dashi stock into a pot and bring to a boil over a medium heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While you wait for the dashi to boil, whisk 2 egg in a small bowl until the yolk and whites are combined.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Optional: If you prefer your porridge with a thinner consistency, wash the cooked rice in a sieve and shake thoroughly to remove excess water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the dashi is boiling, add 200 g cooked Japanese short-grain rice, 1 tsp sake, 1 tsp mirin and 1 tbsp Japanese light soy sauce (usukuchi shoyu).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn heat down to simmer and continue to heat with a lid set slightly ajar. Check the consistency frequently.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once it reaches your desired consistency, pour the whisked egg into the pot and and cook for 20-30 seconds without mixing.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: After 20-30 seconds, mix thoroughly to break up the egg and evenly distribute it through the rice. Remove from the heat and divide into serving bowls.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with 1 drizzle toasted sesame oil and 1 tbsp finely chopped green onions or 2 tbsp kizami nori (shredded nori) (or toppings of your choice).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Yakimeshi - Japanese Fried Rice 焼き飯
description: Easy Japanese fried recipe using a secret ingredient "Japanese mayonnaise"

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise well with the cooked rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Chop the green shallots and bacon into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan over high heat then add the rice and fry for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Put the rice to one side of the pan and add the eggs and scramble them.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once the egg is half cooked, stir it into the rice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the bacon and cook for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the shallots and salt and stir for a bit.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the heat and sprinkle a bit of pepper and serve!

title: Tempura Recipe
description: Battered and deep-fried shrimp and vegetables with savory dipping sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut vegetables into 1/4" thick slices. Make diagonal cuts on shrimp to help straighten.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put cake flour, baking powder, salt in a medium bowl and whisk well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add ice water into flour mixture and stir with chopsticks (not whisk) about 10 times. It's OK to have a lot of lumps in batter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil to very high temperature (375F). Dip vegetables and shrimp in batter, and deep fry until they float and are cooked through.

title: Japanese Strawberry Milk (Ichigo Milk)
description: This luxurious Japanese strawberry milk is made with fresh strawberries mixed with milk, cream, and sweetener, it's seriously delicious and easy to make too!

ingredients.name: strawberries (about 5 medium or 8-10 small per serving)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash and dry 100 g strawberries, then cut off the stems and roughly dice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place the diced strawberries in a small sauce pan with 1 tbsp granulated sugar and 1 tsp lemon juice. Mix and place the pan on the stove over a medium heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: As the strawberries soften, crush them with a fork. (Don't be too thorough, leave some larger chunks in there too!)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the strawberries reach a jam-like consistency, remove the pan from the heat and allow to cool for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Transfer the strawberries purée to a small heatproof bowl and place the bowl in an ice bath to speed the cooling process. (Alternatively, chill in the fridge.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix 200 ml milk, 1 tbsp heavy cream and ½ tbsp condensed milk in a jug until well combined.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Spoon the chilled strawberry purée into your serving cup(s). If adding ice, add half of the strawberry before the ice and the other half after.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Carefully pour the milk mixture over the top to keep the layers separate.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Mix well before drinking and enjoy!

title: Matcha Cookies - Checkerboard Pattern 抹茶市松模様クッキー
description: Matcha flavoured checkerboard cookies recipe. How to make perfect and neat checkerboard pattern cookies with step by step photos

ingredients.name: unsalted butter softened in room temperature

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Measure and sift 100 g of plain flour and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Measure 95g of plain flour and 5g of matcha powder. Sift together and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, cream the butter and sugar until it becomes a white creamish colour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Separate the egg yolk and egg white. Set aside the egg white for later use to glue the cookie doughs together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the egg yolk to the electric mixer and blend the egg yolk on low speed for a minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Divide the creamed butter mixture into half. *3 Leave half in the electric mixer bowl. Change the attachment to a flat beater attachment and gradually add the 100g of plain flour with the mixer on low speed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When all the flour is combined and has become crumbly, take out the dough onto a sheet of cling wrap. Wrap the dough with the cling wrap and shape the dough into 2x4x20cm long board and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Repeat step 7 for the remaining creamed butter and matcha powder combined flour.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Take out both dough and remove the cling wrap.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place the plain dough on a clean work surface.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Using a sharp knife, slice the dough in half.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Brush the cut surface of the palin dough with leftover egg white, then place the matcha dough on top of the plain dough.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Cut it in half again.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Place the half of the dough on the clean surface, brush the top with egg whites. Place another half on top of it in a way that the plain colour and matcha colour alternate.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Gently press together and wrap with a cling wrap sheet and rest it in the fridge for at least one hour. (I left it in the fridge overnight)

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 160°C (338°F).

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Line a baking tray with a baking sheet. Take out the cookie dough from the fridge.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Slice it about 5mm(0. inch) thick and place on the baking tray.

steps.title: Step 19
steps.description: Bake them for 20 minutes

steps.title: Step 20
steps.description: Remove baking tray from the oven and let the cookie cool on a cooling rack.

title: Matcha Green Tea Cookies
description: Cut-out cookies flavored with Matcha green tea

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sift cornstarch, cake flour, and green tea powder together. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Beat soft butter in a mixing bowl. Add powdered sugar and sugar and mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add yolks and milk and mix well. Add flour mixture and mix (don't over mix).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Let the dough rest for 30-60 minutes in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll out dough to 1/4" thick and cut out with cookie cutter.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Bake at 350F (175C) in preheated oven for 10-13 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cool completely on cookie rack, and decorate with chocolate if you want.

title: Salmon Sashimi (with 3 kinds of dipping sauce)
description: Learn everything you need to know about salmon sashimi, from its surprisingly recent history to how to select, prepare and cut it like a professional!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sashimi

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sashimi soy sauce (simple)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sashimi soy sauce (sweetened)

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Salt sesame sauce

title: Tamagoyaki with Green Onions Recipe
description: Japanese pan-fried rolled omelet with chopped green onions

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix eggs, salt, soy sauce and Mirin (or sugar) in a bowl. Mix in green onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a pan at medium high temperature and add oil. (Tamagoyaki pan or a round 8-9 inch non-stick pan)

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour a thin layer of egg mixture in the pan, tilting to cover the bottom of the pan. After the thin egg has set a little, gently roll into a log. Start to roll when the bottom of the egg has set and there is still liquid on top. If you let the egg cook too much, it will not stick as you roll the log. Now you have a log at one end of the pan. You can leave it there or move it to the other end. Pour some more egg mixture to again cover the bottom of the pan. After the new layer has set, roll the log back onto the the cooked thin egg and roll to the other end of the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Repeat adding egg to the pan and rolling until the egg is used up.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Remove from the pan and cool for 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Trim the ends of the log off and then slice the log into 1/2" pieces.

title: Matcha Madeleine 抹茶マドレーヌ
description: Japanese infused traditional Madeleine recipe with Matcha

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sift the plain flour, matcha powder, and baking powder, all together and add almond meal.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the eggs, honey, and sugar all together without airinating the mixture in a separate bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the sifted flour to the egg mixture and stir to combine.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add 1/3 of melted butter at a time and mix all together.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Grease the madeleine tin with melted butter and then flour the tin.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 180 degree celsius and bake it for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Remove from the tin and sift some confectioners sugar on top to serve.

title: Botan Nabe (Japanese Wild Boar Hotpot)
description: Learn how to make Botan Nabe at home with thin slices of wild boar shaped like a peony flower simmered in a sweet miso broth with tofu and vegetables. This beautiful dish is one of Japan's most unique hot pot recipes!

ingredients.name: portions cooked ramen noodles (or udon noodles, to finish the soup)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Take a large pot and add 800 ml dashi stock, 5 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp light brown sugar and 1 tbsp sesame paste (nerigoma). Bring it to a boil over a medium/medium-high heat and allow to bubble for 1-2 minutes. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place 3 tbsp red miso paste and 2 tbsp white miso paste pastes on a mesh spoon or ladle. Dip them in the broth and then whisk inside the spoon until fine enough to mix in with the rest of the broth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the vegetables and tofu and arrange them beautifully in the pot with 200 g wild boar loin rolled into the shape of a peony flower placed in the middle.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the pot to the stove and simmer over a medium heat until the vegetables are softened and the boar meat is cooked through. Eat as it cooks (or divide into bowls once everything is cooked). Sprinkle with sansho pepper to taste. Enjoy the leftover soup with cooked ramen or udon noodles.

title: Onigiri with Beef Shigureni
description: Onigiri rice balls stuffed with soy-ginger beef

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put some rice in a rice bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Wet hands with water and add salt. Place 1/2 cup rice in one hand, put 1 Tbsp beef in the middle of rice.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add some more rice over beef. Press and form into a triangle shape

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Wrap with a sheet of roasted seaweed. Repeat and make 4 pieces.

title: Zenzai (Japanese Red Bean Soup with Toasted Mochi)
description: Zenzai is a sweet and comforting soup made with red adzuki beans and sugar topped with chewy toasted mochi. Make this warming winter treat from scratch at home with just 5 ingredients!

ingredients.name: sugar (increase or decrease by 10% depending on your preferred sweetness.)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 200 g dry adzuki beans into a sieve placed over a large mixing bowl. Fill the bowl with water and swish the beans around to wash them. Repeat 1-2 times and remove any damaged beans.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the beans and add them to a saucepan. Fill the pot with cold water so that the beans are covered by 2.5cm (1 inch) of water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a colander to drain the beans and discard the first batch of water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the beans to the saucepan and fill with fresh cold water (enough to cover the beans by 2.5cm/1"- approx 500ml per 100g of beans). Bring to a boil over medium heat once more, then reduce to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place a drop lid on top of the beans to keep them submerged and simmer for 40-70 minutes. Check them from time to time to make sure the beans are always fully submerged, add more water if necessary (about 100ml at a time). Remove any scum that forms on the surface using a mesh spoon.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once 40-60 minutes have passed, test a bean by running it under cold water and then squashing it between your thumb and forefinger. If you can spread it like a paste it's ready. If not, continue to simmer and test a bean every 10-15 minutes until thoroughly softened.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: When the beans are soft enough, add 180 g sugar and mix over the heat until dissolved.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Taste test to check the sweetness, if it's not sweet enough you can add more sugar. Once you're happy with the sweetness, add a generous pinch of salt to balance the flavour.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Toast the kirimochi on both sides using an oven toaster or grill/broiler feature on your regular oven. I usually place mochi on a piece of foil to prevent sticking. Place the toasted mochi in the center of the serving bowl and pour the red bean soup around it. Enjoy!

title: Sushi rolls Futomaki 太巻き寿司
description: Create your own traditional Japanese futomaki sushi rolls packed full of colorful and delicious ingredients.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the sushi rice by folowing the recipe link.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak the mushrooms in a bowl with 1 cup of water. Soak Kanpyo in a separate bow with 1 cups of water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While the mushrooms are soaking, prepare the carrot, egg, and cucumber.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut the carrot and cucumber into long sticks and set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Prepare the tamagoyaki by following the steps in the recipe link then cut into long sticks.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Squeeze out the excess water from the mushrooms into a bowl (save the water) and slice them thinly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Squeeze out the excess water out of the Kanpyo and cut them in same length of nori sheets.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Put 100ml of the water that the mushroom soaked in and 2 tbs of sugar, 2 tbs sake, and 2 tbs of soy sauce into a saucepan.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Put the sliced mushrooms, Kanpyo and carrots into the sauce pan and bring it to boil then reduce the heat to low and allow it to simmer until the most of the liquid has reduced and the carrots are soft.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove from heat and allow to cool down before putting into the sushi roll.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Lay a seaweed sheet onto a sushi mat and place 1.5 cup rice on top and spread it out about 5mm thick leaving 3cm(1.2 inch) gap at the one edge of nori sheet.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Lay out the fillings in the centre of the sushi rice. Do not layer them on top of each other fillings, rather line them up. *3

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Place a little water on to the larger edge of the seaweed then roll the other side towards it and press down on the fillings as you roll then squeeze tightly.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Repeat for the remaining amount of rice and fillings.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Cut the sushi roll into smaller sizes and serve with Sushi ginger and Wasabi if you have. *4

title: Curry Flavor Age Gyoza (Deep-Fried)
description: These crunchy and addictive age-gyoza are stuffed with a flavorful curry-infused filling and then deep-fried until crispy and golden. They make the perfect appetizer or party snack!

ingredients.name: preferred shredded melting cheese (cheddar, gouda or similar)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Add all of the filling ingredients to a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix thoroughly until everything is evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Prepare a small bowl of water and a tray for the completed gyoza next to you. Place a wrapper on your palm and add about ½-1 tbsp of filling to the center, leaving a thick border. Lightly wet the border.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pinch two parallel edges together and push them to the middle so that the edges form a cross along the top.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Firmly pinch the edges to seal.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fold down each edge in the same direction to create the windmill shape.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: If there is a hole in the center, pinch firmly to close it.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Repeat until you've used up all of your wrappers and filling.

steps.title: Step 9
