steps.description: Preheat your oil to 170 °C (338 °F). Once hot, add the gyoza to the oil and fry for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Flip them over and fry for another 2 minutes, or until crispy and golden.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Transfer to a wire rack to allow the excess oil to drain off.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Enjoy with ponzu or your choice of dipping sauce!

title: Inarizushi (Inari sushi) Recipe
description: Mixed Sushi in seasoned fried Tofu pouches

ingredients.name: Dashi (or liquid from rehydrating Shiitake mushroom)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Roll the Aburaage with a rolling pin a couple of times to flatten them. Cut one side of each Aburaage. Carefully open each Aburaage to make a pouch. Boil the prepared Aburaage in hot water for a minute and drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place water, soy sauce, and sugar in a pot and boil. Add the Aburaage, cook for 10-15 minutes, and let cool for at least 3 hours (overnight in the fridge).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Hydrate shiitake mushrooms in water for 30 minutes. You can reserve the liquid to mix with Dashi later if you want.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Remove stems from Shiitake mushrooms and slice thinly. Cut carrots thinly (1 1/2" long).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Boil Dashi with soy sauce and sugar in a pot, add carrots and mushrooms until the liquid is almost gone.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix sushi rice, cooked vegetables, and sesame seeds well. Make 8 small oblong rice balls (there may be leftover rice). Squeeze the Aburaage just a little and stuff rice balls in the pouches.

title: Japanese Beef and Potatoes 肉じゃが
description: Nikujaga is a delicious Japanese potato and beef stew cooked in a savoury-sweet umami broth. This quick and easy meal is a staple of home cooking and a classic Japanese comfort food.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel the potato and cut into irregular sized chunks. Round the corners off and soak in a bowl of water. *3

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Peel carrot and cut into 4 length wise, then slice it thinly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Peel and cut onion in half then thinly and diagonally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Trim both ends of green beans and cut into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bring water to boil in a pot and cook Konnyaku to remove the fishy smell for a couple minutes. Drain the water and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add onion, carrot and potato to cook.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the onion, carrot and potato are coated with oil evenly and the edge of the potato become transparent, add the beef.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When the beef colour has turned light brown, add the dashi stock and bring to boil.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Remove all the scum from the top and put a sheet of aluminum foil, with a small hole cut in the middle, over the top. *4

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Simmer for about 15 minutes to cook until the potato has become soft.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Add sake, mirin, sugar and soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Add Konnyaku and green beans and simmer until the sauce reduces a little bit.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: When the green beans colour has changed and cooked, turn the heat off and serve.

title: Cucumber and Wakame Seaweed Sunomono
description: Cucumber and seaweed salad with sweet vinegar dressing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Hydrate dried Wakame seaweed in water for 10 minutes. Drain water and squeeze water out from Wakame.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice cucumbers as thin as you can. Stir in salt, and let sit for 5 minutes. Squeeze water out from cucumbers.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and sesame oil together until sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vinegar mixture and sesame seeds to prepared cucumbers and Wakame and mix well.

title: Curry Udon (with leftover Japanese curry)
description: Udon noodles in leftover Japanese curry soup

ingredients.name: serving Udon noodle (fresh or frozen, or cooked dried noodle)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a medium sauce pan, mix curry sauce and dashi broth and bring it to a boil. Add udon and simmer for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix corn starch and water in a small dish and add it to the sauce/udon. Continue to cook for another minute. Add soy sauce to taste.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve it in a bowl and top with sliced green onions.

title: Beef Tataki (Japanese Seared Beef Fillet)
description: Beef tataki is an elegant, melt-in-mouth dish made with tender fillet of beef that has been seared over a high heat, thinly sliced, and served with a delicious homemade soy-based dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: cooking oil (neutral flavor with high smoke point)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place the 300 g fillet of beef in a container and stab it thoroughly all over with a clean fork.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sprinkle with ¼ tsp salt and ⅛ tsp ground black pepper and rub the ½ tbsp garlic paste evenly over the surface. Cover and bring to room temperature.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once the beef reaches room temperature, heat an iron skillet on high. Add ½ tbsp cooking oil and once shimmering hot, place the beef fillet in the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sear for about 30-45 seconds on each side.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once seared all over, turn off the heat. Wrap the meat in foil and place it back in the warm pan to rest in the residual heat for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: While you wait, heat the ½ tbsp sake and 1 tbsp mirin in a saucepan and boil for 30 seconds to 1 minute to burn off the alcohol. Pour into a heatproof bowl.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add ½ tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) and ½ tsp wasabi paste to the bowl and whisk until combined. Store in the fridge until serving time.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the beef has finished resting, remove the foil and cut into thin slices with a sharp knife. Arrange the slices on a plate and drizzle with the sauce. Top with 1 tbsp finely chopped green onions and enjoy!

title: Shogayaki 豚の生姜焼き
description: Discover the secrets behind creating delicious and succulent shogayaki (Japanese ginger pork) using flavourful seasoning and fresh ingredients.

ingredients.name: 2-3 leaves of Cabbage very thinly shredded

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, combine all ginger sauce ingredients. Stir well until the sugar dissolves completely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice the pork thinly if necessary and cut the connective tissue. Marinate them in ginger juice and sake by massaging the seasoning into the pork by hand, then leave it for 10 minutes. *1

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove excess marinade off the pork using kitchen paper towel if necessary, and sift a thin layer of katakuriko on the pork surfaces.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or a large frying pan over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the pork slices to the pan in a single layer, ensuring they do not overlap. Cook for about one minute on each side until browned and slightly crispy around the edges.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Remove the cooked pork slices from the frying pan and add 1 tsp of sesame seed oil and sliced onion to cook.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once the onion is cooked, add the ginger sauce to the frying pan.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: When the ginger sauce has thickened, place the pork back to the frying pan and coat the sauce evenly on to the pork.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: When the sauce has coated all the pork and become shiny, turn the heat off.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve the pork with shredded cabbage on a plate.

title: Ohagi (Botamochi) Sweet Rice Balls
description: Ohagi is a traditional Japanese sweet made with sticky glutinous rice coated with delicious red bean paste or roasted soybean powder. It's typically enjoyed during the Autumn equinox and is perfect with a warm cup of green tea!

ingredients.name: cold water (plus extra for washing and soaking)
red bean paste (anko) (chunky "tsubuan" for ohagi or smooth "koshian" for botamochi)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Measure out 150 g glutinous rice (mochigome) into a sieve and place it over a bowl. Fill the bowl with water, wash the rice and drain. Repeat 3 times to clean and remove the excess starch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Fill the bowl with cold water until the rice is submerged and soak for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the water and let the rice dry for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to a heavy pot (or rice cooker) and add 175 ml cold water.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place a lid on and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once it starts to boil, set a timer for 30 seconds. Reduce the heat to medium-low and set a timer for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. (If you are using a rice cooker, use the regular rice setting.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Blast the heat on high for 10 seconds and then turn off. Leave the rice to steam on the warm stove for 15 minutes. Do not remove the lid before this.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: While you wait for the rice to steam, roll 320 g red bean paste (anko) into balls. Lightly dampen your hands to stop it from sticking and divide into 50g balls for the anko coating and 30g balls for the kinako coating. Cover and store in the fridge until it's time to assemble.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Mix 1 tbsp roasted soybean powder (kinako), 1 tbsp sugar and 1 pinch salt in a bowl until well combined and set aside for later.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Once 15 minutes have passed, remove the lid from the pot of rice and mix in 2 tsp white caster sugar and 1 pinch salt. Continue to mix until the rice is half crushed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Transfer to a wide container to help it cool quicker and cover with plastic wrap touching the surface to stop it from drying out.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Once cool to the touch, divide the rice into balls. The anko coated ohagi uses 30g whereas the kinako ones use 50g. This recipe makes 4 of each.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: To make the anko coated ohagi, use lightly dampened hands (or plastic wrap) to press the 50g anko into a flat circle. Place the rice in the middle and wrap it, it's okay if it doesn't wrap completely as this will be hidden underneath.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: For the kinako ohagi, press the 50g rice ball into a flat circle. I recommend using plastic wrap since it's quite sticky, but slighly dampened hands also work. Place the 30g anko in the middle and wrap the rice around it.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Once sealed, roll the anko-filled rice in the kinako mixture.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Repeat until all the anko and rice is used up.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Homemade Japanese Beef Curry (Kare Raisu)
description: Ditch the store-bought roux cubes and learn how to make rich and flavorful Japanese-style beef curry roux from scratch with your own homemade roux!

ingredients.name: apple jam (apple sauce or apple juice is also okay)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Making the Roux

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Making the Curry

title: Ginger Salmon Teriyaki
description: Grilled salmon with gingery Teriyaki sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix soy sauce, sake, sugar and ginger in a small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat oil in a frying pan at medium high heat and place salmon in pan. Cook salmon for 4-5 minutes on each side. Then reduce to medium heat and add sauce. Spoon sauce over salmon. When sauce thickens, after about 4-5 minutes, remove from heat.

title: Pokemon Ball Sushi ポケモンボール寿司
description: A step-by-step guide on how to make Pokemon Sushi Ball! This is a fun food to make for parties and to put in bento boxes for children (or adults!).

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the sushi rice by following the recipe link.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cook 1 cup of the rice in regular water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cook 1/4 cup of azuki beans in 2 cups of water in a pressure cooker for 15 minutes. Drain the beans and use 1 cup of the azuki bean water to cook the second cup of rice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cut a seaweed sheet into three pieces.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Roll and wrap the two cheese sticks together as the step by step photo indicates and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place 1/3 of red coloured rice on the bottom half of the sushi mould and creat a trench in the middle.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place a nori wrapped cheese stick in the trench.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut the 1/2 nori sheets into 1 cm strips.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place the 1 cm nori strips on both sides of the cheese.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Top the 1 cm nori sheets with Kanpyo sheets.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Place another 1 cm nori strip over the Kanpyo strips.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Fill the top half with white rice, shaping it like a semi sphere.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Place the mould lid on and press it down firmly.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Take the sushi roll out of the mould and roll onto a nori sheet on a bamboo sushi rolling mat.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Wrapped the nori sheet around the sushi by rolling the bamboo mat.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Wet the edge of the nori sheet with water so that it will seal the sushi.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Place the nori overlapped side down for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Slice the sushi roll into 8 pieces and serve with shiso leaves (optional).

title: Wafu Dressing (Japanese Soy Based Salad Dressing)
description: This refreshing Wafu Dressing is a Japanese-inspired vinaigrette made with soy sauce and yuzu. Give your salad a zesty Japanese twist with this 5-minute recipe!

ingredients.name: unseasoned rice vinegar (komezu) (or slightly less apple cider or white vinegar)
dashi stock ((liquid, not powder) or water with a pinch of dashi granules, or water)
yuzu (or zest + juice of lemon/orange as substitute)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a bowl, add 2 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu), 1 tbsp unseasoned rice vinegar (komezu), 1 tbsp dashi stock, 1 tsp toasted white sesame seeds, 1 tbsp ground sesame seeds, and 1 tsp sugar. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Grate the zest and squeeze the juice of 1 yuzu into the bowl and mix vigorously.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Gradually pour in 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil down the edge of the bowl while whisking vigorously.*

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Transfer to a pourable container and enjoy with your favorite salads!

title: Double cheese mushipan ダブルチーズ蒸しパン
description: double cheese mushipan recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 170 degree celsius.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Tear the sliced cheese into small sizes. Place them in a saucepan with cream cheese, milk, and oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the saucepan over medium heat and when all the cheese has melted, turn the heat off and set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix half of the sugar (35g) and yolks in a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add the cheese mixture gradually to the yolk mixture bowl and combine them well.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add sifted flour into the egg yolk and mixture to combine.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites and remaining sugar to make meringue. Beat the egg whites until it forms fine peak.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add 1/3 of meringue into the yolk mixture and fold it in and repeat the same for the remaining amount.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Divide the mixture into 8 muffin tin filling each muffin form about 80%.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place the muffin tin in a deep roasting tray and pour water around the muffin tin. Steam bake the mushipan for 15-20 minutes in the preheated oven.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Take the muffin tin out and remove the lining paper and cool them down on a rack.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Change the oven setting to grill at 180 degree celsius. Place the steam baked Mushi Pans on a flat oven tray lined with baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Grill the surface of the cakes for about one and half minutes depending on the oven. Keep a close watch on them because they brown quickly.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: When the surface has browned, take the tray out and cool them down. You can serve the cake warm or cold. Either way is delicious.

title: Miso Soup with Onion and Potato Recipe
description: Easy and authentic Japanese miso soup you can make with pantry staples.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Slice onion thinly and cut potato into bite size pieces (1/4" thick.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring Dashi to a boil and add onion and potato. Cook until softened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce heat to low and dissolve miso paste in the Dashi. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Homemade Mentsuyu (Japanese Noodle Dipping Sauce)
description: This delicious homemade Mentsuyu is the perfect soup base or dipping sauce for udon and soba noodles and can be served hot or cold!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak 5 g dried kelp (kombu) in 500 ml water for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Transfer the kelp and water to a saucepan and heat on medium-low.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: When the water is almost (but not quite) boiling and remove the kombu. Reduce the heat to low and add 10 g bonito flakes (katsuobushi), 3 tbsp mirin, 6 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) and 1 tbsp sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Strain the bonito flakes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve immediately while it's hot, or leave to cool and chill in the refrigerator for cold dishes. Enjoy!

title: Oven-Baked Char Siu Flavoured Chicken Drumsticks チャーシューチキン
description: Easy and flavourful Asian chicken drumsticks recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Finely chop the onion and garlic and mix together with all other marinade ingredients in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pierce the chicken drumsticks in several places with a fork then add to the marinade mix and rub the marinade in.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cover with saran wrap and leave in the fridge for 5-6 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Bake the chicken drumsticks on 220 c (430 f) for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Flip each chicken drumstick over and bake for a further 20 minutes so both sides are golden brown and crispy.

title: Omurice Recipe
description: Ketchup-flavored fried chicken rice wrapped in an egg crepe.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut chicken thigh into 1" pieces. Cut onion finely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Melt butter and add oil in a frying pan at medium heat. Add chicken and cook for 1-2 minutes. Add onion and cook until onion becomes translucent.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add cooked rice and cook mixing for 2 minutes. Season rice with salt and pepper. Make room in the frying pan and add ketchup. Cook only ketchup for 30 seconds to cook it down. Mix rice and ketchup and fry together for 1-2 minutes. Then add frozen peas and cook some more.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place half of the ketchup rice into a rice bowl or similar kind of bowl, pack lightly, and unmold on a plate. Make another one.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Beat eggs and a pinch of salt together. Heat frying pan with 1/2 tsp oil. Pour 1/2 of egg mixture onto hot frying pan and make a crepe-like thin round egg sheet. Cover molded rice with egg sheet to form an oval shape. Repeat one more time.

title: Ponzu Salad Dressing (with Sesame and Wasabi)
description: This zesty and refreshing ponzu dressing is a perfect blend of Japanese flavors, combining distinct notes of soy, citrus and wasabi to create a bright yet balanced dressing in minutes!

ingredients.name: ponzu sauce (see note for plant-based options)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Measure out 1 tbsp mirin in a heatproof bowl and microwave uncovered for 50 seconds at 500W. (If you increase the recipe, the time will need to be increased.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add 4 tbsp ponzu sauce, 1 tsp ground sesame seeds and 1 tsp wasabi paste and whisk until evenly dispersed. Then slowly pour in ½ tbsp olive oil and ½ tbsp toasted sesame oil while whisking vigorously until emulsified.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Serve immediately, or store in the fridge and whisk right before pouring. Enjoy!

title: Miso Cookies
description: Miso flavored ice-box cookies

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Beat Miso, butter, and sugar in a bowl until creamy. Add egg and beat some more.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Then add flour and baking soda, and mix until dough comes together.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the dough in half and shape into a 2" round log, using flour if the dough is sticking (or cool it in the fridge for 30 minutes to firm). Roll and coat with raw sugar. Wrap with plastic and refrigerate for a couple of hours.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Slice the cookie dough into 1/2" thick rounds. Place cookies on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Bake in preheated oven at 350F (175C) for 12-15 minutes.

title: Gomoku mame 五目豆
description: Healthy Japanese side dish that Japanese people keep in their fridge always; Gomoku (five ingredients) mame(beans)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Soak the Konbu in a bowl of water for 30minutes and cut into small size squares.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dice the carrot and Konjac small.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut the renkon to small sizes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Boil water in a pot and add dashi powder.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in the pot.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add all the other ingredients in the pot and simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Cool it down and refrigerate to allow the flavour to be absorbed.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve as a side dish in a small bowl.

title: Tekka Maki (Tuna Sushi Rolls)
description: Tekka Maki is a simple and delicious sushi roll made with sashimi-grade red tuna. Perfect for beginners and tuna lovers!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix 1 tbsp unseasoned rice vinegar (komezu), 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt until dissolved.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix the seasoned vinegar into 320 g cooked Japanese short-grain rice while it's still warm. Gently fan to cool and cover with a clean damp tea towel until it's time to use.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Next, pat 100 g sashimi-grade tuna dry with kitchen paper and sprinkle with ¼ tsp salt. Rub over both sides then place it in a container propped up on one side to allow any excess liquid to drain to the bottom. Rest in the refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes. After the tuna has finished resting, wipe off any moisture with kitchen paper and cut it into sticks about 7-8mm (1/3 inch) thick.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Optional: Turn your gas burner on low and carefully fan 2 sheets roasted seaweed for sushi (nori) over the fire to improve the texture and aroma of the nori.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fold the nori in half and pinch along the crease so that you can neatly tear them in half. (You can use scissors if you prefer.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Set the rolling mat in front of you with the bamboo laying horizontally. Place the nori down with the rough side facing up, line up the bottom edge with the bottom of the sushi mat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Wet your hands with cold water. Keep a bowl of cold water nearby to use when necessary. (This helps stop rice sticking to your hands.) Take a handful of sushi rice (approx 80g) and shape it into a rough cylinder.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Leaving a finger-width border along the top of the nori, place the rice on one side and gently spread it to the other side. (You can use a rice paddle to spread it if you prefer.)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Use your hand to make a wall and push the rice right up to the edges of the nori. Make sure to leave the border at the top clear.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Make a ridge with the top edge of the rice (next to the border).

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add a small blob of wasabi and spread it down the middle of the rice. Then, place a strip of tuna on top and gently press it into the rice to prevent it from shifting when rolled.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Lift the edge of the bamboo mat closest to you (the bottom edge) and carefully roll it over so that the two edges of the rice meet. (Make sure it's tight!) Lift the bamboo mat slightly and roll over the flap of nori to close the sushi. You don't need to wet it down, the moisture from the rice will help the nori stick together.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Once you have completed the sushi roll, use the bamboo mat to press the edges and seal. Repeat until you have 4 rolls.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Wipe a sharp knife with a damp cloth. Cut each sushi roll in half, then cut each half into thirds, creating 6 pieces per roll. Cut using a short, sharp sawing motion, wiping your knife between each cut.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Enjoy your homemade tekka maki with a small bowl of soy sauce for dipping!

title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork Tenderloin Japanese Plum Sauce プルドポーク
description: This delicious Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork tenderloin is juicy and tender and requires very little effort and time to make! Just throw it all into a slow-cooker overnight!

ingredients.name: Small stalks of celery with leaves on it (the end bits of celery)
Leftover liquid from slow-cooker (after meat is done)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a fry pan and lightly brown the outside of the pork.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Put the pork into the slow cooker along with all the other dry ingredients.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour the liquid (wine and stock) over the top of everything.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Cook it in the slow cooker for about 7-8 hours overnight on the low setting.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Once it's cooked, take the pork out and pull it apart.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sauce

title: Yellowtail Teriyaki (Buri no Teriyaki)
description: Buri no Teriyaki is a classic Japanese homestyle meal made with pan-fried Japanese Amberjack (yellowtail) coated in a delectable homemade teriyaki glaze.

ingredients.name: Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) (for teriyaki sauce)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place 2 yellowtail fillets in a sealable bag and add 1 tsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu) and 1 tsp mirin. Seal the bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu), 2 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp sake and 1 tsp sugar until the sugar has dissolved. Set by the stove for later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Once 15 minutes have passed, transfer the yellowtail fillets to a container and pat them dry with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Sprinkle with 1 tbsp cornstarch, making sure both sides are lightly covered. Pat off the excess before frying.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat a pan on medium and add ½ tbsp cooking oil. Once hot, place the fillets in the pan and fry for 2 minutes on each side.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Increase the heat to high and pour the teriyaki sauce into the pan and fry until thickened to a syrup-like consistency. Turn the fish to make sure both sides are covered with sauce (about 30 seconds each side).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once thickened, remove the pan from the heat and serve.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Sweet potato granola cake さつま芋とグラノーラのケーキ
description: This sweet potato granola cake is sweet and delicious with a Japanese twist. It's soft, fluffy, and sweet with a bit of crunch from the granola.

ingredients.name: purple sweet potato (*or 120g or 1/4 sweet potato)
A sprinkle of black sesame seeds

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat the oven to 356°F (180°C) and cover an 18cm square tin with baking paper. *3

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sift all dry ingredients (minus sugar) together in a bowl and put it aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Wash the sweet potato and chop it into 1cm cubes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Soak the cubes in water in a bowl for about 10 minutes. Pat them dry with a paper towel and place them in a microwavable container.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle 1 tbsp of sugar over the sweet potato and microwave for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the butter into the sweet potato container to coat the sweet potato with butter, then set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Put the egg and 4 tbsp(or 60g) sugar in a large bowl and whisk them together with a handheld mixer. *4

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the oil and beat all together.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add half of the milk to mix and fold the half of the sifted dry ingredients.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Add rest of the milk and then add all the sifted dry ingredients. *5

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add 2/3 of the sweet potato and 2/3 of the granola and fold them into the wet mixture but do not mix too much.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Pour the mixture into the prepared square tin and top with the remaining sweetpotato and granola and sprinkle the black sesame seeds on top.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Bake for about 20 minutes, depending on your oven.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Serve fresh from the oven or allow to cool.

title: Tanindon (Japanese Pork and Egg Rice Bowl)
description: Tanindon is the lesser-known cousin of oyakodon, a hearty rice bowl dish made with slices of juicy pork, tender onions, and silky eggs simmered in an umami-packed dashi sauce.

ingredients.name: thinly sliced pork (preferably belly, loin or butt)
Japanese leek (naganegi) (or regular leek (white part) thin diagonal slices)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place 250 g thinly sliced pork in a bowl and sprinkle with 1 pinch salt and 1 tbsp all-purpose flour. Mix until the pork has a thin, even coat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat a frying pan on medium and add 1 tsp cooking oil. Once hot, add the pork and arrange it in a single layer. Fry until both sides are lightly golden. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate and set aside for later.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Using the same pan, add 3 tbsp mirin, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp dashi granules and 120 ml water. Mix well until the sugar and dashi granules have dissolved, then add 2 fresh shiitake mushroom, ½ yellow onions and 1 Japanese leek (naganegi). Simmer until the onions have softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the pork back to the pan and drizzle 2 tbsp Japanese light soy sauce (usukuchi shoyu). Mix to evenly disperse.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Separate 3 pasteurized egg so that the whites and yolks are in separate bowls. Lightly whisk the whites and pour them around the pan. Cover with a lid and steam the egg for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: After 1 minute, whisk the yolks and pour them around the pan. Continue to cook until the yolks are cooked to your liking (cover with a lid if you don't like runny yolks).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Dish up 2 portions cooked Japanese short-grain rice and divide the contents of the pan over the top. Drizzle any leftover sauce from the pan and garnish with broccoli sprouts, finely chopped green onions and red pickled ginger (benishoga) (optional).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Buri Teriyaki 鰤の照り焼き
description: easy buri teriyaki recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the yellow tail fillet. Sprinkle salt and leave them for about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: After 15 minutes, wipe the excess liquid off the fish with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Heat the butter in a frying pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Fry both side of the fish until brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Turn the heat up and pour the teriyaki sauce over the fish.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook till the sauce has reduced and become thick and shiny.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn the heat off and serve it with shiso leaf and radish.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Kikka Kabu (Chrysanthemum radish)

title: Yaki Onigiri (Pan-Fried Rice Balls with Soy Sauce and Butter)
description: Crunchy grilled rice balls with a soy-butter glaze

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Make plain Onigiri and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat frying pan on medium low heat and melt butter. Place Onigiri in the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes per side until lightly browned.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Brush soy sauce on the surface and cook for 30 seconds - 1 min more per each side. (Watch carefully because it will burn quickly!)

title: Chashu-Style Oven Roasted Pork Belly
description: This super easy and efficient chashu-style pork belly is simply marinated and roasted, creating a meaty and flavorful topping for your homemade ramen with practically no effort!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Start by thoroughly stabbing 450 g slab skinless pork belly all over with a fork.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add the marinade ingredients to a large sealable freezer bag and massage until combined. Then, add the pork belly and the green part of 1 Japanese leek (naganegi). Massage until fully covered, seal the bag and refrigerate overnight.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Preheat your oven to 200 °C (392 °F) and line a roasting pan with baking paper. Place the marinated pork belly slab in the center of the pan and once the oven has finished preheating, place it on the bottom shelf and roast for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: After 10 minutes, reduce the heat to 140 °C (284 °F) and continue to roast for 1 hour. Once cooked, the internal temperature should be at least 62.8 °C (145 °F) to be considered safe to eat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Wrap and rest for 10-15 minutes. Once rested, cut into slices. You can cut small pieces horizontally or long pieces lengthways depending on preference and usage.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Enjoy on ramen or donburi!

title: 15 minute Teriyaki Salmon Bowl 鮭の照り焼き丼
description: Try my 15 minute Teriyaki salmon rice bowl. It's a super easy, healthy and delicious one bowl meal, with tasty homemade teriyaki sauce and hearty vegetables

ingredients.name: Handful of cabbage (or any vegetables to serve)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Sprinkle the sake over the salmon fillet and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Shred cabbage and radish very thinly and soak in water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Remove excess sake and moisture from the salmon fillet with a kitchen paper towel.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pan fry the salmon until it is cooked. Remove the salmon from the frying pan and cut it down into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Wipe the frying pan with a kitchen paper towel and simmer the teriyaki sauce in the pan.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add the salmon back into the pan and coat it with the teriyaki sauce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Put rice into a bowl then top with salmon and vegetables, and serve!

title: Tebasaki Karaage
description: Deep-fried savory chicken wings

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut chicken wings into 2 parts, wings and drumettes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix soy sauce, Sake, Mirin, salt, garlic and ginger in a large bowl. Add chicken and marinade for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a different bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, salt and pepper. Coat marinated chicken pieces with flour mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat oil at medium high heat (350F). Deep fry for 5-8 minutes depending on the size of meat.

title: Kuri Gohan 栗ご飯
description: Cook chestnuts easily in a Japanese way to make Kuri gohan(Chestnuts Rice)!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare chestnuts by using kitchen scissors to remove the outer hard skin. Leave the astringent skin intact.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Place them in a saucepan or pot and pour enough water to cover the chestnuts.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Start to heat the pot over high heat to bring it to boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once it has boiled, turn the heat down to low / medium and simmer to cook the chestnuts for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Drain the hot water and add cold water so that you can handle the chestnuts but the chestnuts will not get dry.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Carefully remove the astringent skin with hands and set aside all.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Wash the rice and glutinous wheat until the washing water becomes clearer (about 3-4 times). Drain the water completely.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Place the washed rice and the glutinous wheat into a rice cooker.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Pour 2 cups of water and add salt and sake.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Place the chestnuts over the rice.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Close the rice cooker lid and set the rice cooker, following the rice cooker instructions.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: When it is cooked, stir gently. Try not to break the chestnuts shape.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Serve in a rice bowl and sprinkle black sesame seeds.

title: Japanese Clam Miso Soup (Asari no Miso Shiru)
description: Asari Miso Soup celebrates the natural briny flavor of fresh clams combined with the rich and satisfying flavor of miso. This must-try miso soup variation is packed with umami and it's easy to make too!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place 450 g clams in a colander and rinse under running water to clean the shells. Remove any clams with broken shells. Pour 500 ml water into a bowl and mix in 2 tsp salt. Once dissolved, add the clams and soak for 1 hour to purge them of salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: At the same time, fill a separate bowl with 1100 ml water and add 5 g dried kelp (kombu). Soak for 1 hour to rehydrate the kombu and make kombu dashi.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: After 1 hour, drain the clams and rinse with running water once more to ensure all of the sand is removed. Transfer to the pot you intend to make the miso soup in and add 3 tbsp sake.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Heat the pot over medium and when the sake starts to bubble, place a lid on top and let the clams steam for 5 minutes or until they have opened.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Scoop the clams out of the pot using a slotted spoon and set aside in a bowl. Pour the kombu dashi into the pot with clam juices and bring the mixture to almost boiling. Reduce to a simmer and remove the sheet of kombu.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add the clams back in and simmer for 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Turn off the heat, then use a mesh spoon to incorporate 4 tbsp yellow miso paste (awase).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Divide the soup and clams into serving bowls and garnish with finely chopped green onions. Enjoy!

title: Kabocha Gohan (kabocha squash rice) Recipe
description: Steamed rice cooked with Kabocha cubes

ingredients.name: Kabocha (peel and cut into 1-1.5 inch cubes)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Put rice in a bowl. Wash and pour water out, then repeat 2 more times. Place rice and water in a heavy pot. Let it soak for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Immediately before cooking, add salt and sake and stir. Add Kabocha and bring it to a boil on high heat without lid. When it reaches the rapid boil, put the lid on and reduce heat to simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Let it stand for 10 minutes (don't open the lid.) Fluff the rice with spatula (kabocha will be so soft that it will be mashed a little bit, but that's OK.)

title: Sekihan (Japanese Red Bean Rice)
description: Sekihan is a traditional rice dish made by cooking glutinous rice with red adzuki beans, giving it a beautiful reddish hue. With a sprinkle of salt and sesame seeds, this dish is simple yet delicious and satisfying!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Start by washing 40 g dry adzuki beans and remove any broken beans, then pour them into a saucepan. Fill with water until the beans are covered by about 2cm and bring to a boil over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil for 10 minutes, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Take the pan off the heat, then drain and discard the cooking water. This step will remove any astringency.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Return the beans to the pot and add 750 ml water. Place a lid on top and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 40-50 minutes or until soft enough to crush between your fingers. Check regularly and top up with more water if necessary.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Be careful not to overcook the beans. Once they're tender, separate them and reserve 350ml of the cooking water. If there isn't enough, top up with cold water.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp sugar and ½ tbsp sake to the water and mix until dissolved. Leave to cool completely, it must not be warm when we start cooking the rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour 300 g glutinous rice (mochigome) into a bowl and fill with water. Gently wash and drain the water. Repeat 3 times.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Transfer the rice to your cooking pot and add the cooled adzuki bean cooking water. Shake the pot to flatten the rice, then sprinkle the cooked adzuki beans over the top (do not mix).

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid and place it on the stove. Heat on medium and bring to boil. Boil for 1 minute, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 7 minutes. Do not remove the lid at any point.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Blast the heat on high for 10 seconds, then turn off the stove. Leave to steam with the lid on for 15 minutes. Steaming is a vital part of the recipe and cannot be skipped or rushed, so make sure not to remove the lid before it has finished steaming.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Once it's finished steaming, remove the lid and gently mix with a rice paddle.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Divide between serving bowls and sprinkle each portion with black sesame seeds and sea salt. Enjoy!

title: Fried Shrimp 海老フライ
description: How to make plump and succulent fried shrimp the Japanese way with step by step photos and tips for presentation, and how to prepare the shrimp.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Prepare the shrimp by removing the shell and deveining it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Score the shrimps belly 2-3 places and snap the muscle to prevent the shrimps from curling up. *3

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Mix the egg, flour, water, and mayonnaise in a small bowl to make a batter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Coat shrimps with the batter then place into the Panko crumbs and coat. *4

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Heat some frying oil in a deep pan until it reaches around 180 °C(356°F).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Fry each shrimp until it's crispy and golden brown on both sides then set aside on paper towel to absorb the excess oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Serve the fried shrimps with vegetables and top with Tartar sauce.

title: Aburaage and Onion Miso Soup Recipe
description: Miso soup with fried thin tofu and sliced brown onion

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut Aburaage in half, then cut into thin strips. Slice onion very thinly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Boil Dashi. Add Aburaage and onion to Dashi and cook until onion becomes tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Reduce heat to low and dissolve miso paste in the Dashi. Take care not to boil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add green onions and remove from heat.

title: Japanese Red Pickled Ginger (Homemade Benishoga)
description: Vibrant and tangy benishoga is a Japanese pickle made with matchsticks of young ginger soaked in a flavorful red ume vinegar. It is the perfect palate cleanser and commonly paired with dishes like yakisoba or gyudon.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Thoroughly wash 100 g young ginger root (shin shoga) and roughly cut into 5cm pieces (approx 2 inches). Cut each piece into thin slices about 2mm thick.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil and blanch the ginger for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Drain the water by pouring the contents of the pan into a colander, then rinse with cold water to cool. Shake thoroughly, then transfer to a bowl and sprinkle with ½ tsp salt. Rub the salt over the ginger until evenly covered.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place a clean plate on top of the ginger and weigh it down with something heavy. Rest for 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Squeeze out the accumulated liquid and discard.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: If you have time, arrange the slices on a bamboo tray or mesh sieve and leave to dry in a well ventilated area for several hours. Alternatively, pat the surface dry with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Once dried, cut each slice into thin matchsticks and place them in a sterilized, sealable jar.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Mix 125 ml red ume plum vinegar (umesu) and ½ tbsp sugar in a jug until the sugar has dissolved. Pour the mixture into the jar, ensuring the ginger is fully submerged.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Store in the refrigerator and rest for at least 1 day (for best results, wait 4-5 days before consuming). Enjoy!

title: Tartar sauce タルタルソース
description: Super easy tartar sauce recipe Japanese version with step by step photos and a video. This sauce can be ready in 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Boil two eggs to make hard boiled eggs for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While the eggs being cooked, chop onion, gherkin and shiso leaves finely and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Squeeze lemon juice and zest the lemon. set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: When the eggs are cooked, peel the eggs and place them in a medium mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Squash the hard boiled eggs with folk.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Add chopped onion, gherkins, shiso leaves.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add mayonnaise, lemon juice and zest as well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Combine them all together and serve with fried seafood such as Ebi fry.

title: Potato Salad Recipe
description: Japanese potato salad with a lot of vegetables and Japanese mayonnaise

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel potatoes and cut into small pieces. Heat water in a pot, and boil potatoes until tender, about 10-15 minutes. Strain and put potatoes in a large bowl. Add 1/2 tsp salt and vinegar, and mash slightly (leave some potato chunks). Let it cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Slice cucumbers to thin rounds, and cut carrots thinly (2" long). In a different bowl, sprinkle a little salt (not in the measurement) over cucumber and carrots, and let it sit for 2-3 minutes. Squeeze out water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Cut boiled eggs into small pieces, and cut ham thinly (2" long strips).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add vegetables, eggs, and ham to potatoes, then mayonnaise. Mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Poke bowl ポキ丼
description: Poke Bowls are a healthy one bowl food craze. They are high in quality protein, fibre and nutrients. Learn how to make your own at home here on my blog.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Dice the tuna fillet and place them in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add soy sauce, sake, mirin and sesame seed oil to the mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Combine them well altogether and marinate the fish for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: While marinating the fish, defrost edamame beans, slice cucumbers and radishes, chop scallions. Also cut avocado.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Serve the sushi rice in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Place shiso leaf over the sushi rice.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Add 1/4 of marinated yellowfin tuna on the shiso leaf.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Top with avocado, cucumber, radish, edamame and pickled ginger.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Garnish with chopped scallions, shredded seaweed.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Sprinkle sesame seeds and drizzle Japanese mayonnaise over.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Add wasabi paste on the side.

title: Takowasa (Wasabi Marinated Octopus)
description: Takowasa is a refreshing and addictive izakaya-style side dish made with tender pieces of octopus marinated in a wasabi-flavored marinade. This simplified version is easy to prepare at home and seriously good!

ingredients.name: boiled octopus (or sashimi grade raw octopus if available)
wasabi paste (increase for a stronger wasabi flavor)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Pour 1 tbsp mirin and 1 tbsp sake into a small saucepan and boil for 30 seconds to burn off the alcohol. Remove the pan from the heat, add 3 g dried kelp (kombu) and leave to cool.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: While you wait, cut 100 g boiled octopus into bitesize pieces.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Place the octopus pieces inside a sealable freezer bag and pour in the sauce. Add 1 tbsp Japanese light soy sauce (usukuchi shoyu), ½ tbsp wasabi paste and 1 dried red chili pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Massage the ingredients until the octopus is evenly covered, then push the air out of the bag and seal. Marinate in the refrigerator for 8 hours.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Avocado Salad with Wasabi Dressing
description: Cubed avocado mixed with spicy Wasabi dressing

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Peel and pit the avocado; cut into 2" cubes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Whisk all the ingredients for the dressing together in a medium bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add avocado and mix with the dressing.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Serve on a plate and sprinkle with Nori.

title: Beef Yawata Maki (Glazed Beef Vegetable Rolls)
description: Beef Yawata Maki is a traditional dish from Kyoto made with beautifully arranged vegetables wrapped in tender beef or eel coated in a sticky teriyaki glaze. This stunning dish is popular in Osechi and makes a great appetizer or side dish!

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Start boiling a small pot of water. While you wait for it to heat up, trim the ends of 8 green beans and cut 1 carrot into batons that match the size of the green beans and the width of the beef. Boil for 3 minutes and then transfer to a bowl of cold water to prevent them overcooking.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Stretch a piece of thinly sliced beef out on a flat surface and sprinkle the top with flour. Place 2 green beans and 2 carrot battons stacked into a 2x2 pattern on one side of the beef.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Tightly roll the beef to encase the vegetables. Repeat with the rest of the beef slices and vegetables, placing each finished roll in a container with the seam facing down to prevent it from unrolling.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Start heating a pan on medium. Sprinkle the beef rolls with a thin even coat of flour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Mix 2 tbsp Japanese soy sauce (koikuchi shoyu), 2 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp mirin and 1 tsp sugar in a small bowl and set by the stove ready for later.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Once the pan is hot, pour a drizzle of oil and add the beef rolls. Fry until browned on all sides.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the sauce into the pan and continue to cook until thickened, turning the beef rolls occasionally to ensure they're evenly covered and don't burn. Once coated, remove the pan from the heat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cut each roll into halves or thirds and serve.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Miso Grilled Chicken Recipe
description: Miso-marinated and grilled chicken

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Mix Miso, Mirin, Sake, sugar, and soy sauce in a bowl. Marinade chicken thighs in Miso mixture for at least 3 hours, or overnight.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Preheat oven to 425F. Wipe marinade liquid well from chicken and place chicken on oiled aluminum foil spread over a sheet pan.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Bake for 15 minutes, turn over and bake 10-15 minutes more until cooked through.

title: Popcorn Chicken 唐揚げポップコーン
description: Iconic Japanese fried chicken Karaage infusion recipe

ingredients.name: Katakuriko (potato starch (enough to cover all the chicken))
Vegetable oil (amount depends on the size of your pan or fryer)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Cut the chicken meat into mini bite sized pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Mix sake, soy sauce, ginger and garlic all together in a ziplock bag.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add the chicken to the bag and massage the bag. Marinate the chicken in the bag and leave it aside for about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Place the potato starch in a shallow container or in a bowl and roll the marinated chicken pieces in it to coat them. Shake off the excess starch.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Fill a deep saucepan with the cooking oil (or an electric deep fryer, which is what I used) about ⅔ full and heat to about 180 c degree. Dip a chopstick into the oil and if tiny bubbles form at the bottom of the pan, then it is ready to deep fry the meat.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook the chicken meat until the outside is golden brown and crispy.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Take the chicken out and leave it on a plate with a paper towels placed under it and over it to absorb the excess oil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Serve with any condiments you like, such as lemon, mayo, or salt and pepper.

title: Homemade Sakura Denbu (Fluffy Pink Fish Flakes)
description: Sakura Denbu is a sweet and fluffy condiment made with fine flakes of cod colored pink like cherry blossoms. It is perfect for decorating and adding flavor to sushi, rice balls, bentos and donburi!

ingredients.name: drops pink food coloring (or natural substitute like beetroot juice)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil and add 200 g cod fillets. Boil for 3-5 minutes depending on the thickness of the fillets.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain and place the cooked cod in a bowl of cold water to cool it. I recommend using a sieve to save any broken pieces of cod. Gently rub the surface of the cod to wash it, then drain the water and rinse with fresh water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pat the surface dry with kitchen paper and then rub the filets between your fingers to break it into fine flakes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix 4 tsp sugar,1 pinch salt,1 tbsp sake and 2 drops pink food coloring in a bowl until dissolved.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Place the cod flakes in a cold non-stick frying pan and pour in the mixture from the previous step. Heat the pan over a low heat and mix continuously to prevent browning.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cook until the liquid has evaporated the flakes are mostly dry with a small amount of moisture.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Use for sushi, rice balls or bento boxes! Enjoy!

title: Spinach Salad with Sesame Sauce Recipe
description: Blanched spinach mixed with sesame sauce

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cool under running water and squeeze out water. Cut into 1" sections.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Grind sesame seeds, and mix with soy sauce and sugar in a bowl.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Mix sauce and spinach.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sprinkle sesame seeds on spinach.

title: Sablé with salted Sakura cherry blossom flower 桜サブレ
description: Japanese infused cookie recipe with Iconic Japanese cherry blossom flower petal on top of the sable

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Gently remove the cherry blossom flower from the packet and soak in a bowl of water for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Drain the water, wipe and remove excess water with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pick 16 flowers and cut some of the stems off if they are too long and do not discard them.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Chop the left over flowers and the stems finely. set aside.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Leave the butter at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Sift the flour and set aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Place the softened unsalted butter and sugar into a stand mixer to mix until creamy.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Add the egg yolk to the mixer and combine well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Add the finely chopped cherry blossom flower.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Change the mixer attachment to the flat coated beater (or use a spatula) and add the sifted flour to combine.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Turn the dough out onto a sheet of cling wrap and roll to shape about 4cm in diameter cylinder on a kitchen bench.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Refrigerate the cookie dough for at least 60 minutes.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Start to preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F).

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Remove the cling wrap and roll the cookie dough on granule sugar in a flat container to coat the dough with granule sugar.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: Cut the cookie dough about 7mm (0.3inch)thick and place them on a lined baking tray with baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Place the cherry blossom flower on each cookie and press it gently.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.description: Bake the cookies for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 18
steps.description: Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Homemade Shibazuke Pickles
description: Shibazuke are vibrant purple pickles made with summer vegetables such as eggplant, cucumbers and Japanese ginger pickled with salt, sugar, and red ume vinegar.

ingredients.name: red perilla leaves (akajiso) ((optional) rubbed with salt and washed)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Fill a bowl with cold water and add a pinch of salt. Mix well. Cut the ends off of 200 g eggplant and cut in half or quarters lengthways. Cut into 3mm slices and place them in the water as you go to prevent discoloration.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Soak the eggplant slices for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: While you wait, bring a small pot of water to a rolling boil. Scrape the skin of 10 g ginger root with the edge of a spoon, then thinly slice. Blanch in the hot water for 30 seconds, then drain and rinse with cold water to quickly cool.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Thinly slice the blanched ginger, 50 g Japanese ginger (myoga) and 5 perilla leaves (shiso).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Wash 100 g Japanese cucumber and cut off the ends. Cut in half lengthways and scoop out the seeds with a spoon.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cut the cucumber into 3mm slices (the same as the eggplant).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Drain the eggplant and place it in a large dry bowl. Add the rest of the cut vegetables, then add 9 g sea salt.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Massage until evenly covered.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of the vegetables, then weigh it down with a plate and a weight. Rest in the refrigerator overnight.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: The next day, squeeze the vegetables thoroughly and discard the accumulated liquid.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Transfer the vegetables to a sealable freezer bag and add 10 g sugar and 45 ml red ume plum vinegar (umesu). If available, you can add a few red perilla leaves (akajiso) for a more intense color.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Massage the bag until the ingredients are evenly coated, then push the air out and seal. Place the bag in a square container so that it lays flat and prevents leaks. Rest in the refrigerator for at least 2 days.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Drain the pickles and squeeze out any excess liquid. Transfer to a sterilized airtight container and store in the refrigerator. Enjoy!

title: Curry Udon カレーうどん
description: Curry Udon combines udon noodles with Japanese style curry to create the ultimate comfort dish. It's easy, delicious, and the perfect meal for a cold winter day.

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the beef and cook until the meat colour change.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Add 2 cups of water and bring it to boil. Remove the scum as often and as necessary.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Open and empty the instant udon soup packet to the frying pan.

steps.description: Add 2 pieces of curry roux.

title: Salmon and Egg Donburi
description: Salmon and eggs in savory sauce over steamed rice

steps.title: Step 2

steps.description: Beat the eggs in a bowl and pour over the salmon and onion. Cover and cook for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4

title: Matcha Pound Cake with Adzuki Beans
description: This delicious matcha pound cake is rich, buttery and flavored with earthy matcha powder and naturally sweet adzuki beans. It's the perfect teatime treat with Japanese flair!

ingredients.name: 2-3 drops vanilla essence (or 1 drop vanilla extract)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Before you start, preheat your oven 175 °C (347 °F) and line a 7x3" (18x7.5cm) loaf pan with baking paper. Crack 2 eggs into a jug and add 20 ml whole milk and 2-3 drops vanilla essence. Whisk until combined and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Sift 100 g unbleached cake flour and 1 tbsp matcha powder together into a bowl and whisk. Scoop out 1 tbsp and save it in a small bowl for later. Add ½ tsp baking powder and 1 pinch salt to the bowl and mix.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: In a separate bowl, whip 100 g butter and 100 g granulated sugar together until pale and smooth. Gradually add the egg mixture while whisking.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients one-third at a time and whisk until smooth and there are no more lumps of dry flour. Be careful not to over-mix.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour 100 g boiled adzuki beans into a separate bowl and pat them with kitchen paper to remove excess moisture. Add the tablespoon of matcha flour from earlier and toss until evenly coated to help prevent sinking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Mix the flour-dusted adzuki beans into the cake batter until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour the batter into the lined loaf pan and bake for 40-50 minutes at 175 °C (347 °F) or until a skewer comes out clean or with just a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Cool in the pan for a few minutes then remove and finish cooling on a wire rack. Once cool enough to touch, slice and enjoy!

title: Chawanmushi 茶碗蒸し
description: Chawanmushi, the silky smooth savoury egg custard, delicately flavoured Japanese classic and sophisticated dish recipe with step by step photos and a video.

ingredients.name: of Kamaboko fish cake (I used Naruto fish cake left over from making Ramen)
Mitsuba to garnish (Option, I did not have one so I used flat leaf parsley instead)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: cut off stem of shiitake mushrooms and cut it into thin slices and slice the carrot about 3mm(0.1inch) and cut out using cookie cutters. *3

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: slice Naruto fish cakes thinly and set aside

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: in a large bowl eggs, soy sauce and mirin together with chopsticks and try not to whisk too much to avoid aerating egg.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour Dashi stock into the ball small amount at a time and mix with egg gradually.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Use a strainer, strain the egg mixture in order to achieve silky soft texture when it is steamed.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: divide the mixture into 3 tea cups(or mugs or ramekins)

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: pour water about 3 cm (1.2 inch) high in a pot 20cm ( 7.9 inch) in diameter and bring it to boil over high heat.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Once the water boiled, place tea cups in the pot and turn down to low heat.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: wrap the lid with a tea towel, so that water does not drip over the chawanmushi. *4

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Put lid on and steam about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: When the egg mixture nearly set, top with shrimp, naruto, shiitake mushrooms, edamame, carrot and Ginnan

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: steam farther 5-3minutes.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: Turn the heat off leave the chawanmushi bowl in the pot for set farther 5 min.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Garnish with Mitsuba (*5 if you have) and serve

title: Kinshi Tamago Recipe
description: Thinly sliced egg crepes, versatile toppings for many dishes

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Beat eggs very well with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Heat small frying pan (such as 8" or 9") at medium heat and coat thinly with oil.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour some of the egg mixture in the pan, spread it thin with a swirl motion of the pan, and cook for 15-30 seconds. Turn it over and immediately remove from the pan. Repeat until the egg mixture is gone.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Roll up the egg crepes and cut into 1/8" strips.

title: Instant Pot Beef Stew ビーフシチュー
description: Instant Pot Beef Stew recipe. Ultimate winter comfort beef stew using instapot and Japanese beef stew roux with step by step photo instructions and a video

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Set the instant pot to saute function.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Add olive oil into the pot. Add beef and cook and partially brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Add diced potato, onion, carrot and mushrooms. Saute about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour red wine and water to the pot. Close the lid and change the setting to Stew for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Manually let the steam go *3 and open the lid.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Break the roux into small cubes and add to the pot.

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 9

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Serve in the shallow bowl, pour a little bit of fresh cream*4 and garnish with thyme. *5

title: Yuzu Kosho (Japanese Citrus Chili Paste)
description: Yuzu Kosho is a spicy fermented condiment made with yuzu citrus and chili peppers. It's the perfect way to add fiery, zesty flavor to hot pots, soups, sashimi, tempura and more!

ingredients.name: yuzu zest (green, unripe (see in post for substitutes) approx 10)
green chili peppers (stems and seeds removed, finely diced)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Wash the surface of the yuzu thoroughly, then dry with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Cut out the top stems to make it easier to grate all over.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use a microplane grater to grate the zest into a large container, being careful not to grate the white pith. You can squeeze the juice out of the leftover fruits to use for other recipes. For larger batches, peel the yuzu and blitz in a food processor.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Weigh the total zest and make a note of it.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Put on some gloves, and cut the stems off of the chili peppers. Slice them down the center lengthways and scoop out the seeds with the back of your knife (or use a spoon).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Weigh the chilis as you go until you have an equal amount to the yuzu zest.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Finely dice them.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Combine the weights of the yuzu zest and chili, then use it to calculate the amount of salt needed to make 20%. (Yuzu + chili = total weight, total weight x 0.2 = salt amount in grams)

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Combine everything in a mortar and grind with a pestle until there are no more large chunks left. For large batches, blitz everything together in a food processor.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: If the mixture seems a little dry, squeeze in some yuzu juice.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Transfer to a sterilized jar. Although it's safe to eat straight away, it's recommended to let it rest for about 1 week to allow the flavors to develop and chili mellow out. Store in the refrigerator and use up within 1 year.

title: Hijiki Gohan ひじきご飯
description: Hijiki Gohan is a delicious rice dish that has been a part of the Japanese diet for many centuries. It is packed with dietary fibre, iron and calcium.

ingredients.name: a pinch of sesame seeds to top
a pinch of bean sprouts to garnish

steps.title: Step 1

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4

steps.title: Step 13

title: Japanese Crepes (Harajuku Style)
description: These iconic Japanese-style crepes served in a cone can be customized with your favorite fillings. Enjoy Japanese street food in the comfort of your own home with this easy and delicious recipe!

ingredients.name: unbleached cake flour (or all purpose flour)
cooking oil (or melted butter (approx 5g per tsp) for batter)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Preheat a 22cm non-stick pan on medium low. While it heats, sift 70 g unbleached cake flour into a bowl. Add ½ tbsp sugar and 1 pinch salt and mix.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: In a separate bowl, crack 1 egg and add 2 tsp cooking oil (or melted butter) and whisk until combined. Add 160 ml whole milk and ⅛ tsp vanilla essence.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Make a well in the dry ingredients and pour the wet mixture into the center. Whisk until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Once the pan is hot, pour in 1 tsp cooking oil and wipe it around the pan using kitchen paper. Save the kitchen paper to grease the pan between each crepe.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Pour 60ml (¼ US cup) of the batter into the pan and swirl it around until the bottom of the pan is completely covered. Heat until the batter has set and small bubbles start to appear on the surface.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Flip the crepe over and fry on the other side for 30 seconds. Remove the crepe from the pan and transfer to a plate. Wipe the pan with the oiled kitchen paper and repeat until all of the batter is used.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Pour 250 ml heavy cream into a large bowl and add 2 ½ tbsp powdered sugar and 2 drops vanilla essence. Place it over a bowl of ice and whip until firm peaks form.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Pipe (or spread) the cream around one-half of the edge of the crepe. Fill 1/6 with cream and add sliced strawberries or bananas. Drizzle with chocolate sauce if desired.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Fold the crepe in half, then fold it in thirds until it makes a triangle shape. For a smaller cone shape, use less filling, fold it in half and roll it instead of folding.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Enjoy!

title: Hiyayakko (cold tofu salad) Recipe
description: Cold Tofu with soy sauce and refreshing toppings

steps.title: Step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour some soy sauce or Ponzu Sauce on top.

title: Demi Glace Sauce デミグラスソース
description: Shortcut Demi-Glace Sauce recipe using Instant pot. Demi-glace sauce is a base sauce for many Yoshoku dishes in Japanese cooking.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Combine bread flour and plain flour in a small mixing bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Microwave for 4 min on 500-600w taking the bowl out and stir in order to brown evenly. Set it aside.

steps.title: Step 3

title: Homemade Umeboshi (Japanese Pickled Plums)
description: Enjoy the salty and sour characteristics of delicious homemade Japanese pickled plums with my easy-to-follow guide that includes tips and tricks to ensure success! Perfect with rice or used in sauces and dressings!

ingredients.name: sea salt (approx 18% weight of the ume)
white liquor (shochu, sake, vodka or similar - for sterilizing)

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Place 450 g Japanese plums (ume) in a bowl and fill it with water. Gently wash the surface of the plums and remove the stems using a bamboo skewer.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Dry each plum with kitchen paper and place them on a clean surface.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Pour 2 tbsp white liquor into a small bowl, then roll each plum in the liquid and place them in a large sealable freezer bag.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Pour 80 g sea salt into the bag and massage until all the plums are evenly covered.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Push the air out of the bag and seal. Place it in a rectangular container big enough that the plums make one layer without overlapping. Place a plate and weight on top of the bag, it should be double the weight of the plums (450g ume -> 900g weight).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Rest in a cool dry place for 3-7 days and flip once a day to move the salt and juices around the bag. During this time the ume will release umesu (plum vinegar). Once the ume are fully submerged in the vinegar, reduce the weight by half.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Wash 80 g red perilla leaves (akajiso) and cut off the thick stems. Place them in a glass bowl, sprinkle with half of the salt and massage thoroughly. Wear food-safe gloves to protect your hands from staining.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.description: Squeeze the shiso leaves thoroughly to release the foamy astringent water and discard.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.description: Repeat with the other half of the salt and again squeeze out the water. This time, the liquid should be cleaner and more vibrant. Discard and place the washed leaves in a new bowl.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.description: Pour about 125ml of the accumulated plum vinegar from the ume into the bowl of shiso leaves and mix to loosen the leaves.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.description: Pour the contents of the bowl into the bag with the plums and gently massage to spread them evenly.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.description: Push the air out and tightly seal the bag. Cover with a weight equal to the weight of the plums and store in a cool dark place for 1-4 weeks. Flip the bag occasionally for a more even color.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.description: When the weather is forecast to be sunny for 3 consecutive days, arrange the ume on a large tray. Make sure they're not touching or they will stick together. Place in a bright sunny area from morning to mid-afternoon, then return to the vinegar and repeat for 2-3 days.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.description: Pour the leftover plum vinegar into a clean glass jar and add the plums. Rest for 5 days to plump them back up.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.description: You can leave the plums in the vinegar (more juicy and vibrant) or drain the vinegar and use it for other recipes. If the umeboshi is not stored in the vinegar, they will be chewier and lighter in color. (I usually do half in half out.)

steps.title: Step 16
steps.description: Store in a cool dark place for at least 3 months before eating. (The best time to eat is after 6-12 months). Enjoy!
